name: Nuchcy coffee & milk tea
review_1_text: This is my go-to local shop. The prices are great value. Their Thai tea is freshly brewed, not from powder. The Americano is reasonably priced and comes in a convenient sip cup. I'm very impressed; it's more than worth the price.
review_2_text: Very delicious and affordable.

name: Koff’N Hops
review_1_text: This place is primarily frequented by guests from the neighbouring airport house and teens. While it has a nice atmosphere, the drinks seemed expensive for their size, and the Thai tea lacked authenticity. Additionally, there were no snack options available. Introducing a few simple food items to the menu could significantly enhance the overall experience.
review_2_text: One of the best Places to have coffee in Chiang Mai. They also have a varied choice of high quality spirits and beers.
review_3_text:
This is my favorite place for coffee and mocca. I take one almost every day. The place is also so chill and prices are very fair ❤️
If you want food you can also order next to it and eat it there.
review_4_text:
Nice coffee and comfortable place for sitting
The coffee shop at the airport home condo
They support some snacks 😋
And selling some import beer at the mini mark also
Highly recommend 👌 👍 👏 💯💯
review_5_text: Great place for hard to find craft beer!

name: Ma-Yom 294 Cafe
review_1_text: A small cafe in Grandville Village, Mae Hia, Chiang Mai. Very cheap. Recommended menu items include cocoa, fresh milk, Milo, and fresh coffee. The owner is lovely and very friendly. Must come again. 10/10

name: Beauty Art Cafe'
review_1_text: good

name: Daisuki Café
review_1_text: Everything on the menu is delicious, and there are cute photo spots too. It has a bit of a Japanese vibe and is located near Hong Jin Tod restaurant. Parking is convenient. The owner is very lovely and friendly.
review_2_text:
I go there regularly and everything on the menu is delicious. I highly recommend this restaurant!
It's a small restaurant with cute Japanese-style photo corners.
review_3_text: Everything on the menu is delicious and the prices are affordable. The owner is very kind and the shop is cute.
review_4_text: A cute Japanese-style coffee shop with a bus stop. Delicious coffee. The owner is beautiful and very friendly to customers.
review_5_text: The atmosphere is inviting. I really liked the Japanese menu; I can read Japanese too! They also have Japanese books for children to practice reading. I especially liked the matcha and strawberry drinks. Prices start from 19 to 35 baht.

name: น้องกุนน้ำปั่น
Cinema cafe
review_1_text:
I stumbled upon this charming little corner café near the Chiang Mai Traffic Department. The owner is a warm and smiling lady. The café offers not only drinks but also delicious burgers, pizza, and pasta. The atmosphere is delightful with vintage movie posters and board games. There’s a peaceful corner with lush greenery and a small water feature. After enjoying a lovely lunch, I relaxed on the hammock and took a peaceful afternoon nap. A perfect spot to unwind!

Mar 18, 2025
review_2_text: Wonderful place! The owner is incredibly kind and has created a unique café. Chillout music, the sound of a fountain, and lots of greenery make for a relaxing atmosphere. The coffee and Thai tea are absolutely delicious. You can even lay back in a hammock and unwind. It’s conveniently located near the Chiang Mai Provincial Land Transport Office, so I highly recommend stopping by during a break from exams.
review_3_text: Love this place, quite and relaxed 😎
review_4_text: AWSOME
review_5_text:
Visited in December 2025.

The last place I stayed before heading to the airport; it was a lovely place.

It was lunchtime, and many people who seemed to be locals were frequently coming in to buy drinks.

My friends and I each ordered: Iced Thai Milk Tea ($30), Iced Coffee ($35), and Iced Latte ($35). The staff were friendly.

We sat there chatting casually, quietly watching the residents and vehicles passing by in the residential area from our seats on the side; it felt very relaxing and peaceful.

Halfway through our stay, a staff member quietly and proactively brought us a box of tissues from elsewhere and turned on the fan for us; it was very thoughtful.

name: Zoomnokgao mae-hia cafe
review_1_text: A hidden gems cafe' where you shouldn't miss. Good taste coffee from a passionated barista and home-made bakery from his mom, very warmth welcome and feel like home. Jazz music from laser disc always best for spending many hours here 😉.
review_2_text: Great place to stop for a coffee and an awesome choice of music! Great vibes
review_3_text: It is definitely the best coffee shop I have ever been to in Thailand. The owner was very generous and gave us two extra cups of coffee to try. The design of the shop is also very beautiful, and it is worth spending half a day enjoying coffee here
review_4_text: Very chill place. Great coffee and music with nice paintings
review_5_text: Chill spot, great music playing, comfortable sofas

name: McDamia Cafe
review_1_text: Sit back and relax in a lovely atmosphere..cheap price..delicious.

name: Baan Aksara cafe&studio(บ้านอักษรา คาเฟ่และสตูดิโอ)
review_1_text: This coffee shop is a wonderful place to relax. The coffee tastes absolutely delicious, and you can really tell they care about quality. The seating area is cozy, peaceful, and very comfortable. I also loved their waffle — they were fresh and tasty. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a calm and enjoyable spot to unwind!
review_2_text: The atmosphere was great! I love the fish tank upstairs. The house is an old traditional woody house. Their coffee was excellent!
review_3_text: Nice
review_4_text: This is a lovely place. It feels like a hidden gem of Chiang Mai. First of all, the staff are really friendly. The atmosphere is so cozy, like you literally came to someone’s house. Also, the food and the coffee are amazing. I really liked it, so I highly recommend it.
review_5_text: This shop is cute, the atmosphere is lovely, and the owner is very attentive. The only problem is the parking, but the shop is looking for ways to improve it. If you're in Chiang Mai, don't forget to stop by and visit... We're currently running a half-and-half program, guaranteed to be worth it! 😘

name: MAX Coffee Studio
review_1_text:
I am glad that they have chatbox on googlemap. Therefore i can ask for their menu before i came here!

The external look of the coffee shop like industrial style! And internal side, the coffee shop is well decorated, clean and bright enough! It is a place that make you comfortable!

And the food price here is reasonable! I ordered a wanton noodle and waffle set, it costs me 170baht only! And the potion is large, worth for the price！

However, one bad side, somw flies and mosquito inside the shop, and the mosquito keep biting me😳 it would be great if coffee shop can put some stuff which is kill the mosquito or try to make them get away from the shop!

By the way, the stuffs are nice and friendly:)

If you are looking for quiet and special design cafe shop, you should come here❤️
review_2_text: I fall in love with Dirty Latte and Max Coffee fill me by enough coffee and Smooth of milk. New Vintage Hardcore and Loft Style Cafe near Chiangmai Airport. Standard Price, Good Barista, Strange Decor, Nice coffee. Unique Music. This is another cafe' Universe you can visit easy.
review_3_text: Nice coffee and atmosphere. But the pizzas are quite a surprise! Very delicious and authentic, and has variety interesting choices. Will be back.
review_4_text: Chic coffee shop. Industrial lost design space. Moderate taste of coffee. Good display. Many of photo shoot spots. Drip station so chic. Stair seat is interesting.
review_5_text:
Good atmosphere.
Recycled materials.
Parking available.
I like the interior here.
Near my home, I will come back for sure.

name: ซีนีม่า คาเฟ่ สาขา2
review_1_text: I've been here a couple of times. Excellent coffee, the pizza is fantastic and it has a cozy atmosphere. Great prices and I'd say well worth a visit. I'm happy to support this little coffee shop 😁
review_2_text: Awesome coffee, try the coconut iced americano and the Italian sodas… exquisite. I keep going back here because the vibe is so chill and the owner is super kind.
review_3_text: Hahaha the pizza baked in the oven is amazing and the coffee is cheap and not bad. It's nice to have a meal and drink coffee since they open late 😘
review_4_text: The environment is comfortable and natural, the shop is well-organized, and the atmosphere is very chill. I came across this shop by chance, and I could never forget it after eating there once. I immediately came back with my boyfriend. He said that these are the best French fries we have ever eaten. When the boss was making hamburgers, the aroma spread throughout the shop. The pizza is freshly baked in the kiln. The key is that it only costs 100 pizzas when you buy a single pizza. Can the boss really make money? I hope the shop will grow bigger and bigger! ! ! !
review_5_text: Oh my god, the 69 baht carbonara is so cheap and creamy, like eating at an expensive restaurant. The 89 baht steak comes with 2 steaks, salad, and french fries. It's a lot!

name: Munchies Café
review_1_text: What a hidden gem 😍🌿 a quiet nature café nestled in the woods ☕ . With good WiFi, indoor and outdoor seating, and plenty of spaces to relax away from the hustle and bustle of the city with the sounds of nature surrounding you. Best grilled cheese (or "cheese toastie" where I'm from) I've had in a long time! Dripping with grated cheese, butter, and fresh tomato on toasted sesame bread 🥪 Absolutely delicious! And served with crisps on the side! Perfection ✨🤩 I think this cafe deserves more recognition. It's definitely worth a visit so if you're reading this, don't hesitate! 💓
review_2_text: Lovely daytime visit—smoothie was delicious nature and atmosphere were perfect. Mosquitoes were around but they offer repellent. Fair prices, I’ll be back.
review_3_text: A very nice cafe, close to the city but feels like it's in the forest. I like it very much
review_4_text: It's good place for reading, working and relaxing. The setting is pretty cozy with little old doggy. Really like the quiet and peaceful vibes here. Price of food and drinks is more reasonable than any others in CNX
review_5_text: This place was absolutely lovely and so quiet. the food is a bit pricey but the portions are awesome and everything is delicious. I am definitely coming back.

name: ลานทรายกาแฟ
review_1_text: The coffee is fragrant and smooth. You can sit inside or outside the shop. The shop is decorated very cutely and is located in front of the sand yard.

name: Yuk coffee ร้านกาแฟ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
I consider to try this coffee shop. Coffee is really good. It is house blend. You can choose 3 type of coffee roast. Today I choose medium cappuccino; the house blend. The impressive is not only taste, but shop can print any photo on milk foam on the top of cup.
There are many cakes too. I choose coconut tart, there are 3 layers of tart, the top layer is like a coconut foam, middle is cream, and the bottom is biscuits. It is so delicious.

Staff and shop environment are really cool, big sofa like a big boss. You can park your car easily in front of shop.

Price is reasonable.
review_2_text:
Lovely place off the main road a bit in a small plaza.  Comfortable chairs/couches and relaxing jazz music.
They offer light, medium, dark coffee choices and a wide range of pastries and pies.  I had the medium and it was delicious.
Very friendly owners.    Plentiful and Easy parking.
review_3_text: The coffee shop itself it’s a great place where to make a stop, nice sofas. Complete display of different cakes and drinking choices. I wish they had non-dairy milk tho
review_4_text: Very tasty cake, unfortunately there is no plant milk.  I really enjoyed the coffee on my first visit, but unfortunately not today. But the cake was always one of the best I've ever had. The fact that they print your own pictures on the coffee is unique and great! Nice ambience.
review_5_text: Special coffee shop with the best drinks, great tasting ice cream, scrumptious cakes. This is definitely a place you must try

review_4_text: Huge place. Nice and quiet. Good coffee. Beautiful garden with misters.
review_5_text: Quality coffee, plenty of seating both inside and outside, spacious and comfortable. Excellent!

review_2_text: One of the best café in Chiang Mai. Wide range of delicious pastries and great selections of beverages. Definitely have to visit here if you have the chance.
review_3_text: Nice and relaxing interior. Coffee is so so..
review_4_text: Good coffee :)
review_5_text: Thai tea and green tea are very delicious. The cakes are beautiful and delicious. The price is not expensive.

name: Highway 121 Coffee Shop CNX | ไฮเวย์ 121 คอฟฟี่ ช็อป
review_1_text: Good coffee, great service, great staff, great view of the mountains, they even feed the cute dogs. I recommend it.
review_2_text: Very friendly staff. We received free samples of green tea. I ordered ice coffee with yuzu soda. It was amazing. Very fresh with citrus jelly that taste like delicious Boba. Prices are very reasonable, better than anything in town. Highly recommend👍
review_3_text:
Perfect taste of handmade pressed coffee. Good selection of roasts. Friendly owners and baristas.
Remember they are closed Thursdays. But the coffee is worth your time to come.
review_4_text:
Good coffee made to order.
Artisanal roaster
Slow bar.
review_5_text: Cute little coffee shop along canal road. Grab a drink on the go or have a seat in their comfy camping chairs. Also carries oat milk.

name: ภพรักที่นี่ (LOVEtiny)
review_1_text: LOVEtiny is a hidden gem in Mae Hia, Chiang Mai just behind Airport! The service is top-notch and the vibe is super chill – perfect for studying, working, or just hanging out. Love the cozy indoor spot, and the outdoor area is a bonus 🌳. The owner is super friendly and the whole crew makes you feel like you're at home 😊. Highly recommend for a productive day or a chill catch-up with friends!
review_2_text: Such a wonderful coffee shop — great coffee, a warm and welcoming vibe, and a perfectly pet-friendly atmosphere. It feels like a little home away from home.
review_3_text: Nice coffee in the fabulous atmosphere. I like having a cup of hot cappuccino in the garden in front of the building. Singing birds , colorful lotus and the pool behind the building are my favorite things.
review_4_text: Their blueberry cheesecake was delicious. Drinks were good. Prices are good, normal range. The cafe is spacious with big parking lot. You can sit outdoors and enjoy the fish pond.
review_5_text:
A Hidden Gem for Coffee Lovers

This coffee shop has quickly become my favorite spot to relax and recharge. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the peaceful and beautiful environment they offer.

The garden is absolutely lovely — filled with big trees that provide shade and a calming atmosphere. There’s a pond with fish that adds to the charm, and the sound of birds singing makes it feel like a peaceful escape from the city.

The staff here are always friendly and welcoming, which adds to the overall relaxing vibe. There’s also a big car park, so parking is never a problem. If you’re looking for a quiet place to enjoy your coffee and unwind, this is the perfect spot. Highly recommended!

name: The Parlor Coffee&Space
review_1_text: This is a relaxing place a short drive along the road from the white temple to visit for Breakfast , meals or snacks. Excellent coffee served with a cup of tea included! The owner is a nice gentle lady. A place we would visit again to enjoy coffee a d relax!
review_2_text: Best coconut matcha, recommend for coffee, tea and matcha lovers.  Comfortable atmosphere, friendly service.  I have to come back for more 🥰❤️❤️. A lot of parking space, very convenient.
review_3_text: A lovely café with a beautiful design and a calm, peaceful atmosphere. Perfect for relaxing, enjoying a drink, or spending quiet time away from the crowds. 🍹✨
review_4_text: This is a very nice place to enjoy a coffee and croissant
review_5_text: Good cafe

name: delicafe สาขาสนามบิน
review_1_text:
Quick one: if you are looking for good and gourmet coffee, this is NOT the place.

Overall, just 2 stars.  But really, if you had no choice and wanna have a stop on the way to, say, the national park, then I would give a 3 stars overall and 4 stars for atmosphere.

Now, I tried Americano, cappuccino, hot chocolate and a slice of lemon cake.

I am surprised by the high ratings from so many.  Perhaps in comparison to petrol kiosk offerings, this is indeed not bad.  The atmosphere was good in general and especially compared with petrol kiosks offerings

But... I was on the hunt for nice cafe places, with good coffee (gourmet).  This is definitely not the gourmet coffee.  But definitely not the burnt type too served at train station etc. More like Nespresso.  One thing though, they dun make their chocolate sweet.

review_3_text: Good place for preparing your flight, enjoy eating and internet cafe. Manu have been available for everyone such as Dessert or main dish.
review_4_text:

review_3_text: The face looks like they're asking for free food. The service is terrible. I just asked for less sweet and they said sarcastically that it can't be less sweet because it's the shop's recipe. Then they look like they don't want to sell it.
review_4_text: The taste is good, but it might be a little too sweet. If you don't like sweet things, the service is good, the price is reasonable, and parking is easy.
review_5_text: The coffee is strong, as rumored, and the pastries are delicious with generous fillings.

review_2_text: Good quality at a low price.

review_3_text:
The shop has tent chairs, making it a great place to sit and relax.
There's no air conditioning, but it's nice and cool in the shade.
They brew their own coffee, and it's delicious.
review_4_text: I was on my way to Doi Inthanon and feeling sleepy, so I stopped for a coffee. I was so impressed with the coffee that I just had to write a review! The aroma was amazing, and it tasted perfect – not too sweet, just right. I loved it so much I even asked if I could buy some coffee beans to take home! If I'm ever in the area again, I'll definitely be back. Delicious, I had to share!
review_5_text: The coffee is fragrant and delicious! I'll definitely come back again.

review_2_text: Very knowledgeable owner. The best coffee: freshly roasted beans tight here. Owner follows coffee making rules. Best equipment.  Best price.
review_3_text: Best coffee in Chiang Mai. The coffee is really good and the atmosphere is so chilled and comfortable. You definitely need to try it if you are in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: Hands down the best Thai Iced Tea with Milk I’ve ever had! The owner is a true connoisseur whose knowledge is equally matched with his passion for coffee. The atmosphere is tranquil and homey which facilitates conversations that can last for hours on end.

review_1_text: Very delicious, excellent taste. There are many varieties to choose from. The vendor is very friendly.

name: Daisy at The Moon
review_1_text: Friendly staff, beautifully and tastefully decorated interior. Have a coffee here with the soft sound of birds and Thai music. Yeah, I am going to recommend you stop by if you are in the neighborhood. ☕️
review_2_text: Delicious homemade ice-cream with over 30 flavors available to pick. Some rare flavors, can't find else where, with good and unique taste. 😋
review_3_text: Amazing home made ice cream.
review_4_text: It's a lovely little shop that sells ice cream and coffee, and it's also a hostel. The space isn't big, but the atmosphere is great, and there's an outdoor courtyard where you can sit. The coffee and ice cream are both good, and the prices are reasonable. I highly recommend it.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious and has its own unique flavor. Personally, I feel the coffee here tastes different from other places; it's distinctive, and even those who don't usually like coffee can enjoy it. The pastries are delicious, the service is excellent, and the shop is beautiful with many photo opportunities.

name: Connect coffee
review_1_text: Very good coffee with fair price. Staff is very friendly and helpful. I left my phone in the taxi. He allowed me to use his phone to contact the driver. This is one my favorite places to go in Chiangmai.
review_2_text: Offside from the big road with plenty of parking options. Very good coffee served in a big mug + delicious toffee cake +friendly barista 👍
review_3_text: I ordered a thai tea delivery from here and I had requested less ice (because lets be honest, everywhere in thailand an iced drink means a cup full of ice and a tiny bit of drink!!!) They packaged it perfectly. They had the thai tea decoction separate, an small bottle of milk separate and a cup of ice. I could decide how much of everything I wanted!! This is what I call customer service! The tea tasted good too. Thank you so much for taking care of a customer!
review_4_text: Good priced matcha latte and delicious. Normal or big cups available
review_5_text: I visited the shop on a chilled Sunday morning. The coffee shop is super nice and clean.

review_5_text: The chocolate cookies are amazing! The staffs are really friendly and they give out used coffee ground.

name: Caffa Coffeemaker
review_1_text:
this clean, lrage-feeling shop primarily sells coffee machines  (and some coffees) , including high-end ones, some look quite commercial; if you need the best you should look here;
they provide coffee on-site but that is more a favor in order to sell their on-site raw coffees; it is not meant to be a coffee shop or cafe, no food, friendly staff; iffy parking, is located in K-Park, turn left at KFC Mahidol
review_2_text:
Haven''t visited the store but buy their beans from a local barista.

Back in March-April 2025, we were very impressed with the flavor of their chocolate-infused bean. It was great!

Now, however, something has gone wrong with roasting process. The chocolate flavor is gone even though it's still marketed as such.

Without this additive flavor, their beans are average at best.
review_3_text: Not meant to be a coffee shop but they have dam good coffee!  Excellent atmosphere and staff! If you are nearby stop and enjoy. Very high end/quality machines for sale as well ☺️

It is always a bliss to stop by and buy some coffee here.
review_5_text: They sell the best coffee in Chiang Mai, it's not a coffee shop, they sell coffee and coffee machines and accessories.

name: Coffee & Me
review_1_text:
i looked for coffee at this place as i was going to a clinic nearby; 3 days in a row; no sign of life, no table outside, no real sign;

The U.S., Starbucks (and pretty much every other café I've been to in many countries) have to really raise their standards and really start to care more about others than their own profits. Sure, Oatmilk cost a little more - though literally on the cost of a cent or two as to how much is usually being used on average.

review_3_text:
While traveling through East Asia, we kept running into the same problem. The coffee just wasn’t doing it for us. We love coffee, and after tasting it all over the world, our expectations are high. Then, in Northern Thailand, everything changed.

We were driving through Chiang Mai with no real plan when we noticed a small sign that simply said “Solace.” Something about it caught our eye, so we pulled in without thinking too much about it. That turned out to be one of the best stops of our trip.

The second we walked into Solace Café, we felt it. Not just the smell of fresh coffee, but a calm that made you slow down without trying. The space was bright and open, with sunlight coming in and soft music playing. It felt peaceful, welcoming, and honestly like exactly where we needed to be at that moment.

My girlfriend and I have always bonded over coffee. Over the years, we’ve made it a thing to search for great coffee wherever we travel. It started with Ethiopian Yirgacheffe, and after that first cup, we were hooked. Since then, every place we visit, we’re chasing that same feeling.

We’ve walked through coffee farms in Colombia, tasting beans roasted right there on the spot. Brazil surprised us with rich, chocolatey flavors that instantly made sense once you tasted them. Costa Rica gave us clean, bright cups grown high in the mountains. Italy taught us to appreciate a simple espresso done right. Turkey and Vietnam showed us completely different ways coffee can be enjoyed, and we loved that too.

Coffee, for us, isn’t just about caffeine. It’s tied to memories, places, and moments we’ll always remember.

Back at Solace, we took our time looking through the display. Freshly baked cakes, snacks, desserts, and fresh squeezed juices all looked incredible. You could tell nothing was rushed and everything was made with care.

I went with the blueberry cheesecake, and it was unreal. Smooth, creamy, not too heavy, with a buttery crust and just enough blueberry to balance it out. I paired it with a cappuccino, warm, rich, and comforting in the best way.

They also offer three coffee roasts, light, medium, and dark, so you can really choose what fits your mood.

We shared a Thai Harvest Energy Bar made with dried longan, toasted coconut, nuts, seeds, and a touch of honey. We also grabbed fresh squeezed juices and a ginger lemon shot, which was the perfect pick me up before heading back out into the city.

Some of the best travel moments happen when you don’t plan them. You just follow your instincts and see where you end up. Solace was one of those places for us, and it’s a stop we won’t forget.

review_2_text:
10:41The Consul's Garden has a stunning location that immediately catches your eye and sets high expectations. The setting is beautiful and atmospheric, the kind of place where you walk in and think you have found a real gem. The drinks were good and well prepared, and the service was genuinely excellent with attentive and friendly staff that made us feel well taken care of throughout our visit.
Unfortunately the food did not live up to what the rest of the experience promised. Given such an impressive location and the overall quality of service, we expected the kitchen to match that same standard. Instead the food was honestly disappointing and fell well below what you would anticipate from a place like this. It felt like a missed opportunity because everything else was so well done that a strong food offering would have made this an easy five star experience.
That is really the frustrating part about The Consul's Garden. The location is there, the service is there, the drinks are there, but the one thing that should be at the heart of any restaurant just does not deliver. We had high hopes based on the ambiance and left feeling let down by what ended up on our plates.
If they manage to bring the food quality up to the level of everything else they offer, this place would be an absolute standout in Chiang Mai. Until then three stars, because a great location and good service can only carry you so far when the food does not hold up its end.

It was really helpful!
Thanks again Ticha and all the best!

name: 99 Villa & Cafe
review_1_text:
visited the café with a friend and it was such a beautiful experience. The café is a bit far from the city center (around 5 km), but it’s absolutely worth the trip. The place is peaceful, charming, and surrounded by nature. At times, it felt like being in an Alice in Wonderland garden, with rabbits hopping around, ducks, and even pigs nearby.
There were very few people when we visited (day week around 4pm) which made the atmosphere even more special. It’s the perfect spot to disconnect, read, write, or simply relax, with the sound of the river flowing in the background.
The service was incredibly kind and attentive. We shared a two-tier basket of pastries with fruit. The portions are small, more like tasting samples, but the flavors were outstandin, delicate and absolutely delicious.

I forgot to ask for my cappuccino without sugar, and the staff was so kind that they prepared a new one for me without charging for the first cappuccino at all ❤. That gesture really stood out.

Overall, the place is beautiful, calm, and full of charm. I highly recommend visiting for the pastries and for a quiet, relaxing afternoon surrounded by nature.

Service and experience: 10/10.

Nights here are especially magical—cool and quiet, perfect for relaxing or enjoying a movie night with their outdoor projector setup. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with thoughtful touches that make you want to stay longer.

The food? Simply amazing. Every dish feels made with love and fits right into the comforting, homey experience.

Highly recommend if you’re after peace, good vibes, and a place that truly feels like a retreat.

review_5_text:
There is a small library called Aruna within that compound. The monthly membership fee is 250 Baht, which allows you to borrow books for the whole month.

There are nearly three thousand books of various types but mostely Myanmar language. The collection is comprehensive, including both non-fiction (knowledge) and fiction (entertainment), with a considerable number being reprints of rare books. While there are cartoons for children, the number of children's books is quite limited.

You can borrow two books at a time for a maximum of 14 days. You can also borrow and return books on the same day. Seating is available for reading inside. They also provide Burmese music cassette tapes and a cassette player. It gets a little hot during the daytime.

The library is open daily from 10 AM to 7 PM, but the librarian will sometimes close for a couple of hours if they have to go out for business.

It is known that the founder brought their personal collection of books to Chiang Mai for reading and then decided to arrange them so that others could read them too.

At first sip, the matcha, which was only on the surface, offered an outstanding taste rich with umami. After mixing it with the yuzu, it turned into a delightful combination. The sourness of the yuzu was perfectly balanced with the matcha flavor and was not overly sweet. Observing their method, they use a mix of yuzu puree syrup and yuzu jam, which I initially thought would be too sweet, but it actually perfected the matcha, yuzu, and soda blend. I also tried their daifuku dessert, which was nice, although the strawberry was a bit too sour for my taste.

However, I was quite disappointed with the drinks. We ordered a dirty coffee with no sugar, and unfortunately, it was not drinkable. The service was excellent. The staff were friendly, polite, and welcoming. They made the whole experience even better with their warm attitude. 😊

The atmosphere is definitely one of the best parts — calm, scenic, and very photogenic. It’s a great place to unwind, think, work, or just enjoy a quiet moment.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for good drinks, great service, and a relaxing environment in nature. I’ll definitely visit again! 🌿✨

review_5_text: Just a perfect espresso shot!

name: Coffee Key &​ Salimy's pizza halal
review_1_text: It’s a small place unlike any other pizza joints with good aesthetics but do not let it deprive you of a chance of having an affordable delicious pizzas. We struggled to find halal pizza spots and got lucky to find this place. Ordered margarita and smoked chicken pizza. RECOMMEND IT 100 times. Also ordered lychee and mango juice and they were refreshing.
review_2_text:
I dont know why somebody remain bad review about here, it just normal local cafe, and affogato, kiwi juice were better than price tho. 🤷
If want excellent high-end beverage with service, then go to high-end shop with deserve prices 🥱
review_3_text: Poor customer service
review_4_text: The juice and pizza were delicious👌🏼
review_5_text: very delicious

name: Tao Bin at Ducky Wash
review_1_text:
While doing my wash & dry at Ducky I watched the men service the Tao Bin dispenser machine.

They cleaned the outer top, back front and sides.

Inside was just as thorough with the cleaning, servicing & refilling. After it was as clean as a hospital operating room.

If this is how the machines are maintained I would not think twice about using these drink dispensers.

name: J.J Cafe
review_1_text: Popped in for lunch, we were attracted to the lovely entrance garden and detailed orchid mosaics. Ordered basil pork mince rice W/egg on top. 10/10. A/C added bonus points. Very good value.
review_2_text: Air conditioned little haven. Refreshing pineapple juice with good chicken stir fry noodles and seafood rice noodles in egg Gravy ( Thai rad na) .
review_3_text: The food is delicious and the staff are very good.
review_4_text: The price is not expensive. The quality of the food is better than the price.
review_5_text: The food is delicious and inexpensive. The staff provides good service.

name: Splashcraft.th
review_1_text: SUCH A PRODUCTIVE ATMOSPHERE !!!
review_2_text: The cocoa is delicious! It's a new shop under the BK dorms, and the prices are reasonable.

name: kluay pa cafe (กล้วยป่า คาเฟ่)
CHIC RUEDOO ชิคฤดู ฤดูไหนก็ชิคได้
review_1_text: Environment is really chill and cute dogs are here to warmly welcome you at the entrance. Beware of over petting cause they are too demanding 😅 The greatest thing is there’s no influencer or photogenic. If you really looking to work in cafe or quite talk or try delicious things, I recommend this place.
review_2_text: We had the Turkish eggs which were done very well and one of the owners shared later that they make their own Greek yoghurt so that explains the quality taste! Banana cake was very good too. Coffees were also commendable with the Americano and Piccolo we ordered. Ambience was very relaxing and chilled with friendly staff and service
review_3_text:
This is one of the best cafés/restaurant I have visited for a long time that offers a harmonious blend of nature and comfort, featuring delicious food and coffee in a welcoming environment.  It is a place with a cozy and relaxing ambiance created by elements like good lighting, relaxing music, and thoughtful decor. This environment is complemented by excellent service from friendly, knowledgeable staff, and high-quality food and drinks, creating a memorable and enjoyable experience for guests. The atmosphere is still and serene, offering a quiet break from the outside world.

There is sufficient outdoor seating as well as indoor seating.
review_4_text:
Super cozy, well decorated and chill coffee shop, hide it in a nice neighborhood.
The coffee is great and the food is quite tasty.
Co-working area, super clean and the staff is very friendly.
A big plus for the cuty dogs! ;)
review_5_text: Calming atmosphere indoors and beautiful garden area outdoors. Service staff is super friendly and I just fell in love with the cute cuddly dogs 🐶🥰

name: Box coffee ช้างคลาน
review_1_text: Great coffee and great price, cheaper than in town and really good, thank you 🙏
review_2_text: Very good coffee for a low price.
review_3_text: This is a hidden gem. If it were in front of my house, I would drink this delicious and cheap coffee every day.

name: ร้านเพลินกรุง
Ratchaburi Cafe
review_1_text: I stumbled upon a gem by chance, coffee from Brazil!!! Of course, the Chiang Mai specialty was offered to me, I recommend it just for the setting and especially the different coffees, in the middle of a mini market that's so great!!!
review_2_text: Delicious coffee, friendly owner

name: Momaybakery baking club & studio
review_1_text: The cakes are delicious! They also offer baking classes. Come and join us!

name: The Great Escake
review_1_text:
A real French pastry by a real French pâtissier.
I ordered 2 espresso, chouquettes, and financiers. I enjoyed this place.

Everything was delicious! I will come back for sure 😋❤️
review_2_text: A pleasant surprise. A coffee bakery in a village. Quiet perfect for work. Good coffee . Does sandwiches n bakery too.
review_3_text: The best French bakeries in town! Nice coffee and friendly service 👏
review_4_text: Ho...ly...cow! This is likely the best pastry shop in the entire city. The chef here is a trained pastry chef and it shows. Our genuine French friend said this is top tier stuff worthy of a real Parisian’s praise and he wasn’t lying. Chef’s kiss after each bite. The owner is sweet too: we ordered two croissants and they could only give one (these delicious morsels were nearly sold out) so she gave us her best selling sweet for the price of a croissant! This level of decadence isn’t cheap (70-150 Baht or so) but it is 100% worth it.
review_5_text: Delish Bakery. Lemon Meringue is the best I have had in Chiang Mai. The other deserts are good too.  Coffee was good but a bit strong for my taste; even in a latte.  Outside patio sitting had ash trays so smoking must be allowed outside :-(.

name: Lalit Coffee
review_1_text: Wow!!  The fist sip is took, I said out loud (im by myself too, btw) wow, that's good!   Go to 1 to 2 new cafes a day, this one is up there with the top 3 in Chiang Mai. The atmosphere is super cute too. The tables are old sowing machine tables. You can sit by the road or in the little side area. Really lovely place with amazing coffee 10/10 recommend
review_2_text: Super friendly staff and good quality coffee and iced tea.
review_3_text: best place to relax a little bit, friendly and cute
review_4_text: Very good coffee
review_5_text: Very good coffee, lovely vibe.

name: ชาไทยใจดำ
review_1_text:
I had Thai Milk Tea with tapioca here. It was sooooooo good. I will be coming back every chance I get.
It was so refreshing, and the tapioca was so good and very fresh.
She had a ton of different menu items as well.
The coffee latte was so tasty.
review_2_text:
Lovely service, and the owner is very friendly.
The Thai tea with pearls is delicious and just the right amount of sweetness. The shop is right on the side of the road. ❤️❤️
review_3_text:
Thai milk tea from 35B.

Affordable and delicious.
review_4_text: Thai tea with pearls and green tea with pearls are very delicious 👍🏻🌟🌟🌟

name: Brekkie Rolls
review_1_text: The atmosphere is relaxed and not chaotic. It is a small homemade cafe, delicious food, coffee is okay. It is an outdoor seat, but these days in Chiang Mai, the weather is not very hot. There are cute cats. If you are around here, I recommend coming.
review_2_text:
Brekkie Rolls is a lovely little spot.
Both savory and sweet dishes are freshly made, well balanced, and easy to enjoy.
Cozy, relaxed atmosphere — a nice place to sit and chill. Definitely recommended 🤍
review_3_text:
If you’re looking for homemade food, delicious pastries, and good coffee, I’d definitely recommend this place! There are fans provided, and it’s not too hot since the tables are surrounded by trees. The owners are incredibly friendly, helpful, and polite — and most importantly, they speak English 👍.

Don’t forget to bring cash or be ready to pay via QR code. I really enjoyed the cozy, homey vibe of this café, and I’ll definitely visit Brekkie Rolls again when I come back to Chiang Mai in the future. ✨💛
review_4_text: New cafe and coffee. Good vibe and delicious Shio-pan with the fantastic smell of they premium butter. Pair really well with coffee. Lovely patio. Worth to try!
review_5_text: The restaurant and café offer a wide variety of delicious dishes and drinks in a pleasant atmosphere with plenty of seating areas. It’s definitely worth a visit! Most importantly, the owner is beautiful and charming.

name: Miracle coffee
review_1_text: Best coffee with this price...
review_2_text: I'd like to ask, what is the name of the iced tea menu that is mixed with coffee at the shop?
review_3_text: For rich, flavorful freshly brewed coffee, this is the place to go.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious and not expensive.

name: Two Sisters Cafe

review_2_text: Lovely place to have a real coffee!
review_3_text: Cheap good coffee. Table for smokers.
review_4_text: good~~
review_5_text: Good coffee, not expensive ^___^

Pleasant open air coffee shop
Fast service
Coffee tasted great
Cakes and cookies are available
Cold water too
review_2_text: Very basic, many other coffee options nearby
review_3_text: Great coffee, we had cappuccino. Bu the cake wasn’t that good, the location is really good you can watch the street and traffic which is a busy area while you are having your good coffee!
review_4_text: Very Good Taste Coffee and Very Kind Manager. WIFI Available.
review_5_text: Good coffee. Noisy road to have coffee shop though. Minimal selection of cake.

name: ร้านน้ำเต้าหู้ หน้าตลาดหนองหอย
review_1_text: It's well-equipped and has a lot of ingredients.

name: CHO (Bar & Music - Craft Beer Chiangmai)
review_1_text:
Chiangmai good vibe & nice beer🍺 A local beer bar near Mae Ping river, serving a selection of on-tap craft beers and stuff.

You can try before ordering. The shop owner is very nice and friendly 👍🏻

This small shop located near 7-11. Few parking spots alongside the road.
review_2_text: Super chill place and the staff very friendly . you can come and try their craft beer . recommended  . from 🇲🇾
review_3_text: Great staff serving you delicious selection of craft beer while you enjoy the local live music. Go here and enjoy!
review_4_text: I came here to have a beer and ordered a Maisel Weiss. If you like IPA, they have about 4 different tastes. Live guitar solo singer on weekends. Great voice. The beer is good.
review_5_text:
Very friendly local craft beer spot! Both local and imported “COLD” Beers on tap  🍻

Staff are very nice and service is really good 👍

Highly recommend for a chill drink

name: Craft cafe @Nhonghoi Chaingmai คราฟท์คาเฟ่ @ หนองหอยเชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
Delicious coffee! Local climate - great to see how everything isn't so fast.
You can also eat cakes :) they are also testy:)
review_2_text:
Small Professional mobile n repair shop incl sim cards etc
It's a nice a/c shop with a comfortable  cafe corner  (very good cafe and toast snacks). The shop owner makes nice crochet bags and flowers souvenirs ,  English speaking family....
review_3_text: Popped in for a coffee and a smoothie, both 1st rate !
review_4_text: Small shop where they have super tasty fresh bread with all kinds of toppings and we also had a delicious smoothie, very nice people
review_5_text: The green tea is fragrant, delicious, and just the right amount of sweet. 40 baht for a very large glass.

name: Fellowship Cafe & Co-Working
review_1_text: Cafe downstairs, office vibe upstairs. Free coworking space with good internet and lots of outlets. Great coffee, phenomenal carrot cake, and very welcoming friendly people. Will go back for dinner soon. Thank you!
review_2_text: Awesome place! I only discovered it on the last day of my visit in the city, but had I known about it earlier, I would have spent a lot more time here, particularly since it is only an 8 minute walk from my hotel.
review_3_text:
Great cafe and co work space.
Can work upstairs in a quiet room and get delicious drinks and food downstairs.
Best part is the community here. The owners often organize live music and game nights.
Perfect place to meet like- minded people
review_4_text: Large is huge and it tastes so good! You are assured of a warm welcome and a great cup of coffee at the Fellowship Cafe.
review_5_text:
Bunch of really lovely people running a cafe together.

They got indian food like Paratha, and chai as well.

I had a sandwich.

The atmosphere was friendly, everyone greets you, makes you feel comfortable and then the food is delicious as well.

The portion is fulfilling and the pricing is on point.

I can see myself coming back again.

name: Fuel Coffee PT หนองหอย
review_1_text: Very pleasant environment in a rather unlikely location adjacent to a service station. Had an iced cappuccino that was excellent. Great place to have a coffee and take a breather from the heat.
review_2_text:
Great coffee cafe in Nong Hoi area of Chiang Mai.  Inside petrol/gas station. One of the best Latte I have tasted recently in Thailand and just the right temperature. The sandwich was also nice but a little too sweet but that's Thailand.  Atmosphere and staff were very nice. Best of all is the very reasonable prices. 95bt for huge coffee and sandwich.
Top recommendation.
24 July 23. Still great
4 Oct 23. Still great coffee and friendly staff.
review_3_text: The staff is lovely and very smiley. It's a cafe next to a gas station, but the warm reception and great coffee aroma make it a very pleasant place.
review_4_text: Nice place for good coffee, got a latte and an Americano
review_5_text: Great little coffee shop. Nice quiet music and subtle lighting. Wish there were more desert choices. Wonderful place on rainy day.

name: Plearn Jai Cafe
review_1_text:
Came across this little gem by accident et while look for shelter during downpour. What a little treasure !! On main road , undercover seating in and outdoor . VEEY AFFORDABLE pricing.

The coffee was delicious and only 50 THB ! . Food was also very delicious and fresh ! Recommend !
review_2_text: I recently visited this local in Chiang Mai and was blown away by the quality of the food and drinks. The coffee was hands down the best I've had in the city, and the toast with egg and cheese was simply divine. I visited this spot for breakfast several times during my stay and was consistently impressed. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a delicious and satisfying breakfast in Chiang Mai. 100% recommended!
review_3_text: Went here for a drink , air conditioning is not cool and the place looks a little run down but not too bad still acceptable and the drinks is normal but I didn't have a meal here as I am not confident, lol anyway they do have a outdoor table with a smoking area
review_4_text: We stayed round the corner and came here every morning for a coffee and a smile. Beautifully made coffee, by a beautiful family. The older lady crochets bags for sale and we bought one. Very pretty.
review_5_text:
I highly recommend this place. Fresh smoothie ,healthy food, reasonable price and friendly staff.
Perfect place for breakfast.

name: Bellinee's Grab & Go โรงพยาบาลราชเวช เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Good service, Delicious Bakery and Coffee.🥰
review_3_text: The coffee is very delicious. The air conditioning is cool. The staff are polite and tidy. Overall, it's very good. Every Wednesday and Friday, there are promotions. Very good.
review_4_text:
Bellini Coffee is located on the 2nd floor of Rajavej Hospital.
The staff are friendly and provide good recommendations.
If you come on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, it's even more worthwhile because they have a drink promotion.
Drinks can be replaced with oat milk at no additional charge.
You can also earn All Member points.
The shop caters mainly to takeout and has approximately three counter-bar seats.
review_5_text:
I love it! Every time I come here, I get to support them with great promotions.
Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, you can collect points and complete missions.
You can do it all on the 7-Eleven app.

name: Irish Coffee And Gallery

review_2_text: The avocado smoothie is amazing! 👍👍
review_3_text: There are coffees to choose from, including medium-dark and dark roasts. The coffee is delicious and reasonably priced, suitable for everyday drinking. There are smoothies (made from real fruit) starting at 25-35 baht. I had a mango yogurt smoothie, which was also delicious.
review_4_text: It's delicious, you should try it.

review_1_text: Be engraved on memory........
review_2_text: Delicious tea

review_1_text: I ordered thai milk tea (less sweet) and it actually was not that sweet at all. It had this creamy flavor which was great. Loved it! Would go back again for this milk tea.
review_3_text: A cozy and relaxing cafe with a friendly owner, great coffee, excellent service, and a wide variety of menu items. I loved it!
review_4_text: The staff provides good service, the parking lot is spacious and convenient, the coffee tastes good, and there's also a small meeting room available.
review_5_text: The owner provides excellent service and the cake is delicious.

name: BLOCK & PLAY Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Absolutely blown away by this place. If you want a few hours entertainment for the kids do not hesitate it’s amazing! Everything for all ages and it’s sparkling clean and new. Wow it’s amazing, my 5 year old even cried when we left!
review_2_text: This place is actually 2 separate buildings - one houses the paid play area (120thb/hr) and the other houses the cafe. Cafe has free wifi and a small play area that is free entry. Paid play area is clean and very well stocked with lots of variety suitable for toddlers/preschoolers as well, not just Lego for big kids. Cafe's free play area is less well maintained but still fun for the littles. Very quiet on a Monday midday timing.
review_3_text: Playtime with the most amazing Lego-Sets! Great for special-dates with your children. It’s not a toy-shop. You play for a certain time and you pay per hour. Great value!
review_4_text: This place is, to borrow an American idiom, “the greatest thing since sliced bread.” My wife bought 50 hours of play so our kids can play while she does lesson planning and other work. Our kids love being here. They love Legos and spend their money on them any chance they get. The great thing about this place is that the kids can have the satisfaction of building the Lego sets they want without having to buy them. Not to mention, the very helpful staff cleans everything up and/or stores the unfinished project for a later date. There are other toys available for various ages of kids, so toddlers up to teenagers (who like Legos) would enjoy this place. I’ve never ordered food from the cafe, but the cookies and drinks are good.
review_5_text: It's hard to get my boy to leave these many themed rooms of great inquisitive fun, so we end up staying for multiple hours.

name: Mellow Meal Cafe
review_1_text: It is a good place for families with children. There is also a toy room attached to the cafe that can be rented out.

Molen Cafe, but it's a board game cafe. They sell drinks, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and you can park right in front of the shop. It's a black and white building on the main road, convenient for a quick stop.

- Delicious Molen (traditional Thai noodle soup)
- Lots of games
- Great place to hang out and have fun with friends.
