review_1_text: Staffs are very friendly and dentist takes descent time to take care of your teeth. It's not painful that's the most important part... Highly recommended ❤️❤️❤️
review_2_text: Currently my son during a dental brarce treatment.So far, the service is excellent, understand English and see very good progress.I'll update later.
review_3_text: Very clean clinic and facility, friend environment and staff and the dentists are all professionals and well-trained.
review_4_text: Excellent orthodontic treatment.  Good attitude of the doctor and the clinic staff.
review_5_text: This was my wife's and my first time getting our teeth cleaned at this dental clinic. The clinic was very clean, and the doctor and nurses treated us very well. They provided professional service, and we will definitely visit again. They even gave us whitening skincare products as a gift at the end! 💯💯💯

name: Livin Cafe
review_1_text:
Food, service, and atmosphere all left a very good impression on me.
The dishes are nicely presented and full of flavor, and you can really taste the freshness of the ingredients and the care put into both the mains and the drinks.
The staff are friendly and polite; ordering and serving are efficient, and they are proactive in helping with any questions, which makes the whole experience very relaxing.
The interior is simple and bright with comfortable seating and great natural light, plus the greenery outside the windows makes it a nice place to chat with friends, work on a laptop, or just enjoy a quiet coffee alone.
Overall, this is a cafe I would love to visit again and one I’m very happy to recommend to my friends.
review_2_text:
Livin Cafe is a great spot if you're looking for a quiet place to study or work. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, and it’s tucked away just enough to avoid car noise and crowds.

They also have a nice alfresco area that’s perfect for catching up with friends or holding a casual work meeting. Overall, it’s a comfortable, peaceful cafe, ideal for getting things done or enjoying a laid-back conversation.
review_3_text: Great place for a coffee and a meal. A wide choice of excellent dishes and drinks at very good prices. Definitely will come again!
review_4_text: Food was fantastic and the Khao soi bowls were huge I ate so fast I forgot to take a picture with food in it. Wonderful!
review_5_text:
If you’re in the area, you’ve got to check out this new café! It’s the perfect relaxing spot with great coffee, yummy bakery treats, and tasty food. The service is super friendly and welcoming. 🥐☕️😋

Just turn left from the Super Highway, and you’ll find this charming little place.

The café has plenty of space, with options for air-conditioned comfort or a more laid-back semi-outdoor vibe.

The interior is cozy and inviting, making it feel like a home away from home.

name: Kid’s Kingdom
review_1_text:
We just visited and it was a great experience overall. The cleanliness was impressive - I’d give it a solid 4.5 out of 5. The play areas, including the jungle gyms and ball pits, were well maintained and felt safe for kids.

We didn’t eat while we were there, but the food looked very good, and the prices seemed perfectly fair for what was offered. There is plenty of seats for parents directly around the entire facility as well.

Most importantly, Jet had a wonderful time. The atmosphere was lively and positive. Most of the kids were Thai, but a few spoke English, and everyone was incredibly kind and friendly. The staff were also very welcoming, attentive, and warm, which really added to the experience.

Overall, this is a fantastic indoor play space for families in Chiang Mai, and we’d happily come back.
review_2_text: A very nice playroom. My nephews, ages 4 and 6, were delighted. There's a workshop area for kids upstairs, but we didn't use it. There's plenty of seating for adults, all around the room. Each table has a nest, so kids can play while parents work. There's a wide selection of food, and you can order online. Our group ordered four-course meals, but I'll only comment on mine – the pad Thai was delicious but very delicate. The entire facility is clean, including the restrooms, although they are located in a different part of the building.
review_3_text: Really nice place, highly recommend if you're in chang mai with your little ones! After coming from vacation in Australia with such great parks this place hit the spot! Nice ball pit, tons of stuff to climb,  a trampoline, huge area to run free,  food to purchase and great value! Nice to support stuff like this :)
review_4_text:
Brought the kids there to play at 11am on a weekday. The kids had lots of fun with the slides, the tunnels. Food there was ok and decent portion for adults as well. Definitely recommend to parents with kids under 12 yo.

It is only 150baht per child for the whole day and 50 baht for each accompanying adult. So worth it!
review_5_text: Amazing place. Air-conditioning, big, nice selection of foods and drinks, plenty of working spaces. Excellent value for money - 150Bhat per kid during the weekdays. Unlimited time. Always full of kids, so our kid quickly found friends both times we went there.

name: Tara Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Great little Thai coffee shop with fair prices and a cozy atmosphere. The coffee tastes good and feels carefully made, not rushed. A nice place to relax, catch up with friends, or just enjoy a quiet cup of coffee.
review_2_text:
1st of all, What a nice place and nice people working there. Pim and tung ting we're fabulous. Both very friendly and talkative, I think another review complained about the service and workers, but a friendly face usually is returned from another. This is Thailand and the land of Smiles.
We have eaten their several times during our stay and will go back again before the end of or trip. Everything is Clean, food is excellent and the staff is hard working and professional. Coffee choices and bakery was terrific.
See you soon Tara Cafe.
review_3_text: This is a wonderful coffee shop off the beaten path. They feature decent coffee and wonderful desserts, including many great cakes at very reasonable prices, about 50 baht per piece.   The service is quick and it is located right on the edge of a nice pond that you can look from above and enjoy your coffee and cake.
review_4_text: Cute small cafe with a lovely seating area facing a pond. I love the bar area that faces the water (indoor and outdoor feel). Unfortunately the coffee isn't that great given the numerous high quality coffee around here. We got a cappuccino which was very milky. Could have been a one off moment.
review_5_text:
Good location. All
Menu was yummy. Friendly staffs and cheap. Nice atmosphere. You can order Krapow Tad with choice of size. Bread and coffee also good quality and taste. Must try.

name: coffee shop Estuntr
review_1_text: The food was delicious, and the coffee was very fragrant and smooth.

name: MAKUB.COFFEE
review_1_text:
This place is special. I have never had such a "favorite coffee spot" as this. The coffee is made with so much care, there's even a secret milk ratio recipe — which means you get the absolutely perfect hot latte.
Plus we could chat for hours with the cheerful, smart and interesting owners. 💛
review_2_text: It is an adorable little coffee shop with extremely lovely owners. And most importantly, absolutely delicious coffee. I had a medium roast hot cappuccino, which I usually drink with sugar, but this one was naturally sweet and smooth. There is no burnt aftertaste. I will be coming here often ❤️
review_3_text:
For any special techniques or megical reasons... They serve the best Hot Coffee latte.
(cow milk with half shot of dark roasted coffee)
review_4_text:
Coffee  and thai tea is very good
You must come here
What a lovely price ♡♡♡♡
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious and affordable. The owner is lovely and friendly, making you feel right at home 🫶🏻

name: Honey coffee กาแฟเพื่อคนรักสุขภาพ
พิม คาเฟ่&ชิล
Na-baan Cafe' - หน้าบ้านคาเฟ่
Cha B-Chu by เจ๊แขก
review_1_text:
Local coffee cafe but have a great test !!!!

Have medium roasted and dark roasted from local.

The price is adorable ( 1$ per cup, 25 - 30 thb).

The owner can speak English.

Recommended for coffee lovers who wanna try good local coffee.
review_2_text: It is a very simple place but loaded with amazing coffee beans
review_3_text: Stopped at Cha B-Chu on the way to Wat U-Mong ( U-Mong Temple ).
review_4_text: Great little coffee place at the side of the road, owner speaks fair English and is nice and helpful, awesome coffee!
review_5_text: Great coffeplace. Not to mention cheap!

name: สุขภิรมย์ Coffee
review_1_text: Best coffee ever. Delicious and you can order a range of different milks for a low price. I love my coffee lady 😄😍
review_2_text: Good Taste. 👌🏻
review_3_text:
Sukphirom Coffee: My Daily Coffee, the Perfect Start to a Great Morning
For me, Sukphirom Coffee is more than just a coffee shop; it's like the perfect starting point for a great workday! It's become my go-to spot for coffee almost every morning because their coffee provides the perfect energy for work.
What I love about this shop:
Consistent aroma and quality: The coffee here is consistently aromatic, fresh, and has a perfectly balanced taste every day. No matter what I order, I'm never disappointed.
Full of energy: Sipping my favorite coffee in the morning helps me feel refreshed and focused, ready to tackle work all day long.
Affordable price: Although the coffee quality is comparable to famous cafes, the price here is very reasonable, making it affordable to drink every day without worrying about the cost.
In summary: If you're looking for a high-quality coffee shop with delicious coffee at a friendly price, and want coffee to help energize you every day, I highly recommend Sukphirom Coffee!
review_4_text:
Fresh, fragrant coffee.
The vendor is patient and the coffee tastes good.
Recommended: Opposite the Wat Pong Noi gate.
review_5_text: Thai tea is very delicious and the price is good too 👍🏼

name: Art Eat Drink at Pongnoi ชมศิลป์ กิน ดื่ม ณ โป่งน้อย
review_1_text:
Food are great here! Khaosoi soup is delightful and not overpriced 🤩 Additionally you can enjoy the arts while waiting for foods, even though I don’t have the sense of art mind it can still widen my experience.

Please try here if you have a chance!
review_2_text: A quiet, uncrowded place. When we arrived, pleasant music was playing, and the owner invited us to stroll around the exhibition while we waited for our order. The pumpkin soup was delicious, and the curry also had a rich, spicy flavor. Thank you for the atmosphere, and I wish this place continued prosperity.
review_3_text: This is one of my favorite spots in Pong Noi. Have kept it to myself for a while but now it’s time to share 😉 Great menu with a wide variety, all of which they execute perfectly. Prices are ridiculously low for the quality of food and ambiance you get. Secluded garden area to dine in and an art gallery with a steady rotation of exhibits and showcases. Staff is fantastic. Owner is very cool. Every time I am here it’s lovely. Could not recommend more.
review_4_text:
We came from Baan Kang Wat and saw this restaurant on google maps so we decided to come. The place is beautiful and we were the only customers there so we had the place to ourselves which was a very nice experience.

Their food is amazing too! We got green curry with pita and beef khao soi for a good price.

Loved everything about the place. Cute cat and doggy.
review_5_text: What a wonderful, wonderful restaurant! The food is incredibly fresh and natural, prepared to perfection and served beautifully. The spring rolls were easily the best we've ever had, as were the thick, flakey roti, but the pumpkin soup and tonkatsi khao soi are at another level - subtle, complex and revealing more and more flavor with each bite. Any 1000-baht-a-plate Chiang Mai restaurant would be proud to serve food like this, but somehow Pongoi's prices are as low as any local place. Highest recommendation!

name: ร้านกาแฟพี่คาปู
Huan Kaew Coffee
review_1_text: A beautiful place with lots of dolls and figurines. Behind the restaurant, there’s a large garden that feels like stepping into a Hayao Miyazaki fairy tale. The decorations are gorgeous, and the food is also very delicious.
review_2_text: Coffee is nice, quiet atmosphere. The food is good too.
review_3_text: Yummy! I love pad kra prao here so much! Whenever I came to these areas, this’s the must location to visit for having the nicest food with friendly prices.
review_4_text: Family run the business. Food is great and price is great as well. Nice and peaceful garden area to eat. I highly recommend this restaurant.
review_5_text: Chill ambiance and delicious food

name: กาแฟสดสังคม
กาแฟ&พิซซ่า
review_1_text: delicious
review_2_text: Delicious!

name: 23 coffee
review_1_text: Pin this shop! Delicious food and reasonable prices. Coffee menu has a choice of light, medium, and dark roasts. Matcha is also delicious. 👍👍
review_2_text: This is a small coffee shop with delicious food and quality that exceeds its price. I recommend the matcha latte. It's not too sweet and very delicious. 👍🏻
review_3_text: Excellent service! The Thai tea was delicious 👍🏻👍🏻
review_4_text: The iced tea is very fragrant and delicious.

name: Kalnas
review_1_text: Beautiful space with indoor and outdoor seating. The outdoor area is especially nice and has swings and a hammock! I had the coffee with salted cream cheese foam (can't remember the name), and it was AMAZING. One of my favourite coffees ever. My wife had the peanut butter vanilla coffee, also very nice. Both were cold drinks but were served in glass, fantastic.
review_2_text: My number #1 coffee shop in CNX. Amazing drinks, best pasta in the city (even though it's not an Italian restaurant) and the atmosphere (!!!). Words cannot describe it. Don't miss it. You can thank me later 😎
review_3_text: I went for a medium roast latte just after they opened in the morning. Really nice cafe in a quiet spot and the latte taste was good.
review_4_text: Very nice place with beautiful garden and chill atmosphere. Cafe is just ordinary tasty, the price not expensive much.
review_5_text: The exterior of the place is very pleasant and cozy, with beautiful architecture, a picturesque landscape, a peaceful atmosphere, a fountain, and a mountain view that create a special vibe. The food options are limited to mostly desserts, with tea and coffee available. So far, I’ve only tried the tea but plan to come back to review the coffee as well.

name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวชักธงดู๋ดี๋
review_1_text:
A little local restaurant, with great food. The restaurant is clean and well kept. They have a great menu with a lot of items. The food has been excellent, a little on the oily side but, still very good.
We had the Pad Kaprow and Kuay Teow. All very good.
We’ve been here a few times.
review_2_text:
The taste is good.
The price and dish portion are reasonable.
They have many tables available.
It's crowded at lunch time.
The waiting time is reasonable.
The table and floor are clean.
They have many kind of noodles, soup, rice dishes and also desserts.
They have normal toilets.
Wheelchair unfriendly place.
If you want free water, you need to take it by yourself.
They have no English menu.
They have no parking space of restaurant but you can sneak to park at hotel nearby the restaurant.
review_3_text:
No attempt at being friendly or welcoming.
Slow service and “sold out” of items (soy milk) on the menu.

On the positive side, inexpensive and acceptable quality / taste.

Not bad, just forgettable.
review_4_text:
Very good Thai food for a good price. Basic looking restaurant, but it's clean and has a good amount of seating. Pad thai here was very good for only 40 or 50 baht.

I've eaten here several times and haven't been disappointed since.
review_5_text: The best👍

name: More Craft
review_1_text:
This coffee shop serves really good quality coffee! The owner is super friendly and genuinely passionate about the craft, and it shows in every cup.

They also offer non-caffeine drinks, including matcha sourced from Chiang Rai.
review_2_text:
This is not just another coffee shop.

It's a wholesome place which reflects the owner's joy of serving people. He is a happy man happy to serve you.
I watch him make each drink with the same level of focus, never multitasking or doing too fast- measuring each time so it's the perfect balance.

The coffee is very good! Great Quality beans are used - you can get medium or dark.

The iced matcha is so smooth and dreamy. Not bitter, not grainy. You can choose Japanese matcha for the better experience!

If you want it a certain way feel free to ask him, his English is great.

Outside oat milk option available.

Mr Ko is amazing.
I end up spending hours here.
review_3_text: A hidden gem making truly excellent espresso. When you drive by you might just assume this is any other standard coffee shop but it’s more than that. The owner is really passionate about finding delicious local beans and pulls a truly excellent shot of espresso. It’s a great place to try if you want to get a taste of the beans that are grown and roasted around Chiang Mai. The owner speaks English so if you’re serious about coffee just let him know and he’ll tell you what beans he has available and what will suit your taste preferences. They also have a nice selection of Matcha as well, if that’s your cup of tea! Definitely give this place a try!
review_4_text: This place is a great little coffee & matcha spot. The drinks are high quality, especially the matcha, which is smooth and well-balanced. The space is cute and cozy, and the staff are super friendly. Definitely worth a visit if you’re into good coffee and great matcha.
review_5_text:
Casually stopped for a coffe while riding arround. I had a great welcoming from Koe! He is very friendly and have good knowledge about cycling. Oh and iced caramel latte was delicious!

Definitely worth to stop & have a chat! 100% recommended!

name: Oxygen Coffee Studio - Wildside
review_1_text:
Since arriving in Chiang Mai last November, I’ve explored dozens of cafes, but Oxygen Coffee Studio Wildside is truly in a league of its own.
The outdoor seating area is a sanctuary. It offers a nature-oriented atmosphere that brings a sense of calm and relaxed joy that is hard to find elsewhere. If you are looking for comfort and peace, this is the place to be.
The coffee quality is top-grade. I particularly enjoyed the "Thai brightness" of their standard beans—the flavor profile and texture are unique and sophisticated. It’s clear the baristas here are operating at another level. Whether you are a coffee connoisseur or just looking for a beautiful place to unwind, I cannot recommend this studio enough.
review_2_text: We had amazing lattes here, had to come back for more!
review_3_text: W place definitely coming back the toast is incredible 5 stars
review_4_text: Very good
review_5_text: Everything is great, including the service, snacks, and drinks. The prices are affordable, not too expensive. You can work here, get free Wi-Fi, and enjoy a shady atmosphere. ❤️

name: OON Cafe
review_1_text: An underrated cozy café in a homestay. I’ve been here twice and absolutely love it.

name: Ohayo Gyoza & Cafe
review_1_text: Little gyoza restaurant just outside the city a great hidden gem for a delicious meal. The fried gyoza is crispy and full of flavor, and the pork katsu set was delicious —tender and perfectly fried. 😋 There’s small seating inside and the service was excellent. The food tasted so fresh and authentic. They also are on grab and food panda.
review_2_text: It's great! We came here very spontaneously and we're surprised with how delicious the food was. Very cheap as well
review_3_text:
Quaint little restaurant hidden away.
We ordered the medium size original gyozas, the pork tonkatsu with rice and extra kimchi.
Within 10 mins our order came out and it was absolutely delicious.
If you are a fan of gyoza they have the option to add cheese or spicy(mala).
Would come back again.
Price is really good for the amount of food you get.
review_4_text: The mala spicy and original dumplings are ok. Not crispy, more on the soft side. Mala had lots of spicy flakes so you will only taste the flakes. Bright, calm and cozy atmosphere. Nice staff.
review_5_text: Delicious restaurant and cafe. Excellent gyoza with options for spice or added cheese.

name: Sun to the Moon Cafe
review_1_text:
Honestly one of the best meals that I had in Thailand. Super delicious and healthy!

The café is very cute and is located in a small village. They have a cute white dog and stickers of the cafe and dog 😊

Service is amazing. I think it was the owner who served me, and he was very nice and had really good English. They have pictures of the food so you can visualise what you're ordering.

I still think about this cute café and would 100% visit if I am back in Thailand!
review_2_text:
I really liked this cafe overall 👍 The owners are very friendly and welcoming. I also appreciated that they serve water for their guests in addition to breakfast 👍👍

The only points I would mention are that, in my opinion, the prices are a bit high, and the portions are a bit small for that price. It feels like it’s hard to get full with dishes under 300 baht. The “add-ons” (extra menu items) also seem rather expensive (in my opinion).

I think if the owners slightly adjusted either the portion size or the price, it would make the cafe close to perfect in my view. The coffee, priced at 90 baht, also seems quite small.

Overall, it’s probably one of the best cafes in this area. But if you live in Nimman, there’s no real reason to come this far - you can find something quite similar around your neighborhood 🙏

Overall, I enjoyed my breakfast today and appreciate the friendly owners. Thank you - your cafe is a nice and pleasant place ☺️
review_3_text: This breakfast spot in Chiang Mai is the cutest! Not only is the food delicious, but the atmosphere is so friendly and welcoming. Plus, they're pet-friendly, so you can bring your furry friend along for the fun! 🐶 Highly recommend checking it out! ✨
review_4_text: Not often to meet places where they do cafe food right here. And this is the place !💫 had a salad and they nailed it along with the perfect pesto 🤌🏿 coffee also great 👍🏽 loved the porch situation,  nice vibes.
review_5_text: We love this cafe! You are greeted by the cutest sunbathing westie as soon as you enter. The owner of the cafe is very kind, and talented. The coffees and food (burger, salad and cookies) were 10/10! The atmosphere is also very relaxing. Highly recommend for when you’re in Chiang Mai!

name: WaWee Coffee หน้าเกท สนามบินเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Rude and unprofessional staff. I was simply looking for a place to sit and enjoy a muffin while waiting for the check-in counter to open. First, a staff member asked me to move to another table. While I was in the process of switching, she started yelling at me to leave my bag outside the café. I had no issue placing my bag elsewhere, but the tone and behavior were completely unnecessary. That’s not an acceptable way to speak to a customer.
review_2_text: Good coffee and good price that’s acceptable at the airport
review_3_text: One of the worst experience. Super rude staff, scolding me because I was asking for a tissue. I mean you can tell it nicely but they were really unfriendly. I will not have any  wawee coffee anymore that's for sure.
review_4_text: No overcharge coffee. Close to the gate 7 6 5 . There is a (vert small but peaceful) dedicated place for tables and sit .
review_5_text: Staffs are talking loud behind the cashier with their phone speakers on. Wish they were more professional

name: On Ground
review_1_text: Sweet potato bubble tea had no flavour apart from milk, just a strong purple colour, and the pearls were hard and chewy, not good at all.  Not sure how they got this so wrong.
review_2_text: They have a restaurant on the ground floor, so if you are close to gate 3, you have to take stairs down. They serve a surprisingly good Khao Soi with chicken. Probably the best thing you can get at this airport, if you are taking a domestic flight.
review_3_text: It's like they think you will not be back but as someone who flies monthly from CNX it is disappointing all the coffee is ordinary.
review_4_text: I ordered 1 mocha and 1 hot chocolate. Worst chocolate I have had in my life.  Can’t be that difficult to make it well.. I had to throw it on the bin straight away. The coffee was cold and tasted so so. Save your money.
review_5_text: I ordered a smoothie and got a slushy

name: Doi Chaang Cafe
review_1_text: Drinking coffee here has become my routine whenever I leave Chiang Mai. It’s consistently delicious. The staff service is smooth, and it’s just right in every way.
review_2_text:
Coffee is good and they are open early in the morning, but it is expensive.
Please note this cafe is located after security, you need to be a flying passenger to be able to access the cafe.
review_3_text: This is a nice potion for who waiting flight gate 11-14
review_4_text: One of the best coffees in Chiang Mai , try the ice doi chaang coffee for the drink. It has a robust coffee taste and with a touch of sweetness is perfect. A must-try when you’re in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: I ordered the mixed berry smoothie. I thought it had a great taste. It was not entirely ice. The barista did a good job. I've read through the other reviews, and I'm not sure what people expect. Food at an airport is always overpriced. For me, that's to be expected. Yes, it cost me 120 bhat, but I got what I wanted in an inconvenient place at an inconvenient time.

name: PHUKHAO Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: This is a nice little cafe within the domestic waiting area at Chiang Mai airport.  The food is slightly expensive but not outrageous considering ‘airport prices’, and it is surprising tasty.  I had the Krapow Gai and was satisfied.   The drink selection is good.  They have beer and wine in addition to the obvious coffee and tea options.  They have a small sitting area and it you eat there they serve the food on proper plates with proper silverware, not plastic as some other places offer.
review_2_text:
Very good coffee!
They have oat milk
review_3_text: The coffee itself is very good, which is kinda rare in Thai airports, they have oat milk
review_4_text: Good quality coffee. They sell several quality true roasts as well.
review_5_text: Very good coffee

name: Yes Coffee
review_1_text: Stopped here before boarding the flight. The food tasted decent but slightly over priced. I got the break eggs with bacon and a toast and Americano
review_2_text: Even in such a busy environment, they still maintained great quality and attentive service. I really appreciated the care and effort they put into what they do. It made the experience much better than expected.
review_3_text:
This new coffee shop in the Chiang Mai airport is really great.
They have all of the usual coffee drinks (hot and cold), matcha drinks, etc.
They have baked goods, sandwiches, and even full hot breakfast made to order.
We like that they have almond and soy milk as an option, too.
It’s a great addition to the International terminal.
review_4_text:
This cafe in Chiang Mai International Airport after security  is okay.

They have places to charge your phone. The seats are comfortable.
The prices are way higher 👀
You are in a Airport so what can you do.
Anyway they have pastries and sandwiches and snacks.

Pro Tip: Also the chair in front of the store. Has plugs to plug in our phones.
review_5_text:
The small outlet in the domestic departure hall is conveniently located opposite one of the security screening points. I ordered their scrambled eggs with bacon and for my wife the chicken sausage with fried eggs. Both menus came with coffe and the taste was very good, real eggs and tasty bacon and sausages. The coffe here is excellent as always, and the service is very good by the attentive staff. I will definitely visit this shop whenever I fly domestic as it is a positive experience in the overcrowded airport.
Happy to have need your guest today. 😊 👏 🤗 😻

name: Starbucks Chiang Mai International Airport
review_1_text: The staff were so friendly and went out of their way to get me a seat . the woman serving me my coffee was so friendly and made such polite conversation with me  but didn't catch her name . my matcha and Americano were lovely and my banana cake was really nice . I have never met such friendly Starbucks workers there normally so grumpy
review_2_text:
On ground floor.
Food & service is okay.
review_3_text: Fast service and with available tables and chairs
review_4_text: Standard coffee shop good services and alot of drinks
review_5_text: Staff very rude!!!  Not even waste ur time in this coffee place special the evening staff.  1 little girl very rude.  Never again will go and pls pep don't try go there or buy something good staff looks like don't want to work or be there or even help clients.

name: Café Amazon สาขา 1191
review_1_text: I loved the waiting area, the coffee and matcha was delicious, the staff was super sweet and the A/C was awesome
review_3_text: It has always been my first choice to drink Thai tea and other drinks.
review_4_text: This is a chain of affordable coffee shops located inside Chiang Mai Airport. The coffee is slightly bitter, but the price is reasonable. On a hot day, an iced coffee (a large iced Americano is 80 baht) is very refreshing.
review_5_text: The shop is located in the airport, the air conditioning is cool and there are many customers. The price is about 5 baht higher than the branch outside. The drinks are delicious and up to the standard Cafe Amazon. There are seats, but there is no charging point. The staff are agile and quick, and the service is good.

name: Wawee Coffee CNX Airport
review_1_text: This cafe is located right in the domestic departure lounge at Chiang Mai Airport. I ordered a cappuccino, and it was okay. The service was quick. There are few seats, but it's not a problem since you can take your coffee back to the lounge.
review_2_text: A small coffe outlet with few seats. Its gets crowded when some travellers decide to stay and relax after they finish their coffee and drinks. Located just outside of the arrival hall, so its pretty easy to find. Coffee was really average for the price it charges. Food served was cold. Staffs seem to be impatient when taking our order. Will not revisit.
review_3_text: I've waited for this guy to serve me for 5 minutes without receiving even a hello. No people before me. He just preferred to count receipts, make a phone call and just chill with the phone instead of asking why I was waiting in front of the counter, or at least telling me he had to do something else.
review_4_text: small cafe inside the airport. comfortable and nice. delicious coffee. helpful staff. green concept. encourage customers to use the plaster coffee cup as a flower pot
review_5_text:
Wawee Coffee is a decent coffee shop. It’s not exceptional, and certainly not up to par with many of the more local shops scattered around Chiang Mai, but it’s better than a place like Starbucks, McCafé or Dunkin’, so that’s what matters most, right?

We got a strawberry americano and a strawberry soda. Both were pretty good, but I prefer the orange coffees and lychee coffees other coffee shops offer. Wawee’s tasted a bit bitter to be honest. However, it’s probably the best coffee at CNX Airport, so if you’re here, Wawee Coffee is the place to go!

One positive was the fact that when you buy coffee, you can sit for 30-40 minutes in their lounge area, which is much more comfortable than the regular seating area outside the coffee shop. Honestly, I’d probably get Wawee again when I fly into the Chiang Mai airport!

name: Caffe Ritazza
review_1_text: Way better than the alternatives in the airport.
review_2_text: Another coffee shop that makes a decent coffee.
review_3_text: very delicious

name: Black Canyon ท่าอากาศยานเชียงใหม่ (Domestic Outside)
review_1_text: I initially ordered a vegetarian fried rice, however what was served contained chicken. I informed the waiter that we do not eat chicken and requested a vegetarian replacement. Unfortunately, instead of preparing a fresh dish, the same plate appeared to be returned with the chicken removed. Small pieces of chicken were still present in the meal. This raised concerns about food handling standards and attention to dietary requirements. While mistakes can happen, the response to the issue was disappointing. Other than that, the atmosphere was nice and less busy than downstairs. Food selection was good too and the staff members were friendly enough.
review_2_text: Located just at the entry to the checkpoint for international flights, nice place to sit around till the crowd clears and then clear the customs and security for your flight. Coffee and tea here are decent but nothing special. Decent place to get a drink to kill some time but that’s about it.
review_3_text:
Black Canyon at Chiang Mai Airport (Domestic Outside) is a convenient and comfortable spot to grab a bite before your flight. Located near Gate 3, it’s perfect for a quick stop to enjoy a meal. The menu offers a great variety of food, and everything I tried was delicious. The dishes are flavorful, satisfying, and definitely worth the price – a great value for airport dining.

I felt really happy with my visit here. The food quality is excellent, and the service was friendly and efficient. It’s an ideal place to relax and refuel before your journey, whether you're traveling for business or leisure. If you're at Chiang Mai Airport and looking for a tasty, affordable meal, I highly recommend Black Canyon. It will definitely make your wait more enjoyable and your day more flavorful
review_4_text: Airport coffee.  Blackcanyon coffee means a good consistently tasty cup of coffee.  Service is professional. Typically, quick and easy.  Comfortable seating inside the airport with free WiFi.  There is only 1 dark roast offered.  There is ample supply of snacks and yummy sweet treats. Price is fair
review_5_text: I had a very unpleasant experience buying coffee at the airport. The Thai staff was impatient during ordering and spoke negatively about customers right in front of us. This was very unprofessional and made me feel uncomfortable. I would not recommend buying coffee here.

name: Wake Up
review_1_text:
Best spot at Chiangmai International Airport! Open 24hrs, offering good coffee and many other beverages, various Snow (bingsu) options, light snacks, accompanied by a Subway counter, a delicious pizza place, AND a Thai cuisine counter.

Spacious, so much variety to suit different preferences, and wifi is available for customers too!

Departure, arrival, or just waiting to pick someone up at odd hours is so much better now.

Where else could we have had pizza, subway, and bingsu all at once at 23.00?
review_2_text: Terrible cafe', DON'T waste your money here
review_3_text: Moved to second floor in domestic building.
review_4_text: The reason I gave it a perfect score is because the food prices are the same as at other branches; there's no markup. The taste is also the same as other branches, with no reduction in quantity or quality. Overall, the restaurant is spacious, not crowded, and has Wi-Fi and power outlets like other branches. It was a little hot, I'm not sure why they didn't turn on the air conditioning, but it wasn't a problem; it was comfortable to sit there. There are other shops nearby, but the smells weren't strong, so it wasn't an issue. Overall, I like it because it's cheap! 555 //RYO
review_5_text:
The staff should be replaced. The one who was in charge on July 10, 2018, at 6:00 PM was chatting loudly and even screaming in the lobby. I don't know if the branch owner knows this or not. The male staff member didn't seem welcoming and didn't smile at all. He just wanted to sell, collect money, play games, and play on his phone. #Looks like he's not mature enough to work in service.
#ImprovementsNeededUrgent

name: ร้านกอล์ฟ & น้ำตาล Coffee BikeCNX!
review_1_text: Delicious drinks, a wide variety of menu items, friendly prices. Closed on Sundays 😁😁

name: กาแฟเย็นใจ Yenjai Coffee
review_1_text:
Do not support this shop and the owner, extremely disrespectful while yelling inappropriate things at my wife.

All we asked for the normal amount of bubbles with no tea and we would pay the normal price, his workers did it but when he saw what they did he lost it.

His workers are great and accommodating and service has been good the many times we have been but after this please do not support this business.
review_2_text: Terrible service. The owner is an extremely rude & angry Thai man. He even yelled at me in front of my two kids. I recommend getting coffee ANYWHERE other than this place. Absolutely horrible experience.
review_3_text: Nice little tea & coffee spot. Quick service, unpretentious.
review_4_text: Hot latte was surprisingly good and inexpensive.
review_5_text:
Robinson Chiang Mai Airport has a "Kad Muang" (city market) which houses the Yenjai Coffee shop ☕️. They offer a diverse menu including coconut coffee, hot coffee, iced coffee 🥤, and honey coffee 🍯. The shop is conveniently located and easy to find, with friendly prices and high-quality drinks.
Customers can sit and relax at the shop, but please don't stay too long due to limited space, to ensure a smooth customer turnover.
🍶🧉🧋

name: The Baristro at Central Chiangmai Airport
review_1_text:
Newly Opened & Worth a Visit!
The Baristro at Robinson Chiang Mai just opened and it’s already one of my favorite spots. The interior is modern and cozy, perfect for relaxing or working.

I had their signature iced coffee topped with whipped cream and espresso, beautifully layered and delicious. The menu also features great pastries and drinks.

If you’re nearby, definitely check it out. Stylish space, great coffee, and a chill vibe!

One think what i dont understand, why i can't add cheese creme.

And why isn't the cheese cream available for separate purchase? That's the only reason I come here. Now I have to buy two drinks and add the cream to my cappuccino myself. Please consider this. Offering the cream separately would make things much easier.
review_3_text: I enjoyed their hot chocolate with latte art and their tiramisu was really good too. They’ll give you extra cane syrup if the hot chocolate isn’t sweet enough for you. Just an FYI, I went in a couple of times and the tiramisu was sold out, but they would usually have more after 12pm.
review_4_text: At coffee shop that resembles high quality in the states. Love the presentation, latte art and taste is great! Aesthetic as well!
review_5_text: Nice big coffee shop. Good for meeting a friend, coworking space. Good coffee and still spacious. Even when its full its not over crowded. One downside. The AC is often too cool and to much airflow.

name: Cham Chaa Coffee

The worst Matcha Latte I've ever had.

Avoid this Cafe at Chiang Mai

name: Eternity-Specialty Coffee at Central Chiangmai Airport
review_1_text: We really love this coffee shop and will definitely keep coming back. Their cappuccino with dark roast and mocha with medium roast (with just a bit of sweetness) are spot on, creamy, velvety, and silky. The Basque burnt cheesecake is also amazing and honestly worth coming back for on its own. Such a perfect little spot.
review_2_text: Skip all the others in the mall, because this is the best. I ordered a flat white and it was spectacular. The menu had it listed under specialty coffees not sure why as im a kiwi and for us this is an everyday drink.  This one was anything but every day. Highly recommended.

review_4_text:

review_1_text:

review_2_text: I will miss this franchise when I leave Chiang Mai
review_3_text: The outlet in Nimman is much better or may be it was just the fact that we were having The Volcano for the first time. So glad we stumbled across this
review_4_text: Less people in the morning

name: Café Amazon สาขาเซ็นทรัลแอร์พอร์ต เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Stupidest coffee experience I have had in Thailand in my 2 years here. I ordered a large hot cappuccino which took forever to make. When I finally get my order, I get a large cup which is only half full of cappuccino coffee. Then when I ask them to fill the cup, they add in some ice. Like really? Then when I tell them that's not what I wanted they act rude and unhelpful. I ask to replace the drink with a black coffee, which they begrudginly agree to do. Then again I get a large cup half full of black coffee. Why even serve in large cups if you can't fill them with coffee? I mean I understand about kreng jai but I'm not Thai so what the... I finally gave up arguing and just drank what they gave me. Maybe there was some issue with my limited Thai language skills, but there's too many other good coffee options in Thailand to deal with this nonsense chain ever again.
review_2_text: Customer service was unsatisfactory 😡😡😡😡😡we ordered 2 coffees and paid with Citi bank credit card, which we should have 10% off from purchase.  There were 3 staff for us, none of them aware or care about the promotion, and didn’t even bother to find out what we were asking for!!!  We had same purchase in other CAFE AMAZON, there’s only one staff for us and other 3 groups of customers, and she managed our drinks and payment correctly according to promotions of Café Amazon.  As we asked them why we couldn’t get 10% off, three staff went off to their mobile instead of taking care of our queries 🤯 I’m upset not only for 15 baht discount, but their attitude and ignorance!  Minus Star for rating!

The bagel was very good quality too, although a bit pricy for the portion.  The bagel and coffee stands are in the same shop but they take separate payments. review_1_text: I stopped by Ming Mitr Café while exploring Chiang Mai and had an espresso. It wasn’t bad at all—smooth, well balanced, and properly extracted. The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, making it a nice place to take a short break from the heat and the busy streets. Good spot for a casual coffee stop.
review_2_text:
Chilled atmosphere and nice staff.
The drinks are good and this location is easily walkable to the airport.
review_3_text: A great cafe. I like this place for the ambience. We'll designed. Good air-conditioning, friendly staff. Coffee prices are typical, not extraordinary. Ordered an iced Black coffee which is hard to screw up. Can't comment on the other drinks yet. WiFi seems good enough. Not overly crowded but a lively atmosphere in the late afternoon.
review_4_text:
“Perfect for locals/residents and visitors (tourists or those who happen to be in this area).”  Those were my thoughts when I came here for coffee for the first time even though I had lived in Chiangmai for several years.

The Xym Café is modeled after Starbucks and for the most part they get it right, from the airconditioning to the light upbeat instrumental music to the incredibly luxurious comfy seats and spaciousness of the place to the availability of Cold Brew, Nitro, Drip, and other coffee options, to the sale of mugs and desserts.   But with an exception:  all of this available at a fraction of what you’d pay at Starbucks.  Oh, and they have plants with watering mists that keep the plants looking green.

Opens at 7am for you early birds who want to seize the day and get a head start on life.  There are also Chang and Singha beer options, just like any self-respecting Thai establishment. Heineken is represented too.
And local Thai snacks to accompany your coffee / beer or other beverage choices in this garden-like setting.  There’s the floral/plant motif that runs through this whole cafe.

Perfect all-around place to come solo, bring someone special, and just have some private time away from the bustle of the world.  This cafe has parking, and is located next to a 7-11 if you need to pick up a few items before/after your coffee.

Pro Tourist Tip:
The Xym Café is also located directly right across the “Old Chiangmai Cultural Center” (which has nightly food and cultural performances, depending on the season), so it’s great to be at Xym Café in the late afternoon and pop over to the Old Chiangmai Cultural Center in the evening for their activities.  The cultural center grounds is nice for a walk too, and there’s a famous Japanese restaurant within its vicinity, along with also a famous malt whiskey drinking place for aficionados.  There’s also the Ma Nee night market (which has a galore of food stalls) just a mere 2 minute stroll from the cafe.  So, all in all, this Café is perfect for an afternoon relaxing stopover before the evening activities just right across from it.

Kindly give me a thumbs up if you found this review helpful.  It encourages me to keep doing this.  Thanks.

name: Underbridge coffee
review_1_text: I went to this coffee shop recently for afternoon coffee. It is a nice place to have a coffee and relax but the unfriendly staff (a lady) with very poor customer service make you feel like you are getting a coffee for free. The price of cappuccino was above average price in Chiang Mai city. I was happy to leave the place as soon as possible.
review_2_text: Came for an early morning coffee, price of a latte is 70 baht (large size latte BTW) ambience is nice but staff not friendly.
review_3_text: Freshly ground coffee, and delicious pastries heated at the moment. Americano coffee with a bit of milk is so tasty. Overall, cozy little coffee shop.
review_4_text: Cozy vibes, food, coffee and services are perfect. One of the best in Chiangmai

name: Elm House of Coffee
review_1_text:
One of the best coffee places in Chiang Mai. The owner is very nice and welcoming, the vibes are amazing. You can sit inside in a wooden artsy room or outside in a small garden.
Highly recommended! :)
review_2_text: The cutest place I've stumbled upon, the owner is so so nice and made sure I had something sweet next to my coffee, power for my computer. Everything! I would make this a regular place of mine if I lived here. Thank you for a great morning!
review_3_text:
Please, do yourself a favor and get coffee and Thai tea here. Best drinks we had! The owner is so sweet and friendly and the coffee shop is so cozy and cute!!!!

Let husband and I went back twice!

Talk to the barista and you will be presented with a host of creative drinks. review_5_text: Best coffee is Chiang Mai! This spot is sooo cozy and the owner is the absolute sweetest 🥹 It’s nestled in a shopping center and she made it such an oasis. This is definitely a must stop!

I ordered a hot latte 40B, what a steal, and spending a good time sitting under the big tree. Listening to music, coffee making sound, traffic, birds, and people chatting, chill cannot be any less than this.

review_3_text: Very good coffee at 40-60B at an excellent location.   Very comfortable under some big trees with ample seating. Excellent rec from a  barber.

name: Caramellow Cafe
review_1_text:

We also got an almond croissant, and it was delicious. We ordered the truffle soup, and it was slightly disappointing, but my kids still liked it.
review_2_text:
Awesometastic Cafe!
We stopped by at Thai cafe before heading off to the airport.

We got the eggBenedict and the Thai traditional pork basil with rice on top with fried egg.

Chocolate banana smoothies is a must and don’t forget the Matcha charcoal cream-pied pastries.

Windy breezy vibes outside, we sat for many hours enjoying our lovely tjme in Chiangmai.
review_3_text:
Caramellow Cafe in Chiang Mai is a charming gem with a near-perfect rating & consistently ranking among the city's top cafes.
The vibe is cozy and whimsical—lush greenery, pastel decor, and plenty of photogenic spots that make it feel like a relaxing escape, ideal for brunch or remote work (strong WiFi and outlets available).
Menu highlights include fresh, homemade dishes using local ingredients (no MSG or artificial additives): all-day brunch, artisanal pastries, signature drinks, and standout desserts.
Staff are friendly and attentive, prices are fair, and it's conveniently located near the airport.
Highly recommended for a delightful, feel-good experience in Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: I walked 1.5km from airport. Quite a nice cafe.  Cake, drink and brunch are fantastic. Variaty of food to choose from. Outdoor area also nice with a lot of greenery
review_5_text: I walked in due to the thousands of great reviews. The food was highly disappointing. This is a 300 baht risotto that was smaller than the size of my palm. The taste was okay, nothing to write home about. The staffs were nice which was the only reason I didn’t give it a lower score.

I was too hungry and forgot to take a picture of my burger, but it looks just like the other pictures I’ve seen on Google
review_2_text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my breakfast at Oasis Community Café and Co-working Space. They have a fantastic menu with fresh, delicious options – perfect for starting the day right. The atmosphere is welcoming, and it's clear they've created a great space for both food and work.

Highly recommend Oasis if you're looking for a tasty breakfast in a friendly and productive environment. I'll definitely be back!
review_3_text:
☕ Chiang Mai's Newest Hidden Gem 🥐

Located near Rimping Supermarket Nim City Branch, this place is a perfect spot for spending your day working in a prime location and air-conditioned cafe/co-working space.

Besides their wide selection of coffee and non-coffee drinks, The Oasis also offered a range of breakfast, brunch and desserts. I would recommend the Thai-style grilled bun with Nutella topping - so tasty!

Plus, having been told about this new giveaway campaign, I decided to write them a review here to get a free house-blend iced coffee, what a treat!
review_4_text: The food was fresh and tasty, and the service was friendly. A great spot for a satisfying brunch.
review_5_text: Hidden  great place!

name: Bulls' CAFÉ
review_1_text: fav coffee shop in town.  the staff very friendly. always come to get the coffee in weekdays. thanks for making a heart too.
review_2_text: Very friendly staff, great coffee, nice prices, and good promotions. In addition to having the regular types of coffee and tea, they also have a selection of creative and adventurous flavours!
review_3_text: I've ordered via Grab many times. It's really nice. Especially the Coconut flavoured Coffee.
review_4_text: The owner operator is very knowledgeable coffee lover.
review_5_text: Good quality beverages, reasonable prices and kind services.

name: สุข-ขิต คาเฟ่
review_1_text: The coffee is really delicious, no complaints, and the price is not expensive.

name: โจ้ก wish me luck
review_1_text: Excellent quality Vietnamese coffee for 40 baht. The porridge in the same area is very high quality at a good price.
review_2_text: Very nice coffee shop with tasty Vietnamese food.  Vietemese coffee is pretty cool.  This is a different and unique experience for coffee lovers.  We enjoyed our experience at this nice shop.   I recommend this shop
review_3_text: The best Vietnamese coffee you can find in Chiang Mai. And served with attention and grace.
review_4_text: Gem!
review_5_text: This breakfast stall near Ghatmanee offers porridge, fried eggs, Vietnamese bami, and Vietnamese coffee. The Vietnamese coffee is delicious for 40 baht. It's a nice, spacious dining area with free water.

name: JOYLIDAY Coffee - เลือกคั่วได้
review_1_text: Amazing coffee and lovely people - this place was my hidden gem in Chiang Mai! It’s next to the Muay Thai gym where my husband trained and I enjoyed many Thai espressos while I waited - so delicious and they take so much care with every drink. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Good Coffee, Good Price, Nice Place to sit and relax - Iced Americano with Orange Medium Roast
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious and great value for money. The shop isn't quite finished yet, so it might be a bit hot sitting inside.
review_4_text: Good coffee quality, good packaging, reasonable price. Good✨👍

name: ชานมไข่มุก
review_1_text: Love it! Very friendly staff
review_2_text: Delicious coffee very friendly
review_3_text: This small shop offers drinks starting at 19 baht. The vendor is efficient and quick, so you don't have to wait long. The drinks taste pretty good!

name: Day off house
review_1_text: We stayed a few weeks and want to stay again after becoming friends with the host and her family. New coffee shop she just opened is amazing the manger tony is a lifelong friend now as well. Night market is close by. Good restaurants are close and old city is an easy walk. The area of the city had a pretty serious flood last year but the owner and house keeper have kept things together. This is a storage container build so keep in mind it's not fully soundproof and you should be respectful of other people no partys! We wanted to meet people and make friends so this was the perfect place for us.
review_2_text: Favorite place in Chiang Mai. I come to Chiang Mai quite often and always return to the Day off house. It’s located in a cute and quiet area of Chiang Mai run my the sweetest ladies. Rooms are always clean and super comfy.
review_3_text:
Beautiful home in the heart of Chiang Mai, real family feel, a peaceful, warm, friendly place. Really great distance from the city whether walking or driving. The host and her family are so friendly and kind. The concept of staying in a converted shipping container is so cool, it had a lovely atmosphere.
Great price and location, would definitely recommend ✨⭐️
review_4_text:
Spacious, clean and modern en suite with a comfy double bed and balcony. Exactly as shown online
Great location between the old town and airport with tasty restaurants and a 711 in walking distance.

Also lovely owners who gave me sandwiches, fruit and homemade yoghurt which I really appreciated and made me feel right at home during my stay.

Room cleaned every ~3days/ on request , well equipped kitchen area

10/10 would recommend this experience to a friend❤️⭐️
review_5_text: I stayed at Day Off House for a month while taking a Thai massage course, and it was the perfect place to call home. The rooms were spacious, impeccably clean, and thoughtfully designed for comfort, and having a small kitchen was a great bonus for preparing snacks and quick meals. However, the best part of my stay was the incredible hospitality of the family running the guesthouse—they were always around, eager to connect, and truly went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. They took my friend and me to a cozy local coffee shop, helped me find a place to get a haircut, and made every effort to ensure we had an amazing experience. Their warmth and generosity turned my stay into something far more meaningful than just accommodation, and I left feeling like part of their extended family. If you’re looking for a place that offers not just comfort but a genuine sense of belonging, Day Off House is the perfect choice—I can’t wait to return!

name: All Day Coffee Food&Beverage
review_1_text: This place is simply amazing. My partner and I were lucky to find it close to our homestay! We would have come everyday but the owner/chef took a well deserved vacation. It’s a one man show, with a cute lil pup guard dog and a homey atmosphere inside. The food is very affordable (50-80 baht a dish) and usually comes with a yummy broth on the side. We repeatedly got the pad-see-ew, pad-ka-krow, tom kha gai because they were the best dishes of our trip. Seriously don’t miss out on this spot!
review_2_text: Amazing food and great portions! It’s a really small and cozy place, with freshly cooked food and very friendly and nice owner. it’s also very affordable! A must visit if you are in the area!
review_3_text: This place is a gem! The restaurant serves tasty and healthy dishes, very good quality and good prices. The chef is really nice and prepares the food outside. The eating area is a cozy place that feels like home. The adjacent Café is run by a very nice lady and offers tasty drinks that can also be ordered in the restaurant.
review_4_text: So happy we found this hidden gem just a few steps away from our place! Food is amazing and the chef basically runs the place by himself! Come here and support this business, each dish is worth a try!!
review_5_text: It’s definitely more like a restaurant than a cafe. You wanna try their red curry with crispy pork because it’s very good. It’s a small yet good AC space especially for the price.

name: Ongsa
review_1_text: Looks good but it's not 24h open as it says
review_2_text:
Drive by, there's parking at the food court.
I ordered a 25% sweet Thai tea. It tasted good, smooth, and had a nice tea aroma.
The price was reasonable.
The atmosphere was nice, with bright white tones and a nice view outside. I enjoyed reading a book.
Recommended.
review_3_text: The Thai tea is delicious. It's a small shop with a nice atmosphere and is very chill. If you're lucky, you might see a cat in the parking lot behind the shop. 😺 It's very cute and noisy.
review_4_text: Newly opened coffee shop. White shop, clean, beautifully decorated, good coffee, cool air conditioning, normal price.
review_5_text: Delicious coffee, great atmosphere.

name: After Sunrise ศรีปิงเมือง
review_1_text: Absolutely loved this place! The coffee at After Sunrise is smooth and flavorful — you can tell they really care about quality. The staff were incredibly friendly and made the whole experience warm and welcoming. Perfect spot to relax, enjoy a good cup of coffee, and start your day right. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Best coffee shop in town! Friendly staff and atmosphere! Good selection of coffee and tea! I would recommend!
review_3_text: Cozy atmosphere cute cats delicious drinks and food
review_4_text: Loved the drinks and the cozy intimate bar seating. Relaxing music and friendly baristro.
review_5_text: Great coffee shop to stop by when in Chiang Mai! Staff was very kind and coffee quality even better!

name: Yadana cafe (ยาดานา คาเฟ่)
review_1_text: Good coffee, great price! At first glance, you wouldn't even know it's a coffee shop ^_^ I initially thought it was a small hotel lounge or restaurant, but it's actually a surprisingly good coffee shop! I was quite surprised. The location is a bit hidden in a side street, so parking might be difficult. You'll need to make a U-turn to get back out as it's a dead-end street, but you can find parking along the side of the road. The decor is a blend of vintage, luxury, modern, and Western styles – hard to describe, but I personally liked it because it's quite spacious, has limited tables, and is comfortable and cool inside because it's air-conditioned. The coffee tastes good; you might need to ask the staff to make it less sweet or unsweetened. The best part is the price! A dirty coffee is only 60 or 65 baht (I can't quite remember the exact price 😅). The milk is creamy, the coffee is strong and aromatic, and not sour. Give it a try! It's a hidden gem, I can't quite describe the style, haha.
review_2_text: So beautiful.
review_3_text: It looks like the shop is closed.
review_4_text: The coffee tastes good.
review_5_text: I don't know, I've never been there.

name: Chill Kuppy coffee
review_1_text: Very good, very precise. And the products look good. I took a Matcha-orange while waiting for the laundry. Excellent choice

name: โฟกัสคอฟฟี่
review_1_text: Fresh coffee, delicious taste, very fragrant coffee

name: ร้านชาเจ้าพระยา
อารย - Araya de café
VP Coffee at VP City Park
review_1_text:
This is an adorable coffee shop and cafe.

The coffee is delicious! There is also a selection of light meals that are great for breakfast or lunch.

You will be sitting in the middle of a beautiful park filled with trees, exercise paths, and an assortment of structures for exercise or use by  special events.
review_2_text: Very green and best landscaping. Friendly atmosphere and helpful staff. Good food and lovely coffee.
review_3_text: A truly wonderful spot! The staff here are so warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere is just beautiful — surrounded by trees, calm, and peaceful. It’s the perfect place to relax with a good cup of coffee and enjoy nature. Highly recommend!
review_4_text: Wonderful chill place for coffee & food in the City surrounded by trees and flowers. Great for your pets also.
review_5_text: Quality coffee and tea with affordable price

name: Achi@Cha Coffee
review_1_text: Hidden Gem that we stumbled upon! Great vibe, super yummy coffee, we had a cappuccino, an Iced Latte and our child had a treat drink called coco mint! The family that runs the shop is so kind. It’s a great place to chill out!
review_2_text: friendly.  nice coffee.  chill
review_3_text: Stumbled upon this friendly place when I was cycling around, it appeared exactly when I needed something refreshing!
review_4_text:
Delicious drinks
Great prices
Amazing atmosphere under the trees

The coffee is very fragrant and rich, and the green tea is strong. The shop may not be large and there aren't many seats, but the baristas are very attentive.

There's enough parking in front of the shop for one car, but it might be more convenient if you're traveling by motorcycle.

If you're passing by, I highly recommend stopping by and giving it a try.
review_5_text: The lemon tea is not very good, it is a small cup and I finish it quickly. The price is 35 baht. You can also drink coffee here. There are two semi-automatic coffee machines, the price is about 50 baht.

name: ร้านขนมเมืองเพชร
review_1_text:
Nine auspicious Thai desserts according to ancient texts, used in auspicious ceremonies: 🍥 Thong Ek, Thong Yip, Thong Yod, Foy Thong, Khanom Met Khanun, Khanom Ja Mongkut, Khanom Chan, Khanom Thua Fu, and Khanom Saneh Chan.
Other Thai desserts: 🍴 Mo Kaeng, Khanom Na Nuan, Khanom Kleeb Lamduan, Khao Tom Mat, etc.
Find them all at Phetchaburi Dessert Shop 💎 Arranged according to the host's wishes 🍶
The coffee is incredibly delicious ☕️ I just had to recommend it!
When you think of Thai desserts, stop by!
review_2_text: The dessert is so delicious. No matter where I go, it's not as delicious as here.💖😊

name: เนี๊ยะงัยกาแฟโบราณ
ตราบุญ Coffee Station
review_1_text:
Hidden Gem small coffee shop in Chiangmai city
Amazing price compared to the taste and quality of coffee.
Cozy atmosphere.
You can park car or motorcycle on the road nearby.
Be back for sure.
review_2_text: Hidden gem in Chiang mai with delicious coffeee!!! And such cheap prices too! Highly recommend! Vegan milks available too!
review_3_text: My new favorite coffee place in Chiang Mai!!! Super friendly owner and good price with delicious coffee that makes us come back every day😍 Plum Americano is 🔥🔥🔥they also have plant based milk available for vegans 💚
review_4_text: Owner was quite fluent with English and was great to talk all things culture with him. Coffee was good and nice to sit in the sun in an informal environment. And just chat .
review_5_text: Excellent Mocha coffee. Very friendly and relaxed place. They even gave us homemade Christmas biscuits and mixed berries tea. Popular with locals. Lovely Wat nearby.

name: Kavarna Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee

name: เลิศนิยม Lortniyom
iHoy
review_1_text:
I recently visited the Fruit Tea Booth and had a delightful experience. The booth offers a wide variety of teas, each with unique and refreshing flavors. Whether you're a fan of classic green tea or prefer something more exotic like passion fruit tea, there's something for everyone.

The prices are very reasonable, making it an affordable treat for any time of the day. Plus, the booth is located in an easily accessible area, so it's convenient to stop by whether you're on a quick break or out for a leisurely stroll.

The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, always ready to help you choose the perfect tea or answer any questions you might have. Their warm service adds to the overall pleasant experience.

Overall, the Fruit Tea Booth is a fantastic spot for tea lovers looking for variety, good prices, and excellent service. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: The fruit tea here tastes very good. Drinking is refreshing and suitable for the hot weather in Thailand.
review_3_text: Excellent! Delicious and healthy too.
review_4_text: The perfume is so sweet and delicious.
review_5_text: Strawberry tea, so fragrant!

name: ร้านเชียงใหม่ คาเฟ่
Best Coffee & Co-Working
review_1_text:
Spent the afternoon here taking advantage of their intro offer, 25 Baht for any item on menu.
Chilled vibe, relaxing background music, Great Coffee, they make their iced coffees with fresh coffee not instant like so many places.
WiFi fast and reliable.
A little out of the city but walking distance or the red taxis stop right outside, well worth the stroll.
review_2_text:
Great Coffee, Good smell and Strong flavour.
Promotion until end of April all menu items 25 Baht.
Great value.
review_3_text: Great Fresh Coffee, Fast WiFi, Sitting in the sun 42° working. Perfect.

name: Restaurante
review_1_text: Newly opened shop, glad to see more Halal restaurants.

name: Boom coffee& bakery
review_1_text: Pretty basic place. But did it’s job.
review_2_text:
☕️This coffee shop is owned by Nang Indy 💁🏻Selling humor, emphasizing friendliness, treating customers like friends 🤪
In addition to drinks 🍶🍹🧉🧋, there are also a variety of snacks that are constantly changing, so you won't get bored. Authentic southern snacks, come and find them here 🥜🍿🍫🍭🍬
The shop has been renovated into a cute corner to accommodate those who like to chill 🧘🏻‍♀️.
If you eat southern curry at Hat Yai Chokdee 🍛, you have to order a drink from Je Bum to get the full flavor 💃🏻
review_3_text: The shop is beautifully decorated. The drinks are reasonably priced. I like it.
review_4_text:
The coffee tastes great, and there's a wide selection of snacks. They also sell souvenirs.
I went during a promotion where they had 3 cups for 100 baht, so the quality was excellent for the price.
The owner is very friendly. I liked it.
review_5_text:
The shop owner is super cute.
Now they also offer fortune telling services for customers. 🥰😍🥰

name: Light Beverage and MORE
review_1_text:
Cocoa Latte 70 ฿ (2026)

Has English menu.

A hidden gem!!

Just look at the view, and the greens in the cafe, they are so relaxing and beautiful.

The owner/staff very friendly and smiling. It gives good vibe.

There are many different types of seating and the design is very good as not cramp so it won’t get noisy.

And the Ping river is the main protagonist, peaceful, calm, murky.

And the sun, best supporting actor of all time, shining thru the trees on my seat, on the river, making it glistening from time to time.

And best cameo goes to occasional boat passing by, making ripples, just like witnessing time passing in slow motion and dance right in front of my eyes.

I stare at it for the longest time, while enjoying my coffee, didn’t realize time passing in un relative sense.

I had my AirPod on, with Debussy playing for me, this could be one of the best moment that I need to remember how wonderful to be alive.

I am just another ordinary human, quietly living, but I awed at my blessing, the beauty of my surroundings.

The feeling is wonderful.

And I wish you could feel that too.
review_2_text: An enchanting coffee shop by the Ping River, with lots of shaded seating throughout the garden and deck areas. It's a tranquil place to relax and watch the river flow by. There are swings, a kids rock climbing wall, an aviary and a large car/motorbike parking area. Friendly service and excellent coffee (hot latte 65 baht, Sep 25).
review_3_text: My new favorite coffee shop in Chiang Mai. Situated off the main road on the Ping River. Loads of outside seating to enjoy the sounds of nature and the river.  Coffee delicious and a simple food menu. Friendly staff. Will try a dessert next time!
review_4_text: Nice, relaxing coffee shop overlooking the Ping River. It has lots of outside seating. With a river breeze and oscillating fans, sitting in the shade sipping an iced latte was comfortable and relaxing even with the temperature hovering around 100°F/38°C. ☕😎
review_5_text: Impressive services with Scrumptious desserts and beverages 👍 Except some healthy point that I must speak it out ➡️ people normally know that chilling themselves amid greenery and nice atmosphere like this should not smoke any cigarettes to harm others' respiratory track, but two foreigners keep smoking just like fresh air exists for themselves only, what a bad social etiquette😣

name: 10 Baht Fruit Shake
review_1_text: This spot deserves a spot in the Guinness World Records for offering the most affordable and delicious juice globally! It baffles me how it remains under the radar. Anyone visiting will witness a diligent woman serving a daily crowd of satisfied customers. And at just 10 baht? It's the steal of the century!
review_2_text: lovely smoothie for 10 bath 🩷
review_3_text: 10 baht smoothies, deal of the century
review_4_text: Unbelievable smoothy of mix fruit, a cup is only 10 baht.
review_5_text: For such a ridiculously low price I cant be super critical of a 10 baht fruit shake but the ones for 4 times the price are so much better.  This was very diluted, not a lot of fruit but for 10 baht what can you expect.  I liked the old lady serving the shakes she had real character and it’s people and places like this I discover that makes Chiang Mai so awesome! #BeatTheGrind

name: Wooden Door Cafe
review_1_text: This place is amazing! Don’t get a water get one of the drinks… they are fun. You can’t go wrong with any of the food certainly recommend any of the items with the sourdough bread. I am from California and I will say this western style food café is better than what’s back at home.
review_2_text: This cafe has excellent service and the food is great. We have had lattes, traditional Thai tea, breakfast and a couple of their desserts. All was well prepared and delicious. The honey mango smoothie was a favourite. The staff are friendly and the location has air conditioning indoors with patio tables covered by umbrellas in the back.
review_3_text: Wonderful breakfast, so we ate here twice during our stay! Generous portion sizes, freshly prepared food, and a nice variety of options. Prompt service, excellent coffee. Inside seating is small but quiet, beautiful courtyard in the back for outside seating. Clean toilets available.
review_4_text:
Go here!!!
The Bacon Cheddar Omelet paired with the sourdough toast could not have been any better, simply perfect as well as delicious!!! Your friendliness,  attentiveness,  food quality, as well as cleanliness are beyond appreciated,  thanks for a flawless dining experience!!

Oh, and also the atmosphere is very nice!!

Keep up the great work.
review_5_text:
one of my favourite place in Chiang Mai 😍
food is absolutely delicious. service it great. have a breakfast here at least 2 times a week and every time it’s the best. I try every dish and I like all of them!

name: Roar Cafe
review_1_text: I absolutely love Roar! Great coffee, especially the iced coconut americano. They serve fresh bakery and breakfast (American - English style, eggs, sausage, etc) but also Greek yogurt. Nice staff, quiet, nice space, excellent WiFi, AC, great to work (laptop friendly) and super honest prices. Highly recommend it :)
review_2_text: Was staying nearby at the Astra and this little coffee shop saved the morning. The baristas are sweet, and the flat white was smooth with cute art :) Calm and open air environment .. you won’t freeze of A/C 🙏
review_3_text: Only bought coffees here but it’s amazing, they started to remember our order. It was just downstairs from where we’re staying and went everyday for 2 weeks! And tried other places but not as good coffee!
review_4_text: Highly recommend, delicious food. Free wifi provided too which is a nice bonus. We ordered the scrambled egg sausage and bacon on rice bowl - yum! Definitely hit the spot. Coffee is on point too. Thank you!
review_5_text: Stumbled here by accident & the matcha & caramel machiato were amazing as were the chocolate danish & almond croissant

name: โรตีมุสตาฟา&มุสลิม ช้างคลาน
review_1_text:
Another recommended rotee shop in the city.
Price is reasonable. And the taste is good, edible.
A bit disappointed with a young lady who served the customer, seemed she is the daughter or the owner or something. She didn’t perform that well in her job. NO SMILE at all. Hope she gets better soon 🔜.
review_2_text: Pleasantly surprised with a piece of cheese and crispy roti or prata  for only 20 thb. Black coffee and ginger tea only 15 thb each and comes with a free tea. So sweet.
review_3_text: Good vibe and delicious!
review_4_text: One of the best rotee and coffee shops in town. Went here for a late night munch and was not disappointed. Went for the milk hot tea and banana roti. Definitely recommend.
review_5_text: Tea, coffee, roti, mataba chicken roti, banana roti..... Mainly roti related all foods are available.

name: เครปกาญจน์ by coffee Rey
review_1_text: My son loves eating this very much!

name: Sert Milk
review_1_text: Worth Cocoa in Chiang Mai. In price 20-30 baht.
review_2_text: Milk, tea, bread, French fries, available. Just a small cafe. Taste is ok
review_3_text: It was good service
review_4_text: It's delicious here. The French fries with cheese on top are super delicious. The owner is so friendly that I buy them as a snack every day.
review_5_text: Every menu is delicious 👍❤️

name: Mooncafe by fon
review_1_text:
I stumbled upon this place by pure chance, but I wasn't disappointed! The place is very cute, and the manager is lovely! She even came back to check if I liked my order (Thai tea), and if it was sweet enough for me (I told her I like it sweet)!
Just a stone's throw from the Night Bazaar, it's perfect for a quick tea/coffee/juice break! I highly recommend it :)

(P.S.: Smoking is allowed outside)

name: Mustafa Roti Canai
review_1_text: Another halal food stall in Chiang Mai
review_2_text:
The roti is delicious. The dough is soft. I like it.
The iced tea and iced Ovaltine are OK.

name: เจี่ยปัง ‘แซนวิชย่าง’ ฮาลาล
Kingha Cafe & Pizza
review_1_text: Ordered the Hawaiian pizza! It was one of the best pizzas I’ve had! The dough and sauce was so tasty, with fresh pineapple! The cafe is such a fun atmosphere too and the staff was lovely. Not one bad thing to say about this place! Definitely a must try!
review_2_text: This is a vibe. The food is incredible.. their cold Thai tea is the best Thai tea I've drank. 5/5, I'd come again.
review_3_text:
We ordered Aparty set and got a six-piece small pizza and a four-piece small bread.

Is 6 pieces of L pizza right?

It wasn't enough for two children to eatㅜㅜ
review_4_text: Loved this pizza.  Crust was delicious. High recommend.
review_5_text: An amazing experience with exceptional service – highly recommended!

name: House of Tea 茶
review_1_text: This café is so lovely! The decor is beautiful, and the drinks taste amazing. I’ve been here twice already but just got the chance to leave a review. The matcha is absolutely incredible — highly recommend everyone to try it 🍵🤎🤎
review_2_text:
A lovely little sanctuary for tea lovers.
Such a cozy and calming space. The tea selection is impressive, and everything—from the aroma to the presentation—feels intentional. Perfect for quiet afternoons.
review_3_text:
A hidden gem for authentic Chinese tea lovers!
This newly opened tea shop offers a truly authentic experience. The staff are incredibly attentive and friendly, and every pot of tea is thoughtfully prepared right in front of you, adding to the charm.

For just THB 120, you get a full pot of premium tea that can be refilled up to five times — perfect for a relaxing break or a quiet conversation. Whether you’re thirsty or simply want to unwind with traditional Chinese tea, this is a must-visit spot.
review_4_text: The coconut matcha is a must-try—rich matcha with a gentle coconut note that’s so soothing. Cozy space, calming energy, and lovely service
review_5_text: New Cafe first time coming here.. trying iced green tea love so much.. Will come back again. Recommended!!!

name: อภิทีคอฟฟี่ สาขา 2 หนองหอย
P&P Coffee Fish Cafe จิบกาแฟแลดูปลา
Whancham coffee
review_1_text:
Hi. I have driven and walked past Sunny Hotel/Cafe on many days and today, decided to come here for a coffee before going to Rimping.

It’s really a nice place.  Not really a coffee cafe but the mocha yen was good and I really enjoyed sitting here with the coffee and a book.  And, walking around the hotel area gave me an idea to stay here someday.  It’s a beautiful hotel area and having a coffee with that in the background, made it a nice stay.  Thanks.

The hotel info:

name: เฒ่าแก่กาแฟนมสด
review_1_text: Very nice people serving cold drinks in their cart. They have a English menu and photos for other drinks. 25baht for the medium size 30 for the large ones.
review_2_text: This plc didn't Close! It becomes a shop stand instead of dine in plc. 20 baht for a big bunch of fresh milk coffee omg which u can't buy anywhere else! It seems no business but turns out the stall owner was sooooo busy to making on line orders. AND THE COFFEE R AUTHENTIC THAI TASTES N VERY GOOD!
review_3_text: The taste is good. I'm a regular customer. The shop has good service. They're friendly and talkative.

name: Minimal coffee บ้านเด่น-ราชเวช URBAN MYX Banden - Rajavej
review_1_text: Great new minimal coffee branch near Rajavej! Lovely local Chiang Mai coffee beans which you can choose from for your order (dark, medium, and light roast) with very friendly English-speaking baristas. Cute, compact, and so affordable!
review_2_text: Cute minimalist Cafe... terrific Chiang Mai beans - 3 levels of roasting ... friendly English speaking service ...
review_3_text:
Minimal coffee is right.
'Are these one or two shot?... Two.'
Get small coffee, minimal taste.
'This cannot be two shot...
'You' re right it's one. Pay more and i will give you two.'

review_5_text: Super cute café and very delicious cappuccino 🥰

name: BIKE CAFE' CNX
review_1_text: Cosy little cafe with indoor and outdoor seating where we stopped for an espresso and a cappuccino. The coffee was good but what really impressed us was the honesty of the barista. We accidentally broke the espresso cup and offered an amount to compensate but he told us it was too much and only took a token sum when we insisted. Five stars for serving up coffee with integrity!
review_2_text: Friendly service, great coffee, cute layout seating inside and out l. Pet friendly outside seating!
review_3_text:
Small, cosy coffee place.
Their orange americano is made of fresh orange juice that smells superb.
review_4_text: Very good coffee here. Only 4 stars because the coffee was quite small. I would be happy to pay a little more for a larger size.  But I would definately go back if I was in the area.
review_5_text: Much better coffee than Doi Chang, and just 35 baht for a latte! Great ambience with cute kittens...

review_2_text: Outside the city center. Very quiet place, easy. The food we ordered was good. The prices are correct. A good place for lunch or dinner.
