review_4_text: Came back two days in a row. They have the very best wings! Super cheap prices.
review_5_text: Delicious food and you can't beat the price. As a Canadian to see macaroni and cheese on a menu was very exciting. Came back to this spot multiple times in my stay in Chiang Mai!

review_2_text: I ordered a strong coffee and hot water? The hot water was in a glass, scalding hot and undrinkable. As someone who really likes Amazon, this was extremely disappointing. The service here was the worst I've ever experienced.
review_3_text: It's located right by the road, a small branch. On days when I work early, I'll come to buy coffee here first. But in the early morning, one employee can still handle the few customers. During midday when there are many people, I don't know if the service will be sufficient or not.
review_4_text: Taking very long and getting a wrong order.
review_5_text: Lower standard of services. Order two coffee, one 50% sweet, and the other normal sweet. No stickers put on.

review_1_text: Mellow coffee beans.  Selection of snacks available.  Prices fair.  Everything written in Thai but no problem at all.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious. Latte is 50 baht. If you like it very sweet, I would like it very, very sweet. I ordered it less sweet, but I think it's still sweet. Haha.
review_3_text:
It's become my regular spot every morning.
Sunday is a holiday, so the shop is a bit busy.
The menu is standard and reliable, and the prices are reasonable.
review_4_text: Affordable coffee prices and a cool spot in the city center. They even have an air purifier.
review_5_text: The coffee is fragrant and delicious. I'm so impressed with the taste that I've become a regular customer.

name: SmoothieLife
review_1_text: Delicious! The toppings are fresh and plentiful. It's great value for money. This is one of my regular shops when I go to Big C.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Nice coffee and Amazon is much cheaper than Starbucks. Good place to have a cup of coffee while the other half is doing the grocery shopping. On the upstairs, there is an interesting Amulet Centre with reputable dealers.
review_2_text: Always good to come here.  Good cappuccino, book and people watching.  Thanks for the good service and atmosphere🙏
review_3_text: nice coffee
review_4_text: Recharged again. I understand that Chiang Mai is a cold city, but it's very hot. I feel refreshed and bright immediately. I'm a fan. I had two glasses and I'm full.
review_5_text: The staff who took orders had a sour face, used words that seemed unwilling to serve customers, and used a contemptuous tone. When I told them I could use points to redeem, they acted even more contemptuously. Overall, it was terrible.

review_3_text: Top notch coffee at reasonable price, service is attentive, air conditioning always on full steam ... And good music on background...

review_5_text: Nice quiet shop in pramanada mall, Good if you are doing some work on the computer and the coffe is good.

review_1_text: Everything is constantly being improved and improved. Thank you for your continued support.
review_2_text: The service of the coffee vendors at this branch is extremely bad. The person making the coffee got upset out of nowhere. When I ordered more coffee, he got upset and acted very rudely. I request permission to not use this branch again.
review_3_text: The hot latte is great, the iced espresso is strong and rich, the Thai tea and bubble tea are my favorites. The plum lemonade soda is delicious, and the cheese toast is also tasty. The prices are friendly. These are the places I frequent. There aren't many seats, but it's okay. Be warned, the air conditioning is very cold!
review_4_text: The coffee tasted great, the price was affordable, and the seller was lovely, smiling, and provided excellent service.
review_5_text:
Coffee taste: 3/5
Service: 1/5

name: Coff-Cac : คอฟแคต
review_1_text:
The coffee tastes great and is very aromatic, so much so that I had to go back for more. Plus, it's not too expensive, making it great value for money.

The shop might not be ideal for sitting and enjoying your coffee, but if you love delicious coffee, you have to come!!!

I only recommend the coffee. I also ordered Milo, but it wasn't good. It was very bland and lacked flavor and aroma. I think they should add more Milo powder to make it stronger.
review_2_text: This coffee shop, which includes the owner's home, is run by adorable twin sisters 👶. The owner speaks English and I learned that most Thais prefer dark roast coffee beans, while the younger generation is starting to embrace light roasts. The beans in the shop are carefully selected by the owner and are very delicious!
review_3_text: The coffee is good. It's located on the main road and has parking.

name: Ram Poeng Cafe
review_1_text: This place is a hidden gem in an otherwise touristy spot due to the art village round the corner! If you want a chilled out vibe with great coffee outside of the city, this is your place. We even featured it on our recent YouTube video as my husband had been dreaming about coming back here for a latte ever since last year… he got his wish!!
review_2_text:
The biggest value of this place lies on its retro vibe and the owner, who was lovely. But it being located right on the narrow street side plus having busy footfalls of incoming tourists nearby make the atmosphere not as chill as expected (loud!).

My coffee was more on the milky taste than coffee. The carrot cake was good enough but nothing to write home about.
review_3_text: Lovely cafe a short walk from Baan Kang Wat artist village. Lovely vibe and carrot cake was delicious. Highly recommend coming here for a quiet coffee and cake.
review_4_text: We stayed at an Airbnb in the same property as this cafe and we were so lucky because the cafe was so amazing! The owners were so kind and generous, the space was so gorgeous and natural, and the food was great!! Everyone should try this cafe!
review_5_text:
I really love this café
Nice owner, nice coffee, nice service

name: ENOUGH FOR LIFE
review_1_text: We were quite disappointed with the drinks. Both the vanilla and cocoa lattes were average but at a very high price. The cocoa was literally Meiji milk with store-bought cocoa but it costs B100. The prices are premium, but the quality it not. The space is cute, but there are thousands of cute coffee places in Chiang Mai with better drinks.
review_2_text: Charming place with plenty of homeware for you to shop. There’s also a cafe space for you to chill. Walking distance from baan kang wat so would recommend you to come when you’re visiting the area
review_3_text:
It is a Café and they have very bad tasting (hot)coffee!
Nice place but the coffee can't Rally be enjoyed.
review_4_text: 100% worth the visit. One of the most beautiful shops in Chiang Mai. The cafe seating outdoors and indoors is impeccably stylish. Spacious and calm, the perfect place to relax. The iced latte and mango smoothie were both made with care.
review_5_text:
I will give here a 8/10.
ENOUGH FOR LIFE not only decent cafe shop that is trending online, their beverage and service also nice!
We ordered four beverage, personally really recommend the strawberry cream one.
I usually don’t eat the cream but this cream was so fluffy, really amazing! And the strawberry jam not only the jam also can eat real strawberries in it.
I need to say, they combined very well.🥛🍓
We going out of our way to visit this shop, and it’s worthy!
If you plan to go to Baan Kang Wat, these two places can be together!

name: Landin
review_1_text:
• Architectural Highlight: The cafe features a distinctive, translucent polycarbonate structure that creates a bright, airy interior during the day and glows beautifully at night.
• Signature Drinks: Visitors frequently recommend the Coconut Latte (Latte Kapi), which blends smooth espresso with creamy coconut milk.
• Vibrant Greenery: The property is shaded by massive, ancient trees and lush gardens, providing a natural cooling effect and a peaceful retreat from the urban heat.
• Transitioning Vibe: While it operates as a serene coffee shop during the daylight hours, it transitions into a relaxed garden bar in the evenings, offering a selection of craft beers.
review_2_text: Went for brunch . Prices are good and ordered honey toast. I only ever come here to order this. So good and fresh.  People are friendly and offered me mosquito repellent when I needed it . The building itself abit old but sitting outside is nice with nature
review_3_text: Nature-kissed chill spot in Chiang Mai! This gem blends minimalist vibes with lush greenery, serving up aromatic coffees like creamy coconut lattes and fresh bakery bites that melt in your mouth—all under the shade of towering trees. Indoor-outdoor nooks for lazy afternoons, affordable bliss, and that serene escape feel? Your perfect hideaway for sips and soul-recharge.
review_4_text:

review_5_text: We got here on Sunday. I sat next to windows and did my homework. It’s really cozy but the place has a lot of little bugs. I ordered a cup of latte, the taste is normal. The cafe is on the street and it’s the biggest store in the square. There was a comfortable music and beautiful views here. We are going to here again. name: Lankinsen
review_1_text: Man, I was so bummed about the food. Everything on the menu looked amazing. I got the papaya salad, and honestly, it was really good. The papaya was super finely chopped and had a real kick. BUT! I also had the pad thai with udon, thinking it would be like normal pad thai, but it was just swimming in this sweet sauce. It was actually pretty awful and the sauce just messed everything up. Then I ordered the panang curry , and the serving was tiny... I probably won't be heading back there... pretty average, really. Kimchi was fine.
review_2_text: This was the first restaurant we ate at after landing in Thailand and oh man, it set the bar high!! Everything that was ordered at our table was delicious (we all tried each others and would agree). The setting itself is so amazing as well! We sat outside and were surrounded by so many plants, and could hear the light pattern of rain, and it was serene. I’d absolutely recommend!
review_3_text: I left my brown goodr sunglasses there today, they have a wire attached. I can't find contact info for the restaurant, can you please respond with contact info so I can reach out? I can't go back to the restaurant soon but I'll explain. Anyway, today my family and I ate here. Lovely atmosphere, great service and food, affordable prices. Would definitely come back!
review_4_text: I really enjoyed food in this restaurant which was more tasty than I expected, also nicely served and some small aperitifs were included in menu. I ordered grilled salmon menu and the fish was grilled accurately that it was tasty, but not dry. I will definitely come again to this restaurant.
review_5_text: Truly excellent food and delightful service! Found this place because our Airbnb was right next door, ordered two soups and the pork gyoza for takeaway which was ready super fast… my husband and I couldn’t stop raving about the food while eating it, especially for under 100 THB a person. They also have ample off the street parking for both cars and scooters. What more could you want? 👍

name: Kessi’s Brunch

review_2_text:
Perhaps the fish filling wasn't enough; it was a bit dry and there was a lot of focaccia, but the chicken and pesto version was good. The coffee was okay.

review_1_text: Come here almost everyday. The staff are cute, always smiling, kind, the shop is very clean. There are a lot of photo spots as well. Even taking a photo of the ceiling is beautiful. The croffle is delicious, I like it the most. The caramel croffle is so delicious that light comes out of your mouth. I like to eat matcha at this shop the most. Thai tea 8/10 Caramel croffle 100000/10💖 Chocolate croffle 10/10 Original croffle 10/10 The croffle is very buttery!! Leave it until it's delicious. You can collect points. review_2_text: The atmosphere is nice and shady, with plenty of photo opportunities. Parking is limited. The drinks are delicious!
review_3_text: I came here to check out the phone. The service is good, the device is beautiful, and the service is good. But the shop is beautiful, and the coffee is very delicious. I'd like you to come and try it. The price is very good. I'll come and support you again.
review_4_text: The shop has a shady atmosphere. It's a phone shop with a cafe inside. So cool! 👍🏻
review_5_text: Nice atmosphere, good coffee, and parking available.

name: MeawPan Landin เหมียวปังลานดิน
review_1_text: The cafe has a nice atmosphere, the drinks are okay, the bingsu is delicious, but the bread is absolutely amazing!
review_2_text: Delicious Bingsu (Kakigori) at a lovely price of 59 baht. Add 10 baht for each topping.

name: Por Phu Cat Cafe
review_1_text: Nice place for the cat lovers. The ticket is 150 baht and you get a free drinks. There are several ddifferent kind of cats. They are peaceful and well fed. Cute and friendly(their own cat way). There are toys too to play with them.
review_2_text:
I like visiting cat cafés whenever I travel, so I stopped by this one while exploring Chiang Mai, and I’m really glad I did. The café is small and cozy, with a warm, relaxed atmosphere that makes it easy to sit down, unwind, and take a break from walking around. It feels like a lovely little hidden spot where you can slow down for a while.
Before entering the cat room, guests are asked to wash their hands, which is a thoughtful touch and shows how much they care about cleanliness and the cats’ well-being. All the cats looked very healthy, well cared for, and adorably chubby! Some were playful and curious, while others were happily lounging around like they owned the place, which made the whole experience feel very natural and comforting.
The staff were incredibly friendly but also gave you space to enjoy everything at your own pace. The surrounding area is nice for simply sitting back and relaxing, and what started as an ordinary weekday turned into something quite special. Overall, it’s a simple, low-key café that’s perfect if you enjoy spending some quiet time with cats
I’ll definitely be coming back again.
review_3_text: Had a great time at this cozy cat café! The entrance fee is just 150, and it includes one free drink, which is a nice touch. They have 10+ adorable cats roaming around, all super friendly. It’s a chill spot to relax, especially for cat lovers. Bonus points for free parking, which makes getting there super convenient. Definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: Amazing place for cat lovers. The cats are pretty lazy and don't do much though. They lie around. Most of them don't like to be carried. It costs around 150 bhat per person for entry and you get one free drink. You could play with a few of the baby cats they engage.
review_5_text: A delightful 2 hours 🐾 for 150bht (drink & socks included) there were so many cuddly, adorable cats to hang out with.

name: ร้านกาแฟสด หน้าวัดร่ำเปิง
Lamour Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: Perfect place for a 70th birthday celebration. The owner and his staff were absolutely amazing. The food was spectacular with burst of flavors in every bite.  The atmosphere so very beautiful. Our table set for 30 was elegant. I would highly recommend this place for any occasion
review_2_text:
2026.1.14 (Thurs)

What a lovely find by 2 of my friends when we were visiting Bang Kang Wat artisanal village. You are transported to Europe and forget you are in Chiang Mai. They literally hibernated here while I went gallivanting at BKW.

The range of drinks is extensive and creative. This cafe is a destination in itself. Especially for weddings 💒 think. Many instagrammable  spots.
review_3_text:
⭐ Google Maps Review for Lamour Café & Restaurant (ลามูร์คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่)
📍 Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200

Tucked away in the quiet Suthep area, Lamour Café & Restaurant is a hidden gem where elegant presentation meets heartfelt Thai flavors. 🌸🇹🇭

Every dish feels like a celebration of Thai culinary tradition — crafted with balance, color, and care. The plating alone is stunning, with banana leaves, gold trays, and fresh flowers enhancing every detail.

🍴 Highlights we loved:

ไข่เจียวฟูกรอบ – light, crispy, and fluffy, perfectly golden and paired with sweet chili and tomato sauces.

ไก่กอและ – Southern-style grilled chicken marinated in rich coconut and curry paste, smoky, tender, and full of flavor.

แกงฮังเล – a deeply spiced Northern curry that’s rich and comforting, beautifully paired with fresh vegetables and crispy roti.

ผัดสะตอกะปิหมูสามชั้น – bold, spicy, and fragrant; the combination of stink beans and pork belly is absolutely addictive.

ออเดิร์ฟเมืองเหนือ – a full Northern appetizer platter with nam prik, sausage, pork crackling, and fresh vegetables — a true Chiang Mai classic that brings together the best of the region.

🌿 Ambience:
Refined and tranquil, with a Lanna-style touch that feels luxurious yet homey. Perfect for families, gatherings, or anyone looking to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine in an elegant setting.

💬 Service:
Excellent hospitality — warm, attentive, and knowledgeable. The team takes time to explain dishes and ensure guests have the best experience possible.

⭐ Verdict:
A perfect blend of Northern charm, authentic flavors, and refined presentation. Every dish tells a story of Thai culinary heritage, elevated with grace and heart.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommended!
review_4_text: This place is so beautiful.  The care put into the esthetics and ambience is so apparent.  You really feel like you're in a palace garden. There was lovely live music playing and you're surrounded by lush greenery. Very authentic feeling and great menu. I highly recommend this restaurant.
review_5_text: It is a nice place, with Garden and big Trees. A bit old and used and not very clean. The Staff is different, but friendly. The Food is mostly Thai, well presented and okay, but completely overprized for what you get, no value for money.

name: GRAPH Coffee Baankangwat
review_1_text:
Coffee 'fine dining'!

I was absolutely amazed by the menu in Graph coffee - techniques used (cold brew jelly) and flavor combinations (coffee with tomato and lime) are unique. I've been to various specialty coffee places across Europe, never encountered anything like that.

This is a must try when you're in Baan Kang Wat, perfect place, located in the heart of the village, giving you the outlook on many craft shops.

Super friendly and helpful staff and a quick service. Would love to see more places experiment with coffee like that.

11/10, highly recommended!
review_2_text: Loved the setting of this branch.  The market itself left a very good impression.  I ordered some orange coffee and it was good.  Will come back to this brand next time in thailand.  There was a long line so drinks took a while.  Happy for their good business.
review_3_text:
The most crowded spot in this area, so we had to drop by for a coffee. Unfortunately, only bills above ฿300 are accepted for credit card payment.

Orders are placed at the counter, and you’ll be given a small tin with an alphabet on it. The staff will then bring the drinks to your table.

The Volcano Latte was one of the popular picks. It uses oat milk, and I was pleasantly surprised that there was no usual oat milk aftertaste. The drink was very smooth, slightly sweet, and served mildly chilled.
review_4_text: Went during the cooler season in Chiang Mai so it was not too hot and stuffy. The shop has innovative coffee menu just like a bar. I really like the Graph No.29, slight hint of pineapple and the margarita like salt added a new flavour  combination.
review_5_text: Place is nice and “Trendy” , this come with a ln extra price tag … me living in Chiang mai long enough , prefer not to pay. Coffe was good , not something that I cannot get in Many other local shops with half price tag. It’s kind of place that young crowd are willing to pay extra in order to have a nice capture for social media. Or maybe I’m not their target audience.  You can try and see.

name: The Old Chiang Mai Cafe' Espresso Bar
review_1_text:
The food here is definitely enjoyable, though it leans towards the pricier side, likely due to its location in a tourist area. The café offers a wide variety of food options, and I appreciate the concept that blends seamlessly with the natural surroundings.

One downside was the slightly slow service after ordering at the counter, probably due to the crowd. However, the fresh fruit juice stood out as a highlight, far from the typical packaged alternatives.

Overall, this place is worth a visit for anyone looking to enjoy a meal in a charming setting.
review_2_text: Stopped for a cake and coffee while my visit to the amazing handcrafts village. The terrace decoration is quite nice with cute little corners. We choose two cakes: basque cheesecake and coconut pie. Both were delicious.
review_3_text:
I had a very unpleasant experience at this café.
Even though there was no long line, ordering took an unusually long time. I patiently waited, assuming the staff was simply slow or inexperienced. However, when it was finally my turn, I was rudely dismissed.
There was a very small handwritten sign on the counter saying “NO COFFEE,” which was not clearly visible at all. Instead of apologizing or explaining politely, the staff member aggressively pointed at the sign and repeatedly said “no coffee” in an unfriendly and dismissive manner.
No apology. No explanation. No basic courtesy.
I understand that cafés may run out of items, but how you communicate with customers matters. The attitude here was rude, unprofessional, and completely unnecessary. It ruined what should have been a relaxing visit in an art village.
I would not recommend this place unless they seriously improve their customer service.
review_4_text:
Was exploring Baan Kang Wat and came across this cafe. The place is very inviting because of the aroma of their cooking and also it has a lush interior with greeneries all around. It’s the place to unwind and has some photo spots as well. They also use mix match furniture which gives that eclectic vibe.
Tried out the Chocolate Mousse Cake which has layers of different chocolate mousse. Also got their iced chocolate & juice (which i forgot the name but it’s one of their recommended menu).
Overall the cafe is ok and service is good.
review_5_text: A cozy café thoughtfully designed with an assortment of plants and flowers, providing a peaceful escape from the crowds of people in the market. It's a lovely spot to sit down with a friend and enjoy a coffee and slice of cake after walking around Baan Kang Wat. I enjoyed an Iced Hazelnut Coffee and a piece of apple crumble pie.

name: FINE HOMESTAY & Local crafts shop
review_1_text:
The service by the owner left us feeling uninvited, even when purchasing items. Firstly I enter the store and ask if I need to take off shoes and she just points to her shoes, with a blank expression.

There’s no changing room so you need to try items on top of your clothes, which we did respectfully. The whole time we are admiring clothes and giving them a go on top of our clothes- she continues being blunt and uninviting. The only time she speaks is after my friend puts the dress she tried on back on the rack,  she finally talks to us saying “ is that not good for you”. My friend politely responds they are nice but not as much on her body. She doesn’t respond or smile and we are left leaving that they just have a pay and go away attitude.

We end up buying hand made side bags (three of them) despite her acting like our presence was a burden. My friend grabs a pair of pants to try and she bluntly and in a tone says shoes off twice even though my friend hadn’t even began putting them on. Mind you, we are being so friendly with smiles despite these interactions trying to make up for the tense energy. After paying, my friend asks to use her cafe bathroom and she says no.

I don’t know what her problem is but you can communicate if something is wrong, we asked about shoes, tried over our clothes and admired everything without trying to disrupt anything. Although items are cute I could not endorse others to spend their money over other places that actually want to make potential customers feel welcome.
review_2_text:
Feeling safe & satisfied of my staying here. Public area’s clean and free to use.
I love the lychi coffee very much.
And thanks to Pui’s treat!
review_3_text:
I stayed at FINE HOMESTAY & FINE BREW for a month, solo and honestly, it felt more like staying at a relative’s beautifully designed home than a typical guesthouse.

First, the location is perfect. You’re a short stroll to 7-Eleven for midnight snacks, close to Baan Kang Wat for your artsy weekend wandering, and surrounded by solid cafes. A personal favorite was mo.cha Coffee, open seven days a week, always quiet, and ideal for getting serious work done without the background buzz of a hundred digital nomads on calls.

The space itself is spotless and full of character. You can tell Pui, the owner, really put heart and soul into the details, there are little design touches and cute corners everywhere that make it feel like a real home, not just a sterile rental.

What sets this place apart is that it isn’t just a homestay. There’s an on-site cafe brewing genuinely good coffee (not the “just okay” you settle for at many places), and they also sell handcrafted Thai crochet pieces, jewelry, and dresses (mostly for the ladies, but fun to browse).

Pui, the host, is a gem. She’s extremely hospitable, often offering you freshly brewed coffee, sharing fruit, or just sitting down for a good chat about life. You don’t get that kind of warmth in most places, it feels natural, not forced. Though there’s slight language barrier, her English is still conversational, just try to keep simple, slow and slightly louder.

Cleanliness and comfort were top-notch the whole time I was there. The vibe is quiet and relaxing, making it easy to focus if you’re working remotely or just want to unwind without constant noise.

A small heads-up: it’s not a big hotel with full-time staff or luxury facilities and that’s exactly why it works. You come here for the human touch, thoughtful design, and a sense of community (if you want it). If you’re looking for a cozy, home-like base with a great host and strong local flavor, this is it. I left feeling recharged, and a bit spoiled for my next stay anywhere else.
review_4_text:
My first time in Chiang Mai and Fine Homestay & Pui gave me a warm welcome.
- Location is great, somewhat in more local & less tourist area. It is surrounded by nature, many great restaurants in walking distance. If you love the green, the nature, then this is the best location in Chiang Mai (after Fine Homestay, we tried other areas to experience and we realized that Fine Homestay's the best when it comes to being close to the nature). Get up early and take a walk around the neighborhood, it feels so greattt!.
- The room is super cozy and clean. Strong wifi for online working. Just feels like home. Just some noise at night as the house is on the street, but just put on the earplugs (provided by Pui) and you will be fine.
- Pui is a super host. She is caring, attentive, kind and so helpful. She gave us lots of recommendation for good restaurants. She also surprised us with tea and fresh fruits sometimes
review_5_text:
We stayed at FINE Homestay for a month as a couple, and it was an absolutely delightful experience. The house is warm, welcoming, and incredibly comfortable – we slept so well every single night! The host, Pui, is truly one of a kind. She is sweet, caring, and always ready to help with anything you need. From offering great local tips to surprising us with fresh fruit as a welcome gift, she made sure our stay felt special and hassle-free.

If you’re looking for a cozy and relaxing place with a host who genuinely cares about her guests, we can’t recommend FINE Homestay enough. We’d happily stay here again!

name: ขุนเดช TATTOO & CHANIM CAFE
review_1_text: Really relaxing and peaceful cafe with a tattoo studio on the upper floor 🫶🏻 The cafe owner is really sweet and has very good taste in music :)) + cute cats !!
review_2_text: Fantastic tattoo and coffeee shop the coffee was divine the owners equally divine and very friendly great English speaking too ! I particularly liked the hand made unique crafts so much I bought quite a bit 😀 the tattoist art is unique, quirky and definitely worth checking out. I was so tempted to have a tattoo but my partner said no more 😞 very clean shop artistic and very trendy
review_3_text:
Good Coffee
Friendly Owner
Nice Atmosphere
Recommended..
review_4_text: It's a small coffee shop behind a house next to the temple. Their fruit tea is delicious, and there are three cats to play with. The pastries are also incredibly tasty. The owner is super kind. It's a high-quality coffee shop; I was very impressed.
review_5_text: A cafe with delicious drinks and desserts at reasonable prices. There are three cats you can check in with! They also offer various workshops including hand painting and tattoos. It's a warm, homey cafe.

name: Farmstory Baankangwat
review_1_text: Really good iced coffee! Asked for an extra shot because otherwise it doesn’t taste that strong. Not the cheapest coffee was around 80-100 baht. Note that it takes 10 minutes to make the coffee! It’s really worth it
review_2_text: ☕️ Excellent variety of coffee beans to choose from. 😊 aromatic beans, freshly ground, prepared by hand with care.  Loved it so much.
review_3_text:
A coffee shop near the entrance of Baan Kang Wat, much less crowded than Graph Coffee inside!

Ordered an iced white latte and was intrigued by the slow process of using a manual lever espresso machine. The taste however was rather mediocre to me but still loved the quietness of this cafe compared to the crowds inside
review_4_text: We picked this cafe for lunch as it was much quieter and more reasonably priced than others in the area. The thai basil rice and omelette was so tasty we went back for a banh mi and coffee as well. The staff were sweet to us explaining the different coffee and bringing us some cold water for free.  Would highly recommend if you are in the area!
review_5_text: Lovely place. Food served with a smile. The Banh Mi was delicious. The bread was super crunchy! Would definitely come back to try all the coffees!

name: ลุงหมานคราฟต์
review_1_text: The uncle provided excellent service and even gave me a discount. I really liked the flower arrangements he made. I'll definitely go back again.
review_2_text: Beautiful work, good quality, I really like it✨

name: Yeedora Cafe
review_1_text: I am always impressed by craftsmen who prepare with care, passion and attention to detail. And of course more importantly is the result and the coffee here at Toki is exactly it. Enjoyed my drip coffee and the shop is really unique and the perfect place to chillax as you get through your insta stories of Baan Kang Wat.
review_2_text: Nice drip coffee and special experience of craft cola, very similar to coke but more sour
review_3_text: If you like drip coffee like me, you will enjoy this 😺
review_4_text: Well, I enjoy drip coffee, but for my taste, I only feel the acidity rather than the body, and the beans don't quite suit me, but the atmosphere is good. I think I'll drink drip coffee in Korea~~

name: ผลไม้สมูทตี้แถวดัง
review_1_text: My local tea shop and juice bar.
review_2_text: Great food !
review_3_text:
A large cup of Thai milk was only 20 yuan, and they said it wasn't too sweet. It was delicious! A great deal.
The restaurant is also very cheap, but the spicy food is quite spicy. I recommend the pork fried rice; it's fragrant and delicious.
review_4_text: The menu is in Chinese, and locals eat there too; it's very cheap.
review_5_text: I thought it was a noodle place, but I accidentally went in and found a great value restaurant! It was delicious. I almost regretted it if I had just had the noodles!

name: Maepoon Moosatay
review_1_text: Lovely place for photos, smoothie is good

name: graincafe.cnx
review_1_text: Special blend what they have it’s amazing! 😻 Since the barista start to make coffee smell incredible, that’s I need every day please!
review_2_text:
They are next to my favorite Gym in CNX : Speed Gym.
They have adapted to that situation by making a special coffee with peanut butter : perfect for a pre-workout.

So most of my afternoons are :
95 baht peanut butter coffee + 100 baht entrance fee for the gym + 10 baht water bottle.
My routine has become so common that I don’t even bother ordering anymore : I just hand the barista a 100 baht and she knows.
review_3_text: This small coffee shop, tucked away in corner building near the gym, offers a quiet atmosphere perfect for relaxation a bit, less people. The coffee is well made. You can choose from a variety of roasts to suit your taste preferences, and the cocoa drink is equally delightful.
review_4_text:
Good coffee. Good service. Good atmosphere.

It felt a bit annoying that the vacuum cleaner was started after every grinding to clean the counter. Use a brush and it’s noiseless…
review_5_text: Nice taste of coffee with full selections of light, medium and dark beans at very reasonable price. The place is beautiful, quite, cozy and clean with spacious car park. Highly recommended.

name: Baan Rom Mai Bali
review_1_text:
Nice atmosphere
Food is average
service is average
Price is too expensive
review_2_text: Services slow in the day time. Staff playing phone while working , taking long time to make a food but it’s tasty.
review_3_text: This place really surprised me. Amazing band on Thursdays. Food was fantastic. The staff were helpful although there is very little english spoken. Its private and quiet most days a week and then all of a sudden its packed to the brim with locals and travellers. Check it out. You won't be disappointed.
review_4_text:
The food was poor and expensive. My dinner genuinely smelt like wet dog. By far the worst meal I’ve had in Thailand in 6 weeks. Staff were pleasant but I would seriously avoid coming here. Not sure why the reviews aren’t worse.

I’ve had a stomach ache all night and next morning.
review_5_text: very good thai kitchen, very tasteful, god place for a nice dinner, live music, parking space available....

review_4_text: Charge your own battery, recharge yourself sometimes.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious. Very convenient.

review_4_text:
The great friendships I've gained from this shop are "excellent" 😚

review_5_text: The coffee is delicious and the staff provides good service.

review_1_text:
This cafe chain is everywhere in Thailand, and though it may not have the best drinks, its presence is appreciated when one needs a place to chill and/or cool down.

Like the case when foreigners need to spend hours waiting at immigration across the street 😄

High ceiling, mostly quiet, good ambiance.
review_2_text:
Honestly, it's one of the worst Amazon coffee in Chiang Mai.
Vietnam definitely has this place beat.
So much for my order inside. The latte is simple, and you have to oder 2 if you want a full cup. You can do better at 7-Eleven and cheaper.
The pastry is well. Go to a local cafe and get everything.

This was a choice waiting on immigration to open. This is a last choice.  😒
review_3_text: just another amazon, right ? this one a small cut above the others,homier feel, supply phone chargers and a little more pastry than most, decent parking ( of course it is in the ptt gas station complex at the rear )
review_4_text: The immigration office is close to this eatery. So I always sit there when I go to the immigration office. lovely, quiet, very private, and pleasant to work in. Likewise, full with plants, as suggested by their name.
review_5_text: They need to have oatmilk alternative for hot coffee, not everyone wants to drink a hormon induced cancerogenic-proven secretion of a very likely maltreated animal lol. Other than that, I love this franchise, good vibe and good priced.

review_2_text: The shop is spacious, comfortable, not crowded, and the coffee is delicious.

review_1_text:
Cool little dessert and coffee restaurant, kind of Japanese style. Went here a few times after dinner to indulge in something sweet.
The mochis are very delicious, so is there new matcha cheesecake. The bread and cheese are also classy and very tasty.

The restaurant is very cool, well decorated, and cozy.
review_2_text:
Japanese dessert
We tried various menus and i love their creme brulee toast
The sweetness juz alright and the bun very soft
We also tried their famous soft pancake
Surprisingly the size of the pancake smaller than usual 🤣
review_3_text: The coconut pancakes and iced latte were delicious however we waited a long time before receiving our order - otherwise the place looks nice and feels homely
review_4_text: Variety of menus and all is very tasty. Crème brûlée is a must try menu. We ordered chocolate lava and thought its a chocolate fondant but its a chocolate pancake with chocolate lava but still delicious. Another must try is mochi, we oredered matcha, melon, and peach yoghurt. Staff is attentive and supportive. Place is clean but quite packed with many ppl during 8 pm (after dinner will be packed.)
review_5_text: The staff were very nice and helpful here. They were kind and gave a good service. The Thai tea got the tea power in the cup but made the drink not smooth like usual. The butter bread was great. No need to buy for three here. They can serve one if you dine in. The room was hot cuz of the position of a/c but understand that outside was hotter.

name: RYO リョウ coffee
review_1_text: This is one of the few shops that serves a really delicious dark roast mocha that suits my taste. The barista is lovely, always smiling, and very friendly.
review_2_text: The caramel latte was not too sweet and had a wonderful caramel aroma. It was delicious! It's a small shop that just opened under an apartment building. The price is affordable. I highly recommend it. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I give it 5 stars. I'll definitely be back :)
review_3_text: The coffee is fragrant and tastes great. The staff are kind, polite, and lovely.

name: DREAM CHAFÉ by KODANGCHA
review_1_text: Found this cute little place while walking by but it’s quite hard to see if you’re not looking for it. The service was great. The owner was super super friendly and all the bubble teas on the menu are roughly ฿20. I got an espresso coffee for ฿40! It was great at a great price!
review_2_text: Very wonderful lady who came and opened the shop just for us! The best bubble tea I had, we got taro milk tea and brown sugar milk tea each only cost 20 baht and the tapioka was free🫶 Definitely coming back tomorrow, thank you:))
review_3_text: Very good

name: หอมกลิ่นชา
Minimal coffee แยกสนามบิน
review_1_text: This is my 2nd visit to a Minimal coffee shop and is now my ‘go to’ place in Chiang Mai for a hot dark roast cappuccino!! .  Nice size of cup, great price, open early, clean, modern, AC, and lovely attentive staff. Well done in a saturated market,
review_2_text: Very good coffee, different roasts available, reasonable prices, enjoy
review_3_text: Pleasant and comfortable place with some unique coffee choices including coffee and coconut water. Prices reasonable and easy to find location. Part of a larger chain.
review_4_text:
The shop is clean, the air conditioning is cool, and the coffee is delicious.
Parking is difficult, so you'll have to find street parking. The coffee is standard for a minimalist shop, and prices start at just 45-50 baht. If you're looking for coffee, stop by and enjoy a cup. You can collect points and get a cup of coffee from this shop. It's great!
review_5_text: The shop is small and cute, with cool air conditioning and plenty of seating. The drinks are delicious. The staff are cheerful, agile, and provide excellent service.

name: Webie Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee, great music, spacious shop, not cramped at all.
review_2_text: Delicious coffee

name: กาแฟสดลองจิม
Honey Berry Slowbar Coffee
review_1_text: Just a small coffee truck on the side of the street. You can choose the roast level and the prices are the same for light, medium, and dark. It’s a good coffee pick up spot.
review_2_text:
My favourite spot in Chiang Mai.
Relax with the drink under the trees.
review_3_text: Great!❤️
review_4_text: It's good, give it a try. You can sit and watch the red cars and pigeons under the big trees; it's nice and cool. The coffee is good and reasonably priced. I didn't get a chance to take a picture before I finished it all! The matcha green tea is also pretty good. Come try it!
review_5_text: Very good street coffee, close to the Saturday night market, next to a wild golf course, the uncle is very cute, the coffee quality is also good, better than my moka and wood wood, very cost-effective, a friend who passed by here recommended it to have a cup

name: Gurkha Chyia
review_1_text: Delicious, healthy food at very inexpensive prices and good-sized portions. A full menu of vegetarian and meat dishes. Especially recommend the Burmese ginger salad. Friendly English speaking owner. Will return for another meal!
review_2_text:
Very nice little restaurant and take away shop. The prices are fair and not expensive and the food is decent and very good. It's good to find a nice place like this for Indian / Myanmar / Nepali food in the city that has reasonable prices. I hope they manage to keep the quality high as the price low for a long time.
I'll go again for sure
review_3_text:
Amazing taste and authentic flavors!
Gurkha Chyia has the best puri bhaji, Gurkha chai, and noodles — all so delicious and freshly made. The food reminds me of real Gurkha home-style cooking. The place is clean, cozy, and has a warm atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic Gurkha food!
review_4_text: Nice Burmese/Nepali/Indian food. The Burmese noodle salad, tea leaf salad and roti are especially good. The masala chai is the best I’ve had so far in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: A truly wonderful place in Chiang Mai for Burmese, Nepali, and Indian food. The food here is absolutely amazing rich flavors.Every dish feels homemade and yummy. Really like the kind, welcoming, and genuinely warm atmosphere. You feel like a guest than a customer. One of those rare spots you keep coming back to, both for the food and the people. 🙏

name: Ziel Koffie
review_1_text: A small coffee shop hidden in a quiet alley, yet not difficult to find. The coffee tastes great, with various bean origins to choose from. The owner is polite and very attentive to every cup—so it’s better not to order too many at once, or you might have to wait a little. There’s also a chubby, sleepy black cat acting as the shop’s little entertainer. ☕🐈‍⬛✨
review_2_text: The coffee was delicious and super affordable. Koffie the cat was an exceptional host, she was upset we moved him from his chair but she still stayed and sat on her box. She is super cute. She even let me give her kisses. The owner is very friendly
review_3_text:
Great little coffeeshop, the owner is very kind and nice. The coffee is excellent, he is a true barista with many of his own creations on the menu as well. We tried about half of the coffees on the menu, all of them great. We stayed in chiang mai almost a month and we were here almost daily.

Its really a joy to see him at work so precisely and with such care. He is also a great conversation partner and he knows English very well. And there will be a nice cat with nice jazz in the background welcoming you as soon as you walk in.
review_4_text:
An absolute hidden gem in Chiang Mai!!! This small café serves the best coffee we had in the city. There’s a huge variety to choose from, and all beans are locally sourced from Thailand.

The owner is super kind and friendly and shares local tips and information, which makes the experience even more special. You can notice the passion he has for coffee!

If you’re looking for truly great coffee away from the usual tourist spots, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: This is one of the best coffee places that I’ve been in Chiang Mai. Don’t skip it. The coffee is so good, the owner is very nice and knows everything about the products that he is selling and the cat is the cutest cat ever.

name: Alchemy Vegan
review_1_text: I had a great experience at Alchemy Vegan. I ordered the Burmese tea leaf salad and the hummus pesto on toast, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a delicious vegetarian meal. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Was searching for a good veg restaurant at chaing mai and finally found this out.  had Buddha bowl bursting with fresh, vibrant flavors 🥗,  then comes the Rich, nutty sesame milk that’s smooth and comforting 😋
my fav Fried rice perfectly seasoned, churros crisp and indulgent 🍚🍩Cozy ambience with limited space, but staff are super helpful and friendly ☕✨😊 but Green Thai noodles were a bit too spicy for our taste 🌶️
review_3_text: I ordered in churros from this place, which were really good! It came with two dips - Chocolate and Caramel. Both really good but the caramel was insanely good. I ordered the cinnamon sugar churros - I don't don't think they are always available but if you do get a chance, order it! Also, they gave me 6pcs instead of 4😄which were huge and good enough to share.
review_4_text:
Ordered via Grab, 2 sandwiches, food arrived still hot , fresh and all was delicious. Will definitely explore their menu more.
Updated 7/2025: visiting the restaurant, staff was very kind and helpful, speak soft, order 3 dishes, made fresh quickly. Very good taste. The couscous salad was amazing and unfortunately so rare to find.
The toilets are extremely clean !!! And it looks like the place is well managed.
review_5_text: I’ve eaten at Alchemy Vegan a few times now, and it’s one of my favorite vegan restaurants in town. Every visit I get the Thai milk tea with oat milk — it’s creamy and delicious! The green salad with avocado and lime dressing is fresh and pairs perfectly with the sourdough. I also love the cheesy olive toast — the vegan cheese is rich and satisfying. And don’t skip the chocolate cake! It’s decadent, definitely big enough to share. The space is calm, the staff are kind, and it’s always a great spot to relax and enjoy a good meal.

name: Artisan Café
review_1_text: I had the best matcha latte with oat milk here since I came to Chiang Mai. I ordered one hot matcha to drink in their charming and comfortable seating and took an iced matcha to go in my travel mug. Both were equally delicious. My partner ordered a house made cold brew coffee. He said it was delicious too and came with a single, huge round ice cube in a low ball cocktail glass. Nice touch. This place is classy and quirky with nice tea cups, glasses, couches, and other interesting furniture.
review_2_text: I had iced coffee and it was very good.  However, I came here mostly for the beautiful decor and comfy chairs.  It’s a good place to sit and work for a while.
review_3_text: Another good coffee shop to try in Chiang Mai. Their coffee is good and made very well. They have good desserts, a couple of different cookies and some croissants. We chose one of each. The one near old town has a bit more seating than the one near Nimman, which is why we chose this location. This coffee shop has a bit more choices than some of the other coffee shops we have rated. This is probably our second favorite shop in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended.
review_4_text: My husband and I came here many times during our stay in CM. This place is perfect for breakfast. Great coffee, great Bagel, great environment and the owner and staff are all very friendly. If we come back to CM will definitely visit again 🙏
review_5_text:
I visited because Google reviews are good, and I thought the seats would be very comfortable.
I visited around 1 o'clock and had lots of customers, but I was able to sit in a comfortable sofa seat.
The atmosphere of the cafe is nice, the staff are friendly, and the coffee is delicious.
The air conditioner temperature is also appropriate, so it was comfortable and not cold during the stay.
You can park left side next to the cafe and the toilet is also inside the cafe, so it's easy to go.
The sofa seat was as comfortable as I expected.

name: Paper Plane Haiya
review_1_text: Beautiful  house , friendly owner  🌼 will come back again
review_2_text: Loved the jice japanese-mininalistic touch.
review_3_text:
The air conditioners in each room aren't very cool, and the bathroom fan is noisy.
But the house is beautiful, clean, and comfortable.

name: นราชาชัก ถนนวัวลาย เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: I picked up thai milk tea and it was cheap and good.
review_2_text:
Very kind, helpful people.
We as backpackers were asking directions to the Taxi and they took all the time out of their day to help us. He even booked us a Taxi, as we couldn't book one.

The Thai coffee with milk was delicious.

Thanks again!

Mike and Mia 😁
review_3_text: The service at this shop was excellent! There was a slight problem with my order from another branch, but the Wualai branch helped resolve it. The drinks were delicious! I will definitely be a regular customer.
review_4_text:
I usually order Thai tea with milk and tea leaves.
But recently, they've been offering fresh coffee, which I don't get very often. It's bitter.
review_5_text: A small but warm shop

name: Earnt Daw Coffee @ Wualai เอิ้นดาว กาแฟ @วัวลาย
review_1_text:
We are not digital nomads. We are a couple on their honeymoon and I am Italian. Thus said, we probably came on their unluckiest day, ad we decided to pay and leave after one sip at our cappuccino (too liquid and way too much bitter coffee tasting) and one tiny taste from our pre baked, low quality croissants.
Not even a question or concern for our untouched breakfast and insanely over priced too, as we paid 237 baht for nothing.
review_2_text: I just got a simple iced Americano and it was really delicious. There is a lot of seating available & they have AC & free wifi. The lady who made my coffee was very welcoming and friendly. Affordable prices & great tasting coffee. I think it would be nice if there was plant milk alternatives available. :)
review_3_text: What a great local shop with amazing staff! Natthanit made us her favorite mango slushy and some fresh coffee. If you’re in the area stop by! The prices are great too!
review_4_text: Excellent coffee. Staff are friendly & professional. Love the relaxed vibe and convenience of this establishment. I love Chiang Mai & The Land of Smiles 😊 . Thank you, guys x
review_5_text: A very nice coffee and food shop. If you are in the mood for a great experience you will not be disappointed in the customer service as well as the drink and food selections. I was pleasently surprised with the Spinach and Cheese  Croissant which was amazing. The staff is very well trained and were very pleasent and had a great conversation with them. If your driving feel free to park in the large adjacent parking lot. I love walking in this area and I is the location of the saturday nite market. name: LUNGO COFFEE BAR

💯This is a regular spot💯

name: kohicha.cnx - coffee x matcha
review_1_text:
I almost didn’t post this review since I don’t want to blow up this spot, but after going here multiple times within the two weeks we were in Chiang Mai, I felt like it was my duty to share how magical this place is.

As someone who drinks matcha everyday at home I was craving  quality matcha spot and kohicha is quite literally the best matcha experience I’ve had. Their menu has a wide variety of strains with tasting notes listed as well as a guide to which ones make for good lattes and which are best drank just with water. Oat milk swap is free and there are other alt milk options!

All the staff is really knowledgeable and have great recommendations.

The wifi is great for working and there are a few larger tables and outlets. It does get busy so these spots are not always guaranteed. It’s also a dog friendly location which has been a welcome distraction in my experience.

I’d also highly recommend the daifuku strawberry mochi. I get it every time! The chocolate cake is also phenomenal. The Nutty Yama has been my favorite so far out of the ~10 I’ve tried but it’s also a limited edition option.

Bring cash as card is not accepted.
review_2_text:
A newly opened spot that’s likely to become very popular soon.

The drinks are excellent, the staff is friendly, and the desserts are really good. The air conditioning is extremely cold, so it’s best to bring something warm to wear. The place looks great inside, and the prices are reasonable.
review_3_text: A hidden minimalist gem in the heart of Chiang Mai. KOHICHA offers such a peaceful and calm atmosphere—it’s the perfect place to slow down. Every drink is crafted with so much care and the flavors are truly exceptional. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quiet, high-quality coffee/tea break! ✨🍵
review_4_text: A GREAT Coffee and Matcha spot. A surprise to find a Japanese Cafe with amazing espresso and traditional ceremonial Matcha's with several flavors and varieties. Modern furniture and interior design with a relaxing vibe. AC was great to cool down on a hot day.
review_5_text: excellence. huge thoughtfully selected menu of ceremonial grade matcha with free oat milk option. absolutely loved it, the staff were so nice and welcoming. definitely recommend!

name: Weave Artisan Society
review_1_text:
Weave Artisan Society has become one of my favorite places in Chiang Mai. It is this big, open warehouse style cafe that feels trendy yet still a bit off the beaten path for most digital nomads, so you get a really nice mix of locals and entrepreneurs. It is usually not overly busy, the vibe is relaxed, and the coffee and food are good.

It is also a great and somewhat unexpected place to invite clients or partners for meetings, because the space feels professional without being stiff. Me and some friends have also hosted events there recently and the venue has been very accommodating and easy to work with.

They recently opened the new coworking space upstairs, which I am renting on a monthly basis, and I absolutely love it. The team is very accommodating, the layout never feels overcrowded, and there is a lot of flexibility for how you want to work or meet people. They keep making thoughtful improvements, and I am genuinely looking forward to seeing how the space continues to grow.
review_2_text:
Very good vibe. Coffee was decent, kept me aware for the meet-up I came to attend.
Can improve on more comfortable sitting arrangements though, but not a big deal.
review_3_text: The place is lovely and WiFi is super fast (400mbps upload and downs load). When you order something at the bar, they’ll give you the voucher for the WiFi which last 3 hours. We had an almond latte and didn’t really like it, I think in some way they burned the milk hence the strange taste.
review_4_text:
Lovely space - great location in the old town and the coworking space is beautiful and the cafe is great with awesome coffee and pastries. Wifi is fast, chairs are nice, everything is brand new.

Unfortunately,  there are a couple of things that need to be sorted before it can compare with other spaces in Chiang Mai.

The first is that there is no free water (I have never seen this at any co work space in Chiang Mai), secondly,  the day pass only allows you to stay until 5pm. That doesn't make sense for most people.

I asked if it were possible to stay until 6pm as a one off, that wasn't an option, I was told to go down to the cafe at 5pm, even though there was just 2 people working in the large space...
