review_4_text: The coffee is very fragrant, it's good, both the ingredients and the roasting 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
review_5_text: Delicious coffee with a unique aroma

name: The Lion’s Crown ライオン
review_1_text:
Very nice cute friendly cafe, the bubble tea is amazing, beautiful and good authentic taste.
They also serve Thai food, like khao soi, Nam ngiao, Ga-pao, with local price👍👍👍
review_2_text: one best random late night food to go. chicken massana curry was delicious ✌🏻
review_3_text: Small, very clean, and quiet restaurant with polite service. Simple menu (white rice, pasta, fried rice with a choice of meat: pork, chicken, beef). A variety of drinks (matcha, latte, milk, various teas, sparkling water, etc.) and very reasonable prices.
review_4_text:
The bubble tea is incredibly fragrant. This is a super hidden gem. The cute decor is perfect for taking photos.
A hidden gem! The brown sugar boba is so fragrant and authentic. It tastes just like the original in Taiwan.
review_5_text: Stir-fried basil pork and garlic pork are delicious, clean, and generous portions. Comfortable seating and a kids' menu are available.

name: Olive Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Cute little shop. Very cozy. The lady there was very kind. Easy to talk to. The food was delicious. I had breakfast. It was delicious and huge. The coffee was great too and a good size!
review_2_text: Yummy carbonara and coffee. Good owners and staff. I pictured the khao soi
review_3_text: This morning I enjoyed a western breakfast with coffee and brownie with soft served ice cream today. Everything was prepared to perfection and the taste was unmatched. I look forward to enjoying other items on the menu to include Spaghetti, sandwiches, and delicious looking cakes. Cafe was clean and the service was excellent.
review_4_text: The best pasta I have ever tasted.  The pizza 🍕 is so..delicious. It is a cute place with air conditioning. The staff is amazing. Their coffee is fresh and bold. They also have fresh baked cakes and other pastries. They also have soft serve ice cream. The cafe is very clean and lovely place.  A must visit.
review_5_text: The staff has served me well even when I arrived at closing time. They are very friendly and warm. Since I found it, I haven't missed a single day. Thank you. I forgot to ask for the photo I took with the staff, but I have one with my girlfriend enjoying the place. See you soon!

name: Jii Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Very sweet place and good coffee. Really friendly stuff
review_2_text:
A small, clean white shop with a cute atmosphere near Kad Kom, Chiang Mai Province, serving both coffee and non-coffee menus at cute, easy on the pocketbook

☕️ Iced Americano 40 baht
review_3_text: A small shop but the coffee and cocoa taste great.
review_4_text: The drink is delicious.

name: Watyanggung Coffee
review_1_text:
This temple and cafe is so special!
I highly recommend coming here if you’re in Chiang Mai. Not only is the temple a beautiful and tranquil space to spend time, the cafe is lovely and the barista is so sweet and hospitable. It’s a perfect spot to do work (there is free wifi) or to just hang out with the temple kitties🐱 Please dress respectfully and be considerate! Enjoy🪷
review_2_text:
Very quiet and relaxing place.
Good choice of warm and cold beverages.
Excellent and friendly service.
review_3_text: Beautiful little cafe right next to a beautiful temple. Good coffee, sweet cats and super nice lady making the coffee! :)
review_4_text: The most welcoming cafe ever.Staff so lovely kind and welcoming. Would highly recommend and say thank you for all your care 🧡
review_5_text: Lovely cafe inside a beautiful temple. Wonderful service with genuinely kind staff. Many beautiful well-cared for cats to watch and pet too. Delicious coffee, and the income from sales supports the temple. Highly recommend! ❤️☕️😻

name: june koff
review_1_text: Cappuccino was not as aesthetic as in the pics. The taste however was great!😃 Lovely little shop, bit out of the main area. The prices are perfect, with great coffee and other drinks. Would recommend👌🏼
review_2_text: A very sweet owner that really cares about the quality of coffee and tea she serves! The prices are very affordable, especially compared to the rest of Chiang Mai, and it is truly some of the best coffee we had in Thailand. Americano, iced, frappe... they're all amazing!
review_3_text: Cute little café. The coffee is great and the lady is super friendly. I can totally recommend this place!
review_4_text: I was passing by and the exterior was so pretty that I was drawn in. I had a Thai milk tea. They brewed it really strong with Thai tea leaves in an espresso machine, and I think they mixed it with something like milk tea powder. It was rich and delicious, and the shop was really hip.
review_5_text:
Excellent Latte Yen. And a wonderful lady serving us. And right across the street, there's a restaurant that serves delicious Khao Soi, and the lady lets us eat at her cafe.
The restaurant across the street serves other things I haven't tried.

name: ร้านกาแฟโบราณเฮงๆปังๆ
review_1_text: The coffee is so good you have to come and try it.
review_2_text: Delicious, especially the traditional coffee! 👍☺

name: ร้านหนึ่งศูนย์แปด(๑๐๘)
review_1_text:
The Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth) was delicious!
It's made by Auntie Noi, Teo's mother.
review_2_text: A really nice local evening market. It's a bit strange for Dutch people, as you walk along a canal with picturesque bridges. You can eat, get massages, and be entertained. Oh, and there are lots of great souvenirs to buy.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is very chill, the beer is delicious, and there are many types of mixed drinks.
review_4_text: A small shop at Khlong Mae Kha. The owner is cute. The taste of the black-hearted dog smoothie is delicious. ^^

name: ริมคลองแม่ข่า
review_1_text: Nice little bar and good variety of local and international beers! Relaxing music with a view on the river and friendly owner. Definitely recommend for a stop. I think no food available, but plenty of beer and some coffee as well (I think). Came here twice during our stay.
review_2_text: “The atmosphere and view are great, and the drinks are delicious, but the staff are not very friendly. !!! When I asked about the price and was ready to pay, the staff were busy on their phones
review_3_text: good place to sit down and people watch , good beer selection
review_4_text: Good beer and drink selection, staff should improve in politeness and service.
review_5_text: Lovely place for a drink by the canal.

name: Splendish
review_1_text: Lovely place and cute staff
review_2_text: Not open

name: Slow bar on the way @คลองแม่ข่า
review_1_text: Absolutely love this cafe and prices are super affordable. Peach tea for just 30 thb is incredible. Also the view is sooo pretty!
review_2_text: Lovely little Cafe with a lot of options to choose from. The Barista Lady was friendly and lively and made delicious drinks. I ordered a Rose Thai Tea which was refreshing! The drinks didnt take long and the scenic view was beautiful. I would recommend this place!
review_3_text: A really good coffee shop in a quaint neighbourhood. The service is great, with the barista knowing what she is selling and being able to communicate it! I had the classic "es yen" here and even though that's like a Spanish Latte, it just tasted great! Definitely a must visit in Haiya.
review_4_text: 30฿ for a coffee? Yes. Awesome. Amazing little place to relax. Not top of the line coffee but absolutely awesome for a quick pick me up. Super friendly staff. I recommend the Thai teas and flavored sodas. We got the ice latte Moka and it was decent!
review_5_text:
Nice underdog coffee shop. Offered varieties of beans for coffee lovers to try. Really love Lao origin coffee beans.

The owner also very friendly and very helpful. It's located at best possible location too. Try it. You won't be disappointed.

name: BLACK COFFEE By DOIWHAN
review_1_text: A to go only serious coffee stall where you can only get Americano, but you can choose from a variety of beans. It’s one of the best places to pick up your cup around.
review_2_text: Good price and the best coffee
review_3_text: The shop owner is kind and the coffee is very delicious and fragrant. Most importantly, there are many types of coffee beans to choose from, both Thai and foreign, and the price is not expensive. I have to go and drink it every day. The shop also sells coffee beans.

name: เก๊ากาแฟ
review_1_text: The atmosphere is great, perfect for relaxing and taking beautiful photos.
review_2_text: I always order through Grab. The price is not expensive. The ice cream menu is very delicious.

name: Craves Cafe' Coffee&Dessert
review_1_text: Really cute shop. Great drinks at an affordable price. Staff was super kind and welcoming and even got me to write a little note for their Christmas tree! Hospitality 10/10
review_2_text: Nice chill vibes for an afternoon treat! Good selection of teas, coffees, smoothies, etc.
review_3_text: This coffee shop is a hidden gem that offers exceptional coffee, delightful treats, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
review_4_text: Waited over an hour for 4 tiny waffles and 2 toasts (and toast wasn’t even what we ordered). Thought this would be a quick grab-and-go breakfast before our day trip out to Chang Rai. If the food was good, would have been worth it, but the food wasn’t even tasty. Waffles were very salty and part of our order was wrong. You can see time-stamp chat with hubs that this order literally took an hour lol.
review_5_text: Very cute café with good food and good drinks! I personally recommend the Thai Milk Tea :)

name: ร้าน สตาร์คอฟฟี่
Homecoffee By Dr.Mon
review_1_text: Dr Mon runs her coffee shop from her home. Excellent and authentic Thai coffee and tea. Mon is a beautiful and kind lady who sells coffee because it is her passion. We returned to every morning while staying in Chiang Mai. Please stop by for a coffee and enjoy a morning conversation with her. Highly recommend!
review_2_text:
Dr Mon was amazing! She welcomed me into her home, gave me a free cold water and made me an amazing authentic Thai coffee.

She also gave me a few recommendations for me to check out in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: The cats are so cute and the owner is so friendly! The coffee is also great👍
review_4_text: Delicious iced tea and an adorable orange cat.

name: Libera Coffee
review_1_text: Little bit expensive but the cappuccino was excellent and a good size
review_2_text: Good coffee shop next to Astra Condo
review_3_text: The coffee there is not good but the price is high. 80฿ for an Americano I expect more. Seems their main customer is guests in Astra condo. You can find way better coffee with cheaper price across the street.
review_4_text: 75 baht for a tiny cappuccino, I wanted to throw it in their face, but I am nice and I wouldn’t do that, although I still had that feeling. Please owner of this business, do not rip people off, if you charge this much money make sure the size is at least double of this. YOU LITERALLY GAVE ME A BABYCINO. Rip off
review_5_text: Decent atmosphere but pretty mediocre coffee

name: Thai Thai Hostel
review_1_text:
Absolutely loved this hostel - simple but good breakfast, friendly staff and cosy beds! We were able to check in early, the showers were clean and hot.

Only complaint is that the curtain didn't go all the way around the bed but overall such a great stay!
review_2_text: Very good place for hostel. The stay was overfilled my expectations. The hostel is close to the market and silver temple. The over is very nice
review_3_text: I am staying here for one week, and this hostel is an amazing place to stay. It’s very clean, the temperature is perfect, and the hospitality is top-notch.
review_4_text: I really enjoyed my time here. I stayed for 2 weeks and then another night while passing through. The staff are very nice and speak English well. AC in the room was super nice to get away from the heat as well as the privacy curtains. It’s kept very clean as well and is quiet so it’s easy to get a good night of rest. Also… the hostel cat is super cute!
review_5_text: Staffs are kind and very helpful. The whole building was cleaned. I love the neighbors nearby. Therr is a washing machine and you can dry ur clothes on the roof top. It makes save time and money:)

name: A Day In Chiang Mai Coffee Brew
review_1_text:
They made delicious coffee.
We found this randomly, a small & cozy coffee shop. I tried their signature coffee, which included 4 types of milk (as i remembered), very very delicious, truly memorable.
Their staffs are also very nice 😆.
review_2_text: Nice and small cafe with parking and good atmosphere. They have local and importad coffee too. Nice to relax and cool down in the heat. Good vibes and friendly service
review_3_text:
The atmosphere is nice and relaxing. The service is good, and the staff are friendly. The coffee is good. The coffee prices (latte 70฿) are higher than local coffee shops, but in line with local "specialty" coffee shops. The prices for desserts are not listed until you choose the dessert in their electronic ordering system. The dessert prices are on the high side compared to other comparable coffee shops. The chocolate mousse cake was rich and good, but was a little small for the 150฿. The cheesecake (140฿) wasn't bad, but the center was frozen and the taste was similar to what you would get from a frozen cheesecake at the supermarket.
I'm summary, the coffee, service, and atmosphere make this a nice place to relax, but the desserts felt overpriced.
Note: The restroom is behind the coffee shop.
review_4_text:
TRUST ME!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

A Day in Chiang Mai easily serves the best coffee in Chiang Mai — and I don’t say that lightly. I had their flat white with both the Culture and Panama Geisha beans, and each cup was exceptional in its own way. The Culture bean brought out a beautifully rounded flavor, while the Panama Geisha was delicate, floral, and truly memorable.

The balance, texture, and aroma were spot on — clearly crafted with care and skill. The café itself is calm, stylish, and welcoming, perfect for a quiet coffee moment or slow afternoon.

If you’re serious about coffee, this place deserves a permanent spot on your Chiang Mai list. ☕✨
review_5_text: This place do amazing coffee - one of the best that we had in Chiangmai! Love how passionate they are in creating every single drink. It’s tucked away in the neighborhood close to where we stay. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Chiangmai!

name: On The Way Chang klan
review_1_text: Not much to say: a great place to start the day - just along the road, but so friendly with great coffee. Will be back, best to start the Chiangmai mornings…
review_2_text:
If I could give 100/10 I would do it.
Criss really has the best service, coffee and we love coming here every day.

We bring our own oat milk which he keeps and we order 2 drinks every day.

For me a cold cappuccino oat and a lemon lychee. 😍  my boyfriend always drinks his hot cappuccino’s and has NO energy crashes during the day. (Thats says how good the coffee is)!!
review_3_text:
This is one of my favorite coffee places I’ve come across in all my travels.

The owner is the friendliest guy and always has a smile on his face.

Coffee is dialed and on point, every time. In the early AM there isn’t many people here, but once the day gets going there are always people lined up.

Really a great find and worth making a stop at!
review_4_text: Go to this coffee stand! Delicious coffee, great prices, and the barista—who seems to also be the owner—is the sweetest! He also speaks excellent English and will tailor the coffee to your taste preference. Thank you for your yummy coffee and kindness ❤️❤️
review_5_text: Chris made this place great. Excellent priced, great tasting coffee options in cute boutique stand with seating and music. Chris was very friendly and informative about the area while serving a delicious morning cappuccino and mocha that tasted excellent. Going to come back here every morning for the rest of our stay in Chiang Mai.

name: THAI THAI Cafe' & Keto | ไทย ไทย คาเฟ่
review_1_text: Im so glad I walked  off the main street to look for this cafe which is part of a hostel (I did miss it at first) Bang for the buck one the one of the best coffee spots in Chiang Mai. I ordered a Thai Iced Tea-Coffee 1/2 sweet and they made it perfect! Its become my new favorite in Thailand!
review_2_text: Best coffee in chiang mai! I ordered on grab app, tastes made me surprise! absolutely recommend❤️
review_3_text:
Cappuccino and a cat, what's not to love. They even have board games and rubics cubes too.
Best cafe ever.
review_4_text: My go-to-place whenever I'm in need of a sugar rush. The resident cat is also lovely.
review_5_text: best the thai tea around old town !

name: Monkey Coffee
review_1_text:
My favorite place to go for coffee in Chiang Mai.

The coffee is great and the owner is friendly and a great local guide.

Highly recommend.
review_2_text: A very high quality coffee shop offers several types of coffee, I chose Brazilian coffee was really delicious and very different from other stores using high quality coffee, the store owner is really friendly and helps with information and tips and information to travelers, thank you 🙏
review_3_text: It’s a small place but with really good coffee. I mean, you can even choose the coffee bean you want👌
review_4_text: Monkey is a great place to relax on the comfortable couch and have a nice cold coffee. You can choose from  different coffee beans, i had the Brasil one and it tasted great. While drinking your coffee you can have a nice chat with owner. She can also give you a lot travel information in and around Chiangmai.
review_5_text: Lovely shop ,Selected coffee been,Great service. Friendly owner.

name: London House​ Cafe
review_1_text: Tasty, but not great. Recommended.
review_2_text: The cake and coffee are excellent. You can sit for a long time. You can use the Wi-Fi to work. I recommend the lime green tea.
review_3_text: A very welcoming and well-decorated place where you can enjoy excellent coffee and cappuccino, and delicious slices of cake in various flavors. Very friendly and helpful staff.

name: เอ้อร์ ชากาแฟ
review_1_text: Food truck with delicious bubble milk tea!!
review_2_text: It's a converted truck selling coffee and drinks. The drinks are very affordable, but the taste is amazing!! It's just as good as any beverage shop in the old town.
review_3_text: Delicious, I like it without worrying about the ingredients. When I eat it, I can feel the full flavor.
review_4_text:
Thai coffee is really good 🤩
And it's only NT$25
review_5_text: Affordable and delicious! Go for it!

name: TuaPa Cafe (ตั่วปา คาเฟ่)
review_1_text: Tiny and cute, you could easily miss this coffee shop if not paying attention.  Owner was really friendly.  Great prices and good coffee. Would definitely recommend.
review_2_text: I have been coming here for years. Best cheapest coffee around. Now with indoor sitting is even better..value for money..good coffee..
review_3_text: Super friendly. Coffee is good but sweet
review_4_text: Coffee here is really nice owner is really friendly and giving dad vibe
review_5_text: This coffee is strong and intense... perfect for those who love dark brews!

name: CPS กาแฟ Cafe 카페 咖啡
review_1_text:
Cappuccino (Hot) 30 THB
Americano (Hot) 30 THB
Inexpensive and super delicious!!
I'm happy to have a cappuccino that's not overly sweet.
The shop is filled with adorable fish swimming in aquariums. 🐟
They also have books and nostalgic mini-games, and the staff are always smiling and very kind, sharing snacks with me. It's a cozy place.

I'll definitely stop by again when I'm in Chiang Mai!
If you're staying nearby, be sure to check it out. 🙌
review_2_text:
The handsome owner is very friendly, and the coffee is delicious.
I happened to visit here on the first day of my trip, and I've been visiting every day since. I almost want to invite him to my house and start a business there.
The only downside is that the store closes around 3 PM.
review_3_text:
Hot basic 40 baht, cold basic 50 baht
Friendly
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious.

name: ร้าน ME WE Coffee
review_1_text: A very small coffee shop with very reasonable pricing.
review_2_text:
Great cappuccino!
Opening hours 08:30ish - 16:00.
I paid 35 THB for one cup
review_3_text:
Great drinks, very good prices, and WiFi is very good!
I finished my 4 hour work there 😌
review_4_text: The owner is incredibly friendly and funny. You can also follow a massage course from her :⁠-⁠)
review_5_text: Tasty coffee and tea for good price. Highly recommend 👍🏻

name: anamii coffee.
review_1_text: The coffee shop manager provided excellent service and managed the business exceptionally well. I could see they provided truly great customer service, and their coffee was delicious. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: The staff was good. Obviously, I will be back again it’s very good  shop I don’t know the staff maybe his name is win he is very good at coffee shop thank you very much. I will be back. Have a good day.
review_3_text: Great coffee and great service
review_4_text: What a humble, lovely place for coffee. It's worth the walk from Mae Kha Canal. The best cocoa mint ever! A hidden gem. I'll be lucky to come here again 😊🤗
review_5_text: A friendly atmosphere with a small terrace for smokers… the coffee is perfect, she sweetens it to your liking, and her smile to say thank you makes your day even better!! 🥰

name: 20Baht Smoothie
review_1_text:
You can get a fresh fruit smoothie for just 20 baht 😉🫶
The owner is very friendly and makes hygienic drinks! They cut the fresh fruit on the spot, blend it with water and ice, and it's deliciously sweet. 🎆 It's right in front of On the Way (a 35 baht coffee truck)! It's also recommended for those with dairy allergies! They don't use milk :-)
review_2_text: Most night markets sell small bags for 30 baht each, but here they're only 10 baht! I bought five bags of various things for 50 baht each. They were delicious. I plan to visit again tomorrow.

name: ร้านกาแฟหมาปั๊ก by Mickeyink tattoo
review_1_text: Cute local coffee shop with a nice local vibe and a friendly owner. I had Matcha iced and a hot cup of cappuccino here. Matcha was so refreshing on a hot day, and the cappuccino was strong and fantastic. Will surely go back for more.
review_2_text: Little coffee place with a very friendly owner & his dog. I came here several times & the coffee as well as the matcha is really good, at very fair prices. My favorite is the matcha with fresh lime juice - very tasty & refreshing:)
review_3_text: Amazing drink and great service. Tips for dog very cute.
review_4_text: I love the green tea strawberry! The  quality of strawberry jam is also amazing
review_5_text: The best quality coffee in this area. We keep coming for our morning coffee and never get disappointed. Great price aswell

name: YoKhu CAFE กาแฟสด
Kacha ChaThai
review_1_text:
Strong Thai tea.
Very fragrant.
Made with high-quality ingredients.
A must-try!
review_2_text: I order from this shop very often. Their tea is strong and flavorful. I usually prefer less sugar, but here I order it with normal sweetness because it's not overly sweet 😄 If you like less sweet, fragrant tea, this is the place to go!

name: Sesto' Sweet Industry
review_1_text: Good coffee n roti.
review_2_text: Sitting comfortably while waiting for the kids to finish their tutoring sessions.

name: ชายงชาเย็น (ชาใต้) สาขาเชียงใหม่ the best of southern thaitea in chiangmai
review_1_text: The taste was great! But I'm giving it 4 stars because it's a bit far from home. The shop is easy to find, a small, minimalist shop opposite Montfort Primary School. 🤩👍🏽
review_2_text: The iced tea is very delicious. I was high for days. It's very strong. If you've never been here, you might want to slow down because the shop is near the intersection to Ra Kaeng. If there's no parking in front of the shop, you can park in the alley that goes through to Ra Kaeng and walk back. The shop is chill and comfortable, suitable for takeaway. But if you want to sit in the shop, there are tables. The shop might be a little dark. I'd like to see some more lights. 😅
review_3_text:
This is an amazing beverage shop! We couldn't stop ordering drinks while we were there 😍. You can feel the owner's care in every single drink; the flavors are delicate and refreshing.

At the end, the owner even treated us to a complimentary Americano coconut, which was such a pleasant surprise and so heartwarming. I'll definitely go back next time I'm in Chiang Mai; I'm already craving their jasmine green tea!
review_4_text:
Made with tea leaves from the south, the tea has a rich aroma and flavor.
Sweetness can be adjusted: 25%, 50%, 75%. The shop has some comfortable seating.
review_5_text: The tea is so good. It's delicious and the shop is chic. The owner is very friendly and kind. 🥰❤️🫶🏻

name: B@B coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee reasonable price

name: ร้านละมุน ช้างคลาน
Trailer Coffee Changklan
review_1_text: I recently visited Trailer Coffee and had a great experience overall. The coffee was smooth and flavorful, offering a nice balance of richness without being overly bitter. However, I found that it wasn’t as strong as I typically like my coffee to be. If you enjoy a lighter brew or prefer a more subtle taste, this will be a great choice for you. The vibe of the place was cozy and welcoming, and the service was friendly. I’d definitely recommend it for those who appreciate good coffee, just maybe not if you're looking for something with a bold kick!
review_2_text: Best coffee I’ve tasted in Chiang Mai (and I’ve tasted quite some coffee here). Owner has won awards in a national championship and also sells professional coffee machines and offers barista training. Super kind service.
review_3_text: I like the lighter brew, so this shop is perfect for me!
review_4_text: The peach iced coffee is amazing! I actually visited their Jing Jai market location and had to go back to have another iced coffee the next day.
review_5_text: Really delicious latte, this is excellent coffee from a nice unassuming cafe that is better than most coffees from specialty coffee shops in European cities

name: ร้านเทวาลาดู สาขาเชียงใหม่ Deva Ladoo Chiangmai
review_1_text: Ordered cocoa drink on the go. Inexpensive and the coco is rich, the texture of their bubble is perfect too.
review_2_text: There are offerings to Lord Ganesha and the Lord Buddha in the room. There are ceremonies for offering on important days. I go almost every day with faith. Jai Ganesh🕉️
review_3_text: This shop offers the widest and most complete selection of items for worshipping deities in Chiang Mai. The ladoo sweets are delicious, especially the Montichu ladoo. For those who don't come to buy anything, there is also a Ganesha statue available for worship inside.
review_4_text: The shop plays pleasant Indian music and the shop smells wonderful. The deities are beautiful and there are many items to choose from. Yesterday I bought a Lakshmi statue, a Navadurga gold plate, an Indian garland, and rose incense. The temple inside is beautiful, sacred, luxurious, and peaceful. It is a very luxurious and peaceful temple. I recommend it to those who believe in superstition. Thank you.
review_5_text: The staff provided excellent service and helpful advice. There was a wide selection of desserts, which were beautiful and delicious. There were also statues of Buddha available for worship and prayer. The interior of the shop was beautiful.

name: The Shepherd
review_1_text: The pup that stays here is so sweet and the coffee came with this little sticker! The vibe is chill and the workers are nice. Most importantly, the coffee is great!!!
review_2_text:
Good coffee, cool place and nice latte art.
Place looks great with art and very chill. Smells like freshly grinded coffee too, nice.
Come check it out if nearby and need a latte
review_3_text: Great coffee - requested flat whites and they were perfect. Better than a lot in Australia.
review_4_text: Great coffee and friendly staff ☕️
review_5_text:
One of my absolute favourite coffee spots in Chiangmai. Good choice of beans and an amazing dark roast.

The aesthetic is super cool and they always have good turns playing.

Located on a pretty soi with seats available  outside.

Staff are also awesome!

name: Chiang Mai Hill-tribe Coffee Tour, Chiang Mai sustainable Tour.
review_1_text:
If you want to have the best, most authentic and connected to nature experience in Chiang Mai, book this tour!!

We booked this coffee farm tour on a whim while visiting Chiang Mai and it became the most memorable part of our trip. It’s been a few months since returning and we still talk about it to this day.

From the off-road-ride into the forest, to the farm fresh foods, beautiful walk through the farm, learning about native plants from Moonshine, and making our own coffee, every step was thoughtful and intentional.

Jack was a wonderful guide; he made this experience what it was. We really enjoyed talking with him. He’s a kind soul who believes in offering an authentic experience worth your precious time in Chiang Mai 💕

NOW BOOK IT!!!
review_2_text:
A must do activity if visiting Chiang Mai.

From the hotel pickup to dropping off at the end of the trip, Jack and Moonshine were amazing guides and teachers about the coffee farm and its history. The lunch provided was absolutely delicious and hit the spot after a walk through the jungle, seeing the coffee tree farm, planting our own tree for the farm and experiencing the raw taste of the coffee pod plant. The workshop is fantastic. You learn how to properly roast to the grade of coffee you want and then roast your own bag to take home! Such a memorable experience and will be back to see how tall the planted tree has grown.  ⭐️ 10/10 ⭐️
review_3_text: We did the full day coffee tour experience and it was unforgettable! Jack is an incredible guide who loves what he does and is very knowledgeable about coffee. The visit to Moonshine’s family coffee farm was memorable, as was the lunch, and coffee roasting/tasting session. We had the best time and can 100% recommend this tour to anyone visiting Chiang Mai for an authentic Thai coffee experience.
review_4_text: Jack and moonshine are fantastic hosts. This tour is also an education in Thai village life and so much more than just a great coffee experience. Running our own independent coffee house in Scotland we appreciate the hard work these guys have put in to create a unique product and a great day out. We learnt so much, highlights being the walk in the jungle and upwards to the current coffee plants and getting the history of Thai coffee making, and the key part it now plays in Thai life. The backdrop, scenery , hospitality and thought put into this tour will not be beaten!
review_5_text: This experience was amazing! My mom really wanted to do a coffee tour and I’m so happy I found this one with Jack as the tour guide. This curated tour brings you into the jungle with a local family from the Karen tribe, teaches you the origins of growing coffee in Chiang Mai, planting your own coffee tree, an amazing lunch by Moonshine’s wife (it was seriously one of the best meals I’ve ever had), a coffee roasting and brewing demo before you get to do it yourself and bring your very own bag of coffee home. name: Little Shelter Hotel Chiang Mai
review_1_text: I’ve been attracted to this hotel by its design. Very impressed by the warm hospitality from the owner who would be transparently present. The staff always give us sincere service. The foods are delicious. I stayed at the hotel once, really love the room & the breakfast . Having home in Chiangmai, I often visit Little Shelter Hotel for several creative events & very much enjoy and love the vibes here. Shout out to gin lovers, you would find various kinds of local & import gins at the hotel’s beautiful restaurant & bar. Sipping a lovely drink with some yummy snacks in the cosy garden by the Ping river is also a must.
review_2_text:
Such a lovely hotel, perfectly located along a curve of the Ping River with a really peaceful and scenic view. It’s a great spot to slow down and enjoy Chiang Mai in a calmer, more relaxed way.

If you’re into architecture and art, you’ll definitely enjoy staying here. The design is simple but thoughtful, and everything feels well put together and comfortable.

The staff are super friendly and welcoming, always happy to help. Don’t miss the bar—great vibes, nice drinks, and a perfect place to hang out and unwind after a day out in the city.
review_3_text:
Don’t be fooled by the pictures — please come knowing what to actually expect.

I was really disappointed with my stay at Little Shelter and want to share my experience so others can make an informed decision.

1. No communication from the hotel
I emailed weeks in advance asking about airport transfers because Agoda said it was included. I never received a reply. My husband even called the morning of our arrival and still heard nothing. For a hotel claiming 4 stars, this is unacceptable.

2. Inconvenient location + difficult access
The hotel is over 3 km from the city center, meaning you’ll need to Grab or taxi everywhere. The road leading to the hotel is under construction — very dusty, bumpy, and dirty — and this was not mentioned anywhere.

3. Nice river view, but lots of mosquitoes
The river setting is pretty, but there are many mosquitoes, which makes sitting outside uncomfortable.

4. Room size and upgrade issue
We booked a Deluxe King room, but it was quite small. We tried to upgrade, but the hotel was fully booked and couldn’t offer anything else.

5. Cleanliness and maintenance issues
This was the biggest disappointment:
•	Plastic mirrors on the walls looked cheap and were dusty.
•	The ceiling images were pixelated and low-quality.
•	Slippers were worn and dirty.
•	Bathroom had grime, and even the lotion bottle looked unclean.

For a hotel claiming design awards, the maintenance and attention to detail were extremely poor.

6. Pool is not functional for swimming
The pool is pretty shallow — it looks more decorative than usable. Not very clean and very narrow

7. Breakfast starts very late
Breakfast only starts at 8:00 AM, the latest I’ve seen in any hotel. Not ideal if you have morning plans.

Overall
This felt more like a 2–3 star experience, not the 4-star hotel it’s advertised as. The design concept and river view are nice, but poor communication, cleanliness issues, small rooms, and an inconvenient location make the stay disappointing. Don’t be fooled by the pictures — set your expectations accordingly.
review_4_text: We had the best time staying in this hotel. Staffs are very lovely and so accomodating🥹❤️‍🩹. Food was amazing! very reasonable price. Location is great as well as its not far from like night bazaar where we had a good time roaming around. The hotel Room was fantastic! very aesthetic and very good price. Well done💕 definitely will come back again❤️‍🩹 Thank you so much!
review_5_text:
A Distinctive Boutique Retreat in Chiang Mai!!

Little Shelter Hotel offers an exceptional stay that blends thoughtful design with serene riverside charm. Each room showcases a unique architectural concept, reflecting both creativity and local heritage — a true celebration of art and space.

Adding to its character, the hotel features an on-site art gallery that showcases works from various local and international artists, further enriching the experience for design and culture enthusiasts.

The atmosphere is calm and refined, complemented by genuinely warm hospitality. Breakfasts were a delight, beautifully plated and paired with locally roasted coffee of superb quality.

Tucked just outside the city bustle, this is a perfect sanctuary for those who appreciate design, comfort, and a sense of place. Highly recommended.

They have many creative workshops like pottery and bead-making, which are both relaxing and fun. The staff are very kind, the atmosphere feels like home, and it’s pet-friendly - our dog was so happy in the air-conditioned room. Truly my favorite café!
review_3_text: Wow I had the best time here for my birthday!! Lovely teacher, she helped us when needed, it was SO fun. Fun thing to do with a group of girls. They also brought out a cake for me 😇 thank you ka
review_4_text: A lovely place where your beautiful soul will be empowered and uplifted. I love this homemade Begel and cream cheese. They just serve new food menu, mainly pizza and pasta. The price is average.
review_5_text:
Such a lovely experience. I came here for the pottery and really wanted to try something new and the owner was incredibly patient and helpful, explaining the process and guiding me through it without rushing.

After pottery, we tried their sourdough bagels — the blueberry and matcha ones were delicious and surprisingly light. The ladies running this place are amazing, very kind, and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even more special.

If I’m in Chiang Mai again, I’ll definitely come back. A must-try for pottery in Chiang Mai, especially for the reasonable prices and warm atmosphere.

name: Mo.cha cafe - โมฉะ คาเฟ่
review_1_text:
This is a great little chill coffee house near the art show. The patio on the back is very relaxing & there was a nice cool breeze the afternoon I went.

Wonderful service and a really great iced mocha!

10/10 nice!
review_2_text: A great place to chill near the busy art marketplace, nice and quiet, I love their matcha latte, the taste is just nice!
review_3_text: Lovely place with lots of space indoors and outdoors, great to work on a laptop there! The coffee is delicious and BIG, staff was friendly and attentive :) will be coming back!
review_4_text:
The place’s signature menu seemed to be match latte. I ordered and loved it!! It was very quite and peaceful place as well as nice staffs.
Match latte was just as perfect, not too sweet, not too milky. But there’re not many seats available in the cafe
review_5_text: Delicious drinks & cool atmosphere with lovely staff.

name: UHOUSE
review_1_text: I can't contact to hotel. What is phone number ?
review_2_text: Very comfortable house
review_3_text: Cosy place
review_4_text: The shop is very beautiful, the desserts are delicious, the atmosphere is good, and there are a fair number of people.
review_5_text: Very beautiful teak house and garden. I heard it is 80 years old.

name: Mini Juice Bar
review_1_text: I can’t say enough good things about this beautiful juice bar. The owner is present and pleasant to be around. The environment is calming and thoughtfully arranged for comfort. The drinks are amazing. We sampled a ginger turmeric drink and purchased a Gingy juice which was very very good. A small cup of fruit was presented with the drink free of charge which was a nice surprise. We went back after a hectic couple of hours at Baan Kang Wat and painted mango seeds while we watched time slip away in the most peaceful way. Grab and Bolt both service this area so there is no excuse to not try this place.
review_2_text: AMAZING experience! Best juice and smoothie I’ve had in Chiang Mai and the kindest owner and best energy and vibes to sit and enjoy slowing having some fresh ingredients and beautiful fruit!
review_3_text: We ordered smoothies that were freshly made by the owner. Because he made too much he gave each of us also a little fruit bowl and a small glass with each of the smoothies in it which was so nice and amazing. The owner was also very friendly and sweet but not pushy and everything was affordable. Highly recommend it!
review_4_text:
I was walking along the road from Wat Umong to the arts centre and happened to pass this place. I almost didn’t walk in but the style of the place caught my eye.

I ordered a smoothie and I don’t say this lightly when it was the best smoothie I’ve had in my life. Not only that but Gap brought out some fruit on a platter to accompany my smoothie.

Truly a fantastic experience, i would give it 6 stars if i could
review_5_text: It’s no surprise they receive full scores you can truly feel the passion behind every dish. Each menu is amazingly crafted, with great quality at very reasonable prices. It may take a bit of time, but everything is 100% worth it.

name: M&M Coffee Club
review_1_text: Relaxing black themed indoor air conditioned cafe , perfect place to get away from the heat over some coffee . Ordered cappuccino , big volume and  taste was great , price was considered cheap for this big cup ! Shop uses single origin Thai local arabica medium roast beans. I like it ! Taste much better than some overrated cafes out there . Definitely a place for coffee lovers . 👍🏻
review_2_text: Quietly tucked back from the busy road, this coffee shop is a great spot to relax in. The staff are so friendly and went above and beyond to help me and provided excellent drinks. Thank you!
review_3_text:
Organic coffee bean, rich and smooth taste.
Competitive price with Air con and wifi
review_4_text: A newly opened cafe. Served with high quality coffee beans, tried their mocha love the nutty taste of the coffee. The customer services are really good, you’ll be served with a friendly greeting and smile and the prices are affordable. Definitely will be back again!
review_5_text: Good coffee for a fair price :)

name: Chim Chill Coffee & Food
review_1_text: Love the environment. The boss is super chill and friendly. Food is amazing. You might not want to miss Thai green tea and avocado shrimp scramble toast there as it’s a great choice for your afternoon tea time. Incredible experience!
review_2_text: Absolutely love this place. It’s run by a super friendly married couple. The vibes are really chill and relaxed and all the food I’ve had has been great. Perfect spot to eat authentic Thai dishes in a nice setting and at a good price! Oh and the homemade lychee soda is 🔥🔥
review_3_text: Cheap, amazing food and the owners are so so cute! They made changes for my allergy and came to check up if I liked it! Also a cheaper stop before going to the artist village!!
review_4_text: Closed. Sunday 15:25 and it is closed. Imagine our disappointment. We came here especially to visit this cafe. Maybe it is nice. But we don't know. Because IT IS CLOSED. And at the same time Google maps shows that it is open. Why you do it? I don't know. People are loosing their valuable time and efforts because of such issues.
review_5_text:
Best coffee I've had in Thailand!
Nice little brunch menu, with lunch options- executed very well. Sourdough bread was a treat!
Service was thoughtful, friendly and quick. 10/10!

name: Chalala Hostel & cafe
review_1_text: We stayed here as the hostel guest. It’s just above the ice cream shop. We was the only ones there in a 6 bed room. So plenty of space. Cute food stalls across the road. Little bit out of the way but a 10 min bike out of the centre. The owner Gone was the sweetest person, made it feel like home 10/10 would stay again
review_2_text:
The shop's cute decor and warm atmosphere make it perfect for relaxing and taking photos. The homemade chocolate ice cream we tried was absolutely delicious! The chocolate aroma was just the right amount of sweet, but not too much.
Besides the ice cream, the cold cocoa drinks we ordered were well-balanced. I personally ordered the 100% sweetness level because I like it extra sweet. It was absolutely amazing.
I give it a 10/10. You have to try it!!!
review_3_text: This ice cream cafe has a great atmosphere. The seating is comfortable, and the ice cream is delicious and varied. The flavors are distinct and not too sweet. The price is also reasonable. I will definitely come back again if I have the chance :)
review_4_text: The shop has a cute decor. The tea is fragrant and delicious, and the ice cream is incredibly delicious – smooth and creamy. Personally, I love the coconut and green tea flavors; they're so fragrant and rich. Today, the owner gave me a complimentary chocolate ice cream, which was also delicious. Everything is not overly sweet, just the right amount of sweetness. I highly recommend it! ❤️
review_5_text: The ice cream is absolutely delicious! The shop is beautifully and cutely decorated, and the prices are affordable.

name: VTHORY
review_1_text:
Make a stop and stay
At VTHORY CAFE

name: Chalala gusto cafe
review_1_text: So Delicious 🤗🤗
review_2_text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is very good.
review_3_text: Delicious. The owner of the shop is beautiful. Haha.

name: MaliPai Roastery & Cafe
review_1_text: Very lovely place to sit still and let time pass by.  Very nice garden with huge Tamarind tree spread its branch cover.  The coffee shop that put a lot of thought and effort in it.
review_2_text: Love this space but more for their space than the refreshments. There are 2 outdoor spaces...each on either side. One has a water element (pond and such) and the seating is super cute, but there's not much coverage and can get very hot. The other covered in greenery and has fans and misters. The seating is super cute and spread out...super comfortable element out here and my preferred seating area...and they're open an hour later than the other cafes in the area. This allows me to hang out just a bit longer.
review_3_text: This is one of my favorite cafes in CM, and I live here. It has a lovely garden, is quiet and peaceful. The people are kind, coffee is excellent, and they have the sweetest golden retriever you’ve ever met. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: Many boutique coffee shops have opened in Chiang Mai recently, selling what is claimed to be high quality coffee at a hefty price. However, the coffee at Mali Pai is superior in quality and a good deal less expensive. The coffee is locally grown and roasted at the shop.
review_5_text:
Garden themed coffee shop - cool without air conditioning on a warm day. With the garden you can expect some mosquitoes.

There is a focus on detail and a desire to please that you will feel. The building itself is quite beautiful.
As usual with these shops iced drinks are served with 90% ice / 10% beverage. After paying 80 baht for their “Signature” drink I left feeling thirsty.

I had:
Iced Orange Expresso 80 baht
Slice of Apple Pie 70 baht

Nice staff and location. There are better overall experiences out there.

name: MaLee เครื่องปั่น
Ragdoll
review_1_text:
Best Butter Croissant I have had in Chiang Mai. Worth coming by if you enjoy expertly made croissant.

Spacious seating area with the typical soft, calming music and pleasant air conditioning. Set a bit off of the road I felt separated from the usual noise and busyness of life.

I would have liked more coffee choices - there are very few. Is there a bathroom available? A sign would be helpful.

I have no idea how they stay open with four
employees and so much space.

I will be happy to return and can easily recommend you have a visit. Yummy. 😃
review_2_text:
Very new cafe’ drink and cake really good
Iced americano is recommended menu
review_3_text:
The place is simply decorated, nice but not a place for those photo frenzy.
But seem they are more focussing on the bakery and the taste is worth trying.
A plus is hospitality of the owner/person in charge, very kind.
review_4_text:
Amazing pastries. Definitely the best Pain Au Chocolat you could find in Chiang Mai! So happy that Chiang Mai finally has decent croissants and Pain Au Chocolat. Again, I am a HUGE fan!

P.S.  The First time that I was there, I had an issue with one of the staff about her hygiene knowledge. She gave me change with her bare hand and after that she pick up my chocolate cake with her bare hand... I was furious and made a complain here. The owner apologized and said they will have this problem solved. When I was back again everything went well and they never did that again! thank you for the improvement of your service. I am a royal customer now!
review_5_text: Every time I've been here, I've only ever ordered the iced mint americano. It is surprisingly delicious...and quite refreshing. They also have cold brewed coffee but always run out before I get to try it. I'll have to go earlier. My favorite item though, is their croffle (croissant waffle). I've had about 3 flavors so far and they're all amazing. My fav at the moment is the gruéyre and honey.

name: What the COFF Chiang Mai
review_1_text: The best hot cappuchino 40 baht can buy. It came back just for the coffee.
review_2_text: Coffee shop in the city center. Hey!!! I didn't think it would be this delicious. The taste is good. The coffee is fragrant. The atmosphere in the shop is also good. Although the shop is a bit small, the price per cup is about 45 baht if it's iced coffee. I recommend this shop.
review_3_text: A coffee shop with a great atmosphere. Strong and delicious coffee. There are many menus. Iced tea, green tea, both green tea with milk and matcha green tea. You can choose. I really like it. Cocoa, soda. The music in the shop is fun.
review_4_text: Affordable prices, delicious taste, and they even have a vehicle inspection service! Friendly baristas, great-tasting coffee, and a beautiful shop.
review_5_text: The taste is delicious. The green tea is very good. The price is also cute. It's also a car inspection station. Very convenient.

name: Fact Cafe
review_1_text: I would like to give more stars, but I can't. The meal was very slow coming out to us. Maybe my fault, was we were in the cafe and not the restaurant itself. No napkins on the table or anywhere in the restaurant was surprising. Did I mention slow? I was in a hurry to get somewhere else and that may effect my score a little. We did get the corn spicy salad that was good, although not spicy like I like it.
review_2_text: Omg. One of the worst coffee I ever had in chiang mai.  A good example of the nice place but the core business is not good.  Coffee quality is bad. 60 baht with bad bean.  Ur profit margin must be huge.
review_3_text: I like latte and latte art there. There are seats you can spend time on working or taking photos.
review_4_text: Good place to relax. Coffee/Cake was ok with ambience great. Price was also good for location.
review_5_text: Nice coffee clean and quiet

name: Pangfan Coffee
review_1_text: Christmas Vibe Cafe. Really enjoyed the croissants as well as the dirty coffee I had. In fact I think the croissants are some of the best I've had in Chiang Mai. Extremely fresh and they do toast them which is really good. Owner is very nice as well I've spoken to him a few times and his English is very good. They don't have much of a restaurant menu so mostly what you can order is what you see in the front display.
review_2_text:
One of the best chilling cafe around here. There're many things that I'm fond of..

- Clean air : The smog in here is almost free (6-10) while outside is around 200. The temperature is just nice as well.
- Friendly with customers : They provided free pillows and blankets which are cleaned really well. You're free to nap, leaning, chating or whatever.
- Spacious, many type of tables, chairs, and sofa

The price is average. There's some discount on the cakes sometimes.

I'd suggest you give it a go if you want to chill around in the smoke-free cafe.

Updated : provided free printing
review_3_text:
Great coffee spot with plenty of parking and ample space for anyone who needs to do work. Lots of comfortable chairs, including the big plush loveseats you see in tv shows.

Really delicious north Thailand coffee on offer here, very good to start the day! Highly recommend!
review_4_text: A cool Coffee Shop with nice atmosphere. Friendly Staff, Carpark in the front of the door
review_5_text: Very good coffee shop both for working or just hanging out, it has an incredibly comfy seating area with many different options: couches, comfy chairs, regular chairs, bar chairs etc. Part of the coffee shop is also colder so depending on preference you can choose what temperature you like. Very relaxing and cozy jazz music, super friendly staff. Tons of places to charge devices. Also oat milk only costs 15baht extra so cheaper than most other places ☺️for my needs I’d say it’s one of the best coffee shops in Chiang mai

name: Beanbag coffee
review_1_text:
☕ The Ultimate Cozy Work Cafe in Chiang Mai! 🥐

This spot is absolutely perfect for a working day. They completely tick all the boxes: convenient parking and a comfortable working area with great vibes.

Their many seating selection makes it incredibly comfortable while enjoying their excellent drinks and fresh bakeries.

Beyond the great space, the staff truly stands out. Their friendliness is the first thing you notice and instantly makes the place feel welcoming.

Considering the high quality and comfortable vibe, the prices are definitely affordable and offer great value. If you need a cozy and wallet-friendly place to chill or work with your laptop in Chiang Mai, you can't miss this one! 👍
review_2_text: A place worth visiting. The coffee is delicious and the people are very friendly. The gravel road at the entrance is a bit slippery, so other people coming here must be very careful. I fell down by accident lol But the owner of the store is very good and provided me with basic medical care. I am very grateful. Thai people are really nice. I love Thailand!
review_3_text:
Consumer Advice.

The atmosphere, the staff and the drinks are good. I wanted to update my review as I feel I had been a bit too harsh in my previous review.

While the ice is a bit too much, I would recommend people to ask about the ice levels of their drinks first before ordering as it can be quite a lot. Really other than this there is nothing wrong with this cafe. Simply an issue of ice level.

This review is for others to consider before ordering their drinks.
review_4_text: A lovely place with great coffee and friendly staff. Huge carpark is a plus as well
review_5_text: There are three sofa seats for more than three people in the store, while the others are double seats. The environment is very good, with many green plants. The waitress is also very friendly, but when we went yesterday, the coffee machine broke down and we didn't drink freshly ground coffee. It's a pity that the bread is very soft and delicious

name: P&L Smoothie
review_1_text: Fresh fruit is delicious, refreshing, smooth, just as the name suggests😊😊😊👏👏

name: No.39 Cafe
review_1_text:
Atmosphere here is great - the pond in the middle is cool and the seating is nice.

Did feel a bit impersonal with the self serve for everything, but I suppose this is the practical way to get it done.

Food was more pricy than other places, not amazing quality or quantity.

Worth a visit, but nothing to rave about.
review_2_text:
No.39 Café is such a beautiful and relaxing place to spend your day. The atmosphere is amazing — a peaceful lake with bright blue water, surrounded by greenery, perfect for chilling with friends or just enjoying quiet time. The food and drinks are really delicious, and the ambience feels so refreshing.
I also love the “amplug” area; it gives the café a cool and unique vibe. The staff are friendly and provide very good service, which makes the experience even better.
If you're looking for a cozy spot with great food, good music, and a relaxing environment, No.39 Café is definitely worth a visit!
review_3_text:
If you’re at Baan Kang Wat (market) walk down here for a chance to sit, have a bite and a cold drink.

Pros- lots of space with tables spread out over the shaded area surrounding a strangely blue colored pond or pool. Low volume music playing which was in no way too much. Wide menu choices, desserts as well as drinks.

Confusing start- you enter into a covered hallway like space then go to the side room to place your order.  From there you walk out towards the radioactive colored water feature with a buzzer to find seating.

Cons- The pizza pictured was essentially a roti thin crust with margarita toppings.  We split it as we weren’t very hungry it did seem small.

Curious con- The ongoing obsession with girls getting pictures taken in several hundred poses using the blue water backdrop was non stop.  Not being young, shapely or from this culture it mystifies me.   It becomes free entertainment for dinners so there’s that.
review_4_text: Nice vibes for taking pictures and videos. The drinks are all well done. We ordered a tiramisu, strawberry shortcake and strawberry cheesecake. The cheesecake was below average so I would not recommend it. As for the visitors, lots of tourists mainly from China.
review_5_text: Looking for a pretty café with chill vibes? This place has so many photo spots, great drinks, and yummy food. I loved the mango coconut cake, and the Thai tea with cheese foam is also a must-try!

name: Paper Spoon
review_1_text:
This cafe was a truly wonderful find. It’s very quaint, set in a beautiful lush garden full of tropical plants. The owner is very kind, and there’s a shop with heaps of handmade goodies at reasonable prices.
The Nutella toast is absolute yummers!
review_2_text: Magical spot! Beautiful ambience, loved the decorations and details, food & coffee was delicious, high quality, and service friendly. (No laptops.)
review_3_text: Paper Spoon is one of those cafés where time naturally slows down. I especially loved the atmosphere on the second floor—quiet, airy, and perfect for sitting with your thoughts or a good book. The passion fruit lassi was refreshing with just the right balance of sweet and tangy, and the scone with homemade strawberry jam felt simple and comforting in the best way. A lovely place to pause, breathe, and enjoy small pleasures.
review_4_text: The second floor is really cozy. I recommend their toast with butter and Nutella. So tasty!
review_5_text: Hidden coffee gems in Chiang Mai. Open more than 10 years and the quality is still very good. This is a quiet place where you can stay calm and enjoy your day-off with a good coffee.

name: City Camp
review_1_text: Charming and unique place. I don’t like mala spice,so it was unpleasantly surprising that they spiced the chicken wings with that.
review_2_text:
That'ld be a nice choice for a date at this Romantic Camp vibe restaurant...
You have to order the foods&drinks with scanning the QR Or have to ask the waiter& waitress...
The Mala BBQ and Hotpot are the popular menu of the restaurant.
You will come again if you wanna avoid the typical live band playing Bar& Restaurants...
review_3_text: Good atmosphere to chill with friends. Good for party and functions at night time. Will come and again. Love to visit here
review_4_text: Very fun here . Good location
review_5_text:
City Camp, located on Kanklong Road in Chiang Mai, offers a spacious, clean, and convenient space that truly enhances the overall experience. The atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming, making it a great spot to spend time with friends or just relax. I felt excited and comfortable during my visit.

The food here is absolutely delicious! The dishes are packed with flavor, and the prices are definitely worth it. It’s a perfect spot to enjoy a casual meal that doesn’t disappoint.

I was really impressed by how everything came together – the food, the environment, and the friendly service. If you're looking for a place to hang out and enjoy great food in Chiang Mai, City Camp is definitely worth a visit. It's a fantastic choice for anyone wanting a good time in a cozy, laid-back setting

name: เมียงมอง Coffee & Drink
review_1_text: The atmosphere is good. The owner is kind and friendly. There are free snacks to go with your coffee. You can sit and relax all day.
review_2_text: Good water, good atmosphere, very good service.
review_3_text: The coffee tastes good.
review_4_text: delicious

name: UniqueCafe'byMook&Mom
review_1_text:
Cafe called Unique Cafe but how unique?  Not big, I would say rather small however rather cozy.  Also they have outside seating.  No pastries available.

Nice place to take a rest if u r nearby.

name: Inthanin Coffee
review_1_text: So I stopped in here to wait for a friend ordered an Americano. I was expecting bitter harsh taste. Instead I got a smooth almost cold brew like cup. Really great surprise. They have WiFi couches and seats. I didn't see any outlets though. Prices range from 35  to 80. Smoothie 65 and have prepackaged pastries and what not.
review_2_text: Lovely place, great staff and great coffee.
review_3_text: Good coffee good price but no free water !!!
review_4_text: Again something that said open but unable to make coffee.
review_5_text:
Intanin, a coffee shop located in a Bangchak gas station,
at a branch in Chiang Mai near the airport.
The shop is large and spacious, with chairs, a bar, and tables. It can accommodate about 15 people inside and another 4 people outside in a garden setting.
I was visiting Chiang Mai today, so I stopped by this cafe to meet up with my team. They have everything.
I ordered a hot Americano for 40 baht (members get a discount, so it's 35 baht).
I also ordered a croissant for 40 baht. It was incredibly soft and smooth, and delicious.
The shop is open from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
If you're passing through, stop by and enjoy a meal. The staff are friendly and helpful. They also sell souvenirs.

name: กระต่าย ชานมไข่มุก
review_1_text: Nice stand with friendly people
review_2_text: This small shop is located in the area of ​​the Thai Post Office. They have a wide variety of drinks at reasonable prices, starting at 20 baht. Free pearls are available for regular drinks. Fresh coffee costs 35 baht and up. They have seating and a loyalty card: buy 10 cups, get 1 free. The taste is sweet and delicious. The vendors are nimble and quick. You don't have to wait long. The service is good.

name: Meo Cafe’
review_1_text: Cute little cafe! Great coffee, great service.
review_2_text: I really liked this place.  It was right around the corner from where we were staying.  Nice quiet atmosphere off the main road.

name: คาร์แคร์ทิพเนตร & กาแฟสด
review_1_text: Good service, polite staff, clean wash, fast service, and affordable price. I'll definitely come back for another wash. Highly recommended.
review_2_text: I always come here to wash my car whenever I have something to do nearby. It's very clean and the service is great.
review_3_text: The price is cheap, the washing is clean, and the service is very satisfactory.
review_4_text: The car wash is very clean.

name: Mellow Cat Coffee (Coffee Shop. Not a cat cafe and not a hostel.)
review_1_text: Not the best I've tried but still good

name: THREE CHIANG MAI
review_1_text:
Great coffee place.
Found this cafe accidentally by passing near it.
Tasty coffee, professional serving, calm music, stylish interior.
Highly recommend! ✨
review_2_text:
If you’re in the mood for a good cup of coffee, this place is worth checking out. It’s a bit pricey for Chiang Mai, but totally fair for the quality. Their house blend already hit the spot for me.

Good vibe. Good-taste cafe.
review_3_text:
One hell of a coffee shop. The space is modest, but the coffee is incredible. No frills, serious bean-lover rodeo over at Three Nakhanik. It’s also pretty cool that they open at 8:33am and close at 3:33pm, and that they project old Cartoon Network cartoons onto the wall. Loved my coffee and the experience.

Update: I finally made it back to CNX and got to revisit THREE. Still love this place and I’m glad they seem to be doing well. I had a split espresso made into a tiny americano and piccolo. I used the Ethiopian bean which was really awesome! It really tasted like toffee. This is one of the best in Chiang Mai, forsure!

Update (Feb 29, 2026): Back once again. Showing a friend around Chiang Mai, and had to come by Three Coffee. Had two lattes, one with Ethiopian beans and one with Panamanian beans. Both were delicious. The shop is still as cool as I recall.
review_4_text: After three weeks of trying well-reviewed coffee shops, this is the first place I'd recommend if someone asked me where to go for good, interesting coffee. Both the flat white and the pour over were excellent, and really interesting beans too. Tasting notes appeared really clearly in the cup
review_5_text:
Date of Visit: August 24th

I visited because I heard this place has won many awards. The coffee had a bit of acidity, but the taste was not bad. It's cool and quiet, making it a good spot to get some work done. Since there's a Saturday market nearby, it would be nice to take a break here before heading to the market.

name: Spanner & Sproket Café
review_1_text:
Me and my boyfriend had an amazing experience with this motor rental!
We got a recommendation ourselves for this rental and when we got there the staff and the owner himself listened to our plans.

So at first we rented an easy scooter to cruise around Chiang Mai and the surroundings.

After that we swapped the scooter for two motorbikes (semi-automatic 125cc) to start our journey to Pai and after a few days back. This was the best decision!

The motors we rented were exactly what we wanted. A bit more than just a regular scooter and yet not the responsibility of driving a real motorbike. Super comfortable, easy to handle and a safe feeling riding them on the northern Thai hilly and curvy roads.
This was definitely a life time experience!!

The whole CBTT team is awesome and gives great tips for stops along the way, always there to help.

Definitely recommend this shop to everyone!
review_2_text: CBTT Cafe offers fantastic service for motorcycle rentals! The staff is friendly, professional, and made the entire process smooth and hassle-free. The bikes were in excellent condition, and they took the time to ensure everything was set up perfectly for my ride. Highly recommend CBTT Cafe for anyone looking to rent a motorcycle with top-notch service!
review_3_text:
Best bike/motor rental place in Chiang Mai! Got it recommended from a guy in the plane who had a super experience himself. Very friendly and helpful staff. Owner is himself an enthousiast and very open for a talk and has helpful tips.

We got two Honda 125cc semi-automatic motor scooters. The staff carefully listened to our plans (our plans for the route, for how long and level of experience). Based on our answers they recommended us those bikes. For us, not very experienced drivers but also not first timers, the bikes were perfect. They where easy to handle and made the drive fun!

Before we left the shop they sent us google maps pins, with their recommendation for stops along our planned route. We drove approx. 550 km in a few days, including the stunning road between Chiang Mai and Pai.

Quality-price ratio is also super so 10 out of 10!
review_4_text: Good
review_5_text: Thank you for making every journey of ours complete. 🤍

name: Bambino Jeweler
review_1_text: The best jewellery  in town♡♡♡♡ very trustworthy and creative. She can make your dreams come true♡♡♡♡
review_2_text: Small shop, but a competent owner. Makes many pieces of jewelry herself. Repairs, etc.

name: INDIAN Bites Cafe & Vegetarian and Vegan Restaurant
review_1_text:
Great veggie food. Lovely service. The recommend (their specialty) dish is excellent.

The garlic nan is very good.

Indian restaurants in Thailand are on the pricey side.. which I don’t know why.. so we would go when we crave for Indian food!!!

Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Our first Gujarati and Indian restaurant in Chiang Mai so we were excited. The staff was nice and friendly and took us in right away. The restaurant is located on a tourist friendly street. Here’s what we ordered:

Poha: texture and flavor on point! There’s a ton of ways to make poha and the way it was made was just right. Potatoes were soft and the sev on top gave a nice crispy texture.

Omlett sandwich: my wife absolutely loved it - the toast was crispy and the omlett on point. Very well made.

Franky paneer: filled with a lot of spices and boy was it amazing! Fist time having a Franky paneer and I was not disappointed.

Dabeli: my favorite dish on the menu! The masalo was on point and bread crispy. It’s also one of my favorite Indian dishes so I was happy to try such a dish here.

Ragda samosa: one of the least favorite dishes because the dish was soggy. However, the samosa itself was great.
review_3_text: We had a wonderful dinner here! As beginners to Indian food, the very kind owner took the time to explain the dishes, which made the experience even better. We shared the combination platter and every bite was full of amazing flavour. Modern, clean interior with comfortable air-conditioning. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
Dining at this Indian restaurant was more than just a meal; it was a wonderful experience. The owner is an absolute gem—warm, friendly, and genuinely passionate about his food. He treated us like family, and his willingness to prepare dishes specifically for us made the meal unforgettable. Every bite was bursting with flavor and made with fresh ingredients. If you're looking for incredible Indian Vegetarian food and top-notch hospitality in Chiang Mai, this is the place to go. You won't be disappointed.
A special mention to the Awesome Vadapav.
review_5_text: Absolutely delightful in every way. Very kind and attentive owner who recognized I was vegan without saying so, and let me know what had dairy without my prompting. The banana smoothie was perfect (not at all boring!), and the food was amazing. Wished we could have gone back a second time. Definitely try this place!

name: Smile Lanna Coffee & สมายล์ ล้านนา คอฟฟี่
review_1_text:
It is a cafe which is attached to the Smile Lanna hotel.
The cafe gets both indoor and outdoor area and both of them are well maintained.
The drink is with very reasonable price which most of them are cheaper than any other cafes in Chiang Mai.

I order a Matcha Honey Yuzu where the Match powder is not the Japanese one which makes the drink quite strange. I would say this is the worst Matcha Honey Yuzu that I have ever had.

Still recommend if u try other drinks as the place is calm and peaceful. Good for taking a rest.
review_2_text:
Always driving by, but this time we purposely went in for a lunch.
The location is on a busy intersection of the moat going to Airport Plaza and KAD so blink and you pass the entrance.
(Don’t blink go in!)
The owners are extremely proud of their hotel and this cafe, and so they should be.
It’s a very beautiful setting in a busy city.
The drinks and meal we had were well made and delicious.
Ample seating inside and out.
With great photo opportunities.
Gardens are maintained to a very high standard.
review_3_text: Beautiful little coffee shop at the entrance to Smile Lanna Hotel. Prices are rather fair and the garden is beautifully done with several small waterfalls and lots of flowers. Several places to sit with old world charm in each setting. Also several interesting artisan coffees week with a try. Need to come back to try more. Not a popular place so no crowds but just as nice as many of the “in places” right now.
review_4_text: A beautiful Café with a great Landscape and Koy Pond. Delicious Coffee
review_5_text:
Very disappointed.
I had breakfast at the coffee shop. There are 3 different sets. This is what I had, 'set c'.(Breakfast set, but not included a drink) Small portion of rice soup, 2 cold boiled eggs, and not fresh fruits. The food looked like they brought from their breakfast buffet. ( The buffet area of the hotel is right in front of the coffee shop.) The fruits were very dry, not any fresh. It looked like they were 'left over' which nobody wanted to take from the buffet.

I used to come here for a coffee, sometimes see friends for lunch and drinks. EspecialIy I like the coffee with coconut milk here very much. I maybe come back here for the coffee and lunch, but not for the breakfast.

name: ma lune (มาลูน) Thai Specialty Coffee Roaster
review_1_text:
I was thrilled when I realized Ma Lune was located across the street from the hotel I stayed at for 11 days. The owner, Ja, roasts local beans and serves them alongside a limited food menu with the help of one or two others. He’s a coffee enthusiast sharing his passion with whoever drops in - make conversation with him, try his incredible light roast espressos or drips, he may give you a taste of his latest roasts. The all day breakfast is a hearty, delicious meal but I only had it once, choosing to explore Thai options for food instead.

Recommend going before 9:30am or it might be 20 minutes til your order is made - this place gets busy with expats remote working in the mid morning.

Thank you Ma Lune for making such a lasting impression on me. I hope to visit you again in the future!
review_2_text:
Great coffee, made with clear passion and enthusiasm by the owner. Getting to taste such nice examples of Thai specialty-grade coffees is amazing.

This is clearly a place operated by someone who truly loves coffee. The DF60 grinder, with an 1zpresso handgrinder sitting next to it, a pair of fellow stagg kettles, and some fresh brew dripping from the v60 - behind the counter is someone who wants nothing more than to share the coffee they've roasted and offer the absolute best way of experiencing it.

Their tasting notes are right on the mark, too, which speaks to the experience and palate of the owner.

Every specialty coffee lover passing through Chiang Mai should go and experience this.
review_3_text: Vibe is comfy and adorable, service is great and staff greeted  us welcomely with a smile. Matcha was perfect and ginger lemon drink was refreshing. Would definitely recommend this peaceful relaxing cafe
review_4_text: I highly recommend this dog friendly little cafe. You can sit indoors or outdoors with your dog. I ate the delicious all day breakfast which will set me up for a whole day sightseeing. The musical ambience is relaxing and the coffee is the best yet on my trip around Thailand and the service impeccable. There are also scones with clotted cream and jam, cookies and Danish pastries. I found a little corner of heaven here. K̄hxbkhuṇ kh̀a
review_5_text: Lovely little coffee shop with a great choice of specialty coffees and friendly staff. I had the all day breakfast and it was DELICIOUS! Perfectly seasoned and light, while filling. Great prices too. Definitely recommend!

name: ROSE SIAM
review_1_text: Nice relaxing cafe with a selection of vegetarian meals and coffee at the temple. I had pineapple fried rice with pumpkin chips, but they also have a number of vegetarian combo sets.
review_2_text: Cute café to get respite from the sun. I had the siew mai, pineapple fried rice and a chai tea. 138 Baht. Satisfied my lunch appetite.
review_3_text: Nice cafe like a hidden gem near the temple. Cozy atmosphere and inexpensive desserts.
review_4_text: During my time in Chiang Mai I had about five different Americano-Orange drinks in five different coffee shops. Americano-Orange is my favourite drink and here I liked it the most. The quality was always similarly good in all five coffee shops but here I had the special vibe of being close to the Silver Temple, also, the cup was a little larger than in the other places, and it was a little lower price than elsewhere.
review_5_text: Very nice coffee.

name: บัวผัน คาเฟ่
review_1_text: The drinks are inexpensive and they also sell snacks. The pies come in many flavors and are so cute I don't dare eat them 😅 They're too cute, 12 baht each. They also have a chicken pie in white sauce and a ham and cheese pie, 25 baht each. The butter cake is moist. I ordered a drink, a yuzu Americano (Valencia orange juice), which was delicious with lots of orange flakes. The Thai tea was smooth and mellow. They also have products from activities promoting careers for psychiatric patients to support. The baristas are polite and provide excellent service. Please stop by and support them.
review_2_text:
Coffee shop in Suan Prung Hospital.
Great coffee, friendly and attentive baristas, good service, and reasonable prices.
I recommend the Yuzu Americano. The coffee is fragrant and has a hint of yuzu. The orange juice has pulp and is well-balanced.
review_3_text: Buaphan Coffee Shop is a coffee and beverage shop located inside Suanprung Hospital. They serve high-quality coffee with excellent taste and provide impressive service.

name: Hot Music Café
review_1_text: Very very cute and friendly owners! Absolute hidden gem on the way to the silver temple. Check it out 🫶
review_2_text: I just stopped here for a coconut but the place is so cute and the owners were so super kind and generous to me. I recommend this as a tranquil spot with authentic good Thai vibes :)))
review_3_text: The sweetest cafe owners ever! Chanced upon this place while walking around the street and it turned out to be one of the more memorable places I’ve eaten at. Give them a shot!

name: ปลายฟ้า coffee
review_1_text: A beautifully designed place and café, right in the city center, perfect for taking a break and enjoying a coffee, smoothie or many other things.

name: Nui Coffee
review_1_text: It's a quaint and unassuming little coffee shop, the menu isn't extensive but they do what they do well. Would recommend the iced Thai tea and the iced latte! The staff were all smiles and very welcoming, give it a go for a drink stop on a hot day!
review_2_text: The freshest coconut we had in Thailand so far! So nice to come sit here with the lovely ladies hosting us so kindly. Perfect resting place after the busy temple.
review_3_text: their coconut smoothie is the best one I've had in Thailand so far! and the owner is really nice too :)
review_4_text: I have no idea I could never find it you need some signs...
review_5_text: Really nice coffee and amazing service. The owner is super-nice, friendly and cheerful.

name: Nanta Baker
review_1_text: Very clean bakery & coffee house. They have also hotel in same location. I had coffee and cranberry sconde. The selection of different pasties could be bigger. They didn't have breakfast for visitors. Friendly staff.
review_2_text:
The pâtissière and owner, Nan, is a graduate of Le Cordon Bleu.

Delicious pastries, and a good selection of single-origin coffee beans from Brazil, Colombia, Guatemala, and Kenya.

During my long stay at the hotel, I tried the choco-banana cake, croffles, croissants, fruit cake, madeleines, and mocha cake - all are excellent. My favourite was the fruit cake, the fruit from which is soaked in rum before cooking.

Very relaxed and homey ambience; jazz playing in the background.
review_3_text: Cozy vibes and amazing hospitality from the owner.
review_4_text: Great coffee and tea, lovely stuff, tasty food. We ate a scrambled egg on toast and a croissant with cheese and ham. Not many choices of food though.
review_5_text:
Just bought croissants from this place. At 75 bahts a piece I was expecting something good.
First, at the opening hour, it wasn't fresh and came from a fridge. Second, instead of the good buttery smell I was expecting, it reeked of rancid butter...

I strongly advise against buying from this shop.

name: สหบาน (SAHABAAN.COFFEE)
review_1_text: Nice Place, not so crowded. 5 min from Chiang Mai Gate market by foot. You can choose bean for  your coffee from light to dark roast. Very enjoy :)
review_2_text:
Coffee was good,

You can choose your coffee roast (medium, dark)
Nice and cozy atmosphere
Good prices
review_3_text:
A cozy coffee spot, this place  is definitely worth a visit.
