👍🏻⭐️Quiet and peaceful setting,high-quality drip coffee, good matcha-Matcha good ,affordable prices and near Chiang Mai Gate.
review_4_text:
Great coffees, amazing hospitality!

This cosy cafe is a passion project to a very friendly host. The coffees here are brewed using moka pot and aeropress using beans roasted from their own plantation. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area!
review_5_text: Excellent coffee in a charming small cafe like a secret place. Great hospitality!

name: Coffee Alley
review_1_text: I went to give alms here on Saturday morning. The atmosphere was very good. It was full of Lanna atmosphere.

name: De Cassowary
review_1_text: good atmosphere

name: Chiangmai koi by AE
review_1_text: Delicious food and good service.

name: Cozy Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Very good food, the service is great, everything is made to order which I love. The atmosphere is very chill and quiet. It’s like sitting in your living room to have a meal. So lovely. I’ve eaten here three times now and haven’t been disappointed with any of my meals. The fruit shakes are a must try and the matcha is just as good!
review_2_text: Really good food both Thai and western. Best fried chicken in town. Lots of tree and outdoor dinning area is recommended. Parking is available.
review_3_text: Cozy and very relax. We have been there in the afternoon try to find the place to escape the sun. The waiter is kind enough to turn on the air con for us. We ordered cold pressed and yogurt drink. They are very nice and fresh.
review_4_text: I love this cafe so much. This is the best cafe I’ve been to ever. Sitting outside with the breeze, a delicious coffee, and amazing meal heals me every time. I highly recommend this cafe if you’re looking for a slow morning in the Chiang Mai area.
review_5_text:
We adore this place. The coffee is consistently superb (top tier amongst the coffee shops we’ve tried in Chiang Mai). The food is delicious and great value for money. And the service is warm and friendly each and every time.

Great coffee. Great food. Great people.

How could this be anything other than a 5-Star highly recommended spot?

name: Poon Coffee & Restaurant
review_1_text:
I've been eating there almost every day for the past 6 weeks. Everything is good: Thai food, European food, coffee, breakfast.
Mike and Poon are the best hosts, always welcoming you with a smile.
It can be very busy sometimes, so don't be in a hurry. Take your time and give them a chance, you won't regret it!
review_2_text: The lady and gentleman are both very nice. I have been there several times. The breakfast or lunch are all delicious and served beautifully. They have European food , Thai food , and drinks. Definitely will be there again.
review_3_text: Lovely Place, Amazing Food, Nice Staff and not expensive at all, was here for 4 days in a row and everything was delicious. Would definitely recommend. Orange Juice, Iced Latte & Honey-Banana Toast With Scrambled Egg for 225 Baht.
review_4_text:
You can live abroad for years, eat like a local, learn the rhythms, and swear you don’t miss a thing.

Then one random morning your brain whispers, not in Thai: tuna sandwich.

I’ve had plenty over the last couple of years, chasing that simple, salty, familiar bite like it’s a postcard from another life. And without a doubt, Poon Coffee & Restaurant (พูนคอฟฟี่) makes the best tuna sandwich in all of Chiang Mai.

It starts with the bread. Toasted just right, that sweet spot between sturdy and tender. Light butter. The kind of toast that makes a quiet crunch and then gets out of the way.

Then the tuna. Not a polite little smear. A real amount. Seasoned well, stacked between three slices of bread like someone decided you deserved a double-decker moment.

On the side: crisp lettuce, tomatoes, onions, plus a slice of watermelon and dragonfruit, like a small edible reminder that you’re not back home at all, and that’s kind of the point.

I washed it down with an Americano, the way I always do. Ice water alongside. A small cookie, because Thailand is generous like that.

“Heaven” is a big word, but breakfast like this earns it. If you’re in Chiang Mai and you get that sudden craving for something that tastes like memory, go see the good people at Poon Coffee & Restaurant. They’ll take care of you.

P.S. they have lots of Thai and Western food too!
review_5_text: Delicious shrimp fried rice! Definitely hit the spot. Cute and cozy place with a good atmosphere for working. Seemed like a lovely place where everyone knew each other.

name: DoReTea Café & Studio
review_1_text: Absolutely amazing! The best doughnuts I’ve ever had – fresh, soft, and perfectly airy. We tried the coconut, cinnamon, and glazed ones, and each was delicious. The coffee and smoothie were fantastic too. Highly recommend! ☕🍩
review_2_text: I ordered takeaway so I’m not sure about service or environment. I ordered the glaze donut, chocolate donut and Thai tea. The glaze donut was delicious and tasted fresh. The chocolate donut was dry and did not taste fresh. The Thai tea tasted nice, not overly sweet but the portion was so disappointing. Even when I filled the cup with ice at home it was not nearly full.
review_3_text:
Really cosy café with nice owner! Inside of the shop is decorated as a living room, so we felt so comfortable and chill there!

Donuts have amazing taste and are good priced. So soft and fluffy that you cant stop eating 🤣🤣
review_4_text: Really lovely, chill cafe with great donuts, food and drinks. The owners are really kind and lovely. I know Khun Noom who is a talented guitarist, guitar teacher and music producer. Noom also teaches guitar and can produce any sort of music in his home studio at reasonable prices.
review_5_text: This place is great. We were there in the middle of a weekday and it was pretty quiet. It has a calm and peaceful feel to it. We had three donuts (strawberry, coconut, and chocolate). They were very light and fluffy. We also had a coffee and and a Thai tea. I know you can get Thai tea everywhere but this one was so rich and creamy. We had all of that for 170 baht.  The service was quick and very nice. I think this place will become one of our favorites.

name: Casa VESPA • BAR & CAFE
review_1_text:
I happened to stop by and the drinks were delicious. The friendly owner
left the restaurant while chatting with a customer, but he came outside to say hello.
review_2_text: It's good to rest quietly. The bathroom is very clean.
review_3_text: A perfect place for an afternoon chill ;). Highly recommended.

name: Jomkwan Coffee Café @Wualai
review_1_text: Although the shop is currently under renovation, I think I'll definitely be back to this coffee shop next year. Today I ordered an iced cappuccino. The flavor was well-balanced and not too sweet. The owner was very friendly. I like this place.
review_2_text:
Really lovely coffee shop with great coffee on silver street.

Lovely calm vibe instead and great tasting coffee.

Lovely staff.

Would recommend
review_3_text: Such nice lovely owners which are taking care of their customers. We ordered several times different smoothies with no sugar added for 35 baht each and all of them were delicious (cantaloupe, Orange, lychee…). Thank you 🙏
review_4_text: Excellent smoothies and lovely service. I asked for less sugar and she adjusted it to exactly my taste by making try a few times. So thoughtful.
review_5_text: Best smoothies in Chiang Mai - and the owners are so friendly! We have come here every day of our month-long vacation in Chiang Mai!

name: Urge!!Sunday slow-bar
review_1_text:
A little pop up coffee shop that is open on Sundays.
Waiting for the day that I can go whenever I want my coffee fix.
It is a slow bar and Bomb the barista really knows what he is doing.
He takes his time to brew the coffee and make it to perfection.
I had the Indo blend and it was so fragrant and delicious.
I chilled on the camping chairs and watch people go by.
Really a great atmosphere!

Will go back again until they open a permanent shop.
review_2_text: Good coffee. The shop is open every Sunday.

name: 8 Cafe&Beyond
review_1_text: Best breakfast in Chiang Mai - home made sausages, proper crispy bacon and the eggs cooked to perfection. Also good strong coffee, best way to start the day!
review_2_text: Great new place with delicious breakfasts,  and amazing coffee and cakes! An excellent addition to the neighbourhood: try them out!

name: herbal juice by tonnam
review_1_text: Fresh, delicious, clean herbal juice with sweetness from stevia.

name: Ego Death Coffee
review_1_text: Great iced coffee, fair prices, and friendly barista. It's conveniently located right in front of the laundromat.
review_2_text: the coffee is really good and cheap and the guy is very nice and kind
review_3_text: Iced coffee is very good!! 😁

name: ดอกปีบชานมไข่มุก Dokpeep buble milk tea and fresh coffee
review_1_text: Doesn’t exist anymore. It’s now a grocery store.
review_2_text: Pink milk with whipped cream @Dokpib Pearl Milk Tea
review_3_text: Cheap and good, the price is satisfactory.

name: Haiya Ta-Bur Experience Space
review_1_text: Nice interior, good service, friendly barista with good English speaking, relaxed and good atmosphere. ✨ Pretty nice and cosy place if you need a break in your day. I ordered iced matcha latte and it was good. They have plant-based milk options. 🙏🏼 Thank you, I will come back!
review_2_text:
Great drip coffee in the morning and wine selections!

We were there in the morning for some coffee. The lady (who I assumed is one of the owners) were very welcoming and very friendly.

The shop offers great wine selections from different regions. Chocolate bars sourced from local produce and some cool coffee gadgets.

The food selection include western and Thai dishes. Which mainly focus on beef dishes.

We returned again for evening drinks. Tried their sliced beef bowl with sunny side egg and a side of fries. The food took some time but throughly prepared.

Overall the experience at the shop both morning and evening was great. Helpful staff, great foods&drinks selection and awesome relaxing vibe at the shop.

If you would like to support this small business to continue, I strongly recommend you to give them a visit 😉
review_3_text: Very beautiful little café doesn’t have AC on but will turn it on upstairs if u like. no one is ever here which is great for doing work.
review_4_text: Such a cute and relaxed space. My breakfast sandwich was absolutely delicious. Service was amazing also. Would definitely come back to this place.
review_5_text:
Good coffee but limited choice of food
Good atmosphere. Good flow of air

name: Bloom cafe&alfresco
review_1_text:
We really enjoyed eating here. The atmosphere was great and the staff were super friendly and helpful! The lady even ran down the road to fetch a bandaid for us when Byron stubbed his toe!

We stayed at the attached guest house and that too was lovely, spacious and had a beautiful design.
review_2_text: Nice location, good food, but bring some time and don’t be too hungry as the service is quite slow.
review_3_text: Enjoyed a tasty breakfast here a few times over the past week. Friendly, helpful staff.
review_4_text: Food is normal. Coffee is too bitter. Interior decoration is beautiful, very girly.
review_5_text: Nice café, good coffee.

name: Sigma cafe wualai ซิกมา คาเฟ่ วัวลาย
review_1_text: Cute little cafe with good WiFi (I video chatted from there). Tucked away with hanging greenery and flowers adding to the ambiance. Cheap price for a good iced cappuccino. Did have a lot of mosquitoes in the back corner, but they went away after a little bit.
review_2_text:
Cafe with garden atmosphere.they serve very good arabica coffee and real delicious thai tea  and green tea. Very cheap price and nice customer services.Free WiFi as well.i spend all day with only 40 thb coffee.
They can give you about travel information and Many tour programs for you.

name: Family Home 2 Chiang Mai
review_1_text: ‏ stayed at this hostel for three nights and had a fantastic experience. The beds were very comfortable, which ensured a good night's sleep. The best part was the atmosphere; it was incredibly welcoming and social, making it easy to meet and connect with other travelers. The staff were friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a great hostel experience.
review_2_text:
I stayed in the dorm and had a really good experience. The place has a warm, home-like atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable right away.

The dorm was clean and well maintained, with a relaxed vibe that made it easy to rest and meet other travelers. The staff were very kind and helpful, always happy to assist and share local tips.
review_3_text: Loved this place. Incredibly social hostel without any of the “free shots at the bar” forced fun type stuff. There’s just a really nice social area where everyone chills and makes friends. They also have daytime and nighttime activities organised every day with loads of people going on them. Staff really lovely too
review_4_text: My first stay at a hostel and was absolutely blown away with an unforgettable experience. The entire staff was incredibly friendly and accommodating, offering breakfast, laundry and drinks for generous prices, assisting in planning excursions, and flexible for check in/out times. Socially, there were always things to do and people to talk with, the amenities were always clean, the rooms were quiet and could fall asleep easily. I will never forget my experience here and cannot recommend enough
review_5_text: Love how social this hostel is. Even when you don't stay with them, you can book their daily sticky waterfall tours! I'll definitely visit this place when I'm back in Chiang mai. The staff are so friendly and helpful which really makes you feel a part of their family too.

name: Koff & Things
review_1_text:
Koff & Things offers a truly refined experience for those seeking a peaceful start to their day. The establishment boasts a unique and thoughtfully designed interior that creates a warm, welcoming atmosphere. It is an ideal sanctuary for focused thinking or enjoying a book in solitude.

Both the coffee and matcha are prepared to a good standard, reflecting a commitment to quality. Whether you are a connoisseur or a casual visitor, the serene ambiance and excellent beverages make this a must-visit destination in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended for those who appreciate a quiet, aesthetic space.
review_2_text:
One of my favorite coffee shop in Chiang Mai!! I came here twice during my vacation.
The dirty coffee is very good, just like my standard.
And the place is sooo nice, it decorated with an old Japanese style / more like Kyoto style with wooden wall, windows, and floor. I can sit an hour there just to enjoy the place, the music, and my coffee.
review_3_text:
Stunning exteriors and interiors with a cozy furnishings. There are seating for singles, small groups and there even is a private room for larger groups.

Drink selection is wide with both coffee and non coffee. There are several signature drinks and seasonal drinks too.

There is no Pour Over option tho.

I had the flat white and the blooming flowers.

The flat white is decently thick with pronounced flavors from the beans. The milk pairs well with chosen beans but this is not the best milk we have tried. However, I like it overall.

The blooming Flowers is refreshing and even tho it has hints of sweetness, we never got tired of it. It’s a nice change of pace on a hot day and you’ve had too much coffee.

I recommend the place for your next coffee crawl.
review_4_text: Not my favorite coffee, but one of the most beautiful cafes. Traditional style lanna teak house with cozy upstairs. Natural light filters through the big windows. You can watch the moat traffic at the nearby gate outside. Great chill space. Also has a small meeting room.
review_5_text: Well worthy of five stars. Probably the best caramel macchiato I’ve had, ever. Peach tea was very good and the cookie 🍪 was also really delicious. Love the Japanese style decor and the staff were friendly 😎 oh yeah and that’s a Pegasus in the coffee 🤩☕️

name: จักรพรรดิ อารมณ์ดี Coffee
review_1_text: There are three cats that guard the coffee house/temple. Inside there is an Oni that guards the kingdom as well. It's like a little Buddhist temple coffee house. They welcomed me and fed me. Most grateful 🥰🙏🏼🔥
review_2_text: Americano here is really good. Service is 5 star!
review_3_text: Good Americano.
review_4_text: There's delicious coffee, peace, and a sacred atmosphere. Everyone can come and join in the chanting. 🙏
review_5_text: Clean, bright, and peaceful. Enjoy delicious coffee while listening to chanting. You can also make merit by purchasing sacred objects directly from the temple and the abbot. The second floor is suitable for meditation and chanting. Followers of Luang Pu Doo and Luang Ta Ma are welcome. The Chakraphat chanting for karmic adjustment is available at any time. Located in Chiang Mai city center, it's easily accessible. There is limited parking in front of the shop, but you can park across the street on the inner sidewalk near the temple and walk over to buy coffee.

name: NU NU NINI's CAFE'
review_1_text: Stopped for a quick morning coffee on the way out. Very sweet staff, you get a glass of iced water with your coffee which is a nice touch. Great for watching the daily hustle of the traffic, which of course makes it a little noisy. Still very good though.
review_2_text:
Great view… if you’re skilled at mentally photoshopping out the forest of power lines.
As for the coffee — let’s just say the scenery ended up being the stronger part of the experience 😅
review_3_text: Very good location. Nice coffee shop. I had coffee with apple pie, it was tasteful. Friendly staff.
review_4_text: I NEVER take sugar in my coffee, but the girl who took my order thought I asked for some. It was too sweet and tasted bad. Hopefully, she learns to listen more carefully when taking orders.
review_5_text:
This little corner coffee shop is absolutely one of our favorites in Chiang Mai!
The owner roasts her own coffee every day (which sometimes smells amazing) and grinds it fresh for every coffee drink.
They make some amazing lattes and cappuccinos, but also have a wide variety of other choices.
There is seating on the street level that is open, but if you prefer a quieter place to relax or work, there is a large, air conditioned room upstairs with couches and tables where you can sit and enjoy your time.
Free WiFi is available.
They have coffee and tea drinks, milk drinks, sodas, water, and smoothies, as well as really great danishes, croissants, and desserts. Ice cream is available, too.
Prices are really reasonable for the high quality.
We will keep recommending this little place to all of our friends!

name: Brecht.
review_1_text: Very cool cafe. Dark theme. Love the Americano (not acidic!) the soda is aesthetically pleasing. Fried chicken and pops are decent. The egg avo toast is good! (it was dark and aircon wasn't switch on when we arrived - save electricity I suppose) we were the only table there at 11ish
review_2_text:
Pros: 1. Beautiful decorations & ambience; 2. Friendly server behind the counter; 3. They serve my almond croissant fresh out of the oven.

Cons: 1. They covered my croissant with powdered sugar.  A little sprinkle would have been enough; 2. Cappuccino not as good as other coffee shops I had tried in CM; 3. I paid California price in Thailand.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience and I will return, cos the almond croissant I had was amazing, sans the excessive powdered sugar.
review_3_text:
Great pastries. The donut was maybe a bit too sweet for my liking and the croissant a bit dry. They were semi reasonably priced but the drinks were quite expensive. Felt like I was paying Sydney prices which kind of brought the experience down.
But! The interior and exterior design is absolutely stunning. Not much in this area with that level of design.
review_4_text:
This place really hits the spot.

The croissant is crispy and flakey on the outside, just the right amount of baked. Buttery and soft on the inside, but not chewy.

The cute barista suggested a dark roast for my hot latte and it didnot disappoint. Really good cuppa on a rainy day.

For me the place  is a little too edgey and strange and the seating isn't that cozy. It didn't matter once I had a sip of coffee 😉
review_5_text:
Visited on 2 December 2023, 0820.

Ordered a triple chocolate croissant and a latte for 185 baht.

The good thing is that the croissant is not overly sweet and with the chocolate, it wasn’t overly dry. Perhaps due to the type of butter or flour used, the croissant wasn’t fragrant. It was light and fluffy but lacks the making of a quality croissant.

Latte didn’t have the wow factor.

Should be at best 3.5 stars. But rounded off to 4 for the not too bad service and the music was not overly loud at the point of time I was there.

name: บ้านลมเจย Baan Lom Joey coffee & homemade bakery
review_1_text: Probably their first visitor from Kosovo (as people say here)! Had americano for few days in a row and some eggs. Owner is nice and welcoming. I would recommend!
review_2_text: Highly recommend visiting here! The owner was sweet, welcoming and very hospitable. We got two Thai milks teas and one milk green tea. Everything was delicious! I will be back next time I come to Chiang Mai!
review_3_text:
What an amazing place to grab a coffee. Really good local coffee and relaxed atmosphere.

So good!
review_4_text: Amazing iced lattes with just the right amount of sweetness and the most insane fresh baked coconut chiffon cake!!! Soooo yummy 10/10 recommend
review_5_text: Such a sweet café! The owner is a lovely sweet lady. We went here twice during our stay in Chiang Mai because we really enjoyed the coffee and the waffles with nutella and cream. They even have oat milk for the coffee.

name: VIENNA DE CAFÉ
review_1_text:
They make tasty coffee from scratch, raw beans to roast to brewing.
We really enjoyed the drinks, service and atmosphere of this café.
review_2_text: Stopped to have a matcha. It was as I expected. While I didn’t eat here I did have a look at the menu and they have a majority plant based menu. Vegans and vegetarians would be just fine here.
review_3_text:
The coffehouse, which is run by Wolfgang from Austria, is a really tidy and fine Café where you can get a really amazing an tasty coffee as well as frappes and other coffee delicacies. On top, they offer freshly baked cakes which didn't disappoint either and were also tasteful.
Moreover, the owner is a really good guy who took the time to explain where he gets his beans from and also recommended different places that are worth a visit.
All in all, it was a real pleasure to spend time in Vienna de Café ♥️
review_4_text: Very nice Place with lots of excellent Coffee. Love the Cake and the Cappuccino is awesome!
review_5_text: Drinks were lovely, although I was disappointed they weren't serving food when I visited.

name: ชาพระนคร สาขาประตูเชียงใหม่ 潘纳空茶 Cha Phra Na Khon
review_1_text: The best Tea shop in Mueang Chiang Mai! I visited some mornings for my Vegan Iced Thai Tea with oatmilk for 50 THB. Very cute friendly man serving, I presume he is the owner.?... quick service, friendly and very tasty. He has good English. Definately recommend :-) perhaps you could offer dining in guests with a reusable glass mug rather than plastic. Kop Khun ka!
review_2_text: This tea shop is absolutely amazing! The environment is clean and cozy, with a charming decor that’s perfect for hanging out with friends or enjoying some alone time. Their black coffee tastes incredible—rich flavors with just the right balance of sweetness, and you can customize it to your liking, which is such a thoughtful touch. The staff are super friendly and welcoming, always serving with a warm smile
review_3_text: Thai tea is really good! For only 30 Baht 😊
review_4_text: Best cafe in Chiang Mai! The Thai milk tea is perfect, the prices are good and the staff are very friendly!
review_5_text: Great taste!! The owner patrick was very friendly

name: Big&O's Cafe
review_1_text: it's part of the hostel, just down the Soi, opposite Baan Bakery. There's free WiFi. An iced latte was 50 baht. They do food as well but I wasn't hungry. Pleasant relaxing background music.
review_2_text:
60 baht for a very small cup of coffee. Breakfast food mediocre. Omelett very fatty. Club Sandwich was okay.
Lots of hungover people (hostel guests) sitting around.
review_3_text: Coffee is too diluted. It tastes like water. 50baht is a bit pricey for watery coffee. Club sandwich is 99 baht. Fair.
review_4_text: I went to eat and it was delicious, also I noticed that they had tours and transportation, so after booking my minibus to Pai through them I also booked a tour to Maerim elephant sanctuary that they recommended to me and it was amazing! Great family run business!
review_5_text: Loved this hostel! It was small but the staff were so lovely. The beds were slightly uncomfy though

name: Rompho coffee
review_1_text: This coffee shop is a nice and cozy place. The coffee tastes good and the price is reasonable. The staff are friendly and helpful. It is a good place to relax and study.
review_2_text: Nice sharing space for monk chat and good  cheap price coffee.
review_3_text: Nice for nature air coffee with lovely people.
review_4_text: The best Thai Tea in Chiangmai
review_5_text: Acredito que o local tenha aberto há pouco tempo. Adorei o ambiente: junto de um templo, de frente para a rua e sob as árvores.  O côco estava bem geladinho e com um preço ótimo. Recomendo.

name: Su Fruit Shake
review_1_text: Best smoothie I’ve tried so far, and the price is amazing! 20 baht for one fruit and 30 baht for mixed fruits! You get a generous amount of fruit in the shake and the service is very smooth. The avocado smoothie is especially good as well as the passion fruit and coconut!
review_2_text: Everyday I buy fruits smoothie from different venders in Chiang Mai, Su is the best one, I really like it, must buy again!
review_3_text:
The value of super fresh fruit smoothie you get for 20 baht is insane. Find this lady and get yourself a smoothie...or two like I did.
Update: the same evening I came back for two more. All 4 that I tried were insanely fresh: coconut, papaya, mango, dragon fruit. The lady is super nice and speaks English. All stalls in this market have the same prices but this one had the fruits I wanted.
review_4_text: Clean stall, great smoothie, super friendly staff, and only 20 baht. Highly recommend!
review_5_text: Definitely the best fruit shakes in town ! The lady puts a lot of fruit in it, and she is really quick. Totally worth the 20 baht. Go for it !

name: ร้านพอหวาน
review_1_text: Por Wan Shop, a freshly blended fruit juice shop, fresh, clean, delicious and affordable.

name: Cha Ka Cher
review_1_text:
Just opened. A big smile in the land of smiles! 20 baht iced coffee and tea right next to the old city Kattam corner with it's water fountains.
I had the green tea and will come tomorrow for the coffee. Brewed - Not espresso
review_2_text: Nice thai tea, very kind people
review_3_text: Just took coffee to go, that was good

name: Lemon Lee
review_1_text:
Very charming, inexpensive little coffee shop right in the canal.
Stop for a coffee, iced drink, ice cream or even a beer or cocktail.

name: Maajoy Cafe & Tailor
review_1_text: perfect!! love the combo of an aesthetic place but still cheap thai food in it! The drinks were beautiful, i never had a strawberry matcha before and it was delicious. The server was really kind. Wish we discovered this place before!
review_2_text:
Thai tea and americano were really good 👍
The staffs are friendly and welcoming too 🙂
review_3_text: Found this gem of a cafe near our hotel! Coffee is amazing and the food absolutely delicious!! Have dined here two days in a row, the food is that good!! Nice cool setting and excellent service, highly recommend!
review_4_text: It’s so nice here! I was surprised that they served such delicious and cheap Thai food (50b for a good sized lunch portion). The drinks are a bit pricier relatively but still reasonable and good quality. Service is good, and the decor is cute-grunge-chic. Really nice quiet spot to grab a bite or hang out for a couple hours.
review_5_text: GUYS !!!!! This coffe it’s amazing wow, she made me a dirty coffe! Which she has this special milk mix super thick foam with  fresh coffe that splits up in the cup. It was amazing, and to get better I walked out with an epic second hand jacked! Alll for 300bath coffe + jacket! HAPPY DAYS ! Thanks joy

name: Anatolia Cafe&Bistro, Grill Turkish Restaurant+Rent Motorcyle
review_1_text:
Food was incredible! We had the beef and the chicken kebabs. The salads were quite tasty, too.
We will be back and bring friends.
review_2_text: A bit of a wait — 45 minutes to an hour for two meals — but it was totally worth it. Food was flavorful and quite literally, perfect.
review_3_text: I’m eating breakfast at 4:00 pm. A little late but delicious. Mediterranean focused with Thai as well. Very friendly family.  My third visit.
review_4_text: Food was so tasty! We really enjoyed our meal 🙂 would recommend
review_5_text: I got the English breakfast with a greek salad (had a skimpy dinner the night before) and I tell ya that hit the spot. The salad was really fresh with delicious Feta cheese. And the english breakfast was a step in a new direction with the mushrooms. The service was great. The terrace is next to a very busy street though so it is a little loud. Overall a great place to eat

name: Heartwork the Sharing Space
review_1_text: ​This is a fantastic co-working spot in Chiang Mai! The vibe is so warm and welcoming, and it's always quiet, which is perfect for getting work done. The Honey Lemon Soda is an absolute must-try, and the staff are wonderful. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Great spot for WFA. I require Wi-Fi, power outlets, a large table, a clean restroom, and air conditioning. It meets all my needs.

The cost is the price of a drink plus a 20 THB top-up.
review_3_text: Great coffee and good space with some good working chairs. It’s more like a very good workable cafe with good drinks than a coworking space. If you are sitting here, then they charge you 20thb extra, which is totally ok given the quality of the coffee by itself already and you get good tables, chairs, fans, AC. It’s well worth it if you wanna get some work done especially. My hot cappuccino was great.
review_4_text:
Workplace - Good and quiet
Coffee - Good
Food - A big NO!!!

I ordered the "pork omelette with rice," but I only received an "omelette with rice." Even though I didn't get what I paid for, I was charged the full price.

This place is only good for working, not for ordering food. The food isn't even made here. They order it from outside. I realized this too late when I saw someone bringing in food from another place.

Bad service!
review_5_text: Cute little cafe serving food and drinks. They have space upstairs with tables and chair for working but it gets crowded so if you want to secure a seat I suggest going early. Everyone is friendly and recommend if you need a quiet spot to work.

name: Berries Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: This was the only breakfast spot we trusted and kept coming back to during our entire stay in Chiang Mai. It’s a cozy hole-in-the-wall place with great food and a clean, pleasant atmosphere—no weird smells at all. Even the bathroom is spotless. They have books you can read, sell amazing cookies (which I brought along on the loop), and the staff are polite, friendly, and speak English. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Superb little restaurant close to town. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing. I went there for lunch and ordered the beef plate, shrimp toast with homemade sauce, fish n chips and shrimp pasta. Everything was very good and well presented.
The owner is super friendly and speaks perfect English.
I really recommend this restaurant for lunch or brunch, with the family, as a couple or even on your own.
A big thank you to the owner for his dedication and politeness to his customers ❤️🥇
review_3_text: My girlfriend stumbled upon this place and we decided to give it a try. And gosh were we glad we did. Besides the fact that this little cafe/restaurant looked really clean and cute, the food and drinks were absolutely phenomenal! You can really taste it was made with love. But what made this place special in particular was the owner Tim. He made us feel like home. Such a warm and humble person. He had a chat with us about our stay in Chiang Mai and even made us a list of things to do during the rest of our stay without us even asking for it. Absolutely a great guy and great place with great food and drinks. Highly highly recommend this place to anyone and everyone visiting Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: Something really went wrong, we arrived at the store and the owner was really nice, only after an hour we received 2 omelettes out of 3 dishes, and he told us that he didn't have ingredients to prepare the 3rd dish. That is - a whole hour without food and without certainty. The eggs were not cooked.. not a good experience to start the morning
review_5_text:
I'm so pleased this place opened in my area !
The restaurant is absolutely lovely, great ambience, it feels like home, it's so cosy, atmosphere relaxed with chill music.
Tim is so lovely with people, always trying to help you with anything he can without having to ask for it.
And the food... It's so delicious... I will try all the menu in the time I have here 😁
I can only recommend this place!

name: TAO Cafe & Community เต่าคาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ Hooman Boardgame house
review_1_text: Great coffee in a relaxed environment that has board games you can play.  There were a couple of Thai guys playing guitar whilst I was there which was great!  The barista that served me was called Bee and she introduced me to a little tradition that they have in the cafe. Basically you write a hallmark type message on a post it note and then the next customer gets that note on their coffee. I love that idea! #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: Coffee is ok, bulletproof is a signature drink ! Friendly staff and nice ambience. Excellent innovation community
review_3_text:
Great cafe but nothing there just a cafe.
Look at my photo you will see they're all close.
review_4_text: Good place, good coffee & Berkeley
review_5_text: Great food and drinks! Affordable prices. And the workers were really really nice to us and helped us out . Lovely place !!!!

name: Green Queen - Cannabis Shop
review_1_text: Mint is very friendly & professional, they have a great variety of selections and the best prices I’ve seen in Thailand, I would highly recommend this business to anyone.
review_2_text: ↖(^ω^)↗ The boss is a warm-hearted handsome guy. The products are great and he gave us a discount and a small gift
review_3_text: Good weed good prices the most expensive one is 299 baht for 1g and its very good
review_4_text:
Best coffeeshop with best manager !! 🤠
Some Bubble 🍌 Gummy 50% +
Crazy stuffs here !
review_5_text: Best place I have came across! Worth the visit! Good quality and great customer service

name: venice home cafe
review_1_text: We went to this place twice during our stay for pineapple smoothies with yogurt. They were delicious and the staff was really kind.

name: Coffee waf
review_1_text:
Found this cafe with a good review while looking for a place to get some work done, and yes, the reviews were all correct. I really love this place.

First of all, the weather was cool that day, so it felt so nice with a good morning vibe in the open-air area, and they even have charging spots. The staff are really nice and give warm hospitality.

The coffee is not bad and I enjoyed it, though the ice was a bit too much and made the flavor fade a little. Still, it is cheap and definitely worth trying.
review_2_text: Al last! Find my little oyster 😂 awesome coffee! I love coffee and looking for a new creative but GOOD COFFE! Yummy highly recommend it 🙏🇹🇭
review_3_text: Coffee Waf is such a lovely little café! The owner makes every cup of coffee with so much passion and care. You can really taste it. The prices are very reasonable, and the coffee tastes absolutely delicious. Whether it’s a cappuccino or any other coffee, she puts her heart and enthusiasm into every single one. A real hidden gem! ☕
review_4_text: Super cute cafe! If you craving for decent oat milk coffee then this is the place for it! Also try out Orange Presso with ice- nicely sour and refreshing espresso kick 🤭💗
review_5_text: Perfect spot for coffee chillout with pleasant atmosphere, nice people/visitors and very kind coffe making lady.

name: Feel Friday Cafe
review_1_text: นั่งเล่นเพลินดี  กาแฟหอม  ปอเปี๊ยะกุ้งชีสอร่อย nice place , coffee and cheesy shrimp  spring rolls  are good taste.

name: Ma-chill Coffee
review_1_text:
You love coffee?
Your needs might very well be satisfied here.
Very good coffee and super tasty pastries.
Unfortunately the place is a little small.
review_2_text:
What a cool and cute place.
I felt like I was in Europe for one hour 😊
The chocolate croissant was really tasty, and the cold brew was just how I like it.
review_3_text: Best roastery and coffee in town. Very chill vibes with great taste of music all day long. I love it. I’ve been coming here since many years, and they did a great effort to make the place better and keep up with quality coffee beans and delicious home made pastries 😋
review_4_text: One of the best espressos in chiang mai. You can choose the coffee you want too. You enjoy every sip. Never burnt. Perfect flavor. Iced coffee never tastes watered down because the espresso is rich. Great milk alternatives (extra 10 baht). Also always has really good music. Cool people work there
review_5_text: Lovely oat lattes, cakes and pastry were really tasty. Bonus is they have a sweet doggie who is super friendly.

name: Sinners N Saints Kafe and Pool Bar
review_1_text:
"Sinners N Saints Kafe and Pool Bar" is a bit of a mouthful but that's its name and you can find it on Kampangdin Road about 2 minutes walk south from Sridonchai Road, the intersection where you find Gekko Restaurant.

It is known for its good pool tables and playing there, but we went for another reason, it's a bar specialising in 'kava' drinks. I won't go into that here but check it out on the internet if you don't know kava drinks.  They are non-alcoholic but give you a bit of a soft buzz.  Sinners N Saints Kafe offers a good range of mocktails using kava and I tried a couple of them, finding them very tasty.

Another feature that marks this establishment out is that the owner Kevin has worked hard to open it out at the back where there is the new Mae Kha Canal wooden walkway, that runs along the back of his establishment.  Kevin has provided a delightful place to sit with a drink and enjoy the sun going down, bearing in mind that you will need protection against the mosquitoes.

A really great place to chill out and enjoy.
review_2_text: Best place in Chiang Mai to catch a a friendly game of pool on solid tables. Drinks are cheap, and there’s tons of great non alcoholic options if you don’t feel like drinking. Tables are free just have to spend 100 bhat and can play as long as you like. The owner Kevin is a super chill guy who will join you for a game. The crowd is also cool, some good players but not an overly competitive environment. Also, only kava and kratom bar I’ve found around. 10/10 recommend this place.
review_3_text: Great food. Very relaxing place to hang. There's seating out back and the newly installed boardwalk by the city. Friendly staff.
review_4_text:
New pool game focussed Bar in Chiang Mai.

3 Pool tables
4 Aircons
Little relaxed garden / outside seating.
Great coffee
Opens early which is a huge plus!

Amazing yet affordable food.
Got a very experienced Thai chef!
Ask for the tamarind chicken and the asparagus chicken. Small but really worth it!

What’s outstanding as well is that they make their own burger Patties from fresh meat. Chicken, Pork, Beef in exceptional quality!
review_5_text: Thank you for the cava mojito cocktail with no alcohol!  At last an health and tasty alternative to alcohol when you don't drink They have a bunch of classic cocktails with alcohol too.

name: Rywin Cafe
review_1_text: Very nice and clean restaurant with excellent food and service. The family running it were very welcoming. We ordered the khao soi, masaman curry and mango sticky rice. The khao soi was very good but the masaman was really exceptional and one of the best we’ve had in Chiang Mai. The mango sticky rice was also exceptionally good. The only issue is that everything is somewhat more pricy than many others serving the same foods. But again, when the food is this good, it’s worth it!
review_2_text: Terrific little cafe!! Highly recommend coming here. I have had 7 mango sticky rices in Thailand so far and this one was the best I have had in my entire life. The caramel macchiato was perfect, not too sweet. And the peach soda was fizzy and refreshing. If you are in the area, please come in and support this small business. Our waiter was so sweet and accommodating!
review_3_text:
This place was on point for dinner.  We both had the Massaman Curry with tofu and rice and Rywin Cafe stepped up.

The food was great, the owner is a character and the restaurant itself was nice.

To note, we waited almost an hour for our food to come which is pretty ridiculous.  We sat down seconds after another group did who got their order in before us. Luckily the food was delicious and the owner apologized profously but an hour long wait is pretty stupid.
review_4_text:
This place!!! I came by on a walk one day and ended up eating luch here almost every day after that for a month. Their Khao Soi is to die for, not chicken on the bone, just the white meat and they adjust spice to your liking. The spring rolls are another favorite.
I recommend this place to everyone I know and I can't wait to be back myself. This is my first stop out of the airport!!

The owners are the sweetest elderly couple, they cook everything themselves and will go out of their way to help you.
12/10 will always recommend!
Khop khun kaa 🙏🏽
review_5_text: Great little cafe in Chiang Klan Sub-district. Great Khoa Soi (even made a vegetarian version for me), papaya salad and a yummy breakfast menu. Beautiful Thai Milk Tea and coffee. Lovely couple who run the cafe!

name: 1st For Coffee (CO1FFEE)
review_1_text: A lovely coffee shop! The inside cute and has a calming atmosphere. We ordered an es Yen and a caramel macchiato - both were fabulous. We were able to pick our roast, which was an unexpected nice touch. We will definitely visit again!
review_2_text:
Best coffee in Chiang Mai!
We came here every day during our stay – a cozy, small, locally owned coffee shop with a relaxed and calm atmosphere. The owner is incredibly friendly and clearly passionate about coffee.
You get to choose your own coffee bean roast – light, medium, or dark – which makes the experience even more personal. The coffee and tea taste amazing, and you can also buy beans to take home with you.
The prices are also very reasonable for both hot and cold drinks. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
Very positive experience. Only 45 baht for a delicious Americano, and they did not charge me extra for oat milk.
You get the choice of 3 coffee beans with different roast levels and origins.
Staff speaks great English and is very friendly and welcoming.
They have some seating with a relaxed vibe and tasteful music.
This seems to be the sweet spot for price and quality.
review_4_text:
I love my coffee and this place does excellent coffee! Reasonably priced, excellent set up, I love that you can choose between light, medium and dark roast.
Great service with a smile!! I will be back for more 🙂
review_5_text:
yummy coffee at a cute, small shop! 55 baht for an iced hazelnut macchiato plus 10 baht more for oatmilk (totally reasonable, some places upcharge 30+ baht!!)

They allow you to customize roast (light, medium, dark) and ask about the sweetness level you’d like!

One of my fav coffees Ive had in CNX 🥰☕️

name: Mosaic Market & Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Lovely secret gem! This place is decorated will love, care and style. I went there during their Christmas Market fair and it was really nice to enjoy the atmosphere, Christmas music and browse around their handmade selection of products and then enjoy a nice tea while chilling in their living room area. Very quiet, super friendly staff, they also have delicious cakes and very affordable prices. If you're looking for crafts, handmade souvenirs and presents, this is the place to get them. They're so conscious and eco-friendly, and sell many natural skin products, essential oils, creams, candles, clothes, bags, jewelry and much more. I'll definitely visit this place again!
review_2_text: It was such a friendly and relaxing environment in Mosaic market where a cup of coffee relaxes you, and the staff smilingly cheers your presence, which I think is a very good service for people to connect with. The bag I bought was of good quality with a reasonable price. It's a place indeed for a community to connect one another with love and joy.
review_3_text:
This place is wonderful! Open until 6.30pm which is a bonus.

Such a lovely quiet space to work or meet a friend. They also have an upstairs with bookable meeting rooms and more space to relax. Comfortable sofas.

Lots of light from the big windows. Drink selection is great, cookies are yummy!
review_4_text:
A lovely shop, i use it as a cafe, due to it having great coffee and food, but it also sells clothes and crafts made accross Asia. Very ethical, spacious, beautifully decorated, and has brilliant WiFi if you need to work in your laptop.
The mint latte is superb, and there is an excellent selection of sweet and savoury snacks.
Most importantly, the staff are wonderful, so attentive and friendly! An absolute gem of a shop
review_5_text:
I love the co-working space this beautiful social enterprise has! Two floors of seating, delicious cookies/cakes and lunch pies 😋

Ill definitely come back again soon. 🥰

name: La Friandise Restaurant & Coffee Shop
review_1_text: Cannot recommend this restaurant enough. chef Jerome has worked in Can Fabes which is the first Spanish restaurant to be awarded 3 Michelin stars. He then worked in various Michelin restaurants before opening his own in Chiangmai. The restaurant is cozy with very good ambience and service is very attentive and warm. The home made terrine is to die for whereas my favorite is the prawn risotto. It is one of the best risotto I have ever had and I highly recommend this dish. The chef is very friendly and will come out and greet you and discuss the dishes with you. Please do come here if you happens to be in Chiangmai. You won’t be disappointed.
review_2_text:
This restaurant is the best French restaurant I’ve ever been to. The food is amazing!!! I could not even manage to describe how I feel when I have the first bite of the beef, the juice like exploding in your mouth —— and you feel like you are in heaven, and I’m not exaggerating!
I’m not a gourmet, I took a long time thinking how to describe the taste? I just think the taste is very complex and complicated, but the magic is: everything is in perfect balance. All the ingredients are in good complementary relationships with each other, like the beef’s meat flavor with sweet and sour pomelo, the fragrance of salmon with fresh green vegetables… all I can say is amazing and could not find other words. No wonder it is made by a professional French chef with 20 years of experience.
My only question is: How come such a wonderful place with relatively little people found that? It should be known to the world haha!
Me and my husband would definitely come twice when we are in Chiang Mai again. You will definitely like here and this place is especially good for dating because the vibe is really romantic!
review_3_text:
La Friandise in Chiang Mai is truly a hidden treasure that deserves every bit of attention. From the moment you arrive, you are warmly welcomed by an exceptionally friendly team that speaks several languages with ease – this instantly makes you feel comfortable and appreciated as a guest.

The cuisine is nothing short of outstanding. Each dish is presented with the finesse and creativity you would expect from star-level dining, combining exquisite flavors, perfect textures, and a clear passion for detail. It is rare to find such high culinary standards delivered so consistently, and every plate feels like a little work of art.

The atmosphere is just as impressive: a modern, stylish, and elegant interior design that creates the perfect setting for both a relaxed dinner or a special evening out. It strikes a great balance between sophistication and comfort, so you can fully enjoy your meal without feeling rushed or out of place.

Despite the top-class quality, the prices remain very fair and reasonable, making La Friandise an incredible value compared to many other fine-dining experiences. This combination of excellence and accessibility is what makes the restaurant such a standout.

All in all, La Friandise is not only highly recommended, but a true insider’s tip in Chiang Mai. If you love fine dining, welcoming service, and a modern yet cozy atmosphere, you should absolutely not miss this place.
review_4_text:
Great hidden gem a bit outside the Old City walls. The restaurant is both: restaurant and coffee shop. It‘s run by a young French-Thai couple. He‘s the chef and she‘s the boss - taking care of everything else.

The restaurant‘s vibe is modern yet warm. They have a nice back yard with a few tables too. The menu is very small so they specialize on a few things and make those really well. I had the grilled mackerel. It was delicious! Value for money is good too. Will definitely be back.
review_5_text: My boyfriend and I just happen to pass by after our spa and went in for a treat! The chef and his wife also are the owners, and the staff are so welcoming and nice. I was looking through the reviews and wanted to order the lasagna, but it was not in the current menu. The chef was so accommodating to make me a lasagna with river prawns as a special. My boyfriend got the braised beef shanks and it melted in our mouth! (I had to try because it looked so good!) We enjoyed every food we ordered, no complaints! The desserts were also amazing!  We savored every bite. Truly a french cuisine. We loved the food and the service. Funny thing is, this was our best meal in both Chiang Mai and Bangkok! (We did like some authentic Thai cuisine too but for our last day this experience took it up a notch). Thank you both for the warm welcome!

name: โกดังขนม-เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
The Best in town for salted egg lava Chinese pastry
A must try definitely.  The pastry is so soft and the lava stuffed tastes super smooth 😋
review_2_text: So yummy😋
review_3_text: Perfect !!
review_4_text:
The pastries were delicious.

The croissants were excellent, with a rich buttery aroma.
The crème brûlée was soft and chewy, and the cream filling wasn't too sweet, greasy, or rancid.
The caramel danish—I've been hooked since my last visit—was incredibly fragrant with caramel. The crust was excellent, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
The sausage buns were soft and the sausages were good.
Unfortunately, the coffee machine was broken on the day I went, so I couldn't have any. I had to take some home in a box.

The staff were all lovely, polite, and had excellent interpersonal skills.
review_5_text: The shop is cute and very minimalist. The air inside the shop, which is in the fan zone, isn't too hot, just right. The desserts are delicious, not too greasy. The cream filling inside is just the right amount of sweet. The dough is soft and firm, and the drinks are delicious. The atmosphere is nice. I really like it. I'm lost in this kind of atmosphere. But if the seats had cushions in the same color tone as the shop to lean against, that would be even better. The overall composition is good. The staff are cute, and the shop owner is cute as well.

name: Pagoda Coffee House
review_1_text: Excellent Coffee!
review_2_text: The shop is cute. I went during Halloween and the shop was fully decorated. There were many special menus for both desserts and drinks. The coffee was delicious and the desserts were delicious.
review_3_text: A shady place, good value for money rooms.
review_4_text: The poor white parrots are in small cages and look unwell. It's sad.

name: betterpast_
review_1_text: A mysterious shop only open on weekends! 😯Their signature Earl Grey milk tea is amazing ^^🥰
review_2_text:
Garlic bread, the best, let me tell you.
Peach tea is very good.
review_3_text: Good price 😍
review_4_text:
This shop has a great atmosphere. #SecretCafe #HiddenShop
There are plenty of photo spots, or you can even take a photo of the mirror in front.
I recommend the Yuzu Lemon Coffee, it's delicious.
The garlic bread is delicious and incredibly crispy.

review_5_text: The restaurant has a good atmosphere, reasonable prices, and every dish is delicious.

name: ร้านกาแฟ Perfect blend coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee. Really good blend. What I like about the location is the chilled non touristic atmosphere next to local restaurants and shops. And the price is reasonable at 50 for. Capoucino (vs 120 at Starbucks)
review_2_text:
It has been my favorite cafe before and even after COVID19. It seems the surrounding business has gone down after the pandemic. It is a pity. Hope that the economy will rise again soon.
The Americano and cappuccino are nice and cheap. The environment is chill and has a local relaxing ambience.
review_3_text:
Very good americano and fair price!
I sometimes have other drinks too, but I mostly come in the early morning for my breakfast coffee ☕ and she opens at 6h30am !
Like her Perfect Blend it's a Perfect time!
Not directly in the busy Changkhlan Road, I love to sit outside enjoying my morning coffee ☺️
review_4_text: Good place to chill and have some coffee and small snack. The ice lattee was about 40 baht and it had a lot of ice, half coffee, and half condensed milk. Not too expensive and it is relaxing place but could be better with more amount of coffee. For the distance wise, it is close to some hotel area, you can walk a bit and relax before you start your day (or at the end of day relaxation).
review_5_text:
One of my favorite coffee shops in Chiangmai. Others are bigger or have fancier decor but the coffee in this place is quite good and the prices are outstanding.

They have their own roaster so locally roasted beans are for sale as well. I’ve had their Americano and their Oreo Coffee Smoothie, both are excellent.

Not far from the Shangra-la this is one of Chiangmai’s hidden gems!

name: โอยูชา 19 บาท สาขา กำแพงดิน(OU CHA)
review_1_text: Bubble tea 19 baht that is delicious!
review_2_text: Very delicious.

name: Miracle Coffee
review_1_text:
Excellent coffee, excellent service!
He doesn’t serve you ‘rushed/cheap coffee’. It’s as good, if not better than some places you’d pay double for.

I had an Americano with arabica beans for 30 Baht.

If you’re in a hotel nearby (or not) give miracle coffee a try, I think you’ll be happy with your choice.
review_2_text: The iced latte always makes me happy. Unbelievable taste with 40 BHT! Very kind barista do not foeget to ask what taste you want.
review_3_text: Best coffee ever!! Literally obsessed with his iced Americanos!! Such a good size for a great price :) lots to drink too (not just all ice haha!!) Only fault is that it’s not open on weekends so have to go somewhere else… never lives up to this guys! The best 🙏🏼
review_4_text:
Good atmosphere, nice coffee, kind master
Thank you
review_5_text: Great coffee great service super cheap

name: Signature coffee
review_1_text: I only went to the cafe and did not stay there. I ordered an iced vanilla latte and it was delicious! I would definitely come back.
review_2_text: Great spot for coffee. Baristas are really nice. This has become my go to morning spot for a fresh latte. Highly recommend.
review_3_text: Room was perfect with 2 toilets and 2 shower rooms.Free coffee in the morning. Perfect place .
review_4_text: Marzocco coffee machine , two selection of beans. They make good coffee ☕️.
review_5_text: Great place for a good coffee , you can work on laptop or read a book

name: Roastniyom Coffee - The Astra Condo
review_1_text: Great variety in the drink menu and tasty croissants. Lots of good seating space to work or a quiet visit, spots to charge your devices, and wifi. Unsure of the other reviews complaining about staff.. We stayed at the Astra and came here daily for a week and had no issues.
review_2_text:
Nice little coffee shop for condo dwellers with many types of seating options around, some have power socket so ideal for recharging while having your preferred dose of caffeine. They also offer many types of cookies, brownies and cheesecakes. Plus four basic types of croissants - pure, ham&cheese, almond and chocolate. Good place to start a day.

EDIT: After one year of regular visits I simply have to give the fifth star. They added more types of pastries and have many special drinks during events and holidays.
review_3_text: The lady in the morning is so rude if you are a foreigner. 7:10 am being yelled at "no coffee" not a great way to start the morning when it says it opens at 7, the people across the street are very kind. I suggest to give them your business.
review_4_text:
I come to this café almost every day since it’s in my residence, but the service has become really unpleasant because of one staff member, Tang Mo. She never says hello, never smiles, and barely answers when you ask for something.

Today I tried to buy a cake displayed on the counter, and she pretended not to see which one I meant — apparently because she had kept it for herself. It was extremely unprofessional and disrespectful.

I’m not sure if she’s the owner or just has a problem with foreigners, but her attitude is very rude and makes it uncomfortable to even grab a takeaway coffee.
review_5_text: Great spot to work or just enjoy a good coffee! The place is calm, cozy, has reliable Wi-Fi, and the staff are super friendly 🙏

name: ร้านพี่ยอมกาแฟโบราณ
โอเวอร์ชา overcha สาขาช้างคลาน
𝙋𝘼𝙐𝙎𝙀 𝘰𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝑯𝑰𝑳𝑳 Coffee and Rooftop bar
review_1_text:
I really dug the 'raw' industrial decor as you head up to the rooftop bar, it gives the whole place a cool, unfinished character.

The vibe is super chill, especially when you’re just sitting back with a couple of cold Singha beers. Watching the sunset from up there is gorgeous and easily the best part of the evening. Also, keep an eye out for the two resident cats; the ginger one is a total character and pretty cheeky!

The food was just okay for me, but you’re really coming here for the relaxed atmosphere rather than a gourmet meal. My only real gripe was the music, it was a bit loud for such a laid-back spot, so lowering the volume would be a huge plus. Definitely a solid choice for a low-key hangout.
review_2_text:
Cool spot! Great coffee (and good value at only 60 baht for a latte!), cool retro vibe furniture, and stylish barista.

Opens early at 7am, has cute cats wandering around and a chill outdoor terrace right opposite the Shangri-La.

Trendy café by day, rooftop bar by night — what more do you need? This place is a hidden gem.
review_3_text:
This place is a great hidden jem with lots of tasty appetizers that they make fresh in house. Unbeatable prices on local beers.

When it's not raining sitting upstairs is a very relaxing atmosphere and the staff are very hospitable.

We were here during slow season so it was not very busy at all yet the staff was still running around to make sure we were comfortable and having a good time.

They accept music requests aswell which is nice.

We mostly dealt with Posh (unsure of spelling of his name) and the other two employees Simba and Nala are pictured below.
review_4_text:
Very nice roof top bar with friendly staff and surprisingly good food. The beer selection is the usual suspects + Asahi, which are reasonably priced (Chang is 88 bhat and the rest are only a little more).

Would highly recommend visiting if you want a chill location with some live DJs
review_5_text: Lovely little bar and coffee shop. We almost missed it and walked past as it is so well hidden. A little sign outside indicates that it is open and that they have a upstairs balcony. The balcony upstairs is very spacious and open with a lot of ambient lighting. Nice view of the Shangri la hotel opposite. The bar serves food as well as a variety of flavoured beers that are locally made in Thailand. Good place to have a chilled drink.

name: Hello Healthy Smoothy - temporary closed due to pregnancy
review_1_text: Awesome place. Awesome owner and great customer service.  Great smoothies and wonderful air conditioning.  Has free WiFi.
review_2_text: Very nice office here and good take care 😊😊😊
review_3_text: Very good place and yummy 😊
review_4_text: Please come visit me
review_5_text: Really good smoothie

name: Drakonnest

They use high-quality coffee, with a rich, deep, and distinctive aroma. You can taste the freshness of every drink.
The tea menu is delicious, especially the Thai tea, matcha green tea, hot tea with fresh lemon, and the shop's signature strawberry tea.
The pizzas are homemade, with fresh, soft, and perfectly flavorful dough. There are a variety of toppings to choose from, and the flavors are so delicious you'll forget you've ever had before.
review_2_text: Pizza cones are incredibly delicious!

Avacado and coconut smoothy was delisious. The prices were really inexpensive, some items cheaper than eating in the market. Nice decor and clean.
review_2_text: Our second time here for breakfast! Food is delicious and there is a good selection from western style breakfast to Thai breakfast. Coffee was also great.
review_3_text: Best breakfast we had in years! Delicious food and cafe. Very friendly service and nice setting.
review_4_text:
C9 is a cozy coffee shop that offers not only delicious food and expertly brewed coffee, but also a calm, comfortable space where you can truly unwind.
Whether you’re looking to relax, focus, or simply enjoy a quiet moment, C9 creates the perfect atmosphere to make you feel at ease.
Wish can visit again soon.
review_5_text: Amazing pasta close to Astra Condo! Good thaifood, very good breakfast. Nice decoration food and affordable prices

name: Bella Goose Cafe at the Hill
review_1_text:
Bella Goose Café at The Hill is a charming little escape tucked away in the hills of Thailand. From the moment you arrive, the peaceful atmosphere and beautiful greenery invite you to slow down and enjoy the moment. The setting is calm and refreshing, with lovely views that make it perfect for a relaxed morning or afternoon.
The café itself is cozy and tastefully designed, offering comfortable indoor seating as well as outdoor spots to soak in the scenery. The food and drinks are thoughtfully prepared, with fresh flavors and beautifully presented dishes. The coffee is especially good—smooth, rich, and clearly made with care.
What truly makes Bella Goose Café special is its warm, welcoming feel. Friendly service, great food, and a serene location come together to create a place you’ll want to visit again. It’s a true hidden gem and well worth the stop. ☕🌿
review_2_text: After a delightful discovery experience at Bella Goose at the Pond, we had to check this one out and it was well worth it! Loved the genuine vibe, especially the original style café doors. The Beetroot Scramble was amazing and the PB Mocha was yummy. I couldn't resist the presentation of the Good Morning Smoothie Bowl, so we went back for it later. It was legit and did not disappoint!!
review_3_text:
Food - Healthy & the taste just nice.

Service - Friendly helpful with lots of smiles.

Atmosphere - Clean, tidy, modern chill cafe.

Lots of choices in the menu, scratching head which to pick. Overall the drink & food is awesome.

Found this Bella Goose randomly & not regret to be here. Keep it up 💪🏼
review_4_text:
Bella Goose is one of those rare places that quietly becomes part of your routine—and then your memory. Tucked into Chiang Mai, it became my daily spot. A place where coffee isn’t just served, it’s respected.

The piccolo was flawless every time—silk-smooth, perfectly textured, carrying a bold, confident espresso that lingered just long enough. Their espresso stands among the best I’ve had in Thailand, and knowing they roast their own beans, sourced through real relationships with local farmers, makes each cup feel intentional.

Whoever is behind the bar is truly gifted—latte art is never guaranteed, yet here every piccolo arrives like a small painting. Consistency like that is rare. It’s craft.
And then there’s the food. The smoked salmon bagel is unforgettable—the kind of dish that follows you home in your thoughts. A beautifully made bagel, rich smoked salmon, a perfect schmear, all plated with care. Every plate tells you the same story: this team loves what they do.

But the heart of Bella Goose is its people. The kindest, warmest staff I encountered in Thailand—no contest. They go beyond service and straight into connection. I showed up every day, and somehow, it felt like coming home. That doesn’t happen by accident. That’s great leadership and genuine hospitality.

Bella Goose is a place to meet, to rest, to work, to linger. A place where time slows just enough for you to notice how good things can be. I couldn’t recommend it more.
review_5_text:
Love this place! While in Chiang Mai for my trail race I ate here twice.

The first time was just before their closing time so it was practically empty. The second time was lunch time and most of the tables were full, but you can still find sitting outside.

The place is located on a corner of a busy intersection but once inside you can barely hear cars and motorcycles outside.

The waitresses are super nice and friendly. They pay attention to the customers and quickly respond if you need them.

You don’t have to wait long for your food to be served. Both times I had a coffee and a cinnamon roll. They are so good!

If I ever return to Chiang Mai I’ll definitely eat here again.

name: Butter is Better Diner & Bakery
review_1_text:
Amazing place—this became our favourite spot during our stay in Chiang Mai.

The service was exceptional and the food was splendid. Everything from lax bagels to scrambled eggs, eggs Benedict, crepes, juices, and smoothies. It really felt like it was done with care and love. You can find this gem in town. Be mindful that they are closed on Tuesdays.
review_2_text:
Great breakfast and a fun atmosphere! We went at lunchtime and ordered breakfast. The blueberry pancakes were delicious, and one was already filling. The bacon was also very good.
I wasn’t sure about the pasta, but it was great for breakfast!
The workers were kind, and it was not too far from the walking area(Mae Kha Canal คลองแม่ข่า).
review_3_text: The best breakfast spot in Chiang Mai when you want pancakes! Not sure if the house cat is still there but I barely noticed it sleeping off some food coma in the booth behind me. With a name like Butter is Better, you really can’t disagree. I believe they are also on grab in case you just want to stay in.
review_4_text: In my 14 years of living in Thailand, this is about the most American breakfast place I have had. It tasted like back home. If you are hankering for an American breakfast in Thailand, this should definitely be on your list.
review_5_text:
A bit ironic that my first experience of an American Diner was in Chiang Mai but if this is the quality of food I should expect I was in heaven! I ordered gingerbread pancakes-huge portion of light fluffy deliciousness! Staff were very attentive and friendly 😁
Highly recommend!

name: Art Farmer Cafe
review_1_text: Great coffee spot. Cute decorations for Halloween. Was my go to place while I was in chiang mai. Staff is very friendly and greets you with a smile. Coffee is very good. Go with the medium roast. Try their specialty drinks. I enjoyed a mojito espresso every morning.
review_2_text:
The coffee was excellent. The service perfect. The only thing I would do here is refresh the interior. The trouble with the nearly all white interior is the maintenance needed to keep it looking good. It only really needs someone with a pot of white paint and an eye for decluttering and using the space better. There are some merchandising stands in the wrong place and the DJ kit could be designed into the space much better. The tiles you probably have to lay again. They are toast.
All this is forgiven because the coffee and the music are very nice.
review_3_text: This was by far one of the best coffee I had. Medium roasted latte just masterful. It has a rich taste, very creamy texture and fruity notes. I took two bags of these beans to brew it myself!
review_4_text:
Awesome coffee and dessert.
🏖️👍☕️🍵🍰🧁

Iced Americano, latte and cocoa all have a fruity aroma and a strong coffee flavor, which is delicious. The icy cheesecake is super delicious! The staff here are also very polite and the service is very good. 👍
review_5_text:
The coffee was too good and of high quality. This was our go to place for morning coffee during our chiang mai stay.

The barista girl was cool and friendly. Would definitely visit again.

Highly recommended for your caffeine fix. Definitely visit if you’re around the neighbourhood, you won’t be disappointed.

name: Savor Society
review_1_text: Savor Society is a very relaxing place for a strong cup of coffee. I got the Iced Coconut Latte and cannot recommend it enough. The coffee flavor did not get diluted at all! I wish I had time to come back and get it again.
review_2_text:
Very cool coffee shop and cafe.

The coffee choices cover a wide range of serving styles and coffee beans that are roasted in house. Savor Society is serious about coffee! Be prepared to state the serving style, the temperature (hot or iced), and type of beans. Enjoy the high quality coffee.

The are nice food choices too. Many of the breakfast meals include freshly made bagels. The attractive selection of sweets will surely tempt you.

Have a seat and enjoy sitting in a shop that is thoughtfully and a bit eclectically decorated.

You’ll find this shop is well patronized morning, noon, and afternoon.  Join the friendly crowd and enjoy the Savor Society!

Feeling down and visiting the Bangkok Hospital? You can grab a coffee from the Savor Society location there!
review_3_text: So good! The latte (I selected Laos beans dark roast) is delicious, I could taste the unique notes. The cake is perfectly lightly sweetened and the fluffy cream balances the denser (but soft and moist) chocolate base.
review_4_text:
Best coffee and best value in Chiang Mai.
The Basque Burnt  cheesecake is not too sweet just perfect with the coffee.👍👍😋😋
review_5_text: 5/5 stars! We're so lucky to have this amazing coffee shop just around the corner from our place. The perfect spot to start our day with a great cup of coffee and delicious drinks. The service is top-notch, and the upstairs seating area is cozy and comfortable. It's the ideal spot to relax and catch up with friends and family. Highly recommended!

name: คาเฟ่วัดใจ Escape room in Chiang Mai Thailand 泰国清迈密室逃脱
review_1_text:
The staff were very accommodating and friendly. They explained everything nicely.

It is definitely not for the faint-hearted. This is my second time trying this out and not finishing again.

The props and experience was very thrilling and scary. The actors were awesome.

Check the prices and promotion first too.
You will also get 50% off their food and drink menu once you choose a package.

The location is very convenient, close to the heart of the city.

There are 4-5 games to experience lasting 60-90mins. There is 5 levels of scary with zero for the easily scared.

They also have pictures and videos for your memories at the end. =D
review_2_text: It's definitely the best escape room I've ever done. It is more of an experience where you follow a story than working out puzzles and clues. We didn't even do the scariest level, and my heart was racing the entire time. The staff were absolutely amazing and really put on a show. With student discount it's only 500baht and lasts over an hour, I'd highly recommend.
review_3_text: What an experience!!! Great service by all the staff. Great acting and support crew. I’m a bit of a softie when it comes to horror, so I’m happy I managed to finish. Definitely worth an hour or two of your time on a rainy Chiang Mai evening. Thanks guys! ขอบคุณครับ
review_4_text:
One of the best and definitely scariest experience I had in Chiang Mai.

We had five levels of difficulty to choose and one scary experience.

I was literally shaking.

If you’re looking for an escape room that combines an horror experience in the best way possible -

This is the place!
review_5_text: This place was great!! Very scary, for my family (I never get scared), I strongly suggest this. The staff is really nice and make it a very enjoyable experience.

name: Cafe de L'Amour
review_1_text:
Came into this quaint little cafe in Chiang Mai for some Aircon and a rest. Nice and cosy that just does a limited selection of food and drinks (primarily coffee) but that is fine.

I ordered the mocha-banana-frappe, my wife had a mocha-mint-frappe and my son had a hot latte.

All perfectly tasty and reasonably priced (THB180 in total). Limited seating but that’s part of the appeal.

My only gripe is they don’t accept Apple Pay - only a local banking QR code or cash.
review_2_text: Very cool little spot and Chiang Mai. Has indoor and outdoor seating with a tree growing through some of the sitting area. Servicewas very polite and everything was made from scratch grinding beans for every single order.
review_3_text: Small cafe with a lovely vibe, fine coffee and delicious cakes. Plenty of different seating options although I liked the most the ones inside around a living tree that gives the place soothing atmosphere. Sometimes there are offered locally grown fruits in the basket next to the entrance for a bargain price.
review_4_text: Very cute cafe with good drinks. I tried the rose tea latte and my friend tried cocoa latte pearl (bubble was out so we replaced with pearl). Both were great. I liked the atmosphere of the shop - not a big place but plants were all around, felt cool even in a hot afternoon. Had place for parking.
review_5_text: Brilliant little coffee shop near Chang klan area. I’ve been coming here for nearly 15 years. Great coffee, fresh juices, smoothies and good little club sandwich if need a change from Thai food. Friendly happy faces, parking and good vibes. Small quaint place to stop and sit outside or inside. I love to come here when I go to my favourite massage shop Aree Thai massage near Anantara. Come down and support local business on Si Don Chai Rd just around corner from night bazaar…

review_2_text: Great coffee, the cappuccino tastes delicious 🙏🏼
review_3_text: I went there today, but it's closed. It's permanently closed.
review_4_text: I really like the matcha bubble tea at this shop. It's rich, not too sweet, and the tapioca pearls are delicious. The brown sugar milk tea is also excellent.

name: Milk Tea Wagon

review_2_text: Tasty drinks made to order and some stools to rest on while your drink is made!

review_2_text: Nice, quiet place to relax. Lots of different coffees available.

review_2_text: I came here for halal food. I saw this incredible place with an amazing atmosphere. The food was fantastic. Reasonable price. It is located on a busy street. review_3_text: A dozen stands of different, inexpensive street food. Friendly vendors.  Great place to start before heading up the crowded sidewalk along Chang Khlan and the other night markets. Some nights, I don't need to go any farther than right here.
review_4_text:
Good place to meet and chil with friend.
Live entertaint
review_5_text: Had mango sticky rice. The most generous portion versus other vendors @ the lowest prices.

review_3_text: I had a caramel frappuccino and it tasted lovely and was a very reasonable price! - highly recommended if you love coffee and you’re in the area 🥳
review_4_text: Delicious Thai Milk Tea for only 39 bhat, he even decorated the top.
review_5_text: Coffee at a very good price. Probably the least expensive but still great tasting coffee in Chiang Mai.

name: Minimal Coffee - ป่าไม้ Charoenprathet
review_1_text:
This is my favorite Minimal Coffee location. The service is always excellent, friendly, and smooth. You can choose to sit comfortably inside with air conditioning or outside under the umbrellas, which is great depending on the weather.

The coffee is consistently good — I’ve never been disappointed here. It’s also a perfect spot for parents who are picking up their kids from the nearby school. Relaxed atmosphere, good drinks, and reliable quality every time.

Highly recommended! ☕️
review_2_text: Brand new café — clean, quaint, and friendly service. Offers Wi-Fi and AC. Located along the quiet Chang Klan Road — a great spot to get some work done or enjoy a good read.
review_3_text: On Charoen Prathet Road, just before Wat Chai Mongkol, there's a small coffee shop with warm service and a wide selection of coffees. The atmosphere is quiet and perfect for relaxing or working.
review_4_text: Been there a couple times, nice place to sit and relax ! Took some pics, nice spot for meet friends !

The shop uses coffee beans from the Royal Project, Faculty of Agriculture, Chiang Mai University, which is considered one of the first producers of roasted coffee beans in Chiang Mai. It's a classic, original recipe.
I ordered a hot cappuccino and it came with a sweet taste from the syrup. It seems to be a flavor that customers prefer. If you prefer it without sugar, don't forget to tell the barista.
