name: NAKAMA Café @ Headquarters
review_1_text: I've been here many times and really enjoy royal milk tea. Other drinks also good but recommend royal milk tea.
review_2_text:
We came to check out the place because of the good reviews about it but a bit disappointing with the taste of the bubble tea. We feel that it’s about an average bubble tea.

We tried 2 different tea—Taiwanese Bubble Tea and Midnight Cacao Brown Sugar Bubble tea. The Taiwanese Bubble Tea was just average like we mentioned earlier although the bubble are quite nice, soft but with good texture. The other one, Midnight Cacao Brown Sugar Bubble Tea was overpowering with the cacao flavor competing with quite sweet brown sugar bubbles and it didn’t taste like anything special about the cacao flavor actually.

Price wise, it’s quite expensive, except for the plain Taiwanese Bubble Tea. We have tried different bubble tea from other places and there are places that make better bubble tea with reasonable price than this.

What we like about this place is it has a potential to make you feel cozy with its minimal Japanese style of decoration. But, we only give actually 2.5 stars for this place because the place feels cluttered with many employees working behind the counter and yet, work gets done quite slowly. From our experiences traveling and visiting many places, small place like this would probably need not more than 2 people working in one shift. They had 5 people working behind a small counter at the time we were visiting the place and it makes the place feel so cramped and loud inside and like we said... it takes time to get your order. So, it wasn’t a pleasant place to sit and relax. The place lacks friendly vibes actually.

So, the best part about this place is its plain bubbles.
review_3_text:
Interesting choices on the menu, all very Japanese, and unusual options to customize for a bubble tea shop, with soy or almond milk, stevia as sweetener and low cal bubbles. Out of curiosity I tried the latter with brown sugar bubbles although they were a bit disappointing, no trace of brown sugar. Maybe it was only forgotten to be added but I'd advise to go with regular bubbles, I think they'd be more enjoyable. Houjicha latte was flavorful. Warm option is not available at all times. The store git busy after around 11am on a weekday for both take out and dine in. The interior is cute same as the entire design. Friendly staff, pick up is with a buzzer.

Update to 4 stars. Hoijicha was a bit chalky this time and chockfull of ice only. Staff is still charming but might need some training, it took me 10 minutes from ordering to paying for a simple order.
review_4_text: Nice cafe. Beautiful interior design. Food / drinks are also good, a bit  pricier compared to the area. But worth to give a try, can experience the interesting interior.
review_5_text: NAKAMA Café is a must-visit for bubble-tea lovers in Chiang Mai.

name: TEDS Coffee & Eatery
review_1_text:
TEDS is a pet-friendly café with a calm, quiet ambience—I fell for it as soon as I walked in. It’s peaceful yet welcoming and lots of people work here with their pets. No pet smell at all—there are multiple air purifiers throughout the shop.

There’s a nice selection of coffee beans; my iced latte (medium roast) was aromatic and smooth. The carrot cake wasn’t too sweet, which I loved.

They also have a meeting room (just ask the staff), plus plenty of seating: work desks, a second-floor counter bar, cozy couches, a four-seat corner and outdoor garden tables.
review_2_text:
Coffee, Cuteness & Chill Vibes

My first time here. A cozy pet-friendly café just a 10-minute walk from Haan-Tueng Chiangmai, the Michelin-recommended spot. Run by two adorable “owners” — Teddy & friend 🐾 😆— usually napping like café mascots.

Coffee’s nice and reasonably priced, with a few homey bakes. Gets busy with teens and locals on holidays, so if prefer to a private and peaceful vibe - better avoid peak times.

It does get busy, though, and seating feels limited. The outdoor space could be improved honestly it’s underused and lacks atmosphere. Still worth visiting.

review_5_text: Very nice design.  I especially like home made scone, and the tea besides regular coffee.

name: Thank You Teacher & Warrior club house
review_1_text: Ordered a waffle and the waitresses forgot even i asked two times. The drinks are average.
review_2_text: Lovely location, friendly owners.
review_3_text: A lovely shop with good service, offering food and drinks. 🫰
review_4_text:
A cute and comfortable coffee shop with a spacious interior. The coffee is strong and aromatic, and delicious.
To get to the shop, enter the alley next to the PTT gas station. Parking is available.
review_5_text:
A stylish coffee house has opened next to the first hole at the Star Dome. 
You can relax here while overlooking the course and practice range.

name: น้ำอ้อยน้ำหวาน
Thong-Urai Cafe & Paw Made Painting
review_1_text:
Art studio cafe with great signature iced chocolate!!! I ordered basque cheesecake and it get along together very well. Also many choices of desserts and comfortable foods.
Next time I will try foods and coffee/matcha.
The place very peaceful, staffs are friendly and helpful.
I ,very much, enjoyed my visiting, eat&drink while reading.
review_2_text: I had a lovely time today participating in one of the painting workshops. Our host was wonderful and helped me set up my canvas and offer guidance on canvas selection, improving my painting and offering encouragement when I didn't know what to do. There was great music in the background which helped to relax into the process. The coffee I had there was great - I didn't sample the food but it smelled amazing.
review_3_text: Cozy and pretty space with relaxing atmosphere and delicious coffee. Enough space to get Chiang Mai on canvas. Recommended for everyone!!!! Called in the morning and visited by walk-in, relaxed. Cheaper than booking through tour site
review_4_text: The painting session was a delightful experience, offering a relaxing atmosphere. The instructor provided clear guidance, which was very helpful, and I appreciate that. Furthermore, the cafe's ambiance created a perfect environment for creativity and social interaction. I found it to be a memorable experience with good service, and I recommend it. Overall, it was a wonderful combination of art and a nice cafe vibe.
review_5_text: ​A very chill and comfortable place. You're welcome to paint, and the staff will give you a sketch and guide you through the process. It's quite a fun and interesting activity.

name: First Officer Coffee Roasters
review_1_text:
great spot for quality coffee at a very reasonable price. It’s one of the few cafés in Chiang Mai that opens early, making it the perfect place for your first cup of the day.

it’s an ideal stop to kick-start your morning :-)
review_2_text:
◽️Highlights
•Tasty coffee, both hot and iced
•Medium-roast beans for the hot latte are especially delicious
•Eco-friendly cups & lids for takeaway
•Cute touch: every cup comes with a smile written on it 😊
•The “CEO” (a dog named Latte) greets you at the door — adorable and well-trained!

◽️Atmosphere
•Small, cozy café with a friendly vibe
•Digital-nomad friendly with limited space

◽️Parking
•Best to come by motorbike
•Street is narrow with limited parking for cars

◽️Tip
Say hi to CEO Latte 🐶 — a highlight of the visit!
review_3_text: This is the best coffee shop in Chiang Mai. It's open at 06.00 AM, absolutely, I like it so much.
review_4_text: Very nice shop. The atmosphere is excellent, the coffee is very good, and the staff here are luxurious. Very friendly people. They are very welcoming. The sessions are quiet. If you want to drink coffee in Chiang Mai. You should try this. the place is beautiful.
review_5_text: Very nice specialty coffee and refreshing craft cola

name: Nara Coffee
review_1_text: A small shop, a small cafe under the trees, shady, cool, delicious drinks.

name: PARADOX
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop tucked away in a corner just off of the highway. Friendly staff, quiet environment. Had a cappuccino which was delicious. I would definitely return if in the area.
review_2_text: Nice airy space, Good coffee for a good price. 55B for iced espresso ... worth a stop off.
review_3_text: We came 11am on a Tues. We were the only people, so lacked a bit of ambiance. However, delicious coffee, good Aircon, and they gave us some sample brownie for free. The art is also cool, with an optical illusion for the sign board on the back wall. See photo.
review_4_text: Dark, medium or light roast coffee beans are available. Nice ambience both air-condition and outdoor.
review_5_text:
Ordered a matcha latte

The cafe has a shy but adorable cat.

name: จู๊ซบาร์แวน
review_1_text: Great spot! The Juice Bar Van served up some amazing, fresh cold pressed juices. We ordered one from the menu and they were happy to custom make a second one. The signs are in Thai but the pictures are self explanatory.(Additionally, the accommodating owners spoke English. We also ordered a kombucha and it was one of the best ones we've had in the country so far. Make sure you stop by if you happen to be in the area and want to treat yourself to a refreshing and healthy cold pressed juice.
review_2_text: Juice up! This place is juicy bro. What you know about this juice? Only Juice World understands. Dope juice with no sugar added. No water or preservatives added. WE WANT THE JUICE, the whole juice AND NOTHING BUT THE JUICE! *no English menu but photos are juicy. I recommend the juice number 3 🤘juice. And we out ✌️
review_3_text: Fresh and clean with reasonable price. Highly recommended.
review_4_text: Fresh, healthy and delicious all at a reasonable price. Signs are in Thai but the owner spoke English.
review_5_text: Fresh and clean place, juice #11 is the BEST if you like vegetables!

name: ธาราคอฟฟี่
review_1_text: good coffee and delicious snacks. And good staff there
review_2_text: Ok
review_3_text: The food is delicious and there's a wide variety. The view is beautiful by the water, and there are many great photo opportunities.
review_4_text: The coffee is fragrant and delicious, the service is fast, the place is clean, and the staff are very helpful.
review_5_text: Affordable coffee

name: Katai Cafe กระต่าย คาเฟ่
review_1_text: The coffee is delicious. The owner is friendly and welcoming, and the staff are also polite. The location is in the city center and very easy to find.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious...the owner is very friendly...after finishing my coffee...I went for a relaxing walk at Nong Buak Haad Park next door...
review_3_text: The shop is absolutely beautiful, the decor is lovely, the staff provides excellent service, and the coffee and drinks are delicious.
review_4_text: Good coffee, small but friendly place, affordable prices
review_5_text: The coffee is very delicious. I drink it every morning.

name: Intend coffee cnx
review_1_text:
Lovely little coffee shop on the south of the old city! The owners are welcoming and friendly and felt so relaxed at an ease. The coffee tasted divine! I chose the Chiang mai bean (dark roast) but they also have a medium roast too from Columbia but yet to try that.

Ive been 3 days on a row! When you find good coffee on your doorstep, it’s a no brainer! ☕️👌🏻
review_2_text:
LOVE this cafe! Coffee is incredibly delicious and smooth. Although my hotel has included coffee, I skip it to go here!

The owner is very kind and knowledgeable about his coffee. I asked about his drawing and he gave me a little coffee lesson! He also roasts the coffee beans in-house.
review_3_text: The coffee here is so delicious and flavourful - the best I’ve had in CM so far! I had the oat milk latte with medium roast. The owners are really friendly too. I would definitely come back ☺️.
review_4_text:
great place runs by a great people with a lot of passion, been super nice.
i bought some whiskey coffee beans and they gave me other samples so i can try more things. the guy really explained me how everything works and gave me some tips.
definitely coming back.
review_5_text: The food was super refreshing and prepared perfectly, i didn't have an issue with the ripeness of the fruit or the temperature of the hot food with the set breakfast which is often a worry. It was all delicious and the dark roast coffee was amazing. On top of it all the service was great and everything arrived quickly!

name: ติด กาแฟ
review_1_text: Went in for a manicure and pedicure, space was clean and very comfortable. Manicurist was very sweet and skilled. Was in and out. Over all very happy with the outcome, would definitely recommend and be a repeat customer if I lived here.
review_2_text: great place for a pedicure.    the place is VERY clean and they always do a great job.
review_3_text: Nice place to stay for a while waiting for boxing class to begin
review_4_text: It's a cafe that also houses a hand and foot spa, offering nail services as well. They do a great job; the work is excellent and the staff are skilled.

name: BRB Cafe
review_1_text: Stopped in for brunch, what a pleasant discovery. Both orders were generous, fresh, great value and this venue is a color party for the eyes. Loved finding yet another treasure in Chiang Mai for future visits. 👍❤️🙏
review_2_text: The staff and food were very good. I ordered the pan eggs and a single waffle. The atmosphere of the cafe was great too since it was connected with a nice hotel.
review_3_text: Coffee was terrible, tasted like instant or robusta. The English breakfast was an ok facsimile. But german sausage had cheese in it like the awful US brats. Beans were the real deal. 'salad' with nothing on it (not even a lemon). Bacon was ok. But ham was just the standard thin 'wet' processed meat but fried.
review_4_text: How is this place not packed with customers? Perfect ambience, excellent location. Oh, did I mention the poached eggs on avocado toast was truly exquisite!!!
review_5_text: The quality/price ratio is not right. Portions are quite small, and preparation takes quite a long time. Unfortunately, it wasn't very good. I didn't find the service very friendly.

name: Coffee at Come-on Place
review_1_text: Hidden gem, this place is incredible. The hosts are so kind and generous. The iced green is one of the best I've had here. To top it off they have 5 beautiful corgis. Definitely worth a visit
review_2_text: amazing amazing amazing cafe!!! Lovely waitress and a beautiful area to sit in. Like 8 stunning corgis running about the place being beautiful and stunning and cute. One came and sat on the table and the waitress asked if we wanted him down but we absolutely did not. He kept us company as we played cards and drank our tasty drinks around him.
review_3_text:
The nicest cafe surrounded by greenery and trees. Seats are outside and there's cute corgis running around, the cutest and friendliest dogs you can pet!
Very cute off the beaten track cafe if you like quirky, greenery and dogs!
review_4_text: CORGIS CORGIS CORGIS also there is coffee which is quite nice, don't mind the barking they're very friendly
review_5_text: It's a coffee shop that doesn't looks like a coffee shop, It's feel like a someone house, but it's a lot of fat corgis.

name: I'll say coffee & space
review_1_text: A really chill cafe and workspace that is actually very spacious. I really enjoyed the yogurt bowl and egg, and the coffee was quite large as well. You can have a decent breakfast here at a good price. Really nice atmosphere as well with good Wi-Fi. Worth trying out forsure!
review_2_text: A really excellent and chill coffee shop in the Old City with coworking space available. Nice staff as well. I would recommend this place to anyone, especially digital nomads looking for coworking.
review_3_text: Nice and cozy western style coffee shop. If you want to scape from the rainy weather and want have a break for yourself with a delightful warm coffee, this is your place.
review_4_text: I love this place! Service is very friendly. Wifi is great and they have login info on the receipt. Bathrooms are very clean. Great place to relax when it’s hot outside!
review_5_text:
A beautiful cafe, I love it very much
Two floors, delicious coffee
Best recommendation💖👍🏼

name: MEVA Icecream & Smoothie
review_1_text: My friend enjoyed her taro ice cream and I enjoyed my coconut ice cream and we both love the passion fruit sorbet in this sweet little ice cream shop - lovely lady and old gentlemen serving great selection of cold treats, a variety of complementary toppings, water and tissue pepper are provided too
review_2_text: Well worth the visit. We tried the coconut milk ice cream and loved it! The free topping station is such a lovely little detail to customise the ice cream too. There are chairs to sit and enjoy inside and outside the shop
review_3_text: Really lovely wee icecream shop. Meva makes all the icecream her self. There are many very yummy vegan options. Everything is very reasonably priced. Definitely a must visit for sweet treats in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: Amazing place! They opened a few minutes earlier for us, the portions are big and the ice cream is delicious! This place also has free topping bar with a huge variety of add-ons, so that's cool as well!!
review_5_text: A bit disappointing considering the good review. Free topping is great if you like lots of extras with your ice cream. Coconut ice cream was decent, vanilla choc chip was almost identical to cheap stuff you can get in the supermarket

name: BRUNCH
review_1_text: Super recommendation for this place! Food is very delicious/presented lovley and the service is perfect. Also good for vegetarians. Besides, the ambient and music are nice, too.
review_2_text: Hidden gem! Westernised food was a nice comfort from home, reasonably priced with a lovely atmosphere, music was splendid
review_3_text: Super delicious breakfast in old town. Avocado on toast was perfect 😩👏🏻
review_4_text: Amazing food and service. Vegetarian friendly also.
review_5_text: Amazing place! Delicious food and drink, great service from the friendly owner. The place looks nice and the ac makes it even more comfortable. 5/5 ☀️!

name: Iiwillsay
review_1_text:
시원 깔끔. 조용하고 분위기 좋습니다.
커피는 진한 편이고. 커피 아닌 음료는 소다류 있어요

name: Pangkhon Coffee
review_1_text: Cute local coffee cafe. Serving locally roasted coffee. The Americano I ordered was very good. We also ordered a vanilla lattes with oat milk and it was not good. It was still black and we asked if it had oat milk and they said no. It was not creamy at all.
review_2_text:
Cappuchino tasted really bad. Was given a replacement but still tasted strange.

Places used old milk or old beans. Will not go again.
review_3_text: We ordered a hot latte and a iced hazlenut latte for 120THB! The coffee was amazing and we will definitely be back. We didn’t order food but the table next to us did and it looked really nice.
review_4_text:
I had fried vegetables with rice. It had a twist of garlic and chili, very delicious. Good value as well, only 65 baht.
Not busy at all. I might return for copy paste this dish.
review_5_text: I came to have a massage and as it is connected to the coffee shop, it was a bit noisy. The lady that gave me the massage had a cold, and not only she was wiping her nose while she was giving the massage, but also she was sending text messages. You could improve your respect for your customers.

name: Chuan Chong coffee
review_1_text:
I just passed by this coffee shop shop!
Owner was very pleasant to buy a latte from and super friendly! You all shall go try her coffee which taste really good and was professional done with the hand drawn flowery sign on the top of the latte ❤️👍😊! I will definitely go back and the shop is easy to sit in also !
review_2_text: Lovely quiet and comfortable, best mango coffee I ever had
review_3_text: Great place to stop for a coffee, tea, or juice. Great price & lovely people working there
review_4_text: Dropped by to get a cold Thai tea. The price is cheap and the tea was very tasty!
review_5_text: Lovely and nice services with thai chill music 90's, my order is cocoa no milk no sugar 28TH its very nice

name: TENTEN SUKIYAKI & CAFE
review_1_text: Hidden upstairs near our hotel we found this Japanese gem. The quality of the food was excellent. Every dish was flavorful and well presented. The restaurant is a quiet and comfortable place to have a delicious meal, a few beers on tap and some sake. Service is very attentive and detail oriented. A perfect spot for our last night in Chiang Mai. We are amazed at the quality they can offer at this price point. Do not hesitate to visit if you want an alternative to Thai food.
review_2_text:
Excellent beverages. Superb coffee and service was excellent. The establishment was spotlessly clean, cool, relaxed and friendly. Another 'gem' in Chiang Mai. I will definitely return for a meal next time.
Thank you so much for adding to my memories ❤️ of Chiang Mai. Thank you 😊 🙏
review_3_text: We were here for NYE dinner and they didn't disappoint. Wagyu Sukiyaki was phenomenal including wagyu steak bowl and yakisoba! The service is superb too.
review_4_text:
Taste: ★★★★★★★
Price: ★
Service: ★★

The taste is well worth the price, and it’s truly the best beef in Chiang Mai. Our bill came to nearly 4,000 baht, but due to a mistake in the calculation, we almost ended up paying more. I’m not sure if it was just an error or because we are foreigners, but it’s important to double-check the bill.
review_5_text: Delicious food and great service. The staff were very attentive and the food came very quickly. We got the sukiyaki soup base with wagyu beef and japanese pork, both were really good.

name: Bloomin' Moon Hostel, Chiang Mai Old Town
review_1_text: Came here with my toddler and had such a delicious lunch! Really tasty fresh noodle dish with crispy chicken and my little one enjoyed waffles and cream. All so beautifully presented and a really lovely atmosphere. Nice, clean fresh and lovely attentive service. A great selection of desserts and drinks. A must visit :) highly recommend!
review_2_text:
I paid more by accident, and the kind waitress gave me my money back — I really appreciate the honesty!
Thank you so much! By the way, the coffee was delicious. The lunch portion was generous, and the quality of the meat was very good.
They offer free water refills and always ask if we are okay, so you can see they truly care about their customers.🥰
review_3_text: Review for the coffee shop attached: Cutest little coffee shop with an incredible variety of hot/cold matcha/coffee options. Staff was the absolute friendliest with nothing but smiles as they helped us decide what to order. Went for the fresh coconut iced americano and the moon drop. Both were spectacular. The moon drop is a super unique blend of textures, temperatures, and flavors! Definitely will stop back by.
review_4_text: I stayed here 5D4N here and I completely enjoy the stay. All staff are kind and helpful. They greeted me every morning when I came down to the cafe. Free breakfast provided to guest also tastes very good. I did ordered the tomyum spaghetti, omg the best ever had. There are 7-11 and laundry nearby which is very convenient. Recommended!
review_5_text: I had breakfast with my family here and it was one of the most beautiful meals I’ve ever had! The food was delicious and fresh, served in an amazing way! The staff is also super nice and the serving time quick! Strongly recommend!!!

name: 9 Siblings Restaurant
review_1_text:
I’d added 9 Siblings to my list before my trip to Thailand. I think I’d seen it mentioned by a YouTuber previously.

Either way, I was not disappointed. I ate there twice during my few days in Chiang Mai. I’m 100% sure I’d have ended up back there again if not for being caught out by the 8pm closing time.

The decor was nice and their vibe was nice, chill and casual, perfect for a solo traveller. The staff were lovely friendly too.

For breakfast I had one of the set menu choices and on the same day, I went back for dinner and got their beef khao soi to takeaway. Unfortunately I got there close to closing time so I took it back to my hotel room to eat. It was SO unbelievably good!!

It was my first time ever trying khao soi so I have nothing to compare it to but wow, the flavours, the tender beef, the broth, the onions adding a extra zing, the portion size, everything about it was chefs kiss. And to think it only cost 100 baht.

If I’d had more time in Chiang Mai, I would’ve gone back to try the chicken khao soi as well as many other things on their menu. Yum.
review_2_text:
I really liked this place!
Loved the atmosphere and the staff, especially the elderly people working there are absolute sweethearts! 🫶🏻 The food was good and we paid a total of 260 baht for food and drinks for two people.
review_3_text: This restaurant was a 30 minute walk from our hotel, but I feel it was worth it. It was one of the best Khao Soi I have had in Chiang Mai. Friendly staff, and a quaint clean atmosphere. Would eat there again.
review_4_text:
The food was more suited to foreigners than authentic Thai. The Pad Thai was edible, but not very good. The flavor wasn't very intense (I'm not talking about spicy).

The place is cozy with Lego elements (there's also a display), although the name doesn't suggest it. The downside is that the staff doesn't clean the tables regularly, so you have to eat in an atmosphere of dirty tables.

My visit was at the end of October.
review_5_text:
Lovely little Khao soi place hidden 5mins away from the gate market. Very tender chicken drumsticks and flavourful broth.
The stirred pork was also very tender.
Worth a visit if u are in the area.

name: Carrot coffee cnx
review_1_text: Great, roomy cafe along a quiet street, spanning two sizeable yet cosy floors and an airy patio out back, contemporarily inspired with old-school finishes. Fantastic for chats and work alike. Great coffee with bean/roast selection; cakes look swell as well. Service is bright and cordial. Not busy on a weekday morning, with plenty of comfortable seating to choose from.
review_2_text: Nice cozy café in the middle of the city. Relaxed atmosphere, interesting drink options. Carrot cake is delicious! Good place to chill and take a rest. Staff is polite. Unfortunately they do not accept credit cards.
review_3_text: I suggest you do not miss this place. A real gem in the middle of nowhere. We found this by chance. Amazing coffee, great carrot cake and a chill grungy interiors. The internal courtyard is a japandi decor, a juxtaposition from the rough warehouse feel of the main cafe itself. They also have free wifi.
review_4_text:
One of the best cafes in Chiang Mai.
Fantastic carrot cake, a great selection of beverages, and a beautiful, laid-back interior with a very prominent Korean vibe.
The music is great, the staff are super kind, and the toilets are clean.
It’s also set in a lovely neighbourhood full of greenery.
review_5_text:
Another nice little underrated cafe. Very cozy interior, cool but somehow cozy. They got kinda everything. From very good coffee to nice healthy freshly pressed cold juices. 🥤
I had the 🥕+ 🍎 + 🫚 = healthy and good👌🏻
Definitely worth a visit

name: OWL brasserie
review_1_text: A great fusion experience. You'll love the place when you enter the front gate and walk through the courtyard, inside the restaurant it's nice, spacious and cozy. They change menu every 4 months and you can tell from the menu and the food that the chef knows how to cook cuisines from all over the world, I only ordered 4 dishes and I can taste Asian, Italian, Spanish and French, everything was cooked to perfection and the service is also very good, I'd love to come again for sure!
review_2_text: Been here twice in a week.  Cooking was excellent. We had the Akami ceviche, beef tartare, coq co vin, and risotto. You can tell the care and passion they put in to it. Ten out of ten. ❤️
review_3_text: Food is creative and flavourful. After an amazing dinner we had to come back for lunch a few days later. Second visit did not disappoint. I am surprised they don’t have a Michelin Star.
review_4_text: Food is super duper delicious. Services are incredible. Most of ingredients are self-made by Chef. All dishes I ordered were yummy. Really recommended that you need to try and you will have the 2nd and 3rd time for sure. It’s worth your spending.
review_5_text:
Very impressive dinner at Owl Brasserie on 15 February.

We booked over their website in advance and had a glance of the menu beforehand.

The restaurant is located in a quite neighborhood the old city but just a few minutes walk to the main road. It was renovated from an old house with a spacious indoor which also can view the operation of the kitchen and a large patio that have a giant old tree. The whole ambience from the first step to the restaurant is tranquil.

I love their deco, furniture and all the table ware, especially the clay, wood & shades of blue.

Lady owner was friendly & kind, she's very warm & love the share the is history of the heritage house as well as the background of head chef.

We had a very enjoyable dinner from the friendly service team, the lovely live music and of course the food we had.

All the food we had from welcome canapes, appetiters, warm bread, main course to dessert can see, taste & feel how much efforts behind been made. Presentation is great and I found they put the details in little aspects even on the side dishes & gravy which most appreciated.

Owl Brasserie is one of the best restaurants I've been to. The time i was having dinner, already told myself I have to come back again on next trip to Chiangmai. The only regret was I came too late for the dinner so it's a bit rush.

Thank you very much team Owl.

name: Sweet Home coffee -A little Corner
review_1_text:
●●●Sweet Home Coffee is a,Chiang Mai top pick●●●
Everything about SHC is top notch 👌
The coffee quality is great.
Service by everyone is excellent.
And the space is cozy and super welcoming.
Unfortunately,  the owner has lost her lease by the the end off December 2025. She has not found a new space as of end November 2025  please stay tuned.
Handicap doable and recommended
Inexpensive
Restrooms NO
Final take....Highly recommended for all of the above.  ....but hurry!!!
review_2_text: If there’s one place you need to visit in Chiang Mai, it’s this cafe!! The staff are truly the kindest people you’ve ever met — so happy and helpful in the most authentic way — and the food and drinks are as delicious as they are beautiful (see photos if you want a spoiler, but seriously, you will not be disappointed)!! It’s a little hole in the wall spot with just a few tables, but we went twice and they had room for us both times. And it’s perfect with little kids, as they had kid-friendly treats and a bag of toys! Our favorites were the mango sticky rice, fruit platter, and fresh coconut, but their entire menu looks absolutely incredible. This is by far one of our favorite cafes in all of Thailand, we wish we lived here so we could be regulars!!
review_3_text: The passion they put in preparing the food and drinks is INCREDIBLE!! They have the best mango sticky rice I’ve tasted, the iced latte was also amazing, better than in overpriced coffee shops. The muesli and yogurt bowl with fruits was to die for and we came back every morning! We have a 3 year old and they brought her toys to play with and prepared her a bowl of oat milk like she was royalty.
review_4_text:
What a perfect place! The staff are so lovely, and it’s the best mango sticky rice I’ve ever had!!! I came here three times and I definitely want to come back again. You order a dish and receive a piece of art, everything is made with so much care!
Highly recommend! The prices are also very fair.
review_5_text: All the staff were warm and friendly. I made a complicated takeout order and they were very accommodating. They made a great effort adding the floral decorations into the takeout container and made it visually pleasing. The people who I ordered for were delighted with how the food presentation was done. The freshness and taste of the mango sticky rice is unmatched. This has got to be the best tasting mango of all the places I have tried in Chiang Mai and I am glad to have come to this place before my flight home.

name: Weekday Coffee&Bar
review_1_text: SUCH A CUTE GIRLY COFFEE SHOP. They have nice drink items and sweet treats. They played girly songs. It was suchhhh a vibe. Plus you can make bracelets and paint plates. It was so cute
review_2_text:
Korean style of cafe that sounds accidentally?... It was clean and quiet. I was able to see the room, but it is a space that is large even if I use it with my family, and I am looking forward to opening a new one on the second floor bar soon. Coffee also uses Arabica beans, so I think I thought about the taste and aroma.
Just be careful when you go out to the backyard, tall people
review_3_text: Cute, modern facade slyly hides a large, airy patio out back. Great drinks to go along with the space, served up by a real friendly group of staff. Not busy on a weekday afternoon, lovely spot.
review_4_text: Came by for 2 ice coffees at 9am o. A Friday. Only a couple before us who ordered coffees and dessert. Waited at least 20 minutes before I got impatient and lost track of how long we waited. If in a hurry I suggest this isn't the spot. Nice decor and coffee was decent.
review_5_text: great atmosphere, amazing service, good prices, good quality and quantity, had a great time painting plaster plates and eating yummy food and good drinks

name: Mom and Me
review_1_text: I absolutely loved this place!! We came here for breakfast and while the service was on the slower side, the food, lattes and juices were incredible. I could smell her cooking the garlic chicken in the back and the taste of that crispy garlic is still making my mouth water. The vibe in the restaurant is also really cool and very peaceful. Highly recommend for some good coffee and breakfast.
review_2_text:
this fantastic mom and pop restaurant feels like your family is cooking for you, it is so cozy. It is simple but so well executed and everything was delicious (the scrambled eggs on the toast were superb and the fresh fruit was great to share over smoothies).

It really shines when you are not in a rush and just want to appreciate the little things. Will definitely return.
review_3_text:
A nice breakfast retaurant.

Its very small, with only a few tables, so recommend getting here early.

The service was great, coffee strong and food tasty. A nice way to start the day.

We had avacardo on toast qith scrambled egg.  Two coffee's and a ginger tea.  It came in less than 200b per person.

The portions were very generous.
review_4_text:
My canteen!
I've been coming here every lunchtime for a month now. The food is excellent and lovingly prepared by Li and her daughter.
The setting, filled with flowers and plants, is also very soothing and relaxing.
I highly recommend it !
review_5_text:
Great coffee and good breakfast options. The fruit bowl with muesli and yogurt has tons of fruit - the best we had in Thailand so far. We can also recommend the Avodaco Toast and the omelette.
Much cheaper than other places around and still super high quality

name: Garage Café
review_1_text: Cozy café with the best Pad Thai I have ever had in town. I’ve come here so many times. Whenever I crave Pad Thai, this is always my go‑to spot, with warm service that makes every visit special.
review_2_text: We stumbled into this place totally by accident. But it turned out to be a great experience. There is not a lot on the menu but their Pad Thai is definitely on the top tier that I have had. Not to mention, the Thai ice tea is also a must try! We have devoured the food so much before we took a picture. Highly recommend this.
review_3_text: Kind, welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. We stumbled across the cafe and loved it. Pad Thai and mango sticky rice, the only menu items, were perfect. The owner told us he opened the cafe to serve the Thai iced tea but added other options just because. The cafe offers bananas for free while we wait and he prepared the pad Thai fresh. It was like eating in the patio of a family friend who also makes really delicious authentic Thai food. Thank you 🙏
review_4_text: I’ve been all over Thailand, can say hands down this is one of the best Pad Thai’s out there! This guy can cook!
review_5_text: What a great place for a nice warm meal! This spot was always in our route and we kept walking by it every day so we wanted to try their secret recipe Pad Thai. We ordered that plus one of the milk chocolate drinks. Everything was delicious and the owner was very kind! I find that a lot of places see tourists and automatically give them tourist flavors. We’ve tried a bunch of places for Pad Thai in the past week we’ve been here but I can def say this is the best one we’ve tried so far! We’ll be coming back to try the Thai Iced Tea and mango sticky rice along with another Pad Thai!

name: Nok Kafe / Home Cooked Vegetarian and Thai Food
review_1_text: Highly recommended for vegetarians! Auntie is super nice and welcoming, she’ll customize each dish for you. Ate here four times, the food is delicious! Tried the spicy thai basil fried rice, tom yum fried rice, tofu curry, mushrooms stir fry, broccoli stir fry, and the ginger tofu stir fry! Every dish on the menu can be made vegetarian with eggs/tofu. They have a very loving dog as well, don’t forget to play with it when you’re there. I’ll miss this place.
review_2_text: Amazing Khao Soi soup! The best I had in Chiang Mai. I am not the fan of fish sause so either here was very little or none. I went for veggie option and my partner ordered veggie plus tofu.
review_3_text:
Home cooking haven. If you wanna have a meal that feels like your aunt and granny are cooking for you, this is your place.

Food is fresh, tasty, with some herbs hand-picked on the spot right before preparation, and gets ready swiftly. And the menu is very affordable.

The atmosphere is lovely, full (like, full!) of plants, on a not so busy street, with a home vibe whose only downside is the maker space next to it which 1 out of 3 times we've eaten here this far has had some loud noise.

The ladies who run this are so very kind. I can definitely feel the love they put into the food, and have come here almost daily during my stay.

I'd 1000% recommend it!
review_4_text: The food is amazing, lovely homemade food, definitely worth the wait! Relaxing, serene restaurant with friendly, smiley owners! Hopefully be back in the future!!
review_5_text: This is a hidden hole in the wall that we discovered the last day of our stay of 10 days! To increase the irony, we stayed at the hotel right next to it, but the tendency is to walk towards the action and main street... We wished we had discovered it before because this was by far the best meal and dishes we had in Thailand! Atmosphere is quiet surrounded by nature and the owner served us with grace. The food was literally spectacular. I wish Michelin would discover this place because the food is high quality and to the level of the highest quality restaurants with prices of any street food quality... Seriously you must try this place! Thank you so much for this last meal before our flight. The highlight of food of our 2 weeks in Thailand.

name: Waker Club
review_1_text: Delicious yogurt bowl with fresh fruit, great coffee and the owners are lovely. Awesome place to hang out, relax, socialize in a quiet area tucked in the old city.
review_2_text: We loved having breakfast at this spot - awesome morning vibes on the patio, with lovely lattes and smoothie bowls! We went back multiple times during our stay - highly recommend!
review_3_text:
Good smoothies, good food and good vibes!
Love spending time here with friends. Free wifi 🥰✌🏻🥣
review_4_text: The best smoothies in town 🫶🏻 my favorite is Papi Chulo!
review_5_text: Nice place to have a good and yummy breakfast 🫰🏻

name: Tiny House [Bakery&Coffee] - Old Town Branch
review_1_text:
Tiny House is a small and very cozy café, perfect for escaping the heat and the bustle of Chiang Mai. It has the charm of those hidden places that feel like a little secret. Their homemade muffins are delicious, freshly baked and perfect to enjoy with a coffee.
Besides the pastries, you can also eat typical Thai dishes like pad krapao or pad thai, so it’s a great spot both for a sweet break or for something more filling. The staff is wonderful, very kind and attentive,and makes you feel at home from the very first moment.
A simple, authentic place full of charm that you’ll want to come back to 🪴🐞🌺💕🌱
review_2_text:
Lovely bakery hidden away. Treated ourselves to five cupcakes (Nutella, Nutella Cheesecake, Orange Crumble, Red Velvet and Chocolate).

All were delicious and very well priced with the cheapest being only 25 baht.
review_3_text:
We love this bakery!
The prices are fair, they are super tasty. I came back to this bakery so many times while my stay in Chiang Mai!
I love their cupcakes 🧁😋
review_4_text:
What a marvel!
All the beautiful cupcakes and scones hidden in a little alley of Chiamg Mai
review_5_text: So sweet and very delicious! We went there just before closing and they were so sweet to open again for us to get some cupcakes! Would definitely recommend

name: High On Pain Tattoo & Cafe
review_1_text: Ice absolutely nailed my tattoo. The shop has such a friendly, family vibe and I felt comfortable straight away. His family were so welcoming too honestly felt like I was being looked after at home. Ice added extra little details so it came out perfect, I could really tell he takes a lot of pride in his work. Couldn’t recommend this place enough!
review_2_text:
Ice et sa compagne ont été d’une gentillesse remarquable, très à l’écoute pour ma demande de tatouage, un super bon niveau en anglais qui rendait l’échange très fluide.
Très contente d’être passé sous son aiguille pour immortaliser mon voyage en Thaïlande. Je recommande à 100% ✨

name: COFFEE STATION
review_1_text: Quality brew! Nice owner/barista speaks some English and seems to know his coffee. I came here last year and still my fave cup on the street. Seems to have a legit European style machine. Sit solo on the side or with friends at the picnic table- enough roof to shield from rain or sun! PS-guard yourself against mosquitoes

name: Gain Ground
review_1_text: Gain Ground is an exquisite cafe (and shop) attached to a hotel serving high-quality tea with high-quality service. Truly a gem!

name: Samsibsan
review_1_text: Good
review_2_text: I'll give it four stars first. The staff are very nice. The only thing I'm concerned about is that there's no drinking water, so I'll give it four stars.
review_3_text:
Clean and affordable rooms.
Located in the heart of the city.
review_4_text: It is a hotel in a community near Chiang Mai Gate.
review_5_text: Excellent!

name: Baan weekday Guest House chiang Mai
Sunday Baker
review_1_text:
This coffee shop is conveniently located on the main road of old town, has an outdoor sunny space to have your breakfast under the sun.
Large selection of breakfast and good coffees to choose from. Cappuccino is not state-of-the-art in term of latte art. Staff is attentive.
Probably they need only to pay more attention to the outside tables cleanings. Anyway is worth to try.
review_2_text: Came back two days in a row. Food is delicious and they have so many options. Their scones are delicious as well as the corn flake crusted French toast. They have tons of pastries and cakes that all look delicious. Coffee is decent, they have a very large matcha menu which I have yet to try but they seem to be well versed in the matcha dept. Great atmosphere and has great AC.
review_3_text: It was so lovely I had to eat here two mornings in a row! Such a cute little cafe with many options for food, pastries, and beverages. The latte was good, but nothing too special. They do have an extensive selection of matcha, which I’d love to try one time. The French toast and scrambled eggs were absolutely delicious. If you order a side of bacon, be prepared to only get about 2 pieces. The almond croissant was decent. It was tasty but veryyy buttery and a bit messy. The atmosphere was great, they play some good music, and the AC is perfect.
review_4_text: Beautiful space, good service, delicious food, and VERY high quality standards. Simply amazing. Please let me help you open one in Central Viet Nam, you would kill it!!
review_5_text: Came here for breakfast. The muffin was lovely. The avocado and toast was okay. The coffee was just okay. It wasn't great. It was quite expensive as well considering other meals we have had in Chiang Mai.

name: Le light cafe'
review_1_text:
A yogurt bowl cold Summer case, was quite good. The bottle contains plain yogurt, oats, honey, apple, mango, banana, flux seeds.(hopefully I mentioned all.)
It was more than I expected for its price!!

It was actually to find the place to work on my lap top more than to have meal or drink after the cafe I was staying before reached to their closing time. But it was a such a nice encounter that I randomly picked this cafe. Table and chairs were right to work on computer, the bowl was tasty and right size, the waiter was sweet😌
review_2_text:
If you find yourself in Chiang Mai and are looking for a place where you can not only have a great meal but also have a nice time, Tsuneki Ramen is the place to go. The name of the place may not be too well known due to Google Maps misunderstandings, but trust me, it's worth it.

Stepping inside, you will immediately feel the welcoming atmosphere, thanks to the wonderful staff and cozy ambiance. The interior is complemented by comfortable furniture and a huge collection of graphic novels, which will especially appeal to fans of reading and Japanese culture. Despite the fact that the cafe is located next to the road, it is surprisingly quiet inside, allowing you to completely relax and enjoy a delicious meal.

Speaking of food, Tsuneki Ramen's menu will delight you with a variety of flavors. I stopped in here for a coffee but couldn't resist their culinary offerings. Everything I tried was simply delicious and the prices were quite nice.

This place deserves to be much more popular. I wish Tsuneki Ramen a huge success and I am sure that everyone who visits here will be satisfied with their visit. Don't miss this gem of Chiang Mai
review_3_text:
Great breakfast and super tasty Matcha Latte.

My god, there is even the Berserk series and Vagabond manga in japanese with Hiragana for those who cannot read kanjis.

You're pretty good
review_4_text: Absolutely loved my experience at this coffee shop in Chiang Mai! The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. Their 100% fruit juices are an absolute must-try – no added sugars or ice !!, just pure goodness. And the bonus? A shelf full of classic manga, including Berserk, for some delightful reading while sipping on those amazing juices.
review_5_text: The atmosphere and service was good, maybe a bit slow, but we didn’t mind. However, the food quality was not what we expected. I had avocado egg sandwich and it had more mayo than avo and egg, the smash was more white than green, and to top it all the toasts were buttered, quite a heavy breakfast. My husband had americano and he said it was okay.

name: M&N Coffee bubble tea
review_1_text:
This is the best avocado shake in town!
And the owner is the most friendly and loving person we met. We are really looking forward to come back to her whenever we‘re in town.
Lovely little shop and as I mentioned the best and friendliest service!
Thank you and hopefully see you soon!
review_2_text: The owner is so sweet and lovely! We talked a lot, she is funny and kind. She also has 2 dogs, very cute place!
review_3_text:
Nim is adorable!! And it was delicious!!
Go for it!

name: Friend Coffee & Bar
review_1_text: Very clean and good mood. Until late time, coffee is available because it’s running with bar together from 6pm. Kind staff. I just feel outside space is too small but very good for computer works in day and good drinking sun night.
review_2_text: A little more expensive, but good coffee & nice interior. Peaceful and cool. Nice break from the main streets!
review_3_text:
Love the vibe of this place, very minimal interior and clean. Spacious enough to do some work, though a lot of the seating is not conducive to doing extensive laptop work.

Coffee was top notch. I got the Double Black which is 2 shots of espresso and orange. It was good if you like that sort of thing.

Shout out to the music curator, I loved the music. It was a soulful deep house kind of vibe. Exactly my cup of tea (or coffee rather 😉)
review_4_text: This a good place to read, rest and good taste of coffee . 👍👍👍 Canada visitor.
review_5_text: Solid matcha latte and excellent atmosphere! I would skip on the pastries here though, nothing outstanding

name: HomeStation By Kokodrip
review_1_text: Great little hidden spot down the backs streets of the old town.  There’s several areas to hang out including some couches, bench seats and bean bags next to an outdoor pond.  The owners are very friendly and made me a fantastic chilled green tea.  Great spot to come and listen to the trickling of the waterfall in symphony with some piano keys tinkling in the background. #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: Stumbled upon it.  Super friendly host welcomed us in.  Surprised to eat delicious food sitting next to a beautiful koi pond
review_3_text: This place is BEAUTIFUL! Very cool, kitsch décor with amazing coffee, tea, delicious smoothies and a very reasonably priced menu! It's also a bar at night time. The owner is so interesting and friendly as well. Very quirky lady, and she creates such a nice atmosphere. We will definitely be back!
review_4_text: Probably the most beautiful cafe I’ve ever been to. Friendliest host as well!
review_5_text: Cozy place hidden in middle of the alley. Perfect atmosphere with friendly staff.

name: CAPULUS Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
This coffee shop is a MUST. The decor is incredible, it’s so comfy and cozy while giving dark academia vibes…. The staff was sooo sweet, coffee was perfect and tasty and they offer free snacks.

I mean… 5 stars. It’s also bigger than I thought when looking at the pictures; perfect place to work or read a book
review_2_text: A beautiful café to enjoy a good cup of coffee in a calm and relaxed atmosphere. The décor is elegant and thoughtfully curated, creating a soothing space that invites you to stay longer than planned. Perfect for unwinding, reading for a while, or simply savoring the moment ☕🌱🪴
review_3_text:
What a gorgeous latte art! Thanks !

This café has officially become my favorite coffee spot in Chiang Mai — almost my little secret that I hesitate to share.
Tucked away on a quiet street yet still close to everything, it’s the perfect place to catch up with friends over afternoon tea, or simply sit down with a book and work in peace. The atmosphere is calm, cozy, and effortlessly welcoming.
What truly makes this place special, though, is the people. The barista and staff are incredibly warm and friendly — you instantly feel comfortable and at ease.
And of course, the coffee is excellent. The latte is beautifully balanced, with the milk foam blending seamlessly into the espresso — smooth, rich, and crafted with care.
Highly recommended if you’re looking for a peaceful and high-quality coffee experience in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: Very welcoming coffee shop with charming library-inspired decor.  It was a great place for friends to catch up over some very delicious coffees.  The beverage-only menu is supplemented with a lovely assortment of free snacks.  The vibe was relaxed and low-key, the service was very friendly and efficient, and everything was spotlessly clean.  Definitely a good choice for a leisurely chat in a cool, cozy cafe.
review_5_text: Walked past this coffee shop and glad we decided to pop in. Lovely, quirky place with extremely helpful and friendly staff. The atmosphere is very relaxed and they really care about their coffee. Well worth a visit

name: คาเฟ่ ชิค โดยนางสาววนัสนันท์ ประดับสุข
P.J. Coffee & Food
review_1_text:
Pretty nice breakfast spot that also allows takeaways.

An open air restaurant that feels warm and cozy. The shop owners are very friendly, attentive, and speaks good English.

I got their omelette rice which is simple yet delicious, the portion is pretty big too. Also had a pad thai as a takeaway for my family, they enjoyed it as well. Loved the texture of the noodles especially, the taste is above average.

Also got a cappuccino with sugar, a bit on the sweeter side but it still tasted good.
review_2_text:
Wow! What a little slice of heaven. Delicious coffee, even more delicious food, all with friendly service and in an adorable atmosphere. Had the best time and ate every bite of my Pad See Ew - Khao soi was also perfection!

Come here if you want a quiet, peaceful meal with a great family serving you.
review_3_text: “Found this place by accident and had the best Pad Thai I ever ate! I came back two more times. The owners are so friendly and kind. Highly recommend!”
review_4_text: Had ice Americano & a chicken basil- server substituted the rice for veg for me. I appreciate this spot for its v lowkey simplicity that hits the spot to quench an on the go craving for something to eat or drink while also being cheap
review_5_text: The food is amazing and in great price. But most importantly the owner is such a lovely person! Very helpful and kind. We will definitely come back! :)

name: GORD CHIANGMAI HOTEL
review_1_text:
We walked through this little local street and saw GORD, a very charming hotel with character, like a hidden oasis in a very hot day.  So we stopped for lunch. Love the oasis atmosphere, so relaxing. Staff was well trained, so welcoming and friendly. We order three dishes: Ginger chicken with rice was very well crafted, the juicy and tender chicken meat and homemade ginger sauce was so savoury favor; Vermicelli minced pork kra-pao was a must if you look for the local spice; And not to miss tasty and crispy outside and tender on the inside chicken wings.
We will definitely try the hotel next time. 👍❤️
review_2_text: Absolutely loved my stay here at this hotel. The service was amazing. One morning I had an early pick up for a tour they, made me a sandwich to go. So unexpected and so sweet. They were very helpful with locations and recommending various activities. Would stay here again. Central location as well, so lots of options with food, Sunday market etc.
review_3_text: Great hotel for the price. The owners/front desk employees are so helpful and kind. Ideally located near night markets, temples and nightlife activities, but still very quiet at night. Clean, spacious rooms with basic amenities. Didn't get the opportunity to eat breakfast or at the onsite restaurant, but the outside areas are nice and relaxing.
review_4_text: The service was excellent. The staff were friendly and always ready to help. The room was clean and cosy. The food was delicious. 😊
review_5_text: Amazing place. My family stayed 5 days in the loft. Location is great, cozy and quiet and staff is very service-minded!

name: Gord Chiangmai Kitchen ครัวกอดเชียงใหม่ - Breakfast, Brunch & Lunch in the garden
review_1_text:
A very enjoyable breakfast, with both Western and Thai options. The menu is available all day, which is great 😍😍

It wasn't too noisy, with both hotel guests and others coming in for breakfast. The atmosphere was very relaxing, and the breakfast was delicious.

Credit cards are accepted for orders over 200 baht without any extra fees. 👍👍

I'm sure the lunch here must be good too, haha.
review_2_text: Some of the best food I have had in Thailand so far. Also a nice clean, relaxing atmosphere. Actually came back two days in a row to try some more food. The flavors and quality of food are crazy good. Definitely try this pork stuff, it’s amazing.. The squid is incredible as well
review_3_text:
Was so fortunate to stumble upon this gem today! The food is delicious, healthy and inexpensive. All the tables are surrounded by tropical greenery and there is a carp pond next to some comfy leather sofas, making for a lovely atmosphere.
What really stood out was the wonderful staff, who helped me with my sleeping baby. They provided an extra fan for him and moved the entire sofa further into the restaurant when it started pouring down with rain to make sure he wasn’t splashed 🥹 Thank you!
review_4_text:
We stayed at this little resort for two nights, and I’d definitely recommend this place if you come to Chiang Mai for a short visit. The location was spot on, we enjoyed are walks around the old down, it’s cute little streets. The food at the hotel was tasty and not expensive.

🌴 If you enjoy discovering hidden gems in Thailand , come join me on Instagram: @tanya.hanoff
review_5_text: Very cosy and nice food (also quite cheap). The chocolate chip with banana was one of the best things I’ve eaten in a while

name: MINTNIMAL
review_1_text:
Small but lovely ice cream shop.
Amazing mint chocolate ice cream! Great texture and perfectly balanced sweetness. Highly recommend! ;)
review_2_text: Absolutely wonderful banana chocolate cake, and the Thai iced tea is made fresh and is wonderfully roasted tea leaf-flavored. Cute little shop, too!
review_3_text: The smoothie I got was frickin great and chunky. There’s a nice vibe to the place as well.
review_4_text:
Very cute place to take a break, a great selection of ice-creams and sorbets, as well as a few baked treats too.

Went back a second time, the apple cake was delicious!
review_5_text: literally kicked out to wait into the heat while there was plenty of space inside. Very long waiting times, not sure how serving a scoop of ice cream can take this long. Smoothie was good, ice cream tastes meh

name: Pegasus Café & Roastery
review_1_text:
My wife and I stayed in Gord Nuea for a week, and this adorable little café was literally right downstairs from our place. To be honest, I didn’t check any social media or Google reviews before walking in — I just stumbled upon it — and I was absolutely blown away by the quality.
As someone who’s been drinking at least two cups of coffee a day for the past 8 years, I can confidently say their Americano is better than 95% of the coffee I’ve ever had anywhere in the world. Their pour-over (hand-brew) is straight-up boutique level: incredibly rich, layered, clean, and with that unique character that comes from locally sourced Thai beans. If you truly love coffee and appreciate the good things in life, you will fall in love with this place.
We ended up coming here every single morning of our stay — nothing starts a Chiang Mai day better than a cup from here. On the very last day, we found out the owner roasts the beans himself (we felt so stupid for only discovering this at the end!), so of course we immediately bought 3 bags to take home. It’s one of our most precious and happy memories from Chiang Mai.
We’ll definitely be back. Thank you to the lovely baristas and this lovely café — see you again soon!
review_2_text: Had a flat white and it was easily one of the best coffee we have had during our stay in Thailand. The medium roast beans they used tasted very good. There was a hint of sweetness, and apparently it comes from the milk produced here. It was an interesting surprise.
review_3_text: Lovely coffee roast, very calming space with relaxing water tricking down the made water sculptures. Only downfall they didnt have coconut milk but we got oat instead and enjoyed it. Would return again.
review_4_text: Great coffee, amazing atmosphere, relaxed quiet space. We were surprised with equipment that they buy from Italy. Definitely worth visiting.
review_5_text:
This is the best coffee we’ve had in Thailand after two weeks in both Bangkok and Chiang Mai.

Coming from Seattle and Portland, good coffee brings a special kind of joy. And the coffee here lives up to the hype. The space is also as others described, quiet and peaceful.

The owner is also excited to tell you about the different coffee drinks he makes. And for us English speakers, his English is very conversational.

name: GAAD Coffee/Bar & Conversation
review_1_text:
Flat White 75฿ (2026)

Has English menu, also accepts card.

Friendly staff. The cute girl who took my order also made my coffee, she is very careful when pouring foam milk into the cup.

There are at least 2 floors up, I went to the second floor, with a charging port for my phone and facing outside, so is a nice place to sit.

It is nice environment, some nice music, and quiet. And nice coffee.

I think is good to have some chat with friends, or quietly enjoying the day, reading a book, or listening to music, or just watching the outside busy street.

Nice place for me.
review_2_text:
One of the best cafés I’ve visited in Chiang Mai. I could feel that beloved sour-tangy flavour in the Americano — exactly how I like my coffee. The flat white was also exceptional.

The ambience is simple, elegant, and really calming. Coffee that truly hits the spot and makes you want to come back again.

A perfect place to hang around, relax, and enjoy great coffee in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: Such a good coffee and very nicely place They use north Thai coffee beans ,The shop is near Chiang Mai Gate Market. Makes you see the lifestyle of local people. Sourdough tuna pesto sandwich is delicious.
review_4_text:
Good place for a quick refresher. Alcohol and coffee in one place. Nice ambients. Nice renovation. Look at those wiring
..above you
review_5_text: Good coffee, delicious sandwiches, and a great atmosphere. Perfect for a morning visit or a relaxing evening chill.

name: Breakfast & brunch for healthy chamalay café bistro @Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Nice place, cool, good atmosphere
Good mix of western style food & drinks but no full English breakfast. No thai food either. Good presentation, but bland.  Sourdough spinach cheese & mushroom very bland without salt. Advocado, spinch & egg toast also bland without salt.
Special 'jaguar' coffee mediocre even with two shots. Shakes and smoothies are on the small side.  Tables & benches are smallish. Overall style over substance. Quite pricy too.  Will not return.
review_2_text: So many avocado options in the menu that i just want to try them all. lol The place is quiet, calming, and no wonder it has great reviews! Their Matcha Latte tastes good too! Avooolicious. 🥑💯🫶🏻
review_3_text: Lovely, quaint little breakfast spot across from the art centre and close to the food market. Choco bowl with soy protein was my favourite, lots of vegan/vego options along with usual eggs etc. Owner/cook is so friendly, always happy and welcomes you with a smile. Coffee is good, closed on Wednesdays.
review_4_text: Great place for a good and tasty breakfast. When it is full, there is a bit of a waiting time, but still worth the wait. The toast and coffee were very tasty and hearty. 10/10 would recommend and visit again.
review_5_text: Only open 8am - 12.30pm and normally a wait for a table. Extensive breakfast menu. We had an Acai bowl which was yum. Coffees were delicious too. Service was on the slow side but only because each order is made fresh to order. Worth the wait.

name: Rei coffee roaster
review_1_text: I love the atmosphere! And coffee is sooo delightful! Highly recommended
review_2_text: Best espresso I‘ve had on my trip so far, perfectly extracted light roast. Roasted in-house. Beans from thailand are available as hand brew.
review_3_text:
Rei Coffee Roaster – Specialty Coffee in Chiang Mai

Rei Coffee Roaster is a specialty coffee shop located at 5/1 Phra Pok Klao Road, Phra Singh, Chiang Mai. The café offers a minimalist and stylish ambiance, providing a cozy environment for coffee enthusiasts. Their menu features a variety of specialty coffee blends and delicious desserts. The café operates daily from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
review_4_text:
One of the best coffee in Thailand—I missed this coffee so much while I was abroad. The blend of Brazilian and Laotian beans is incredible. The caramel custard paired perfectly with the coffee. 🍮☕️

The service was outstanding, and the owner, who roasts the beans himself, is not only kind but also highly knowledgeable about coffee. If you're a coffee lover, I highly recommend this place. Plus, the prices are very reasonable!
review_5_text:
Great spot to take a break. Had a delicious iced matcha and my husband had an iced coffee. They also have Australian MilkLab almond milk and Japanese Oakside oatmilk available.

Great music too.

name: Konjohn coffee 2
review_1_text: Great coffee shop in the bottom floor of the Jomkitti Hotel, plenty of tea options and coffee and cakes! Staff is great. The lemon honey tea is so very refreshing! Lemon cake is good too!
review_2_text:
The staff were polite and the coffees I tried were both great (medium and dark roasts).

There's plenty of seating and the aircon is strong.
review_3_text: This cafe has a very relaxing nice vibe and a few comfy chairs and ok tables available. The prices of their drinks are pretty fair and a bit cheaper comparing to similar cafes with AC. My light roast americano was not good as expected though.
review_4_text:
Small nice, air-conditioned Café.
Selection is not too wide, varied but I think that's also a plus.
You can also choose your roast, light, medium or dark roast according to the coffee/latte you have selected.
But for example for a latte the medium roast (not so bitter) costs a little bit more.
Their Thai tea tastes really great, strong Thai tea flavor, you can also choose your sweetness.
Prices are good, acceptable
They have a toilet to use, toilet paper is outside the toilet to take inside with you.
All in all a nice small cafe to escape the hot heat.
review_5_text: Chilled vibe with the ambient instrumental music and comfy seats and sofas. Other customers are silent so we are talking quietly ourselves! Choice of roast level for the coffees of light, medium or dark. Choice of sugar level in the iced mocha. Basque cheesecake was really similar to those I've had in Andalusia! 100% recommended. To note - cash only.

name: Kalm Coffee
review_1_text: This is an amazingly cool space that is very inviting for just about everybody. It has a nice calm, feel to it. You can sit here and relax, enjoy editing to photos, reading some emails and just getting a great vibe, this is a very one of the kind place that should be in many places, not just here.
review_2_text: I only had time for hot coffee and I think will the calm atmosphere, this place is a place that I will definitely come back.
review_3_text: Nice and quiet spot to read, chill, or simply do nothing. Ordered an iced latte and enjoyed the peaceful silence in the café.
review_4_text: A cute coffee shop cafe with a variety of teas and coffees. They also had dessert, though not many of it - only around 4 options to pick from. The brownie was good! Lovely interior.
review_5_text:
Amazing concept, comfortable coffee shop, perfect air temperature, spacious indoor and outdoor area, and dirty cofee was absolutely delicious! What else do you want?

Drink selection is limited but still good enough.

name: Aunty Lek Coffeehouse
review_1_text:
Lovely roadside stall opposite CM market. Good and strong thai-style coffee and delicious toasties.
Good place to watch the hustle and bustle at the morning market and relax with a glass of coffee or tea.
Very affordable!
review_2_text:
This place is legit. Hot coffee = 15 baht. Sweet thick toast and poached eggs. Coffee was delicious!

She's in a good truck stand next to the market.
review_3_text: A good choice for easy local breakfast in Chiangmai near the market. My first time at this place and I loved it. The owner lady is really nice and friendly. I ordered eggs, coffee and toast with all cost at 30THB. I’d definitely come back again💕
review_4_text: The best toasties in Chiang Mai!!!!!!  a loving lady who prepares her toasts with lots of love!  Without a doubt the best local breakfast experience 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
review_5_text: Experience the lively busy local thai morning market and have breakfast at this Aunty Lek coffeehouse which is across from the market. I had all these for 39 baht -2 slices of milk toast, 2 soft boiled eggs and a cup of strong (sweet) thai coffee. AMAZING!

name: Coffee Tid Doi / e-Cin Cafe
review_1_text:
2009 Thailand Indy Barista Champion! Located inside the Chiang Mai Gate Market, near the main entrance. Great coffee! Smooth dark chocolate smokey woodsy flavor taste. Exceptional service with a smile and friendly welcoming! She also sells desserts as well. Highly recommended visit 👌

Scale 1-10:
Food/drink-10
Price-9
Service-10
Atmosphere-8
Cleanliness-9
review_2_text:
Best Thai Iced tea that we had so far.
Coffee is also exceptional!

Loved it and the owner is kind and heartwarming!
review_3_text: I saw the raving reviews here and I had to come here to try. As expected, the coffee is really great and you get a great amount in a cup. It is definitely one of the best place to get a to go coffee. I will be a regular and will come back to try different coffee on the menu. It’s located in the food court area in B1.
review_4_text:
She is hidden in the alley of the morning market , but still open when I went around 5:00 pm today.
Coffee latte was excellent and love her friendliness and big smile on her face when telling me her story of moving from a big shopping center to this booth. I admire her spirit and customer service , I rated her number #1 in the coffee taste and her service 👍
review_5_text: Lovely friendly shop owner! And great coffee in the market. Grab a cup and walk around.

name: กาแฟป้าเล็ก ประตูเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: The shop is opened really early and is located in front of the market near the gate. You can enjoy the breakfast after your morning walk. Nice and local taste.
review_2_text: recommend！
review_3_text: Coffee, Ovaltine, soft-boiled eggs. After eating, you can walk and look at the geese up close.
review_4_text:
Auntie Lek's coffee stall in front of Chiang Mai Gate Market.
I ordered and was amazed at how she could sell things at these prices! 5555
Soft-boiled eggs are 8 baht each.
The yolks are slightly cooked, not fishy at all.
Toast is 6 baht per slice, grilled over charcoal.
The bread is so soft.
Plus, free hot tea!
Auntie Lek came to chat with me when I paid. She was in a great mood.
She even wished me a safe journey home.
I was very impressed!
review_5_text: 10 | 10 | 10 No deductions. The way of life is not chaotic, not rushed. Sit and sip hot tea, soft-boiled eggs, light atmosphere, friendly owner, very kind. Most importantly, the price is not expensive at all.

name: ร้ากาแฟพิมผกา ตลาดประตูเชียงใหม่
도이 커피숍 Mae Ai
review_1_text:
Gourmet Hunter JOSH's Coffee Hunt Target No. 61:
Chiang Mai Gate Market 'Doi Coffee Mae Ai'

Location: In the heart of Chiang Mai Gate Market,
Amidst a maze of fishy aromas and spices.
Target: A small take-out-only coffee stand, 'Doi Coffee Shop Mae Ai Coffee'
Price: 40 baht each
Capturing the owner's smile Difficulty: S-Rank

[Iced Americano]

"This... is strong!!"

The first sip, a strong bitterness hits your tongue!

No acidity! No nuttiness!
The aroma... is faint, as if it's vanished into the darkness!

It's like the essence of bitterness freshly picked from the jungle!
It's not a special flavor,
but this cup
captures the spirit of Chiang Mai!

[Old Style Americano Top Milk]

"Wow!!!!" (Eyes wide open)

This is... a mixed coffee! The holy trinity of coffee, creamer, and sugar!

And with the addition of ice, a burst of cold sweetness!!

The moment I drank this,
my brain recalled memories of my childhood in front of a street vending machine!

Familiar... intense...

and dangerously addictive!!

[The Ultimate Smile – Hidden Ingredient]

But the true flavor...

wasn't in the coffee!

It was...

"The boss's smile!!!"

Soft and warm,
a serenity that could silence all the noise in this market.

That smile...

was like the final touch from the goddess of the culinary world!

"The taste was ordinary! But... the boss's smile
was legendary and uncaptureable!!"

This cup of coffee was something to be felt not with the tongue, but with the heart.

name: 121 Coffee
review_1_text:
Really nice little hidden coffee stall, they have good beans ground fresh right there, with a choice of roast, and a good selection of syrups. You can ask for how sweet you want your drinks. Friendly and quick service.

It's a walking beverage, no tables, but the quality is some of the best in the neighborhood and the grassy area of the moat is right across the street.
review_2_text: Great little hidden coffee stall. The lady here uses proper beans, Meiji milk and high quality syrups. Great place to try all the drinks
review_3_text:
Stopped here for a coffee on a walk.  We tried the Matcha Latte and Caramel Coffee Latte.  They were both made quickly and very tasty and refreshing.

I would ask for a bit less ice as it really waters down the drink.

Make barista was very friendly!
review_4_text: Real coffee from beans are 35B! Good aroma and tasty! I drink every morning. It's better less sugar or no sugar when you order!
review_5_text: My favorite little coffee/tea stand in all of Chiang Mai! The owner is lovely and the drinks are perfectly delicious! Highly recommend

name: บ้านยายมอญ : Baan Yai Morn (traditional food)
review_1_text: Morning quiet vintage deco coffee place in the market ☕️💚
review_2_text:
This place is a little gem and serves the absolute best coffee and noodles in town.

I was here in 2022 and again in 2023. It’s a very interesting little coffee and noodle shop right by the night market. There are quirky and interesting signs and images on the walls and some unusual ornamental items. The owner and his wife are very friendly, nice people.
review_3_text: Nice spot. nice coffee. nice price.
review_4_text: Loved the atmosphere, the coffee was best I've had in a while and such a good price!! Super friendly staff aswell. Would recommend
review_5_text: Great stop for a coffee. Thai tea and latte were superb. See all the hustle & bustle of the market.

name: Brown Coli Cafe
review_1_text: This is such a gem of a cafe. Well air conditioned, relaxing atmosphere, strong wifi for working, lovely workers, delicious food, and very well priced. I asked for little to no sugar in my mocha and it was excellent. The banana cake with caramel was surprisingly moist, warm, and absolutely delicious (coming from a chocolate lover)! This is tucked away along a busy main road. I hope more people discover them soon so they get more patronage.
review_2_text:
We enjoyed our drinks: coffee with oat milk + Camomile tea.
A cute cafe with cute clay work that you can buy.
Wouldn't recommend the cake though, I chose the chocolate cake and it wasn't tasty at all.
review_3_text:
Very nice small Cafe with AC. Friendly owner. Cafe Latte is 50 Baht. It also has a small arts gallery on the top floor.
I like the atmosphere.
review_4_text:
A nice little two-storey cafe, a few minutes walk from the Chiang Mai Gate Market. It faces the road and is tucked away with a small entrance. You need to look out for it.

The drinks are reasonably priced and the aircon + wifi is great. There are some charging points but not around all the tables. Suitable for work.

You can buy some artistic clay souvenirs here too. If you like a good view, sit on the second storey.

The owners are very friendly and welcoming. Worth a visit.
review_5_text: My friend and I loved this café so much we visited three times during our stay in Chiang Mai! They have a gorgeous selection of coffees, teas, and sodas, all beautifully presented. The staff are so kind and friendly as well. Definitely add this hidden gem to your Chiang Mai bucket list! ❤️

name: Psalm 1 shop & coffee
review_1_text:
Visiting from Seattle, USA!
After a wonderful breakfast across the street, we stopped in for a coffee and were not prepared for how good it was.

The latte is lightly sweetened to be perfectly balanced, and the cappuccino was excellent.
review_2_text: This is such a great place to stop and get coffee! Just opened 3 months ago. Only 40 - 50 baht for a delicious coffee- I had the iced cappuccino! The owner is so sweet and friendly!! Don’t miss this place :)
review_3_text: Best Thai tea I have gotten so far. Locals come here, and it's affordable. Hidden gem 💎
review_4_text: Lovely place in town with very high quality coffee at a very cheap price.
review_5_text: Friendly and professional service. We really enjoyed our time having coffee. We highly recommend this place!

name: Muan nai vieng cafe
review_1_text: Good coffee, chill and cozy. Highly recommended.
review_2_text: So good vibe cafe ☕️ The cafe is so cute!
review_3_text: The shop is so cute, it's a newly opened cafe.

name: HP House Cafe
review_1_text:
Good & not expensive spot for a more western-style breakfast.
For less then 500 bhats we had eggs/ sausage / fresh juice and coffee for 3.
review_2_text: Very good quality drinks. We had a mango pineapple yoghourt and a hot cocoa, both really nice
review_3_text: Nice and cozy pleace with tasty design. Quiet and polite service (struggling with English a bit). Tastt and fresh made food. Clean facilities. And last but not least - good coffee
review_4_text: Super cool coffee / breakfast cafe, friendly staff and environment.
review_5_text: Lovely staff and food. Very enjoyable.

name: Healthy​ club cafe' เฮลตี้คลับคาเฟ
review_1_text: Both cash and installment payment options are available.
review_2_text: beautiful

name: July coffee&bar&hostel
review_1_text: Comfortable little bar/bistro on the south-eastern part of Old Town. Iron barrels/drums are used as table bases.
review_2_text: Nice music, clean and a good variety of drink selection.

name: Unseen Lanna
review_1_text: I am trully delighted to discover this little coffee stall in a market. Lady there is very cute and coffee is top notch! Good quality beans, fresh milk for your capuccino or cafe latte, and probably best price for this quality of coffee in entire Chiang Mai! I went there couple of times in the morning during usual working hours of this market.

name: Benmeet Smoothie
review_1_text:
Stumbled upon Beenmeet Smoothie one night and keep going back for more! The lady is so lovely and so are her smoothies and soda's. Banana & cocoa with a scoop of protein powder is 90BHT🍌 🍫
Coconut smoothie 🥥
Honey Lime Soda 🍯 🍋‍🟩
Honestly perfect every time. Taste & consistency ✨
review_2_text: I always go to this place for smoothies every time I come to Chiangmai and it’s always been the best smoothies I’v ever tried here. Mango yogurt and cocoa smoothies are awesome ❤️❤️❤️❤️
review_3_text:
I’m always on the search for great smoothies. This place is a quality option.

I heard many people ask for many flavor mixes and each person loved their smoothie.

So many different options!
review_4_text: Best smoothies, good price and a lot of fruits i side, we have been there twice and it is definetely not enough :)
review_5_text: I came here for a smoothie, I left with a higher sperm count, clearer mind, and more joy in my soul! Benmeet  changed my life more than I knew it could, I will never go anywhere else for a smoothie

name: お母さんの美味しいタイティ屋さん
review_1_text:
A tiny little shop 😌

So adorable 🥰

The kind owner makes delicious Thai tea 🫖

name: Elliebum Bar &Bistro
