review_1_text: Had a coffee here. Was a very good one! And the price is very fair - 65 baht for iced cappo. The service of the staff there is also very nice and friendly! Great spot and their food looked amazing!
review_2_text: Elliebum Bar & Bistro is a lovely and calm bistro. Their food, as well their smoothies and fizzy drinks, taste great! Everyone is very friendly and polite. 10/10 would recommend!
review_3_text:
In this cup of lemon tea, I could really taste the lemon and the tea — not some artificial flavor from food science tricks.

The place felt like home. The staff treated me like family, not just a guest.They speak both English and Thai, so communication was super easy.

The space is modern, clean, and comfortable 🥳
Food and drinks are beautifully made, high quality, and really tasty

Must try: Lanna style friend rice if you love Thai spice and spicy food ❤️
review_4_text: The food is excellent. Authentic Thai food. We ate here three out of the four nights. Staff are very friendly and the service is quick.
review_5_text: I was not a guest of the hotel, but visited very often the bar and restaurant. Drinks, Food and People were amazing. By chance I heard the hotel organizes also tours and i directly booked one tour, one cooking class and a private driver for one day. All tours were perfect and even I was not a guest of the hotel I always felt at home. When I come back to chiang mai I will stay also at the hotel.

name: Cha cha coffee & tea
review_1_text: Very good bubble tea and a lot of choice of Coffee or tea or soda.
review_2_text:
Very tasty and affordable.

Not as sweet as other milk tea / bubble tea places around the area.

The portions are pretty big, don't consist exclusively of ice for once and taste very nice.

Priced well at around 30 thai baht.

They have fruit teas, milk teas and coffee. We tried the lychee green tea and the jasmine green tea, both 30thb.
review_3_text: Thai tea iced 45Baht

name: เป็นมิตร สมูทตี้
review_1_text: Very good smoothies, large selection of fruits, cheap prices and they ask if you want with or without sugar. Recommended.
review_2_text: A small shop near Chiang Mai Gate sells fruit smoothies made with many kinds of fruit. They are sweet, refreshing, and inexpensive. The vendor is quick and efficient, so you don't have to wait long. There are many foreign customers here.
review_3_text: Delicious and very affordable. I love it and visit often.

name: Daily Cha
review_1_text:
Best place I found to have cheap and delicious coffee or tea.

I ordered the coconut americano coffee, the coconut matcha and the Thai tea, and everything was delicious!

Great drinks for a cheap price, and very good size.

The staff is friendly, and depending on who takes your order speaks english as well.

Saw a lot of locals getting their drinks here, and that is a good signal.

The menu is HUGE with great variety! And they also have a special menu all with matcha, and another for coconut coffee tea or drinks, I add a translated photo.

For 20-25 baht you get a big delicious drink, and you can complement it with some delicious thai sweets from around the corner.

I don’t know exactly the hours the shop is open, but it is open at morning for sure.
It is inside the market under the roof, next to the “Coffee Tid Doi” shop.

Don’t miss it! :)
review_2_text: Delicious!

name: Aree Coffee and Tea
review_1_text: A nice spot for morning coffee. And a friend of Aree's sometimes stops by with an exotic bird or monkey, too.
review_2_text: Cofe or tea morning till noon. Weekend the family will take over as Saturday crowd there for local night market.

name: Soi7 espresso bar
review_1_text: Cold americano was decent. the place looks like a garage for coffee machines
review_2_text: Yummy and the guy making the coffee is nice!
review_3_text: Loved this place with a very industrial aesthetic. I literally thought it was an actual mechanics shop when I passed by the first time. The barista Toby is the sweetest guy you will meet in your whole life. Coffee is good and strong.
review_4_text: Rare gem for authentic moments, friendly barista, good quality coffee, chill vibe, great space for writing/sketching/reading. Highly recommend for non-insta focused people.
review_5_text: Fantastic coffee and a great place to watch people pass by

name: ขวัญถุงกาแฟสด
Poolside Coffee
review_1_text: Nice coffee near the swimming pool. The pool has a child zone. Also can rent a motorbike here.
review_2_text:
The best place to chill in Chiang Mai!
I love how peaceful this café is! Sitting by the pool with a fresh cup of coffee is just perfect. Plus, they have parking and motorbike rentals, so it’s super convenient. The owner is friendly and speaks different languages too.
review_3_text: Cute cafe by the pool with yummy food
review_4_text: Sipping a delicious coffee by the pool is an amazing experience! The peaceful atmosphere, great service, and perfect coffee make this place truly special. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: Amazing coffee in the quiet place of the town. Friendly and kind staff, with great outdoor seating and pool where you can enjoy the afternoon. Really a gem of coffee places of this city.

name: Craft.coffee
review_1_text:
Nice coffee. Prepared well.
The Latte was rich and flavourful... Strong coffee flavour.
A niche along the street for a bit of a rest to enjoy nice coffee.
review_2_text:
We stopped by chance and couldn’t have been more pleasantly surprised!!
The coffee is one of the best I’ve had so far. The young barista was lovely and made us an excellent coffee. It’s a small corner to take a break and enjoy a relaxed atmosphere.
review_3_text: This coffee was so good! I’ve worked in cafes at home in the UK for years and this is one of the best tasting coffees I’ve ever had, definitely recommend. Also a really cute sitting area! ☕️
review_4_text:
This coffee spot was an amazing experience! ☕✨

In just three days, we ended up going there six times and every single visit was great.

The coffee tastes incredible! You can choose between two types of beans dark or medium roast and both are absolutely delicious.

I also tried their matcha, and let me tell you, the quality is very good and very tasty! 🍵

One of the best things about this place is affordable, making it one of the best spots to enjoy a great cup of coffee without breaking the bank.

And to top it all off, the staff is super friendly and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better! 💛
review_5_text: Great coffee, lovely atmosphere, and a super friendly barista. Come and give it a try!

name: Real coffee & bubble tea
review_1_text: Good coffee
review_2_text: So good
review_3_text: “Delicious” and the seller is very friendly and lovely. 😍☕️✨
review_4_text: The latte was very delicious. The owner provided good service. I recommend it.
review_5_text: Another one of my favorite shops. Whenever I pass by, I have to stop and buy something. The owner is friendly and nice.

name: Little moon health caffe
review_1_text: Adorable really sweet staff good food beautiful presentation, so clean and pretty like a little oasis in the old town

name: Mango corner cafe
review_1_text: The smoothie was good, but it wasn't fresh, the worker just gave us what he had in the blender, who knows when he had made it. We had to rush back to our apt to use the bathroom. Won't be returning for smoothies, but may try the mango sticky rice.
review_2_text:
I actually clicked on 5 stars before getting my food but so far so good. No restroom but they filter water. Great options as well. Barely any room to sit but free WiFi if you ask.

Just got my food and its bomb. Do me a favor and eat here.
review_3_text:
Great, tasty food without MSG! Also vegetarian options, I took a Pad Thai with Tofu and peanuts and it was excellent. Will visit here again for sure.

Owner is super friendly guy and really helpful. He has served in the US national guard.

Unfortunately this place is now under reconstruction.
review_4_text: Very good mango and sticky rice for 79 baht. It was so good, we ordered a second. A really nice, what seemed to be couple, running the place.
review_5_text: There's no shortage of places to get a mango smoothie, it could be here, or across the street. But this place does an excellent job.

name: กาแฟสดรีบอร์น
review_1_text: Inside the temple area. Good price, good coffee!

name: The Cozy Caffè
review_1_text: Cute little place for when you want an American or European breakfast. The young lady that served us was so pleasant and such a joy. The food was fantastic and presented with great artistry. The whole experience was a really nice vibe. Definitely recommend, especially if you need a little different type of breakfast for a change.
review_2_text: Really good food and service! I ordered the french toast and it was a big and amazing serving. My friend wanted to order also and they ran out of bread and quickly went to the grocery store to get her fresh bread and they even apologized for the waiting!! amazing staff. Really good food.
review_3_text: This place is amazing! The atmosphere is peaceful, modern, and relaxing. The food was absolutely delicious – I had a healthy bowl and it was perfect. The coffee was really good too. I’ll definitely be back!
review_4_text:
I had a wonderful experience at this local Thai café. The staff were incredibly attentive and genuinely kind, which made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. The interior is beautifully designed — calm, cozy, and full of small details that create a very relaxing atmosphere. It’s the kind of place where you immediately feel at ease.

I came for brunch and the food was excellent: fresh, flavorful, and clearly prepared with care. Considering the quality, the prices are reasonable as well.

Overall, this café is a lovely spot for anyone looking to enjoy great food in a peaceful and warm setting. I’ll definitely be coming back.
review_5_text: Amazing place! The French toast is incredible, so much fresh fruit!!! The waitress who is a young lady is so so sweet and friendly. Also you can work from there in a peaceful environment and you don’t feel rushed at all. They have a very nice and quiet upstairs area. Only suggestion would be to offer honey instead of maple syrup for the French toast :-)

name: Thaan Aoan
review_1_text:
I had a pleasant meal at Thaan Aoan Restaurant in Chiang Mai. The food is good and generally well prepared, with flavors that reflect traditional Thai cuisine without being overly adjusted for tourists.

The menu offers a decent selection of local dishes. What we tried was tasty and made with fresh ingredients, even if not particularly memorable. Portions are fair and prices are reasonable for the area.

The atmosphere is simple and relaxed, suitable for an easy, no-frills meal. Service was polite and efficient, nothing exceptional but perfectly adequate.

Overall, Thaan Aoan is a solid option if you’re nearby and looking for straightforward Thai food in a calm setting. Not a standout destination, but a reliable choice.i
review_2_text:
A absolutely perfect breakfast! It gave me all the energy for the day.

The staff were incredibly friendly, always smiling, and happy to answer any questions.

Before 8:00 AM, the environment was very quiet with few customers, and the food came out very quickly. After 8:30 AM, it got busier and busier, haha.

I highly recommend this restaurant; as long as you avoid peak hours, it will be a very enjoyable meal.
review_3_text:
Was pleasantly surprised with the meal I got here. It was next to a main road and even though I sat outside with all the planting and lights it was actually very atmospheric.
Pretty standard Thai meal of spring rolls, pad Thai and mango sticky rice but it was my last night in Chiang Mai and you can't go wrong with these classics.
Really lovely food and impeccable service and not expensive for what I got.
Very tasty and super impressed.
review_4_text:
This place deserves 5 stars all around, one of the best in all of Chiang Mai.

Each dish was prepared fresh and presented with care. Food was flavourful, portions large, and food quality high, all with very reasonable prices. The mango bowl was a highlight!

Service was friendly, polite, and quick without being intrusive. The restaurant has a welcoming vibe. Will definitely be back!
review_5_text:
Nice dining in atmosphere. Clean authentic Chiang Mai design. I had the signature Chiang Mai Khao Soi with pork meat, which is a yellow noodle with Thai curry soup. So delicious. You can ask for less spicy or no spicy.

Saw their Western breakfast looks delicious too. A blend of perfectly local Chiang Mai, Thai food and Western food.

name: Bear Hug Cafe'
review_1_text:
I was really excited to visit Bear Hug Café after seeing photos online, especially for their latte art, but unfortunately it turned out to be a disappointment. When I ordered, they told me they couldn’t do latte art, which was surprising since that’s what the place is supposed to be known for.
The café felt dusty and old, with an atmosphere that was a bit uninviting. The food options were limited, and the quality didn’t impress me. Overall, it was not the experience I expected, and I left feeling disappointed. I wouldn’t personally recommend it based on my visit.
review_2_text: Amazing food and cafe! Vibe is super cute.. staff is nice and service is very very quick. Highlighly recommend the frappe and the sandwiches.
review_3_text:
I got a latte with bear art - super cute!
I also ordered the Korean Egg Drop bacon and egg sandwich. It was SO good! It had a slightly sweet flavor. I was worried it was going to be a bunch of runny egg but it was perfection. Im sad I discovered this on my last day because I would've come back!
review_4_text:
Amazing drinks and food !!! Staff are nice service is great. Atmosphere is super cute with vibey music playing softly in the background.
Great spot to pop in for a lunch or to bring your laptop, chill out and do some work.
review_5_text: Nice drink and delicious meal❤️ Must check in when visiting Chiang Mai🤩🤩

name: Mitt Studio
review_1_text: Such a great place to do ceramic work. The studio is clean, well-organized, and really relaxing—perfect for focusing and enjoying the process. The staff are friendly and helpful, and they explain everything clearly without hovering. Materials and tools are well prepared, and the overall vibe is calm and inspiring. I’ll definitely come back again!
review_2_text: Had a fantastic time here again, this time I learned wheel throwing. My wife and I have been coming here for over 3 years. Great teachers, great personalities, great art! Lovely place to relax and create some art, really bright and welcoming. Highly recommend.
review_3_text: Had such a great time here - such a unique, cozy, welcoming studio for anyone who wants to do some crafts 💗 would recommend to everyone who wants to just relax and make art!
review_4_text: Affordable first time pot throwing class! You get a couple hours to practice on the wheel and then keep a few pieces you make. The instructors speak some English so it was easy for us foreigners to understand the instructions very well. Friendly and easy to follow, just takes practice.
review_5_text: Went for my first wheel throwing experience and learned so much. The instructors were amazing and very kind. They spoke good English. Highly recommend :)

name: Meilleur Wine Coffee
review_1_text:
Walking through the streets of Chiang Mai, my wife and I found this Wine Oasis. The first  proper well curated selection of wines from around the world.
Its nice interior, and music, mixed with friendly attitude, at the correct room temperature, made our visit delightful. My wife had a glass of French  rose wine, I ordered a premium local lager beer, and then we shared a bottle of La Vieille Ferme white wine which drenched our curiosity to try new things in a town not very used to serving wine.
Feeling grateful, Sam Zesati and Bárbara Ortega
review_2_text: One of my favorite hidden gems in Chiang Mai.  Classy, Quality, Excellent Atmosphere!  Highly recommend if you’d like a chill evening with premium drinks and great service.
review_3_text: Small, cozy wine bar. Well curated selection of wine from around the globe and some things to nibble on while enjoying your wine. Nice little terrace, if you prefer to sit outside. Professional coffee maker available as well.
review_4_text: Very small but perfectly formed! A great selection of bottled wines, only a couple available by the glass but they were lovely. The owners are super friendly and the service excellent. Highly recommend for anyone wanting something more relaxed and refined to drink in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Great selection of wines (for Asia) and fair prices. Really enjoyed my Montepulciano red wine from the Abruzzo region. Probably the best place for a decent glass of wine in Chiang Mai Old town.

name: The Little Moon Lifestyle Cafe
review_1_text: Really delicious coffee and amazing focaccia sandwiches!! The most gorgeous decor too - perfect place to relax and enjoy the coffee. Staff are all lovely.
review_2_text:
Great coffee, music and atmosphere! Perfect to chill and have a coffee break!
The owner was really nice and kind also :)
review_3_text: Nice coffee, good people and relaxing ambience.
review_4_text: Lovely place! I just visited and got the iced cafe peanut butter. Coffee was delicious. The cafe itself is a great space with air conditioning and Wi-Fi, and the staff were all very friendly. I hope this place does well since it just opened :)
review_5_text: Coffee was delicious and the price was more than reasonable, especially as I added oat milk. Owner is lovely, a great atmosphere. Also super clean, would come back

name: SOME SPACE.CNX
review_1_text:
I visited this café yesterday and had a really nice experience. They offer frappes, but not a coffee one, so I asked if it would be possible to make it. They told me they had never done it before, but were happy to try — and the result was delicious.
They made me a coffee frappe with oat milk, perfectly balanced, smooth, and very tasty. You can really tell when people put effort into something, even if it’s not on the menu. We even talked about possibly adding it to the menu in the future, because it turned out so well.
The staff were friendly and open-minded, and the atmosphere was calm and welcoming.
If a coffee oat milk frappe ever makes it onto the menu… “Totty - frappetotty” wouldn’t be a bad name 😉.
Definitely a place I’d come back to.
review_2_text: Awesome place with delicious drinks! They have fruit smoothies, matcha drinks, coffees, lattes, frappes, and smiles! Very friendly owners are always here and ready to serve you a tasty drink and a nice smile!
review_3_text: Notice to espresso aficionados: they have a SINGLE  dose grinder. Ask for their médium roast and they will serve you a beautifully extracted fruity coffee like we rarely see in any coffee shop. And it is not even expensive. And on top of that they are some of the friendliest owners there is and love to share about coffee. Go, it's quite an experience.
review_4_text: This cafe is such a hidden gem! The coffee is absolutely delicious and aromatic — you can really taste the quality in every sip. The owner is super friendly and takes time to chat with customers, which makes the experience even more special. I love the warm, welcoming vibe here, and I’d definitely recommend everyone to come and try it out. Trust me, you’ll want to come back again!
review_5_text:
Thank you for your kindness! The drinks were really good !!
We will come back ☺️

name: Mrs.Clean Laundry café
review_1_text: An amazingly friendly and tasty breakfast and laundry service! The most fantastic Thai tea and home made jam - truly wish we had found this gem earlier in our visit to chiang mai as we would come daily. 10/10!
review_2_text:
Genuinely one of the best meals I had in my two weeks of traveling Thailand and, without a doubt, the best Thai tea. I ordered the massaman curry and spent the rest of my trip thinking about it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a genuine taste of Thailand at an affordable price. If you're having a hard time with the heat, just nite that the building does not have AC -- though the fans inside proved a pleasant breeze.

They also run a very efficient and affordable laundry service. Best of both worlds
review_3_text:
The best thai tea we had in 2 weeks in Thailand! If nothing else, you need to stop by and try the thai tea. I also had the wonton dumpling soup and my friend had the massaman curry and both were incredible. Well priced, perfect portion size, and friendly owners. Can’t ask for much more!

Cash only and no AC, but they have fans so it wasn’t too hot.

Also dropped some laundry off and was very happy! 50 baht per kilo for wash and dry and everything was returned folded very nicely. I would use their laundry service again.
review_4_text: Super friendly and welcoming staff! We just stopped by for a coffee, Thai tea, and some pancakes with yogurt and fruit — meant to be a little afternoon snack, but the portions were huge and we left totally stuffed. Everything was really tasty and the place has such a nice vibe. Totally recommend!
review_5_text: The food here is incredible!! Fresh and local ingredients, authentic and generous portions for a good price. And the coffee was spot on. Really friendly folks, give them a try. Khao Soi was the best I had in Thailand.

name: Alley Caffe
review_1_text: Cute little hole in the wall cafe with good coffee. Honestly the best coffee I’ve had in Thailand and they have alternative milks (inc. oat). Definitely worth dropping in for a coffee and a cookie!
review_2_text: Perfect if you want a handmade, affordable, instagramable place just inside of the old town. This place has a lovely iced Thai tea and matcha however the actual shop is a little small which makes it more like a takeaway cafe. All in all I would definitely recommend. :)
review_3_text: A small cozy cafe in the peaceful alley in old town. They have an oat milk option, which made me so glad! Matcha latte with oat milk was nice, good music and good vibe for saturday afternoon.
review_4_text: Super cute little alley cafe with delicious coffee and friendly baristas. Worth the visit for a nice cup of joe.
review_5_text: Good coffee and very cheap too. Unfortunately not a lot of space inside so it's more of a takeaway shop.

name: Kang pool cafe X bar
review_1_text: Such great food, sophisticated ambiance but at reasonable prices. Stayed at the hotel attached, The Chimes, also very nice. Live music on the patio, perfect place to have some drinks and relax. Also has parking which is great if you’re renting a car. Hard to find in this part of town.
review_2_text: Excellent food and very attentive service. Ate on the patio with a very talented acoustic guitarist. Pad Thai was very interestingly rolled inside a thin egg/omelette covering with large prawns on top. Haven’t seen that before and very tasty. Shrimp fried rice in a pineapple was superb. Very reasonable prices for the excellent quality. Highly recommended
review_3_text:
This is such a treat!
Great food!
Try the Kiki smoothie, fried rice in a pine apple, beef and everything! Tastes soooo goood!
Listen to this young man's song. We've requested Thai song even if we don't understand the meaning, and english songs are also sang in here.
Service was sooo good! We shall return someday when we are around Chiang Mai.
Kodus!
review_4_text:
Simply the​ Best​ Thai restaurant in​ Chiangmai.​ My most​ favorite menus​ are​below:
1) Stir-Fried​ Crispy​ Catfish in​ Dried Red​ Curry​ Paste
2) Deep​ Fried​ Fish​Cake
3) Stir-Fried​ Braised​ Pork​  with​ Basil​ Leaves
4) Stir-Fried​ Gourami​ Fish​  and​ Red​ Curry​ Paste
5) Crispy​ Pork​ Spicy​ salad​
review_5_text: Old hotel got renovated into a nice cafe in the middle of chiang mai touristy spots. Still have a scent of old-hand tasty food. Staff is polite and you can park there and walk to a lot of famous temples around the old town

name: Sunkiss Breakfast&Brunch
review_1_text: It is always interesting to visit new places, and this time we found this place for lunch. Here you can sit inside or outside as you wish, in a nice place with a good interior. The menu had a good selection of both food and drinks, with good service from the staff. Parking in the street past the place, or in the surrounding area.
review_2_text: Great breakfast spot if you fancy western. Good smooth coffee. Fairly priced. Big portions. Quick service. Cute decor and service. Indoor and outdoor seating.
review_3_text: ~ comfortable and relaxing atmosphere for breakfast.  the breakfast is fresh and made to order.  very delicious!!
review_4_text:
Sunkiss Breakfast & Brunch is a great spot for a relaxing meal. I had the chicken sandwich, and it was fresh, tasty, and came with a good portion of fries (although they could have been a bit more crispy in my opinion). The juice was also refreshing and paired well with the meal.

The service was excellent, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. I’d definitely recommend this place for brunch or a light lunch. A great place to unwind and enjoy good food!
review_5_text:
We had a lovely breakfast here that we wish to have pancakes so we searched from Google and went right away.

We had pancake set, waffle with avocado, Reddy Red(Beetroot and passion fruit), Go Green(Kale, pineaapple and cucumber) cold pressed juice. Food was made to order so need to be patient as well as the juice.

Food was nicely presented, bacon was crispy yet not dry and the fat was almost out. Waffles and pancake itself were a bit too sweet though.

Unfortunately we couldn't order coffee as the linked cafe was closed during low season...

Music and decorations was nice, overall is recommended.

name: C.U. CORNER Bar and Cafe
review_1_text: What a great find. Great and friendly open mic/jam. Every day except Sun? can’t remember. When they’re closed. Lovely staff also.
review_2_text: Tiny little bar on Moon Muang soi1. Wonderful live music too. Definitely worth a visit
review_3_text: A very small bar hidden in the alley of old town. I stayed in old town and went out at night walking around and looking for somewhere to have a drink, I saw some guitars on the wall when I passed by there, so I thought there might be some live music. As I expected that there were some cute British grandpas jamming some English songs. I had 2 bottles of beer and had a chill and relaxing time there.
review_4_text: Great little bar with brilliant live music when we visited. Great service and they serve dry cider.
review_5_text: A very intimate place with excellent live music provided by two great resident guitarists on Saturdays and Tuesdays. It’s wonderfully informal and if anyone wants to join in ( a harmonica player did yesterday plus a young lady) they’re made really welcome.

name: J-Ju Coffee
review_1_text: Super cute little coffee shop. The family that run it are really friendly too. Good coffee, Thai tea, and cocoa! They also have WiFi :)
review_2_text: I loved the quiet atmosphere in the morning and the lovely owners. The coffee was great, too. Would go there every day if ut was in my neighbourhood!
review_3_text: Great place and lovely staff. They make awesome coffee and French toast. We ate so much French toast that they went to the shops to get more bread for us - would recommend.
review_4_text: This small cosy cafe brewing very strong coffee grown in the mountains of Chiangmai is managed by family who also stay in the premise.
review_5_text: Just the most amazing place with the kindest owners. They made you feel very welcome and serve delicious hot Thai tea. The even made me a vegetarian toasted sandwich which wasn’t on the menu. Prepare for happiness and to leave with a smile!

name: Vipuya Bowls & Juice
review_1_text: Cute little hole-in-the-wall. Excellent oatmeal bowl. The service is what would make be come back. I almost ordered a coffee but at the last moment saw it was cold brew and I lightly said, "Ah, nevermind. I can't drink cold drinks." All with a smile. No big deal. All that was available though was cold water so I grabbed a small cup and sipped slowly, trying to heat it in my mouth before swallowing. I was just minding my business. The girl working here quietly noticed everything and offered me a cup of hot water!!! This was so sweet and thoughtful and I was so grateful 🙏 🥲
review_2_text: I just had a juice here but it was refreshing and the service friendly. Interesting selection of books, Ayn Rand and other selected reading!
review_3_text:
If you want something healthy and fresh come here when in Chiang Mai!

Just destroyed my green 💚 protein shake smoothie and it tasted delicious 😋 I'm feeling great 👍

3 types of protein powder to choose from. Don't forget to ask for Cinnamon for Free.

Nice slow calming music 🎶 with a few spots to sit at. Wasn't busy but business was steady. So I found a place to sit no problem.

Will come again 😊

Please 🙏 follow bouncingplaces here on Google or YouTube as I travel through Thailand 🇹🇭 and around the world 🌎 full time.

Enjoy your day today and every day 💯

Keep on Bouncing Baby!!
review_4_text:
Update - after the owners response to my initial comment, I decided to visit again as I had more appreciation for the quality of processes and ingredients. I actually eat organic whenever possible and when I’m home I cook alot from scratch so this response was welcomed and I thought I better visit again so I could update my review.

I ordered the same berry oats - my husband tried the tropical one this time and enjoyed it. He also got a pea protein shake which he enjoyed. I loved the porridge like I did last time. The owner also provided me with a juice for free at the end following my last review which was just going above and beyond and caught me off guard. I really appreciated that. It was delicious - I believe it was the liver detox one. She also had the music on this time which I noticed changed the ambience immediately - in a positive way ofcourse!

Thank you for a great experience!!

———————————————

Came here for breakfast. I got the very berries oats, & the boost memory/hair health juice & my husband got the comforts oats & glowing skin juice.
I enjoyed my oats, my husband didn’t enjoy his as much. Both juices were also average, mine tasted predominantly like beetroot & my husbands, celery. I think it was a little pricey, 500THB total for what you get but in saying that, I did really enjoy the oats so I would only get that if I were to come again.
Minimal ambience, felt almost awkward to have a chat because it was so quiet everyone would hear, some background music may have helped.
review_5_text: Food a little underwhelming.  I think they changed their management.  It used to be great.  Not any longer.  Less for more. Disappointing.  See Açai bowl in picture.  Not worth it

name: MORISTA - Specialty Matcha Cafe
review_1_text: A truly authentic matcha shop. The matcha is delicious, the desserts are tasty, and the atmosphere is great with a very natural feel. It's located right by the moat, making it perfect for taking beautiful photos.
review_2_text: The atmosphere is great, right by the moat. They have many different matcha flavors, each with its own unique character. The daifuku is also very soft, I loved it! I'll definitely come again. It's also close to home, easy to get to.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is great, the photos turn out beautiful, and you get a view of the moat. The white table is especially nice, it's really pretty.
review_4_text: The sheet cake is very delicious.
review_5_text: I really like daifuku; the strawberries are so sweet and juicy.

name: เฉาก๊วยเต็งหนึ่ง บ้านอิ่มอุ่น
Montree House
review_1_text: Such a cute place with very good coffee. 😁😁
review_2_text: Quiet and chill cafe located in the center of town. Great coffee beans. Coming here everyday.
review_3_text: I love this place! They have organic coffee beans from Chiang Mai, homemade coffee soap, and matcha from Uji, Japan. I highly recommend everyone visiting Chiang Mai try their coffee and matcha！
review_4_text: In the back of an eclectic yard, down a small lane from another small lane… it is worth seeking out. Most flavorful coffee I found in this area, and open early!
review_5_text: We had a lovely stay at Montree House! The room was spacious and the furnishings were new. The owner is incredibly friendly! There's free coffee downstairs, which is really delicious! You share the bathroom and refrigerator with another room, but we didn't mind that at all.

name: TUMA Coff
review_1_text: Good service
review_2_text: Good local coffee ☕️
review_3_text: Hommy Drip Coffee Shop feels like having coffee at a friend's house. The owner is kind. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
Chiang Mai's best drip coffee☺️
Experience the best coffee with a view of Old Town. The friendly baristas will make you happy. 🤍
review_5_text: This is a place where energy gathers, and not only do you have delicious hand-drip coffee, but you will also have many unexpected gains if you come here.

name: Brazil Blue Coffee
review_1_text:
I discovered this little cute cafe by chance. It started raining hard and I needed to get my day started with a jolt of caffeine.

I love the ambience, with outside patio area, lot of plants. Inside you have a corner sofa and a couple tables.

The latte is great, very bold flavor. I also had the Banana bread. Homemade and fresh.

The lady was absolutely cheerful and helpful. Free wifi and that's a plus.
review_2_text: Pleasantly comfortable little cafe in the same plaza of the gas station. There's a laundry mat next door so you pretty much can get your laundry done, a nice cup of Joe and chill out.
review_3_text: this is a favorite place , really great cappuccino & Latte & Americano & Blue Hawaii Yogart Smoothie, at extremely fair prices, always served with Tea .
review_4_text: Fast service, good coffee, lots of snacks to choose from. Cute decorations and comfy seating.
review_5_text: Delicious (and very strong) coffee in a quiet, cool, unassuming café tucked away next to a petrol station

name: Onesky Fiveseas Dripcoffee & Hand roaster(หนึ่งฟ้าห้าทะเล กาแฟดริปออแกนิค )
review_1_text:
Nice handdrip coffee in good taste and  good price. There serving is larger than other place in chiangmai and more importantly, the handdrip is very tasty.

The owners are very professional and gave me coffee advice suits for my daily routine :)
review_2_text: Best coffee I've ever had! Beans are hand picked, roasted and variety of ways giving amazing unique tastes and aroma. Just by chatting with them you can tell how passionate they are about making great coffee. Black pour over, hot or iced, is all that is available. But it's so good I wouldn't want to add anything.
review_3_text: Super serious coffee shop operated by a coffee loving couple. They gave me a good lecture and showed me and let me smell many different types of beans from Thailand. You can only get pour over here and no milk or anything else and just taste the coffee. If you are looking for a great cup of coffee, this is one of the places you can not miss in Chiang mai.
review_4_text:
The owners were super friendly and shared some interesting insight about Chiang Mai coffee beans while making a perfect pour over.

Honestly, the pour over was the best we’ve had tried in Chiang Mai—fantastic aroma, clean taste and layers of flavor in each sip.

He told us he personally selected and roasted the beans and we were really touched by his passion and love for promoting high-quality, locally grown coffee from Chiang Mai. Truly a  hidden gem. If you are a pour over lover, you must try it!
review_5_text:
While exploring the old town, randomly bumped into this cool looking coffee stand on the road a few weeks ago and finally got a chance to try it today. My girlfriend and I were not disappointed.

The quality of the coffee beans aroma and taste were quite strong and flavourful. They used a small hand grinder and after dripped the coffee into the cup. This artistic and organic coffee stand is quite unique. Try smelling a sample of the beans and give it a try! Prices are quite decent as well if you want hot or cold drinks.

Strike up a conversation with the owners (Thai and a lady from Hong Kong), they are quite nice as well and can tell you a little bit about the coffee. Highly recommend this place if you're in the area.

name: Baan Tem Aim Thai Cuisine
review_1_text:
Nice little charming cafe with tiny front garden, artsy type. The service is polite and professional but the coffee was weak in flavor. 50 bahts for average coffee. I did not try their food so, I do not know.
Scale 1-10:
Food/drink-5
Price-7
Service-10
Atmosphere-9
Cleanliness-9
review_2_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A Hidden Gem in Chiang Mai’s Old City

Even while the shop is under renovation, the experience at this matcha ice tea spot is wonderful. The staff are warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind—happy to chat and share their love for matcha. The service was smooth and attentive, and the iced matcha itself is rich, refreshing, and perfectly balanced.

It’s tucked away in the charming lanes of Chiang Mai’s Old City, making it feel like a special discovery. I can’t wait to come back next week when they officially reopen—the atmosphere is sure to be as delightful as the tea. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic, quality matcha! 🍵
review_3_text: Very cute little spot. Good coffee. Reasonable price. Soft sofas and lots of plants. The owner is very nice and polite. Free WiFi.
review_4_text: Smal family run coffee shop. Service is excellent, recommend supporting a local family. Coffee is very cheap also
review_5_text: Cute and nice vibe coffee..Will return nice people watching spot..staff friendly and helpful

name: Tiny-Coffee
review_1_text: Amazing little coffee shop. Good prices and delicious coffee! Also have two cute cats hanging around during the day
review_2_text:
Absolutely wonderful place!
Very friendly barista, Excellent drinks.
review_3_text: Coffee is delicious, we had the hot cappuccino and it was perfect - lovely lady too that gave us mosquito spray and a banana 😇
review_4_text: Loved this place so much! The owner and her cute cat were so warm and welcoming and we had such a peaceful time here. We are back home from our trip but still thinking fondly about our visit to Tiny Coffee
review_5_text:
This cafe is a hidden jem nestled in the Old Town in Chiang Mai.

It's on a one-way Soi in old town.

The owner is very kind and English is very good.

I got a hot latte, and it was good. It's a nice little spot to chill under a tree.
There is plenty of scooter parking.

name: Café Noah
review_1_text: Very friendly staff & coffee for a cause. Maybe the most meaningful coffee you can have is one that supports at risk children. Nice atmosphere & a good location near the most to rest in the A/C & talk to the lovely staff. Thank you 👏
review_2_text: I had one of the cheapest cappuccino that actually tasted good in the whole Thailand here.
review_3_text: Great Cafe with free WiFi, located downtown CM. This Cafe is a business for mission, helping disadvantaged children in Thailand.
review_4_text: Free WiFi. Delicious bakery items. Great tasting coffee. Friendly staff.
review_5_text: Amazzing

name: JoodJudz
review_1_text:
I had a mango smoothie with beautiful fresh flowers and an oatmilk matcha late. Both were ridiculously good. I didn’t know oatmilk could be so delicious!

Mill is such an incredibly sweet human, too. He clearly really cares about the drinks and food he makes and puts so much attention to detail into them. So helpful too! He helped me with suggestions in Chiangmai for a ton of things and was very friendly and patient despite my many, many questions :p
review_2_text:
This is a great cafe at our hotel. The owner Mill  is a brilliant host and looks after all his customers.  We can order and just sit and relax till he brings our order to us. Lovely man and we hope your business does well for you. You have perfect personality for what you do.
Regards Sandra
From Auckland New Zealand
review_3_text:
Best smoothies in Chiang Mai, and best of it the service!

Totally recommend it!

Ps: ask for the special green smoothie (bomb of flavours in your mouth)
review_4_text:
Great experience, the owner is professional, he has suggested us the itinerary trip with honest price.
He learn to make a cappuccino as a very Italian!
review_5_text: If you're in Chiang Mai, don’t miss Jood Judz Their mixed berry smoothie is incredibly delicious — smooth, balanced, and perfectly refreshing. One of the best I’ve had

name: ร้านกาแฟน้องเม่น
Roastniyom Coffee - มณีนาราคร
review_1_text:
Roastiyom 60 ฿ (2026)

Has English menu.

I actually don’t know what exactly is Roastiyom but since it is its signature so I give it a try.

It is nice, like latte but somehow tastier, maybe sweeter.

Good environment, with charging port available. Small but cozy.

Many locals.

Not sure if there is a toilet but it is not at the premise.
review_2_text: What a great place - with polite and friendly staff, tasty coffee that comes with a glass of water and a mini-jar of condensed milk, tasty cakes and relaxing atmosphere. The location is great too: just between the mall district and the old town. A must for a break in exploring.
review_3_text:
Open from 7am, it's a great place to relax after a morning stroll
The place is relaxing, calm and the soft background music helps to feel that sensation. As well as The gentle and polite staff :)
My brownie and cappuccino were also good !
review_4_text:
We had Iced Matcha Latte and Croissants for Breakfast. Everything was good and I can really recommend the Matcha Latte (we had 50% sweetness)!
Nice seats indoor and also to sit outdoor.
review_5_text:
Cozy little cafe.
I didn’t like the coffee, nor the croissant too much though.

name: Thai Milk Tea Stall
review_1_text:
I had the pleasure of visiting Tik’s Tea Stand, a hidden gem in Chiang Mai that has been serving authentic Thai drinks for over 20 years! The dedication and passion Tik puts into every cup are unmatched. Her Thai milk tea is rich, perfectly balanced, and absolutely unforgettable. Whether you’re craving a refreshing iced coffee or a comforting Thai tea, Tik’s expertise shines through in every sip.

A must-visit spot for anyone looking for authentic and delicious Thai beverages!
review_2_text: Great drinks
review_3_text: Amazing delicious
review_4_text: The best Thai milk tea in Thailand. The owner can customize a variety of drinks, all of which are very delicious!

name: SukiShake Café
review_1_text: We came for breakfast around 11am. It was quite busy and there was only one table left. The menu had lots of options and was pretty affordable. The food was delicious and took around 15 minutes to come. The food was fresh and the portions were great. The staff were friendly and the service was good. Everytime we walk past here it is full and I can see why! Would recommend.
review_2_text:
We arrived in Chiang Mai at 7am after a long ride from Bangkok. I went to Google maps and found this breakfast place was close to our accommodation. We waited until it opened and had the most delicious breakfast. They have lots of healthy freshly prepared meals. We have been here 5 times and order different things each time.
Everything tastes unreal and at a very good price. We have been traveling Thailand for 2 months and this is definitely my favourite breakfast/ lunch spot.
The negative reviews are not accurate at all.
My favourite is the sourdough bread with cream cheese and fresh tomato 10/10.
review_3_text: Amazing canal side resturant. The food is delicious, I have had breakfast here several times. The food is consistently amazing, service is very friendly. Would for sure return and recommend.
review_4_text: A lovely spot for health lovers! The prices are super affordable, and everything tastes amazing. I tried the Combo Set for only 200 THB, which includes a rice bowl and a freshly pressed juice. I chose honey + ginger + lime + cinnamon, and it was perfect refreshing and flavorful. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys healthy and delicious food. Lots of menu options to explore!
review_5_text: I came here three years ago and had a great experience,but this time was even better. I am happy to see they expanded the team and how the things have improved. The food as usual is delicious and went there every day of my stay in Chiang Mai. Congrats and see u on the next visit .

name: Dada Kafe
review_1_text: What an amazing celebration of our birthdays and an anniversary. Dada and her staff were amazing. The food was incredible and the bruschetta was a huge hit along with great thai food. Both vegetarians and meat eaters were thrilled with their meals. The birthday cake was a great surprise and delicious. DaDa’s suggestions for amounts and what would work best for a group was spot on. I can’t thank you enough for all you did to make this a fun and highly memorable celebration. Paul
review_2_text: The portions are very large and delicious. You can ask for extra peppers for Pad Thai, which are delicious. A lot of interesting items in the card.
review_3_text:
Its a nice place to hang out, super friendly staff. After a day cooking thai food in a course we took a western salad and some bruchette with yogurt on the side. Olive oil allowed us to dress salad ourselves whichbis how we prefer and the bread was surprisingly good. I saw thai food options as well so something for everyone.

On a subsequent visit we tried the thai options and a smoothie and both eete exellrnt.
review_4_text: Calm place, nice people and healthy food. A must in Chiang Maï. Energy smoothie based on avocado + mango + coconut milk + honey is to take if you want a pause in the old city and restart 😀
review_5_text: I found this place on my first night in Chiang Mai and had to go back for the next 2 evenings for dinner. The food was AMAZING and so FULL OF FLAVOUR - freshly cooked! The staff were very friendly and the low price point was a bonus. I had Sweet & Sour Pork x 2 nights, Red Curry, Berry rice x 3 nights and Smoothie Lassie #2 on the menu x 2 nights! Highly recommended!!

name: Trailer Coffee
review_1_text:
Trailer Coffee is part of the Suriwong bookshop, so easy to find.  It has two entrances, inside and outside seating with tables and some interesting and amusing decor.  Right now centred on Halloween.

My coffee was delicious, but very small -  and they don't do a large cup or mug.

Breakfast snacks are available and seem very popular.  There are live bands in the evening sometimes.  I will return and check the music out.

I particularly liked the low ceiling - which was well decorated.
review_2_text:
We stopped by while doing laundry across the street at Super wash. Excellent coffee and a good price. Great value for the quality. Really nice decor and tasteful music. The noodles looked great. We may come back to try while our dryer is going.

Yes the ceiling is a little low. No biggie. Coffee is Excellent.
review_3_text:
I had an iced matcha latte; it was pretty standard. What makes this place great is the fact that during the middle of the day, it's possible to sit outside under the shade without getting exposed to the sun, enjoy a drink and listen to the music playlist they put on (at a reasonable volume). Very chill.

I believe this used to be a bookstore, so there's plenty of space both indoors and outdoors.
review_4_text:
Consistent Good favor Kanom-Jean (domestic Thai noodle)

Coffee nice as always,

Now Open Till night with beer.

Please update shop photo and location .
review_5_text:
Simple place , with many coffee machine in the display, good strong coffee with 19g of coffee per shot
They have a training room for barista
The atmosphere is ok
Not really standing out in the coffee scene
Espresso shot 60thb

name: Coffee and Relax
review_1_text: My husband and I stopped here for a cold matcha latte and a hot cappuccino. The cafe served the matcha latte unsweetened, so I had to add the sugar myself. However, because the drink was cold, the sugar didn't dissolve well and leaving the matcha still bitter. Meanwhile, my husband felt that the hot cappuccino at a coffee shop near Waroros Market was much better and more affordable than the one here. It was a bit of a disappointing experience for us
review_2_text: Nice spot for a drink or a meal (they have breakfast options). I’ve only had drinks, but have seen many plates of food that looked delicious. Last time I was here I ended up getting a brown sugar fresh milk, which was refreshing and not too sweet. The women working here are friendly, and it’s nice to relax (as the name suggests) and have a drink to escape the heat for an hour or two.
review_3_text:
I was looking for a coffee shop that had comfortable sitting area and found this to the perfect place. I ended staying for over 2 hours and it never got packed. The staff is very friendly with everyone and seem to know many of the customers who stopped by. I also had my lunch and some yogurt too. If I’m ever back to Chiang Mai I’ll definitely come here again.

Food was delicious
It’s a small shop but enough sitting area inside and at the entrance.
review_4_text: Honestly, this might be the best matcha I’ve ever had in my life. You can feel it’s made with care, not just prepared and served. The sweet older lady who owns the place is an absolute gem, so warm, kind, and genuine, it feels like being welcomed into someone’s home. The matcha was insanely good, deep, smooth, perfectly balanced, just pure joy in a cup. Everything about this place feels right. Total gem. Absolute must-visit.
review_5_text: Delicious breakfast (on the photo: musli-yogurt with fruits) and coffee. Very friendly service!

name: Somewhere Espresso Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: A small and cozy café with amazing coffee 10/10, no doubt! They roast their own beans, so the flavor is super fresh and aromatic. The homemade cookies are also delicious, and coffee starts at just 45 THB, such a great deal for the quality. It’s a cute little spot that I always come back to whenever I’m in Chiang Mai. Must visit for coffee lovers! ☕🍪✨
review_2_text: If you want real good roastery-grade coffee in Chiangmai, this is the place! So many options for Single Origin beans - the owner also knows what to recommend when I asked for something more fruity. Lovely atmosphere inside as well!
review_3_text:
Just purchased 2 coffees this second and they were divine.
iced caramel latte with oat milk and a Thai style coffee

Both were so flavourful and refreshing, I've found my local whilst where in Chiang Mai!!
review_4_text:
This is my favorite little “hidden gem” coffee shop in Chiang Mai. Super-friendly owners, amazing coffee and non-coffee drinks (their Thai iced tea) was one of the best I had in Thailand), and some tasty pastries to go along with it!  They sell some fantastic local beans as well, which I can highly recommend. For the quality, it’s amazing how reasonable the prices are as well.

When the weather is moderate they open up the front of the shop to be open-air, but during the heat of the afternoon they close it to keep it nice and cool inside with air conditioning. Very convenient location to grab-and-go, but they have a surprising large amount of seating for such a tiny little place: 2-3 benches/tables inside, as well as 3 tables outside. Really recommend for a getting a drink and people-watching for a wee bit outside.

Edit (August 2025): was back in Chiang Mai and wanted to stop on again. The shop has changed a bit and became better! They had added a much larger indoor seating area now (you can comfortably sit with your drink), and they also have a list of single origin and house blend coffee beans you can choose from to have as a pour-over or in your coffee drink of choice. I am adding the pictures below to show these changes. They’ve also got a few more creative coffee concoction, as well as some desserts (cookies and cheesecake) to choose from. The couple who own this place are still lovely, and the woman’s English is excellent for talking about coffee, so if you have an questions please feel free to ask! I cannot recommend this spot highly enough - in a city filled with awesome coffee shops, this one is my favorite.
review_5_text: Amazing small coffee shop with a great Cappuccino and Late. Owners are so friendly and welcoming!!! We went every morning for a coffee. Not pricy and very cozy.

name: ENP Coffee In City
review_1_text: Fantastic vegan white chocolate and macadamia cookie and the best vegan banana bread! The bread was moist for a vegan dessert not to mention the delicious iced thai tea. We are pleased with their vegan desserts.
review_2_text:
A calm, cool space where you can enjoy an excellent coffee and something to eat whilst supporting a fantastic organisation, Elephant Nature Park, and a remarkable woman, Lek Chailert.
I highly recommend a visit here...and to Elephant Nature Park, which is an ethical sanctuary.
review_3_text: Thai tea is superb. I asked for unsweetened and got sweet, but that’s ok. It’s delicious anyways. I love the Thai tea here. The inside is very clean and service was friendly. There is air conditioning, so it’s great to come in and cool off from the heat. Grab a good drink and eat up before your next adventure.
review_4_text:
Good coffee but very bad coffee cups. Spilled the cappuccino all over my shirt and pants. Had to go launder the shirt in the restroom. Now it’s all soaking wet. Very bad cup lids. I advise to not use them at all. Get a cup to stay or take the to-go cup without the lid.

Also minus half a point for not having a whole milk.
review_5_text: Great place to stop for coffee and snacks. Also ice cream! And lots of space in air con

name: One Point Six Design & Cafe'
review_1_text: Absolutely in love with this place. Chill jazz music is exactly what I want to hear in a place where I come to get reading, drawing or work done. Strong coffee for a very fair price. Beautiful. There is also a very affordable laundry service in the same building which I will try soon if I don’t move to a new area of the city. All in all: One point siz is my new go to gem. ♡ review would be 5 stars if they reduced their plastic use. They use one time use plastic cups even if you stay and drink in house, and always give you a lid and straw even though it’s technically not always neccessary ☹
review_2_text: This place is a hidden gem. It is very small and quaint. The atmosphere is cool and relaxing with smooth jazz in the background and nice A/C. The coffee is outstanding and the staff are kind and efficient. Prices are very reasonable and cheap. If you're looking for good WiFi, coffee and a mellow place away from the hustle and bustle, definitely check out One Point Six. Highly recommended.
review_3_text: It's always my favourite little spot for an afternoon coffee!

name: Deal COFFEE n' Drunk
review_1_text: Unless you are french the owner will probably like you but this this place has horrible service. i will avoid this place at all cost. Other bars are more welcoming.
review_2_text: Good coffee, nice service

name: Moody Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text: Small hostel with two 8-bed rooms, mixed on 2nd floor, female on 3rd floor. Bed is spacious, with own light and powerpoint, blackout curtain. Shower, toilet, hairdryer, huge see through cage type locker for each bed right outside the room. But no mirror, except in common area on 1st floor. Clean overall.  Good coffee from the cafe attached to the reception.
review_2_text: This is a cat cave! the cats are so friendly and welcoming. The barista, he's as cute as his cats. Coffee is nice and well-balanced. Cookies are french -ish sweet(pretty sweet). Overall the place is relaxing. feel like home. back of the shop is under construction including toilet. They might open the hostel area soon. I'm looking forward to visit the café to cuddle with their cats again.
review_3_text:
Best hostel in Chiang Mai. The owner is very helpful and kind, gave us few recommendations about attractions around the city. Very clean and comfortable beds, each resembles private capsule, 8 beds in dorm. Great localization, not far from Phae Gate. At the entrance you can also drink one of the best coffees in Chiang Mai.

Only thing I can complain about is lack of mirrors in bathroom, but overall I recommend the place very much.
review_4_text: Great cat cafe. Good host good coffee good cats. It’s not as commercialize like other cat cafe that will force you to buy cat treats. The 3 cats here are calm and easy going. Highly recommended
review_5_text: Absolutely delicious, high quality coffee! And the three resident cats (ruby, gyoza and sammy I think) are sooo cute and friendly! Highly recommend for a pick-me-up coffee break :)

name: Cha haus.Thapae & The gifted vibes
review_1_text: Highly recommend for Thai tea! We are staying right down the road from here and stumbled upon it and I’m so glad we did. The biscoff lover is AMAZING! The cream cheese is basically just a really thick foam that’s absolutely delicious. 10/10 recommend and will be making daily stops here.
review_2_text:
The tea was super rich, both Thai tea and cheese topping were perfectly balance.

I ordered the Double Thai Tea Cheese yesterday, and it was absolutely amazing!
I really want to drink it again, but I can’t 😭
If I come back to Chiang Mai, I’ll definitely come back here!

They also have Reiki + Sound Healing in the same place!
an incredible spot to stay calm and stay delicious at the same time.🥹🌳
It’s not far from Tha Phae Road, yet it feels so peaceful, just like home. 🏡

The service was so warm and friendly!
And there’s a cute dog named khun "Happy" who came to greet us
barking a bit😅
but super adorable 🐕

I really love this place. Highly recommended! 🌿✨🧋👍🏻
review_3_text: This place is such a hidden gem! The biscoff lover drink with whipped cream cheese was AMAZING. Some of the best Thai tea we’ve had while in Thailand.
review_4_text: Very good, simple Thai tea. We got 10% sweet and it’s perfect! The bread with custard is nice too. You sit outside.
review_5_text: This is always my favourite place to order afternoon tea on Grab! They have a great variety of drinks, and one of my favourites is the Osmanthus tea with 25% sweetness. The delivery is always fast, and the shop really pays attention to small details. Everything is nicely packed and well prepared — love it! ❤️

name: Batch : baked and brew
review_1_text: Its just within the vicinity of Raming Lodge, where I am staying so it’s very accessible for me. And I tried their Brown Sugar and Pan De Chocolat and i loved it! My go to when I’m craving for something sweet! Plus the lady staff is very nice too! Love the overall vibe of the coffee shop 💚
review_2_text:
Great for coffee and a snack.
Cappuccino was 60B.
Strong and hot.
Perfect.
review_3_text: Top notch cafe with a stellar coffee barrister. The coffees are smooth, delicious and when I visited they were brewing coffee from Laos and also Thai style coffee which was a real treat. Thank you for the soothing coffee experience. It’s set in a nice street with a modern interior.
review_4_text:
Cute little coffee with some pastries and donuts, good prices, i had a cappuccino for 55 baht. They have pretty comfortable tables and chairs in case you want to work and great air conditioning which is rare. Also great wifi.
Coffee is good but would be nicer if they were served in actual cups and not plastic.
review_5_text:
Nestled in the heart of Chiang Mai, Batch is a delightful haven for pastry lovers and café enthusiasts alike. I visited on a Sunday morning, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional.

The staff were incredibly friendly and charming, greeting me with warm smiles and ensuring every detail of my visit was perfect. Their genuine hospitality elevated the already inviting atmosphere. As I sat down to enjoy my treats, the soothing melody of "Summer is for Falling in Love" played softly in the background, adding a romantic, serene ambiance to the space.

The selection of baked goods was impressive, showcasing an array of beautifully crafted pastries. I treated myself to a pain au chocolat and a croffle, both of which were absolute perfection. The pain au chocolat had the perfect balance of buttery flakiness and rich chocolate filling, while the croffle was delightfully crisp with just the right amount of sweetness.

The attention to detail, both in the food and the atmosphere, makes Batch a must-visit spot in Chiang Mai. Whether you're looking for a quiet place to unwind or simply craving delicious pastries, Batch promises a memorable experience. I can't wait to return!

name: Doi Tung Fresh Coffee
review_1_text: Fantastic coffee for where it is, latte bold in favour good hot temperature and large mug 70b . Thai tea 40b  Thank you.
review_2_text: Not a fancy cafe but a little coffee kiosk in Pantip building. Quite a relax place for a quick fix of coffee or Thai tea in a hot day. Staff with polite attitude 👍. Price is very fair, of course if you are looking for a very good coffee, this is not a place for you. 😅
review_3_text:
Delicious coffee.  Reliable quality.

I ordered the iced Doi Tung Dark Roast.  Packed with rich coffee flavour without being bitter.

Located inside Pantip Plaza the cafe has comfortable seating ... fully air-conditioned.
review_4_text:
Even with the extreme renovations taking place in Pantip Plaza, the 'Doi Tung Fresh Coffee' stall is still open.

Nothing to look a - but some of the best coffee and snacks to be found in downtown Chiang Mai.  Always plenty of customers here, even during the renovations.
review_5_text: Located at the ground floor of Pantip Plaza, nothing fancy, just a nice place to chill with drinks for a hot afternoon. I had 55THB Cocoa which was served in a big cup, tasting not bad.

name: Wawee coffee pantip
review_1_text:
We really like this new coffee shop that opened up close to the night market area in the Pantip Lifestyle center.
They have all of the “usual” coffee shop drinks and snacks, and some interesting different iced drinks that we enjoy.
They have oat and almond milk for those that prefer to avoid dairy.
There is plenty of indoor seating, and comfortable covered and uncovered outdoor seating, also.
Service was great. Prices are average.
review_2_text:
Small franchise coffee shop in the Pantip/BigC shop.  Pretty good pretty strong coffee.
Service is friendly and helpful
review_3_text: This cafe is now closed. The old shop has been split into an ice cream shop, and a shop that sells bags.
review_4_text: Nice, small Coffeeshop. But wuite expensive.
review_5_text:
Reliable quality across the chain.

The shop in Pantip Plaza/Big C is great for people watching or a break before shopping.

name: KAHI NUI COFFEE - Street side café bakery
review_1_text: Not here. Needs to update hours
review_2_text: Delicious coffee and baked goods! But he’s suddenly disappeared and not sure where he moved to or closed down?
review_3_text: Really the best coffee I have had in Thailand for only 40 bhat
review_4_text: perfect iced mocha and owner is very friendly, great value and highly recommended
review_5_text: Street-side coffee carts have everything, and even use organic beans.

name: ออม&ญ่าชาไข่มุก Aom&Ya Bubble Tea
review_1_text: Good bubble tea, low prices, and very kind service
review_2_text: Super nice selection, very low price, possibility to order low sugar - loved it!
review_3_text: Awesome, friendly owner and bubble drinks
review_4_text: I really like jasmine milk tea. It's so delicious and has the most jasmine aroma. If you love jasmine tea, you have to come and try it. Most importantly, the price is very friendly.😉😊
review_5_text:
Quite simply: zero stars if the store isn't open, but the opening hours on the storefront and online say it should be open.

I came all this way only to find the doors closed – I'M UTTERLY ANGRY!

name: UJIM Café & Bistro
review_1_text:
I can't work this place out.  I live nearby and have visited it MANY times, but never find anybody there.  It's often open, and I walk inside, but still nobody.  I've been there again just now, as it says open on the Google site, but still nobody.

The menu looks interesting, and as I pass it so often, if I EVER find anyone there and get served, I will write a new review.

NEW ADDITION TO REVIEW:
Well, tonight I finally found it open!  I had a coffee and it was just OK.  The person who served me said it was open every day, so I suspect this means evening time.  It's certainly a large, interesting place to visit, with a number of outside and inside areas.  The toilet actually has a tree in the middle of it, and is brightly decorated.  Finding it at night with minimum lights on is a challenge!

Why not give it a go and see what you think.
review_2_text: Love this cafe! They have an extensive outdoor space and a well-sized indoor space. It’s all themed around camping and the furniture is super comfortable and quality - you’ll want to stay for hours because of it! Drinks are standard price and taste great, can’t comment on the food since I haven’t had it. If you live in the area, Ujim is a great cafe to do some work in! Staff is friendly :)
review_3_text:
Awesome place to have lunch, dinner, have a cup of coffee, spend a nice time with friends, o by yourself.
Beds Khao Soy ever in all of Chiang Mai. Also it was here the first time I had orange juice with coffee! Refreshing!!
Very comfortable, air conditioner, none expensive,  beautiful house and nice attention.
Really loved the place!!!
review_4_text: Great cosy coffee shop wit cool interior and a big outdoor  space. Very  good coffee and very friendly owner. Definitely worth a visit
review_5_text: Food and coffee is great! Recommend coconut coffee! Love it!

name: Café Woodhouse at S*Trips
review_1_text: Total scam. Staff hostile. Claims cafe is for inhouse guest only. Should be -5 star. Avoid to help take the place down and celebrate their bankruptcy
review_2_text: It's a very friendly place; the owner and staff are truly exceptional, and the food is excellent. And it's inexpensive.

name: Mccafe
review_1_text: The service is very good. I have always bought from this shop and have been impressed every time I have used their services.

name: Magokoro Teahouse by มีใจให้มัทฉะ
review_1_text:
We discovered Magokoro Teahouse by coincidence while walking through Chiang Mai and decided to stop in for some tea - what a great decision. The place is beautifully designed in a traditional Japanese teahouse style, with a calm and peaceful atmosphere. There’s also a lovely garden area outside, which must be even more beautiful during the day (we visited after dark).

The matcha selection is outstanding, with several grades and varieties to choose from. The staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, and the presentation of the tea was elegant and authentic.

We enjoyed the experience so much that we even bought some matcha to take home. A truly serene and authentic spot - highly recommended for any tea lover visiting Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Love the real Japanese vibe and the matcha taste was great! I ordered the usucha set with wagachi and loved it. Want to order the second one, but have to stop myself 'coz I still have a lot of matcha selection in my freezer 😊 If I lived in Chiangmai, I guess I would find myself come here quite often. Thank you for having this beautiful matcha house in the city center like this so, people can come here and experience peace! Hope your business will always do well.
review_3_text:
Very disappointing experience for a place with so much potential. On a positive note, the Kokoro matcha was really good. Unfortunately, that was the highlight.

The service was poor, and communication with the waiter was difficult due to a language barrier. The place was extremely crowded, which completely took away the calm, quiet feeling you’d expect from a Japanese matcha tea house. It felt like they were trying to squeeze in as many people as possible, making it anything but relaxing.

We asked for a bit of extra milk, and only after checking our bill were we told we could get a small amount — just once. While we were still drinking our matcha, the waiter brought the bill, took our credit card, and didn’t return it. About 10 minutes after we could see the payment had gone through, we had to ask for our card back. This was uncomfortable, especially with how packed the place was and the card left unattended.

This place has all the elements to be something special, but unfortunately it fell short. It felt overpriced and underdelivered.
review_4_text: Came in for a late dessert and was blown away by the quality of food and beverage, gorgeous tatami room, also the friendly service from the wait staff. By far the best place for Japanese style parfaits. The Yuzu parfait came with sorbet and yoghurt gelato, a perfectly balanced dessert with all the trimmings. The hojicha parfait came with hojicha gelato that's smokey, rich and decadent, perfectly paired with mochi and red beans. We also ordered sencha tea that came in the most beautiful artisan teapot, the best quality ceramic I've experienced in a tea house outside of Japan. The Japanese garden is simply zen and a delight. Definitely coming back for more!
review_5_text: Beautiful place with different areas to see. Extensive menu of matcha drinks. We took yamayuki. Interesting flavor, but personally felt too much wakame seaweed flavor. Matcha roll was perfectly smooth and not too sweet. Expect to wait in the queue to be sifted

name: Malee Bakery & Ice Cream
review_1_text: The coconut cake here is delicious and a must-try. It’s perfectly sweet with light, well-whipped cream that doesn’t feel heavy. I bought as take away so will no comment about the atmosphere when eat there. The store is little cute and no noisy.
review_2_text: Great place to pick up yummy cakes and pastries. The coconut cake is layered inside a real whole round coconut flesh, very decadent and I've never had this presentation anywhere else before. The fluffy cheese cake was airy and the right amount of sweetness, very morish! Price is on the higher range but we'll worth the quality and perfect for a treat.
review_3_text: I got the blueberry cheesecake. It’s cute but bad, especially that purple cream and the cheesecake had a weird consistency. Not a fan of cute desserts that don’t taste great. Expensive and extra calories
review_4_text: We had a great experience here. The sweets were delicious, perfectly sweet and the cakes were perfectly moist. The coffee was very good, but maybe a little too much milk and could use more coffee flavor. But we were very happy and would come back!
review_5_text:
Awesome bakery
The coconut cake was delicious as was the tiramisu.
Must go back for the strawberry shortcake asap
Service was amazing and although it’s a small shop it’s just cozy enough to enjoy!!

name: Starbucks
review_1_text:
I really like the Starbucks it’s easy and convenient to the night bizarre market and the service is really fast and good and I also love that you can get sweet tea in Thailand. If you order a black shaken iced tea with five sugar pumps, you’ll have sweet tea like you have in Texas. You can adjust accordingly to your taste. I don’t like mine super sweet so if you’d like it super sweet, maybe seven or eight pumps

it’s right across the street from the Marriott and right on the street with the night bizarre market

I hope this helps and I hope you enjoy your time in Thailand
review_2_text:
Dropped by this Starbucks outlet a week before Christmas and they were in full swing for the holidays.

Ordered a mocha and an affogato. The Starbucks affogato is, unbeatable. I strongly recommend it.

The service at this outlet was pretty fast, especially with only one person working.

Can't say much for the ambience because there were Christmas decor inside and the street vendors right outside.
review_3_text: Spacious little but plenty of tables starbucks. Great plates and beverages that i have not seen in other starbucks not even in Bangkok. Very clean and the coffees are made very well. It has all the great taste as it should be and its location is incredible.
review_4_text:
The staff here are polite, friendly, and helpful. The prices are standard for Starbucks in Thailand. My chai tea cost 95B. They also have a good selection of merchandise available, including the Christmas range.
The cafe is big with lots of seating available. They pull the blinds half down when it is too sunny 😊
review_5_text:
Went in to grab a souvenir mug.
The clerk was extremely friendly and helpful.

name: Going up cafe
review_1_text: Fresh sandwiches homemade which has a good taste and clean. Friendly staffs and reasonable price. Seating is available for eat in and balcony. Breakfast menu is interesting and please try sandwich and wrap. Coffee and drinks  is available Must try
review_2_text:
nice to have a sandwich again. We both enjoyed them!  Oh and they’re pretty affordable!

we also ordered through grab. it came warm and the bread was still nice. The english tea had milk and was tasty.
review_3_text:
small cafe but seems to enjoy good patronage.
Cute cafe, cool inside with smoker friendly seating outside.
Good quality ingredients and surprisingly good coffee.
Excellent value.
review_4_text: This was the best chicken&avokado sandwich I have ever had 🥪 Fresh and tasty food, great service and good price 🙂 Sandwiches are really big so if you take also scrambled eggs with bacon, you can share one sandwich for 2 people. Ya and they have also almond milk if you are lactose intolerant 😊
review_5_text: Had breakfast in Going Up Cafe for 4 days from Jan 12-15, 2026.  Menu includes breakfast sets and many varieties of sandwiches at very reasonable prices.  All are freshly prepared on the spot.  Great service and ambience.   Staff were very efficient in their service of customers in the cafe as well as online / phone orders for takeaway.  Clearly a very popular cafe with many Thai locals dining in the cafe and also order takeaway.   A gem in Chiang Mai not to be missed if one wishes to have freshly prepared sandwiches instead of paying over-priced breakfast in the hotels within walking distance from the cafe (eg Melia hotel, Anantara and others).  Highly recommend.

name: LAZY LEMON BREAKFAST CLUB
review_1_text: SUCH great eggs royale, not on the menu so I was one of those annoying people who “made their own” breakfast and my god was it delicious, hollandaise was perfectly balanced and they added capers and red onion which elevated the entire dish, poached eggs were perfect too; I got a chai latte which tasted homemade it was so yummy and my partner got the tropical fruit pancakes which were HUGE! I will be coming back here a lot!
review_2_text: This place is amazing. Food is delicious and like art. We got tea, which had fresh herbs, compote pancakes and avocado toast. Every single thing exceeded expectations. Highly highly recommend especially if you are craving western food
review_3_text: Amazing amazing experience at the last lemon breakfast at club!! Saw this place in a Chiang mai YouTube video and had to come because it’s super aesthetic pancake + tropical fruit plate and it’s beautiful menu 🙏🏼 did not disappoint!! I got an egg and bacon with pancakes and added sourdough in the side (iykyk) and my girlfriend got the tropical pancakes! Everything was delicious, pancakes with syrup were a highlight! 10/10 recommend this lowkey spot 😭❤️
review_4_text: Food here is delicious, beautifully presented and very reasonably priced! We got the tropical fruit pancakes, they were light and fluffy as a cloud and came with so much fruit we had to take them in a to-go box because we weren’t able to finish them all. Service was perfect as well! Recommend this place for breakfast.
review_5_text: Getting breakfast here was exceptional! I got avocado toast. My husband got pancakes with bacon and eggs and my brother got pancakes with fruit and each dish was a work of art and also extremely well plated and cooked and of course delicious. Would definitely come back here for breakfast again

name: Sultan harlem
review_1_text:
I have been a regular here for quite some time, and have always had a great experience. Staff is friendly, service is always A1 and the shisha is always great too. The pricing is very good, and there is something at the shop for everyone food, drink, shisha.
The atmosphere in the shop is great and the vibe is friendly, there are board games and card games at all the tables too, and music playing at a reasonable volume so that you can enjoy conversation with your friends.

I’d definitely recommend to anyone in Chiang Mai to come past and spend a night out here
review_2_text:
Sultan’s Harlem offers a welcoming atmosphere, excellent service, and delicious drinks.
The space is clean, air-conditioned, and designed for comfort — perfect for relaxing with friends over smooth baraku in a stylish and laid-back setting.
Highly recommended for those looking to unwind in a cool, cozy spot.
review_3_text:
Was looking for best Shisha spot in Chiang Mai and then came across this.

Hands down best Shisha in town + the brands they use.

Vibe is cozy and makes you stay longer.

If you are a shisha lover, you must visit here.
review_4_text: Shisha was great, always happy to find a lounge in Thailand. Will definitely be back when in town.
review_5_text:
Great place. Recommended to visit.
Guy who runs the place - Ahmed is super professional.
Flavors selection is good. He can also make you Dark Side or some other heavier tobacco.
Great place!

name: Buncha’s slow bar
review_1_text: Atmospheric place, good people, coffee and prices. However it’s very hot inside and if you would like to work with your laptop - there’s  no tables
review_2_text: Really nice coffee to start your mornings with, you can even choose your preferred beans. Also quite affordable :)
review_3_text: Really cool coffee spot! Friendly service, great cappuccino. You can choose which roast you like- light, medium, dark. They gave me some cute stickers as well ;)
review_4_text: Very nice speciality coffee, super friendly staff and chill atmosphere ☕️
review_5_text: The best coffee in Chiang Mai in my opinion. I also bought some coffee beans and am very happy drinking my Thai coffee at home.

name: เดอะ ซิลเวอร์ คาเฟ่ 80/2 ถนนลอยเคราะห์
T'leaf Cafe
review_1_text: Wonderful place with proper latte
review_2_text: If you want to try Burmese food, this is the place to go. I've been here three times, and it's super delicious, whether it's fried rice or noodles. I love the refreshing and not-too-greasy seasoning. The environment is also very comfortable; I love coming here in the afternoon to enjoy the sunshine.

name: Guu Luscious Roti & Tea กู โรตีชาชัก ไนท์บาซาร์
review_1_text: Big variety of Roti & Dessert menu options available. Tried 2 different types of Roti and both were delicious. Owner & staff are super friendly. Open late night vs. other restaurants in the area.
review_2_text: Delicious   Dessert yummy tea   Happy friendly staff what else i can ask l for !! I highly recommend 😍👌
review_3_text: Halal food.... Hot tea
review_4_text: Need some refreshment during trolling along the street of Chiang Mai's Night Bazaar.
review_5_text: Great.

name: ร้านกาแฟมิราเคิล
review_1_text: Friendly proprietor who makes a delicious hot latte at her corner cafe. I enjoyed this very much. Thank you!

name: The Plaii Eatery Cafe & Bar
