review_1_text: Love this little bar. I only went for drinks so that’s all I can really speak to but the service is amazing. Atmosphere is more upscale and the prices do reflect that. Their drinks are very creative and yummy. They bring you a couple complimentary snacks to go with your drink which I found to be a nice surprise. We did also get the red velvet croissant which was delicious. I would 100% recommend I have no complaints.
review_2_text: Pretty simple to find accessible from the parking lot and the main hotel had myself a black coffee girl had an oat milk latte. Both of them tasted pretty great. They gave you this little biscuit thing. I’m not exactly sure what it is. Didn’t really eat it but all in all pretty great place to stop to grab some coffee.
review_3_text:
A really nice addition to the hotel.  Very stylish, clean and comfortable.

Friendly staff and interesting promotions.  A good range of cocktails and wines.
review_4_text: Awesome little spot in a very busy place in Chiang Mai inside of the hotel area so very premium seating in selection coffee taste very good. That was the black coffee that I just tasted about to taste. The latte latte is good, but prefer it with vanilla great place to stop
review_5_text: Love the vibes and atmosphere with fresh coffee and delicious pastries. Highly recommend to chill out @ChangKlan and old town.

review_2_text:
Amazing coffee, organic beans, lovely service! Plus the value for money.
Pad Thai outside is great too.
review_3_text: Tiny little coffee shop with amazing coffee and very affordable prices! Highly recommended!
review_4_text: Lovely coffee place.
review_5_text:
The best Thai tea I've ever tasted, for 30 baht!
A gem!

name: Casa Verde, Dusit Princess Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Good & safe environment for a chill drink. Unlimited cocktail/ wine for 1.5hr OR buy 1 free 1 at certain timing. Check out the restaurant for more info. This is not a paid ads 😁😁
review_2_text: The atmosphere inside is comfortable, the vibe is good, the staff are lovely, provide good service, and are fun to talk to. Khun Phet, Khun Jane, Khun Pleng, Khun Jan ordered cocktails to go with the delicious food. The cocktails were very good. The bar staff, Khun Ball, Khun Yod, served every glass well. I highly recommend it.
review_3_text: We visited during Chinese New Year and there were many activities. The service was excellent, and the food was delicious and satisfying with a wide variety of dishes. My favorites were the Peking duck and crispy pork. The staff were very helpful and provided great service. I was very impressed. Jan was especially helpful with information; she was lovely.
review_4_text: Great atmosphere, great cocktails, delicious food, great prices 🥰😘
review_5_text:
Manager Petch
Bartender Nong Jane
Great bartender
Chef Tum
Excellent service
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: pista.chio cafe
review_1_text: Grilled cheese sandwich is so perfect price is very cheap is 69฿ a cute little cafe I think it's a new opened coffee shop There are very good promotions
review_2_text:
Coffee here is great, and the team at Pista.chio are genuinely honest and helpful. I lost a ring on a day I’d been to several places, so I went back everywhere to check. Pista.chio took my details, and the next day they messaged to say they’d found it. The barista said they searched around the store and found it that morning.

Also, their Thai tea is excellent. Chatramue will always be my favourite, but this is a very close second.
review_3_text: Underrated place for coffee. Did not try any food here but their flat white is very good, much better than the coffee place two stores down. Great service and very polite.
review_4_text: Well made coffee drinks.  Bright interior with big windows for people watching.
review_5_text: This place is underrated - great vibe, great coffee and great service. All for a great price too. Def would recommend 👌🏾

name: GoGreen Bar - Weed & Cannabis
review_1_text:
Zada was incredibly helpful and
knowledgeable during my visit. She took the time to listen to what I was looking for and made thoughtful recommendations based on my preferences. Her friendly attitude and professional vibe made the whole experience super comfortable and easy. You can tell she really knows her stuff and genuinely cares about helping customers find the right products.
review_2_text: Great shop with an awesome vibe and super friendly staff. Whether you’re in the mood for a unique cocktail or looking to enjoy some quality medicine, this is the perfect spot to check out. Highly recommend!
review_3_text: The staff is really nice. The drinks are really good and decorated so lovely.
review_4_text: Upscale dispensary that also serves drinks too. This is the best place to buy, smoke & hang out. My go to place for bud in Chiang Mai. They have flower for every budget. Employees are very friendly & they roll for free (please tip)
review_5_text:
Selection kinda sucks and 450-500 baht for just ONE gram of good weed sucks a lot
Almost every other dispensary in chiang mai sells at least an eighth for 450-500

name: Absolutely Roti & Tea : โรตีป้าเด by ลาเจ
review_1_text:
Quite an interesting place to have breakfast.  The rotis are made fresh to order and come in a variety of flavours, including with chicken curry.

We loved the banana and nutella, and the cheese, as well as the plain one.

Service was quick and tables are often at a premium.

The coffees were okay.
review_2_text: This is the best breakfast spot in all of Chiang Mai. The roti and tea is incredible. Staff are super friendly and hospitable. A must try if you're in Chiang Mai. They only cook in coconut oil and don't use MSG.
review_3_text:
This restaurant, located on the street, is, in my opinion, the best in Chiang Mai. The staff here are incredibly kind, delightful, and eager to communicate. Having enjoyed Roti in various cities such as Kota Kinabalu, Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru, Bangkok, and Phuket, I must say that this experience is truly amazing. If you're looking to enjoy Roti in the morning, this restaurant is a must-visit.
※ They are using healthy coconut oil and goat milk straight from the farm.
review_4_text:
Run by 3 macik, was there at 11am and it's no crowd, Likely I'm the late one there. The restaurant had moved and is now across the road, you can park along the road to visit the restaurant, just be sure to avoid the red and white pedestrian tiles. The food they served looks fantastic, Will need to visit at least few more time to taste them all.
Tips: ate the mutton curry, the mutton is soo tender, it's probably fresh from Hamza farm, don't miss the goat milk and lastly the ice lemon tea is huge for 59baht.
review_5_text: While walking in the morning around the temples we found their stalls and were attracted by the smell and we decided to stop. We enjoyed the roti with cheese, children got the spinach cheese roti and the coffee with goat milk was super tasty 😋😋😋. Miss Juju is super friendly and she also gives us details about their own farm. The opening time is 6am until 11am.

name: Stations cafe'
review_1_text:
Beautiful place with beautiful ladies.
Very enjoyable 😌🙂

name: Mooncafe by fon
review_1_text: Best smoothy I have buy in my life, completely impressed for the quality, the smoothy is concise not just water
review_2_text: The coffee here is delicious and not too sweet like other places. They use good quality beans. Easily a daily morning pick-me-up before exploring the city.
review_3_text: Nice small cafe serving coffee, smoothies and soda. The passion fruit soda is refreshing. The vibe is chill and relaxing.
review_4_text: 100% recommend. Nice cozy place. Owner is so genuinely friendly.  Had to make it a point to stop again and visit before I left Chiang Mai. Smoothies and coffee are great.
review_5_text: Delicious, strong and fairly priced coffee in a calm and friendly atmosphere. I came back almost every day I was in Chiang Mai as the coffee was so tasty and could be adapted to suit the customers preferences. We chatted quite a lot with the owner and felt very welcomed by her - one day she even invited us to join her for a lunch of noodle soup at a nearby food outlet, for which she let me ride on the back of her moped and helped me order vegetarian food by speaking in Thai to the restaurant staff. Reasonable price of 65 baht for frappe and less for iced or hot coffee, including a choice of cow, soya or almond milk. Really loved this place will defo b coming back if I'm in Chiang Mai again!

name: O.M.G. Coffee
review_1_text:
Last Sunday I went to OMG and had their famous Sunday Roast.  I usually find a meal of this size too much and that is why I haven't had one previously.  Well - it was delicious, and beautifully cooked and served - a truly outstanding meal.  I was well stuffed!

My second review:
Tonight I went along to OMG's third anniversary party.  And, OMG (pun intended) - is it really only three years that OMG has been in Chiang Mai.  It seems so much longer - they have established themselves as a superb restaurant and bar, with many loyal customers.

The food and drinks are excellent, the staff are friendly and efficient, and on top of that, the owners have organized many events to support local charities and orphanages.  Long may they remain a successful bar-restaurant here.

My original review:
OMG - a new pretender to claim the crown of "best fish & chips in Chiang Mai'.

This well positioned site on the eastern corner of Loi Kroh, just prior to the Iron Bridge, has proved a graveyard for previous restaurants, having seen about 3 fail there in the past few years.

I sincerely hope this new one survives; it should. It has been thoroughly modernized and is clean as a new pin. The hostesses are divine and the owners very friendly.

Lots of dining and bar space, the cleanest toilets I've seen in a long while, a pool table, big TV screen and comprehensive menu. One could ask for nothing more.

I would hope to try some of the other dishes, but with 'fish & chips' this good, I won't be having anything else for a while. "OMG" uses only Atlantic cod (as does Kelly's, the previous holder of 'best fish & chips', but that's out of town).

Very highly recommended.
review_2_text:
Went to the restaurant rather than the coffee.
Superb, just superb.
Great staff, service, clean, efficient and the food, so very very good.
The best fish and chips I can imagine here in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: New and very nicely designed coffee shop and soon restaurant.  Perfect location on the corner with limited motorcycle parking. Excellent coffee with great presentation. Friendly staff and good attention to details. They also have very attractive prices... I will be back
review_4_text: Great mix of food especially for Aussie’s and Brit’s craving some western food. Plus sports bar and pool table
review_5_text: Great quality, well-made coffee and, although I didn’t have it, the Full English looked banging too.

name: Pick a Bowl
review_1_text: We enjoyed the food so much we came here three times during our stay! The smoothie bowls are the best I’ve ever had. There are so many toppings to choose from and so many combinations to try! I highly recommend to try their granola and peanut butter—absolutely delicious. The owner is very kind too 😊
review_2_text: The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing, and the music is fantastic. Just looking at the menu reveals a deep sense of expertise. Ordering is a bit complicated, but the friendly owner explains everything clearly. The food is delicious and makes you feel healthy. I definitely want to come back with my family.
review_3_text:
I arrived it Chiang Mai early this morning, without being able to book into my hostel until the afternoon, I took a 30 minute walk over to pick a bowl especially from reviews I’d seen on social media. I was absolutely not disappointed!
The order system was super easy to navigate, and it was lovely to be able to pick, mix and match your ingredients and toppings. It was absolutely delicious, and so fresh!
The staff are very kind and welcoming and Dang even gave me recommendations for activities and temples to see around the city. Thank you! Hopefully I will be back soon!
review_4_text: The best smoothie bowl I’ve ever had! I dream about this place when I’m back home in California and always return when I visit Chiang Mai. I’ve visited the past 3 years and always make it a point to get a bowl multiple times. Make sure to add the homemade peanut butter and homemade granola as well. Made in house daily. Sweetest staff, and Dang is so warm and friendly. A must visit when in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text:
Our favourite place for breakfast in Chiang Mai. The smoothie bowls are the best I’ve ever had (I love the way of ordering as well, creating your own bowl with your own toppings ((berry & banana base is my fave)). The owner can also recommend loads of excursions & activities in Chiang Mai (often at a reduced rate).

If you’re in Chiang Mai and don’t come here - you’re missing out 😎

name: Mamia Coffee
review_1_text:
After nearly 4 years of absence, Mamia coffee finally reopened its doors last week, same lovely owner, same menu, same reasonable (not to say: really really cheap) prices.

I enjoyed my time there comfortably sitting in one of the 3 little huts overlooking the river.

Food is just amazing taste and value.  My regular go to place for a little (or long and lazy) Thai food lunch.  10/10
review_2_text:
Great to have Mamia back!
Fantastic food, blinding location on the Ping River, lovely owners.
Go and visit and support a family owned business.
review_3_text: One of the best hidden gems near the river! A somewhat small selection of very good and tasty Thai food, good drinks including smoothies and coffee, and even an impressive bakery selection. All at very reasonable prices and in an unpretentious but very cute location by the river, just in front of the mighty Anantara. Totally recommended!
review_4_text: Legitimately the best food I’ve had in Thailand so far. The Tom Yum fried rice and Papaya salad were amazing. Great service and people who run this place. We went on a Tuesday morning and we were the only customers there! I’d love to see this place get more business because they deserve it.
review_5_text:
The restaurant by the river with   nice view and chilling atmosphere.
The menu is variaty, so you can choose Thai, European or even Thai-European food.  Good food, good coffee, good price.

name: MORITORA • River & View
review_1_text: Good view 👍🏻
review_2_text: A camp-style cafe by the Ping River, next to the Iron Bridge. The atmosphere is great during the winter months. They serve drinks and food, and have parking.
review_3_text: Fresh orange juice 🍊 and a riverside camp 🏕🪵 cafe... so refreshing! ☺️

name: Zeit Roaster - Brewing Lab Cafe&Coffee shop
review_1_text:
If you’re visiting Chiang Mai, this is a café you absolutely have to check out!

The coffee offers a wide range of deep and complex flavors and aromas. You can truly feel the owner’s deep passion for coffee and the years of research and dedication behind every cup. I highly recommend ordering several different menu items to fully experience the variety.

The interior is stylish and beautiful, and the view outside the window—lush green grass and a flowing river—adds to the relaxing atmosphere. The staff are also very friendly.

Although I visited many cafés during my trip to Chiang Mai, this is the one I think about the most. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
I did the coffee farm tour that partnered with Zeit and the guide asked if we would like to try out the coffee shop on our way back to the hotel and as a coffee enthusiast I had to take them up and I’m glad I did. I would also like to take a moment to recommend the coffee farm tour they offered as it was a fun experience and the guide was great!

Easily the best coffee I’ve had during my stay in Thailand. This shop is a true specialty coffee shop and very fairly priced for what you get. Not only did the drinks taste great but they were presented nicely as well.

The space was comfortable and had lots to look at. Personally was a fan of the wall of coffee brewers behind the counter.
review_3_text: They have beans with flavour notes I really like here (Chiang Mai single origin) - barley, brown rice, cereal - so this has been my go-to place in Chiang Mai for pour-over coffee. On one visit, they kindly let me try their cold brew cream and it was nice! Oh, they also have the comfiest chair for reading.
review_4_text:
Very modern beautiful well designed café. Coffees are similar to Einspanner in Korea.

Ordered a hot chocolate for my daughter which came in a cocktail glass with gold on top which she was very excited and delighted about. Beautifully presented.

The Madeleine‘s are more like chocolate brownies and Madeleine shapes with different colours of chocolate but are delicious.
review_5_text: Nice coffee roasters and brewers in an old house restaurant compound. Common Parking 🅿️ for 12 cars and great lawn sundry area. Coffee and non-coffee drinks were up to the point.

name: STORIES Ping River • cafe&bistro •
review_1_text: Great location by the river and friendly accommodating staff. We ordered 3 dishes and only 1 dish actually taste good (the rice with fluffy omelette and prawns) although a bit too spicy (I requested for reduced spicines). The pasta with soft shell crab comes with white sauce (taste a bit like cloying beschamel sauce) which doesn't go with the crab. The sour pork entree is too salty and too sour, unbalanced flavour overall. The live music outside clashes with the live music from next door restaurant (this is definitely not their fault) but staff are happy for us to chose to sit inside. Price point on the mid-upmarket scale.
review_2_text: Beautiful setting with a fantastic view of the Old Bridge and the lively bars and restaurants across the Ping River. This place has so much potential, though it feels like it could do a bit more to match the beauty of its surroundings. The atmosphere comes entirely from the location - not from the setup or the music. I came around 5:30 pm for sunset and was surprised to find it almost empty, despite the stunning scenery. Hopefully, they’ll refine the experience in the future.
review_3_text: The food was all very very good! The service was nice and accommodating the food didn't come super fast, but this isn't a fast past vibe it's a place you go to relax and enjoy atmosphere. My kids love the the playground and there were kid friendly items on menu. We spent the evening enjoying music and food. I almost didn't go because of recent bad reviews but I'm very glad we did
review_4_text: This place quite calm and has delicious food. Stuff are very kind and prices are acceptable. Best place for calm, dinner and drinking
review_5_text: The only good thing about this restaurant is the atmosphere. We booked a table, yet the food was served an hour later, and it was all cold and tasteless. The service was poor—the server and the manager didn’t seem to know what to do, to the point that my friend had to pick up the glasses, dises, and staff himself.

name: มิ่งมิตร ร้านกาแฟ
review_1_text:
Always reliable.

Es Yen.  Thai Style Coffee - strong but not sweet.  Delicious

Bold coffee flavors and delicious drinks ... hot or cold. Hydrate with a refreshing Italian Soda before heading into the heat.

Convenient location at RimPing Supermarket for a quick cup before shopping.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee shop. Located inside the shopping mall.  Nice cool AC inside.  Fast friendly service.
review_3_text:
Good taste
Good service
Good mood
review_4_text: Their iced latte was super good that I had even take away after having one cup there. yummy!!
review_5_text: Inside the rimping shopping complex. Quite a small shop. Coffee is good.

name: Vianghug coffee & restaurant
review_1_text:
Home made kitchen really good! Don t be in a hurry if you want to eat there but the service is really friendly.
The keto recipes are really tasty!
review_2_text: The shop is cute and the owner is very kind.

name: เอสเค คอฟฟี่ บายสากลการค้า
สุขพอดี simply happy coffee
review_1_text:
Cozy café with a garden-like atmosphere. The space is filled with large, lush trees, making it feel as if you are sitting inside a green garden rather than a café

One unique highlight is the separate bookshop on site, which adds a nice, peaceful touch for those who enjoy reading or browsing books while having a drink.

The staff are very friendly and can communicate well in English, which is a big plus for international visitors. The drinks are tasty and thoughtfully presented, with nice attention to detail. Overall, it’s a great spot to relax, enjoy good coffee, and slow down for a while.
review_2_text:
Amazing!

Thai tea 65 ฿ (2025)

Has English menu.

Stumbled upon this lovely cafe and I am so glad. The entrance had me at Hobbiton vibe.

Such a nice homey place, with seating inside and outside, a super giant tree like Ehwa tree in Avatar.

I am sold at hello.

Thai tea was good, a little too sweet to my liking although I already requested half sweet.

The outside environment is best, okay quiet, but may have mosquitos.

And there have some live music performance on certain dates with artist.

I think this place has not blown up in IG yet, and secretly I wish it never will so it would keep its nice charm, but how selfish I am.
review_3_text:
Best coffee shop. Such beautiful atmosphere here, with astonishing trees, great coffee and artists. They have lovely and tender performance here.
I found this magic little place, makes my Sunday happy.
review_4_text:
Good place to get a coffe and relax.

Not ideal for working with laptop cuz no proper sits with charger.

They have a big tree in the garden that make the atmosphere very nice 👍

Coffe not expensive.

Service was great. They are very nice and friendly!
review_5_text:
Another Chiang Mai cafe gem. Love the name, the place, and the atmosphere. Did not try the coffee but the tea was decent.

They sell books for adults and children as well as cute toys and decor items. But the winner here is absolutely the tasteful blend of greeneries and chill vibe.

Two major points to consider:
1. Mosquitoes
2. Dirty, basic toilet

name: SELF
review_1_text:
Lovely coffee. I had one of their signature called ‘Citrus Boy’ which is milk coffee with orange syrup. It was so good.

The place is perfect for hiding away from the afternoon sun to sit back and relax with good music.
review_2_text:
Hidden gem doesn’t even begin to describe it, after countless cafés around Chiang Mai, this one stands out as unforgettable.
When coffee is done right, it demands your full attention. No distractions, no extras, just you and the cup, completely absorbed in its flavor and aroma.
review_3_text: This quirky coffee shop, with its small sign and retro minimalist design, offers unique but limited coffee options. The citrus coffee with milk blend, surprisingly delightful, is a must-try. The service is excellent, transporting you to an oldies feel coffee shop. However, the price may not be the cheapest for coffee, it’s worth for trying
review_4_text:
Exceeded all expectations — truly a hidden gem, even after visiting over 50 cafés in Chiang Mai.
A truly great cup of coffee makes you only drink coffee — nothing else. You’re fully immersed, surrounded by the aroma and flavor.

Started with the Citrus Boy. I love citrus-based drinks, and this one nailed it — a beautiful blend of citrusy sweetness, vanilla, milk, and espresso. Topped with a slice of orange soaked perfectly in espresso.

Immediately ordered a second — the Black Amber. I’m a big fan of truffle, so this was a no-brainer. It came with a passionfruit crisp on top, and right before serving, they sprinkled fresh black truffle over the coffee — the aroma and depth it added were incredible.

The vibe and music? Spot on. Whether it’s sunny or rainy, this place just makes you feel calm, cozy, and safe.

I drink and drunk here👉ig：OneCupWithYv
review_5_text:
Creative cold brew coffee variation.

We order the signature drinks - Black Amber and Warmness.

Feel like drinking cocktails

name: Iron32 Hotel Bar and Bistro
review_1_text: Great location, great staff, everthing is great, location wise is good, walking distance for night bazaar..
review_2_text: We stayed here 3 nights on the top floor. We spent pretty much a whole day drinking on the very spacious patio overlooking the city. The room could get hot, but AC works well. Very clean with modern amenities. The staff is friendly and the restuarant downstairs is tasty and super convenient for breakfast. The location is close walking distance to many things including the night bazaar, restaurants, bars and massage parlours. We really enjoyed our stay here and are really pleased with our selection of Iron32
review_3_text: This hotel was fantastic and clean and comfortable.  The owner was helpful finding us another place to stay as well when we wanted to extend our stay but he was booked solid. Had the green curry chicken for lunch as well and that was also fantastic. This hotel is in a great location with plenty of nightlife as well as authentic shopping from the local market. There is also a great security entrance to the building and rooms as well. This place was all pros and no cons. Would definitely recommend to a friend or family member!
review_4_text: I stayed in the hotel, the room was comfortable and clean. Great location. But being on the main street you get street noise which you can't do anything about it. I also had most of my breakfast /lunch there ,food also good. Very nice and friendly staff. No parking here though. If you rented a car, there might be street parking but don't count on it.
review_5_text:
Loved our stay here at iron 32. We had a party of ten stay here and we had the entire hotel to ourselves. It was a perfect location for us, right around the corner from a busy night market! Everything was walking distance with cute little spots to eat at.

Turbo was amazing host and his staff was extremely friendly. This place was run very well, trustworthy host and staff I might add. The place was extremely clean and well decorated.

Iron 32, won't disappoint! Especially of you have a large group of friends travelling!

name: Box coffeeริมปิง
review_1_text:
ive gone here a handful of times and its been consistently good. 5/5

Bonus: stamp card,get 10 stamps= 1 free coffee.
Extra bonus: shop kitty!!!
review_2_text: Very lovely service, nice take away coffee or also seat next to the desk
review_3_text: Very, very good coffee 🙂

name: Hebi cafe - เฮะบิคาเฟ่
review_1_text: This is one of the best coffee shops in Chiang Mai, located on a quiet street. I highly recommend the waffle — it’s crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. The beverages are also great, and the prices are reasonable. It’s a perfect spot to relax and escape the noise of the town. The owner, Sun, is so kind and welcoming. I truly enjoyed my time at Hebi — thank you so much! ❤️❤️❤️
review_2_text: Such a cute and cozy little café with incredibly friendly staff. Easily one of the best cups of coffee you’ll find in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Great local coffee shop across from our hotel. A daily stop (sometimes twice per day :)) for me during our stay. Warm, welcoming, friendly Thai hospitality along with delicious expresso and ice coffee. If you're lucky, you might even get to meet Meg and Seymour, the resident cats 🐈. Highly recommend!
review_4_text: My one of the favorite coffee places in Chiang Mai. So friendly and helpful owner. Best Matcha Latte so far. This place has lovely friendly cats
review_5_text: such a cute coffee shop, the lady who served me was so sweet. Made a great iced oat latte. Will definitely be returning whilst I’m in Chiang Mai.

name: Nord 108 Express
review_1_text: Mobile coffee shop with a great coffee stand! I had the iced expresso coffee and it was delicious!
review_2_text: Stopped for a quick coffee and it was quick and fresh quality coffee, highly recommend!

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขากาดสันป่าข่อย
review_1_text:
The shop is located inside the Kad San Pa Khoi parking lot, perfect for takeout or a quick stop.
They also have a menu for those who don't drink milk, both plain and with oat milk.
Personal recommendations: Megano, Mocha, Peach Green Tea, Peach Tea, or plain cocoa (you can choose without milk).

On the way out, tell them you're buying drinks from this shop. There's no parking fee. Normally, you have to pay to park.

name: Bus Coffee
review_1_text: A very cute little coffee shop, where we got to drink delicious coffee each morning for a few days 😌 Best coffee in town for a fair price! Very friendly and warmhearted owners - you should definitely try them out! ☀️
review_2_text:
25B for coffee latte. (Actually it seems everything is 25B)

This is a home cafe, nice.

It’s cozy and relax, and coffee is good.

Good to come and enjoy.
review_3_text:
Nice change of pace.

Refreshing blue lemon soda.  Crispy and delicious seeded cookies.

No smoking.
review_4_text: Friendly staff,  cheap local coffee place with good Gaffey(coffee in Thai) Could use a better fan system and a toilet
review_5_text:
Great coffee,friendly staff well worth a visit coffee 25 Baht
Now they only do takeaway drinks.
Still good quality coffee at a reasonable price and nice owners.

name: La-Moon
review_1_text:
Super cute corner coffee shop with all the Thai milk drinks you could hope for! 🧋 most reasonable prices I’ve seen by far with quick service and a very kind and welcoming vendor!

I’d recommend this place over any other vendor for your daily coffee/tea 😋. Glad I discovered this place on my last day! ❤️

(I’d already drank 1/3 of my drink in the photo haha)
review_2_text: A great little café with unbeatable prices. The owner is very friendly and works so quickly. It's definitely worth a visit!
review_3_text: The coffee is fragrant, strong, and has a well-rounded flavor. I highly recommend it.

name: Boxcoffee สันป่าข่อย
review_1_text: Fantastic coffee and reasonable price! I'll recommend your nice coffee to my friends who's gonna visit Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: Very good coffee and friendly Personal. Highly recommend!
review_3_text: Friendly service and delicious drinks! They have several coffee roasts, and definitely try the iced Thai tea! Delicious!
review_4_text: Beautiful and clean. Excellent service with a smile!

name: น.อนุสรณ์ กาแฟนวล
review_1_text:
Coca cola collectors will love this coffeeshop . Cabinets full of coke and other soda cans.

Simply seating but good vibes overall

Parking : Kerbside only

Seating : indoor , non- air-conditioned
review_2_text: Stumbled into this coffee shop while exploring this street. It’s looks so unassuming but once you step inside, it’s like a Coca Cola museum 😂 delicious coffee at half the price charged by other hipster coffee places in town (40 THB for a great cup of hot latte) and even though I didn’t get to try any of the pastries, they were all decently priced and looks delicious. Owner is friendly too!
review_3_text: Cozy neighborhood coffee shop with classic vibes. Good coffee at great prices, this shop is like a small step back in time. Nice to sit outside and watch the street go by, and if I lived in the neighborhood I imagine I'd come here often. Owners are very friendly. Some small pastries available.
review_4_text: Really nice atmos. The owners are super sweet. Coffee is great. Recommended!!!
review_5_text: good coffee at affordable prices. fun collections of books and stuff to look at and bring back the old days to my mind.

name: DÉJÀ Brew Café and Gallery
review_1_text: A very nice café with soothing music and three types of coffee beans to choose from. The only downside is the difficulty in finding parking. Suitable for motorcyclists and bicycles.
review_2_text:
What a hidden gem!

I came here to do some light work but ended up staying a couple of hours and I didn't even notice. The place is so warm and inviting. Amazing staff, great drinks, good cookies and 100MBs internet.

What more can you ask for 10/10
review_3_text: Very cool cafe and gallery-a place of style and substance. Serious art and superb coffee etc in an uber stylish setting. Located just outside the city center. Great place to chill away from the throngs of people in cm. My new favorite spot.
review_4_text: Flash back memories when it was still a wooden house.  Wondered the cafe name is after the owner’s name.   Fragrance hot latte and delicious cold latte in a nice vacuumed glass.  Friendly staff.  Pet friendly is a big bonus.  We need to keep the area clean.
review_5_text: Great space for an afternoon coffee. There’s a gallery behind the coffee shop that is worth checking out as well. They hold art events and presentations. They’ve also got a tattoo studio with a great artist and Airbnb on the property. Very English friendly and worth checking out 👍🏼

name: ตี๋นมสด Tee Nom Sod 小弟鲜奶
review_1_text: Toast with cream and grated custard. The amount of whip cream was excessive, but the combination off eggy custard and toast is really good
review_3_text: love toast sweet milk
review_4_text: This local milk bread shop serves delicious bread at affordable prices. Parking might be a little difficult. Their Milo toast and milk cocoa are particularly tasty.
review_5_text: I really like eating at this shop. The green tea has a real tea aroma. I like the bread, milk, butter, Milo, and whipped cream. But I have to criticize the staff. They treat me like I'm asking for free food. They treat me like a beggar. But overall, I like it. ^^

name: Minimal coffee Sanpakoi
review_1_text:
Delicious coffee drinks at this always reliable chain of coffee shops.

Great break before or after shopping at San Pa Koi Market.   Large picture window is great for people watching at this popular market.
review_2_text: The strength is the coffee, the weakness is the service. I never have high expectations because it's always the same every time I come here. 😅
review_3_text: What a great find. I'll definitely be back. 45 baht hot latte with a choice of light, medium or dark roasted coffee grown here in Thailand. Friendly staff, great seating indoors and out.
review_4_text: Good quality for affordable price coffee. 😍
review_5_text: Delicious cappuccino, friendly service, great prices and atmosphere.

name: MiKi Coffee
review_1_text: The cocoa is rich and smooth (I forgot to take a picture). Another thing that was very delicious was the Hong Kong butter cookies. They were fragrant with butter and just the right amount of sweetness. I will definitely order them again.
review_2_text: It was very delicious. I will definitely visit again. 😘
review_3_text: It's delicious! There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the restaurant stays open late. Highly recommended for night owls!
review_4_text: I ordered the Line Man waffles with care. They made the matcha green tea waffles very delicious :)
review_5_text: Everything is delicious.

name: กาแฟโบราณถุงกระดาษ the sun สันป่าข่อย
review_1_text: This cheese tea is incredibly delicious and amazing value at only 35 baht. Bangkokians will be screaming with delight! OMG!

name: Chakaimuk ชาไข่มุกดอทคอม สันป่าข่อย by นู๋นิด
review_1_text: Very friendly attendant, quality product and fair price. I recommend!
review_2_text: A cafe in front of Sankeppai Market. The friendly owner makes me want to come here every day. It's the perfect place to eat at the market and enjoy bubble tea. They also sell small figurines, so kids will love it.
review_3_text: Good taste, reasonable price, cute seller, very good service, there is a place to sit and wait in front of the shop.

name: ชาตังเหนือ
review_1_text: Chatang Nuea Branch 58 is located in front of the flower market at Kad Luang. The taste is delicious and rich, especially the two-tone cocoa with pearls. The prices are affordable; currently, all menu items are 19 baht per cup. The friendly, long-haired young vendor makes the drinks with care.

name: good coffee
review_1_text: Lovely couple running the shop. Coffee at very reasonable prices. I love their homemade cookies!!
review_2_text:
I'm trying to support local businesses in my area in Chiang Mai.
I saw this coffee shop and gave it a try.
The coffee was okay. Irs got a weird aftertaste. I think 7-ELEVEN is better. That's just my opinion.  You also get more for your money.
The guy was really polite.
I also like the decor of the coffee shop.
review_3_text: One of the best places for get a strong and cheap coffee in Chiang Mai ! And very good service in a nice atmosphere 👍👍👍
review_4_text: Had hot thai tea because of very salty meal at northern eatery not too far away. Gd place to relax as it was drizzly too. Good pricing.
review_5_text: Love this place! Very friendly owners who speak good English and Thai, really good fresh Thai coffee, delicious Thai food, WIFI and a great little outdoor garden seating area, at the front of the cafe. This is a place I love to come for a few hours to relax, read a book or meet friends. A nice relaxing atmosphere.

name: Treespresso cafe
review_1_text:
I am biased towards places with big trees and good shade like this, so: yeah, it's pretty nice to chill here despite the leaf shedding state of the trees 🍂 it lends a nice atmosphere as long as the sun is not screaming hot. Both indoor and outdoor seatings available.

Coffee is pretty decent.
review_2_text: Grabbed a quick coffee here and loved the relaxed atmosphere of the shop. The tree in the middle of the yard is beautiful and we loved the peaceful vibe. Staff are great, prices are good. I love when coffee shops serve a small glass of water with a coffee -- it's the little things. We would come back again for coffee and to give the food a try.
review_3_text: Absolutely wonderful hot cappuccino and a wonderful beautiful garden area spend your afternoon
review_4_text:
Our work spot for the day.

Small cafe with a large outdoor space. We sat outdoor today as the weather is cloudy and the large tree canopy keeps the area pretty cool.

I love the rattan pool deck chairs ... U can easily fall asleep here 😴😴😴

F&B :
Orange Tea was good. The base tea tastes like thai tea and the orange flavour pairs well with this black tea.

Biscoff machiatto
Didnt like this at all unfortunately. Shall have to try something else next time 😅

Parking : within compound
review_5_text:
Pleasant Experience:
It was really pleasant surprise having a light meal at Treespresso Cafe. Everything from coffee & soda to main course as well as dessert were delicious and presented in a very impressive way. It is gem hidden in a narrow ally but credit goes to my wife Eram who discovered it. Staff were also courteous and helpful in selecting items. Overall it was an excellent experience & we both enjoyed a lot.

name: SEUA
review_1_text: Great little cafe in a quiet little street. They have put in a lot of effort to succesfully create a  fabulous Xmasy atmosphere this december! Big presies tower at the entrance  and Xmas trees inside. There's also a small gallery and a small co-working space. Definitely worth a visit!
review_2_text: Seua is super cool! It's very chic and arty. Nice vibes. Wonderful Thai soul songs. Wonderful to sip coffee and chill out in this beautiful cafe!
review_3_text: The store was super cute and Christmasy, latte was nice
review_4_text: I ordered one hot americano and iced latte, and they were tasty and worth spending. The coffee mainly tasted fruity with medium roasted beans. The baristas were so nice and friendly. Its location was near Chiang Mai railway station by 5-min walking. Personally, I will come back again in the next trip to CNX.
review_5_text: A delicious matcha, good music, and a place full of art!

name: Vanilla Fruits Bar & Coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee for very good price, will come back multiple times for sure!

name: The Baristro at Train Station
review_1_text:
It’s been quite a long time since I last came back to this café, mainly because it’s quite far from my home.

The place still maintains great quality — the coffee is excellent, and the tiramisu is a wonderful dessert.

There is also a DJ playing music at the café.

The café is clean, spacious, and airy.

The staff are friendly, and the restroom is very clean.
review_2_text:
Hot Latte 85 ฿ (2025)

Has English menu.

Brutalist at its nice side. Love the structure and decorations. Simple and minimalism.

AC is very strong power 😂 totally good to hide away from hot sun.

The coffee is stronger than most starbucks type, almost like to flat white to me, and i love it!!

I was wondering for a flat white but it isnt on their menu, so this one made up for me.

I charge my phone.

I read and having a good time.

Clean toilets too.

I like it more because less crowd, not much tourist at this hour, and less locals.
review_3_text: Lovely caffeine destination, cool place  sip a cup of ☕️.  Bake also good. 🥕 cake and Japanese cake recipes recommended.
review_4_text:
Good coffee, stylish industrial interior.

A bit too loud music. So not the best option to work with laptop from here.
review_5_text:
Have a morning coffee after a running event in rail train park nearby.
This place is fantastic and their coffee is great.
I am happy to have this place in my list😉

name: สถานีกาแฟ coffee station
review_1_text:
Price starts from 65฿ if you would like to sit in the cafe for 1 hour.

Staff is not friendly. Rarely smile.
Please see the comment that staff replied to other users for more details.
review_2_text: Finding a place to relax with a friend that is leaving soon, popping in to this place unintendedly, and then feeling surprised when we were informed about the shop's policies after ordering our drinks. Anyways, then we had a topic to talk - the customer's journey and experiences. We then compare this café to others.
review_3_text: Nice place to stop by while waiting, near the train as well, coffee is great and affordable
review_4_text:
8 Reasons Why This Cafe Is the Lowest Rated in Chiang Mai
1. They tell you you can't stay more than an hour before you even sit down.
2. The air conditioning is on, but the room temperature is barely 30 degrees Celsius.
3. They prohibit the use of fans (including a sign prohibiting the use of power).
4. It costs 20 baht to charge your phone.
5. A cup of hot Americano costs a whopping 60 baht.
6. The coffee is bitter and tasteless.
7. They don't even offer water.
8. The owner is playing a noisy PC game by himself.

The only reason I recommend this place is because:
1. There are no customers, so you can spend your time quietly as long as you tolerate the owner's gaming noise (but only for an hour).
review_5_text:
The service was terrible and the staff were rude.
Everyone who ate in the restaurant had to order something. Anyone who didn't order wasn't allowed to sit down. Terrible!

name: สภากาแฟเจ๊นิด
CountryCoff
review_1_text:
After getting off the train, I stopped by this cafe to check in and have a coffee.
Great coffee at a great price. Highly recommended! 💓💓
review_2_text: The taste is good. I will stop by again when I pass by.
review_3_text:
Country Coffee — Super cool shop
The baristas make coffee with care for every drop. Awesome!
review_4_text: Good atmosphere, delicious and aromatic coffee. Will definitely come back again.
review_5_text: Good coffee, aromatic, and inexpensive. ☕️

name: โซบาร์
review_1_text: Just visit during weekday
review_2_text: This was fantastic! My train was at 9:35, and I arrived by motorcycle taxi at 9:31. Immediately, a staff member asked if I was taking the 9:35 train, directed me to the counter to buy a ticket, and showed me which vehicle to take, ensuring I caught the train on time. The service was amazing!
review_3_text: OK
review_4_text: Cool, relaxed

name: P E A N U T . P A T T E R Cafe
review_1_text: We waited there for out train and it was the perfect spot. Very reasonably priced, good wifi, clean toilet. We ordered the signature coffee drink and later a cocoa and thai tea and all three drinks really tasted sooo good. Absolutely recommend stopping by!
review_2_text: Google maps says its open today from 8am.  Im standing in front of the cafe at 10.15am and its closed.  Typical.
review_3_text: Just outside of the Chiang Mai train station. Fantastic drinks at more than reasonable prices. The environment is great for getting some work done before catching a train. The toilet is very clean.
review_4_text:
Comfortable place to chill on a hot afternoon.
3mins walk to the train station
review_5_text: Such a vibe here 😌 I like this café so much.

name: Pour&Purr Home cafe
review_1_text: The coffee is excellent and the shop has so many interesting things, mostly antiques. You can also buy a guitar there.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee with local beans roasted by the owner on site.
review_3_text: Best latte we've had in Thailand
review_4_text: Good coffee with a well-rounded flavor. Coffee lovers shouldn't miss this place. The owner is cute, friendly, and speaks politely. The atmosphere is chill and cute. I highly recommend it. ☕🍵 The green tea is also well-rounded and delicious. ☺️
review_5_text: A small but very nice café. Owned by someone who moved from Bangkok to Chiang Mai, and it shows. It has a great urban feel. Really good music. Beautiful decor. Very friendly, open-minded people. Great homemade coffee and iced tea.

name: สมคิดคาเฟ่
เอลิม คอฟฟี่เฮ้าส์ กาแฟสด เชียงใหม่ Elim Coffee House
review_1_text: This place is great!!! Great coffee, great environment, great excellent attention.
review_2_text: Relaxing , charming , homely place, never lacking in creativity & warmth . Now they only serve drinks n snacks.
review_3_text:
My coffee house my worship house..
Coffee and worship in 1..
The best place for spirituality and chillin' with God..
Love this place..My Eli Family Coffee House And Church..😍😊🙏🙏
The coffee and Lemon-Iced Tea are great!!!😚🥰🥰
review_4_text: Try the hot Late! Nice family atmosphere. Good for relaxing 😍 & hanging out.
review_5_text: Amazing people and place. Food and beverages are just great! 100% Recommend

name: Bogie Coffee Bar
review_1_text: amazing coffee with very kid and sweet owner
review_2_text:
Cute café right on the street. With seating.

A wide selection of coffees and teas. The service is very friendly.

It's perfect for a quick break after arriving by train.

The view isn't breathtaking, but it's quite fun to watch all the drivers.
review_3_text: The coffee is good and delicious, and the atmosphere is nice and relaxing.

name: Chimm coffee
review_1_text: I highly recommend this! Cocoa lovers are going to love it. The flavor is super intense—I’m definitely coming back for more.
review_2_text: Staff are very friendly and Chimm coffee must try
review_3_text: Went there for the macha latte was really good hit for the gym 💪🏽. Gave me lot of energy. Will go again. Great customer service as well very kind. And they had vegan milk options
review_4_text: love this espresso and americano
review_5_text: Creamy and rich matcha at a very reasonable price.

name: BIG Body Coffee เจริญเมือง
review_1_text: The best coffeeshop
review_2_text: One of my favorite coffee shop 🥰 great coffee here!
review_3_text: Good coffee and very friendly barista / owner
review_4_text:
I just visited BIG Body Coffee for the first time, and I can say that I was impressed from the moment I stepped inside. 💛

The shop is small but very cute. The atmosphere is warm and professional, yet not too formal. The walls are lined with SCA certificates. You can tell the baristas here aren't just playing around with coffee. ☕

I ordered an iced Americano in Omkoi—it was incredibly fragrant and had a full body, truly living up to the name "Big Body." 👍

The counter has a selection of coffee beans, including Nicaragua, Kenya, and Honduras. Perfect for coffee lovers who love to try new things. Every cup seems to have its own story.

Overall, this shop is incredibly attentive to every detail: the coffee, the atmosphere, and the decor.
If you enjoy good coffee with a touch of dedication, I highly recommend you give it a try. ❤️
review_5_text: A cute coffee shop with a selection of specialty coffee beans. The prices are very good and the quality is also very good. The owner is a roaster with a lot of knowledge and experience about coffee.

name: อิสยาห์ กาเเฟสด - Isaiah Coffee
review_1_text: Lovely coffee, dark or medium roast to order. Phan, the owner is really lovely and friendly and helpful. I recommend calling in here!
review_2_text: Love this coffee shop great coffee I call in  everyday now great service the owner is a beautiful young girl always smiling and a great atmosphere please try this place as its just opened 😊
review_3_text: Coffee deliciouse. The owner is very kind and nice. Ill come back definitely.
review_4_text: Young owner barista very hardworking all by herself!
review_5_text: A beautiful young woman skillfully makes delicious coffee. Her smile makes me feel at ease. If it were close to my house, I would want to stop by every day.

name: Adenosine Receptor
review_1_text: I personally really like the fruit coffee at this shop. It costs 55 baht per cup. The orange coffee is really good, unlike anywhere else. But my favorite menu item is the berry coffee. It's really delicious. If I can't think of anything else, I'll order an Americano. I admit that the coffee is really good. Prices start at 45 baht. Oh, and another thing I like is the cocoa. I think you have to try the cocoa. You don't have to wait for the ones at the Bai Mai gas station to have a sale. This one is no different at all.
review_2_text: A cute little shop with air conditioning. Very cheap prices and good taste. I hope you'll be with us for a long time.
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious, the owner is friendly, and most importantly, the price is not expensive. I can drink it every day.
review_4_text:
Cute shop with delicious fruit-themed coffee. Everything on the menu is delicious.
Orange, berry, peach!
review_5_text: Good coffee, but even better is the barista. Absolutely amazing!

name: Coffee Connect@เจริญเมือง
review_1_text: Delicious matcha and Japanese muffins, and amazing service! The man working there is very kind and so we went there twice during our stay in Chiang Mai
review_2_text: Great coffee and drinks, very friendly and they have reusable cups which is amazing 🧡
review_3_text:
Congratulations to the new Coffee Connect @ Charoen Mueang!
#FragrantCoffee Quality coffee
#AffordablePrices Check-in promotion: Thai tea and green tea for only 29 baht! Valid until June 30, 2020. (Stay tuned for more promotions!)
review_4_text:
The coffee is fragrant and delicious, very smooth.
The staff are very friendly and welcoming.
The location is very easy to find. The building is beautiful and the shop is cute.

name: คอฟฟี่พริก
Lanpoh Coffee
review_1_text: Excellent food, cozy atmosphere, it's a hidden gem. Recommended and will definitely be back for more.
review_2_text:
Max and Kai are two /wonderful/ people. Their coffee is amazing (could do with a bit less ice, though) and their food is great. The prices are a bit steep for your average Thai places (I top out at 40 baht most places) but it's worth it for the atmosphere if you don't mind paying for that sort of thing. It also helps to know a bit of Thai, too, because Max and Kai tend to like to talk to you and get to know you better, especially if you live in the area. It's sort of off-the-beaten path and I've never seen more than two other people there.

tl;dr Great place, great food, just a tad steep on the average Thai prices.
review_3_text: Great coffee and tea drinks, fast WiFi, and a beautiful patio with lots of fans.  Off the main road, so look for the chalkboard sign.
review_4_text: Nice atmosphere. Food and drinks are delicious and beautiful!

name: 119coffee
review_1_text: Great place to have an amazing cappuccino and surf the web at the speed of light, great deserts and service
review_2_text: convenient

name: ร้านกาแฟนครน่าน
Sally's (Sandwich, Breakfast and Bakery)
review_1_text: It was amazing 😊 I love this cafe, my favorite kind of cafe. Clean, calm, nice atmosphere. They have a lot of options from western to thai and diy, price is reasonable, as a big breakfast like this in Bangkok can be like 350b. And it taste really good too!
review_2_text: This is a nice cafe for a delicious breakfast. I’ve visited many times for their signature Sally’s breakfast. The staff is super friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere is cozy and quiet. Their menu offers plenty of options to choose from. I also appreciated that they accept card payments, which is convenient since many places in the area are cash-only.
review_3_text: The Greek yoghurt was amazing! ordered it again. No added sugar, thick and creamy.
review_4_text: Wow the sourdough on toast was great super fresh and tasty beautiful eggs and great coffee and homemade Greek yogurt
review_5_text: What a wonderful little spot… I was originally a little disappointed because they didn’t have avocado, but the French toast was delicious !!!…homemade seeded bread and the two eggs were cooked to perfection ! Both Fern and Gun  were  super friendly! It is people like that that remind me how much I love Thailand and why I love it so much! And they had Beatles songs playing in the background! Highly recommend this place

name: CROP cafe
review_1_text: Good atmosphere, nice shop, delicious coffee.

name: กาแฟนิยม สาขาถนนเจริญเมือง Niyomcoffee
review_1_text:
Very kind and friendly people! Fast service and a really nice latte. And I’ve had some amazing lattes in my life living in Vancouver and South America. I’ll definitely come back here again.

Also they have a huge selection, good prices, lots of little snacks, and a lovely outdoor covered area to sit and enjoy your coffee.

If you’re in the area definitely come for a coffee 👌🏼

I got a latte (see photo)
review_2_text: I've been coming to Niyom Coffee here in Chiang Mai since it opened on 23.12.2016. Mon & K the sister brother owners are friendly & fabulous at making my favourite Lattecinos.. all snacks & drinks are high quality & very reasonably priced. K & Mon's other staff  including Daeng & Arm are great too! Highly recommended! Thanks guys!
review_3_text: I always order the light roast Americano from both branches — it’s my go-to! The flavor is aromatic, and perfectly balanced. The quality is consistent every time, and the baristas really know how to bring out the best in the beans.
review_4_text: Good coffee and matcha, and the sweetest batista.
review_5_text:
Great coffee.
Delightful local bean dark roast
Lovely people

name: minimal coffee บิ๊กซีดอนจั่น
Black Single Coffee Bar
review_1_text: A fantastic little coffee shop run by two talented baristas. I’ve been coming here for years, but I’ve never written a review before, this place deserves a good one. The guys that run this place have great taste, and take a lot of pride in giving you the best possible coffee at a very reasonable price.. what more could you ask for? I like a hot cappuccino and theirs is perfect for 55 baht. Most places charge almost 100 baht for a cappuccino that doesn’t measure up to theirs. These guys  take great pride in their work and it’s a pleasure to see and an even greater pleasure to taste their coffee. The atmosphere is nice, they played great music, but the coffee is the main reason for visiting this establishment. Give B.S.C a try, you won’t be disappointed.
review_2_text: Small place, good vibe, and great price. Most important, the coffee was delicious! Another place to add to my list of Chiang Mai coffee shops to return to
review_3_text: With only one week in Chiang Mai I set out to see and try new coffee shops but by day two I stumbled upon Black Single Coffee and fell in love with this beautiful little shop! The shop itself is smaller but maturely decorated, with unique black and white decor, a cozy but refreshing environment! The owner works daily to craft and design delicious, affordable, and beautiful coffee!!! No better way to start a morning then with a sunrise walk, adorable latte art, bible study, and a welcoming smile from our wonderful barista!!! The coffee itself is delicious and carefully crafted to perfection! If you’re looking for a sweet coffee this isn’t it, but if you want a genuinely amazing drink this is the place! The latte art is truly incredible and always brought a smile to my face, I’ll be admiring it forever! Thank you so much Pan for a lovely week of coffee and smiles!!!! 🤎☕️
review_4_text: This coffee shop provides an outstanding informative experience. The bartista provides you with 3 different coffee bean roasts to choose from. He will share a little taste and flavor information and you can select your bean.  You can also mix beans.  The dude who works here is pretty charming and it is nice to watch him chat about his passion. I recommend this coffee shop. There is No legal car parking here.
review_5_text:
This is a very popular coffee shop in Chiang Mai with the locals and tourists.
The vibe in this cafe is so cool. The decor is spot on. 👌
This is the kind of place you just want to sit and chill.

The seating is limited on the inside.  There is also seating on the outside.
The Barista is the skills. I was so impressed with his pour. It tasted great as well. He I the best Barista I've seen in my travels.  The menu for the coffee was great.

name: SON OF A BREW
review_1_text: Nice cafe and cozy place.
review_2_text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and plenty of parking. The owner is lovely and friendly, and the prices are affordable.
review_3_text: A cool coffee shop with premium quality coffee 🤍
review_4_text: Great taste, disciplined, and attentive to customers🤘
review_5_text: Matcha is my absolute favorite ❤️ Delicious, rich, and the vendor is super friendly.

name: กาแฟสุดรัก
review_1_text: Love it! Small but with a couple of chairs. Fantastic coffee. Variety of local brands. Wish I could come every day. Just go there!
review_2_text: Best cappuccino we had in Thailand! Nice and friendly barista :) ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: น้ำสิงห์เชียงใหม่
Mingmitr Coffee - หนองประทีป
review_1_text: Tables in coffee shop are very comfortable and cleaned with plugs under the tables. The drinks are good. I love hot latte. Recommend!!!
review_2_text: Warm decorations and good coffee

review_1_text:
Lovely shop with great atmosphere.

The most recommended is Shio pan i bought Almond and Chocolate even bring it for eating at home still in great taste and texture.

Another surprise for me was Cocoa drink. Top 3 in Chiangmai with their taste and smell. When on top with Mint ice cream still go well together.

Carrot was great in texture, I expected for a little bit smell of cinnamon but acceptable. Still great taste and texture.

The most disappointing for today was Red velvet. It looked like the cake not rise or im not sure that is the recipe of the shop. I think its quite dense in texture. Its dense more than brownie even i left out the refrigerator until the cream was melted. The cream was too sour for me not working well with cake taste.

BTW I still give 5 stars due to really great Cocoa drink and Shio pan. I suggest all cream f you to try. 😊☺️🥰
review_2_text:
Christmas theme decoration is Super cute and cozy😍😍

Sitting area and order area are separated, makes the sitting area more private. I love that!!

Variety choice of bread (Shio pan the most) MUST NOT MISS!! So delicious
review_3_text: Cute cafe in ChiangMai, variety type of bread. Buy from one place and bring to the sitting zone (self-service).
review_4_text: I recently visited ROUND N ROUND, and it was a great experience! The café has a chilled zone where you can comfortably enjoy salted breads. Their fresh bread, straight from the oven, is definitely a highlight—soft, warm, and delicious. The overall vibe is relaxing, making it a perfect spot to unwind. Plus, the café offers plenty of parking space, which is super convenient. If you’re looking for a place to enjoy fresh food in a cozy setting, this is a great choice!
review_5_text:
Round n Round is a charming bakery that’s definitely worth a visit if you’re in Chiang Mai. The highlight here is the bread—freshly baked, with a wide variety of choices ranging from crusty loaves to soft, sweet pastries. Each item looks thoughtfully made, and the quality is impressive.

The shop atmosphere is cozy and homey, with warm wooden decor and a relaxed vibe that makes you feel comfortable the moment you walk in. It’s clear that attention has been given to both the design and the customer experience.

There’s plenty of parking available, which is a big plus especially if you’re driving. However, one thing to note is that the dining area is located separately from the main selling area. While this setup helps keep the bakery space organized, it can feel slightly inconvenient if you’re hoping to enjoy your food on the spot without moving between areas.

Overall, Round n Round is a lovely place for quality baked goods, a calm atmosphere, and a nice little break from the city buzz. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys fresh bread and relaxing spaces.

review_1_text: Very good coffee for only 50 baht! ☕️ I was surprised by how many choices they have on the menu for such a small coffee shop. The staff were really nice, and I was so glad I found this place. If I lived in Chiang Mai, I would definitely come here every day. Highly recommended!

review_5_text:
Wonderful little coffee joint in Suthep. Great coffee and vibe. Defo be back.

name: Tantawan Café
review_1_text:
Cute, somewhat nostalgically designed, student-oriented cafe with a homey hospitality. The solo lady manning the operations is very friendly and the kittens rather naughty 😸😻 (they got rounded up and sent to the back one time 😆).

It's quiet here as it's in a small alley. The clientele are mostly students having lunch and studying.

I like stopping by here because of the donuts. Homemade, old school type with some meat to it rather than a modern-day airy light one. They're not special on their own but in the atmosphere of this bright yellow space, it feels special🌻
review_2_text: Great little cafe with such lovely and kind staff. During my stay in Chiang Mai I visited the cafe every morning for iced coffee and donuts and everything was perfection. The vibe is cosy and homely, I felt very comfortable inside.
review_3_text: a cozy place with a very nice owner who makes you feel welcome :) the donut and the drink were absolutely amazing, 200% recommend this place !!
review_4_text: Freshly baked donuts with a variety of flavors, a nice place with a great environment for a quiet afternoon break, and a very friendly welcome. I will definitely come back kaa 🍩🤎
review_5_text: Look at this cute soup, it has noodle inside! I think it provides good value for the price.

name: The Baristro Asian Style
review_1_text:
This place is huge and features a beautiful Japanese-style garden. It was super crowded when I visited, likely because it coincided with the Chiang Mai University graduation. The crowd was a mix of teenagers and office workers, so it was quite bustling and not very peaceful. Luckily, my group managed to find a seat just in time!

There is an 80 THB entrance fee, but you can use the ticket as a discount for food and drinks inside.

The prices are standard for a cafe, and everything tasted good. The staff were friendly and provided great service. Since it was so busy, the drinks were served in order, so you might have to wait a bit. Overall, a lovely spot—just be prepared for the crowd on busy days!
review_2_text: We visited during the New Year holiday, so it was extremely crowded and the queues were quite long everywhere. There is an entrance fee of 80 THB, which can be redeemed for drinks inside. The café features beautiful Japanese-style architecture and a serene environment, making it very photogenic and perfect for taking pictures. The green tea tasted very authentic, with a rich and refined flavor, and the strawberry daifuku was excellent — soft, fresh, and truly delicious. Overall, it was a pleasant experience, especially for those who enjoy Japanese aesthetics and desserts.
review_3_text:
I have a suspicion that places like Baristro Asian Style are built mainly with the Instagram and influencer crowd in mind. Even so, it’s hard not to be impressed by this one. The entire place — the architecture, the garden, the layout — feels as if you’ve been transported straight to Japan. It’s a coffee and tea lounge that genuinely creates a sense of calm and serenity, and it’s a real pleasure to be there, at least when it’s not busy or overrun by people taking selfies.
We were lucky on the day we visited and found it relatively quiet, which made the experience much more enjoyable. What ultimately matters, though, is that the coffee is good. A nicely made cappuccino for 85 baht, enjoyed in such beautiful and peaceful surroundings, makes this a worthwhile trip out of town.
review_4_text: Great environment, seats at indoor and outdoor. Salted caramel cheesecake is a surprise for me, salted caramel lava in the middle of the cheesecake. Macha crepe cake is nice too, not very sweet just nice. Macha is best to drink it when it is still warm. Black coconut, is espresso with coconut juice and fresh instead of coconut milk, maybe coconut milk is better, to provide a little bit of saltiness and sweetness and with the bitterness of espresso. It is good to come early in the morning if you would like to avoid the crowds.
review_5_text: A very nice Japanese garden in Chiang Mai with a relaxing, laid-back atmosphere. The beautiful architecture really made for an enjoyable visit. The green tea served was rich and flavorful. The entry fee is 80 Baht, which can be fully redeemed against the cost of a drink. While the prices might be a bit high, the overall experience and vibe are certainly worth it.

The exterior is all black, so it's hard to tell if it's a coffee shop or a hip-hop joint. Step inside and you'll find the interior, of course, decorated in black. The staff are friendly, and you can pay with GNL. Cold drinks are 5 THB more expensive than hot drinks. I had the Thai milk tea, and it was delicious. You can sit down and enjoy your drink, and the air conditioning keeps things cool. Hahahaha.
review_2_text:

Inside, the atmosphere is simple and uncluttered. There's plenty of seating, and the air conditioning is cool, but not too hot. You barely notice the glare from the outside. The owner is friendly. The coffee is good, and the fruit tea is good. They also sell drinks from the vending machine.

name: Transit Number 8
review_1_text: Very beautifully decorated like a tiny Japanese town during winter. Met the lady owner, very sweet lady. The coconut cake is a must try! Will need to pay an "entrance" fees to enter but can take the ticket and exchange for food/drinks. Only downside - the staff within the cafe could be more cheerful and prices inside the cafe are touristy priced. Overall, enjoyed our 2hr stopover at this cafe ❤️
review_2_text:
Really loved this cafe’s concept and food! Worked here for a bit with my laptop, otherwise i really liked the pork don they had - this is kinda like a cafe concept with other shops owned by the same company (massage parlour, rice bowl shop etc), so i could order the rice dishes from the shop across the mini street. I really liked the milk roti too, crispy and they gave you a bottle of condensed milk so you could add as much as you’d like! :) def kid friendly and a great spot for instsgram pics!! oh they have coffee and beans/ drip bags too.

Note that you’ll have to pay an entrance fee.

i felt it was pretty pricey for thai local pricing though !
review_3_text: Been meaning to review this place for years but never got around to doing so until someone asked me where was my most memorable coffee experience and I have to say THIS !! Hands down!!  Everything from decor, service, coffee selection, taste, smell, even temperature is a perfect 5star+ The coffee was brewed perfectly and the infused milk was NOTHING I’ve ever tried before. The rose/ orange/ whatever else they used were paired amazingly well with coffee. Who would have guessed. This was such a random find on my trip to Chiang Mai but it’s moments like these which stays with you for a long time.
review_4_text:

The price for a cup of coffee is little bit above the average cafes in Chiang Mai.

I didn’t go to their dining area, which was in a unique design (as many people reviews), but I very much liked their front store set-up and design. Really felt like I was in Japan.
review_5_text: First, they charge you 70bht/person at the entrance. Then you find out there's no empty seats on Sunday. Girls just save a seat with a drink, then go to another seat to make pictures. Some laptop users also were there. The coffee tasted ok. Maybe come on weekday.

review_5_text: The creamy scrambled eggs were delicious! The restaurant was decorated adorably for the occasion, the music was great, and the place was clean.

name: The Coffee Work

review_5_text: superb coffee shop.

review_2_text: The tea is delicious and not too expensive, perfect for content creators and those who want to take beautiful photos.

name: Coffice Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: Had a morning visit and honestythis has become one of my favourite spots in Chiang Mai. The matcha is top-tier — balanced and not sweet at all. The bagels were incredibly fresh showing real quality. There’s enough seating inside plus a few outdoor tables, perfect for a calm start to the day. review_5_text:

The tomato bagel looks cute too

review_1_text: This place is even better than we expected! The coffee and matcha are really good. The shi-o pan and the red beans with toasted bread are super delicious. So sad I only got takeaway for one — I’ll definitely come back next time. Highly recommended!!!
review_2_text:
The coffee was great, no complaints.
The staff was also friendly, and the ambience was nice.

My only issue was when I decided to buy the coffee beans, Strawberry Kix blend, I was informed that at first by the staff for 500 gram, the price is 600 baht, which I agreed and I waited for 15-20 minutes because the 500 gram pack was not available, then when I was about to pay, the other staff told me the price was actually 820 baht for 500 gram. They have like a fridge or something (I don’t know), but it can keep coffee beans really well. Before giving the coffee beans to the barista, you pick them out of the fridge, then give them to the barista. He or she will make coffee for you.
review_5_text: They have a lot of beans to select from. Definitively must visit. Blueberry beans are fire!

review_1_text: The coffee is delicious and the atmosphere is lovely and cozy.

name: Inbox Coffee Bar สาขากองบิน41
review_1_text:
While it has "Coffee Bar" in the name, the evening food menu is what actually steals the show.
• Moo Jum (Thai Clay Pot Hot Pot): This is their undeniable signature dish. Almost every table orders it, especially during the cooler months. The broth is highly praised for being rich and comforting.
• Grilled Intestines (ไส้ย่าง): A local favorite, known for being perfectly grilled with a great dipping sauce and no bitter aftertaste.
• Sun-Fried Chicken Wings (ปีกไก่ทอดพระอาทิตย์): Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside—the ultimate bar snack.
• Drinks: They offer a standard cafe menu during the day (coffee, matcha, cakes) and transition to cold beers and evening drinks at night.
🎤 Amenities (Including Karaoke!)
Since your last message cut off while asking about karaoke, you are in luck! Inbox Coffee Bar features a private karaoke room. It’s a fantastic option if you want to eat their famous hot pot, have a few drinks, and sing with a group of friends without worrying about being too loud in the main dining area. The venue is also very close to the airport, making it a great pre- or post-flight stop.
review_2_text:
4.5 / 5 (but ill give it a 5star) - Inbox Coffee Bar
A quick food fix after jiu-jitsu training, just a few steps outside my gym. I swear, every time I walk out after rolling, the aroma of grilled meat hits me like a flying armbar. 😅 While I was standing outside waiting for a delivery, the smell was so good it made me question all my life decisions. And because I am fragile and vulnerable after training (and also very hungry), I gave in. I ordered the Grilled Pork because honestly, who can say no to grilled pork, and the Grilled Beef Picanha with chili sauce (phet nit noi). The flavors were straightforward but full of character: Thai aromatics, savory richness, and just a touch of sweetness that doesn’t try to steal the spotlight. It sits quietly at the back of your tongue like that one friend who doesn’t talk much but completes the group. Even the rice surprised me. It was mixed with Northern Thai sausage, which added more depth and made the whole meal feel like a complete experience. Great food, great smell, great timing. 4.5 because perfection is impossible, but they got pretty close. Value for money #nocokezero
review_3_text: The food was passable... but the service was incredibly slow. We finished all the dishes before the rice even arrived; we waited at least 20 minutes. To make matters worse, some dishes were missed and forgotten.
review_4_text: I had a fantastic time at this bar! It's super nice and cozy, and they've managed to create a spacious atmosphere with tables in every corner. The food was delicious, especially if you're a fan of hot pot, and they offer a variety of mouthwatering appetizers. I highly recommend this place for an evening dinner with friends, where you can unwind with a chilled beer. It's the perfect spot for a memorable night out!
review_5_text: Good place to enjoin with friends. Food is right taste. Staff is very friendly.

The taste of the food was average, basic, and nothing impressive.
First and last time.

I don't recommend this restaurant.

name: M Café
review_1_text:
I discovered this café by chance a year ago, but it quickly became my go-to spot almost every day. The owner is truly passionate about coffee and puts great care into every cup served—and the staff are just as dedicated!

My favorite menu item is the iced Americano. The house blend is already well-balanced and satisfying, but if you’re looking for something with a special touch, the floral blend brings a unique and refreshing twist that makes it even more memorable.

Whether you're sitting in to relax or grabbing a cup to go, you’ll always be greeted warmly with friendly service that makes every visit feel welcoming.
review_2_text: Finding a cozy cafe in Chiang Mai is becoming increasingly challenging, but this little gem stands out. The cafe is situated adjacent to a HIIT workout place called “I AM FIT”, and it is owned by someone passionate about coffee. The cafe offers beans from different parts of the world, including some highly sought-after ones sold at popular spots in Chiang Mai, but at a fraction of the cost. It's worth giving this cafe a try at least once. You could bring a laptop and work here too!
review_3_text: The cafe has a small and lovely vibe.  I tried pocky coffee, one of the coffee that recommended by the owner. Taste is cute as a snack. The prices are also cute and friendly – definitely a hidden gem worth visiting
review_4_text: The cafe run out of a passion for drinks made us feel at home on a cozy Sunday morning. The matcha was made to perfection and we had to come back the next day. The owner is warm, friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend!
review_5_text: Small cafe but friendly staff and good quality coffee

The brownie was good but coconut pie even better.

The Barn green plants decorations of the exterior seems became the main selling points of the cafe. The interior of the cafe seem simple and the decorations seem little disorganised and such as cleverly using the space and some of the plants already dried up but still on the pots and it's really look miserable!
