review_1_text:
I love this cafe. The whole vibe is nice and cozy and green. Good aircon, comfortable seats, affordable drinks, soft lighting, outlets. I got a honey granola croffle and hot tea.

I was working today but I'd definitely come back on the weekend with a nice book
review_2_text: I love the vibe + the coffee quality and baristas skills are great. The only thing I wish was different was the opening hour, 10 seems a bit late but that only means I'd just love to have my morning coffee there :) food options are rather limited, perhaps adding fresh pastries like croissants would be a good idea!
review_3_text:
A nice place with great greens and environment to have a cup of dark roasted americano. The coffee is well balanced and strong in taste but yet not too acidic.
Nice environment for a quiet afternoon enjoying your sip of coffee.
Friendly barrister and staff even though I speak a foreign language.
Got 300g of roasted beans for self brewing and making.
review_4_text: Cute and comfortable specialty coffee shop with a small selection of good Thai beans. We tried two pour-overs, and both were fantastic. The space is filled with plants and has a relaxing feel. We got to connect with the owner, who is really kind and knew we were interested in specialty beans, so he showed us a variety of beans and gave us recommendations for a couple really good ones.
review_5_text:
The coffee is very good and served in lovely cups. Beautifully presented.

We didn't eat there, as we only wanted coffee.

The most sad thing is that lone fish are kept in sad conditions in vases. They can't swim due to the plant roots and it is no life for a poor living creature. There are many fish in small little vases.

They would do much better to release the fish and keep the plants only.

🙏🙏I hope that the owners will read this and make a change. 🙏🙏

The shop is really lovely and books are available to read or flip through.

The coffee as I said was excellent 👌

name: Stella Coffee
review_1_text:
Roast and Roll in Chiang Mai is a hidden gem that captures the perfect blend of ambiance, comfort, and quality. The staff here are exceptionally friendly, welcoming you with warm smiles and a genuine eagerness to make your experience enjoyable. They go out of their way to ensure you feel right at home.

The seating is wonderfully cozy, especially their comfy couches, which make it a great spot to settle in and relax. Whether you're catching up with friends or enjoying some solo time, the seating setup invites you to linger. It's the kind of place where time slips by as you sip your coffee and watch the world go by – the people-watching here is a treat, with a lively mix of locals and travelers adding to the charm.

The coffee and food are excellent, with rich flavors and careful attention to detail. Roast and Roll strikes a perfect balance between quality and a laid-back vibe, making it a must-visit spot in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Lovely little café for takeaway coffee. I’ve been coming here for a few days now and the coffee is delicious. The lady is extremely kind and welcoming. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: Great coffee, cake was delicious. Staff are so friendly. Recommend!!!
review_4_text: Very chill  and good coffee
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious. When visiting Chieng Mai, I loved to start my days with my coffee and butter cake, and I enjoyed the great service and charming attention.

name: Found
review_1_text: Lovely small place friendly staff
review_2_text: This shop is very nice, with a beautiful view. The matcha is delicious and worth the price. I would like to inform the shop that the smell of cigarettes from the shop's smoking area. As a customer who is allergic to cigarette smells, it spoils the atmosphere while drinking coffee and has to endure the smell all the time in the shop. I would like to ask the shop to consider changing/moving the smoking area away from the customer area and adjusting the direction of that area so that the smell does not enter the shop area. I personally like the shop very much, but I would like to inform you that if this problem persists, I may decide not to return to use the service again, which would be a great pity.
review_3_text:

It's small, but I like that I can stay for a long time.
I appreciate the outlets at the tables.

It's a shame that there aren't many hot drinks besides coffee, but I enjoyed a refreshing apple tea.

Very good coconut-focused smoothie place with very friendly staff. Half of their huge menu items are coconut based so it's just a matter of mixing your favorite fruit(s) or drinks with 🥥.

I've had several different mixes here and was not disappointed. Maybe not THE best place for fruit smoothie in town, but the coconut part is certainly good.
review_2_text:

Recommended
review_3_text: The SD Coconut House in Chiang Mai is an absolute gem and the perfect oasis on a hot day. Whether you're strolling through the city or seeking a refreshing break, this spot delivers in every way. Their smoothies and coconut ice cream are simply divine—creamy, flavorful, and sure to cool you down in the most delightful way. What makes it even more special is the kind and friendly staff who greet you with warmth and genuine hospitality, making you feel right at home. Don't miss a visit here; it's a must-stop for anyone wanting a delicious taste of refreshment in Chiang Mai!

review_1_text: no restroom allowed
review_2_text:
Thank you for opening a branch here! I'm a loyal Thai customer!

The staff are amazing! The bottom was sweet and smooth, while the top was tea-flavored, very bitter and strong. I loved it! It wasn't bitter like coffee. After stirring it, it was perfectly balanced. There are so many other menu items to try, including some that support Thai products. I'm a huge fan of Thai products! The store is always busy!

Parking on the street.
review_4_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The Friendliest Punthai Branch in Town | Essential Stop for Daily Thai Tea & Coffee on Suthep Road🥤☕
.
Punthai Coffee, Suthep Road branch, is one of the few branches in Chiang Mai located outside a gas station and right in the heart of the city. What impressed us most about this branch is the friendliness of the staff.
.
As a regular (everyday) Thai tea drinker, Punthai's 75% sweetened Thai tea has a rich and perfectly sweet flavor. With a Max Card, the price is only 27 baht per cup, which is a great value (although limited to 10 cups per month). The shop also offers promotions pairing drinks with a wide selection of desserts, including croissants, sandwiches, and even dim sum items like buns and dumplings.
.
Note: Since I came to buy food in the morning to go to work, parking on the side of the road wasn't difficult. Even on weekend mornings, you can park in front of the shop or across the street. We usually didn't have to wait long, as there were usually 4-5 staff members working at the same time during peak hours.
.
In summary, this Punthai branch This is perfect for those looking for affordable everyday drinks. It's even more worthwhile with a membership card, but parking can be difficult during the morning or afternoon on weekdays for those driving.

📍Location: Located on busy Suthep Road, right next to 7-11. Easy to find and conveniently located near Chiang Mai University's Suan Dok Campus.
✨The Vibe: Clean with a minimal design. Offers a bar with three high chairs and a couple of tables.
🏆Strengths: Exceptional staff friendliness (the most friendly Punthai branch we've found in town!). They offer reliable taste and great value, especially with a Max Card membership (Thai Tea at THB 27). Excellent variety of bakery and snacks, including dim sum.
💡Parking Note: Easy street parking in the early mornings and weekends; challenging during weekday peak hours.

📝Highly recommended for international travelers who want to try quality coffee or non-coffee Thai brand drinks at an affordable price. Dim sum and Thai-style bakery items are also available.

name: Na Wat Coffee

The shop is white and clean. The owner is super kind and speaks English.  We have to slow it down when we talk.

The latte was good. Was it the best I've had? No, but she can pour, that's for sure. Pastries are good.

Overall, this is a place where I would come and hangout without any reservations.  It's a solid pick on this side of Chiang Mai.

name: Fernpresso Flagship Store at Suandok
review_1_text:
Fernpresso is a great café to relax or get some work done in Chiang Mai. ☕ We ordered a hot cappuccino and an iced latte, both of which tasted excellent — rich, smooth, and well-balanced. The café has a modern and stylish interior with comfortable seating, making it a nice spot to spend some time reading, working, or chatting with friends.

In addition to coffee, they also have a selection of freshly baked goods. The pastries are definitely worth trying, especially if you want something to accompany your drink. The atmosphere is calm and relatively quiet, which is perfect for people looking for a peaceful café experience.

Parking is easy for motorbikes, but car parking is limited, so plan accordingly. The staff are polite and attentive, contributing to a pleasant overall experience.

Overall, Fernpresso at Suandok is a cozy, modern café with good coffee, tasty bakery items, and a peaceful vibe — ideal for both casual visitors and those looking to work or study in a quiet environment. Definitely worth a stop when exploring Chiang Mai
review_2_text:
Perfect Brunch! Everything you want to start your day!

I recently visited this cozy spot, hoping to start my day with some avocado toast, but unfortunately, they were out of avocados. As a vegetarian, I found their breakfast menu somewhat lacking in showcased vegetarian options, which was disappointing.

That said, their Thai tea with almond milk was frothy and absolutely delicious, and the fresh fruit juice smoothies were refreshing and flavorful. I also tried the breakfast sandwich on fresh whole-grain bread, which was excellent—hearty, flavorful, and satisfying. However, I wasn’t informed that the sandwich included cheese, which was an issue for me as I’m lactose intolerant. The staff were super friendly and warm, but they could benefit from being more knowledgeable about the menu and its ingredients.

The restaurant has a chill, laid-back vibe, with quiet music that makes it a great place to study or relax. There's both an air-conditioned indoor space and outdoor seating where you can enjoy the bustle of the busy street.

Overall, the vibe and drinks stood out, and the food was tasty, but a bit more attention to menu transparency and vegetarian options would elevate the experience.

review_1_text:
Review of MilkLand, Chiang Mai

If you’re in Chiang Mai and craving something deliciously fresh, MilkLand is a must-visit! This cozy spot beautifully showcases the unique and strong partnership between Thailand and Denmark, where Danish dairy expertise meets Thai creativity. This relationship between the two nations goes beyond mere business; it’s a celebration of quality and innovation that has stood the test of time, and MilkLand is a shining example of this collaboration.

MilkLand specializes in smoothies, baked goods, and coffee-based drinks, each crafted with high-quality dairy that reflects Denmark's rich dairy tradition. Their yogurt smoothies, in particular, are a standout—perfectly balanced in tartness and sweetness, and ideal for a refreshing break on a warm Chiang Mai day. Their coffee drinks, made with creamy milk and paired with freshly baked treats, offer a delightful experience that’s both indulgent and energizing.

For those curious to experience Danish culture, MilkLand brings a taste of it right here to Thailand. And for anyone inspired to visit Denmark afterward, here’s a tip: maybe skip December! Winter in Denmark is very dark, with limited daylight, which can be a stark contrast to the vibrant, sunlit atmosphere here in Chiang Mai. Instead, enjoy the Danish influence at MilkLand in the warm Thai sunshine.

Whether you’re a dairy lover or simply in the mood for a delicious smoothie or coffee treat, MilkLand delivers quality and charm. It’s more than just a café; it’s a celebration of the strong, enduring connection between Denmark and Thailand. Highly recommended!

review_2_text: Lovely chill place to have a drink and watch the world go by. Music was great! We came back twice.
review_3_text: Cute authentic place for sunset drinks with a view and fresh air.
review_4_text: So disappointed that there is no food here anymore. I used to love the menu and the elevator that brought the meals up to the rooftop patio was such a fun quirk. Very quiet atmosphere now when we went too. Zero locals. I remember this place being packed. Things seem to have changed a lot since the pandemic...
review_5_text: Good local restaurant on the roof top. The food taste good and price is cheap. Not that convenience on parking spot because the restaurant are in the city center of Chiang Mai, for customer need to parking beside the side-walk.

name: Bella Goose Coffee at Alt_ChiangMai
review_1_text:
This spot was an awesome find, I have been to their other locations and this one, like the others did not disappoint.

This time I went for the Americano. Fantastic. Definitely a chill spot to catch up on some emails. The space is small but intentionally and thoughtfully designed. The barista working was incredibly friendly , which seems to be a common theme with Bella Goose, best team in Thailand.
review_2_text: Loved the coffee here. Only had a simple flat white, early-ish in the morning, so wasn't busy at all. We really liked it (of course this was for a bit of nostalgic Aussie coffee, not for a Thai experience!).
review_3_text: The only pumpkin latte except Starbucks in town, but it was too sweet…and expensive, the seat wasn’t comfortable, quite awkward to work from outside when people working inside the coworking space.
review_4_text:
Absolutely love Bella Goose! 🪿
I’m a big fan of their smoothies and cakes every item on the menu is a hit. My favorite smoothie bowl can only be found here, and it never disappoints.

Their smoothies are beautifully presented, taste amazing, and come with generous toppings. Best of all, they’re guilt-free and perfect as a healthy breakfast option.

What really makes the experience even better is the service. Special shout-out to Jaab, the barista at this branch always friendly, polite, and genuinely helpful when recommending menu items. A true gem!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a delicious and wholesome treat to start the day right. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
review_5_text: Super nice café! The atmosphere was modern and felt very new. We just tried the café, but it looks wonderful for remote work as well. They have great coffee and delicious smoothies and the stuff was really really nice.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Nice place to get Good Roffe insider the hospital. Rally buss in the morsning.
review_2_text: It is okay to order here if you have no choice and need some caffeine for the day. Go for premium coffee to get the real milk. Coffee is dark roast and it is bitter.
review_3_text: Good coffee
review_4_text: Cafe Amazon is a chain coffee shop located inside Maharanakhon Chiang Mai (Suan Dok) Hospital. They offer seasonal flavors that you'll never get tired of. They serve high-quality, delicious coffee. It's located on the first floor of the hospital, near the blood collection room, across from the 7-Eleven and bakery.
review_5_text: All the staff were lovely and working hard against the clock, which was great. I really liked it. Even though there were many customers, they were still smiling and cheerful, and served quickly. No long waits.

name: Around Town Coffee
review_1_text:
Lovely small independent coffee shop over looking a section of the City Wall.

60 THB for an outstanding hot latte. The best I've had in Thailand, smooth, well balanced flavour.

Friendly owner who clearly knows his business well. I'll be here several mornings a week when I return to Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Absolutely amazing coffee at this tiny spot. The latte art feels almost as if it’s there simply because the coffee itself can’t be perfected any further. Unfortunately, with the traffic right outside, it’s not the comfiest place to stay.
review_3_text: I drink a lot of coffee, I love the stuff. I’ve been in hundreds of cafes, plantations, resorts all around the world that all specialise in coffee in all forms and I have had plenty of really good coffee. But there are only two that really stand out and I can remember vividly. One is in Vietnam the other is here.  Make sure you get the special blend, it really is special.
review_4_text: Around Town Coffee in Chiang Mai is a total gem—great vibes, friendly barista, and seriously good coffee. The space feels cozy but stylish, perfect for hanging out a bit!
review_5_text:
This guy is the best barista I've had the pleasure of encountering during my stay in Asia (I've been to at least 50 different cafes on my trip). A real pro. He owns the cafe and nailed everything about the establishment. The vibe is relaxed and cozy. The pricing is ridiculously low, it really should be higher for this excellent quality (I told him)! Coffee tastes really, really good, and the latte art is... well, see for yourself in the pics. Most importantly though, he's such a nice person.

We quickly became friends!
I recommend the "Dirty" drink (his is excellent), and of course the hot lattes so you can see his amazingly extraordinary latte art.

Even if you're not thirsty, you should stop by to talk to him!

name: Gramophone & Coffee
review_1_text: This cafe is pretty tiny but has a big personality. The mango smoothie I had was fantastic and prices are pretty cheap given the location. It’s a bit off the beaten path for old town but worth it, especially if you’re into records. They sell all kinds of LPs. The lady owner was so friendly and kind and the interior is cramped but very comfortable. There’s a bit of space for motorbike parking out front.
review_2_text:
Lovely experience and amazing place to just sit and work.

The owners are super friendly and all the records are full sale as well!

The Cats name is Toong Tong (Gold Bag), he’s also super chill and the perfect work companion.

If you’re near by don’t hesitate and stop by :-)
review_3_text: The coffee shop is cozy with soft music.  Managed by a lovely smiling lady, they offer beverages and coffee with very affordable price.  Suitable for a stop-by and take a break especially during the hot summer!
review_4_text:
This place is amazing! Small cafe with decent coffee. Tons of vinyl records of local and global artists.

It's not a specialty coffee place, there is no food, it's tiny and super local. But If you're on a walk on a hot day, it's the best spot to take a breather.
review_5_text: Fabulous place. Great for every music lover. Nice coffee too. We tried a hot latte; the taste was good and a bit stronger than we expected, so we liked it.

name: Bellinee's Bake & Brew เทคนิคการแพทย์ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Good location
review_2_text: Good
review_3_text: All the desserts are delicious, freshly made every day, and the prices are good. I recommend trying them. The staff are also lovely.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious! There's a great buy-one-get-one-free promotion. The bread is also tasty. The atmosphere is nice and there's seating for customers. 🥰☕
review_5_text:
Today, I was running errands near the Faculty of Medical Technology, Chiang Mai University, and came across a newly opened bakery. Actually, they already have several branches in Chiang Mai. It's a small shop, but they bake everything fresh. When I went, they had just finished baking the croissants. They're known for their croissants and shio bread. They have many flavors of croissants, including some imported from France. The shio bread is large and buttery. Prices start at only 30 baht.
They also have matcha michio bread; I tried the coconut blossom flavor and it was amazing! Highly recommend it.

name: Coco Loco @cnx
review_1_text: Small local coconut place in the old town, very good choice for the quick refreshment after walking around the old town. To be honest, I planed to stop by for quick refreshing but was amazed by the creativity of the menu. The owner is friendly and makes the perfect drink!!  I did order the signature and Tanod drink and it was sooo good! I love the way there is the texture of coconut pulp to chew while drinking. I will definitely be back again and again. Most recommended!!!
review_2_text:
I had the signature coconut shake and omg it was amazing! Money well spent guys~
It was creamy, full of flavor and refreshing.
The interior is super cute, perfect for some insta pics for the girlies, there's good chill music and the owner is super nice!
Highly recommend coming here~
review_3_text:
I’m not usually one to leave reviews but I had to just for this place. Amazing little hole-in-the-wall spot that serves delicious almost ice cream, almost smoothie drinks that hit the spot on a hot and humid afternoon. Janah, the owner (and only employee), is the sweetest human being, always up for a chat.

The drinks are made with real fruit and ice cream, not overly sweet but not bland, either. Serving sizes are generous and prices are great (65-75 baht per drink). The store is a super clean, cute place to hang out, too. Tons of unique flavour choices, all served gorgeously.

Amazing, authentic little family shop that’s well worth a visit. We’ll definitely be coming back.

Thanks for the great drinks and the great chat, Janah! Lots of love from Canada

P.S. Janah did not ask us to leave a review - just had to share how amazing this place is
review_4_text: Passing by this little treasure during our walks by the old town area… we were captivated by the various selections of treats being offered… needless to say, we went with one of the best sellers…. It was simply delicious with the perfect amount of coconut delight… perfect sweetness and was amazed by the presentation…. We are still enjoying this treat while doing this review as it was perfectly made for a nice sunny day in Chiang Mai ❤️
review_5_text: Love this place! Very cosy spot to enjoy a drink. Owner is super friendly and sweet. I had The Signature and it was full of coconut flesh in small chunks, so good!!

name: Ratika Coffee (ชั้น 3)
review_1_text: In the area next to Ratika coffee shop on the 3rd floor of the Chalermprakiat Building, there is a food center for doctors, nurses, workers, and service recipients of Maharaj Hospital. It's convenient, so you don't have to go down from the building to use medical services. There are 4 restaurants and 1 coffee shop. The food they serve includes rice with curry, noodles, yen ta fo, omelet rice, various som tam and yam dishes, and chicken rice. You can choose from a variety of options. The place is clean. During mealtimes, it can be a bit cramped.
review_2_text: This was my first time here. My child wanted a smoothie and it took me a long time to choose. We saw a sign that said "Pay at the front." I'd never been here before, so I wasn't sure where it was. So I asked the staff where to pay. The staff said indignantly, "Have you ordered yet?" When I asked for a receipt, they said, "They don't have a receipt like at 7-Eleven. They only have a cash receipt. Do you want one? I'll write it for you." So I said, "It's 50 baht. Don't you have a receipt?" I won't come again. I won't recommend it to anyone."
review_3_text: The coffee shop is located on the 3rd floor of the Chalerm Phra Barami Building at Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital, in the food court area. The coffee is of average taste, with options for light and dark roasts, priced at 30-40 baht, which is considered reasonable, especially for hospital staff and patients. They also offer a variety of other items including bakery goods, ice cream, and drinks.

name: Deep green @ Deejai Garden
review_1_text: Just passing by and popped in for a quick coffee + toilet break, but wow – turned out to be an incredibly cool space! Amazing visual art all around and even a proper smoking area. Ended up chilling and enjoying the vibe for over an hour. Totally unexpected gem! ☕🎨
review_2_text: Cool, friendly spot for some drinks and smoke with your mates. Simple food, great cocktails on offer. Nothing more, nothing less.
review_3_text:
Really friendly bar with swimming pool you can use when you spend 100 baht minimum.
Nice chill out and smoking area, great djs at night. Great hang to start or close the day, hippie traveler vibes with a 90’s feel.
review_4_text: I love it. A magical little gem in the heart of old city, great vibes, beats, pool and people
review_5_text: Fun and friendly place very close to Wat Pra Singh and the backpacker/traveler area. Hosts regular events that are always a good time. Great place to meet other travelers or go and chill on your own in the pool with a delicious beverage and some good food. Stand out nights are Locked In Asia underground house/garage/DnB.

name: Gravity Cafe’ & Bistro
review_1_text:
We went for breakfast at Gravity Cafe and really enjoyed it. The food selection is very good and everything looks great. They also have a huge selection of coffees, juices and other beverages. I had an açaí bowl, a caramel macchiato and a watermelon juice. My husband chose an avocado toast with a poached egg and a watermelon juice.

The juice was fresh and very tasteful. The açaí bowl was delicious with a great variety of fresh fruit and nice crunchy granola. The avocado toast also tasted good and the egg was perfectly cooked. Overall, it was a really good breakfast and I would definitely come again and recommend it.

The only reason I considered taking away a star is that they offer a 5 percent discount for making 5 star reviews, which feels dishonest. That said, the breakfast itself is honestly close to a perfect 5 out of 5, so for now they are forgiven.
review_2_text:
Note: The place gives 5 % off for 5 star reviews.

I don't like that review practice at all, so we did not take the 5 %, but the place is undeniably a 5/5 place!

The avocado toast had crisp bread, a delicious smash and a perfectly poached egg. The watermelon juice was flawless and so was the acai bowl and coffee. They also have some fun instagram items like the smoothie or tea with a white bubble on top (didn't try it).

We will be back for more in the coming days.
review_3_text:
A good spacious place
A lot of options on the menu
Credit cards are accepted
The prices are a bit on the high side for food and drinks.
Good place for tea, coffee and drinks if you don't mind paying extra. Croissants are fresh and delicious.
Good service
review_4_text: Breakfast is okey but nothing super special, like european style. Coffee is of course sweet so you need to say first if you don’t want it sweet. Banana bread is little bit to fat and too banana taste
review_5_text: Nice food, friendly staff, good aircon. Seeing some reviews I can only say: if you're not American and need a constant fake smile or people to ask how your grandma's youngest cousin twice removed is doing, then you'll be happy here. These people are working hard and someone may be a bit tired or have a headache... They are not rude just not overly enthusiastic about your order 😅😂

name: Strong. Coffee เชียงใหม่
Café de Siam @Le Naview Hotel
review_1_text:
Could not fault this place. Attractive and classy looking but the food is moderately priced and was all very good. Very pleasant and relaxed atmosphere.
I had a stir-fried seafood dish + a mango sticky rice, both very good.
I was a little surprised that even the cafe latte was good.
It felt very well run, a smooth and efficient operation.
review_2_text:
There lives a rat running between the tables and customers. The waitress saw it too, but didn't care... must be normal.
But the food is good, both european and thai.
review_3_text: Fresh and tasty. They have both indoor and outdoor seating. The wait was a bit long considering Thai food is typically super fast. It’s inside the moat with lots of tourists and adjacent to a hotel
review_4_text: It is a beautiful place. Better to visit this at night. More beautiful at night than daytime because of the lantern/ lamp decor.
review_5_text: Excellent food in a nice restaurant with A/C and reasonable prices. It looks more upscale than other restaurants nearby.

name: Fresh Brewed Coffee
review_1_text:
After reading other reviews I feel like my review I'm about to leave doesn't justify the place - maybe a timing issue 🙃

I ordered a hot latte and a Thai ice green tea. Although the coffee was good, the green tea was just average.

The service was extremely slow (no one else there) and took 15 minutes to make our take away order. This is the main reason for the low rating score.

The atmosphere of this Cafe is 5 star 🌟 with the comfortable lounges and the plant arrangement was also fabulous. I will try again and update my review if the service changed.

If you found this review helpful, please leave a thumbs up 👍 (it's free!) and follow me for more honest reviews 🙏 ❤️ 🙌
review_2_text: Really nice atmosphere, really good service, get to choose your own coffee beans, baristas are excellent and really welcoming. Great place for a coffee
review_3_text: Excellent cup of cappuccino! Very smooth coffee but service is ok. People are friendly but not efficient.
review_4_text: Very nice and cozy vibe quiet place. Smooth coffee and good craft. Recommend for coffee lover. Friendly & expert barista.
review_5_text:
The Cappuccino is fantastic, it's smooth and creamy and so good I had to have two.
Very friendly service and nice atmosphere. My only suggestion would be to close the door when people are sitting outside smoking because all the smoke comes inside.

name: Cross
review_1_text: A vibrant coffee shop in Chiang Mai's old city. Loved its bright blue exterior and unique decor, especially the gigantic receipt wall art. Tried their special dirty coffee with a traditional Thai scent - a unique taste. They also have a hidden bar at the back. Great spot for chilling, working, or catching up with friends. Worth checking out when in town!
review_2_text: Polished concrete and striking blue accents fill Cross yet it still keeps a relaxed and calm vibe inside. The house blend coffee is a mix of Thai, Ethiopian, and Columbian beans which was absolutely delicious as a hot americano (70b), with light floral and berry notes. The prices are all reasonable and you can pay slightly extra to upgrade to the premium beans. An actual good café in a city of too many subpar cafe's.
review_3_text:
🏣Blue building in town opposite the post office.

🥳This coffee shop I love so much when I came here in first time, they have good taste of coffee in fast bar and single origin blend in slow bar.

😎Iced Americano 85 THB is so goood with friendly staff.
review_4_text:
Lovely cup of Latte even tho it was on the pricier side.

Barista did not ask me which roast I want though (there was 2 roast being offered)

Maybe he went with the one which was better for the Latte?

Would recommend.
review_5_text: Best coffee in chiang mai, very smooth, not bitter. We love coffee and love this place. Friendly service, cute and original.

name: Workshop Coffee Space & CatHouse
review_1_text: The smell is very bad, the cats didn’t have water and almost no food, some of tem very skinny. 4 of them had really bad infections in the eyes. The room is small, no windows and no fresh air. They pee close to where they eat, not hygienic at all. I felt so bad seeing the cats living there. I hope this Place changes, as I see many bad reviews. That’s inappropriated for cat’s health and comfort.
review_2_text: The first floor is ok, but the upper floor with cat smells so terrible 🤮. No one is care enough to take care of the cats. They didn’t even take them to baht or brush them!! They only feed and left the cat all alone by themselves. It’s like a small cage that traps them.
review_3_text: The staff didn't even ask what I want and also told me nothing about the cats. I had no idea that the cats were upstairs. Looking from outside the place was nice, but once you're inside there were nothing like that. The place wasn't clean and also the bathroom. Moreover, every cats were skinny and they didn't have blankets or anything to keep the cats warm in a very very small, cold air-conditioned room. When I was there, the cats were seeking something to lay on and keep warm , so they just used every customers' bags. That was very depressive. The coffee was fine but wasn't worth a baht. Will never go back again. If you want to keep 5-6 cats together in such a small room can you please at least take good care of them?
review_4_text: The mocha was lovely. The cats seem very content, comfortable and well looked after. The place upstairs isn't very comfy for guests but you're only there to see the cats so it's fine!
review_5_text: Best green tea I ever tried. Charming and peaceful place in noising Chiang Mai. I will repeat sure!

name: Janice boutique house
review_1_text: This hotel is simply perfect. You can’t get a location better than this one. Everything is spotless clean. The room is also very comfortable, although there’s no elevator in this hotel. The air conditioner and fridge are perfect (and silent). Very friendly service. Awesome breakfast.  In my opinion, it can be really tough to find a better place to stay in this awesome town.
review_2_text: Me and my brother stayed here for 4 nights. During our travels we haven't spent this many nights in one place, but this was the perfect place to do so. Room was big modern and clean. The staff was very friendly and a special shout-out to the girl in the reception who was very helpful.
review_3_text: Great little boutique that made our stay really pleasant. They helped us arrange our tours and with taxi service. The breakfast has always been nice, and they prepare a box for us if we ask. I’m grateful for such nice accommodations. Enjoyed our short stay here that we even added another night.
review_4_text: The rooms are clean, nice and cozy, separated by a gap in the wall, meaning that you'll never have to hear your neighbors. The bed matress is firm but very comfortable, the shower pressure can be regulated and the staff very friendly. You can even ask them for advice regarding your trips and be sure to have an honest opinion. One thing that was a minus was the thin window glass;  during the night it was quiet, but during the day you could hear everything that happens on the street.
review_5_text:
We stayed in this hotel for 4 nights. And have nothing to complain about.
Cleaning was every day, breakfasts were “same same” but good)
It may be noisy as there is a road nearby.
Kindergarten starts around 8. For those who like to sleep longer it may be a minus, because kids are loud )

name: NORTH COFFEE สาขาพระสิงห์
review_1_text: Wow, only 35 baht for a DELICIOUS iced vanilla latte! It was quite big too, definitely the best value I’ve found in chiang mai! 😍 I got half sweet and the lady working was very nice and speedy in preparing the drink! ☕️
review_2_text: I order Thai tea here, not bad but it will be great if they change to paper cup the plastic cup isn't good for hot beverage.
review_3_text: 35 bath coffee. It’s great. The service is quick and the place is cute.
review_4_text:
the iced cappuccino was amazing and only 35thb !
great flavour and quite big
review_5_text:
Make coffee with Thai smile.
The location is convenient, it’s a simple roadside take way shop (coffee and Thai tea). The staff is very friendly. It's nice to have an iced drink in the chill morning.

name: เตเต้ กาแฟสด
review_1_text: Delicious coffee for 25-40 bhatt. Staff is very kind and you could customize the drinks, just use body language to show what you want.
review_2_text: Small coffee stall, only 25 Baht, good quality
review_3_text: Rude staff.
review_4_text:
After my morning walk, I had a morning coffee here because it was the only place open. Almost all their coffees are 25 baht hot and 35 baht iced!
It's a great value, and the coffee is rich and delicious. I was going for an Americano, but the price was the same, so I went with a cappuccino. The hot one was a bit small, but it was perfect for my morning coffee.
They open at 7:20. Lots of locals get takeout. I was curious, so I Googled it, but there weren't any reviews, so I thought I'd leave a comment.
review_5_text:
I recommend Tahiti!
The tea leaves are brewed directly in the coffee machine, creating a rich tea aroma.
I asked for it to be a little sweeter, and it was perfect! ̆̈
Looking around, I noticed they have a wide variety of teas and are reasonably priced.
The coffee is rich and savory, without any acidity. :)

name: Akha Ama Phrasingh
review_1_text: My first visit to this cafe on a Sunday morning, before 10am it was quiet and peaceful. After 10am the crowd started to fill up the place. My go to coffee has always been an espresso, no sugar. I tried the medium roast today and it was quite balanced and not overly bitter. I didn’t see a separate food menu, what was available right next to the cashier was banana muffin, which tasted warm and delicious. I liked the extra seeds in the mix. This place has an industrial feel to the design, spacious and yet warming with the lighting and furniture. They have a separate shelf selling coffee beans and other products, I will most definitely buy some before I leave town. They deliberately don’t provide any electric sockets, in a move to discourage people to linger. The balcony is closed, but there is one table outside by the entrance.
review_2_text:
Another must-visit coffee spot in Chiang Mai, set in a really beautiful café space. I stopped by around 4 pm on a Sunday, and the place was still packed—including the upstairs seating.

We ended up sitting outside, which turned out to be quite nice with the Sunday market setting up nearby—a great atmosphere if you don’t mind the buzz.

I ordered their dirty coffee, which was excellent and didn’t disappoint. I also picked up some coffee pods for my Nespresso, which I’m looking forward to trying at home.

A great stop if you’re exploring Chiang Mai’s coffee scene.
review_3_text:
I tried both their espresso & hot drip (hand-pour over filter coffee) both are execute nicely. And I tried all their beans. Asoom, aya, Ader (Geisha). The calibration is on point.

came here continuously for 3 days. Will definitely revisit if I’m at Chiang Mai again. Or should I say, I will revisit Chiang Mai because of Akha Ama.

If you truly appreciate coffee/specialty coffee. Here’s an excellent choice for you.

Bonus points if you’re looking to try local Chiang mai beans.
review_4_text: Good local Geisha - tried both hot and ice drip and taste different (hot: more fruity, ice is sweeter).  The banana muffin is also fluffy and yummy!  Oh and Not to mention, marvelous interior design.  Don't miss this if you are in town (and they close early at 1745 (Wed)
review_5_text: Loved this café! The coffee is genuinely great, and the whole aesthetic of the place is beautiful — very thoughtfully designed. Everything felt spotless and well taken care of, which made the experience even better. Definitely a place I’d come back to for both the vibe and the coffee.

name: Main Wall Climbing Gym
review_1_text: Dropped pin are kinda wonky but  no worries, just ask the people in neighbourhood they will happy to give you direction. Overall, its a very good climbing gym. 2 main floors. From top rope climbing, lead  & bouldering. I see alot of begineer climbers which is awesome to see the sport is growing well here. Plenty of inhouse guide/belayer & equipment to hire. Clean toilet and have shower room. Recommended.
review_2_text: Amazing climbing center, gear shops are well equipped and reasonable price. Kids loving it and their instructors are very good. We will be coming here for a long time. Has good parking space as well.
review_3_text:
Me and my partner have been climbing for 11 years now, and we always make a point of going to local gyms whenever we travel.

Main wall is clean, relatively cool and well staffed. It is perfect for a visit once maybe twice during a holiday visit to CM.

Setting wise (Bouldering only!), it's definitely angled at the more intermediate climber which is understandable. My partner climbs ~6b/v4 and I climb ~7b+/v8/v9, and there was a lack of harder climbs there for me.

From what I could see there were no bouldering problems set for the two higher v grade colour tags, with ~5 blue tags at v5-6 which was a shame.

We both still had a good 2 hours climb however, and enjoyed our time there. If you are an advanced boulderer, it's a perfect gym for a good stretch and to hold onto some plastic for a bit, but don't expect a hard project session.
review_4_text:
I have climbed at many gyms within Australia eg: Sydney, Brisbane  Perth and Adelaide and now I'm attending the "Mai Wall rock climbing and bouldering complex in Chiang Mai. I must say it's extremely well set out, with fantastic climb selections from beginners to hard-core climbers. There's a separate wam-up room with finger racks and a -45 degree bouldering warm up as well. Lockers for your valuables are available and they also sell a small range of climbing essentials on site.
If your a beginner or just haven't bought all your gear yet, you can hire the equipment as well.
Very happy to recommend this climbing gym to anyone. Cheers Van Moore
I rate this gym up there with the best I've experienced in Australia
Also it is kept very clean and tidy which is a credit to the management...thank you!
review_5_text:
This place is super fun climbing center of Chiangmai. If You want to enjoy both of lead & Bouldering on same time then You can pick this to the best. Even this place is super cool & trendy accommodation for indoor climbing.
Even if You have your kids or you don’t know how to climbing then Don’t worry about it
They have lots of skilled coachs for the guest.

name: Zohng Coffee
review_1_text: The avocado toast was fresh and creamy, perfectly paired with crispy bacon and a cup of latte. The Zhong breakfast was satisfying and well-balanced, with classic flavors done right. A comforting and filling meal to start the day.
review_2_text:
Really nice atmosphere
the new decoration makes the place feel more modern and comfortable.
There’s a good variety of food to choose from, especially the chicken breast steak and the beef burger, both were really good.
The coffee is great, and the service is friendly and attentive.
Overall a chill spot with good food and drinks. Would definitely come back.
review_3_text:
Decent coffee with a streetside funky atmosphere . good service.
Bombon is killer morning wakeup.
Lemon,ginger honey shot is a great standout!
Baked goods decent. Egg bagel breakfast sandwich was aroy 🤩
Handicap ♿️ possible but steps up to store could pose issues. SEE PHOTO
FINAL TAKE...Recommended
review_4_text: Very good meals, wide menu and tasty food! Had steak with egg for breakfast and the seasonal fruit mix, 10/10! The eggs benedict were missing the hollandeise sauce, but they had their own personal twist which was very good!
review_5_text:
Zohng Coffee is highly recommended!
A very nice and unique style in the inside and some nice outdoor seating area as well.
There is an upper floor, which is for the Hostel Guests the waiter told me.
Their Cappuccino was pretty solid and around 80 baht.
Their food seemed to be pretty good as well.

name: Baan Buri Café & Restaurant
review_1_text:
Absolutely Loved This Place!

We stopped by Baan Buri Café and were honestly surprised by how great everything was. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, the staff are super friendly, and the service is quick and attentive.

The food and drinks were fresh, tasty, and beautifully served. You can really feel the love and attention they put into every dish.

The café has a really positive vibe, perfect for relaxing, grabbing a light meal, or just enjoying a good coffee break.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area, this place definitely deserves more attention.

We’ll gladly come back again!
review_2_text: Ordered the Massaman chicken curry with rice and a mango shake. Both were good value for the price. The mango shake was refreshing, though the artificial flavour was a bit stronger than other mango shakes I’ve had in Thailand. The Massaman was tasty but only had one piece of chicken. Still decent considering the portion size and price. Presentation is excellent. 4 stars for atmosphere cause i think place needs a lil bit of revamping and better lighting. Service was great & lightning fast.
review_3_text: Baan Buri is both a café and a restaurant. The espresso 'Thai style', served with milk and sugar over ice in a large glass, is strong, slightly sweet, and ice-cold – a real find in Thailand! The muffin with soft chocolate chunks on chocolate sauce – here served with rosemary and two orange wedges – easily lives up to its name, "Chocolate Combo." The Thai service is good and friendly. The ambiance, with a touch of coffeehouse, exoticism, and Thai style – naturally, what else? – is somewhere between delicious, wonderful, and perfect. Sorry, couldn‘t resist to try before the shooting 😂
review_4_text: Loved the French toast—fluffy, lightly sweet, and not soggy at all. The American breakfast was hearty and filling, with well-cooked eggs, crispy bacon, and tasty sausages. A great choice if you’re craving a classic breakfast. The place has a calm ambiance perfect for a morning meal.
review_5_text:
Love it!! Prices are right, service excellent and food heavenly, we ask for extra spice and they provide. If we return to Chiang Mai definitely we coming back.
Ps we order the same twice but with variations like egg rolls or fried chicken as side dish.

name: Sunflower Smoothies and Coffee & Breakfast
review_1_text:
Everything was very clean and well maintained. The fruits were fresh and perfectly ripe with great sweetness which made everything taste even better. The shop itself is clean, bright, and nicely air conditioned. So it’s a comfortable place to sit and enjoy your food.

The portion is generous and reasonably sized for the price. I especially loved that they offer an açaí bowl.
review_2_text: Such a lovely breakfast spot! I ordered a smoothie bowl and it was incredibly tasty – fresh, flavorful and just the perfect start to the day. Everything looked beautiful and felt made with care. The vibe is relaxed and the team is super friendly. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m around!
review_3_text:
Sunflower Smoothies and Cafe hits on all cylinders.
Great, easy location with both indoor and outdoor seating.  Comfortable setting.
Service is fast , efficient and friendly.
Food is delicious and well prepared.
The Avo toast with mango salsa is a definite  standout 😁😁😁
Restrooms 🚻 available upstairs.
Handicap ♿️ doable and recommended
Final.take....Sunflower is a highly recommended find for a relaxing,  enjoyable breakfast.
review_4_text: Its the great place for breakfast i explored in chiang mai so far; I really loved the atmosphere and food in here as the presentation is top notch and food is delicious , staff is super friendly and prompt.
review_5_text:
Super friendly team, good coffee, excellent fresh food, clean & bright inside, with free Wi-Fi.
We could try different cafes for breakfast, however the 3 of us enjoyed Sunflower so much, we felt comfortable choosing to return each morning over our 4-day stay in the old town

name: HappyBlue Coffee - the neighborhood cafe
review_1_text:
Such a nice little café tucked away from the crowds it’s a perfect spot if you’re looking to escape the hustle and bustle for a bit. The location feels calm and minimalistic, with very chill background music that makes it easy to relax and enjoy your time.

The cappuccino with oat milk was the real highlight for me. Creamy, smooth, and absolutely delicious this was easily the kind of coffee I’d come back for again. The croissant was served warm and nicely flaky, exactly how it should be.

I also tried the coconut matcha, which was really well balanced, not too sweet and not too bitter, making it very enjoyable. The only downside for me was the signature lemon cake. It wasn’t as spongy as I expected and leaned a bit dry and too sweet for my taste. Not terrible, just not my favorite.

Overall, a great spot for a quality cappuccino with oat milk and a peaceful atmosphere. Definitely worth stopping by if you want good coffee in a calm, tucked-away setting.
review_2_text:
Cute, kind of hidden cafe with good cappuccino and delicious Matcha (especially the Matcha Coconut drink). Adding oat milk costs only +5 THB, and there are also other plant-based milk options. And there is an option to use premium matcha instead of regular for +30 THB

The croissant was delicious even though the baked goods are a bit overpriced

The atmosphere is quiet and calm, which is just what I wa looking for
review_3_text: Quaint cafe perched in a deceivingly quiet back street given how central it is. Tended to by warm and welcoming folks who speak great English. Serves up solid drinks, and the pastries look equally swell. Sees decent foot traffic on a weekend morning.
review_4_text: I stumbled upon the cutest little café — the perfect hideaway for a peaceful coffee break. It’s cozy and beautifully decorated, with soft music playing in the background that makes you feel instantly relaxed. The prices are super friendly, and the calm vibe makes it such a lovely spot to read a book or just unwind. Totally a hidden gem!
review_5_text: Delicious coffee! We got a latte and the Coconut Thai Tea Cloud, and both were great though the tea cloud was the star! The atmosphere is very calming and quiet, tucked down a side street near the main walking street. Id recommend it to everyone!

name: PIMM'S CUP : Roastory Lab
review_1_text:
We are always on the lookout for great coffee and authenticity. You definitely can find that here. I’ve had a lot of coffee in my life but this is the first time I’ve had farm to table.

Pim, the owner and farmer, happened to be in the shop and made two wonderful coffees for us. Despite her costs doubling over the last few years she’s kept her ristretto, espresso and doppio at 50 THB.

If you’re into coffee, you have to give the place a try. Btw, there is a great wine bar, Cru, across the street.

Pim recommended visiting the nearby night market as well as Wat Phra Singh to catch the sunset behind the gold stupa.
review_2_text: Honestly, best drip and americano we tasted in Thailand. Simple atmosphere where you understand - all is about coffee, no additional gake vibes. In Chiang Mai is a must place to try coffee. Thank you and best of luck!
review_3_text:
The staffs were very polite and welcoming. I had a really good coffee here, and bought a bag of beans back. They farm and roast their beans to be sold here. It is worth my money to support the local roasters.

I will definitely cone back again when in chiang mai. Thank you!
review_4_text: Wow wow wow. Get her speciality coffee iced. Best I've ever had and I've had coffee from all over the world! The owner is so lovely and makes this special amazing milk that you need to try! So unique and never tried a coffee like it before!! 5 star
review_5_text:
One of the few no-nonsense coffee spots in Chiang Mai with a clear focus on the coffee rather than fancy aesthetics—and it delivers.

Tried their dirty coffee, which was very well done and nicely balanced.

Definitely worth a stop if you’re serious about coffee and exploring Chiang Mai’s café scene

name: ทอฝัน Thor-Phan Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: A true specialty coffee spot in Chiang Mai. You can genuinely taste the quality of the coffee (smooth, balanced, and thoughtfully brewed) unlike many places where the flavor is overwhelmed by a burnt aftertaste. Really good coffee, done right ❤️
review_2_text: I can picky when it comes to my coffee, and this place is one of the best! The espresso pulls are really smooth and not bitter. The coffee shop is simple but nice and chilled with two AC units. Combined with a few games it has, it’s a wonderful place for a coffee break.
review_3_text:
I've ordered a caramel latte (specifically asked for just a little sweetness)
Saying that it was amazing is just an understatement. This is by far one of the best coffees I've ever had.
Vanilla latte was also good but just a little below the first one in my taste scale
The taste is rich and smooth, the foam is not too thick which is good IMHO.
The atmosphere is nice and relaxing, not too many people during lunch time.
review_4_text: Good filtered coffee, great quality espresso based coffee, all the tasting notes mentioned were spot on. It is just the chair , not that good for my back if its a long time sitting. But overall very awesome place to get your daily specialty coffee that is roasted by their own in the same place!
review_5_text: I came in for a morning coffee and was very impressed. The americano was very good and the coffee beans were very good and fresh. The place is nicely set up and decorated and the service was great. Prices are pretty reasonable. Although it’s a little small it was nice. They also serve some homemade baked goods which looked pretty tasty.

name: Coffee Lovers
review_1_text: At Coffee Lovers they have a great selection of coffee and breakfast. I wanted something simple with just eggs and avocado, but it was quite difficult to get a good overview of the menu as it is very complicated and detailed, with no pictures. I would suggest a much simpler menu to make it easier to decide. In the end I chose the avocado toast with scrambled eggs after seeing a picture on Google, and I also had a cappuccino. Everything tasted very good. The bread was just plain white toast and could have been more interesting, so I mainly ate the avocado and eggs. I did like that they served a bit of fruit on the side.
review_2_text: Lovely quaint cafe with mostly outdoor and some indoor seating. Ordered 2 eggs, sausage and toast with black coffee. No complaints. My friend ordered BLT and it was nothing special. Excellent service.
review_3_text: Quiet and peaceful restaurant with many american and asian food and drink choices.  Found this place randomly close to the hotel. Was great food and peaceful
review_4_text: My favorite beautiful little cozy place to get my morning started everyday I am here in Chaing Mai 🤍 I highly recommend the Thai tea latte banana pancakes. The staff is wonderful and you can sit and relax with the fans blowing on the front patio and people watch and enjoy all the good energy you need to start the day.
review_5_text: We stopped in just for a quick drink and were very happy with the decision. Cafe is very quaint. Decor is eclectic and the menu is great. We had iced drinks and they were great. Worth a visit.

name: .Werb Haus Coffee
review_1_text: Stumbled upon .Werb Haus in Chiang Mai’s Old City and instantly loved the earthy orange tones and retro art of ginger cats artwork on the coffee cups — it has a warm, laid-back vibe. The owner was super welcoming and helped me pick a drink. I ended up trying ES-Yen, a cold espresso I’d never had before — surprisingly smooth and very effective (kept me wired until 2 AM). Spent a good hour just chatting with him and soaking in the Songkran chaos on the street. Ended up staying for a beer and enjoying the moment. Great spot, even better people.
review_2_text:
Great coffee at a coffee shop away from the main road. Coffee prices are slightly cheaper compared to the other coffee shops. Quick service too, and the baristar is able to make the drink efficiently.

WiFi is available, but slightly unstable.

Many seats and plug points available.
review_3_text: The cappuccino here is very fragrant and delicious. Maybe it’s the best one I have tasted in Chiang Mai so far. However, the cake is a bit sweet. Great vibe with nice deco. Kpop playlists are often played in the store. It’s also my work playlist (⁎⁍̴̛ᴗ⁍̴̛⁎)
review_4_text: Nice two-floor cafe. Good price coffee, the place is quiet, has enough space and each table has their charger available, good for working on your laptop.
review_5_text:
Best café in the neighborhood 💪

Coffee is really good, with plenty of different options, and prices are more than reasonable.

Not many desserts options, that's maybe the only improvement I'd suggest!

name: IKA:ffeine
review_1_text: Japanese style coffee shop, tranquility surroundings, just few steps from the main road. Good coffee and toast.
review_2_text: A really good coffee place. Not many people, you can have a coffee and do some work. Definitely worth visiting.
review_3_text: This place is so nice and calm! Very good Matcha and also Coffee ♥️
review_4_text: Good vibe, Calm place, Hidden Gems
review_5_text: Quiet. Good coffee.

name: OldHouse Cafe
review_1_text: Mixed Berry Yogurt & Vanilla Milk Berry @ Old House Café. It’s a new cafe located on Jabaan road, behind Wat Chedilung Monastery. The place is spotless and beautiful. They have a very nice team of service staff to take care of customers and also have a sit down seat area if you wanna dine in. Splendid! 🌺🌸🌼
review_2_text:
New beautiful cafe in the old city of Chiang Mai, Thailand. They just opened so still getting there feet wet. Located in a nice quiet soi with great coffee in a quiet friendly atmosphere. I didn’t get food, but next time I will be sure to indulge in everything. The aesthetic of the place were wonderful, very impressive. Look forward to coming back again.
ขอบคุณครับ 😊🙏
review_3_text: Very elegantly decorated cafe!  It reminded me of walking onto the grounds of one of those huge southern American plantation estates, a huge facade and manicured lawns with an old well.  Prices are quite high though, a latte costs around 100 baht, they have to pay for the lavish interior and pleasant bathrooms somehow though.  There are power points in the corner of the room to charge your laptop if you decide to work there. #BeatTheGrind
review_4_text: The coffee was a little bit pricey, but I loooove the vibes here. They do have a lot of indoor plants & they play nice music the last time we went. Internet was reliable and it was not busy - hence, I could sit & work for hours without feeling guilty.
review_5_text: This is the best cafe place I have ever been. The cafe is really good and I love the atmosphere here. Super relax and fresh! A wonderful place if you wanna have a touch of paradise ~ highly recommend

name: Cafe'de Maross
review_1_text:
If I could put 6 stars, I would.

I have been eating my breakfast/lunch there every day for 1-2 weeks.
The food is delicious, the place is cozy and they play jazz music in the background.
The service is always on point and the two people (that I have seen) working there are always incredibly nice.
The price is also attractive for the quality that you receive.

Go there and see for yourself!
review_2_text: There was not a lot of people when i came. Nice athmosphere, really calm, nice is super friendly, i took the ceasar salad that I was dreaming about for two months and I was not disapointed !! Also took the lemon tea and it was good.
review_3_text: Definitely caters more for tourists at slightly higher price points, but it was clean, comfortable and had more Western options if you want some variety from the usual Thai fare (although they also offer Thai food).
review_4_text: Delicious breakfast, fruit is so sweet and fresh, if you are in old town, you need to try this one.
review_5_text: I came here to get something to eat for lunch. The service was great and the food was pretty good as well. The honey milk was really good. The place is clean and they have free wifi as well.

name: Minihome cafe
review_1_text: Delicious. Great prices. Try the toast. Too bad they are not open earlier!
review_2_text: Great juices.
review_3_text: Everything was great! The food was delicious, and the staff were very welcoming and kind. The owner even offered us snacks before we started.

name: Witch’s Cake
review_1_text: I had a strawberry smoothie. It was rich and delicious, and the portion was generous. They use high-quality syrup and ingredients. The owner is also very friendly.
review_2_text: The cafe is small but cozy, and the family that owns it is friendly. The coffee was delicious, and the air conditioning kept it cool.

name: Lady Cha
review_1_text:
Lady Coffee in Chiang Mai is a true gem and the perfect spot to escape the heat. The well-air-conditioned space offers a refreshing oasis on a sweltering day, making it an ideal place to relax and recharge. Their coconut smoothie is a must-try—refreshing and full of tropical flavor.

The Wi-Fi here is fast and reliable, perfect for getting work done or catching up on emails. Additionally, they provide the thoughtful amenity of phone charging, making it a convenient stop for travelers. The friendly and attentive staff further enhance the experience, ensuring you feel welcome and well taken care of.

One standout menu item is their Vietnamese egg coffee, a unique and delicious treat that’s hard to find elsewhere. Lady Coffee combines great amenities, a cool atmosphere, and tasty beverages to make it a top-notch spot in Chiang Mai. Highly recommend visiting!
review_2_text: Very delicious Vietnamese egg coffee and the black coconut coffee was very good too! Both made with lots of care and the lady who served us was lovely!
review_3_text: This place now is a cannabis store and has really good sativa stuff with 90% & 80% sativa for good prices it's a must try in Chiang mai. The staff is also very nice
review_4_text: The delicious kiwi smoothie is the best healthy drink I have ever had here. I really like this drink shop! And the sincere and friendly hospitality of the clerk.
review_5_text:
The best mango shake I've ever had and I've had a lot all over the country in my month here!!

It was so thick and fresh and so mangoey so you could tell lots of fresh mango had been used :) was also topped with mango pieces 😍

The woman who served me was so lovely as well!

name: Greather Coffee
review_1_text:
Modern, spacious coffee shop with a clean and inviting vibe—plenty of seating to chill for a while or just grab a quick drink before exploring the area.
I had the iced matcha: refreshing, well-made, and exactly what I needed on a warm day.
They also sell small pastries and bags of coffee beans.
Great spot if you're in the neighborhood and want a comfortable place for coffee. Recommended!
review_2_text: Lovely owner, great service! The waffle sandwich has the perfect mix of sweet and savory. Loved it!
review_3_text: Had a good coffee polite host. Simple clean ambience
review_4_text:
Great coffee selection.
Anaerobic Thai was very good.
Made perfectly to order.
review_5_text:
I went there for breakfast and lunch.
There seemed to be only 1 or 2 staff members working there, and the service was great. It was a great place to relax!
They have both a breakfast menu and a regular menu.
Drinks include coffee, mixed shakes, soft drinks, and more.
The food and drinks were pretty tasty, and I felt the prices were reasonable for a cafe.
This time, a meal including drinks cost around 130 baht.

name: The Sila Cafe
review_1_text: The Sila is a cafe inside the same name hotel that is located very close to the Wat Phra Singh, one of the key city temples. Very convenient location, right at the city center. It is the ideal place to drink tea/coffee or order some food. Cozy interior with a nice view.
review_2_text: Less crowded than the other cafes, good bagel sandwich and coffee. You can bring your laptop and work remotely from here. They have good wifi and charging. The owner is friendly and speaks English, and cashless payment is preferred.
review_3_text: Good coffee, not many people but I guess due to low amount of reviews, prices are a bit expensive compared to other places that do a full lunch for the price of a sandwich. the food is tasty and everything is served very fast, just the prices need to chill down a bit
review_4_text: Nice cafe to stop and work a while. It is attached to a hotel and tour guide office. The coffee shop is modern inside, not so much unique character but it is convenient.
review_5_text: coffee was so good, quite place for work

name: Chong Chaa
review_1_text: So good we came back multiple times! Great morning spot to people watch and have lovely food and coffee. Reasonable prices and welcoming staff here✨
review_2_text: Great cafe to visit on a morning for breakfast and coffee. Friendly staff that make you feel welcome. A must visit in Chiang Mai old town
review_3_text: Lovely cafe with amazing breakfast! Very affordable and a nice atmosphere.
review_4_text: Really good breakfast, we ate here daily during our stay in Chiang Mai. Food is traditional but also sandwiches with special "twist". Try!
review_5_text: The food is great, the service is incredible!!! love ittt

name: คอฟฟี่ เลิฟเวอร์
review_1_text: The shop is beautiful, the coffee and pastries are delicious, and it's a comfortable place to sit.

name: ร้านชาโทระ ChaToRa
review_1_text: This shop's tea is very fragrant and the pearls are chewy and delicious. I highly recommend it.
review_2_text: They were kind and the food was delicious.

name: อุ่นกาแฟสดOunArabicaCoffee
review_1_text: Very delicious cocoa iced 🥰🥰👌

name: Tar Sawang Coffee At Suandok
review_1_text:
Wonderful hotdog and coffee set.
The hot dogs are surprisingly quite delicious.
Americano is nice.
review_2_text: Clean, minimal interior. They let you choose the coffee blend, so you can go with your preference. It’s cool and cozy inside, and even someone like me who can’t handle bitter coffee was fine with it.
review_3_text: Their bread is delicious. The service is great
review_4_text: You can choose roasting of beans, light jazz in the background, cute seats outside - my goodness... the coffee was delicious!!!
review_5_text: Great little coffee shop with delicious coffee and some great pastries too. Service is excellent.

name: Shongcafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Really nice coffee shop just off the main street. Both the iced latte and iced americano orange were both so tasty, and so affordable. Service was excellent and with a smile too :)
review_2_text: Delicious coffee and cute little packaged cakes! Quick service! 10/10
review_3_text: Great experience..BEST COFFEE IN TOWN ☕️ ☕️ ☕️ ❤️ 💙 💜 💖 🇹🇭 THE BEST 👌 ✌️ 🇹🇭
review_4_text: Lovely hot 🔥 coffee cappuccino for 40 baht and lovely happy owner 10/10 from us! 🤤
review_5_text: Very cute little coffee shop with a few seats so you can relax. The drinks are very refreshing with plenty of ice and coffee or flavouring and only cost 40 baht. We tried both a soda and a latte. The lady who runs it is very friendly.

name: Esseppo Coffee พระสิงห์
review_1_text: This coffee shop offers a wide variety of menu options at affordable prices. They use high-quality ingredients, and every drink tastes delicious. The staff provides excellent service, always friendly and attentive. They also introduce new seasonal drinks, keeping the menu fresh and exciting. The smoothies are especially impressive—super smooth and perfectly blended. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Second visit in 2 days! The staff were so lovely and it great drinks. Felt like a local favourite. So many ppl ordering as take away.

Sacha, uk
review_3_text:
I got a Taiwanese milk tea , free boba pearls, you can adjust sugar.
It was delicious + staff adorable
Only 35baht for a large drink !
review_4_text:
Fantastic coffee latte ... strong and crowned with a perfect foam ... takeaway or served by absolutely lovely ladies! And all this for half price compared to the wannabe fancy places. Can the day start better? Well, go and find out for yourself
!
review_5_text: Cute little coffee shop, amazing coffee and great selection.

name: Woody Coffee กาแฟวู้ดดี้
review_1_text: The coffee was excellent, and I loved the aroma of the blend Woody made. If you enjoy nice coffee with friendly owners, you should definitely give this place a try. I've become a regular customer already. 😍😂
review_2_text: I love this cafe because they open so early in the morning (6.30 am.) that help me easily find the coffee to wake me up. If you would like to get calm and coffee please come. They serve coffee with resonable price. You could choose your taste by choosing the dark roasted or medium roasted coffee bean. You also can find some sandwich on weekend.
review_3_text: It is a very new place and the baristas are super nice. I got a cappuccino and it was very good!
review_4_text: What a wonderful artisan coffee shop! We stumbled upon this place when we were bleary-eyed after the night bus. The coffee is Chiang Mai beans and it smells and tastes wonderful. Artsy hipster vibe with good music and cool, friendly owners. Definitely worth a visit (or several!)
review_5_text: Very good coffee .Made to order

name: กาแฟ พระสิงห์
review_1_text: Coffee & Fruit Smoothie shop inside Temple. Beautiful shaded atmosphere with breeze. Music. Mango-Banana 🤙🏼divine mango mana in heaven. ✨
review_2_text: Honey coffee please.. hot or iced?.. Hot.. Ah iced it is.. yeah that was a good choice..
review_3_text:
Very nice quite large iced latte, good price, padded seats and a breeze.   We are pleased
Recommended
review_4_text: At 'Phrasingh Coffee' it's all about the location.  A small garden area with basic seats and tables and good coffee.  Ideal if you're exploring Wat Phra Singh in the hot sun.
review_5_text: Small coffee inside the temple. Great to rest for a while and great coffee too. Friendly service on top!

name: Durianism Cafe’ Phra Singh Chiang Mai ทุเรียนคาเฟ่พร้อมเสิร์ฟ 365 วัน
review_1_text:
This is a place for durian lovers. All sorts of durian inspired desserts, from sticky rice to drinks and ice cream.

They do serve meals too. But we didn't try. It has pasta and so on.

Shout out to the best durian ice cream I ever had so far.
review_2_text:
If you are a true durian lover, just eat it from the fruit markets. I paid for the most expensive 5 star durian and it wasn't ripe. I know what good durian is and didn't come back here.

Saying that the durian sticky rice was good using ripe durian.
review_3_text:
Our first stop after arriving and we all got the flavoured milks. Very tasty.
Food wise, 3 of us got the same thing, crispy back chicken with rice. Very tasty, but far too much garlic on it. Literally see the garlic. Vampires don't stand a chance tonight.
Great location and good for people watching.
If you use a debit or credit card, you'll pay 3% more no big deal, but cash is easier.
review_4_text:
Food is nice. They have shop which is nice. Got buy something nice for present.
Nearest to the temple, is nice area you seat outside eating while watching the people walking.
review_5_text: Being Asian, I always love durian. And to have a cafe with varieties are awesome. Staffs are friendly, actually most Thais are super very friendly. This is my 3rd time to the cafe & sadly last night here. Highly recommended. Will definitely come back if I'm visiting Chiang Mai❤️❤️❤️❤️

name: ชาพะยอมวัดพระสิงห์
review_1_text: Good friendly place good food and clean
review_2_text: It's quite tasty and the price isn't bad at all.
review_3_text: Really strong
review_4_text: You must try it. The quality is excellent.
review_5_text: Very good.

name: Tomorrow Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: Very cute spot! My daughter and I were looking for a place to have some Phat Thai noodles and curry and this is the spot we stumbled on. The ambience was very nice. It was very clean, very modern. The smoothies were really quite delicious. We ordered a pineapple and mango smoothie. We also ordered the green curry and the Penang curry, which were done very well. I would go back just for the curry and the smoothies! Unfortunately, the pot Thai noodles were very wet and soggy, and I really would not recommend eating them there. They have other items that they are stronger at. They have a very diverse drink menu and food menu so there’s lots to choose from and the prices are fantastic. I only gave it four stars because of the Phat Thai noodles not being that good.
review_2_text:
We were looking for a nice place to have a smoothie and this was the best decision! They have a loooooot of different options in their menu. Fruit and cookies or coffee too. We finished ordering a kiwi slushy and mango smoothie and they were just perfect. Great flavor, sugared correctly and with a pretty good texture 😋
We will come back to try more of their flavors.
The vibe of the place is so quiet with very nice music and they have AC and toilet, which is also something that adds value.
They sell food options and more, but we didn't try them.
The girls were very friendly and they understand English. Thanks so much for the great experience 🙌🏽
review_3_text: Lovely clean and central place for food and coffee. I ordered a soy cappuccino and it was nothing to write home about. I was looking for a really good coffee place, walked around for quite awhile, saw some people out front, so thought this would be a good place to try. However, the coffee was lacklustre.
review_4_text: We came to Tomorrow because we were walking around looking for a place to eat. My boyfriend ordered the carbonara pasta and I had the Pad Thai. Honestly, everything was delicious. The service was good too, and the food came quickly. We also ordered some Spring Rolls, and they were really tasty. In terms of price and quality, it was definitely worth it. So yes, I’d recommend stopping by this place.
review_5_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5 stars rating)

I recently visited Tomorrow Cafe & Bistro, and we enjoyed it overall! It has a cozy and inviting atmosphere set the tone for a pleasant coffee break. ☕️🪴 The decor was charming and modern, making it an ideal spot for relaxation or catching up with friends.

We ordered the coconut espressos, which turned out to be a refreshing and delicious surprise! 🥥☕️ It's not something you find everywhere, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to try something new. The coffee was perfectly brewed, with the coconut adding a subtle sweetness that complemented the espresso nicely.

As for the desserts, we indulged in both the cheesecake and carrot cake. 🍰🥕 Both were incredibly soft and flavorful, with textures that melted in our mouths. The cheesecake had a creamy, rich consistency, while the carrot cake was perfectly spiced, making each bite a delight.

While the overall experience was wonderful, the only downside was that the service was a bit slow. 🐢⏳ Despite this, the staff were friendly and attentive, ensuring that we felt welcome and comfortable throughout our visit.

In conclusion, Tomorrow Cafe & Bistro offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with unique and tasty offerings. With a bit of improvement in service speed, it could easily become a top-notch cafe experience. Highly recommended for anyone in the area looking to enjoy a relaxing coffee break with delicious treats! 🎉🍵🍰

name: HONEYBOON Café & Art Gallery
review_1_text: Love the place, great vibes, chill music, and highly recommend the sodas after a very hot day out doing temple hopping. Shoutout to the shop owner too really kind and attentive, gave my partner a  lemon shot thing for his scratchy throat ✨️
review_2_text:
Many coffee menu to choose from at affordable price.

Coffee was kind of okay, with lingering bitter aftertaste.

The shop is just opposite to the Phra Sing Temple. They also sell popsicles.

Free wifi. However, the shop host just a few pieces of arts, so do not have high expectation on the 'gallery' part.
review_3_text: Hazelnut HB recommended, even though it’s great to have ICE latte during the hot noon.
review_4_text: The iced latte here was great, and Boon the owner was very friendly and attentive, giving me recommendations for places to eat and check out while in Chiang Mai. I will definitely be coming again!
review_5_text: Cheap & very good coffee! Definitely worth the try

name: Republic Coffee
review_1_text: Had coffee here. Combined with the gentle breeze that blows in the area almost all the time, it was a great experience. Coffee was good, locally crafter cappuccino.
review_2_text: Cool van, awesome drinks and nice atmosphere. If you're walking around the old town area, definitely stop by here and check it out. They serve many drinks (hot/cold). Tried the macha green tea and it was good. The van is located inside the temple grounds here. On Sundays I have seen it on the streets.
review_3_text: Great place to refresh and have a break. Right inside the temple grounds and next to massage places. Very nice atmosphere and the guy here is very friendly.
review_4_text: Can’t even describe how much I loved it! Truly amazing coffee!
review_5_text: The perfect place to sit back and enjoy a great coffee. They have a great selection of Coffee and Tea to enjoy the peaceful spot in which the groovy coffee van is located. With their very reasonable prices, it's hard to just have one!

name: Easy Easy Coffee
review_1_text: Small friendly place.  Coffee is pretty cheap at 40 Baht for an iced latte.  Remember to say not sweet please if you prefer no sugar.  There are fans inside to help keep cool.  You can drink your coffee here or take it aay.  They don't seem to have wifi.
review_2_text: Lovely tiny place tucked only minutes from the bustling road. Owner is the sweetest!
review_3_text: Great place. One of those treasures you will cl your own! Small food offering due to lack of tourists. Toast, coffee, tea
review_4_text: Great little find ..old school Thai vibe with a good inexpensive coffee...fantastic place to chill
review_5_text: Lovely place. Great coffee. Inexpensive.

name: Fresh Coffee
review_1_text: I really wanted coffee, so I took it out. It's cheaper than Starbucks, but not that cheap. I had coffee because I was in a hurry. Ahhh - 65 baht. It's delicious! There's also a breakfast menu, but it's cheaper because it includes coffee. Recommended if you're traveling for a long time.

name: City Coffee shop
review_1_text:
The worst place I have been in.
Sausage was cold, coffee terrible.
No atmosphere at all...
Not recommend it at all.

name: กาแฟสด นั่งบาร์
CHEDI little stand
review_1_text: Awesome little coffee stand tucked away on a nice sunny street in Chiang Mai. I enjoyed the Chedi special, iced coffee with homemade cream - was delicious! Owner is really friendly, and there’s a few nice spots to sit outside. Highly recommend! ☕️
review_2_text: Stopped by this random coffee stand because they had a very interesting storefront display. So impressed that this tiny stand produces such a wonderful coffee. Will definitely be back for more.
review_3_text: Came for the Cinemarise film handbills,  but stayed and returned for the coffee and the serene vibe.  If I could take this little stand and put it in my pocket I would.  It’s the little space that could. Everything about it is well thought-off and created a very comforting vibe, to think they don’t actually have that much space and part of enjoying the coffee,  was a enjoying the world moving outside,  with the Wat Chedi Luang in view,  framed by an apartment complex.  The two days I went there, was so hot, I had to opt for cold coffee —The Chedi, no sugar, simply perfect. Thank you for comforting me on my visit. Didn’t really have much interaction with anyone but just being there with my sad soul,  and good coffee, listening to the birds outside, felt like a hug already.
