review_4_text: Stumbled upon this place and was happy to have found it. Great coffee, a few chairs outside to sit and relax on the quiet street and very friendly service.
review_5_text: Tried their signature Chedi Coffee : 10/10 ! Loved the vibe of this place, thank you !

name: นวลจันทร์ Nuanchan Cafe&Drink : Coffee : Drink : Toast
กาแฟบ้านน้ำปั่น
review_1_text: Affordable and refreshing drinks are available here. A nice little shop set up at home. I ordered Thai tea and it is good.
review_2_text: I love the small home owned drink establishments. Peaceful, not owned by big business, money goes to familu. Coffee was great, hot and strong. Good flavour. 35 baht. Smoothies looked great, fruit very fresh
review_3_text: Peaceful place to enjoy a delicious and inexpensive drink in the shade.
review_4_text:
Absolutely adorable tiny cafe. In front of someone's home. Only few tables. Super friendly people and cheap drinks.
Quiet peaceful and lovely!
review_5_text: Great smoothies and very sweet owner. Family run, it’s their home, small seating area.best tasting coconut water.

name: TWENTY MAR
review_1_text: The atmosphere is good, and the boss and the staff are very friendly. Of course, it tastes great. Personally, the coffee tastes the best in Chiang Mai. I said I would visit every day before returning to Korea, but unfortunately, today is a temporary closure...
review_2_text:
Amazing coffee, they really know how to make great drinks. A must visit if you are looking for unique drinks and an awesome overall experience. Had to buy some coffee beans as well because the coffee was great.

The service is also top-notch. Not a lot of seats and no kids allowed. So just a nice coffee drinking experience for coffee lovers. Absolute mist visit!
review_3_text:
This is place is a mood, like a coffee speakeasy.  They have a smooth jazz vibe with the music, and everything is about the coffee.

They have a couple variations of the classic Thai coffee drink “the dirty”.  We tried the “sense of dirty” and the “super dirty”. Both were unique improvements on the original. They really elevate everything.  High craft coffee.
review_4_text:
Good spot to enjoy your specialty coffee from Colombia. With a twist of Japanese look and feel. Kind of not for ‘kanji’ and ´kids’… but for sure ´adult only’

Highly recommended for the mood and vibes !!
review_5_text: Small shop but very cosy place. If you like to listen to soft music and sit with a cup of nice coffee, this is the place. Bring your love one and I believe she/he will enjoy... We ordered Perfect Orange & Super Dirty. Both are 😘

name: The Old City Spa - Ice Bath, Finnish Sauna, Himalayan Salt Far-Infrared Sauna, Magnesium Hot Bath, Thai Herbal Steam Room
review_1_text:
An exceptional experience. The sauna is beautifully maintained, offering steady, relaxing heat, while the cold plunge provides an invigorating contrast that leaves you refreshed and energized.
The atmosphere is calm and refined, with meticulous attention to cleanliness and temperature control. I left feeling genuinely restored, both physically and mentally. A remarkable wellness spot that I look forward to visiting again.
review_2_text:
Enjoyed this far more than I thought I would.

Really lovely spa with two cold plunges, steam room, sauna, infrared room, and showers. They also provided drinking water, jasmine tea, chamomile tea, and mini pineapple tarts which were yummy!

450 baht per entry.
review_3_text: Had a fantastic guided breathwork session with Jason, followed by a cold plunge and a sauna. The facility is beautiful and the whole experience was incredible from start to finish. Thank you to Jason and the staff at Old City Spa for the great experience — and the food was super tasty too! Highly recommend.
review_4_text: Amazing experience so worth it! 2 hours of contrast therapy. I absolutely loved the infra red sauna. Complimentary tea provided. Super friendly staff, they provide a locker for your belongings. Great atmosphere and location.
review_5_text:
Highly recommended!

Such a relaxing and intimistic bubble !
The best place to take care of yourself in Chiang Mai.
All the equipments you need for your journey. It's clean, quiet, and they provide everything you need for a great experience.
The room was clean and very comfortable.
I had a really good time.
Thank you kaaap 🙏

name: Blue Coffee At Old Town
review_1_text:
As good as the Blue Coffee near Nimman.
Very nice and cozy seating, inside as outside.
Their hot cappuccino is 80 baht, which is my opinion a fair price overall.
Definitely a nice little cafe and the staff is very kind and friendly.
review_2_text:
Absolutely loved Blue Coffee in Chiang Mai!
A cosy spot with really warm vibes, perfect for a quick caffeine fix or a slow morning. The coffee is smooth, fragrant, and well-balanced — you can really taste the quality. Staff were friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience even better.

The café is clean, comfortable, and a nice escape from the busy streets. Prices are reasonable too. Definitely a place I’d return to whenever I’m in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended! ☕💙
review_3_text:
I’ve had Blue Coffee in Maya Mall, and thus knew this would be a good time. I really enjoy the Blue Coffee, iced, that I got with no sweetness.

Wi-Fi is nice, seating is decent, and quiet enough to rest / talk. Would definitely recommend this spot - and full disclaimer got a 10 baht discount for writing this review.
review_4_text:
If you’re looking for a café that perfectly blends calm vibes with minimalist charm, Blue Coffee at Old Town is an absolute must-visit. Located right in the heart of Chiang Mai’s historic old town, this spot stands out with its clean, simple aesthetic and bright, airy atmosphere. Large glass panels open up the space beautifully, making it feel spacious and refreshing whether you’re sitting inside the cool air-conditioned room or choosing a cozy seat by the street.

Their drink selection is solid — from smooth, well-balanced coffee to refreshing signature beverages — and everything is crafted with noticeable care. The bakery corner is another highlight; fresh pastries with just the right sweetness, perfect for pairing with your drink and slowing down for a quiet moment.

Whether you’re dropping by for a mid-day coffee break, looking for a comfy place to work, or just exploring the old town, Blue Coffee delivers both great taste and great vibes. It’s the kind of café that makes you want to linger a little longer.
review_5_text: Cozy cafe with outside seating area. Great coffee selection! Almost no waiting for my order to arrive. Cafe is shared space with the treasury museum of Chiang Mai.

name: Nap’s Coffee Roaster CNX
review_1_text: Great place for coffee nerds to buy coffee beans! They offer a wide range of origins, from local Thai to Ethiopian, Honduras, Brazil, etc. they have these little tubes with ground coffee and perfume pump heads so you can smell the ground beans and choose the one you like. I got a light roast Ethiopian blend and came back for more the next time.
review_2_text: This is an excellent cafe with great tasting coffee with very affordable prices, especially given how modern and clean the aesthetics here are. You can pick the beans you would like, I went with dark smoky but will go for the medium chocolate one next time. They even serve in glass containers making it very easy to recommend.
review_3_text: Great coffee and pastry destination!  Went with the dark roast Cappuccino, very good.  The star of the show however was the Toast Brown Butter, yummy!!
review_4_text: 10/10 coffee is delicious. Can choose blend, milks, croissant and food for lunch. Nice large seating area. They clearly take pride in their coffee. Can also buy beans here.
review_5_text: The best coffee and service I seen in Chiang Mai. Very much recommend. Just one thing is their water feels containing chloride but maybe that’s just me. But the cappuccino is soo good with the tasty and thick cream that I still come here just drink water from 7/11

name: Herb Basics
review_1_text: If you love Herbal products, this shop  is a “must go” place. Quality is great and price is reasonable. You can buy cosmetics and essential oil, balm made from herbal. There are also coffee and cakes inside. You can sit and relax inside. Every time I’m in Chiang Mai, I always go shopping in this place. 🤩
review_2_text:
A popular shop to buy inexpensive herbal products made locally in Chiangmai.
A large majority of the products are aromatherapy related and personal toiletries, emphasising natural and free of harmful chemicals.
There’s a refreshment counter serving barista coffee and snacks too.
Worth to check it out if you’re around the area.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is cozy, and the scent is relaxing. Desserts are good portions, and the salted caramel brownie is amazing.
review_4_text: It's my second time in the shop. Last September, I bought some essential oils and cosmetics and had Thai milk tea to spend whole afternoon. Now, I take vacation with family and take them here. Soft drinks are good, staffs are kind, products are fantastic. I enjoy everything here!
review_5_text:
Very elegant coffee and perfume shop.  Coffee good.  Cosmetics good quality and well priced, at least the body lotion I bought is.
Certainly would come here again. 😊😊😊

name: Lazy Lemon, Old City
review_1_text: Massive breakfast servings for lower cost, really delicious breakfast to help start your day off right. Recommend the Happy Bowl and Pancakes with Mixed Fruits. Coffee was really worthwhile, coming from an Australian. Would love to come back and visit here again soon.
review_2_text:
I usually don’t distrust reviews, but in the case of Lazy Lemonn, it’s impossible not to wonder how this place has achieved such a high rating. The only plausible explanation is that the reviews are seriously inflated, because the real experience falls far short of what is promised.

There were two of us, and we arrived at 8:29 a.m. As soon as we walked in, a girl told us they weren’t open yet, in a rather dry manner. I asked if we could simply sit and wait, since there was less than a minute to go and there were already other customers sitting outside. She reluctantly agreed.
What’s striking is that while we were waiting, the staff were calmly preparing things behind the counter, yet the menu wasn’t brought to us until 8:45 am, fifteen minutes after their supposed opening time. A first sign of disorganization… or indifference.

The latte was disappointing: it tasted almost entirely like milk, with no balance or character. The iced Thai tea was fine, nothing more.
The ham and cheese bagel was a complete disaster: chewy, clearly defrosted, with visible cracks on the surface. A low quality product whose appearance already warned you that the taste and quality would not justify the price.
The pancakes with tropical fruit were good, but by no means exceptional or memorable, something you can easily find in dozens of cafés around Chiang Mai without paying an “Instagram premium.”

If the food was underwhelming, the service finished sinking the experience. With the exception of one male staff member who was genuinely kind and service oriented, the rest of the staff, especially a girl wearing a hat and a black-and-white sweater, had a rude, unfriendly, almost confrontational attitude, as if serving you were a favor rather than their job.
From the moment we arrived, the feeling was clear: we were not welcome.

No one asks how the food was, not even when they see plates left half untouched. There is zero interest in customer feedback or improvement. The unspoken message is simple: pay and leave. Preferably as quickly as possible.

To make matters worse, they only accept cash, something that is not mentioned on any sign nor communicated when you arrive. In 2026, for a modern and far from cheap café, not accepting cards is simply unacceptable.

First and last time.
Don’t waste your time or money on this place with inflated reviews. Chiang Mai is full of cafés that are infinitely better, with honest products and, above all, warm and respectful service. Lazy Lemonn offers neither.

I regret writing such a negative review, as I don’t enjoy doing so, but the experience was so uncomfortable and disappointing that if it helps other customers make a better decision before coming here for breakfast, it’s worth being clear:
walk past it, it’s absolutely not worth it.
review_3_text: Amazing breakfast spot in the middle of city center. Service is a bit slow depending on the rush, but the wait is worth it. The weather in mid-November was bliss-if you’re lucky you’ll get one of the 5 patio tables. Reasonable price for excellent quality western-style breakfast. Everything we tried from the food to the coffee was on point.
review_4_text:
Encore Lazy Lemon!
So disappointed Avocado on Toast SOLD out. No Avocado.

However, scrambled eggs with cheese on toast EXCELLENT! Must Order!

Strawberry and banana smoothie also 👍🏼 GREAT!

Must come again 🥳🥳🥳
review_5_text: The venue was impeccably clean and well maintained. The staff, though occasionally a little absent‑minded, were consistently kind and attentive. We ordered two savoury dishes and one sweet, not realising that the portions were generous enough to be filling on their own; in the end, the third was more than we needed. Nevertheless, every dish we tried was delicious and thoughtfully prepared.

name: Coffee Cop
review_1_text:
This is a small cafe that is connected to a massage shop next door. The drinks are cheap. My thai milk tea costs only 40 baht.

The owner is friendly. I think she runs the massage shop next door too as I saw her welcoming customers there.

There is WiFi there but I did not use it. You can find a place to relax or read a book. Not sure if it is suitable for online work as I did not see any power points. The cafe has an open concept and is not air-conditioned.
review_2_text:
Perfect little coffee shop the cold mocca was perfect and tasty.. small terrace facing the road!
The lady was very friendly
Free wifi and confortable chairs
Go there!!!
review_3_text: It is a small coffee shop right next to Thai Massage Conservation Club which sharing the similar address. They only served coffee and tea. Liked the green tea latte!
review_4_text:
The milk they used was bad....

While I love the concept of the next door blind massage, save yourself the trouble and the money and don't get coffee here. When I first tasted the coffee, it tasted a bit funny. I thought the milk in it may have been bad - but silly me I drank anyway. At this moment, I feel completely sick.
review_5_text:
My favorite coffee shop in Old Chiang Mai. We visited at least once daily
Service was friendly and attentive

name: Mesa Coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee with a friendly greeting every morning when staying nearby. Remembered my order and made great quality coffee every time!
review_2_text: They're friendly and the coffee is delicious. I came here in a hurry because everything else around here was closed, but it was great.
review_3_text: Very friendly and accommodating. The Thai tea is exquisite.
review_4_text: Very nice owner, drinks taste very good :) btw has just opened
review_5_text: Great family business, nice atmosphere, and good, refreshing drinks! We'll be back 👍🏻

name: Ratchadumnern Coffee and Food
review_1_text:
Stopped off for a nice coffee and a delicious banana cake 😋.
Comfortable seating inside with air conditioning. The toilets were clean and tidy.
Service was a little slow but it was during a very quiet period.
review_2_text:
I've eaten lunch here every other day for about four weeks. I've tried almost everything on the menu, and I haven't been disappointed once.
There are two fish dishes in the Thai food section of the menu that particularly stood out for me.
Generous servings. Excellent service. The server remembered everything I had tried over the weeks, and helped me a few times to navigate the menu.
They also have a few excellent pork dishes, including an appetizer with the perfect garlic ingredients.
Highly recommend this restaurant.
review_3_text: Very cute Coffee Shop. The choices were great, drinks menu is extensive.  The food was tasty and staff were happy to make an allergy adjustment. A great experience
review_4_text: Small cafe that has indoor AC and outdoor seating. The atmosphere is cozy and cute! Drinks were so good, we had the coffee, green tea frappe and hot thai tea. The breakfast food was also pretty good, but I think the cakes, pastries and drinks are the best here.
review_5_text:
I’ve been a customer of this cafe for 10 years. Best food in town, especially Tom yum. There’s Thai and European food. Also great beverages (matcha and Thai milk tee are my favorite), yummy desserts. Atmosphere is quiet and friendly but not overly. Prices are fair for the amount and quality.
Thank you for the great service and delicious food 🙏🏻💓

name: Doisuthep Coffee
review_1_text: Enjoy coffee at a temple with stunning forest views. The coffee is delicious and the prices are reasonable.

name: The Coffee Bull School
review_1_text: AungKarn is a very kind, nice and generous owner of this lovely cafe. He is a true coffee master who knows from planting coffee tree, roasting beans to dripping. He is also a film teacher in a university. What is the most precious thing is that he is openminded and willing to share his coffee knowledge with different people. We enjoyed a unforgettable afternoon with AungKarn in this ancient house. I will recommend to anyone who loves coffee!
review_2_text:
Intrigued by the bric-a-brac inside, I walked in the coffee bull school and interrupted Aungkarn while he was teaching a student. That did not fuss him; to the contrary - he included me in his lesson. I ended up spending all afternoon there, chatting with him and his student about coffee, history, love, religion and all things in between.
I am so grateful for the time we spent together, it’s for these moments of connection between strange humans that I travel!
review_3_text:
Organic, home grown coffee beans. The owner is very nice and loves what he does. I’m surprised this place doesn’t have more reviews or customers.
Also - the iced coffee is huge!
review_4_text: Angkarn, the owner, is one of the sweetest, most genuine and passionate people we've ever met. He gave us amazing recommendations for local food, and really spent time with us!! And his carefully chosen, hand-roasted coffee is OUT OF THIS WORLD. I'd recommend this place to EVERYONE!
review_5_text: Best place for coffee beans. Price is too reasonable for the quality. Talk to Ajarn Angkarn ( Mr. Tuesday ) the owner and you will go back with more thsn just coffee but sincerity and good thoughts.

name: Kumo cha
review_1_text: The bubble tea wasnt it, tasted like water
review_2_text: The iced Americano was delicious. The smoothie was so-so. The cream cheese bagel was very tasty. There weren't many people, so it was quiet and comfortable.
review_3_text: Lovely to sit inside, lots to order.

name: the butterfly effect - organic cafe
review_1_text:
The avocado chocolate cake seems to be sent from heaven - honestly the best cake I've ever tried. Just the right amount of sweetness and the avocado works wonderfully with the chocolate. Place has a fancy design with wooden elements. However, I sensed somehow a weird vibe inside the coffee, nobody talks and stares at their phones. If you talk the whole room listens which is why we decided to eat outside.

The cake is a full recommendation while the ambience might not be for everyone.
review_2_text: My favourite breakfast and lunch spot in Chiang Mai. Unbeatable chilled atmosphere, super friendly staff and don’t miss out on the Iced Oat Latte, flavoured Hemp Milks, Chia Pudding and Kimchi Sourdough Sandwich.
review_3_text:
This was a lovely cafe with great drink and food options. This was the first time I’ve had a matcha cortado and I loved the more matcha-forward tasted compared to a more milk heavy latte. The sourdough toasts and smoothie bowl were all fantastic as well. Everything is vegan, so no dairy and plenty of alternative milk options.

The space has tons of windows and feels so bright with the variety of plants and wood furniture. A great place to spend a little time!
review_4_text: The smoothie bowl is good. But the coffee is disappointing given the price is much higher than other places. Plus the cup is really hard to hold while the coffee is hot. They are trying hard to create the “vibe” but I would say it’s not worth the hype. You can get better options in town.
review_5_text: I ordered the kimchi, pumpkin and cashew toast and WOW. It was outstanding. It’s been over a week since i’ve had and I still dream about it. Also the mango matcha 🤤 I would come back to Chiang Mai just to eat here. And the staff were very lovely. definitely recommend this place.

name: 97% Nothing But Cocoa
review_1_text: Delicious of course. Other than the name, it's not clear what is 97%. The most bitter special drink is chocolate ice cubes with cold chocolate poured over them, but both are certainly sweeter than straight up 97%. Great offerings in a great environment. Highly recommend!
review_2_text:
A charming cocoa shop tucked away from the hustle and bustle, only open on weekends. I ordered the 97% craft cocoa for 100 THB, which was different from what I imagined—it had a slushy texture. Personally, I would have preferred it to be a bit richer, but the lime jelly at the bottom added a refreshing touch. The shop has limited seating indoors, but there are two long stone benches outside where you can also sit. I made some new friends here and had a wonderful time. Highly recommended for cocoa lovers living nearby!

Jan 4, 2025
review_3_text: Located in a backyard alley, still worth an effort to come and enjoy their creations. Their 97% specialty cocoa drink is indeed very good and should be ordered first. Prices are very reasonable taken into account quality and taste. Shame they are only open on weekends.
review_4_text: Craft chocolate bar with 4 menu only for choco. With a comfortable price and good looking cafe. They only have 2 small tables and 5 sits. I love 72% really delicious. *Pls note they only open 11-18:00 sat-sun*
review_5_text:
Those of you who are Sweet teeth will love it if you come here. I feel like my stomach is healing because of the spicy taste It's not just sweetness, it's luxury sweetness.
If you order today, you'll get a lottery ticket I got a small cactus, the prize for the last place. I made a living friend while I was here.

name: At All Café
review_1_text: Highly recommend! Cozy environment! Warmly reception n fresh smoothies! High quality coffee! Must come if u r in Chiangmai!
review_2_text: I tried Iced coffee and watermelon juice, both of them are so good ❤️owners are kind and also there’s cute dog who’s always smiling - I visited to this cafe to see this cutie 🫶 (first two photos & the last photo were taken by film camera)
review_3_text:
At All Café is an absolutely charming coffee shop that offers not just great coffee but an unforgettable experience. The highlight of this delightful spot is the adorable dog, who is both a well-dressed little companion and a beacon of joy for every guest.

As seen in the photo, this sweet pup, donning an irresistibly cute striped outfit, sits at the table with you, providing unparalleled company. While the dog refrains from drinking coffee—wisely avoiding any potential snout-burning mishaps—their presence makes the coffee-sipping experience so much better.

The café itself is warm and welcoming, with a cozy ambiance that pairs perfectly with their delicious drinks. Whether you're a dog lover or simply looking for a unique coffee spot to brighten your day, At All Café is a must-visit. Just don't be surprised if you end up staying longer than planned, captivated by the charm of this furry little host!
review_4_text: Delicious Apple 🍏 smoothies. Couple owners also owned the massage next door. I did 60 min full body and felt like waking on clouds afterwards 😀👍. I rented a motorbike with them for four days 200 baht a day with only 1000baht deposit. Cheapest around this area and the Honda scooter ran perfectly. Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
Was here for scooter rental!
Great people and very honest.
Scooter was not the newest but did a great job and for a great price.
Highly recommend

name: Happy Monday coffee
review_1_text: We’ve only been in Chiang Mai for a couple of days and we’ve been to Happy Monday Coffee twice. Both times we had a mango and a passion fruit smoothie. It was so freaking good. They make it without sugar for you. It’s very smooth blended frozen fruit that you can even scoop out of your cup at first. Super tasteful and delicious! And they even have a cute little garden behind the house which is very calm and relaxed 🙏🏼
review_2_text: Small spot in central location. I had a mango smoothie and a carrot muffin. Mango smoothie was creamy and mango flavor of moderate intensity. I really liked the texture. The carrot muffin seemed handmade and of great quality for 70baht, it was served warm when seated. There is also a small backyard.
review_3_text:
A small open-air coffee shop in the middle of a tourist street.
They serve nice coffee (if lucky you might find imported beans) along with other small snacks such as sandwiches and croissants. The price is quite reasonable.

A nice place to stop, take a break from the busy life, read a chapter from a book, or just have a good chat with a friend.
review_4_text:
Happy Monday Cafe is a cafe that exudes a charming, laid-back vibe that immediately sets you at ease.

The drink we tried was the Coconut Coffee and their signature Happy Monday. They masterfully merges the comforting warmth of well-brewed coffee with the tropical twist of coconut. The coconut flavour was far from overwhelming and instead complemented the rich, robust taste of the coffee.

This café is definitely a gem in Chiang Mai that shouldn’t be missed.
review_5_text:
Good family owned coffee shop, they also had small selection of pastry.
Limited seating, but nice environment
Coffee and tea were good.
Good for a quick break from the heat. AC.

name: Khum Cafe
review_1_text:
This place got some great vibes!
You can have either a seat in the very cozy little cafe, where you have AC.
Or you can sit in their wonderful little garden which is absolutely worth it!
You can grab some coffee and have a great time in their garden, definitely recommended!
review_2_text: This place is an oasis in the center of the old city. I've been searching for quiet green spaces and this is the best spot. It's located within the architectural center and has cute souvenirs inside the cafe. The Thai style coffee and banana muffin were delicious.
review_3_text:
This is a very cozy garden cafe, a hidden spot in the Old Town. I had peach tea with honey and lemon which was really nice and refreshing. Nok also offered me a muffin, which was very sweet of her.

It’s quiet and away from the buzz. Highly recommended for reading or working!
review_4_text:
coconut pie and latte were delicious. Coconut pie was not too sweet, creamy and filling.
There seemed to be an art event going on, there were many people with easel and paint. People seemed happy and at ease, which is lovely.
review_5_text: Really cute place tucked away from the road in a garden in front of the architecture centre, but right in the heart of the old city! Super nice staff! And nice attention to details!

name: H Cafe - เอช คาเฟ่
review_1_text: Best way to celebrate my birthday after walking in Chiangmai in a wild heat, Smoothies were so delicious and the cheesecake was unreal. Yum yum vibes with good music
review_2_text: There are lots of herbs oils creams soaps made of Thai herbs and flowers. Prices are quite reasonable. Drinks and blubbery cheesecake were amazing
review_3_text: Great little cafe and souvenir store. Refreshing drinks and a great escape from the heat!
review_4_text: The Cafe smells very good because of the aroma shop that’s in here too, the coffee tastes great and the cinnamon roll was super delicious, would highly recommend!
review_5_text: Great atmosphere, very well decorated and my coffee was excellent 🤩💫

name: Eleven Pillar Site Chiangmai
review_1_text: Such a lovely place to stay in Chiang Mai. The hospitality was warm and welcoming, with spacious and spotlessly clean rooms. Complimentary snacks and drinks were thoughtfully provided in the room, along with a cup of free coffee served every morning. The hotel is tucked away on a quiet street yet conveniently close to key attractions. The only minor downside was the weak shower water pressure. Overall, it was a great and enjoyable stay.
review_2_text: Beautiful cafe, owner makes amazing flat white and I love their food too, at affordable prices, great ambience, central yet quiet. People and service are great, they’re friendly but not fake, I appreciate that.
review_3_text: Such a pity that the space is great and the food is actually not too bad, but the service is always lacking. Came three times before I am finally giving this review - and each time it’s been a disappointment. Go next door, the staff working there will at least greet you, and are happy to serve you too.
review_4_text: Nice owner, great breakfast and early check-in. Stayed with my little family and definitely will come back.
review_5_text: Such a lovely place to stay in Chiang Mai. Warm hospitality, spacious and clean rooms, plus a cafe serving great food and drinks. Only downside was the weak shower water pressure, but that didn’t take away too much from the overall experience. Would definitely stay here again next time.

name: Inner Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text:
Wow!
Another amazing cafe in Chiang Mai. Great Tasty Food, Friendly Service, Welcoming Ambience and very Convenient Seating.

The campus includes a Hostel, 24h Coin Laundry, few other eateries and few shops.
review_2_text: Good brunch spot. A lot of options on the menu. In my opinion the avocado egg toast would have needed more salt. Mango bowl was delicious. Liked it.
review_3_text: Came here for breakfast. Got avocado and toast beautiful. I got avocado and toast with bacon and the bacon was lovely as well. Highly recommended and the price was good as well
review_4_text:
We had breakfast and came back the next day for lunch.  The drinks are amazing but I had the lemon soda for Lunch and it was very sour and I didn’t like it. But the smoothies and coffees were delicious.

Our breakfast was delicious. The Lunch was lovely too. Lots of options on the menu hard to pick what you want. Their menu is all day so you can get breakfast at any time.

The prices were very good too.

Definitely recommend coming here.
review_5_text: Nice place, good food and coffee. Prices are higher than usual, but it's worth it. You can pay by card, but there is a 3% surcharge.

name: MUNN.cnx
review_1_text:
All menu are testy I recommend overload milky toasted.
The cafe is at second floor of Dong restaurant.
review_2_text: “Yummy desserts, refreshing drinks, cute place, and super friendly staff!” 😋
review_4_text: Nice place and good taste
review_5_text: The shop is on the 2nd floor of Dong Na restaurant. Just walk into Dong Na restaurant and go upstairs. The pastries aren't too sweet, they're rich and fragrant. The bread is soft and aromatic, and the toasted coconut topping is crunchy and fragrant. A must-try item is the Three Kings pastry.

name: Nong.Hom สาขาหลิ่งมื่น (แม่โจ้)
Chala Cafe
review_1_text: Number one, the coffee was excellent. I ordered a cold cappuccino, no sugar. I forgot to order almond milk, and they were happy to make me a new one with a surcharge on the almond milk. Thank you very much for doing that. The setting is also really lovely, there's inside air-conditioned comfortable seats and small tables outside. Highly recommended venue.
review_2_text:
Nice surroundings, but coffee poor.  We had iced lattes, they were the worst we have had here, very weak.  When I had drunk my coffee the mug was still 3/4 full of ice cubes ( see picture ) Basically, they were selling ice at a high price.
Certainly not recommended for coffee
review_3_text:
Just for a coffee and a break between long walks and especially a long visit at the so close Wat Chedi Luang
Recommended!
review_4_text: The signature coffee by snack is must try if you are a coffee lover!
review_5_text: The coffee was delicious! The Thai dessert was delicious. The male staff member was really fun and friendly.

name: CHEF COFFEE.cnx
review_1_text: It was a very nice and refreshing iced Americano during the hot day in Chiang Mai. A small, yet cozy and nice coffee (not only) spot inside the old city. Also enjoyed the conversation :) and thanks for the hint on visiting Chiang Mai university's surroundings! I went there and it was amazing 🙌
review_2_text:
My partner had coffee here, got a stomach ache directly afterwards and later had to throw up.
Not 100% sure if it's from here but the last food we had before this was eaten hours before and definitely safe so probably something wrong with the ice cubes or milk.
review_3_text:
easy to stop  by
the owner is so freindly.
latte is worth trying
review_4_text: We stumbled across this cute little coffee shop while we were walking past craving a refreshing iced mocha and some iced milk tea. They delivered! It was delicious! We can definitely recommend them if you are in the area 👍🏼☕
review_5_text: Beautiful coffee and nice service

name: เทศบาลนครเชียงใหม่
ILY Cafe สาขาท่าแพ
review_1_text: The drinks were good and plenty of options to choose from. Got the thai lime tea which was a delight especially with the heat but the lime was too strong to get a whiff of the thai tea flavor at the same time. Would order again? Most definitely but would be inclined to try their other drinks as well as their soft serve ice cream.
review_2_text: Cute little cafe with tasty cold drinks I got the iced Thai tea because I LOVE it! This place is very cute looking and a nice stop by around the area when you need to rest your feet!
review_3_text: Coffee was great and you can also tell them how you like your coffee and they will accommodate.
review_4_text: Amazing coffee & the Matcha Ice-cream is 100% worth a try if you want something different. Great location as well right next to the market stores.
review_5_text: such delicious thai tea ice cream and very good price !

name: Por Jai Fruits Juice & Coffee
review_1_text:
You need to specify the level of sugar because unfortunately they add it to the smoothies.
Payment is possible only by cash or QR code.

They have nice clay figurines to observe while you wait for your order. The smoothie was tasty, but felt watered down; the cup was very full.
review_2_text: 2nd time here. This time I went for banana smoothie. Such a bargain price in old city. Chill inside and cozy music in the afternoon. Good place to take a rest
review_3_text:
I recently visited this charming little shop in the heart of a quaint old town, and I was blown away by the quality of their offerings. The fruit juices are absolutely incredible—refreshing, full of flavor, and made with the freshest ingredients. The coffee is equally impressive, especially the cappuccino, which is just perfect. The prices are extremely reasonable, which makes this place even more of a hidden gem.

The atmosphere is lovely, with outdoor seating right by the street, perfect for sitting back, relaxing, and people-watching. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall experience. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for great drinks in a cozy setting.
review_4_text:
My partner and I were looking for a coffee and chose this cafe. The coffee was very good so we decided to order something else and the smoothie was also very tasty.
Besides that very nice chill atmosphere and the staff was very kind!!

Would definitely recommend.
review_5_text: little cafe nicely decorated with vintage item and some Japanese anime stuff. Friendly staff and everything priced reasonably here.

name: Minimal coffee
review_1_text:
Coffee Place near the Three Kings Monument.
We had a double espresso & iced coconut americano.
My americano was okay but the espresso, unfortunately, was very sour and my partner didn’t drink it.
Service was great and store looks cool.
review_2_text:
Clean and modern simple coffee shop that opens earlier than others. Helps someone like me early risers :)
Only downside I see is that there is outside table in front of of the shop but it smells due to cat’s droppings :(
review_3_text: Damn good coffee! Friendly barista, friendly pricing... I had a dirty latte with 25% sugar, memorable indeed.
review_4_text: Sit back and relax with a cup of coffee.
review_5_text: Good taste, full body...

name: ร้านบ้านไม้คุณยาย
review_1_text: We got a lovely vegetarian lunch/breakfast here! Chef was lovely and so sweet. Fried rice was so good we got seconds and the iced coffee was fantastic as well. wish we knew about it sooner we would have gone back again
review_2_text: The beef burger was perfect. They have a lot of interest food in menu as well that I would like to try again next time I'm there.
review_3_text: Good handmade food and kind staff. Small, but cosy! Best burger we've had in Thailand.
review_4_text: Pretty good burger and cheap price. They are super kind! Everything is homemade
review_5_text: Super Burger

name: Garden to Table Chiangmai
review_1_text:
Soooooo good! Found this place because of the reviews and so glad we went! Excellent experience, waited around 20 minutes for a table, was served super quickly as we’d had plenty of time to look at the menu while waiting and food came within about 10 minutes. Every dish was delicious & beautifully presented. Staff were attentive and helpful!
I’m not a veggie but i love vegetables! they veggie khao soi was amazing and had such fresh delicious veg, i’ve found some places i order veggie and just get cabbage! There was plenty of yummy veg!
review_2_text: Incredible food, fresh, full of flavour. We came back to eat here 3 times because it was so good!  Enjoyed every bite. We always came at an odd time (4-5pm) so never had to stand in a queue. Fast and very attentive kind service. Very cozy atmosphere.
review_3_text:
When we came for close to 7pm there was predictably a queue. But we only had to wait 20 mins or so before we were seated. We happened to be close by and decided to try this. I saw the 4.9 reviews and I would say 98% of the time they are accurate.
So we came along and were blown away by  how fresh and tasty it all was and how the meat dishes were accompanied by a generous variety of vegetables. I felt so healthy eating it. More importantly everything was delicious and lip smacking good. It made me happy that such a fantastic eaterie exists. Love the ethos and brand. Great service as mentioned by the others. And incredible value. Will come again if we can while we’re here.
review_4_text:
Finally a safe and truly gluten-free Thai food experience in Chiang Mai!
This restaurant really understands what gluten-free means, which is still rare in Thailand. It's a welcoming place for *gluten-free, vegan, and vegetarian* diets — everyone can eat together here without any worries or discrimination.

The food is delicious, made with *high-quality ingredients*, and the place is very *clean*. The staff all speak *good English*, which is a huge help for travelers with dietary needs.

There’s often a line because it’s so popular, and rightly so! I truly hope they keep going this way. It’s a gem in Chiang Mai for anyone with food restrictions or just looking for honest, healthy, tasty Thai food.

Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
Garden to Table Chiang Mai was absolutely outstanding. We ordered the beef Khao Soi, and it was genuinely one of the best things I’ve ever eaten—rich, comforting, and full of flavor.
We also tried the dumplings, which were delicious, and I really appreciated how carefully the staff asked about allergies. That level of attention made the experience even better.
The menu offers a great selection of authentic Northern Thai dishes, and everything we had felt thoughtful and beautifully prepared. I can’t wait to come back and try more. Highly recommend.

name: 136 coffee
review_1_text: A very cute and friendly coffee shop that opens very early. It's great that there aren't many early bird shops in the area. Convenient for tourists who want a good cup of coffee that opens early in the morning. Highly recommended.
review_2_text: The sweetest young man runs this quaint little coffee shop. Coffees and Thai teas are delicious. Stop by and support him as he is never busy and he is open at 7am for that early morning coffee to start your day.   He is so welcoming and friendly.
review_3_text:
Really great Café with delicious and high quality matcha 🍵

The service is incredibly friendly and makes you feel very welcomed.

Recommend to everyone ❤️
review_4_text: Very good coffee and good service
review_5_text: Amazing coffee. Amazing staff. A must visit if you are in this area.

name: FRIEDE Artisan Café
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop that serves the best esthai. It’s tucked away from the street and has a nice porch with a shaded yard. Not crowded or touristy, but in a prime location so it’s easy to dip over here for a recharge. Owners are super nice and they have a feed station for the local cats. They play relaxing music, the wifi is strong and the chairs are comfortable. Love starting my day with these guys.
review_2_text: Discovered this cafe while walking through the streets of the old town. Fabulous coffee place, relaxing and calm atmosphere very close to famous temples. Recommended
review_3_text:
Update: Lowered my score to 3 stars as this place seems to never be open. I tried going twice and both times it was closed when maps said it shouldn't be.

Amazing cafe hidden away in the old town, it's quiet and has a good range of drinks.

Well worth the visit, not sure why this place only has a few reviews.
review_4_text: Amazing location, super peaceful, nice chill vibes, lovely staff and delicious drinks. Can't ask for more!! Thanks so much
review_5_text:
Hidden Gems in Chiang Mai
Small cafe under Hostel in the big city serve you with big small
A sense of welcoming come from every drinks that being served

The relaxed and calm environment welcome you like coming to your friends house

Don’t hesitate to skip your busy day outside and find your comfy here at this cafe

name: Viman Meow Cafe
review_1_text: Amazing and adorable cats!! Was so much fun and you get a free coffee/drink with your entry 😻
review_2_text: Cats are all very friendly and great matcha
review_3_text:
The cats are ready, but the store isn't 😭😭
I went because it said it opens at 10, but it wasn't open sob sob

name: Count Me In The Cafe by Villa Thai Orchid
Punn Smoothies ปั่น สมูทตี้ by PUN Patisseries
review_1_text:
Good mood good food good service 🩵
I love Thai style ice cream coconut milk ice cream. Yummy cookies and fresh smoothies 🥥 mango sticky rice 🏅
review_2_text: Nice smoothie place. The Avocado coconut smoothie was good and the mango parfait was tasty as well. Friendly staff. Nice shady courtyard to sit at as well.
review_3_text: Delicious and inexpensive mango sticky rice (65baht).   Very friendly service.  Situated in a very calm and relaxing little garden / courtyard where you sit and enjoy it.
review_4_text: Good Smoothies and valuable price
review_5_text: Great food at fair prices. Would especially recommend the mango sticky rice, coconut supreme milkshake and the cookies. Very nice casual vibe too

name: REDTEA THAITEA CHIANGMAI
review_1_text:
Great thai milk tea blended with the coffee.
The coffee is not too bitter and the thai milk tea is strong.
It’s amazing that these two combined together that is still very smooth.
Cozy seats outside and very chill vibes
review_2_text: Favourite Thai milk tea in Chiang Mai!!! Also bought the passion fruit red tree to try - another hit! But remember to ask for less sugar if you don't have a sweet tooth like me!
review_3_text: Love atmosphere of this place easy to stop by they have good Thai tea and staff friendly service . Cheers
review_4_text: Delicious iced Thai tea creamy. I chose less sweet and it was perfect
review_5_text:
30% sweetness is the best.
This thai tea with a stronger tea flavor that I like 👍

name: Dee Cup Coffee กาแฟวัดพันอ้น
review_1_text: Great place to get a cool drink - it’s off in a side street so you have to look for it but it’s worth it.
review_2_text: Milk tea and Thai coffee with Milk…. Both great!
review_3_text: Surprisingly, a local food area exists in the serene Buddhist temple square. Enjoying an iced coffee under the bright sunshine and shady trees is truly a pleasure!
review_4_text: The drinks taste good and are very cheap. Iced milk tea costs 25 baht and comes with free pearls.
review_5_text: The price is very cheap and delicious. I really like it. I will come again when I visit Chiang Mai.

name: Starbucks (Thapae)
review_1_text:
If you’re looking for one of the only places in Chiang Mai that DOESNT have a bidet in the men’s toilet, THIS IS THE PLACE! Even the worst hostels in the city have them installed.

What a disgrace for an international coffee chain!!! Friends don’t let friends drink corporate garbage coffee anyway. Do yourself a favor and get better coffee literally anywhere!
review_2_text:
It’s too crowded to stay.
The drink warms in my hand,
with nowhere to sit.
The restroom is closed,
a sign reads Out of service.
Some people stand on the narrow stair landing,
setting their drinks down to eat.
Only the counter
keeps selling.
review_3_text: Bought the chiang mai souvenir mug here. Overall it was good. Ordered matcha latte and matcha croissant. Good location.
review_4_text:
I would like to thank Bell for his kindness and professionalism. What a polite and helpful young gentleman. He actually made my and my wife's visit to Starbucks a real pleasure. This branch overlooks Tha Phae Gate. Its cool, clean and spacious. A great branch 👍.
I actually wanted to get a selfie with Bell but it was rather busy due to Yi Peng festival. Hope you dont mind my capturing your imagine for this review. Thank you 😊 🙏
review_5_text: Great location, right opposite the Thapae Gate. Pleasant staff, happy to please, there does seem to be a lot of people with bags, hogging tables and sat for hours enjoying wifi and cool aircon waiting for checkin time at their Hotels.

name: North Gate Spirit
review_1_text:
They’ve got everything here from live jazz music, coffee and a speakeasy style bar in the evenings. The atmosphere was bright friendly and creative with a nice atheistic for photos. The staff all spoke perfect English and the cashier Pear-wa was really helpful in helping me decide on which coffee to have, I went with the coconut coffee foam and it was delicious! As a coffee lover this place is perfect for that unique experience and quality coffee and specialty cocktails.
Don’t miss this spot if you’re in Chiang Mai you would be missing out !
review_2_text: Very beautiful modern decor cafe. Initially curious as lot of young kids were taking selfie here. I had to ask them is this in a movie or famous? One told me this place has a good coffee. To my surprise they do have a very good tasting coffee. They offer it in medium or dark roast. I chose Iced Americano, it has note of citrus taste and tad bit sour taste, clean and refreshing!
review_3_text:
The best cocktails bar so far!! We went there and tried some of the cocktails and described what we like, the bartender came out with our unique cocktails in our fav flavours without anything in the menu!! Amazing!!

The vibe was nice and the place was so cozy with the good service! Def be back if I go to CM again!
review_4_text: Super aesthetic little cafe tucked in the neighbourhood that gives Japanese minimalist vibes! They also sell spirits (see photo) and an assortment of creative drink options. There’s also a cool mural right outside for more photo opportunities ✨
review_5_text:
Definitely very local jazz bar with tons of foreign tourist around. It drinks a little bit expensive. I think the number of people are too much so maybe the experience wasn’t very best.

But the band is really good . For me, I would prefer somewhere quieter.

name: Single Origin Store Tha Pae
review_1_text:
So for all coffee enthusiasts and snobs, this is the place. I’m a very passionate home barista and annoying as hell as a customer because the coffee almost never meets my expectations. This was the first place in ages to deliver more than expected!

The vibe is immaculate, the staff friendly, chill and attentive, the music is a vibe and fits well, the cookie slapped and the coffee…
well I had one and immediately after, ordered a second.

Especially the Chiang Rai Saenchai Estate was brutally good as a flat white.
What awaits you are first class beans, kind of the best machine on the market (Kees van der Westen Spirit- if you know, you know), Mahlkönig EK43 OG Grinder and other MK grinders + even one from Ditting.

And the homies know how to use the gear. So you’ll get what you pay for!

They also offer beans to buy, drip bags, ice cream, apparel and more. Amazing place for enthusiasts.
review_2_text:
The coffee here is excellent — high quality with a great selection of beans, offering a rich yet well-balanced flavor. The atmosphere is just as impressive: calm, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed.

The location is unbeatable, right by Ta Phae Gate. It’s a perfect spot to work while watching people come and go, with the old city wall right in front of you. A great place to slow down and enjoy both the coffee and the surroundings.
review_3_text:
Came here for our last day in Chiang Mai while we waited for the train. Was a great chill space to sit and watch the busy road outside. Great location. Little bit of calm in amongst the hustle and bustle of old town.

Really cool selection of drinks. We also got a bunch of food. Was hearty and filling. Spent just under 1000 baht but it felt worth it for the food, aircon and place to relax before the  trek out.
review_4_text: Singles Origin Store in Chiang Mai offers a beautiful and minimalist atmosphere with a fantastic location right near the Tha Pae Gate, providing stunning views of the Old City wall. The interior is bright, clean, and features charming touches like the spiral staircase and warm wooden furniture, making it a perfect spot to relax or get some work done. Their specialty drinks are a must-try, especially the vibrant Matcha Spanner, which is a creamy, layered delight topped with a generous swirl of sweet foam and matcha dust. Meanwhile, the Coco Dirty is an exquisite, rich espresso drink served with a coconut-flaked rim for a delightful textural and tropical contrast. This cafe is highly recommended for anyone looking for exceptional coffee and a gorgeous setting in the heart of Chiang Mai.
review_5_text:
Nice coffee shop near Tha Phae Gate ประตูท่าแพ, tried it their dirty coffee and Americano. Both ok. Fresh and have a nice body.

The shop has cool atmosphere and nice design, price ok la counting the location and the space.

name: CoolMuang Coffee
review_1_text: I never realized that the tiny building was just where they made the coffee. There are several other areas... all with very comfortable seating ❤️❤️🙏🙏. A very relaxed and comfortable area right in the middle of busy Thae Phae Gate. Good coffee too 😎👍👍. Free parking for bikes and cars too. Wow!
review_2_text:
☕✨

CoolMuang Coffee is a cozy local café with a warm atmosphere. The coffee is smooth and flavorful, made with care, and the space is perfect for relaxing or taking a short break. A great spot to enjoy good coffee and chill vibes in town.
review_3_text: Awesome little coffee shop that serves amazing lattes!! The vibe is really cool with a small outdoor area. Got 3 lattes and 2 water bottles for 260 baht.
review_4_text: Coffee was average. Kinda touristy. Not much to mention. They have indoor and outdoor seatings which was great.
review_5_text:
Absolutely loved this coffee shop! The atmosphere is cozy and inviting — perfect for working, reading, or just relaxing with friends. The staff are super friendly and welcoming. They even offered great recommendations.

I also appreciated the clean space, soft music. Will definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality coffee and a chill vibe!

name: STORIES
review_1_text:
Stories in Chiang Mai is a solid choice if you are looking for a meal that feels both fresh and indulgent. Also, the staff were so nice and friendly. The burger is a standout. It arrives well-assembled with a juicy patty and a generous amount of melted cheese, all balanced by crisp lettuce and pickles that add a nice crunch. The seasoned potato wedges served on the side are a highlight as well, providing a satisfying texture that beats standard fries.
The smoothie bowl is equally impressive and clearly prepared with care. It is packed with a vibrant mix of toppings like sliced bananas, dragon fruit, blueberries, and a hearty portion of granola and seeds for texture. The presentation is beautiful, even featuring a small decorative flower that makes the dish feel special. It is a great spot for a relaxed meal where the quality of the ingredients really shines through in every bite.
review_2_text:
A very modern and stylish cafe.
They offer a wide variety of foods and drinks.
I got their cappuccino for 75 baht which is a bit pricey but it was a very good cappuccino. Italians would approve.
Besides that the staff is very friendly and their seating inside got AC. Outside you can take a seat and observe the streets. Great cafe.
review_3_text: I came across this spot this morning while exploring Chiang Mai, it’s a cute little restaurant. The vibe is nice. I ordered the mixed berry French toast which I enjoyed very much. I’m not entirely a fan of the service style, or walking up to order your food but I will say the food didn’t take very long. French toast were 10/10 not too sweet and the fruits were perfect!
review_4_text:
If you’re looking for a cozy spot to sip your morning coffee and enjoy a hearty breakfast, this place is a gem. They’ve got plenty of vegetarian and vegan options, which makes it easy for everyone to find something delicious. And the best part? It’s not one of those overly “experimental” cafes. you get comfort food done right.

If Chiang Mai is your last stop in Thailand, this cafe is the kind of place you’ll be glad you wrapped up your trip with. Sure, the staff can come off a little snobby, but honestly, my breakfast was so good it completely made up for it. One of those meals that just puts a smile on your face.
review_5_text: Just flew into Chiang Mai, checked in, and stumbled into Four Stories — it instantly felt like a home away from home. Exceptional in every way, from the atmosphere to the care and comfort. Exactly what you want after landing in a new city. Highly recommend.

name: To The Moon Guesthouse
review_1_text: I absolutely adore this hotel. Honestly, out of my six weeks traveling across Thailand and Vietnam, this has been my absolute favorite stay and how lucky I am I to have found this gem 💎! The place is newly renovated, lovely rooms and the atmosphere / vibe is great! Super nice outside area and pool to chill and relax. Plus they have 8 puppies! 🥹 highly recommend this place - 10/10 and nearly forgot, the owners are lovely and super sweet!
review_2_text: Fave place. Very quirky design. Great for a day by the pool. Great food and drinks. I stayed in a tent on the second floor. Great experience. Ideal location for temples bars and restaurants. Plus there's 6 gorgeous puppies that just wander around loving attention
review_3_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting this lovely spot, and it was an absolute delight. The ambiance is incredibly nice—very chill and perfect for relaxing after a long day. One of the highlights was the adorable dogs; they added such a warm, friendly vibe to the place.

The owner/staff is exceptionally friendly, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. We visited around 8 PM, which might explain why it wasn’t crowded yet, but that actually added to the serene, laid-back atmosphere.

Overall, I would love to visit again for more chill nights. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a cosy and friendly hangout spot!
review_4_text: Can’t comment on lodging but love the vibes here 👩‍🍳💋✨ serving tunes, food, drinks, and smiles. Nice relaxing spot. The puppies don’t hurt either 💜 🐶
review_5_text:
Amazing location, very nice hotel, very nice space for breakfast and relaxing. We stayed there for 5 nights and it was just perfect. Extra calm, the staff is just super nice and friendly. The food is good and the room are simple yet bery clean and comfortable. Truly a little bubble of calm and paradise in Chiang Mai. Truly recommend and will recommend to friends. Thank you for everything.
(during our stay they had 3 baby dogs... We fell in love with them!) ✨

name: กาแฟพันธุ์ไทย สาขาประตูท่าแพ
review_1_text: I ordered a drink via delivery and paid an additional 10 baht to have the ice separated, but the restaurant refused. I requested a refund through the app, but was refused, citing insufficient evidence. They shifted responsibility to the customer. The restaurant should thoroughly review the order and verify its accuracy. 10 baht isn't much, but it's money. How much will this cost to multiple customers? The comments are full of people who haven't received the ice separated service. If they're not going to separate the ice, why would they charge extra?
review_2_text: I ordered through a delivery app, but I'm confused why it's so difficult to just not want ice. I mean, don't put it in a cup. And you're not wasting the store's ice anyway, so there's no need to include it since I'm not drinking it immediately. Usually, when I order without ice, it's fine, but why have they included it these past two days?
review_3_text: It's just a storefront located at the entrance of the Im Hotel; there's no seating area. There's one long bench in front of the shop for customers to sit and wait for their drinks. However, it's the branch closest to the moat.
review_4_text: The staff were friendly and smiling, the service was good, and the coffee was made to a high standard. It's a shame there aren't any proper tables to sit at.
review_5_text: The two female staff members were kind, friendly, and provided excellent service, even bowing respectfully.

name: Zalux Coffee Cafe
review_1_text: This is a little quiet oasis and slice of heaven away from the main drag. Expect top notch coffe and kind service. A hidden gem ❤️
review_2_text: This place was a hidden little paradise. The birds singing across made for lovely morning. Great prices and good food!
review_3_text: Not easy to find but lovely when you get there. Very serene environment. Family owned business. Great place to spend an hour or two sipping a coffee and reading a book or whatever. Had an iced cappuccino which was delicious.
review_4_text: A delicious coffee with soy milk and a beautiful location that is peaceful and relaxing. I can’t have regular milk and they happen to have soy milk and made me a delicious latte. Highly recommend.
review_5_text: Super beautiful Atmosphere, well hidden in a tiny ally right in front of a temple. Good music and amazing drinks

name: Burkta Tha Phae Gate
review_1_text: Had a delicious Thai tea! The woman serving us was very kind. I only wish they had a free dairy milk alternative! 20b is quite steep
review_2_text: Great coffee in a fantastic little work environment right next to PunSpace.  An americano will set you back 55 baht, the WiFi is super fast here and there’s a few power points near the bench seats you can use.  There’s a large table to work from if you’re meeting a friend and also some individual tables.  Staff are friendly and welcoming, only thing I noticed is that they allocate you a WiFi username which expires in 2 hours. #BeatTheGrind
review_3_text:
Really great place for a coffee!
The place is located close to a coworking space.
Staff helpful and super nice Mocca! Ice cold :)
review_4_text: Excellent coffee, best in town. Highly recommend. Also great air conditioning. It's part of a beautiful working space.
review_5_text: Small cafe in small lane, adjacent to co-working space. Very quiet, cheap but not bad coffee(starts from 55B). Good for me & coffee time.

name: Tyme.coffee (ไทม์)
review_1_text: The cat!! Coffee very good! But the cat is soooooooo cute! And we also joined a nice khratong class and everybody was very nice!!
review_2_text: This cafe is connected to the hostel we are stying in and we can definitely recommend both! We got a flat white and a November soda, they are delicious! It’s a perfect spot for a cosy afternoon reading a book or getting some work done! ☕️
review_3_text: Nice coffee and matcha super tasty and great atmosphere too place to see in town
review_4_text: Lovely place with great coffee, nice weather, and the cutest cat around :) 💓
review_5_text: I went to Tyme coffee for a cup of iced Hojicha tea. The drink was great as well as the atmosphere. The cat and staff are very nice!

name: Glyn Chiangmai Thai Cuisine กลิ่นเชียงใหม่ไทยคูซีน – Breakfast, Brunch & Lunch with Local Charm
review_1_text:
Highly Recommended Oasis in the City
​This restaurant left a profound impression on my family and me. The quality and service far exceeded the price point—truly excellent value for money.
​The staff were all incredibly polite and kind, contributing to the overall wonderful experience. I ordered the smoothie, Thai tea, spaghetti, Tom Yum Goong (Spicy Shrimp Soup), and a salad, and I felt that every dish was prepared with great attention to detail and care.
​While the space itself is not very large, the atmosphere is incredibly relaxing and peaceful. It truly feels like a hidden "oasis" right in the heart of the city. We left feeling completely satisfied and impressed.
review_2_text: We stopped here for breakfast and it was a great find. The Four Treasures breakfast was a really delicious mix of flavours and beautifully done. The space is airy and cool with welcome air conditioning, and the team were warm and attentive. Would absolutely recommend if you’re in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: Super cute spot! We grabbed a delicious breakfast. Food was good and presentation was beautiful. We opted for a lighter breakfast but menu had many other options that looked good.
review_4_text: Really fantastic restaurant with fresh and delicious food and drinks. We had pad thai, stir fried beef with rice, yummy smoothie and a fresh house salad.  Really impressed with the quality and the attention to the food.  Definitely would return!  Oh, has a menu of western breakfast items and a lot of authentic Thai options.
review_5_text: Service was great and the atmosphere had a very chill vibe. Food was decent but not great. The beef krapow was really tough and had no business being served like this. Portions were a little small too. The kiwi smoothie was refreshing and is a plus point. One thing I thought wasn't great was that they were giving away a free salad in exchange for a Google review, but I think they'll give a review regardless of a good or bad review.

name: Cafe Chungdam
review_1_text:
It was a very bad idea to come here. After a long flight, I was extremely hungry. We ordered a Hawaiian pizza that was advertised on the menu board and two salads.

The salads took more than 30 minutes and were brought only after I mentioned the waiting time. The pizza arrived after about 40 minutes in total. It was absolutely not worth the wait — it tasted like a cheap store-bought pizza. I honestly don’t understand why it took so long to prepare. The dough was completely dry.

The only positive thing is that the salad was actually tasty.
review_2_text:
Great matcha and big selection of smoothie bowls that come generously topped.
Nice place for laptop work too (wifi, chargers, comfortable sitting).
review_3_text: Not a good place if you want to Work. To sit and use your laptop you have to buy food/drinks for 150 bath per hour. Coffee was good.
review_4_text: A vibrant and cozy place to dine. Their menu has a variety of options, they have Thai cuisine and western. I was delighted that they have alternative options for dairy milk such as oat/soy milk.
review_5_text: Friendly, attentive service, with a modern, airy ambience right across the moat. Good coffee. Good wifi but no power outlets available (the ones next to me were covered with tape). Called Moats Moment Cafe outside (?).

name: Moat Moments Cafe
review_1_text:
Conveniently located next to the hotel i was staying, Himku, this cafe was delightful!

Staff were friendly and kind, food was great and service to match.
While the menu is extensive for a lot of Western food, i opted for something more local and it didn't disappoint!

Would recommend, and especially for anyone staying next door! So convenient, good value and quality.
review_2_text: All in all the breakfast was really good, a lot of choices. We - as Germans - liked the bread. Unfortunately the Feta cheese tasted old and we didn't eat that. But it is still a very nice, western place to eat. The location is good and the prices also affordable. I'd recommend the Café
review_3_text:
A nice place with great atmosphere to have a meal and look at the old city moat view. Also one of the best coffee in Chiang Mai.

You can even ask the chef whether they be able to cook other recipes that is not in the menu, they would cook for you if they know how and have sufficient ingredient.

The staffs are able to communicate in English.
review_4_text: The barista reccomended the strawberry coffee latte and I was skeptical. Strawberry and coffee seemed as if they wouldn't pair well together, yet the strawberry coffee drink here worked so well. The sweet strawberries cut down on the bitterness in the coffee and made for a delicious drink!
review_5_text: Recently opened place and I had the opportunity to have a meal here. Nicely made beef burger and a cuppa Thai tea afterwards. Prices incredibly reasonable and great service with a smile.

name: Travel Cafe
review_1_text: Wow the food is so good and good prices too, if you are staying near tha phae gate you have to eat here
review_2_text: High quality meals and not small portioned, as well as reasonable price (only 99 bhat for a whole meal unlike other places nearby that offer the same for 200+) and friendly-English speaking staff
review_3_text: I had beef khao soi and it was amazing, not too spicy and very tasty. Ice cold coffee was nice too.
review_4_text:
Nice little cafe restraint. Had air-conditioning. They do little European food and most classic Thai food.
I thought the Thai food was well done.
review_5_text: The staff have great smiles and the food is delicious. The recommended yellow curry noodles on the menu are definitely worth a try.

name: Gin Coffee CNX
review_1_text:
Lovely coffee shop near Sunday market and open in the afternoon.
Cute inside with seating mostly on bar stools along the windows, also some seats on outside patio.
The coffee tastes great, a double shot in a latte ist still at THB 80, and made with care and attention.
It’s a cute place to rest a while …
review_2_text: Love the atmosphere & secluded outdoor seating space. Enjoyed a very tasty black citrus coffee & coconut latte while watching the activities of the city hustle. Staff was so nice & allowed us to enjoy our time there even after closing hours. Highly recommend!
review_3_text: Good taste and good service, Cafe have indoor and outdoor.
review_4_text:
Cute little place with a nice cactus outdoor area and some indoor seating. Affordable options too.
The ginger milk tea was just about right, with a hint of ginger to spice it up.
review_5_text: Highly recommend the green tea latte. Delicious! Loved the chill atmosphere as well.

name: Mi Cha Kafe thapae branch
review_1_text: Mi Cha Kafe in Chiang Mai is a great spot! Affordable prices and really nice tables outside where you can chill and enjoy the main street vibe.
review_2_text:
Best thing to say is that they have outside seating and ac inside seating.  Oh, and good location.

Service horrible.
Bubble tea had very soft buba and some hard chewy ones.
Overpriced
review_3_text:
Best cappuccino in Chiang Mai, for sure! Friendly staff, quick service, and good prices.
They have oat milk as an alternative for vegans or lactose intolerant customers, too.
review_4_text:
Great coffee and great location.
The have outdoor seating and smoking possible.
Excellent place to chill and relax in the city walls!
review_5_text:
Ordered the thai milk tea, it’s very rich, not diluted.
The less sweeten is really good to go.
Good interior design and the atmosphere.
Lovely place to take a coffee break or friends gathering.

name: Na Pia Cafe & Restaurant (Halal)
review_1_text: We ventured to Na Pia for our first meal in Chiang Mai and were so pleased with the food and the service here. We ordered chicken tom yum soup with rice, chicken panang, and avo toast with egg and we thoroughly enjoyed all that we ordered. The coconut smoothie was also very fresh and delicious.
review_2_text: The atmosphere is very peaceful and the food is great. The owners are Muslims so you can feel assured that the food is halal. The owner is really kind and gave us information about the food we ordered as well as information about the area. The prices are very fair. 100% recommended especially if you are looking for halal food in Chiang Mai in the old town. There's also a masjid within walking distance.
review_3_text:
Na Pia Cafe & Restaurant (Halal) is in an excellent location right near Tha Phae Gate, making it a super convenient stop while exploring Chiang Mai’s Old City. Easy to walk to, quiet enough to relax, and a great break spot between sightseeing, temples, and markets.

The food is halal, tasty, and well priced for such a central area. Portions are solid, prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable. Friendly service and a dependable option if you want a good meal without overpaying in a tourist-heavy area.
review_4_text: We came here on Sunday evening, just before we started walking along the sunday night market. Variety of food to choose from. We had 6 dishes and all of them tested good. They are reasonably priced too.
review_5_text:
This restaurant is inside Vieng Mantra hotel and offers AirCon upon request. It’s clean but a little non-descript.
Several choices for breakfast /lunch/ dinner, the old menu shows pictures of each food which makes it easier to decide.
Korean chicken came out hot and flavorful after about 10 minutes.
Overall a pleasant experience but a bit expensive at close to THB 200 pP.

name: Coffee Plus
review_1_text:
My spouse and I stopped here for a slow start morning while in the city. We were greeted by the most warm and kind owners, an amazing vibe with indoor and outdoor seating, and delicious (and I mean delicious) food.
We got an iced latte (half sweet), and hot latte (they offer dairy and non-dairy milk options) and some of the best bites of baked goods yet (all on the menu because it’s a family favorite and baked by the owner’s sister!) the coconut crepe cake was absolutely one of my favorite sweet bites since being in Thailand (and there are a lot of sweet bites here!) and the almond croissant was delectable.
You should not skip this coffee shop!!
review_2_text: One of the best coffee shops we have been! Owners are the kindest, everything is made on the spot and with love and care. The dirty thai tea: an addictive discovery! We ended up going 2 days straight, and the lady also gave us some recommendations for temples and things to see. Thank you for the coffee and the smiles! Hopefully we will be here soon again 🙏❤️
review_3_text: A lovely place to grab a coffee, breakfast and start your day in Chiang Mai. The couple that owns the place were so sweet and kind with us and gave us great recommendations for the city. The coffee and food is excellent and the atmosphere is quite peaceful. I highly recommend Coffee Plus!!
review_4_text:
It’s highly recommended for a reason! The couple inside were so sweet and made me feel at home.. I got the Thai style coffee with oat milk and the ham, scrambled egg with the croissant. All the food was very fresh and I was so happily surprised to find out my coffee came with a little cat spoon and coaster, it honestly made my day.

The couple also gave me recommendations of what I could do over the weekend!

Great place to stop for a light meal and coffee. The presentation was lovely, the vibe was great, and the whole place felt like a bit of a hidden gem. I left smiling the whole way back to my hotel.
review_5_text: I went in on one random morning to get a Thai iced tea takeaway. The family who runs it were so cute and nice :) I impulsively bought the chocolatine and one of the danish things… it was so good. I was shook, like it had no business being warmed and so tasty. I hadn’t found such good pastry in Thailand in three weeks! I went back again to do an online meeting and small breakfast. I’m in love with the family running the place. They are so sweet. They are 100% the example I why I think Thai people are the nicest on the planet. I’m sad they’re closed tomorrow because I would absolutely go back. The WiFi worked pretty well but it did cut out at the end of my 90-minute meeting (saved by the bell, can’t complain lol). The cafe also has squirrels and pigeons (love). The family speaks English well.

name: Weed Organic 100% by BC Green Grower Thaphae in the garden
review_1_text: I have been in Thailand for 6 weeks and I just got the Chiang Mai, yesterday.  This is the place. Pete is super chill and the quality and variety are impressive. Check out their specials. Bought more than I needed but when you find what you need… stop searching. The back is a very cool place to relax, grab a beverage or play pool. The staff are top notch and very nice and helpful.
review_2_text: Very cool hang out and vibes like in countryside old style farm house.  Very friendly and helpful staff with many great quailty and variety of selections and much LOWER PRICES than most places and there are alcohol drinks available too as well.  A MUST visit place to escape and chill in a countryside home feel in the city.
review_3_text: Soooo cozy and fun nice song!! Also Good quality good price! They’re super kind as well I will definitely comeback ☺️
review_4_text: An amazing place to relax and enjoy. The quality of the products is outstanding, but what really stands out is the service. The staff are super friendly, attentive, and always in a great mood. They make you feel at home and are happy to help you choose what suits your preferences best. Definitely a place I’ll recommend and return to. Thank you Mr Han ! You are the best !
review_5_text: I was really impressed by this place. I had a great time. The owner is a very friendly and kind person.

name: Kareem Coffee คารีมคอฟฟี่
review_1_text:
A must-visit for true coffee lovers ☕️
This place really knows their beans. You can tell the baristas are passionate about what they do. I had a iced latte and the flavor profile was incredible. It’s a small, cozy space that feels very local and authentic. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a quality brew.
review_2_text: Good coffee good people good atmosphere
review_3_text: Dark roast coffee. Those who like dark roast coffee will love it. Price 50!!! Very cheap. The shop is near Tha Phae Gate.
review_5_text: ร้านบรรยากาศดีมาก มีที่นั่งทั้งในร้านและหน้าร้าน กาแฟหอม รสชาติดี ราคาไม่แพง ใครผ่านแถวนี้ลองแวะมานั่งพักหรือเบื่อๆมาเล่นpoolในร้านได้

name: Café Amazon Three Kings Chiangmai
review_1_text: This outlet's management must check on their staffs, I came here 2 months plus ago in a morning and went straight to the toilet at the back luckily before I order my drink. There is only one toilet and I waited 10 minutes yet nobody comes out, I went to ask the staff whether if the toilet is locked and she say no someone must be inside. I return to the toilet and this time heard a lady's voice inside talking, 10 to 15 minutes later a woman came out and to my horror, she is a staff !! I am so unhappy that I left without any coffee and walk all the way to another outlet nearThapae Gate. There is only one Amazon around this popular part of the Old City and only one toilet in the large garden at the back ,they should make better use of the place and add another toilet.
review_2_text: we had coffee here, coffee was very plain taste. the staff could have been more nice and friendly though. i supposed her having a long day.
review_3_text:
Tucked just a few steps from the iconic Three Kings Monument.
Here i drank a delicious chocolate frappe with a shot of espresso. Always a great combination.
Staff was friendly, great english and my order was done fast.
review_4_text: Love it, my first stop in the morning for an iced cappuccino 60Bht. Cheaper and loads better than any Starbucks. Air-conditioning seating inside plus several tables outside.
review_5_text:
Staff is just OK, not more. Coffee tastes weaker than elsewhere.
Worst of all, it's stupidly cold in there. People are sitting with their jackets buttoned up to the chin.

name: Coffee & Snack by Zeam & Gain & Gail
review_1_text:
Nice restaurant, a lot of foreigners,
prices are higher than other local restaurants, but the food is good.
Only thing that bothered us were the non-fresh Croissants in the morning.
review_2_text: Avoid this place that treats customers extremely bad, they don't even give you a glass of water even if you need to take a medicine. The service as well it is disappointing and unorganized. Food is not bad, but there is plenty of nicer places around, cheaper as well and attended by human beings that care about yourself
review_3_text: The staff at the cashier counter is bad customer service and rude.I’ll never come back to your shop again .
review_4_text: Great smoothie bowls as you can see and coffee to follow
review_5_text: Avocado-mango smoothie is crazy. You have to eat this one. 95B.

name: Again.cafe
review_1_text: Great little cafe with AC. Chill vibe inside with 2 charming Hostess and Barista. Service was warm, friendly, and quick. Prices are good, iced Thai milk tea for 55b.
review_2_text:
Good atmosphere and seemed very clean.
The coffee and food options need to improve
review_3_text: Cute cafe with cute interiors and friendly baristas.
review_4_text: Very cute cafe and a welcome respite from the heat during the day. Inviting atmosphere and super friendly staff, tasty yuzu soda that came just right in sweetness when ordered less sweet. Some sweet treats available.
review_5_text: I walked past and bought an iced Americano. The coffee was good, the decoration was nice, and the space was comfortable. The price was also reasonable.

name: mek Oort Café
review_1_text:
I walked into Mek Oort Cafe intrigued by cold beverages on offer and was welcomed in like family by Mai. I had samples of the kombucha on offer before settling on the Longan flavour (the addition of cinnamon in this was so appreciated!)

Mai and I sat and talked for a long time about her farm (where she sources most of her products), interspersed with some more sampling! Highlights were the freshly made peanut milk (an absolute revelation), the local popcorn, and the flavoured honey (lychee, macadamia, longan and elderberry).
