review_2_text: It’s a very nice café with a good place and nice drinks.
review_3_text: A lovely small farm to table cafe. They sell great coffee, kombucha, honey and more. All products come from their farm in the area.
review_4_text: Great little shop with delicious kombucha. Really enjoyed talking to the owners about their farm in nearby Lamphun where they grow the fruits used in the brewing process.
review_5_text: Amazing service

name: The Canteen - Tha Pae
review_1_text:
Great atmosphere. Delicious food. Friendly staff. Chill, modern, natural vibe.

Breakfast plate was nice.
Coffee was good.

To me, a bit too salty on spinach and eggs.
Consider asking for low sodium option if you want to adjust the amount of sodium intake.
review_2_text:
Stopped after walking past for a few days. The latte was smooth even without vanilla syrup, and the “10 AM Breakfast” was cooked well. The pancake was light, fluffy, and worth adding.

Interior is small but comfortable, staff were friendly, and the wifi was fast. Ask for maple syrup if you want it. Easy late-morning stop and I’d happily return.
review_3_text: A wonderful brunch spot with affordable and delicious food. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and well air-conditioned. Definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: Great hidden gem! The menu was great and had lots of variety and my breakfast was delicious. If you're in Chiang Mai you need to visit!!
review_5_text: Cane in early morning for lush food and coffee. 10am breakfast was a good portion! Bruschetta was yummy and staff were friendly :)

name: Farm social
review_1_text: So underrated, the coffee shop in front is full and this one is way more chill. Quieter and fresh, I don't understand why people don't come. Prices are also normal and drinks are ok.
review_2_text: I usually work at this place as there’s no one else there but me and it’s mostly quiet. the place offers big variety of drinks and food and stable internet access. for some reason they don’t add any details about their place to Maps but you should try it out

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ สาขาท่าแพ
บริษัท อินเทกริตี้ ครีเอชั่น จำกัด
ร้านน้ำท่าแพ สุดซอย 4 | Tha Phae Soi 4 Beverage
TTT Tattoo Cafe
review_1_text: Great place for drinks, beers are served in iced glasses. Lovely cool atmosphere, nice tattoo designs framed around. Pretty cool and would recommend with friends or anyone wanting a nice drink. 👍
review_2_text: After a long search for a fully air-conditioned bar in Chiang Mai, the only one I could find with an actual functioning air-con was this one (very important in Chiang Mai in the hottest months). The selection of beers, spirits and cocktails here is excellent. The staff members are efficient and polite. They do not have their own food menu, but rather the menu from a nearby restaurant (which, BTW, does not have proper functioning air-con). They phone in your food selection, and it arrives pronto for you to enjoy  in the comfort of this wonderful cooool bar.
review_3_text: Cold beer on tap and great service, what more do you want? Well if you want more they have it, lots of cocktails, spirits and wine. A really cool place, relaxing and friendly.  Great visual to the street and its air conditioned! There is room to park right out front. Thanks for the beers.
review_4_text:
This is such a cool and awesome coffee shop in this part of the city!❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
It has an incredible bar and makes really delicious coffee!🔥🔥
And the barista has the best smile — she’ll make everyone’s morning bright and cheerful!😘😘😘😘
review_5_text: Great cocktails and a great spot to do some people watching as there are a few tables out front.

name: Go Green by Kanya - Weed Shop & Dispensary & Cannabis Tha Phae
review_1_text: Very cozy place.
review_2_text: Very cozy place.
review_3_text: “Affordable” I bought 3g and it’s such a good deal. The buds are dense and smells amazing.
review_4_text: Can't fault the place, absolutely perfect for everything. Enjoy people.
review_5_text: Fah was just amazing, such a lovely lady very friendly, helpful with quality service and amazing smoko, cheers Benny Australia 🦘

name: Rumpair รัมแพ - Thai cocktails & Foods
review_1_text:
We sat there today after searching where we can eat thai foods for good prices and not be disappointed.
the pad see ew was amazing!
It was so flavorful, the sauce and noodles were very very good.
The atmosphere of the place is very chill, nice acoustic songs and you have a nice view on the street.
The service was also very nice and food came quick
We will be back
Thank you :)
review_2_text:
We came as soon as they were open as I was excited for their pizza. Their service was excellent and here’s what we ordered:

Cheese balls: sweet but delicious - perfectly fried.

Garlic bread: house made tasty bread! It’s our first garlic bread in Thailand and it did not disappoint.

Pad kra pow: my wife truly enjoyed this dish as it was one of the best pad krao’s we had.

Cacao bowl: our first bowl in Thailand and boy was it amazing! Can’t go wrong with fresh milk and fruits.

Pesto pizza: best pesto we’ve ever had because the Thai basil leaves are just super rich and fresh. My wife doesn’t usually like the crust but she killed it this time.

Overall, great brunch location and perfectly located on the main street for tourists.
review_3_text: Great service, exceptional craft cocktails using the delicious power of Thai spirits and flavors. Tom Yum cocktail was so creative and delicious- very friendly staff & prime, comfortable location! Would definitely return!
review_4_text: A local spirits bar/restaurant that has amazing drinks made with more than 20 local liquors. Great Thai food, but basic tourist food as well. I ate the wide noodles in black soy sauce with seafood and tried one of the sticky rice liquors on ice, like shoju. Beer Lao IPA also. Reminds me of the Museum del Pisco in Peru for local flavor.
review_5_text:
We had here dinner 3 times! My kids looooved their pizza and mango smoothie!  I had the green curry soup with rice that was hot and delicious.
The staff where welcoming and remembered us

name: Nice Sweet Place
review_1_text: I visited nice sweet place today and had the mango sticky rice. It cost 80 Baht and the mango was fresh. My partner and I did not feel well after eating the rice with the coconut sauce. It might have been spoiled. The decor was beautiful and I love the atmosphere in this cafe. I am giving 3 stars as the staff and service was slow, and there were only two other customers in the cafe.
review_2_text: Had bread here for breakfast two times whilst staying in Chiang Mai. Delicious bread and great selection too. The place is also cosy, filled with natural light. Great location as it is near the Thapae Gate.
review_3_text:
I stopped by this place for some AC on my way to the public park. Ordered a matcha green tea and I loved it! It’s more of a matcha latte than green tea, tastes very milky. You can choose how much sweetness you want. I told them that I didn’t like sugar but I only wanted a little bit. And it turned out to be exactly the way I wanted it!
Very clean and cozy environment. Perfect for a short rest in the middle of the hassle and bustle of the hot summer day in Chiangmai!
review_4_text: Cute cafe with good matcha but the vibe felt a little off so I didn't feel as welcome.
review_5_text: My sweet girlfriend can't get enough of this place, the matcha is amazing (you get 10x more of that chlorophyll goodness than you'd get in London) and the banana bread cupcake is excellent by any standard. I had the Khao Soi (a Chiang mai local curry) and it was one of the best I've had.

name: Simon Says CNX
review_1_text: Super cool place, we’re hanging out outside. They have a coffee& joint special so I’ll be back in a day. Really cool vice here and the guy is super nice. Gave us lasts, a grinder & a lighter. And they have a big ass bong that hits super smooth. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Great shop to chill, listen to live DJs and blaze high quality with nice glass and nice friends
review_3_text: Great place, always a chill vibe and good products, small little outdoor space but it’s a really cute and nice location
review_4_text: The Simon says cannabis bit was great, drinks and food and weed love it
review_5_text: Great board games!

name: JalaHu coffee shop
review_1_text: Cute little coffee shop a bit hidden away in a small alley. Very sweet and welcoming owner and also very good English speaking. I went here just for a cup of coffee and had a good time here. They also offers home stay. Very cozy spot to drop by for a cup of coffee or a homemade sandwich and some relaxation
review_2_text:
We were greeted with such warmth by Prom and David. The food is delicious, giving a home cooked super yummy taste. Because of all this, we extended our stay in Chiang Mai and it started to feel like home.

Must try their breakfast, coffee and especially home-baked cookies!
review_3_text:
I highly recommend this coffee shop in Chiang Mai.
I had an amazing experience at this place.
Food and drinks are delicious, good products and so well cooked!
Service is more than great, they make you feel like home ❤️
The place is fabulous located close to the Tha Phae Gate as well as many beautiful temples and for sure the Streer Market!
If you ever visit Chiang Mai, don’t miss it!
review_4_text: BBQ night on Friday!!  Great food and atmosphere ♥️♥️
review_5_text:
Incredible cafe, excellent atmosphere and vibe
One of the best lattes in Thailand
Super ambient and lovely owners

name: Yendee Coffee
review_1_text: The shop next to the Nama hostel Chiangmai ,  the owner and her brother and the staff , all of them are so nice , and the drink taste very well , I will come back and order one more tomorrow..

name: Brewginning Coffee
review_1_text:
had coffee
@brewginning.

this a hip happening place, with crowd, instragrammable

seems like many tourists more into taking photo at chan moi kao road than in coffee

we had dirty and yuzu expresso, later was good but former was nothing like the superb brew @ restr8to

our fault really as the the description was completely different this one here having honey- didn’t like the sweetness but the nice coffee aroma still there.

2.1.2026
review_2_text:
This is a must-visit.
If you like a strong, bold taste, this is the coffee you need to try. the outdoor area it’s super chilled and the staff is the sweetest.
I’ve been coming here for three years and the quality is always the same. I also love that they have a stamp card for regular customers.
review_3_text: My new, fave coffee shop in Chiang Mai. Friendly helpful team, an open-air indoor outdoor design with lots of seating, solid wifi … and most of all, delicious coffees! Open early another huge plus!!
review_4_text:
Brewginning Coffee is one of Chiang Mai's most popular coffee shops right now, and it’s easy to see why! It has a distinctly trendy social media photo vibe, drawing a large crowd of Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and domestic Thai travellers.
The staff truly elevates the experience; everyone was friendly and served with a warm smile. I ordered an Orange Espresso for my friend, and the presentation was excellent.
If you are looking for a beautiful, vibrant space to enjoy a coffee and capture some great photos, this is your spot. A definite five-star experience!
review_5_text: This coffee shop is famous for its IG spot which offers really great coffee made from great beans. The taste of coffee is strong and a good blend. They have a good inside room for working which is perfect if you work from home or work remotely and away from crowds outside. Staff are friendly and give you good recommendations, try cookies which go well with coffee. I would recommend visiting if you are looking for one of the places for coffee with great IG pics.

name: Monday__attack
review_1_text: lovely place and decor, kind ladies working. Drinks were just alright, the es yen was small, the capuccino was nothing special. As others have said, many people taking pictures everywhere so it’s not that much of a relaxing atmosphere. they give you a free ice cream if you review it, that could explain a higher rating.
review_2_text:
Nice location and delicious drink. You can take plenty of pictures here as they decorate it very nice. There is also a photobooth as well, i forgot how much it was but def give it a try.

The only thing i wanna complain was that i bought a drink but my friend wanna use the washroom. They didnt allow her to use it but requested her to buy a drink first. I found it unusual for a coffee shop like this.
review_3_text: Roomy yet cosy joint with wavy vibes tucked down a small alley. The servings are solid, the service is cheery, and the ambiance makes the menu prices worthwhile. Not all that busy at noon on a weekend.
review_4_text: Great interior. I really like old TVs showing noice as a design choice! Coffee is alright, the variations are better than the classic choices.
review_5_text:
Thick taste of iced Latte/ Matcha latte. Love it. Can’t miss the vintage deco and chill musics.
btw visit on Thursday, no heart attack by now though

name: Ministry of Roasters - Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
My top priority when in chiang mai.
They are just one level above all else even in chiang mai, captial of great coffee and cafes.

The accuracy and attention to details brings out the best flavors in all aspects and color possible.

I am always inspired but how good can coffee get and how surprising new flavors can always merge when coming here.

So should you. Its A MUST
review_2_text: Amazing specialty coffee in Chiang Mai! The staff are super knowledgeable and friendly, and the coffee is always perfectly brewed. Great spot to relax, work, or learn about different beans and brewing methods. Cozy, modern vibe and definitely worth a visit for any coffee lover!☕💕🌱
review_3_text: Really like the coffee here. It is very good. I ordered a Hot Americano, the Director blend (Medium Roast - Honduras). The serving cup was unique. It was deep with enough space to allow the notes and aroma to come through clearly while drinking. Nice!
review_4_text: We had a latte and caramel popcorn and omg, both were sooo good. The coffee itself is just amazing. Team is nice and WiFi is good. They also have a cute back garden where you can take few nice pictures and enjoy a coffee if isn’t too hot. If you’re a coffee lover, this is the place for you!
review_5_text:
Exceptional and complex flavours. These guys have it dialed in….
Can choose your blend of coffee.
Fun space
—it’s the price of eating two local Thai dishes but a treat and experience —

name: millilit cafe
review_1_text:
Do not miss this place! Super cute interior retro decor.

Great coffee and the banofee pie was yummy!

They also sell brand merchandising of their cute dog logo.

They play some chill background music. Good for a working afternoon.

My only issue with this place were the plethora of young, overdressed Gen Zs with too much make-up on treating this place as a studio for their social media photoshoot.
review_2_text:
Absolutely loved Millilit Cafe! It’s got that perfect cool, vintage vibe that makes you feel like you stumbled on a secret spot in Chiang Mai.

We had an iced mocha, flat white, strawberry soda, and a chocolate cookie that did not last long (because… delicious). Drinks were spot-on, the cookie was heavenly, and the little stickers they gave us were such a cute surprise to take home.

Great atmosphere, great coffee, great treats. Millilit Cafe is an easy yes if you love character-filled cafés with personality.
review_3_text: Upper-floor space with magnificent, upper-shelf vibes. Solid bevs, sunny service. Scenic seating choices, fantastic tunes. Not that busy at all on a weekend morning. Ground-floor entrance is on a side street aside the Muay Thai joint. Easily one to come back to.
review_4_text: Great coffee shop. Always nice to find a spot where the coffee is solid & the atmosphere feels intentional. You can feel the care behind the experience.
review_5_text: I love this cafe so much!!!🫶🏻  Aesthetic! Cool! Pls try apple cream soda here, it's so nice 🥤

name: Neighborhood Community
review_1_text:
This is a typical renovation plan for new old houses.

It's very similar to those small renovations on the Charoen Krung Road in Bangkok.

Re-plan the space of the old house and attract investment

There are many shared spaces in the middle.

It really makes people feel: openness, community, inclusiveness, freedom, relaxation

I like spaces like Bangkok and Chiang Mai very much.

You can sit in it all afternoon.
review_2_text: It’s like a community inside with many restaurants combined together. At first I thought you can buy food anywhere inside and use any table there but some seems like they aren’t shared🤔🤔🤔. The restaurant (I forgot the name 😣) near the balcony where we had drinks said we can’t buy food from other shop inside. But some areas I saw they seems to be sharing so I not really sure, I think it’s quite confusing🫨🫨. Not cheap tho…. And no air conditioning here
review_3_text: Newly opened restaurant/bar complex, which is like an upgraded version of food court. This place has some of the well known restaurants in it like the pretty popular pizza place in Chiang Mai. I think it is a good place to come especially in a group.
review_4_text: Good atmosphere with friends. chilling vibes. Not much meal to make you fell full, but lots of appetizers. Food is a bit pricy. There is paid parking with pickup-drop off service.
review_5_text: Came here for Adirak and it is AS GOOD as the Adirak restaurant in Suthep. This place comes with a DJ and other food options. Crazy how quiet this gem of a place is on a Saturday night.

name: Aob-Sook cafe & restaurant
review_1_text:
Tucked away in a small Soi near Thapai gate.
A small café restaurant which has a good selection of western dishes and croissants.
The shakes are wonderful. However the food though wonderfully presented and cooked felt a little bland. They just needed something more. (taste wise)
Maybe I'm just used to Thai food too much.
Great if you want a quiet place to eat. No car parking. It has motorcycle parking. WiFi
review_2_text: This was probably the best breakfast I've had in... all my life? & I've had a lot of good breakfasts. The bread is AMAZING, both the croissant and the sourdough. The crispy potatoes were heavenly. Drinks amazing. I'm VERY impressed with this place.
review_3_text: This cafe is awesome, like ABSOLUTE AWESOME! Came here for breakfast & tea time. They have a number of delicious food & drinks. Staff team are really nice people and their service is top notch.
review_4_text: A favorite cafe in the old city for delicious fresh baked pastries and superb sourdough breads.  Offering an extensive range of very good coffee drinks, tasty brunch options and many pasta choices as well.  Very lovely staff, talented friendly chef, and an easy atmosphere with inside AC seating and shaded outdoor seating.  Everything we tried was perfectly prepared and plated.
review_5_text: Very nice and cozy place! The food and coffee were delicious and affordable. I especially love the chocolate bread!

name: JAI LOY CAFE & ROOFTOP
review_1_text:
Poor Value Accommodation! READ the negative reviews...

I don't know how this place can be rated so highly on Agoda, Booking and Google. I suspect this place has paid an internet company to boost it's ratings by giving fake high ratings. I observed 3 or 4 high ratings put in within 1 minute on google reviews most likely by the same person on the evening I stayed there.

The staff are so unmotivated and take hotel guests as intruders when we want to go back to our rooms. There are so many things wrong with this place ...rooms with no windows, super hard beds, dark and dim rooms resembling a jail cell!

The rooftop bar had only 1 table occupied at 8pm on the Friday/Saturday that i went up to take a look. There was a couple in the same lift as me coming down probably deciding the rooftop bar was not worth their baht...

To be fair some of the staff do try to make yr stay more pleasant but the systemic issues with the place are too extreme.

The owner should really take a hard look and stay in the "hotel" to understand the issues or maybe he/she doesn't care and just wants to keep the place afloat.

This is the worst accommodation i have ever stayed in Thailand and I felt so deceived by the high ratings to stay here!
review_2_text:
Jai Loy is our favorite hangout place in Chiang Mai. Amazing and friendly staff which makes the rooftop bar an extraordinary experience. Food and drinks are priced cheaply with high quality.

We, especially, are always enjoying the sunset at around 6 to 7pm when the sun decends behind the mountain: priceless!

A must go place when in Chiang Mai enjoying a relaxed and chilled atmosphere.
review_3_text: Beautiful sunset view and the dry Khao soa was so good, my partner has been asking to go back for the noodles. It came with a very crispy skinned chicken and the sauce was thick and creamy and just delightful.the green curry was typical but delicious too. Views are breathtaking. We came around 6pm to enjoy the pink skies! It does get quite busy too.
review_4_text:
At first I was thinking if the place will be noisy because there is rooftop bar on 5th floor and cafe on the 1st floor, but surprisingly the room was quiet! Room also clean and smells good. I stayed in a private room on the 2nd floor with shared bathroom, and the bathroom was clean.

Location is perfect, many good places that we can reach by walking distance.

Only 1 small feedback, because we have to take off our own shoes or slippers, it will be great if the accommodation can also provide slipper in the room or for us to walk around the communal area 🙏🏻
review_5_text:
Mixed review.

We booked the same day as we were quite limited on places available in our budget, they kindly let us check in early for no charge which was great. The only room available was the standard room with no window, at £25 a night. The bed was comfy but the room was quite dingy and smelt musty. The bathroom as well had the typical sewage smell that is all too often here. Plus the A/C spat out smelly air. I think these things wouldn’t have been a problem if we had spent maybe £10 less per night, but as Thailand has so many budget stays this was one of the more expensive budget rooms but it was not reflected in the quality.
This is not to say don’t stay here it’s just a reflection of the standard room with no window, as for the price you can get better (if you book in advance not like us).

Apart from that the staff were nice and there is great seating areas down stairs and on the rooftop with a sunset view. The prices were quite expensive on the rooftop though, I suppose due to the view.

name: Tar Sawang Coffee At Tha phae - กาแฟ ตาสว่าง สาขาท่าแพ
review_1_text:
Great little cafe near Tha Phae Gate.
Very friendly staff and good coffee!
Nice decoration and great outdoor seating. They also offer some bakery goods and other snacks. Not to pricey as well.
review_2_text: The carefully brewed coffee here is truly special. With its bright atmosphere featuring wood tones and orange accents, it’s a popular spot where many people gather for a coffee break!
review_3_text: Cozy little coffee shop! ☕️ 85 baht for a yummy iced oat milk caramel macchiato. I enjoyed working on my laptop here - fast wifi and trendy coffee shop music.
review_4_text:
we got the canele, and breakfast sets for food and strawberry latte & orange espresso for drinks.

they offer four types of blends & you can choose a blend for your coffee! we picked the "santa lucia" blend and there was a very fragrant, pleasant floral scent to the coffee. we loved how it paired with the orange flavour. the strawberry latte was really great too, and i loved the subtle taste of strawberry in my coffee.

Overall we loved the atmosphere of the cafe, and the two cats that they have are very entertaining and lovely!
review_5_text:
Must visit!!!

This place has a relaxed atmosphere, an awesome playlist, and fantastic barista drinks.

I tried the Thai coffee and green tea, and they were nothing short of heavenly.

And the price was really affordable✨

name: MiLa Thapae Hotel@Chiang Mai Old City
review_1_text: Excellent location, rooms had excellent AC and water, breakfast were very mid, staff extremely friendly and nice, beds comfy
review_2_text: A small boutique hotel that is a calm , cool and quiet oasis from the madness outside.  Absolutely lovely staff who are friendly and helpful and looked after us with delicious breakfasts and coffees.  I was even given a little cream patisserie with a card and candles for my birthday.  Loved our 4 night stay here.
review_3_text: When you first walk in you’ll be greeted by the lovely staff. They are nice, friendly and helpful. We stayed here for 3 nights in the Deluxe Suite with the bathtub. Very spacious room. Such a great value. If you’re looking for a private and quiet atmosphere this is the spot. We were served simple but good quality breakfast with fresh fruits and juice. The best part was the cafe had free unlimited coffee, juice and smoothies from open until 10pm. Great location not far from the airport or railway station. Overall a great experience and will be staying again when I come back to Chiang Mai. Thank you!
review_4_text: Just got back, comparing to my stay years ago, I feel breakfast quality is going down also with less choices. Bed cover had stains when walking in but probably is just an incidental miss which I tend to believe as all staff are very attentive and friendly during the whole stay. For this price, it’s still a place with good value. Location is unbeatable it’s just right next to Thapae gate.
review_5_text: Overall great experience. Strong hot water, walkable distance to east side of old city. In house breakfast is okay. Plenty of local food. Limited parking at front door. Hight CP value. Recommended.

name: Spice Garden Cafe
review_1_text: We discovered the Spice garden while wandering around the back streets. And we went back the next night. It is just such a beautiful place to sit and enjoy the amazing cocktails and food. We felt our children were very welcome and the garden is big enough that there is plenty of space for them to play safely. Gorgeously kept gardens and atmospheric lighting in the evening with lovely indoor-outdoor spaces. A Special mention should go to the lovely staff, especially Pun - an absolute star.
review_2_text:
The coffee tastes like dark roasted bean. Usually I prefer light roast more.
The scone with jams is good.
Food is delicious.
Service here is excellent. Staffs are very nice and supportive.
Seats in the garden or indoor are both comfortable.
review_3_text: The place is beautiful, and the staff are friendly. My experience wasn't the best, I just wanted to drink something. I ordered a passion fruit juice, thinking it would be home made as in most places, and I insisted I didn't want sugar on it. And I got a drink that had an insane amount of sugar. I don't think they added sugar themselves, I assume their juices are just some fake bottles juices. But I would expect a place like this to have higher quality drinks and staff that would understand what they are serving.
review_4_text: I stopped by here for coffee since I saw a very nice garden. I tried cappuccino and latte and both are below average quality. The space is very nice and vibe is good, so you may wanna try something else on the menu. It’s still a well located nice spot to chill though.
review_5_text:
The setting was lovely and the staff very friendly and polite. However, I was sat waiting to order a drink for about ten minutes when I arrived. We tried to start ordering food and kept being asked to wait until all the group had arrived. As one of the guests is notorious for turning up late we didn't want to wait, we also didn't want to bombard the kitchen with 14 orders at the same time, Thai restaurants are never able to serve all dishes at once in any case. In the end, our latecomer was served his food first, despite arriving after the rest of us had ordered.
The prawn salad was actually 2 prawns and a little bit of yellow pepper in bone marrow. It was very nice, but the word salad is misleading and several people thought the combination of prawns and beef marrow was odd. The seabass was delicious and the espresso choux pastry got compliments from everyone who tried it. Overall, the set menu was good value.
We were given a round of mocktails to celebrate my birthday, which was a nice touch.
I can't fault the attitude of the staff, they were all very pleasant and it's not easy dealing with such a large group. The food was interesting and well-presented, I think we would have spent a lot more on drinks if the staff had been more attentive, but as it was our bill was reasonable.

name: สโลว์ลิฟวิ่ง-Slow Living Coffee
review_1_text:
I visited this café for the first time last month, and the atmosphere was absolutely amazing — calm, cozy, and full of good vibes. The staff were really friendly and took great care of me. Since then, I’ve been coming back regularly for their coffee because the price is reasonable and the taste is totally worth it.

I also found out that at night, they turn the place into a beer bar, which sounds really cool! I hope I can visit one evening soon.

If you’re looking for a nice café or a chill beer bar, I highly recommend this place. It’s located on the second floor of the building!
review_2_text: The place is really next level , managed by young chap , it’s got one of the most untouched classy vibe..  I must mentioned music they have in cafe it’s better than many pubs and bars ..
review_3_text: It's really good! Americano rychee is special👍👍
review_4_text: The atmosphere is great. The food is delicious. This restaurant is more delicious than Star or something.
review_5_text: A hidden cafe with cheap and delicious coffee, and a stylish atmosphere and music playing.

name: Bake n Wake Co-Working Space
review_1_text:
🌟 Amazing Café Experience!
Stopped by for breakfast and coffee, and I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The place is clean, has a cozy atmosphere, and every breakfast dish was fresh, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious.

The coffee was aromatic and rich, clearly made from high-quality beans and prepared with care. A must-try for all coffee lovers!

What stood out the most was the exceptional service – special thanks to Khun Dew❤️, who was incredibly friendly and helpful. Always smiling, polite, and ready to give great recommendations. It really made the experience feel warm and welcoming.

✅ Delicious food
✅ Quality coffee
✅ Outstanding service
✅ Super clean environment

If you're looking for a cozy café with great breakfast, top-notch coffee, and excellent service – this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Delicious ice cream served with a smile!! After a long day out walking, it was so wonderful to relax in this spacious café furnished with comfortable chairs and tables. There are work stations for those wanting to get work done. Soft music plays in the background to further enhance the experience!! We would definitely come back again!!
review_3_text: The cafe staff were exceptionally friendly and made me feel very welcome. The atmosphere was pleasant and airy, making it a great place to relax. Their drinks were also really good . Will miss this place so much , the cafe and also the hotel 😢
review_4_text: Loved everything about this place! The food is super tasty and the service is just amazing. It’s clean, neat, and has such a cozy vibe. The breakfast menu is simple but sooo good. My top pick? Definitely the Matcha Coconut — highly recommend! 💚🥥
review_5_text: Amazing coffee experience, very good food, generous portions, excellent lunches. Very pleasant staff. I recommend it.

name: HIDE LAND__SPACE
review_1_text:
The Chiang Mai Rooftop Bar Review
Conversation with Gemini
Write a 210 word review on Hide Land Bar in Chiang Mai. Highlight it's Chic ambience, nice roof top restaurant and excellent view of the surrounding area and also the hill view. Mention how many people come here for the sunset views. The food drinks are famous especially the cocktails

Nestled in the heart of the city, Hide Land is one of Chiang Mai's most captivating "secret" rooftop bars. Known for its chic, industrial-meets-minimalist ambiance, it offers a sophisticated yet relaxed escape from the bustling streets below.

The highlight of any visit is undoubtedly the rooftop restaurant, which provides an excellent 360-degree view of the surrounding urban landscape. As the evening approaches, the space transforms; it is a prime destination for sunset enthusiasts, with dozens of people flocking here daily to catch the golden hour. The sight of the sun dipping behind the lush green hills and the iconic Doi Suthep mountain range is nothing short of breathtaking.

Beyond the scenery, Hide Land has built a stellar reputation for its culinary and mixology offerings. The cocktails are the true stars—famous for being expertly balanced and creatively presented. Whether you prefer a classic or a signature Thai-inspired infusion, the drinks are as impressive as the vista. Complementing the bar is a menu of high-quality food that elevates the experience from a simple drink spot to a full dining destination. For anyone seeking a trendy atmosphere and a million-dollar view, Hide Land is an absolute must-visit place
review_2_text: The best for working or studying or just chill. They have really good music and the place is spacious and u can see the city view with mountain. The drinks are pretty good and reasonable. I really like the decorations here..
review_3_text: A beautiful rooftop terrace with a lovely atmosphere and amazing views a perfect spot for taking photos. The menu offers food options as well as a wide variety of drinks, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic. It’s a great place to relax, enjoy the vibe, and spend a nice time while capturing some beautiful moments. Highly recommended 🥰🫶
review_4_text:
Super nice view, good coffee and chocolate drink! They also have matcha and hojicha here. I think the vibe of the place and that you can see the old town view of Changmoi street.
Nice for a sunset too
review_5_text: Great views, vibe & coffee. But we ordered an onigiri, had to wait for 30 min, staff weren’t approachable and it came out drenched in sauce. Couldn’t eat it.

name: แอ่วดี คาเฟ่ All Day Breakfast and coffee
review_1_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
American breakfast was super delicious. Fresh ingredients, solid portion of veggies. We ate there two days in a row. Great value for money.
Highly recommended 👌
review_2_text:
Amazing breakfast the lady is really cool and the food is perfect and cheap. I enjoyed it so much.
Just one thing, waiting 40min is a bit too much , she was preparing everything by herself so it’s understandable but don’t stay if you need to go quick.

Again very good place/food/person
review_3_text:
Lovely ambience with really friendly owner! The place is ready at 7.30am and you can sit outside to enjoy the morning sun!!

The breakfast is simple and nice, not to mention the wonderful perk-me-up coffee! A good place to relax and chat.
review_4_text: *"An absolutely excellent cafe! I have breakfast here every single morning, and they never disappoint. The quality is outstanding, it's brilliant value for money, and what really sets them apart is how well they look after you. Truly a great place!"**
review_5_text: Lovely place!❤️ The breakfast was delicious and the staff is super kind!😍

name: Tapae Gate Kafe
review_1_text: Nice little restaurant close to Tapae Gate. Reasonable prices, friendly service and well prepared food.
review_2_text: Pleasant experiences staff were friendly and good with service. Prices are affordable and the food and drinks were good. The food portions (mains) are quite large and are pretty much a share size so one dish may actually be enough for 2 people. Reasonably air conditioned and clean venue. Would go back
review_3_text: It's the first cafe I went to when I arrived in Chiang Mai. They are open earlier than most cafes in the area. The food is good and the place feels relaxing. The staff are nice.
review_4_text: We discovered this place by walking around the neighborhood and wanted to give it a try and it was definitely worth it, their breakfast menu is very complex, I went for the club sandwich and it was very tasty, the staff was very friendly and brought our meals quick, they also offer nice drinks I tried the lime smoothie and was one of the best I’ve ever had. I recommend this place 100%
review_5_text: Very clean, great coffee and food. staff can speak English well. No surprises.

name: MiLa Cafe
review_1_text: Love the coffee here. Staff is also very friendly and best part is it stays open till 10pm unlike other cafes in this proximity
review_2_text: Hotel lobby? A cafe on the first floor. Clean, quiet, and, best of all, the sofas are comfortable.
review_3_text: I happened to come here and had a good rest.
review_4_text: It's nice and comfortable because the seating area is a sofa.

name: Doi Chaang Coffee
review_1_text: Small shop with good coffee by our hotel.
review_2_text:
The owner lady is very nice and the coffie is just perfect. Coffie, and tea is really well prepared. I wanted to share a photo of one of those precious drinks, but sadly I drank it and then realized that I should share this info.
Try it out!
review_3_text: This place on the map is NOT Doi Chaang coffee. It has been changed by mistake on the map. I hope someone can correct it. Must be a bad update with Google.
review_4_text: Great little coffee shop off the beaten path.  Good range of coffees at Thai prices (very cheap). Seating both inside and out. Great service by the Thai owner. Free wifi and a quiet place to relax on a warm day. Highly recommended.
review_5_text: Nice place to stop at. The coffee and the cake are good

name: W8 x viangpha cafe
review_1_text:
A convenient spot for anyone looking to work. There are outlets available, and they only require you to purchase one drink, which is reasonably priced.

They don’t accept credit cards, only cash, and not 1,000. I had only a 1,000 note, so I had to call my friend to come and pay for me.
There are steep stairs at the entrance, and the overall maintenance isn’t great.

The coffee wasn’t to my taste, and the place is mainly suited for people who want to get work done rather than enjoy the coffee.
review_2_text: Amazing place to grab a coffee or tea and chill for an hour or two. The seating area is quite large with many different tables and couch lounging area, plus an outdoor terrace. Extension cables are available in case you need power or to get some work done.
review_3_text: Cutest hole in the wall ever! Super quiet and mellow place to work. On a side note, you can tell they actually do a really good job taking care of the small aquariums in the cafe. Peach tea was 10/10 as well ❤️
review_4_text: Good workable cafe located in the 2nd floor. There are many good tables and ok chairs as well as power outlets. It’s an optimized working environment. I tried their hot cappuccino and it was good, but their iced latte was not so good. If you are planning to get some work done in this area, it’s a good place to hop in and GSD.
review_5_text: Lovely place to work, study, and chill. My partner loved his iced mocha and I adored my rose cappuccino! You can smell the roses 🌹. Come chill out here

name: Fatboi Coffee
review_1_text: Super chill joint on the first floor up in the Neighborhood complex, overlooking the street below. Open-air concept that fits seamlessly into the neo-foodcourt microcosm it's a part of. Friendly staff that brew up some top coffee. Surprisingly quiet on a weekend afternoon.
review_2_text: Climb the stairs to the second floor and you’ll find this great, lesser-known coffee spot. The coffee is simply spectacular. The only drawback is the background music, which can be too loud and detracts from an otherwise excellent experience.
review_3_text: We went early morning for a coffee and it was super quiet. Nice view from the top balcony and great for watching the busy streets. We had a Thai style iced coffee (with condensed milk) and an affogato and both were really tasty.
review_4_text: Came by to Fatboi Coffee which is in a space-sharing location with some f&b at 2F. Seems like this place is cater more to the evening to night crowd. Very trendy place well done from a very big old shop.
review_5_text:
Nice coffee place, on the 2nd floor of the neighborhood community (newly open) in Chang Moi area.

Ordered Iced Es-yen (95 THB), it tastes good.

Staff was okay…

You can sit at the balcony to watch the view from above.

It was quite difficult to find a parking space.

name: Coffee Bar Thapae
review_1_text:
A tiny hidden café that feels like a well-kept secret in Chiang Mai. It’s perfect for grabbing your coffee to go, but there’s also a small cozy spot if you prefer to enjoy it there. The place is simple yet charming, ideal if you love quiet, non-touristy spots.
I ordered a dirty latte and it was delicious, rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced between the coffee and milk. Definitely one of those coffees that makes your day better. A perfect little spot if you’re looking for something small, cute, and authentic.☕🌺🫶
review_2_text:
Was casually walking around when i discovered this shop.

The owner is a kind & happy gentleman who suggested me his signature Dirty coffee (i was skeptical) & i absolutely loved it, must try. Also tried Americano.

This is a must visit place if you want to have a heartily warm conversation & a coffee.

This shop deserves more attention, please walk by if you are looking for a wholesome experience.
review_3_text: Tasty coffee to go for a really good price. The place is quite small but has few seats in case you want to have your drink there.
review_4_text: I ordered an iced mocha, it came with too much ice (there was barely any milk in it). I asked to make it with less ice and that’s what I ended up with (see picture). The taste is pretty good but prices are not exactly cheap so I would expect a full cup, not half full. If I ask for less ice it’s because I want more milk in it.
review_5_text: It's a warm feeling shop with good coffee and reasonable prices. I'd like everyone to come my fave one Caramel Macchiato!! Sooo good

name: Just chill coffee
review_1_text: The coffee is delicious, and Kara is super cute!
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious. There are beautiful and stylish second-hand clothes. The owner is kind, the weather is great, and it's close to tourist attractions.
review_3_text: The coffee is very delicious.

name: Victor French Bakery
review_1_text: They have the best bread, pastries, and coffee!!! I went here just to try their bread, but I ended up coming back for more. Their tarts were immaculate! Plus, the staff were so friendly and attentive to your needs :) The ambiance was also perfect for someone like me who doesn't want too noisy and crowded places!
review_2_text: Came here for pastries but ended up getting their menu of the day - beef cheek with mashed potatoes. Beef cheek was very good. Lemon meringue tart was not bad! But the vibes of the place was really nice and quiet.
review_3_text:
Friendly, nice atmosphere good prices for yummy food. (Should come early before everything sells out) coffee was good and staff was friendly. Plus there is a black Leopard stalking the customers.

We had coffee, good cookies that were just the right amount of crisp to them but soft and full of ingredients.

Come give them a try!
review_4_text: Decent breakfast place. I like their baguette bread. The panini was alright. Nothing special. We also tried the vanilla pastry which was tasty but very dry. But that’s fine for me. What I don’t like here is the coffee. Better just get some food and get your coffee elsewhere. The owner / staff (not sure) didn’t have her best day either. She seemed very annoyed by something. Possibly by me - but I wouldn’t know why.
review_5_text: Great croissants and tasty coffee! I had the breakfast set with oat latte, fresh orange juice and (huge!) croissant. All delicious, with the croissant so great we ordered a pain au chocolate too.

name: Twenty T coffee (สาขากำแพงดิน)
review_1_text:
A place you simply want to come back to.
A café with outstanding pastries and pizzas, truly some of the best I’ve ever had. Everything is fresh, well-made, and you can feel the attention to detail in every bite. Excellent coffee, a pleasant atmosphere, and friendly, welcoming staff. Definitely a spot you visit once and find yourself returning to again. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: I love this coffee shop so much,not too big but comfortable for sit and chill , this coffee shop is nearly night bazaar, they have many unique menu example is Black latte and dessert like cookie and nutella rolls i recommend u guys to come here
review_3_text: Fantastic little cafe, you have a variety of different beans to choose from. Just opened up.
review_4_text: Great coffee shop with variety of coffee beans, fantastic owner
review_5_text:
Great little coffee shop with reasonably priced coffee with crema!
Also got some free Nutella cake from friendly owner.

name: Into Thapae Street Coffee
review_1_text: I’ve had many dirty coffees from China, Singapore, Japan, but this is easily one of the top ones i’ve tasted!! The coffee to milk ratio is perfect and I think they concocted their own milk to be creamier and a lil sweet, just how I like it! It’s a hidden gem situated at a very unassuming alley beside a laundromat so you can do laundry too~ The owner is very nice and kind, and the vibe was outdoors but nice and cooling. I loved my experience here!!! Definitely will be back!
review_2_text: Good coffee, reasonable price, Thapae area. You can wash and dry clothes next door and sip coffee while waiting. The atmosphere is comfortable. The owner is kind. They also sell homemade pastries. Delicious!!!
review_3_text: First day in Chiang Mai and brilliant first pit stop for coffee! Strong, delicious espresso with awesome service to match. Thank you!
review_4_text:
INTO COFFEE: A Gem on Thaphae Road

If you're a coffee enthusiast exploring Chiang Mai, INTO COFFEE on Thaphae Road is a must-visit. This cozy little shop offers a delightful blend of quality and affordability, making it a favorite among locals and tourists alike.

Their signature dirty coffee is a crowd-pleaser, perfectly balancing the bitterness of espresso with the sweetness of milk. But don't limit yourself to just that. Their Americano Orange is another unique and refreshing drink that combines the classic Americano with a citrusy twist. It's a perfect choice for those who prefer a lighter, more refreshing coffee experience.

So, next time you're strolling through Thaphae Road, be sure to stop by INTO COFFEE and immerse yourself in Chiang Mai's vibrant coffee culture.
review_5_text:
I've been in the area for a few weeks and I love coming here. The seats are comfy, the music is nice and relaxing, the whole vibe is great.
I love to drink milk in my coffee but my tummy doesn't always agree with me, here they serve alternative milk and the coffee with soy milk is great!
I highly recommend to visit this place :)

name: Mingmitr Tha Phae
review_1_text: Excellent coffee… highly recommended to try the Thai style coffee..mingmitr, hom la mai and es yen… love the coffee, pastry, cookies, environment and the ambient.
review_2_text: Perfect hideaway in the middle of Chiang Mai town, near Tha Phae gate. If seated inside, sound isolation is very good, and coffee is excellent. Cash or QR payment only, though.
review_3_text:
Used to come here everyday.
Great place to work with a laptop.
Good coffee. Reasonable prices.
Removed 2 stars because staff were unfriendly and always in a bad mood. Weird for a shop called "the friendly coffee bar"
review_4_text: This is a cute coffee shop with reasonable prices. I wish I would have found this place on my first day in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: Nice tea but the staff is rude, not a single smile when you enter or leave or any hospitality

name: Yourproject_
review_1_text: I found this café by chance while walking around Chiang Mai, and I really loved it. The guys working there were very kind and welcoming, and the coffee was really good, perfect for recharging and continuing to explore the city. A lovely little stop if you need a break during your wanderings☕☺️
review_2_text:
One of the most inspiring hidden spots in Chiang Mai!
Yourproject_ is a beautiful blend of a vintage boutique and a cozy coffee shop. You can sip a well-made cappuccino while browsing through curated vintage pieces - from fashion to unique home decor.
The space feels artistic and relaxed, with a touch of Tokyo-style aesthetics. Every visit brings something new.
I included it in my Chiang Mai recommendations - check it in profile!
review_3_text:
Great Vibe, lovely weird combo of interior design and coffee place with nice music, nice owner and last bn least: great coffee.
Loved the Tonic Espresso (will take that one home)!
review_4_text: I recently visited this coffee shop and I must say, it was a true gem. The coffee was amazing, and I was pleasantly surprised to find out that they also offered oat milk. The small corners filled with vintage furniture gave the place a cozy and unique atmosphere, reminiscent of Berlin. The music selection was also fantastic, with a great mix of hits. While the prices may be a bit higher than other places I've seen (100bts latte with out), the overall experience was well worth it. I highly recommend this coffee shop for its delicious coffee, charming ambiance, and excellent music. It's definitely a must-visit spot for coffee lovers.
review_5_text: What a place! Speciality coffee was very good, I got Ethiopia and what a flavor! My fiancé got matcha and it was the best matcha in town. Atmosphere inside so chill, some music, some vinyls to buy, really cool furniture. Highly recommend for matcha and coffee lovers. It’s a little bit more expensive but really worth it.

name: Craftsmanship Café
review_1_text:
I had Dirty ☕️ and it was great. It was little bit more sweet than on other places but I like it this way. This place has peaceful vibe in busy street 🙂

They also sell coffee beans 👍
review_2_text: Great vibes, tasty drinks, and a perfect spot to work and chill!
review_3_text: A lovely café with a great atmosphere and a beautiful view of Chiang Mai. They use locally grown Chiang Mai coffee beans, and the flavor is excellent. Definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: nice oasis

name: SipSpot
review_1_text: A very good coffee place with good vibes but also: the owner’s attitude to the clients. It’s like coming to someone’s home. I liked the details there and the taste. The only suggestion would be to make espresso as the last drink in the queue cuz I came with a friend who ordered flat white and when my espresso arrived it wasn’t hot but warm. Anyway, I’m extremely happy to visit this place and wanna come again!
review_2_text: Highly recommended. 1. I asked before ordering if the cold brew is light roasted, she said yes, but it turns out to be dark roasted and too bitter for me. She immediately made another coffee for me without any hesitation for free. 2. The new coffee, which is the lab sip, it’s good. 3. It’s very chill, sitting by the roadside but it’s not hot at all
review_3_text: The Arabica coffee roasted just nice and perfect taste with flavourful aroma... Just happened to walk by this shop and the ambience and the smell of the coffee captire my attention...  try out whenever you around this area...
review_4_text: One of the best flat whites that i have had in a while… and its open late which is nice for me who drinks coffee even at night
review_5_text:
The shop owner is adorable, you can tell she truly cares about everything she makes and wants you to enjoy it, you think you're ordering ice cream, but it's more than just ice cream.

I ended up helping them setup some decorations (which I hope don't fall down 😅) and she made me a sesame milkshake and it was amazing. One of my favorite spots in Chiang Mai

name: Seegate coffee
review_1_text: best coffee on this side of chiang mai!
review_2_text: Good coffee, good view, you can see Tha Phae Gate right away.
review_3_text: The coffee is good and the barista is lovely.
review_4_text: An alternative for coffee lovers around Tha Phae

name: Coffee Waan
review_1_text:
Without doubt the best coffee I’ve had in Thailand.
Someone actually knows how to make an espresso, served with a glass of water, without asking.
Highly recommend.
review_2_text: I've been to many coffee shops in Chiang Mai and Coffee Waan is the best one. The coffee quality is excellent. The location is small but cosy and has a nice vibe. The owner Waan is very friendly and will quickly become your friend. There is a large menu of drinks and most are between 40-50 thb, but the quality is higher than other places that charge much more. Highly recommend.
review_3_text: The coffee is great and the shop owner is very kind and friendly. We had a lovely chat whilst I was there and she immediately made me feel at home. The inside is small but cosy and there is some outdoor seating too. Also, the coffee is excellently priced!
review_4_text:
Coffee Waan: A Hidden Gem That Redefines Refreshment

In the bustling heart of Chiang Mai, where charming cafes abound, Coffee Waan stands out as an oasis of perfection—a tiny but mighty temple of taste. I stopped here for an Italian soda, having wisely decided it was too late in the day for coffee (a rare but necessary concession to my caffeine sensitivity). What I encountered was nothing short of extraordinary.

Let’s start with the Italian soda. Sure, it’s a simple beverage by nature, but here, it transcends its humble origins. Served not in the soulless confines of plastic but in a mason jar, this drink radiates class and authenticity. There is an inexplicable joy in sipping something served in real glass—it tastes better, feels better, and simply is better. The mason jar was a stroke of genius, a nod to rustic charm that perfectly aligns with the cafe's vibe. I felt like I was drinking the elixir of life.

The space itself is a cozy haven of charm. Every inch of this tiny cafe feels curated with love. The seating is snug and intimate, the lighting warm and inviting. The playlist? Absolute perfection. It's the kind of background music that makes you feel like the star of your own independent film, sitting there with your mason jar of soda, contemplating life's mysteries or maybe just the refreshing taste of your drink.

The staff? Attentive without being overbearing, radiating that rare combination of professionalism and warmth. Their smiles alone could power the cafe’s charm for a week.

To say Coffee Waan is worth a visit would be an understatement. Whether you’re here for coffee or for an impeccably served Italian soda, it’s an experience that reminds you that life’s pleasures are often found in the smallest details—like a mason jar that turns a simple drink into an unforgettable moment.
review_5_text: Went searching for a local coffee shop near my hotel during the earlier hours of the day! Great coffee and a nice environment to people watch and listen to the birds chirp! I didn’t grab her name, but the owner/barista did an awesome job at making me feel welcomed! Check it out!

name: ขนมเบื้องช้างม่อย (Deer Terminal)
review_1_text:
Located right in front of Seven Eleven.
They have a offer of coconut coffee with kanom Bueng.
It’s perfect snack after long walk from the Waroros market!
review_2_text:
Very good Coffee and service.
highly recommend
review_3_text: Thai tea is really good😊
review_4_text: Veryyyyy Delicioussssss
review_5_text: This cafe was one I'd walked past once before, but on my way back I just couldn't resist stopping by. The Thai crepes (Khanom Bueang) looked so tempting! They're 20฿ per piece, or 50฿ for a set of 5. Highly recommended! The cream is soft and subtly sweet, the batter is thin and crispy, and they're made fresh. I went when the shop wasn't busy, so I didn't have to wait long. The coffee was strong and definitely woke me up! The shop is decorated cutely and stylishly, with lots of photo opportunities. They also have ice cream, but I haven't tried it yet. If you're in the area, give it a try!

name: GRAPH X
review_1_text: Good coffee, great atmosphere 🤍
review_2_text: stumbled upon this place which had a matcha and pottery fair that weekend
review_3_text: Have a nice days🎀
review_4_text:
Spacious parking lot.
The cold brew coffee is delicious, and the pastries are tasty.
The shop is beautifully decorated.
There's an art gallery on the second floor.

name: Cafe blanco
review_1_text: Nice hidden 🍸 cocktaibar,good beers and wonderfull music 🎶 ...... lovely owner to
review_2_text: Love it !! Quiet little bar.. Owner is fabulous.
review_3_text: Relax and taste is better but cheaper than the other bar.
review_4_text: Many good food, good price.
review_5_text: I love it here, the vibe is so relaxed. I could sit and have drinks all night. 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥳

name: Eternity Coffee Thapae
review_1_text: Nice coffee place with a wide variety of coffee choices for all tastes. Super friendly and helpful staff who make coffee to taste. It may take a little time but it's worth the wait. Nice inside area and also has a few seats outside. The staff speak limited English but as we're in Thailand this isn't an issue for those who have been complaining in previous reviews. They also gave a few pastries options as well. Many different coffee offerings with a very expansive menu not really overpriced for what you're getting. Would highly recommend the signature coffee selections.
review_2_text:
I came to this coffee shop for the first time in October 2023 and visited it three times the entire week because of how good it was.

I came today in 2025 just to make sure it was still good. I think they got better!?!??

I ordered the emerald and it was one of the tastiest drinks I’ve had in a while. Highly recommend!!
review_3_text: Great coffee. Very smooth and level of strength can be choosen. The barista know how to make them right! Mot much option for food but enough. Most customers take away while we sit n soak in the 🎶 in a slow morning
review_4_text: Great coffee! Ordered a drip coffee using their local beans. It was served in a wine glass! I'm sure the glass helps with the aroma and taste. They also sell their own blend of beans and some from around the world. Very friendly staff.
review_5_text:
Seriously great Decaf Latte.
I've enjoyed a couple here lately and they just seem to get better.
Today's, 25/03/21, coffee was perfect. 👌☕

I've been to other Cafés and asked for a Decaf and am greeted with a blank stare of non comprehension. 😶
I walked in here and they just smiled and said, "sure". 😊

Coffee is ground fresh.
Presentation is great.
Staff are friendly and polite.

I'm glad to be a customer.

The new renovation is good.
There's a bathroom.
There's drinking water.
There's room to enjoy a moment to yourself.

name: scout.selected
review_1_text: I went to the pin and couldn't find it. I circled around twice, both driving and walking. Please fix it.

name: 清迈胡子叔最爱草药热茶
Cafe Soi
review_1_text: Dim Sum Buffet is pretty good. Steamed baby back ribs with black pepper was so tender and yummy. Both kinds of soups are mild. Shrimp Dumplings were lovely. Worth to try.
review_2_text: Just arrived for our guided trip with big bike tours. This Cafe located in the lobby of the hotel had a very delicious breakfast buffet with options for everyone. Even a few western style options for those still needing a balance of home and Thailand.
review_3_text: I had dinner once at restaurant. It was Dim sum buffet but just a few dim sum menu compared with other dim sum buffet that I have ever eaten. However a man who always serve us was friendly and his service was outstanding. He almost the one who cleared empty plates, refilled drinks and taking order. There was minor billing issue for billing. There is flyer in our room stated that inhouse guests could get 25% discount on this buffet but when I checked my bill, discount was not applied. When I asked staff, he asked me that I brought the flyer and presented to him. He said that other guests always brought the flyer to present at restaurant. Finally I got discount. But the point is flyer did now show anywhere that guests have to present flyer to staff to get discount.
review_4_text: I’m here for the Dim Sum lunch. The quality is very good, definitely worth the price asked. However the service seems slow. It’s only half full the capacity but many table still look around for their food. If you look for good Dim Sum in Chiang Mai, I could easily recommend this place.
review_5_text: Had a great time here. Staff super friendly and delicious food

name: Hangarr
review_1_text:
For travellers and locals alike, Hangarr is a seemingly undiscovered gem in the crown of Chiang Mai.

If you get as lucky as me you will get to meet Chol and his friends, maybe watch a movie, or watch a Chiang Mai sunset from one of the best rooftop outlooks in Chiang Mai.

Hangarr can be easily missed on the street and even if it looks closed give the door a try!

Update: Went back to watch the sun set and have a quiet drink on my last night in Chiang Mai. Was not disappointed.
review_2_text: The shop has different coffee beans for coffee lovers to choose. I had dripping coffee (single origin from Thailand). Good quality and inexpensive. The place is very cozy and homey. Friendly staffs.
review_3_text: Nice place , good service , private place but relax and chilling have rooftop , coffee or beer are both ,love it!
review_4_text: Very nice from rooftop!
review_5_text: The rooftop atmosphere is peaceful when you're alone, and relaxing when you're with friends.

name: Baimon Massage
review_1_text: Love this place so much me and a friend visited twice within 24 hours. We each got a foot massage and head, back, shoulder massage. Great relaxing environment and the friendliest staff I could ever imagine. And the price is great! If we had more time in Chiang Mai I'm sure we'd be back again tomorrow.
review_2_text: While the atmosphere downstairs can be a bit noisy when the door opens, the overall experience was phenomenal. My wife and I went here after a day of cooking class and it was just what the doctor ordered. We both highly recommend and will definitely be back!
review_3_text: Massagists are welcoming and kind and the atmosphere is very relaxing. After the massage they offer a cup of tea with pastry. I really enjoyed the experience!
review_4_text: I found the manager of the shop to be very rude with a bad attitude. She spoke rudely in Thai. Thinking that i could not understand. Quickly taking money off me and rushing me out of the door. I will not go back.
review_5_text: Had the 1h Thai massage and my girlfriend had foot, head, back & shoulder. Both top notch.

name: On the Way Coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee, great friendly service at a great price. What more does one need?!  Came here every morning for a week as I was staying at a nearby hotel. This coffee stand does not serve food. They have a few types of packaged cookies that look tasty. But people come for the fantastic drinks
review_2_text: Love this coffee shop. There were lots of locals when we went. The owner is so nice and welcoming. Cappuccino is flavourful, delicious and great price. We will come back every morning until we leave.
review_3_text: Great value real espresso coffee for 45b. Tastes great aswell!
review_4_text: Some of the best coffee of the city and at THE best price! Not every day but most days they also have very tasty sandwiches for only 25 baht. Always very friendly service also. I go here almost every day, love it :)
review_5_text: Amazing coconut water with black iced coffee! Lovely gentleman serving us as well. Good vibes!!

name: anamii.coffee X woody restaurant bar
review_1_text:
So in love with this hidden gem. Just walking along the phae road when suddenly found this little cool coffee shop for hangout.

My luck, the coffee was good, the service was top notch, the vibe is nice and the place is good for a hangout session.

Definitely will come again when i'm around.
review_2_text:
Absolutely loved the experience at Anamii.Coffee x Woody Restaurant Bar! The café side offers excellent coffee—smooth, rich, and clearly brewed with passion. Great spot to unwind or get some work done during the day.

Come evening, the vibe shifts perfectly into a stylish restaurant-bar setting. Friendly staff, great ambiance, and a unique dual-concept that really works.
Highly recommended when you’re in for a chill coffee break !!! 😃😃
review_3_text: The coffee is very delicious! The service is good and the barista is cute ^^
review_4_text: The best coffee in Chiang Mai made by the nicest Thai!! 🙏🏽🙏🏽
review_5_text: Cool menu and cold cocoa!!

name: เติมสุข Coffee Truck (กาดนัดจีนยูนนาน)
Wrapper Espresso Stand
review_1_text:
Good coffee and home made bakery. It’s located at the far end corner of Yunnan Friday Market which opens every Friday morning.
The two owners are very friendly. Boy, one of the owners has been making coffee for about 6 years. หลิน, the other owner loves bakery, and has been making bread since little.

name: Rich Homemade Cake Changmoi
review_1_text:
A cozy, minimalist café with a calm soul. Warm wood everywhere, soft light and that peaceful atmosphere where time seems to slow down 🌿
I ordered a coconut coffee and it was really good: smooth, well balanced, with a subtle tropical touch that fits Chiang Mai perfectly 🥥✨
A lovely place to sit, think, read, or simply enjoy the moment.
📍 Chiang Mai
💭 Would definitely come back ☺️😍
review_2_text: This was my second visit, after my first time in April 2025. This place serves the best dirty coffee I’ve found in Chiang Mai so far. The coconut pandan cake is a must-order and, in my opinion, the best item on the menu. The cake is fragrant, not overly sweet, and has pieces of coconut meat in the cream, which adds a great texture. I recommend visiting on a weekday or at a time when most people wouldn’t usually have dessert, as it can get quite crowded.
review_3_text:
Such a cozy and beautifully designed café! The atmosphere is warm and relaxing with its wooden interiors, soft lighting, and clean minimalist layout. The space feels very open and comfortable — perfect for studying, working, or just enjoying a quiet coffee break.

The pastry display looks amazing and everything is neatly presented. Staff are friendly and welcoming. I really like the attention to detail in the decor — simple but stylish, with a nice mix of rustic and modern touches. Definitely a great spot to chill or meet friends. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
The food was great, and I really enjoyed the coconut cake and dirty coffee. I would say the Americano with coconut water was not as good as we thought. The cafe is well-decorated with rustic interiors (natural wood), but with cutesy art pieces and postcards. You also get free stickers with purchases!

A great place to come sit and work or chat with friends.
review_5_text:
Such a cozy little spot with a beautifully warm, wooden interior and soft natural light.
The cakes are excellent: not overly sweet, well-balanced, and genuinely delicious. The coffee is just as good

name: The Story 106 Co-Working Space &Cafe
review_1_text:
Very quiet café, perfect for working or reading. The atmosphere is calm and cozy, ideal if you’re looking for a place to focus without distractions. Right next door there’s a lovely shop selling wooden accessories and small handcrafted items, perfect for home decor or as thoughtful gifts.
The staff is very friendly and welcoming. I ordered an organic cacao and it was delicious. Definitely a place to come back to 🧋☕🍪💕😊🫶
review_2_text: I visited here to quietly read and write. The coffee was delicious, but the atmosphere was also great. It seemed like many people came here alone to work or read. It's a perfect place for those who come alone!! Even if you're not alone, it's a great place for those who enjoy a quiet atmosphere!!
review_3_text: This place is a boutique cafe. The boutique has a plethora of hand craft wood work, from practical kitchen ware like chop sticks, ladles, photo frames and item meant for display.  The coffee and food is the main draw for me.  Latte from espresso machine with a selection of light roast to dart roast. The medium roast is entirely Thai local coffee beans with a medium body and nutty flavour. Pastries are great too. Banana croffle, mango sticky rice we had were well presented and look really nice. A place to hang out for 2 hours, browsing through the wood crafts and enjoy the latte and pastries. The wall was well decorated. Highly recommended.
review_4_text:
Got the whole space to ourselves on a Saturday morning at Level 1. Started the day with their bakes and coffee.

Presentation of food when served was nice, but the food was so-so. WiFi credentials are only provided after payment is made. Latency is fast!

Credit cards are accepted, though there is a 3% surcharge for card payments.
review_5_text: A charming, quiet, and private co-working space — perfect for boosting productivity and creativity. The coffee is excellent, and the breakfast is a great bonus. Highly recommended for anyone seeking focus and inspiration.

name: Still.Coffee&Life
review_1_text:
A hidden café with city views.
To get there, you need to enter through a clothing store and go up to the fifth floor, which already makes it a bit different. The space has a minimalist, warehouse-style design that feels clean and well thought out.
It’s a quiet, tidy place, ideal for reading or working on your laptop. The city views add a nice touch without being overwhelming.
The service is good and friendly, and everything feels well organized. A comfortable spot to spend some time in💕✨☕
review_2_text:
I found this coffee shop thanks to a recommendation from someone I met during a tour yesterday. It is very hidden inside a clothes market, and you have to climb all the way up to the 4th floor. Honestly, while walking up the stairs, I kept doubting myself and wondering if I was going the right way.

But once you reach the top, you will be rewarded with a cozy space, great vibes, and really good coffee. The journey makes it even more special. Definitely worth the adventure if you love unique, tucked-away cafés. Highly recommended! ☕✨
review_3_text:
We spotted this cafe on Google Maps and decided to check it out and were pleasantly surprised by how good the drinks were.

We ordered the Rainy Pink and Haven't We Met and were truly impressed by the flavour profiles and presentation of the drinks.

Highly recommend popping by for drinks if you're in the area.
review_4_text:
I love this place, it's a bit hidden but makes it even more interesting place to visit! It's somehow industrial modern but the mall around it has some post-apocalyptic vibes.
The place itself is spacious and super clean, very pleasant subtle music is playing, AC had perfect temperature.
They have some vibrant coffee variations. I tried the Orange-Apricot espresso, 10/10.
review_5_text: A nice place with good coffee to stop at and take a break from exploring Chinatown. It’s kind of hidden on the 4th floor, but a good spot to get out of the crowds.

name: Issara Coffee Space
review_1_text:
Issara Coffee is one of those rare places that instantly makes you slow down and appreciate where you are. Tucked away in Chiang Mai, it perfectly captures the calm, soulful charm of the city while still delivering coffee that easily rivals some of the best cafés anywhere in the world.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels intentional and warm — minimal without being cold, cozy without feeling cramped. There’s a beautiful balance between modern design and local character, and it feels like a space made for conversation, reflection, or quietly enjoying a really good cup of coffee. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick espresso or planning to sit for a while, Issara makes you feel welcome.

The coffee itself is outstanding. You can tell there’s real care behind every cup, from the quality of the beans to the precision in how everything is brewed. The flavors are clean, smooth, and well-balanced, with none of the bitterness you sometimes get at more touristy spots. If you’re someone who genuinely appreciates coffee — not just caffeine — this place delivers. Their specialty drinks are thoughtfully crafted, and even the basics are executed perfectly.

What really elevates Issara Coffee is the attention to detail and service. The staff are knowledgeable, friendly, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They’re happy to explain different beans or brewing methods without being pretentious, which makes the experience feel personal and relaxed rather than intimidating.

Issara Coffee feels like the kind of place locals return to again and again, which says a lot. It’s not trying too hard to be trendy — it just focuses on quality, atmosphere, and consistency, and that’s what makes it special. If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a café that combines excellent coffee, thoughtful design, and a calm, authentic vibe, Issara Coffee is absolutely worth your time. It’s easily a standout and a place I’d go out of my way to visit again.
review_2_text: Dirty Coffee is one of the best that I’ve ever tasted, with the cozy lounge and some workshop space, here is a must visit cafe when you visit CNX 🥤
review_3_text: Such delicious single origin coffee! Their anaerobic washed beans were super clean and fragrant - can’t wait to try the others!
review_4_text:
Good post cards, really special and unique design, you can find something you like here.
Coffee is ok, just have a cup of hot latte, to be honest most coffee shops in Chiangmai are very good.
Pretty little store.
review_5_text: Very cute coffee shop + misc store. Mainly writing to say that they have oat milk because I couldn’t find it in any other reviews lol. Iced latte is 85 baht and +15 for alt milk. Highly recommend! Also, the staff is super sweet :)

name: Chapter 2WO
review_1_text: What an incredible hidden gem. Its down a little side road. Its a little jungle/forset setting. Very welcoming and green. The music is great. The coffee flavor is bold but not bitter. The atmosphere makes me want to sit here forever. They also have big turtles!!!!! Like alive turtles doing turtle things in a big pit. 12/10 recommend oh and the prices are great and the coffee art is beautiful
review_2_text: It's cool and very green place in the open air. The cats on the logo actually live there and act like real stars. They also have tortoises which was a bit if a surprise. Coffee is good with some very interesting recipes and varieties. Could use more pastry selection imo but he Korean bun was still amazing
review_3_text: I’ve put this coffee shop on my Google map for a long time, but didn’t get the chance to go. Today went there with friends and we really enjoyed the atmosphere! The cats were very cute, I’ll definitely go there again!
review_4_text:
Peaceful green heaven.  I am not sure if a 5 star review and attracting more people here is a good idea but it is just beautiful.
Don't confuse with the neighbours... this place is better 😂
review_5_text: Cozy and quiet café with a lovely green space surrounded by plants. Good coffee and friendly staff. Perfect place to relax with a coffee and read a book 🫖☕🍰🍮

name: Blue & Teak eatery. Stay. Space
review_1_text:
Had a lovely English breakfast at Blue & Teak today. The portion size was generous and really filling — proper comfort food done right. Everything tasted fresh and well-prepared, just what you want from a hearty breakfast.

The staff were warm and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Great vibes overall — relaxed atmosphere, good energy, and a perfect spot to start the day.

Definitely recommended if you’re craving a solid English breakfast with friendly service. Would happily come back again.
review_2_text:
I absolutely loved the time I spent here! The vibe is so positive, especially with the large glass windows looking out onto the street. It feels very peaceful with the minimalist wooden decor.

The menu is varied and reasonably priced. I ordered the Caesar salad, and as a baker and pastry chef myself, I have to say the sourdough bread was excellent! I also had the overnight oats with fruit and honey. It was delicious and packed with vitamins and fiber to start the day.

The service was impeccable: fast, and the waitresses were incredibly kind and kept smiling the whole time. The place is spotless. I highly recommend it!
review_3_text: Visited this place three times during our four day stay in Chiang Mai. Absolutely loved it. Staff super super friendly. Very nice vibe. Food was fantastic. My regular one was the creme cheese salmon croissant. My family had a few sour dough options - tried them all and absolutely fantastic. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
This is a really lovely cafe with excellent food and warm service! It is run by really nice and hardworking people who serve with high quality standards in mind.

The food was overall really delicious and of good quality! A special mention for the Thai Basil Aglio Olio! I was craving for a good aglio olio and Blue & Teak’s was perfect with a special hint of local flavors. The penne was a little overcooked for my liking but the tomato sauce and sausage was super yummy! I loved everything I ate here and even went twice so I could try more. Their menu was well-designed by the chef and the food was of high quality.

I highly recommend Blue & Teak if you need yummy food with great and friendly service and a cosy atmosphere to people watch or to chill. The location is really great too as there are cute streets and shops nearby!
review_5_text: Wonderful experience! We had the French toast and the egg bacon croissant. Everything we ate was delicious and the staff were so kind and attentive.  I wish I could remember our servers name, she was so sweet and kind. Definitely recommend.

name: attika studio Café & Workshop
review_1_text: Wonderful place to connect 🤍I've joined their workshops several times and it's so much fun! Ranging from dance, art therapy, natural colour art, candle making, midday sketch, all has been an incredible opportunity to meet and get to know likeminded individuals. The place itself is so homey and the staffs are kind and helpful! Looking forward to a soap making lesson next!
review_2_text: Absolutely love this cafe. The coffee tastes amazing. The mood and tone of the place are so cozy and welcoming, it’s perfect for relaxing. The owner is super friendly and kind, which makes the experience even better. She also offers a variety of fun workshops like candle-making and more, which gives the cafe a really creative and community-friendly vibe. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!
review_3_text:
Passed by Thapae Street, this cozy café is a true charms for those who love a warm, natural ambiance. The soft sunlight streams through large windows, gently illuminating the beautifully crafted wooden décor that gives the space a homey, peaceful feel.
Perfectly for snap a shot for your IG

The Attika Studio also has creative workshops weekly! what a perfect spot for your day-off as well, I had join one of the workshop and definitely returned for more !
