Highly recommended :)
review_4_text: My husband and I joined a bracelet workshop at attika studio and had a lovely time. Super cute space, good coffee and friendly atmosphere. Recommended.
review_5_text:
One of my favorite spots to work in Chiang Mai! The cafe has a peaceful, minimal vibe with lots of natural light and well-designed seating. The Wi-Fi is fast and stable, making it perfect for getting work done or having video calls.

Tried their iced coffee with tiramisu cream super unique and delicious. Friendly staff, great music, and just the right kind of quiet.

Highly recommend for remote workers or anyone looking for a cozy corner to focus or relax!

name: Kilim Coffee House
review_1_text: A lovely Turkish-style coffee shop with a beautifully rich and bold coffee flavor. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, The shop is exceptionally clean and well maintained, which makes the visit even more pleasant. A wonderful spot for anyone who appreciates strong coffee, great ambiance, and attention to detail. Highly recommended:)
review_2_text:
A very nice getaway from the noontime sun after shopping in the Warorot Market.

Turkish style decorations. Both indoor air conditioning and open air seating. Nice coffee. And the boss is very friendly. Reasonable price.

Carpet everywhere. So please take off your shoes before entering.
review_3_text: I visited the place from a friend’s recommendation, mainly to try the Turkish coffee, and I’m so glad I did. The place gives a delightful reflection of Turkish culture, not just in the drinks but also in the decor, ambience and honestly feels like you’ve stepped into another corner of the world. I’d happily recommend it to anyone looking for a café with a unique and culturally rich vibe.
review_4_text: I was on the hunt for a good coffee spot and came across this cafe on Google Maps, so I decided to give it a try. The place had a charming Turkish theme, and the barista shared that he had just returned from Turkey. He even offered a Turkish snack to pair with our coffee, adding an authentic touch to the experience. The cafe has a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere, perfect for lingering and chatting for hours. Highly recommend checking it out!
review_5_text:
I recently visited an amazing authentic Arabic-style cafe located in the Chinese Market area. From the first steps inside, you feel as if you are transported to another world - a world of oriental fairy tales, comfort and tranquility.

The interior is thought out to the smallest detail.

I would especially like to note the third floor - this is a real oasis. A relaxing atmosphere reigns here, where you can slowly enjoy a cup of aromatic Masala tea served in an exquisite teapot. The spicy, rich taste of tea perfectly matches the overall harmony of this place.

If you are looking for a place to relax your soul, immerse yourself in oriental culture and have leisurely conversations - this cafe is definitely worth a visit! Special thanks to gpt chat for choosing the words

Remember about a problem with parking.

name: Chaiyee Coffee
review_1_text:
Excellent Stay at Chaiyee Coffee!

My stay at Chaiyee Coffee was excellent. I stayed here for about two and half weeks and really don't have anything to complain. The location is perfect, within walking distance of many food markets and just few mins from the famous Sunday Night Market at Thaphae Gate.

The accommodation itself is very clean and well-maintained. I really appreciated the comfortable bed, reliable WiFi, and handy basic kitchen utilities. The owner, Winn, ensured a smooth check-in with clear instructions, and amenities like free towels and room service were great touches.

While it's next to a main road and can be a little noisy in the evening, the sound subsides quickly and was never very disruptive. The shared bathroom was kept very neat.

I highly recommend Chaiyee Coffee for a convenient, comfortable, and well-hosted stay in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: Great value for money. The room was spacious and clean, the accommodation was cozy, and the location was unbeatable—very close to the night market, where you can eat really well. Highly recommended.
review_3_text:
If I could sign a three- or six-month lease here, I would!
I stayed at Chayinee Coffee during my time in Chiang Mai, and it was genuinely one of the most convenient and comfortable stays I’ve had in the city. The rooms are always impeccably clean, the service is consistently warm and welcoming, and the location couldn’t be better. It’s clear the team here takes great pride in maintaining the space. I only wish they offered long-term stays—I’d absolutely sign up for a monthly contract in a heartbeat. Highly recommend for travelers looking for a calm, cozy spot with great energy and even better hospitality.
review_4_text:
Returned to stay at this place in Chiangmai on 26Dec- 31 Dec 2024 after a superb experience stay with my friends in Nov24.

Excellent location; easy access to amenities. All within walking distances.

Stayed with my 2 kids without any safety issue although I was regretful about my conduct towards Mr Win on the last day.

Mr Win was gracious and generously kind and forgave me. Thank you

Super thumbs up to this hostel.

It was Price, Location, Comfort all stacked in the tenants favor.

Child friendly, I don't know if it's pets friendly because It is just too troublesome to bring your pet overseas.

Nice place, nice people, nice recommendations.

Love it!
review_5_text:
Very nice room in a very good location to experience Chiang Mai. All the amenities you could wish for were available.
Amazing staff, we were able to have a shower the day we checked out, they preserved our towels for us which they absolutely didn't have to do.
Fully recommended!

review_1_text: The best hidden café in Chiang Mai. Honestly, I kind of want to keep this place to myself—I’m afraid it’ll get too crowded 😅. I haven’t had a single drink here that wasn’t good. The service is excellent, and the music is thoughtfully selected—great vibes without disturbing your reading. Absolutely perfect for sitting and relaxing for hours. 😭❤️
review_2_text:
I really like it

coffee and brownies available

Air conditioned
Comfortable tables and chairs

review_4_text: Soft cookie tastes very good. Atmosphere and surroundings are really nice. Very recommended!
review_5_text: Perfect place for working online. This cafe has good WiFi and reasonable prices. It's not busy most of the time, so it will be ideal for your online work. There's a bell to literally wake up the barista, and the service is quite fast. I would definitely come back. I had a hot Thai milk tea and a hot Thai tea and a brownie. The place as many sockets and big tables so you'll be comfortable and your devices charged up.

Banviang Coffee
review_1_text: Had my best experience with coffeeshop owner / stuff in Chiangmai! Living here for 6 month, this is the best I had. The owner cares about his coffee and his customers. Yes. The care matters the most! Holding door to let me in, holding on to make coffee till my husband arrives, and speaking humblely about his coffee. But it's indeed terrific! We both ordered hot latte. It's definitely the best we had here. The shop have around 4 tables inside with AC provided and several seats outside. I love the atmosphere in the shop. Super friendly owner, and very nice lovely old customers. The owner even helped his customers with their Thai language. How thoughtful! I won't expect more in a coffee shop. So thankful for the afternoon time spent there. Made a sketch while talking with them. Will definitely go back to see my friends there!
review_2_text: The orange and coconut were crazy fresh and sweet — just perfect. And the coffee? So fresh with great body. This tiny café had that warm Thai vibe I love… smiles, kindness, everything. Out of my 10 days in Chiang Mai, this place made me the happiest for sure. 💛✨
review_3_text: So nice owner Po. Coffee&cookies is yummy. Also unique hand crafted bracelets, anklets.
review_4_text:

The shop has coconut americano, which is the combination of fresh coconut juice with a shot of espresso.
Mango smoothies without sugar still has the natural sweetness.
The shop owner is nice.
review_5_text:

But to be honest there’s no air conditioning so if you come on a summer day it’s really hot.

The big portion of mango smoothie is really pure and sweet , love it.
So if you are wondering in town , just come.

This coffee shop is so good! ☕️ The taste is amazing, prices are super reasonable, and the place has a cute minimal vibe with a small outdoor area. It can get a bit hot during the day, but in the late afternoon it’s perfect, great light, cozy atmosphere, and totally Instagram-worthy 📸

Located right inside Kad Luang Market, Chiang Mai, it’s a must-try spot for coffee lovers. Don’t miss this one!! highly recommended! 💛
review_2_text: A nice little café inside the market. The atmosphere is cozy and local. There’s no air-conditioning, but it’s airy enough to sit and enjoy a drink. There are only a few tables, but the location is very convenient — right by the market, easy to stop by after shopping or to grab some souvenirs. The coffee is really good!
review_3_text: After a little adventure following Google Maps through Chiangmai's narrow streets, we arrived at this charming coffee shop located in a small soi. *no parking car here
review_4_text: Coconut latte is absolutely amazing! Really nice coffee break in the market
review_5_text: Now that was an incredible coconut matcha ! 😍

If you're near Warorot Market, this is a lovely spot for a cup of coffee (or two). It’s both a roaster and a cafe, so the quality is top-notch.

I really liked being able to choose between various roasts, and the prices are very reasonable for such a specialty feel.

The rustic decor gives the place a great vibe, and there’s even a massage and spa upstairs if you need a break from walking. Just a stone’s throw from the market, it’s the perfect pit stop to recharge.
review_2_text: Roaster and cafe. Good coffee. Good ambience. Next to Waroros market. Great stop in between. Prices good relative to tourist trap cafes (50 for capoucino). And you can choose the roast.
review_3_text: Great staff and wonderful shop complete with coffee roasting oven that is a work of art.  The dark roast cappuccino is perfect.  Prices are good.
review_4_text: Great coffee…! Excellent price, and lovely being in the vibe of Wororos Market
review_5_text: Really good coffee 🩷

name: Kadluang Cafe & Roaster
review_1_text:
I honestly can’t say enough good things about this place. The coffee is consistently excellent, expertly roasted, beautifully brewed, and always fresh. On top of that, the prices are incredibly reasonable, especially for the quality you’re getting.

The staff are warm, welcoming, and genuinely care about every customer. Service is always fast, friendly, and professional, which makes every visit a pleasure.

And as if the café wasn’t already amazing enough, the massage upstairs is fantastic. It’s clean, relaxing, and the therapists are highly skilled. It’s the perfect way to recharge after enjoying a great coffee.

I’ve been here at least five times now, and I keep coming back for a reason. This place has become one of my absolute favorites. Great coffee, great value, great people, and a great atmosphere. Highly recommended to anyone in the area.

Excellent selection of local beans, through different processes and roasts.

The light roasts from Chiang Mai are out of this world ✌️

first time visit here, hopeful that there will be next 🥰

review_1_text: While strolling through the Warorot market, I really wanted to drink Thai milk tea. I kept smelling the aroma of Thai tea, and only after smelling it closely did I realize that it was coming from a jewelry store. I thought it was very special, so I went in and bought coffee and Thai milk tea. I found it to be surprisingly delicious!

name: Fruits Shake
review_1_text:
100% Fresh Fruit Smoothie
Freshly squeezed orange juice, whole apples.

name: Best Thai Tea @Warorot Market
review_1_text: I came on December 28, 2025 and there was absolutely no queue. One serving cost 30 yuan.
review_2_text:
Traditional Thai-style coffee and tea. I ordered Thai iced tea for only 30 baht per glass. The taste was not too sweet and had a distinct tea aroma, typical of Thai iced tea. It's recommended to come before 2:00 PM, as it can sell out quickly on some days. Overall, it's worth a try (parking is difficult for cars, so find a parking spot).
Traditional Thai-style coffee and tea: I ordered Thai iced tea for only 30 baht per glass. The taste was not too sweet and had a distinct tea aroma, typical of iced tea. You should try it before 2:00 PM, as it can run out very quickly on some days. We were told we should come and try it (parking is very difficult for cars). Find a place to park your car.
review_3_text:
I just asked the roadside vendors, and they said the old man has stopped selling after the flood and has closed down, so don't go there empty-handed!

But you can buy the coconut ice cream next door; it's very refreshing (50g).
review_4_text:
Our tour leader, A, said the coffee was delicious, but it sold out! 😆😆😆 So we all bought #ThaiMilkTea. It was really good~~~ I think it had about 45 tea pearls.

⭐️Yoyo's Dietary Reference:
Sweet: Half-sweet for hand-shaken drinks > Occasionally 30% sweet
Salty: Quite salty
Spicy: Medium spicy
review_5_text: It tastes so good🥹Many people line up to buy it, the Thai milk flavor is strong and very fragrant! I will come to drink it and recommend it to everyone🥰The price is cheap and affordable!

name: MEDELLÍN - Yes, we cannabis (420 weed shop 大麻 마리화나)
review_1_text: Best cannabis lounge in Chiang Mai by far. Great atmosphere, friendly staff, and a pool table upstairs along with a balcony that overlooks the street. They also serve delicious food. Try the Oreo milkshake and butter chicken with garlic naan😋
review_2_text:
Very nice and chill place with a lot of space and great atmosphere. You can sit upstairs, play billiards, enjoy drinks or snacks, and even go out to the balcony to smoke – which is very rare in Chiang Mai!

I really like their original and creative packaging – small “egg” jars that keep the smell perfectly sealed, super practical for storage. Big plus for that!

They offer a good selection of strains – both indoor and outdoor, all Thai-grown, plus sometimes imported ones from Amsterdam. When I was there, they had two hash types, which is great – not every shop has that!

Prices are fair:

Outdoor from 70 THB

Indoor from 300 THB to 450 THB

Quality is very nice – great smell, clean burn, good effect.
The owner has been running coffee shops in Chiang Mai for years – this is already his second location, and you can really feel the experience and passion.

Also, the owner is extremely friendly, polite, and VERY HELPFUL – speaks very good English, so it’s easy to communicate and ask about strains or recommendations.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for authentic Thai weed, good hash, and a comfortable chill spot to relax. 🌿💨
review_3_text: Really loved the vibe here 🌿✨ Super cozy spot with a nice chill atmosphere, good music, and that neon cannabis sign giving the whole place a cool touch. The staff are friendly, the seating is comfortable, and the menu has some fun options to try (the shakes are a win). Perfect spot to just relax, hang out, and spend time without any rush. Definitely worth coming back.
review_4_text: Big shop with very friendly staff. Great selection of both outdoor and indoor items. There is even a room for smoking. Good prices and regular promotions.
review_5_text: Good selections of weed. Tukta, the store owner was very nice to me. Ask about their deals as they aren’t written anywhere. I got three hybrid joints for 500 baht. Cash only.

name: Khagee
review_1_text:
A hidden gem in Chiang Mai. Everything was perfect: the lemon tart had the right amount of sourness and looked beautiful, the scones were excellent, and the coffee was great. The environment was lovely and quiet, though they only accept cash.

Definitely worth a visit!
review_2_text:
A lovely spot in Chiang Mai. The atmosphere inside is calm and cozy—. Their pastries are delicious, especially the carrot cake (highly recommend!).

Coffee is well made, and the hot chocolate/cocoa is rich and tasty. The whipped cream is a bit dense, but if you like it creamy, you’ll love it 100%!

The only downside is there’s no dedicated parking, so you’ll have to park along the street. On rainy days, getting in can be a bit messy. But once inside, the warm smiles and kind service from the staff make you forget the hassle right away.
review_3_text: Classic Chiang Mai coffee house with wonderful patisserie. Coffee and bagel were taste very good and fresh. Staff had very good attitude. The place looks clean and inviting, simple yet interesting.
review_4_text:
Khagee never disappoints. Calm relaxed atmosphere.

Delicious well made coffee served a variety of ways.  Fresh baked goods & food.
review_5_text: Great atmosphere. Staff are attentive and helpful. Drinks are above par to me. Lemon tarts is quite good, it is sour dominant. Unfortunately not quite lemony as I expected.

name: Heart Together.cnx (สาขา2)
review_1_text:
Been here for matcha and hojicha twice.
The service from both the lady and the guy behind the counter was very pleasant and friendly both visits and the drinks are pretty good. Haven't tried their food just yet and although I think they could work on a cozier/inviting lighting inside this place is perfect for a quick caffeine fix.
review_2_text: Ridiculous experience. Waited for over 40mins and then got told one of the order cannot be served. And the other order finally came without included toast and drink. Mentioned it and still did not come. Our patience ran out after 1 hour being there having nothing in the stomach. Horrible way to start the day.
review_3_text: awesome place for a coffee & a fruit bowl 😋
review_4_text: The brunch-style plates served at the hotel next door are delicious. The staff are also very friendly!
review_5_text:
The atmosphere is great, perfect for chilling out.
This time I came during the day and had drip coffee, hojicha, and their signature menu item. It looked exactly like the picture, and tasted delicious and refreshing.
Next time I come to chill at night, I'll write another review! 🍷🥰

name: Lion bike wash & Coffee shop
review_1_text: Latte yen (iced coffee) is sooo good, and comes at a great price. One of my favourite cafes in Chiang Mai

name: Minced - Cafe & Garden
review_1_text: Wow, what a wonderful little cafe down a side street in Chiang Mai. I had the Pancakes, Scrambled Eggs and Bacon which was terrific and filling. First time I have had bacon in Thailand that was cooked perfectly (it is usually burnt beyond recognition but this was great). My wife had a Build Your Own Salad Bowl. She chose grilled chicken with sauteed vegetables, feta cheese and sweet BBQ sauce. The flavours were amazing and she didn't want it to end.
review_2_text:
It's fine, quite good. You have to pay cash, no cards accepted.
Pancakes and waffles are the main thing. I'd go waffles next time as the pancake wasn't quite to my liking (a little too dry and sweet, but that may be because of wat I had it with)
review_3_text:
Definitely one of my most favorite place for breakfast and coffee in Chiang Mai. I came here several times, the spaghetti with meatballs and the pancakes where outstanding, by far the best I have had in Thailand.
The service was always fast and friendly as well. If you are looking for a comfortable place with a lovely little garden and super yummy food + coffee this place is perfect.
review_4_text: I had the best breakfast in Chiang Mai here. Tried their Thai style coffee and the red curry here was more authentic than other places and tasted good. Also this place is well air-conditioned, has free wifi and is comfortable for working with laptop for long hours
review_5_text:
A completely new cafe on the site that for many years was 'Guitar Man' - a well-known and respected venue in Chiang Mai for many years.  Sadly missed.

This is a spacious, comfortable cafe inside with a cute outside garden area adjacent.  It offers a varied, mainly breakfast, menu plus a range of coffees and teas.  Easily found on Loi Kroh road (river end), next to OMG.

There is an amusing touch of humour in the toilet, which makes a change.

I can't speak for the food yet, which looks good, but I thought the coffees were small and a bit pricey.

name: es•pe•cial Coffee Bar
review_1_text: Small beautiful coffee shop but fully of coffee quality. Mostly of Signature menu are served with cold but hot coffee was amazing too. Taste of coffee was really nice that they served with warm water on bronze plate with shop logo. If you have no idea which coffee you want, you can ask for suggestion from staffs.
review_2_text: Stunning with the decoration in the café especially the antique Lion Sculpture from India. Light roast arabica coffee beans extracted from one of the hi-end espresso machine brand, La Marzocco. Great coffee. Good vibe and great ambience. Very friendly staff.
review_3_text: My family and I have been traveling the world for 6 months; three of which were in Europe.  We serendipitously discovered this little oasis because we were in the Bridge Hotel (next door and somehow connected) and they served us a latte from es.pe.cial.  It was one of the best lattes in our travels so far and then we were hooked!  Amazing flavor with gourmet beans, very tranquil atmosphere, friendly service, and a cute little garden in back where you can sit and drink your amazing drink. We spent a lot of time hanging out there when we needed to get business/email done.   The internet was good at about 120Mbit/s (I test this everywhere we go :). It is also right next to the Nawarat Bridge, which is a great place to visit along the way.
review_4_text: A wonderful little coffee shop! This coffee shop has extremely tasty and innovative coffee you’ll be hard-pressed to find anywhere else. I am so happy I came here! The barista behind the counter was really happy and friendly, and the shop is decorated very well. I got the Fig Me Up cold brew coffee, and it had actual figs inside, alongside some other interesting syrups that made it so, so good! Definitely one of the most unique (and best) cold coffee drinks I have ever had! I can’t wait to go back and try all of the others. So many looked incredible. Awesome place; highly recommend!!
review_5_text: Lovely coffee shop. Hot Americano is delicious food quality and the sunset cold brew with orange is delicious on a hot day. Very nice bathrooms as it is attached to a hotel. Everything very beautiful and aesthetic. Great place to while away a few hours and staff very kind. You need cash unless payment reaches over 500 baht, at which point card payments accepted

name: Bella Goose Coffee at Alt_PingRiver
review_1_text:
Bella Goose is top notch.
Grab the piccolo for a silky, well-balanced coffee. If you’re not feeling caffeine, the honey lemon soda is refreshing and perfect for cooling down.
The staff really make this place special—so friendly and welcoming.

This is a great spot to get work done. Similar vibe but much smaller than their Hill location.
review_2_text: If you are looking for a western/American dirty chai, this spot makes a delicious one! Finding a chai tea latte in Thailand has been a search, but this spot is delicious! They also have fantastic rocky road & salted caramel cookies!
review_3_text: Arguably one of the best places for breakfast in Chiang Rai - fantastic menu and even better coffee. Should be on your must visit list of chiang mai if you’re doing a cafe crawl.
review_4_text: Mod is the best barista ever!! So accommodating and makes a good matcha - 10/10!
review_5_text: Really love this cafe! Gorgeous natural light, a calming atmosphere and really tasty coffee and pastries. Staff is always friendly and welcoming!

name: Flo Coffee Brewers
review_1_text: This award-winning cafe in Chiang Mai is a must-visit for every coffee lover. They offer a varieties selection of beans with both speed and slow bar options to suit your style. The shop is beautifully decorated, and serves some of the best coffee in the city. If you're looking for a perfect cup in a great atmosphere, don't miss this place!!!
review_2_text: Amazing coffee omg!! We had the medium and dark roast and both were really good. Finally a good flat white. Prices are not too expensive and the vibes are really cute!
review_3_text: This wonderful cafe is worthy of its awards, and it should get one for its welcoming service too! It really feels like a coffee lab and the antique atmosphere only makes the coffee taste better. Pop in for a cup and stay for two!
review_4_text: I went to Chiang Mai after years and checked out this cafe. The place has its own vibe and the staff were really lovely. Even though it was hot, I still grabbed a flat white. It was soooooo good.
review_5_text: An Americano made with lightly roasted beans is priced at 120 THB per cup, which feels a bit expensive compared to the taste. Aside from that, the atmosphere and service are both excellent.

name: Building A
review_1_text: This place is so relaxing and slightly hidden. The only thing I would say is the coffee wasn’t hot enough to my liking but overall a good vibe
review_2_text: Amazing space to eat, chill, relax, meet friends… excellent Thai tea, I’m sure their coffee is great too. Perfect vibes. Loved it!
review_3_text: A unique and pleasant coffee shop hidden on the second floor of an old building. Coffee and a special selection of non-coffee drinks and bakery are offered at a reasonable price. Don’t miss it if you are in Chiangmai. 🤩
review_4_text:
On the 2nd floor sharing space with Me&Bacon.
Good coffee. Premium Beans. Cheap Price. Nice decoration. Open quite late. Open time 9AM is more for tourist time not local
review_5_text:
Cool space - very hipster! Lovely place to take photos when the light shines in. Fab place to sit, do some work and chill.

The coffee was okay, I got a tiramisu latte which was a nice twist! However… didn’t really taste too much like coffee which was strange? Very milky. The cocoa non-coffee drink was also okay - but again, on the milkier side.

name: Love At First Bite
review_1_text: I've been spending my winters in Chiang Mai for over 10 years. This café is everytime a must for me. The coffee, tea, and desserts are simply superb. What I also particularly appreciate is the lovely outdoor seating area. It has a jungle-like garden, a terrace, and a beautiful waterfall, all in a peaceful and relaxed atmosphere. There's also an air-conditioned room. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The real stars are the freshly made desserts. They're among the best in Chiang Mai. So do yourself a favor and stop by for a nice cup of coffee and try a dessert. You won't be disappointed. There's a dedicated parking area.
review_2_text: This is a beautiful little cafe with a large selection of cakes and a smaller menu of delicious main courses. I loved the cheese cake and the chicken dish I ordered here. Definitely a place if looking for a cake too
review_3_text: Visited here whilst in Chiang Mai for cheesecake and absolutely loved it. Huge variety of cakes, perfect if you have a sweet tooth. As someone who considers themselves a connoisseur of cheesecakes, the New York style was a 10/10. The outdoor seating amongst plants and flowers also provided a beautiful and calming atmosphere. Will definitely be back.
review_4_text:
A pleasant green oasis in the heart of the city with fantastic staff and a refreshing mist to cool you down on hot days.

It might be a few Baht more expensive than other places, but you get what you pay for.

They serve coffee, smoothies, cakes, pastries, lunch...
review_5_text:
So I ordered online.  I walked in the door, and the ladies working was having a good time💃💃

As soon as I walked into the door, I was met with the display refrigerator holding all the cakes and dessert.

I got the big carrot cake with walnuts. It was worth the 200 baht.
It's worth the value of what you would pay for a single slice.

It tasted so amazing.  😋
I'm a foodie at heart, and I'll be back for that rum bread pudding

name: คัลท์ คาเฟอีน (Cult Caffeine)
review_1_text: What made me want to try this spot? The name. The interior is honestly insane. Definitely an experience. As you walk in you're greeted by a wall of posters and old school telephones with cute messages on them. You walk through the doorway, mirrors on your left and a massive open space to your right. Incredibly tall ceiling. More art. A bar. A small shop selling Tees, keychains, caps. Then you slide the door open to the coffee shop with clinical stainless steel seating, a small baked goods selection and your go-to coffee orders and a sign that says we should thank Buddha for caffeine. Perk: getting to choose your beans. Light, medium or dark roast. Super cool experience. This place must be an absolute vibe at night.
review_2_text: The owner only allows employees to serve coffee in single-use cups, said the employee. I do not support a business that chooses to create more waste. The world will benefit from businesses making small choices to reuse instead of throwing out. I hope this invokes positive change. Lots of love.
review_3_text:
Good drinks, but even better vibes! The shop is decorated so beautifully and it’s super peaceful inside. Highly recommend for anyone who loves taking photos.
you'll get amazing shots here.
review_4_text: Perfect spot for coffee. Good service decent coffee n chill ambience. Can work too.
review_5_text: A chill spot with good taste. 🤩🥤

name: la.moon cold cafe
review_1_text: I got a dirty coffee and seriously, it's the best one in Chiang Mai. I had the best in Shanghai, but this one also has that flavor that changes with every sip. The only thing is the glass should be chilled, the milk should be cold, and the ice is a bit of a problem, but everything else is really well made. I'd totally recommend it.
review_2_text:
The outside of this store doesn't look big.

As a result, I didn't know until I went in that there was another cave.

Three areas are connected together.

It's a spacious cafe in Chiang Mai.

Due to my coffee shop bad habits

I directly ordered medium roasted hot American coffee without thinking.

Test the level of each cafe shop with very basic coffee

It's about 80 points. No surprise there but satisfied

I also ordered Brown Clouds.

Chocolate with vanilla cream

The chocolate is very rich.

Try the signature cold-extracted coffee next time.
review_3_text:
La.moon cold cafe is a pleasantly satisfying spot for coffee lovers. The aroma and flavor of the coffee are both impressive, with a wide range of options to choose from — whether you’re into classic brews or something a bit more adventurous.

Their cakes are a delightful bonus — rich, well-balanced, and clearly made with quality ingredients. The overall vibe is cozy and inviting, making it a great place to relax or catch up with friends.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a cafe that takes both coffee and dessert seriously.
review_4_text: Wonderful place for coffee lovers - serves classic coffees, six varieties of cold brew, signature coffee and teas. The place is clean, tidy and cozy. The staff is welcoming and friendly. There's a lovely selection of desserts to complement the coffees. The mini croissants are the blast!
review_5_text:
This is my first time to this cafe in Chiang Mai.

Lots of themed drinks. It has lots of seating. There is plenty of parking in the front and rear.

We tried different coffees, and I got this what I thought was a coffee, but it was hot chocolate.  It was okay.

This seems to be the spot for taking your Instagram and TikTok videos.

name: The Toys Club
review_1_text:
I have been in Chiang Mai for so long.

This is my first time to enter this interesting bar

I didn't expect the atmosphere to be so good.

Relaxed and friendly

The handsome boss spin the vinyls by himself. Was quite good.

All kinds of alcohol are available here.

Draft beer, whiskey, highball, cocktails

I think Asahi draft beer is good.

It provides coffee during the day.

Perfectly achieve the living state of morning C and night A
review_2_text: Great place for a nerd! You can get a coffee here, play some video games or board games and admire the collection of Japanese pop cultural stuff.
review_3_text: Absolutely loved the vibe at Toy Club Chiang Mai! Fantastic drinks – especially enjoyed trying the [mention KOSAPAN or TENDO if you remember which one you liked better, otherwise keep it general]. The attention to detail, like the perfectly stacked ice
review_4_text: One of the coolest cafes in Chiang Mai that turns into this retro Japanese style bar at night where they're straight up mixing vinyls and serving epic cocktails. You can play you childhoood favorite games in the back and are surrounded by some of the best nostalgic characters in the stands and walls that Japan has to offer. Places like this usually only exist in the movies, we're lucky to have it in real life.
review_5_text: This place makes you travel and go back in time!! Insanely well decorated and there’s also a coffeeshop and a DJ inside, all in one! Everything is there for you to have fun and enjoy the quirky space. Truly unique!

name: Sambrvk Kulture Dispensary
review_1_text:
The coolest little shop with good vibes and delightful experience of blazing.
Great prices and promos.
And excellent eye to good quality.
Warm friendly smiles behind the counter.
review_2_text: Amazing location, in night market bazaar area. Visited Sambrvk Kulture recently and was impressed by the variety of ganja they offer. The owner was knowledgeable and friendly, providing helpful recommendations based on my preferences. The atmosphere was relaxed laid back and the overall experience hella positive. Quality products and great service make it a recommended spot for those seeking a diverse selection of cannabis products. Their brownies were SUPER yummy!!
review_3_text:
top place in the center of Chiang Mai ⚡️
great stuff , all top shelf , cozy ambient and the owner is super gentle and always get you the proper advise !!
really recommend !!
💨🎄🌝🔥
review_4_text:
Didn’t walk into a weed shop — walked into a friend’s cozy home
Warm lights, good music, and that sweet aroma in the air… everything just hits right.
A perfect spot to smoke, chill, and heal your soul 💚 #HomieVibes #ChillSpot
review_5_text: Amazing place with the best weed in town. Edibles and weed. Big recommendation if you come to chiang mai!

name: ร้านกาแฟ McClanahan
review_1_text: McClanahan Coffee Cafe features unique decor, as it was converted from an old hospital or operating room. This unexpected, clean setting is quite interesting and makes the cafe a memorable place to enjoy excellent coffee.
review_2_text: Here is calm and comfortable Cafe next to ChiangMai Community Church, end of Nawarat bridge. We are here twice caused it's not too far from the hotel we stay. We order non-coffee beverages like Iced Creamy Coco Matcha 🍸 and White Peach Apple Tea🍹both are so flavourful and aromatic😋There're several corners within the Cafe for us to choose 🪑🍽️ 🚙🌳🌲100% Recommended if you like Cafe which is not in the popular lists, not too crowded but feeling Relax and Silently Happy ☘️💚
review_3_text:
mcclanahan -

Just a few months in business as of March 2023, the lovely renovated building is like two coffee places in the same location. Downstairs and upstairs. I like them both. Not really a coffee guru, can't really say how good it is. If I pay a bit over 100 baht for a signature drink, it's still mainly for their pleasant ambience, cool air, and friendly staff. Pay a visit and enjoy the old photos and the historical feel of the place.
review_4_text: Drinks are good and coffee delicious. This place has the best barista material in the town. Coffee shop so clean and relaxing as well. Big free parking in the garden behind the store. This place is definitely a gem ❤️
review_5_text: I really like the atmosphere, good coffee, good dessert and nice interior. This is a good place to chill with friends. It has a car park

name: Mandala cocoa
review_1_text:
Sure! Here’s a polished, natural-sounding review you can use:

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Mandala Cocoa is an excellent place for high-quality cacao. The cacao is rich, well-crafted, and full of deep, concentrated flavors—every sip tastes amazing. The location is great and very relaxing, perfect for enjoying and focusing on the taste experience. Everything was so good, definitely two thumbs up 👍👍. Highly recommended for cacao lovers!
review_2_text: 🍫💥 Boom Boom Chocolate lives up to its name. Rich, intense, and unapologetically chocolatey—deep cocoa flavour, smooth finish, zero fluff. One sip and it hits hard in the best way. A must for serious chocolate lovers!
review_3_text: I was very blessed to encounter this chocolate business in Jungle Market on a Saturday morning. This is the best chocolate drink ive ever tasted in my life! Order the BOOM BOOM CHOCOLATE which is not on their menu, except if youre in the Jungle Market. No need to put sugar/sweet milk. You will not regret it. Trust me. I know what i am talking about. This is the best.
review_4_text: Absolutely loved the Mondala Cocoa I picked up at the Sanpakhoi market! This cacao from Chiang Dao is truly special. Rich, flavorful, and incredibly satisfying. A must-try for any chocolate lover! 🍫
review_5_text: Great cocoa - very thick and rich with some fruity flavor. Prices are great for the quality. Place is ecclectic and unique. Recommended.

name: Praise Cafe
review_1_text: Lovely iced latte and banana cake. Felt great to drink from a real glass; sorry for the plastic straw though. To me the vintage props decor bring back the sweet memories of the good old days. Nice also that the barista/owner was up for a chat. It was like having coffee at a friend's.
review_2_text: A small coffee shop that sell coffee , tea and italian soda. The shop is decorate in lanna loft style. The price is average. You can park in front of the shop.
review_3_text: Cute hole in the wall cafe. Very friendly and helpful owner. Super strong coffee; amazing. Good music, good vibes.
review_4_text: Cosy easy place for a coffee with no air-conditioning. Reasonable price. With Praise, a baby girl around, along with a closed off section where you can get lessons and learn how to play instruments, it's like visiting a friend's place.
review_5_text: Coffee was ok, there’s no AC or WiFi so it’s not really a great spot to work from.  The atmosphere is cool though, nice place to come to hang out although it’s situated on a busy arterial road. #BeatTheGrind

name: Roastniyom Exclusive เจริญเมือง
review_1_text:
Excellent Ethiopian light roast oatmilk iced latte!! Several beans to choose from.

Very friendly staff.

Great light & airy work space downstairs and up with a large meeting room.

Falang approved!

Short walk from train station.
review_2_text:
Cool spot, delicious coffee, good ambiance.

Well made Flat White served with a fresh flakey almond croissant.

Great spot for pictures.  During the day they have fantastic natural light.
review_3_text: One of the hidden place in Chiangmai. Recommend to visit. Good coffee taste. Good design space and friendly. Multifunctional cafe. Backyard was so nice. You can have a time to rest or work here.
review_4_text: Well decorate the shop both inside and outside.  There are many types of coffee beans to choose from.  mid price  The overall atmosphere is fine.
review_5_text:
I’ve only tried the premium matcha late for 135 baht. It was decent. Hard to get a tasty matcha that actually taste like matcha — pleasantly surprised.

Would come back if in the area.

name: Brewing Room
review_1_text: Great coffee for 65 baht!! Nice place to work from also but there’s literally only one power point at the end of the large desk so secure that position if you need to charge!  Colorful interior but no padded seats so staying for any lengthy period gets a little uncomfortable.  The barista was very friendly and welcoming.  Nice bathroom here also which is always a good thing! #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: Calm, soothing decor and ambience. Great service! Coffee was great. They have cookies.
review_3_text: Street side cafe with minimalist decor friendly staff reasonable prices. You can sit at the cafe sidewalk table watching local life passing by.
review_4_text:
A​ good​ coffee​ shop​ serving​ you a good selection of coffee beans.
This shop decoration is nice chic and cleans.
The coffee machine also nice.
review_5_text: Best coffee in town... Hidden gem...Attentive Staff...Quiet place to enjoy relaxing time with a good cup of coffee. Recommended!

name: Wawee Coffee Kadluang
review_1_text:
Iced Thai Tea 60 ฿ (2025)

Has English menu.

Great cafe to rest after the nearby market strolling. It is almost empty when i arrived.

I could have nice AC, charge my phone and enjoy the quietness.

Normally those popular cafe are crowded with instafamous and other tourist, so i am glad to be here.

Spend a good couple hours to read and really enjoy myself.
review_2_text:
Dirty seats, dirty restrooms 🚻 but air conditioned
The only reason to come in here abuy overpriced coffee or tea is the crypt quality AC.
FILTHY, and I've been in Chiang Mai many times.
The cloth chairs were so dirty I actually moved to a non cloth upholstered seat. ( see pics ).
Restrooms were filthy.
Next to Ping River,  this place could be so much better for the price.
Service was adequate at best.
●●●●●NOT RECOMMENDED unless you need a dose of AC in the Chiang Mai heat.●●●●●
Final take....The 🍋 lemon iced tea was ok.
review_3_text: Super quaint coffee shop with an attached bookstore! Nice seating options by the river. As a heads up: their bathroom is out of service at the time of this review, so you’ll have to use the one across the street. Also, their AC is out of commission, though they are using portable AC units.
review_4_text: No A/C, place looks like it's about to fall into the river, the rear is basically a dump. No hello or smile upon entry, everyone wearing masks like they are afraid of breathing air.  Skip it.
review_5_text: No air conditioning but the place is five star with 100 hat drinks. The owner must have money issues, it's 39c outside and no Aircon. They do they just don't wanna turn it on. Place is failing for a reason

name: หลงชา สาขาตลาดทองคำ
review_1_text: The shop is right in front of the market. Overall, the prices are good. The tapioca pearls are delicious, chewy, and not too sweet. The tea itself is quite fragrant, and you can even request less sugar. Anyone eating Khanom Jeen (Thai rice noodles) can stop by this shop. For parking, I recommend parking near the temple across from the market. The staff are friendly and smiling.

name: KUMBO MATCHA
review_1_text: The shop itself is nice and well-designed, but there were lots of customers and not enough tables, which made it a bit uncomfortable. The matcha was okay — enjoyable, but not particularly memorable.
review_2_text: A-Must Try Matcha Cafe on the 2nd floor of Anusarn building, also our first time visiting here☘️ We order Coconut Matcha and Basque Burnt Matcha Cheesecake😋 in which we really love its taste so much cause it's so flavorful and less sweet🍯 The Cafe atmosphere inside is Perfect with the sound of soft music playing🎷and minimal decoration🎨 200% Recommended to absorb the well-balanced in sipping flavorful Matcha beverages amid Comfy atmosphere👍👍👍
review_3_text: Good quality matcha that’s smooth. Calm, low-key space that’s easy to hang out in.
review_4_text: Good matcha but waiting for 30 min after order
review_5_text:
The atmosphere really reminds me of some cafes I've been to in both Taiwan and Japan. Love the design of the place and they really serve amazing matcha!
The only thing that was a letdown was the matcha tiramisu, I felt like it was a rip-off...the portion is way tiny and you have to wait a bit for the ladyfingers(savoiardi) to soften and the taste is really so-so, I don't think it's worth the price.
I'd recommend just going for the drinks as they also have a good selection and made with care.

name: Limsakdakul Sanpakoi
review_1_text: Vibrant meeting place. Interesting art and antiques at the back of the cafe.
review_2_text: Best coffee in town, period 👍
review_3_text: Good place, friendly people.
review_4_text:
A coffee shop that blends the charm of Chiang Mai's past, with a familiar and nostalgic feel. Good vibe, good coffee.
There are photo opportunities for social media check-ins.

It was quite crowded the day I went; all the tables were full, even from the front of the shop. It's becoming a trend, so I recommend visiting in the morning.

Street parking is only available until 3 PM; otherwise, your car will be towed.
review_5_text: The shop is cute and very stylishly decorated. There are many photo spots, a corner for collectibles and antiques, and a cute shop inside. The coffee here is really good, fragrant and delicious. The only downside is that there are a lot of tourists, so you might have to wait a bit for your partner. Take the opportunity to walk around and take photos while waiting, but it's worth it.

name: แววว๊าว! น้ำผึ้งมะนาวเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: I never thought that Chiang Mai would have a "Honey Lemon Collagen Juice" menu. It's so refreshing and delicious that I have to come back every time I come here.
review_2_text: I was impressed when the shop set up a charity food stall at Wat Hariphunchai. When I tasted their drink, wow, it was amazing! It's my number one favorite honey lemon drink.
review_3_text:
This honey lemon shop has the best honey in Chiang Mai. Very refreshing.

Amazing ❤️
review_4_text:
Every dish is fresh, fragrant, and sweet. Drinking it is truly refreshing and beneficial for your body.
Immediately awakens your senses.
review_5_text: We went three days in a row for this lemon tea with honey. Absolutely delicious, and the service was wonderful. Located in a local area next to a market... 1000% recommended

name: ชาจง ชง ดี สาขาสันป่อย
review_1_text:
Delicious Southern Thai tea.
The taste is good.
Good value for money.
review_2_text: This is incredibly strong southern Thai tea. It makes me miss home in the south.
review_3_text: I ordered 50% sweetness but received very sweet tea. It couldn't be changed because it was already brewed.

name: coffee
review_1_text: Coffee was very good, affordable and fast!

name: RoseWhiteCha CNX. โรสไวท์ชา ชาเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: A wonderful tea blend in a Chinese shrine-themed cafe
review_2_text: There is a place where you can worship Guan Gong and drink delicious tea.
review_3_text:
A Chinese-style tea shop with a spiritual corner for praying and seeking blessings from deities. There's a spot to offer tea to Guan Yu, believed to boost inner strength.
All the drinks in the shop are delicious, especially the matcha, which is excellent and not too sweet.
Whether you come to enjoy delicious drinks, take photos in the Chinese-style corner, or pay respects to the deities, it's a great place to visit.
review_4_text:
Drinks: They offer both hot and cold teas.
I've tried:
☘️ Blended Teas: Many options available, very easy to drink. A healthy hot tea option.
🍵 Matcha: Pure matcha and matcha latte. Easy to drink, with plant-based milk options.
☕️ Coffee: Americano, made with the shop's own selection of beans. Easy to drink, amazing taste! ✨ Even beginners can try it. They also offer fruit juices.
💪🏻 Health-conscious individuals can enjoy their drinks here. The shop uses stevia for sweetness, and their honey lemon drinks are homemade.

☺️ Service: The owner and staff are friendly, smiling, and helpful.

💵 Payment: Cash and QR code payment.

🚗 Parking: Available along the roadside from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

This review is based on my personal experience and positive feedback. I highly recommend it! 💗
review_5_text:
✨ Had the wonderful opportunity to participate in the tea ceremony at Rose White Tea, Chiang Mai Tea House. 🍵🫖
This place is more than just a tea shop, it's a "space of peace" that invites everyone to take a break from the outside world and recharge their batteries.

The interior is exquisitely decorated, with meticulous attention to every detail.
There are corners emanating from the home of a grandparent, giving a warm, family-like feeling.
Another corner is as beautiful as a Chinese shrine, filled with the power of faith, perfect for praying for blessings, opening up your wealth, and receiving the power of prosperity and good fortune.

Heartfelt congratulations to Professor Louis and P'Oi on the opening of their new shop.

You can feel the dedication, meticulousness, and heart that goes into every element of the shop.

The food and drinks here are exceptional, especially the "tea menu," which is meticulously served, with a deep, mellow aroma and a smooth, gentle taste, like taking a stroll through a tranquil tea garden.

If you're visiting Chiang Mai, we highly recommend stopping by at least once.
To sip some delicious tea, calm your mind, and meditate… May your life be joyful and prosperous. 🌿

name: DWBH
review_1_text:
The place has prominent use of steel, concrete and glass. With unique art pieces for furnishings.

They offer mostly espresso based coffee drinks with creatice concoctions.

Popular with the locals for pick up and delivery.
review_2_text: We just walk in on our walk from train station and it was the best decision. The atmosphere and designe of café is really modern. The service is amazing, nice gentleman behind counter gave us description of their beverage options depending on what we wanted. The coffees were really tasty, croissants and croffle were delicious. I truly recommend to step in if you nearby. There is no toilet in the building but we were told we could use one across the street.
review_3_text:
Great coffee and very nice and modern place. Found it in our way from the station, took a break, charged our phones and relaxed. The lazy Monday drink is soooooo good.

They speak well and replied to some of our Thai questions. The lady offered to take a picture of the two of us together :)

Thank you!
review_4_text:
Cool place.
I like Dirty Latte, they call it a Lazy Latte for 70 baht. Okay. I am alright with that.
Might have a club feel if your imagination is wide, broad and unfocused like mine.
The seats (concrete) won’t let your hard a** get no relief but you are a busy person so that should be a minor thing. A minor thing when you consider all the other real problems sprouting up in your life at this very moment.

I recommend this coffee shop for a few air conditioned, caffeinated moments.

Go get em’ champ!
review_5_text: Absolutely delicious - their Brazilian/Thai bean espresso is a perfect blend with milk. We got the piccolo, espresso, and an americano & would definitely come again! Not many big tables, but a perfect chill/photo spot & DELICIOUS coffee offerings!

name: น้ำจับเลี้ยง สูตรยายเกื้อ สันป่าข่อย
GRAPH contemporary
review_1_text:
A vintage yet stylish cafe. You may miss the entrance when u pass by the cafe but it is a different world when u goes in. The cafe is very spacious with 2 floors. The upper floor is without ac, so it can be quite hot.

There many special drinks for this cafe, but the price is quite pricey and the taste is not particularly outstanding.

Good place to chill around or if u wanna try GRAPH as this branch is far less crowded than the other branches of GRAPH.
review_2_text: Just amazing coffee in beautiful surroundings. The menu was so creative and both our drinks were sublime. They have a few branches in the city but this felt the most relaxing and interesting.
review_3_text: Amazing coffee! There's an unassuming entrance, but I was blown away once I walked inside. Very cool, trendy vibes here with chill music. Coffee options are excellent--lots of cold brew mixes and single origin options. I really enjoyed my coffee and also ordered a carrot cake, which had great icing. Really can't go wrong here, I'd recommend anyone who loves coffee to check out one of the Graph shops around town. Prices are slightly higher, but it's a great coffee experience and I look forward to going back.
review_4_text: Good vibes. Great spacious design. Good, creative coffee. Friendly and helpful staffs. Down side, there’s only 1 mixed toilet which is really annoying. If you want to spend your time here, maybe an hour chat is cool, over the afternoon when things aren’t busy. My personal view, best to take away. Chairs aren’t comfortable. It’s really for quick chat, photos and nicely presented coffee. Still give it 4-star for product quality and services.
review_5_text: Insane coffee creations and even insaner location! It's and old building, featuring high ceilings and wooden floors, integrating some concrete elements, mixing old and modern. In addition to its instagrammable aesthetics, it is a very calm place to study and work.

name: LA-MOON COFFEE
review_1_text: Amazing service and great coffee, the Italian sodas are so refreshing. A gem of a coffee stop, we kept going back while in Chiang Mai
review_2_text: Very nice coffee. And very friendly people.
review_3_text: The orange coffee is delicious. The seller is very pretty.

name: ปั่นโป๋พลัส-สันป่าข่อย
OHB Cafe and Meal - Chiangmai
review_1_text:
We walked in and suddenly we were sitting in a little jungle oasis. The atmosphere is the main reason to come: lush greenery everywhere, warm natural light, and a calm pond with colorful fish (koi) right next to the seating. If you manage to get a table by the water, it’s incredibly relaxing—quiet, cool, and honestly feels like you’re far away from the city.

The space is also well designed. There’s a comfortable indoor area with beautiful woven hanging lamps and a clean, modern look, plus plenty of outdoor seating that blends into the garden. It’s a great place to slow down, have a long coffee, and take photos without it feeling “too touristy.”

Food and drinks were nicely presented and enjoyable. The coffee looked and tasted well-made (latte art was on point), and the breakfast-style dishes came out fresh and comforting. Overall, it’s a solid choice whether you’re coming for coffee, a light meal, or just to enjoy the vibe.
review_2_text: Beautiful atmosphere, absolutely welcoming and inviting. Service doesn't come to your table, it took us a while to realize that. Go order up front, pay first, then they deliver. I didn't find the food that good. I had indo breakfast. Raw yolk is always a massive turn off for me, lack of seasoning is the next major turn off. This breakfast ticked both those disappointing features Nice looking food, lacking in taste sums it up.
review_3_text:
The environment here is undeniably elegant and comfortable—the "Urban Sanctuary" vibe with the waterfall and lush greenery is truly world-class. However, the service was a massive disappointment and completely ruined the experience.

The staff were cold and unprofessional. I wasn't even given a receipt after my purchase, and there wasn't a single "thank you" or any form of basic courtesy throughout the interaction. For a place of this caliber, such poor hospitality is unacceptable. I came here for a peaceful escape but left feeling disrespected. Great aesthetics cannot compensate for such bad service.
review_4_text: Nice cafe with greenery and forestry atmosphere. There is a fishpond and cozy garden furniture if you like outdoor seating (beware of mosquitoes) or air-conditioned inside greenhouse. Plenty of choice for healthy food and drinks, served with a smile.
review_5_text: Beautiful forest atmosphere with outside dining and clean and cozy inside. The drinks are all well made and delicious. We also ordered the dark chocolate raspberry cake and the carrot cake and the quality of cake is the best so far for us in Chiang Mai. Will definitely be coming back.

name: Johoney Ice Cream
review_1_text: An out-of-the way ice cream and coffee shop across the river. All ice cream is homemade with exceptional flavors only available in Thailand. Served in frosted bowls if you eat in. Make a point to visit, so worth it!
review_2_text:
Quality homade icecream in Chiangmai. Plenty of flavors to try, I've tried honey comb and their new mango menu. They serve it in a frozen bowl.
The paint point is no proper parking lot. But you have to find it near by this place and walk
review_3_text: home made ice cream with only 4-5 tables.  But the flavours are very impressive.  So many various selection to choose from.  only 50 thb per scoop. Will definitely revisit!!
review_4_text: Super tasty ice cream! There are many flavors of ice cream and sherbet to choose from at John Honey. Every time you go, there is something new to try because the flavors change with the seasons and new recipes.
review_5_text: I was very happy when I found this place!! Actually it was because the name is kinda similar to my favorite korean idol's name, Joohoney. I tried to visit and try the ice cream, it was sooooo good! I tried the mint choco, yogurt blueberry, and the hokkaido milk, very recommended 👌 I'll definitely come again when I visit Chiangmai 🤭 thank you!!

name: ซายูริ ค๊อฟฟี่ช็อป
review_1_text: This is a very good app.

name: Omakase
review_1_text: A very unique coffee shop with an authentic wabi-sabi flavor, both in it's decorating and omakase style hand brewed coffee. Appear to be not well known but definitely worth a try.
review_2_text: The best cold drip coffee I've ever had😍
review_3_text: Very good ice hand drip I had, the roaster shared some knowledge about drippers with me. Very friendly
review_4_text: Amazing place and coffee
review_5_text:
A hipster cafe with a local barista from Nakhon Si Thammarat in Chiang Mai.
A small coffee bar on Chang Moi Road, surrounded by coffee shops.
This artistic cafe offers coffee made to suit the mood of both the drinker and the barista.
The coffee I had that day was an Americano, which was quite tasty.
The barista was pleasant to talk to. He's from Nakhon Si Thammarat but has a fondness for the north.
The price is negotiable. I personally gave him 150 baht because I was in a good mood that day.

name: F Cafe cnx
review_1_text:
Good friendly cafe out of touriat area. Walking towards the train station and stumbled upon this nice quaint cafe! Coffee is good, iced americano for only 40 bahts, good flavor and a good courteous customer service with a smile!! Highly recommended 👌
Scale 1-10:
Food/drink-9
Price-10
Service-9
Atmosphere-8
Cleanliness-9
review_2_text:
Passed it on our way, and happy that we decided to go in for a matcha.
They are using a nice quality powder, making it from scratch and you can have it with oat milk.
If you love matcha, then this is your place 😉
And btw, it's very affordable
review_3_text: Our first coffee in Chiang Mai and also the best! It is definitely worth a stop!
review_4_text: best damn cup of capuccino i had in chiang mai. 40 baht a pop. perfectly balanced ratio of coffee to milk. prestine 5/5
review_5_text: Nice place with a great coffee. They use 100% arabica dark rost. Highly recommend for hipsters especially:)

name: VOLKS charoenmuang : bagels and coffee
review_1_text: I stumbled upon this place on a quick run to my school. I tried their americano - on the lighter side. But my favorite was the blueberry bagel with strawberry cream cheese. Everything was so delicious and a cute cozy shop to explore for breakfast in chiang mai
review_2_text: I love this amazing BLT bagel sandwich with egg added. Highly recommend!!!
review_3_text: “very friendly service and good breakfast/ brunch options” 🥰🥰
review_4_text: Wide variety of bagels with a unique texture. The crust is crunchy while the airy and chewy interiors make Volks bagels a great way to start your day. Limited seating for the pop up format.
review_5_text: Amazing Bagles in city 🤤

name: อินไวทช์คาเฟ่เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
My boyfriend and I absolutely love this café in Chiang Mai!
The lemon soda and cakes are excellent.
He orders them all the time, haha.
You can’t go wrong with anything on the menu.

It’s a clean, delicious, and affordable café.
Truly the best café in Chiang Mai!✨✨
review_2_text: In the same compound as the Otteri laundry place, the cafe & bakery newcomer on the block (about 4 months old) offers affordable cofffee and non-coffee drinks plus great smoothies as well as home-made cake. Seats available both inside (air-conditioned) and outside. Closed Mondays.
review_3_text: Great lychee soda! Went to do laundry and saw they were still open at 6 pm which was nice to stay cool while our clothes became clean
review_4_text: We ended up here by chance, as we tried  to go to a nearby place but it was closed. Very nice surprise and very nice coffee place! Great cakes and frappes! Recommended.
review_5_text: This is a homemade bakery that makes delicious pastries using high-quality ingredients, but at affordable prices. I'll definitely come back to try other items. It's a small shop with air conditioning and parking. The owner bakes the pastries herself and is very friendly.

name: La Leng Kaffee
review_1_text: Look around the tiny little place and you can tell from all those coffee-related paraphernalia that they are serious about their hsnd roasted coffee. Very good coffee. Don't be surprised by non-coffee stuff. The place sells motorcycle spare parts on ebay. So I've heard.
review_2_text: Happy 😊
review_3_text: It was fun to help you make your own coffee, and the taste was amazing! Above all, the cozy atmosphere and the owner were pleasant and friendly. It was the best :-)
review_4_text:
Coffee shop near Chiang Mai train station.

The coffee beans are roasted by hand, ground fresh for you, and the service is outstanding.

The coffee has a flavor that will surprise you.

name: 9 Garden Green Bean (สารกาแฟ กาแฟคั่ว ปลีก-ส่ง)
Exotic Roasting Coffee (สาขาเจริญเมือง)
Cha Lum Dee - Sanpakhoi
review_1_text: Great little coffee stall tucked inside the business center. The ice americano is strong, smooth, and hits the spot every time. Friendly service and quick turnaround — perfect for a workday caffeine fix. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: The price is friendly and the food is very delicious. ☕️
review_3_text: Fresh milk yogurt smoothie, very delicious.
review_4_text: It's cheap and delicious too.

name: Half.cnx
review_1_text: Nice spot for coffee with a view of the park
review_2_text: Good vibes, but coffee is not really good. and seats are not comfort
review_3_text: Feeling good
review_4_text:
This shop is very clever in its marketing and advertising. The facade facing the garden is illuminated with striking orange lights.
Great location near the garden entrance/exit.
Beautiful view.
The drinks are okay.
The decor uses raw materials, exposing the surfaces of the old building.
There are air-conditioned rooms on the 1st and 2nd floors.
The 3rd floor is open air.
This was a shop I visited at the perfect time.
You can scan to view the menu before entering.
And you can scan to order drinks.
review_5_text:
Who would have thought there'd be such a great cafe next to Chiang Mai train station! This is 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗳.𝗰𝗻𝘅. I love the cool design of the cafe. It's a three-story building with a raw, loft-style feel, but when the large windows open, you get a full view of the lush green railway park. The atmosphere is airy and spacious; it's very relaxing and not at all cramped. 😌🌿

For those who love taking photos, 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗳.𝗰𝗻𝘅 has tons of chic spots. The coffee is good, the pastries are delicious, and it's perfect for working or just taking a break in the afternoon. This is another must-visit spot in Chiang Mai that I highly recommend everyone experience! ☺️💓

Hard to believe there’s such a vibe right next to the Chiang Mai Railway Station! 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗳.𝗰𝗻𝘅 is a stunning 3-story industrial loft that perfectly balances its raw, edgy design with the lush, green views of the Railway Park. The space is so airy and open—definitely a place where you can just sit back and breathe. 😌🌿

For all the photographers out there, this place is a goldmine for cool shots. The coffee is top-notch, the treats are delicious, and it’s the ideal spot to get some work done or just enjoy a quiet afternoon. If you’re in Chiang Mai, you’ve got to check this one out! ☺️💗

name: วรพงษ์ กราฟฟิค
Minimal Coffee - สถานีรถไฟ
review_1_text: Great modern coffeebar with super friendly staff.
review_2_text: Solid cup of Joe. Chill vibes, good spot to kill a little time if you're catching/getting off a bus around the corner, and want some good coffee and some AC.
review_3_text: Good coffee, lovely and friendly staff. Great place to exercise at the train park and then chill out afterwards. Perfect!
review_4_text: After getting off the train, I went straight to drink coffee and immediately turned on my computer to work. I remember it used to be a small shop, but now it's become very big.
review_5_text:
Strong coffee, friendly staff, and comfortable seating.
This cafe is open early, which is great (7:00 AM - 4:00 PM), but I'm a little disappointed that it closes a bit early.

name: Ploy Cafe Slow Bar
review_1_text:
Best Thai tea! Must try.
The food also delicious!
review_2_text: Variety of Breakfasts. Delicious. Nice Service 😃My favorite place in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Super friendly and relaxing little coffee stall along the road. Thanks for all the great coffee!
review_4_text: Super chill roadside slow bar
review_5_text: Amazing coffee and even better service!!

name: Khun Ning Coffee Shop
review_1_text:
Cool, good food, reasonable price.
Mango n passion fruit smoothie is wonderful. Avocado salsa and salad cream is like the picture, real delicious and true vegan.
review_2_text: I loved the vibe of this place. So relaxing. The breakfast was delicious. The service was great. Fast free WiFi. Charged our devices as we enjoyed hanging out in the coffee shop. Fun treat as we got a surprise in our cappuccinos: cappuccino art! 👌🏼
review_3_text: Such a beautiful and calm coffee shop in the heart of bustling Chiang Mai. Loved the toast and sandwiches and the latte art is the best I’ve seen in the city. Definitely will be back. Meaw is the best barista and such a kind person, she makes the coffee shop so welcoming!
review_4_text: On the walk from train station to center we found this treasure. They were welcoming, food was really good and you get a cafe portrait. We definitely want to come again!
review_5_text: So this is the cafe attached to the hotel. it is called the shewe wanna cafe. cafe is lovely and the garden seating is beautiful. Higher than Thai prices but lower than any hotel breakfast I have had. Got a portrait coffee and a bacon avocado egg toast. My bacon was way over done, but everything tasted good. The barista is lovely and I would go again :)

name: กาแฟสดดอยหลวง รวมโชค
มอมอชา ชานมไข่มุก
ฮ่อมกาแฟ Hhom coffee
สมร Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text:
Very tasty and creative cakes.  We had two mochi cakes and a banoffee.  The cakes were beyond our expectation.

For coffee, I had a caramel biscuit coffee.   Very nice as well.

The icon of the restaurant, the Samorn family dogs.  Very cute and add a pet-friendly vibe to the cafe.
review_2_text: Such a cute cafe. I think the main entertainment is doggies. They are adorable, so well behaved and treated. I took Americano and mochi matcha cake. I like matcha, but I think the taste was super strong, so it was hard to finish a piece on my own. I would highly recommend to come and visit this cafe to cuddle with doggies. (And of course, they are pet-friendly)
review_3_text: so happy to see the sausage dogs running around!! sweet and friendly little ones and apparently you can even bring your own pet dog here! otherwise this place was a bit hard to find on grab but the lovely furry friends made up for the company
review_4_text: Amazing coffee with fun specialty flavors. They are decorated for Christmas and it looks unreal right now with snow and everything!! They have 3 gorgeous weiner dogs you can play with and the whole cafe is dauschand themed!! Amazing spot to hang out!
review_5_text:
First impression there: I love these 2 dogs!
They are very well known for their cake. And it is amazing. The drinks were on point and the cafe gives off a relaxing vibes. I would love to stay longer so if you are someone who enjoy sitting in cafe and working or chilling, this is the place.

Overall: Cake&drinks 8/10, Atmosphere 9/10 the interior are to my liking so +1, Staff 8/10 Super friendly, DOGS: 10000000/10

name: Yardoo kids Cafe
review_1_text: It's convenient to park. The price is not cheap, but the toys are all made of wood and have a good texture. There are places to play both indoors and outdoors. I think three hours of play is completely enough. It would be perfect if a free drink could be obtained with the ticket.
review_2_text:
A very cute cafe with many different indoor and outdoor spaces. The toys and areas were clean and not worn. I appreciated that they allowed me in even though I didn’t have a method of QR payment, only cash. And, they gave my daughter a cute Pokémon gift upon leaving. They have the sweetest staff.

There was no one really monitoring the areas so parents of younger ones need to be somewhat vigilant at all times - with toys on higher shelves and a steep slide into the ball pit
review_3_text: Had my son’s 4th birthday party here and it was wonderful! It was a private party and I couldn’t be happier. The decorations were fantastic and the staff were wonderful. Really great toys, outside area and excellent slide. 100% would recommend. Coffees were delicious too. Thank you Yardoo 🙏
review_4_text:
Great family and kids space with both indoor and outdoor play spaces. Whole room with Plan International wooden toys. Another room with big slide and ball pit.

Food is adequate. Only downside is they use plastic cutlery in plastic bags and disposable bowls for all dining, creating tons of unnecessary waste.
review_5_text: It was good size for my 2yo toddler. Safe and clean toys and playground. Staff was nice and friendly too. Just one thing, there are TOO MANY mosquitoes (especially hiding in the indoor slide/ball pool area) in such a place for kids, the owner should consider to leave a mosquito catch during the night… Mosquitoes carry diseases and kill most human on earth 😬

name: Roasto - รสโต
review_1_text: I'm writing this review solely for the owners of this cafe and hotel, as I understand that Chiang Mai's tourism and hospitality industries have been struggling for the past years due to various reasons, covid, flood, negative news, etc. This cafe is affiliated with the hotel, and I happened to pass by and stopped in for coffee and breakfast. The cafe and hotel are beautiful, with a lovely atmosphere. The hot latte was good, and the set breakfast was regular and okay. However, when I picked up the strawberry jam to spread on my bread, I noticed it was opened and a corner had been eaten. I assumed it was recycled, presumably the last customer hadn't eaten it, but actually he/she did. I handed it to the staff, who immediately replaced it from the kitchen without even a word of apology. In my opinion, this is a serious management issue. I hope the owners will take note and make improvements. After all, such a beautiful cafe and hotel, I wish it'll have good business.
review_2_text: chilled, relaxed, tranquil, great coffee, salad is a bit small in portion but ok as snack. sure will come again for Panna cotta
review_3_text: I agree with all the good reviews so far. The beautiful latté tastes even better than it looks, and the barista is skilled and courteous.
review_4_text: Quite and soft music 🎶🎶🎶
review_5_text: Great spot to come for a drink or coffee.

name: กับแกล้มยายแอ๊ว
review_1_text: The food was terrible, the noodles were the worst I've ever had. They were also smoking in the restaurant. It was awful. The price and the food quality don't match at all.
review_2_text: Good food, parking available, very cheap.
review_3_text: The food is delicious and very cheap.
review_4_text: The food is delicious and cheap. I'm delighted.
review_5_text: Very cheap, good beer, red banknotes with change.

name: Fusion Village
review_1_text:
awesome restaurant, we were there to eat the pizza buffet. you can order half pizzas and they are delicious. pastas and mushroom soup were amazing and when you are there, order the smoked ham, wow
the staff that makes the dishes are so kind. really recommend this place👍👍👍
review_2_text: The food is amazing, the staff were friendly and helpful and the atmosphere was great.  The have a buffet during the day and a great menu in the evening with live music.  They often have special events as well  like rock music once a month.  I will absolutely be back often.
review_3_text: Nice idea for a buffet restaurant. We tried the Italian buffet: tasty and a bit of choice. The pizza was very good. It keeps coming out from the oven non stop. Hurry up!
review_4_text: Great food and atmosphere for the lunch buffet. Perfect set up in the evening for live music.
review_5_text:
Vibe good
Friendly staff
Pineapple fried rice is delicious

name: Coffee, Cats & Company
review_1_text: A small home based cafe, very polite and hospitable owner. The cats and a dog are a wonderful delight. They have small space to sit inside, smokers can sit outside. They also have digital payment methods in case you want to do cashless transfers.
review_2_text:
I love this place with all my heart! The people that are working here are one of the best people that I have met in my life.
The food is very cheap and tasty, personally I loved honey milk very much. And, of course, the cats! And a dog :) They are so cute and friendly, every cat has its own behavior. Very very cute, if you are around this area, you should definitely visit this cafe ❤️🐱
review_3_text:
Super friendly staff and great coffee.
Plenty of seating.
review_4_text: Hidden gem in the little local alley in ChiangMai. Tasty hot latte and fun talks with the barista, best way to start a chilly winter morning.
review_5_text: Came for the cats, stayed for the coffee and the cute barista, who speaks some of the best English I’ve come across in thailand. Hidden on a little soi in a local neighborhood.

name: Popo’s Cafe Chiangmai คาเฟ่แมว เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Coming here before my flight back. No entrance fee, yet the price of drink and food on the higher side which is I expected. The place quite cozy, the iced latte and toast are good. Caution for those who order food, watch out because the cats seems eyeing the food or water 😂 Just, when i came in, there are strong cat pee odour. Overall, i think make a good choice came in here just before back to Bangkok. Might came back if going back to Chiang Mai again.
review_2_text:
My favorite cat cafe! It’s very welcoming, the staff is so incredibly nice and friendly, the drinks are amazing and all the deserts are delicious! (my god, the nutella burnt cheesecake is to die for🤤)
But, most importantly, the cats are absolutely adorable, well taken care of, groomed and happy:)
Love love love coming here🥰 it’s my happy place!
review_3_text: Cute cafe with adorable friendly cats. Clean and well loved.
review_4_text: A lovely small cat cafe, no entry fee, just order a drink is ok! Not many cats there, but everyone is cute!
review_5_text:
I sent my car for service at the Expat Auto and took a short walk down to this cosy Cafe with it's lovely people friendly cats. I ordered a cappuccino and lemon cheese cake which both were delicious. The owner of this small Cafe is a very friendly charming lady and this small Café is a welcome feature in the area.
You find it by going down the Soi between Thai Prakan and the Alpine car electronics shop and opposite Expat Auto take the small Soi on the right and almost at the end of the Soi on the left side is Popo's Café. Well worth a visit to cuddle with cute cats, but be careful, they might steal your cheese cake 😉

name: Black Canyon รพ.กรุงเทพ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
No matter the location,  always reliable for quality & service.

Food is always fresh and delicious.  Well made coffee drinks.
review_2_text:
Well, the food is... meh. BUT if you're really hungry like we were then you will enjoy it.
I understand that not every restaurant will be a 5 star rating.
This coffee shop/restaurant does the job.

I would say don't go out of your way BUT if you're getting your truck fixed nearby hungry and need to wait- then this place is PERFECT.

It is worth a stop by plus they have cannabis teas and coffee🤔
review_3_text: A very good quality Black Canyon. The food is all delicious and the staff are friendly. It’s right next to Bangkok hospital so we ate here while visiting the hospital. We were very hungry and this place hit the spot.
review_4_text:
I came here with a coupon from Bangkok Hospital that is next door.
There is a list of choices for that, a few drinks and a few food selections.
I asked about tuna sandwich and was pointed to a display (see photo 1) with a good looking sandwich and selected that.
As I was eating in they didn’t want me to take pre-packed but serve it on a plate… and all I got was a half can of tuna between 2 tasteless slices of white bread without crust.  No lettuce, tomato, or mayo in sight. Bland and tasteless.
Even worse than any school or hospital cafeteria.
2 tables sent their food back while I was there.

Maybe this is acceptable if your mind is worried about a loved one in hospital and you don’t taste anything or don’t care - but otherwise I’d strongly advise against going here.
review_5_text:
I wanted to like this place and the food, but unfortunately, it didn't meet my expectations. I ordered the Ribeye with Truffle sauce, cooked medium-rare. They seemed to focus too much on the truffle and not enough on the meat. When I first looked at it, I thought it was chopped meat; however, upon cutting into it, it turned out to be very dry and stringy. The truffle sauce was okay but nothing exceptional. The salad was fresh, and the potato was pretty standard. I also ordered the combo, which included the Thai Iced tea. It was better than what you'd get at 7, but not nearly as good as what Hand Brand offers.

Additionally, I had an iced Coffee from here in the morning, it was bitter and not very flavorful.

name: Starbucks Bangkok Hospital Chiangmai
review_1_text: This is a great Starbucks, they have a huge seating area and great customer service. I received my order quickly and it was delicious, as usual with a Starbucks. I don’t typically visit Starbucks but it is super convenient being right here at Bangkok hospital while waiting for tests, etc. it is a cashless store, but they take all other forms of payment, including my debit card from America so you don’t have to have a Thai bank account in order to pay here.
review_2_text: It is a cashless store. I hate these stores. What's next? Kiosk ordering like at McDonalds or KFC? Customer service going out of fashion I guess.
review_3_text: They refuse to accept cash. Ridiculous. It should be illegal to not accept cash.
review_4_text:
