review_5_text: Today I was lucky enough to get a free coffee. The shop offered a free drip coffee. It's a special seasonal coffee. I really like it. It goes really well with the cheesecake. It's so delicious.

name: Fresh Me ร.พ.กรุงเทพ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: it was one of the most surpriseing visit of chiangmai. I never expected such a small shop to have such great milk tea. not only that I went back to order the strawberry delight, an amazing blend of juice and tea. my friend got the strawberry gelato, he had such a great reaction I had to try his drink. my reaction was the same. it was more than amazing.
review_2_text: FreshMe is an amazing bubble tea shop! Their drinks are super tasty, fresh, and made with quality ingredients. They have lots of options, from classic milk teas to fruity blends, so there’s something for everyone. The tapioca pearls are always chewy and perfect. The staff is friendly, and the shop has a cozy vibe. If you love bubble tea, FreshMe is the place to go!
review_3_text: The calamansi tea is so refreshing! They also have a promotion every Monday and Wednesday. ☺️☺️
review_4_text: The staff are very unprofessional. You ask for one thing and get another. The price is very expensive. Don't buy anything from here. You will be disappointed.
review_5_text: I got a lot. It's delicious and just the right amount of sweet.

name: Gourmet Primo Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Great distraction during a hospital visit.

Well made coffee and drinks. Large selection of fresh sweet and savory items.

Located off the ground lobby of Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Located on the ground floor at Chiangmai Bangkok Hospital. The best Coffee and pastry selections.
review_3_text:
The coffee shop at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai has delicious drinks.
The prices are reasonable, and they also sell inexpensive baked goods and pastries.
I often stop by while waiting to drop off patients. It's located near the checkout counter on the 1st floor.
review_4_text: The staff were so lovely, like they stepped straight out of Disney, super friendly. The snacks in the shop were also incredibly delicious – I was surprised there was a snack shop in a hospital! Very impressed.

name: BILLY BEAN
review_1_text: Good taste and texture. A bit weird when a specialty shop barista asks if you’d like your piccolo latte hot or cold, and if you want it sweet. My read is that they pull quality shots but cater to a non-specialty audience, so they need to ask these sorts of questions.
review_2_text: Best option for coffee if you’re at the hospital - certainly better than the big brand store nearby that charges more than 3x for a terrible latte 😜
review_3_text: This coffee is perfect for those who prefer medium-light roasts.

name: ณิชา คอฟฟี่
Savor Society Superior
review_1_text:
Excellent cup of coffee.  The service is kind and friendly.   Nice place to sit with a coffee.  But, the chairs are not very comfortable.  I think nobody sits here because these chairs are
Very uncomfortable for a foreigner who has a large body.  Management please consider buying larger more Comfortable chairs.
review_2_text: Very good coffee with a great choice of coffee beans. Thank you Panwad for being always friendly and keep smiling.
review_3_text: Good coffee with a wide selection of beans and brew styles. Each cup has its own character. The service is friendly and makes the whole experience even better.
review_4_text:
One of two new specialty coffee shops in the new wing of Bangkok hospital. I’m overall satisfied, but the baristas struggled a bit making a piccolo latte. Perhaps they are only recently trained.

Edit: downgraded to 3 stars. After drinking more of my latte, it proves to be uninteresting. Almost watery, milk is lacking any texture.
review_5_text: This coffee shop is located on the 2nd floor of the Plaza2 building of  Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai. Good coffee with affordable price. Barista is very friendly and helpful for coffee recommendations. There are seats and tables for you to enjoy your coffee too.

name: Dopio Coffee
review_1_text: Coffee is expensive in proportion to the cost of hospital treatment.

name: PaLaCafe
review_1_text: Delicious, premium quality. The taste far exceeds the price. I encourage you to give it a try!

name: หจก. ไทยคอฟฟี่บีน
Inbox Coffee​ หนองป่าครั่ง
review_1_text: The owner is very kind. No matter what menu I order, he always asks for details. He is attentive and provides excellent service.

name: MORNING STREET CAFE' ร้านกาแฟอะไรเหมือนร้านเหล้า
Mizu cafe in car. หนองป่าครั่ง
review_1_text: The drinks are amazing. No food/sweet snacks though. But only coming for the drinks is definitely worth it. I had the Thai Tea Cream Cheese.
review_2_text:
The coffee is excellent, comparable to other coffee shops.
The price is reasonable.
There might not be parking available.
review_3_text: The coffee is excellent and the price is good too. It's perfect for everyday drinking for working professionals. There's no parking, so Grab to go is available.

name: ชายฝุ่นคอฟฟี่เฮ้าส์
🏡บ้านแม่นุ้ย พุทธพันธ์
ร้านตัดผมชาย ต้าร์วินเทจ
หมู่บ้านธารทอง
LUBE - Coffee & Special Drinks
review_1_text:
Lube Coffee Shop in Chiang Mai is an absolute gem nestled atop a picturesque hill, offering breathtaking views of a lush canopy of trees. This spot instantly transports you to a serene haven, making it the perfect place to unwind. My Monday morning visit was nothing short of delightful—sipping on a beautifully crafted coffee while gazing out over the greenery was a calming and rejuvenating experience.

The personal touch of having a heartfelt "thank you" message handwritten on the coffee lid added a thoughtful, warm touch that made me feel genuinely appreciated. The attention to detail, welcoming ambiance, and gorgeous natural setting make Lube Coffee Shop a must-visit for anyone looking to slow down and soak in some tranquility. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: I lovely coffee shop with a large yard. Found it while on a walk and read a while here. Was a quiet getaway from the louder main streets and seems like a good place for music in the evenings as well. The staff was kind, and the orchid soda was pleasantly refreshing.
review_3_text: reasonable price with great quality and atmosphere.
review_5_text: quite and peaceful

name: Basecamp Trail Cafe (Thailand)
review_1_text: The location is amazing and the area itself is very nice. The staff are friendly and helpful, but the Pad Thai was mostly just noodles, with almost no vegetables or tofu. The portion was also quite small, and since I was hoping for a proper breakfast, it wasn’t ideal for me. Coffee was okay.
review_2_text:
Great atmosphere chilling house vibes
Delicious smoothies and strong coffee!!!

Good weather.
Uphill location.

Amazing hiking starting off place. Parking spots available.
review_3_text:
Excellent selection of local Thai beans for sale or extraction.

I got V60 local light roast beans over ice, highly reccomend 👌
review_4_text:
Basecamp Coffee Club is a pleasant café with a relaxed atmosphere, good coffee and tea, and several comfortable seating options. The outdoor terrace is especially nice and a good place to sit and unwind.

Inside, however, the air conditioning is very cold, so it’s not really a place to warm up. Prices are quite high, particularly for pastries, cakes, and cinnamon rolls, which feel rather expensive for the portions.

A plus point is the small courtyard with convenient parking for scooters and bicycles, as well as a sports shop next door and a small kiosk downstairs. Overall a nice stop for a drink, but noticeably pricey.
review_5_text:
Great cafe in a beautiful and quiet spot surrounded by trees. I tried their dirty coffee which was fantastic, and ordered chicken rolls as a snack which was delicious. They have showering facilities and clean toilets too.

Just watch out for the falling nuts from the trees, and ensure you sit under the cover, as they were quite hefty and made a large thud when hitting the ground, can imagine how painful it'll be if it hit your head!

name: Annonymous Cafe : คาเฟ่ แอนโนนิมัส
review_1_text: Must try!
review_2_text: Nice coffee and warm service...parking available. The coffee is delicious, the staff are lovely and friendly. It's near Chiang Mai University, perfect for a coffee break, work, or just relaxing before heading back to class.

name: ห้ามจอดเดอะ คอฟฟี่ Hunjod the coffee
Plearn cafe : เพลิน คาเฟ่ หลัง มช.
review_1_text:
tables and chairs are uncomfortable for tall people at all!
coffee is so-so maybe i did a wrong choice to light roast…it taste too sour
but i like the big tree growing from the coffee house.it’s chill and happy to have my coffee with the ancient tree
i like the atmosphere(though AC was too cold!)so i did a drawing of this little cafe
review_2_text: The cafe is built with a tall tree jutting from its center. That itself is pretty cool. It has both covered seating downstairs and a rather un-maintained terrace upstairs (could use some TLC and cleaning). The drinks were not very good but the staff were friendly.
review_3_text: Lovely small coffee shop. Here provides drinks and desserts. Brownie is super tasty, drinks are great, love it. Will definitely come back if I visit Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: Ordered via grab : Thai tea and banana cake were very good but the french fries were the worst I had ever had - undercooked, no salt - impossible to eat
review_5_text:
Good place for local coffee but good taste!
More local coffee place. Coffee price start from 50THB. Middle roasted coffee bean is recommended!

name: Tantou Cha (ทันโตชา) - สาขาหลังมช.
Slope motion studio&cafe
review_1_text:
I like the Thai Tea, taste is good. The garden is nice, the cats is nice too.
They have smoke area seperately
review_2_text: Came here for a drink after visiting wat pha lat and had a delicious iced green tea and flat white. Also loved playing the guitar they had on hand! Staff were super friendly and attentive
review_3_text: Fantastic cafe to come and relax whilst you’re serenaded by various acoustic artists.  Plenty of seating outdoors, good WiFi and power points inside of you want to work.  Coffee is great and costs 55 baht for a latte.  Highly recommend this little oasis in suburbia! #BeatTheGrind
review_4_text: Nice place for chill out in the afternoon. Tasty coffee with relaxing environment! Good location around Chiang Mai University area.
review_5_text: Good coffee , Nature & Relex atmosphere

name: Blue House Cafe
review_1_text: Delicious food

name: Monday Cafe
review_1_text: Colorful cafe with nice drinks near the Chiang Mai university.
review_2_text: The coffee shop has been turned into a place to stay.
review_3_text: Very chill out place. Good 360 view of doi suthep good and delicious menu of coffee. friendly weed smoking zone
review_4_text: It's a lovely cafe with several antique cars. It's beautiful to take pictures.
review_5_text: Good

name: NEVER GIVE UP - Cafe
review_1_text:
This place has had several names in the past. It was called The Coffee Rich (Ritch), Never Give Up and now, NVGU. It was three floors now two with bathrooms on each floor. There is a classroom for rent on the second floor.

This place is comfortable for students to study and talk. Not a Instagram photo spot but there is plenty of room.

I ordered a Ice Latte and paid 65 baht.
review_2_text: Cute little cafe
review_3_text: The interior is calming, with a modern white design. However, 65 baht for a latte is a bit pricey, even though it's in the student area of ​​Chiang Mai University. The white base is nice, but adding some wood or greenery would create a more pleasant atmosphere. The music can be a little loud, but if you ask the staff, they'll turn it down. The coffee is generally tasty.
review_5_text: #EasyGuide

name: 333 MiNi House
review_1_text:
We really enjoyed our stay here!

The location is super convenient — few kms away to CMU and Ang Kaew Reservoir, which became our favorite spot for peaceful morning runs. It’s also close to the starting point of the Monk’s Trail. Near Lang Mor Night Market, so we had plenty of food options around. Even though it’s close to everything, the area is tucked away from the main road, so it’s quiet and relaxing.

The room was cozy with a big comfy bed and Netflix for lazy nights in. The bathroom is separate but still private because of the partition, so it wasn’t an issue at all. And huge thanks to Adel, the host — very responsive and helpful from start to finish.

Overall, it’s a great place to stay if you want comfort, convenience, and calm vibes in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: The bed sheets are very comfortable and clean. TV can watch Netflix. Downstairs had coffee and bread and biscuits. Owner is very nice
review_3_text: The owner is lovely, the bedroom is very comfortable, just like home, very relaxing, the air conditioning is cool, and there's Netflix 🤍
review_4_text: The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The hallway wasn't very soundproof, but the price was good. It was good value for money.
review_5_text: The room was clean. The owner was very helpful and took care of us like we were at home. We even got to eat seasonal lychees. There was a sitting area on the first floor with Wi-Fi and a TV. I will definitely come back again.

name: Real Slow Cafe&BBQ
review_1_text: Oh my, it's so delicious!!! I really want to give it 100 stars! The owner personally grills the pork belly in the yard to make it easy to eat. I ordered small plates at a reasonable price and ended up eating a mountain of them. For the kids who don't eat pork belly, I ordered rose tteokbokki, tteokgalbi, rolled eggs, and oden, and they were all not spicy and naturally delicious~~ The staff were friendly, and above all, I enjoyed a leisurely dinner in the camping atmosphere. I hope your business prospers!!! I'll come again next time!!!
review_2_text:
The coffee, Thai tea, and all the other drinks sold at Real Slow are absolutely delicious!

They've also started a Korean BBQ in the front yard, and it's also incredibly delicious! They also sell Korean-style hotteok (Korean pancakes), which are even tastier than the ones in Korea. ^^

The owner and staff are incredibly friendly.
review_3_text: This Korean BBQ restaurant is delicious, but it's not a buffet. The fried chicken is amazing and a must-order. The pork is pre-grilled, and you grill it yourself. There's only one type of dipping sauce. The atmosphere is nice, and there's plenty of parking.
review_4_text:
The camping-style atmosphere is amazing ⛺
The pork belly was great value for money, and the other Korean dishes were delicious too.

Anyone who loves K-POP has to come!
The music and the atmosphere are super hip. Coming with friends was so much fun.

I'm 100% certain I'll be back!
review_5_text: It's a la carte, but the price is like a buffet. And you get a lot. I recommend the gochujang pork. It's really delicious. The service is Korean style. You don't have to grill it yourself. A handsome Korean will grill it and serve it to you. When you arrive, you can eat it right away. It's excellent. I highly recommend it. After eating, you can also shop for secondhand clothes. The price is over a hundred. Seriously, did you make a profit? 555555

name: Little Basecamp
review_1_text: The new kid on the block with same great coffee and atmosphere as the old Basecamp. Talk with friends, plan great runs with friends and pet Mr. Bright the sometimes friendly dog. You can order food from across the street or enjoy some light snacks sold by the counter. Recommended.
review_2_text: Not as nice atmosphere as the original shop and the cats are missing. Service and drinks/food are still excellent. Would be nice if they had a sign/map to their new location.

name: ร้านจับนม (Since 2015) Jaabnom
review_1_text: Amazing cute little cafe. They have a study room as well which is chargeable. The scrambled egg with toast bread and northern pork sausage was the best. The hot Thai tea was so calming and is the best on a rainy day. Overall a nice place for breakfast they open at 9 am.
review_2_text: I had the cocoa husk tea, with bread, custard and chocolate dipping. I couldn't believe how delicious it was. I will definitely go back and try other flavors. It's worth the price. Owners very nice. Really recommend !! Check in !!
review_3_text: Good place for cacao drinks and beverages. Chill vibes, chitchat place with friends. But you can't bring ANY food in here. Even if you order a lot of things, you still can't bring and eat outside food. They gonna talk with you like "We not allowed to bring any food to eat here, you can eat them outside". For me, it's rude when you talk too loud to embarrass others in the restaurant. They talk to my mate like that, haha. But the food and beverages are still good to me, tho. I went to this place 6 times already. I can say that the cacao and food are good enough to come back.
review_4_text: This is a great place with a nice cozy atmosphere and delicious deserts. Especially their craft chocolate is amazing. Made of real cocoa beans. Drinking chocolate was 80 bhat and toast with chocolate, banana and condensed milk was 45 bhat.
review_5_text: This is the most gorgeous little place to sit and work, read or hang out! The family who run it are so lovely and the food and drinks are delicious. Such a wide range of drinks on offer and lots of flavours of sweet treats. The prices are so cheap too.

name: Dumnern Saduak Coffee Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: We found this restaurant by researching and was not disappointed. It is a very local restaurant, where there is no english menu (also, no wifi). We have been in Chiang mai for a couple of weeks now and tjis was a GREAT surprise, food-wise. It is not a touristy place at all and we found the food to be DELICIOUS. By watching the plates that were being ordered by the tables around, we understood that there are some dishes that are the fav ones - like the one I ordered:  scrambled eggs with seafood on top of rice. And I was surprised by how delicious it was. My husband ordered the rice with fried fish and he also was very pleased with it’s flavores and quality. They offer a very unique selection of chillis/ sauces. Both our plates costed 70 bahts. And we would love to come back to try many other dishes from the menu.
review_2_text: Food was delicious and clean, huge portions. Highly recommend - great service. They have a name-calling system when your order's ready, which I thought was a nice touch. Will definitely be back.
review_3_text: There are coffee shop and restaurant with separate cooking areas, but with common dining area. I should say food was not great, but capuchino was fantastic. We enjoyed sitting under the tree with a cup of good coffee.
review_4_text: good coffee good food and cheap. staff can speak english well and someone can speak Chinese language. good location near Chiangmai university
review_5_text:
I like the ambiance of this place. It's for students really but I don't think anyone would feel out of place in the relaxing green courtyard. Staff are friendly and the prices very reasonable. Lots of hot and cold drinks on offer, but no booze. There's also a good range of food options. Rather confusing system where you pay for your food and drinks separately.

The food is pretty sub-par, unfortunately. Gristly chicken and uncooked broccoli that had just been removed from the freezer. Perhaps they're using cheaper ingredients, but a good chef should know how to get the best out of off-cuts and this one clearly doesn't.

name: THE VOLCANO หลัง มช.
review_1_text: The café has a lovely atmosphere, with a simple yet beautifully designed space. Both the drinks and the pocket cheese toast are delicious and made with high-quality ingredients.
review_2_text:
I've had The Volcano toast a few years ago in Bangkok but only recently found out that it's a Chiang Mai original! I love their cheese toast - legit has a pull to it (see pic) and the cheese is not sweet.

This branch has plenty of seating on the second floor - on each of my visits so far it was quite empty. Some tables have plug outlets. Some tables are designed to link with the table next to them so it was rather annoying to sit by someone who kept shaking the entire structure. There are some simple board games free to use.

The staff here are mostly young, don't speak English much, but are super friendly and accommodating.

Toilets are outside communally shared with other restaurants, so ask for a key from the cashier to avoid paying.
review_3_text: Abit old and outdated . Sort of reminds of a kids playroom in some way . Food was okay but ice cream had no flavour at all.
review_4_text:
We really enjoyed our toasts! Nice and fun to eat!!! The prices are not expensive. Seatings are nice.

Parking along side the road. Not limited space but quite a lot of cars too. Must try your luck.

Bathrooms available outside of the shop. Not that clean though.
review_5_text:
I visited Volcano to enjoy our family's favorite dessert.
I always went to Volcano in Central Airport, and this was our first time visiting there. First, it's on the second floor, so if you order on the first floor and wait at the table on the second floor, they bring you food.
When they're busy, you'll have to look at the electronic display and go down to pick it up yourself.
The second floor is very hot because it only has one air conditioner.
The weather is so hot these days that it feels hot. It's cool to sit in the direction of the air conditioner.
Volcano cheese toast and chocolate toast are always so delicious, and the staff were really friendly and so kind.

name: SOFUTO CREAM หลัง มช.
review_1_text: Love the Japanese style soufflé pancakes 🥰 Sofuto Cream has a very nice selection of desserts, it’s one of my favorite spots to indulge in light fluffy carbs on cheat days. They have several locations in Chiang Mai so Google your way to the nearest spot and enjoy yourself 🤤🫶🥰
review_2_text: Yummy Japanese style desserts, and the kakigori is massive. Best to enjoy with your gang!🥞
review_3_text: Sofuto Cream, located behind Chiang Mai University (CMU), is a cozy Japanese-style café known for its premium soft-serve ice cream made from pure cow's milk sourced from Japan and Italy. The café offers a variety of flavors, including matcha, Hokkaido milk, and seasonal treats like Musang King durian and strawberry daifuku. In addition to soft-serve, they serve Kakigori, a finely shaved ice dessert topped with fresh ingredients like mango or red bean. With its minimalist and inviting interior, Sofuto Cream is a popular spot among students and dessert lovers seeking a peaceful place to enjoy high-quality treats.
review_4_text:
So good!!

I'm not an ice cream person but their matcha soft serve is delicious, creamy smooth, right amount of matcha, not bitter.

It was sweet for me but not as sweet as what other places offer.

The strawberry cheesecake Mochi was good too, didn't think there was ice cream inside, wasn't a fan, I don't like biting into the cold.

Inexpensive place with good standards
review_5_text:
So cute check-in restaurant. 👍
However, tasty is not good and very expensive. I ordered Original Soft Fancake and the cake flour still uncooked. 😡
Tried to writing the comments many times with ordered photos uploading but it's not work until today.

name: H A N D - Have A Nice Day
review_1_text: Mix and match 😍😅 Taste delicious
review_2_text: Nice bubble tea shop! Love that you can mix and match!
review_3_text: So deliciousssssss
review_4_text: Not bad!
review_5_text: #LetsGuide

name: Supattra x JourneyMan
review_1_text: Opens early in the morning. The staff are friendly. You have a lot of options for matcha. It gets crowded a bit on University days in the morning since everyone is rushing for their coffee. We had Americano medium roast which was amazing.
review_2_text:
Hands down one of the best coffee spots in the area.

Chill music and crowd. Great service. they also speak good English which is nice.

And they have great beans hah
review_3_text: Absolutely love this cafe! The staff are so nice, the coffee and food is incredible (pad thai crispy pork and the sandwiches are the best!) and unbeatable value, and it's in a really nice part of town, at the foot of Doi Suthep. One of the best cafes in CM.
review_4_text:
After a decade, I returned to what used to be my favorite restaurant, now transformed into a charming coffee shop. The ambiance has evolved, but it retains a welcoming vibe that feels both familiar and new.

The variety of coffee beans available was impressive, even though many had similar taste profiles. The coffee I tried was excellent. Although the Pad Thai has changed from what I remember, it was still enjoyable.

Prices are reasonable and environment is cozy.
review_5_text:
Very positively surprised by how good and tasty the food was.
We stopped there a little bit by accident to have a bite before a long ride and it was really great. We had a caesar salad and then a pad Thai/ a chicken curry. Both dishes were delicious (the Curry 😍😍).
PS ; it was 2pm and we hadnt eaten since the day before. Portions are really ok.

In addition, the service is really nice and friendly, and we loved the music that was played.

name: LAW COFF & CO ลอว์คอฟ แอนด์ โค หลังมช.
review_1_text: I hit up this cafe every time I'm in Chiang Mai. I still remember how the chef made the coffee. It's the best coffee in all of Chiang Mai; there's no better. The perfect amount of milk and coffee, the flat white tastes exceptional, the coffee is very intense, and it's always take dark roast. This December, I visited many cafes, but even those that promote great design can't compare to this tiny one on the corner. I love this place.
review_2_text: We gotta gather all the laws in this world to break free from jails. Drinking a cup of coffee frees me from the jail of sleepiness. The staff are super nice and smiley. The coffee tastes amazing. Besides all the different coffees and drinks, the shop also has some souvenirs like T-shirts, postcards, and stickers. The WiFi is super fast with a really long password, so hackers will have a tough time messing with your privacy. The shop has both inside and outside seating. Being close to Suthep Road and Chiang Mai University is a huge plus. They also have a reward program where you get a 40 Thai Baht discount after buying 10 cups.
review_3_text: ฿50 for a very delicious cappuccino. Highly recommend their medium roast.
review_4_text: It is a tiny cafe, but is a great place to pick up to go coffee. There are some types of beans available and the service is very good and they explained to me really well. I tried ice americano to go and it was great and well priced.
review_5_text: My favorite coffee beans ❤️ I also like going to the other Law coffee shops at CMU.  Light roast R&B blend.  I buy 3 bags of these every month.  Thank you 🙏

name: Bankha.cnx
review_1_text: homey cafe vibe👍🏻🏡 wifi available, good coffee and bakery, recommend for chilling with your friends (we’re have a lot of boardgame) or study/reading a book/working🥰
review_2_text:
Such a Cozy cafe.
Good drink
Good mood
Great VIBE!!!
review_3_text:
A new shop near the university.
Beautifully decorated, perfect for chilling out or reading a book.
review_4_text:
Delicious coffee, great atmosphere. Perfect for chilling out for a long time!
#The owner is so lovely!
review_5_text: A newly opened coffee shop in a hidden location, but the drinks are delicious! They also have games to play and the staff provides great service. 🤲❤️

name: ร้าน COCOA BLACK หลังมช.ฝั่งประตูวิศวะ
Catopia Chiangmai
review_1_text: The lady running the place is really nice but I'm afraid it's my least favorite cat cafe so far. I wish they could make more money though to improve the place. They have under 10 cats, Persians and Thai cats. It's more like someone's house and they opened to visitors as long as you buy a drink. But the place is quite old and a bit too small for the amount of cats, I think.
review_2_text: Came here to relax in the A/C and pet some very beautiful Thai cats.  Had a blueberry smoothie, was good!  Nice place for travellers and locals alike to chill.
review_3_text: Poor cats. They look sick. Some of them have infections. They pee on the floor which is unusual to be seen like that. And the food is everywhere on the floor.
review_4_text: Tried coming twice and they were closed during hours they say they are open. Don’t waste your time and money to come here. This isn’t a business.
review_5_text: Good selection of cats, kept us entertained for a solid hour.

name: A Peace Of Cake's Baking Studio
Sode Cafe
review_1_text: Fantastic cafe just across from Chiang Mai University. Beautiful park like settings. Super cafe with very reasonably priced and good quality coffee. Around the cafe area are lots of different food options from Thai regulars to pizzas and also a range of kebabs etc. Many different areas to sit under trees etc. All in all a really lovely cafe. Very busy during lunch times and frequented by many university students. We'll worth a stop if you're in the neighbourhood. I had a falafel kebab for lunch which was delicious and my eating partner said his Khao Soi was very good also.
review_2_text:
One of the nicest cafes in Chiang Mai.
Good coffee, tea and desserts.
Nicely decorated, as siting in the garden.
A bit far from the Old City, but worth an effort to visit, riding a bicycle or a motorcycle
review_3_text:
Dear manager,

I am really happy to discover your lovely place. The only reason I do not give 5 stars is because of the plastic cups…

I was so sad to see that all customers who ordered an ice coffee or tea got a plastic cup.  I understand when customers order take away... but why you don't have glasses for customers who drink in the cafe?

Thailand is one of the countries where most plastic is being used in the world.
In this time of global warming, we all need to take responsibility to keep our planet healthy for our children and grand children.

I hope I will see people drinking from reusable glasses in the future.

Warm regards,
Cat 🙏
review_4_text: I love this café. It's one of the best spots in CM for working and has great and cheap drinks. The sandwich is also very good. The whole atmosphere is amazing.
review_5_text: It is very near Chiang Mai university. So there are mostly young students and also few foreigners who live in Chiag Mai for years. This cafe is in a garden. In this garden there are 4-5 small restaurants for eating too. You can order your food from any shop and eat in cafe with your drink. Prices are reasonable. Cafe latte 35 baht.

name: Minimal coffee - CMU
review_1_text: I visited Minimal Cafe CMU in Chiang Mai, Thailand, and was impressed. The ambiance is serene and inviting with clean lines, neutral tones, and ample natural light. The coffee and beverages are exceptional, and the menu reflects a commitment to quality and flavor. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the prices are reasonable. Overall, Minimal Cafe CMU is a must-visit for those seeking a good taste coffee in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Good coffee, reasonable prices.
review_3_text: Ordered a Caramel macchiato, love the taste. The cafe looks cute too.
review_4_text: Perfect place to go for a cheap but good quality coffee!
review_5_text: Single shot for latte, but flavour good.

name: Coffee77
review_1_text: One of my default coffee shops around the neighborhood to chill at mostly due to its quietness and decent coffee. Open air seating within a garden. During the day when it doesn't rain it's comfortable under the shades but inside or towards late afternoon there's definitely mosquitoes abound. Toilet cleanliness could be better.
review_2_text: Cute covered outdoor cafe.  Babe got an Iced Caramel milk and I got an Apple tea and they were both so delicious
review_3_text:
short review:
Excellent coffee a normal price, good cookies and chill vibe setting, don't miss this!

They offer 3 types specialty coffee in light, medium, and medium-dark roast.
For your milk based coffee they also have oat milk.
I tried the medium roast in espresso and it's a great acidic entry for anyone who wants to try something different, come and see how espresso can be something else than plain bitterness and dry after taste.
Good coffee beans is great, but they know how to pull a shot correctly, and espresso enthusiasts know it's not about pressing a button on an expensive machine.

As usual, not much food to go with it but they have exceptionally good cookies almond or chocolate, don't let their look fool you these are dense!
The pricing is really friendly too, usually this type places charge you "specialty money coffee" , and the setting is their garden with tables laying around, chill jazz music..

The street still has some traffic but very slow paced, not a major route so I'd consider this a chill place for South Asia 😅
review_4_text: Very cosy and quiet coffee shop with affordable coffee and different kinds of roasts. Nice surroundings. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: Really good coffee. Breakfast was ok, nice people.

name: Fav. coffee. roaster - UniLoft
review_1_text: There’s really nothing to complain about apart from lack of parking space. I wouldn’t mind drinking from this place everyday.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee and lovely service. This is a small coffee booth with a few seats. The medium dark roast is just perfect - not too sour or acidic. The server is friendly and prices are great.
review_3_text: Great coffee in a good location (and very cheap prices). I strongly recommend!
review_4_text: This place makes the best cappuccino from the several places in the area that I have tried. I've also had an Es-Yen - my first - and it was excellent. They will have my business whenever I stay in this part of the area.
review_5_text: This place is amazing value for money. High quality coffee and friendly service.

name: Early Bird Korean Study Cafe
review_1_text: Very good study&work environment in Chiangmai if you think your hotel is too cold. Not many people there so it’s very quiet. The drink and service are all very nice. Internet is also good. Toilet is clean
review_2_text: Wonderful place to study with 3 floors and many tables! Would recommend 🥰
review_3_text:
Really impressive. Had i found this place sooner id be here all day while i stayd in chiangmai.
Havent felt this kind of vibe since i was a little kid in korea. The atmosphere is designed so that you can zone in and focus. If you cant focus here theres gotta be something wrong with you. Very clean too
Coffee is cheap and there are no people at the moment on early Saturday morning . There are three stories w ac and bathsrooms n lights n everything i wonder how they afford to pay rent n utilities because coffees relatively cheaper than other cafes too. Maybe its the location idk but one of the hidden gem for cafe bug digital nomad like me .
review_4_text:
The shop was under renovation and closed for a long time but now the shop is open again recently, from 11 am to 11 pm.
This shop is good for those who want to study.
Students can get some benefits from the shop though I don't remember what they are(Because I am not a student).
Somebody posted the menu but it is incorrect(A cup of coffee doesn't cost 80 baht!)
No music was played in the second floor(Good for people who want to study).
review_5_text: So fine, to study

name: วันชัยโยเกิร์สดปั่น
review_1_text: My favorite place to buy yogurt smoothies!! I recommend the avocado or mango though everything is delicious.
review_2_text: Good helping of yogurt! Fantastic.
review_3_text: Tasty and cheap price
review_4_text: This is a real dessert, very sweet, extremely sweet, incredibly sweet. Iced bread dessert starts at 49 baht.
review_5_text: All the smoothies are delicious.

name: MAMAMADE
review_1_text: Cute cafe with nice and value cocoa!!!
review_2_text: More than 10 cocoa related products to choose from! Love the taste and affordable price!
review_3_text: A truly authentic cocoa shop for cocoa lovers. Every cocoa drink on the menu is delicious, and the prices are student-friendly. The owner is very kind, and the atmosphere is perfect for relaxing. This is a cafe I highly recommend to anyone passing by the area behind Chiang Mai University.
review_4_text: The price seemed a bit high, but the taste was worth it. The restaurant was cool with air conditioning and soothing music. I highly recommend it.
review_5_text: This cocoa is so fragrant and delicious! If you're a cocoa lover, I highly recommend it. The price is great for the taste. I'll definitely be back for more.

name: Behind 42 Cafe
review_1_text: Cozy and quiet little café near CMU, with a spacious second floor co-working space. Perfect for a quick refreshment or a comfortable spot to get some work done.
review_2_text: This cute little café is located at the backside of CMU. It has a cozy atmosphere, great coffee.
review_3_text: nice coffee shop
review_4_text: The coffee menu is delicious. I recommend the vanilla latte. The desserts are also delicious.
review_5_text: When in-store orders come in, we recommend that you serve in-store customers first. Customers will have to wait for orders after 3-4 delivery orders, so in-store customers will have to wait for their drinks for half an hour. 😊

name: นมกระป๋อง
review_1_text: A shop that sells delicious milk at very cheap prices!! Free blended milk, free pearls, like selling for the community, not for profit. The seller is smiling and kind. If you like it less sweet, you can get it less sweet. Every menu is delicious. There is also fresh coffee, various clear tea menus, and fresh blended fruit juices.

name: น้ำเต้าหู้ หลัง มช.
Simpsons' Coffee Bar
review_1_text: เมนูนี้ก็อร่อย ชาไทย มัทฉะ คือดีสำหรับคนที่ไม่ดื่มกาแฟ 😍 ราคาไม่แพง ร้านนั่งสบาย

name: Ice coffee
review_1_text: The turtle is so cute and funny. He came to suck milk and suck on the pearls. The price is good and the pearls are pop too. So yummy! 🐢🐢
review_2_text: I ordered a strawberry fresh milk cocoa. It was very delicious.
review_3_text: Strawberry milk shake with jelly is very delicious and rich. I highly recommend Nong Tao's shop.
review_4_text: Strawberry milk green tea is very delicious. It's near my office so I order it often.
review_5_text: Excellent 👍👍

name: Mild Coffee
review_1_text: We ordered the cold chocolate and it was absolutely amazing. The sweetness level was perfect and creamy and thick. Loved every sip of it !!! It has limited seating and is near another restaurant.
review_2_text:
Always good to go.
They serve a long drink menu but no food. No inside dining but some table and chairs outside.
A little bit less expensive than the rest. Next to 7-11.
review_3_text: Good coffee at a reasonable price💯👌They serve other drinks too.
review_4_text: Smooth, good tasting coffee, good price for vanilla latte 35 baht and only 30 baht for a smooth very good tasting, slightly sweet regular coffee. For the superior taste this place offers this is the best deal I’m town for high quality coffee. Very impressive. The coffee is mild and pleasant. The owner uses coffee bean from the north of Thailand, the quality is top notch. It’s one of the places for coffee I like to frequent. Clean serving area and nice place to sit. Quick order window service. Funny little fact they are closed only one day a month. The 25th of each month is the only day they are closed. Interesting, quirky policy...makes me like the place even more. This place is just perfect for a quick really good tasting cup of Joe. You will be a fan to, this place does not disappoint.
review_5_text: Reasonable price coffee

name: ร้านกาแฟสดน้ำปั่นป้านก สาธิตมช.
review_1_text: grilled chicken

name: Khunmor Coffee
review_1_text: Cute coffee stand with great coffee for really good prices.  Small indoor seating area and decent WiFi.  Iced cap was huge!
review_2_text: You get what you pay for lol
review_3_text: Orange coffee, cheap, good and strong, 55 baht. Stopped by for a quick drink after parking. Loved it!
review_4_text: The coffee had no aroma, it didn't taste like fresh coffee at all, and the flavor was strange, bland, and tasteless. The iced tea smelled like medicine, like they didn't care about making the coffee. 😤 I'm so disappointed and regret wasting my money. The person who made it didn't put any effort into it.
review_5_text: Different pearls, different taste

name: ร้านกาแฟป้าพรรณ
review_1_text: Good local coffee and fresh drink.
review_2_text: The shop owner is kind and the service is friendly. The haircut was excellent, and the coffee was incredibly delicious.
review_3_text: Mama noodles are delicious.
review_4_text: Delicious, strong iced coffee
review_5_text: Delicious coffee at a reasonable price

name: Neighbor CNX
review_1_text: Super chill vibes. Fun with friends. Music, food, environment immaculate. Must visits great pizza! Wine, whiskey, plum wine, variety of draft beer- enjoyable. Will definitely come here often.

name: คอฟฟี่ สเตชั่น 109
Vitamin Bar
review_1_text: Fresh and good price. You will not feel more thirsty , after take a drink
review_2_text: Samrang makes awesome smoothies. Loved the mango breeze, coffee and avocado smoothie.
review_3_text: Fresh fruit Recommend 👍🏼
review_4_text: Really good place to pick up a cocktail. Great selection, love their avocado banana smoothie. Definitely recommend this place.
review_5_text: Good tastes and reasonable price

name: นมจอยหลังมอ
review_1_text: The drinks are delicious and the staff provides excellent service.

name: BM DIARY coffee
review_1_text: Very delicious. Must try.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious.

name: ส้มถังหลังมอ.Thai Tea (ร้านน้ำผลไม้ปั่นซอยวัดอุโมงค์)
review_1_text: Delicious and refreshing fresh fruit smoothies at affordable prices. The taro bubble tea is rich and tasty for only 20 baht. They use Meiji milk too. Other places would charge at least 30 baht for this quality.
review_2_text: The iced cocoa is amazing! Deliciously rich and creamy, the best behind the university. And it's only 20 baht, such great value!
review_3_text: I ordered a lemonade and it was wonderfully sour!
review_4_text: Delicious! I highly recommend it. The cocoa is rich and flavorful, and the price is very reasonable at only 20 baht.

name: Favor Cafe' Chiang Mai
review_1_text: This is a quiet and lovely little cafe . Although the drinks weren't amazing, the cake was delicious enough! The staff were very warm and polite, and the atmosphere was great.
review_3_text: Quiet place and coffee is tasty.
review_4_text: Pad Thai is the best!!!! I recommend !!!! Also I ordered “Black Orange” which mean black coffee  orange juice that is so refreshing
review_5_text: Good 👍🏻

name: อ้อนนมสด
review_1_text:
Streetside vendor offering toast, steamed bread with kaya dipping, and different drinks ie. coffee, tea, flavoured milk.
It's been around for approx 20 years so that says something about this stall.
review_2_text: amazing milk ！ I love hot milk and milk smooth and must eat the green bread with green sauce. I always come here for dinner.
review_3_text: Aon Nom Sod in Chiang Mai is a must-try spot if you're craving fresh milk drinks! This place serves delicious, creamy fresh milk with a variety of toppings and flavors, making it a perfect treat for any time of day. The milk is super fresh, and the sweetness is just right—not too overwhelming. You can choose from a range of options, from classic flavors to unique ones, all prepared with care. The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, with friendly staff who make you feel at home. Whether you're a milk lover or just looking for a refreshing drink, Aon Nom Sod offers a great experience in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: Hot milk is good here.
review_5_text: Cheap toast and drinks. Always crowded.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: I like it. The price is cheap. The taste is the best
review_2_text: I have been to Thailand for a total of one year and can understand some Thai.  The waiter's attitude is too "good". I will use Thai language when I am bored. I will write an email to the company.  Never see again.
review_3_text: The coffee shop I usually go closed so I went here. the coffee is just as any other amazon coffee which is not that good. But the staff at this shop really has an attitude when he serves or talks to you. Nice one.
review_4_text: Cozy place to relax. Better not come during exam weeks.
review_5_text: Green tea is made of black tea with adding green coloring. Makes one wonder what all those smoothies are made of

name: Thima Cafe (ฐิมา คาเฟ่)
review_1_text:
Really cute small cafe behind CMU.
If you're a fan of Zootopia, you shouldn't missed this cafe! Good coffee and atmosphere. The service is very good too!
review_2_text: Zootopia fans definitely shouldn’t miss this place! 🐰🦊✨ A new café and a lovely co-working space with cute Zootopia dolls and an adorable little hamster. The café is still expanding, and I love how the owner asks for customer feedback. It really makes you feel part of their journey. The Coco soft cream was delicious, smooth, and not too sweet. The staff and owner are very kind and welcoming. Parking can be a bit tricky, but it’s worth a short walk. The menu is still limited for now. So I’m looking forward to more in the future naka. 😊
review_3_text: Great place for working or just chill. The couple running it is lovely and the Thai tea was delicious 😊
review_4_text:
Chill cafe great for relaxing in the sofa.
The couple running it are lovely and cared a lot about us. The latte with soft cream was delicious, aroi mak!
review_5_text:
Service good , I love coffee cake  so yumm🥰
I❤️thima cafe

name: LUCKY CUP COFFEE CMU ลัคกี้คัพ คอฟฟี่ สาขาหลัง มช 幸运咖
review_1_text: It's delicious. What's exciting is that this restaurant is not only delicious, but also cheap.
review_2_text:
The ambiance is absolutely perfect! After a tiring day exploring Chiang Mai University, it's so relaxing to sit in this coffee shop!

The coffee is delicious! The ice cream is cheap! The croissants are yummy!
review_3_text: Delicious, inexpensive, and good service.
review_4_text: Lucky Coffee is now available in Chiang Mai, along with other products not available in China. The products are delicious, and the store has a warm and inviting atmosphere.
review_5_text: I saw them giving away free ice cream, so I went in to buy some. There were so many people with coupons, I thought I'd get one if I bought first. But I bought one and still didn't get one. Turns out they gave it to everyone except me! So annoying. The taste was okay, the vanilla ice cream was a little strange. They didn't have milk tea, only coffee (as the name suggests) and fruit tea. I ordered the strawberry green tea, which was alright, not bad. The worst part is not getting a coupon! 😡😡😡 (But the staff were nice.)

name: MR.WHITE COFFEE
review_1_text: Coffee is ok. Only outside tables. Clean. Price is like 60-70 bth. Coffee price near Chiangmai university here is a little expensive. Next to door with dental clinic. Owner needs more kindness.
review_2_text:
👍🏼
1) Friendly services
2) Tasty hot latte
3) Clean and modern looking cafe
4) Reasonable prices for the beans quality

👎🏼
5) It's sharing a lot with the WHITE Dental, not sure if coffee goes so well with dental health, cause the dentist I visited told me to cut down on coffee to prevent the further staining my teeth
6) Outdoor seatings, not the greatest, not really comfortable, partly Chiang Mai is quite warm
7) Portion seems a bit too small
8) The inside of the cafe seems occupying so much space where the barista only occupies the front part of the shop

*All photographs by me, using LEICA SL2, paired with LUMIX 28-220mm lens
review_3_text: Took a little break while walking around. Randomly came across this coffee shop. Decent matcha latte and iced latte. Offers three different blends. Good for a quick break. Basic roadside seating available.
review_4_text: The coffee tastes really good and delicious! 😍
review_5_text: The cocoa is delicious.

name: กาแฟสดสังคม สาขาข้างแจ่มฟ้า
review_1_text: The iced tea and cocoa are delicious! Super cheap at only 20 baht, but the quality is excellent. Parking might be a little difficult though.
review_2_text: Delicious, cheap, very rich. Whether it's the regular Nestea tea, iced tea, or green tea, you can order the sweetness level at this shop. If you don't specify, Phi Kai, the maker, will make it a little sweet. The secret is to say that it's not too sweet, which is just right. Now the shop has upgraded, allowing you to add pearls for only +5.-, which is even more delicious. Phi Kai's staff is lovely and friendly. This is my regular shop.
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious, but the female staff spoke rudely and argued with the customers every time. 9/8/21 3:20 PM
review_4_text: Delicious, minus the staff.

name: Whoops ice cream gelato homemade cafe - ฮูปไอศครีมเจลาโต้โฮมเมด ร้านของคนรักไอศครีม
review_1_text: Very yummy ice cream with great value for money! 🍨 Portions are huge and there’s a wide variety of flavors. Highly recommend for ice cream lovers💕
review_2_text: Good gelato that come with a good price. I have ordered a small size sundae with only 63 bahts which is really worth it. But overall of this sundae I feel like it's getting a bit too sweet at the end. If the salted caramel can get a bit salty it would be better. Still definitely must try tho 🌟😋
review_3_text: The chocolate ice cream was tasty and creamy. Loved it.
review_4_text:
Best Gelato in Chiang Mai!
Whoops Gelato is hands down the best gelato spot in Chiang Mai! The flavors are fresh, unique, and perfect for the hot weather. Their signature Nam Dao Hu (Soy milk)  is a must-try—creamy, refreshing, and unlike anything else. Every scoop reminds me of the authentic gelato I had in Florence. I absolutely love this place and will definitely be coming back again and again! Highly recommended!
review_5_text: This place sells HOMEMADE gelato. Interesting flavors. Right amount of sweetness. Must try! The shop is nice and clean with AC, perfect for a hot weather in Thailand🍧

name: Agri Chapter : Art Farmer
review_1_text:
The place has a cozy vibe with green and brown tones, lots of wood, and a warm, relaxing atmosphere.

They serve spaghetti, steaks, salads, wraps, and sandwiches — all tasty and reasonably priced. The coffee and matcha are also really good.

Overall, it’s a comfortable spot with good food and drinks.
review_2_text: A newly open cafe at CMU, good location and free paring space. Available both European and Thai food menu. The price is quite high in average, but b8g portion.
review_3_text: My new favourite coffee shop in Chiang Mai. This place ticks all the boxes for me.  Art Farmer Cafe has always had some of the best coffee you can get in Thailand but now with this new venue they have a wonderfully designed environment. Very good place to get work done, great music, wonderful people, and now they do good food too.
review_4_text: New cafe at faculty of agriculture, so sage green here! Big space and plenty seats
review_5_text: Hi! I was wondering if you have an air purifier in the cafe, or any air filtration system?

name: นมเกษตร มช. @ KORINOMILK
review_1_text: Had soft cream in cup for lunch at the shop. Soft as the name but a bit too sweet for me.
review_2_text: Really nice little shop to try out delicious milky drinks, milk shakes, and ice cream🍦🥛🧋
review_3_text: This is a famous restaurant near Chiang Mai University. I've been a customer since my daughter was in grade 7 at the Chiang Mai University Demonstration School, and now she's in her fourth year of medical school at Chiang Mai University, and the taste is still the same – unique and delicious. There's convenient seating and parking inside the university. I encourage everyone to try it; you'll be hooked!
review_4_text: The staff recommended a 35 baht shake + ice cream, so we tried it, but it wasn't the kind of ice cream that tasted like milk; it was just fat and sugar. It was so sweet that we couldn't help but leave it behind. It was a calorie bomb. ^^;;
review_5_text: This milk shop is run by students from the Faculty of Agriculture at Chiang Mai University (CMU). Everyone has to try it because the milk is fragrant, creamy, and cheap. Whenever I'm back at CMU, I always stop by for a glass. The shop has tables under the shade of trees, making it a nice, relaxing place to sit. If you're visiting CMU, I highly recommend trying it!

name: Taruka ชานมไข่มุก-สาขาหลัง มช.
review_1_text: I ordered bubble tea with no ice. When it was delivered there was only half a cup of bubble tea for 68 baht? We drove to the shop to check and I have to say the girls were very kind. They were sweet and patient. They stated that if you ask for no ice that’s the standard amount you get but how do they measure that? Very disappointing for the price.
review_2_text: The staff are always lovely. Even though the other branch is closer, I don't drive to buy it. I always come to this branch. Everyone knows what I usually order.
review_3_text: I really like this shop's pearls. They're so sweet, soft, and delicious. I ordered them with less sweet Taiwanese milk tea. They really won my heart!🥹🫶
review_4_text:
The water was delicious, and most of the staff were lovely.
However, on March 2, 2015, we ordered jasmine tea, but the staff member said they were out of stock, so we ordered peach tea. He told us the peach tea was out of stock, and we were confused as to how it could be. He slammed the menu down hard and yelled at us, saying the jasmine tea was out of stock, which was confusing. The person behind us then explained that jasmine tea is the base of all fruit teas, and we got it. We wish the staff would have spoken politely, but they wouldn't have done that.
I had a stern expression, and I had to explain clearly to the customers why it was out of stock, because some people just don't know, and not all customers know. ^^
review_5_text: The cheese here is the best I've ever had. The cheese at other branches is always runny.

name: นมหมีปั่น Over bear หลัง มช
เสพย์ติดชา สาขาหลัง ม.ช.
review_1_text:
It's good.
Very fast services.
review_2_text: It's an ordinary tea shop with no unexpectedly delicious flavors, but it's a suitable meeting place before going to other shops because it has air conditioning inside, so you can sit and order tea while you wait.
review_3_text: A small shop in an alley. Visited on 21/7/2024. Parked in the university and walked there.
review_4_text: This shop is in the alley opposite the Chiang Mai University Engineering entrance. Walk in for about five to sixty meters and you'll find a small shop on the left. The front of the shop looks simple. The interior is decorated in the style of an old coffee shop with broken walls, providing some photo opportunities. The drinks are tasty and there's a wide variety of menu items at student prices. Those who drive should find parking near the entrance of the alley before walking in, as parking within the alley is very difficult.
review_5_text: Nestea bubble tea, 50% sweetness, was great. I used to drink it all the time when I was a university student (student ID 59).

name: Mormilk CMU
review_1_text: Best Greek yoghurt I've had in a while...super cute and low key cafe in the university area
review_2_text:
They don't always have everything that's on the menu, but maybe it was good to break my habit and try minty milk lol it was refreshing!
The staff was kind and patient. Interesting pets on the table, snakes and fish lol
review_3_text:
This shop is located next to the Faculty of Agriculture at Chiang Mai University.
The coffee, drinks, and food are quite affordable.
The milk is produced by the Faculty of Agriculture and is quite delicious; the hot cappuccino I ordered was smooth and tasty.

The outdoor seating is even more comfortable when the weather isn't hot.
They offer board games inside, making it a great place for student gatherings. It doesn't seem to have many foreign tourists usually.
review_4_text: Suitable for working or playing with friends. There are free board games, a variety of drinks, coffee, tea, milk, soda, matcha, desserts, sandwiches, and ice cream. There is music, and seats inside have air conditioning, and outside have fans.
review_5_text: The coffee here is great 👍, and I also recommend the milk and ice cream.

name: ร้านน้ำปั่น Love Juice Smoothies
กาแฟสดจากไร่
Mee Sha - มีชา ชานมไข่มุก
ร้านเอื้องแซะสวนดอก(วิไล ขนมหวานไทย)
review_1_text: It's a food court next to the pharmacy at the Faculty of Pharmacy. People from outside the faculty can also eat there. There's plenty of seating, but it's best to sit on the outer edges so you don't disturb the doctors or eavesdrop on them. 😁 They serve noodles, made-to-order dishes, rice with curry, and desserts.

name: Espresso the Dark
review_1_text: The best coffee that serve you by the first priority is coffee’s test not other thing, however can order the owner to serve with the test you like.
review_2_text: This place has really good tasting ice coffee. I highly recommend the Thai style coffee it’s the best in Chiang mai from my experience. What makes it so great is the coffee bean blend. The flavor is just so intense and deep without being bitter. It’s smooth and satisfyingly intense. Deep intense flavor. The Thai owner guy understands English pretty good and is a nice guy to talk to. It’s worth the trip to try this place out you will for sure have a satisfying fantastic cup of coffee at this place. Enjoy!!
review_3_text: Roadside coffee van that uses the lever extraction method for espresso etc. A few bar seats under the awning and very friendly owner. Pretty good espresso, which is all I've tried. Overall a good spot for a quick drink.
review_4_text:
Black van coffee. They serve good coffee. My fav menu is iced mocha.
Update 2024:
From black van to green booth in front of Lamour baber shop
review_5_text:
Surprisingly Very Nice Roasted Coffee !!!!
Strong Caramelised Taste Black Coffee.
The owner actually asked which type you preferred between fruity taste and dark roast.

name: ร้านกาเเฟสดภูพยัคฆ์ สาขาเชียงใหม่ ( มูลนิธิเทพรัตนเวชชานุกูล )
review_2_text: Good coffee with reasonable price and nice staff
review_3_text: Coffee lovers with milk have to try this! It's super rich and creamy. The staff member, Nong Som, is so lovely. You get exactly what you order, and "less sweet" really means less sweet.
review_4_text: This coffee shop is located in the Thep Ratana Vechanukul Foundation building. If you don't look carefully, you might not even realize it's a coffee shop, as it's not very prominent, with only a small sign protruding from the building. But once you try the service, the atmosphere is warm and friendly, the coffee is delicious, and you get the chance to learn more about the foundation at the same time. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
ร้านกาเเฟที่ทรงคุณค่าอีกร้านนึง ...
สมเด็จพระเทพรัตนราชสุดาฯ สยามบรมราชกุมารี
เสด็จพระราชดำเนินเปิดอาคารมูลนิธิเทพรัตนเวชชานุกูล เเละร้านกาเเฟภูพยัคฆ์ สาขาเชียงใหม่ (มูลนิธิเทพรัตนเวชชานุกูล) เมื่อวันที่ 26 มกราคม 2561

name: willeamกาแฟโบราณ
review_1_text: Our menu is amazing, orders are pouring in!

name: Roastniyom coffee(Suan Dok)
review_1_text: This was a nice place to visit. Very quiet but vibrant. The coffee was good, the chairs were very  comfortable for seating and talking. The location has wifi for laptop working. It is right next door to the hospital so there are a lot of ppl that come in and out for business and pleasure. You must be comfortable with the traffic flow of customers to enjoy the location. Once you are inside and seated, the atmosphere is fine. I will visit again.
review_2_text:
Good place to work from if you have noise cancelling headphones. Well located if you’re living in Nimman.

Possibility to sit at the tables with regular chairs or to go for lower tables with more comfortable sofas or leather blanket.

Coffee is good. Air conditioning tends to be too high, so being a jumper with you.
review_3_text: This is a franchise cafe with good coffee. It definitely has franchise vibe, which is not my preference. Americano is 55thb here and it’s good
review_4_text: The best coffee shop around near Suan Dok hospital. You can come to chill out or working. There’s space for you to sit and have a coffee and work. Pleas come and enjoy your time!!
review_5_text:
Edit June 2023...
Recently renovated and really nice looking but the WiFi is still horrible.
AC and good coffee at reasonable prices.

Good coffee and comfortable environment but the last two times I've gone there the Wifi was not working so, 3/5 stars

name: Yosniyom Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee. Nice little spot to relax and enjoy a cup of coffee🧋. But a bit pricey compared to the other cafes in the area.
review_2_text: Best coffee in town for single origins and micro lots. Also home made ice creams and non coffee drinks
review_3_text: Cheap and decent coffee. Workout at gym 30 m away ( the playground) the. Get ur coffee here 😁
review_4_text: Small hole in the wall coffee. But the coffee taste is good n good price.
review_5_text: Good coffee available , Ice Americano with medium roast

name: Jaritt Nymmanh Hotel
review_1_text:
“Great location, clean and spacious room, friendly staffs & furstaffs”
The hotel is located in a very strategic location. Walking distance to all the great food spots, endless cafes, massage centres, and One Nimman mall. The room was well prepared and very clean when we checked-in. Our room was located on the ground level. The room is spacious and equipped with the standard amenities. The bed is comfortable. The minibar is well stocked up and complimentary. The minibar provides some local snacks, in a way supporting local business. The owners/staffs are very friendly and helpful. The furstaffs are happy to work for food. Treats are accepted by the furstaffs. I would definitely return to stay in this hotel, and would recommend to stay in this hotel. Good vibes!
review_2_text: Very serene, quiet and calming place to stay. The staff are super friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend.
review_3_text: This hotel truly feels like a home away from home. The rooms are spacious with large, comfortable beds, perfect for a restful night's sleep. The room includes a cozy living area and a generously sized bathroom with a luxurious shower. One of the highlights is the outdoor space, where guests can relax on the wooden sofa by the tranquil fish pond. The on-site café is beautifully designed and offers a lovely spot to unwind. Above all, the staff is exceptionally friendly and attentive, making every stay a memorable experience.
review_4_text: We had a great stay. The room is clean and cozy. It has beautiful vintage decorations in the room, yard and lobby. The hotel is located in a quiet zone, but is close to the busy street/road. The hostess and hosts are kind and hospitality. I would strong recommend this hotel as your stay in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: Beautiful, unique rooms and a gorgeous, tranquil koi pond with seating area in the center courtyard. AC units worked great. Our room had a large bathtub as well. They provide a small but delicious breakfast in their "lobby" each morning-glory local fruits were tasty. The only reason I took off 1 star was because we ran out of toilet paper twice during our stay (4 days) because the roll they replaced it with was never a full one. So a few times we had to ration tissues from my purse (though bidet was provided). Because it's a very local spot, prepare to hear some birds and lizard sounds throughout the night and hear the scattering of critters around (none in room). For an authentic experience in a great location, this is a perfect choice! If you're more into a standard hotel, maybe not for you.

name: เฉาก๊วย หน้าหอแพทย์ มช.
review_1_text: Another good grass jelly with sweet syrup in town. Homemade style. Getting some to stop your thirst. Grass jelly can also heal inner hot. The lady owner is kind.
review_2_text: The best for this test
review_3_text: Traditional grass jelly, chewy and soft, perfectly sweet and fragrant. The owner is lovely and provides excellent service. So refreshing on a hot day! 🎉💕

review_5_text: This dessert shop offers refreshing treats, including delicious grass jelly that's soft, chewy, and perfectly sweet. The price is also great at only 15 baht per cup.

name: Sahai cafe
review_1_text: This cafe is a take out only place, but it is a part of a local food court, so there is a plenty of chairs and tables. I tried ice cappuccino for 45thb and it was good.
review_2_text:
Sahai Cafe is a cozy little spot located inside a food court, close to Green Nimman ☕🍴. Even though it’s in a shared space, it still manages to have a calm and relaxing vibe, perfect for a quick coffee break or quiet time.

The setup is simple but stylish, with nice lighting and a peaceful atmosphere 🌿🪴. It’s a great place to sit down and enjoy your drink while being in the middle of a convenient location.

The drinks and desserts are really nice! 🍵🍰 I especially love their coffee, good flavor, good presentation, and reasonably priced. It’s a sweet find in a food court setting.

The staff are friendly and welcoming 😊💬. If you’re around the Nimman area and want a chill cafe inside a food court, Sahai Cafe is worth checking out! 🙌📍
review_3_text: Sahai Cafe in Chiang Mai is a beloved local coffee chain known for its affordable prices, friendly service, and consistently good coffee. With multiple branches across the city, including Nimman, Nong Hoi, and San Pa Khoi, the cafes offer a variety of beverages such as iced cappuccinos, Americanos, and unique options like orange Americano. Customers appreciate the clean, spacious settings, quick service, and availability of vegan choices. While some locations are take-out only, they are often situated within or near food courts or gas stations, providing ample seating options. Sahai Cafe’s commitment to quality and value has made it a go-to spot for both locals and visitors seeking a reliable caffeine fix.  ￼
review_4_text: If you're looking for a laid-back and cozy spot in Chiang Mai, Sahai Cafe is a great choice! This charming café has a relaxed atmosphere with a simple yet welcoming vibe. The coffee here is fantastic—whether you're in the mood for a smooth espresso, a creamy cappuccino, or a refreshing iced coffee, they've got you covered. They also serve a variety of tasty pastries and snacks that pair perfectly with your drink. The staff is friendly and attentive, making it a wonderful place to chill out or catch up with friends. Whether you're a local or just passing through, Sahai Cafe is definitely worth a visit for a great coffee experience
review_5_text: Good coffee with toasted and steamed bread. Reasonable price and parking lot.

name: nitroffee
review_1_text:
A nice decent coffee shop in hospital compound...
A good place to spend sometime while you are waiting...
review_2_text: It's a tea shop, the taste is decent, and the service is quick. It was ready before I even had a chance to scan the QR code. The government's co-payment scheme is participating right now.
review_3_text: The shop isn't big, perfect for grabbing something to eat on the go. The prices aren't too expensive, and the menu items aren't what you'd find at a typical coffee shop. The taste is decent, acceptable.
review_4_text:
A cafe near the outpatient building at Sripathana Chiang Mai Center.
They have both a speed and slow bar. The orange juice here is amazing.
Perfect for waiting in line for a checkup, which can be quite lengthy.
review_5_text: A small coffee cafe under the Suan Dok Park parking garage, near the elevator entrance. They serve nitro coffee with a variety of menu items. You can eat in the shop or take it home. The price is reasonable, the taste is good, and the staff are friendly and helpful.

name: Phimmy
review_1_text: Chiang Mai coffee shops usually close early, but I came out after a nap and had a cup of coffee. The coffee was good, and at 30 baht, it seemed like the cheapest price in Thailand.

name: ชาตาตั้ง​ สวนดอก
review_1_text: Penang tea is a southern Thai tea with a delicious aroma. Taiwanese tea is a delicious bubble milk tea with a fragrant tea aroma and is not too sweet.

name: PIT STOP CNX
review_1_text: The coffee is delicious.

name: Coffee Arigato
review_1_text: The drinks are affordable, the snacks are delicious, and there's plenty of seating.
review_2_text: The staff at the Central Festival branch are really bad. The shop is in bad shape. They should find someone else. They didn't ask to see the e-voucher before using it and yelled loudly that it couldn't be used here. They need to be trained. I've never had a problem using it anywhere else.
review_3_text: The green tea is very delicious.

name: ห้องสมุดกาแฟ ชั้น 5
review_1_text: I really like the view outside.

name: Free Bird Cafe CNX Donation Center and Thrift Store
review_1_text: Free Bird is my favorite third space in Chiang Mai! Lisa the owner fosters such an amazing community-focused environment, I’ve made so many friends here at the women’s’ Wednesday lunches, in the charity shop and hanging out. The vegan food is amazing and the space is so chill and nice. It just attracts great people. I recommend it to anyone visiting Chiang Mai, I’m here all the time. The recent thrifted fashion show event was especially amazing!!!
review_2_text: Love this place! Easily one of my new favorites in Chiang Mai! Delicious food, good service, and good  atmosphere. Great seating areas (both indoor & outdoor), and loved all the natural and holistic products inside and the thrifting area! Bought some cute little decorations and stickers and it feels good knowing you’re supporting a good cause! Will be coming back! 🫶🏼
review_3_text: We had a disappointing dinner there recently.  We ordered the lentil soup, chickpea curry, a potato appetizer, a roti, and rice.  The potato dish was not bad, and was the best value as the portion size was reasonable.  Unfortunatly, the rest of the food was not good.  We did not enjoy the flavors at all.  We rated the food low because the portion size was very small, and the cost was much higher than what we pay for larger portions of better food elsewhere in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text:
One of the best restaurants I’ve ever been to! The food was incredible and catered to my and my wife’s dietary needs. The restaurant and food told a story so not only was the food delicious, but it was also a great leaning experience. The staff was so kind and took good care of us. We were so full after eating!! Great sized portions and so many yummy choices.
We will definitely be back when we return to Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: We visited in October 2025 as a couple. The place has good vegetarian, gluten-free, and non-spicy food options. The price is decent for the quality and quantity offered. The service can be improved as we have to order and pay at counter, but the ambience is charming. Its located on a main street, and so there is easy access to taxi and parking. There are also games to play in indoor sitting area and shop to buy near the cash counter. It is a romantic family-friendly and cat-friendly place to eat authentic Thai food.

name: GRAPH quarter
review_1_text:
This palce is a beautiful café with a modern, well-designed space surrounded by greenery that creates a very calm atmosphere. The place is spacious, bright, and quiet, making it perfect for relaxing or working on your laptop.
The coffee is high quality, and you can really feel the attention to detail, from the presentation to the overall vibe. I especially loved the wooden terrace — a great spot to sit, unwind, and escape the city noise.
An elegant, peaceful café with great energy. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a nice place to enjoy coffee in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Graph is one of our favorite cafes, and just having one so close to our accommodation was a bonus.  We walked to Graph Quarter to have one of their most amazing specialty coffees.  This graph is very cute inside. Small but super tasty selection of baked treats, we got a blueberry cheesecake to share.  But their coffee list is amazing, and there are lots of different specialty coffees to choose from.  We chose Soul Smith and Graph No.29,  both completely different but both so delicious.  The staff here are friendly.  It was a very chill vibe inside, and I loved the chill music, too.  They have a cute little gift section too for little gifts you might like to buy and take home.
review_3_text: I loved this coffe place, in Chiang Mai there is a pleasant coffee culture. The coffee was great, great inventions, even the PAC and the canele were great (European standards). I have to say, the coffee is pretty expensive for the standards so I think the place is more appropriate as an experience rather than the usual coffee you take every day.
review_4_text: My top 3 favorite cafés! The coffee, cake, and vibes are just right. 🤎
review_5_text:
Love this place! I discovered GRAPH in a small coffee shop in Chiang Mai old city in 2017, and was happily surprised to see it expanded in 2023.

The nitro coffee creations are like nothing I've tasted before and are a mixture of lots of combinations to suit anyone.

My favourite was downtown! Refreshing with a hint of chocolate flavour and coffee.

The resident kitty is also another reason to come.

I think if there is one coffee shop to visit, GRAPH is one of them! You won't taste coffee like it.

name: Sonday
review_1_text:
The café has a small and cozy space, with tables suitable for 2 to 3 people, making it more ideal for a quick stop rather than a long sit-down. They serve coffee only, if I’m not mistaken, which makes it a focused spot for coffee lovers.

The coffee is great for takeaway, and since we enjoy dirty coffee, we decided to give it a try. It was worth trying and didn’t disappoint.

Overall, it’s a nice spot to grab a good cup of coffee, especially if you’re nearby.
review_2_text:
Easily the best Dirty Coffee I've had in Chiang Mai. They've got a special menu with different types of milk used in making dirty. I tried the first option with coconut cream and it was mind-blowingly smooth.

It's a cute little cafe with lovely decorations. But you'll probably not find a table there as there are only 3 of them.

I need to learn from them how they make their coffee.
review_3_text: The location is relatively small, but don't underestimate how tasty their coffees are. More specifically, their dirty lattes show a sense of creativity and innovation from their owners which isn't seen in many other cafes. I specifically liked the mango sticky rice dirty latte, but I'm sure the other ones would also be delicious.
review_4_text: At the barista’s recommendation, I tried the salted caramel iced coffee - it was delicious! I also snagged two of their cookies to go, and the lemon curd one I’ve eaten so far is tart and yummy. They have a small cafe (maybe 3 tables) and small menu, but several unique flavors of homemade cookies like tiramisu, carrot cake, chocolate with marshmallow, and gooey macadamia nut. The cafe was cutely decorated with Valentine’s decor, as was my cup. A great spot to grab a drink on your way to CMU or Nimman!
review_5_text: Is a small area well decorated with christmas feel. Came to try their dirty coffee with creme brulee. Not dissapointed with the taste and surprisingly nice. Should drop by to grab a cup of yourd.

name: Gatone's Burmese Food and Teashop
review_1_text:
If you’re looking to try something a little different from the usual café scene in Chiang Mai, and you’re curious about authentic Myanmar flavors, I recommend Gatone's Teashop. If you visit, don’t miss: (1) Nan Gyi Thoke – rice noodles with simple shredded chicken curry, somewhat similar to udon but served in a Myanmar style, rich and comforting. (2) Rakhine Mote Ti – a light fish-based soup with thin rice noodles; flavorful and aromatic without being fishy. (3) Burmese tea – a uniquely balanced blend of tea, milk, and condensed milk, smooth and satisfying, with no artificial aroma.
It’s a humble spot, but the flavors feel honest and thoughtfully prepared
review_2_text:
I tried the ginger salad and mohinga, both were absolutely delicious. The ginger salad was fresh, crunchy, and perfectly balanced with a light tangy flavor that felt very authentic. The mohinga was comforting and flavorfulbthat reminded me of true Myanmar home-style cooking.

The restaurant has a simple, clean, and Burmese traditional tea shop style sitting area,  the service was friendly and welcoming. It’s a great place to enjoy real Burmese food in Chiang Mai, especially if you’re craving something traditional and satisfying. Highly recommended 🇲🇲🍜
review_3_text: The fried ginger salad looks like an innocent mess but it’s sooo delicious! I also had the black bean steamed dumplings as dessert with the hot Chinese tea they serve for free - delicious. I’m vegetarian so I’m happy I found options here. At a great price and staff is so kind.
review_4_text: I love to eat here for breakfast and lunch. They do not have curry meals, but if you are missing the tea shop in Myanmar, this is the place for you. The food is good and clean, and I love the vibe in this restaurant. Myanmar green tea and water are free to drink here. You just need to grab one where you sit.
review_5_text:
Cute restaurant
Great food ,lot of variety
And tea is so rich and good

name: Tea of us
review_1_text: Really liked the taste of the Thai tea. There is limited space to sit, but the entire cafe looks really pretty. I enjoyed my time here, will keep coming back, and would definitely recommend it.
review_2_text: The tea is of exceptional quality, with an inviting aroma that greets you the moment you step in. Each sip is perfectly creamy and balanced, delightfully smooth without being too sweet. The store’s warm orange-brick décor creates a cozy atmosphere, featuring several photo-worthy spots that add charm to every visit.
review_3_text: A cute little boutique tea shop. Tea tastes great and the toppings even better !
review_4_text:
I absolutely love this place! Whether you’re a foreigner exploring Thailand or a local looking for quality Thai tea, Tea of US is a must-visit. They offer both Southern-style Thai tea—which is sweet, milky, and rich—and Northern-style, which has more of a coffee-forward, aromatic flavor with a bold taste. Both are fantastic, and it’s rare to find a spot that does both styles so well!

The staff here are friendly, helpful, and clearly passionate about their tea. The overall vibe is great—warm, welcoming, and full of energy. I noticed a lot of locals taking photos and hanging out, which to me is always a sign that the place is legit and beloved by the community.

If you’re serious about Thai tea or just curious to try different styles done right, Tea of US is the place to go. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: Good taste , rich flavor, reasonable price for tea and cute atmosphere ☺️🧋

name: Mingmitr Coffee
review_1_text: I tried the es yen and a chocolate danish, and I finished the coffee before I walked the remaining few minutes to CMU it was so good! The cafe is clean, modern, and spacious with free wifi and a water station. The indoor chairs are very comfortable, and there is also some outdoor seating. The staff were very kind and spoke great English. There was a decent variety of drinks and pastries on their menu. I walk past the cafe every day and only today finally decided to stop in - and I’m very glad I did!
review_2_text:
Mingmitr Coffee - Wonderful Drinks and Friendly Service
