My group of 7 friends came here and we all loved our drinks! I tried the Hom La Mai Thai style coffee, and the staff were super helpful in adding some extra condensed milk to make it the perfect sweetness for my taste.

I also really enjoyed their clementine juice - it was delicious! And I have to say, I absolutely loved the store's decor and overall atmosphere. It had a really cozy, welcoming vibe.

Overall, a great experience at Mingmitr Coffee. The staff went above and beyond to customize the drinks to our liking, and the friendly service and nice environment made the visit even better. I'd definitely recommend giving this place a try if you're in the area!
review_3_text:
Edit: they renovated this place and now it's a comfy place to shelter from the heat or even work at.

I always get their signature Mingmitr iced coffee drink as it's quite decent.

In my last visit I felt like the staff could be friendlier though.

Small place, friendly service, great drinks.
review_4_text:
Super low prices (a latte and a croissant was ฿105), GREAT coffee, AC, good WiFi, plenty of seating, friendly service.  Hidden gem of a spot.
Highly recommend.
review_5_text: It seems to be a cafe that local people will grab a cup of coffee to start their day. I got a cup of iced Ming Mitr (65 thb) — less sweet. It’s well balanced and mellow. Nice coffee and affordable price. 5 thb discount for personal cup. 😉

name: Ombra Caffe Nimman
review_1_text:
The breakfast portions were huge! We had Ombra’s Breakfast and the Eggs Benedict with avocado cream, plus an add-on of hash browns. The hash browns were really good and nicely crispy. The avocado cream, however, was a bit too much for our liking, and it would have been nicer if it were served warm.

Overall, it’s a nice spot for a quiet breakfast. The space is also very large, making it suitable for bigger groups as well.
review_2_text: A lovely spot for breakfast or brunch in the beautiful Nimman neighborhood. The place has a charming terrace that creates a calm and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for starting the day slowly. Ideal for enjoying a good coffee, unwinding, and soaking in the laid-back vibe of the area ✨🌿🫶🌺🌿☕🌱
review_3_text: The place has gorgeous atmosphere. The menu offer plenty of choice but it’s not over complicated. And in comparison to many other places, they accept credit cards! What a nuance but it’s very important for tourists. My choice was Benedict eggs and hazelnut latte with waffles.
review_4_text:
2026.1.10 Sat

We just arrived in Nimman area today to check into our Airbnb and was directed to this cafe by the owner, as we were unable to do an early check-in before 3pm.

Hard pressed for time, we decided to catch our lunch here. The latte is excellent. Just a bit surprised to be served in paper cups for dine-in service. All the food we ate is excellent.

Love the ambience and love the quality of the food here !
review_5_text: Loved the new addition to our fav Ombra. The menu is the same. The space has different areas. Amazing for work, chitchat with a friend or having a peaceful escape. We would definitely come back. (The staff needs a better training. Maybe a minimum level of English)

name: Biguri Sirimang
review_1_text: I know that this restaurant is known for it's donuts, but we came to fullfil my wife's craving for a tuna sandwich on sourdough and I have to say that this restaurant far exceeded our expectations.  The sandwiches were absolutely amazing. The restaurant was clean and the staff were very nice.  If you are interested in a tuna sandwich this is the place to come.
review_2_text: Perfect breakfast, delicious food and a huge choice (sweet and savory!). They have good European options too. The coffee and matcha are excellent, and the service is super friendly. Good prices compared to other places nearby.
review_3_text:
A Japanese-style donut outpost in Nimman. Bikkuri's offering includes ice cream, pastries, cookies, little cakes, and various coffee, tea and bubble tea options.

Fast and friendly service, upbeat and clean interior. The owner moved her donut shop here this Tuesday, following success at her previous location for several years. The expansive new location offers ice cream, cookies, espresso, and seating that wasn't available at the previous spot.

I ordered a dark chocolate donut and espresso. The owner cautioned me that their espresso machine was new, and to feel free to comment on the quality. Overall, a pleasantly sweet  and savory espresso, with no heavily discernible notes. I included a photo of their default espresso blend.

Baking isn't done at this location, but at the main bakery, "Mai Bakery". Donuts come out from around 0700 to 1500.
review_4_text: Delicious doughnuts.  We tried the lemon curd and the Burnt Sugar doughnut.  Both were delicious.  The doughnuts are fluffy and not too sweet.  The cream filling in the Burnt Sugar doughnut was sweet and creamy to balance with the bitter-sweet burnt sugar.
review_5_text: Despite its long-standing reputation, I recently had the opportunity to try the menu at "Sri Prakad" event and was pleasantly surprised. This snack were unexpectedly delicious, surpassing their ordinary appearance. The thin, crispy texture of the pastry complemented the soft, sweet cream, and the subtle tartness of strawberry added a delightful touch. All of this for just 20 Baht—it's truly a delightful find!

name: Light Brown Coffee
review_1_text: More than expectation! the coffee is really really good and many choices of menu. Not too crowded which is good. My light roasted Americano made the day.
review_2_text: Definitely my favorite go to coffee shop, reasonable price. The location is perfect between my gym and office, a lot of parking space along the street in the morning. Their coffee will never fail you, selection of beans and milk alternatives. Banana bread and cheese cake are also available if you feel like a little more than just coffee.
review_3_text: High quality matcha latte with oat milk. They are very friendly and chill atmosphere. Highly recommend!
review_4_text:
Tasty tasty black smooth coffee. No fuss cafe. Space for laptops, good lighting and also some seating out the front for a more social group.
Cash only and some good looking pastries and sweets available.
review_5_text:
There’s quite a lot of seating available both indoors and outdoors for a small sized cafe but we wanted to takeaway our coffee anyway.

My girlfriend ordered an iced latte and although they didn’t have decaf, we were able to get just the single shot of espresso in our latte instead of 2 to 3 shots.

My gf said her latte tasted good so we will be back again.

65 baht for a latte - really fairly priced

name: เต้าฮวยเสวย
review_1_text:
Hot Ginger drink has a strong and delicious taste. Black sesame glutinous rice balls is sooooooo nice. The outer part is covered with white sesame too. I also love ginkgo and tofu pudding. A perfect combo bowl!!!

The shop is quite small, but the owner is lovely.
review_2_text:
I found this small food stall by chance in Nimman, and I absolutely loved it. The elderly man who runs it makes ginger hot soup with tofu, a warm and comforting traditional dish.
The soup includes soft tofu, fried dough (pa thong ko) and other local ingredients soaked in a sweet, slightly spicy ginger broth. It’s perfect in the evening and feels very nourishing.
The place is simple, authentic and not touristy at all. You can really feel that this is old-school local food made with care.
I highly recommend stopping by and trying it if you want a true local experience in Chiang Mai 💕💕
review_3_text: This spot specializes in ginger tea with traditional toppings like soy curd and sesame balls. Authentic old school vibe with the tea prepared right outside their home. The owner, a laid-back old guy, prefers local clientele, so best to visit with a Thai friend. Open briefly from 6-9 am or 5-8 pm. Unique experience and a must-try!
review_4_text:
A local dessert place on a very quiet street.

Nowadays there are many other desserts options with better internal store designs, better dessert quality, younger servers with more enthusiastic attitude. But if you want to try a local Thai dessert, served by an old grandpa, this could be a place to try.

Seems like he operates the store himself here.

The store has few chairs and tables. Mainly sells bean curb, ginko, black sesame glutinous rice ball (bua loy) with ginger tea.

Shop owner doesn’t speak English much. You can show him the picture of what you want, he’ll tell you how much it is before making the order.

Updated in Dec 2023

I ate a set of crispy twist with custard and bua loy with hot soy milk and some other toppings at other store, ~1/2 of the price here, better in quality.
review_5_text: The reviews sound like a local gem, so I came to try and it was a mistake. It is a vendor in a parking lot and the seller is a grumpy grandpa. I got what feels like 50thb and paid 100thb for it. The hygiene is not even in the discussion and my food had some small dead flies floating on the surface. It is just a disappointment and there are many cheaper and better dessert options around.

name: Fresh & Mild since 1992
review_1_text: It is a coffee shop located in Chiang Mai University. It's a coffee shop in the university, so there are a lot of customers. The price range of coffee and ice cream is relatively affordable. The interior of the coffee shop is neat and cool, and the staff is very friendly.
review_2_text: It's a cafe with delicious coffee, yummy snacks, and comfy seating areas - both air-conditioned and outdoor. They're open from 7 am to 7 pm. Personally, I'd highly recommend trying their hot latte; it's super rich and creamy!
review_3_text:
Located next to medical university this place offers a nice space to open laptop with very good WiFi speed.
Beverages are very affordable. I ordered a milkshake and the staff give me free packaged milk that was also taste good! ✨
Just a disclaimer that even though this place it beyond comfortable, they don’t have toilet.
If you need to go you have to borrow the toilet from another building that wasn’t so clean.
review_4_text: Fresh & Mild provides quality of drinks and snacks. It’s just next to Faculty of nursing, opposite to the canteen of Faculty of Medicine. It’s inside Chiangmai Maharaj hospital. I like a scone with jam strawberry and whipped milk. I like mild milk with whole grain, milk shake with strawberry. Homemade ice cream is fit for a warm afternoon.
review_5_text: Super-fast service. I just paid and got to my seat and my order was already prepared. Amazing coffee

name: Mystery Monster Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text:
Unfortunately, my stay was a very disappointing experience. The room I was given did not match the photos shown online or on the booking platform, and the rooms are quite small. I booked a room for one person with a double bed and a private space, but instead I was given a much smaller room with two single beds, which was a completely different room type.

There was no reception and no staff on-site. Someone contacted me only via WhatsApp, but they were not at the property, and communication was ineffective. I could not find anyone to properly address the situation in person.

I arrived at the hotel at 2:00 PM, but since the room I was promised was not provided, I had to leave and search for another hotel around 5:00 PM. This caused significant stress and inconvenience.

This experience completely ruined my vacation, my mood, and my energy. It was a very frustrating and negative experience overall. I strongly recommend that future guests carefully confirm the room details and on-site support before booking.
review_2_text: the environment of this hotel is very good, which is very convenient for tourists to visit because there are many places to walk nearby. The house is very clean and warm, and it is suitable for family, friends or couples to stay,,^^
review_3_text: Cheap accommodation in Nimman. The location is great, surrounded by famous restaurants, cafes, massage parlors. The staff are lovely, the host responds quickly. The room is an apartment with two rooms and one bathroom on each floor, which means we have to share a bathroom with another room, but it's not a problem. All equipment is complete. The pillows are comfortable, but the bed is quite hard for us. If you add a topper or an extra mattress, it would be great. 🥹💚
review_4_text: I've lived here for a month and don't want to leave. The manager is a warm, generous and beautiful northerner. The location is excellent. I'll contact her next time. She also has a place to stay in the ancient city.
review_5_text: Self-service

name: circle.pound - IN TOWN
review_1_text: Delicious cakes and desserts, especially the custard🥰I loved it! The drinks were tasty and nicely prepared. Great atmosphere, cozy and relaxing. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Recommended by my local friend. Good choice for dessert. Not too sweet. Creative and cute
review_3_text: Cozy little cafe. Cakes are delicious. Perfect place for a short break ♥️🍰
review_4_text: Desserts are delicious, The atmosphere in the shop is great, Everything is incredibly perfect. You have to come and try it at least once.❣️✨
review_5_text: A lovely little café with the best matcha 🍵💚 The matcha is so rich and smooth, and the desserts are absolutely delicious 🍰✨ Everything in the shop is just so cute and cozy. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to again ☕💕

name: S&P สาขาหอพักคณะพยาบาลศาสตร์ มช
review_1_text: Fast talking question avoiding phone obsessed customer service. Unclear as to what and where to eat, changed his mind and will never go back . Customer centered  service   lacking .
review_2_text: Worst S&P ever dont come here
review_3_text: Good service and delicious food
review_4_text: Do not eat at this place.
review_5_text: The staff provided good service, even though it was busy that day and there was a long wait. The food was delicious. The weather was very hot at noon, but it was still a good place to escape the heat while waiting to do business at the hospital in the afternoon.

name: ชาตรามือ สาขา หอพักคณะพยาบาลศาสตร์ มช
review_1_text: I came in the afternoon on a weekday. The atmosphere was very relaxing. I enjoyed a smooth and mellow coffee, not too bitter or strong, along with an eclair and chocolate cake. The shop was neither too cold nor too hot; everything was perfect.
review_2_text:
Except for iced tea and Thai tea, only you are in my heart.

Cha Tra Mue, Faculty of Nursing Student Dormitory, Chiang Mai University
Cha Tra Mue (Cha Tre Mue) is a genuine Thai brand, a legendary original tea brand, one of the first Thai tea brands to be famous since the time of his grandparents, who turned Thai tea into a signature beverage that has become world-renowned.
The family of Ditthapong Ruangrittidej arrived in Thailand in 1925 and established a Chinese tea shop called Lim Meng Kee at the Chalerm Buri Intersection on Yaowarat Road. They imported tea products from China, but hot Chinese tea was not popular due to Thailand's hot climate. Therefore, they imported red tea to make milk tea and Thai black tea with ice, known as iced tea. In 1945, they launched the Cha Tra Mue brand, growing their own tea in Chiang Rai and establishing a factory in Bangkok.
Ditthapong later inherited the Cha Tra Mue business from his father. Established Siam FB Products Co., Ltd. in 1994, which produced canned tea products. Later, the third generation, Praonarin Ruangrittidet, in 2018, launched rose tea and soft serve products in various flavors, such as Thai tea ice cream.
review_3_text: The water is very slow.

name: Chathochi ชาโตชิ
review_1_text: The fruit and bread are very delicious.

name: กาแฟสดดอยหลวง สาขาคณะพยาบาลศาสตร์ มช
review_1_text: The cafe where we ordered food to go is located behind the building, but it is very crowded because the price is not expensive and it serves students and university staff.
review_2_text: This coffee shop makes drinks that taste okay. They're delicious. But I have to criticize their service a little. We ordered drinks that we wanted with pearls, but the shop didn't put up a sign saying they were out of pearls and didn't ask us first, even though we were sitting waiting in front of the shop the whole time. It would have been good to ask before making the drink if we wanted a drink without pearls. But the staff still made the drink without pearls. This is the third time we've encountered this. When we told them we didn't get what we ordered, they didn't seem interested and chose to ask if we could have something else instead. We ordered with pearls because we wanted pearls, not fruit salad. So I'd like to write this review to suggest improvements.
review_3_text: This is a cheap and delicious coffee shop located on the hospital grounds.
review_4_text: The taste is decent. The iced coffee costs 40 baht, which isn't too expensive.
review_5_text: It closed a little too early.

name: SMOON DRINK
review_1_text: Taste good.  Reasonable price.
review_2_text: good coffee good tea  good people

name: Mix Kaffee
review_1_text:
Interesting afternoon with this coffee Omakase experience!
Four seaters boutique size coffee restaurant with handcrafted coffee and Michelin chef dessert to pair with your coffee set.
They only use Japan flown in Arabica coffee bean.
Should at least come here once in your lifetime to experience if you get a chance. I’ve been to few countries and this is the one and only that we chance about and it’s in Chiang Mai Thailand, surprisingly!
Thinking this kind of Omakase coffee experience will be in some big city!
review_2_text:
Fantastic coffee experience, from the interior, service, presentation, coffee, pairing experience, and even just the water, you can feel the owner’s attention to details.
Would def recommend to come have a try, and remember to make a reservation in advance
review_3_text: This café offers unique brewing methods like fermentation and nitro, with delicate and refined coffee flavors that really stand out. Definitely worth visiting if you’re in Chiang Mai and want to explore high-quality coffee
review_4_text: did the top level of the craft coffee pairing/tasting and it was in the top 5 things we did in the whole country in a whole month. DO NOT HESITATE. Since its a custom type thing, id go 6 stars actually.
review_5_text: Definitely my favorite coffee place in Chiang Mai! The owner is very knowledgeable, he know his stuffs and will give you a very thorough explanation of the coffee technique and beans he is using. Love the experience, if you are a coffee lover, you should definitely come! Remember to make booking via facebook

name: MARS.cnx
review_1_text:
We had passed by this cafe several times before finally deciding to stop in, and we’re so glad we did. From the outside it already caught our attention with its unique style, but stepping inside was even better. The atmosphere was super cool and creative—something about the design and interior gave us this futuristic, almost “Mars-like” vibe. It’s definitely not your average coffee shop; every corner feels thoughtfully designed and Instagram-worthy.

We ordered their signature drinks along with coffee, and both were excellent. The flavors were rich and well-balanced, clearly made with care, and the presentation was just as impressive. It’s one of those places where you can tell the drinks are crafted to stand out, not just served.

Beyond the drinks, the overall experience was really enjoyable. The seating was comfortable, the music matched the vibe, and it was the kind of place where you can relax for a while—whether to chat with friends, read a book, or just enjoy the ambiance.

This cafe has such a cool personality that makes it stand out in town. We left already planning to come back again, not only for the great drinks but also for the one-of-a-kind atmosphere. A must-visit if you’re looking for something different and stylish!
review_2_text:
I ended up at MARS.cnx on a whim, and it instantly felt different. The space has this surreal, almost dream-like vibe — part art gallery, part cozy hideaway. The design is cool, and the music? Absolutely spot-on. It creates this perfect atmosphere that makes you want to stay longer.
I only had a cappuccino, but the place is definitely a hidden gem for a creative, laid-back escape.
review_3_text: Really like the concept. The ambience is great. Feels like that you are in a restaurant that’s on Mars. They have given effort to make it look like one from the walls, chairs, desks and everything. Staff looked friendly. Service was good. Just went there for a coffee and it was good too. Recommend. Love from 🇱🇰
review_4_text:
The space is modern yet minimal, with warm wooden tones and big windows that let in lots of nature light. Their signature drinks are delicious especially the cold brew and dirty coffee.
The staff are friendly and the vibes feel peaceful. One of definitely worth visit.
review_5_text: MARS.cnx gets very positive feedback overall — high ratings, particularly for its atmosphere, theme, creativity, and vibe. It seems to be less about being a serious gourmet food destination and more about the experience: décor, ambiance, drinks, photo opportunities. If you go expecting that, you’re likely to enjoy it a lot. If your priority is large food portions, a super quiet café for studying, or cheap coffee, there might be better choices.

name: Starbucks
review_1_text: I didn’t actually eat here.  However, I recommend this as the best place to work for a while on the computer.  Lots of comfortable seating, WiFi and electrical outlets.
review_2_text:
1. We waited and waited for our order. Finally I had to go to the counter to ask what happened... the sandwich was already cold... they had to warm it up again. It wasn't that busy, either.

2. I asked to have our table cleaned... the server cleaned the table and wiped the crumbs from another customer's order onto the floor!!! No sweeping up.

The service really needs to be improved.

Nice People, Bad Training.
review_3_text: Super comfy. Waiting in here for almost 5 hours (I got night flight) and everything in here is perfect. The ambience is very good. You can walk around the building which has pond and mini garden if you are boring. And you can also walk to 7 eleven, just 2 minutes walking to grab a snack
review_4_text:
This double story building is situated opposite the Suan Dok gate on the western side of the most in Chang Mai old town.

It has a convenient drive-in facility but inside you will experience a nice ambience even though the air conditioning is super cold. You can also sit outside.

Generally, the decoration is comfortable browns and wood and laid-back style. Check out the photos
review_5_text: Nice location with both indoor and outdoor area. Also have the drive trough service. There is a meeting room available on the second floor also. :)

name: Pa Rang Cafe & Art Stay
review_1_text:
Our favorite place in Chiang Mai! Thank you to Bora for making our trip so memorable.

Prime location, large rooms with comfy beds, great outdoor garden and balcony spaces. Hot hot water is limited but that’s common everywhere in Chiang Mai even in 5* hotels (just something to note). There is always something going on here, you just need to be open for it 😉

A stay that feels like you are living like a local, meeting other travellers and local people from all over the world who also live in CM. We didn’t want to leave, it’s somewhere that stays with you forever. This is not just an accomodation, this is a home. It’s exactly how we love to travel and we will 100% be back to drink with you to the early hours and enjoy the random little creative workshops in the day time.

A stay for the curious, open minded and the kind. Thanks for everything.
review_2_text:
Great accommodation. Very nice located. Quite atmosphere.

Great quality coffees and smoothies.
Music selection during the day is very well curated.

Friendly and professional staff.
Highly recommended !!
review_3_text: I only went here for a music event. It was a nice gathering with excellent molam music. Very friendly staff with beer at reasonable prices. Also looks like it is a cozy guesthouse built with shipping containers. Very creative bunch of people there
review_4_text: Lovely place to stay in a quiet neighborhood of the old city. Primarily an Art Stay, (visiting artists, artists in residence.. ) Parang also welcomes other guests. I spent 4 nites there and loved my spacious room and the overall chilled vibe so much that I almost didn't want to leave! Bora is a great host and she also manages Thapae East, a super cool bar with live music, not to be missed!
review_5_text: Great accomodation close to the center! Rooms are huge and freshly renovated - everything is brand new with modern amenities. Bathroom is fantastic, nice modern and refreshing design from higher end hotels - so much appreciated after couple of days on the road. Korean owner is an art curator and runs an occasional art cafe. Thanks to that the building has a huge patio with cool vibe. Great for hanging out. Highly recommended!

name: The Peaberry Cafe & Coworking
review_1_text:
The Peaberry Café offers super delicious and fresh smoothies and açaí bowls, along with good coffee. The staff are friendly and the service is quite fast, which makes the experience even better.
Just a note — it’s not a dedicated coworking space with desks and ergonomic chairs, but more of a work-friendly café. It’s a comfortable place to bring your laptop and get some work done while enjoying brunch, a smoothie, or a coffee.
Overall, a great spot for tasty, healthy food and a relaxed work-friendly environment!
review_2_text: We had the Nutella french toast and sunny side up eggs. For drinks the peach soda, chocobananut smoothie, Carmel macchiato and Thia style Expresso.  All were very delicious. 💯% recommend.  They even have an adorable and playful kat Luna.
review_3_text: I came here twice during my visit to Chiang Mai and the food was fantastic. I got the french toast, tuna salad, and beverages. It was also a clean, minimal, and quiet place to work on my computer.
review_4_text: Great atmosphere, delicious drinks/smoothies, they offer oat milk/dairy-free options which I appreciated. Staff was incredibly friendly and even let me and another person stay a little bit after closing to finish working on our laptops. Will be coming back here, had an awesome experience :)
review_5_text: Had a delicious Thai iced coffee and French toast at peaberry cafe. Such a peaceful vibe inside and there was a really cute cat too!

name: LANN Cafe'
review_1_text:
Lann – where coffee meets calm and excellent taste in design

Lann is one of those rare little cafés that feels intentionally beautiful without trying too hard. Tucked right in front of a hotel spa (yes, that kind of vibe), it’s the perfect spot to decompress before or after pretending you live a slower, more elegant life.

There’s easy parking (already winning), and once inside, you immediately feel how much care the owners put into every detail. The space blends classic Thai rattan textures with clean, modern architecture, creating a mood that’s equal parts cozy, stylish, and quietly luxurious. It’s the kind of place where you sit down and instantly lower your voice without knowing why.

Great coffee, calm energy, and an atmosphere that makes you want to stay longer than planned—whether you’re post-spa, pre-meeting, or just escaping Bangkok chaos for a moment.

Highly recommended if you appreciate good design, thoughtful spaces, and cafés that feel like a small retreat rather than just another caffeine stop
review_2_text:
You have to come eat here! So delicious and super cute vibes!

Their breakfast was top tier! The bread they brought to the table was so fresh and very delicious! I try to stay away from bread but I literally almost finished the entire basket! That’s how good it was!

very instagramable and cute for photos. The staff was friendly!
review_3_text: Great breakfast place in Chiang Mai center! I was desperately searching for a breakfast spot where I can have a nice meal before touring the center of Chiang Mai. They have a very nice menu and if the decor is very relaxed and beautiful. The service was wonderful! I had a breakfast platter with bacon,ham, eggs, sausage, and tomato. Fully recommended!
review_4_text: Had a wonderful experience at LANN Cafe’ in Chiang Mai. I tried their signature chili fried rice, which was full of flavor with just the right level of spice — absolutely delicious. The mango passionfruit frappe was refreshing, perfectly balanced, and a great match for the meal. The service was friendly and attentive, and the location is lovely, calm, and convenient (at the heart of the center area) for relaxing or enjoying a meal. Highly recommended if you’re looking for great taste, good service, and a nice atmosphere.
review_5_text: LANN CAFE is a charming spot on the edge of the Old City. The atmosphere is relaxing, especially in the garden area. The space is small and cozy, thoughtfully designed with a stylish touch. Prices are on the higher side for Chiang Mai, but still inexpensive compared to most European cities. Service was fast and the staff were friendly and attentive. The place is clean, and the brunch was delicious. Overall, I definitely recommend it!

name: Something on Mars
review_1_text: The  cocktails 🍸 🍸 here are really nice. I am not a big gin fan but the blend of gin with the other elements was great. The place is very Insta worthy as are the drinks. However they charge a 10% surcharge on all drinks which aren’t cheap to begin with. The place was pretty empty so  it didn’t have the best atmosphere. I think if they reduce some of their prices on their non signature drinks they would have more people coming in because it is a nice place to hang out . The staff were great and very friendly.
review_2_text:
Hidden cocktails bar that serves best cocktails. Tried all signature drinks and you will love them all. Nice service and atmosphere. Will definitely come back.

Highly recommended Autumn No. 9 , Pluto, Venus… all signature must try.
review_3_text: Super cool bar! And great drinks made by our bartender Art. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a unique and intimate cocktail bar
review_4_text: Having a blast now here. Must visit when in Chiang Mai Thailand… coffee is perfect and food is superb. Drinks are the best and we’re having a blast with the friendliest bartender “Nes” …
review_5_text: The most amazing cocktail, try the “Venus” it will not disappoint. The bartenders were very knowledgeable and friendly. Such a cool vibe!

name: Marner Coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee and lots of cheap snacks. Nice cafe overall
review_2_text: Perfect coffee and extremely friendly :)
review_3_text: The coffee is strong, and the mint cocoa is delicious. They also sell crunchy snacks, like baked bananas, which I buy every time I come.
review_4_text: A quiet, hidden cafe in the bustling Nimmanhaemin area. For Nimman, it offers affordable coffee and friendly service, making it a great spot for nomads.
review_5_text: Came to try some Thai tea. I've been here for years but never stopped by. Today I had free time so I decided to give it a try. The shop doesn't have a sign out front so I didn't really notice it. I had to turn around to see that it was there. The tea flavor was good, as usual. But I like the atmosphere, which is open, airy, and quiet. The service from the staff was very good. There's a good amount of parking in front. Anyone who lives around here should come and try it.

name: Bake A Seat
review_1_text: I stopped on the way to my apartment, to get something tasty and find a place to rest while waiting for my friends. The lady greeted me with a smile, explained about the drinks and had so much patience, she even placed the air conditioner in front of me so I don’t get hot. The food itself was very good, the banana muffin is very tasty. The place itself is very cozy, I loved that there is an option to write notes and there was even a poem. Very quiet comfortable place, I will come back definitely
review_2_text:
Delivery service also available, ask cafe for more information.

I bought Carrots cake / Peanut brownie / Scone and cookies.

All of them were above my expectations!
Quality of products were beyond their prices.

Carrot cake was a bit loose not too sweet and without cream cheese on top - Good and healthy meal.

Brownie was the most sweet menu and be very good with peanut butter, makes its balance in taste.

Cookies are also great in texture and chocolate inside mix together and not too sweet.

Scone ( delivery service without clotted cream and jam ) smell good and great taste ( with my own Jam and Butter)

Recommend this cafe for you all.
review_3_text:
Cozy atmosphere, and an incredibly warm and friendly owner.

Breakfast is hearty and savoury. The banana cake is fluffy and delicious! It pairs perfectly with the good coffee ♥️

Had my first Thai milk tea here too, it was absolutely lovely.

Thank you 😊
review_4_text:
Such a delight! An amazing place to start the day.

The cafe is compact but an adorable space with a cozy vibe. The food is DELICIOUS and fresh with breakfast sets starting at 100baht!

Will definitely be back
review_5_text: Bake a Seat is a gem in Chiang Mai! The lady owner is  kind and welcoming, creating a truly cozy and inviting atmosphere. The food is delicious, and the prices are very affordable. I highly recommend this cafe! The baked pastries are especially amazing, and the banana cake is a must-try. You won't be disappointed!

name: OneDeeDee Coffee House
review_1_text:
We literally go here everyday. Aside from the waffles & coffee being yummy and cheap, DeeDee, the owner is the warmest and kindest person you'll meet! Really shows how a dining experience can be dictated by how people welcome you!

It's a tiny cafe but they have fast wifi and electric fan. Thanks Deedee 🙏
review_2_text: HIDDEN GEM! This place is a must visit. The waffles are some of the best I have ever had. The Nutella ones were to die for. What really blew my mind was the value for money — unbelievably generous for what you get. I would come back again and again without hesitation. If you’re nearby, don’t skip this place!
review_3_text: This is such a sweet coffee and breakfast place. Dee Dee, the owner, is so sweet and makes delicious drinks. I usually ordered a Thai tea with no sugar and it was so delicious every time and with lots of foam on top. The chocolate chip waffle is great too! And great  prices!!
review_4_text:
Amazing place, hostess & food
This is clearly a labour of love
Dee Dee enjoys the chat and working from outside her home where she cares for her Mum
She was patient with my indecision and helped my decide on peanut butter (of the quality kind) with almonds and gave me lots of fruit then later tried to give me more
Just go support and enjoy her
review_5_text: Dee Dee is such a nice lady and hostess and the place has such a cute ambience.  Her prices of food is amazingly low at about 1/2-1/3 the price of other places we tried. The breakfast is so big and filling I struggled to finish it. First class food at a more budget price. This is a must stop when visiting Chiang Mai and it's just off the circle going around the inside of the Old City.

name: Winglet - brunch coffee & Thai dessert
review_1_text:
you get what you paid for. 65 baht for latte and 80 baht for simple bagel and avocado egg toast. I would say i was satisfied (portion-wise) and taste wise but it was good enough For the affordable price. Coffee was good tho!

Around only 7 people can fit inside this small cafe but ir gives off a homey neighborhood cafe feels to it. Best part is wifi is 600 mbps!  but its not really a cafe where you can work with no distractions and big space
review_2_text: Cute cafe which good prices. The Caramel Macchiato was yummy - only 60 Bhat.  This was my first lox and cream cheese bagel in Thailand and it was good as well!  Fresh orange juice and Lamduan cookies were nice too 😋🙏🌟
review_3_text:
1. Meet the bagel I wanted for that particular moment.
2. Nice atmosphere, pleasant staff and chillin music deliver good mood.
3. Tasty coffee with many choices to make.
4. Lovely piece of whole day breakfast.
review_4_text: A small, cozy café quietly turning out seriously good breakfast. The plates are simple but thoughtfully executed, letting the ingredients shine. The apple crumble is a standout—warm, comforting, and beautifully balanced. Paired with a well-made dirty coffee, it’s the perfect morning stop. ☕🍎
review_5_text:
A little gem tucked inside Chiang Mai's Old City. This place strikes the perfect balance between cozy and functional — you can grab a seat indoors with the AC cranking or settle in outside if you want to soak up the atmosphere. Either way, the vibe is warm and relaxed without feeling too try-hard.

The coffee menu has solid variety, so whether you're a black coffee purist or want something a little more creative, you'll find something that works. I went with the bagel breakfast sandwich and it did not disappoint.

The staff were genuinely friendly and made the whole experience feel welcoming rather than transactional, which goes a long way.

If you're wandering the moat area and need a proper sit-down spot to recharge, this is the move. Already planning to come back on my next visit.

name: Freshy Coffee
review_1_text:
A kind husband and wife make coffee on the secret side street behind the hospital. It is a favorite with the hospital staff.
They open around 9am.

name: DCafe Coffee​ Chiang​mai​ Brand​
review_1_text: WOW!!!!!! this cappuccino is incredible!! The art was stunning and my first sip was incredible!! 10/10 recommend
review_2_text:
I found the high quality of coffee here!
The owner of cafe is making coffee by himself one by one. I am foreigner usually drinking a hot latte here which is the best coffee in ChiangMai.
review_3_text: Best coffee!!! Owner is very kind, and the coffee is the best I’ve had in Thailand. The price is also unbeatable, my favorite coffee shop around
review_4_text: Today, I went to this café shop. I told him that I'm also a Barista. Then the kindly owner let me make the coffee by myself. The quality of coffee is so amazing.
review_5_text:
As good as it can get 🙏🏼🥳 this place blows price/quality out of the windows 🪟. It’s funny to me that there’s a Starbucks right around the corner ... wouldn’t touch that overpriced over-glorified coffee with a 10-foot pole 😁🤫

Come to this lovely shop and let your tastebuds enjoy some real quality coffee brewed with care and love. The owners are kind people who are naturally hospitable 🙏🏼 I come back for the coffee and am always greeted with warm smiles!

Been to many coffee shops (100s) around chiang mai and can tell you - you won’t find any better quality / care for the price you’re paying 🙏🏼 - I dare you to prove me otherwise 😏

It’s not a place where you can sit and work. Just get a coffee for takeaway or drink it at the shop and go 😄👌 enjoy!

@shop-owners, thanks for doing this everyday! Making many people happy with your dedication to brewing arooiiiii coffee 🙏🏼🥳

name: Rinnara Coffee
review_1_text:
We discovered this lovely café while waiting for our friend at the hospital. The owner is very sweet, the place is cozy, the prices are great, and the matcha is excellent! Don’t hesitate to stop by if you’re nearby.

Bonus: Right across the street, there’s a street food stall in case you want a quick bite. ;)
review_2_text: Beautiful coffee the lady is so sweet and cute very nice definitely go back
review_3_text: This is a lovely coffee shop behind the Chiang Mai RAM hospital. The coffee is really nice and the owner is lovely! Stop by and get some coffee if you're nearby ☺️ I will come again next time I'm in the area.
review_4_text:
Great coffee made to order.
Medium roast and dark roast
review_5_text: Super lovely staff with some knowledge of English, so perfect for foreigners! Great coffee, choice between two coffees (medium iced latte for me), I recommend it.

name: Sweet Stories : Old town
review_1_text: We had great breakfast, some of the best coffees yet in Chiang Mai. The Basque burnt cheesecake is delicious. The staff is always super nice, the place is well airconditioned, the toilets are clean, tables are nice and big and with power plugs so it is a good option for working as well.
review_2_text: Best bakery in town. The toast is fantastic, large serving with reasonable price. Overall, must try!
review_3_text: Amazing, fresh bake goods 🤎 coffee is ok, nothing extraordinary. All in all, if you want to have a nice baked dessert and a coffee, this is the place to consider.
review_4_text: American breakfast and yoghurt bowl are quite large and delicious.
review_5_text:
Great spot with modern atmosphere. Really like the hot cappuccino here, it's big and European style.
The pastries were okay, not really to my taste because they are too spongy. I think this might be more of a Japanese style bit I don't know.

Edit
Just talked to the staff and apparently it is French style pastries. However then the pastries shouldn't be sticky or gummy. It probably has to do with keeping them in the fridge and then heating them up.

name: Pran Cafe
review_1_text: I was looking at near cafes when I was temple hopping and found this place in maps. Cute and cozy cafe. Quiet enough to enjoy coffee and read a book. They take card (5% surcharge) and cash. Food, coffee and drinks were great. Interior and exterior were nice. Beside it is their hotel. Nice place to check out!
review_2_text: This place was extraordinarily exceptional. A beautiful and aesthetically decorated place. Our experience  in Chiang Mai was enhanced due to this cafe that I found on Booking.com. Now this Cafe will be my go-to whenever I visit Chiang Mai again. The location is very close to the Chiang Mai gate where all the action takes place. The rooms were very beautiful, modern and very comfortable. Each room has a small balcony to enjoy the morning sun or the afternoon siesta. The cafe has very friendly and polite staff at check-in as well as the breakfast kitchen. The owner-Ms. Pree and her husband are delightful people who makes you feel you are home away from home. The morning breakfast is also very good with excellent coffee that you can buy from the cafe. It is locally grown and has a hint of the taste of the hills around Chiang Mai. The thai food selection for the breakfast was delicious and I am still craving for it miles away. They also had some very good vegetarian options. Moreover, they also helped arrange all the tours that I took at Chiang Mail with a 10% discount. Do not book tours at the airport, they were more expensive than the ones I got from Pran Cafe. We were there during the Loh Kratong festival hence the Cafe was fully booked. I wished we could have stayed longer..this place was one of the highlights of our incredible time in Chiang Mai. I came away feeling that I left my extended family back at this cafe. I was also traveling with my 83 year old father who was very comfortable and happy at this beautiful cafe. Also, did I say that the plants and flowers in this cafe makes one feel that they are in paradise. I will surely be back to this location. Book your whole stay in Chiang Mai at this place..you will not regret it. Wifi and all other modern amenities are great.
review_3_text: Cute cafe with tasty food and delicious cappuccinos! The owner is really sweet and brought her dog over to me so I could pet it. Good WiFi and air conditioning, so it was a nice place for remote work.
review_4_text: Beautiful little café. So quaint and the service was outstanding. They grow and roast their own beans and take great pride in the quality of the product.
review_5_text: This cafe looks amazing! Such a cute decor and ambience! Food was sooo good delicious! Staff very polite and friendly. Loved everything about this cosy cafe.

name: Roast a day
review_1_text: Roast a Day is a litte gem tucked away on a corner of Intrawarot Road near Suan Dok gate. Specialising in light meals, smoothies and pancakes served with a choice of fillings, it is light, bright and full of atmosphere. Pim and Dtit provide a warm, friendly welcome and delicious food enjoyed by a youthful clientele of students and backpackers. Well worth a visit if your in the area.
review_2_text: Is this smoothie? This is just a drink.  Lie
review_3_text: The place has amazing vibes with delicious food at affordable price.
review_4_text:
I stopped by because it was hot, and they gave me a lot of drinks and were very kind
If the timing is not right, they might not have the fruit I wanted ㅠㅠ
I wanted to eat passion fruit, but they didn't have any, so I ate watermelon,,,
The curry tasted like Ottogi curry, so it felt like eating a home-cooked meal. It seems like the owner runs the restaurant with his daughter...
Drink 40, curry 49

name: C Zaab Thai Traditional Snack and Art Work
review_1_text:
Very authentic and delicious Khao Soi cooked in a clay pot.
It had a sweet-sour scent and the spices harmonized well. We've tried the vegetarian and the non-vegetarian Khao Soi.
In the non-vegetarian version the chicken was super soft and melt like candy floss. Vegetarians don't have to worry about any animal based ingredients in their Khao Soi. They are cooked in 2 separate pots.

The restaurant was quite comfy and the cook / waitress super friendly. They care a lot about on how you like their cooking. So do not hesitate to give feedback.

Insiders' tip: If you are used to the spicyness level of native Thais you may ask the cook to make it spicy. She is super carefull with foreigners and tends to add less chili powder. 😉
review_2_text:
Such a great restaurant! My husband and I stumbled upon this place while walking around and decided to try it after seeing the reviews, which were spot on.

The food was so good. Probably some of the best we have had in Chiang Mai or even Thailand. My husband had chicken Khao Soi and I had the Tofu Khao Soi. We split the vegetarian fresh spring rolls. Everything tasted delicious and fresh. The curry had so much flavor.

The owner, BB, was so sweet and took the time to understand what we wanted so we could order properly. She even helped us understand the spice levels to ensure we could enjoy the food without overburdening our palettes by the spice. Prices are also very reasonable.

We’re trying to squeeze in one more visit before leaving Chiang Mai. Highly recommend!!!
review_3_text: I’ve been there a few times already and the food was very fresh and tasty always. It’s not a busy place so most time I was the only customer but the good think about that is you getting the food super quick. Also a good place for vegetarian and vegan food. Nice salad and fresh rolls. I just give four stars because they still using plastic straws and no proper reusable sticks.
review_4_text:
A lovely place.

The food is very authentic. Vegetarian, chicken, pork, or sea food assortments for most meals.

Cook asks for spicy level before getting on with putting things together. Quiet and chilled, not a great drink selection but food more than worth it to give up on everything else. Also prices are great.

Highly recommend
review_5_text: The rolls were fresh & delicious. We were a bit unsure on the differences between a few items, it didn’t matter as everything came out tasty. Great prices too.

name: Fern Forest Cafe
review_1_text:
A Hidden Green Oasis in the Heart of Chiang Mai 🌿

Fern Forest Cafe is a true gem tucked away in the city. The moment you walk in, you’re surrounded by lush greenery and tall trees fresh, shaded, and incredibly peaceful. It feels like escaping into a secret garden right in the middle of Chiang Mai.

The atmosphere is perfect for relaxing and staying awhile. Many international visitors love spending time here, and it’s easy to understand why, it’s calm, charming, and beautifully natural.

I ordered the tiramisu and coconut cake, and both were excellent. The tiramisu was rich and well-balanced, the coconut cake light and fragrant without being too sweet.

The yuzu cold brew coffee was also fantastic refreshing, smooth, and a perfect pairing with the desserts.

If you’re looking for a serene garden café with great cakes and quality drinks, this is definitely a must visit in Chiang Mai.
Highly recommended.
review_2_text: For me, the best place in Chiang Mai. They have amazing desserts, drinks, and food. I loved this place so much that I come here every day. What you also get here is an amazing atmosphere and comfort. This place has Genius Loci. ❤️
review_3_text: It's a popular place with people waiting in line for a table. We ordered a fruit smoothie and the black forest chocolate shake. Both were amazing. The smoothie was bursting with flavor while the shake, topped with tiny squares of cake and a cherry, was sweetly thick. The rich green curry goes well with the roti. The tumeric rice is well balanced, with fried battered fish fillets. Service is fast despite the place fully packed. Ambience is an oasis of forest in the middle of the city.
review_4_text:
A sweet little place making you feel right in the lap of nature with great food, ambient music and sound of water.

Food quantity and quality are both good with one of the best Caramel Milkshakes!
The tropical and fruit bowls are a little too cold (need atleast 30 min outside for the temperature to come down to being eatable). Hence one piece of advise will be to kindly keep them in a little less colder place before serving so that they can be eaten straightaway.

Loved the rest.
review_5_text:
Amazing spot for a break from your activities and travels. They have coffee, pastries and desserts, as well as a full food menu with breakfast items as well as traditional thai food.

Ambience is amazing with a koi pond and you get to sit underneath the tall trees in the shade.

name: Bird's Nest Cafe
review_1_text: I gotta say I've been to a lot of cafes in CNX and this place is by far my favorite one. The food tastes divine full stop. We got hash browns and scrambled eggs for our picky eater kids and they devoured it. It was so lovely of the cafe to serve clementines on the side for our kids. Then we ate a superb tom kha and a perfect grilled veggie wrap and topped it all with what they call a "local porridge" and Bird's Nest coffee (ie. masala coffee / coffee with spices). You can not beat this. Every single thing was cooked to perfection. We will frequent this place that's for sure. I'm glad my small kids made only tolerable amount of noise otherwise we'd feel embarrassed to go back but now we can't wait to eat there again and try new things! Kapunka!
review_2_text: The best breakfast/brunch place! They have a really big menu, lots to choose from. The quality is amazing, the fruit is so fresh and the portion sizes are huge! The banana pancakes and the set menu were great, the local porridge was super interesting and delicious. Would definitely recommend 🫶
review_3_text:
I absolutely love the VIBE of this place. Downstairs seating as normal, upstairs seating is no shoes, and it's open and breezy and beautiful. The street itself is on the quieter side so it was nice to relax here. I also love that all the food is local and fresh, and they try to be as eco-friendly as possible.

Expect to wait a little while for the food, it comes out staggered one at a time. The food was good but lacked some seasoning (it tasted on the healthier side if that makes sense, high protein and high fiber) and had big portions. The mango smoothie with yogurt was very plain.

Overall I would come if you are trying to stay healthy and enjoy a relaxing environment :)
review_4_text: What a lovely place & friendly staff. Had brunch there with my wife. Food made with love. Top notch Coconut Latte. Proper slow drip coffee. Wonderful rustic, cute, chilled & peaceful atmosphere. Well done team!!! xx
review_5_text:
I had #20, the Big Green Sandwich! Delicious! Love the open air atmosphere. Everything, other than the vegetables, is made in/house. However, all the vegetables are locally grown. A very diverse menu to meet anyone’s preference and palate!
Absolutely Wonderful!

name: Sorasora Cafe (โซระ โซระ คาเฟ่)
review_1_text: Everything is amazing! The coconut cake was well balanced and fresh, with real coconut inside. It was the first time I had tried anything like it in Thailand! They also have a very good gluten-free vanilla cheesecake with a hint of lemon. I also tried the signature banana bread with caramelised banana — it was full of different textures and flavours: soft, sweet, salty and crunchy! The owner and staff are also super friendly and kind!
review_2_text: Cute lil cafe was in walkable distance from my hotel. Ordered their signature Caramel banana cloud and Thai tea. The dessert completely blew me away. Staff were very sweet.
review_3_text: Here we go! We’ve been around the town a couple of weeks and tried top rated restaurants and cafes. Of course, we went for coconut cakes and I can tell you we finally find the place for coconut cakes. This place is a little bit off from the busy area but it’s only 3 minutes walks from Wat Phra Singh. If you are around here, you better try.
review_4_text:
This place has the best coconut cake! It’s not just a cake with a hint of coconut flavor — it’s packed with real coconut meat and has a rich, intense coconut aroma. It’s honestly the best coconut cake I’ve had in Thailand!
I also ordered the peach tea, and it was delicious — fragrant with real peach pieces you can actually chew.
review_5_text: Let me tell you - this absolutely amazing cake was worth it all. I have never had a better dessert than this piece of art. The owners are really sweet and the food was also really good! Good vibes and really nice food.

name: SEVEN • SLASH • TWO
review_1_text: Love this place! Seven Slash Two has a clean, modern, yet comfortable and relaxing atmosphere. Great oat milk latte and American Breakfast. The service is super friendly and it has become my morning go-to spot whenever I visit Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Nice cafe sporting a roomy space with varied seating that's pretty quiet on a weekday morning. Service is cordial and the coffee is great.
review_3_text:
From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles, a sleek cozy atmosphere, and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee in the air

What stood out most was the attention to detail in taste, in presentation, and in service.
Absolutely a place I’ll come back to. A new favorite!!!
review_4_text: Great latte. Big space inside not obvious from the road. Plenty of places to work for a few hours.
review_5_text: I found this cafe towards the end of my stay in Chiang Mai, but I returned nearly everyday until I left. The staff are super nice, and it’s a lovely place to hang out and enjoy a coffee. The barista practically convinced me to become a barista when I’m done traveling because of his enthusiasm for the craft and role in customers’ daily lives. It’s a special place! Both the coffee (iced americano was my go to) and the food were superb. The interior is very beautifully designed and was a calming getaway from the busy streets - like a protective bunker. Unfortunately I took no pictures because I was too busy enjoying the vibes here to even think about it.

name: Café & Baristo
review_1_text: AMAZING coffee. Had a flat white that blew my mind.
review_2_text: Great Place and coffee !
review_3_text: Try the dirty signature coffee!!! Amazing!! 🤩
review_4_text: I think I had the best coffee of my life here!
review_5_text: It's a very calm, clean place that makes high-quality coffee. I recommend it.

name: The Bell Cafe
review_1_text:
What a little Gem this find was ,wow we loved our filter coffee from this place,if you  love a Good coffee,then it's a must and at 45bht it's even more tasty,we sat outside and watched the world go by.
Served by students who are so friendly. Thank you for a fantastic coffee.
review_2_text: Love the environment and the flavor of the coffee here☺️🫶🏻. Nice place and wonderful barista
review_3_text: Stop by and try some hot and cold drinks from the students here.😁
review_4_text: Flavour of the iced latte was amazing and really good service.
review_5_text: Amazing price for quality drinks

name: Singharat Soi 3
review_1_text: Terrible experience. Dirty room, no parking, bad attitude owner I would never stay here again and definitely do NOT recommend this place to anyone.
review_2_text:
I wanna recommend this place. A co-working space is available here. We can get chilled in a small homemade café with WIFI. There are two kinds of rooms
a double bedroom and a big room for 6 people! The host is warm and kind. ✨️
review_3_text:
I received a warm welcome from the host!
The location is good for strolling around Chiang Mai old city. The room is compact and nice 👍
review_4_text: Good vibe
review_5_text: I stopped by to read a book after a long walk, and the owner was very friendly. It was a great place to stop and rest! The coffee was also pretty good.

name: Sao กาแฟโบราณ
กาแฟโบราณถุงกระดาษข้างเทคนิคเชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
20 Baht Happiness
Sweet and delicious when drunk on a hot day.
review_2_text: The milk tea recommended by the massage parlor staff. They brew it right in front of you, and it's delicious👍

name: ร้านลุงหน้าวิทลัย
review_1_text: He has a high quality drinks for a fair price. Gentleman running the shop was super nice. The Thai tea we got was like a Thai tea icee. already blended with the ice. Very nice

name: Kum Jan Cafe and Thai Dessert
review_1_text: Nice little coffee, good place for relaxing after some hours Chiang Mai. Good music in background, friendly stuff and important -> the air-conditioning is perfect - not to cold like Starbucks. So we spent arround 2h and it was very comfortable. The coffee shop is open for anybody, not only for the hotel guests opposite.
review_2_text:
Lovely chilled cafe, tasty drinks, delicious sandwiches. The owner and staff were super friendly we got a complementary brownie and snacks while hanging out in the front patio. Highly recommend ☺️

While checking into the hotel you get a free drink ticket!
review_3_text: Love this place! The food is incredible tasty! It was the very first time someone taught me how to eat Thai food! The people are so lovely, I felt great here! I highly recommend you to come if you are in Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: Cute little place. Food was ok. The employees are nice, but they might have been a bit understaffed. Took a very long time to get the drinks we ordered. Food came out quick through. And more importantly they have AC
review_5_text: Very local to our hotel. Very friendly staff and the service was good. The menu is very varied and so able to eat all sorts.

name: Ponganes Coffee Roasters
review_1_text:
This roaster came for the first time.

Looking at the score of 4.4, it belongs to the middle and lower coffee roaster.

But generally speaking, the coffee of the roaster is not too bad.

Unless there is a human error on the day.

I tried the blended beans.

The name is Ocean blend which is recommended from the coffee shop

Light roasted

A cup of 90 baht, blended beans, is also not cheap in Chiang Mai.

The overall acidity is good, but the bitter taste destroys the overall acidity balance.

But it is also an understandable style.

As far as this price is concerned

You can't give full marks, but it's also a high score.
review_2_text: One of the coffee shops that I’ve save on my to go list for so long! Def worth the visit
review_3_text: The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, perfect for both work and relaxation. The coffee selection is outstanding, with a variety of high-quality beans roasted on-site. Each cup is a testament to their dedication to the craft, delivering rich, aromatic flavors that truly stand out.  If you appreciate artisanal coffee and a warm, welcoming environment, this is the place to be.
review_4_text: This was our favorite coffee place we tried in Thailand (and rivals the best coffees I’ve had all over the world)! The chiang mai blend over ice was so flavorful and I was easily able to get all the notes of the coffee. The owner was super nice as well— he gave us his last bag of chiang mai beans that he was keeping to age when we wanted to purchase the beans. He also gave us recommendations for a beautiful hike and local food favorites. I will definitely be making another stop next time I’m in chiangmai!
review_5_text: A local roaster hidden in a precious place. The shop is brand new high top tech but with traditional methods variety. I has the opportunity to taste the coffee bean winner od 2025 in Thailand.

name: Chockdee Cafe
review_1_text: It's okay not expensive
review_2_text: Very good coffee and barista is VERY friendly
review_3_text: Good
review_4_text: To expensive
review_5_text: Relatively good roadside stalls

name: My Moka Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee and friendly owner. The coffee is totally handmade and no machine. Even I am not sensitive about coffee but I still can feel the scent and good taste.
review_2_text:
2025:
My lovely cafe has upgraded!

It is now setting a more permanent spot.

So good to see lady owner grinding beans and making moka pots of coffee.

Just a chill and Thai feeling.

Wonderful!

2024:
what is this feeling? It’s Thai hospitality!

Located at a quite shady roadside, and wrecked furniture and very old van, however don’t let these disguise you from getting a good cup of coffee!

for only 20B I get a hot cup of latte, freshly grind beans, the aroma can be smelled from afar, and the famous moka pots. it turns into a sweet cup? Lovely, super hot, (I love it hot) and really spend some time to sip and enjoy it.

My my my, no wonder it has so many local fans, and the owner such a friendly lady, so happy to see this little gem.
review_3_text: The lady that runs it is really lovely and friendly, we have tried the mocha, my moka thai drink, and the latte and have been impressed by them all! So we came two days in a row, would have been more if we weren’t leaving chiang mai! Only 30 baht for an iced drink which is amazing 👏🏼😍
review_4_text:
Great local coffee for 20thb (hot) / 30thb (iced). Served in a basic paper cup, but does the job!

Owner is friendly and grinds the coffee beans with a manual grinder right before you!

Definitely a hidden find and the best find whilst in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Taste good and cheap, 20 baht hot, 30 ice👍🏼 better than you buy instant sachet / can coffee ☕️

name: BYB Club CNX
review_1_text: Great after hours club located near the big bar streets in Nimman. Their drink selection is adequate, with many different alcohol choices. They also sell weed as well if you are into that. They’re open from 10 pm until late, normally still open long after the other bars close.
review_2_text:
Yes for cool vibes, great techno and house music.

An eclectic group of people who head there. Weed, alcohol and nitric-oxide balloons. Enough to get quite inebriated pretty damn quickly.

Service staff were awesome and very welcoming. One of the owners (Val?) was chill and inviting, the other dude was arrogant and downright rude - [who the hell has a business meeting at 1am in a nightclub and doesn't want to be disturbed ¿] ... FFS 🙄😝

Anyway, definitely a very cool place to go dance and chill late into the night. Reminded me of my old days partying in crowded Hong Kong clubs like Drop and Homebase. 💥🎶

Parteeee CENTRAL!

🔊🎶🎶💥🤩😎
review_3_text:
This club is very nice, its tiny, it has super art inside, UV decor & string art is next level! The music also, from good techno into hard and melodic Psy trance!
Just the crowd is missing,i hope many people will come here!!♾🙏🕉💜
review_4_text: These are the droids you are looking for. Came for the music, stayed for the human connection. Will come back if I'm ever in CNX again.
review_5_text:
Great place to go very profesional DJs.
Love there cocktails great price and not skimpy.
The staff are chatty and friendly.
Be nice to see some professional  dancers sometimes in the cage. lol
I love to go there and unwind into the lights and beats.
Its just a great club to go if you like the nightlife.

name: NAREE Coffee De' Klangwiang สถานฝึกวิชาชีพทัณฑสถานหญิงเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Very nice homey restaurant. I ate Banana with Coconut Milk and coffee, it was delicious. It's also nice breakfast place. Very friendly staff.
review_2_text: Beautiful atmosphere - a green oasis in the middle of Chiang Mai. 🌳 The staff was so wonderful and friendly, I felt very welcome. I only came in here to order a fresh orange juice; but the beautiful little garden made me stay. 🥰
review_3_text: Fairly nice open space garden to have lunch. This is supposedly a rehabilitation place for inmates, so I think most of the workers here have some history, but the service quality is much better than most of the cafes around and they are very nice. Their tom ka Gai was great, but their pad see ew was not so good that they should add more spice/black pepper or something. If you know what to order, it’s a great place to spend some relaxing time.
review_4_text: I loved coming here in the morning to enjoy my iced coffee. The terrace outside is a little green oasis 🪴. Nice atmosphere, the staff was very friendly. Good prices.
review_5_text:
Lunch at the prison! Chiang Mai woman's prison offers a great training program for Thai massage and restaurant. Open to all. I had many massages here before but first time for lunch. Pretty good, I recommend trying it out.
The Strawberry smoothie was great.
#thaifood #thailand #prison #chiangmai

name: ร้านลับในซอยเล็ก by เจ้าหมู่กาแฟ
Brain awake
review_1_text:
Dessert was yummy but cappuccino was too sweet and very chemical.
The place is neat and clean yet too quite, more like a library instead of a coffee shop.
Wifi is good, one set of username and password  only allow one device to connect to, you can ask for another set if you have multiple devices.
review_2_text: I was able to concentrate and work very well! Had a caramel cappuccino and a chocolate waffle there and was very happy with it. I was the only one there for 4h though. Would absolutely recommend
review_3_text:
Might be good. Hard to tell considering the drink was 99% ice, so gone after 2 sips. The photo below is after I finished the drink... The lid barely closed from so much ice.

2 stars for having good AC.
review_4_text: My favorite place to work in Chiang Mai - with great vegan options! ❤️ Coffee with soy milk, delicious smoothies and my beloved... steamed buns (with taro, red bean or vegetables!) :-)))
review_5_text: Very spacious place, large windows, lots of light. great place to relax, have a chat work or study. smoothies use real fruit (not puree or syrup), good coffee. great coffee shop 😊

name: Golden Bee Shop & Coffee น้ำผึ้ง เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
10/10 - my favourite working cafe in Chiang Mai. Delicious drinks, delicious food, affordable local prices - under $100 THB. There is help yourself honey you can use and add to your drinks including raw honey combs you can cut.

EVERYTHING I have ordered on the menu so far has been delicious. I am literally shocked.

Clean, spacious, there are electric outlets, wifi, air conditioning, windows and natural lighting. Washroom is clean but in the back.

The products are really nice also. I like the inhaler, body skin balm, and the lip balm. Made with natural ingredients. Between 45-55 THB.

It closes at 6pm, otherwise, I work work here all day!
review_2_text: Great location, absolutely comfortable seats… Lots of tables available, beautifully decorated cafe… Bought some honeycomb for my sweet tooth sugar fix… The waitress that brought my food to the table had a beautiful big smile delivering the food… Great food, great prices, oat milk hot Thai tea was fabulous along with the meal.
review_3_text:
if I'd brought my friend with my to chaing mai & to this beautiful cafe ' he would of caused quite the sticky outburst!
There's honey everywhere ' it's just heaven 😍
I have truly enjoyed my two months trip in Thailand but one of the highlights for me which I'll never forget is the Golden Bee ' 🐝

Thanks to all the staff for their great smiles and homely honey service
review_4_text: Very clean and lovely AC. We had Durian Moon Cake, a honey latte & Affogato with coconut Ice cream. My partner liked his latte so much he got a second to go! I got the Honey Lemonade and it was lovely. The bit of honeycomb on top was a fantastic touch
review_5_text:
Delicious vegan coffee with oat milk! You have to pay 15 extra baht for the vegan milk, making a latte 75 baht.
But, you have comfortable seats or couch for working and aircon.

name: Liberated Seed Coffee Roaster (LibSeed)
review_1_text:
Great coffee with lots of options — including matcha!
Super chill vibe with both indoor and outdoor seating.
Perfect spot to sit back and relax ☕️🍵✨
review_2_text: The coffee is excellent, and the staff make you feel so comfortable and welcome. The atmosphere is cozy, and it’s a great place to relax or spend time with friends. I’d definitely come back again.
review_3_text: The cafe has a great atmosphere—cool and comfortable The barista is friendly and lovely The prices are great value for the quality you get and it’s a perfect place to sit back and relax for a long time.
review_4_text:
A cozy place to grab great coffee and start your day.
Warm, welcoming baristas and good conversations.
Excellent coffee with a variety of beans and well-crafted, great-tasting menu.
review_5_text: Good flat white and friendly service. Only improvement I would suggest is to make the seating area a bit more comfortable and cosy.

name: K2 Coff
review_1_text: Delicious coffee treat!! I had the honey cinnamon iced latte and it was incredible! Sweet but strong. Great coffee bean and presentation is spot on. My bf had the caramel iced latte which was also amazing. It’s decor is also super cute with a garden and stuffed animals everywhere. Def worth checking out :)
review_2_text: Great americano (from an American’s perspective).  Wonderful, quiet working environment and nice touches throughout the shop!  Highly recommended.
review_3_text: This place is just ok. Neither the service, coffee or decor demand a second visit.
review_4_text: Very yummy “house specialty”! It was so yummy, I’d never had anything like it and it was an amazing treat. I used to work as a barista and I continued to be wowed by all these amazing Thai coffee places.
review_5_text: Clean, airy, tastefully planned and decorated. Quiet and comfortably cool. Nice drinks at reasonable prices.

name: Gallery Drip Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text: I‘ve been here for the second time. I can tell you that the coffee tastes very good. The price is also good. It is a shop that hidden in the Chiang mai culture centre. Good coffee and it’s worth to try even if you aren’t drinking coffee. There are many types of beans to choose. The staff can recommend each menu well. Both talkative, smiling, many seats, both inside and outside.
review_2_text:
Nice coffee shop in a nice building/museum. They had lots of beans to choose, we picked affogato & cold brew.
To be honest, that's best affogato i tried in my life, seriously. It had coconut ice cream with coffee, and something fun on top (i guess it's made from sugarcane or something like that). Perfect in a hot summer day. Very calm & chill atmosphere that we still remember till now.
review_3_text: Love the vibes and the coffee ☕️ great hideaway spot with quietness and comfortable atmosphere. Outside sitting at a very cute garden set up inside the museum…can easily spend hours enjoying the coffee & vibes there!
review_4_text: Cafe culture is in its infancy in Thailand. However, this place demonstrates that the Thais are getting there. After touring, the Gallery, you exit by the cafe and as soon as I entered, I knew this place wasn't going to disappoint. I could see that the barista who was preparing to make drip coffee learned his technique properly when he carefully trimmed and foldted the filter to its proper size. I asked to see the beans and was told that the beans were locally sourced and washed and roasted by the Cafe. While I asked for robust beans, the Cafe owner said that she didn't have robust but favored medium roast and that I should try it. I did, and while the medium roast was flavorful and you could taste the hint of hazelnut, I still would have preferred a more robust bean. Overall, this place is for serious coffee afficionados. I think that if the Cafe wants to please more serious coffee drinkers, it must add a robust bean selection. I was happy and pleased that I found this place and I recommend that if you are in Chiang Mai and want to learn about the City and afterwards be rewarded with a good cup of coffee, stop by!
review_5_text: Best coffee we had in Thailand. Drip coffee is so much better than americano. And we had a great table host.

The staffs can still remember me after half year.makes me so surprised.Also like the cheese bread is extremely crispy and tasty.A wonderful afternoon in Chiang mai.
review_3_text: Love the food and the vibe of the place! Really cute aesthetic for the entire place. Good portion sizes. I would highly recommend their brownie. Portion size was also big lol. Can’t finish the whole pad thai that I’ve ordered. Overall a great experience
review_4_text: This is a great place to relax with your dog. We can sit and eat with our beloved dogs. There's a wide variety of delicious dishes to choose from, and the prices are reasonable. The food is delicious, and the wait isn't too long. The staff are impressive, help taking photos for us, and even holding an umbrella when it's raining. I'll definitely be back. Love this place 🐶❤️🌲🌿
review_5_text: This café is absolutely one of my favorites! It's super photogenic with plenty of cute spots for taking pictures. The owner is incredibly kind and even brings out their adorable dog, Robert Rowie, for customers to play with – such a sweet touch! The staff are all friendly and welcoming. The food and drinks are delicious, and the prices are very reasonable. I've been here many times and always leave happy. Highly recommended!

review_1_text: This place is gorgeous, relaxing with the best outdoor vibe. There’s a tree right in the middle, thoughtful decor everywhere, and a soft mist that makes it feel extra calm. We stopped in after a massage for smoothies, coffee, and a pizza, and everything hit the spot. The service was warm and  attentive.
review_2_text: What a lovely cafe. Its almost magical out back with the water mill, fog and koi fish. Music is perfect. Atmosphere 20/10 cappuccino 30/10. It was hot, great flavor, good size.   I didn't have the food but I saw some go out and it looked good. Also so the smoking coconut coffee drink they do. Looked stunning. I just don't drink cold drinks. 200/10 recommend this place. Also has strong wifi.
review_3_text: We both had eggs Benedict and they were superb. The atmosphere is relaxing and peaceful. It was one of the few places open and we are so thankful we stumbled upon it. We’ve been back twice already.
review_4_text: So glad we found this place — it’s our second year coming here whenever we visit Chiang Mai! The coffee is excellent — strong, smooth, and perfectly balanced (I’m quite picky about coffee, and this one really impressed me!). The honey toast was to die for — crispy, tasty, and consistently great both times we visited. The relaxing atmosphere with the water mill adds such a lovely touch. review_5_text: Excellent coffee and a unique atmosphere! This review focuses on their main specialty: the drinks. I had a cappuccino and my wife tried the matcha latte. There’s also a shop right next door where you can buy products and scents from the same brand. Highly recommended!

The all-black theme inside looks super clean and modern, and the atmosphere is perfect for a spot or to chill or getting some work done.

The coffee was genuinely great, and the service was friendly and quick.

review_4_text:
Review for On the Way Cafe, Chiang Mai

On a bright and sunny Sunday around noon, I found myself drawn to On the Way Cafe in Chiang Mai. The retro-inspired sign outside caught my eye, promising a unique experience within. As I entered, Sun Rai’s San Francisco Street was playing softly, adding a warm, nostalgic vibe to the sunny atmosphere. The upbeat melody reminded me of lazy Sunday mornings in a foggy coffee shop back in San Francisco—only here, the sunlight streamed through the windows, casting a golden glow across the room.

The cafe itself has a cozy yet vibrant charm, with vintage touches that feel thoughtfully curated. It’s the perfect place to unwind, inviting you to sit back and take in the bright day outside while savoring something delicious.

I opted for their coconut coffee, intrigued by the blend of local flavors. It was fantastic—smooth and creamy, with just the right hint of coconut that brought a refreshing twist without overpowering the coffee. The drink felt like a mini-vacation in itself, blending the comforting richness of coffee with a touch of tropical escape.

On the Way Cafe captures that ideal balance between nostalgia and novelty. Whether you’re reminiscing about foggy mornings in San Francisco or enjoying the sunny charm of Chiang Mai, this little gem provides a welcoming spot to pause, reflect, and savor the moment. It’s a must-visit for anyone looking to experience a taste of creativity and warmth on a beautiful, sunlit day in Chiang Mai.

review_2_text: This cafe is a part of a school, so the prices are much cheaper than many others around. It’s na nice AC space with some good tables and chairs. My hot cappuccino was below average quality, but the value is not bad given this location and the price.
review_3_text: Prices range from 30-35 Baht for a hot cold coffee Matcha etc and 40-45 for a smoothie in a clean quiet spacious aircon atmosphere. Excellent place to enjoy a quiet drink and use a laptop while supporting the local vocational school.
review_4_text:
CMVC Coffee, part of Chiangmai vocational College is a specialty coffee shop located in Chiang Mai, Thailand, celebrated for its commitment to high-quality, locally-sourced coffee. The café often features coffee from organic farms in northern Thailand, including single-origin beans from sustainable sources like Paradise Mountain Organic Coffee. Known for its relaxed ambiance and dedication to the art of coffee-making, CMVC uses a variety of brewing techniques and serves a range of unique blends, aiming to offer both locals and tourists a refined coffee experience within a peaceful setting.

The Chiang Mai coffee scene is rich with third-wave coffee shops that emphasize traceability, organic farming, and artisanal brewing, and CMVC Coffee stands out for embodying these values while showcasing the region’s coffee-growing heritage. If you’re in Chiang Mai, CMVC provides an authentic taste of Thailand’s coffee culture in a stylish, inviting environment ￼.
