name: Improvise Coffee ll
review_1_text: I was walking past yesterday when I saw the sign out the front for "egg coffee", but I couldn't fit in a third coffee so I had to wait till today. When I was in Vietnam last year I absolutely loved the egg coffee. So I was excited to find a place in Chiang Mai that made it. This egg coffee is really great. It's served a little different than in Vietnam. Instead of being in a tall class with lots of ice, this is in a small glass and absolutely delicious. You don't need all the ice in a cooler climate like Chiang Mai -- in Vietnam you do as it is so hot. 🌟🌟🌟🌟 oh, and I can't leave out that the venue has a huge amount of seating. There is a little deck area with garden, then there are another two outdoor seating areas plus space upstairs. Customer service was polite and friendly.
review_2_text:
Charming little cargotecture cafe with nice cafe garden. I took the medium roast coffee, it has citrus flavor a bit of sourness taste, hint of sour apple. I was temped to try their Vietnam inspired egg coffee but decided to go with Americano to get the coffee bean taste. Spoke to two customers and they both said, you do not taste the egg nor the raw slimy eggs. I should of spoken to them before ordering my Americano, next visit, I will try the Thai Egg Coffee. They have fans running outside under the canopy and a laptop work desk and wall outlets for laptops. Great customer service, too. Highly recommended 👌

review_4_text: It's a nice coffee shop, good prices. Our drinks were delicious especially the rose Lemon Soda. Chill music is playing and there is a lot of space and tables to sit. We'd recommend it!
review_5_text: Was craving a good coffee in Chiang Mai and found a range of iced coffees at Improvise.  Went with the "Improvise" which was a standard iced latte with butterscotch soda thrown in.  Very happy with my choice!

name: Coffee Telling
review_1_text:
The best cup of coffee in Chiang Mai, and the kindest, sweetest owner.
Coffee is 50 baht, he doesn’t charge for an oat milk alternative, and he uses the best one there is- Oatly! Great banana bread too!
There’s plenty of seating available outside, and it feels like sitting in someone’s garden.
There’s also a cute cat roaming about :)
My husband and I are sad we couldn’t visit more often and wish we could have stayed in this neighbourhood.
review_2_text: This is my FAVORITE coffee spot in Chiang Mai. First of all, the coffee is so delicious and that's what counts the most.. and second it's not extra to have soy milk. The mugs have a decent size, perfect for me. And the owner is very friendly, the atmosphere chill, lot's of greenery and nice decorations. I enjoy coming here so much! Thank you :)
review_3_text:
Cozy spot with lush back and front patios.
The owner and staff are super friendly and cool. Banana bread is out of this world, vegan to top it. Coffee is amazing, and the mango smoothie is mmmmm.
Must visit in CNX for coffee.
review_4_text: Nice little cafe here, so you can grab yiur coffee, tea, Matcha, or get in and try their cheesecake. Very pleasant with the hospitality here, the girls are amazing and always welcoming with a smile on their faces. I visit often when I'm around. Pop in and get yourself a latte or some refreshments. 🙏💪
review_5_text:
Lovely little spot for a drink and chill. The Thai milk tea was great and even did it with oat milk for me, and if you go, you have to get the vegan banana bread, it's so yummy!

The service was great as the owner is incredibly sweet and clearly loves what he does. A definite place to go for a calm, relaxing vibe

name: At Chiangmai Restaurant
review_1_text:
so we went to the the famous mango place and asked for mango shake which they didn't have, so they told me to order from this restaurant . I thought it was 70 baht but it was actually 80baht . I don't have any problem paying 80 but I was curious so asked for the right price and the server said it is a shake not a juice so It was 10baht more expensive. I totally get it . but the problem is the server started to talk in THAI saying that I am making drama because of 10baht!
he didn't know I understood Thai...

poor service... very RUDE!!!!
review_2_text: I did not eat at this restaurant but the sticky nice outside of it is. 100/10 !! Defo have some
review_3_text:
This vegetarian sandwich is delicious, 99฿.
Note: whoever stay at this hotel is at good location for food tasting around this area.
review_4_text: We are passing here with hundred degree of afternoon heat. The restaurant has quiet elegant environment with cool air. We ordered the basil rice with pork and stir fried red curry pork. Both are exceedingly yummy. We also ordered the mango sticky rice from the stand in front the restaurant as dessert. Very satisfying meal.
review_5_text: Great air conditioning and the hardest working host in Chiang Mai serving our food. Super convenient escape from the heat (and Songkram) just outside our hotel.

name: Scoof
review_1_text: A heartwarming spot full of positive energy, plus the drinks are healthy and delicious! I visited on Christmas Eve and loved the afternoon show. Seeing the guests singing along was a wonderful surprise and made for a very happy time.
review_2_text: It’s a homely, tasty, and healthy brunch spot, as the owner runs their own organic farm. If you’re looking for a place to escape the hustle and enjoy quality dishes made with premium ingredients, this one is highly recommended.
review_3_text: Just walked past and fancied a coffee stop and scoof looked good. Whole family had smoothies, and food looked good so we all had meals. Kao Tom was delicious, as was chicken with gravy and salad. Also had Spaghetti bolognese and this was good too. Also speaking with staff and found out some of the fresh produce grown on their local farm. Really friendly staff
review_4_text:
New healthy cafe
Healthy & Yummy home grown refreshment with options from booster to detoxification.

Quality sausages plate. Love meat sausages.
A very tasty perilla bun salmon plate.

Fresh squeeze , smoothy and plenty of juices and healthy food create by “De Farm”

High ceiling, nice music, cool interior and welcome cafe place.
review_5_text: We stopped here for a mid-morning snack and it was great! We shared an egg & meat dish, a booster shot, a matcha coconut, and a delicious honey kombucha. Everything was so tasty. It was a great vibe and we enjoyed hanging out here for a bit.

name: Baan Rim Rua Restaurant
review_1_text: A small coffee shop surrounded by greenery. They serve coffee, Thai milk tea, and cakes. They're only open on Saturdays and Sundays.
review_2_text: A cozy, homey restaurant with delicious food. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: Shady atmosphere, delicious food, excellent service.

name: RAGGA COZY HEALTHY SPACE
review_1_text:
The best Masala Chai tea and smoothie in Chiangmai!!! The owner is a musician and love this shop’s decoration and sense of fashion about the clothes.
Good place to chill out~
review_2_text: Just discovered this place without looking for it and I ended up staying for a bit because the vibe is really nice and the tea amazing. Highly recommend to slow down and stop by this lovely place.
review_3_text: Such a cozy spot with a lovely atmosphere. Super friendly owner, tasty drinks, and absolutely delicious food!!!
review_4_text: Cool place, cool drink, cool music, and really cool people!!!
review_5_text: Chill space to relax

name: CUPKUP
review_1_text:
Lovely fresh Thai food at a very good price with a nice outdoor dining area out the back
Recommend maybe getting a dish and a half if hungry though! Smallish portions but the prices are very fair for them
review_2_text: Very reasonable and great selection of thai food. Lovely outdoor dining area out the back away from the main road.

name: TEMPT cafe&brunch
review_1_text:
From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming.
The barista ☕ were friendly, attentive, and genuinely cared about providing great service.
Everything is homemade by The owner is super sweet💘, lovely, and feels just like a girl bestie! 💕 and absolutely delicious.
Highly recommend the Basque cheesecake 🍰 🍽️. it’s rich, creamy, and pairs perfectly with their Iced Coffee. Brunch menus were such a huge!! and chick decorated portion 🍓 🫐 🥝💐😋
Will definitely be back again!
review_2_text: We came back here to Temt Cafe, to have the delicious cheesecake 😋 again. Coffee can be better, but was OK. We enjoy the relaxing atmosphere, air conditioning. It is a nice and comfortable place.
review_3_text: Great cafe. I visit here often because it's always good to come back. The drinks are delicious, the service is good, the quality of the coffee is excellent, and the price is not expensive at all and excellent compared to other cafes around the city. The barista is very nice and always happy to provide service. The place is comfortable, quiet and is in a good location. Like everywhere in Chiang Mai, to use a laptop you have to buy a certain amount and there is no problem with that, I don't know of a place that lets you use its electricity for free. There is oat milk for vegetarians. There are spacious and clean toilets. There is seating inside and outside.
review_4_text: The shop is lovely. The staff very friendly and nice. She always smiles. The price of the coffee is cheap, cheap enough, reasonable prices to buy it. 😘🥰🩷
review_5_text: Simple and perfect. This place will make your soul and belly happy! Incredible beverages and the most beautiful dishes. Make a point of visiting when you are in town - serious, don’t sleep on this place.

name: Su-Jai Coffee
review_1_text: Walked by and fancied a cold drink, got two iced Thai milk teas. Customised with less sugar. One of the best Thai milk teas I've had, nice and strong and not too sweet!! Could easily drink a litre of it, thanks so much! Had as a takeaway so can't comment on much else but looked like a cosy chill space
review_2_text:
Stopping by Su-Jai Coffee after a rejuvenating Christmas Day yoga session in Chiang Mai felt like a serendipitous gift. Tucked away behind a peaceful canopy of trees, the shop exudes an inviting charm that perfectly balances coziness with simplicity. It's the kind of place where you half-expect Telly Savalas to stroll in, snapping his fingers, and proclaiming, "Who loves ya, baby?"—but instead of a lollipop, he'd grab a steaming hot Americano.

The café feels like it could be a Norm Macdonald monologue in physical form—laid-back, unpretentious, and quietly brilliant. Their latte is so velvety and rich that it feels like a nod to Norm's comedic timing: deceptively simple yet unforgettable. And the watermelon smoothie? It’s as refreshing and vibrant as Norm's dry wit—a perfect pick-me-up after working up a sweat in yoga.

The prices are surprisingly affordable (just 50 to 55฿ for most drinks), which made it feel like I had stumbled onto a hidden gem. As I sipped my cold cappuccino, I couldn't help but chuckle at how fitting this place was—a tiny oasis of relaxation in the heart of Chiang Mai. Whether you're chasing Christmas calm or looking to channel some Kojak-level coolness, Su-Jai Coffee is the spot to savor.
review_3_text: The best and coziest café in town. The owners are so nice, we loved our time there
review_4_text: It was pure bliss when my girlfriend and I first discovered this place — a haven of tranquility where the gentle melodies played by the staff danced through the air. The coconut milk was heavenly. I know this will be a place I return to, time and again, to savor peaceful afternoons in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: Fun to sit, nice and shady. The mango shake is thick and sweet.

name: Hopf Coffee House
review_1_text: We popped in here for a drink and ended up having a few. The atmosphere was great with friendly staff and happy customers. They have live musicians playing good music, and very reasonably priced drinks. I can't comment on the food but I can say we had a great time. Recommended 👍
review_2_text: Super cool bar! Max the owner is really chill and friendly - you feel like a local the first time you go there. They also have live music Friday / Saturday / Sunday. Immaculate vibes 🙏🍻
review_3_text: Great food, friendly service and live music at night! Cant beat it.
review_4_text:
This is my absolute favorite bar in Chiang Mai! The place has a magical charm, and the owner truly brings it to life. He personally handles the service and has such a unique and welcoming vibe that makes the experience unforgettable.

The atmosphere feels so warm and familiar—you’ll notice many people coming by not just as customers, but as friends who’ve built a connection with the owner. It’s the kind of place where everyone feels at home, and the amazing vibe keeps you coming back. They have live music every night :)
I ended up spending most of my nights in Chiang Mai here, and I highly recommend you try it! The prices are very reasonable, and the mojitos are absolutely delicious. Don’t miss out on this gem!
review_5_text: The owner is very friendly and helpful. There is great live music. I recommend you come and have a drink. There are Pai and max waiting to welcome you.

name: Mountain Coffee by Noi
review_1_text:
A Flavor Journey in Every Cup: Chiang Dao Coffee with the Most Unique Finish

This Old City gem offers a complete artisan experience that starts with your palate and ends with a story. Beyond their incredible hand-roasted, organic Chiang Dao Arabica coffee and exceptional homemade breads, they serve a cup with a truly unique taste profile.

Coffee Experience: Their must-try Iced Americano showcases beans roasted right on-site. But here’s what sets it apart: the taste journey. It begins with a surprisingly sweet, bright palette—notes of citrus and honey—that then transforms into a distinct, intentional, warming "burn" at the finish. It’s not bitter; it’s a complex, almost smoky depth that lingers beautifully. This unique progression from sweet to roasted warmth is unforgettable.

Perfect Pairings: The homemade Mum's Banana Bread (walnuts, whole wheat, honey) complements the coffee's sweetness, while their Flourless Seed & Nut Bread (no yeast/dairy) stands up to its robust finish.

More than a café—it's a destination for those who appreciate craftsmanship in both coffee and food. A must-visit for a complete, sophisticated experience in the Old City.
review_2_text:
Absolutely wonderful spot.👍

Wonderful setting, inside old town. Filled with peaceful nature. They have Oat milk and other vegan-friendly, dairy substitutes available.
I had a wonderful oat milk latte!
Wonderful tasting organic and fresh mountain coffee; all locally sourced.

Service is wonderful and atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing. Plenty of outdoor, yet sheltered, and shaded seating.
The perfect place to stop your walking and take a break.
I am now totally reenergized!

Thank you so much!

I highly recommend this place and I will come back again.
review_3_text:
A favorite spot for getting really flavourfull good coffee. The lovely owner collects his coffeebeans in Chiang Dao and roast it in the garden with years of experience and born out of pure passion.

All the option are simply great and have a rich deep flavour. If you feel like a little adventure ask for an off-menu coffee and be suprised. Support the local family & enjoy your lovely coffee. Above all spend time talking to Noum. She truly cares and is interested in you as a person 🙏
review_4_text: Come back a year later. Still my best spot in Chiangmai. It's my dream to sit here and enjoy a cup of coffee every morning under such peaceful and teak style greenery setting. Another kind of 5 star enjoyment.  This year I brought home a few bags of beans as well. Hope to come back soon.  Thx Noi.
review_5_text: Amazing coffee that is roasted on site. Great atmosphere and the service was excellent. Visited several times during our stay

name: Akha Ama Coffee ( The New Original )
review_1_text:
The branding and mission here are excellent. The menu highlights specific farmers (like Yongyuth and Ader) and details the processing methods, which adds a nice personal connection to the coffee. The shop itself is warm and inviting, with lots of wood and brick.
I tried their "Ader Geisha" and a standard drip. While it's great to see Thai single-origins being elevated, the flavor profile in the cup was straightforward rather than complex. It’s a good stop if you want to support local agriculture and buy some beans to take home, but the drink experience was fairly standard.
review_2_text: One of the the highest quality coffee place in Chiang Mai. We tried the dirty coffee and it was rich and creamy and not acidic, which we like. The interior of the place is very beautiful wood finishes with 2 storeys level. The seating took into consideration multiple seating groups of singles, doubles and families. They have a 2nd storey balcony view and a private garden seating at the back. A very nice and relaxing way to spend a quiet afternoon feeling like you're in a Japanese home enjoying their great coffee.
review_3_text:
Cozy coffee place nested in the north side of Chiang Mai old town. Wide selection of coffee products including local coffee beans.
Espresso was perfect. Chill and cool atmosphere with second floor seating option.
Recommended for your coffee fix.
review_4_text: Coffee is serious here. Outstanding coffee and Baristros who know how to make coffee.  I buy most of my coffee here for take home.  Unfortunately, there is no car parking. The seating inside is also poor.  Hence, 4 star rating.  Everything else is 5 star at this coffee shop. It is usually busy here
review_5_text:
This coffee shop offers inside & outside seating and a true coffee lovers experience.
Inside various roasts and coffees are offered in preparation methods that will bring out the best flavors.
The immediate choice is light / medium / dark roast and through espresso machine versus drip coffee using the Japanese method.
We thoroughly enjoyed a flat white as well as a drip coffee with distinct flavor profiles.
Prices are average for CNX and service is fantastic.
A place not to be missed!

name: GRAPH Cafe
review_1_text:
A wonderful cafe in Old Town Chiang Mai. Small and cozy. Super nice staff. Great coffee. The best we’ve had thus far in Chiang Mai. Price is the highest we’ve paid as well.

The space is small and refined rustic. We didn’t have to wait but previously we came and gave up as it didn’t seem tables were going to turn anytime soon. They are using a VBM Espresso Machine. Nice attention to detail.
review_2_text:
This is definitely the most creative and innovative cafe in Thailand. I love their spirit and idea of “GRAGH”. Totally agreed their initial thought of naming this brand.

Coffee is just amazing and good mixture and combination with others. I really love this cafe. You can feel their soul and mind. It’s completely different from blue bottle or Starbucks.
review_3_text: Graph has to be one of the most innovative coffee shops in the world right now. The craft they put into the drinks - avocado cream in dirty lattes, somehow blending coffee and orange juice together PERFECTLY, it’s super exciting to know that there are people passionately engaged in their craft to this extent. The location in this craft market is also wonderful, chiang mai is one of my favorite places to visit because of this genuine spirit of creativity. Please support Graph, you won’t regret it.
review_4_text: Amazing coffee creations. Like a cocktail without the booze. Small and cozy, a true coffee aficionado dream. We had midtown, soul smith and monochrome. Expensive but worth it for the craftsmanship.
review_5_text: I had an absolutely phenomenal experience at this coffee shop. The place is very small, so I got my coffee to go. I ordered an iced coffee with dark chocolate and orange, and it tasted super refreshing and unique. I will definitely be back to try some other unusual coffee drinks. The price is higher than regular coffee prices, but it is definitely worth it.

name: Bart Coffee
review_1_text: Bart’s Coffee in Chiang Mai is a gem! A perfect fusion of local blends with a touch of Australian flavor. The coffee is smooth and rich, and the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. A must-visit for coffee lovers!
review_2_text:
Bartcoffee is a small coffee shop located under a tamarind tree in Soi Muang Mueang, Chiang Mai.

The shop has a cozy interior with seating available both inside and at the bar, and it is located close to a barista. When I visited, I had the Espresso Aroma, which was fantastic, with a fruity taste.

As I sipped on the Dirty Coffee, I was immediately struck by the rich, sweet, and creamy flavor. The homemade syrup added a unique sweetness and depth to the drink, while the chilled milk provided a creamy, refreshing texture.

Overall, I highly recommend trying the Dirty Coffee at Bartcoffee. It's a perfect example of the coffee shop's commitment to quality and creativity, and it's sure to satisfy any coffee lover's taste buds.

Parking may be a bit difficult to find as the coffee shop is located in a small alley, but it makes for a peaceful and quiet atmosphere. If you happen to visit on a cool day in Chiang Mai, it's even better.

Facebook : From The Earth To A Cup
review_3_text:
I had heard that their opening hours can be unpredictable, but fortunately, they were open when I got there
lucky me! They serve an excellent dirty coffee, one of the best I’ve had. I also noticed many Korean customers, which I took as a good sign, as they tend to take their coffee seriously. Overall, a great experience. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
Bart Coffee is a small coffee shop that makes some of the best coffee I had in Chiang Mai. The dirty coffee we ordered was smooth, creamy and refreshing! Loved the overall atmosphere of the place, with scribbles and writings from people all over the world.

The barista was really friendly and we could tell he loved his job!

There are some seats inside, but limited.
Great place, also to take photos.
review_5_text:
So good! My first good coffee in CNX after three nights. I am finally awake again.

This guy really opens only after 10.30 for some reason, so don’t come early haha

name: The Haus 224
review_1_text:
Really nice place with a great vibe. From the outside it already looks inviting, and once inside it feels cozy, clean, and well put together. The atmosphere is relaxed but still feels special, perfect for an easy dinner or drinks.
I tried the Summer Day cocktail and it was refreshing, smooth, and easy to drink. Very balanced and light, ideal for starting the meal.
For food, I had a classic Yum seafood soup, and it was excellent. Flavorful, comforting, and well balanced, with fresh shrimp and seafood cooked just right. The broth had depth and a nice kick without being too heavy, making it a great choice if you enjoy traditional Thai flavors.
Service was friendly and attentive, and everything came out at a good pace. Overall, a very solid experience with good food, good drinks, and a comfortable atmosphere. I’d definitely come back.
review_2_text:
Kaosoi was interesting the way of their own.
But looks like the owner was never greeting at all.
Even he was at front of the door he didn’t say hello (sawadikha) at all.
It was impressed in chiangmai people. 😢
If you don’t mind please say hello to the people in your area.
This is your local place with small business.
Don’t focus on the menu photo.
review_3_text: Lovely building and who doesn’t love curves and high ceilings. The food was good enough and relatively tasty. It presents well.  It’s ok for Thai prices.
review_4_text:
I recently dined at Hausa 224 and had the pleasure of trying three dishes that truly impressed me.

1. **Pomelo Salad:** This refreshing dish was a delightful start to my meal. The pomelo was perfectly ripe, and the combination of flavors—crunchy vegetables and zesty dressing—made it a vibrant and invigorating experience.

2. **Fire Chicken Curry Noodles:** The star of the show! The noodles were cooked to perfection, and the chicken was tender with just the right amount of spice. The rich curry sauce was bursting with flavor and left me wanting more—I highly recommend it for spice lovers!

3. **Bread of Pork:** This dish was a comforting addition to my meal. The pork was juicy and flavorful, and the bread was soft and perfect for soaking up all the delicious juices.

Overall, my experience at Hausa 224 was fantastic, and I can't wait to return for more culinary delights!

---

Feel free to adjust any part to better match your experience!
review_5_text: Wonderful cuisine! Impressed with all dishes especially Tom Yum Kung spaghetti and Khao Soi Mee Krob.  Good vibes for celebrating.

name: Zmoy Cafe
review_1_text:
An absolute gem in Chiang Mai! 🤎

I spent a wonderful, peaceful moment here – exactly the kind of gentle day I needed. I stayed for over two hours, reading and journaling in this incredibly soothing atmosphere.

As a pastry chef from France, I can say their Tiramisu was truly excellent. The quality is outstanding: refined, perfectly balanced, not too sweet, with a rich cocoa flavor. A real treat! I also had a sparkling Honey & Lemon Matcha, which was refreshing and perfectly executed.

The cafe is a true haven of serenity. It’s amazing how calm this little alley is, even though it's right near a main street and a car dealership. I loved taking photos for my memories; every corner is so photogenic.

The staff is lovely, smiling, and very well-organized. I really enjoyed watching them work in their kitchen (the second room has a charming 'country house' vibe). It almost made me want to jump in and start baking with them!

I recommend this place 1000%, whether for the quality of the desserts or the warm welcome. I’ll definitely be back to try the Carrot Cake. Thank you for a perfect afternoon! ✨

I've been coming here for a month now and I felt the need to update my review...

We should normalize going back to the places that make us feel good, over and over again.
During my month in Chiang Mai, Zmoy Cafe became my sanctuary. It was the place I returned to several times a week whenever I needed comfort, silence, or a moment of peace.

Beyond the technical excellence—because everything here is perfectly mastered, from the subtle sugar balance to the coffee quality that easily rivals the best shops in France—it’s the soul of the place that stays with you. It is a little slice of paradise tucked away in the Old City where you immediately feel at home.

It has become my personal 'Proust’s Madeleine' in Thailand. I love the reassuring consistency: the service is always gentle and kind, and the homemade pastries always taste just as delicious, time after time. They don't try to do everything; they focus on what they do best, and you can feel the heart they put into it—from their social media to the way they treat every customer.

If there is one thing I will truly miss about Chiang Mai, it’s the feeling of warmth I got every time I walked through those doors. It’s not a goodbye, just a 'see you later.' I highly recommend anyone to stop here, step away from the dust and noise, and just enjoy the moment.
review_2_text: Nik is the sweetest and Zmoy is a such a cute cafe. Definitely one of the cutest cafe’s I’ve ever visited. And the coffee does not disappoint. We tried the Zmoy Coffee and lemon cake and both were so good! Please add this place to your list.
review_3_text: Lovely and cozy modern cafe in the middle of old town and old temples. The drinks and snacks are unique and tasty but cheaper than similar options in the new town.
review_4_text: Great Latte, very friendly staff and nice to sit. Just the music inside was a bit too loud for my liking. All in all still a super great place to enjoy your coffee
review_5_text: I come here to write and spend the day. Very peaceful and it feels like you've escaped the noise. The drinks are delicious! Especially the cold (room temp) lattes.

name: Vigie Sist Cafe
review_1_text:
We’ve been here a few times for breakfast and really like it. They have both salty and sweet options, and the homemade pastries are so good.

It’s a small, cozy place run by a family, so the vibe feels warm and friendly. Good food, good service, and good price.

We’ll definitely come back again 😊
review_2_text:
Best breakfast in Chiang Mai. Beautiful rustic cafe where all bread and cakes are homemade. Staff were extremely polite and accommodating.
Food is also very reasonably priced and cheaper than many nearby breakfast places while being of much higher quality.
Homemade chocolate shokupan bread with cream/ ice cream and homemade focaccia breakfast plate. Even the jam was homemade!
Total meal including a coffee, fresh smoothie and brownie to go came to just over 400 baht.
review_3_text:
stopped by Vigiesist by chance, and I’m so glad I did! The place is super cozy and charming. I had a bagel here - honestly one of the most delicious bagels I’ve had in a long time, and it’s homemade! You absolutely have to try it.
The staff are also incredibly kind and friendly. Highly recommend!
review_4_text:
Vigie Sist Cafe is truly a hidden gem in Chiang Mai! A lovely cafe owned and run by a wonderful mother and daughter team — they are always so warm and friendly, and they make you feel right at home the moment you walk in.

The space is cosy and filled with personal touches, charming decorations, and artworks that create such a comfortable atmosphere. I had their spinach omelette with toast for breakfast — healthy, tasty, and made with so much care. The toast and jam are homemade by the lady boss, and they are absolutely delicious!

I enjoyed my breakfast here almost every morning during my last two trips to Chiang Mai — that’s how much I love this place. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a homely, heartwarming cafe experience. ❤️🍳☕️
review_5_text: A place to relax and chill. Their coffee is great as with their brownies. There are many good Cafe in Chiang Mai, this is one of them. Most importantly, their staffs very friendly and helpful.

name: Café de Chill in CNX
review_1_text: This is my favourite place in Chiang Mai, so much so that I try to stay as close to it as possible. I would come for breakfast here every morning. The sandwiches and coffee are so good! Bas, the owner, speaks Japanese, German, English and Thai and is so accommodating and sweet. Love starting my day talking to her, getting advice about Chiang Mai and practicing my Japanese. Highly recommend this lovely spot!
review_2_text:
Egg-cellent!!! I got the bacon sandwich and added a fried egg. The egg was cooked beautifully. Presentation lovely. The owner is so sweet and accommodating. Coming back to try her pancakes.
Atmosphere is cozy, a little warm, but there are some fans. A lot of art to look at.
review_3_text:
Had an amazing breakfast here!
The coffee was very nice, and Bas gave one of the best fruit pancakes I’ve ever had!
And she topped it off with extra fruits she had!
It’s a very cozy place with a lot of options for a nice quick breakfast!
And extremely well priced (underpriced for the value she gives honestly!)

Bas runs this place alone and she also paints!! The place is full of small paintings she’s made over the last couple of years! A very personal touch that makes it feel like home!

10/10 would recommend going there for a few bites!
review_4_text: My favorite cafe in Chiang Mai. The food is made fresh and SO delicious, and the coffee is really good. You will love the lady who runs the place. She is so nice and will make you feel so welcomed.
review_5_text: Amazing food! Very good price and you can chose the toppings of your sandwich. The lady that works there is so sweet and nice!!!! Really loved this place :)

name: NOWHERE COFFEE BREWERS
review_1_text:
Great place to work and chill. The atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable, and it’s weed-friendly.☘️

They serve caffeine-based drinks only (no smoothies), and while the menu is limited, the coffee is very good. Perfect spot if you’re looking for a laid-back vibe and a solid cup of coffee.
review_2_text:
This cafe offers a high quality local coffee bean grown in Chiang Mai.
The tast is great with the best balance.
I enjoyed it in a relaxing cozy garden.
I strongly recommend the hot filter coffee to jave the best coffee experience.
review_3_text:
Hidden gem I could tell , i love the vibe and cattttttt 😼
Ps, someone who wear blue jacket so cool Unfortunately, I didn't ask for their contact ;-;
review_4_text:
Ramen - absolute masterpiece
Spicy rice curry - heaven on earth
Coffees - soul touching

Vibe - it's a serendipity that we got this place ! We chilled all the way and it was beautiful !!
review_5_text:
This cafe is located on the corner of an alley in the ancient city☕️

The environment is very comfortable.

It's a sitting in a daze for an afternoon.

Or an afternoon break

Where is the coffee?

Up to the middle

Latte is not good.

American-style medium-baked beans

Generally up

But the price is also above-middle.

Good environment, high score

Coffee is so-so. Don't expect high.

Just think of it as finding a place to sit.

name: de forest @ NIDHRA CAFE
review_1_text:
I came here for breakfast and had a really pleasant experience. The food was nutritious, fresh, and delicious — a great way to start the day.

Highlights
• Well-balanced and tasty breakfast
• Fresh ingredients and light, clean flavors
• Quiet and comfortable atmosphere in the morning
• The owner is very kind and welcoming
• We were even given a small elephant pouch as a gift — such a thoughtful touch

Overall
If you’re looking for a cozy and quality breakfast spot, this place is definitely worth a visit. Good food, relaxing vibes, and warm hospitality made it a lovely experience.
review_2_text:
I rarely make reviews but this place deserves it.

This family run small restaurant is out of this world.
They take care of even the smallest details on the plate. Food is stunning and incredibly tasty.

Fruits are seasonal and so sweet. 3 out of 4 mornings we came here for breakfast, and each time we were surprised and wondered how can they keep up with this consistency.

Fair warning though:
As it is a small business, husband and wife, don’t expect fast pace . Be patient as I promise you, it is worth it.
Especially when the restaurant is full, expect to spend here a good hour.

Please give it a try , be patient and I assure you, you will be very happy as we were.

Thank you to the family again and we will come back again for sure one day ❤️.
review_3_text: This was a lovely little cafe. Staff were so friendly. This lovely older man. Serviced with  smile. Service was slow but worth the wait. Good was so well presented and colourful and very tasty. Highly recommend this place.
review_4_text:
Nice food, some of the items with a good price, but some a little bit overpriced. The old gentleman was really sweet and kind, even after the food that we ate he brought me a plate of fruit and fresh iced water

The out doors design a little bit strange but cute)
review_5_text: The food was amazing - beautiful and tasty! We were 5 people, we tried everything: French toast, waffle, eggs, yogurt, smoothie…everything was delicious

name: Bar weather cnx
review_1_text: Friendliest owner to chat with. Had the peach drink which was super refreshing. The cafe is also very Korean-aesthetic, perfect for Instagram
review_2_text: When I arrived the bartender/owner threw coffee on a customer of the place next door. When I asked the customer what happened he said that two others put a coffee down for a second and the owner crashed out and threw it at him. Don’t go here!
review_3_text: One of my favourite places in CNX to have a coffee and chill/work
review_4_text: Nice place and good coffee. Outstanding in this area
review_5_text: Best coffee I’ve ever had!!

name: BB cafe' บีบี คาเฟ่
review_1_text:
While staying at the attached Manee House, we ate most of our breakfasts and some lunches here. Great, reasonably priced food with a lovely server.
Recommended!
review_2_text:
We ordered #set 1, #set 4, #set 18 and Kkao pad.:
Those were sooo delicious.
Especially Set 4 and Kkao pad.
We had a great breakfast.
review_3_text: The waitress is soooooo friendly!! And I love the latte there!
review_4_text: Really good food and shakes. Super friendly staff.
review_5_text: We came here just for a cappucino, and thr coffee was amazing!

name: GRASP 1981 Espresso Bar
review_1_text: Upon reading the reviews, I was expecting a proper cafe, but actually it was a really small shop next to the Six-Natures Salon. I passed by it the first time and had to come back to find it hahaha 😂 Coffee tasted good like the reviews and would recommend the iced coffee Thai style! 🇹🇭❤️ I sat for a minute till the coffee was ready and took it out ☺️
review_2_text: Super nice staff! Get the orange americano even if it’s not your thing, it’s orange juice - no syrup or added sugar. Yum! By the road so you can sit and it’s lovely, but you will be accompanied by cars.
review_3_text: This coffee shop is outstanding! I live in Chiang Mai, and I can honestly say this is some of the best coffee you can get here. This time I ordered a cold latte (Latte Yen), and I really like that they serve it in a smaller cup – it means less ice compared to most other coffee shops. Definitely a must-try!
review_4_text: I went to Chiang mai for 3 days 3 nights, had coffee each day, 1-2 cups a day. This place gave me the best coffee for Chiang Mai trip this time, thanks so much!! Good price tho, good atmosphere tho!! Cozy, tiny and special!! Ps. My order is Mocha not a black coffee 🫠
review_5_text: Great coffee for 60 baht, highly recommended

name: Coffee kiss
review_1_text: Delicious iced caramel latte! Feeling super happy with our coffees this morning! The man was very sweet n we watched him grind the beans! Super good, sweet caramel iced latte! Cost 65 bhat= £1.50😍
review_2_text:
Biggest coffee (and tea) in Chiang Mai for only 30 BHT! The cups are as big as my head :) The Thai Black Tea and the Iced Coffee taste amazing! It opens between 8 and 9 am.
We will come back!
review_3_text:
Best Thai coffee in town.

Warning: they are BIG coffees
review_4_text: The black Thai coffee with cream was unreal ! Very affordable!
review_5_text: Delicious coffee for just 30 baht!

name: Mee Gin Coffee
review_1_text:
My favorite coffee shop! I’ve been coming here literally every single day, and it’s always a wonderful experience. The coffee is delicious, and the prices are very reasonable.
A special shout-out to the barista — he’s such a nice and polite guy who always brightens my day. I truly like this place and highly recommend it to everyone!
review_2_text: Very yummy. Portion just nice with the pricing. Only auntie serving everyone so all customers automatically will self service and clean table before leaving.
review_3_text:
We have been coming back every year haha.
Thai milk tea tastes great and the price is also very good. A very local and cute place.
The owner is also so nice.
好喝而且店主人很好
review_4_text: The best Kao Soi in town !!!! Served with a chicken both if you want. Very busy so you may have to waiting as she also get order over the phone. Many dises to chose from. She deserved a Michelin Star. Tasty and cheap. A must go !!
review_5_text: A small local cafe that uses organic coffee. Prices are reasonable and about half compared to nearby chic cafes. Space can be improved.

name: Neighborhood Goods
review_1_text: This is an amazing coffee with excellent coffee with a strong flavor profile. The pieces are affordable and the owner is kind and friendly. She is also very knowledgeable about coffee and even makes her own homemade strawberry jam that tasted great with the matcha. Can highly recommend this place and even has outdoor seating. The best part is that glass containers can be used to avoid plastics.
review_2_text: Nice little place and very friendly owner. Please their signature shaken oat espresso! It’s refreshing and definitely the best world of latte and americano.
review_3_text:
Really cute café, got an iced matcha strawberry with oat milk. Super tasty, not too sweet as requested, real matcha powder and made fresh for the drink. Not top quality matcha but wouldn't expect it to be for that price
Would definitely come again
Beautiful little space, definitely recommend!
review_4_text: Absolute gem in Chiang Mai. Best coffee in town & a lovely atmosphere to sit and watch the world go by. Pastries were also amazing. Staff are super welcoming & friendly. No extra charge for Oat milk which is always a win!
review_5_text: The atmosphere of the cafe is so nice. The staff is so nice and the coffee is so delicious! I'd love to come back again

name: Prem Coffee
review_1_text: Better and cheaper coffee than 7/11. My favourite coffee takeaway from now on :-)
review_2_text: This stand is located right in front of a grocery store. It’s cheap and they have chocolate drinks aside from coffee.
review_3_text: Really tasty and cheap coffee to go and very hard working staff.
review_4_text: Best coffee and tea at best price.
review_5_text: The coffee is very strong and delicious.

name: OON Poshtel x Cafe
review_1_text: I stayed here 4 nights. The good thing of this place is the location, super central, especially to the south gate of the city where tours pick up people. The room I stayed was simple and clean. The included breakfast was ok for the price. It's cheap. There is also a laundry service next door. But it's very noisy during the night as other guests can be inconsiderate with slamming doors and stomping. The place has no sound proof and you can also hear the scooters on the adjacent street. If you don't mind the noise this is a good place to stay.
review_2_text: Opinions are subjective, but to me Oon Poshtel was amazing. I rented a single room for 9 days. 7/11, laundry, money exchange, and scooter rental are all next door. Old town is right across the street.  This is a very clean establishment. Every morning this hotel is swept, mopped, and dusted. I fell in love with the family who owns the cafe. They all have warm smiles and are always eager to help.  The food in the cafe looks just the way it does in the pictures. Fresh, colorful, and tasty. This is a great place for a cute date with your wife. Thank You so much. I appreciate you all!
review_3_text: Only went for breakfast which was ok. Good size portion. Croissant was fine, I had worse in europe. Service fine.
review_4_text: It is really great, momeries and the staff helped us to have our 7th Anniversary day perfect 🙏🙏🙏 unexpectedly my husband shared our anniversary info and they tried to help us with the best surprises in a short notice period. Really feel amazing and lovely day to our couple. Thanks million 🙏 ❤️ 😘 ♥️  See you again, and we will  come and stay here again ❤️ 💙 ♥️ 😀 💕  Thank Oon Postel Owner and staff members really kind and share their hospitality.
review_5_text: I didn't stay here, but had breakfast here every day, as my hotel was just around the corner. It's a MUST to at least once, trying one of their incredible breakfast plates. Bring your camera!

name: Eurana Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: A great quiet place with very calm environment and very good food. Great for remote workers. Great for those who want to sit down and have not entirely street food. Good for groups who are divided on food choices - here you will get both Thai and international dishes. One of the photo - club sandwich. Or, more precisely, leftovers - my partner ate it faster than I took a photo.
review_2_text: I was staying at the hotel and decided to try the cafe. The food was excellent, pad Thai was one of the best I've had in Thailand. My only issue is the container for the soup. It was in one of the square containers, I don't even know if it was food safe plastic. A bowl would have been much better.
review_3_text:
We went to this place for lunch and dinner on separate days, and the food did not disappoint. We had different local dishes such as Khao Soi, and everything tasted great. The fried noodles on top of the Khao Soi were very crispy and the curry tasted great (although a little spicy for my tastebuds, but nothing I couldn't manage).

The atmosphere was relaxed and we even sat down to play cards before leaving.

The price for food and drinks were most reasonable - quite inexpensive actually.

This is also the place where I've hands down have had THE best Italian soda in Thailand. My favourite is the one with peach and butterfly pea. It comes with small bits of gelly (which:at first glance seemed a little odd, but I actually really liked it). The syrup used for this Italian soda just tastes better and more like actual fruit than the synthetic syrups used in many other places. We would absolutely come back if we are ever in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: Came here to use the self service laundry as I only had a few hours before my bus. 40 baht for a 14 minute wash, 10 baht for washing powder, 40 baht for 90 minute dry. There are signs up stating that clothes may need two cycles to be fully dry and that there are no refunds. I thought after 90 minutes my clothes would be mostly dry with some damp bits which would have been fine but most of them were still soaking wet. I didn’t have time for another 90 minute dry as they don’t offer anything shorter so I had no choice but to pack up my wet clothes. The cafe itself is nice to sit in while you wait and they have free wifi and nice coffee.
review_5_text: The best breakfast restaurant I have ever been to. The food is fresh, generous, and beautifully served. Their hot chocolate is absolutely amazing: rich, sweet in the perfect way, and truly addictive. The atmosphere is calm and pleasant from the moment you walk in. Pang is a lovely woman who gives service from the heart, with a warm smile and real care. A perfect place to start your day. Highly recommended.

name: Phin & Feta - Coffee & Sourdough
review_1_text:
We had a great experience at Phin & Feta. The Sourdough Donuts were light, a little chewy, and just the right amount of sweet. They were something we kept talking about even after we left.

The Salmon Smash was another standout. It was fresh, full of flavor, and put together really well. The portion was generous and the mix of textures made it easy to enjoy.

The Coconut Blended Coffee was the perfect finish. It was creamy, refreshing, and had a nice coconut flavor without being too sweet.

Overall, everything tasted great and the whole place had a relaxed, welcoming vibe. We’ll definitely be back :)
review_2_text: One of the most unique donut I ever had in my life!  This coffee shop is run by a friendly couple. The sourdough donut was soft & chewy like the artisan times. The feta cream on top of the donut was to die for (I fought with my wife for the last bite!)  The feta salt coffee (hand pressed) was very smooth and incredibly flavorful.  What a hidden gem.  We love it!   너무나 맛있어요. 아직 이런 커피를 처음으로 마셨습니다.
review_3_text:
An absolute gem in Chiang Mai!
Phin and Feta is, without a doubt, one of the best cafés in Chiang Mai. Everything here is made with such care and passion — you can truly taste it in every bite.

We tried their sourdough bread with real butter, and it was divine. The aroma of the butter alone was irresistible, and the bread itself was perfectly crisp on the outside and soft inside. The sourdough with avocado and salmon was an explosion of flavours — fresh, balanced, and beautifully presented.

And then there is the famous sourdough donut with cream and feta — an unforgettable experience! Light and airy dough, silky velvet cream, and the subtle touch of feta that makes it truly unique.

The owners are incredibly kind and dedicated, and their love for what they do shines through. A warm, welcoming atmosphere, excellent coffee, and food that delights all the senses — Phin and Feta is simply unmissable.

If you love good coffee and sourdough bread, this is the place in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: This small coffee shop was a delightful find for breakfast. A short walk from our hotel their selection of sweet treats and avocado smash is quite nice. Their is limited seating inside and outside, but it was workable for the time we were there. I highly recommend stopping in and sampling some tasty sourdough.
review_5_text: The BEST chocolate chip cookies we’ve had in Asia. And we’re pretty snobby Americans when it comes to what makes a good cookie. And their raspberry donut oh my goodness, absolutely delicious! Right up there with Voodoo Donuts Homer donut in America. The sourdough bread was delicious as well (salmon lox could been better but not bad). The sourdough focaccia didn’t have the same fluffiness as regular focaccia but the sourness gave it interesting flavor. Can’t wait to go back!

name: I Coffee
review_1_text:
Top quality coffee for a super cheap price. They've got all the equipment like a barista does.

I was pleasantly surprised to see how well they prepared my iced cappuccino. Great espresso shot topped with milk & milk foam. They even added a pinch of coffee grind on top for decoration.

It's an ideal place for takeaway coffee. Loved this place.
review_2_text: Amazing coffee in Chiang Mai for a fair price. The barista here knows exactly what she's doing, and besides she's super nice and friendly. If you like and appreciate good quality coffee, you should come here!
review_3_text:
One of the best Thai Teas I've ever had in Thailand, and for 30 THB like it should actually cost... fantastic, rich flavor, and very large size.
Lovely costumer service too
review_4_text:
There are 3 super cheap (below 40 baht) coffee stall nearby: Hom coffee, Prem coffee and I coffee.

Tried all of them and I would say I coffee is the best and smoothest coffee I ever had in cnx.

Supported them alot of time and never get disappointed, I recommended you to do the 'iced green tea with milk', that's a hidden gemin the shop!

The guy owner can speak English and very polite and friendly to talk with.

You may visit or take a lunch in the market opposite then stop for their perfect drinks 💯
review_5_text: Well priced and best coffee we’ve had around here. Owners are super friendly and welcoming, even remembering our order everytime we came. Highly recommend :)

name: Good Shot coffee bar
review_1_text:
An unassuming place.
This was our best coffee in town CNX 2026! Amazing local coffee!
They have a pin board on the patio, one of the post-its summerizes it well, and this place embodies it.
We love this place! The seats on the patio are gold.
Best barista, her coffee makes everything right as rain!!
Thank You
🙏🫰
review_2_text: Super chill place. Small but have indoor and outdoor seating. Only one server/ shop owner but she manages the drink order very quickly. A good stop for an early refreshment
review_3_text: Nice place to chill with a great medium roast latte anytime of the day. Soft jazzy music playing with patio seats available and watch peoples and car, scooter, tuk tuk passes by. Such a relaxing vibe. Simple snacks and great espresso is the option here.
review_4_text: Cutest, cosy coffee bar - although I only had a Thai coffee, the cake options looked lovely. Beautiful viewing bar outside. Service was fab and drink tasted amazing. Would definitely recommend!
review_5_text:
My favourite every day morning stop! Best cortado ever! And sucha nice ambient with a lovely girl working there!
Happy I was a part of her big moment, the first successful decoration ❤️

name: Valentier Cafe and Hotel
review_1_text:
I made a mistake with the booking dates and contacted them immediately to fix it. Despite having availability, they refused any change, marked me as a no-show and charged me the full amount for a long stay.
Then they stopped replying to both me and Booking.com.
This is not hospitality, it’s pure greed.
Stay far from there, they are just hungry for money
review_2_text: Very pleasant basic hotel with everything you need and no surprises. Located in a busy area, but in a quiet, peaceful lane. Very kind, helpful owners. Excellent value.
review_3_text:
Perfect location
The staff is very king
Amazing value for money in total
The room are clean
We were at five different hotels in Thailand and this hotel’s shower is the best we had here
We will definitely come again
review_4_text:
I had the best time in this hotel.
The hotel owner was really nice.
It was quiet and clean, and everyone on staff was friendly and quiet.
The bathroom was clean.
And it has a reasonably sized swimming pool.
It is also close to the Tha phae Gate.
If I come back to Chiang Mai, I will book this hotel.

One thing to note is, there is something like a mechanical sound in the room.
If you are sensitive to noise, you should be careful.
review_5_text:
This is my first time staying in Chiang Mai, and it was the perfect place to do so. It was so good that I stayed there for over two months.
The location is perfect, in a relatively quiet neighborhood within the old city. The place is close to everything I needed. The design of the hotel is clean, pleasant and calm, including a pool for those interested.
The room suited all needs, including a table and a comfortable chair when I needed to work.
But the most important thing is the people who run the place. Lovely people who helped with everything I needed, gave me a feeling of home.
A place I would like to return to

name: Nes Cafe
review_1_text:
This coffee shop is right near my hotel, it is often very busy when I'm walking past, so I wanted to go in and try it. I ordered an oat milk iced coffee and it was excellent. My only suggestion is less ice, please, as I would have rather more liquid and less ice (10% ice would've been sufficient). Excellent customer service, and nice venue. Would definitely go back but would request less ice next time.

🌟🙏🏼🌟
review_2_text: Good customer service. In a nice artsy neighborhood. The cafe scene is nice but cappuccino had too much milk and not enough taste of the coffee beans.
review_3_text: This spot is convenient with great wifi, service, and prices. It’s nice that they have a variety of coffee, tea, sodas, and beer. The owners were very kind, too! I definitely recommend.
review_4_text:
I ordered an iced espresso with coconut milk, but overall it just tasted like coconut milk. I could barely taste the espresso, which was very disappointing.
The price is quite high for the quality offered.
review_5_text:
Nice coffee in a relaxing space facing the moat.
Cool breezes in northern Winter months make for an idyllic time.
Coffees were good aromatic brews, and service was friendly enough.
Wouldn't mind coming back.

name: IN TOWN Cafe 2 - อินทาวน์คาเฟ่ สาขาท่าแพ
review_1_text:
We happened to stumble upon this cafe while killing time before our Airbnb check-in, and it turned out to be a highlight of our trip.
The space is small and charming, with a cozy atmosphere that instantly made us feel at home. The staff were incredibly polite and welcoming—their genuine kindness was exactly what we needed while waiting with our luggage. It’s a peaceful little sanctuary, and I’m so glad we found it. A perfect spot to slow down and enjoy the moment
review_2_text: Wow wow!!!! Amazing dark roast coffee. Food was a pleasant surprise. Amazing value. The staff was so amazing. Hom provided great service. My new regular coffee shop in the old city.
review_3_text: This café is an absolute gem! The atmosphere is so cozy and inviting—perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. The food is not only delicious but also beautifully presented, with every dish looking like a work of art. The attention to detail in the plating is impressive! On top of that, the service is exceptional: the staff are attentive, friendly, and make you feel truly welcomed. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a delightful dining experience!
review_4_text: I absolutely loved this place. The coffee is super delicious ☕️, and the breakfast sets are great — everything is prepared quickly and tastes amazing. The music is nice, and I loved the lively street atmosphere in the background. It was a perfect spot to enjoy breakfast with my family.
review_5_text: Great spot for breakfast - they do oat milk with all their drinks. We had the egg sandwich and coconut toast with mango and both were great. Definitely recommend.

name: Cofe Stand
review_1_text: There, the Thai tea is still brewed properly (not powdered tea). Great, absolutely delicious :-)
review_2_text: I come here every day, the girl is very nice and the food is always delicious.

name: Lady Bake
review_1_text: Cute, quiet cafe with quick service. I tried the orangano, the orange juice was super fresh and delicious. Nice tasting espresso as well. For food I tried the just breakfast platter, simple but delicious and has everything you need.
review_2_text: Open and sunny cafe near the Old City with a calm setting and a small mascot dachshund that keeps the place welcoming. The western breakfast was prepared well, and the vanilla latte balanced and smooth. Reliable morning option I’d come back to
review_3_text: Super fresh and tasty lovely eggs and coffee and the cake here is great! Great WiFi and cute staff the mushrooms on toast was lovely
review_4_text:
I ordered mushroom bread with cream cheese and a lemonade.

The bread came with almost no cream cheese, nothing like in the picture. I suggest that if they don’t have enough cream cheese, they should offer customers the option to order something else.

The lemonade, which cost 70 baht, came in a small cup and wasn’t even filled to the top.

The food tastes good, though.
review_5_text: Delicious tuna melts! Came here many times for all their sandwiches. The salmon egg one is also very good. Coffees and juices are nice too! Nice sitting area and self service/order and pay at the bar.

name: Lamchang Coffee
review_1_text: A local coffee shop,the Thai milk tea is perfect and the cookies are excellent. The shop owner are really warm and friendly. The price is cheaper than expected. And you can use Alipay. It is very convenient.
review_2_text: The best coffee in town.. and the cake freshly made.. our favourite place.. ☕️ 🍰
review_3_text: The best coffee in the Old-city 👍✨ The owner is super friendly and the taste of coffee better than Starbuck! Would really recommend to stopping by. Definitely back again every morning🙏🤩
review_4_text: Simple and just perfect kind of breakfast.  The lady boss is so sweet and friendly 💕 I stay just around the corner, I'll come again before I leave this area.
review_5_text: good quality with cheap price coffee. light Roast recommended and they also have waffle with coconut and mini donut for 10 baht 👍

name: SLOW 3 Cafe
review_1_text: Very beautiful and lovely cafe. There are quiet corners to sit and work, and the drinks are delicious.
review_2_text: Lovely place, beautifull, new, calm, nice outside area aswell. Verry good coffee, lovely staff. Highly recommend
review_3_text: Cute little cafe. Coffee tasted delicious, as did the chocolate chip cookies. The interior is very updated and new, as well as quite lush and green. Inside area was air conditioned, and the shop looked to have an outdoor area as well that was quite beautiful as well. It seems they are relatively new, but I’m certain they will continue to do well!
review_4_text: A cozy cafe with a beautiful garden view bright, peaceful, and perfect for working or relaxing with a coffee.☕️🍃✨
review_5_text: Good cozy cafe just open recently. They have lots of greenery inside and outside. Comfortable for work or just relax and chat with friends.

name: ก๊วยฮงฮวด 郭豐發
TARN coffee bar
review_1_text:
Prices are ok and plenty of space to sit inside the market.
Mango smoothie was great, but a bit more expensive than elsewhere.
QR code payments (via Moreta, for example) are accepted, which is very convenient.
review_2_text:
A hidden gem in the market, you get a fresh mango smoothie or an espresso. It was delicious!
And the girl on that prepared our drinks was super nice to us and explained some thai specialities to us.
Also, this café seems to be popular around locals, there were many people.
review_3_text: A stand inside the market, worth the detour, very warm welcome, a large choice for a very good price and above all fresh fruit, thank you to the owner
review_4_text: Jackfruit + Passion is good!
review_5_text: We ordered Americano Lychee and American Coconut. Both are good! 😀highly recommended! The owner is also friendly.❤️

name: ChokeDee Cafe family
review_1_text: ChokeDee Cafe Family is a hidden gem in Soi 7 with a laid-back vibe and a cool owner who speaks English fluently, making it easy for travellers and locals alike to feel welcome. The atmosphere is always relaxed, with groovy music setting the perfect mood and a distinct, sweet smokey aroma wafting from the front. Whether you're here to enjoy a perfectly brewed slow drip coffee, chill with good tunes, or just soak in the unique ambience, this spot never disappoints. Highly recommended for anyone looking to unwind in style!
review_2_text: Best coffee in old city Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Absolutely lovely and rich taste of coffee. So good
review_4_text: I was looking for a cafe that opened early in the morning. The owner, seeing me loitering around, must have taken pity on me and offered me a coffee. It was my first time trying a latte in a mocha pot, and it was delicious. I passed by last year and wanted to visit again, so I finally got around to it. Thank you for your kindness ❤️❤️❤️

name: Baan Borijinda (บ้านบริจินดา)
review_1_text: One of the best cups of coffee I've had in Chiang Mai. This city has so many great coffee shops, but Baan Borijinda stands out for quality and flavor. Really nice Americano here, definitely worth the visit if you love coffee. Good prices too and the shop itself is very cozy. Will definitely return!
review_2_text: Cosiest little coffee spot. The ice came as a large spherical ice ball which was a first for me. Delicious iced americano. Highly recommend. Cheers
review_3_text:
We walked passed to head for breakfast and loved the wood house so we made our way back here after our meal to grab an organic coffee.

Ice cappuccino was good.

They have 3 villas here too which you can see via QR from pics below or via Airbnb.
review_4_text:
We came here for coffee.

The shop has a relaxing atmosphere with no air conditioning areas. Best to visit when the weather is nice and cool. There are limited seating though, just 4 coffee tables and around ten seats. The shop is located in a quiet alley so you can enjoy the calming ambience.

Coffee was very good at a reasonable price. They also sell their roasted beans. I had a good time in the shop.

Free wifi available and also the power outlets near some tables.
review_5_text:
I tried the Iced Thai Tea and it was incredible — super refreshing and full of flavor. I’ll definitely come back for more!
By the way, I run a travel agency in Cusco, Peru: @dopkertravel ✈️🇵🇪

name: Prem COFFEE
review_1_text:
Simply unbeatable prices and yummy drinks! 35 baht for iced, 25 baht for hot drinks. The barista who was working today was going nonstop, it was impressive!

I got a yummy iced vanilla latte, half sweet. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Absolutely incredible and with great prices. I get my coffee and milk tea from here every day. Obsessed with butterfly pea milk tea
review_3_text: My favorite coffee place. Ppl are nice and cheap. They open at 7am. Hot americano 25baht. Ice americano 35baht
review_4_text: super nice, kind and tasty! cafe highly recommend on the ice Brazil, for a strong fully aromatic cafe.
review_5_text:
Always a good iced Thai tea and iced coffee. Perfect sweetness.
The person making coffees/drinks is also very nice!

name: Khun Jack Fashion
review_1_text:
Very high quality, organic items.
The owner and store cat (fufu) are very kind
review_2_text:
It's a beautiful shop with a beautiful concept.
Everything is handcrafted and the owner is really passionate about it. She helped give lots of information about the products and is just loving what she does
Highly recommend.
review_3_text: Beautiful handmade clothes. Check it out and see if you find something that fits you.
review_4_text: Beautiful hand dyed clothing
review_5_text:
這家店的服裝設計真的很有品味，風格獨特，在別的地方很難找到類似的款式。每一件衣服的布料都選得非常講究，染色與質地都是使用天然素材，手感非常舒服，穿上身也非常透氣自然。老闆娘是一位非常有熱情的人，不但親切地接待我們，還主動介紹了許多服裝製作的細節與背後的設計理念。她也很用心地教我們如何保養這些衣服，讓它們可以長久使用，不只是穿著，更像是收藏一件藝術品。雖然價格相較一般市集商品來說不算便宜，但我認為非常值得，是來清邁旅遊時最讓我驚喜與喜歡的店家之一。推薦大家如果來「藤編一條街」逛街，千萬不要錯過這家店，一定會有收穫！

⸻

This boutique offers truly tasteful clothing designs that are hard to find elsewhere. Each piece is crafted with great care, using natural fabrics with beautiful textures and dyeing techniques. The materials feel soft and comfortable against the skin, and the clothes are breathable and naturally elegant. The owner is incredibly passionate and welcoming. She not only greeted us warmly but also shared many insights into the craftsmanship and philosophy behind each garment. She took the time to explain how to properly care for these clothes, so they can last a long time and retain their beauty. Wearing them feels more like appreciating a piece of art than just putting on clothes. While the prices are not cheap compared to regular market items, I think they are very fair considering the quality and uniqueness. This is definitely one of my favorite shops in Chiang Mai. If you happen to walk through the nearby streets, be sure to drop by—you won’t regret it!

⸻

このお店の服のデザインはとてもセンスがよく、他ではなかなか手に入らないユニークなスタイルです。生地の染色や質感はすべて天然素材を使用していて、手触りが非常に良く、着心地も抜群です。オーナーの女性はとても情熱的で親切な方で、服作りの技術や精神を詳しく説明してくれました。さらに、服のケア方法も丁寧に教えてくださり、大切に着続けられるように配慮されています。価格は決して安くはありませんが、それだけの価値があります。チェンマイで訪れた中で最も印象に残ったお店のひとつです。近くの通りを散歩するときは、ぜひこのお店にも立ち寄ってみてください！

⸻

이 가게의 옷 디자인은 정말 세련되고 감각적이며, 다른 곳에서는 쉽게 볼 수 없는 독특한 스타일입니다. 원단은 천연 소재로 염색과 질감이 자연스럽고, 손으로 만졌을 때 부드럽고 착용감도 매우 좋습니다. 사장님은 굉장히 열정적이고 따뜻한 분으로, 옷을 만드는 과정과 철학을 자세히 설명해 주셨습니다. 또한 이 옷들을 오래 입을 수 있도록 세심하게 관리 방법도 알려주셔서 감동받았습니다. 가격은 일반 시장 상품보다는 비싸지만, 그만한 가치가 충분히 있습니다. 치앙마이에서 가장 인상 깊었던 가게 중 하나로, 근처 거리를 산책하다 보면 꼭 들러볼 만한 곳입니다. 강력히 추천드립니다!

name: ร้านกาแฟสด
Dawwin Hometel & Cafe
review_1_text: Wonderful new place! Super friendly owners and staff plus amazing iced coffee❤️. Try their signature Iced Espresso Romano. It's coffee with lime, who knew this would be so tasty!? Bring a book too and chill on their comfy couches.
review_2_text: When everything else was closed because of a holiday, the owner opened the place exclusively for us, offering an exceptional selection of good whiskey, and off-the-menu salads and snacks just because we said we are hungry. What a kind and hospitable people! Also, the owner speaks decent English, so we talked, laughed, and hug at the end that came way too soon. 5/5
review_3_text: I use this place for working. The enviroment is so chill and very creativity for me to work as a writer. The price is not expensive and they have a plug for you as a nomad.
review_4_text: Perfectly placed if your attending a massage course next door, good rates, good organic tea and coffee  selection. Freindly helpful staff
review_5_text: Had been visiting this cafe for the ice latte. Such a relaxing place to chill in.

name: Tropical Chang Moi
review_1_text: My girlfriend and I stopped here for breakfast. The owner/chef and her son were very friendly both speaking great English. We had a passion fruit and mango smoothie which were the best we have had in SE Asia so far. The pad Thai was also amazing. Would highly recommend stopping here!
review_2_text:
A cute little coffee shop away from the hustle and bustle of the city
Warm and cozy, a cute coffee shop in an alley in the old city of Chiang Mai. The atmosphere is unbeatable.
review_3_text: Delicious restaurant, good atmosphere, peaceful I recommend this place 🤟🏼
review_4_text: Nice restaurant. Good smoothies and dumplings.
review_5_text: If you're looking for the slow life of Chiang Mai in a peaceful setting with a perfect welcome, smoothies and delicious food, this is the place!

name: Baan Klang Vieng Coffee & Juice Design
review_1_text: Baan Klang Vieng Coffee offers a cozy atmosphere with rich, flavorful coffee. Friendly staff and a relaxing vibe make it a great spot to unwind in Chiang Mai. A perfect place for coffee lovers!
review_2_text: Nice laidback place in the middle of the center. Good atmosphere , good food, good music and good service
review_3_text: good

name: MITTE MITTE Chiangmai - Cafe & Brunch
review_1_text:
A really nice café with a warm, welcoming vibe and super friendly staff. The coffee was good, and while the food was decent, it wasn’t particularly memorable.

There were five of us, so we ordered a variety of dishes to share—overall solid but nothing that really stood out. The smoothies were quite good though and worth ordering.

A pleasant spot for a relaxed coffee or casual brunch, especially if you’re in the area.
review_2_text: Super kind welcoming staff and great service! The food was so yummy and beautifully presented and decently priced and the drinks were great too! Really lovely space and decor, outside seating and tons of indoor seating with fun upstairs area. Nice bathrooms! They take card with a minimum I think over $500 baht so we combined our orders. Overall wonderful experience and would definitely recommend! Also my friend is celiac and they were very accommodating and helped show their product ingredients.
review_3_text:
I decided to visit Mitte Mitte cause it was right next to my accommodation and I'm glad I did! I had a Chang Moi Katsu Bagel and it was really tasty. The waitress kindly informed me that the sausage in it is a bit spicy and - as a person who avoids spicy stuff - it was indeed :D but definitely bearable, especially with a glass of cold drink.
The waitresses were all really lovely and I have to appreciate the music there too - when I was there they played covers of popular songs, but in really pleasant, soft acoustic versions. Overall a great experience  🤍
review_4_text: Great place for brunch! Not a lot of people but food is superb. What we ordered: wonton nachos, lemony angel hair with crab meat (pasta), avocado smoothie, big brekkie, spring salad. These all are great and all are recommended.
review_5_text: Almost everything here is exquisite, but my true favorites are the pavlova, the bagel Chang Moi katsu, and the smoked salmon sourdough. Every time I return to Chiang Mai, these are the flavors I crave. It’s more than just good food, it’s the familiarity and quiet comfort of coming back to something you love. Each visit feels a little like coming home.

name: The Goodcery
review_1_text:
A shockingly impressive discovery!   The menu is Burmese known for dishes with salty, sour, bitter, and spicy.  The watermelon w/ the Burmese sauce was spicy bitter salty and sweet a unique and powerful combination making it a must try.   The others we tried was the smoked eggplant dip w/ cucumber again a powerful tasting dish absolutely loved it.  Their meat is meticulously picked out from only one approved vendor to ensure quality and value.  The item is their flank steak and again w/ an exceptional Burmese flavorful sauce.  We ordered another one being it was so amazingly tender and good.
They also try to specialize in offering only organic wines that use very low sulphites sparingly. A+.  We questioned why Michelin hasn’t uncovered this place yet, but being their fairly new it would probably likely explain it.  The sauces make it a gem of a find, really incredible highly recommend!
review_2_text:
Had low expectations for the food but we were genuinely surprised how good it was. Think they're going for traditional Thai dishes, beautifully presented and served in a slight upscale way.

Portions are decent, and the flavour is amazing. The pork jowl was well cooked, nice and soft with a torched exterior. The underlying sticky rice was quite spicy and flavourful. The fried chicken was salty and crispy but a small portion.

The place also serves as a shop for local products from Whisky, Rum and Thai Spirits to honey, spices and rice flour.
review_3_text: Nice modern space that looks newly built. The sailing is high and the vibe is great. There is also a large terrace area inside. They bake their bread here and their food also looks great. It is a very nice cafe, but it would be also nice to have a brunch. The bathroom is super clean as well. There are many workable tables, but the power outlet is very limited.
review_4_text:
The food was delish!🔥They have variety of menu and they use local ingredients for the food! The restaurant is nice and clean and very spacious. The Thai food can be too spicy for non-Thai (cause even us Thai it was spicy😂) make sure to tell them less less to no spicy at all. The price tho was higher than average but due the quality of the food it’s somehow reasonable.

They could improve the lighting at night to be more light+ more life. It was a bit too quiet and a bit dark that it seemed like it’s closed. I feel like this place has so much potential but just need a little bit of improvement here and there.

I also wish this place has a live workshop - a sense of community. It would be so much fun
review_5_text:
This cafe and restaurant is a charming, cozy spot offering a delightful selection of food and high-quality grocery products from various regions in Thailand.

The coffee is exceptional, and the food is truly outstanding with good portion. It's not easy to find a restaurant that excels at preparing dishes from different regions, making this place a rare gem. The staff are not only friendly but also attentive and well-informed.

Additionally, the restaurant boasts an extensive array of exceptional products sourced from many provinces. I was particularly impressed with the quality of the honey lip balm and sea salt I purchased.

To top it off, in the evenings, they host enchanting live music performances featuring instruments such as the violin and guitar. It adds a wonderful touch to the overall experience.

name: Once in a Blue Moon Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text:
Very clean and calm.

Stood one night - very affordable prices for the small room with air con but no window. It's absolutely okay for a night.

Modern bathroom (super clean)

Negative:
You will get a disposable Towel for the shower/bath (?why?) - please use normal towels - less plastic and less waste

I totally recommend this place.
review_2_text:
Nice place, perfect location in the old city, staff nice. But I wish they would have explain more the door opening after 21:00. The button are all erased. But after 3-4 minutes i figured it out hahaha! I love the light and the outlet in my bed. Comfy pillow and bed cover. No toilet paper in the toilet 😕

I would stay here again.
review_3_text:
This cafe is really great, it’s giving the cozy vibes, the staff is so nice tho! What i can’t even forget to talk about is coffee. what a coffee!! the taste is sooooooo good. I didn’t know much what the coffee beans are. Didn’t have the knowledge in this fields tho, but you should try it. If you are a coffee lover, don‘t miss it!!!

Also I had the opportunity to stay at the hostel above. I can tell you that it is very minimalist. There is good management. The cleanliness is ten out of ten! Very quiet. And the location is in the heart of the city. You can walk around at night. There is a market not far away. and there are many restaurants around. Easy to go and easy to come.
review_4_text: The coffee here is sooo good ☕️ They roast their own beans and the aroma is amazing! There are different roast levels to choose from, and the place itself is small and cozy — quiet, not crowded at all. Perfect spot to sit back, relax, and enjoy a cup of coffee. Love it! ❤️
review_5_text: Did not stay at the hostel just went for a coffee, which is amazing! The cafe itself is not too big but has lovely decor. Definitely recommend trying one of their signature coffees, especially the “dirty”. Not to miss

name: Good Monday - Homemade donut and coffee
review_1_text: A quaint little place in CNX area where you can get your caffeine fix, cool down and enjoy your cup of java either on your own or woth a friend or two.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee (strong!) and delicious homemade donuts. The lady is a whirlwind of positive bubbling energy, super polite and attentive with a big smile. I always feel seen and welcome here. The coffee and the bagels are a must when in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: Came here for the first time today.  Great place.  Good atmosphere and the toffee coffee donut was the best.  Even though this place is in a touristy area, it didn’t feel like it sitting in here with a cappuccino.  Good Monday is a hidden gem…enjoying a cappuccino and donut as the tourists walk by outside.
review_4_text:
Really nice coffee
No big space, but the atmosphere is welcoming in general.
Thank you for the good service
review_5_text:
Beautiful shop with a great atmosphere.
The donuts are top notch. Made fresh daily.
The staff are lovely and kind.
Coffees are also delicious.
Seating inside and out. Cool air con is great on a hot day!
The glazed donut is heavenly!
Try their double chocolate donut if you love chocolate!

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text:
We had to check out an Amazon cafe during our stay in Chiang Mai after seeing them all around. Very comfortable indoor seating area. The matcha lattes are delicious. We almost did not go since there are so many other non-chain cafes around but glad we tried it out.

Now for my standard comments. Location is very clean and well kept.
review_2_text:
Great for co-working spaces. Strong air-conditioned so long sleeves are a must.

I have been here twice.
review_3_text: Coffee ok, staff is rude. Not a nice experience for it being my first day in Chiang Mai. Will not recommend
review_4_text: Can't say I have ever had a bad experience at an amazon cafe : )
review_5_text: Great coffee shop chain throughout Thailand very much in the Starbucks vein but better value and free wi-fi. We haven't eaten there yet but sure we do will soon.

name: 選品衣服Lyke&Lia
review_1_text: One of the million ice creams I really like. The ice cream is delicious, the bread is even more delicious, you can feel it. The shop also has a delicious breakfast. But as I said, the small comment is that their desserts have a lot of variety and almost every menu is delicious. The shop has cute clothes and home decorations. The clothes sold in the shop and home decorations are from Chiang Mai, they are Chiang Mai brands. You can park at Wat Duang Dee next to the shop. It is decorated and is another shop that is recommended.
review_2_text: True authentic craft ice cream. I’m a big fan of homemade ice cream and I love trying all kind of flavors from classics to creative seasonal ones. This ice cream parlor has mastered all the flavors! I love the hockey pokey, pistachio(with homemade pistachio sauce!) and the yuzu ones. They also have really good coffee and seasonal refreshing drinks. The cafe also offers cute handmade clothing and ceramic goods. If you are walking around Chang Moi area, this place is a must. You won’t be disappointed (I went back three times in two days)
review_3_text: A charming craft ice cream shop offering refreshing drinks and unique ice cream flavors. A lovely place to sit, relax, and escape the heat for a while.
review_4_text:
Such a cool little place and even better ice cream.

They will even give you a taste test before choosing your perfect scoop. My daughter loved it.
