review_5_text: Everything made here is to a high quality. Beautiful textures and harmonious flavours. If you're looking for a high quality Thai Western dinner, come here after indulging at Paper Butter on the Roof.

name: Blue Coffee at Somphet Market
review_1_text: Very relaxed atmosphere and very friendly service. We had the croissant and the original pretzel and it was fantastic - salty and chewy with the right amount of sweet. The coffee was lovely both hot and cold and we would most certainly return
review_2_text: What a lovely, fancy little coffee shop! Great service from the staff, amazing velvety coffee and yummy sweet treats! They also offer ice cream and coffee packets to take home! Amazing.
review_3_text: A lovely café by the historic moat—bright, clean, with friendly staff. Coffee and cakes are delicious, paired with relaxing background music. Comfy chairs and tables make it perfect whether you're working or unwinding! Highly recommend!
review_4_text: The food was okay — nothing extraordinary, but perfectly fine for a quick breakfast. What really stands out are the lovely vibes and the space itself. The staff was wonderful, and the design is beautiful, minimal, and perfect for unwinding.
review_5_text: I really enjoy here. The coffee and drinks here are so good and delicious croissants. The staffs are so friendly and kind. I'll definitely come back here again. Love it!!! ❤️

name: Fruit Plus+ Cafe
review_1_text: Wawa makes all her smoothie / acai bowl fresh to order, soo healthy and taste so good. Her homemade salad dressing is amazing. Wawa is the owner and she really has put her heart and soul into trying new ways to perfect her acai bowls. She prides herself on health food for a healthy body! The best 💛😊
review_2_text: Very nice avocado and eggs on toast, for those days when you just don’t feel like Thai food. Super chill vibes, sit outside and watch the world go by.
review_3_text: Super friendly staff. Amazing options for fresh juices, smoothies, smoothie bowls, coffees. Came back daily.
review_4_text: I ordered their acai bowl and it was amazing! Needed to go back several times at our stay. I also ordered a coconut latte which was great too.
review_5_text: The best acai bowl I have ever tasted, and it will be hard to beat this one. Not just the taste, but the bowl looked insane! Will miss this place!

name: Lecker Café & Bistro
review_1_text:
Came here just to have a few beers with a friend, but I accidentally looked at the menu and was thrilled to see they offered Atlantic Cod and Chips!
​What made the visit truly excellent was the staff, who went above and beyond to cater to my dietary needs. Their attention and effort were impressive and greatly appreciated.
​Bonus Tip: Even though I didn't use it, they have a nice pool table area on the second floor, making this a great spot for hanging out. Highly recommend this place for drinks, food, and great service!
review_2_text: While taking a walk, I happened to pass by this shop and decided to go in. I ordered a drink but wasn’t satisfied with it, so I explained the situation to the staff. They were very polite and replaced it with another drink for me. The owner was sitting at the entrance and talked with me for a while. Due to the street noise, I couldn’t hear clearly what he was saying and even thought he might be upset. Later, when settling the bill, the owner kindly offered us complimentary fries. I then realized I might have misunderstood him earlier—this is truly a wonderful shop with a very kind owner. I felt quite guilty for misjudging the situation. All in all, it turned into a lovely evening. Thank you so much, and I wish your business continued success! More importantly, I wish peace and love could always surround everyone.
review_3_text: Really good place to start for Chiang mai night life. Food is delicious 😋 Better prices if compared with others. Strongly recommended 👍🏽🫶🏼
review_4_text: Great local bar with a second floor pool table room and view of the river. Co working space. Easy atmosphere. Varied menu. Visited a few times and different events different days from live music to a small and fun karaoke night. Recommend 👍
review_5_text: We came in the night to chiang mai. And were so hungry and they made us food in the middle of the night. So welcoming and friendly. Much nice traveling ppl and ppl who stay in thailand. Owners are so nice. They have breakfast. Coffee. Lunch and dinner . Very thai style. But also European food. Karaoke also . Love to come and spend time here

name: Yaya Coffee
review_1_text:
This lovely little open-air café is truly a hidden gem. Located just outside a guest house, it offers the perfect relaxed setting to enjoy a wide variety of coffees and refreshing drinks.

What makes this place really special is Yaya, the owner. She is incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely caring with every guest. Her warm hospitality makes you feel welcome from the very first moment.

The products are artisanal and absolutely delicious — you can really taste the quality and passion behind everything that’s served. Whether you’re in the mood for a strong, well-prepared coffee or a refreshing beverage, you won’t be disappointed.

The atmosphere is positive, peaceful, and inviting. It’s the kind of place where interesting conversations naturally happen, and where you can meet inspiring people while slowly sipping an excellent cup of coffee.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a cozy, authentic experience. ☕
review_2_text:
Yaya coffee is the best coffee in Chiang Mai.
Not only does it have a great smooth taste but it comes with a warm heart of the owner Yaya.
She is so kind and so welcoming of foreign tourists and takes the time to tell you the story about her family’s coffee farms.
You go to her coffee shop as a customer and you leave as a friend.
review_3_text: Yaya has the best coffee in Chiang Mai hands down. I highly recommend her coffee shop to anyone travelling in Chiang Mai. Lots of selection and the most kind person you will ever meet.
review_4_text: Great local family grown coffee from Thailand. Best prices in chiang Mai. Lovely owner lady. Very friendly. It's nice to support her. Closed Sunday. Outside seating. Come and try.
review_5_text: Orange juice coffee was freshly squeezed, and on par with some of the famous coffee places in town!

name: Hom Coffee
review_1_text: Sweet spot but small in size. Great coffee offered. Sitting here and grabbing a cup of coffee is always a great experience due to the atmosphere and surroundings. The prices are decent. I would go and sit there daily if I were staying near there. Their location is also very accessible. Highly recommended.
review_2_text:
Tucked away on the roadside, this little coffee shop isn’t about trends—it’s about familiarity. Regulars walk up and barely need to speak before their usual order is ready.
The coffee is strong and no-nonsense. Their Thai-style brew is like a punchy latte with a more bitter flavor profile. Add a simple sandwich, and you’ve got a humble but satisfying breakfast that won’t break the bank.
review_3_text: Hands down the best spot to get coffee in Chiang Mai. I will come here every day from now on. Amazing service, staff, and of course the coffee is great.
review_4_text:
Wonderful coffee at reasonable prices served by friendly people.
The rich coffee flavours are always evident. We enjoy the iced latte, especially on Chiang Mai's hot afternoons. Sit and relax while watching the world pass by.
Will come back.
Highly recommended.
Still around after the Covid pandemic, business seems to be good.
review_5_text:
This is a small cafe with limited seating. Most people get their coffee to-go anyway. We decided to sit in one of the small tables outside facing the busy street to people watch.

They have good coffee. The freshly ground bean smell of good quality. Their iced latte and iced americano were both good.

name: TIW
review_1_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

TIW is an absolute gem of a coffee and smoothie shop! The smoothies here are not just refreshing, but downright addictive. Made with real fruit and priced at only 50 baht, they're a steal! Pro tip: ask for no extra sugar water for the purest, most delicious experience. Their coffee is equally impressive, hitting the spot just right. The cozy ambiance of this cute cafe nestled on the side of the street adds to the charm. What makes TIW truly special, though, is the lovely couple who run it with passion and care. A definite must-visit for anyone craving a flavorful pick-me-up in town!
review_2_text: The smoothies and ice cream are very delicious. I recommend it.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is great, and every dish is delicious. I will definitely come back again and again.

name: ShaPel Hostel x Cafés
review_1_text: First time staying in a hostel! I booked this one as it appeared to be fresh, modern and clean. It was a really good experience and the hostess was amazing. I will 100% stay at the same place when I travel to Chiang mai in the future.
review_2_text: Had a great time at ShaPel Hostel. It's clean and quiet and well-located. A cute café is located downstairs. Recommend if you're looking for a friendly, safe environment. Definitely not a party hostel.
review_3_text: It’s clean, aircon is great and comfortable, beds are great and private with under bed drawers that lock. Bathroom facilities are nice and perfect location for a backpacker in Chiang Mai. Will note that it isn’t a very social hostel so if you’re looking for that wouldn’t recommend this place, but besides that I had an amazing time and experience here.
review_4_text: The room is clean and reasonably priced. There’s a nice café downstairs, and their Thai tea is really delicious! I highly recommend this place — it’s also close to Tha Phae Gate. 😍
review_5_text: Fantstic little gem of a hostel..near Thae Pai gate but quiet zone. Lovely host..very immaculate spaces.

name: Dollar Coffee
review_1_text: Fantastic coffee. Cheap and great quality. The sweet older lady who owns it is exceptionally kind and speaks great english. I started going regularly and she would bring me food for free every now and then — egg, chinese black bean moon cake. Really lovely lady and really great coffee. Great place to do work or just relax
review_2_text: A cozy, family-owned café that opens early. It’s the perfect spot to enjoy a cup of coffee and soak in the tranquil atmosphere of Old Chiang Mai before the city fully wakes up.
review_3_text: Nice lemon and passion juice and the place is very calm and clean. Nice people and atmosphere, plus they open early in the morning
review_4_text:
Right next to historical Sriphum corner of moat surrounding the walled old city of Chiang Mai, this Dollar Cafe is located on main moon Muang road. Run by two inspiring dedicated women, range of coffee and other drinks including coconut and sandwiches like tuna cheese sandwich are all amazing. Very reasonably priced (35 baht onwards sandwich for example), neat and clean cafe. It has indoor air conditioned seating as well as outdoor covered open air seating as per preference of guest.

Recommended.
review_5_text: Nice little quiet place open early staff are so nice. Nice to sit inside and watch the traffic go by on a cold Chiang Mai winter’s morning.

name: 8To18 Breakfast&Brew
review_1_text:
Ice Americano 10/10

Double shot of espresso over ice 10/10

Rosemary salt bagel with cream cheese egg and mayo 10/10

Seasonal fruit 10/10 (we have wanted just fruit, no added anything, for a while - happy this place has it!)

Mom and pop shop
Free WiFi
Clean
Cleansing wipes on table
Indoor and out door seating
Resident cat on a leash
Music is not loud, and great playlist! (I'm surprised actually how well the volume is)

Got here at 8:25am. Zero wait. Seat your self.

Everyone here is incredibly kind, portion sizes are big. Prices are more than reasonable! I'll be coming back.

------

I went back the next day to try the French toast and egg Sando. Again good stuff!
review_2_text:
I visited this place for brunch and was pleasantly surprised. The pancakes were delicious—fluffy, flavorful, and definitely the highlight of my visit. The atmosphere is simple, nothing fancy, but comfortable enough to enjoy a relaxed meal.

I also loved the small detail of having wet wipes on the tables, which is both practical and thoughtful. On top of that, the staff was very attentive and friendly, making the overall experience even better. A great spot if you’re looking for a tasty, no-frills brunch.

The only thing I’d recommend improving is the cleanliness of the restroom 🚽.
review_3_text: Amazing breakfast spot, they give you SO much food got like half of mine to go and didn’t finish some of it. I ordered the French toast with fruit and it was insanely delicious. My friends got the waffle sandwhich which they also agreed was so much food they didn’t finish as well. We all agreed we probably could have split just two of these meals amongst the three of us. We sat outfront, there’s a cute cat too! Service was good and friendly, the guy forgot to make my matcha drink order but I was thankful because I was so FULL I told him don’t worry about making it.
review_4_text: So happy to have found this cafe! They open early, serve delicious homemade dishes with quality and fresh ingredients. Great variety and huge portions. Their homemade bread is so yummy and same for their chocolate sauce and iced chocolate. Also love their pancakes. Family run, super nice and welcoming and there's acute little cat. Will definitely come back :)
review_5_text: We visited this brunch spot two days in a row and absolutely loved it. We ordered the bacon pancakes and the seasonal fruit, and everything was fresh and delicious. I can also recommend the French toast!! The interior is minimalist with a really warm and welcoming atmosphere. On top of that, the guy working there was incredibly friendly and made us feel right at home. I can highly recommend this place and would definitely come back!

name: Homie Coffee
review_1_text: Sweet little coffee place. The lady is very sweet and speaks good english as well. She made a great cappuccino with oat milk. Best price/ quality in Chiang Mai :)
review_2_text: Really affordable and delicious drinks! My iced latte was so tasty. The owner was so nice and the little sitting area in the back is very cozy.
review_3_text: Great little hidden shop next to a parking lot with a lovely owner and propper coffee machine. I’ve had a thai desert cake with thai tea filling  (25thb) and orange americano (45thb). Great way to start a day!
review_4_text:
The place is nice for a good chill and drink to recharge and refresh.
There are chairs and tables for you to sit and rest tired legs after walking around.
The host is very friendly and speak good English.
review_5_text: Very good coffee and matcha. It is possible to choose plant milk. Very welcoming owner, speaks english.

name: Nomad Coffee
review_1_text: Can't recommend this enough! Lovely locally run small business. Organic coffee from their own farm in the mountains. Owner speaks good English so have a chat, he appreciates any support. And not unimportant of course: the coffee is amazing
review_2_text: Fantastic locally grown and roasted beans. Freshly brewed in a cozy little cart by a super friendly owner. Great place to grab an espresso or iced americano. The scones are tasty as well!
review_3_text: Calling all Adventurers, Travelers, Coffee Lovers and especially Cyclists: this place is a must visit for so many reasons, starting with the delicious, locally sourced coffee. The owner, Sawang, is a world cyclist — he has ridden his bicycle all across Asia, South America, the USA and is now planning his next departure from Vancouver through Canada up to Alaska. He embodies the spirit of the traveler we all can relate to, but don’t take my word for it— go meet Sawang yourself. Also, he has 4 books out about his adventures on two wheels. Go for the coffee, stay for the owner’s stories. 🌏 ☕️ 📚 🚴‍♂️
review_4_text:
Was walking down the street to find a good coffee. I’m please that we stop on our way to the old town to nomad coffee.
The owner explained us where the coffee is from and we can see the quality of the equipment and the love he put in each brew🙏
review_5_text:
It’s part of the Michelin Street Food Tour, but I was just passing by when I saw a couple of people lining up for a cup of coffee/tea.
I tried the Iced Thai Milk tea, and I must say, it’s strong and refreshing.

name: Heartening Coffee.Bar
review_1_text: Amazing drip coffee (had the Honduras whisky) and very relaxing atmosphere and friendly service. Highly recommend.
review_2_text: The owner is very friendly, the environment is comfortable and quiet, the drinks are of good quality. Highly recommended.
review_3_text: Gorgeous, tranquil coffee shop. Has really comfortable seats and relaxing music - really enjoyed reading by book here with a pot of peppermint tea. The woman working there was kind enough to refill it so I could have another pot. Really recommend this lovely place!
review_4_text: I spent a really relaxed and chilled out evening here. The owners are lovely people and very creative mixing drinks. Loved it and as a local will be back for sure.
review_5_text:
I feel  cozy and comfy in here.
Coffee is nice and atmospere is good.

name: Anyway Cafe (Book Cafe)
review_1_text: Such as a nice cozy and homey book cafe. There’re full of great translation books and thai fictions. And also lots of rotation workshops and activities that you might enjoy💙
review_2_text:
An absolutely beautiful small cafe with a very local feel. A perfect place to come and get some work or admin done. I came here twice during my stay in Chiang Mai and both times had delicious drinks and friendly staff. Prices are quite decent as well.

They also hold workshops from time to time (they invited me to a flower arrangement workshop but I unfortunately couldn’t make it).

They have books for sale, books to swap and just books to read as well.
review_3_text: First thing I stumbled into in Chiang Mai and already the best place ever! Such a cute bookstore and café with all the right values and nice people :))
review_4_text: Cool chic atmosphere.  Friendly barista and a very nice expresso e61 faema machine.   Cool books in the front, nice pastries and cool projector video game in the back.  Love these down to earth cafes and local vibe with cool music in the back.  Enjoyable and relaxing.
review_5_text: Unique genre of book and love all the vibe service for recommending books with warm conversation.

name: Good Day Farm to Table
review_1_text: Great vibes and a cute location in a breezy alley, but the food was just average. The Eggs Benedict looked good, but the hollandaise sauce was off, and it wasn't a proper poached egg…the yolk was about 90% cooked. The side salad wasn't fresh either. Some of them were even starting to rot. On the bright side, the corn ribs were decent, and the bacons and smoked salmon were nice. The medium-roast Americano was a bit light but fine.
review_2_text:
A solid choice if you prioritize a quiet, pet-friendly vibe and a good location.

Great spot inside The Warehouse surrounded by shops. The atmosphere is cozy, peaceful, and not at all crowded. We went there around 11am on Friday a day after X’Mas.

The food is okay—standard breakfast fare that does the job for a casual morning meal.

Love the outdoor seating and the fact that it’s pet-friendly. A very relaxing environment!
review_3_text:
A beautifully designed restaurant with an elegant atmosphere and perfect natural lighting.

Chef Blue’s cuisine is exceptional — the salmon spaghetti was outstanding, and the organic salad was impressively fresh.
review_4_text:
Good food, fresh salad
Friendly staff !
Egg Benedict was done just right, hollandaise sauce was creamy with a lemony taste at the end.
Tomatoes with ricotta cheese was very refreshing
We highly recommend this place :)
review_5_text: Coffee was good but not special considering Chiang Mai coffee game. Food was below average with higher price range than most of the brunch places around it. Service was ok but more than that, as a brunch place, I would not recommend this cafe.

name: SINC Cafe’
review_1_text:
We were there for lunch and the food was delicious. We had a dey kahp soi and minced beef with rice. The price is good.
Only the man who served us seemed to be rather bothered than amused. He did not reply a lot when I asked something and just looked very bored.
review_2_text: Very interesting decor in this cafe. Lots of picture opportunities. Very English friendly with a mix of local and western foods. Their pizza was delicious and crust was crunchy, freshly made. Khao soi was flavorful and yummy as well. We enjoyed our food here very much. Nice place to chill
review_3_text: Very cool vibe, great lounge music, perfect to hangout. Good food. Coffee was average. Friendly staff.
review_4_text: A wonderful place with excellent food, great coffee, and warm, hospitable service. The decor is lovely.
review_5_text: Such a cool place!! Every single detail of their interior is so cute!! The food was tasty too 🥰 I’d totally come again

name: Kuro Kuro Boba
review_1_text: The cutest cafe in Chiang Mai, what a hidden gem this is! Lots of cute and quirky decorations, delicious coffee and a little garden area out back near the river. So peaceful, the staff are amazingly friendly and lovely. There are cats! I recommend this place to all my friends who are visiting Chiang Mai. Reasonable prices too, its really my favourite cafe in the city.
review_2_text: Very cute place, perfect coconut matcha 👌🏻
review_3_text:
Very sweet coffee store ☺️☺️ In the backyard waits tiny cats to cuddle. Also the coffee tastes wonderful ☕️

A great place to relax with a coffee in the backyard.
review_4_text: the founder is so sweet! and the latte is to die for. oh dont forget to order the banana cakes. so delightful
review_5_text:
I've been in Chiang Mai for two weeks now and every day I've been here for morning coffee. I made a mistake once and went to a different place which I regret. That says a lot. Best coffee shop in town.

Also they three(?) beutiful cats walking around! And many vegan milk options.

name: kurokuro.coffee.roaster
review_1_text: Such a lovely little coffee shop tucked away next to the temple, it’s a real hidden gem. The coffee was delicious and the Tiramisu latte was especially amazing. The cafe has such a cute, cosy, cat themed vibe that instantly makes you feel welcome. I’ll definitely be back tomorrow for another coffee and to sample one of their bakes because the tiramisu, brownies and cheesecake all looked incredible. A really sweet spot that’s well worth a visit. ☕🐾🍰
review_2_text: Today we are at Kurokuro Coffee in Chiangmai. We ordered two cappuccinos with oat milk and two cakes. The cappuccino tastes very good. Cake also tastes good, but there is nothing to come to this café for. The café itself is small, very friendly, quiet and relaxed. The two young people who work in this café are very very nice but they are pretty much all in Thailand... we can really recommend the café to everyone who visits the city. It's already something special.
review_3_text: A truly lovely little café! It’s a bit hidden, but that’s part of its charm. The coffee is absolutely delicious  and the cakes are fresh and tasty. The staff are very friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home. A real hidden gem for anyone who loves great coffee and a cozy atmosphere!
review_4_text: absolutely fantastic. lovely cats and drinks, the iced latte was perfect and i’ve never had a dirty before and that was really nice too. the people working there serve you  with a smile and they  are really kind! :)) I also found the prices affordable  ( specially for the “ special”  drinks ) compared to others
review_5_text:
Lovely little coffee shop with intimate atmosphere. The staff/owners are very kind. High quality coffee for low price. Cozy to sit and chill, read, have a relaxed conversation. Free drinking water.
Just good laidback vibes - will come again when I am in Chiang Mai.

name: STAY & STI.L
review_1_text: Must come and try
review_3_text: The coffee is excellent, and the music creates a pleasant atmosphere. The staff is exceptionally polite and welcoming. I highly recommend this establishment.

name: ร้าน เติมแฟ Slow bar
review_1_text: Delicious, affordable, and good coffee!

name: Hightown Chinatown Rooftop Cafe & Cannabis
review_1_text: Very nice shop with great selection and the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable.
review_2_text: Great music, weed and vibes! Can't wait to visit again.
review_3_text: Well to start with this place has a very chilled smoke room and the rooftop is incredible views especially at sunset id definitely advise to do it and check it out for yourself but a j and this sunset is amazing. The quality of the weed is definitely top shelf and the prices are good for this quality of weed. I visit very often, cool place to chill and study
review_4_text: Nice place, good music and great service of Shaun! I will definitely come back
review_5_text: Fantastic shop!!!!! Great staff great quality :)

name: CUBE MOKA cafe
review_1_text: Good and cheap coffee place in wararot market
review_2_text: Great coffee ❤️
review_3_text:
A cozy cafe. I loved it. There were so many delicious-looking dishes, but I couldn't finish them all because I didn't have time. ㅠㅠ
The iced Americano was delicious.
It's a great place to take a break after wandering around the market.

name: sripingbar coffee
review_1_text: Stopped by on January 20, 2026 while walking around the neighborhood. A cute, local outdoor coffee bar with a relaxed atmosphere. They sell locally grown and produced coffee beans from Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai—great to support regional producers.
review_2_text: Found this quiet coffee bar that’s definitely a hidden gem near the local market. I ordered double brown macchiato and my partner tried the tamarind bomb and they went beyond our expectations! Price is also super amazing. Will definitely return to this place!
review_3_text: Wonderful place for a quick coffee if you are around the market . Taste well and hot the way I like it. Barista is nice and easy to talk with.
review_4_text:
Very good place to have a hot or cold drink.  I strongly recommend it!
Original drinks too.
The owner is very nice!
review_5_text:
Tucked away in a quiet corner of Chiang Mai's bustling Chinatown, Sriping Bar is a hidden gem. This cozy spot serves excellent coffee, a perfect refuge from the vibrant streets.

The owner's warm hospitality made us feel right at home. He kindly allowed us to enjoy our outside food on the premises.

Although the space is compact, the owner's background as an architect shines through in the thoughtful design and unique touches throughout.

A must-visit for coffee lovers seeking a tranquil oasis in the heart of Chinatown!

name: Makad Rooftop
review_1_text:
We visited Makad Rooftop to watch the sunset 🌅
There are a few flights of stairs to reach the top, but my mum—who has mobility issues—was able to take them slowly.

We ordered our food and drinks downstairs before heading up.
The outdoor area was lovely, with plenty of space and a mix of tables, chairs, and comfy sofas to relax on.

The food was fine—just what you’d expect for some light, picky bits—and the atmosphere was great. We really enjoyed watching the sunset, even if a big block of flats was right in the way 😂
review_2_text: This cafe offers a truly magical atmosphere. The beautiful rooftop provides an exceptional view, and the weather here is just perfectly cool and breezy. It’s the ideal escape for a relaxed, intimate conversation with your significant other. The soulful background music makes everything feel fresh and utterly delightful. A breath of fresh air!
review_3_text: Very good value for money. The owner is super nice and helpful. He really cares about your well-being. The rooftop bar is also nice, meet some nice people there. Rooms are very reasonable for the price!
review_4_text: This hostel is so amazing I really love the rooftop area the best. The vibes are so comfy and at night you can see the starts for perfectly. And then if you go out on a night out coming back to watch the sunrise is a bookmark worthy moment for your travel stories ☀️ also get a soju bucket from the bar ❤️ also the location of this hostel is in the perfect area for the old town of chiang mai to walk around and explore the town.
review_5_text:
such a great hostel to stay at, cheap prices, great atmosphere and the rooftop is the best.

and the owner GARY, he’s the best guy. He made sure everything was perfect, even provided extra towel and water for my trip, I’ll be surely staying here again.

name: กาแฟน้องพีท
review_1_text: Super refreshing, Delicious, handcrafted street style coffee and teas. Just a great and cheap experience by a kind and beautiful young lady.
review_2_text: The coffee and other drinks are flavorful and affordable.
review_3_text: Hi, sir.

name: โรงคั่วกาดหลวง kadluangRoaster (สาขา3) ถนนช้างม่อย
review_1_text: Good early morning coffee in 3 different roasts. They are all good baristas. They roast on site and sell beans and ground coffee from many places. A real no nonsense  cafe. My go-to morning stop as I live near the market.
review_2_text: I just attached the Google Translate screen of what I just showed to the barista. Great find! Love the place. Will come back more frequently now.
review_3_text: A nice little shop with calm atmosphere a little out of the way of the main road. I had a peach tea that was just perfect. +The staff were super nice and friendly so that was a nice bonus.
review_4_text: Wow! Incredible coffee at such a good price!
review_5_text: This coffee shop looked nice so I went inside and bought an iced coffee. Minutes later, I went back again and got myself a treat- a bag of coffee beans.

name: พรประเสริฐ​ กาแฟโครงการหลวง
BIG BLACK COFFEE
review_1_text:
The taste was delicious. The seller was very polite.
So cute!

name: โกเตี๊ยม@กาดหลวง gotiem@waroros
review_1_text:
A Breakfast shop located at second floor! Love the chiang rai Thai tea and the bread they served!

Highly recommend if you plan to drop by before shopping for dried food
review_2_text: A cute small tea shop in the market. Very friendly clerk with nice snacks and various tea and coffee options.
review_3_text: Cute little shop located in Waroros market that serve affordable drinks.
review_4_text: Very nice coffe, traditional vietnamese coffe
review_5_text: Very tasty and nice to drink

name: ชาตรามือ สาขาตลาดวโรรส
review_1_text:
Stopped by Cha Tra Mue for a quick meal and it did not disappoint. We ordered the Hong Kong noodles and the century egg porridge—both comforting and flavorful. The porridge was creamy and hearty, while the noodles had a nice light broth with fresh greens and dumplings.
For drinks, we tried the lemon tea with rose and the green tea with honey lemon—both refreshing and perfect with the meal.
A great spot if you’re craving simple dim sum-style comfort food with their signature Thai teas. Downside is there are  flies hovering on tables.
review_2_text:
Cha Tra Mue is a must-visit tea shop with an impressively wide menu.

It’s the perfect place to stop by and take a break when you’re tired from walking around the city.

From the classic Thai milk tea to fruit teas and matcha variations, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Each drink is carefully prepared, and you can really taste the quality in every sip.

A great spot to recharge and refresh during your sightseeing.
review_3_text:
I love the brown sugar bubble tea!
The green tea was delicious too!
I bought a bunch of their products to take home.
review_4_text:
Cha Tra Mue is a classic Thai tea brand. This store was new looking, clean and most importantly, had air con. Lots of seating upstairs and had a toilet.

The ice cream had great tea flavour but was a bit lacking in milk - wasn't that creamy.  But then, this is to be expected in South East Asia, where dairy is very expensive. I didn't have cha yen this time but I've had it before in Bangkok, and it was good.
review_5_text:
Best Thai tea while I visit Thai.
Very fragrantly delicious 🤤
The cafe also very comfortable

name: สถานีเล็ก​ Kad​ Luang
review_1_text: The taste is average, and the price is typical.

name: สถานีเล็ก Lek Station - Bingsu dessert
Fringe.th - Cafe ad Restaurant
review_1_text:
Super cute place, furniture and spacious ✅
Beans seem to be good ✅
Music inside is too loud ❌
Flat white has NO latte art ❌
Flat white is just a single shot latte ❌
(It's not because you serve it in a glass that it makes a latte a flat white! It's the double shot that makes it a latte.
Music outside is okay, but road noise is too intense ❌
Flat white is 85 Baht ❌ you can get a much better one for 50 baht up the road
There's no service you come pick up your coffee with the buzzer ❌
The bench outside are horrible to sit onto ❌

I'm putting two stars, because I want to be nice for the effort but in Europe I'd put only one. I hope this will be taken as constructive feedback because the place has a lot of potential to be a peaceful heaven to resource into with a nice coffee; currently it's hell.
review_2_text: The place is nice, but for me too noisy. But I liked the whole atmosphere, for me it was more for a friendly session meeting than for a coffee break. You can find there also aj Dj set, nice for a couple of drink than a coffee spot.
review_3_text:
Fringe.th Cafe & Restaurant Chiang Mai is such a beautiful and cozy place! The atmosphere is calm and stylish perfect for relaxing, working, or just enjoying a slow morning. The coffee here is really good! ☕

A perfect spot for coffee in Changmai. Highly recommend stopping by if you want great coffee and chill aesthetics vibe!
review_4_text: Fringe Café is one of the best spots for coffee and breakfast in Chiang Mai. Their brews are consistently rich and smooth, and the breakfast options are fresh, tasty, and beautifully prepared. Surprisingly, their pasta is also really good—comforting, flavorful, and a great choice any time of day. A cozy and reliable café that never disappoints!
review_5_text:
Since I parked a car, This is one of the recommended cafes to visit in Chiang Mai. Mood and vibes are really comfy and sociable. I ordered an iced americano, The taste also great!

Suit with chilling out with friend and also for lovely couple.

name: Samsen Villa
review_1_text: Sam sen was awarded Michelin star restaurant but the Thai food was only average. Quite a lot of China tourist in the restaurant. Good to give it a first time try. We had about close to 36 people in the group.
review_2_text:
The food is decent but really it's just average for Thailand. I'm not surprised the last Michelin recommendation is from 2023. They've milked the Michelin rec as much as they could and are now selling snacks and whatever they can.
We ordered fish (usually takes at least 20min), soup and some other dishes and we're surprised that everything was on the table within 5-10min. They've maximized efficiency over the freshness, as the fish was definitely pre-fried and then kept warm. Everything was good but nothing special. The coconut shake was too sweet. The service was efficient again, but lackluster.
Good parking if you have a car.
Would I come back? No.
review_3_text: I had higher expectations for a place that has Michelin star rated plates. I had the red snail curry which was very tasty and flavorful whereas the fried squid was quite chewy and bland. I thought the prices were very high compared to other local restaurants. The service was just ok... not a whole lot of engagement or interaction. One of the benefits was that there was some live music which made the atmosphere a bit better. Overall, it was an ok experience.
review_4_text:
The food is delicious and full of authentic Thai flavors.
Portion sizes are very generous and satisfying.
The atmosphere is calm, peaceful, and very pleasant, with a beautiful riverside setting along the Ping River.
A great place to enjoy a relaxed and high-quality Thai meal.
review_5_text: Thai restaurant with a wide variety of dishes. Nice riverside atmosphere by the Ping River. A great place to relax and enjoy good food in Chiang Mai.

name: khna coffee brewers
review_1_text:
A charming specialty coffee spot in Chiang Mai's Wat Gate neighborhood, housed in a beautifully renovated old wooden house.
It offers a peaceful, homey vibe with natural light flooding through large windows, vintage furnishings, wooden floors, and a lovely garden area out back—perfect for slowing down and savoring the moment.
The cafe focuses on sustainably sourced single-origin Arabica beans from northern Thailand hills, micro-roasted in small batches for fresh, flavorful brews.  It's a cozy escape ideal for relaxing or light work, with friendly staffs adding to the warm, welcoming feel. A hidden gem for coffee lovers seeking quality and tranquility in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: One of my to-go spots for coffee in the area. Quiet and cozy. Right across from a few yummy places too - that’s why I enjoy spending some time on this street with good coffee and food.
review_3_text: Serious roasters = delicious coffee. Lots to 💕@Khna:  a warm contemporary design, smart,  helpful service and coffees that will having coming back again and again.
review_4_text:
Decent coffee. Good vibes cozy atmosphere.

Sunny breezy cafe of Chiangmai.
review_5_text:
My new favourite cafe in Chiang Mai!! 😍So good i went back the next day!!
The flat white was so good and iced latte was amazing too. It’s actually hard to find really good cup of coffee among so many cafes in town but this one is legit. One sip and instant fave! Great price too! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Take a Break
review_1_text:
I visited during one day of my long and happy New Year holiday. I understand there was some chaos with the orders; however, the staff were very kind and polite. They sincerely apologized for the long waiting time, which I found very humble and endearing.

For parking, you can park at Wat Ket Ka Ram (Wat Ket) and walk through to TAKE A BREAK.

The prices may seem a bit high for a basic menu, but the taste is reasonable and definitely worth it.

Dear all staffs,
Please don’t give up—keep going and keep improving! You’re one of my favorite places, and I’d love to come back whenever I travel to CNX!
review_2_text:
Such a cute place!

The Eggcelent Melt toast was fantastic. Also ordered super delicious Mango Sticky Rice with the sweetest mango ❤️‍🔥 I could get the Thai milk tea in my travel mug, all items for take away.

Everyone is very inviting and friendly here, great staff.
review_3_text: Breakfast place with variety of food and drinks. Chill atmosphere. Staff are friendly and polite. Plenty of parking in the temple nearby and short walk to cafe.
review_4_text: One of the best breakfast spot in the town. Food is good, service is very good. Also thanks for the cake it was very yummy also 😋 (special thanks to guy who served us was speaking very good English and nice)
review_5_text: Found this place by chance and we were so happy! The inside is super beautiful, the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful and the food tasted great! The temple views from the 2nd floor are especially stunning!

name: Café Amazon @SCBตลาดวโรรส สาขา 3503
review_1_text: Favourite cafe sharing with bank.
review_2_text: Rude customer service. Ordered coffee, they asked sweetness level and we chose 0 and the person started questioning our choices with "Really? Are you sure?".
review_3_text:
The location is next to Warorot Market, next to a bank.

I bought some un-artificial Thai milk tea, which I hadn't had for months—very satisfying!
review_4_text: Please train the staff here well. I asked if I could bring my dog ​​in and they said I could, so I ordered three drinks, but they told me to leave while my group was using the bathroom. They said dogs weren't allowed, so I couldn't even get a drink in. I had no choice but to leave with my bag. When I came out, I saw a no-pet sign under the counter. So, if we hadn't seen it when we went in, shouldn't we have told them? We ordered, our drinks came out, and they told us to leave. It's ridiculous. This is the first time I've been this absurd since coming to Thailand.
review_5_text: Motorcycles are crowded. Cars are parked in front of others. Other people will be annoyed.

name: เก๋ไก๋ Café Coffee & Juice Bar
review_1_text: An amazing coffee shop located in the back of the market past the dried fish vendors.  Auntie and uncle are so welcoming and the Thai tea with coffee is a must try.
review_2_text:
Kaykai Café Coffee & Juice Bar located in Tonlamyai Market.

Cafe decorate as cozy and relaxing but taste of drinks ordered was Thai Milk Tea at 25THB which is reasonable price.

Taste is okay but other drinks might be good.

Must try up yourself. Thanks you.
review_3_text: The most wonderful fruit juice for an amazing price! With friendliest owner couple. A must-stop in the market!
review_4_text: A unique place to enjoy one of the many beverages. The barista is a very cheerful and courteous man. 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

name: Ranchuan Cafe - Chiangmai
review_1_text:
Air con in China town!   This is one of the only cafe’s in China town w/ air con.  The food was very good, signature dishes - pad thai, fried chicken and their mango smoothie.

3rd floor is a secret find, very private secluded entire floor for work space, small group, or romantic couple for eats and relax.  Again air con.

Privately owned and pride of ownership food n drinks.  A++.

Will be going back again
very soon for sure.
review_2_text: We were walking through the market and came across a wonderful cafe. We went in and it was a surprise, an amazing place with a wonderful atmosphere and great fun, excellent service with a big smile and a rich menu of drinks, cakes and goodies. Recommend a visit.
review_3_text: A gem near warorot market. A lovely old school vibe café. And the barista there is friendly too. If you looking for a coffee break near that area, this cafe definitely is a good place
review_4_text: Wonderful coffee shop for a break while exploring the market. Staff was very very nice and the presentation was so nice. They have both hot and cold selection of drinks along with cakes and bread.
review_5_text:
Wonderful cafe in China Town with the usual vibrant atmosphere but at the same time calm
Great coffee and cake
Highly recommend this place

name: Weng Homecooking Cafe
review_1_text: Great coffee, delicious food, excellent service.  We arrived by mistake, we were surprised by a delicious espresso.  We were surprised that there was oat milk, we ate a stir-fry with chicken that was amazing, almost not spicy.  and marble  The title was a delicate dessert called Glorgi, ancient and unique to Bangkok.  The style is Chinese.  We will definitely come back here.
review_2_text:
Very tasty. Loved the mantou, I also got chicken with cashew nuts, very tasty! We will be back soon.

Something also that was very sweet was that  the lady working there came out to wave us goodbye as we were leaving. Very cute.
review_3_text: The best Chinese lunch ever. The portion is perfect for 1-2 persons. I absolutely love this place! 😋🫶🏻
review_4_text: Loved the concept! I loved how it is a sustainable retro revival renovation.  The salty egg fried bun is to die for…
review_5_text: Very nice staff and well located :))

name: A Cafe' CNX
review_1_text: Situated in proximity to Warorot Market (Kad Luang), this expansive coffee shop and bistro offers a diverse selection of beverages and culinary options. The proprietor is known for their amiable demeanor and commitment to excellent service. While the establishment provides ample space, it would be beneficial to enhance the ambiance through the incorporation of Thai or international design elements, particularly during celebratory periods.
review_2_text: Beautiful cafe with strong AC. Delicious pasta and Thai food. Nice service.
review_3_text: A beautiful atmosphere to enjoy breakfast or a cup of delicious Cold Brew coffee. Lovely garden attached to the cafe! Happy we decided to give it a try, thank you 🙏🏼☕️
review_4_text:
Lovely Cafe
Great menu
Fantastic friendly staff ❤️
review_5_text: Delicious coffee and relaxing atmosphere....you will be glad you came

name: DemoCrazy!
review_1_text: DemoCrazy is such a cool and versatile spot! By day, it’s a cozy coffee shop perfect for getting some work done or catching up with friends. Come evening, it transforms into a relaxed bar with beers, good vibes, and live music. The atmosphere is laid-back, the staff are friendly, and the music makes the night even better. Great place to unwind after a long day!
review_2_text:
Nice coffee, chill vibe, and fair prices

Air-con’s cool, internet works great, and they’ve got both drinks and food. I love how this place feels — not just another café, but somewhere with a bit of spirit. Feels good spending money here, knowing it’s also supporting something bigger than just coffee.

If you’re tired of the same old stuff and believe in moving forward (not backwards like some dinosaurs 🦖), this place hits different.
review_3_text: Super cozy vibes, friendly staff, and good coffee. Great spot to hang out or just chill with a good cup!
review_4_text: Good place to visit! Nice coffee but a little bit cold.
review_5_text: The peaceful place for democracy community in Chiangmai.

name: Wake Up Coffee @ B2 Riverside Colonial
review_1_text: This is the only coffee shop that I know of in chiang mai that is 24 hours open. The coffee taste is good. This is a simple small coffee shop that is consistently good.  It only has a few snacks.  The location is on the ping river. There are only a few seats inside.  This is more of a take away type shop.
review_2_text:
Super chill cafe located in a medium sized hotel. Most of the guests seem to be locals there to avail themselves of the very well lit and air conditioned coffee shop.

This is a nice little spot for locals with plenty of power outlets for laptops.

Some tasty pastries and coffee and Italian sodas were available they're a bunch of delicious looking bingsus on the menu but unfortunately were not available  during my visit.

I will definitely come back here again.
review_3_text: I asked for chocolate mocha he said no don't have . I said what is this Belgium chocolate mocha on the menu. He said ok,  I said large but only 8 oz. So I ask for 2 . Paid 160 baht and left. Got to my table, open the lid, and it was half full, 4 freaking oz. I was able to pour the entire contents of the second one into the first to make one 8 ounce mocha. This place is a good start for a coffee shop. Rite now it is nothing  but a hotel desk.
review_4_text:
This is an extremely overrated franchisee, misrepresented by multiple travel bloggers as a 24h co-working space. There is less than six tables, and barely enough room to squeeze in twelve people.

I waste a taxi fare to find that there was no space here to actually sit, machine would not accept wireless payments, and quickly left. The staff also seemed very tired, and was not particularly friendly nor helpful.
review_5_text: There are 1 staff always on the phone all the time and talking pretty loud, I used to go often, but I don't want to go anymore.

name: 우 카페
review_1_text:
This cafe exceeded expectations in every aspect.
The decor is stunning from every angle; every photo is beautiful.
The lighting is gorgeous.

All the staff are incredibly attentive.
This is the best part; everyone is genuinely ready to serve, from the servers to the front-of-house staff.

I arrived early in the morning, right when they opened.
They were arranging flowers.
I loved it, especially the smell of fresh flowers.

The food presentation is gorgeous.
Every dish is beautiful, really.
You can tell they put a lot of thought into it.

It's so beautiful it almost overshadows the taste of the food! 555
The food itself is decent for a cafe.

The desserts and drinks are photogenic.
I loved the Citrus Americano; it was so refreshing.

I also loved the Caesar Chicken Tortilla.
If they could pay more attention to the refrigerator smell on the vegetables,
this dish would be perfect.

This cafe is definitely worth a try!

name: Cafe Willow
review_1_text: I had this place for myself for hours. The Thai tea was delicious. There were lots of bugs-mosquitos flying around but i guess that’s normal. The service could be better, the lady working at the cafe looked a bit miserable, as if it was a bother that one client came in and made her work.
review_2_text: Cafe has dark and classic decoration. It also has fish pound and garden. There’s no other guest when we visited there so we got the whole place yo ourselves The staff was very attentive, friendly and helpful. Coffee and cheese cake were good. Spicy seafood salad lack of spicy and sour punch. A good place to chill.
review_3_text:
I can't say enough good stuff about this place.   The decor is serene from the table placement to the decorative touches.  The view through the Willow garden and beyond to the Ping River.

Then there is the food and drink.   All thoughtfully prepared and presented.   An appetizer of crispy pork rinds, chicken Pad Thai garnished with Banana flowers, ending with coconut milk ice cream, black plum and banana (with a crisp sugar coating).

They also open for breakfast, it's a calm way to start the day.

Oh, and the staff ... excellent!
review_4_text:
The place is quite. A good place to work. They have charging station and free WIFI. The staff is really polite. Cool ambiance.

Had a hard time finding it because it's part of7 the hotel. If you find a brown and white hotel on the pinned location. That is it.
review_5_text: Wonderful wonderful food, awesome and friendly staff and reasonable prices!!  The carbonara pasta and Thai style fried rice were our favorites!  The sides with the breakfast sets were so delicious!!  We are gonna miss this place when we go home.

name: UpperCrust Bakery & Cafe
review_1_text: Such a lovely place to eat, create and relax. Love the Laab tofu. It is the best I have eaten.
review_2_text: A cozy, quiet café with delicious food. The staff is very friendly, and the owner speaks English well. The prices are appropriate for a place of this level. The cashew chicken is outstanding! 👌 The cheesecake is also good, made with the right cheese. It’s not overly sweet (just make sure to ask for it without the blueberry jam if you don't like sweet).
review_3_text:
Usually good.
This time we have a bit of hair in the cashew chicken. Not wonderful.
Bon appétit!
review_4_text: They serve the best mango cheesecake in the world! This place used to be in front the train station, but has moved here! Enjoy!
review_5_text:
Disclaimer: I haven't stepped foot in their physical store and my review is based on their food alone.

Every time I go to Rimping to pick up groceries I wind up picking up at least two cookies for my husband and me. Their Red Velvet Cappuccino Cookies are the things dreams are made of. All of their baked goods (found in the fridges) are heavenly. My husband loves their Carrot Cake, and we just tried and raved about how good their Peanut Butter and Caramel Brownie is. I have yet to be disappointed in any of their creations. I discovered that they have a physical location last week and you better believe I am making my way in as soon as I can. Absolutely obsessed.

name: khanom babin Pancake
review_1_text: I've been looking for this place since I was in JJ, but most of the options were too sweet. This one is located 10 meters inside the market on the right. They don't have Thai tea sauce, but it's not sweet, so it's a good alternative.
review_2_text: I saw these while browsing the market and bought some small coconut pancakes. They were delicious. They had a chewy, chewy texture and the coconut flesh was thick and filling. Just one was enough to fill me up.
review_3_text: The smell will have you coming here, and once you try the coconut cake, you'll be hooked. Just ask for the babin, 4 for 20 baht. Chiang Mai's best dessert.

name: Wake Up Coffee @ B2 Riverside Premier
review_1_text:
Not impressed the staff seemed aloof, and frankly annoyed I asked any questions. Seems like they were more focused on a call with their boyfriend than working.

Slightly better than working at a McDonalds. But there are few options late at night.

In addition I wasn’t given a receipt for my order I had to scan the reviews here for the WiFi password which is “wakeup1328” for any unfortunate soul who chooses to work here.
review_2_text: A cozy place to stay while waiting for my hotel check-in. I arrived in Chiangmai at 5am and I needed to stay somewhere while waiting, good thing this 24 hrs cafe is along the way to my hotel. The staff speaks very well English and very accommodating. Their coffee is tasty and the vibe of the place is quite nice. Not too bright and not too dim. Not too cold either. Wifi available. Highly recommended.
review_3_text: Clutch coffee shop for overnight in Chiang Mai. Really is 24/7 with chill vibes inside. Only problem was wifi was down when I was there but It didnt bother me as I had stuff to work on offline. The wifi probably usually works too
review_4_text: I like this cafe because it's the only 24h cafe I found in Chiang Mai so far (but maybe there are others too). It offers wi-fi and tables with outlets, which is very convenient for working. The drinks are not very special, but they are good. And staff is very friendly and nice.
review_5_text: I came here a long time ago (a few years) while walking around and this time I wanted to stop in to get a coffee and wait before taking a bus to Bangkok, sadly they have gone cashless and I didn’t want to use my debit card and get an international charge so I had to leave. I remember before there were many people maybe students studying this time there was only one person. Maybe it was a bad time or maybe it’s not very popular spot. I like that it stays open 24/7 and that was also why i came here because I would need to stay past the typical coffee shop closing time of 6pm. I give it five stars because I didn’t want to rate low for something out of anyone’s control, I just felt like sharing that they are cashless now.

name: THAI HERB CO.
review_1_text: I enjoyed the vibes at night, very cool music playlist. I enjoyed the cheese onion toast my favourite and the owner is nice she accommodated me well due to my leg injury got me a different seat.
review_2_text: Stumbled across this cafe and had to come back a few more times throughout my week here. Kindest staff you could ask for. Great value for money on both food and drinks. The smoothies in particular are incredible. I highly recommend you come here.
review_3_text: Thai Herb Co. Is a favorite spot for us to come to eat, drink, and smoke. The back garden is beautiful and has great vibes/ atmosphere with a pool table. The cannabis is good quality and Pla and the other staff are always pleasant and excited to see us. We love Thai Herb Co and recommend it for anyone looking for a good local spot to hang out. The hours are great too and we never feel rushed! The vibes are great and the cannabis is strong.
review_4_text: I had an amazing experience at Thai Herb.co! The place has a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it a perfect spot to relax and unwind. The quality of their products is outstanding — you can really tell they put care and expertise into everything they offer. The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, always ready to help and share their knowledge. Whether you're looking for authentic herbs, wellness products, or just a chill place to hang out, Thai Herb.co is definitely the place to go. Highly recommend for anyone seeking quality, good vibes, and great service!
review_5_text: Absolutely loved the vibe and setup of Thai Herb Co - the whole place is awesome. Eespecially the back garden 🤩 the staff are incredible as well. We couldn't resist stopping by many times! Also, by far the best 🍁

name: Series 8 Cafe
review_1_text: Good atmosphere, good price for coffee.
review_2_text: There is also a river view next to the shop.

name: All Time Coffee
review_1_text: Great espresso, really friendly staff. Perfect for a break when walking through the busy market hall
review_2_text:
Brilliant espresso, lovely staff

Great place to stop in the markets when you need to chill
review_3_text: Hot espresso...good
review_4_text: great!
review_5_text: Good coffee

name: ชาแฟ ChaFe'
review_1_text: Very nice coffee shop in Ton Lam Yai Market
review_2_text: One of The best flat white coffees ive had in the 10 yrs ive been coming to Thailand, this guy knows how to make a great coffee 10/10.
review_3_text: The very best Thai coffee in town.
review_4_text: Handy large cafe serving traditional Thai food or coffee tea etc Young staff friendly Open at front to busy street Popular with locals and tourists Adjoining clothing and food stores as well as tourist agency advertising local attractions
review_5_text: Very strong and decent coffee

name: ฺBhealth สาขา เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: This is a must-visit restaurant in Chiang Mai. The food is indeed a bit pricey, but the taste is just right and quite suitable for Taiwanese palates. The reason it's worth going is because the atmosphere is so lively. You should arrive around 5 pm to grab a good spot and enjoy the experience!

name: Tanita Coffee House
review_1_text: Tanita Coffee House is such a charming and peaceful spot tucked away in Chiang Mai. The traditional wooden house setting gives it a cozy, nostalgic vibe that feels instantly relaxing. Their coffee is smooth and well-made, and the whole place has a slow, calming atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours. A perfect hideaway for anyone who loves quiet cafés with character.
review_2_text:
Tanita Coffee House is a true hidden gem in Chiang Mai! The moment you step into the compound, you're transported into a peaceful, traditional Lanna-style oasis. The coffee is excellent—they use quality, local Arabica beans—and the Thai cuisine is delicious. It’s the perfect, relaxing escape from the city hustle, wrapped in beautiful old-world charm. Highly recommended for an authentic and tranquil coffee experience!

Plus point it's that there is a Thai antiques store located at the back of the coffee shop. Some really interesting pieces and owners are extremely friendly and happy to talk about the history of the items.
review_3_text: I really enjoyed this restaurant. The place feels cozy and friendly, and the food came out fast. I ordered Pad Thai and it was delicious, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The cappuccino was also really good.
review_4_text:
A Hidden Gem in Chiang Mai !

Staying at Tanita House has been a designer’s dream. Every morning felt special — having breakfast in an antique furniture shop, surrounded by old timber homes full of character and charm.

The wooden houses are beautifully preserved, with rich teak textures and warm details. In the café, vintage sewing machines are cleverly used as table bases — playful, functional, and full of personality.

The food is clean, healthy, and homemade, and Aor and her family are incredibly warm and welcoming.

If you love thoughtful design and quiet, soulful stays, I’d highly recommend this place.
review_5_text: Coffee was fantastic and was served with free snacks and a small tea. The space is beautiful and cool, with nice traditional art.

name: Chez Nous Wat Ket
review_1_text: What a special, cozy place to enjoy an extraordinary treat and delicious food. We look forward to returning soon.  Everything on the menu looks so delicious.  The atmosphere here is like a warm hug and the food matches that perfectly. The staff are extremely sweet and welcoming.  We look foward to our next visit and recommend this to all who visit beautiful Chiang Mai 🙏☺️
review_2_text:
Hidden gem in heart of Chiang Mai. The signature cuisine Spaghetti with salmon was highly recommended. The bakery shop and quiet restaurant were separated.
The great stuff Ms. Nanny answered all my questions not only menu but history and culture about Chiang Mai. I'll try to visit again next year.
review_3_text: Had an amazing breakfast here, everything was fresh, delicious, and beautifully served. The coffee was rich and perfectly made. The atmosphere is cozy, and the staff are incredibly friendly and attentive. Special thanks to Nani, she made my visit truly exceptional with her warmth and professionalism. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great start to the day!
review_4_text: Experience exceptional staff, delicious food, and passionate ownership. Make sure to add this gem to your must-visit list when you're in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Great experience and chill vibe. Thanks for the awesome swan latte art and milk froth. We ordered the pandan coconut croissant and black truffle were both absolutely tasty. Highly recommend.

name: มธุรส ไอศกรีม เชียงใหม่ (Mathuros ice cream ChiangMai) 冰淇淋店
review_1_text: Came here with my better half to drop off sky lanterns for her brother, and had a double surprise of meeting my future mother in law and the oddities within this cafe, loved the Frenchie called Allathe who albeit being a bit snooty comes right up for a cuddle once she realizes the patrons are dog lovers haha, apart from that the interiors are pretty surreal and beautiful with taxidermied exotic birds like Macaws, cockatoos and even a whole darn male peacock. The tea, biscuits and the coconut ice cream we had in our surprise meeting were very nice and pleasant and the staff friendly as always. It's definitely worth visiting for the awe factor and the ice cream here.
review_2_text: Fabulous treats and comfy setting. Decorations were over the top beautiful. And if you like dogs you might get to play with the resident Frenchie. We’ve so glad we found this place!
review_3_text: Cute ice cream and dessert house. Antiques and stuffed birds in the setting
review_4_text: Since the entrance I already felt welcome here, the staff was real friendly, explaining me with details about each topping for the ice cream, I love the decoration and ambient music, ice cream tastes very nice not too sweet + had amazing tea, definitely will be coming back here 🙏🏼
review_5_text: Cute place to get tasty coconut ice cream ~

name: Baan Cafe by Eddy
review_1_text: We have been staying at Sakorn Residence for years. Eddy cafe is small but very friendly and homelike. The coffee is great Eddy always welcomes you you with a smile. A place to relax and hang out.
review_2_text: Casual and friendly, Eddy serves a latte with a smile. The place is clean and comfortable.
review_3_text: Was passing by, and as always in need of Coffee :) only  a small place. but must say, had a latte and it was great hot. its on back street couple of blocks back from the Ping river.
review_4_text: Friendly, convenient and comfortable. We loved coming here for a morning espresso drink during our stay next door. We were always greeted with a smile and rewarded with tasty drinks to enjoy in the bright space.
review_5_text: My home away from home. I'm so happy every time I am at Eddie's

name: Forest Bake
review_1_text: Forest Bake is a peaceful gem surrounded by nature. We enjoyed dining here weekly for the 2 months we visited Chiang Mai. Its a beautiful calm atmosphere, the owners and staff are so welcoming and kind. The food is very delicious and the bake shop is devine. Thank you for many delicious meals and enjoyable visits. We highly recommend Forest bake for top quality food, atmosphere and a all around wonderful experience.
review_2_text: We shared a selection of cakes and pies.  They were all fresh and delicious. The garden was gorgeous to sit in. Very tranquil. Well worth the cheap tuktuk ride from the old city. ♥️
review_3_text: This morning I visited Forest Bake, a nearby café from my fiancé’s apartment. I enjoyed their Avocado Eggs Benedict on Toast and coffee. Special kudos to the lady barista and the staff for being attentive and friendly. The place has a lovely nature vibe with my favorite view, the black cat 😊.
review_4_text:
This place is essentially a bakery. Upon entering the main area, you’ll find a whimsical forest-like ambiance small store with a variety of baked goods. The bakery items are beautifully displayed and look enticing. It’s like a kid’s candy shop, making it difficult to decide what to choose.

The cheesecake blueberry roll is noteworthy. It’s soft and has a perfect balance of flavors. The drinks are made at a separate corner.

This bakery has the potential to be a lovely garden cafe if the garden is well-maintained and aesthetically pleasing. However, for now, it’s simply a delightful bakery shop. It’s a great place to sit outside on a cool day, but it could be even better if the garden were more inviting.
review_5_text: I walked by this place a few days ago and the aesthetic really caught my eye with all of the surrounding greenery. It has a very peaceful ambiance from the bustling city. I ordered a latte and the big breakfast, which was too much for just me. I enjoyed my time there. It’s like a nice, little getaway.

name: มีชากาแฟ สาขาป่าเหมือด
ร้านกาแฟโมมู
review_1_text: Momu is really nice, great Thai coffee we drank, it is small but cosy :) would recommend!
review_2_text: Lovely people , had the best smoothie ever here
review_3_text:
I visited Momo Coffee and ordered all five iced drinks with my friends. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for fresh, aromatic, strong, and well-rounded coffee. The coffee is delicious and full of flavor.
The shop is located on the 4th floor of the Food Park at Central Airport Plaza. This place is incredibly delicious.
review_4_text: The drinks are very delicious.
review_5_text: This restaurant is delicious!👏👏👍👍👍 I'm very impressed!💓💓

name: Later on | cafe and bar
review_1_text:
A charming and quiet place with seating both indoors and outdoors. The décor is sweet, the staff is kind, and the desserts are good.

I didn’t personally love their signature drink, though.
review_2_text: Nice quiet cafe tuck in a corner of the rural street. Nice decor and lotsa drinks selection. Recommended if you have a lazy afternoon to read, work or chill.
review_3_text: The cafe is very cozy and a good place to take pictures. Staff was friendly and welcoming. The drinks had the right amount of sweetness and the baked goods were exceptional, especially the chocolate fudge cake. Best part, they have a parking lot.
review_4_text:
Friendly staff, good service(Accidently left 1 drink and the staff chase and brought to the villa where i'm staying(beside the shop), Nice deco, very Instagramable place of cos drinks are nice.
Should try out the ice mocha
review_5_text: Lovely and Cozy cafe! the croffle is my fav! the drinks are so good and the owner is so sweet. also there are parking spaces!! highly recommended

name: redfern เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
Pure mango frappe ☺️ The best!! ️
The clothes are a unique style, a little pricey, but the quality is high.

name: Take Me Home Ice Cream - Ping River
review_1_text: So good! Staff were welcoming, made suggestions and let us try many flavors. The flavors are unique and so quality!
review_2_text:
We found this amazing Italian restaurant by chance, we needed a break from Thia food, we love this food, this place was incredible, the service was top notch as was the pasta and wine, we decided to finish with simple ice-cream, I was proven completely wrong the ice-creamer was totally full of passion and ran us perfectly through the complexity of all his wonderful flavours, what a great experience, thanks a million 🙂
Yummo...
review_3_text:
All the ice cream had such unique flavors — I liked every single one!
And it turns out this place isn’t only about ice cream — they’ve got food as well!
review_4_text:
As an ice cream lover I have to say, it's very good.
Calamansi is my favorite.
Other than that, the place is nice, clean and staff very welcoming.
review_5_text: The shop and staff are nice, but we didn’t like the ice-cream. We tried Durian, Yuzu Honey, Thai tea and Roasted coconut. They all tasted perfumey. Perhaps, I expected more natural tastes, especially given that most flavors are local.

name: ร้านน้ำน้องลีวาย
review_1_text:
Purchased on 14/2/2026
Drinks and toast shop
Drinks are inexpensive, starting at 25 baht.

Ordered an espresso for 30 baht.
Very delicious, and a large cup!

No parking available.
Drinks are made quickly; you might be able to order from your car in front of the shop.
Similar to a drive-thru, no need to get out of your car.

name: 39 Coffee House
review_1_text:
I'm a huge fan of this coffee shop. They offer drip coffee, reasonable prices, a variety of menu options, and friendly service.

The owner is welcoming, and there's even a counter seat available. My personal favorites are the Medium Roast hot Americano and their delicious sandwiches.
review_2_text: Very friendly staff. Good tasting coffee. I will return in a few days to taste the food
review_3_text: I enjoyed my americano very much.
review_4_text: Nice Coffee and friendly Service
review_5_text: I'm from Taiwan. There's only one stylist here. The shampoo and massage are very comfortable, and my hair is incredibly smooth afterwards. I recommend it.

name: ทักว่า タクワ Coffee Stand
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee stand serving handcrafted coffee of all kinds, adjusted to your preferences. The owner is very kind and great to chat to - she told us a bit about the area and gave us a few recommendations for our trip. We will be back next time! 🐇🌿☕
review_2_text:
The owner lady is friendly and kind, and the coffee beans are great too. I had a medium-roast Americano made from Colombian coffee beans roasted in Thailand, which was very delicious. The handmade cookies were also nice.

The café has a quiet room inside with air conditioning, and you can also sit at the counter.
review_3_text: Great coffee shop in a peaceful area a short walk from the main road. Was originally going to get coffee to go but ended up staying! Staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Great recommendations given for Chiang Mai. Definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: Stumbled upon this cafe without any expectations, just looking to grab a coffee post-lunch at Habib. Surprisingly, the atmosphere is delightful, prompting me to relax for a while. The barista/owner is incredibly friendly, and my iced americano stands out as one of the best in Chiang Mai. Definitely worth a try!
review_5_text: A cute local coffee place with friendly barrista, using slow bar machine.  Coffee is lovingly made, using local beans and single origin Colombian beans.  Give it a try.

name: FAV FAV coffee
review_1_text: If you’re looking for a cozy little spot to brighten your day, FAVFAV is just perfect! The coffee is made with so much love, and every corner of the café feels warm and welcoming.
review_2_text: Excellent quiet corner. Fantastic coffee, Haru is the cutest fat (not pregnant) cat! 🙏
review_3_text: Amazing coffee and tea that comes with a great service, place atmosphere and an adorable cat 😺. Can't ask for more!
review_4_text: Professional Fluffy receptionist🐈.   Coffee + Cat = Good combination. Great Mocca 👍🏼
review_5_text: Delicious coffee, relaxing atmosphere and friendly cats 🐈

name: Green o'clock
review_1_text:
Casual mostly outdoor seating in a tranquil garden setting.  Reliable choice for inexpensive and delicious Thai foods in a neighborhood setting.

Frequented by lots of students sitting around in deep discussion.  It is not unusual to see one  strumming a guitar.
review_2_text: We loved eating here.  Fabulous food!  The family are lovely.
review_3_text: Very delicious food.and  very nice place, I will be back soon
review_4_text: there is something lovely in this place. the atmosphere is like you are invited to a family party but u also have your own privacy..a lot of youngsters are there for study, playing music, chitchat, and another group is middle aged people drinking beer. good environment. food menu is simpke but tasty. they have enough drink list for your selection. price is really acceptable. open air with green makes it great at any season. highly recommended.
review_5_text: A beautiful garden cafe. The food is mostly Thai and freshly prepared. Beer is available. A nice place to relax, read, write, chat etc. No live music. Mostly visited by young locals from universities nearby. Very few tourists/travelers know about this place. Not expensive if you order Thai food.

name: แอบ คาเฟ่ - Aebb Cafe
movo room
review_1_text: Such a cute little cafe in Chiang Mai! The owner (I believe) was SUPER friendly & made such good drinks. We had gotten the matcha latte & Movo latte (vanilla latte) and they were my favorite I’ve had here. I came back two days in a row haha. Recommend checking out this place for all coffee & matcha lovers! 🤍
review_2_text: This is a cute cafe with friendly service. I highly recommend you stop by!

name: Good trip&Co.
review_1_text:
Homemade bakery&coffee ；chill ,cozy , comfy!
Three types of coffee beans!
Love it!
Recommend!
review_2_text: Matcha  so good !
review_3_text: Very good dark roast Americano! They also have amazing seating and great service from the barista.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious, the shop is cute, and the owner is friendly. I'll definitely come back again.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious and reasonably priced; I could come back often. The owner is friendly. I really like their homemade cakes; they're light and not heavy on the stomach.

name: Drink First Love Second
review_1_text: Good coffee. Car wash is awesome. Very friendly and detail very good.
review_2_text: A cozy little house, a quiet hostess, and delicious coffee. Enjoy a quiet afternoon while waiting for your car to be washed! P.S.: Both the coffee and the car wash are very cheap!
review_3_text:
A cute and cozy little shop with delicious orange coffee and pastries.
There's a car wash nearby, so you can sit and wait in the cool, comfortable shop.
🌞🏡💖🌻🙆🏼‍♀️🥰💕
review_4_text: Cute shop with a friendly atmosphere.
review_5_text: Good coffee and service

name: Roastniyom Coffee - Wat Ket Hotel

review_1_text: Nice place, good service but espresso to milk ratio wasn't ideal. Hence our coffees were bland and diluted. Even for the hot caffe latte we ordered. Food is excellent on Tamarind side and will be back for the Khao Soi and Crispy Namtok Noodles.

review_3_text:
I love this café a lot.
You can have breakfast, lunch, or brunch there until around 3:30–4:00 PM. The place feels like a combination of different shops.
You order everything at the café first, then sit anywhere you like.

I didn’t see any air-conditioned indoor area, but the outdoor atmosphere was quite comfortable — the weather was slightly rainy, and the space is surrounded by lots of greenery.

It’s also okay to do remote work upstairs for around 3–4 hours. It’s not crowded at all, which makes it even better.
Plus, there’s a separate and lovely gift shop where you can buy some Burmese traditional products.

Highly recommended if you enjoy a peaceful vibe.
review_4_text: The Loft Cafe in Chiang Mai is a gem! I absolutely loved the cool, industrial-chic atmosphere—it’s the perfect spot to relax or get some work done. The coffee is excellent, robust, and expertly made, and the pastries are delicious. The staff are friendly and the vibe is always chill and welcoming. Definitely a must-visit for a great cafe experience in Chiang Mai!

name: สวักลี คอฟฟี่
กาแฟนิยม สาขาถนนทุ่งโฮเต็ล Niyomcoffee
review_1_text:
Great vibe & Great coffee!

Had an iced mint latte that was pretty awesome. The happy vibe in this shop is what happens when a proprieter loves what they do and take pride in how they do it.

Here's the extra good, since it's easy to find a great cup of coffee in Chiang Mai. It's the happy vibe.

While being relatively small in size, the walls of windows make the space feel open, warm & inviting. It is a clean, well lighted place.

The seating design has two couches, two countertops, and four tables inside, and two tables under a covered awning for coffee in a garden.

The way the indoor seating is arranged, the comfortable padded seats and tabletop provide islands of privacy in an open space. It's very well thought out. The decor also changes slightly in each mini seating area to further amplify a feeling of separation and privacy in this open setting.

The decor is also funny, happy, and bright. Kids and the kid in you will be moved towards a relaxing mindset to maybe share conversations and coffee with a friend, or doom scroll in search of the end limits of the internet. In either case, this place will add to the happy mood of your activity.

Plenty of parking. Laundry mat across the street, and  Lotus Fresh next door, as well as a wine shop to grab a bottle for later.

10/10 Fantastic!

Im going back for more.
review_2_text: Our favourite coffee shop of Thailand after visiting dozens of others across the country during our month stay. The man working here is a true obsessed barista, great attraction to details whilst creating his art. Atmosphere wonderful. We'll be back.
review_3_text: Just discovered Niyom Coffee in Chiang Mai and wow 🤩 — this place is such a vibe. The coffee is next-level (smooth, rich, and clearly brewed with love), and the café itself has that perfect mix of cozy + minimal that makes you want to hang out all day. The baristas are super friendly and actually take the time to chat about the beans, which makes the whole experience feel personal. Definitely adding this to my “must return” list whenever I need good coffee and a chill spot. ☕✨
review_4_text: I come here regularly. The coffee is well-balanced and satisfying. The staff provides good service. There is parking. The atmosphere in the shop is nice and inviting.
review_5_text: I ordered a latte and a cold Nestea Tea. The presentation was beautiful. The atmosphere is serene and quiet. Very beautiful little place. The prices are amazing. At least 20 - 40 Bht less than anywhere else I've been. Definitely a must for coffee lovers.
