review_1_text: Top quality coffee, super friendly stuff, chill atmosphere! 10/10 way yo boost your day. Best of luck to Minimal coffee 👍
review_2_text:
Beautiful environment, high-quality coffee machine, delicious coffee, and warm, attentive service. ❤️❤️❤️

The atmosphere is great, they use a quality coffee machine, the coffee tastes delicious, the service is polite, and the staff are cheerful and smiling.

The atmosphere is great, they use a quality coffee machine, the coffee tastes delicious, and the staff are cheerful and smiling.

name: PuenPlay Cafe
review_1_text: Very good
review_2_text: Too cute! Christmas-themed
review_3_text: Very good americano with rich and fruity senses.
review_4_text: Looks decent.
review_5_text: The shop has a great atmosphere, delicious drinks, and the owner is incredibly lovely and kind! 💖😍 I love it so much!

name: Starbucks CMU Food Center
review_1_text: Starbucks CMU Food Center is a cozy and convenient spot located within the Chiang Mai University campus. Perfect for students, faculty, and visitors, this Starbucks offers a relaxing environment to unwind or catch up on work. The atmosphere is calm, with plenty of seating options both indoors and outdoors, allowing you to enjoy your coffee in a peaceful setting. As with any Starbucks, the menu features a wide range of coffee drinks, teas, and delicious pastries, all made with their signature quality. The staff are friendly and efficient, ensuring that your order is made just right. Whether you're looking for a quick caffeine fix or a place to study, Starbucks CMU Food Center is a great choice!
review_2_text:
Chill chill chill i love it
So green pretty cozy and quite
review_3_text: good
review_4_text: Nice.
review_5_text: A new place that opened in 2024. It seems like the number of cafe-goers is increasing in Thailand these days. I often see people studying in the cafe. From the outside, it was all open seating, but when I went inside, I found a cozy space. It was Songkran, so there weren't many people, which was nice. I'll have to come back tomorrow.

name: Fresh&Mild since 1992 - Chiang Mai University Food Court Branch
review_1_text:
Good place to study: few people, air conditioned, soft music, comfy table setup, though lacking plugs. Great central location within the campus with access to cheap meals in the food court next door.

Coffee is on the stronger side.
review_2_text: Decent cafe with good square tables for work. The food court right next to it is very crowded during the lunch time, but this cafe is rather quiet and nice to relax. Hot cappuccino here is 50thb and it is good. One thing to keep in your mind is that the power outlet is a bit limited unless you sit by the window.
review_3_text: Fresh&Mild since 1992 at the CMU Food Center is a great place for those looking for healthy and delicious food. Located conveniently within Chiang Mai University, it offers a variety of fresh, flavorful dishes that are perfect for a quick bite between classes or a relaxed meal with friends. The menu features a wide selection of salads, sandwiches, and smoothies, all made with high-quality ingredients. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it a popular spot for students and faculty alike. The friendly staff provide excellent service, and the food is always served fresh and tasty. If you're craving something light, nutritious, and satisfying, this is definitely a go-to place!
review_4_text: It’s a lovely and cozy place inside the university campus. The coffee is great, so is the ice cream and the atmosphere. Most importantly, the staff is incredibly polite and nice. They always make your day. Today we just stopped by while running because we ran out of water, had only 1000 baht note and felt bad to ask just for water but it wasn’t problem at all. A good spot when you want to run away from the centre.
review_5_text: Nice coffee shop in CMU.

name: BOTAN COFFEE BY PE.SHOP
review_1_text: Good coffee
review_2_text: Delish
review_3_text: The welcome was warm and the staff incredibly friendly! The latte and lemon tea were absolutely delicious, as were the farm-fresh yogurts and the brownie 🤤 A fantastic café in the heart of Chiang Mai University with very reasonable prices: just perfect! 👍
review_4_text: The matcha is delicious. There are both matcha lattes and pure/coconut water. Everything else is delicious. There are bakery and desserts to try. The price is cute. The shop has a half-price program, making the price even cheaper. The atmosphere is friendly. Everyone in the shop is very good and friendly. The shop is nice to sit in, but you should avoid children's break time. The shop can be a bit noisy because it's a break time, but it's a short time and not too disturbing.
review_5_text: The coffee tastes great, with every roast available. They offer free seasonal fruit, and the prices are very reasonable. You won't be disappointed if you stop by!

name: The Dorm
review_1_text: The space is modern, but the seats are limited. I asked for the recommendation and it was Americano coconut, so I tried. Sadly, it was way too sweet and I could not drink it at all literally. The music here is also too loud. I can’t recommend this place to anyone honestly.
review_2_text: Amazing experience. The owner and his mother are so sweet 🥰 and the drinks are very good. Baked goods are homemade! We had Coco and the Dirty. Best Dirty I have tried 💯🏁
review_3_text:
A cool little cafe hiding behind the CMU basketball courts just near the Clock Tower and under the girl's dorm building 6.

I tried the Thai Tea because I don't drink coffee and it was good. The menu was pretty cheap and definitely priced to suit the CMU students.

It's a great location to sit and study and if you need some English help talk to the owner.
review_4_text: Small and cosy. Apple crumble is nice (not too sweet).
review_5_text:
An excellent cafe for working with a laptop, excellent design and delicious coffee, comfortable tables and chairs.

The Internet is not stable, the network sometimes lags, the speed is for browsing (3-5 megabit).

name: กาแฟมิราเคิล 81 หมู่14 ถ.สุเทพ อ.เมือง จ.เชียงใหม่ 50200
HOM HOM NA CAFE
review_1_text: The cafe is cute and it gives you more private space and atmosphere if you don’t like dining out in public. Plus, the owner is so friendly, kind and makes your eating space comfortable.
review_2_text: This is my go-to shop. The coffee is good, high-quality, and reasonably priced. They have a wide variety of drinks to choose from. The shop has a Japanese theme, and they play music and decorate according to the seasons. The owner is very friendly, and they also sell some fried snacks.
review_3_text: The shop moved from the female dormitory 1 (already demolished) to the male dormitory 6. The shop is closed every Monday. It is a cafe that sells rice dishes and steamed bread as a dessert. The tea menu is considered common except for the matcha which is easy to drink and has a fragrant milky smell for 35 baht. I have not tried the cocoa menu. I have not tried the coffee yet, but the menu with milk is delicious and fragrant and just the right amount. The shop does not have black pearls, but will have konjac pearls instead. If you want to add them, the price will be an additional 5 baht. As for the food, the ramen costs 35 baht, the noodles are soft and the toppings are delicious, especially the Naruto. The soup is considered normal. As for the chicken karaage rice, it is very delicious. You can choose the sauce. I personally chose the tonkatsu sauce, which is delicious. The rice is soft and not soggy. The vegetables are fresh. The fried chicken is fragrant, crispy, and not oily for 35 baht. The shop does not have special orders, but you can ask for more when ordering, for example, 1 chicken and 1 rice, the price will increase to 55 baht. The shop owner is good, smiling, and friendly. There is a point collection system via Line. The shop is small but has a good atmosphere and is clean, but there may be a few ants at the counter (I have never seen any ants in the water or food). There are seats both inside and outside the shop.
review_4_text:
Hom Hom Na Cafe (หอมหอมนะ) is located at Male Dormitory 6, Chiang Mai University. It offers a wide variety of Japanese food and drinks that you must try, especially the Karaage Chicken Rice and various snacks, which are all delicious. I personally love the coffee made by the owner, who is very attentive and meticulous in her preparation. The interior is decorated in a Japanese theme, surrounded by trees, creating a pleasant and relaxing atmosphere.
P.S. The owner is very kind and friendly. Feel free to chat with her! 😅
review_5_text: This is a shop that offers a variety of drinks, especially fruit tea, which I personally feel is hard to find. The price is not expensive. The shop is small and cute and minimal. There are inexpensive food and snacks. The service is good. There are points to collect (only drinks) 🥰💞 *The picture shows raspberry tea.

name: GutCha (กั๊ตชา)
review_2_text:
The cocoa is very rich and delicious, I like that you can scoop your own tapioca pearls.
#Katcha
review_3_text: Unlimited scoops of pearls, soft and chewy, very delicious. Too bad there is no coffee menu.

name: ร้านน้ำหอชาย4
review_1_text: There are fresh fruits here

name: ร้านน้ำกะหนม
BAPE CUP
review_2_text: Ordered through Line Man. Good taste, quick delivery, and reasonable price. ✌️
review_3_text: It was so delicious!

name: ROASTO @ MidS CMU
review_1_text:
We ordered an orange coffee and a latte.
Because it's a takeout-only place in Dande, hot drinks are served in paper cups, not cold ones.
The coffee was good.
There's a bench outside in front of the cafe, providing shade, which is perfect for the December weather.
We also ordered peach iced tea, which wasn't bad.
It was Wednesday, and they closed at 4 p.m.
review_2_text:
Let's try a new coffee shop!
The shop is pretty and cute.
The coffee tastes good.
Starts at 40 baht.
The taste is really good!
The shop is located opposite the Faculty of Business Administration.
Under the building of the College of Multidisciplinary Studies (MIds).
The shop has limited seating, but there is outdoor seating or you can take it away.
I'll come back to try the non-coffee menu items, they look delicious too.
review_3_text: The shop's name is Rosto, which we pronounce as "Rosto," sounding quite foreign. The coffee tastes good, delicious, and the price is reasonable. The staff are very friendly.
review_4_text: I ordered a slightly sweet strawberry matcha latte. It was so delicious! ✨🥰

name: Fresh&Mild since 1992 @Acc-BA CMU
review_1_text: Like the branch next to the CMU central food court, the coffee in Fresh&Mild tends to be on the bitter side. Nonetheless it's quiet here, more seats, with options for both indoors and outdoors.
review_2_text: Not bad~ It tastes better when eaten with the food in the cafeteria
review_3_text: Really delicious. The fresh milk is really good.
review_4_text: The atmosphere is great.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious.

name: Uncle Coffee Fresh
review_1_text:
A cafe at the back of the building next to LICMU.
It's cheap and delicious.

name: Blue coffee at Agriculture CMU
review_1_text:
Blue Coffee at Agriculture CMU is a hidden gem tucked into the Faculty of Agriculture at Chiang Mai University. This spacious cafe boasts stunning glass walls, high ceilings, and wooden accents that create a warm, modern farmhouse vibe, all while overlooking experimental agricultural fields and greenery.
It's the perfect blend of cafe and co-working space—ideal for students, digital nomads, or anyone seeking a peaceful spot to sip specialty coffee, study, or relax. The drinks, from The Baristro brand, feature standout artisanal roasts and creative specials in a serene, nature-inspired setting.
Highly recommended for its photogenic interior, lovely views, and productive atmosphere. A must-visit if you're near CMU!
review_2_text: It is located within Chiang Mai University (CMU), about a 15-minute drive from the city center. The cafe features a beautiful wooden interior and exterior, making it a perfect spot for a relaxing coffee break. I noticed many people studying and working here, as it doubles as a co-working space. If you prefer to sit outside, they have camping chairs available; it’s not actually that hot thanks to the shade and greenery. Their signature Blue Coffee is a must-try — I enjoyed it very much!
review_3_text: Came here on a day of heavy rain. The place was full of students studying, and there were barely any seats left. If you’re alone, you’ll likely end up in a corner. Still, the environment is really nice a great spot to relax.The Wi-Fi has a time limit.
review_4_text: Really cute coffee spot. They have several indoor seating and also it’s perfect if you need to do a little bit of work. They have plugs and WiFi is decent. They give you the code once you purchase a coffee. The coconut latte was really good!
review_5_text: Nice and cozy space inside the Chiang Mai university. Love their cold brew and also try the viral soft matcha which surprisingly good. Can be a bit too crowded in the afternoon

name: เมล่อนปั่นนมสด แต่งแตงแต้ง
review_1_text: Fresh but takes minute..
review_2_text: The vendor is lovely, speaks politely, and is always in a good mood. She's never rude or upset, and always tastes the juice before blending it. The taste is great, and she uses good quality fruit. She's my favorite vendor in Chiang Mai!

name: ลินชา กาแฟถุงกระดาษ หลัง มช.
Rotee Parataros
review_1_text: The roti and cheese we ordered wasn't great. The condensed milk used is so less. And the cheese was not spread evenly. Did not get a good vibe from the place either.
review_3_text: Very delicious
review_4_text: Ok
review_5_text: Very very delicious. Brother Singto brought good luck to sell it himself. Hehe 😅 He seems indifferent, but he is very kind. Everything is delicious. If you are looking for dessert, I recommend this shop. 😊 Try it, you won't be disappointed.

name: กาแฟรสนิยม หลัง มช
review_1_text: Very comfortable place for me.
review_2_text: Delicious food, lovely staff.

name: สตางค์มะพร้าวปั่นนมสด
I LOVE COFFEE
review_1_text: The best americano orange i ever had! I love the ambiance, internet is fast and it's clean, airy and quiet. I love the chill music they play as well. The only downside is there's no toilet inside the cafe. You need to walk a little outside to use the building's toilet
review_2_text: Good coffee and great service. Best of all, no American pop music playing! They just have unobtrusive musak.
review_3_text: Pretty good cafe on campus with a workable long table and some outside tables and chairs. The prices are as good as others on campus and it’s good.
review_4_text: Great place for a delicious coffee ☕️
review_5_text:
Clean, bright space to sit and work. Only tried the iced latte (very...strong?) I got too energized to finish even half 😅
I saw groups of students and teachers come while I was here. Mostly quiet and not too crowded. Plenty of parking. Enjoy!

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: The green tea is very delicious.

name: กาแฟเย็นใจ CMU
review_1_text: Excellent. Great taste. Three roast options to choose from. The bubble milk tea is delicious.

name: Duem Dood ดื่มดูด
review_1_text: This concentrated green tea is incredibly delicious and affordable. The best of the best!

name: สไมล์ คอฟฟี่ (Smile Coffee)โรงพยาบาลสัตว์เล็ก
review_1_text: Nice hidden place with nice vibe. A cup of Americano for 25B. It's worth visiting for relaxing your mood.
review_2_text: This is the cafeteria inside the Chiang Mai University Veterinary Hospital. It's the best value for money. Coffee and sandwiches for two are under 5,000 won. The taste is okay, but it's hard to find.
review_3_text: The coffee at this shop is very delicious. The price is only 30 baht, which is a great value.
review_4_text: Inexpensive, accept half payment
review_5_text: กาแฟราคาถูก รสชาติดี

name: Taste Cafe
review_1_text:
I’ve been coming to Taste Cafe for about 8 years now, and I still keep coming back every time I visit Chiang Mai.

It’s one of those places I feel genuinely connected to. The coffee has always been consistent — rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced, just the way I like it. Whether I order my usual favorite or try something new, I’m never disappointed.

The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, great for relaxing, catching up with friends, or even getting some work done. The staff are friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even more special.

For me, Taste Cafe is a must-visit spot in Chiang Mai — a place I’ll always return to. ☕
review_2_text:
Fairly crowded on a Sunday morning around 8:45am, but we managed to get a table for two. The crowd continued to build up shortly after.

Food options are limited, though there’s a wide variety of drinks. We tried the classic shiopan and the shiopan with pork and cream cheese. The classic shiopan was dense on the outside, hollow in the middle, and nicely buttery with a hint of salt — enjoyable.

We had a mocha and a latte; both were decent.

The music was a little loud, but overall it’s a pleasant spot to sit, relax, and people-watch.

Note: credit cards are not accepted — payment is via cash or QR only.
review_3_text: Taste Cafe has a great atmosphere and really good coffee. The must try is the Soft Latte. For non coffee drinkers, there are Soft Chocolate, Soft Matcha, and Soft Thai Tea. The cream topping is smooth, lightly sweet, and pairs perfectly with the coffee. I had been in Chiang Mai for 5 days I went there twice, REALLY LOVE HERE
review_4_text: What a lovely surprise. A contemporary looking spacious open-plan coffee shop with really great coffee, a relaxed musical vibe, prompt & friendly service from the staff and a huge tasty chocolate brownie. Cannot fault it. You must come and get some.
review_5_text: I've been here once, but this place was recommended by my friend, who used to be a regular here during his university days. It's true, the place is buzzing with CMU students and the atmosphere is great. The coffee is good too, but/and the air conditioner is quite strong! Highly recommend!

name: Runecoffee
review_1_text: The best coffee shop in Chiang Mai! It's very recommended!
review_2_text: A very good coffee place. The dirty I ordered is executed nicely, balanced creaminess and coffee flavour. The interior design is modern and cozy. The staff are very friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend 👍
review_3_text:
A really pleasant coffee shop!
The Americano and cappuccino have great flavor! They also offer homemade cakes and cookies.
Highly recommend visiting!
review_4_text: 커피 나뿌지 않음... I like where the shop uses paper lid..less plastic. Only one seat on outside. 55 baht. There are plenty of seats inside. Clean.
review_5_text:
I stumbled upon this place after visiting the copy shop next door.

WOW. friendly service, lovely clean aesthetic and - most importantly - a fantastic cup of coffee for Chiang Mai standards.

They offer light, medium and dark roast. I opted for an Americano w the light roast, which was a little sour and fruity - just how I like it.

This coffee shop makes the cut on my list of places in CM that deliver a truly good, complex coffee. I will be back!

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text:
A quick drinking spot at gas station.

Visited the shop while refuelling the motorcycle at gas station. The weather was pouring rain so I decided to take a sip in here. I ordered ice tea & hot latte. It's quite affordable with generous portion. Nice and okay.
review_2_text: Expensive coffee. The quality and quantity needs improvement. Just because this cafe is easily found at gas stations, it doesn’t mean you overcharge and underserve your customers.
review_3_text: Can pay with credit cards. Nice place, not overcrowded.
review_4_text: Convenient coffee shop of PTT gas station. Get small discount for CMU students & staffs only regular menu. Neither barista nor signature menu serving, just a recipe following cup to sip. Do not expect smiley face when you redeem discount coupon as it's more like a campus refreshment shop. There are always some unprofessional people in business when margins claimed.
review_5_text: Each single time I come to this place, they made a mistake in the order. It's not a language problem since I speak Thai and rarely have issues with my orders anywhere else, it's just they are tremendously stupid. Not recommended place.

name: The 12 Cafe'
review_1_text: This is a hidden gem with beautiful greenery and open space sitting in a corner. Very peaceful vibes and all flowers in the cafe are fresh and well taken care of. Awesome for private conversations and working solo here.
review_2_text:
Very very good cappuccino, lovely environment and a great service. They tried to create a homely atmosphere and they absolutely nailed it. And I‘m gonna say it again: the cappuccino is fabulous!

Total recommendation from my side if you want to spend a little time working or just chatting with friends.
review_3_text: Food is served after 10:30AM. If you come earlier, only coffee and drinks are available.
review_4_text: Nice little cafe that seems to be run by the next-door Pingnakorn Nimman Hotel. The decor is pleasant, and my hot latte was nice.
review_5_text: Coffee was good and the interior is nice but I don't think I would return as it's part of a hotel.

name: October : Japanese Home Cooking
review_1_text: A cozy little Japanese fusion restaurant! Amazing food!! Highly recommended when you’re in Chiang Mai!!
review_2_text: Fantastic restaurant! The beef was very high quality and the service was amazing. Our food came so fast we were so surprised! I’d recommend coming here if you like Japanese food it’s excellent! 5 stars!
review_3_text:
If Google have 10stars, I will give all!
I’m a beef lover that’s why I love this restaurant. Almost every menu are so interesting. My friend and I selected the best 4 menus as the picture. I wasn’t remembered what’s the menu that we ordered but all menus are delicious!
I love beef soup and fried rice with garlic. Both menu are excellent more than I can say!
The restaurant have quite less seating. I think I may suggest you had better call to make a reservation in advance.
In totally I like this restaurant.
review_4_text: One of my most favorite restaurants to go to in Chiang Mai. The beef is so tender and delicious. The pasta was also very good and so was the mango cheesecake. So to sum it up, everything on the menu was great! The price is pretty high but it is really worth it.
review_5_text: Very nice authentic Japanese food. The place is cozy the decoration is simple but the staff is very friendly and they also have coffee and Japanese desserts. I eat here often and recommend it to everyone.

name: ดิ ทเว็ลฟ์
บลูฮาร์ท & มูตะเฟรนช์คอฟฟ์
Tew Cafe
review_1_text: Good food with live music

name: Sonnen cafe
review_1_text:
A perfect cafe that I was looking for! I didn't wanna go to modern cafes because I'm visiting Thailand and I'd like to visit places where give us local vibes. This is the perfect cafe that suits my needs.

The owner is very lovely, nice, and welcoming. Very very delicious latte. I ordered both iced and hot, great choices! Also very cheap price. Only 35 Baht for a hot latte.

It's a small local cafe, but it's got lots of seats. 5 tables inside, little terrace next to the main building. Outside smoking seats as well. I absolutely love the interior too. There's a massage shop close by so why not visit Sonnen Cafe! :)
review_2_text: I went to this café today by accident just because it was so hot outside. What an absolute gem. So chilled and the staff are so friendly. Drinks extremely reasonable. And even better on the tables were signs asking people if they wanted to use social media could they plug in their headphones. If I am in this part of town next year, I will definitely come back. The lady even helped me with my grab taxi when there was a problem.
review_3_text: Not a modern cafe, but delightful staffs and their drinks are cheaper than most of other cafes. I got dirty coffee for 55thb and it’s unique that the milk is frozen in a circular shape. They also have smoothie and other drinks and the prices are much cheaper than other stores as well.
review_4_text: Super cute cafe tucked away on the busy road. Really attractive interior design, little office spaces you can sit off to the side in, and the friendliest staff. Best prices in the area!
review_5_text: Excellent coffee for the value and quality. Double shot is only 40Thb. Located on the side of a busy intersection but the atmosphere (two small enclosed glass rooms) though small, is quite tranquil. However, not an ideal place for group meetings because space is quite confined.

name: Memorize Brownie
review_1_text: Tiramisu taste so bad... Only cheap cream not mascarpone at all. I want to give you 1 star but I don't want to be rude... Recommend You to change this. This is not for sale. Only look good and is big portion. I ordered two boxes and I gonna throw everything to the trash.
review_2_text: A nice little cafe to take a break from the hot chiang mai weather. Drinks are alright, as for the brownie, we prefer the original  as compare to the cheesecake flavour. Matcha is nice and the jasmine tea is refreshing.
review_3_text: Wow! Stumbled upon this place after we had dinner and I’m so glad I did! Their brownies are so good! Which has been surprisingly hard to find here in Chiang Mai. We will definitely be back. The memorize brownie is amazing
review_4_text: I love this brownie kit. So far I have only tried the original brownie. The cream is really delicious so is the brownie. It really does taste like it just came out of the oven if you heat it up. I ordered it on delivery in Bangkok and then realized that my Chiang Mai hotel is right next to the store so I went to check that out. I will definitely order another kit.
review_5_text: Gosh, walked in, place was empty, thinking maybe this was a mistake. Ordered the standard memorize brownie anyway. Was warned the brownie takes ten minutes. By the time the brownie was ready, the place was packed. Then I understood: their brownie is outstanding! Warm, slightly gooey structure, with warmed milk cream... Paired with decent cappuccino. This is truly one of the best I ever had. Well done. If you have a sweet tooth and don't give a damn about calories, macro mix... this is heaven.

name: Cafe Kantary, Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Beautiful and cosy cafe!

Tried their mango cheese cake and Thai tea. I liked the Thai tea, but the mango cheese cake was okay. I would have liked if the cheesecake had a thick base biscuit layer to balance the cheese taste.

Nice cafe to relax at and to enjoy some desserts as they have a variety of drinks and dessert options to choose from.

I also saw people working, editing, etc at the cafe.
review_2_text: Well made, flavorful & strong latte.  Delicious sausage roll (warmed in an oven, not a microwave, so the pastry was crisp and flaky).
review_3_text: I love this cafe! It is actually part of the Kantary Hotel but in a separate area. The pastries are really great, especially the almond enhanced peach tarte. It can get a bit pricy if you're not careful but the service is great and the ladies there are always friendly which makes it all worth it!
review_4_text:
Nov2025. We came here to chill and do some urgent work.
We had macha latte, americano, flat white and a lava cake. It was a nice place.
review_5_text:
Very cute & cozy place.
We ordered pasta & some ice creams.
The pasta was damn good. Infact checked in once again for a repeat order. The ice cream was equally good.
The only thing we did not like about the place was they were very particular about the time & last order due to which we missed trying the pancakes . But then that's a policy matter. So no complains .

name: Chichai coffee Nimman
review_1_text: A hidden gem, delicious coffee always made quickly and with a friendly smile! Beautiful outdoor seating area and cozy atmosphere inside. Prices are the best around by far. I’ve loved their coffee for a while now but they recently added a matcha menu as well and it is truly so good!
review_2_text: The tiny cute cafe shop under the condo and the cafe is good with reasonable price. The atmosphere here is quite cozy and u can work here..I drink hot cappuccino here...
review_3_text:
I really love this little cafe. It’s hidden in the corner of the lower floor of an apartment complex, and it is the perfect spot to relax.

It’s really peaceful, quiet, and comfortable.

Plus the coffee is great. Better than the majority of the bougier spots.
review_4_text:
Cozy and cute café.
All coffee drinks are 60B (hot or iced).
The iced latte is good — it has a flavor that Koreans would likely enjoy.
review_5_text:
This place is located in the same building as a yoga studio.

I stopped by after class and what a surprise 🫢 good cheap coffee.

The coffee smell hit me as I walked in.

It's very small, nothing special about the decor, and the walls are mostly plain. No real photo opportunities. Not a lot of seating available.

The coffee was excellent. The flavors were there, not over powered by milk or sweetness.

I would mark it a 4 star based on decor, but the coffee saved it.

name: Wake Cup Café
review_1_text: A small coffee shop located infront of 7-11 store. The coffee shop looks normal from the outside but their coffee , tea and soda taste very good. The price is a bit lower than average but the quality exceed the price. The waiting time for 1 drink is around 5-10 minutes. You can park near the coffee shop.
review_2_text: A take out only coffee store right in front of a seven eleven. Coffee here is 40thb regardless of ice/hot or type. The portion seems a bit more than other cafes.
review_3_text: Best coffee in Chiang Mai! The place was right around the corner from our Airbnb so we stopped here on a whim- WOW we’re glad we did. I got an iced latte 4 days in a row because it was so good. It’s prepared fresh for you while you wait. I love this place!
review_4_text: Unassuming coffeeshop at the corner of the road, right next to 7-Eleven and Chiang Mai Holistic. Owner Palm obviously takes great pride in his work and during my 10mins of waiting, I could tell he was very invested in making sure of the quality of his coffee. Good quality and reasonably priced (most are just around 40 baht). Was one of my best finds in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: The best price performance ratio cappuccino I have found anywhere. Quality almost on par with Ristr8tto, for less than half the price.

name: ROASTRYN COFFEE BAR
review_1_text:
Recently moved to this new location. Counter seating only.

Great coffee and the gentleman spoke English so communication is not an issue.

My fresh brewed cappuccino was 45baht

Right to 7-11 so easy parking.
review_2_text:
I went there because it opened early in the morning.
The coffee was also excellent.
Thanks to you, I started my morning off right.
review_3_text: All menus are 45 baht, and the coffee is from Chiang Mai, very strong and fragrant (chocolate flavor). The owner is friendly and chatty haha.
review_4_text: I had the orange smoothie coffee for the first time, and wow, it was delicious. The strong coffee and orange smoothie go so well together. The owner speaks English well and is very friendly. I hope you have a great time 👍 👍
review_5_text: Excellent coffee! Great selection and nicely laid out. A very friendly man who puts in a lot of effort.

name: WAN-WI COFFEE
review_1_text: The green tea is delicious! Sweet, creamy, and perfectly balanced. This is the place to go! 🥰
review_2_text: The coffee is really good. The taste is okay, just like in expensive shops. 😆😆
review_3_text:
Today, I'm recharging with an iced coffee from Tom's Coffee ☕️.
I have to say, "It's amazing!" The flavor is rich, the coffee aroma is fragrant, and it's not too sweet.
It's refreshing, perfect for a long workday.
If you're near this shop, stop by and give it a try. I highly recommend it 💯
review_4_text: A cute little coffee bar. The owner is super friendly. The green tea is fragrant and delicious. The peach soda tea is also great. 😋😋
review_5_text: I had the opportunity to try the cold milk. It was very delicious. The sweetness was just right, well-balanced, and the colors were beautiful. The shop was clean and looked very appetizing.

name: Changkham Chiangmai Tea Shop ร้านใบชาตราช้างคำ
review_1_text: Amazing tea shop!! I love this style, traditional Chinese tea service but using tea grown in Thailand. What a cool idea! The owner was very friendly and knowledgeable. I had a great time ☺️🙏🏼
review_2_text:
Tea Shop Recommendation

This tea shop is perfect for true tea lovers. The quality of the tea is exceptional, as the shop carefully selects only rare and premium tea leaves. Each cup offers a rich aroma and a refined taste that reflects the uniqueness of the tea leaves.

If you are looking for high-quality tea made from rare leaves, this shop is definitely worth visiting.
review_3_text: Beautiful new tea shop with local, good tea from Thailand and tea ware. The very friendly owner took all time to serve tea to taste, explain about tea, answer my questions. I definitely come back!
review_4_text: A very wide selection of high-quality products. I recommend it to anyone who loves and appreciates the art and culture of tea drinking. The owner is very kind and very experienced in his craft, and you can also try some of the tea varieties at tastings.
review_5_text: An exquisite tea tasting space and shop (Thai teas, Stingless bee honey, ceramics, and upcoming: coffee and Chinese tea rooms). The owner Tian is passionate, a seasoned expert, and very generous. He is as enthusiastic as a visionary entrepreneur can be. Highly recommended! Thank you, Tian.

name: ก๋าไก่ ชาร์ก่ะแฟร์ เชียงใหม่ Kakai Cha-Ka-Fair
review_1_text: Dry-rice porridge with pork (Serve with signature dip and soup ) 👍🏻👍🏻
review_2_text: It is a breakfast restaurant with a cute corner for checking in. It is like checking in at Lampang. Their dry rice soup menu is very delicious. The sauce is delicious. The fried eggs are full of ingredients. I will come and support you again.
review_3_text: The atmosphere was great and the food was delicious.
review_4_text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and the food is reasonably priced 👍

name: BIG BENNY'S AÇAI BAR
review_1_text: Absolutely love this acai bowl! So fresh, thick, and perfectly balanced — not too sweet, just pure deliciousness. The toppings were super fresh and generous. I’ll definitely be back again! 💜
review_2_text: Awesome Açai and even better staff !!!
review_3_text: Great service, lovely staff
review_4_text: Excellent service, every dish was delicious.

name: Nimman Nest Hostel & Cafe
review_1_text:
I had 3 nights stay in Chiang Mai. Nimman nest was the last night in there. We booked last week ago for this room. The service is really nice. The room is surely to come back and night stay again when we are in Chiang Mai again. Thank you for welcoming coffee.
I hope to see you again in Nimman Nest.
review_2_text:
This is a CAFE with excellent COFFEE and the best VALUE BREAKFAST available in Nimman. Check out the MENU photos. It has AIRCON and power outlets. Chill vibe. It is on the bottom floor of a hostel. I did not stay here. I've only had the breakfast and coffee. LARGE breakfast in the picture is only 99 baht.

Definitely worth it. Choice of medium or dark roast. Also has smoothie drinks.
review_3_text: The girls at the reception are a sweetheart. The rooms are super clean as the bathrooms, one of the best end hostels in Asia!!
review_4_text:
Affordable, reasonable, comfortable with very nice location.
Also,
The owner is very gentle &
Their staffs are very kind.
review_5_text: New place in Nimman. The master bedroom is really nice and the staff is very kind!

name: 4Seas Nimman Coliving Coworking Space
review_1_text:
This is a beautiful clean modern space. The people are nice. I’ve had a smoothies and hot tea from the cafe. Both were quite yummy.
The space is not designed for those with Mobility challenges even though is a new building.
This is why I can’t give it 5 stars. Restrooms are on the first floor only a few steps to the entrance but many meetings rooms for events are on the third floor.
review_2_text:
4seas Nimman Coworking opened around 18 months ago and I have been there many times for meetings and events around blockchain, AI, social goods, bio hacking and many other topics.

It's a fantastic place to cowork from with all the best technology you might need, plus a good cafe and starting a food service for customers.

The team are dedicated to creating a community space for all to use. Check it out and see if it works for you.
review_3_text:
Great place.

This is not a cafe, thus is a coworking spot that is more quiet, it seems to have a thriving community, however I am just in for focusing on work.

No fees
At the time of writing this they only charge for coffees and drinks, no membership cost for using this space.

Tip
They have spare monitors around - first come first serve, if you bring your own HDMI cable you’ll likely get your own monitor, as there are cables missing!
review_4_text: I can't say enough good things about my stay at this coliving space. As a remote worker, having a dedicated quiet working area was a huge plus, but what really sold me was the design. With the living spaces located right upstairs, it was incredibly easy to step away for a break and then get right back to work without any wasted time. The staff were exceptionally friendly and made me feel welcome from day one. The convenience of having everything taken care of—from laundry to cooking—is a total game-changer. This is the perfect setup for a productive "work from anywhere" trip.
review_5_text: I am here at 4Seas for ETHChiangmai. Just the right vibe to work and chill, and participate in events from the local tourist and crypto community. Highly recommend 4Seas

name: Always LOAF U Nimman Soi.17
review_1_text: Delicious at first bite! We had the best experience eating at this quaint cafe. The pastries are light and delightful and not too sweet — very French! And beautifully decorated. The staff were very friendly  too. The cafe offers indoor and outdoor seating, and believe it or not there’s parking for cars one block away. As we were leaving we spotted the certificate from Le Cordon Bleu on the wall, which explains the craft and quality of both food and atmosphere.
review_2_text:
Always LOAF U at Nimman Soi 17 is such a great spot if you’re into good coffee and pastries. We tried the classic croissant and the matcha strawberry croissant, both served warm with a perfectly flaky, buttery crust. The matcha strawberry croissant really stood out. We enjoyed the tartness of the strawberry paired beautifully with the slightly bitter matcha. It was a well balanced and unique combination.

I also ordered a cappuccino with oat milk, and it was creamy, smooth, and generously sized, which I really appreciated. It is a bit on the pricier side, my cappuccino with oat milk came out to 110 baht, but honestly, it was delightful and worth it.

The atmosphere is very inviting, with soothing music and an amazing pastry selection. There were so many options that it was hard to limit ourselves to just two. Overall, this is a must-stop for a quality cappuccino with oat milk and a great pastry when you’re in the area.
review_3_text: Such a cozy place! The staff is lovely, the coffee is great, and the selection of desserts is so huge that it’ll take you forever to choose. We tried the croissant, the lemon tart, and the strawberry cream cake in a container — everything was absolutely delicious! If you mix the warm croissant with the cream from the cake, it’s pure magic. The breakfasts are huge and look beautiful. We’re so happy with everything, thank you! 🙏
review_4_text:
It becomes one of my favorite patisseries in Chiang Mai as it’s baked perfectly with great ingredients and smells so good. Owners and staff are so friendly and give a warm welcome. I had breakfast before (Sourdough with Salmon), which was good. This time I only take away croissants and croissant pops which are my fav now. Croissant is baked beautifully to have a crispy outside while inside so soft.
Located on Nimman Road which is easily walkable from my hotel. It closes on Monday.
review_5_text:
Nice little Bakery style cafe with amazing food and even better coffee. The food was fresh and delicious, the coffee's were top tier and customizable (extra shots). You're not going to be able to just get one pastry!
We got the egg tart and lemon cake and both were excellent, just a bit to sweet for our taste.

name: Nimman Forest Cafe นิมมาน ฟอร์เรส คาเฟ่
review_1_text: I had a thai tea and food:) They were delicious! I had a great time:) All the staff are very kind and friendly. Highly recommend:)
review_2_text:
Hello guys, welcome to everyone.
If you guys come at Chiangmai don’t know how to sleep and can connect this Nimman forest and cafe it’s very g beautiful hotel and sweet cafe..it’s cheaper and get free coffee😍😍
review_3_text: Great coffee, nice atmosphere.  The staff is very nice.
review_4_text: Hidden but worth finding great food and prices friendly workers.
review_5_text: The bedroom is clean, the bed is comfortable, and there are shared male and female bathrooms. The male staff member was helpful. Overall, it's good. It's close to Nimmanhaemin Market, with many cafes and restaurants, including some with live music. The atmosphere is nice, and the price is good. Breakfast is not included. The style is simple and chic loft. There's no parking, so you might want to ask the shops if there is any. There's a cafe downstairs with average-tasting food.

name: STRIDE
review_1_text: best place
review_2_text: A sports shoe shop that also serves good coffee. Although the shop is small, it's comfortable and relaxing.
review_3_text:
It's a shame there are only 5 stars.
If there were more, I would give it full marks.
Excellent service and quality. My deepest gratitude.
review_4_text: There's coffee and shoes.
review_5_text: Lam Coffee

review_2_text: Legend

The owner's hands quickly and accurately create recipes that are perfect for both the kitchen and the dining room.
I pass by the alley near my accommodation every day, and I feel like he's a truly hard-working, kind person.
I hope your business prospers.
I had a coffee latte and milk tea.
The milk tea wasn't overly sweet, but it was delicious.
review_4_text: This shop already has check-in, haha. It's really great. Tao Un iced tea is really delicious. Jamjon. If you want to make a new leaf, you will see a new leaf. I will show you the best of the best, I will show you the best of the best.
review_5_text: ของเขาดีจริงอร่อยจริง

name: ฮันกัง บิงซู
review_1_text:
Chicken was overpriced and only a small bite of meat. Small portion sizes except the gyoza, spend about 350b just to leave still hungry. The food itself was very delicious though. Service was non existent.

The vibe of the restaurant was not good either, but this was at night time. I have been here for bingsu in the day and that is very delicious and well priced, and the atmosphere was different then.
review_2_text: Good Korean shaved ice - bingsu. Wish you could customize flavors and toppings, a build your own. But the watermelon was very good. Kiwi one was alright.
review_3_text: Their bingsoo is 89thb to 99thb for a small size which is good for 2 people after a meal. The quality of the bingsoo is pretty good and I liked it. There are several tables in the AC room, so you can chill here for a bit comfortably as well.
review_4_text: Hands down the best Bingsu in town! Came back 2nd day in a row for another mango bingsu. Fresh, sweet mango cubes. Service is quick and friendly. Prices very reasonably and huge portion, 3 adults split one.
review_5_text:
Verry fresh,
If you miss healthy and tasty breakfast or snacks this is the right place for you!

I opted for bread topped with fresh tomato and cucumber, along with half a freshly sliced ​​avocado and an omelette, all topped with fresh dill.

The Bingsoo is allways a good refresher and I love it with brownie (they bake it fresh and serve you also Kornflakes and chocolatesause with it.

Chilled atmosphere with verry kind Service.

name: Subway - Sandwich Restaurants Burger ร้านอาหาร นิมมาน
review_1_text: Ate here once way back when I was living in Chiangmai and got the sad-looking thing in my picture. Never returned again.. but I read their standard might have improved since then.
review_2_text: Sandwiches are getting smaller by the day!! While being more expensive! Today, my 6" sandwich was about 4.5", this is borderline scammy !
review_3_text: The Turkey Breast sub is light but filling. Fresh lettuce and cucumbers make it taste balanced. Great for a healthy lunch.
review_4_text: Where's the tuna??? Looks like they only put one scoop of tuna (if that) instead of the standard two on a 6" sub. With that being said, everything else tasted fine.
review_5_text: Love that the staff always check if I want extra veggies or sauce. Makes the experience more personal, and the sandwich tastes just right.

name: Wanlamai by Mor
review_1_text: The food was delicious! I highly recommend the creamy scrambled eggs with bacon – it was incredibly juicy! The drinks were also tasty, and the atmosphere was great. The owner was very nice!
review_2_text: The food is delicious and very cheap. The owner is very friendly and the daifuku is very delicious. I will definitely come back and use the service again. 😄
review_3_text: The food is delicious and the portions are very generous. The price is very cheap compared to other restaurants in the Nimmanhaemin area.
review_4_text: Great atmosphere, delicious food, and delicious drinks.
review_5_text: Delicious, good, beautiful and cheap.

name: Roast8ry Coffee Flagship Store
review_1_text:
Santan Latte 100 ฿ , Walking Fox latte art 200 ฿  (2025)

Has English menu, can accept card payment.

Seems very famous place as many local and younger generations.

Dim lighting inside with some house or lo-fi music, it is quite noisy to me.

The latte art is very nice, but I feel maybe I pay 200 ฿ for the skill is not very necessary. I remember the cheapest options are also approaching 85 ฿ for Americano or expresso.

there is electric charge port, and free water.

The place is a hip and vibing, maybe suitable for IG photos.

Good coffee also.

It is a little loud inside but there are seating area outside as well.

Maybe I am just too old for this cafe 🤣
review_2_text:
One of my favorite coffee stops in Chiang Mai. The coffee was absolutely amazing with a large variety of choices. Lots of people at this location so come on off peak hours if you want seats. There are seats inside and outside.

The music may be a little loud if you plan on doing work or studying. Absolute great experience overall.
review_3_text:
Another good cafe in Chiang Mai!
Roast8ry got another store close by, but this is their Flagship store which you can tell.
Its a very fancy design and unique vibe here.
The Staff is very friendly, kind and generous.
My only minus is: the price.
I got a Machiato for 95 baht, which is the size of a normal sized espresso.
Of course this is more a lifestyle product than a regular coffee, tho for that price their coffee should be tasting next level, not average.
But besides that, a very nice coffee i recommend to visit.
review_4_text: Incredible coffee experience! Huge choice of interesting coffee beans, cool cups and beautiful latte art. Love the details that add to the experience, fire playlist, Japanese toilets and insane smelling hand soap
review_5_text: Roast8ry Flagship is clearly designed to showcase professional barista skills, with a menu full of award-winning options and distinct latte art patterns. I ordered a pour-over from their selection, which was served with a nice scientific presentation. While the shop executes the technical side and the service perfectly, the experience focuses heavily on the "performance" of coffee. A solid stop if you enjoy a modern, showroom-style cafe environment.

name: Ristr8to Original
review_1_text:
When I think of best coffee, this is my happy place.

This is an OG of Thailand coffee. The barristras here know their crafts and are themselves coffees addict. Not much words need to be spoken. I don't need fancy place. Just give me a damn good cup of coffee and let me enjoy.

Best dark roast coffee anywhere in the world. If you don't give this a try you are missing out.
review_2_text: With many cafes in Nimman to choose from, Ristr8to has become a firm favourite of mine. I’ve become partial to a Cortado and have to admit I’ve never been let down here. Smooth and strong its made with care and attention. With wonderfully friendly staff, it’s nice to have somewhere I can call my local cafe. There’s a lovely ambiance that allows one to sit back, drink nice coffee and let the world drift by. Based on my own experience I can recommend Rist8to.
review_3_text: Extensive menu with almost every variety of coffee you can imagine. Tried some of the popular favorite and agree that the coffee is good. Pretty chill ambience with both indoor and outdoor seating. They do have a few food options like waffles but wish there was more. Place only accepts cash.
review_4_text:
Hot mocha is a must order. Sg mocha is very milky but theirs is house blend.

This one hits different.

Make sure you finish every single drop before you leave.

The barista here is better than SG one in general. Taste the coffee and you’ll know.

My brother in law ordered the cigaretto and he said it’s nice. You can try it if you want.

If you duno what is what, the menu has the coffee description.

One thing I really kennut is the barista face is way too near to my coffee -.-
Almost breathing into it when doing yo my order: As shown in photo. But whatever.

You can get coffee beans here as well. Haven’t tried it but you can ask the staff for recommendations.

You can even request to smell the beans before getting it.

Atmosphere is just meh, normal cafe nothing special. Enjoy the coffee and move to next cafe.
review_5_text:
There are coffees you drink, and then there are coffees that slow you down.
Ristr8to is firmly in the second category.
The cappuccino here is exceptional — beautifully balanced, with a creamy, velvety texture and a depth that tells you the beans have been treated with real respect. The roast leans toward the complex rather than the aggressive: rich chocolate notes, a gentle nuttiness, and a clean finish with just enough acidity to keep things lively, not sharp. You can taste that this is coffee made by people who obsess over details — in the best possible way.
What really elevates the experience, though, is the vibe. Sitting here in Nimman, you’re surrounded by a mix of young locals, creatives, digital nomads, and curious travelers. There’s a quiet energy to the place — laptops open, conversations flowing, tourists pausing mid-walk for “just one more coffee.” It’s the kind of café where you don’t feel rushed, and you don’t feel invisible either.
I found myself doing what this place seems designed for: sitting still, coffee in hand, watching the world pass by. Traffic, footsteps, snippets of languages, sunlight shifting across tables — all of it framed by a damn good cup of coffee.
Some cafés are about caffeine.
This one is about presence.
If you’re in Nimman and you care about coffee — really care — this is not optional. ☕

name: Mont Nomsod Chiangmai
review_1_text: Quite crowded during night time and we had this at 9pm with lots of table occupied. Order the pandan and egg custard toast which is 2 of their famous one. Taste is very good and pair with their famous chocolate milk or pink milk is out of the world. Service is pretty fast less than 5 minutes I have my order ready. You can sit outside or inside to enjoy your toast. Overall worth it and price is not expensive.
review_2_text: We were walking on the street and saw crowd. Just tried without having any expectations. It’s surprisingly very good. Love it. It’s more than just a toasted bread.
review_3_text:
This was a nice little stop for dessert after dinner. They had the usual and traditional flair of steamed and toasted bread with variations of toppings.  There was a steady flow of people so the wait for a table and the food isn’t long. It faces the main road on Nimman so it was a nice little area to people watch after a long day of walking.
Nice stop to fill up the space you saved for dessert.
review_4_text:
Seems to be very popular for locals (most of the customers here were speaking Thai)

Tried the steamed bread w pandan custard. Tasted quite good but a tad too sweet for me.

I’d like to try the other items on their menu next time.
review_5_text: I walked in curious because of the long queue , and left regretting it. The cleanliness was unacceptable , hair on the floor, sticky and dirty surfaces. Dirty plates next to us were left on the table for over 20 minutes. When the staff finally came to clean our table specifically , he looked annoyed, picked up previous customer trash , and didn’t even bother wiping the table.  We had to clean it ourselves with tissues ! The service was shockingly rude , easily the worst I’ve experienced in Thailand. On top of that, the chairs were so uncomfortable they gave us back pain. As for the toast , completely normal. Nothing special to offer.

name: KLĀY cafe
review_1_text:
I haven’t tried the food yet but I’ve come here several times for drinks and the atmosphere and I love this place.

The staff are super friendly and cool and the interior is beautiful minimal, warm brown/beige tones, very Japanese-inspired. Perfect for anyone who appreciates calm, aesthetic cafés. It has indoor and outdoor seatings.

It’s a small space but very well located in the middle of Nimman. A great spot to stop by, refresh and just enjoy the vibe.
review_2_text:
KLAY Café is such a beautiful hidden gem in Chiang Mai. The moment you step in, you’ll feel the calm, minimalist vibe — warm wood tones, natural textures, soft lighting, and thoughtful interior design that makes the whole space feel cozy yet modern. It’s the kind of café where you just naturally slow down and enjoy your meal.

We tried a few dishes and everything was beautifully plated and full of flavour:

Smoked Salmon & Eggs Toast
The toast was soft and buttery, topped with generous slices of fresh salmon and perfectly runny eggs. The mix of pickles, tomatoes, and passionfruit on the side added a bright, refreshing balance. Loved how satisfying yet light it was.

Thai Beef Salad
A colourful bowl with tender slices of beef, sweet oranges, juicy tomatoes, red onions, and a nice kick from fresh chili. It’s refreshing with a nice balance of sweet, tangy, and mildly spicy — great for brunch or a hot day.

Besides the food, the café also has a small curated retail corner with skincare and lifestyle products, adding a boutique feel to the place. It’s a lovely spot for brunch, a slow afternoon coffee, or even just to chill and enjoy the aesthetic environment.

Overall, KLAY Café is definitely worth a visit if you’re in Chiang Mai — delicious food, beautiful ambience, and a very inviting atmosphere.
review_3_text: I came to Klay Cafe for breakfast because I wanted something healthy, well-priced and delicious. I got the colorful tropical smoothie bowl which was perfectly balanced in taste and texture. Sometimes bowls can be too sweet, too runny, or sometimes - too cold. This one was just right. However, the tropical bowl wasn’t the highlight…it was the coffee. I had one of the best flat whites I’ve ever had. It was silky - like sipping a coffee liqueur without the alcohol or overwhelming sweetness. I’ll definitely be back to try some other things on the menu.
review_4_text: The best breakfast we had in Chiang Mai. I think the pictures speak for themselves but they have a great range of dishes in a beautiful setting. The service is slightly slow but it doesn’t take away from the food and the atmosphere. Great coffee and French toast!
review_5_text:
I’d heard several people recommend this place, so I had to check it out, and I honestly don’t understand the hype.

The place was packed, and we ended up sharing a table with three different people during our time there. The chairs and table were wobbly, and even the slightest movement shook the whole table and almost spilled the drink. The food took ages to arrive.
The food itself was fine - nothing amazing, nothing terrible.

The good parts? The prices are good, the staff is very friendly, and they clear tables quickly.

name: Charin Pie
review_1_text:
What a sweet and peaceful oasis in busy Nimman!   The staff are so kind and the espresso was delicious!   I liked that they offer light, medium and dark roast choices.  I had a medium roast espresso and it was perfectly smooth and chocolaty.   So many neat spots to sit and relax.   We chose the  inside back room which was cool and really quiet!
The Christmas hats everyone wore made it that much more fun.
Thank you for a great first experience after years of staying near by.
review_2_text: The desserts all look amazing, but need to try the coconut pie! The coffee is amazing as well. There are a lot of seats at the place, so great to stop by with friends for some coffee and desserts. The place is kept pretty tidy and the staff was friendly as well. Great stop to visit while in Chiang Mai’
review_3_text: You can’t go wrong with any of their pies.  My fav combo is lemon pie and coconut meringue pie that gave mw a good touch of sweet & sour. I also like its crust.  Was known the cafe was established for long and still continues baking and selling more flavors.
review_4_text:
Pie was great. I ate Lemon pie and coconut pie. Many people take out their pie. Many kinds of pies you can meet.
Coffee was soso. Tea was a little bit blend. I don’t recommend it.
Not many seat inside but there’s air conditioning. Atmosphere was cute.

But inside there was so many mosquitoes. So it was awful. If you're going, make sure to use mosquito detizer. I ran away because I was hit by a mosquito because I didn't have it.
review_5_text: Very nice coffee place to make a stop while walking in the area, with veriaty of cakes. We took the chocolate, which was great. There are nice places to sit outside, but people may smoke there. There are more places inside, air-conditioned.

name: Starbucks Nimmanhemin Soi 9
review_1_text:
Nice service with good quality coffee
There are many tables and seats. If you like to sit privately there is the 2nd floor space
review_2_text: The staffs here are nice and polite. Fluent in English. 4 parking spaces for car . The old man at the parking lot is a bit annoying though, moody all the time .
review_3_text: I’m visiting Chiang Mai and have been to this branch twice during my trip. The staff are very nice, helpful, and friendly. They recommended the drip coffee, and it tasted amazing. The atmosphere is cozy, with charming northern-style decorations. Highly recommend!
review_4_text: Disclaimer that I'm not a Starbucks fan. I gave it another try again here because the location looked nice and I wanted to know for sure that there's plant milk. It really is a nice place to sit and the staff are very nice. I ordered a hot Houjicha Latte w soy milk, no sugar. The drink was more on the warm than hot side, not very flavorful and really sweet, maybe sugar was added? Also really big size even for smallest order.
review_5_text: Best Starbucks in Chiang Mai. The staff are very nice, helpful, and friendly. The way they make the brewed coffee is different than usual and the coffee tastes great. Highly recommended!

name: Toffee Roasters
review_1_text:
THB70 for the quickest Iced Americano in the world. While it doesn't seem like there would be a lot of space for you to stay, it's highly recommended for those who need their coffee right away and have somewhere else to go.

I'm not fancy enough to go connoisseur with beans so whatever the house blends is fine with me.
review_2_text:
Great coffee, we tried 1 hot filter & 1 dirty. One of the best dirty coffee i've tried during our trip in Thailand (i tried at least 20 dirty in every coffeeshop 😆).
The hot filter is clean & good acidity.
review_3_text: Great place to experience high standard quality coffee. They are knowledgeable of coffee culture beyond just serving coffee beverages, and we talked about Ethiopian coffee varieties. The almond orange cake was fresh and full of flavours. Congrats!
review_4_text:
I visited this café in September 2025 and had a hot latte, which turned out to be excellent. At that time, they were using a blend of Brazilian, Thai, and Ethiopian beans, and the coffee was truly delicious.

The flavor was rich, the temperature was perfectly managed—not too hot and not too cold, just right for a good latte—and it was really smooth. Inside, the atmosphere is very minimalist. I don’t think it’s very suitable for working on a laptop, as the tables are quite low and small. But it’s definitely a nice spot to chill.

They play music, serve bread and snacks, and there are even beds. So I recommend this place to anyone who just wants to enjoy a great latte without overthinking it.

For more travel tips and hidden gems, check out my Instagram: @hichem_airways
review_5_text:
Rating: 100/10!
The service and staff are super lovely! 🩷

This café offers free water (love that 😆).
Drinks are good:
•	Green tea — mild and a bit seaweed-like, not bitter.
•	Orange juice — just okay.
•	Banana bread — tasty and not too sweet!

Reasonable price and highly recommended!🫶

name: 7 Senses Gelato
review_1_text:
I’ve been to 7 Senses Gelato many times, and it’s one of those places that I always find myself coming back to. 🍨 The shop offers a wide selection of flavors, from classic options to creative seasonal ones. Every time I visit, I try to discover a new favorite, though I have to admit that most of the flavors are quite sweet for my personal taste since I don’t eat much sugar. However, my company — whether my friend or boyfriend — always enjoys them a lot, so it’s a great spot to share something sweet together.

The shop provides free drinking water, which I find very thoughtful, especially after eating gelato. The staff are a bit shy but always kind, polite, and ready to help. The atmosphere is peaceful and quiet, perfect for sitting down to enjoy a slow afternoon in Chiang Mai.

The location is convenient but not ideal for car parking since the street is quite small; however, it’s easy to park a motorbike nearby. I usually order one or two scoops each visit.

Overall, it’s a charming little gelato shop that serves great flavors with a friendly vibe. Definitely recommended!
review_2_text: Absolutely delicious gelato! There are so many tasty flavors to choose from — everything looked amazing, and the ones I tried were creamy, rich, and full of flavor. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. The staff were friendly and patient while I was deciding (which was hard because everything looked so good!). The place itself is cute and inviting, perfect for a little treat on a warm day. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re in the area! 🍦💛
review_3_text:
Nice place for gelato. They have many flavor for you to choose and enough space to sit indoor or outdoor.
The ice-cream portion is big and cup filled accordingly.
review_4_text: Delicious ice cream. We were recommended to come here and are so happy we did. Hazelnut and mixed berry were delicious. Understand there is another shop selling their brand in the Old City (Riflesso) which we will be visiting as it’s much closer to where we are staying.
review_5_text:
WOW!!!! Amazing gelato, owner is Italian and the gelato is excellent quality, really unique and delicious flavour combinations.

I was hoping to try the famous ricotta and caramelized fig but they had sold out. I had the ricotta and pear instead, which was excellent, as was the strawberry cheesecake. I also got the salted caramel (normally my favourite) but I thought it was lacking in flavour a little (compared with the amazing taste of the other flavours. They also had take away tubs available in a freezer.
Great environment, indoor and outdoor seating.

I’d love if they had small scoop options as I wanted to try lots of flavors but the scoops were too big!! I’ll just have to come back!!

name: CHARLIE (ชาร์ลี) Thai Tea - Nimman Soi13 (Grab&Go)
review_1_text:
Came by specifically to try their Thai tea and was genuinely impressed. The quality exceeded expectations, ordered less sweet, with well-balanced flavors that aren’t overly sweet — exactly to our preference. Standout picks were the Charlie (Salted Caramel Cold Foam Pour Over Thai Milk Tea) and the Soft Latte Thai Tea, both smooth, fragrant, and nicely layered. We went with the staff’s recommendations for type of tea and honestly, you can’t go wrong with any of them.

The outlet itself is small and minimal, quite cool inside, with only a handful of chairs available indoors and outdoors. There was no queue when we visited, making it ideal for a quick grab-and-go. Perfect for picking up a drink and strolling around the area. Definitely worth a try if you’re a Thai tea fan. I prefer this outlet compared others.
review_2_text: Cute store with a cozy atmosphere. You get to choose from their selection of tea leaves and if you order in they allow you to mix your own Thai iced tea as well which makes for a great experience! Smooth balance of flavour and if it’s your first time in Thailand then I would suggest getting 50% sugar as I’ve noticed their default sugar level is higher than normal.
review_3_text:
A must-visit for tea lovers, especially if you love Thai tea! They offer a wide variety of teas from different parts of Thailand, and you can customize how dark you want your tea and the sweetness level.

I highly recommend the Satun tea (4 mins, 75% sweetness), it’s rich and flavorful.

They also have a great selection of coffee, but the Thai tea is the real highlight. If you’re a Thai tea fan, this is the place for you!
review_4_text:
This staff member at this bubble tea shop is an absolute disgrace to Chiang Mai's service industry. From the moment we started ordering, she was impatient and had a terrible attitude. The drink she made was almost entirely ice — there was less than 80ml of actual liquid in the cup.

When I tried to raise the issue with her, she remained unfriendly and unhelpful. She kept her back turned to us the entire time, completely unwilling to communicate. Another staff member had to step in to talk to us and then relayed our concerns to her. Her response? She couldn’t have cared less and said, “Go ahead and complain about us if you want.”

Absolutely unacceptable behavior and a completely disappointing experience.

I know it's impolite to post someone's photo publicly, but she also showed no respect to us as customers! As a tourist and a foreigner, I don’t understand why she treated us differently. So disappointed!
review_5_text: Randomly bumped into this small booth, it comes with various selection of Thai tea and make it on the spot thus you can choose the sweetness. I really like it without sugar to get the tea aroma fully.

name: Manifreshto Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: This restaurant was in a very convenient location and seemed full of tourists. I liked the idea that the food was farm to table. We had both the regular and beef Benedict’s along with a healthy vegetable and fruit smoothie. You could tell everything was made with high quality ingredients and the smoothie tasted very good. The Benedict’s both tasted really good, but not mind-blowing. Price is a bit higher than other spots.
review_2_text:
I walked around my neighbourhood while i came across this restaurant. I saw from the outside something which hyped me really up: „free range eggs“, and you can taste that these chickens actually got some sunlight and could enjoy life.
Besides that they look for their ingredients, real cheese, real meat, real eggs,… their staff is super friendly and kind.
The food was also very good. You can create your own „breakfast“ which is pretty convenient.
10/10
review_3_text: Nice quality. Good service. But it's just too expensive. 265 THB for an English breakfast. In Hua Hin the same breakfast is 149 THB. I like this place but the prices keep getting higher. Why? Thailand inflation is very low.. 2%!
review_4_text:
Good cafe for all day breakfast & they also served some german food, some local beers & all of it looks good but I don't try it. I came only in the morning for breakfast.

You can create your own breakfast & mostly is very good.
Baked potatoes: 5/5
Crispy bacon: 5/5 (well cooked, crispy & flavourful)
English Breakfast Sausage: 4/5
Croissant: 3/5 (a bit chewy & not so crispy)
Scramble egg: 5/5 (cooked perfectly, still moist, creamy & balanced)
Omelette: 5/5 (perfectly cooked).

The environment is also very nice, you can seat indoor or outdoor. The temperature in Chiang Mai is perfect for this kind of setup. It's also a great place to hangout with small circle
review_5_text:
Top-tier brunch spot in Chiang Mai 🍳🥗

We found ourselves at Manifreshto every morning of our stay and it was always a win. From the fresh juices and smoothie bowls to the all-day breakfasts and paninis, the ingredients tasted real and the flavour was next level.  ￼

The atmosphere? Laid-back, friendly and comfortable. The team genuinely cares about what they serve, you can see they’ve put real effort into sourcing clean ingredients, and the mood is just easy-going and welcoming.  ￼

If you’re in the Nimmanhaemin area and want a place where you feel looked after, with great food, great service and good vibes, this is it. Will definitely be coming back 🙌

name: Blue Coffee At Nimman
review_1_text:
Finally some good coffee again like being back in Vietnam!
Even Thailand has also a great coffee culture, you can feel its more for faran (foreigners), but this cafe here is a game changer.
This coffee, especially the medium beans, taste like a real yummy coffee!
Cappuccino hot for 80 baht is not cheap but consider that taste and its a well worthy coffee.
10/10 definitely recommend with a nice outside seating.
review_2_text: Great spot for a coffee. I tried their blue latte which was very good. I like the vibe here and definitely I place I would come back to for another coffee. The service is great too
review_3_text: Decent coffee shop on the main road in Nimman. The coffee is ok. Not the best one in the neighborhood but ok. The staff was very nice. They have indoor seating as well as a terrace. Prices are ok. Standard for the area. I paid 80 Baht for a cappuccino. Looks like they have several places across Bangkok and Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: I am a regular at a few cafés in the area, Blue being one of them. It is open until 1 AM which suits me perfectly when I just feel like being out and around other people at night. Staff is excellent. I really enjoy the coffee, maybe my favorite in the area. It’s also got a bit of a unique vibe with a nice mix of local young people, students, and westerners like me.
review_5_text:
Great little coffee spot! ☕️

Had an iced black coffee for just 65฿ – super refreshing 🧊Also tried the piccolo, which was smooth and well-balanced. Loved that you can choose your own beans – such a nice touch!

Bonus: they had decaf options too!! 🎉

Will definitely be back! 😊

name: CHARLIE THAI TEA x KAME KAFE - Nimman Soi9
review_1_text:
Go grab a tea here.. like yesterday 😅

I'm usually not a fan of expensive "Instagram cafes", but this one is worth the price tag!
They have a wiiiiide variety of different teas (including green tea, red tear, black tea, Cylon etc) all regionally sourced within Thailand.

They also have a ton of super nice looking and even more delicious Thai tea creation! You'll chosose yiur own tea, vrewing time and sweetness. Really worth testing it out

Unfortunately, they do not offer non-dairy milk options (no oat, almond or other plant based  milk), otherwise this would have been an easy 5 stars for me
review_2_text: This is the best Thai tea I’ve had in Thailand so far! When you order the Soft Latte Thai Tea, you can choose the type of tea leaves you want, which makes it even better. The tea aroma comes through gently in the drink, and it tastes amazing. I also added an espresso shot to the Mint Choco Latte, and it was incredibly good too! If you’re a mint-choco lover, I highly recommend it!
review_3_text: Recommended by our tour friend who got milk tea here for every day of her stay in Chiang Mai. Ordered their OG milk tea with 100% sweetness for 70 THB and it was good.
review_4_text:
Cute cafe in the Nimman neighbourhood that serves up incredible Thai milk teas.
They have the option to customise which tea (which you can also smell before you order), sweetness level and brew time to decide how intense the tea flavour is.
We went with the servers recommendations and opted for the OG and the Charlie with the Chiang Rai Gold and Songkhla tea options. 50% sweetness was more than enough for us (probably would choose 25% sweetness in the future). Would highly recommend both drinks as a cute relaxing cafe date.
review_5_text:
My experience here was honestly frustrating.

When ordering, the staff appeared disengaged and unhelpful. The counter area is extremely cramped — it barely fits one person to look at the menu and smell the tea leaves. The shop only has 13 seats (7 small tables), and there is no clear system for seating. Some customers look for seats first, others order first, but the staff provides no guidance at all.

As a result, after we ordered, we had nowhere to sit. This confusion also led to our drinks being served to the wrong table — they were given to customers who ordered after us but found seats first. After a while, the staff realized the mistake and simply brought the drinks over to us. Honestly, would you feel comfortable drinking something that had already been sitting on someone else’s table????

There is also no self-service return area for finished drinks, and staff were not proactive about clearing used cups. When we finally sat down, two of the six seating groups were occupied by new customers sitting with leftover cups and trays still on the tables — that’s one-third of the seating area. At one point, a customer had already finished their drink but continued occupying a table while four people waited. The staff made no effort to coordinate or manage the situation.

The drinks themselves are okay, but the purchasing and seating process is chaotic and poorly managed. There’s really no reason to endure this kind of experience for a shop that serves “okay” Thai milk tea. Compared to Khiri Thai Tea in Bangkok, the difference in organization and customer experience is significant.

name: JULIET.cnx
review_1_text:
Cute store with lovely flowers in the front. Greek yogurt was also nice but absolutely tiny portion, so don't go expecting a meal size - more of a snack.

Had an orange americano which was also really good! Recommend if you're looking for something light.

Only a small seating area
review_2_text: Great hangout spot, a hidden gem. The croffle was amazing, should've asked for more honey 😔. Staff is really friendly too. 10/10 would visit again for the yogurt.
review_3_text: Greek yogurt croffle is gooddddd. The store is so small. There are a few table outside but the weather is too hot to sit chilly. The vibes are good despite the weather. There are free parking lots near the store.
review_4_text:
Such a lovely café
I ordered a berry glazed smoothie, and it was super fresh and nice!
review_5_text: One of the best Greek yogurt bowl I’ve ever tried, delicious and amazing price, I think this is a very special Greek yogurt because of the taste it’s kinda different from others, in my opinion this one is even more delicious, the place it’s beautiful, very peaceful and cozy, it feels like home, the girl who works there is very friendly and makes the bowls very quickly, I completely recommend the place❤️

name: The Barisotel by The Baristro
review_1_text:
Walked into this cafe and instantly felt like I stepped into a dream. The all-white theme is surreal and calming, perfect for both relaxing and working. I had the English breakfast, which was genuinely authentic and satisfying, followed by a cappuccino and an espresso shot both were spot on.

I spent around 3–5 hours upstairs working and the vibe was quiet, peaceful, and very Instagrammable. Though the Wi-Fi lagged a bit at times, the overall experience was still excellent. Would totally come back for the aesthetic, the food, and the chill atmosphere.
review_2_text:
THIS IS FOR THE COFFEE SHOP

A hostel and coffee shop combined - something you see quite often in Nimman, and very convenient. They offer a good selection of different coffee roasts and also sell beans to take home. I tried one of the pastries as well and really enjoyed it.

There’s seating both indoors and outdoors, with the outdoor area being my clear preference. The atmosphere inside feels a bit stiff, but overall it’s a nice spot for good coffee and a relaxed break.
review_3_text:
I come here almost every day. Work gets done very efficiently, and the staff are extremely kind and thoughtful.
The Wi-Fi connection is stable, and the white-themed décor gives it a stylish feel.
The entrance has a distinctly Japanese aesthetic, and the matcha is served in the traditional Japanese style, making it feel as though I’m in Japan.
review_4_text:
Beautiful Spot, Disappointing Food Quality

I visited today with a friend after high recommendations, and while the venue is absolutely beautiful and highly photogenic, the food was a big letdown.
Our items were stale and tasted old. My friend’s scone was dry and crumbling. My House Roti was mainly whipped cream and didn't taste fresh. The quality was far below cheaper street food options. We left both plates unfinished.
Sadly, I won't be returning unless the quality of the pastries and desserts drastically improves
review_5_text:
Review the café, not the hotel.
Food itself was quite good overall.
Staff can improve in the service itself though and even make a buck out of it. Adapting small things that are not on the menu won't hurt really

name: The Larder Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: We came here 9 years ago after hearing about this amazing local eatery. We're back and the food is still top notch! The same staff are still here as well as the delicious food. Do not understand why such low ratings because this , hands down, is THE best place for breakfast/lunch in Chiang Mai! Their fruit is fresh and mounded on your plate. The Raspberry/White Chocolate scones are freshly baked and once they run out, they're gone! The atmosphere is simple yet tasteful. Soft jazzy/contemporary music in the background to add to ambience but nothing overpowering as to disturb a quiet conversation. Their food is edible art! People have complained about the prices and I don't know why. If you tried to find this quality of food and portions, you'd pay twice as much for less quality! DO NOT let the reviews sway you!!! Cone and taste why this is where you should eat!!!
review_2_text:
If you ask any real local person they’d say this place is the best place for brunch! Ive been coming here for years and the food + service have always been top notched.
