My to go is the parmesan scramble egg because it’s super rich & creamy so much so that it melts in your mouth sometimes. You wouldnt be able to find a better egg than this. Their veggies and tomatoes are fresh & sweet too.

Other bake goods are also nice. Their scones have the half scone half biscuit texture which for me is really addictive haha

Anyway, it’s the most perfect place to start your day in CNX!
review_3_text:
Super Fluffy crunchy on the edge pancakes with fresh fruit are a showstopper light sweetness and topped generously with vibrant seasonal fruits.

Perfect if you’re craving something sweet without feeling too heavy.

The scrambled eggs with avocado toast and salmon on the side is a standout. The eggs are soft and creamy, the avocado perfectly ripe, and the smoked salmon adds that extra boost of peanut butter Chocolate protein shake putting a cherry on top.

Zucchini toast is an exquisite menu to try out on a side note.
review_4_text:
Tasty dishes with fresh and quality ingredients.

Still one of my reco places for brunch in Chiangmai.

French toast with mixed fruits today was the best!!!
review_5_text:
So good I had to come back twice!
Portion was huge, coffee was good, the cats were a nice surprise. Just a cool cafe around the neighbourhood ❤️

name: Ji Matcha Tea Time
review_1_text: Beautifully decorated to give off a feeling of tranquility. Lots of unique and pretty matcha bowls displayed. The staff could speak English and patiently introduced their various desserts. I tried the matcha coconut milk and sakura ice cream which felt like I was eating white chocolate. They added a nice touch to the dishes as well, pairing the matcha with a sweet gummy.
review_2_text: A lovely Japanese teahouse with a Beautifully authentic decoration that creates a very calm and relaxing atmosphere. They offer a good variety of Japanese teas and matcha, all well prepared. The Japanese-style sweets are delicious and pair perfectly with the tea. A great place to slow down and enjoy a peaceful moment 🍵🫖💕
review_3_text: Experienced a real premium matcha with coconut milk. Tastes rich for the match and the coconut milk is absolutely match with it. Shop environment and atmosphere here really feel in japan. Staff is good in service as well. Definitely a hidden gem in a crowded next to the high street. Worth to visit to enjoy the f&b here.
review_4_text:
Beautiful and cute little cafe, extremely serene and peaceful. Great for enjoying real high quality matcha. Best matcha i’ve had ever!

Great high quality ingredients, desserts and tea.

They also have cats 🤗
review_5_text: Really lovely Japanese place, with a large area to sit. The seats are low down in true Japanese style. Food was really well presented and tasted good. Overall a nice experience and a break from the hustle of Thailand.

name: Jungle De Cafe Nimman จังเกิ้ล เดอ คาเฟ่ สาขา นิมมาน
review_1_text: Very large nice modern cafe/restaurant with a plenty of nice tables. It would be nice for group gatherings, working, and studying, or having meetings. This place also has a variety of food from Thai to western and pizza as well. It is really nice and relaxing, but it’s very empty so you wanna come take a look. Coffee here is around 70THB.
review_2_text:
Popped in for an iced coffee, and it was one of the best we've had!
The cafe is beautifully decorated, and there is plenty of space to sit whether you prefer inside or out.
The staff are super friendly, and the cakes looked scrummy!
The stars of the show were definitely the cats!
We left feeling so chilled and happy!
review_3_text: I was searching a cafe where I can lay down and rest. When I went there not lots of people on weekend. They kindly turn on ac for us. I ordered greentea(great smell like chatramue), lemon tea(brown lemon syrup). Price was reasonable to visit. Chair is comfortable to seat. now they have only one place to laydown inside. Outside have alot but hot. One thing that they don't care babies, it was very loud. Not recommend for people who wants to study or take a rest.
review_4_text:
Nice cozy place for coffee.
Looks like there is a bar on the second floor.
review_5_text: Brought my family here for lunch. Food is good. Reasonable prices. Very friendly staff. Most like is the lady boss.

name: Krema Cafe
review_1_text: Good coffee shop with nice pastries. The place is quite small. Only a few tables inside and a couple more outside. It feels a bit odd sitting inside. Maybe just because I was by myself when I came here. And it was super quiet. But prices are fair and the guy who worked here was very nice. And I liked the lemon tart.
review_2_text:
We came here specifically for the pistachio tart, and left highly satisfied. While it's on the pricier side for its size, we found that the quality of the flavor was worth it. The flavor is rich and you can take your time to savor it.

As for the drinks, the cheese cream strawberry latte was really, really good too. It tastes like a strawberry shortcake in liquid form and had real chunks of strawberry. The coffee was just okay for me, but it worked well as a palate cleanser to help appreciate the sweetness of the tart.

For an upscale dessert, Krema is an absolute yes.
review_3_text: Absolutely lovely café with a calm, elegant atmosphere. The desserts are beautifully presented and taste just as amazing as they look—fresh, well-balanced, and not overly sweet. The coffee is smooth and perfectly crafted, making it a great pairing with the pastries. I really enjoyed the cozy, minimalist décor; it’s a perfect spot to relax, catch up with friends, or enjoy some quiet time. Friendly service and great attention to detail. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: This place is so good. I highly recommend the treats here, not too sweet and so fresh, but for the coffee a bit too light for me anyway, I can't wait to go back and try so many other treats
review_5_text: I ordered the Pistachio Tart — it was rich and flavorful. I also tried the Strawberry Latte, one of the shop’s signature drinks, and it had a wonderfully smooth taste. The atmosphere in the café is clean and relaxing, with a soft white-toned decor.

name: Nimm Cafe & Brunch
review_1_text: During my stay in Chiang Mai, I ate here almost every day. The main dishes were delicious, the atmosphere was quiet, and the drinks were exquisite. It's a perfect place to read and relax. ☺️
review_2_text: Easily my top 3 favorite spot in Nimman, Chiang Mai! Great coffee, good food and snacks. Love the space and seatings are very comfy. Staffs are very friendly and lovely. Highly recommend ❤️
review_3_text: Lovely atmosphere and breakfast choice for mornings , outdoor seating environment is nice, calm, bird chirping , lovely staffs, decent choices of menu! Will be my go-to for breakfast spot!
review_4_text: The food is delicious and serves are so sweet,they even give us a free croissant before we leaving.🥺🫰💗
review_5_text: Nice place to visit, Sweet and beverage: rich taste love it!

name: Pai Yan Yai Coffee
review_1_text:
I randomly found that cafe on my morning walk, and i am glad i did! Its a cozy little cafe/co-working place with a decent menu and coffee!
The Cappuccino was great, 80 THB.
As you can see on the other pictures, they also have a lot of food, especially their Thai food should be very nice!
The Staff is very welcoming and kind. Overall a great and not to pricey experience, recommended.
review_2_text: Great place for breakfast, lunch, coffees and other drinks. You can also work from here. The staff are very lovely and friendly! Much try their signature coffee! We visit regularly and would definitely recommend.
review_3_text:
This has quietly become my favorite coffee spot in Chiang Mai. And I don’t say that lightly.
The service is genuinely stellar. Not the performative kind. Just kind, attentive, human. The sort of place where you feel remembered, even if it’s your first visit.
The atmosphere is calm without being sleepy, and it’s clearly a local favorite. I’ve had coffee sitting in, coffee to go, rushed mornings and slow ones, and it’s always exactly right. If you’re looking for a place you’ll end up returning to every morning without really questioning why, this is it.
review_4_text: Deliciously prepared fresh, healthy foods with freshly brewed coffees & teas. Lots to 💕 @ Pai Yan Yai. Friendly service team and totally fair prices!!
review_5_text: Good warmth place + nice cake and Juice - good for working if you are looking for a quiet place ,sitting 2nd floor there is no music you can concentrate on work - all chairs cover with pillow very comfy  - Thank you for warm welcome - Had aa very productive meeting here.

name: yesterday cafe'
review_1_text: One of the best-designed cafés in Chiang Mai with truly excellent coffee. The space is beautifully curated and thoughtfully detailed, and the location is perfect. The owner is incredibly sweet and welcoming. God is truly in the details here—don’t miss exploring their hotel right next to the café as well. A must-visit!
review_2_text:
Apologies! I did not get a photo of my strong, flavorful Americano this morning due to savoring every sip from start to finish. Only afterwards thinking oh damn, I didn’t get a photo.

I’m always looking for coffee at 7 AM and this, so far,  is the best I found open early in the Nimman area. Small patio in front perfect for sunny mornings.
review_3_text:
Me and my husband come here twice a week, and we truly love this coffee shop. It’s the best one open at night, and we always enjoy our visits.

However, today we ordered our usual drinks — the hot chocolate and the almond chocolate — and unfortunately both were disappointing. The cocoa drink was tasteless, and the almond chocolate had very little chocolate flavor. This has never happened before.

As regular customers, we really hope the owner pays attention to this issue because we don’t want to lose such a great place.
review_4_text:
Something magical about this place because I was mysteriously pulled in while walking past the cafe. ❤️

I knew it was going to be good as soon as I saw the design, the architecture, the old wood, and the coffee bar inside. I was immediately greeted by the manager who was very helpful and informative. I don't usually choose coffee bars, but this one is special. After 5 minutes of learning about their slow drip process and the different coffees they offered, I chose the Ethiopian bean.

They take their time and bring you what you need to enjoy the coffee. The Ethiopian blend was amazing. Exactly as described. I drank it without any sugar or cream. I had to have the chocolate croissant.

The seating is comfortable. The atmosphere is relaxing and great for meetings, couples, or by yourself. You don't hear a lot of street noise if you sit inside. I can tell that it would be fun to sit outside in the evenings when it's cooler and you can watch people walk by.

I definitely found a great cafe and will come back. I highly recommend this place if you are picky about coffee and want to experience something different than your average coffee shop. The cost is worth the visit. You are paying for quality and ambience as well as for great service.
review_5_text:
Coffee is good, they made us fast &delicious .
But oh well, came to have a breakfast with literally Noone in cafee besides us . How you can  cook scramble eggs for 45 minutes ?? Was already thinking to leave and get food from 7/11 ... rather than waiting for sooo long for simple scrambled eggs with toast and they didn't make a toast in the end ... I belled on a bell they have for 2 minutes before someone came out to talk to me

name: Go Green Café & Restaurant
review_1_text: We stopped by accident and so happy we did. A small cafe restaurant with a fresh and friendly menu, especially easy for tourists. My husband had the omelette with pork which was light and fluffy and I had the Pad See Ew with mince and instant noodles. It was fresh and delicious with a good spice. They have a great selection of sodas and also cold beer. Definitely try this place when in Nimman
review_2_text:
We ordered the afternoon special Twin set - a meal and a drink each. The mince pork rice dish is so nice. I like the Pendan & Lemongrass tea, so freshing and '100% guilt-free'. A good place to relax for a while.

We like the restaurant so much so we are back the second day for a different dish on the Twin set deal. A bit chilli but we loved it.
review_3_text: Been here a couple of times for coffee including to work. Very chilled environment with decent WI-FI. The coffee though is amazing. Flat white is up there with New Zealand or Australian quality.
review_4_text: The pictures speak for themselves— the food here is rockin. Just soooooo tasty. You can just taste the wok fire in it, super authentic and delicious made with real skill. They keep their menu simple because what they do, they do exceptionally well.
review_5_text: Very nice spicy vegan tofu meal! Forgot to take a photo before eating :/ Friendly service, free WiFi and love the music

name: Rich Mellow
review_1_text:
Here you go 🤍
Little Marshmallow, this sweet girl, is very cute and super friendly.
I would highly recommend the cocoa.
The shop’s cocoa is perfect for those who truly love a rich, intense flavor.
🌸💮🌸
review_2_text: A unique coffee with a cute mascot! It made my trip even more meaningful. Stay healthy, Mellow!💙
review_3_text: Cozy cute cafe in Nimman. Staffs are friendly and the cafe has variety of options for coffee and tea.
review_4_text: The atmosphere was friendly and calming. The sweetness of the Thai tea was perfect. I will bring my daughter and wife back to visit the wallaby. Very cool!!
review_5_text: Newly opened small coffee shop in Nimman area. They are offering 100 cups of free coffee per day only during the opening days of 25-27 Dec, 2025.

name: Nine One Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
If you search for a little cafe to work in, that could be your place.
They got a very unique design and its pretty cozy to take a seat and relax a while.
I got a cappuccino for 85 baht, not the cheapest, but still alright.
They offer you a variety of beans 🫘 for that.
Definitely a chill vibe here.
review_2_text: One of the best tasting coffees ☕️ in Nimman.  As you know, traveling is a challenge when you cannot find a great cup of coffee!   Nine One delivers on the simple promise of fantastic coffee.  The cafe is charming.  Sit out front and watch the world go by, inside, or in the back garden.  My absolute favorite is the medium-dark roast.   Beautifully prepared by the friendliest coffee staff in the city.  ♥️ ☕️
review_3_text: This has been my go to cafe in Niman area and it’s simply amazing! Lovely staff, delicious food and affordable prices 💚 definitely recommend! The only thing is that they only accept cash.
review_4_text: Very good ice coffee. Chilling cozy coffee place to relax with nice coffee in Nimman Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: I tried the coconut coffee and a plain hot latte, and enjoyed both. The two women working were friendly and spoke English. Prices were good. Menu is fairly basic but the coffee is solid. They also sell minimal food (waffles and eggs), coffee beans, and some merchandise. Very cute spot with large windows and natural sunlight. Also has outdoor seating. Free WiFi and a water station for customers. Would return here!

name: Hang & Craft
review_1_text: Hang & Craft is such a lovely hidden gem. They serve great coffee and delicious matcha with red beans, beautifully presented and full of flavor. What makes this place truly special is the free painting activity you can sit, relax, enjoy your drink, and paint at your own pace. The atmosphere feels creative, cozy, and inspiring, perfect for unwinding or spending quality time with friends. A wonderful spot for both coffee lovers and art lovers alike. 🎨☕🍵
review_2_text:
Please keep existing, place as such! So cozy decor and the fun part is u get to painton a wooden little piece with a drink.
Cute 😚 definitely a cloud to hang ... for as long as you want ☁️
review_3_text: Came in expecting to sit down for a coffee and relax, but unexpectedly painted one of the wooden blocks. Would highly recommend if you are in Nimman area. Great selection of drinks as well.
review_4_text: This is a coffeeshop with a theme: handicraft and leather works. The atmosphere is quite nice. Coffee tastes good. Some of the cakes are quite nice. Service is good as when they messed up one of my orders, they immediately changed it. The macadamia cake is a must try. Parking spaces available in front of the shop.
review_5_text:
Lovely coffee and handcraft place but not ideal if you’re looking for a place to work.

The overall atmosphere feels wonderful, creative and peaceful. I especially loved the natural materials (wood, leather, plants) everywhere. It feels like being outside in nature. Lovely for a change compared to white, modern other places.

All over the shop, you can find handcrafts and other handmade products. If you’re into DIY, that place will trigger your curiosity.

It’s nice for a change to work there. Working from the couches can be nice for a while. But if you’re looking for long time work (half a day for example), there more suited options in the neighborhood.

name: FRIENDS CAFE
review_1_text:
A small, cute café located right in the heart of Nimman, just in front of Stay Collection Hotel. I ordered the coconut coffee and it was surprisingly good! My friend tried the Thai-espresso and it was also very nice and flavorful.

Even though the café is right by the main street and there’s a bit of noise, you can still talk comfortably — though it might be more suitable for a quick grab-and-go. Overall, I really enjoyed it and would definitely come back again!
review_2_text:
Nice little coffee pop up shop.
Its always pretty full, i mean you have 4 seats, and yes they are likely to be full.
Still a great little cafe especially if you just want to to grab to go.
Only minus, it is a bit pricey in my opinion for such a small place.
review_3_text: Had a Matcha Latte and a Matcha Latte with strawberry 🍓 Both were really nice! The matcha was smooth and not too sweet. Service was friendly and welcoming. Will definitely come back!
review_4_text:
Seriously loved this spot! Got the Americano (medium and dark roasts) and the coffee was so good, legit flavor and perfect for a quick boost.

The staff super friendly and welcoming.

It's a small coffee stand but they have a nice little chill area out front. Great vibes for a quick break.

PS. You'll have to find street parking, so plan accordingly.
review_5_text:
Simple outdoor cafe, order a latte and boss just ask to pay whatever you want.
Nice way of doing business and customer will value it by the quality.

The latte was nice, accurate temperature, nice note, smooth. I almost finish it within 1 mins I have it

name: Bangpun coffee bar
review_1_text:
It’s a chill place, quiet most of the times I’ve been there, with good indoor space and even a few tables in a walled-off garden.

The coffee was really good and the chocolate confectionery is to die for. They have a good amount of locally sourced chocolate, too, and the price is right.

Internet is fast too, so it makes for a good space to spend a couple of hours
review_2_text:
Wow 🤩
Discovered a new coffee place n the coffee is fantastic!!

Excellent service n beautifully designed coffee shop. The deserts are so good especially the chocolate cookies!

Without a doubt we will be coming back here every time we visit Chiang Mai!!!
review_3_text: This cafe could work great like a coworking space. Unfortunately, it lacks plugs to charge laptops. I recommend this improvement to the owners if they want to attract more customers.
review_4_text: I got ice cappuccino to go here and it is very good. This store is tiny and only for take aways, but it is not bad to try if you want to get a to go coffee. Most of their coffee are 55THB does not matter it is hot or ice.
review_5_text:
Beautiful little cafe and chocolate shop.
The coffee and chocolate are both high level.
Defo recommend

name: On the way cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Thai milk tea and coffee are good in quality with very affordable price.
There are 3 types of coffee beans you can choose for your cup of coffee: light roast, medium roast and dark roast.
I don’t like the bitterness much so my preference is light roast.
35-40 BTH/ drinks.
Owner is very nice too.
You can buy to take away or you can sit at the store to drink.
review_2_text: Best value take out coffee in this area only 35thb for any coffee including cappuccino or latte and many more. You get to choose the roast level of the bean and the process looks professional as well. There are some small seats, but it’s better to get a to go here.
review_3_text: Great coffee at a decent price with friendly service! This air conditioned cafe has 3 coffee strengths to choose from (light, medium, strong) and offers interesting coffee combinations. For example, the lychee coffee was yummy, as the sweet lychee flavor blended well with the slightly acidic notes of the coffee.
review_4_text: Amazing coffee for a great price, lovely kind service, and rad music. Waited out the rain here and loved it, definitely recommend
review_5_text: Better than expected for 35 THB coffee. Also can choose the coffee bean, light, medium or dark roasted. Better than some famous brand here.

name: MIDDLE 11 - Acai bowl & Brunch
review_1_text:
Came to Middle11 Cafe for brunch and loved how well-rounded the menu is. I had the pancakes and an eggs croissant, but they also offer healthy smoothies, fresh açaí bowls, and breakfast sandwiches perfect whether you’re craving comfort food or something lighter.

The space is pretty, calm, and ideal for a slow morning. Staff are friendly, and the Nimman 11 location is super convenient. A lovely little spot for brunch and chill time in town.
review_2_text:
I have eaten here multiple times because I really enjoy the acai bowls! Very good value and flavors!

Easy to communicate as they have the menu on boards and you can point, buy everyone is very friendly.  Cash only here no cc are taken.

Very worth the stop over!
review_3_text: I got the refreshing açai bowl from here and it’s very filling and delicious. Definitely come here if you want something refreshing like a smoothie açai bowl or even healthy food!
review_4_text: Very comfortable little diner spot. Friendly staff with a nice bench seating or window window table. I  asked what they recommended and the  açai bowl “refreshing” did not disappoint. I also got French toast with bacon and bananas. They grill the bananas, that was nice.
review_5_text: Cozy cafe serving well presented dishes. Staff was nice. Acai bowls and breakfast options both are good but quite pricey (250-ish) for the small quantity you are served. The place will give you a free drink if you provide a Google review so I would guess lots of reviews might be skewed.

name: Sway CNX - Rooftop Artisan Coffee (No more smoothie bowls)
review_1_text: Super cute café! The rooftop view is absolutely stunning, perfect for relaxing or getting some work done. The vibe is cozy, the drinks are good, and it’s a really nice spot in Nimman to chill and enjoy the scenery
review_2_text:
We came a little before 6pm, the couple before us were able to order coffee but when it was our turn, the staff said we could only order alcohol now. My friends before me were able to order mocktails but when it was my turn, the staff said they did not have mocktails 🤨🤔
It was a very confusing experience. We did not see any signs about ordering time so I'm not sure what's the rule here.
The view was nice, the drinks were mediocre.
review_3_text: Great 10/10 coffee and even greater place to work on your laptop. 5 floors up, it’s a secret haven with a lovely team. Music is the perfect vibe to relax and work to.
review_4_text: There is no lift, you have to take the staircases to go up. But it's still worth! Perfect place for the remote worker.
review_5_text: Having “coworking” in the name of the place may be a bit of stretch, l since there are only a few good tables inside. The quality of the drink is good and I like their latte especially the thing is you have to walk up 5 floor to get here and that’s a bit of work already.

name: Pop Up Tropical Café
review_1_text: Even Moo Deng enjoys to sit, relax and take pics here... 😁
review_2_text:
Thank you so much for all you kind for mango sticky rice and & the surprise for us

Beautiful decorations and nice service 🙏🏾
Eric

—————

Many thanks for the great and amazing food. And the mango sticky rice - so tasty. What a beautiful surprise 🫶
CHABA (Eric’s friend from Berlin) 🌺
review_3_text: Amazing ice cream and amazing sticky rice
review_4_text:
I love this cafe, the juices & food 😋

The corner for this cafe is very good and nice to take your drink in this cafe

Every day, I sit in this coffee for an hour
review_5_text: Fried rice here everyday 😋 the best

name: The Spot Cannabis Dispensary | ร้านกัญชาเชียงใหม่ Cannabis shop Chiang Mai
review_1_text: My favorite spot to smoke in the Nimman area. Great staff and lounge (on the 2nd floor). Just don't play the music too loud :D
review_2_text: Very relaxing chill space for stoner and helpful staff who can advise me in choosing the product . His rolling artwork are badass too.
review_3_text: The best spot in chian mai no doubt! Selection is top notch. If you care about the quality, come here 👌🏻
review_4_text:
The Spot CNX held a Farmers Market and we were one of their vendors at the event. This location attracts some very friendly customers who enjoy community and aren't afraid to show support to the vendors by purchasing their high quality products.

If you ever have the chance to sell your wares within this location at an event or perhaps you were thinking of hosting your own event let me say from first hand experience this location and the facilities within this dispensary are first class.

White Labs Thailand sold completely out of product 5 hours into a 6 hour event. We could not be happier with the result and look forward to being a part of the next event.
review_5_text: Don't worry. They got you. Nice quality buds. Great staff. I recommend this for cannabis enjoyers.

name: N11 cafe&maisonette
review_1_text: The coffee shop is decorated very beautifully. Upstairs, there are very clean and beautiful rooms. I came to stay without expecting anything, but it turned out to be much better than expected. The owner was lovely and kind enough to lend me a motorbike to drive. 🥰🥰🥰🥰 I recommend coming to stay here. Coming from Bangkok.

name: Stoic cafe & Brunch
review_1_text: Decent coffee shop. The sandwich and bagel we ordered were good. The coffee is a bit flat though. Nothing special. They have indoor and terrace seating. Indoors is nicely decorated. But the music they played was a bit of a turnoff. Especially for breakfast. It felt a bit like a touristy beach bar.
review_2_text: Stoic is a very bright and welcoming café, perfect for a relaxing break. I ordered a French crepe with Nutella and a caramel cappuccino, and everything was absolutely delicious and well prepared. The quality of the ingredients really stood out. The staff were kind, friendly, and attentive, which made the experience even better. I would definitely recommend Stoic for a great coffee and dessert in a pleasant atmosphere.
review_3_text: A charming, small Scandinavian-style coffee shop with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The minimalist interior feels cozy and calm, making it an ideal place to unwind or enjoy a slow morning. The bagel is a standout — fresh, flavorful, and thoughtfully prepared. The scrambled eggs are incredibly delicious: soft, creamy, and perfectly seasoned. The coffee is excellent, rich in flavor and clearly made with care. The service is friendly and attentive, which really elevates the whole experience. A lovely spot that’s absolutely worth visiting
review_4_text:
Great coffee and matcha but the food is a hit and miss. We tried the salmon avocado toast (so good!) and the avocado egg toast (meh - was very undersalted).

The place is cute and boutique so they charge more than usual places. Parking is a challenge on is street so try to walk or bike it.

Come here for the coffee!
review_5_text: wandered in based off the enticing photos. Small shop with ac and limited, outside seating on some small uncomfortable stools. Prepare your translation app and be prepared to wait a while. Enjoyed my cappuccino but honestly all the food fell short. I ordered avocado egg bagel and it was so bland and the bagel so dry. Copious amounts of salt and pepper was needed and it still was flavorless… I tried to revive the dish by ordering extra tomatoes 35 thb and feta 40 thb. The food does not taste as good as it looks! Definitely pass on this place, there are so many better places at this price point with better food, ambience and service.

name: ALL BLACK COFFEE
review_1_text:
🐱☕ Best place in Nimman if you're looking for delicious specialty coffee and a place to chill.
This spot has been my second home for months — not only thanks to their flavorful black coffees, friendly staff, and relaxing outdoor space, but maybe mostly because of Bobby: the sweet, adorable cat you’ll usually find on her favorite chair, often in a yogic position and deep sleep.

You can choose from various blends from around the world. Many are single-origin, with info about the washing process, altitude, and bean type. I preferred the hot Americanos: they’re made so well! A perfect way to really taste the beans and take your time to simmer with your coffee.
review_2_text: If you’re a true black coffee lover who enjoys bold flavors, loves exploring beans from different origins, and wants to chill in the relaxed morning vibe of Nimman — ALL BLACK COFFEE is definitely one of the must-visit spots in Chiang Mai. ☕️🔥
review_3_text:
☕️All black: Simplicity is the best👍🏻
This tiny hidden coffee shop sells only americano with a selection of local and imported beans. Prices vary from 50 to 100+ baht. I tried their Khun Chang Khian for just 50 baht, and the taste is worth more than its price👍🏻✨
review_4_text:
Good coffee, cute cat.

Recommend if you like specialty coffee. The espresso has been well-made both times I've been there, not over- or under-extracted, and they have a good range of beans from around the world.

It's a small place with mostly outdoor seating. There is a discount for to-go drinks if you bring your own cup.
review_5_text:
Simply the best coffee spot in Nimman. I love black coffee, and their quality is truly top tier — you can taste the difference. It’s incredibly refreshing in the morning.
My little son also loves playing with the owner’s black cat, who is just as chill as the café vibe.
If black coffee isn’t your thing, you can still order it and add milk at home . I usually drink half straight and turn the rest into an iced latte.

name: Diciotto SlowBar Coffee
review_1_text: I always walked past that little cafe, but today i went inside and it was a good decision! Compared to others close by, which are charging same or even more, he is the one which is definitely worth it! I got an Machiato Espresso for 80 Baht, not the cheapest, but the way and the quality of it, makes it worth it! The owner, i guess a older thai guy, is very friendly, professional and polite! I definitely recommend coming here since its like an Vietnamese coffee experience! 10/10
review_2_text:
A hidden gem where Japanese precision meets Italian art in the world of coffee. Every cup here is crafted with elegance, care, and passion. Master Ohm is not just a barista – he is a true artist, elevating the experience of coffee to something memorable and unique.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with beautiful music that perfectly complements the slow bar philosophy. From the rich aroma to the balanced flavors, every sip feels like a journey. If you love coffee, this place is a must-visit – not just for the drink, but for the artistry behind it.
review_3_text:
Good vibe to relax and chill while enjoy the boss preparing the coffee...
Espresso is made with Flair manual coffee machine
Love the setup and music
review_4_text: There are many cafes in Chiang Mai, but everything in Diciotto is perfect. I can feel the barista’s expertise and passion for coffee. I ordered a cup of pour-over with light-roasted beans. The coffee has a rich taste, which really impressed me.
review_5_text:
The barista here takes his craft very seriously and pours a lot of love into his brewing.

He uses manual devices, so your coffee can take time. Hence the concept – slow bar. The quality of coffee that comes out of it is top-notch.

I ordered the special dirty coffee. More than the taste (which was great), I loved seeing him prepare it.

It's a small cafe with only about four small tables. And the WiFi isn't great either. So it's not meant for coworking but rather enjoying the coffee over conversations.

My only complaint is with the menu design. It's ridiculously tough to read anything on it. As a designer, I'd be happy to help him out with it.

name: Kafong Kafe CNX
review_1_text: I had a great experience here. The staff are super friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. The shop feels clean and welcoming, and the products are high quality. Everything was explained clearly, and the service was quick and easy. Definitely recommend this place!
review_2_text: Great vibe here, a lovely place to come chill out. Amazing drinks and snacks would definitely recommend.
review_3_text: I was strolling around and found this hidden shop at the end of Soi 17 Nimman. It's an old-school cafe, but what's special is that they have delicious Albero ice cream. I've had it in Bangkok before, but now they have it in Chiang Mai. It's delicious! I'll definitely stop by again.
review_4_text: I love this cafe so much! The chicken pops are delicious, the cakes and drinks are also tasty, and the prices are affordable. There are lots of photo opportunities. It's a peaceful place to relax, work, or just chill, and the air conditioning is wonderfully cool.
review_5_text: There are so many menus. 🤤

name: CAFE DENIM And Brandnameshop
review_1_text:
My first bad review in Chiangmai after 3 months of living here. I have been to many places, both expensive and cheap places with amazing signature coffee tastes but this was the worst experience I had anywhere in the world. Chiangmai has really good cafes and baristas that are artists with really good coffee blends. Anyhow, I ordered a coffee  called dirty coffee, and tastes horrible to be honest I couldn’t have more than 2 sips from it. However, I rarely complain, if something is not suiting my taste, I just let it go and move on. But when I asked to pay, the barista asked for 160 TBH. I never paid this much for coffee here.

Absolute rip off.
review_2_text: The signature dirty coffee is really delicious. I love having a quiet cup of coffee while taking a walk around Nimmanhaemin.
review_3_text: The Dirty here is very delicious. The taste is very unique. You must try it.
review_4_text: The coffee is very delicious. The seller is friendly and fun to talk to.
review_5_text: Must come and experience it.

name: KongCafe
review_1_text: A beautiful and peaceful place with both a café and a massage shop
review_2_text: Very nice place. Seems very new and peaceful.
review_3_text: It’s perfect for laptop work — very relaxing!
review_4_text: I happened to stop by a Korean supermarket and found this japchae, a Chiang Mai-inspired dish. It's been a while since I've had a sweet latte.
review_5_text:
The atmosphere is great.
The music is beautiful.

name: Coco Corner
review_1_text: Tried their 350 baht Aloha Set! Mango sticky rice, coco mango pudding and coconut milkshake are so delicious!!! They sell Linen/Cotton clothes too, there’s a boutique upstairs. Cozy environment, can chill here after a walk nearby. Will definitely revisit if i come to Chiang Mai again!
review_2_text: Wonderful place, everything I’ve tried was super nice, ambient music, friendly stuff. Mango and coconuts very very yummy. The only thing is there is a commission if you are paying with card. So cash is better or the 220 BHT fee applies.
review_3_text:
There’s ac inside!

Nice clean spot with chill music, also sells linen clothes and small trinkets/coasters/artisanal Siamaya chocolate.

The coconut milkshake (99 THB) I got had a pleasant, fresh coconut taste that wasn’t icy as it was blended properly. Took maybe 10 or so min for my order to come out.

The older lady speaks some English and offered nice service.

They take credit card with an additional 3% processing fee.

Will have to come back for the pandan custard toast!!
review_4_text: You will love it, we ordered the signature "Aloha Set" with Coconut Ice Cream, Coconut Smoothie, Coconut Pudding, and Mango Sticky Rice.  just delicious.
review_5_text: I tried their mango smoothie with half mango fruit diced - take away. Really refreshing and the mango was super sweet too. What a nice dessert after dinner and something to enjoy on my walk back to our hotel.

name: RK Cafe x Looper&Co.
review_1_text:
Very friendly, small cozy spot.
Coffee was ok for me. Had a piccolo.
review_2_text: A hipster coffee shop in Chaingmai with selection shop inside.
review_3_text:
Super hipster cafe in the Nimman area.

The coffee is quite good and the price is reasonable. You can sit outside.
review_4_text: The taste was more than I expected. Quite good quality and kind staff :)
review_5_text: Coffee fix with some creative offering on the menu.

name: Cafe N.Kee 37.5
review_1_text: So chill! The owner us super nice. And you can pet the cats

name: SIP & REPEAT by TeaTales
review_1_text:
What a great little tea house!
They have a wide selection of teas and as well coffee. It is very quiet and calm. The indoor seating got a great vibe and you can also enjoy your tea out front. They also make a decent coffee. I even got a free tea! The staff is so friendly and welcoming, as well the little fat cat, very nice!
review_2_text:
Stunning, great coffee and tea spot run by an absolute angel.
Cold brew oolong and coffee on point.
Service lovely.
Nicely priced.

Also a great selection of wines.
My go to spot.
review_3_text: I was looking for a good tea shop as I can’t drink coffee. Here, the lovely, cozy shop where a lady with a beautiful smile welcomed me :)
review_4_text: Classy place for a traditional hot tea lover - good selection, attentive service, cozy space for work. We especially enjoyed the sweetness of brownies with our slightly bitter green sencha. Tea was superb. If it's too late for a coffee, this is a great place to spend a quiet evening with an aromathic cup of tea people watching.
review_5_text: Has a nice selection of tea, both hot and cold. There's a table outside if you wanna smoke. Overall, an enjoyable experience.

name: Café Amazon Nimman
review_1_text: If you want a quick coffee avoid coming here the endless queue of Lineman and GRAB getting takeaway orders for lazy people means a 20 minute wait. It’s a joke the manager here has no idea
review_2_text: Give this hidden away Cafe Amazon a try. Certainly the best Iced Chocolate I had . Great Wifi, cosy and friendly service.
review_3_text: One of my favourite cafe in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: Grab and other delivery take absolute priority here. I was the only customer in the shop, standing at the register, face to face with a staff member, who completely ignored me for several minutes. Kind, polite behavior of customers are ignored here. If you want to order, you might have to be aggressive, confrontational, and make some noise to get their attention.
review_5_text: I love aunty Aoy so much. She’s very patient

name: GRAPH/XAU
review_1_text: "Just visited the new café on Nimman Road in Chiang Mai, and it’s a standout! They offer excellent coffee and a unique feature—forex trading services. It's a great place to enjoy a drink while staying on top of the markets. Definitely worth checking out!"
review_3_text: There is no such place
review_4_text:
It is only 7:18pm Sat. CLOSED....

PLEASE UPDATE YOUR BUSINESS HOUR
review_5_text: Happy hours.

name: Sugar Plump! Nimman
review_1_text: Really good ice cream! Found this after going for a meal and struggling to find an ice cream place that was open and a reasonable price - but Sugar Plump delivered! The salted caramel and peanut butter flavours were amazing, free toppings as well!
review_2_text: Good ice cream. We tried the marry me (i.e., maple + blueberry) and apple sorbet and the flavors were unique and delicious.
review_3_text: Good for one who is craving for SUGAR. Topping are free-flow. We tried strawberry cheesecake and Matcha.
review_4_text:
Thai Iced Tea Ice cream with grass Jelly is a must try!! Stumbled upon this place randomly on a night when it was raining really hard & the sweet young man let us come inside and wait until our grab arrived.  Came back a few days later to thank him & also try the ice cream!!   Hands down the best Thai Iced Tea ice cream! Which is rare!

All the other flavors were good too but the Thai Iced tea a must try!

Very clean and good energy kind of ice cream shop!  Hidden gem!
review_5_text: We walked around Nimanhemin area after dinner and just bumped (literally tripped) in front of this tiny cutie ice cream place. Best yet, they have five tiny scoops option which you can try five flavours. It's really a great nice idea for someone like me who struggle to finish big scoop. You can later try something that you like in big scoop. We tried coconut, strawberry, lemon, Thai tea and grass jelly and caramel. All of them are totally YUMMY!!! We will definitely come again.

name: Juice's Me by Waasu
review_1_text: Very fresh fruit and vegetable juices. There are many recipes, each with different health benefits. The shop was originally located in Nimmanhaemin Road. Now, you can find us at Tops Green (Kad Jing Jai).
review_2_text: This smoothie is so rich and delicious, and right now it's 50% off! Such a great deal!
review_3_text: The smoothies are very delicious. The owner is kind and friendly. The staff are also lovely.
review_4_text: I've never had a smoothie this delicious before. If you come to Chiang Mai, don't miss it!
review_5_text: A small shop but the products are interesting, delicious and beautiful.

name: Saded Cafe'
review_1_text: This was the first place we had something to eat during our first trip to Thailand. The pineapple rice meal I had was delicious and there was so much of it that i couldn't finish it all which is rare for me! There was a varied menu from a full English breakfast to waffles & fruit. For the three of us the total bill was £15 which included two full set meals (main, accompaniments, fruit platter and hot & cold drinks) and dessert waffles with a cold drink. The complimentary water was topped up at least 6 times before our glasses were empty and the waiter service in general was excellent. Lots of fans to keep you cool and very modern, tasteful wooden decor made it a delight to look at.
review_2_text:
our tenth meal in CNX，and it is the worst

we order pad thai and american breakfast

the bacon is uneatable like paper，we ask to change another one but still the same

pad thai is too sweet and undercooked

service is good though
review_3_text:
Delicious pan cooked eggs with a selection of sausages.   Good latte.

Cafe seating is on an elevated terrace along a peaceful Soi in an otherwise busy Nimman area.
review_4_text: Reasonable price with big portion, so if you are not a big eater, you can share the portion. A good place for breakfast or brunch, I didn’t get to try other dishes on the menu though. Fast service, thoughtful staff.
review_5_text:
Opens at 7am. One of the earlier breakfast places in nimman. 230 for a full English. Very good portion. Fast service , friendly staff

Only concern was there was a crazy amount of grease.

name: Ray Coffee
review_1_text: Oops, made a mistake in coming here, but was nearby for lunch and thought I would have a quick cup. Must have caught them on a bad day. Only 3PM, but door locked when I first arrived. Staff opened it, the place was empty but for two staffs. Staffs completely unfriendly, cold, rushed… no welcome, no warmth, no smile. Seemed like it was an inconvenience for a customer to walk in. Got the coffee order wrong (Americano, nothing too tricky). Then brought the correct coffee, but the taste wasn’t to my liking.  No food options. No music. No vibe at all (well, there was a cat, so maybe that counts for something, though he also seemed uninterested in guests)… perhaps just having a bad day
review_2_text: Most of the coffee start from 50thb here. The seats are a bit limited, but there is a few workable tables. There is a construction going on right next to this cafe as of January, 2023 so it gets super loud. This place is well located and reasonably priced.
review_3_text: I had the mocha on ice and the Irish coffee. Both very good! For those two and iced latte I think it was 270. Latte and mocha were like 65 each.
review_4_text: They do very yummy bread, had just been baked when I ordered - pumpkin bread was delicious. Also got the biscoff brownie which was good but more of a cake consistency and taste rather than rich brownie.
review_5_text:
while waiting for the check in hostel so I order breakfast here..
the two cups of coffee are using medium roast, but the taste on Caffè latte little bit bitter-creamy and americano little bit sour-bitter, they are so good..

the foods: butter croissant is good and healthy banana cake is soft and sweetness from raisin

this is my first time in chiangmai and get the affordable coffee shop here is Ray Coffee

name: Yellow Cafe
review_1_text: This cafe is located in a nice coworking space in the center of the city. Their drinks start from 100thb, so it’s not cheap, but if you have friends or business partners working at this coworking space, it’s a good spot to wait while having a good drink. There was an event going on at the time of my visit and they gave me good free food and that was nice.
review_2_text: The Caramel Macchiato is delicious, I have to come back for more.

name: Rosie&Willow cafe
review_1_text: Afternoon treat 😊

name: TYT - Take Your Tea
review_1_text: I recently visited this newly opened matcha and tea spot and tried the Uji Clear Matcha. The drink was delightful—smooth, rich, and full of authentic matcha flavor. The café itself has a lovely decor, making it a comfortable and worthy work and study here a good place to relax. Definitely a great spot for matcha lovers!
review_2_text:
A beautiful, relaxing little tea shop with great atmosphere and delicious tea. The staff are pleasant, welcoming and knowledgeable.

If you want somewhere to read a book, do some work or enjoy some company while sipping some great tea, this is the place.
review_3_text: Amazing tea shop, can easily get work done , wifi is great and awesome board games ! Came two days in a row ! Love the osmathus tea 🫖
review_4_text: I came here because I wanted something other than coffee. The person working was very kind and friendly, recommending a really nice oolong tea which was prepared with care. The interior is decorated well and overall the atmosphere was calm and relaxing. A great place to relax and read in the morning. I would definitely come again next time I am in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: the tea here is amazing! and it’s the perfect place to get work done. also the staff is so friendly and always has a smile :) have been here a lot and will keep coming back

name: VOLKS G Nimman 17 : bagels and coffee
review_1_text:
Volk’s Bagel is such a great little find in Nimman. The entrance is a bit easy to miss since you have to go inside the G Nimman Hotel, but once you find it, it’s totally worth it.

It’s a small space with mostly stool and bar-top seating, but it’s comfortable and nicely air-conditioned. They also have fast Wi-Fi, which makes it a solid spot to sit and enjoy your food.

I tried their orange espresso and really liked it… refreshing and different in a good way. For food, I ordered the sausage and egg sandwich and everything tasted amazing. The bagel was perfectly chewy and fresh, and the flavors all worked really well together.

They also have a ton of specialty bagel options, so I’m definitely coming back to try more next time I’m in the area. If you’re looking for a great bagel sandwich in Nimman, I highly recommend this place.
review_2_text: Very good bagel. so much variety to choose. but i came here with 7 people, and there’s only one staff here. so it took a bit time to make the bagels. The staff is very nice by the way.
review_3_text:
Not kettle boiled = not a true bagel in my books. 😐

They do hand-roll and bake them fresh, which helps, but only if you eat them right there while they’re hot. Because once they cool down, it’s basically a savory bread donut that’s lost its will to live. 😅

Takeaway or delivery ends up a bit dense and bready rather than chewy, like bread that got tired halfway through trying to be a bagel.

If you’ve had a proper kettle-boiled bagel, the difference is obvious. It’s like upgrading from instant coffee to a decent café brew.

As a regular “bread roll with a hole,” the taste is great though. But compared to a real New York style bagel, nowhere close. As for the black Truffle  cream cheese, I didn’t taste Truffle at all 🤔 Tasted like regular cream cheese, which was good too, but sadly no truffle taste.

And for the price, I don’t think it’s worth it. Unless you enjoy paying premium prices for bagel cosplay. 🙈

I rated it 4 overall, 5 for the great service and Atmosphere. 3 for the food itself.
review_4_text:
Amazing variety of bagels. Good flavour. Coffee was nice. Atmosphere is minimalist, Nordic, clean. Nice with the glass looking out to the pool.
It’s not cheap however, a smoked salmon bagel with extra egg and coffee was almost 400 THB!!
review_5_text: Amazing find! Volks Bagels offers the best homemade bagels in the area. The variety of flavors is fantastic and they taste incredibly fresh. The staff is lovely and the atmosphere is great. Highly recommended for a delicious breakfast or lunch!"

name: KanVela Craft Chocolate x Bangpun Coffee Bar
review_1_text:
Kanvela Craft Chocolate Cafe is a nice place to visit if you love chocolate drinks and a calm café atmosphere.

The café is easy to find and has a friendly, relaxed feeling when you walk in.

Plenty of table and space, which is simple and cozy, with indoor and outdoor seating. It is a good place to sit with friends, study, or enjoy some quiet time alone.

I ordered a 100% craft chocolate that cost 128 THB. The drink was served hot with a smooth and creamy texture and no sugar added, so I could really taste the pure chocolate flavor. It was rich, warm, and comforting, and I felt it was a high-quality chocolate drink.

The café also served the drink with a cookie and a cup of hot tea, which made the experience even better. The cookie was soft and sweet, and the hot tea balanced the strong chocolate taste nicely. But if you don't like pure chocolate they also offer a light chocolate as well.

The staff were polite and served everything with care. They explained the menu and made sure my order was just right. The prices are ok compared to the quality of the chocolate and the nice service make it worth it. (THB100-130)

Overall, Kanvela Craft Chocolate Cafe is a great place for chocolate lovers who want a special, delicious drink and a quiet place to relax.
review_2_text: Great products. Been in love with their multiple choices of products and flavour since I visited the branch in Bangkok. Really spacious here. Much bigger and quieter than Bkk with some parking spaces. Same quality of chocolate. Good standards.
review_3_text: As a big admirer of Kanvela and its amazing chocolate i visited that place. The pralines were amazing, especially the mulled wine. As a chocolate maker from Switzerland i have to say this chocolate is absolutely my favourite one in Thailand, the quality is on its top also the story behind it. Definitely come back and if someone want a really amazing hot chocolate which is absolutely outstanding in Thailand you have to visit here
review_4_text: Delicious chocolates and drinks, beautiful interior, and wonderful service! The guava with chile and salt was some of the best chocolate I have ever tasted. I also tried the taro and coconut, macadamia and biscoff, and green apple - all were gorgeously decorated and sinfully sweet. They have a nice selection of drinks ranging from hot chocolates (using their chocolates, of course) to coffees and teas to juices. There are also many packaged goods that make great gifts for others, or snacks for yourself later! You can sample the chocolate bars, and I loved the strong strawberry flavor of the white chocolate and strawberry bar. There are many other unique chocolate flavors as well, like cereal milk, honey, and some local blends. The women working today were so kind and helpful with their recommendations. I enjoyed my experience sitting among their large plants and savoring each bite or sip of decadent chocolate! If you are on the fence about visiting, let this be your sign to go!
review_5_text: Drinks were not up to our expectation and chocolate was on the light rather than rich side. All drinks were served in plastic glasses. Would be nice if reusable glasses can be used for dine-in. The café is spacious, decor is nice and it is relatively quiet.

name: nana puzzle & coffee
review_1_text: I really like all puzzles here ，many interesting brands from all over the world ，nice coffee，tasty croissant ，from the balcony，you can have good view ，just enjoy sunset，and sometimes airplane pass by，it’s hard to find this kind of cafe around nimman RD
review_2_text:
STRONGLY RECCOMENDED - Very good afternoon spent here, the place is chill and has good coffee and drinks. You can play puzzle and have a nice time inside!
Plus the staff is very friendly :)
review_3_text:
A cute new cafe upstairs with puzzles over large tables … sometimes you start your own and sometimes you continue on someone else’s puzzle.
On the menu are various hot and cold drinks, served in unique cups. Wish there were more drink options and maybe also some snacks?
The staff is absolutely lovely and it’s a great place to spend an afternoon…
review_4_text: A new place with very good coffee and atmosphere, loved the puzzle concept!
review_5_text: Newly opened hidden gem. Located on first floor, you will just walk by if you don’t know where it is situated.  Fancy comfortable seating and awesome croissants that go with the good coffee.

name: Large Coffee Nimman
review_1_text:
Giving three stars mainly because of the coffee. There might be good options on the menu, but the caramel macchiato I ordered was honestly horrible. They really need to learn how to make a proper caramel macchiato.

That said, the place itself is nice. You can sit for a while or just grab your coffee to go. The staff were good too, no complaints at all. Everything else was fine, but the coffee really let it down for me.
review_2_text: We ordered an iced latte and Thai iced tea. They were both very good and low price for the neighbourhood. The tea has a very fruity/floral flavour.
review_3_text:
The coffee is delicious and the portions are generous.
It lives up to its name, Large Coffee.

The shop is beautifully decorated in a yellow and blue theme.
The cups are designed in a lovely color scheme, perfect for taking photos against a backdrop of forests, mountains, and trees.

The prices are reasonable, the coffee is good, and the Thai tea is rich and flavorful. Highly recommended.
review_4_text: Delicious coffee beans, fragrant, medium and dark roasted, just the right flavor, perfect for a satisfying drink.
review_5_text: We stayed at this hostel and the rooms were great and clean. It's conveniently located near many tourist attractions, all within walking distance. The staff were lovely, and most importantly, the coffee was amazing – fragrant and smooth. I especially recommend the Thai tea; it's delicious and not too sweet. Their signature drink is a large, satisfying cup! We'll definitely go back again. 😉☺️

name: Rubber Killer Cafe x Sawaa Project
Miracle coffee@nimmanhaemin
review_1_text: Quick to go coffee spot with a few outside chairs. 30thb for most of the hot coffee and it’s 40thb if you want a hot one. Better to get it a to go since it’s a tiny spot.
review_2_text: Great little shop! Really delicious coffee at great prices. No seating, just grab your cup and go!
review_3_text: Awesome little coffee stand in front of Lotus Express. Been coming here for over 2 years now. The husband and wife who runs the place is so sweet and speak a little bit of English. Their drinks are amazing and when you ask for no sugars, there will be no sugars!
review_4_text: Great little place for a take a away coffee!
review_5_text: Cute coffee shop with great prices and wow strong coffee! Me and my girlfriend always come here every morning, they have nice seats in the shade (outside).highly recommend :)!

name: EB Coffee
review_1_text:
Small, but oh, so cute. Slightly surprising to find this kind of place in middle of what I consider commercial zone. Very glad I did find this, though.

Everything looks so delicious and tastes delicious as well. I had possibly best vegetable based drink of my life. Staff is friendly (and very cute 😊).
If you are around this area, do yourself a favor and enjoy a tiny piece of Japan here.
review_2_text: I like how they make fresh, high-quality juices. You can choose one based on what your body needs. The interior is quite dark, and despite being right next to the Decathlon entrance, it feels somewhat secluded. The outdoor "gym" and the occasional decor make it easy to overlook.
review_3_text: Good place to chill at Decathlon.
review_4_text:
Fresh, bright coffee spot at the Decathlon entrance.

Flavorful coffee and a fresh sandwich.
review_5_text:
ร้านน่ารักมาก อยู่หน้าดีแคทลอน เป็นสไตล์ญี่ปุ่นมีเมนูเครื่องดื่ม ชากาแฟ น้ำเพื่อสุขภาพ น้ำผลไม้ ชาร้อน เมนูเย็น เค้กน่ารักมาก ตกแต่งร้านสวย ต้องลองไปกันดูนะ ดีแนะนำ

とても可愛いお店 デカトロンの前で 和風のスタイルで、ドリンクメニュー、紅茶、コーヒー、健康水、フルーツジュース、ホットティー、冷たいメニュー、とっても可愛いケーキが揃っています。 美しい店の装飾 ぜひ試してみましょう。ぜひお勧めします。

아주 귀여운 가게 데카트론 앞에서 음료 메뉴, 차, 커피, 건강 물, 과일 주스, 따뜻한 차, 차가운 메뉴, 매우 귀여운 케이크가 있는 일본식입니다. 아름다운 가게 장식 시도해야 합니다. 가자. 좋은 추천입니다.

very cute shop in front of Decathlon It is a Japanese style with a drink menu, tea, coffee, healthy water, fruit juice, hot tea, cold menu, very cute cakes. beautiful shop decoration Must try. Let's go. Good recommend.

很可愛的店 在迪卡儂面前 是日式的，有飲品單，茶，咖啡，健康水，果汁，熱茶，冷單，很可愛的蛋糕。 漂亮的店鋪裝修 必須嘗試。我們走吧。很好的推薦。

name: เดียร์ สมูทตี้ Deer Smoothie
KongLounge
review_1_text:
Chiang mai is famous for coffee...
And this cafe is really great...
Quiet and relaxing your time with having great coffee...
Also if you want, you can take a massage as well...
review_2_text: Must be the Fastest internet in Thailand in a nice cafe.
review_3_text:
I went for a massage before heading to the airport.
The atmosphere was clean and the massage was refreshing and good. My husband and children got Thai massages, and I wasn't feeling well, so I got an oil massage. The masseuse was very attentive to my condition and it was great.
Since it was an oil massage, I had to wash off with water.
I don't think there was any warm water, so please keep that in mind.
I also had coffee, which was perfect for my taste. It would be a great place to stop by and spend some time before heading to the airport.
review_4_text: 우리나라 사장님이 너무 친절하시고 서비스도 좋아요...다시 갈일이 있으면 또 가보싶네요
review_5_text:
밤 11시 비행기를 타기 전에 샤워를 해야 했고, 낮 동안에는 배낭을 맡겨야 했습니다. 마사지를 받을 수 있으면 더 좋겠어서 예약했습니다.

더 일찍 배낭을 맡기고 싶었지만, 오픈시간이 오전 10시라서 시간에 맞춰서 갔고, 비용은 1인당 100바트였습니다.

저녁 때 예약한 6시 30분에 도착했는데, 앞 타임 마사지가 늦어져 10여분 지연되었습니다.  마사지는 사람에 따라 복불복인 것 같습니다. 저는 매우 시원하게 잘 받았는데, 같이 간 사람은 어디를 마사지해야 하는지 전혀 모르는 사람 같다고 했습니다. 마사지 비용은 1인당 350바트였습니다.

그리고 마사지룸의 매트는 앞 타임에서 사용했더라도 커버를 새로 바꾸거나 새로운 깔개를 깔지는 않는 것 같습니다. 너무 미끌미끌했습니다. 위생상태가 걱정되었지만 다른 곳으로 이동할 수도 없어서 그냥 받았습니다.

샤워비용도 1인당 40바트(?)를 더 지불했습니다. 샤워실은 마사지룸에 딸린 샤워실이었는데, 샤워용품이 구비되어 있지 않아서 여행 때 갖고 간 것을 사용했습니다.

마지막으로 공항으로 가야 했는데, 무료셔틀 시간은 맞지 않았지만, 콩라운지에서 그랩택시를 잡아주셔서 빨리 이동할 수 있었습니다.

전체적으로 약간 비싼 듯하지만 직원은 매우 친절하셨고, 땀이 난 몸도 개운하게 샤워를 할 수 있으니, 나름 최선의 선택을 한 것 같아 만족합니다.

name: Wawee Coffee
review_1_text: A lovely café connected to a bakery, perfect for breakfast or brunch. The space is cozy and beautifully designed, with a calm atmosphere. The food is fresh and delicious, especially the baked goods, and the service is friendly and efficient. A great place to start the day ✨🫖🍵🍪☕
review_2_text: This is a franchise cafe and there are several locations in Chiang Mai. I have never been to other ones, but this location is fairy nice with AC. It’s directly connected to a bakery next to it so you can utilize either space. Their wifi is very fast and there are some good seats as well.
review_3_text:
A cool coffee & Bakery shop together with Retro vibe interior...
Can sit outdoor & Indoor...
There are many kinds of bakery products available...

Coffee shop area is quite annoying cause Coffee Grinder noise... Even difficult to have conversation cause of noises...
review_4_text:
It is a comfortable and relaxing place to stop. They have a kitchen to cook you a breakfast, freshly baked goods, sweets on one side and coffee and tea on the other.

Nothing revolutionary - nothing too crazy you know. A variety of seating arrangements indoors and out, English language newspapers, standard air conditioning and soft music… in a convenient area for many.
Playground Fitness is across the street if you feel the need to shed some calories…
review_5_text:
Very good coffee and cakes, but the attitude of the barista (not the chubby one with glasses) is the worse. She is making unnecessary noises while doing her own duty and talk to us very rudely. I am not coming back here because of her.

The girls from the cake counter are lovely.

name: Loca Coco : Smoothie & Juice
review_1_text: “I got the watermelon and orange smoothies — both were absolutely delicious! They were packed with so much fresh fruit, you could taste it in every sip. So refreshing and naturally sweet. I’m definitely coming back for more during my trip!”
review_2_text: The drink is very refreshing and tasty, the owner also very nice! (she put loads of fruits in my drink, she s not stingy at all super AWESOME!!!)
review_3_text: Good choices, fresh and run by the owner. Best smoothie. Chose avocado and coconut.
review_4_text: This is a great place to get smoothies with pretty much any fruit or vegetable of your choice. I can't say I was hugely impressed by their coffees, but it's likely that's not why you would be stopping by here in the first place. Also, if you happen to be at Cherng Doi Roast Chicken, you can scan the QR code and have them bring smoothies from Loca Coco.
review_5_text:
Don't miss when visit Nimman.

Pink smootie shop, Loca Coco at Nimman, the Price is GREAT !!!
I recommend "My love" (lychee+yoghurt) less sweet so yummy. Looking forward to try all the Menu...:)

name: TERROIR.CNX
review_1_text:
Best in town.
The Geisha iced filter was clean and premium. High-quality coffee done right, and it’s clear these guys know exactly what they’re doing. A must-visit in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text:
A gem for true coffee enthusiasts. Small space, big flavor. The focus here is all about quality coffee. Their bean selection is impressive ranging from local to international origins and the baristas really know their craft. Prices are fair for the level of quality you get. Highly recommend the V60 and espresso clean, well-balanced, and full of character.

If you’re serious about coffee, Terroir is a must-visit.
review_3_text: Cool coffee bar with well designed interior, very friendly baristas and amazing coffees 🖤 Perfect place to wind (and cool) down!
review_4_text: The S Sorbet is one of the best coffees I’ve had in a long time. It was delicious as a pour over and even better imo as a 20 hour cold brew. The biggest regret of my trip to Chiang Mai is only bringing a single bag of these beans home. I didn’t know how good it was :-(
review_5_text: Was walking towards Toffee Roasters and chanced upon this cafe by chance. Had a hot drip coffee that was recommended by the barista and it was so perfect and mind-blowing I don't have any other words to describe it. Went to order a second cup and this time opted for milk based, which was equally pulled to perfection. Coffee here is truly a sensory experience and for genuine coffee lovers.

name: Bubble Tea & Coffee - CuteToScary
review_1_text: This café is next-level! Cozy vibes, amazing coffee, and the unique “Scary Box” experience is a must-try! 👻
review_2_text: Amasing concept, i really want to thanks the waiter. I will come back soon with friends. I highly recommand ☀️✅
review_3_text: Excellent shop ! I really like this original concept !
review_4_text: The drinks are very delicious. The shop is interesting and exciting.
review_5_text: Interesting shop, delicious water, must try at least once.

name: The Craft Plus
review_1_text: really nice clean studio room with a balcony. the bed is comfortable and the a/c is quiet and efficient.  there is not a lot of traffic noise however it is under the flight path of planes. while the noise of planes flying over is loud from the shady balcony at times it is not noticeable at night time or from in the room. I would have rated 5 stars but it has 3 flights of stairs, which are easy to climb there are no hand rails. There is a bath and a number of shower heads but only the one over the bath allows you to shower without the whole area getting drenched and you need to walk through the bathroom to get to the toilet. the hand basin is on the other side of the bathroom though. Towels etc are good quality and numerous. The staff are nice and fresh fruit supplied daily. we enjoyed our stay here. It is not budget accommodation.
review_2_text: marvelous

name: The Barrel Chiang Mai เดอะบาร์เรล เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Nice selection of wine for prices pretty consistent with other places
review_2_text: The world’s smallest pour for 190 baht. 1 selection of red by the glass, 2 different whites. I wouldn’t go back.
review_3_text: Has a great selection of wines and spirits worldwide at very reasonable prices. I attended a wine tasting event with excellent cheeses and other great food.
review_4_text: Surprised to find Georgian wine!
review_5_text: Good quality wine at affordable prices and delicious food.

name: CHARLIE THAI TEA x KAME KAFE - NIMMAN 5
review_1_text: Delicious cold coffee beverages. Friendly and unassuming place. Great price point and simple deserts.  Recommended drinks are their Rose Phuket, Jasmine Tokyo and Golden Samui which was my standout favourite bar none. I got a sweet tooth though ;-)
review_2_text: I love this place. One of good coffee maker in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: The tea is delicious and there's a wide variety to choose from. The prices are reasonable, and the shop opens early in the morning. The staff provides good service.
review_4_text: This shop offers coffee, green tea, and Thai tea. Today I chose the green tea, which I personally didn't find very appealing. I also tried the Thai tea, and I was very impressed. They have a wide selection of tea leaves, about 10 different kinds, which you can smell before deciding what to have in your drink. The aroma is amazing. You can also choose how you want it made and customize the sweetness level.
review_5_text: Open early in the morning. They have a wide selection of coffee beans and matcha, both café-grade and ceremonial grade. The prices are reasonable, but the matcha was a bit too foamy today. 😅

name: ILY Cafe สาขานิมมาน
review_1_text:
The boutique coffee shop beside of ping river...
Nice interior design...
Coffee taste good ...
This is a fine place to chill alone or with partner...
review_2_text: great coffee for good price :)
review_3_text: Barista is very kindness & good time to good tea.
review_4_text: Really nice place!
review_5_text:
จอดรถหน้าร้านหนะ เดินพุ่งลิ่วไปดูข้างริมแม่น้ำปิงก่อน มีร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวอยู่ข้างๆ เป็นแพ มีคนไปนั่งกินด้วย (คือมาหากาแฟซด) แต่ไปเผือกร้านข้างๆ ด้วย) ร้านเบเกอรี่เหมือนจะเคยมีคือจะติดกันกับร้านกาแฟเลยนะ หายไปไหนแล้วก็ไม่รู้ มีเฉพาะกาแฟ เมนูอื่นก็มีแหละ ไม่เยอะมาก วันที่ไปคนไม่เยอะ

อันที่จริงควรเรียกว่า มีแต่ลุงกะป้าสองคน น้องที่ดูแลร้านก็น่ารักดี น่าจะอยู่คนเดียวด้วย ข้างนอกก็มีที่นั่ง ไปเล็งละ มันยังไม่โดนใจ นั่งข้างในเย็นนะ เสียดายไม่มีขนม เบเกอรี่ให้กิน นั่งละเลียดกันอยู่สักพัก ได้แต่มองออกไปข้างร้าน จัดซุ้มไฟสวยดี ถ้ามาตอนกลางคืนคงได้อีกบรรยากาศ .. ตอนจะกลับออกมา เห็นหน้าร้านมีกระจกสะท้อนวิญญาณด้วย (ไม่ช่ายยยย ... เป็นป้ายร้านเค้าออกจะเกร๋) เห็นหน้าตัวเองแล้วตกใจหมดเลย แฮ่

name: KOKORO: weed cafe Bar:cannabis ChiangMai
review_1_text: Walking around the streets of Nimman and popped by this cute shop for midafternoon bevvy. Super friendly, helpful, and great place to sit and relax for a bit. The atmosphere is welcoming with great natural light as you people watch. Worth the visit!
review_2_text: American stoner here. My first weed in Thailand and Full Gas was truly full gas. Tea was lovely. Wonderful service and conversation. Wild to sip tea and rip a bong in the same shop but highly recommend!
review_3_text: cute coffee shop, good vibes and very friendly staff… great coffee, especially orange americano by Aom. Thank you
review_4_text: Cute little dispensary serving a range of teas/matcha, sodas, juices and a solid selection of weed. Love chilling out here ✌️
review_5_text: Super cute place and staff and high quality gummies and joints! My fav in Chiangmai for sure

name: Groon Bread & Brunch Cafe
review_1_text:
Absolutely wonderful place to grab brunch with a friend loved one.

The atmosphere is incredible on a crispy November morning in Chiang Mai.

Good: The shio pan was most notable - perfectly enjoyable. Everything else was decent!

So-so: as a matcha lover, I would skip buying from here, nothing to wow.

Bonus: pet-friendly outside seating
review_2_text: A perfect café for breakfast or brunch. The menu offers a wide variety of options to choose from, such as bagels, sandwiches, pasta, coffee, and fresh juices. I ordered a chicken quesadilla and a “Good Morning” coffee — both were very good. The staff is gentle, friendly, and welcoming 🍪🥃☕
review_3_text: Amazing little brunch place with the tastiest pesto I’ve ever had, and à Wonderful ice latte. Beautifully cooked egg and omelette. A little noisy maybe but over all worth a visit just for the pesto! 😅❤️
review_4_text: I like cream coffee very much. The coffee is very mellow and goes well with the coffee. The shop has a variety of menus to choose from. The atmosphere inside the shop is warm, the service staff is good and friendly. Anyone who likes sandwiches should not miss it because the shop bakes bread itself every day.
review_5_text: The spot is very nice, coffee is great, the food is delicious. As a big pastry lover I was impressed with their products, especially croffles (it’s not a typo btw). Big bonus, they accept credit cards which is super convenient for tourists.

name: Cafe17
review_1_text: A place I haven't been to

name: Mingmitr
review_1_text: Mingmitr Coffee is a great spot to relax and catch up with friends. I had a latte and an almond croissant, both of which were excellent. The café offers cozy indoor seating and a nice outdoor area, making it a perfect place to unwind. Definitely worth a visit whilst in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: Trendy coffee shop with good view of traffic. More for the hi so people. Not much for decoration or service. Spendy but will do in a pinch. Good aircon
review_3_text: Nice coffee in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: 🩷💖So delicious! The coffee is so fragrant. I ordered the Thai tea with less sugar, and it was perfectly less sweet. It's so hard to find this taste in Bangkok. Please open a branch in Bangkok! 🥹
review_5_text: The latte is so delicious

name: ชาไทยจะเยียวยาทุกสิ่ง
review_1_text:
If you like tea, I'd like to recommend good, quality tea.

Tea lovers, you have to try this shop. It's the best.
It's amazing! They have all the teas. You can't go anywhere else. You have to order them. Whether they add tea leaves or love potions, they'll make you fall in love. Chiang Mai is amazing! 🫶🏻🥰

name: la.moon cold cafe (สาขาศิริมังคลาจารย์)
review_1_text: Love coming here in the morning to have my first cup of coffee of the day. Cold brew with coconut flavor is the best! Never knew black coffee could taste so delicious.
review_2_text: The best ceremonial grade matcha latte I’ve had in Chiang Mai! They call is premium matcha (they have two types) and it’s on the pricier side (155 thb) but I’d rather pay for good matcha than pay a lesser price for a not so good one. The umami taste is just perfect. Their recipe is on the sweeter side so ask for it to be less sweet or not at all if that’s what you prefer!
review_3_text: Nice modern cafe with good coffee and nice space with AC. The main thing here is the space that they have long tables with power outlets in the 2nd floor and it’s pretty optimized for working. Their lemon custard cake is pretty bad so you don’t want to get that though.
review_4_text:
Perfect for digital nomads. They have a lot of tables with outlets. Place is very quiet.

I tried their iced chocolate, it was good.

Staff are nice too!!
review_5_text:
- I live here for a long time but it’s it’s my first time to come here
- They have the second floor it’s really nice
- I tried that strawberry Matcha latte I think it is too sweet …

name: Coffee Window @ 14 Soi 7
review_1_text: Most excellent es yen (Thai iced coffee) in Chiangmai! Perfectly balanced sweetness and good beans for the price (45 bhat). Cute shop with some colorful seats outdoors, on a quiet street.
review_2_text: Really nice small latte for 30THB.  Definitely good value for the money. There was nobody there when we arrived so we just rang the bell on the counter and 20 seconds later the owner lady was making our small hot lattes.  Will have to ask what beans they use but the flavour was good for a darker roast. There was no seating so we got them to go. Will definitely go back! 👍
review_3_text:
After 5 years, Cappuccino at Coffee Window is still my favorite FIRST cup of the day . Good price, high quality coffee ☕️☕️☕️

We loved the coffee at Coffee Window.  It is our daily coffee with Beautiful aroma and taste.  The price is cheap compared to the aroma and the taste of the coffee. Highly recommend ❤️❤️
review_4_text: I've been coming here for years – a delightful little café, perfect for a quick coffee. It's mainly a grab-and-go spot with a small waiting area. Most customers are regulars, including locals and expats. The owner, a quietly friendly lady who keeps things simple, focuses at crafting superb coffee and other delightful drinks at reasonable prices. I highly recommend this place.
review_5_text:
Came across this little haven for coffee lovers, nestled on a side street. As you step up, you're enveloped in an ambiance defined by charming baby blue decor and exquisite tiles that create a peaceful and inviting atmosphere. Reminds me of the tiles in Lisbon. The café's delightful color palette makes it a great spot for both relaxation and recharging.

The true star of Coffee Window is, undoubtedly, its coffee. The baristas here have mastered the art of the strong shot, serving up robust and flavorful espresso that awakens the senses. Each cup is a testament to their dedication and skill, ensuring that coffee aficionados and casual drinkers alike are treated to an exceptional experience.

In addition to its impressive coffee offerings, the café boasts a friendly and attentive staff, contributing to a warm and welcoming environment. Whether you're stopping by for a quick caffeine fix or settling in for a leisurely afternoon, Coffee Window offers a unique blend of tranquility, charm, and superb coffee. This quaint spot is a must-visit for anyone seeking a beautiful escape and a truly memorable cup of coffee.

name: not._.sofar cafe
review_1_text:
my favorite place to take time with my friend and I like friendly staff, good decor and good coffee ❤️
DON’T MISS🔥
review_2_text:
This is our favorite coffee in town ! ! !
One thing we can't do without though is the Life Instructional you get with your drink !
I mean, how else would you know how to put the next foot ahead ? !
review_3_text: nice place good coffee ✨
review_4_text: coffee is really good taste. i’m enjoyed drinking 👍🏼☕️
review_5_text: Don’t missed ❤️

name: Room cafe'69
review_1_text: Visited during the day for a quick coffee. The café’s small but has a nice, relaxed vibe better for chatting than working. Tried the iced chocolate it was tasty and not too sweet. Prices are cheap but quality’s solid. The owner was really friendly and welcoming, which made the visit nicer
review_2_text: 35thb for any coffee here, which is already as good price as you can get in this area since many of the cafe charges double the price. The quality of the coffee is good as well. It’s not only a take away place and this store actually has a few good tables and seats. This is one of the best budget cafe.
review_3_text: A fresh coffee in the morning and the owner is so friendly and cool! Highly recommend this chill place!
review_4_text: A small coffee shop where all drinks are priced at 35 baht (~ £0.78). The matcha latte is delightful, and the ambiance is quite nice. Highly recommend!!
review_5_text: Great business model! They serve a very high quality product for a very low price. No wonder there are always people drinking coffee here. I had the iced hazelnut latte and it was delicious.

name: Brew Fact
review_1_text:
Very happy to find a café that opens as early as 7am, with a good variety of bakes available. We had the shio pan (salty butter roll) at ฿30, the ham & cheese bread, and two hot lattes — one medium roast and one dark roast.

The medium and dark roasts tasted quite similar; it was hard to tell much of a difference. The shio pan was really good — loved it. The ham & cheese bread was decent as well, and we added shredded pork with mayonnaise. I actually rank this after shio pan, as it reminded me of ba-hu (pork floss).

The only downside for me is that they don’t accept credit cards, only Thai payment methods or cash.
review_2_text:
◽️Highlights:
•Not just coffee — they also bake their own pastries fresh daily.
•Must-try: Shi-O (butter bun with salt) — served hot, soft, and addictive! Perfect match with a hot coffee. This keeps me coming back every time.
•Love the hot latte (medium-roast) — smooth and flavorful. Tried the iced latte but didn’t enjoy it as much.

◽️Atmosphere:
•Cozy and welcoming, with a friendly vibe.
•Staff are attentive (one even remembered my previous order — impressive!).

💡 Tip: Pair the hot latte with the Shi-O bun.
review_3_text:
The place is very beautiful and probably the best coffee that I tried. I was impressed with their minimalistic design and would like to be there a bit longer, but unfortunately I was in rush. Bakery is good and worth to try.
I took 1 star away in service because they don’t take credit cards which is not that convenient for tourists that visit this city a lot.
review_4_text: Very comfy little cafe. Its quiet, clean and got some good vibes. Also got good coffee with a variety of beans
review_5_text:
Brew Fact in Chiang Mai is a coffee lover’s dream come true. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted by the warm aroma of freshly brewed coffee and a cozy, modern atmosphere that makes you want to linger.
