The attention to detail here is exceptional—whether it’s the beautifully crafted drinks or the inviting decor.

Their pour-over coffee is an absolute standout, showcasing their expertise in sourcing and roasting beans. Each cup is rich, flavorful, and brewed to perfection, with notes so complex you’ll savor every sip. For something unique, their signature coffee creations are a must-try, blending bold flavors with a creative twist.

The food menu is equally impressive, with thoughtful pairings that complement their coffee offerings. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do, always happy to recommend a drink or share the story behind their beans.

Brew Fact is not just a café—it’s an experience. Whether you’re a casual coffee drinker or a serious enthusiast, this is a spot you’ll keep coming back to. It’s a perfect escape in Chiang Mai to enjoy great coffee, great vibes, and exceptional service.

name: Wabi sabi coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee, friendly staff, good beans and cozy vibes. You can sit inside or outside. The prices are very reasonable and they got different cup sizes. One of the cheaper places but they still deliver awesome quality with a variety of 3 different beans, mild, medium and strong. ☕️
review_2_text:
A simple and cozy café in Chiang Mai with very good prices and excellent, flavorful coffee. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful, ideal for relaxing or spending some time working.
The staff is very friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even better. A no-frills place with great quality and a nice vibe. Highly recommended.
review_3_text:
A new favourite coffee place.
A good flat white, a very nice young team and a relaxed, clean lines vibe.
Prices on the low side.
review_4_text: A modest little coffee shop offering standard sandwiches, waffles and delicious brownies. The place has a few tables and one clean toilet. It’s not a formal dining setup — just a straightforward spot to enjoy a cup of coffee without the extras.
review_5_text:
Short stop for morning coffee☕️
Medium roast is a bit too dark for my taste but overall is okay. The price is worth its quality. Quite crowded in the morning with food delivery and passerby🏃

name: ABK Art and Studio 1991 School
review_1_text:
Today, we booked and participated in a 3-hour program.

After the meal, there was a period of free outdoor play time at the end. During this time, some older boys—who seemed to visit this place regularly—created their own rules and imposed restrictions on how the children could play.

While this kind of interaction can be seen as part of developing social skills, once a few children start following rules made by older kids, those who dislike them are often forced to comply. My child did not want to follow these rules.
What was more concerning was that the older boys were seen getting angry at my child.

This is a situation where staff supervision is clearly needed, but we felt that this time period was left unattended for too long.

Depending on a child’s personality, this free play time can be either enjoyable or uncomfortable, and inappropriate behavior by older children should be properly managed.

Because of this disappointing ending, I am leaving a 2-star review.
review_2_text: Nice shady outdoor area for kids to play in. Toys are dirty and worn out but my kid enjoyed them. The mosquito coil smelled way too strong and I had a bad headache after staying indoor for 10 minutes, not sure if the kids are ok with it. Music playlist could be kids songs instead of Bruno Mars imo.
review_3_text: Very nice for kids come to play and do activity class . Food also yummy :)
review_4_text: My kids loveeeedd with the teachers and they played so happily! My kids loved it here bcs he can sing, draw and play anything what they want.
review_5_text: Teachers are so friendly and kids love this place. Recommend!

name: Sol Haus
review_1_text: The best coffee ever! Absolutely love this place.  If you haven't been try it!! Lovely staff and delicious coffee and snacks, the iced latte and chocolate cookie is amazing 🤩
review_2_text:
A lovely hidden coffee shop with high quality coffee and cookies.
Great atmosphere and very friendly service.🙏🏼💙
review_3_text: Arguably the best coffee I had in Chiang Mai. The interior is clean and cool, and the coffee has some personality to it. Staff werr friendly and accommodating to tourists
review_4_text: Sol haus “house of the sun” new coffee shop in Chiangmai. Pet friendly, Great coffee and good vibes. Strongly recommended ‘Dirty Coffee’ and  caramel popcorn for non-coffee menu. 👍🏻
review_5_text: Latte is so nice! Decaf is served here if you’re looking for. The decaf tastes & smell good. Decaf is rare in Chiang Mai

name: fimue
review_1_text: A beautiful café with lovely decoration. The place feels like an antique house, full of vintage furniture and old objects, which gives it a very special charm. I ordered a sesame latte and it was delicious. They also had a tiramisu that I didn’t try, but it looked amazing. The staff was absolutely charming 🍪🍰☕
review_2_text: Very nice coffee shop. Unfortunately many people think so. The place was packed with people posing for pictures. But ok. They do sell a lot of cute knock knacks. It’s worth checking out. The coffee was ok. Not exceptional. But the matcha madeleine was great. Moist and too sweet.
review_3_text:
One of my top cafe experiences in Chiangmai. They also have a super cute shop cat (Messi who is super sweet and friendly), and the cafe is separated into a sitting area and a store area. The cafe sells various trinkets including mother of pearl jewellery and ceramic or glass home goods including little spoons. They also sell home fragrances!

Our drinks were good - Americano was really great (note that hey have no decaf - which seems to be common in Chiang Mai). The strawberry latte was really good and they let me change to oat milk but I’d say it was a little too sweet for me. Still, very much worth going!
review_4_text: Highly recommend the cinnamon roll! Its one of the best i have had. Not too sweet, fragrant cinnamon and texture is unlike those fluffy rolls, its abit more densed. The tiramisu is very good as well! Would recommend.
review_5_text:
Quaint cafe that shares space in a shop that also sells jewelry/accessories. Guess most of the items on display are for sale.
Cozy cafe to spend an afternoon.
We had the hot latte, orange coffee & matcha tiramisu.

name: Roast8ry Coffee Lab
review_1_text: Rated as coffee as the year! (My opinion) I have traveled to many Asian countries, and I always search for good coffee along the way! I was surprised what I was told the coffee is 500, because most of the coffee in Chiang Mai is like 50. But after I take a sip, it’s totally worth it! The beans are well selected and I picked Ethiopia, the scent is fermented very well with the fruity flavor. You won’t get such a quality with the price else where. Definitely would recommend if you’re a picky coffee drinker!
review_2_text: Nice little coffee shop near One Nimman, within walking distance. Their coffee was unique and interesting. If you want to try something different, this place is a fun one to visit. I went before lunchtime, and it was very busy, but the line moved pretty fast.
review_3_text: Coffee was amazing - had the flat white with art, husband had restretto, pricing was good for us but we’re from London so used to it 😂 worth it! Guys working there are lovely - lab is nice to sit and enjoy some time in the day.  Award winning - worth a stop if you’re in the area!!
review_4_text:
This legendary spot is highly recommended for all coffee lovers. Make this (or its sister spot) a must visit. The cafe is located on a fairly quiet Soi in what appears to be an affluent neighborhood.

Absolutely beautiful coffee and friendly team that are always smiling
review_5_text: Excellent coffee with stunning latte art. Drinks are smooth, well-balanced, and made with real skill. The space is relaxed with both indoor and outdoor seating perfect for anyone who truly appreciates quality coffee.

name: FOHHIDE
review_1_text: Great cafe !!! Super highly recommended. Nice balanced taste of all the flavors. I recommend medium roast. Great taste coffee and an incredible mountain views! It is located on the 5th floor, tiny little elevator up to 5th floor. They use Slayer espresso machine and mahlkonig grinders. They serve light and medium roast.
review_2_text:
Hidden little gem.
Sadly, a lot of digital nomads/tourist know that place and take a lot of space to „work“.
Besides that, their staff is very friendly and helpful. Their Menu is pretty variable and their beans taste good.
And the view…its amazing to start your day with a view over jungly mountain ⛰️
review_3_text: A true hidden gem in Nimman! The coffee is excellent (highly recommend the Dirty Coffee), and the mountain view from the 5th floor is breathtaking. Bonus: the baristas are very handsome and friendly! 10/10 vibes.
review_4_text: They serve good cappuccino here but my go-to is the dirty latte. Cute little drink that’s perfect for late afternoons in Chiang Mai. It’s a cozy spot to do crosswords or sudoku (but not reading) and I’ve also seen people writing in their journals. Mornings and sunsets are especially lovely with the sun hitting Doi Suthep and the surrounding buildings. Another reason I keep coming back is I love taking the lift here lol
review_5_text:
Fohhide is a must-visit coffee shop in Chiang Mai, living up to its name ("Full of Happiness Hiding"). Tucked away on the 5th floor of a building in Nimmanhaemin Soi 5, it's an elevated oasis.
The coffee is exceptional—try a signature espresso mocktail like the "Bua Phen" or the popular Dirty Latte. The real draw, however, is the stunning panoramic view of Doi Suthep from the balcony.
How to Get There:
Find the building entrance on Nimmanhaemin Soi 5. Look for the small elevator or take the stairs up to the 5th floor. It’s worth the short, hidden journey for the incredible view and quality brew. The atmosphere is peaceful, chic, and perfect for a slow morning.

name: Samudlanna
review_1_text:
A good stationery store. I was looking for acrylic paints and markers and found them here.
Parking is at the back of the building.
review_2_text:
We love this little stationary and office/craft supplies store. They seem to have almost everything that you need for a project or for your home office. They also sell quite a lot of home goods, like picture hangers, hooks, tape, adhesives, small hand tools, light bulbs, etc, etc.
The staff is always friendly and helpful.
They often have holiday decor, too.
review_3_text: A nice stationery store--paints and canvases on the mezzanine level, most everything else (writing instruments, notebooks, envelopes, adhesives, whiteboards/corkboards, erasers, craft supplies, binders, etc.) on the ground floor. Carries fewer fountain pens now than 5+ years ago, and doesn't appear to carry capped Uniball Signo pens (I know, that's very specific, but they're personal faves) anymore, but it does carry more locally produced crafts than before and the selection of pens is still large. For those who are on the lookout for fountain pen-friendly paper on a small budget, the kraft paper-covered BSP notebooks (see photo) they carry have done surprisingly well in my experience. (I should note that I prefer extra-fine and fine nibs, which usually write drier than medium and bold nibs.)
review_4_text:
A huge stationary store at Niman...
There are couple of stationary stores in Chaing Mai but this one is bigger and more items then those stores...
There are many things for Students, Artists, Designers, Etc...
The Interior design of the shop is also quite interesting...
If you need stationary no doubt to just go there if you are near Niman...
review_5_text: One of the best stationary shops in Chiang Mai. It has everything from sketchbooks and drawing supplies for illustrations. They have a wide selection of pens and pencils. They have various colors and sizes for sticky notes. They have a lot of postcards available. They had cute note books and sketch books. They had nice gel pens and color pens. They also have washi tapes and stickers, all what you need for journaling. They have Id card holders too. They have birthday decorations as well, ranging from balloons, to happy birthday banners and decorations. They have a variety of tapes for packing. They also have a variety of files and envelopes available. They had special decorations for the Chinese new year. They also have a cute cafe connected to the store.

name: Newtown Nimman
review_1_text: This place gets packed every night. You don’t think it‘s much of a buzz when you walk past it around six or seven. But after eight there is hardly a seat left. Almost all of the customers are young Thai people. They even have a bouncer. But he only checks age.
review_2_text: Electric nights in Nimman's heart! Pulsing with a killer DJ spinning infectious beats that get the whole crowd grooving, this hotspot buzzes with vibrant energy—perfect for letting loose amid the lively throng. Finger foods arrive fashionably late but pack a punch of crispy, flavorful bliss that keeps the party fueled. Unbeatable vibes for your wildest evenings out!
review_3_text:
I visited Newtown Nimman around 10:00–12:00 and it was the perfect spot for a chill morning.

The place wasn’t crowded, so it had a really relaxed vibe—great for chatting with friends or getting some work done. The coffee was solid and the space is beautifully designed, with both indoor and outdoor seating.

Definitely a nice find if you’re looking for a calm café in the Nimman area!

7/10
review_4_text:
New hype place for brunch/coffee/beer/bar and easy bistro open 8am to mid night.

easy fast food: hot dogs, fried chicken with fried potatoes.

Nice vibes with outdoor seats but out door seat is quite not comfy.

Nice and friendly staffs.
review_5_text: Great little place. Friendly staff. Fast wifi. We're vegan. Didn't have any vegan options but had fries, onion rings and plant based milk. My daughter loved her pancakes and my son enjoyed his hotdog. Would go back. Coffee was great!

name: TANN
review_1_text: Very hip and nice coffeeshop / runners shop. They also sell running equipment (not shoes). The coffee shop is a bit hidden and quite small. But they have a nice outdoor seating area. Although it‘s a bit messy too. Sandwiches are very tasty and coffee is good. Staff can be very nice. Depends on who you end up with.
review_2_text: The shop is nice and calm. The staff knows things well about coffee. This is my personal preference that I didn’t like sour coffee but if you like fruity and sour coffee, you will like this place. Nice outdoor seating.
review_3_text: Stayed nearby Tann coffee during my stay in Chiang Mai and I was there for 3 days consecutively. The coffee was incredible and aromatic, food wise was tasty as well. I ordered the ham and cheese sourdough - crispy, full of flavors and kept you wanting for more. Sourdough with scrambled eggs was simple yet homely. Highly recommend this cozy cafe!
review_4_text: the vibes / atmosphere of the cafe was nice, calm and relaxing. One of the best places to have a slow morning with a coffee in your hand. The coffee was nice as well. Ordered dirty latte and mocha. I prefer the dirty latte tho. the tuna melts was good as well, delicious !
review_5_text:
A nice, simple cafe that opens from 7am onwards. Offering a unique but rather simple menu in term of drink and food.

Espresso, Americano are nice but choose the right one roast will make a big difference.

Love their ham cheese sandwich. Very crunchy sourdough bread with thick cheese applied on top

name: GRAPH ground
review_1_text:
I asked the staff member for their top recommendation, and he suggested the Monochrome with natural charcoal, describing it as delicious and distinctive. The shop itself has a clean, modern atmosphere that adds to the overall experience.

I have edited this post several times, as I visit the café daily and try a different coffee each time. Today, I tried the Sompetch with orange, and it was excellent
review_2_text:
Service - 4.5 stars

Seaweed coffee cocktail - 4.5 stars
The seaweed was fragrant and the savoury umami flavour balanced the coffee well. I'm not usually a fan of coffee cocktails but this was well done!

6oz white
Khun chang kian - 4 stars

Huay chom phu - 4 stars

Both were pretty delicate. No obvious notes in the white coffees. Reliable WiFi and clean bathroom.
review_3_text: Good and fancy coffee shop. There are several Graph coffee shops in Chiang Mai. I only visited this one. I tried the coffee and bought some beans to take home. We also bought some cute cups. Unfortunately we just had breakfast before. There was no room for pastries. But they surely look good! Next time for sure.
review_4_text: Recently, the quality of coffee in northern Thailand has dramatically improved, and Thai coffee beans also have a distinct flavor. There are many good cafes in town, and this cafe is one of them. If you like coffee, you’ll like this cafe. They’re serious about the coffee they serve.
review_5_text:
Graph Ground is one of those cafés that makes you stop at the door and go, “Okay, this place knows what it’s doing.”*It’s industrial-modern in the best possible way — dark tones, concrete and metal textures, clean lines, and a quiet, creative atmosphere. It feels like the meeting point of urban coffee culture and Chiang Mai craftsmanship, and it pulls that identity off perfectly.

What I Tried

Wildweekend Seasonal Blend
Local Chiang Mai beans with:

* Tropical fruit acidity
* Bergamot notes
* A yogurt-like tang
* Sweet, clean finish

Aromatic, slightly fermented in character, beautifully balanced. One of those coffees where you keep smelling the cup between sips.

Breaking Brown (Espresso Cold Brew + Almond Milk)

* Smooth but deep espresso flavor
* Almond milk adding natural sweetness
* Very “third-wave Chiang Mai”

Honestly, this one surprised me the most — soft, layered, and extremely easy to drink. A comfort coffee but with personality.

Overall Experience

Graph Ground was the perfect choice for today. Calm, design-focused, and serious about its coffee. It captures Chiang Mai’s modern side in such a clean, stylish way that sitting here instantly puts you in a good headspace.

name: Co&Co cafe
review_1_text:
Translation:

My first visit to Chiang Mai truly surprised me. There are many very lovely restaurants and cafés here. The staff are very enthusiastic and friendly. The food at the café really suited my taste. I arrived at 10:00 a.m., so the place was quite quiet.
review_2_text: This english looking cafe took me by surprise. The decor was beautiful inside and out. What's best is that the service was immaculate as well. Food was great as well. I tried the fish and chips with no expectations but it turned out to be one of the best I've tried in recent times. Coffee was good too. This is not a paid review but a genuine one. If you're in Chiangmai, consider dropping by here! My server / waiter, Pang was very good and considerate too. 10/10 will be back!
review_3_text:
The cafe itself seems enticing at first. Nice modern fit out with cool waiters.   When we arrived, it was suspiciously empty : only one other table. We ordered the Khao Soi Fettucini and a Wagyu Fried Rice. We then waited. 20 minutes later, the waiter came back and said they were sold out of the wagyu. It was then I realised they hadn’t started cooking at all. So I changed it to a slow cooked pork curry - knowing that they probably had this prepared since it needs hours slow cooking.

So we waited. And waited. And waited. In the meantime, the staff had gone missing. Some other table had to go inside to find some service staff.

We finally had our meals after 35 minutes of waiting. The slow cooked pork curry had been reheated, but was leaning on the lukewarm side. The fettucini was fusion khao soi fettucini , but ended up less tasty than either dish.

But oh my, the wait! The wait wasn’t worth it for us, but for people who have a lot of time on their hands to waste, it may be worth it for them.
review_4_text: Great place to grab a coffee in Nimman. The food was also really good and you can choose to sit inside or out! The building itself is amazing and so is the service. They also have live music in the evening.
review_5_text: Interior is very luxurious and they have a nice shaded seating outdoors. We got breakfast salmon toast and poached bacon eggs, both of them were delicious and the bacon was crispy with well seasoned side greens. Only comment is that the portions are a bit small.

name: Third Place Coffee - Chiang Mai
review_1_text: The café is very charming, with a lovely two-floor layout, and the coffee is excellent, making it a really enjoyable place to spend some time. The staff is also very friendly and nice.
review_2_text: We orders an Americano and a an iced cappuccino. Very tasty. The staff is friendly and work hard to make a good cup of coffee. The shop has free WiFi and plays relaxing piano jazz vibes.
review_3_text: This café is a gem! The coffee is excellent, rich, and smooth, but the muffin really stole the show, fresh, soft, and full of chocolate. The cozy vibe makes it a perfect spot to relax or get some work done. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to!
review_4_text: Rather a small cafe. 2nd floor is like a small quiet space with only a few tables. They are open until 7pm, but 2nd floor is only open until 445pm. I got hot cappuccino and it was ok.
review_5_text: I Love this place!!  The lattes are fabulous, the service is exceptional.  I visit every day now that I am living not far away.  Sometimes I enjoy the atmosphere and sometimes I take it to go.  Always perfectly wonderful.  Highly recommend!!  I would call this First Place!!  🏆

name: The OT Dispensary - OLD TOWN
review_1_text: Very helpful and friendly staff who shared his mungkud fruit with us. The upstairs room was really comfortable with good AC, a PS5, restroom, and small patio.
review_2_text: Nice chill place to be. Cozy environment. Staff is super friendly. Clean establishment.
review_3_text: A bit pricey but a really cool environment and staff! Great for a quick smoke before getting pizza across the street!
review_4_text: My good friend Nekky made me the best deal in town, 100 baht Thai stick prerolls! Left this review…and scored a free Thai stick joint out the door! ❤️‍🔥100% recommend in Chiang Mai 🫶
review_5_text:
The OT Dispensary is one of the most premium dispensaries in all of Chiang Mai.
The OT boasts a great selection of flowers, displayed beautifully. It’s in an intimate, bar-like setup which really compliments the vibe.
However, the highlight of The OT are the incredible staff. They are helpful, of course, but also really fun and happy to have a chat and a giggle or a game of Uno.
It can be hard to choose where to shop with all of the dispensaries around, but The OT is the one you should visit first!

name: I Tim Baan Yaii - homemade ice cream

review_2_text:
Cute place & good price I had Cocoa Bomb
was very yummy and not too sweet.
Love it! 2 big scoops in waffles 125-.
Only Matcha Biscoff +10baht (recommended) Btw, you can try it for free before ordering.
review_3_text:
Quaint cosy little shop with homemade ice cream and coffee/tea.
Ordered a chocolate strawberry ice cream which was really good.. not too sweet
They have flavors like yuzu sorbet, rum and raisins, choc bomb etc
review_4_text:
Homemade ice cream with a homely vibe. They've got a good selection of flavours, I tried their classic Thai Milk Tea flavour and really enjoyed it.

The portions of the ice cream scoop are also good and at a reasonable price. There's also free topping and sauces.

Ample indoor & outdoor space with WiFi & toilet. It could also be used as a space for coworking.
review_5_text: Amazing ice-cream, i ordered the rum raisin. The iced latte was soso though. Great vibes with clean environment, thoughtful decor and white themed design.

name: Creativitea
review_1_text:
[editing my comment below since Amy is referring to another person, certainly not me, since I am not entrepreneur, and I have been to only one meet up of her friend, which showed me her Xenophobic comment on WhatsApp, and I was hanging out with other random travellers not her "friends", I am surprised with the amount of lies she mentioned to defend herself, not surprised though, shame on your lies Amy, get better]

I came here to echo what other guests have already said about Amy and her "coworking".  When many unrelated people report similar bad experiences, it is worth paying attention. Please read the other reviews together with mine below.  As you can see in other comments, she systematically dismisses concerns by inventing a justification for each one and she will do it again, let's see.

I have travelled a lot, and this was by far the worst experience I have had , not because of the place itself, but because of the owner, Amy.

I ended up leaving halfway through my stay due to the way Amy repeatedly spoke to me in an aggressive, condescending, and hostile manner. From very early on, the atmosphere felt tense and uncomfortable. Every day felt like walking on eggshells. The energy in the house was chaotic and openly aggressive, making it impossible to feel at ease.

From the start, basic things that were advertised or reasonably expected were missing. I informed her in advance of my arrival time, yet when I arrived the ground was flooded due to defrosting, and I had to clean everything myself. There was no air purifier initially; she provided one only after I asked, and then I had to ask again once I realized the filters were dirty and unusable. Only after a second request did she replace it with a proper one. Throughout the stay, I constantly had to ask for basic necessities.

There were no cooking basics at all, no pots, pans, oil, salt, or pepper. When I asked about this, her response was extremely aggressive, and she explicitly told me, “You will not enter my kitchen.” As a result, any utensils she provided had to be washed in the bathroom. Her justification was that “cooking basics were not listed,” even though there was literally nothing available to cook with. I was also given a stained towel and had to ask for a replacement.

After these repeated adjustments, instead of addressing things professionally, Amy created a completely hostile environment. She would ignore me when I entered the building, refuse to greet or acknowledge me, and consistently made my presence feel unwelcome. No one should feel uncomfortable or emotionally unsafe in a place they are paying to stay.

At one point, I contacted Airbnb to explore changing accommodations. However, the prospect of having to face another aggressive interaction made me avoid further direct communication. I ultimately chose to leave early, and despite this, the host later sent a request demanding additional payment for my early departure.

I also want to highlight something deeply concerning. Amy made remarks to others implying that people of my nationality are entitled and exaggerate requests. This kind of generalization is inappropriate and discriminatory, and has no place in hospitality. Asking for what is advertised is not entitlement.

She frequently says, “If you need something, ask,” yet reacts aggressively when guests do ask, and then accuses them of being demanding. Most issues here could have been manageable if her attitude and behavior were not so unprofessional and hostile.

Amy should not be running an Airbnb. Again, If you look at other recent reviews of Creativitea, you will find similar patterns, which I am unfortunately here to corroborate.

I do not recommend any of the rooms in this place under any circumstances. There are far better, safer, and more respectful options in Chiang Mai. Stay away from this place.
review_2_text: My tour with Creativitea was canceled by the organiser less than 12 hours before the start, leaving me no realistic opportunity to arrange an alternative. The booking process involved copying a WhatsApp post about the tour, adding your name to the list, and transferring payment to the owner’s private account, without a formal booking confirmation or clearly communicated payment and cancellation terms. The communication from the owner, Amy, was aggressive and accusatory rather than professional. The organizer repeatedly shifted the blame onto customers instead of taking responsibility. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this company.
review_3_text:
I had an amazing time at creativitea, the room was super spacious, cozy, quit, clean and the bed is very comfortable. Felt very welcomed by the staff and owner. They have free laundry service, which is amazing! Very worth the already good price :)

The area is the best in town in my opinion, super quiet but very close to everything and only 10min away from the airport.
review_4_text:
I recently booked to stay here for one month.  I left half way through my stay due to the way Amy regularly spoke to me in an aggressive and condescending way that was completely unprovoked, I couldn't even walk from my room to the door without her finding a reason to bereate me,  it was awful. I didn't even ask for a refund as I didn't want to deal with another of her outbursts.

It was very upsetting to see the way Amy treated her sweet staff, the staff members mentioned in the earlier reviews have all left.  When I stayed 4 new staff had just been hired, when I left 2 weeks later 2 had already quit, and I hadn't seen one other around so hopefully he got out too.

I wouldn't recommend staying here, every day is like walking on eggshells
review_5_text: Poor coffee, poor communication from staff. The place looks decent but one of the staff shouldn't have been working and taken a day off to rest when I visited as she behaved strangely.

review_5_text: Nice weed. Good taste. Same strains I smoke in America.

The friendliness of the owner and staff is an added bonus.

Parking is very convenient, as there is a dedicated parking space right in front of the café (not street parking).
review_2_text: Chic cafe ! Seems like Seoul one tho.. pretty chills and peaceful recom to come to work !
review_3_text:
Best cakes and deserts and coffee in Chiang Mai.
Small but very cosy.
review_4_text: Tasty cakes and good service, minimalist Cafe, recommend 👌
review_5_text: If you want a well prepared cup of coffee please come here. Great beans and diligently prepared to bring out the tasting notes.

name: NoRA Matcha

The owner is super friendly and really passionate about matcha. Even if you don’t know anything about matcha, you’ll leave having learned something haha.

Great experience, thank you Nurse!
review_2_text: This shop is super cute! The owner is incredibly friendly and lovely, talkative, and provides excellent service. The green tea is amazing – not bitter, astringent, or cloying. Great vibe and delicious taste. Located in the Nimmanhaemin area.
review_3_text:
My first visit was amazing, and I was so impressed by the owner, Nurse.

review_2_text:

My go-to cafe in Chiang Mai. It can be packed but the people are friendly and some don’t mind sharing a table with you. The staff are friendly too!

I recommend the americano with orange juice (THB 100). It’s refreshing.
review_5_text:

name: TANVA Kafe

review_2_text: Tom, the owner is kind and handsome.  Coffee tastes good and high quality. Chic but casual and calming vibe.
review_3_text:
This place is proof you can do good coffee at an affordable price.

Nice retro atmosphere in the basement car park of a condo building. Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of Nimman. Quiet and peaceful environment.

The menu is pretty straightforward but the coffee quality is above average. Very affordable price for an area jam packed with expensive cafés serving mediocre coffee.
review_4_text: What an amazing place. Amazing coffee! Delicious and honest. Owner smiles a lot, my wife loves the decor. Recommend.
review_5_text:
Nice place to wait or if bored upstairs you can come down from your condo unit and enjoy drinking coffee or tea and relax.

Owner is nice and friendly. Foreigners and Thais enjoy their sip below while reading or waiting for a friend to come by. They have sandwiches also. Prices are very affordable.

name: Chapterone/cm
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop! Very pretty and aesthetic. Quiet and peaceful for working and has great internet. Staff was so friendly and kind. We enjoyed the honey garlic chicken, gochujang chicken, paprika french fries, iced latte and iced peach tea. There is a variety of seating upstairs in addition to what is available downstairs. review_2_text:
Nice minimalist Cafe, pleasant interior theme and calming music ideal of chats or even getting some work done.
Great atmosphere and friendly staff. Nice coffee. Average prices.
Wish they could have some nicer bakery items.
review_3_text: Pretty nice cafe with reasonable prices. 2nd floor is much bigger and it’s well spaced out. However the seats are limited. You may wanna check if your seat is available before ordering your drink here. Cappuccino here is 55k and it was good. There is a pubic bathroom right outside and it’s very clean.
review_4_text:
It is always a shame when businesses waste customers time with misinformation.

Boardgame evenings here are fun though.
review_5_text:
Very clean and quiet space to work. The matcha latte was delicious and the staff was so helpful and friendly. Will definitely come back 🤍

They also have board games to play upstairs (:

name: BeansLiquor
review_1_text:

Service was great(limited english speaking, but english on menus), atmosphere pretty quiet(great place to study and has outlets so your laptop doesnt die!), the decor was clearly thought about. And it has 3 FLOORS(eventually to be 4??) with lots of great seating and lighting. Highly recommend the place whether for a hangout or a study session.
I tried a coffee with Lychee syrup and a dessert cake, both of which were pretty decent. I will definitely come back!
review_2_text: Stumbled upon this place randomly on a morning walk. Delicious coffee and breakfast sandwich. The coffee shop is also very uniquely decorated and quite spacious with three floors.
review_3_text: Good coffee and delicious food, reasonably priced. The space is pleasant for working or studying with plenty of tables available (outlets too), but also nice minimalist decor for just enjoying a coffee. The staff are very kind and helpful
review_4_text:
Coffee is okay. Pasta is okay.

Staff are nice!! This coffee shop is very much work friendly.

Dont make the same mistake as me, good amount of tables and chairs with outlets are located at the 2nd and 3rd floor.
review_5_text: To be completely honest, I didn't set my expectations towards the food to taste this good despite how good the presentation is. The while place is well decorated and super chill. It's perfect for hanging out or even a nice brunch. 100% recommended.

review_5_text: Espresso is very smooth. Very nice costumer service. Prices are the best in the area, especially for the quality of ingredients.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Versailles de Flore
review_1_text:
I visited Versailles de Flore one morning with a friend for breakfast and to take photos. My main expectation was based on the Renaissance-style decoration inspired by the Palace of Versailles in France, so I initially imagined a more refined, luxury like experience.

In reality, it is not a luxury place, but rather a lovely and peaceful café with beautiful decor. The setting is very well done and makes you feel like you are walking through a small European museum. It’s a calm place and perfect for taking photos.

The breakfast was good. I ordered fried eggs served in a pan, accompanied by fish sausage, minced pork, toasted bread with butter and a touch of garlic, plus a small salad with lettuce and cherry tomatoes. I also had a cappuccino, which was nicely prepared.

There is no table service; you need to order and pay at the counter first, and then the staff brings your food. When we visited around 10 a.m., there was only one waiter and the cook, so the service felt simple and casual.

Prices are not high or exaggerated at all, they are very reasonable and comparable to other cafés in Chiang Mai, even those with much simpler designs. Coffee starts around 65–70 THB, which I found fair considering the atmosphere.
Overall, my experience was good, even though it was different from what I originally expected. I would recommend this place if you are looking for a beautiful, quiet, and photogenic café, as long as you don’t expect a luxury dining experience
review_2_text: I went there for coffee, the place is well designed but you will feel very unwelcomed, indoor ventilation is very poor, I request them to on some air-conditioning but after about one hour they off it. Service is also poor as staffs are few and they are busy observing outsiders to make sure that nobody take photos without any purchases. They need to change their marketing strategy considering that business isn't good despite such a special place.
review_3_text:
I had a great experience at Versailles de Flore in Chiang Mai. I tried their Duchess drink (a blend of rose, lychee, and cherry), and it was refreshing.  The fried rice with prawns was flavorful.

The place itself has a lovely ambiance, relaxing, aesthetic, and perfect for a slow afternoon or casual dinner. Overall, a wonderful spot to unwind with good food and drinks. Definitely worth a visit! 💪
review_4_text: It’s a Must visit if you are visiting Chiang Mai. Amazing food with amazing photo location. Place is not too far from the Old city. I visited there for breakfast. The french toast is 10000/10 amazing Highly Recommended 🤩
review_5_text:
I ordered the pasta with chilli and bacon which was good if you’re into spicy food.
I did not like my chai latte on the other hand :( but the staff was very nice and the vibe was so nice that I forgive the drink 😅

name: Ombra Caffe
review_1_text:
A calm and relaxing café with a refined sense of style. The interior is beautifully arranged with vintage typewriters and globes, creating a nostalgic yet cozy atmosphere. A bookshelf adds to the charm, making it an ideal place to enjoy a quiet moment with a book.

Free Wi-Fi is available, making it convenient for light work or a relaxing break. I had a latte and vanilla ice cream waffle — both were delicious and carefully prepared. A perfect hidden gem in Chiang Mai for those who appreciate a peaceful and well-designed space.
review_2_text: Had a wonderful breakfast here, super generos portions, coffee was really good as well. There's plenty of space and a few tables outside as well. It's laptop friendly too and with good wifi! Definitely recommend.
review_3_text: Ombra Caffe offers a fantastic atmosphere that perfectly balances modern, sleek design with a cozy, plant-filled interior patio. It’s an ideal workspace, boasting excellent Wi-Fi, abundant power sockets, and comfortable seating. The coffee is a highlight, with many praising their strong, well-made cappuccinos and beautiful latte art. They also cater to various dietary needs with non-dairy milk and vegetarian options on their food menu (which includes breakfast, brunch, and desserts like éclairs).
review_4_text:
Excellent cafe in Chiang Mai. Avocado on toast is very good. Bread is soft and delicious. Fresh ingredients. Excellent cappuccino. Oat milk and cane sugar. Knives cut well (you don’t get crazy to cut the bread). Nice interior, fresh ac, quiet cozy and well designed. Staff very friendly.
Highly recommended
review_5_text:
it used to be an issue finding good quality coffee in Chiangmai
but now a days there are good cafes in town. This is one of it and their espresso is very rich and full of flavors. I love this cafe.

name: MATCHA CABINET
review_1_text: I’m over the moon with this place. My hot matcha latte was exquisite! I have to come back to try all the different varieties. The place is super cute, walking through the door is like stepping through a portal into another dimension.
review_2_text: Matcha tart is very delicious. The coco cabinet signature menu is mellow and refreshing. There are many choices of matcha. Cute shop, cozy Japanese and Chiangmai vibes , with seats both inside and outside.
review_3_text: Cozy spot for matcha lovers. Their ceremonial-grade matcha is vibrant and perfectly whisked. Reasonable price for ceremonial-grade quality. Will definitely be back🍵
review_4_text: Matcha is delicious, good quality, good price. Most importantly, the dessert is very delicious. There are outdoor and indoor seats.
review_5_text: Nice shop with a good atmosphere, but it gets very crowded and there aren’t enough tables. The matcha tasted alright — decent, but nothing outstanding.

name: Connect
review_1_text: Cheap coffee, deckchairs and umbrellas. Very relaxing.
review_2_text: Coffee, Green Tea, Thai Tea

name: Deli Cafe : ห้วยแก้ว
review_1_text: Visited here 30 Dec 2023 around 7.45 am. The shop was not busy. Why was the staff impatient to serve the customer when there was no customer? The worst was that there is no way the cashier/waiter shouting his/her customer for nothing. Mostly, Thais are polite but not this staff. Super rude! Other than that, the shop is cozy, cute, and foods are good.
review_2_text:
Yes it's a gas station Cafe, and yet
☕ Is good, staff so nice and they have nice cakes
Who needs more?
review_3_text: I ordered a coffee and asked the only staff here “are the food menu available” and she shouted “NO NO FOOD!!” at me for no reason. There were only 2 customers including me. DO NOT GET YOUR COFFEE HERE. coffee is mid and customer service is terrible.
review_4_text: Next to the gas station, if there are not often guests outside the door, I would not know that there is a coffee shop, there are coffee bread and shop together, the store has a sign marked only in Thai, but I do not understand Thai.
review_5_text: Good place to work with your laptop.

name: Tawansy Restaurant & Cafe ตะวันซี่
review_1_text:
This little place, just northwest of old town, is a gem. While many restaurants have Thai and western offerings, the food here truly is truly a fusion of Thai, western, and middle eastern cuisines.

The owners, Ramy and Vi, are kind and attentive. Really nice people.

Everything was cooked to perfection and fresh. They use deliciously tender Australian beef for some dishes (like the beef with Jaew sauce) and Thai beef for others. They understand the nuances of flavors and use only the best seasonal ingredients.

Their Tamirind glazed chicken wings and prawns are unbelievably delicious.

The papaya salad (Some Tum Prara) is spicy, tangy, and delicious. Get some rice to soak up all the tasty good juice. Yum!

I will be coming back for sure.
review_2_text: Another really good spot in Chiang Mai. The food is always fresh and delicious. The menu is pretty big, so I had a lot of options to choose from. I already have been here a couple of times and every time I left with satisfaction in my stomach.😁
review_3_text: I stumbled on here looking for ginger tea. The lady was super kind enough to prepare one despite they don't make one as a regular drink from the menu. She also offered me a local Thai drink with spices that helps ease the stomach and prevents nausea. Thank you're very much!
review_4_text: I came here based on the good reviews on the map, but I was quite disappointed. The food took forever to arrive, and there was only one Thai chef. Considering the quality of the food, the price was far too high. The value for money was extremely low. I'm very puzzled by the positive reviews. The burger was okay, but at this price, I'd rather eat at Burger King.Not recommended, please do not take this risk.
review_5_text:
What a great find, such a warm welcome from the owner.
The food was amazing, so tasty, cooked perfectly to our taste, lots of gorgeous food to order off the menu, very reasonably priced.
Excellent service! We ordered the banana samosas…. New to the menu! Delicious, a must try! Highly recommend here..

name: CAFFEINE SHOP
review_1_text: This is the best Mocha I ever tried in Chiangmai! 60 Baht for a nice big cup. It's so delicious I just ordered another one. 😋
review_2_text: Good coffee made to order. Medium roast.Nutty,no bitterness.
review_3_text: Nice decoration in a cute little coffee bar. Covered outside seating for 2 to 4 makes it a pleasant experience.
review_4_text: Tiny cafe with good coffee. Outdoor sitting. 45B for a cold Americano.
review_5_text: Delicious Latte and nice owner

name: Calm Stay & Cafe
review_1_text:
I stayed here for 7 nights. The rooms are incredibly clean and well-organized. Located in a peaceful area, it’s only a 15-minute walk to Nimman and the Old Town. With Michelin-listed spots and local food stalls nearby, it’s the perfect base for foodies. It’s also ideal for those wanting a private bathroom on a budget. The cafe’s treats are great to give it a try.

Beyond the stay, the owner's kindness was the highlight. As a solo traveler in a career transition, his travel tips and sincere encouragement gave me so much courage to move forward. Calm Stay & Cafe will definitely be my first choice in Chiang Mai.😊
review_2_text: Good cafe with coffee and cakes. The coffee is reasonable priced. The atmosphere is welcoming. Staff is super friendly. Highly recommend for a little break or work place
review_3_text: What can I say about this place? The best carrot cake in Chiang Mai! I highly recommend it. The owner, Fifi, is incredibly kind and makes every customer feel truly welcome. If you're in Chiang Mai, take some time to visit Calm Stay & Café.
review_4_text:
We had a wonderful trip in Chiang Mai with help of airbnb owner. They helped us a lots, are very kind. The room is nice, comfortable and really new. On the first floor, there’s their coffee shop with good coffee and cake.
Airbnb is near a lots of good Michelin restaurant, from there to One Nimman is close too.
If I come back in Chiang Mai, I will recontact them for sure.
review_5_text: The bestest coffee shop open near to us using good materials and quality i l like there coffee cake and cha thai .there have room for stay also .

name: So good coffee & smoothie
review_1_text:
Perfect place for a drink stop (takeaway or small sit in place) while waiting for a table at the famous Michelin Khao Soi Maesai up the road.
The passionfruit yoghurt smoothie was a perfect blend of creaminess, sweetness and refreshing tangy flavour. So so delicious and the staff were super friendly too!
Would be keen to try other drinks including the mango, blueberry or mixed berry yoghurt smoothies.
review_2_text: Found this place by the famous Michelin Khao Soi Mae Sai and popped in while waiting for a table there. 5/5 and highly recommend! Service, atmosphere and the Thai green milk tea was exceptional. Don't get the Thai milk tea though, there are definitely places that do it better.
review_3_text: I tried their mixed berries smoothie and it was so good! 🍓Perfect balance of sweet and tangy, super refreshing, and you can really taste the fresh fruits. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the visit even better. Price was really affordable too, great value for such quality! Definitely a spot I’d come back to again. 💕
review_4_text: Great spot for a take away coffee or smoothie! It’s very small, so not much of a dine-in place. The service and prices are excellent. So far I’ve just had an Orange Americano. I love that they use real orange juice rather than syrup like some places. Will definitely be back.
review_5_text: Good coffee in town🫶🏻 small coffee shop that has such a good vibes either inside or outside. I ordered Iced Espresso, my favorite one!💖 and I tried Banana Smoothie which is not too sweet and still smell the scent of banana and honey🍌🍯

name: Happy Bird Day coffee
review_1_text:
We really enjoy this little neighborhood coffee shop, and it is definitely one of our favorites!
We always get amazing coffee, lattes, cappuccinos, and matcha drinks here. They have oat milk available for those who prefer to avoid dairy products.
Fresh pastries and cookies are available, too.
The place is small, so seating is a bit limited, but inside and outside seating is available.
We will keep stopping in here and will recommend it to our friends.
review_2_text:
Happy Bird Day Coffee is honestly a Chiang Mai gem. From the moment I walked in, the jazz and soul playing in the background set the whole mood  smooth, relaxed, and intentional. It just feels good to be there.
The coffee is rich and balanced, not overly bitter, just done right. You can tell care goes into what they serve. It’s the kind of place where you can sit for a while, think, have a real conversation, or just enjoy your own company. Definitely one of those spots you’re happy you discovered.
review_3_text: Great coffee and the owner seems like a very lovely person. We have been here several times since our accommodation was right around the corner. We really liked their cappuccino and matcha latte and the fact they also served oat milk.
review_4_text: Tiny coffee shop for a reasonable price. I had a cappuccino for 50 baht, which tasted great. Outside have only 5-6 chairs, so probably great just for a quick coffee break
review_5_text:
I love it here! Staff is absolutely gorgeous and their dog Panda is super cute. This place is my 1st or 2nd best coffee spot in Chiang Mai. It’s little and hidden from the hustle. Worth visiting. You can choose the roast and take a look to the cute pottery store next „door” (there is no door tho 😄)
I’ve ordered ice americano + extra espresso shot and paid 60 thb

name: Heart Together .cnx
review_1_text: Ordering coffee here is a bit difficult.  You will receive No smiles, no hello, no thank you, no have a nice day.   Not a polite coffee shop.  But, the coffee taste is excellent.  Management should train the staff in how to behave professionally.
review_2_text: This is my Fav.cafe for work and chill. They're so nice. I even need to order anymore just said SAME, they will bring that too me.
review_3_text: Great cafe! We tried their signature coffee (hot heart style coffee) and matcha latte.
review_4_text: Nice chilled air con bar and cafe serving lights meals, snacks and craft beer.
review_5_text:
Great coffee, great matcha tea.
Great place to work; good internet, comfortable chairs, good music, AC not annoying.

name: Ma Chill Dee สาขาสันติธรรม
Water is น้ำคือ วอเตอร์อีส
review_1_text: A small but very famous coffee shop in Chiang Mai. The coffee is fragrant, and the morning atmosphere by the old moat is lovely.

name: BogBog Coffee สาขา 2
review_1_text: Cute little coffee stand! Lots of options, kind staff spoke excellent English and I got to customize the sweetness of my coffee AND pick medium or dark roast. 45 baht latte, super yum!
review_2_text: Due to my own mistake, I misheard "normal sweet" as "no more sweet" when ordering. However, the shop owner kindly remade my drink free of charge. The coffee was delicious, the owner was very friendly, and the price was quite affordable.
review_3_text:
BogBog Coffee สาขา 2 is an absolute gem and a must-visit if you're in the area. This charming coffee shop, with its adorable dog-themed decor, creates a whimsical and cozy atmosphere that’s perfect for a refreshing break. I stopped here for a blueberry smoothie on my way to pick up my journal for 2025, and it was just what I needed. The smoothie was vibrant, fresh, and perfectly blended—a delicious pick-me-up that added a splash of color to my day.

What truly sets BogBog apart is its delightful dog motif, which runs through every corner of the shop. From the decor to the small, thoughtful details, it’s clear that this place is a labor of love for dog enthusiasts. It even got me reminiscing about Noel, my standard poodle from childhood. The idea that smart dogs, like Noel, might teach other dogs is a charming thought—and one that fits perfectly with the friendly and warm vibe of this café. I could easily imagine Noel leading a pack of eager students in this delightful setting.

If you’re in the mood for great drinks, a welcoming atmosphere, and a touch of canine-inspired cheer, BogBog Coffee สาขา 2 is the place to be. It’s the perfect stop to recharge and reflect on your day—whether you’re planning for the year ahead or just taking a moment to enjoy life’s simple pleasures.
review_4_text: They have really delicious drinks I had the cocoa with father
review_5_text: Do you like coffee, this is very good choice, for good price ❤️

name: Rom-D Brunch & Coffee
review_1_text: Very nice place!cozy atmosphere and the food was very delicious!Europeans will appreciate it anymore little more cause the breakfast menu is perfect 👌!recommend!
review_2_text: I saw they had pancakes on pictures so i asked for it but they were not on the menu. Now i understand why because they were not good. Jus plane pancakes and they charged 70 bht for it. I also ordered a toast with avocado and eggs, this was better but you can find a better price somewhere else. The ladies were kind and friendly tho!
review_3_text:
Very nice breakfast restaurant, extremely friendly owners and delicious food! I liked the toast with scrambled egg and bacon. My friend had the vegetarian set. Notice that the portions are bigger than they look ok the menu.

We will come tomorrow one more time, thank you!
review_4_text: Ended up being the best coffee I had in that area the whole 8 days I stayed in the area! Best big breaky in Thailand!!! Muffins are so yummy all flavours thanks so much 🙏🏽🙏🏽
review_5_text:
Had a great Brekky here. Options of a set menu or buffet for an affordable price. Got to try some food off the new menu and it was delicious. Coffee’s were great too!

Would happily return for good coffee, great food and lovely service!

name: PerSimmon Café
review_1_text: Beautiful little coffee shop - very chill ambience and fantastic coffee along with yummy soft cookies.
review_2_text: What a gorgeous find in Chiang Mai! A stones throw from where I am staying. They serve delicious coffee and have a cat (perfect combo) also they sell local ground coffee so I can enjoy the coffee elsewhere too. Such a cute place really quirky and reminds me of home cafes.
review_3_text:
Laid back coffee shop with AC.  Nice coffee and good value.  Inside and outside seating
We had Lattes
review_4_text: Stumbled upon this hidden gem around the corner with coconut ice cream and a nostalgic & relaxed atmosphere 😎
review_5_text: My favorite coffee shop in the old city! Great coffee and lovely people working there☺️

name: Marie Coffee กาแฟมารี
review_1_text: The best café, kind lady, big size drinks, tasty! Also have plant based / vegan milk options 🥰 I come here almost daily
review_2_text: Lovely place and very kind owner. The drinks are amazing and affordable. Been going there for month. Recommend!
review_3_text: A lovely little café with excellent coffee quality. You can really taste the care in every cup. The owner is incredibly kind and welcoming, which makes the whole atmosphere warm and inviting :)
review_4_text: Super cute and chill coffee shop run by a lovely woman! The coffee tastes great and the prices are fair 🌞
review_5_text: very cozy and chill place 😊 the owner is very kind and available, will be back for sure!

name: Stan’s Cafe
review_1_text: Small cozy café with a great atmosphere. I love that they offer a wide selection of coffee beans to choose from
review_2_text: I have a hot coffee latte, the taste was very delicious for me. Normally I like to have medium roasted bean, this time I grow in the dark roast. The music taste and the atmosphere was match with the coffee. The barista 'Liam' also really nice and so friendly.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee
review_4_text: The shop is cute and the staff provides good service.

name: Mac Cafe Santitham
review_1_text: Excellent phone shop with a wide range of products. The staff are knowledgeable, polite, and not pushy. Prices are reasonable, and the overall service was smooth and trustworthy.
review_2_text: Great service every time! Friendly staff, easy to talk to, and very supportive. They take good care of your items. Highly recommend if you need quick cash. 😊🙏🏻
review_3_text: The price is really valuable for us. The shop and cafe are spacious. We are grateful that Oil helped us a lot. She is polite, gentle, explain very clear and carefully all information. If you need some place to buy the IPhone Ipad Macbook, we recommend this place
review_4_text: The staff are polite and the service is friendly. The shop is clean.
review_5_text: such a wonderful experience to be here, also the service are great!

name: One life Hostel
review_1_text: Had such a great stay at One Life Hostel! Fabien and Jenny were incredibly hospitable and friendly, they really make you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. My bed was super comfortable, the place was very clean and just had such a nice, relaxed aura about it. The location is perfect as well. I’d definitely stay here again on my next trip to Chiang Mai 😊
review_2_text:
Had the best stay here at One Life! A lovely social-but-not-party community feeling hostel!

‼️‼️**I stayed in 9+ hostels in Old City over my 2 months in CNX - see my FAVS at the bottom**‼️‼️

Owner Fabien does an excellent job of making you feel at home, I’m so impressed he greets everyone by name as they come in the door!

The rooms were great, single beds - not bunks😍 I love that the girls room had an on suite bathroom but the room was so spacious and the bathroom was far from the beds - just perfect!

Beds were cozy, with a huge comforter! Mattress was classic for an asian hostel- fine but not as plush as I am used to from home.

Great wifi, lobby/cafe to work from and free coffee / tea!

+Kawa the dog 🥰🐕

Amazing - would highly recommend!

‼️I stayed in 9+ hostels in Old City over my 2 months in CNX here are my 5 favs I would stay at again!
(Chill 😌 & Party ish 🍻 & free brekky🍳)

😌🗣️🍳Entaneer Poshtel (south)
😌🍳Common Hostel (NW)
😌🗣️One Life Hostel (north)
🍻🗣️Islander Chiang Mai (south)
🍻🍻🗣️Stamps (east)
review_3_text:
Amazing stay at One Life Hostel Chiang Mai!
I was warmly welcomed by Jenny, Fabien, and their lovely dog. they were incredibly kind and gave me great recommendations.
The hostel is very clean, calm, and comfortable. The breakfast and coffee are excellent, and the location is perfect.
If I ever come back to Chiang Mai, I will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: Had a lovely 4 night stay at One Life, it was the perfect hostel for my travel style! It was social in the sense that everyone I met was very friendly, but it is not a party vibe so I could sleep peacefully at night. Always kept very clean, and the owners are helpful to arrange tours if you'd like. Kawa, the dog, comes with the owners to work most days to hang out in the lobby and is a perfect angel! She's friendly, but if you're wary of dogs she minds her own business. They also offer a same-day laundry service that is incredibly convenient and affordable. One life is on the same street as many other hostels, so you can find lots of other travelers if you'd like. Also right along the center square of town, and down the street from a 7-11.
review_5_text:
I stayed at One Life Hostel and honestly, it was one of the best parts of my Chiang Mai trip. The hosts were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and they even have a super cute Shiba Inu (sorry, I forgot the name but she made my mornings!).

The rooms are unique and thoughtfully designed. They offer both private rooms and dorms, which is perfect depending on how you’re traveling. The common area is cozy and great for meeting other travelers, and they even provide free snacks and beverages which is a lovely touch.

Located in a great area with lots of restaurants and cafes nearby, it’s super convenient. I’ll definitely be staying here again when I’m back in town!

name: Red Panda Hostel & Cafe
review_1_text: I’m extremely happy with everything 👍 The place is clean, cozy, and welcoming. The staff are thoughtful and attentive—two wonderful girls. I really appreciated the daily breakfast; it was delicious, and I ended up loving the fried eggs and cornflakes. As a keepsake, I even bought a little panda to take home. This hostel gave me amazing memories and truly made my trip special.
review_2_text:
Red Panda Café & Hostel is an absolute gem in Chiang Mai.

From the moment I arrived, the whole place felt incredibly warm, cozy, and welcoming — the kind of hostel where you instantly feel at home. The atmosphere is calm and comfy, perfect for relaxing after exploring the city.

The staff and service are truly exquisite. Everyone is friendly, attentive, and genuinely cares about the guests. They even helped me organize transportation to Mon Jam, which made the trip completely stress-free and easy — a huge plus!

The bedding deserves a special mention: the laundry was spotless, fresh, and super comfortable. It’s one of those small details that makes a big difference, and here it was done perfectly.

On top of all that, the café is lovely and adds so much character to the hostel. Great vibes, great people, and great service all around.

I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend Red Panda Café & Hostel to anyone looking for a cozy, friendly, and well-run place to stay in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: This place is amazing! Chonnicha is such a bright, hard working, kind hearted woman (speaks multiply languages also). I have been coming back to this place again and again, because I am so happy with everything. Always clean, charming hostel. The breakfast you can chose and tastes amazing also. They pay attention to details and that everything goes perfectly. I think one if not the best hostel in Ching Mai. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to rest in a safe, clean, charming place.
review_4_text: Very lucky to stay in this nice hostel. The whole place is super modern and convenient. The bed is super clean and comfortable, the breakfast is awesome with many options, both the receptionists are helpful and nice, met some really nice people from different countries. If next time I come to Chiangmai, I would definitely stay in this place again.
review_5_text: Highly recommended youth hostel! The place is tastefully decorated, absolutely gorgeous, and has such a vibrant vibe. It’s not just a hostel—it also doubles as a café, and their coffee and drinks are truly delightful. The hostel itself is set in a lovely environment, with spotlessly clean shared bathrooms, incredibly soft beds, and a delicious breakfast. What’s more, the two female staff members are exceptionally warm, outstanding, and dedicated to serving every guest with care. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

name: Barneo Dessert Bar
review_1_text:
Such a cozy and charming dessert spot 🧀✨
The cheese pastry was absolutely amazing: served hot, perfectly crispy on the outside, and generously filled with rich, sweet cheese filling. Every bite was incredibly satisfying.

The place itself feels warm and inviting, with lots of beautiful flowers adding a special touch. Everything was clean and well-kept, making the experience even more enjoyable.

A lovely place to relax and treat yourself. I’d definitely come back again!
review_2_text:
I was here two years ago, and they moved the location to the side of the building where it onee was. A very cute place and definitely a place to bring a date.  They make really good dessert especially the cheese cake, and they also have a very good coffee making machine.  While I was there for brunch, I only had coffee and the cheese cake 🍰 dessert.  Because it’s December, it was really nicely decorated, and I can’t imagine it being a good spot for taking holiday photos.

For me this place offer one of the best cheesecake in town and I will definitely be back for some more. 🍰
review_3_text: Loved everything about this café delicious drinks, amazing Cheesecake and desserts, and such a peaceful vibe. Perfect spot to just sit, relax, and escape the city for a while. If you’re in Chiang Mai, you really shouldn’t miss this place.
review_4_text:
Awesome desert bar/cafe!
You must try all the deserts….
The cheesecake and the coconut cake were our favorite!
The cafe is very nicely decorated and the service was excellent.
A must visit in Chiang Mai and free onsite parking….
review_5_text: The owner is very friendly and very attentive,  she even turned on the AC for me when I came in! The matcha lemonade is super delicious, tastes very fresh, and is the perfect amount of sweetness, and the tapioca tastes very fresh and high quality! This is the best boba I’ve had in Thailand so far :) the interior is also very cute and cozy, they have free wifi, and I love how they decorate for Christmas. There’s also cute cats who live nearby. I highly recommend this place if you are in the old city and are looking to relax while drinking refreshing boba tea

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Best staff in Chiang  Mai in any Amazon .I always friendly, I always start my day with a double espresso , luckily non of those cheap one coffee use free wi fi Nomads here….
review_2_text: It's not a good workspace because there's a 1-hour limit on wifi. The air isn't that good either, perhaps because of the smell from the air conditioner, and the seats are uncomfortable.
review_3_text: You can pour the entire content of a regular cappuccino into a small cappuccino. A complete scam to make an extra 10 Bahts from customers.
review_4_text: I could smell moles…. Tables were very dirty… view in front of a temple was good though
review_5_text: I love their hot americano ☕️, staff is always professional , AC is great, good place to work too or cool down while on road trip

name: ASMR Cafe & Wellness
review_1_text: Such a great spot! The massage was really good, and I loved the big complimentary bowl of soup — the pineapple ginger pork rib soup and passionfruit tom yum were super yummy. The drinks tasted great too. I ordered the Khao Soi Kai and it had a small twist from the usual, subtle but interesting. Definitely worth checking out if you’re in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text:
ลำ! = delicious 😋

Must do cafe while in Chiang Mai!

Such a pleasant cafe to get the juices flowing... We ordered a Khao Soi which was the best we've ever had... also had a latte which tasted fantastic 😋

The atmosphere was great and the service was 10 out of 10. Prices are also great for what you get.

Highly recommended 👌

If you found this review helpful, please give me a thumbs up 👍 (it's free!) and follow me for more honest reviews 🙏 ❤️ 🙌
review_3_text: Of all the places I've been to eat and drink, this is probably my favorite. It is such a nice place, the atmosphere is pretty chill. But the thing is this place also has the best hot chocolate I've tried and they have options on how yoh want your hot cocoa. And the coffee they serve is also very good with different options as well. I get the americano every time i go to a new cafe and I can say it was one of my favourites of all time. The Khao Soi and the Ash Pepper Fried Chicken are also some of the must trys. If you're ever in Chiang Mai, you must definitely give this place a try.
review_4_text: “Such a lovely find in this diverse food heaven. Authentic flavours made with heart. We tried the morning glory soup — what a wonderful surprise! The duck egg added beautiful texture. The décor is elegant, modern and stylish. It’s a pity we came so late. We’ll definitely be back for the drinks.
review_5_text:
Wow, such an amazing and aesthetically pleasing cafe! I enjoyed working on my laptop here with an iced coffee and their fast wifi. I love that they give you a glass of complimentary ice water on arrival!! 😍😍😍🧊

Seriously one of my fave quiet working cafes in CNX!

name: Minimal coffee - santitham
review_1_text: Nice atmosphere, good coffee, and friendly staff. Prices are reasonable and the café is very comfortable. Highly recommended!...
review_2_text: Great coffee cute staff and love atmosphere at a great price
review_3_text: Minimal is a good pick up coffee chain in Chiang Mai. This location does not feel as nice as others I have been to probably because others were much newer. The coffee here was still pretty good though.
review_4_text: The shop is cute  minimalist easy on the eyes good drinks affordable price good service staff
review_5_text:
If you are looking for a decent coffee at a reasonable price, this is a place you must try.
Believe it or not, all the drinks are under 50 THB.

name: alga.cafe
review_1_text:
The cafe features stunning architecture and interior design with beautifully coordinated materials. It creates the ambiance of being in a cozy shelter—cool and inviting with a warm atmosphere. The wait was a bit long due to their meticulous preparation, but the coffee is delicious. The latte is exceptionally good and aromatic.
​​​​​​​
review_2_text: Passed by this cafe on my way to lunch. It’s air conditioned, empty and had a minimalist environment. Got a pear latte less sweet (thb85) to try, love how the coffee was pretty strong and not overpowered by the milk. The pear syrup also went nicely with the coffee, adding a hint of sweetness but not cloying. Highly recommend as a pit stop in the hot weather!
review_3_text:
A great little cafe just north of Chiang Mai's old city. Alga serves fantastic coffee and cakes. Staff are friendly and the decor is beautiful. From the outside the view of the cafe is stunning and this is matched by the design on the inside. Highly recommended!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
review_4_text:
Cleanest bathroom in a cafe- Ever.
Free wifi, comfy seats (inside) and good coffee (had the oatmilk latte with dark roast which was was smooth and balanced).
review_5_text: We had pear latte, ice americano and banoffee. That was great. Lots of parking space, indoor and outdoor seating.

name: MokaBrikka
review_1_text: Outstanding service and the most delicious smoothies I've ever had! The staff was friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience enjoyable.
review_2_text: Good price for coffee n smoothies.
review_3_text: The shop is lovely, and the owner is very kind and friendly.
review_4_text: This small, clean café offers a very strong Americano. The staff are friendly and have a beautiful smile.
review_5_text: Plum soda.... 🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻

name: T&M CAFE
review_1_text: Good coffee, tasty cake and super nice staff! Overall just an very comfortable atmosphere
review_2_text: I met a cutie cat Dollars. Love chocolate cakes ❤️
review_3_text: The location of this café is very convenient for visitors. It is located in the heart of the city, very close to a lot of attractions. The snacks and drinks are also some of the best in the area. Not to mention, the cheap prices and cozy atmosphere. 10/10 would come back again.
review_4_text: cake is nice and cheap
review_5_text: A cute cafe decorated with cat models everywhere. Delicious drinks, lots of snacks, and cute knick-knacks too. 💗

name: NOOK CAFExBAR
review_1_text: Fantastic breakfast plate. Fha and his staff are so friendly and go out of their way to make sure you’re happy. The kids had the waffles and pancakes. My husband and I had the yogurt muesli fruit bowl and avocado toast with latte’s. It did not disappoint!
review_2_text: This café is located next to Premier Hostel, where I regularly stay. The hostel is very convenient and provides good service, and every time I stay there, I also visit this café. Whether for work or meeting with friends, the service here is excellent, genuine and attentive to customers.
review_3_text:
Scale 1-10:
Food-8
Price-6
Service-8
Atmosphere-9
Cleanliness-9
review_4_text: The mango sticky rice, the watermelon juice and watermelon smoothie were all excellent 🤤
review_5_text: We order from here often because we live close by (dine in, takeaway, and delivery)and it's always pretty good. Unfortunately each time we order, something in our order is wrong or missing. (Missing sides, missing fruit, wrong preparation) Today I ordered hot coffee, but received an iced coffee. We've tried to call, but no answer and today we've left Facebook messages trying to fix the order, but no response. It's cheap so I understand and don't expect much, but it would be nice if we could contact someone when things are wrong. Thank you for having us 🙏

name: Stan's Cafe
review_1_text: Amazing coffee and very friendly staff ❤️🙂
review_2_text: Stumbled on this cute little cafe and had a delicious iced coffee. Staff were so friendly! If you’re in the area, don’t miss out!
review_3_text: The smoothies and hot coffee are delicious. There's plenty of seating, and the staff are lovely.
review_4_text:
The drinks are delicious, the staff are kind and friendly, and the restrooms are clean and inviting.
The shop is right next to the restaurant.
review_5_text: The matcha latte was delicious, and the service was great. A perfect place to relax and chill.

name: Dr.Manny Cafe
review_1_text: Reasonable prices. Unfriendly staff. I ate here three times (the breakfast  was good). The waitress and the owner both do not smile or make eye contact.  They make you feel very unwelcome. I am giving two stars just because of that.
review_2_text: Used as a restaurant, not stayed. Khao Tom ข้าวต้ม was quite good for my stomach every morning. Coffice made me wake up. Took out Sandwich and yummy. You can be relaxed. Could charge mobile and laptop. Mosquito protection is essential.
review_3_text: We have eaten here several times while in Chiang Mai.  It is our favorite here! The prices are great; the Thai food is fabulous and fresh.  Wonderful coffees and fresh fruit shakes.  The staff is lovely and some understand English, quite well.
review_4_text: When simple local food is done so well and authentically, it is such a blessing. Pineapple fried rice, a common dish in Thailand, is yummy and cooked with good Jasmine rice and fresh ingredients. No hypster-ized decor or fancy fusion menu but what is presented on the table is so comforting to the appetite and the soul. Pairing that with a heaven-sent fresh coconut with tender flavourful flesh and refreshingly delicious water, this lunch of 130 baht is  a wonderful first meal in Chiang Mai. A very lucky chance encounter.
review_5_text:
I ate Fried rice chicken, it was super good. Big portion and delicious. People who is working there are really nice.
I will definitely come back.
Please if your are around here, just go there and try their food. You won't regret.

name: One life Café
review_1_text:
Must visit this cafe when you're in Chiang Mai. Its so clean and comfortable and social, the owners Jenny and Fabien are lovely too! Such a relaxing vibe. I had Yorkshire Tea and French Toast with Nutella and Banana, and it was AMAZING!
Kawa the dog topped it all off. SO cute!

P.s there is a hostel attached to the cafe, the best hostel I have stayed in so far on my trip.
review_2_text: Very good spot for breakfast. The atmosphere is chill and friendly with nice people from the hostel and super nice staff always up for a chat. There was an adorable dog when we were there. The coffee is good and the food is nice for a good price
review_3_text: Lovely little cafe I happened to come across for quick breakfast, the owners are very friendly, and they have the loveliest little dog! The French toast with fruit was so delicious and refreshing! I didn’t stay, but would definitely wish too if I return to chiang Mai!
review_4_text: Amazing food and drinks. Great atmosphere. The owners are so lovely, and their dog is so cute. I would recommend this place to anyone coming to Chiang Mai! 5⭐️
review_5_text:
We had breakfast the last morning we stayed at the hostel and it was so freaking good! We ordered one iced latte and an iced mocca which was so so good and after that we had the French toast bacon which was also amazing for a really good price🙈
Go check it out if you want to have a chill moment and if you want to meet new people or even talk with the owners, Jenny and Fabien who are amazing people😇

name: Red Panda Cafe - Santitham
review_1_text: Love this place! However last few times I have come its always closed… not sure why it doesn’t show up in google.
review_2_text: I stayed for 10 days, and the bed was made every day. The bed was spacious enough that I could sit up straight without bending over, and it was very soft and comfortable. The soundproofing was a little poor, but backpacker rooms are really unpredictable; if you're worried about noise, just stay in a hotel. Thank you, beautiful Lily! 😘😘😘
review_3_text: A peaceful place, friendly atmosphere, and all the staff are lovely. Perfect for reading, working, or just chilling. Highly recommended! ❤️
review_4_text: The atmosphere is great, the coffee is delicious, and there are many beautiful photo spots.
review_5_text:
I tried their coffee two months ago. It tasted good.
I recommend improving the air conditioning system.
The AC is very noisy.

name: Macnuts Coffee
review_1_text: I usually travel across town to get their coffee. It’s really good. You can actually taste the coffee. Many of these coffee places all you taste is the milk so this was a very lovely experience. My partner also enjoys their Thai tea. No place to really sit minimal chairs and not a place to work. Is attached to a hostel.
review_2_text: Hands down the best coffee I’ve had in Thailand!
review_3_text:
We got ourselves Iced Americano and Iced Latte, love it. It's so refreshing and love that the barista is serious about her techniques.

Would come back again.
review_4_text: A coffee shop in the Chang Phuek area. I got a coffee matcha latte and it's nice! Besides, they roasted coffee beans by themselves and also have their house brand cold brew.
review_5_text: Best coffee I've had in Chiang Mai, freshly roasted and brewed, and I always get the best service.

name: Hair Caffé
review_1_text: I was curious because it was near my one-month stay. I asked the friendly staff for recommendations on good toppings, and they gave me iced coconut milk with toppings, shaved ice, and syrup. The others were served warm, but this was cold. Among the recommended toppings, this one had a crunchy texture, and the base was sweet enough even on its own, so I skipped the syrup and added shaved ice here and there. I think it's Thai-style jerky, but I've seen it sold in markets and stores. You should try it. I liked it. The store was clean, too. The outlets only work on the ones on the cement wall.

name: Star coffee
review_1_text: Great place! The couple is super lovely! And the coffee is great, iced is 45bn. I reccomend!
review_2_text: Good coffee and affordable.
review_3_text: The ice mocha I got was really nice and chocolaty. It was 45 baht for an iced mocha or 40 for a normal one.
review_4_text:
A really great experience! We had coffee and matcha tea.
Very friendly and full of adorable cats belonging to the owners.
review_5_text: One of the best places in Chiang Mai to have a quiet coffee. I went back every day I was in the city.

name: HUTO HOME STAY - ฮูโต๋ โฮมสเตย์
review_1_text: An intimate and peaceful small Zen oasis in Chiang Mai. The couple who run the cafè are really sweet and friendly. In addition to a good selection of warm and cold drinks, they offerend  nice books, heartwarming conversations & reccomandations for meditation centres and other travel advices. A good place if you feel overwhelmed by the sometimes loud soundscapes of Chiang Mai with a lovely atmosphere and a small, beautiful garden.
review_2_text:
