Had a really wonderful time and experience at the HUTO Meditation Cafe.

The environment is really nice, calm, and comfortable. I ordered a cappuccino and it was delicious. Quality coffee and presentation.

I also spoke to the owners and they were so kind and generous. I asked some questions about meditation and he was a former monk so he has a vast knowledge and understanding, and he gave me really detailed and helpful answers.

It was a really cool experience. One I’ll surely remember. I’m very grateful.

I definitely will be returning and I highly recommend you take a visit, it’s a special spot.
review_3_text: We stumbled across this lovely little cafe accidentally and SO glad we did! Peaceful atmosphere, very sweet staff, delicious coffee, and a calm space to sit and relax and enjoy 🙏
review_4_text: Highly recommend! Awesome environment, Got tons of energy in this magical space, Good quality cafe, Great music! Here’s heaven with no doubt!!
review_5_text: Five stars are not enough to describe the experience at this place!! Bell and FM are the absolute best!! We love them and will be back as soon as we can for sure. Much Love

name: ร้านแฮปปี้คอฟฟี่ ถนนหัสดิเสวี
review_1_text: I purchased an avocado large smoothie here for 30 baht. I guess the name has changed but can also confirm I purchased from the pink sign Happy Coffee immediately through the gate. Very delicious. Would buy repeatedly.
review_2_text: The name of the shop has changed. It's now Happy Coffee. They only serve drinks, no food. There are chairs and tables lined up so you can sit and drink.
review_3_text: It must have gone bad. We took the mango out of the freezer, and it was frozen, about 100 grams at most, the rest was ice and water—you couldn't even taste the mango.
review_4_text: Very kind and nice coffee.
review_5_text: The best mango shake, cheap and delicious

name: Café chez JEUNE
review_1_text: I like the design and very good coffee in Chiang Mai. Thank you for serving me a thai herbal tea (little bit sweet but good smell).

name: Lady secret cafe
review_1_text:
Adorable cafe with green views and lovely staff.
We spend 250 baht and got a lucky stuffy.
Coffee is excellent too.
Worth the 4 floor climb.
Not wheelchair accessible.
review_2_text: If you walk into an abandoned warehouse looking thing and wonder if you’re going the right way — you are! Once you’re up on the fourth floor, tasty drinks, a cool place to recharge, and WiFi await. Was a great place to stop when we had an hour to kill.
review_3_text:
This place is truly a wonderful secret
Delicious drinks and yummy pastries
A nice cool and relaxing place to sit and enjoy some treats and time listening to local music while hiding away from the bustling city with a Birds Eye view of the activities below
review_4_text: This cafe has a charming, calm atmosphere—perfect for a quick coffee break or getting some work done. The cozy rooftop area is a great spot to relax, and there are plenty of seating options inside as well
review_5_text: Super cute hidden gem on the edge of the old city. Views were immaculate and the coffee was delightful. Definitely recommend for a morning drink.

name: Convex Cafe
review_1_text: Make sure you put this on your must try list!  Superb espresso drinks, lattes, macchiato, etc.  Very friendly service and just overall wonderful people!
review_2_text: A perfect little no frills coffee shop! The coffee is great and I love the complimentary little cookie. Would recommend the iced Americano!
review_3_text: Beautiful coffee, great service and relaxing atmosphere to sit down and enjoy
review_4_text: I was walking on the road and found this amazing coffee shop, very cosy and the coffee was delicious. Also the owner took care of me very well, she was so friendly and beautiful! I recommend anyone who wants to chill out and drink coffee to try this new coffee shop!
review_5_text: Delicious coffee and fruit shakes. Very reasonable prices in a great quiet location. Owner and staff speak good english and are very friendly and accommodating. I would highly recommend this coffee shop.

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขาช้างเผือก
review_1_text: Really delicious coffee to go, oat milk available, unbeatable price, and super cool staff. Definitely deserves more attention! ☕️
review_2_text:
The best Iced Thaitea i drank so far!
The barista is also very friendly. Thank you so much and see you soon!
review_3_text: Super good coffee in Chiang Mai. They are open from 7am and have a tasty coffee. The barist is also super nice. Recommended!

name: coffee Let it Be & Beer
review_1_text: The lovely lady running the place makes every Thai Tea from scratch and really cares about her costumers. She also makes clothes and little cute souvenirs herself. The atmosphere is very chill and great to relax there.
review_2_text: A very cozy café with a home-like atmosphere. It is located in the owner’s home, and all of the décor is handmade by the owner, which adds a personal touch. The space is small but peaceful, and we felt welcomed and comfortable during our visit. The owner showed us all the things she made herself. A nice spot to relax and enjoy a quiet café experience. Drinks were priced reasonably and were good.
review_3_text:
I ordered Thai Tea with ice.

A lovely café with a great atmosphere and a charming vintage vibe. It’s a perfect place to relax, run by a lovely couple who are very warm and welcoming.
review_4_text:
Foremost: The owner is such a friendly woman! She is so polite friendly and happy, we came back a second time.
The Fresh orange juice with espresso coffee combination is so perfect and tastes so good, really nice place to sit some time and relax.

Roy and Angelo
review_5_text: Such a cute little coffee spot! Really friendly service, great prices and amazing drinks. I was craving Thai milk tea with coffee, despite it on being actually on the menu she was happy to make it! Will be coming back here for sure!

name: mountain view cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Great place to sit, work and enjoy a meal! The space is small but has great wifi so I was able to work on my laptop for a few hours. Eggs and toast were 89 baht, good but as is common in asia they were too sweet (I think its the butter??) the 100 baht small fruit plate was great! I’m sure they rotate but today came with pineapple, watermelon and mango 😍
review_2_text: We loved this place for our morning breakfast. Decent price, food was tasty and we enjoyed quite a lot the banana pancake. The patio is quite and lovely for a relaxing breakfast.
review_3_text:
What a cute and cozy cafe! Very nice staff, good sandwiches, decent cappuccino.
They also have a few handmade jewelry for same and some souvenirs made from an ngo helping women who went thru abuse. I actually bought a necklace as it was very nice and well made.
Give this place a visit. 😁

🙋🏻‍♀️ My travel tips & recommendations on insta: deea_journey
review_4_text:
This is a great cafe on Chang Pheuk gate of the walled old city of Chiang Mai. It has a lovely outdoor seating overlooking the busy road and moat and Chang Pheuk gate as well as a great garden outdoor seating behind the guest house (yes they also run a lovely guest house). Indoor air conditioned seating is there too.

Food is good, from breakfast to main course meals - both Thai and western. Coffee is good too.

Best asset is the staff of Mountain View. Very helpful and warm and hospitable,

Lovely maintained plants and water fountains
review_5_text: A cool small cafe on the opposite to chiang phuak market on the main Street. The food is great, usually there is no waiting. It's work friendly cafe, you can also meet other tourists. WiFi and water is free. Closes on 6 pm and sometimes 5 pm.

name: ทองสุขคาเฟ่ | THONGSUK CAFE |
A-Roon coffee
review_1_text:
Best coffee in Chang Mai without a doubt. Extraordinary service and perfect quality.
The basque cheesecake was surprisingly delicious.
The barista is a very nice and very polite young man.

Kop khun ka, my friend🙏🏼🫶🏼
review_2_text: By far the best coffee in Chiang Mai so far. Espresso 40 baht is light, fruity, lemon, not bitter at all, made from Arabica beans of the family farm of the owner, a young guy. Don't go elsewhere, highly recommended.
review_3_text: The owner is very friendly and warm.There are many coffee shops in Chiang Mai, but I highly recommend this coffee shop.The owner gave me my favorite cake as a gift.🤭Drinking coffee makes me feel happy.☺️
review_4_text: This is the place for caffee lovers and all these people who want to try excellent caffee for just a fair and affordable price. The owner is a caffee enthusiast and every cup he makes it's really the real deal. It's a MUST when you are visiting Chiang Mai! Thank you for great cup of latte and the positive vibes in your great caffee shop! Appreciate it 🙌
review_5_text: A lovely and popular coffee shop located near the North Gate of the Old Town. Good coffee at affordable prices, friendly staff!

name: Into the Woods
review_1_text: The second time I have come back here and we are only here for a few days! The food is so good ♡ and the atmosphere is relaxing and calm. They don't rush you and have a few great all day breakfast options. I love the mural on the wall and the decorations 😍
review_2_text: Lovely place for coffee, a chat, or an hour or so of focus. Mellow tunes, woody tones, great coffee, comfy chairs, and pleasant service. Solid! Pretty popular with a touristy crowd on a weekday midmorning.
review_3_text: Welcome to the lost woods in the old town Chiangmai. Loved their hospitality and interior. Good coffee and dishes.
review_4_text:
What a gem! The first day I came here I ordered the latte with chili honey - the coffee here is amazing! I also ordered the pork stew - no exaggeration to say it was one of the best stews of my life! So simple, yet so delicious.

I enjoyed it so much I came back the next day and ordered the glass noodle soup. They also have a dessert that looks just like a kitchen sponge! It’s so realistic I thought they were making a joke of selling sponges in the dessert window lol! I had to buy it and it was fun and tasty.
review_5_text: Super cozy cafe with amazing atmosphere 😍 Ladies working there were kind and friendly. Recommend trying the carrot cake ☺️

name: Hillkoff (Chang Puek)
review_1_text: Coffee lovers dream place. Lol heaven on earth. I always buy my coffee beans here. Either online or when I'm physically here, I have them ship it. They've got a cute coffeeshop as well and it's the best cappu yen I've had. 😂
review_2_text: Nicest coffee store in have seen in Thailand and lived here 10 years. Many Single estate and local coffees from Northern Thailand 🇹🇭 awesome selection of high end espresso machines and accessories😁
review_3_text: This place has everything coffee related, from wholesale coffee machines to drip coffee. I was so happy I was able to find coffee filters for my AeroPress!
review_4_text: Hillkoff coffee shop is the best! They have everything you could possibly need. And the staff is very nice and helpful. I highly recommend!
review_5_text: This place has almost everything you can possibly image needing for coffee or tea. Just a cool experience to walk around in. We also got a hot cappuccino & an iced mocha. Both very good! 😍

name: Riflesso Artisan Gelato
review_1_text:
Best gelato we’ve had in Asia so far! Super creamy, rich, and full of flavor. They also have vegan options and they’re surprisingly creamy too, not watery at all.
You can really taste the quality of the ingredients. If you’re in Chiang Mai and want proper gelato, this is the place. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
The best ice cream in Chiang Mai!
Super creamy, rich flavors, and made with very fresh ingredients. You can really taste the quality and attention to detail. Great variety of unique flavors, friendly staff, and a relaxed atmosphere. A must-visit for all ice cream lovers — I’ll definitely be back! 🍦😄
review_3_text: Giving this place 3 stars. The gelato tasted good, no complaints about the flavor, but it was nothing extraordinary to justify the price. I understand they use imported ingredients and I am not saying they should not charge premium prices, but 100 THB for such a small scoop feels a bit too much. It is decent ice cream, just not something that makes me want to come back again.
review_4_text:
Lovely little place with very tasty and refreshing gelato, perfect to cool down on yet another hot day!
The Chocomint was very mibty which I loved. Not so easy to find good icecream places in the city, so finding Riflesso was a wonderful surprise. I now know where to stop for an gelato icecream break when in the old city.
review_5_text: Tried their Pistachio Vegan and Dubai Chocolate — both were smooth, creamy, and a little sweet. The Pistachio had a rich, I personally prefer their Vegan version compared to the one with milk, nutty flavor that tasted authentic, not artificial. The Dubai Chocolate was deep and indulgent, with a hint of luxury cocoa and Kunafa. Perfect combo if you like balanced sweetness and real flavor!

name: Rich coffee house
review_1_text: The lemon cake here is just sublime. Moist cake layers, perfect structure, tartness just the way I like it, and the cake is light to the taste. Absolutely a place to release your craving for cakes or sweets. The cafe also oversees the water and the coming traffic in a serene way, good place to spend time at.
review_2_text:
True masters of espresso. This is one of those rare places where every step of the process is done with precision and respect for the craft. You can choose between a medium roast Thai–Laos blend or a dark roast Thai blend — both roasted and extracted perfectly.

Each bean type has its own dedicated grinder, calibrated to deliver exactly 15 grams of coffee. After dosing, the barista uses WDT needles to evenly distribute the grounds, followed by a leveler and tamper for perfect consistency. The extraction is spot-on: 30 ml in precisely 30 seconds.

The result? A flawless almond-colored crema, a cup that’s neither overheated nor under-extracted — just beautifully balanced and full of character. Every espresso is served with a small glass of water (I’d personally suggest a slightly smaller one, since it’s meant just to cleanse the palate — but that’s a minor, personal note).

For this level of attention to detail and repeatable perfection, you could easily compete with some of the best espresso bars in Italy or Portugal.

And honestly — if I had to choose anyone’s espresso (apart from my own 😉) — I’d choose yours!
Congratulations, Rich Coffee House — truly exceptional work.
review_3_text: This cafe serves outstanding coffee. While the space itself is not very large, it's beautifully designed, with a simple yet elegant decor that shows excellent taste.
review_4_text: Our new favorite spot in Chiang Mai! Next to the lovely and friendly hotel rich lanna house. Best start of the day.
review_5_text: Cozy little cafe with open seating for few, cheerful staff. Ham-cheese was great, latte was nice, a bit dark for a latte. Cakes were fresh. Macademia cheesecake was great! There is a detergent-included laundromat right next door. Takes about 45 mins. So it's convenient to get the laundry done while getting a coffee here. It does tend to get busy.

name: Snooze ChiangMai
review_1_text:
Very delicious smoothie bowls and also  breads with different toppings.
We were sad that we just discovered it shortly before leaving (it is hidden a little bit) otherwise we would have came more often. The location was so nice and relaxing sitting under the trees and the food very good. Perfect for breakfast or brunch :)
If we ever visit Chiang Mai again we will definitely come back!
review_2_text: Such a nice atmosphere. The dining área is outdoors and very beautiful and serene. I really enjoyed the hammock. The food was delicious i tried a small yoghurt granola and the tomato feta toast and it was so good i went back the next day to try the scrambled egg spinach toast (also delicious). You order and the counter and they bring the food over to you. Very relaxed environment and no smoking which is nice.
review_3_text: Lovely place, hidden in a courtyard among trees. Definitely recommend smoothie bowls - great quality! 🥭
review_4_text:
I loved the smoothies but disliked the avocado toast! It was lacking flavor and was bland, making it not really worth the price. I wish I had ordered one of the breakfast bowls instead as my friends were very happy with theirs.

You have to order at the counter and they bring the food to the table. The atmosphere is relaxed, the courtyard has a good vibe but the tables and service are basic. The reviews had me expecting more, but the food could use improvement. It looks amazing but lacks taste and it's overpriced.
review_5_text: The smoothie bowl was very mediocre. The acai was low quality and there's not too much of a difference in sizes. Not worth getting a bowl here but maybe something else.

name: FLOW
review_1_text:
Came here today for coffee..lovely coffee, great vibes and the nicest people work there!! Met some really good people ❤️❤️🙏

Definitely support a local business and drop in!🥰🙏

Oh, and they have the CUTEST cat!! And it has a bandana!!!😍😍
review_2_text: Great modest cafe with great coffee. The owner even asked me if I wanted dark or medium roast! The only fault was the total absence of any sugar or sweetener, only their local honey looking sirop that I never tasted. I recommend!
review_3_text: Affordable and good coffee for pick up. Not much acidity level and they don’t have light roast beans.
review_4_text: Awesome little cafe and bar! Open from 10 - midnight! Dope and cheap. 50 baht coffees. I suggest the peach tea!
review_5_text:
Coffee quality is good.
There are some seats at the store if customers want to drink at the shop.

name: The Highlandner
review_1_text: Absolutely amazing service. I needed to get new gear for trail running - they were very helpful in selecting the right hydration pack and other essentials. I highly, highly recommend runners to stock up on equipment here and to bring all your questions. Great service!
review_2_text: Made for endurance junkies like myself. Terrific curated quality products for mountain and adventure sports. Can refuel with healthy energy bars for next leg of Northern Thailand bike tour of over 2,000 km. Terrific coffee and music to boot. Solid place and good vibes.
review_3_text: Wow impressive store I didn't even know was here. They seem to focus on running. But have biking and swimming stuff too. Everything is high quality so don't expect cheap prices. But very well stocked and knowledgeable English speaking staff.
review_4_text: Very solid trail running store. Friendly staff and great selection.
review_5_text: Not open on Saturday when you say you are. Same experience at CMU store.  Please update the info

name: IN TOWN Cafe
review_1_text: Friendly service and a great view of the street life, especially in the morning when the weather was perfect. Nice background music and a very relaxing atmosphere. The breakfast was beautifully presented, with thoughtful extras like a macaroon and coconut milk. The croissant and coffee were great, and the atmosphere was definitely the highlight.
review_2_text:
Cute little cafe with great food and drinks! Situated right in front of the Le Canal Boutique Hotel.

Menu has many creative options for breakfast and lunch, including Thai selections. Fruit and waffle portion was large, easily enough to fill anyone. Presentation was superb, with high quality ingredients and very fresh.

Service was attentive, warm, and friendly. Food came out within 10 minutes, everything made to order. Atmosphere is warm and serene.
review_3_text: A must-visit in Chiang Mai! I had an amazing breakfast at In Town Cafe. The rice omelette was delicious, and the avocado croissant was super fresh. A special shoutout to Pai for her outstanding service – she is so friendly and welcoming! Great vibes and even better food
review_4_text: We’ve been to this cafe several times. The service is wonderful, and the food and coffee are great. In addition to the Thai omelette, we’ve had the fruit and yogurt bowl, mango sticky rice, coconut toast, and croffles (crepe waffle) and we’ve loved it all. The cafe is mostly outdoors. It is noisy due to being next to the road.
review_5_text:
Positive:
+ very Good breakfast menues
+ low/moderate backpacker prices
+ very good coffee

Negative:
- spoon/knife/fork 🍴 is served in plastic bags
- cooky for the Cafe in plastic bag
(please use nothing or paper)
- use as less plastic as possible please

Thank you 🙏🏽

name: The Bottle Club - Flagship Store
review_1_text:
It’s my first time at The Bottle Club, and love it already 😍
Food is amazing such a unique Thai creative appetizer and main food. The staff so friendly and so knowledgeable with wine and alcohol. With a big selection of that too. The perfect place for hangout with your friends from brunch time to dinner.
review_2_text: The place is well decorated with a wide selection of drinks. There are a great variety of wines at good prices, starting from 600 THB per bottle. The small and large plates are creative and delicious, and are not just for snacking but can make a complete meal. Good vibes. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
They offer a nice selection of wines by the glass and by the bottle!! making it easy to find something you like.

The staff are friendly and helpful with recommendations, which makes the experience even better.
review_4_text: Loved the atmosphere at The Bottle Club. Cozy wine bar in Chiang Mai with carefully selected wines and great service. Staff are knowledgeable and helpful. Will definitely come back again!❤️
review_5_text: Great wine selection, good food, even better vibe

name: Idao Cafe&Restaurant
review_1_text: Had breakfast here before my flight out of Chiang Mai. The service is incredibly warm and loving, attentive and friendly. Food is incredibly tasty. Highly recommend the mixed fruit bowl.
review_2_text:
Been to Idao Cafe four times already and honestly, that says everything.
The coffee is rich, comforting, and full of soul ☕
The vibe feels calm and cozy
and Vallen’s smiley service makes the experience even more beautiful.

Some cafés don’t just serve coffee, they serve warmth.
review_3_text: The food was delicious and the little tropical setting was the perfect way to start the day. The Fresh squeezed OJ was absolutely delicious along with the pork burger and the croissant with scrambled eggs and bacon on it. The surface was friendly and attentive.
review_4_text: Quite extraordinary and very tasty food and drinks, plus extremely friendly service 👍🏼😀
review_5_text: Lovely little coffee shop! We didn’t eat but the coffee is awesome. Such friendly staff and a really nice little place to sit and relax.

name: ร้านHi You Coffee Tea สาขาพระปกเกล้า
review_1_text: Very nice cafe
review_2_text: The coffee is good and served quickly.

name: Need Coffee?
review_1_text: This café seems to have disappeared. Maybe it closed
review_2_text: Good coffee and great service!
review_3_text: Love Green tea Latte
review_4_text: This cafe is located in the middle of the Champo Gate morning market. It's clean and reasonably priced, so I recommend buying a coffee here and eating some porridge from the morning market.

name: Meeting Hotel & Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Good location, near tourist attraction, food market, old city. Comfortable room and nice staffs.
review_2_text: The staff from the coffee shop called „se“ is a very friendly woman! She does an awesome job!
review_3_text:
How unpleasant!

This is the first time I’ve had such a dreadful experience before even stepping foot in a hotel. I booked through Airbnb, and everything seemed fine until a few days later, I got a message from the host saying there’d been a “glitch” in their reservation system and asking me to cancel the booking. That alone is completely unacceptable for any hotel, but unfortunately, it doesn’t stop there.

When I went to check the cancellation terms, I saw it’s a strict no-refund policy. Now that’s where it starts to feel really dodgy. The host surely knows the policy, so why ask me to cancel instead of doing it from their end? Sounds very sketchy like a tactic to keep the money and turn around saying, “Oh, the guest cancelled it!”

I’ve now messaged them asking them to cancel, since they’re the ones backing out. and surprise, no reply yet. I know it might be early to judge, but honestly, the whole thing feels deliberate.
review_4_text:
The rooms are gorgeous. Very spacious, beautiful and clean! The location is good, not noisy at night. There were two showers❤️ I really felt very comfortable. It was nice that shampoo and conditioner were prepared for guests, in beautiful, non-disposable jars, as it seemed to me, not the worst quality.
It should be noted that there is no 24-hour reception.
The problem with the room is the mosquitoes that bit at night. But judging by the fumigators, the owner is aware of this, only ours turned out to be empty. And the main problem is the old and very crushed mattress and very bad pillows, it is not comfortable to sleep.
If this problem is solved, this can become the best hotel in Chiang Mai)
review_5_text: It is a hotel located near tourist attractions or restaurants. You can walk to the center of Chiang Mai. Close to tourist attractions such as Chiang Mai Walking Street or the night and morning markets at Chang Phueak. Close to Chiang Mai Chang Phueak Bus Station. On the 1st floor there is a convenient coffee shop.

name: Speed Addict Society
review_1_text: Great coffee shop where they serve decent drip coffee 107 baht, it's also a Harley Davidson specialist, and though I'm not a motorbike fan, the whole atmosphere is great.
review_2_text: A motorcycle shop with a cafe, selling HD motorcycle accessories, with a lot of products. The motorcycle service is excellent, meticulous, and the prices are reasonable. All the staff are friendly. The coffee is excellent and the price is good. The shop is beautiful and the atmosphere is good. It is not a waste of time to stop by.
review_3_text: Good atmosphere for bikers. Hang out with friends. Also be a modified Harley shop in Chiangmai. Come to check it out. Good taste coffee. Lovely staffs including owner.
review_4_text: Absolutely love this place, great coffee, great price, pool table! Plus bikes bikes bikes
review_5_text: Great little place, friendly staff and good coffee.

name: Pippa's Caffe (ภิภากาแฟ)
Enjoy cafe
review_1_text: Very good coffee, most affordable coffee shop i have been in the two months I’ve stayed in chiang mai. It’s a hidden pearl 🙏😊
review_2_text:
A hidden small coffee shop running by a young and polite lady boss. She sells coffee, tea, snacks, and the boba tea start from 19 baht only, buddy you can't find this price in other place ya.

The shop provides wifi and space here and good for some remote work option.

Definitely the most valuable coffee shop, serve with good decent quality of coffee which matched with its price.

Came here for many times, tried the blue mountain cold which is not strong and smooth. Feels good.

Recommended all the backpacker dropby if your hostel is nearby. Support the local business.
review_3_text:
Awesome Iced or Hot Coffee at new cafe
66 4 Changphuak Soi 4, Si Phum Sub-district.

Got the Blue Mountain Iced - Loved it

Friendly staff very welcomed
review_4_text: Ceylon is good as it gets. Hella affordable
review_5_text:
The best place for bubble tea.
The place is clean with an air-conditioner
29 Baht for big bubble tea!

name: BogBog Coffee
review_1_text: My favorite coffee shop now! They provide variety of drinks from simple to smoothie. I’d recommend their coffee. You can choose your own roasted bean. If you like dark, go for it! I’m more than happy to support local business with good quality 💗
review_2_text: My favorite coffee place with a choice of medium or dark roast. Good coffee quality and great place to hang out and chill watch the cars and diverse people pass by.
review_3_text: Everything is super cute and this is my favourite place in Chiang mai where to have my matcha latte!
review_4_text: Prefect Caramel macchiato with oat milk
review_5_text: The drinks are delicious and the atmosphere is nice.

name: นราชาชัก ข้างรพ.เทพปัญญา2(รพ.ช้างเผือกเก่า)
review_1_text:
The tea has a smooth, delicious flavor.
The service is excellent, and most importantly, it's very clean.

name: Oldtown Café
review_1_text: This cafe has cool cafe vibes.  Good place to chill and do some work.  Nice relaxing piped-in music.  Breakfast semi-buffet at Thb 149 entitles you to one drink and free flow snacks, fruits, a Thai dessert and cookies.  It comes with free small mineral water bottle.
review_2_text: Great cafe located at the lobby area of a hotel. The space has AC and is very relaxing and has a nice long tables and some comfy chairs. This is definitely one of the better cafes if you are looking for a place to spend some quality time. My hot cappuccino was very good as well.
review_3_text:
🚨Avoid for breakfast 🚨
Well I was just looking for a drink, which is around 80-90 for something that doesn't look professional.
Then they propose the breakfast buffet option at 150. I tried and I'm disappointed 😞.
The fruits are not so fresh. The breads and croissant they propose are seven eleven like, and nothing is handmade. For this price we would except something a bit better.
Good thing : they give the wificode directly and it's a buffet so you can eat as much as you can even tho it's really not any better then the supermarket.
Also the music and decoration is cool, that's the good point.
review_4_text: Beautiful and calm café. Only deducting stars because they do not cater for vegans at all. No even soy milk, only cow's milk. :( Pretty much all I can have there is black coffee, but I'd be more than happy to spend more money if they catered for vegan needs.
review_5_text:
I've come in a few times on my daily walks, and always order a hot cappuccino, which is delicious...but I love sitting in the atmosphere of this calming cafe! The servers are super friendly and attentive! Highly recommend!

April 9, 2025...last stop in before flying home tomorrow. Look at this beautiful hot cappuccino the friendly staff served me this morning! I loved it! Highly recommend this place! See you next year!

name: Cup of Hobby by เพลินจิต
review_1_text: Very cute little place. They sell 120mm and 35mm film and more. Pricing is reasonable and better than most places in the city. Friendly and attentive staff. Developing Colour/ BW and scanning also available here for the most reasonable pricing I've seen in Chiang Mai.

name: BREW MORE TRAILER COFFEE
review_1_text: Great espresso, crema and chocloately
review_2_text: Fram to cup
review_3_text: A quality coffee shop. I highly recommend it. You won't be disappointed. I've tried it myself.
review_4_text: The coffee is of very good quality and there are many types of beans to choose from. If you come to Chiang Mai, I recommend this shop. The owner is very friendly.
review_5_text:
Dark roast hot latte = creamy chocolate, so good ^^
Dark roast iced espresso = great coffee, delicious no matter how you brew it.

name: Master Cof / น้ำใบบัวบกคั่นสด (BiBuaBok)
review_1_text: You probably won't find anything fresher than this! The price is very reasonable. The owner is kind and lovely. The shop is located next to Ch. Phochana noodle shop.

name: สมนา (so ma na)
review_1_text:
Top place and good drinks

Love the greenthea
review_2_text: Very friendly. And the green tea is delicious.

name: QUU HOTEL Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
⸻

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wonderful stay — stylish, comfortable, and full of charm!

I’ve stayed here twice and loved both visits. The first time was in a Junior Suite on the road side (room #302, if I remember correctly) — super nice, spacious, crisp, and clean. This time I stayed two nights in a Deluxe Room (#203) and loved it just as much.

All the rooms I’ve stayed in are beautifully designed and built with great attention to detail — simple but elegant, high-quality, clean, and very comfortable. It feels like staying at a small boutique hotel somewhere in Europe, with lovely greenery and stylish décor. I especially love the cool artworks from around the world displayed throughout the hotel.

The best part is enjoying breakfast early in the morning in the glass room overlooking the vibrant town — watching locals jogging by the old town moat of Chiang Mai. The hotel’s location is perfect too, just 5–10 minutes from all the nice spots and restaurants.
review_2_text:
Close to Old Town and a 7/11.
Rooms were clean and felt "new".
Good AC and a SMART TV!
No noise from nearby traffic at all.
Friendly staff, could communicate easily in English.
Very good price/quality ratio.
Would absolutely recommend or stay here again.
review_3_text: Love this hotel. Great for everyone—solo, couple, friends or family. Very clean, comfortable, good vibes, safe, delicious breakfast. We will be back and highly recommend!
review_4_text: Everything here was amazing! For a great price , you get a modern and fresh room, free room cleaning every day, a great location across the street from the old city, great service, and a filling and delicious breakfast.
review_5_text:
Loved my stay here! I booked a Standard room for two, and they initially set up the bed as two singles, but after seeing I was solo, they combined it into a king the next day — so thoughtful! HUGE NOTE THE BED WAS SOO COMFORTABLE! The bed comfort alone deserves 5-stars.

Upon my arrival they gave me a non-alcoholic welcome drink in a coupe—it was peach tea, so delicious.  I normally don’t drink cold tea, but this was very good.  The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the water pressure in the shower was excellent with consistently hot water. The room was compact but very well-designed, perfect for one person or a couple. Everything was modern, spotless, and the HVAC worked great, though I often turned the AC off.

I stayed on the 3rd floor — there’s an elevator for luggage, but I preferred using the stairs. Breakfast was included with my reservation, and they were happy to modify it to accommodate my no meat/dairy diet. I enjoyed sweet bread, tea, a boiled egg, and fruit each morning — simple but perfect.

The location is ideal — just outside the old city moat and close to Tha Phae Gate, where the Sunday Night Market begins/ends. Highly recommend checking it out if you're there on a Sunday! There are also a few vegan/vegetarian restaurants nearby. There is a coffee shop on premise with comfortable seating to people / traffic watch while doing work or having a drink. Lastly, even though the hotel is on the street, it was very quiet and I had great rest each night.

I’d 100% stay here again and highly recommend it!

name: mew.coffee.craft
review_1_text:
Chanced upon this cool quirky cafe with sleepy cat, cosy vibe, chill
music and friendly owner. Nicely located just opposite old town away from the crowd and noise.
review_2_text: The café is small but cozy, with good service. I ordered a hot latte, which was a bit too milky for my taste, but I still enjoyed it!
review_3_text: Lovely cafe! They serve amazing coffe, according to ur liking. We ordered two hot lattes and they were really affordable. The staff was so nice and the sweet cat was also a huge plus! I definitely recommend getting a coffee here!
review_4_text: I had a couple of beers here one night when there were some folks singing on acoustic guitar, was a cool night but they need to work on the sound.
review_5_text: Great place for a hip night out, indie alternative lovers this is the spot! Great staff and good beer options! Coming back again for sure ✌🏽

name: Wabi Sabi Coffee
review_1_text: The quality of coffee was just expected, but the price was super affordable. Besides, they have 2 adorable cats here!
review_2_text:
Simple place & Quick service
Good coffee and matcha
There are Really 2 lovely cats so cute
review_3_text: Good coffee lovely staff
review_4_text:
Wow!!!....shop 3.
Closer to home
Great coffee made to order.
review_5_text: Work-friendly • Free Wi-Fi • Power outlets •Great coffee 🤎🤍🤎🤍🤎🤍

name: กาแฟและเครื่องดื่ม
Cat Brothers Cafe
review_1_text: This was the 4th cat cafe I went to in Chiang Mai and probably my favorite. As of 17 Feb 2026, entry fee is 120b/hour which also includes a complimentary drink. I ended up staying slightly over two hours but I wasn't chased away as there were just a few customers at my time of visit (big plus). Of course, when there's many cats together, there will be a slight unpleasant aroma but it's a minor issue. Cats looked well groomed and loved. There are some reviews complaining about cats not wanting to play; obviously these people don't know cats well enough. Highly recommended if you're a cat slave. Do buy some cat treat and enjoy the cats swarming over you.
review_2_text: Atmosphere is rated 100 stars out of 5. Cats look happy and very content :)
review_3_text: This is my second time visiting this cafe, i do it every time I'm in Chiang Mai. Entrance is 120 baht and you get a drink of your choice and an hour with the cats. I also recommend buying treats for the cats for 20 baht per serving. This portion is enough to feed several cats and they will happily come to you for food. All the cats are clean and beautiful. I highly recommend visiting this place 🙏🏼👍🏼
review_4_text: Way too many cats in a small and poorly ventilated room (about 15 cats and 15m²). The cats didn't get along very well and many of them seemed stressed or unhappy. The cats all approached you to get candy but other than that they weren't very playful or cuddly.
review_5_text:
I had a great time at Cat Brothers Cafe! This is a really well-organized space with a fantastic concept - a cat cafe where the cats are well taken care of and always supervised by a staff member. The entrance fee of 120 baht is a fair price, and it includes a drink. You can also buy treats to feed the cats, which is a lot of fun.

The cafe is clean and comfortable, and there are plenty of places to sit and relax while you enjoy the company of the cats. The cats are friendly and playful, and it's clear that they are very well-cared for. The staff member supervising the cats and visitors is always on hand to make sure that everything is running smoothly.

I also appreciated the fact that the cafe is well-ventilated and doesn't smell like a typical animal cafe. It's clear that the owners have taken great care to create a space that is comfortable for both the cats and the visitors.

Overall, I would highly recommend Cat Brothers Cafe to anyone who loves cats or just wants to have a fun and unique experience while in Chiang Mai. It's a well-organized and well-managed space that is a joy to visit.

name: Koufuku Matcha
review_1_text: This tiny cafe serves excellent matcha and has oatmilk for a small fee hosted by a nice woman with soft jazz wafting through the air…
review_2_text: Owner is a sweet darling. Many Matchas to choose from. My choice, ceremonial, clear, no sweet… that’s my sweet spot. Sit inside and enjoy the calm 🎶.
review_3_text:
Matcha is one of my favorite treats, ever since my first trip to explore Japan. This is why, wherever I see some, I need to try it!
At Koufuku Matcha I was not disappointed: the best matcha out of Japan that I’ve tried so far (and also with coconut water!).
Positioned right on the border of the old city, it’s easy to miss. Small and cozy, keep your eyes open and give it a go. You’ll love it.
review_4_text: What makes Kofuku truly unique is that the owner, P’ Ae, personally travels to Japan to handpick the matcha directly from the source—no middlemen. The teas come from legendary regions such as Shizuoka, Uji, Fukuoka, and Ichio. Each terroir brings its own distinct character, from fragrant freshness to natural sweetness and deep, robust flavors.
review_5_text: i was rushing back to my hostel after a healthy dose of breakfast khao soi and i had the runs, then i stumbled upon this little cafe kiosk selling matcha lattes and got genuinely curious. no choice but to hold my 💩 in a bit longer but lemme tell ya,it was worth it. havent had matcha in a long while since i poisoned my self drinking too much of it in Japan 2 years ago. this is proper matcha latte...she even had the ceremonial cup and brush. 10/10 would come here again when im in nimman.

name: ตุ้ยต๊ะโต ขนมหวาน ของหวาน
review_1_text:
the atmosphere makes me feel like at home
foods are very good
must try when you are in Chiang Mai ❤️
review_2_text: This place is SOOOO good!! Not far from the old city and totally worth it to pop over for a light sweet treat!!! Go go go!!!
review_3_text: Very nice and stylish place. We tried the coffee drinks, soda and desert and all was very good. Try the shortbread, it was amazing. Very pleasant!
review_4_text: The jelly in sweet syrup and plum juice is delicious and refreshing. The Taiwanese-style pies are also very tasty. Everything tastes great and is priced at 40 baht each. The shop is cute, clean, and comfortable.
review_5_text:
This is a small shop, but the desserts here are delicious. There aren't many options, only about 4-5 kinds, but they are all delicious. They are refreshing and tasty, and the prices are not expensive.
这家店虽然很小，但店里的甜点非常好吃。选择不多，只有4-5种，但都很美味。吃起来清爽可口，价格也不贵。

name: ARABIA COFFEE MUANG LAN NA
review_1_text: Good vibe modern cafe inside old lanna architecture. Friendly Staff. Coffee taste is a bit bitter if you like medium dark roast should visit here.
review_2_text: Beautiful place with coffee and soft drinks menu.
review_3_text: Overall, it was okay. I had coffee and chatted with friends for a while.

name: Mr Green Restaurant
review_1_text:
Chiang Mai has a fantastic number of vegan and vegetarian restaurants, and Mr Green's is kne of our favourites.

Always great service, amazing food and great prices.

The fresh spring rolls are heavenly.
review_2_text:
I came 45 minutes before closing, but they were already getting ready to close. However, I still managed to place an order and they didn’t refuse me. Glad I had dinner 🍽️

I tried the soup — the vegetables were a bit undercooked, but if this portion was prepared just for me, then that’s fine. Overall, the soup itself was incredibly delicious.

I also ordered spring rolls, tried one and took the rest to go.

They also let me use mosquito spray, which was very thoughtful of the staff.

The atmosphere feels like homemade food but with restaurant-style presentation. I would definitely come back here again 🐥✨
review_3_text: I came here twice during my time in chiang mai. Tucked on a side street, the outdoor tables are great for people watching and watching the world go by. The pad see ewe and papaya salad are delicious!
review_4_text: A lot of good options on the menu, I tried Khao Soi and it was AMAZING, very delicious taste, filled with lots of veggies, mushrooms and delicious noodles and the service was really good, hardworking and friendly
review_5_text: So delicious !! And a really nice server in a chill environment filled with avocado plants. Will be coming back ASAP :)

name: The South African - Cafe, Restaurant & Rooftop
review_1_text: Lovely place to grab a bite of Thai food or a large portion of South African food. Based on the menu we ordered the bunny chow, which looks like a manageable portion however, it came out in a whole sourdough bread bowl! No complaints just very filling. I ordered the pad krapao which was delicious. The fried egg was also cooked perfectly! We would defiantly eat here again!
review_2_text: A very nice, clean restaurant with friendly staff! I had the Chakalaka, which was served with Pap, a corn porridge. Pap tastes similar to Italian polenta and was very delicious! The restaurant has a few South African dishes on the menu, as well as some Thai dishes. I also really enjoyed the yummy Penang Curry. I highly recommend this restaurant!
review_3_text:
Spotless Cleanliness

The establishment gleams with meticulous care—tables wiped spotless, floors pristine, and restrooms impeccable, fostering a fresh, hygienic vibe that enhances every visit. I was so impressed.
Let me tell you about the desserts.
The desserts here are a real highlight: beautifully presented, generously portioned, and clearly made with attention to detail, and the desserts draw from African traditions, featuring many wonderful delights that will take many visits to sample each one. 🤭
I will be visiting ofter.

Cheers
GLT
review_4_text: "Lekker Man!, Lekker" If you understand the comment, you’ll understand that the food is truly amazing—definitely feels homemade. It was a really wonderful experience, and I feel fortunate to have visited this place before it becomes super busy and crowded. I especially loved the personal attention they give to their customers.
review_5_text: We visited on a Friday night to try some of their South African offerings. We met with the owner who cooked us boerewors and pap, really tasty meal!The boerewors is infused with Thai flavours, almost like Thai Green Curry flavours- would definitely recommend! The staff were lovely too, very helpful. Wishing the owner all the best with his business🍀

name: TWO - โท: Bed and Cafe
review_1_text: The cafe' is so amazing, I love your style black and white that's really cool. Coffee so good, Staff they're so nice and friendly. So quite cafe' i meaning is a little bit private.
review_2_text: Had a perfect stay and beautiful hospitality from our friends. Delicious food and coffees.
review_3_text: Their drink are very created and intend for every menus. More photo corner you'll fall in love this space. Really recommend !
review_4_text:
Minimal style and very clean room.
Breakfast better than we think.
Mind service, very well suggestion.
So appreciate !!!
review_5_text: cozy in minimal style. Their drink is quite good. So chill and warm.

name: ON THE WAY CAFE @ Jang Sri Poom
review_1_text:
Stepping into On the Way Cafe @ Jan Sri Poom was an absolute delight. It quickly became my favorite Chiang Mai stop. I was immediately struck by the truly calming atmosphere. The interior design thoughtfully uses soft, warm lighting, natural wood tones, and lush greenery, creating a peaceful escape from the city bustle. It’s the perfect environment whether you need to focus on work, enjoy a quiet read, or simply unwind. I happily spent several hours here and felt completely relaxed and welcome.
Beyond the aesthetics, the service here is genuinely top-tier. Every member of the team is exceptionally friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about their craft. They were patient in explaining different brewing methods and offered excellent recommendations tailored precisely to my preferences. My order was served quickly, always with a genuine smile, which truly elevated the entire visit.
The menu boasts an impressive variety of cold and hot drinks, catering to every possible craving imaginable. I first tried their signature iced latte, which was perfectly balanced and refreshing, and later enjoyed a rich, expertly crafted hot chocolate. They also frequently have unique seasonal specials and a fantastic selection of teas. This cafe is a must-visit gem—a rare combination of superb quality, peaceful ambiance, and five-star hospitality. Recommended!
review_2_text:
Happened to pass by this cafe and saw this big Thai tea sign with the price (35 baht!), so I went in and tried it. Safe to say I finally found the best Thai milk tea in Chiang Mai! Yassss! 🤩

P.S. i always ask for less sugar
review_3_text:
This is a great little place. Modern and clean. Note - they ONLY sell hot and cold drinks - the lovely looking macaroons are only for decoration 😂.
Great coffee and Thai tea.  Most drinks are only 35 bhat.
review_4_text:
Nice cafe, chill spot with good prices.
Perfect for a relaxing break!
review_5_text: Iced latte and pain au choc 10/10

name: Kanoon Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: When in Chiang Mai, this hidden gem is a must-visit. Their matcha coconut drink is incredibly delicious – it'll make your taste buds explode! The place is adorable, the food is amazing, don't miss it! Very Enjoy!
review_2_text: Clean restaurant that serves amazing food. Best meat skewer I had in Thailand by far. Halal and friendly staff
review_3_text: Really enjoy the vibe.. so serene..the food also delicious.. and the service .. 👍🏻the best..
review_4_text:
Drove past when we were in the area and came back to try after getting our errands done.

There is an old wood house that you will first notice and you can park around here.

Large garden space with some basic flowers etc.

F&B :
Wife ordered an ice capucino. Really strong for me but Thai wife likes it this way

They have some cakes also

Good for a pit stop if in the area especially if u like this type of strong coffee

Seating : indoor air conditioning

Parking : within compound
review_5_text: Beautiful place but espresso not correct. The owner apologized saying that "the grinder was faulty", but I never heard of bad grinder making a foamless espresso. As compensation they kindly gave a piece of delicious cake for free. Also had only brown sugar and it wouldn't cost anything to have white sugar also. In Thailand they NEVER have any type of sweetener available.

name: Fresh fruit smoothie
review_1_text: Fruit salads, juices, and smoothies at affordable prices. Fruit stand is owned and run by a friendly Thai auntie. Went over 10 times in my month-stay in Chiang Mai. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Possibly my favorite place in Thailand; these fruit salad as are astonishing and good at any time of day. The operator of the business is a lovely lady too. Always come back here!
review_3_text: Hidden gem.  Best mango smoothie I've had. They actually use a whole mango for the smoothie.
review_4_text: It‘s a great smoothie and you can choose between many different fruits and combinations. There was a verd kind woman and I would totally recommend it.
review_5_text: Every day breakfast spot! Incredible fruit salad, great price, lovely lady and always nice place to chat with people :) No western overpriced fruit bowls, this is the top place :)

name: เกรซ วินเทจ
review_1_text: Good cafe  & relaxing place
review_2_text: Excellent service. The owner is friendly.

name: Jue Kim
review_1_text: Great coffees, Khun Jane is really friendly and speaks excellent English, and there's a cute dog too! Can be hard to find with Grab, go to the nearby guesthouse at Wishes Hotel and walk.
review_2_text: Such a lovely cafe, gorgeous interior and great energy for a relaxing morning coffee. Nice quiet location, and very friendly owner (with the cutest dog!!) :)
review_3_text: Recommends Jeu kim cafe!!! Thai tea&Dirty that so impressive.Best Thai tea forever! Absolutely worth trying! P.s.Khaonueng soooooo cute🤩
review_4_text:
This is exactly what an ideal coffee shop should be. The vibe is incredibly chill. You can relax at the bar and chat with the owner for as long as you like. By the way, the owner is super friendly and a multiple barista competition winner!

Alternatively, you and your friends can simply enjoy the coffee and savor the supremely relaxing environment. From what I understand, the building used to be a Chinese drugstore owned by the owner's grandparents. This history gives the place a charmingly retro vibe. And of course, the coffee itself is also excellent.
review_5_text:
The owner is really sweet and friendly, the drinks are delicious, the place and atmosphere is beautiful & their dog is so so cute💫
I've been here twice in the span of 1 week!

name: Baanlansa Bed&Bar
review_1_text: Nice enough place but a little too expensive and they need more fans.  The service was friendly enough but I started getting attacked by mosquitos almost as soon as I arrived (which was at dusk).  There are 2 ceiling fans (neither of which were on) and a floor fan.  I turned on a ceiling fan.  I got bitten a little later.  The waiter finally got off his mobile phone for long enough to notice that I kept looking at my legs and correctly guessed I was under attack by mosquito's and turned on the floor level fan.  Thanks. The food and beer arrived.  The large Chang was 85 Baht which is a little expensive.  The Khao Soi was a ridiculous 85 Baht!  It was average.  My bill was 170 Baht.  I can get the same meal and beer for 110 Baht at Grazie, only 10 minutes walk away.  The KS is better and I never get attacked my mosquitos there.  Upto you....  There is free wifi and there is also a toilet.  There was a place for a live band but there was no-one laying when I was there.  This place was very quiet when I was there, that's because there are better places close by which are much cheaper.
review_2_text: Went for brunch: Pad Thai good, omelette & toast small portion with good fresh coffee. Evenings have a live band too.
review_3_text: Right next to the old town. The food is tastety and there is the band at night.
review_4_text: Budget hostel very convenience
review_5_text: Massage not so good

name: Soi Dog Blues
review_1_text: The Soi Dog Blues bar is a fantastic bar to visit, great atmosphere and music. The owners and staff are very welcoming. I attended a Sunday night jam session, got up to play and had a wonderful time. The standard of musicianship was very good. It was a totally enjoyable evening with friendly people and great conversations. The only bar in Chiang Mai where you can listen to great blues and soul music.
review_2_text:
At last I got to Soy Dog blues bar and was it worth it.   A proper sized bar for bands, excellent service and a great range of cocktails.  Snacks were good too.

Plenty of room for a performing band and seating inside and out.  Very clean and professionally run.  I will certainly be back.

Tonight I was there to see and hear Moat Rats who were pretty damn good too.

Highly recommended for music and good drinks.
review_3_text:
Loved spending the evening here! The service, drinks, atmosphere, and live blues music were all excellent 😊 Tonight was my second visit, and I loved it just as much as the first. You really don’t feel like leaving early! The hosts, artists, and guests all share a genuine love for good music, which makes the place feel so warm and welcoming.
If you enjoy real blues, this cozy little bar in Chiang Mai is a must-visit. Great sound, friendly people, and talented musicians — perfect spot for a relaxed, music-filled evening. 🎶🍸
review_4_text: Deserving of praise, a friendly, intimate neighborhood bar with talented musicians performing throughout the week. Check their calendar and get yourself there. 💕me some .. Soi Dog Blues.
review_5_text: Finally, a new spot in Chiang Mai. Soi Dog Blues is the real deal. The live music is awesome, the beers are ice-cold, and the vibe is perfect. The crowd is spilling out into the street, which says it all. This is going to be a local favourite.

name: Refine Coffee Roaster.TCDC
review_1_text: The mocha was beautifully balanced — rich, smooth, and comforting without being too sweet. Paired with their homemade desserts, it created the perfect little moment of calm. The staff were kind and welcoming, adding to the cozy vibe that makes the place feel a bit like home.
review_2_text:
A lovely little coffee spot with a cozy and refreshing vibe. 🌿
The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, surrounded by greenery — perfect for a peaceful break or a casual meet-up.
The staff are friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home. Whether you’re grabbing a quick coffee to go or staying to enjoy it in the garden, it’s a great place to recharge.
review_3_text: Cute cafe with friendly owner. The coffees are good and the service is really excellent.
review_4_text: My friend told me to try Refine coffee. So when I flew from USA I stop by Refine coffee and it is as good as my friend advertised. Coffee aroma is amazing and the barista Karn told me about the Rose Soda, very refreshing.
review_5_text: Great little Cafe, walked past it many times.  So clean and bright inside.  As you can see from the pictures.  There opening sign is there mascot, who on first entering greeted us.  "So Cute". Staff were very friendly.   Will be back again soon thank you.

name: The Cabin Backpackers Hostel & Bar
review_1_text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Cabin. Had some of the coolest community spaces I’ve seen in a hostel and the dorms were spacious and well-kept. The staff is incredibly friendly and ready to help and they offer laundry services as well as organize events! Although located next to a party hostel, I could not hear a sound on the third floor and had some of my best sleep here.
review_2_text: Very lovely place! Pla and Rachel were so lovely and helped me with everything and made it feel very engaging, very kind people. Very easy location, chill vibes with more lively hostels next door but this was perfect as was more spacious, cheaper, and even the drinks were cheap. Will definitely come back when I am in Chiang Mai
review_3_text: Had a great time here, great location and the rooms met my needs. Great atmosphere. Useful for booking tours. The staff were amazing, and very helpful. Pla, Om, Rachel (the male staff were great too but I don't know how to spell their names lol) all were very helpful and made my trip to Chiang Mai very special. Would highly recommend and I am ready planning my trip back already
review_4_text:
Had an amazing stay here and came back again for a night!

Super small hostel so you see the same few mates everyday which is amazing and makes it so easy to make cool friends! U can join them for activities in the day (muay thai/waterfalls etc) and at night go to the myriad of amazing jazz clubs/nightlife spots.

I recommend northgate (go early), soi dog blues bar and thapae east (amazing movie set vibes)

Not so much a party vibe (more next door at stamps or sylvie and sometimes those folks come over so you can join them) but its very social. Staff rachel and kate (the manager/boss) are also v lovely. Also the peanut banana smoothie is divine.

I loved the semi private dorms (own bed and partition). U get ur own space for a dollar more a night which is super worth vs the bunks. Rooms are cleaned everyday and best part is no shoes in rooms.

One thing that i wished they could do was turn off the AC after 10/11am in the morning. Sometimes staff shuts it off at 9am and the heat makes you wake up which...after a late night out isnt so pleasant 😭 also as someone who is in construction/homebuilding the bath shower needs to be tiled on the right side or its a potential huge mold problem down the road (rn its a concrete white wall exposed to water.)

Overall great place will come back again!!
review_5_text: Loved the people who were working at the cabin backpackers hostel! They were very friendly and helped us with al kind of things! The location was perfect everything was walkable from here and the rooms were clean! Only lesser thing is that your sleep wing in a staple bed that moves a lot of one of the two persons turns. Loved it!

name: Dara Vietnamese Restaurant
review_1_text: Had such a good brunch here … clean, fresh food that felt like a much needed break. Super tasty but light, and you actually feel calm and good after eating. If you’re in Chiang Mai and want something soothing that makes your body feel clean, this place is definitely worth trying!!✨
review_2_text: Noodles were incredibly delicious, certainly home made. Lots of fresh vegetables and great flavors. Bowl of noodles was 80 thb and fresh spring rolls just 70. Great quaint spot for lunch. Also very kind service.
review_3_text: 5 stars for the food. Ordered the Pho and Nam Nueng. The vegetables were fresh and clean, and the service was polite and welcoming. The only disappointment was the Thai tea, which was quite thin and not something I would recommend.
review_4_text: Clean, authentic Vietnamese food. They have a cute backyard where you can spot cats, birds and squirrels while enjoying delicious food and coffee.
review_5_text:
Fantastic food if you want a taste it Vietnamese food. Having been in Vietnam 2 weeks ago it felt like I was back.

Only reason for 4/5 and not 5/5 is because the restaurant signs D has fallen off causing me and my grab driver to the airport some confusion 🤣

name: น้ำเต้าหู้
review_1_text: My favorite place! The soy drink is so good! You have to come here.And order the mixed soy drink which costs 20 baht.Or you just show the pic.They open the shop from 5pm-8.30pm until they sold out the soy drinks.They don't open the shop on Sunday:) Anyway I love this soy shop!
review_2_text: My number one place for warm soy milk in Chiang Mai. They use many more ingredients to chew on than all other places that I know - in variety and in mass.
review_3_text: The best soy milk in town with only 10 baht each
review_4_text: Soymilk good taste .
review_5_text: Very nice desserts.

name: Boonrawd cuisine
review_1_text: Service a bit slow. Food's fine. Liked the crab curry. Pretty presentation.  A nice place with history. Same place as the Sync Cafe. Asked for coriander with roe salad. Told no roe then but would give a discount if it's still wanted. Said ok. Got 10% reduction on that item.
review_2_text: 6/23 great cafe! Congee was delicious and fresh. Thai curry was also fresh and good. Good prices. Perfect open in the morning on the way back from the bus station.
review_3_text: Incredible Thai food in a quirky, eccentric decor! The food was mind blowing ! ( a little slow for service but so so so worth it) some of the best Thai food we ever had ! Highly recommend.
review_4_text: Cute restaurant near the phae gate, offering good drinks and delicious khao soi, along with other dishes. Friendly staff and good prices!
review_5_text: Chill vibe and fresh, clean Thai cuisine at very reasonable prices. Low key place.

name: OWL Coffee & Bakery
review_1_text: The cake made me go: wow - audibly 😂 / what a great find! If you want coffee & cake this is the place!
review_2_text: Really nicely surprised by this little cafe. I only went because the TCDC wasn't open yet but I had a very nice Thai tea, less sweet, which came with a nice cap of foamed milk for only 25 baht in a very generous size. Seating is open to the outside but there are fans that kept everything cool. There's a wide array of cakes and they are super affordable but tasty based on one cheesecake I tried. Friendly service too. Really recommended when you're in the area!
review_3_text:
Very relaxing atmosphere, watching the world go by.
Latte was nice and strong, just how I like.
The cheesecake was so tasty 😋
All for 100 baht 👌🏼
Will be back.
Could do with a toilet though.
review_4_text: Great pastries and nice coffee. Small place with limited seating and no bathroom. However, the open air atmosphere is relaxing and the service is friendly. I definitely recommend this place, especially for the pastries.
review_5_text: Cakes are neighbourhood quality. Coffee beans are more on the burnt taste type. Pricing is lowest rung. Ambience is cosy and homely!

name: ร้านชุมชนสุขภาพดีกาดเมืองใหม่
review_1_text: It is a place to take care of your health and get good nutrition.

review_1_text: Great coffee, nice ambient and the lady at the counter is super nice
review_2_text: A very nice small coffee shop. The woman owner is extremely nice.
review_3_text: Good coffee at a cheap price. Lovely lady.
review_4_text: Cute little coffee shop with good and cheap coffee and very friendly owner.
review_5_text:
This shop is my most fav. 💛💛💛
Really recommend for all who love easy coffee with good taste and good price.

review_1_text: Bright modern coffee shop across from Muang Mai Market.   Great spot for a well made coffee drink while you are waiting for a Grab.
review_2_text:
A really good coffee at the market.
Good place to have a break from walking the market.
review_3_text:
Great coffee and great service!
Nice place to cool down after visiting the market.
review_4_text: A cute little cafe next to the market, a good place to rest after shopping.  The lemon and honey ice tea is excellent, as is the coffee.  recommended
review_5_text: Is it ended? I think they don't open on Sundays (or on weekends)

name: T-Koff Coffee
review_1_text: Very nice iced coffee. 45 baht.
review_2_text: Good coffee👍
review_3_text:
I've been to T-Koff Coffee several times now, and each time it's been a delight. I particularly like the Iced Thai Coffee Tea. It's intense, aromatic, and simply unique. You rarely find something like it.

The owner is incredibly friendly, always in a good mood, and makes you feel immediately welcome. It's one of those places where you'll want to stay because everything is just right: the taste, atmosphere, and heart.

If you don't stop by, you're really missing out!
review_4_text: The cafe latte was delicious! 40 baht
review_5_text: Excellent and inexpensive coffee, the barista is super friendly!

name: บารัก คอฟฟี่
review_1_text: It's a small kiosk, but they use Doi Chang coffee and have their own coffee roasting machine, so the coffee is fresh and fragrant every day. The price is cheap and the quality is great.
review_2_text: Order black coffee without sugar and get the taste of freshly roasted coffee. Excellent and cheap.
review_3_text: I ordered an unsweetened latte. The carefully made latte was delicious.
review_4_text: It's next to a 7-Eleven, and a utility pole is blocking the view; you almost wouldn't know there's a
review_5_text: Delicious and great value.

MAR Marocchino Coffee Chiangmai
review_1_text: Great little place with an outside and inside dining area.  Coffee was good and the waitress was friendly.  Latte will set you back 50 baht, good place to work from but I couldn’t see many power points inside.  Breakfast is available and the WiFi is fast. #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text:
Nice place to get some work done or relax after an afternoon walk near Ping river. Coffee was nice with nutty taste.

Interior is somewhat modern with white walls and high ceilings.

Wifi available. Electrical sockets are scarce. And the shop closes early in the evening (5:30 PM)
review_3_text: Awesome coffee shop!!  Yummy.  Friendly.  Caramel Macchiato!!  Caffe Latte and Mocha were great too!
review_4_text:
Been here a couple times and really didn't enjoy the staff. So cold that Doesn't look like Thailand.

Besides that and things being more on the overpriced spectrum,  it's a good and cozy place and excellent overall quality of good and beverages.
review_5_text: Lovely latte, good price, nice staff

name: Tropical juice and smoothie bar
review_1_text: Best smoothie bowl we had so far in Asia ! I really recommend it !
review_2_text:
Great selection of smoothies and juices
Friendly staff
review_3_text: This place is closed at least currently. May be renovating but may be gone for good.
review_4_text:
The smoothies are a 2 out of 10 in terms of value for money. Nice staff, unfriendly owner!

I'd rather go somewhere else!

Regards, Franz

name: หมิน หม่าน ชา
หมูทอดอาม่า - Moo Tod Ama
review_1_text:
Went for breakfast. The restaurant was empty but we were greeted by a friendly staff.
Food was made fresh and rather yummy. The black coffee was not strong enough though.
BLT sandwich was good but I feel that it's a little pricey.
The atmosphere of the restaurant was cosy. Overall, a good place for early breakfast.
review_2_text: The food here was super yummy, good price and the sandwich was really tasty- the bread wasn't sweet, and it was a really good size. I also got a chai latte with coffee that was tasty and enjoyed the fruit bowl with yogurt- although the yogurt was a very liquid consistency. I will come back :)
review_3_text: Had an amazing brunch at Moo Tod Ama! The food was delicious and portion sizes were generous. We ordered one bacon toast and one fried garlic rice with pork, which easily satisfied three people. The staff was super friendly and provided excellent service. Highly recommend this place for a delightful brunch experience!
review_4_text: Cozy and good vibe restaurant, feel liked home. The staff are gentle and amazing service. Clean food, good taste, cheap price. It's worth coming here once I were in Chiangmai. Absolutely to visit again. ❤️❤️
review_5_text: One of the BEST breakfast I have ate around old city. The chicken is very tender, a great combination with sticky rice. Latte and butterfly pea drink are good too. The staffs are very friendly, they also recommend us some must visit site in Chiang Mai. I will definitely visit Moo Tod Ama again. Highly recommend!

name: Ni-Yom Restaurant
review_1_text:
The authentic of Thai food, the variety is various and the atmosphere is  absolutely peaceful. I love the cafe in the middle of the restaurant which gave you a smell of cooked coffee bean. It would be better if the portion of the food comes a little bigger, because I feel like not completely full after finish one dish, probably have to order one more.

The staff also friendly and nice service.

The parking is only one minute away from the restaurant and cost 30฿ for 60 minutes, after that will cost more. (You cannot park in front of restaurant which next to the road)
review_2_text: I was surprised to find the food so tasty! One of the top Thai food places in Chiangmai. Well-balanced, good portions, good for the soul. I went to the place, took some home, and ordered Grab again the next day. It was equally as good delivery too! Bonus that it's located in such wonderful space with cool unique local products, cafe, and wine bar. Super chill place to be. Their signature "dry porridge" and spicy pickle soup are worth trying.
review_3_text: A cosy dining place in the heart of Chiangmai. All the dishes we ordered are so appertising and mouth watering. We truly enjoyed the dining experience here. The staff is attentive and will definitely recommend my friends to try Niyom when they visit Chiangmai. 🥰👍👏
review_4_text:
What a shame... Came because of good reviews... Hard to find, hidden in a closed grocery store, with an odd wine bar in the front. Apparently separate businesses, the only beverages available at the restaurant are pre bottle fancy ice teas. Not even the wine  menu, and they cant make a cup of tea.

Staff was completely unattentive. Better customer care from the street food vendors, or the run down Pad Thai shacks around the corner.

The food is smaller than the portions pictured on the menu and is under seasoned. The pork fried rice mostly tasted like flared oil from poor wok skill.... For such fancy presenting place I am very disappointed. Leaving hungry, needing to get some better flavors In my mouth.
review_5_text:
Very authentic Thai food restaurant in Chiangmai. Food tasty, reasonable price, clean and nice service. Owner is friendly. You will love here for sure, if you like Thai food. Must try!

Just revisit this restaurant in Jan 2024, still good as usual. Will come again when visiting Chiangmai

This restaurant sits in my Thai favorite top list easily.

Gustdy
review_1_text: This shop is very friendly and sells a wide variety of smoothies, drinks, and snacks.

name: ร้านขนมหมี Kanommee
review_1_text: The cake is very delicious. The shop is cozy.

name: Baan 104
review_1_text: Baan 104 is a truly special spot! The atmosphere is incredibly warm and inviting, making it the perfect place to sit back and relax. A major highlight is the live piano music, which creates a beautifully serene and elegant backdrop for your visit. The drinks are delicious, and the desserts are absolutely fantastic! Highly recommend this cozy gem.
review_2_text: The cafe shop in old house... The matcha is good not outstanding... There is piano and has pianist..the shop is cozy and chill... Recommend if u like to chill or work here
review_3_text:
Nice environment with piano and cello to play.
The citrus Americano is great. Fresh orange juicy.
review_4_text: The best cafe in Chiang Mai or dare I say Thailand!!! This spot offers exceptional quality in both its bakery selection (waffles, scones, madeleines, cakes and cookies) and hand crafted coffee. Definitely worth visiting anytime of the day to savour in the vintage colonial-style setting. They also have brilliant live music in the afternoon on the weekends, simply a perfect place to relax and indulge!
review_5_text: A little (kinda) hidden cafe that hyped on social media as many local young people come here. The drink is nice, but just need some improvement in food variety. The atmosphere is perfect and calming, there was a jazz pianist performing when i came here. Worth to try 👍

name: Peppa Bubble Tea
review_1_text: Great Thai milk tea with boba and cheese cream! I don’t know what else they added, I just told them everything you want! They were so kind! Delicious and refreshing!!
review_2_text: We had an omelet with ham and rice for 50 thb. And had a berry smoothie too. All good 👍
review_3_text: The bread and tea was nice. The vendor for some reason told me that they are closing the place inside and told me to eat outside, but I saw others come in and eat inside. Did I just get discriminated against? Oh jee I hope not, that would be sad.
review_4_text: Fancy! Delicious Bubble Tea!
review_5_text: The shop is clean and has a wide selection of snacks. All the drinks are delicious, especially the cream cheese one.. 🧋😋

name: Fresh&Mild @ The Prince Royal's College
review_1_text:
On campus so mostly for staff and students.
AC, WiFi and coffee all good.
review_2_text: The shop is located inside Prince of Songkla University School, next to the Grade 4 cafeteria. It's a small milk shop in the school, but it has air conditioning and not many tables. Children often come here to order milk.
review_3_text: Located next to the Prince School gymnasium, we recommend the Prince Milk menu, which is butterfly pea milk mixed with coconut milk. Delicious and refreshing! 😻 Only 35฿!
review_4_text: A coffee shop located in Prince School. The shop is decorated cutely. They have desserts, fresh coffee, and fresh milk with pearls. I came here because of a parent meeting.

name: LivingRoom Cafe'192
review_1_text: I love coming here. The owners are friendly and their menu is top tier for a local café. You would love a variety of coffee and non-coffee drinks. You can also have late “breakfast” here as well. Highly recommended!!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
review_2_text:
A Hidden Gem in Chiang Mai: Living Room Coffee Shop

Living Room Coffee Shop is an absolute delight and quickly became one of my favorite spots in Chiang Mai. Nestled away from the hustle and bustle, this café is a serene escape with a unique charm that sets it apart from the rest.

First and foremost, the coconut smoothie is nothing short of spectacular. It's rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced — an absolute must-try for anyone visiting. Pair it with their delicious snacks or coffee, and you’ve got yourself a winning combo.

The staff are warm, welcoming, and always ready with a smile. They truly make the experience feel special, adding to the relaxing and friendly atmosphere of the café.

But perhaps the most unique and delightful feature is the gang of four adorable bunnies that roam in their little enclosure! These furry companions add a whimsical touch to the café’s vibe. Watching them hop around is a soothing and oddly entertaining experience. It got me wondering — what is the difference between a bunny and a rabbit? And while we’re at it, what do you call a group of rabbits? (Someone tell me so I can stop calling them a “gang” — though it suits them perfectly!)

Whether you're looking for a quiet spot to relax, a place to work, or just craving a great coconut smoothie in Chiang Mai, Living Room Coffee Shop is an absolute must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back for the vibes, the drinks, and of course, to visit my bunny friends!
review_3_text: Lovely cozy space. The shop offers both normal and fusion coffee. The lychee or coconut juice is a must try. The owner is very friendly. The shop is a good place to take a breath read a chapter in a book before moving on.
review_4_text:
Good cafe to spend chill time...
It's my first time to see Luk chup at a cafe (usually I see it at night markets or Thai sweets shops)
I like their cappuccino taste :)

There are outdoor seats in the back, around a pond. You may need mosquito repellent (They kindly let me use theirs), but nice atmosphere.
review_5_text: I loved getting my morning latte here because the staff are wonderful, personable people. The atmosphere is modern and tastefully appointed. The decor is chic and and the coffee is tasty and affordable!
