review_2_text: We get here very special coffee!!! 🌸🌸🌸👏👏👌 bravo!!!🙌 very tasty 😋 recommend this place for everyone Who loves coffee ☕️
review_3_text: Had flavourful iced coffee with toasted bread.
review_4_text: Cosy with more choices of coffee, drinks, toasts& bakery. Hard to find parking. Easier by king.
review_5_text: Bright coffee shop.  AC inside, outdoor terrace.   Well presented coffee and tasty cappuccino.

name: mosaic coffee
review_1_text: Such a cozy spot! The ambiance truly feels like home, warm and welcoming. Plus, I loved meeting Mocha the dog—so sweet and friendly. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to.
review_2_text: Among hundreds of coffee places of various ages in Chiang Mai, Mosaic has been here 17 years and counting. Enjoy coffee drinks and fruit smoothies here with mosaic tables and floors, legacy of owner's business earlier. The big table boasts of great iron works, made by owner's significant other in the back workshop. Cacti inside and out front look well-cared for. Spent an easy afternoon here over a hot cappuccino and a coconut with milk smoothie made more exciting with a shot of espresso.
review_3_text: Coffee was good, I tried the americano served with a side glass of water which is always welcome.  There’s an area out the front where all the smokers hangout next to the street if you’re French and need a coffee and cigarette 😝. Inside was comfortable and cool although I did notice a sign saying it’s 20 baht to charge your phone for an hour on the power point! #BeatTheGrind
review_4_text: I enjoy good coffee. Mosaic Coffee is a wonderful place to enjoy a good cup of coffee and relax. Great atmosphere and staff.
review_5_text: Favourite coffee shop in Chiang mai! The owner Ao magmde all the Mozaïc art herself, it's very arty, inspiring atmosphere! The coffee is peaceful and perfect for a quiet time. The coffee and brownies are delicious!

name: ALong Cafe
review_1_text: Easy and little place but full with the atmosphere of local with sound of birds and nature sound. Sitting cozy talking with friends reading or relaxing looking the old factory beside. It gives you mythical feel like being somewhere  far from town but still in town.
review_2_text: Good coffee and teas with lovely rural vibes. Total tranquility🙏
review_3_text: A good place to have some coffee & relax. Friendly staff.
review_4_text: I love coming here in the mornings. I think she makes the best americanos and Es Yen. There is lots of comfortable and clean seating. Even though it’s by a road and outside it’s quiet and cozy.
review_5_text: Two very nice black Americano coffees (40B each). Very tranquil rural setting off the road. Shady garden

name: Thriving77 coffee bar and หม่าล่า คาเฟ่
นมหมีปั่น The Honey Bee
review_1_text: Lovely little place in a clean area. The owner is delightful to order from and talk to and makes really tasty drinks at great prices. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Great taste with quality products 🥤
review_3_text: Everything on the menu is delicious! My son loves the chocolate mint drink ❤️🥤
review_4_text: The shop is easy on the eyes and the prices are easy on the wallet. ❤️❤️❤️🇹🇭Delicious and delicious🤭
review_5_text: It was so delicious, Na Boon Te! I really liked this! 🤩🤩🤩

name: Chin Cafe- จินต์
review_1_text: Take a break during the hike; the scrambled eggs with rice are delicious. (The parking lot is quite large.)
review_2_text: It's delicious.

name: P&P Home Cafe
review_1_text: I have to say, I ordered coffee to try and was impressed with both the taste and the price. The atmosphere is relaxing and the service is friendly. They offer breakfast sets, drinks, and homemade baked goods, including apple pie, blueberry cheesecake, and chocolate cake, all delicious and at great prices. It was so good I couldn't resist ordering some to take home for my family to try! I highly recommend P&P Home Cafe; you won't be disappointed!
review_2_text: The atmosphere is great! It feels warm and welcoming, like visiting relatives. It's located in Chiang Mai city, near Maestro Hospital. ;)
review_3_text: I came here with 4 friends. The air conditioning is cool, the coffee is strong and flavorful, and the homemade bakery items are delicious. We'll definitely visit again next time.
review_4_text: Hidden World Coffee House is located in someone's back garden. It has ample space and air conditioning. The coffee and cakes are delicious. I spent a comfortable afternoon here and will definitely come back to try its savory food!

name: Sweetday ไมโลดิบหน้าปรินส์
C Clover
review_1_text:
A must-visit shop for introverts ❤️
P.S. I love you, Pop.

name: chubbi hobbi coffee
review_1_text: The shop is creative and has designed a menu for people who don't drink coffee. They can drink coffee with a smooth and delicious taste.
review_2_text: The service is very good, the atmosphere of the shop is cool and comfortable, there are cool photo corners.
review_3_text: good

name: Nerb Nerb coffee roaster
review_1_text: Amazing coffee, possibly the best flat white I've had in Chiang Mai. They use a special milk that is super smooth, creamy and the medium roast beans had a good nutty and fruity balance. Tried the americano with medium roast beans too and the balance was perfect, smooth and silky. Love this place! Wished I could bring their beans home!
review_2_text: A great little coffee shop. I had a cold Americano while I waited for my motorbike to get repaired down the street. Great atmosphere and very kind owner.
review_3_text: A place for slow life for chilling with coffee and tea. Barista also recommend a drink whatever you want !!! 👏✌️😎 price not too high and good taste.
review_4_text: The place is quite tiny, not much table; recommend for take away. Parking lot is available behind the shop[same one with the printing shop].They serve specialty coffee, the barrista speaks English very well. The price is very cheap compare to the special bean they served.
review_5_text: Coffee was great! The medium roast wasn’t bitter and it was very smooth. Burger, the man who runs it, is very nice too and knows a lot about coffee! I’ll definitely come back. They also sell fresh eggs!

name: ฮามุก ชานมไต้หวัน
Bubble Jam - Coffee & Taiwan milk tea
review_1_text: Kind, welcoming staff; tasty food, nice music, good prices
review_2_text: Excellent place for quiet reading and really good latte and dessert 👍
review_3_text: Great place, fair prices and super friendly staff! The coffee is very good
review_4_text: Lovely and cozy cafe with cold aircon. Had the Tiramisu Latte Frappe with pearls and it is gd! Very friendly & warm staff!
review_5_text: Very friendly and accommodating staff. Delicious and very reasonable priced drinks!

name: Mabel Cort Cafe'
review_1_text: Just across McCormick Hospital. A lovely place renovated from once the garage next to the house of Dr. Edwin Charles Cort and his wife, Mabel Cort decades ago. Hence the cafe's name. I had my iced latte in the air-conditioned seating  inside  waiting for the guided tour of the Doctor Prince Museum to start. Might try outdoor area when it's cooler.
review_2_text: Good location, nature environment, hot latte 60 baht Easy parking, open early.
review_3_text: Great cafe one the way from bus terminal to Chiang Mai’s town centre. Very nice coffee and great atmosphere, and the surrounding garden is amazing.
review_4_text: An excellent spot for an early morning coffee. Very kind staff and delicious coffee drinks.
review_5_text:
Nice brand new ( opened 6 months ago) coffee shop. Coffee is ok ( for my taste)

Shop is very very clean so that’s absolutely worth a lot of  ++++

The sitting area outside has a big garden around it. Although the road is like 50 meters apart n front of the shop it’s not annoying with regard to noise,  because the cars drive relatively speaking very slow at this specific location. Today I had my coffee here and I understand that every Monday coffee has 50% off. I do not know if this is a limited promotion or all the time. If in the neighborhood absolutely worth the visit.

name: นมสดหน้าแมคฯ
review_1_text:
Delicious, legendary!
Very cheap!
Hot milk is only 12 baht per glass.
Toast with custard is 15 baht.
review_2_text: Fresh milk is deliciously fragrant. Iced cocoa, iced coffee mixed tea, and iced Nestea tea are also delicious and inexpensive. There are pearls, sago, and jelly to choose from. Most importantly, the auntie's custard is very delicious, fragrant, and not too sweet. The auntie who sells it is very kind.

name: HO-SHI ร.พ.แมคคอร์มอค
review_1_text: Whenever I come to buy, the staff never speaks nicely. It's like they're not willing to serve. They see that I'm here first, but they still take orders from other people. It's very confusing. I haven't encountered this just once, but every time I come here, everyone who comes to buy says the same thing. I recommend that you don't support them.
review_2_text: The price doesn't match the price on the sign. I asked the staff and they made faces at me. I couldn't buy it and asked to eat it. Should I change the staff so that sales will improve?

name: S&P McCormack hospital
review_1_text: This S&P store in the hospital has everything: food, drinks, and bakery items.
review_2_text:
They have snacks, food, and drinks.
The service staff is excellent.
The food is delicious and clean.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text:
Friendly service.  Calm space for a coffee.   Comfortable indoor seating, nice deck for outdoor seating.

Iced capuchino tasty, butter cake fresh.
review_2_text: Really nice coffee and friendly staff. A great place to kill time of you're hanging around the bus station.
review_3_text: Nice coffee shop for a quick stop. Small but ok!
review_4_text: I liked that there were power plugs for phones and notebooks. Not even seats though.
review_5_text:
Staff's good
Taste is up-to standard
Environment is great

name: StarWork Chiangmai
review_1_text:
1 day price 300 Thb/ person.
*No drink is included in this price.

In my opinion, a bit pricey for Thai minimum wage.
However, the environment is pretty clean but there are ppl walking around(not sure if they were customers or staff or residents).

Therefore, if you need a privacy, you can go in the office room (it’s already included in the daily price).

Overall I rated 4/5, 1 point missing is for the price (my opinion).
review_2_text: I bought a 1-day pass here for 199 THB (included 1 drink from "Café Amazon" ☕ There are about 15 working desks with comfortable office chairs. The people here worked quietly 👍 (I love it because in other co-working spaces I get annoyed of 20 people talking loudly all the time). At this place I can really focus on my work 👍 There is soft background music so it's not boring. (I hate loud background music at other cafe's). The staff was helpful and spoke excellent English 👍 They close at time 18.00 (like most co-working spaces) ☹
review_3_text: My workplace is wonderful! It's surrounded by greenery and even has a waterfall. We have free meeting rooms, and the people here are really nice.
review_4_text:
I bet this is a great place for co-working if you work 9am-6pm.

If like many remote workers visiting Thailand you have obligations during late evening / early morning hours - do note that the "24 hours access" on the front page of their website is for their "service office" offering only (quoted starting at 1000 THB / day when I visited).

Hot / cold desks and the relatively-cheaper co-working private offices are only available 9-6pm and there is no key card / key code / biometric etc. system for allowing after-hours access as offered by other co-working spaces in Chiang Mai.

4 stars for a beautiful space and a friendly, helpful representative who answered my questions when I arrived in person. -1 star for a wasted trip that could have been saved by a clearer menu of services (and their hours) on the website.
review_5_text: I recommened service office here is super private and cozy. Near 7-11 and cafe Amazon in area not far from Central festival easy to find. Staff are so nice and friendly.

name: พี่เล็กกาแฟสด
review_1_text: Very good place to drink a good espresso or a thai coffee
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious, the Thai tea is also delicious, the price is not expensive.

name: TEMPO
review_1_text: Shows open on Google Maps. Was closed, owner not reachable by phone. After a while an employee came and said “just open on app, not open now.”
review_2_text: Excellent coffee and neat place to drink coffee.
review_3_text: This coffee shop and restaurant is a favorite among the students of Dara School because it's located right next to the school's back gate.

name: Jiratcha cafe
review_1_text:
This is why you should walk around to find those good eats.

Found this place on my way to get some fried chicken 🍗. Don't judge me.

They are opened from 7am to 5pm. From sandwiches to brownies. From ice latte to fruit sodas.

They do catering and always have specials.

Now, to be totally honest, I don't do runny eggs. Well, I jumped in after a little hesitant.  But winner, winner chicken dinner.

It was so good. I went back today to get their "Signature Sandwich. "
review_2_text: I ordered their food via Food Panda. Their sandwich is amazing! Cream horn is also ideal style... I realized I don't have to give up delicious cream horn in Thailand by it.
review_3_text:
I arrived 9:00 when they should officially open. Almost everything sold out, no sandwiches at all, offered fried chicken (shopee driver help me translate Bc waiter can't speak English at all)
Waiting already 20min, since they processing delivery service first...
review_4_text:
No idea why or how the score on googlemaps is so low.
This place SLAYSSS. Everything I’ve tried here screams quality.
review_5_text: Great food and service, Highly recommended!

name: Best Part Coffee Roasters
review_1_text: Probably the best latte in town. Big cups, great coffee, and Ethiopian beans are a must-try. The owner is very friendly, and there’s a cute cat who sometimes feels like the real owner of the place.
review_2_text: variety of coffee blends and cozy perfect for slowing down and enjoying the moment. The service is friendly, the cup is full of flavor
review_3_text: The owner surprised me with a delicious pour-over coffee and two cats named Jedi and Snowman. Such a nice place to grab a coffee or a cold drink!! 🥰
review_4_text: 5 stars for happy lazy cat.  Loses two stars for being closed at 9.10am when Google map shows them open. I hope to visit again
review_5_text: First time I had this Latte here, mysterious aroma kept in my mouth after a sip, like some nuts or something else I never knew, very interesting, I like it.

name: Ice-cool หวานเย็น
Coffee Jame Cafe in garden
review_1_text:
Super friendly, chill and client orientation. Food is very good quality and different side dish day by day - avocado/apple. Very cheap price, and food super quality. Premium salt/pepper/Tabasco, orange 🍊 juice.

I so happy to visit every day.
Thank you for the team of this place

Peace. Big hello from guy who ordering extra bread, 3 eggs and +2 ham + orange juice.
review_2_text: Amazing place and full of positive energy! The dogs are adorable and very well looked after. They’re free to roam as they wish and quite happily come and sit on your feet if they want some attention. Please visit if you have the time 🙏
review_3_text: We come for the cat, but cats are off on Mon Wed and Fri, only two dogs here played with us. Coconut Americano was good. A quite place for cats and dog's lover, if you come on schedule.
review_4_text: Absolutely delicious! Coffee is great and foot as well. We had pancakes and rice with omelette. A cute little doggy gave as a warmly welcome as well as the owner.
review_5_text: Hidden gem. We went for some lunch and the service and food was fantastic. The staff were friendly. The seating is so cute and they have a little garden you can sit and eat in. I recommend the French toast and vanilla milk.

name: Cloud9 Coffee at CHIANGMAI BUS TERMINAL
review_1_text: Great matcha but no food. Great WiFi but too much glare to work on the laptop. At least they're generally open, randomly open/closed is Y Smart coffee and which is great for working with low glare, there's never anyone there, but bring headphones to listen to something other than their music.
review_2_text: A coffee shop with a great vibe near the arcade, affordable prices, perfect for ordering coffee while waiting for your bus.

name: Nine Nine Coffee Bar - ไนน์ ไนน์ คอฟฟี่ บาร์
review_1_text:
Real authentic arabica coffee with range of roasting levels: low/medium/high. All cups are served with double shots that will kick your alertness till sunset 😂. The shop is situated in the middle of Chiang Mai Business Park and they offer all varieties of beverages: hot/cold coffee, non-coffee, and pastries.

Price per cup starts from 40-45 THB.
Super cheap price for their good quality coffee.
Do give this place a chance to kickstart your day. My favorite here is peppermint latte 🥰.
review_2_text: Very nice coffee with good prices and nice open windows. Couldn’t find yet in CM like this kinda cool coffee shops to work. I think after 5pm it turning into to bar. I visited in the rainy morning and enjoyed a lot. Definitely try their Americano with peach.
review_3_text: I really like the iced latte here. I've gotten it twice now and really enjoyed it. The atmosphere is nice. The place smells a bit strange, but I think it's possibly just paint smells.
review_4_text:
Price is  cheaper than others
I am very satisfied with coffee especially Cocoa The  location is near Payap university it's the best place ever
review_5_text: I was disappointed. It says it’s a coffee shop that’s open late, but when I got there, it’s actually more like a bar and they weren’t serving coffee at all. If you are going to be a bar, don’t advertise to be a coffee shop.

name: Sonnen Cafe
review_1_text:
Cozy little coffee shop in Chiang Mai.
It's very pleasing to the eye. Very well decorated.  Very inviting and relaxing.
This is the kind of shop you can sit and work on your laptop.
They have plenty of seating inside and out.
The latte was nice. They only have a small choice in pastries.  But the brownie was delicious 😋
I enjoyed my time here, and the staff is very accommodating
review_2_text: This place is hidden away in a strip mall next to a parking garage, but it's actually a very nice cafe. The interior is well decorated and comfortable. Most important the coffee is great! I'm actually amazed at the rich flavor of the iced black coffee from here.
review_3_text: Ok coffee taste , service was good but it’s so small it’s cute place unique style decoration
review_4_text: Best coffee around. Get a warm welcome - at least, most of the times😉. Nice Maroccan interior. A place to rest and enjoy drink.
review_5_text: Resonable price and good coffee

name: Pot'it cafe
review_1_text: Brewing with a Moka pot might require a little waiting, but the taste is excellent and the price is affordable. (The location on the map is incorrect; the shop is now located next to Index.)

name: DESERVES coffee and espresso bar
review_1_text: Minimal, Barista and Reasonable Price. My Orange Americano is suitable between real orange Juice and middle roasted coffee from Lampang ( Near Chiangmai) that tastes like Cocoa, Butter, Honey and fruit. The price is reasonable, The Barista can mix the different ingredients balanced. Deserves coffee are recommended to all coffee lovers.
review_2_text: Nice small coffee shop with friendly and knowledgeable barista. There are various coffee beans to choose from with reasonable price.
review_3_text: Nice small coffee shop with knowledgeable and friendly baristas. Imported coffee beans are also available at your choice.
review_4_text: Very good coffee, quick stop to grab a cup coffee! A few seats available.
review_5_text: Good taste of latte.i use Google maps to find this small shop.latte was smooth and rich，like it haha！

name: GIVE ME COFF
review_1_text:
This is also a small cafe with high scores.

Eat near here.

Must come and have a drink.

The price is very friendly.

It tastes pretty good.

I ordered a cup of signature.

It's coffee with milk.

No sugar can be added.

Rich and layered

Very delicious

I also bought a latte.

A little lighter

So I recommend the signature coffee.

"Give me coffee"

Recommend recommendation
review_2_text: It's a very small shop, but it is also very carefully arranged. I like the combination of white inside and green plants outside the window. I ordered honey American style, and the coffee has acidity. Next time, try something that is not sweet!
review_3_text: I have been here a hundred times and their coffee taste is consistent. Very good taste for a great price top with nice owners serving you. I will keep coming back.
review_4_text: Good vibe, not too busy
review_5_text: Coffee was good, and there's a chill little spot outbsideb5o to sit and relax, and the staff was friendly.

name: ชาจอมพล (เอ-พาร์ค)
Summer Vibes Cafe & Bar - ซัมเมอร์ ไวบ์ส คาเฟ่ และ บาร์
review_1_text: Soooo gooood, recommended!
review_2_text: Delicious and inexpensive yogurt milk sandwiches. There's also delicious and fragrant Taiwanese tea pudding.
review_3_text:
🍓The shop owner is very lovely and polite.
The strawberry yogurt milk is also delicious.
The croffle is fragrant, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. I highly recommend it. Please go and support her!

name: Cherry Monkey Craft Bar
review_1_text: Great coffee great staff amazing matcha and now with cats.
review_2_text: Already was here and everything was amazing. But the last time was disappointing. I came 1 hour before closing. The barista was unfriendly, made a to-go drink instead of nice cups they have, even though I didn’t ask for it. No water. Also I chose middle roasting but got the cheapest dark one. Felt like the barista wanted me to leave quickly🥴
review_3_text: The location is great, the coffee is aromatic, and the cafe has a beautiful atmosphere. Whenever I visit Chiang Mai, I always make sure to stop by.
review_4_text: Every time I come during the day, the coffee in this shop is very good. I like whisky coffee best.
review_5_text:
You can choose your favorite coffee beans and place an order.
First of all, the coffee is delicious, and the place stands out with its spacious seating and cool air conditioning.

name: Teawa Chatai
review_1_text:
Delicious beyond its price tag, this is probably the definition of this beverage shop. Although there's a wide selection on the menu, the drinks aren't disappointing. Their signature drink is the milk tea.
The sales staff are friendly and helpful. Parking is available at 7-Eleven.

name: Blue Cafe and Apartment service
review_1_text: we stayed here when we came back to Chaing Mai just for 2 nights as it was near the bus station. i wouldn't stay here if I actually wanted to explore Chaing Mai just because of the distance to things. staff were lovely. did think it was strange that it had a kitchenette (hob) but no pans were provided (it didn't state that when we booked it). bed was mega comfy and the room was huge. bathroom was nice with a lovely warm shower.
review_2_text:
This place is great.  Excellent prices and a great atmosphere that feels like something I'd see back home in California.

Try it, you won't regret it.
review_3_text: ♥️ Best tasting coffee in Chiangmai also only 60THB, They also have a good food selection menu also well priced.
review_4_text:
Came here just for a bite and to charge the phone.

Food is a bit overpriced. Drinks 70-120 THB, food 80-180.

I got a smoothie for 80 and personal pizza for 165. They were both good, but wouldn't say any better than cheaper places around. The smoothie was kinda too sweet, pizza was nothing to write home about.
review_5_text: Just stopped for coffee, but it was good, and the cafe had a nice atmosphere.

name: Nine Nine Car Protection Center ศูนย์บริการติดฟิล์มใสกันรอย เคลือบแก้ว
review_1_text: Nine Nine was very helpful explaining the product and services. I was told to show up on Monday and it would take 4 hours to apply the Ceramic Coating 3 layer 10H+. When I came back at 12pm, the car looks stunning and had the shine coat all over. The inside was all clean without a speck of dust. I am very happy and will return for the follow up check after 6 months.  Good job Nine Nine!
review_2_text: Good car washing service Fast and clean, delicious coffee and croissants.
review_3_text: The best car wash , ceramic coating and film protect in Doi saket district. Amazing service and quality. There’s also a cafe right next to the car wash area. Which is very convenient. Great value for money for a good service.
review_4_text: Reasonably priced, did washing inside and outside and they did a good job for my car. Have a nice AC cafe for customers to wait while the car is getting clean. Will definitely visit again.
review_5_text: delicious coffee, pleasant and air-conditioned place and the greatest company of a dog 🐶

name: CHIC COFFEE &BAR
review_1_text: I drink a lot of coffee and I love the coffee at this place. Excellent dark roast !  The baristas know how to make good coffee.  Very comfortable and quiet inside.
review_2_text:
Tucked away near Khum Paya resort, this is a chilled out spot perfect for your morning coffee - for us vegans/plant-based, the oat milk option here is delicious and iced or hot, you can be assured you’ll have a beautiful drink every time.

The staff are polite, friendly and considerate in every way - affordable, convenient but also serene in amongst a little hustle and bustle of outer Chiang Mai.

Highly recommend!
review_3_text: The atmosphere and coffee here are very nice they make a very good coffee here for coffee lovers. The location is great, with air-conditioned indoor seating and plush chairs, as well as outdoor seating to enjoy your coffee. It's also very well priced.
review_4_text:
Friendly greetings from staff.
My husband ordered a hot cappuccino and I got iced latte we also got cookies.
Everything was nice.

Good chill vibes inside small cafe - clean and quiet.

nice place to sit and enjoy coffee in the morning :)
review_5_text: Great little coffee shop with excellent coffee, mixed drinks and some snacks. Employees are very kind and respectful, would definitely come back here!

name: Chiangmai Christian International Library
review_1_text: Good place to study and read book! Nice service.
review_2_text: This is the space that helped me the most during my month-long stay in Chiang Mai. It has many great books for children and adults, and a recently opened cafe makes it a great place to read with your children. Regardless of religious affiliation, you are worthy of respect for your continued support of Korean residents. Thank you so much for everything you've done.
review_3_text: This library is Chiang Mai's only Korean-style library operated on a membership basis. Upon joining, you pay a one-time annual fee and gain free library access for one year. You can borrow books, use the bookshelves during library hours, and even study at the book café.
review_4_text:
It feels like a collection of only foreign books, so it's actually better than libraries in Korea.
There are so many books!
There are not only Korean books, but also books in English, Chinese, and Thai, so it's incredibly diverse.
There's a separate children's area, which moms like me are simply grateful for.
review_5_text:
The annual fee is cheap, making it more economical than studying at a cafe. Cafes usually offer drinks, but with an annual fee, you can study there anytime and spend your time comfortably. It's highly recommended. There's also parking available.

(Note: The repeated "ประจำปีราคาถูก" translates to "The annual fee is cheap, so it's more economical than studying at a cafe. Cafes usually offer drinks, but if you pay an annual fee, you can study there anytime and spend your time comfortably. It's highly recommended. There's also parking available.")

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Americano is not good……. the interior is great and air-conditioned though
review_2_text:
We enjoyed sitting here for a while and working. We ordered fruit smoothies, but surprisingly the available flavors were strawberry and a couple other berries. Not sure if this is an international brand that has to be consistent, but where was mango or dragon fruit or...
You are in Thailand, be proud of your local fruits!
review_3_text:
Too cold
The staff doesn't know how to control the Aircon
review_4_text: Being able to sit outside under the roof in the shade  is for me personally a pro. The coffee is ok.
review_5_text: Still have a nice coffee. Friendly and pleasant customer services.

name: The Extraction CBP
review_1_text: Ning is the best waitress in the world, I wish she worked in England so I could see her everyday! I will miss her beautiful face every time I’m not with her
review_2_text: Two very milky flat whites and the barista does not know what "magic" is for the third cup.
review_3_text: Very small coffee
review_4_text: A small coffee shop with two types of coffee beans, both delicious and inexpensive. The menu isn't extensive, so don't overthink it. It's very convenient. The shop has one table inside with plugs, one outside, and one on the side of the road. The green tea is quite ordinary.
review_5_text:
The coffee is delicious and aromatic. They've selected good quality coffee beans for you to try, with a variety of options at reasonable prices.
I give it an 8.5/10. Highly recommend it!

name: Ninebar Coffee Roaster; Business Park
review_1_text:
Nice coffee and a good price!

A lot of seating and all are outdoors covered by a roof.

The parking lots are many around there.
review_2_text:
Had a few hot cappuccino and latte here. I like the taste of the coffee. Price is ok, but the coffee should be hotter.
Today we got the first time paper cups instead of real cups. If they keep that we are not coming back.
review_3_text: Awesome little corner cafe with interesting drink choices: I recommend the coffee with orange
review_4_text: Lovely freshly brew coffee at very reasonable price at cozy atmosphere!

review_2_text: Bad customer service
review_3_text:
The advantages are that there's a Cha Tra Mue tea shop in CMU, and they offer a wide variety of teas, including vegan and low-calorie healthy options.

⚠️However, the disadvantage is that the staff is very rigid in making milk tea according to their recipe. I ordered a less-sweet milk tea, and when I asked how many ml of condensed milk to use for a typical less-sweet order, the staff member said it had to be measured in a cup without specifying their "less-sweet" recipe. I didn't ask further because their answer wasn't direct.

When I received the tea, it was still quite sweet. Normally, when I order less-sweet drinks, I only ask for about 10-15 ml of syrup or condensed milk. But at this shop, "less-sweet" was probably equivalent to adding about 25-30 ml of condensed milk.

I went back to ask the staff member how much sweetness they had added, but I didn't get an answer. So I asked if it would be possible to ask for even less sweetness next time.

The staff member looked confused (probably wondering how to answer) and replied, "It's possible, but we have to follow the recipe."

So we asked again, "Isn't it just a matter of reducing the amount of condensed milk?" The staff member hesitated and replied that if other branches knew that this branch adjusted the sweetness level to "less sweet" as requested by customers, it would undermine their standards. Otherwise, customers would have to choose the "unsweetened" option... But...🙄

In short, this branch cannot adjust the sweetness level to customer preferences. One visit is enough.

review_2_text: Tasty drinks with reasonable price
review_3_text:
I'd like the restaurant to try improving their matcha menu because, to be honest, it's not delicious at all. In the matcha menu, they don't measure the matcha. They just scoop it and add it to the hot water. Even whisking the matcha doesn't break it up. The matcha is lumpy because it's mixed with a spoon, and the taste is very astringent. I've tried ordering coconut matcha, pure matcha, and honey lemon matcha, but this one is the most edible (because the lemon and honey flavors completely mask the bitterness of the matcha). I've stopped eating matcha at the restaurant for a while now.

If the restaurant wants to make a matcha menu that stands out at a budget price, they don't need to add or change anything. They just need to be more meticulous in making it. For example, they don't measure the matcha a lot—just 3 grams is enough. (The vendor probably scooped over 10 grams because it was so much.) It also saves on ingredients. You can use a tea whisk or a frother if you're in a hurry to break up the matcha. That's how delicious it is.

Please consider this feedback. And I'll be waiting to try the shop's delicious matcha. I'd like to see a delicious matcha shop in the university. I'm rooting for you.
review_4_text: You should definitely try the Chiang Mai cafeteria. The average price is around 35 baht, which is cheaper than other expensive restaurants in Chiang Mai, and it's clean. In particular, noodle shop #6, which costs around 35 baht, has a generous seating area where you can add your own condiments, and there's a water purifier (next to the trash can). Drink shop #7 offers green water with condensed milk. A large size is 20 baht, and I personally recommend it if you're not sensitive to strong aromas. They don't have Zero Coke.

Bread and beverage here are good

name: Peony house Cafe

review_2_text:

Nice tables to sit

I also love iced coffee with orange and cake's varieties are very fantastic.

review_5_text:

I had a cup of latte, it was great with reasonable price . The doggy in the shop was also cute.

review_2_text: Great quality coffee at a very affordable price. You can also buy beans from them. :) Really friendly owners as well.

It’s a must visit if you find yourself in Chiang Mai!

review_5_text: Very nice gentleman making great tasting coffee ! Highly recommend 🙏🙏

review_5_text: Cute coffee shop and friendly owner. Cozy outdoor decoration and the coffee is very nice at reasonable price.

We tried the rose latte, the pixie latte, the potion for our children, and the nuggets and fries. It was all perfect, thank you for giving us an experience we won’t forget.

review_3_text:
A very cool coffee shop.
The decor here is very quirky with a sort if wizard/harry potter theme.
The menu is amazing with so many different drinks and the presentation is so good.
review_4_text:
Super fun place, had an amazing iced latte, wasn’t too sweet like they usually do here, with a beautiful (also not too sweet) red velvet cake.
My husband got a blueberry smoothie which we couldn’t finish because it was way too sweet, but the way it was served was beautiful! We are total harry potter fans, so we loved it!!

review_2_text: Great coffee, good price but reliability is a bit of issue. I went there 7.15am and need to wait for them to arrange the shop. I went there the other day around 12.45 and shop already close. So open 7am-1pm as shown in Google is not true.
review_3_text: Sweet little take away coffee corner with amazing coffee and sweet lady making it :) we’ll be back!!!!

review_5_text: We had a great coffee ☕️! I had the es-yeh (Thai Style) and I loved it! Such a good coffee 🙏 try it out 👌

5-star in all aspects: food, service ambiance!

We went for coffee and snacks. Also needed a cake for our daughter’s birthday celebration.

Both the cappuccino and Matcha were delicious. The cake with painting option, too, was really scrumptious. The baker was very friendly and skilled. Last but not the least: the location is so convenient and beautiful.
review_2_text:

My partner ordered a regular coffee and i didn't like the taste at all
review_3_text:
There are too many cafes in Nimman!
But glad we found this one, easily the best space so far, great design and it's easy to relax. Great prices and service. They got meals and snacks too.
review_4_text:
Loved painting my cake at Morestto Cafe it was delicious! The Thai tea was rich and tasty. 🎂✨

Staff gave great recommendations and were super friendly. Cozy cafe with plenty of plugs-highly recommend! 🥰
review_5_text: This coffee shop is disappointing. Their coffee is unevenly brewed, and the coffee liquid tastes like water. The Thai food they serve is also the most mediocre I've had in many days. Many people come here just to take photos of the environment. If you want to enjoy a delicious cup of coffee and a tasty meal, I wouldn't recommend coming here.

name: Uncle Kani
review_1_text: The ambiance is great, the cats are super well-behaved, and all the staff members adore them. The food here is delicious too—especially the beef, which is perfectly tender, and it only costs 190 baht, such a great deal! The grilled salmon is a bit overcooked, but the rice is fragrant and tasty. I’ll definitely come back just for the beef.
review_2_text: Tranquil atmosphere, with nice music not a large menu (which is a good sign), the food was delicious and the steak meat was grilled medium rare in my dish, I also had the egg on top. It had a great chilled ambience too. At the end when going to pay they have free cat stickers 😂, unique little spot and a bit of a gem in Chiang Mai. Highly recommend. I think we will be coming back ! I want to check out their coffee!
review_3_text: I was craving Japanese food for lunch, and an acquaintance recommended me to try this cat-themed restaurant. It’s a nice, cozy little spot with relaxing music setting a great vibe. I ordered beef fat fried rice with steak and a soy sauce-marinated egg yolk, and it absolutely lived up to my expectations.
review_4_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Uncle Kani is a lovely, quiet spot in Chiang Mai. One of the highlights is their three super cute cats which make the place feel extra cozy and welcoming.

The food is great — we really enjoyed the beef fried rice, steak, and salad. Everything was tasty and affordable. We actually went there twice during our stay,and the second visit was even better. The rice came out hotter and the overall flavor was improved.✔️

If you’re looking for a calm place with good food and a relaxedmosphere (plus adorable cats), Uncle Kani is definitely worth a visit
review_5_text:
lovely place & lovely comfort food! i went here for dinner with my husband & ordered the beef fat fried rice, hashbrown, aus ribeye, peach tea, ginger ale, and the caramel custard thing (shaped heart, so cute). all are tastes nice!

bonus: they had 2 lovely cats hehe. as a cat lover, this is like +10000000 aura! must visit when you are in chiang mai.

name: 8days Cafe
review_1_text:
This café on Nimmanhaemin Road in Chiang Mai has a quiet, peaceful atmosphere with a subtle Japanese-style design. The space feels calm and relaxing, making it a place I instantly fell in love with.

I visited with a friend and we ordered their signature green tea, priced at 150 baht. The flavor was rich and well-balanced, with a smooth, deep taste that felt very comforting. It was clear that a lot of care went into the quality of the tea.

The café is also very photogenic—every corner looks great in photos—yet it never feels noisy or crowded. It’s an ideal spot to slow down, enjoy a drink, and spend some quiet time with friends. I truly enjoyed being here and would happily come back again.
review_2_text: The Vanilla Sour beer is to die for: flavorful, crisp, and very refreshing.  The staff are great hosts and the menu features local Thai Cuisine.  A short walk from the Silver Temple or a Tuk-tuk from the airport.  Worth it!
review_3_text: This place is absolutely fantastic. Not only is there coffee amazing but they pass all the vibe checks. Super cool design inside and out and you can just tell they put a lot of creativity into their work. I really appreciate this coffee shop and will be back again for another iced Americano.
review_4_text: Amazing little cafe. Cosy and chill with good coffee and good pricey. Great place to get some work done! All coffee is solid
review_5_text: Very good coffee! Delicious desserts! Excellent service and very nice ambiance. You can seat inside with the air conditioning or outside for the fresh air. You can come alone to work or come with friends to enjoy the coffee and the atmosphere!

name: Rainy's Veggie Burgers
review_1_text: This was our first meal in the city and definitely one of the best. We had Khao Suey Burger,Khaprao Sauce burger, Green Thai Sauce Sphagetti,French Fries and Blue Pea Lime juice. Khaprao sauce and Green Thai were spicy but tasty. We even packed two patties for later. This is definitely recommended for vegetarians, vegans around one nimman area. This shop is run by Rainy, a wonderful and friendly person to converse with.
review_2_text:
The Best Veggie Burgers in Chiang Mai – A True Hidden Gem!
We were so impressed by the food and the vibe at Rainy's Veggie Burgers that we simply had to come back the next day. This place is a true gem. The burgers are simple yet incredibly flavorful, with the patties being clearly homemade with love and care. It's the perfect, no-frills spot for a delicious and very affordable meal. The atmosphere is so cozy and welcoming, and Rainy herself is just the kindest and friendliest owner. This isn't just a place to eat—it feels like you're being welcomed into a friend's home. We're already looking forward to our next visit!
review_3_text:
Rainy is doing such an amazing job with her business so it's not a surprise that her average score here is 5! The burgers and fries are really tasty plus I recommend to go for the butterfly lime juice, it's delicious! However, beside food, Rainy puts so much effort into making her guests to feel like they are at home that I honestly can't remember the last time I had such a pleasant experience when visiting a restaurant. On top of it all, the pricw of the food is very affordable and if you leave the tip, Rainy will make sure it gets donated to the nearest hospital.
Big love from Sinisa and Dragan, we will come back to Chiang Mai next year just to visit Rainy and taste some of the finest veggie burgers in Thailand.
review_4_text:
This little outdoor but covered restaurant in the Nimman neighborhood run by super sweet Rainy/Fon has really tasty fusion burgers and pasta.

Everything is apparently vegan except the buns (which unfortunately contain eggs; I urged her to find vegan buns).
review_5_text: I don’t normally eat burgers; however, I decided to try Rainy’s vegetarian burgers and I was not disappointed! I went for the one with green curry sauce, which had a two chilli heat rating, but it was perfectly balanced. Full of  flavours without being overpowering. The patty tasted fresh and homemade.  Rainy’s warm, genuine hospitality made the experience even better.

review_2_text: This bakery was very delicious both times I visited. The customer service is stellar and the atmosphere is chill and relaxed. My food was warm, fresh, and delicious and the to go bags are super cute (I paired them with some other snacksnin the pictures)Definitely plan on going again. I ordered plain croissants and egg croissants.
review_3_text: Great breakfast, and beautiful to smell fresh baked croissant!  Ice americano was perfect and the owners very friendly. Good prices for  western style breakfasts.
review_4_text:
Tick for every box. Atmosphere is welcoming and friendly. Vibe is positive 🩷 and music great too.🎶
Menu is simple, and delicious 🤤. Simple things are quite often the best. And affordable. Will definitely make it a regular thing and have already started telling my friends about it. Credit where it's due. 🙏🏽🩷🎶
review_5_text: Was getting my motorbike serviced at Honda nearby and wanted to have some breakfast. Glad I found this place just 50m down the road. Had the egg pesto feta toast, it was incredibly tasty. Everything is reasonably priced and unlike many places, all their pastries seem to be actually homemade.

name: ร้านผกา Phaka

Nice sandwiches and salad at this place. Craft beer and desserts too

The place next door has other hot food and drinks and is the same owner

We had a bacon sandwich and a very good large  Caesar salad
review_2_text: coziest chill spot away from the noise :) really good sandwiches and nice music
review_3_text: I love this place so so much. I’ve been here a handful of times and it has never disappointed. They always make sure I have plenty of shade and am comfortable, they truly go above and beyond
review_4_text:

Friendly and chill guy who runs the place, always plays some nice chill music to vibe with in the garden under the tree 👌🏻
review_5_text: Came across this really cute coffee and tea bus stand while walking in the neighborhood:) I tried the hot apple tea and it was delicious. They have some seating on the side with a fan to keep you cool from the heat. Cash only.

review_4_text: The owner is very friendly and helpful. The food and drinks are tasty and reasonably priced.
review_5_text: Friendly guy who owns the shop. Great coffee and lovely atmosphere.

Toast range is excellent and delicious.

review_2_text: Great ice green tea and banana bread.

review_5_text: Very delicious. The shop is cute. The price is very cheap compared to the quality. I will definitely come back again.

name: Feel Nimman Boutique
review_1_text:
The front receptionist was amazing, helping me carry my 25kg suitcase and also during check-out due to no elevators available.

My room was spacious with a work table and stable Wi-Fi. Receptions often asking whether I needed my room cleaned, which was helpful.

They ask you to store your shoes away at receptions in replace of hotel slippers, which was a first for me but was no hassle.

Great location with 7/11, cafes, and restaurants nearby (some within 1 min walk), quiet side streets despite being near the main road, and scenic mountain views.

The pool wasn’t functional, but there was a convenient laundromat on the same street.

Overall, i felt safe and comfortable as receptions was also 24/7 and the location was safe for a solo female traveller.
review_2_text:
Rooms were nice and comfortable.
The establishment has a policy where you have to remove your shoes near the reception and use a pair of slied provided by them.
Apart from that and the fact that it does not have a lift, no complaints about the rooms or the service.  The staff was very friendly and the rooms were clean, modern and good value for money
review_3_text:
Do not trust the other reviews of this hotel.

My room, infested with ants, forced me to request a cancellation, but the manager refused a refund.

This place is for you if you like hotels with:
- a ridiculously tiny and creepy pool,
- a cramped entrance,
- bizarre "design"
- no elevator

I left the hotel when the staff came into my room to spray it with insecticide.

Be warned: if you choose this hotel, expect the manager to be remorseless and adopt a ruthless approach to any issues that arise.

The standard professional ethics found in most reputable hotels are absent at Feel Nimman Boutique. In fact, I struggle to find any similarities between this establishment and a professionally managed hotel.

I strongly recommend considering hotels like Hi Chiangmai, Bed Nimman, or Baan Sang Singh. I've stayed at all three and they excel in cleanliness and comfort. They are also slightly more affordable.

Meanwhile, Agoda, the booking platform through which I reserved the stay at Feel Nimman, acknowledged the deplorable situation and compensated me with an appropriate voucher. As I understand it, the voucher's value equates to their commission on the booking.

Currently, I am still fighting for a refund from the hotel, although it appears that issuing refunds for mishandled customers is not part of their policy.
review_4_text: Amazing place: love the desk and functionality of the room. The lobby lady is really kind. They are a bit weird with shoes system but at least it is clean
review_5_text:
room is clean, area nearby convenient. staff is good and helpful. noisy at night before 12am coz a bar is just opposite to my double bed room. no lift for 3 floors house.

name: HISO NIMMAN
review_1_text: Nothing special. Just another coffee shop. They will give you the tourist price if you don't speak Thai. Which is double.
review_2_text: Great coffee at a quiet ally near nimman center, came here once and came back every morning. Clean and welcoming, very recomended.

review_4_text:
Hi, so??..??
The plates... really??
