review_5_text: Shoe spa, like new.

name: Lot of Taste
review_1_text:
I recently visited Lot of Taste in Chiang Mai and had a great experience.

The staff were very friendly and welcoming, making the atmosphere feel relaxed and comfortable from the moment I walked in. Their service was attentive and warm, which made the visit even more enjoyable.

The drinks were really good — well-balanced, refreshing, and nicely presented. You can tell they put care into both the quality and the details.

Overall, it’s a lovely place to chill, enjoy good drinks, and experience friendly service. I would definitely come back again! 😊
review_2_text: The coffee was delicious, and the cake was equally good! Perhaps it’s popular because the place is showing signs of wear and tear. I’d love to return for the coffee.
review_3_text: This coffee shop demonstrates a clear commitment to exceptional coffee brewing and minimal space design. It has attracted a significant number of patrons, both local and international, and benefits from its proximity to the prominent and bustling Nimmanhaemin Road. However, a notable concern arises regarding the placement of the designated smoking area, which is situated near the public pavement. The proximity of this area allows cigarette smoke to disperse, potentially affecting pedestrians and motorcyclists passing by. I urge the owner of this establishment to consider their social responsibility in this matter, as the current arrangement may negatively impact the health of others. While the coffee quality is commendable, individuals prioritizing social responsibility may wish to re-evaluate their patronage of this establishment.
review_4_text: I had a flat white with oat milk take away - great coffee, good vibes of the cafe. I didn't get a chance to chill at the cafe, but it looked good, modern and reasonably priced. My coffee was 80 plus 20 for oat milk. They didn't have any vegan foods/bakery to offer which was a con, but good overall.
review_5_text: My first try of the "soft" cloud cream topping on drinks and it was wondrously delightful. Delicious with the Thai tea!

name: 1% coffee Nimman
review_1_text:
Not a cafe-hopper, but definitely a coffee-hopper. so glad I made the right choice!

Chiang Mai has so many cafes, but the coffee here is amazing. I was so impressed with the light roast latte (usually I drink dark roast) that I had to go back and ask what coffee it was.

Definitely a good call among so many coffee spots!
review_2_text:
Good, hop coffee shop. Tiny place right by the main road. There is some seating. But most people just stop and by take away. They also sell beans.

The coffee is good and very cheap. 50 Baht for a cappuccino and other hot drinks. Lot‘s of locals but also tourists stop for coffee.
review_3_text: A small, no-nonsense coffee spot in Nimmanhaemin, Chiang Mai. The owner truly knows coffee and gives spot-on recommendations. Fair prices, a solid variety of beans, and quality in every cup. Simple, honest, and made for people who take their coffee seriously.
review_4_text:
Stumbled across this small startup coffee shop and boy I was lucky! Great coffee, two good flavour profiles of beans to choose from and since I was the last order of the day, he didn’t even charge me, what a guy :)
It was my first day & first coffee in Chiang Mai and what a lovely welcome experience.
review_5_text: Randomly found this gem while strolling around Nimman today. I ordered an Americano, and it is so juicy, in fact, much better than many specialty coffee cafes. Would revisit every time I have a chance! Recommended to everyone who loves great coffee, not to mention that it is not pricey at all. I hope the owner gets his own store/building in the future!

name: Starbucks reserve Nimman soi3
review_1_text:
Starbucks Reserve on Nimman Soi 3 is a very cozy and inviting place. If you are walking around One Nimman, it is just a short walk to enjoy your favorite coffee here.

The staff are friendly and always smiling, making the atmosphere even more pleasant. The coffee quality is excellent, on par with what you would find in the U.S.

It is a great spot whether you come alone or with friends, as there is plenty of comfortable seating.

Dr. Niwech
review_2_text: Enjoyable experience at this Starbucks Reserve location in Chiang Mai. The space is well-designed with a good selection of coffees. A warmer welcome from the staff would have enhanced the visit. ☕️
review_3_text:
This is a really beautiful coffee shop.  They have some small batch coffees and drinks that are specific to Starbucks reserve.

There is a large area upstairs that is a nice place to work or have a meeting.
review_4_text: Baristas here provide warm service. Love the vibe in the whole place. Coffee is of the same standards of course.
review_5_text: Very cozy cafe at Nimmana Haeminda Road, Starbucks reserve Nimman soi.3. There are some alcohol options like espresso martini highly recommended. Overall atmosphere is calm and gorgeous. Very easy to find its location.

name: Yelloo
review_1_text:
A nice shop that is easy to find in the Nimman area. Bright coffee shop with a simple but effective menu that focuses on the basics. Everything has a sort of clean look to it, including the items you order.

Service is intuitive which is a nice pleasant surprise as well. An enjoyable experience.
review_2_text: Wow. What a gorgeous environment, incredibly friendly staff, and the best unique iced coffee that I've had in my life. You HAVE to try the Yelloo Latte - it's the marriage of a creme brulee and iced coffee, done to perfection. Amazing
review_3_text: Well located quaint little coffee place full of light, some plants and lots of warm smiles. The staff speaks English.
review_4_text: I ordered cafe latte choosing dark roasted coffee bean a little bittersweet taste not bad.
review_5_text: The place is great for fun unique drinks, it’s not too loud, there is also great lighting and great WiFi

name: Nimman Social
review_1_text: Great place as the open plan space keeps the area nice and breezy so you never get too hot or too cold. The drinks are a decent price, 75 baht for a hot coffee. They have a good variety of food on their menu; curries, nachos, and paninis. You receive a wifi code with a purchase. The wifi is okay, I wouldn't say it's the best. It takes a while to set up.
review_2_text: LOVE THIS PLACE!!! I have used this place since the opening in 2017 and keep coming back. What makes this place special is the staffs. They are always helpful and super nice, so you do not feel like you need to leave soon after finishing your drink. They also provide fast Internet and I love the long tables here!!!
review_3_text:
Nice area very open floor, right next to a hostel  and there are many outlets for you to charge your electronic devices, nice pleasant music that is upbeat.

We are traveling as a family with a one year old and it was nice to find a nice infant high chair, the little one love the waffles. My wife enjoyed the macchiato and we have some of the hot sandwiches for breakfast. Restrooms are small but very clean and nice. The service was good they brought the foot to our table after ordering.

You're able to pay with debit or credit card since in a lot of places here in Thailand that's not an option that was nice.
review_4_text: A nice place to work from especially you don't mind a beer at the same time.  Staff are very friendly and the space is open and comfortable.  Pricing is on par with Nimman, perhaps even a bit cheaper.  My latte was 75 Baht.  I had the Panang Curry which was nice, but not at the level of the local Thai restaurants I frequent in Santitam.  The sound track is pop and more Bar / Cafe than coworking place.  To be fair this is what Niman Social markets itself as.  I did have to block it out with headphones in order to concentrate.
review_5_text: Good coffee and great place to work from. Comfortable chairs and large tables. Nice staff. Fast wifi. Not many outlets, though, but enough.

name: PLAYWORKS SHOP&CAFE
review_1_text:
If you love unique and high-quality souvenirs, PLAYWORKS is a must-visit in Chiang Mai! I had already visited their branch at Terminal 21 and loved their T-shirts, postcards, and gifts, so I was excited to check out the main store.

The shop is filled with beautifully printed art, stylish clothing, and fun accessories like pins and stickers. Everything is well-designed, making it hard to leave without picking up more than planned!

Another great surprise was the location—right outside the store, we stumbled upon some amazing photo spots with aesthetic youth park vibes. It’s definitely worth a stop, whether you’re shopping for souvenirs or just exploring the area.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for creative, locally inspired gifts! 🎨✨
review_2_text: Nice and beautiful store, lots of souvenirs available and clothing brands. But the store is quite small and narrow. Some of the souvenirs and cloths prices are quite high. Overall just a nice place to pay a visit. This area is very famous for the tourist and neaar this also there are few stores that sell souvenirs and items for visitors.
review_3_text:
Great and unique gifts. Really a must visit when in Chiang Mai, only downside is you’ll end up buying more than planned!
Great art prints, nice clothes and accessories for sale. The cafe is really cute too with a nice variety of drinks. The Thai milk tea was less sweet as requested, very appreciated.
review_4_text: Love this cute little souvenir shop selling all kinds of local postcards, pins, stickers. If not for this place we wouldn't have discovered the photo spots right outside the shop as well, very aesthetic youth park vibes area worth a stop by for insta
review_5_text: I love this shop and the art they have. The business is run by three siblings who are the artists. I got plenty of new art for my apartment. I can highly recomment to check them out, I am sure you will find something for yourself or as a souvenir for friends and family.

name: Mali Cat Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: Visiting this cat café in Thailand was such a special experience. You purchase a ticket that includes a free drink and an hour to spend with the cats, which felt like the perfect amount of time. The space was clean, peaceful, and thoughtfully maintained, so it never felt chaotic or overwhelming. Being so far from home and missing my own cats, it was such a gift to sit, relax, and enjoy their sweet company. I left feeling happy and refreshed. Highly recommend if you love cats!
review_2_text: There are so many cute beautiful cats here. Loved the place and spending time with them all. The package is 250bhat per hour and you get a drink with it also. You can feed the cats also but i think it’s extra. You can pet the cats, play with them or just simply enjoy the company. I bought the Thai tea and it was good. I just went there to see those cute beautiful cats anyway. There are care takers as well. Overall the staff is good and cleanliness is maintained. I hope the welfare of the cats are maintained as well. Like to recommend this place. Love from 🇱🇰
review_3_text: Came here in the evening with my husband as I love cats, The Café it itself was very clean had no smell and was quite large. The amount of cats they had there they had some toys that humans could play with them. I did notice that majority of the cats were not interactive and not playing. Maybe this is because they’re not used to being played with I’m not sure. I would like to make a suggestion to have a few of those catnip toys that cats love to play with as I know my cat loves them. You can also get a bird on a stretchy string that you attach to the ceiling that I think cats would love as they can play with it to themselves when there are no humans around
review_4_text:
Happened to stay at an airbnb near this cafe and was so glad i decided to visit. Exceptional! Super huge, clean and the cats look healthy and well fed. They provide socks, lint rollers and lockers. Price is so reasonable and they did not chase us out even when we stayed longer than what we paid for. The price also includes a drink and they have many varieties.

The cats were friendly and adorable and i would totally visit again if i ever go to chiang mai again!

You can also tell that the staff love their job and they take care of the cats very well.
review_5_text:
If you’re a cat lover who appreciates quiet elegance, Mali Café in Chiang Mai is like stepping into a furry palace of British Shorthairs and Scottish Folds— Mixed Munchins, Sphinx others around 80 of them! These kitties aren’t your typical clingy types; they’re more like the soft-spoken aristocrats of the cat world—polite, poised, and preferring gentle admiration over hugs and squeezes. Please follow the café rules; keeps things calm, be mindful for all visitors not to pet too aggressively (totally fair—these cats are basically celebrities).

The place feels cozy and well-kept, and watching all those fluffy faces stroll around is honestly therapeutic. It’s less about cuddling and more about soaking up the feline vibes. Perfect spot for cat lovers who enjoy observing the graceful side of meow-life. 🩵☕🐾meow meow

name: Funky Roaster ฟังกี้ โรสเตอร์ 咖啡厅和酒吧
review_1_text:
Cool concept. Cafe/Bike Rental/and BBQ?????
Cool vibe in the morning sipping drinks in a cafe/autoshop. Coffee's alright too.

(posted a photo of their menu)
review_2_text:
Cool Coffee Shop that opens early in the morning. So it was perfect for me to stop on my way to the office. Skipping hotel coffee and having a proper one instead.

The place is actually a motorbike rental shop. But they share the space with a coffee shop.
review_3_text: Very cool coffee place for a quick coffee run. It’s inside a bike rental shop and the store looks so cool with vintage bikes as props.
review_4_text: I absolutely adore you. This is the strongest coffee in Chiang Mai! And you make it incredibly fast. I don’t even know how I’d live without you. Love you!
review_5_text: Very good concept, very good coffee, but sadly provided wifi didn't worked and I had to go somwhere else :(

name: York Caffe
review_1_text: A nice place to drink high quality coffee in the shadow of the tress

name: Slow Bar Zapacoffee ซะป๊ะกาแฟ Specialty Coffee
review_1_text: Incredible drip coffee. Skip the big stores and come to this stall
review_2_text: Very good coffee, made with a lot of care and attention
review_3_text: Located in the plant nursery district, this is a delight of coffee knowledge and taste. I have often stopoed by the market stall in Nimman and now I've found the home.
review_4_text: Unique coffee tasting experience!!! A must try with affordable prices and premium quality. Can also find the stall at one nimman white market.
review_5_text: chiang mai and its coffee is special indeed, and the staff put so much passion into a cup of coffee the result is mind blowing

name: Graph One Nimman
review_1_text: This place is a gem for coffee lovers! The coffee is incredibly fragrant and well-balanced. They have a wide variety of beans and creative menu options that all look so interesting. The presentation of each drink is stunning and very 'Instagrammable.' I also love the moody, dark interior—it’s beautifully designed and has a great vibe. While prices are a bit on the higher side, it’s definitely worth it considering the prime location and the overall experience.
review_2_text: What a wonderful coffee shop and overall experience. This is modern coffee brewing at its finest. They have some 10 different beans and combined with the style of brewing you can definitely visit multiple times to enjoy your coffee as you like it. The food on offer is also delicious and worthy. Their entire shop's architecture is what I found amazing, with the unique quote on the main door and the dark, bar like aesthetic interiors makes for an unique experience .
review_3_text:
Randomly came across Graph while out cruising around.  What a cool cafe.

Super edgy with an industrial feel. One of Chiang Mai’s superb cafes for the cafe crowd.
review_4_text:
Graph has firmly established itself as a must-visit destination for specialty coffee lovers in Chiang Mai. It's not just a café; it's a curated experience that blends high-quality coffee with high-concept art and design.
​
Graph is serious about its coffee, offering a sophisticated selection of single-origin beans for classic espresso drinks and pour-overs. Where they truly stand out, however, is with their incredibly creative signature menu. They are well-known for their inventive "nitro" cold brews, often infused with unexpected ingredients like fruit, spices, or floral notes. While the prices are at a premium, you are paying for a unique, well-crafted beverage that you won't find elsewhere.
​
Each Graph location is an exercise in minimalist, artistic design. They are famous for their "Instagrammable" interiors—think monochrome color palettes, dramatic lighting, and modern, gallery-like aesthetics. The cafés are often small and intimate, focusing on the quality of the product and the design-forward atmosphere rather than offering large, comfortable workspaces. It's a place for appreciating the craft and soaking in the cool, quiet vibe.
review_5_text: Excellent coffee drinks, Graph is well worth the visit. Really a must visit if you love coffee. There's a substantial menu of different coffee concoctions available,it's a little pricier but the quality is there. I want to keep returning until I've tried the whole menu. This visit I had monochrome - espresso, charcoal, milk, and vanilla over ice, it was great. This location is a bit small, but I love the vibe of a full coffee shop with lots of conversations going on.

name: Café l’arbre | คาเฟ่ลับบร์
review_1_text:
The place deserves to be more known. The garden is amazing and offers a peaceful atmosphere. Roosters walking around.

Wifi works perfectly even on high-demanding tasks and the place isn’t crowded nor noisy so I could work from there all morning easily and focused.

If they develop their food and drink offer with more qualitative products and maybe more diversified drinks, this could be a reference in Nimman as a working/nice place to spend time.
review_2_text: Great hidden jarden in Nimman area. I recommand it for have a peacefull break. Employée are polite and take good care of the place. Go to have a look 🐅😊
review_3_text:
The garden is filled with greenery and trees, the scent is pleasant, and the gentle music and birdsong create a pleasant atmosphere.
The seating is comfortable and varied, making it a great place to work. However, it closes early! The lack of crowds makes it peaceful, and the owner is incredibly friendly, making it a place I'll definitely return to!
If you visit, you'll see real chickens.
review_4_text: I'm so glad I chose this hotel!

name: MOO Coffee & Bar @One Nimman
review_1_text:
26 Feb 2026 12:30pm
This coffee in the center of Food market / court sells very very good quality coffee
Choose from dark roasted or medium roasted beans of your choice
They prepare and serve where you can clearly see the whole process of preparations, cleanliness as well as their system onsite ! very smooth and not chaotic
Today i order special made Thai Tea hot with 2 shot of dark roast espresso !
Look at the form and color
Love it ! its not in the normal menu.
They also have very special crafted coffee variety menu
review_2_text: Moo Coffee has just opened inside the Maya shopping center. I couldn't find the location on Google Maps, so I'm leaving my review here. I ordered a hot cappuccino to go — the drink was great. The staff were friendly and cheerful.
review_3_text: Amazing coffee and great service. Just ask “for here”. In glass coffee tastes much better than in plastic cup
review_4_text:
Good coffee quality. There are several coffee bean options: light roast, medium roast, dark roast.
The coffee store located inside One Nimman.
The take away bag is very creative.
review_5_text: You can pick up great quality of coffee here at One Nimman. How they make coffee is very detailed and things look right and taste right as well. You can choose your preferred roast level. There are many chairs and tables around as it is located in the food court area.

name: Ccccc CAFE
review_1_text: Brilliant coffee at this small joint. The decor is high end and comfortable, making it a great place to get some work done.
review_2_text:
Dirty is nice.
Not too sweet and very creamy.
The coffee is not too strong and blended in very well with the milk.
Friendly staff.
review_3_text:
Excellent coffee shop. A small shop located in the heart of nimmaman. The cheese cake is awesome. They have a good supply of drinks and cakes
To choose From.  2 different roasts to choose from.  Service is friendly.  No parking. Good AC
review_4_text: Dirty coffee was okay. Only shame is the place full of people on laptops leaving no space for customers to consume and killing the ambience. We had to take our dirty coffee in a paper cup outside, which degraded the experience.
review_5_text: Passed by this cafe while staying in Eastin Tan Hotel located next door and decided to come in since it was empty. Ordered cappuccino and mentaiko pasta which were both amazing! My cappuccino choice of dark roast hit the spot and the mentaiko pasta was to die for! Staffs were really polite and friendly and I appreciate the interior, vibe and choice of lofi music. Highly recommended when you are in Nimman!

name: Jian cha Tea 见茶山(เจี้ยนชา) - MAYA Chiang Mai เมญ่า เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Just stepped in and decided to give the promanganade tea a try — it was incredibly fresh. The tea quality was really good. The staff were super friendly and welcoming.
review_2_text: I just tried it for the first time and it was delicious. The tea aroma was amazing. If you haven't tried it yet, I recommend you come and try it. The staff provided excellent service and were very quick.
review_3_text: The taste is refreshing. The shop is on the ground floor. There aren't many people, but it takes a long time to receive the product. There is a seating area in front of the shop.
review_4_text: The wait is over for the most delicious tea shop. This premium Chinese shop's staff claims that the grapes are freshly hand-picked and the softness goes perfectly with the drink. They have both tea and fruit tea. Located on the basement floor B1 of Maya Shopping Center, Chiang Mai, I want everyone to try their delicious food. 👍🏻🍇🍇🍇
review_5_text:
The staff provided excellent and prompt service. The shop has seating available.
The tea was delicious.

name: Tiger Ted Cafe
review_1_text:
Ice lattes are not my first choice order. But on this hot and sunny day I went for one.

This is one very decent ice latte. The body of the espresso itself should be quite heavy, resulting in an overall pleasing texture. Strong tasting notes that does not let the mill dilute it.

If the ice latte is good, I figure the other coffees gotta be good.
review_2_text:
This is one of the best cafes behind the giant mall.
I'm telling you if you want a better tasting coffee with delicious pastry. The price is amazing.  With parking.

You have outdoor and indoor seating with aircon.
It's better than trying to fight for parking. This is too easy. Pay half the price for your latte and pastries.
Also, it's set up for your social media 📸

The service was amazing, and the coffee was delicious 😋
They warmed up the banana bread.
review_3_text: Had the Thai tea and a ham & cheese sandwich — both were delicious 🤤. The prices are very reasonable , and it’s conveniently located right next to Maya Mall.
review_4_text: Had breakfast and lunch here multiple times, we just kept coming back! Best matcha I have ever had, but their coffee(machine) is just as impressive. Food is great also, thai omelet and thai basil stir fry where my favorite. Staff is super friendly. Overall, 10/10 would recommend!
review_5_text:
A very convenient cafe.
Opens early (7:00) & next to Maya shopping centre.(10:00)
I am impressed with the versatility of coffee strength.
Decent seats.
The music is the only problem they play it too loud to have
a conversation or have a quiet time.

name: Roastniyom Craft
review_1_text: The lady working there (I think it's the manager) is so impolite and in bad mood. The young man was very nice but the attitude of the lady manager means I won't return. (I live here). I understand that we can have bad days but she was rude to other people too. A lady needed help and she acted like she was disgusted by this. Why work in customer service if so unhappy with nice customers? Unprofessional :(
review_2_text:
Great coffee spot on the 3rd floor of Maya shopping mall. The black orange is really, really good and incredibly refreshing on a hot day. It looked like they were squeezing fresh orange juice for each order, and it was perfectly balanced with the espresso. At 100 baht, it feels like a good value too.

I saw some of the reviews about bad service, but that wasn't my experience at all. I was there on a Tuesday afternoon and the service staff couldn't have been nicer.
review_3_text: Favourite coffee ever..!!! Super friendly service and nice seating in Maya Mall. 😘
review_4_text:
Before you got the nice service. Now with the same price you have to make the queue and pick up yourself. The cake was before on a porcelain plate, now it's iron.
I was regularly here, but no reason anymore. It's a pity..
review_5_text: Excellent hot latte, staff bring drinks to table, polite and friendly, tables to relax on, charging points too, excellent!

name: Blue Coffee x Bar Cha at Maya
review_1_text: Great place for good coffee and matcha.
review_2_text: Good price and service
review_4_text: Wonderful
review_5_text: The cafe has a beautiful, simple, minimalist vibe. They have a wide selection of drinks and matcha options. Finishing off with these two soft serve ice creams is a must-try 🤍

name: 1:2 Chiangmai brew - Maya Chiangmai
review_1_text: Medium Dark Latte hot...well, one of the best around here in CNX. Cafe should first be rated based on their espresso & latte quality first..they rest of the sugary drinks can come later.
review_2_text:
- A famous shop from Chiang Rai opened in Bangkok and became a huge hit due to its affordable prices. Now, they've opened their first branch in Chiang Mai at Maya.
- When you look at the prices, they're not that cheap.
- I ordered a matcha latte for 70 baht, which was average.
- There's seating next to the shop, making it convenient for those visiting the mall and wanting a drink.
review_3_text:
I finally had a chance to try it. The shop is located on the ground floor.
The price is affordable and the quality is as expected.
The staff gave good recommendations and were friendly.
There's a small seating area next to the shop.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious and not too expensive. The staff are friendly and provide good service.
review_5_text: Affordable and high quality cafe

name: Toastally U
review_1_text:
While waiting for the missus, ordered a caramel macchiato n it’s simply excellent!!

So if you are like me and I really do enjoy my caramel macchiatos , then this is the one of the best coffee shops that I have found for this!!
review_2_text: A cute little cafe that specializes in toast. We tried the Thai milk tea toast and the cheese garlic toast—both were pretty good. The Thai milk tea cream was nicely balanced, not overly sweet, and the cheese garlic toast was rich with garlic aroma. The shio-pan looked good but didn't have the chance to try. Definitely a cozy spot for a quick and tasty snack.
review_3_text: I also recommend mini cream cheese garlic bread. It’s not too salty, juicy butter and cream cheese with garlic.
review_4_text:
Cute place, especially for those who are toast lovers. The food looks amazing, we only had coffee and matcha latte but I will visit again to try the toast when I can.
The menu looks very affordable, the matcha has a great flavour.
It is right next to the VFS for visas in Chiang Mai so a great spot to get your information ready prior to going in for interview and document checks.
review_5_text: I usually do not have dessert (for health reasons) but I have to say this is really good. Sweetness of both the ice cream and the bread is on point. Delicious!

name: GONGDEE GARDEN
review_1_text:
Let me tell you, this is my favourite mental spa, not only in Chiang Mai, but in general.
I'm coming every day and staying for 5 hours, equally enjoying peace and quiet for my work, food  and amazing hospitality of the staff. Service is 5 star, food amazing! What ever you order will be fresh, tasty and filling! Portions are big for foody people like me! Luckily for me that my accommodation is a walking distance!
review_2_text: I had coffee and croissants here. Everything is great and the space is very nice. The terrace seats are relaxing and great vibe. The service is also great. It’s located in one of the most traffic heavy area, but somehow this place usually does not have many customers.
review_3_text:
Delightful spot with covered outdoor seating and spacious attractive indoor seating.

Well made coffee drinks and fresh croissants.

Yoghurt with granola and fruit... delicious.

Conveniently located just beside One Nimman.
review_4_text: The food is delicious and the place is very quiet. I worked for hours with my laptop.🎉
review_5_text: Let me preface this by saying that I consider myself a burger connoisseur. It’s my favorite food and I’ve eaten many, many burgers. And yet, this hidden spot in Chiang Mai, had the best burger of my life. I am begging you to try it. I was left speechless.

name: % Arabica Chiang Mai One Nimman
review_1_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Visited Chiang Mai in December — it’s truly one of the best months to go, thanks to the cool and pleasant weather. The highlight was the One Nimman Christmas Market, which gave off such a charming European winter vibe.

I especially loved the atmosphere at % Arabica café in One Nimman. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee combined with the crisp, cool air reminded me of wintertime in Europe.

If you happen to be in Chiang Mai, One Nimman is definitely a must-visit destination. The area is lively and popular with many Japanese and Korean visitors as well. Enjoy a cup of % Arabica coffee, soak in the fragrance, and take your time exploring the shops around One Nimman — it’s a wonderful experience. ☕✨
review_2_text: Such a great cup of coffee with an amazing selection of pour overs, lattes, Americanos, and everything else! The service is also wonderful and the crew were very helpful. This coffee shop is located in One Nimann in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Definitely a must try.
review_3_text: I loved how clean and edgy this cafe is.  A chain store cafe for sure, but so nice inside and in a great location.
review_4_text: For the area this is good coffee in a wonderfully atmosphere at a higher than average price. The design aesthetic of the coffee shop is what brought us in. And the coffee was great, by default it is not served with sugar which is refreshing and the only place in Thailand we have seen to do this. We ordered two hot lates, a chocolate croissant, an almond croissant, an iced chocolate milk and were offered two small child sized milks for free. (COST: 800TB, $22USD) We were the first in the shop at 9 AM.
review_5_text: Friendly staff and great coffee. The service was warm and attentive, and the coffee was smooth and delicious. Highly recommended 👍🏻

name: ai pang chiangmai
review_1_text: Blown away by how delicious this crepe was. I decided to grab one on a whim right before closing, and it turned out to be an absolute treat. Without a doubt, one of the best desserts I’ve had here.
review_2_text:
Hmm...
Is this the best place for crapes...?
Telling the fact that what they call scrape is different from “crapes”.

A crunchy, crepe-like dessert, I’d call it.

Many praised their Thai tea, but it is a very ordinary Thai tea that can be found anywhere in Thailand.
Don't waste your stomach space for ordinal food while you stay in Chiangmai.
review_3_text: Rude attitude towards costumers(at least foreigners for sure). Crepes are crispy(ok that's how they make it here in Thailand apparently) but with almost none filling, Nutella could hardly see it. Better find another place if you're fancying a nice crepes.
review_4_text: I just had my best crepe in my life just now. It’s just delicious. I like the Thai version of crepe, very crispy
review_5_text: Good taste in Thai Tea. I love this flavor the most. It’s different and fresh! The orange bubble is super surprise for me.

name: Minimal Coffee - Think Park
review_1_text: Great little coffee spot near Maya Mall with tasty, affordable drinks and a relaxed minimalist vibe. Perfect for grabbing a latte or iced coffee after shopping. The area around has fun photo opportunities, including cool art and a Japan‑style photo corner nearby at Think Park. A nice place to sip, take pictures, and enjoy a break in Chiang Mai!☕💕🌱
review_2_text:
Cute minimalist cafe who offer oat milk, so you can easily order vegan coffee, matcha or Thai tea!

The Staff was really friendly.
Prices are good!
review_3_text: Many time in the morning staff is out. It mean if you want coffee at 9:00 (opening hour) there are high chance that is empty
review_4_text:
Fresh coffee...friendly staff
I spilled my coffee while walking out...
and got another one for free! Thank you! ^^
That's why I'm coming back!
review_5_text: Nice spot. It's a small, minimalist shop, true to its name. The coffee is standard, but the price is good.

name: FOUR floor cafe
review_1_text:
Beautiful and unique interior design. The Thai milk tea slushy was sooo good 👍 friendly and excellent service. 10/10 would recommend.

อร่อย!!
review_2_text:
This newly opened cafe is located on the 4th floor of the same building as Beans Liquor (you have to enter the Beans store and then take the stairs).

The cafe's highlight is the large glass windows, which make it feel less crowded. It's a delightful place to sit and work, relax, and enjoy a drink. There are about 6-7 tables.

Signature: Thai Tea Slurpee. The taste is okay. Both coffee and non-coffee drinks are available. Prices range from 75-95 baht. I haven't tried the coffee yet. It looks like they also sell food.

P.S. There's a white cat and clothes for sale in the shop.
review_3_text:
New shop in the same building as Bean Liqueur.
Sells food and snacks + Slurpy iced tea.
Lots of photo opportunities, 4 floors.
You can order coffee downstairs or upstairs.
Parking is available in the complex behind the shop.
The shop is located at the corner of the traffic light at the Sirimang intersection, turn left towards the Maya intersection.
review_4_text: The shop is on the 4th floor. You can park in the back lot. You can park in a space without a sign or in the Palm Springs parking lot. The shop serves drinks, food and bakery. There are also some clothes for sale in the shop. The Thai tea slurpee is delicious.
review_5_text: This cafe is a great place to relax and has plenty of photo opportunities. It's spacious and has a friendly atmosphere. The coffee is fragrant, but unfortunately, the portions are only small, which might not be enough for those who drink coffee regularly throughout the day.

name: Food & Drink cafe
review_1_text: The restaurant right next to Monday Restaurant~ Not on the mapㅜ Pork stir-fry? 70 baht to-go~ The packaging is neat and the taste is good.

name: 远记燕窝huaykaew
review_1_text: Seeing the extremely low rating actually piqued my curiosity; I wondered how bad the food and service could be for a 2.5 rating. Perhaps because my expectations were low, the experience was actually quite good. The bird's nest yogurt was delicious; the yogurt seemed homemade, and the mango inside was very sweet. It was a bit pricey, over 60 RMB per cup. The servers weren't rude. Because there weren't many people, we stayed there quietly for quite a while.
review_2_text: They charge such an expensive price for bird's nest soy milk and they don't even use fresh soy milk. They use cheap soy milk powder, and it's still hot. I'm speechless. They use cheap powder to make your drink, please avoid it.
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious. It would be even more delicious if the vendor smiled.
review_4_text: The boss took the money and then ignored us; he's a scammer!

name: Cozy Owls Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Stayed here for two nights and honestly, you can’t beat the price — 5 USD a night is insane for what you get. The accommodations were simple but totally fine. My sheets were clean, no hair, and the bed was comfortable enough. The room did get a little warm, but that’s just part of sharing a dorm with other people, not the hostel’s fault.

What really stood out was the front desk. Super helpful every time I asked for assistance. They even made calls for me and helped confirm my pickup for an elephant sanctuary reservation I had. They really go out of their way to make sure things run smoothly for you.

Overall, great value, clean stay, and genuinely kind staff. I’d definitely stay here again.
review_2_text: Overall a pleasant stay. The rooms were ok, you get what you pay for. Cleanliness was very good, the maids would clean and disinfect the rooms and bathroom every day. Mai who was at the front desk goes above and beyond. She’s so bubbly, positive and friendly a real refreshing ray of light. Unfortunately, the boy who’s there “Puu” is miserable and rude. Extremely rude and unhelpful. All he does is sit play his games and look at you like you’ve asked him for a kidney if you require any assistance. Not what I want to be seeing during my travels this negative energy. But it’s okay because Mai countered it. I would stay here again I liked the vibe, the rooms and the location. Rent a ped though as it’s way easier to get around
review_3_text: Stayed at Cozy Owls for 1 month in their Double Deluxe Studio. It was perfect. The room is new and spacious. There’s a little balcony to chill. Staff is very friendly too. Wi-fi is also good, I could work on it. It’s in a very quiet location, but very close to everything you need (restaurants/supermarket, etc).
review_4_text:
Cozy Owls Chiang Mai is an excellent choice for budget-conscious travelers and long-term visitors, offering a combination of hostel and apartment-style living. Guests consistently praise its exceptional cleanliness—it’s often noted as one of the cleanest hostels in the area. The rooms and private accommodations (which sometimes feature balconies with mountain views) are modern and comfortable, providing good value for money.
The staff are frequently highlighted as friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable about the local area, enhancing the overall welcoming atmosphere. While the location is a short distance from the Old City, it's conveniently close to local markets like Chang Puak and accessible by local transport.
review_5_text:
Room 301 – Terrible experience
There was a strong smell coming from the bathroom, hair on the bed and floor, and dirty marks in the bathroom. The sheets and pillows were also dirty and had hair on them. It was impossible to sleep with those bad odors. When I spoke with the manager, she said it was the guest’s fault and claimed the room was fine, but she refused to come and check the room herself to see how dirty and smelly it really was.
Stay date: November 6, 2025.

review_3_text: Go green is a great clean space, they’ve got a lot of variety of strains and it’s very reasonably priced. They have everything you need, flower, edibles, drinks, and other topical products and CBD stuff as well
review_4_text: I met with Jumbo he had very good customer service, and talked with us about traveling to thailand! Great experience! Dont go to the other shop next door come to this one!

worthy to spend sometime for  vibe

name: TOOB LAB
review_1_text: A small coffee roaster with a wide variety of roasted coffee beans from various sources. Please make an appointment before visiting the shop.

name: The Donut Cafe
review_1_text:
I had such a lovely experience at The Donut Cafe 🤍

The customer service is incredibly sweet and welcoming. The staff speak very well English, which makes everything comfortable and easy, especially for international visitors 💁‍♀️

They offer a great variety of donut flavours, so many choices! Honestly, it feels like the best donuts in town. Each one is fresh, soft, and full of flavor 🍩❤️

What I really love is how the cafe gently touches Thai culture while still giving you that warm Western-style breakfast feeling. It’s such a nice balance ❣️🍂

Their Laos coffee is also very good,  rich, smooth, and perfect with donuts ☕

Plus, the WiFi is strong and reliable, great for working or relaxing.
They have both indoor seating and a cozy outdoor patio, so you can choose your vibe.🌱🙏

Definitely a place I will come back to again! 🍩☕🍃
review_2_text:
I got a Thai tea with oat milk, then I asked if they had vegan donuts and to my surprise, ALL DONUTS ARE VEGAN!!! I was so shocked I asked - no egg and no milk? And the sweet cashier said - no egg no milk 😍
So I got the glazed donut and it was pretty good despite being so early for me to eat sweets 😅
I will most certainly go back for more!
Updated: went back today at 7:15am for a Thai tea, and they weren’t open yet. I had a call so took it from there - the WiFi is great! They opened around 7:30am 🤍
They were very friendly and didn’t mind making the Thai tea on my reusable cup 🥰
review_3_text:
We have been looking for donut spots and were happy to see The Donut Cafe was nearby. It's a nice, open lobby space with lots of seating areas and lots of donut flavors. We got 6 different flavors and have enjoyed them all - but Lemon Poppyseed is THE BEST!

When we brought our donuts to the counter, the cashier let us know it was Buy 6, Get 1 FREE! So we snagged 1 more!

We are satisfied customers and will definitely be back.
review_4_text:
Very cute lovely cafe with very nice staff. The food is good home cooked recipes. I love the buttermilk pancakes, french toast, orange chicken.

The cafe is very cute and colorful. They have games at table to keep busy while food gets prepared.

The coffee is good.

Cafe has parking.

Highly recommend this cafe.

The Boston cream donut was godly.

What a great little gem in chiang mai.
review_5_text: Been there twice because the food is really good. The atmosphere as well and they have boardgames for you to play while waiting/ eating. Really nice Cafe

name: House no 33 ️
review_1_text: Lovely cafe with a woody, warmly appearance and a familial atmosphere, with a decent amount of sturdy seating, tended to by a bright and friendly bunch. The drinks and cakes are great, and its morning hours on a weekday don't get too busy, with the jazz playing on its speakers always taking centre stage audio-wise. Fantastic spot for some morning bevs and a bit of focus or a chat.
review_2_text: Coffee is good. Located on a crowded street as there’s 2 famous restaurants here. Customers of cafe can park their car in front of their cafe. Its pretty empty when i’m there.
review_3_text:
This minimalist-style café has a simple and cozy atmosphere, offering a selection of drinks, pastries, and possibly whole cakes for order. I stopped by after having a meal at the restaurant across the street and decided to try some desserts.
The staff were friendly and provided great service. I ordered a scone and a hot chocolate. The hot chocolate was delicious—rich and well-balanced. However, the scone wasn’t quite to my taste. It was generously sized, but the texture inside was a bit too crumbly for my liking.
There are a few seats inside, and while the space isn’t too large, it doesn’t feel cramped. It’s a nice spot to relax with a drink. If you enjoy minimalist cafés with good service, this place is worth checking out!
review_4_text: One of my favourite-favourite cafes in CNX; I only wish I'd discovered it sooner. Beautiful drinks, and the strawberry cake had a wonderful soft, plush crumb and a frosting that wasn't too sweet or overpowering. No need for sweetener in the hot coffee (unless you enjoy sweet coffee, no judgment!) because there's no unpleasant bitterness to be found, nor is it a sour shot. Very balanced. My favourite iced drink--and I tried several, for science!--was the coffee and fresh orange juice, which is seasonal. Presentation is perfection, and by this I mean that not only is it aesthetically charming with the cups and stickers, but they even open a tab on the iced drink lid for smooth, easy straw insertion. It's not necessary, but I deeply appreciate that level of thoughtful attention to detail. Cafe is mostly quiet, comfortably air conditioned (and there's an air purifier)--perfect place to read, journal, and write letters. Or bring a friend! Seriously, I can't recommend it enough, the quality of the experience and the very reasonable prices had me coming back daily.
review_5_text:
Cosy and clean cafe! Came here to chill as was waiting for the northern food opposite which was packed, surprisingly found another nice place to chill here.
They have quite a wide range of coffee, teas, sofas and a few different varieties of cakes and traditional biscuits.
The coconut latte was just the right taste and creaminess, the butter cake is not overpowering buttery, it's soft and moist, perfect to go with the latte.
Coconut cream pie is another nice cake to go with the lattes, the coconut is on a lightly sweet end.

name: Yokojung Yogurt
review_1_text: Absolutely loved this yogurt shop in Chiang Mai! The yogurt was incredibly smooth, creamy, and had the perfect amount of tang. We tried their smoothies and an ice cream bowl, and both were fantastic. The ice cream was soooo good—rich yet refreshing—and came with fresh fruit, which we topped with a drizzle of honey. We even took some of their homemade yogurt home because it was that delicious. Friendly atmosphere, great quality, and truly delightful treats. Highly recommend!
review_2_text:
Adjacent to the famous Michelin recommended Khao Soi Maesai, Yokojung yoghurt offers yoghurt bowls, smoothies and coffee in a relaxing space.
The Thai style coffee was intense but not bitter, with a touch of sweetness from the condensed milk. We ordered a lychee strawberry yoghurt shake as well which was good but felt the lychee flavour could have been stronger (perhaps was overpowered by the strawberry too much). A comfortable place to get a drink while waiting in line next door.
review_3_text: Neat little cafe seated next to a good noodle store. Overall chill vibes and excellent service. Very lovely atmosphere. I would def come back again.
review_4_text:
I wish I lived near this place so I could buy their yogurt every morning or enjoy it at home. Their yogurt is excellent and offers great value. They have a variety of options, from regular yogurt to Greek yogurt.

As for the dessert dishes, they come with fresh fruits, other toppings, and free honey. It’s absolutely delicious! Also, the ice cream is refreshing as well.
review_5_text:
A cute yogurt shop in Chiang Mai! They have delicious Greek yogurt and coffee.
We got their Es Yen coffee, and their medium size Greek yogurt bowl that had orange, mango, banana, kiwi, strawberry, and granola on top. They also have honey on the side if you want more sweetness 🐝🍯😋.

name: Ratchapruek Cafe'
review_1_text: Understated, underrated, great little no-frills coffee joint along a quiet street, sporting a cosy and most-times quiet interior flooded with light, tended to by equally bright folks who serve up superb sips at a very solid price. Very little to complain about; never a bad pit-stop when strolling down this neck of town.
review_2_text: Small shop with modern aesthetics. Very affordable and quiet spot to get a little work done. Tried the caramel latte and almond coffee cake (a little dry) but hope they'll add to their bakery case by my next visit.
review_3_text:
This is a coffee shop with good prices.

☕Hot Americano
We give it a 4 out of 5. The aroma is fragrant, medium roast, and fairly strong flavor. The cup size is suitable for the price of only 35 baht. It's hard to find a shop in this area at this price.

☕Hot Cocoa (less sweet)
We give it a 1 out of 5. The aroma is weak, but the taste wasn't to our liking. It lacked richness and didn't have a strong cocoa flavor. It seemed like there were unmixed milk streaks or spoiled milk floating on top when stirred. We hope the barista will adjust this menu item.

🧋Iced Thai Tea (less sweet) (take away)
We give it a 4 out of 5. The taste is quite good, strong but not so strong that it keeps you awake. It has a mild aroma and doesn't have a milky aftertaste.

The shop has a restroom at the back, which might not be very convenient. We give it a 2 out of 5. It's reasonably clean.

Service and atmosphere: We give it a 4 out of 5. The downstairs area has limited seating but is clean. There are some power outlets, and there's a second floor with a view. The service is good.

Overall, if you plan to sit for a long time or work... it's not recommended. But if you don't need to use the restroom frequently and just want to enjoy tea and coffee, it's great.
review_4_text: This new cafe is located on the same street as Phan Mong Jai. The interior is very clean and the seats on the second floor are very comfortable. There were ashtrays, so it seems you can smoke upstairs. I ordered an iced orange americano for 50B. It had a strong orange flavor, but it was very delicious.
review_5_text:
A small, simple, yet lovely newly opened cafe. I ordered an espresso, dark roast, 50% sweetness, and it was quite good. The coffee was very fragrant, but it would have been even better if it were a little stronger. My younger sibling ordered a less sweet cocoa and said it was delicious and rich.

The day I went, the owner personally made it for me. He was very friendly and hospitable. They even offered free desserts during the new opening. If you're looking for a cafe with cool air conditioning and parking, I highly recommend this place.

name: Bannom cafe
review_1_text:
Pasta and spaghetti cafe. Have a lot different kinds of drink. I try tje spaghetti beacon with dry chilli.

Facilities:
* Indoor lounge
* AC
* Private room with Japanesse seating style
* Free wifi

Note:
* The Mango bingsu need to try, aroi mak 👍
review_2_text: My initial visit was not entirely satisfactory. The music selection, specifically the K-POP dance performance, seemed incongruous with the coffee shop's intended atmosphere, and the volume was somewhat elevated. While I surmise the establishment may be targeting a mid-tier market segment, the overall experience was rather unremarkable. The practice of presenting the bill immediately upon service of coffee and food warrants discussion. Although some establishments adopt this approach to ensure transparency regarding order details, I find it less than optimal for customer engagement. This practice may inadvertently discourage additional purchases due to heightened budget awareness. Furthermore, given that order details were reiterated at the point of payment, the immediate printing of the bill appears to be an unnecessary expenditure of resources and is not environmentally sustainable. On a positive note, the coffee's flavor was exceptional and exceeded my expectations. The staff members were consistently polite and helpful.
review_3_text:
not bad

but my back hurts because of the chairs I sit in at the coworking space.

review_4_text:

review_5_text: With reasonable prices and a diverse menu, it’s perfect for having brunch or just coffee and dessert. The atmosphere is cozy and versatile—great for chatting or getting some work done over brunch.

name: Santitham Breakfast​ & Chiang Mai Pizza​
review_1_text: Great breakfast eatery open from early till past noon, with a casual open-air atmosphere, serving up great food at a decent price, from a menu ranging from Thai staples to Western offerings. Service is warm and cordial. Had the Pad Thai for breakfast, which was as hearty as it was delicious, and well worth the price. The space is amply tabled and while it gets a little busy on a weekday morning catering mostly to foreign diners, a few tables always appear to be available.
review_2_text: Wide variety of breakfast to choose. Both Thai and Western(but does not have Northern Thai food, so keep that in mind). Food are great! Delicious and fairly priced. They got  rice soup, porridge, noodles, omelette, toast and more. Sourdough toast is amazing! Great spot for getting breakfast.
review_3_text: Came here for breakfast, it was ok. Maybe I ordered the wrong thing. I got smoked salmon and scrambled eggs. For the price was a bit bland, only 1 small piece of sourdough (although their freshly baked sourdough) and wasn’t proper smoked salmon, was more flaked salmon. Ice coffee was nice and chill vibe but overall was average.
review_4_text: Whatta menu. Many of the food items I like are included so it's a great start to the day whether eggs and toast or โจ๊ก. Many topping options. Quiet street is quite nice. US country music playlist is a bit odd!
review_5_text: Easy Thai and western food at reasonable price. Thai food wasn’t the best but ok. They don’t accept card payment.

review_3_text: Loved their cup bingsu for 40 THB, their Peach soda (30 THB)  is amazing too!
review_4_text: So tasty!
review_5_text: Good Good Good

name: Have You Bean
review_1_text: Nice, chic cafe along a quiet street with a cosy, wood-padded aesthetic and tasteful decorative finishes and furnishings—albeit with limited dine-in seating—sporting a contemporary aesthetic across the board. Tended to by nice and cordial staff/owners, serving up superb coffee and cakes at a pretty solid price.
review_2_text: Just discovered this new coffee shop and already in love! 🧡🤎 Great Coffee & Thai Tea at a good reasonable price, with a stylish space that’s full of charm. Nice staff. The vibes are super relaxed — perfect for catching up with friends or getting some work done!
review_3_text: You can feel great taste of coffee. I love here that I can choose the coffee bean with the affordable price.
review_4_text:
A cool coffee space that pop up around the corner of the street. Coffee is good, price is really affordable, the place is great if you want a quiet place to work or relax away from the heat.
You can also choose your coffee roast! Definitely coming back and making it my regular coffee spot.
review_5_text:
I recently stumbled upon this charming little café run by a talented young barrister, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience! The atmosphere is well lit, cozy and inviting, making it the perfect spot to relax with a good book or catch up with friends.

The highlight, of course, is the coffee. They use a Victoria Arduino espresso machine and local beans, and you can really taste the quality in every cup. The hot latte is a masterpiece—both visually stunning and deliciously rich. And let’s not forget the latte art! Each cup is a work of art, showcasing the barista’s skill and creativity.

I’ll definitely be returning for more of that amazing coffee and to see what new designs the barista comes up with. Highly recommend!

name: Uhas Cafe เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
Clean and bright brand new space with ample seating including power outlets and wifi. Excellent pour over coffee. Overall great and very affordable .

If they added some healthy snacks it would be a great place to get some work done for a longer session.
review_2_text:
They have a lovely light roast coffee hidden away in a drawer.

If you ask them they will take it out 😉 was glad I did as I don’t normally drink dark roast coffee.

Was one of the best cups I have had in chiang mai.
review_3_text: There are plenty of seats and power outlets available. They also offer non-coffee drinks like cocoa. The air conditioning is just right, so it’s comfortable even for long stays. It’s open from morning until night, which is really convenient. I was pleasantly surprised by how clean the restroom was.
review_4_text: Very nice cafe 👌
review_5_text: Good

name: ชาตาโต คาเฟ่&คาร์แคร์ สาขาสันติธรรมเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: It’s a very cute coffee spot in Chiang Mai. The attention is great and so many good options of drinks and dessert. I recommend it, cool spot for pictures but also quality drinks for a good price.
review_2_text: Very good cleaning job. My car damage In flood and they open all and full cleaning. It is 10 years old. Now looks like my new car. Good job. 👍👍
review_3_text: A bright and cozy cafe with amazing drinks that located not too far from the old town. Today they offer me Strawberry Smoothie topped with Waffle and Mixed Fruits and I enjoyed it very much. Lovely place and reasonable price. High recommended. 🫰🏻❤️
review_4_text: Only reason I come here is because of the adjacent car wash, one of the more honest ones I can find in Chiang Mai. Typical coffee bar with an assortment of hot and cold drinks. It's still a nice place to drop by even if you're not getting a car wash.
review_5_text: Original taste and very good quality value of money i like that place and recommend to all

name: Dee Cafe
review_1_text:
Dropped by Dee Cafe and was pleasantly surprised. Their coffee is really aromatic, smooth and strong enough to perk you up. I had the orange Americano—the coffee is quite intense, but it is to my liking. If you prefer something lighter, you can actually ask them to adjust with less coffee and more fresh orange juice—they’re happy to tweak it for your taste.

The raisin Danish puff pastry was nicely done—crispy outside, soft inside, not too sweet, just right.

But the one that really stood out was the coconut cake. Super soft, moist, and topped with a thick layer of coconut cream with actual coconut flesh inside. It’s rich but not jelak—seriously good!

The cafe itself is cozy and comfortable, perfect spot to chill. I think travellers will find this place worth visiting, especially with their unique drinks and dessert options. Highly recommend trying the ones I mentioned!
review_2_text: This is a comfortable little cafe I visit to enjoy a refreshing iced tea or coffee and read a book. The owner is very friendly and makes a great mocha yen. There is comfortable seating, both, inside and outside. The pastries are always fresh. There's also a club card buy 10 get 1 free. That's pretty cool 😎
review_3_text:
Our favorite café in all of Chiang Mai – and probably all of Thailand! 😊

We first visited in April 2024 and loved it so much that we made sure to come back in January 2025.

Don makes the best drinks, and we have so many favorites: - Cappuccino (hot & cold) – perfect every time - Thai Milk Tea – richer and more flavorful than most places, hence the darker color  - Green Tea – made with high-quality tea, you can really taste the difference - Thai Tea Lemon – not on the menu, but Don made it for us, and wow, it was THE BEST - Honey Lemon Soda – so refreshing!

We worked from the café every day, and Don always greeted us with a warm smile – it really felt like home. We’ll miss this place so much in the coming months but can’t wait to come back for more of Don’s amazing creations.

Highly recommend it to anyone in Chiang Mai!

Fabrication with fresh coconut with pieces of coconut inside
The owner is very kind
Come on 😍
review_5_text: Found a great cafe at Dee Cafe! Dee is mean good! I think this cafe is even more good like extremely cafe😄love it!

review_2_text:

review_3_text: I like as much the ambient as the thai tea, very recommended!
review_4_text: Looks like it’s closed down
review_5_text: A cool and clean café. I've been here several times, and the Thai tea is truly delicious. They also offer snacks and meals, but I've only tried the roti twice. Its crispy texture makes it perfect for a snack. The interior is cool, and there are ashtrays outside for smokers.

name: Lam Kod Kod
review_1_text: It's so delicious. I eat it regularly even though new restaurants have opened. No one can beat the pearls from this shop. You can order it less sweet and get it less sweet. Honestly, it's freshly made too. 🫶🏻
review_2_text: There are a variety of drinks to choose from, including tea, traditional coffee in paper bags, and bubble milk tea with different flavors.

name: ชาพระนคร สาขาถนนสันติสุข
review_1_text:
I ordered Thai milk tea and ovaltine drinks.
Ovaltine drinks is good.
Thai milk tea is a bit sweet to my taste.
Pricing here is cheap.
Store owner is nice.
Good for take away.
review_2_text: Got thai milk tea here to go and asked for less sugar. It came out still a bit too sweet, but it is cheap and good enough overall.
review_3_text: Best cappuccino in the city
review_4_text: It's been seven months since I've been here. Everything here is delicious. Especially the orange coffee on a hot day. I came here because I was thinking about it. In the evening, it's nice to have a drink while waiting for skewers from the skewer place next door.
review_5_text: Affordable and delicious milk tea spot. There's plenty of seating and a supermarket behind the restaurant, so it's open late, making it a great place to stop for a late-night drink. The owner is also friendly, so I visit often.

name: Geppetto Bar&Cafe

review_2_text: Very nice service and Thai tea. Will have to get back for his specialty coffee
review_3_text: A great place to relax, sip cocktails, and have a fun conversation with the bartender 👍👍👍
review_4_text: Very cute place and great coffee local from chiang Mai. Owner is very friendly too
review_5_text: Nice little cafe with exceptionally good coffee! Especially the lichee coffee is surprisingly tasty even though it sounds odd at first

name: Very, Very Delicious Coffee

Cheap prices and quick service.
Good Thai iced coffee.
review_2_text: Yes, the name doesn't lie.
review_3_text: It's average. I wonder if the other menu will be better next time.
review_4_text: I go here almost every day. Best of all, I love that I can order a large size. And the large size is really big.
review_5_text: The milk tea here has a rich and delicious tea flavor.

name: Priya DIY cafe
review_1_text:
Little shop where you can make your own brackets and necklaces with a variety of beads. Bracelets are 50thb and necklaces are 100thb. The owner is really nice and will help you with your DIY accessories. You can order beverages while you make them.

There are also pre-made ones you can buy for much cheaper (20-50tjb) than at the stalls at one nimman.
review_2_text:
Super cute DIY jewellery cafe! Loads of beads and charms to choose from, you can sit as long as you like and create whatever you like! Owner is friendly and kind, it cost me 200 baht to make 2 necklaces :)

Keywords: Craft activity cheap fun creative art bracelet custom shop cafe make your own things to do in chiang mai
review_3_text:
Such a nice vibe! The atmosphere is really calm and perfect for immersing yourself into the jewellery making
Very sweet owner and a fantastic selection of pretty beads
And really good prices aswell
I really recommend taking the time to visit here
review_4_text:
I highly recommend this one-day necklace and bracelet making experience!
You can make them yourself or buy them at a low price!
I wanted a solid-colored necklace, but I couldn't find it anywhere at the market, so I decided to make one myself. They were selling them here for 20 baht. The necklace I bought was 20 baht, and the bracelet was 10 baht!
If you have some free time in Chiang Mai, stop by and try it out! :)
The owner was so friendly and answered all my questions. Thanks to him, I had a lot of fun making them! I highly recommend it! 😊
review_5_text: I happened to be passing by and stopped by when the time came. The owner was so kind, and the bracelets for my child were truly healing. My child loved the bracelet I made with his name on it, and I plan to visit with him this weekend.

name: Small Talk Coffee
review_1_text: Nice aromatic coffee made by a cool local boss. A perfect choice to start the day. Been there everyday during my trip.
review_2_text:
I lived on the opposite side of Chiang Mai…
Still, I rode here nine times just for one thing — their coffee.

Rich. Aromatic. Organic beans brewed with real intention.
No hype. No shortcuts. Just pure quality that hits exactly right.

And the owner…
A truly kind, grounded woman.
Every time I stopped by, we ended up talking about life, the world, everything.
It felt less like a café — more like stepping into calm energy.

This place became my reset button.
My little sanctuary in the middle of the city.

If you want coffee that actually centers you, this is the place.

Small Talk Coffee — where a man comes to breathe.
review_3_text:
Owner was constantly on phone but otherwise kind to us.

Had a mango smoothie (less sweet), and a mango yogurt smoothie normal sweet. Would definitely recommend a touch of sugar, otherwise the smoothie will come out a bit bland / watery tasting. But great price and thus a great value!
review_4_text:
First, I would like to say that the location and the owner were wonderful.  She is super nice.

I did the Google search, and I had to check it out.

I got a hot latte. Yes, I'm that person.  It looked wonderful.  The taste was almost too much milk and not enough coffee flavor. I even brought me some cookies for my afternoon coffee ☕️ 😋

I will come back and get a do over.  👌
review_5_text:
My girlfriend and I regularly eat lunch at the buffet next to this cafe, and we always grab a smoothie/coffee after our lunch.

I like to order the Mango, Passion Fruit, and Banana smoothie. Its delicious! I also had a mango smoothie, but I didn't like it as much.  My girlfriend gets a brownie and says that they are the best brownies she's had in Asia.

The staff is always friendly, and it is a great place to meet other travelers. There is also WiFi, but there is only outdoor seating.

I would highly recommend this place to anyone.

name: Fumo+1Cafe
review_1_text: If you're a coffee lover, add this one to your list. Outstanding quality with local and international blends. Staff are friendly and helpful. Air conditioned. Pastries are very yummy too. Glad I discovered it and it will be a regular for me.
review_2_text:
Coffee shops in Thailand are on another level — unique, creative, delicate, and absolutely delicious. This place is a perfect example. Every single detail is beautiful, from the exterior to the interior, the decor, the drinks, and the food.

A must-try in Chiang Mai 🤌🏻👍
review_3_text: They have a nice selection of drip coffees and the service was welcoming and friendly. They also have medium and dark roast espresso for milk drinks.  The atmosphere is hip and modern with a retro diner vibe.
review_4_text: Good bakery in a stylish atmosphere. I ordered Thai tea and my husband ordered hot latte coffee. They both are very good.
review_5_text:
I love this place!
Bakery: Freshly made
Atmosphere: So cozy and feels at home
Coffee: Specialty coffee i gotta say

name: The Little Corner: Healthy Food & Drinks
review_1_text: The food tastes like homemade cooking and everything is freshly prepared. Prices are affordable, and the owner is very friendly. It’s a small cozy place, perfect for a simple healthy meal.
review_2_text:
We had brunch here and everything was absolutely perfect. The food was delicious, fresh, and healthy, you can really tell a lot of care goes into each dish. Everything tasted amazing.

The girl working there was incredibly kind and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. Great atmosphere, great food, and great service. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: The food here is super delicious without the help of MSG. If you are like me who is sensitive to it, then you would really appreciate this place. We tried avocado toasts, Shan noodles, tea leaves salad and a Burmese rice spaghetti. Never thought gluten free spaghetti could taste this good. It’s a shame that we discovered this place so late during our stay. We highly recommend it.
review_4_text: The food here is so good especially for the ones who really enjoy Burmese Dishes. Portion is big. The prices are reasonable. Nan Gyi Toke is a gem for me. Highly recommend to try if you are around.
review_5_text: Amazing amazing amazing food. We stumbled upon the Little Corner accidentally, but very glad we did. Best fried rice and chicken noodle soup we’ve had so far, for an extremely fair price and big portions.

name: KRATOM CHAYAN CNX

review_2_text: Not bad! Recommended
review_3_text: yummy

What a wonderful pleasant surprise. Atmosphere is wonderful, relaxing but stylish. Not noisy, and more upscale than places around it. An oasis of sorts.

I like it so much that I will be back!
review_2_text:
Cozy cafe for "thiefing" your time in reading book, online working or mingle with friend for coffee or muffins. Quiet & calm place, not noisy with traffic.

review_4_text: Really a cool place with a brilliant design and a positive vibe.. several cozy spaces with seating and surfaces, good for getting things done… nice people and a simple but satisfying menu.. would recommend to others
review_5_text:
Super cute cafe and chill area where you can relax and work from here also.

Coffee was nice but not the best I have had in the area, it’s worth coming for the chilled vibe and lovely staff though.

name: Nicha Coffee

review_3_text: I love going to Nicha. The iced latte is absolutely delicious and freshly made. Ni is such a lovely lady who is extremely hospitable and helpful. A great spot for a pick-me-up and a friendly chat or quiet drink and cake. Highly recommended!!

review_5_text: Coffee and drinks menu very tasty 😋😋 cake 🎂 and dessert 🤤 very delicious! Owner very friendly and helpful always feel nice to be here 😊

review_2_text: A cute little shop in the middle of the neighborhood. Great coffee at an affordable price, and the air conditioning is super cool! I'll definitely be back to support them regularly. 🤭🤭🤭

review_2_text: Very cute and clean coffee shop, with an upbeat vibe. The owner was very welcoming and warm. Coffee was delicious and prepared just the way I like it. I'll definitely be coming back again!

review_3_text:
Koji Matcha is the best matcha I’ve ever tried-  rich, smooth, and top quality.
You can tell the girls put so much care into making it, and it tastes incredible. The place is cozy, spotless, and has such a lovely vibe that you just want to come back again and again! Live this place!
review_4_text:
omg absolutely delicious, you need to give this a try :) the girls working there are so kind too.

i wanted to add, this is my favorite matcha place now. have to say, i don’t know much about match, i just like to drink it. . but this is the best matcha i’ve had , the  flavor is delicious, and i love how delicate they are making it, i like how they do the process in front of you. what a work of art!! :) 🩷
review_5_text:
Probably the best matcha place I’ve ever been to! From the kindness of the workers to the incredibly made matcha the full experience was perfect.

They helped us choosing the best option for us, we took the ceremony quality matcha, enjoyed them elaborate it and spend good time in the terrace they have.

review_2_text: Very good coffee! 4 chairs outside nice to sit in while drinking.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee at a great price. The owner is very nice.

review_2_text: Great service and delicious coffee!

name: The Juice House - Coffee Shop
review_1_text: Now The Juice House is my favorite coffee and juice place in Chiang Mai. This place in cozy and kind of “totally lovely and reasonable”. Inside and outside sitting. They also have small paper clips “please write your order”. And the price: hot cappuccino 35; espresso 35 and so on... So it is totally reasonable to have pure fresh pineapple juice plus double espresso for 85 baht. Big thanks to the owner :)
review_2_text:
Juice and blended smoothies are available in fresh fruits or frozen fruits.
The store also serves coffee, other drinks and some baked cookies.
I ordered mixed berries with yogurt. The smoothies texture is very creamy.
review_3_text:
I've been a patron since 2013. I usually purchase fruit smoothies and fresh juice blends.

The prices have changes since then. Small smoothie is 45THB and large 60THB.

They all sorts of snack and cake now to enjoy with your coffee, frappe or smoothie.

The best juices and smoothies in Chiang Mai. Why? No ice. No water. No sugar. The  smoothies are perfectly blended to a creamy consistency. The fruit is always ripe and naturally sweet.

No matter how much time passes over the years I can trust The Juice House to deliver every time. I get my daily dose of goodness twice a day.

I am equally grateful for their consistency and quality.

I am a traveling plant-based chef specializing in food science and flavorology. Check out my other reviews on Google Maps.
review_4_text: came here while waiting for check in nearby.  this place is an ABSOLUTE hidden gem. the latte is good, the juices are great, i ordered the orange carrot, TWICE. they have other fresh juice combinations like beetroot, cantaloupe, watermelon, apple.
review_5_text: The juices here are extremely good value for money they are huge!!  If you get yoghurt added to the drinks they are even better value as they fill you up more than a usual juice.  There’s not a lot of ice added to the glass so I felt like I was getting great value for money as it’s super thick!  I tried the banana frappe, that was great. review_2_text: This is my regular morning stop on the way to school. The facility is clean and welcoming and the staff are very friendly. And of course the espresso and croissants are excellent, hence my regular stop each day.
review_3_text: Goodplace best croffle
review_4_text: Everything is done right.
review_5_text: Sup is a minimalist-style cafe with a simple and comfortable atmosphere, surprisingly offering a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle outside. Their coffee beans lean towards a strong, bold flavor, perfect for those who enjoy a robust taste. The coffee is reasonably priced, and they also offer brownies, croissants, and other pastries. While there's no dedicated parking lot, you can usually find some space on the street in front of the shop.

name: LIL Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Kindest staff. I went in needing the bathroom not feeling so good. They gave me some Chinese medicine for free and let me wait there till I felt better. Wouldn’t take any money.

Sadly I couldn’t try any food or drinks. They play relaxing music, give free drinkable water, have a bathroom to use, and nice comfortable seating inside, outside, and upstairs. Thankful for the hospitality, I hope they are rewarded 🙏
review_2_text:
I really enjoy coming to Lil Cafe because the food, coffee and the service you receive is tasty, refreshing and heartfelt.

Seeing their smiling faces is always comforting. A regular go-to place for reliable food and service. It is a quaint and cozy place.
review_3_text:
Excellent, good value cakes and coffee. A pleasant, clean cafe with very friendly, welcoming and helpful staff.

A quiet place, so I gave only 3 stars for 'Atmosphere' (when I actually prefer quiet.🤭).
review_4_text: Very friendly cafe.  Staff are very nice and make me feel welcome.  Coffee and cake is good too.
review_5_text: The coffee was delicious! I'll definitely stop by again.

name: Rong Ros Cafe'
