review_2_text: A small cafe only for take aways. You can’t choose roast level here and what they have is medium roast.
review_3_text: Just ordered a soy mocha on food panda and mocha was just coffee and chocolate with a drop of soy milk. The cup was half full, or was it half empty? 🤔The Drink was bitter. Am i thirsty? Yes i still am, even after ordering a drink.
review_4_text: This cafe is my usual stop on the way to the SMH massage school. Perfect for a quick coffee break :)
review_5_text: A small gem in a busy street. So nice, clean and stylish. They offer oat milk as vegan alternative. I had an iced cappuccino in a paper cup to go with a paper straw(!)

name: Over The Moon Cafe
review_1_text:
They have a unique Orange Americano menu.
65 baht.
There are seats on two floors, and the interior has a boutique concept.
review_2_text: The shop is newly opened. The atmosphere is good, the air conditioning is cool and refreshing, it's a nice place to sit and take pictures. The coffee is delicious and the drinks are delicious. I've been there many times and I'm addicted to the iced cappuccino, Passion Fruit Italian Soda, and honey lemon. It's refreshing and just the right amount of sweet.

name: Firefly Factory - Thai & Italian Fusion Restaurant & 3D Immersive Dining Experience
review_1_text:
I really wanted to give a five star review, but there are too many things nit quite matching the atmosphere.

Firstly, the 4 stars is all on atmosphere.  Our kids had a fantastic time interacting with the walls.  They drew pictures which were then scanned up into the projections.  Really fun and rewarding.

Look at the pictures and you will see that the dining experience would be also a great place for romance... at the other end of the room.  Or, the place would be a sensational venue for a special group event if you booked it out entirely.

Some unwarranted criticism in other reviews - you don't need to walk through rubbish or a warehouse.  The restaurant is easy to find.  Go up the stairs and look for the signs - or simply turn right (ser the video).

Warranted comments in other reviews.  The service - yes, the stagg are unfriendly.  They are abrupt and generally just take your order with a forced smile.  There are too many of them, so perhaps they like leaving the work to their colleagues.  I don't know... but it needs fixing to match the experience factor.

The food - the Brazilian styke BBQ was great.  It was tge only dish that truly matched the ambience.  The rest were ordinary - but the portions were good, so I think the pricing is about right.

A few minor things.  There are power cords across the floor.  I almost tripped on one.  They need to be properly secured.

The table positioning means.that some seats are in direct line with the projectors.  I sat with lights in my eyes and couldn't see the people sitting opposite.  Simply putting the edge tables on angles would fix this issue.  Otherwise, take a table in the middle of the room.

The food mostly came out together - so that previously mentioned issue seems to have been fixed.  Although, there was a small gap as only one waiter served us despite there being many staff on hand.

So come here for the experience and enjoy the food.  You will have a good night out.
review_2_text: If you want to go to those super fancy hologram rooms, but you don’t have enough money to pay for it, This is a place to go! The food is priced reasonably well for the room that you sent in. I recommend getting the salmon as it is very crispy and peppery . But I don’t recommend getting the floating barbecue because the pork is very chewy but other than that I’ve definitely recommend going to this place because of it’s holograms and style. I recommend going with you and one other person.
review_3_text: What an amazing experience! Had a group birthday dinner and it was a magical time. All those projectors set up were very impressive and created a 180 immersion. Drinks were fantastic! Best cocktails I’ve had in Chiang Mai. Definitely a cool place to come with friends for a celebration.
review_4_text: Overall, it was a good experience. However, the staff could benefit from some additional service training. For example, when we ordered a bottle of wine, the server poured it directly into the glasses without first asking our preference or offering to serve each guest individually. Additionally, with four dishes on a small table for two, it would have been helpful if the staff checked in to clear empty plates as we went along. Small improvements in attentiveness would make the dining experience even better.
review_5_text: This place is a gem you might not find unless you were looking for it. The food was good-- one of the best takes on khao soi pizza I've had so far. But the atmosphere of the seperate dining spaces is the real draw. It was fun and whimsical.

name: BOB Coffee
review_1_text: A chic spot for bevs, work, and chats, popular with locals and expats alike, as is evident from an ecclectic weekday midafternoon crowd. The place has an interesting layout spanning several separate buildings with a central compound. The place to order is a smaller open-air space immediately to the right upon entering the compound's front gates, tended to by attentive and cordial staff. Past an arch-like way beyond that is an air-conditioned seating hall to the left, and another roomy space to the right, which acts as the venue for the "OB" restaurant after 1700. There's plenty of varied seating across these spaces. The October halloween themed decor dotted throughout is cheeky, real tasteful. Bob's a solid choice anongst cafes in the area.
review_2_text: Nice coffee, lovely staff, and a comfortable, spacious place where you can choose your own spot.
review_3_text: Great place to have coffee and spend some time to chat or even work! Love the furnitures and the overall vibe there. There's not much to eat tho
review_4_text:
Lovely cafe in Santitham. Very good coffee and beautiful aesthetic. Even had super tasty 12 baht brownies!

There is a quiet in door area, seems more suited for co-working. A small outdoor area at the front and a larger courtyard round the back with beautiful plants.

Good coffee, good vibes.
review_5_text: Is a really nice and cosy coffee shop. Their coffee is really nice and the bakery tastes really good. There's other space at the back of the shop where you can take pictures and bring your laptop for work.

review_1_text:
Cool and warm ambient, great coffee like Australia's test, great cake and cookie
Very enjoy this momnet.
review_2_text:
Forgot to write a review about this place .

Hidden at the end of a road. Coffee was great but I only took pics of the cakes which were equally good.

Owner was friendly and didn't realise it was a co-working space also until I saw the other area.

Parking : within compound
review_3_text:
This café is tucked away at the end of a quiet alley, making it a peaceful spot to relax. I’ve been here twice, and the cakes are delicious—light, fresh, and not too sweet. The atmosphere is cozy, with a charming message board full of cute sticky notes, along with books and self-serve drinking water.

It also serves as a co-working space, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The restroom is clean, which is always a plus. A great place to unwind or get some work done!
review_4_text:
Tucked away in the far back of a Soi, you can find Tora the tiger 🐅. He doesn't look too impressed with tourist photos but his owner makes some great Coconut Water Americano. The Orange Americano was really nice as well thanks to the fresh orange juice.

We also had a Banoffee cake which was very tasty. It has a biscuit base that tastes similar to Oreos, a thick layer of bananas and it's covered in cream. I generally do not like Banoffee cake but I have to admit this was great 👍

If you're in the area and up for an adventure down the Soi, pay Tora Bake a visit. You'll walk through some traditional Thai living quarters and be able to see the local way of life.
review_5_text: The best cafe in Chiang Mai! Great oat milk latte and matcha. And Mod and the owner are so kind.

name: OYES Smoothies & Happy Food - โอเยส ผักผลไม้ปั่นเพื่อสุขภาพ

Amazing spot for fresh juices, great coffee, and the best smoothie bowls. Everything is made fresh right in front of you and tastes incredible. A must-visit!
The Sunshine smoothie bowl with a drizzle of honey is absolutely to die for.
review_2_text:
Highly recommend. Delicious creamy chocolate strawberry smoothie bowl with chocolate protein. YUM. Delicious and healthy! Best prices too!
Calm relaxing atmosphere. Tried coffee from the Karen Tribe in northern Thailand here , now I have a new favourite coffee bean!!

Wonderful place. Many healthy options with protein (whey + vegan) Come, you’ll enjoy it. 😌
review_3_text:
OYES Smoothies & Happy Food is a great spot with friendly staff and a pet- and work-friendly atmosphere. The smoothies and açaí bowls are delicious and refreshing, and the coffee is tasty as well. The cookies are absolutely to die for!
It’s an excellent place for breakfast or brunch, especially if you’re looking for healthy and satisfying options in a relaxed environment. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
The food- amazing smoothies and smoothie bowls.
The service- most friendly staff in the area.
The atmosphere- wonderfully appointed, soft music, quiet inside, wifi, good vibes, nice outside area.
review_5_text:
One of my go to spots to enjoy a tasty and healthy breakfast before going to a coworking space around the corner.

Kind staff and also good coffee!

Pro tip; add in a scoop of Whey protein to make sure you’ll hit your macro’s

name: Epilogue Cafe & Souvenir
review_1_text:
A new cozy café with a stylish interior and convenient opening hours.
Good coffee, desserts, and food. You can come here just to relax or to work with a laptop.

You can also buy souvenirs from local artisans here: wooden and leather items, bags, jewelry, as well as dried fruits, soaps, and fragrances.

The service is polite and friendly. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
I was looking for a cafe where a nomad could work, so I visited, and found out it was the cafe of popular YouTuber Ricky (aka Mango Family). I also happened to run into Ricky, who happened to be at a cafe.

It boasts a cozy atmosphere,
and I had a flat white, and the coffee was delicious. and Pad thai was also really delicious.

The network speed was also very good. The cafe was packed with people working remotely.
review_3_text:
Great location and good food. A relaxing place that’s perfect for taking a break, grabbing some tea, and reading.

One suggestion for improvement: the order bell is very loud. It might be better to use one that just vibrates.
review_4_text:
All about style here. Not really a place for espresso lovers, generic at best. Up beat pop playlist mostly old American if you like that. It's a rainy day so I'm enjoying the bright lights and sense of being somewhere else kinda suspended in time!
Their concept is carrying to travelers on the last day in CNX, even adding an airport shuttle service. Somehow slightly louder music intentionally fits that aesthetic.
review_5_text: A bright double-storied space with varied seating that, while decently ample, does get quite occupied on a midafternoon. The drinks are refreshing, served by very warm and friendly staff.

name: Villa Nard
review_1_text:
Had a matcha tiramisu and a cafe latte. Cake is delicious with a soft texture. Coffee is full of flavour and no bitterness.
Glad to see European style cafe/coffee shop evolving in Thailand and doing well.
review_2_text: Absolutely amazing space, delicious coffee which is accompanied by complimentary piece of chocolate. Beautiful ambiance and they sell home made vintage home decor which is out of this world! Love the place and will be definitely back tomorrow 😃🙌.
review_3_text:
Five stars for every subject. 🤩🤩🤩

If you are lucky, you will meet the very hospitable owner. 👩🏻

The food satisfies my tummy, and the coffee is good. The space is huge, and you can feel you have a private area to yourself. Kids are also welcome 👧🏻👶🏻🧒🏻.

Highly recommended.
review_4_text:
This restaurant is an absolute gem. We had Eggs Benedict — hands down the best you’ll find in Thailand. I dare you to challenge it.
The place is filled with beautiful vintage furniture you can actually buy, which makes the whole atmosphere feel warm and special.
And the food? Absolute banger for the quality you’re getting. A fantastic spo
review_5_text: Delicious food (I got French Toast) and a really lovely interior. A little more expensive than other brunches I’ve had so far in Chiang Mai, but it was worth it for me

name: The pool Cafe & swimming
review_1_text: Sunday afternoon and 5 pm . Pool I think closes at 7 pm today . What's not to love. Think the restaurant closes at 5pm so nothing ordered. Price was thb50 entrance. I see there is a sign for thb650 for a month which is a consideration for those staying for a long time.
review_2_text: Clean pool with big space and no one here !! Feel like my own place HAHAHA , 50 BHT  swim you can stay as long as you want. Also they selling coffee for good price.
review_3_text: Really cosy space with great coffee and drinks menu. Cafe has really nice chairs and tables to do some work at. 50baht swimming pool entrance and the area is great to relax in or swim laps. Quite deep one end and shallow on the other. There’s also a small swimming pool which is a safer option for young children.
review_4_text: A great swimming pool.  Only 50bht for as long as you like.  It has a shallow end but is very deep at the other end.  The perfect place to swim or sunbathe on a hot day.  They do have a small cafe.
review_5_text:
The pool water was so dirty, murky and GROSS!

Price and service were good but facility is old and not worth it if the water is unsanitary!!!

name: BULOV CAFE
review_1_text: The coffee was not only incredibly delicious but also served at the perfect temperature. The foam on top had an ideal consistency—creamy and smooth, enhancing the overall experience. Each sip was a delightful blend of rich flavors and impeccable texture, making it a standout choice for any coffee lover. Whether you’re in need of a morning pick-me-up or a leisurely afternoon treat, this coffee hits all the right notes. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a top-notch coffee experience!
review_2_text:
4.5
Agree to other reviews (many suspicious reviews in Chiangmai...), great latte, great staff. Coffee, temperature, proportion, all in great balance. Great latte, but there is no air con. Also there are better cups (eg. Ceramic, stone) for coffee. Black theme also attracts mosquitos. Location a bit far from the city center.
review_3_text: One of the best cafes in town. It has an indoor and outdoor seating area, beautifully decorated and I appreciate the details put into the different drinks and snacks. The coffee is of very high quality, with an option for dairy free milk. Highly recommended 💕🌟🫶
review_4_text:
This cafe in Chiang Mai is a vibe.

I was worried that it would be all show. Bulov did not disappoint.

The Swan Art I was definitely impressed.  You can see things posted online, and when you get there, the Barista is not there. She delivered the goods. But what good is the art if the flavor is not there. It was delicious to the last sip. 😋

The owner was really nice and pleasant.

This is the kind of spot that a true coffee snob can appreciate.  I even got the vegan oatmeal cookies.  😋

As soon as you walk into the door. It's calm music  and the decor is very elegant but not over the top.

It's a great use of space.  The color  is simple, but it just works.

You have small tables, and even a couch wear you, and six of your closest friends can hang out.  There is also plenty of seating outside.

So, if you want to treat yourself and step out of the hot sun. Yes, this is one of the good ones.
review_5_text: I love their coconut coffee! Having tried it all over Chiang Mai, this place serves the best! The coffee is strong but not overpowering and complements nicely with the coconut juice and tender coconut pieces. It is beautifully presented—a drink made with care! I look forward to this delight every morning in a very relaxing space. Baristas are also very friendly!

name: IN Side CAFE
review_1_text:
O local tem muitas variedades de café e coisas pra comer
Bons preços e localização
Recomendo visitar
review_2_text: Affordable prices and delicious coffee. Highly recommended for coffee lovers. You must try it!

name: ACCIO Café
review_1_text: This cafe is a part of a hotel. The space is not big, but I believe you can use the hotel space and you have access to more chairs and tables. I have come to this cafe several times, but it was always closed, so it’s probably inconsistent. The opening hours are also a bit strange that they close at 4pm. Their drinks are not bad though.
review_2_text:
A comfy hotel cafe. A decent place to work for an hour or two. The seats are likely most comfortable for people who are similar in height to Thais.

There is a loft level above the main floor, with floor/counter seating and USB charging ports.

Charming staff and pleasant atmosphere. I'll be back if I'm in the area.
review_3_text: went for a coffee and a cake, it was very good! the staff is really kind, and the place so enjoyable
review_4_text:
Cafe of ISTY Hotel. It's air-con but use the glass wall so always bright and a bit hot till noon. Nevertheless the good place for a sip of coffee and relax. There is a white cat to pat but today she's not here :(.

For a coffee, i ordered the piccolo latte the flavor tends to be a little dark coffee but not bad, recommend to drink with water for a milder tastes
review_5_text: Great coffee. Good place to work. Not busy, but even has a second floor!

name: CAFE LungChang
review_1_text: Great place with great atmosphere and service 👍
review_2_text:
A relaxed place with soft music, perfect for chilling.
An old wooden house, with a homey, friend's vibe.
review_3_text:
A pleasant place with a stylish atmosphere a bit reminiscent of Cuban bars. Great food, try the SangSom rum, something between rum and whiskey. But the original preparation of coffee got us. The coffee was absolutely luxurious.
They play blues here, so it's something a bit different than a classic Thai restaurant in every way. We recommend it!

name: LIDO ART SPACE ลิโด อาร์ต สเปซ
review_1_text: Interesting setting, spacious, coffee and cocktails bar, live music starts 9.30 pm every night.
review_2_text: Awesome little art space with nice beer selection. They also have a great coffee selection! 👍
review_3_text:
Hipsterish place.
Excellent cocktails and for a fair price.
Nice environment and visuals.
DJ playing the obvious tunes, but ok.
Art on display extremely bad and priced at 10k  :D
review_4_text: Richard Keys has grand opening of his work. He is a very brilliant and enthusiastic artist
review_5_text: Very fun bar with cool live music and great cocktails!

name: Box​ Coffee​ สันติธรรม
review_1_text: As one of many small street venues this is the best one so far i have found here in Chiang Mai. For the price you can choose three types of roast grade. The coffee tastes like real Arabica so for those who like Italian/Spanish taste of coffee that’s the spot. The lady behind counter is SUPER nice, smiley and that makes this place even greater. Besides coffee you have also other drinks.  Highly recommend!
review_2_text:
We stayed around the corner from here and came to this coffee shop for some sort of iced coffee every day! Honestly one of the best coffees we've had during our trip to Thailand. Really well priced and goes down a treat on a hot morning.
I've never liked matcha before and thought I'd try it from here, it's the only place where I enjoyed it and would actually buy it again!
We already really miss this coffee shop so much and will absolutely come back when we're next in Thailand!
review_3_text: Good coffee with affordable price. They let you choose the bean and the sweetness of your cofffee before making
review_4_text: I picked up americano and it was just ok. You can choose either medium or dark roast. I got medium, but it tasted like dark roast.
review_5_text: Delicious coffee (with a distorted art of my heart 💔😅), welcoming barista with a beautiful smile 💐 made a beautiful cup of coffee ☕😋 for a beautiful start of the day, thank you ☺️🙏

name: Lanna Laundry & Lanna Coffee
review_1_text: Bring your laundry here! Not only they open 24/7, it is staffed so you don't need to anything after dropping it off!!! You can select water and dryer temperature to your liking. Pick up as quickly as 2 hours. The cost is also unbeatable. 65thb to wash 14kg and another 65thb for drying.
review_2_text: Best laundry ever! State of the art new and clean SpeedQueen laundry machines! Enjoy a drink with aircond while waiting for laundry!! There are friendly staff here to take care of your laundry while you are away and pick-up later!!
review_3_text: The best best best laundry ever.  Drop off fluff and fold in 3 hrs (depending how busy they are).  They even gave me my pocket change back!  Open 24/7, great staff, modern machines, awesome price.  Can they open branches everywhere I live because they’re really the best!  Thanks Lanna!
review_4_text: Very recently used these guys for my dirty clothes. Friendly service, clothes were clean and folded nicely. Offered me a 3hr turn around but they said I could turn up whenever (they are 24hr which is good). Easy drop off and pick up. Will use again before I leave.
review_5_text: Good place to do laundry, you can just drop and go, come back to pick your clothes after 3 hours and they are done washing drying and folding!

name: dot.coffee
review_1_text: The atmosphere is relaxing, perfect for studying, just enjoying some quiet time. Coffee tastes amazing rich flavor 👍👍the staff are super friendly and polite. I also loved the little details clean tables& nice background music. Definitely one of my new favorite spots. Highly recommend! 🌿✨
review_2_text:
Delightful little cafe tucked snugly along a quiet street, sporting a small and tasteful woody interior with a comfy albeit limited number of seats, run by a very nice and friendly owner who brews up some superb coffee. It does draw a rotating crowd akin to its size throughout a weekday afternoon, though a table or two was always available when I visited.

WC—outside; facing the shop's facade from the street, go down the entryway to the left, walk all the way down till you see a WC sign on the wall, where you'll be prompted to turn right into the corridor at the far end; it'll be the last door down that corridor. There's a sink right by the initial entryway one can use.
review_3_text: I love this coffee shop! The coconut coffee latte is the best I've had. The shop is small but the interior is very tastefull and well picked. You can tell the owner has a an eye for the beautiful. The music is also chill to work to and not your regular radio pop (except during Christmas to be fair). The owner might seem short of polite phrases but is actually very nice. One time I lost my wallet and didn't know where I left it and he not only checked the shop but also checked the cctv for me. Also very reasonable priced, just an overall 10/10 for me.
review_4_text: It’s a very nice little shop and the staff was very nice and welcoming. He even exchanged all my coins to paper notes, which I didn’t even ask for, I was asking him if I can put all my coins in the tip jar and he just exchanged them for me. So kind. Will definitely come back next time I’m here!
review_5_text:
"Thank you very much indeed! As a coffee shop owner, I prefer good coffee, but the barista makes high-quality coffee and creates a great environment in the room.
Please allow the owner to take a photo with the Library Teacher and English book on the bookshelf.

Additionally, my favorite drink is Matcha Milk Coconut—it’s even more delicious!

Thank you so much, na krab.
From Kru Watthanakorn Kanthakaew 😊🙏🏻
I purchased a drinking third time! 😁

name: บ้านคาเฟอีน
review_1_text: Great coffee and amazing people
review_2_text: The coffee tasted average, nothing special, but the atmosphere was chill and felt like home. There were dolls, pillows, small plants, and most of the decorations were collectibles like dolls, figurines, and model cars, giving it a vintage feel.
review_3_text: A small coffee shop in the alley of Kowitthamrong School. Sit at the bar or on the antique teak chairs. You can park inside the house.
review_4_text: Delicious

name: BARK.Home Cafe
review_1_text:
The 80 baht rich coffee is seriously delicious! Choo choo choo choo!!!
It's so much better than the orange coffee you'll find at most places (they do sell orange coffee, too).
They grind the beans before you order, so I highly recommend it👍
review_2_text: Wow, the coffee at this price is really good. It's a small shop but they really care about their coffee. It's suitable for coffee lovers. I recommend it.
review_3_text: There are so many different menus. I couldn't decide, so I ended up having three glasses.
review_4_text: The shop is cute and the owner is friendly.

name: ชานมมุก19บาท
CTK Coffee
review_1_text: Coffee prices are going up everywhere, but this newly opened shop is cheap at 25 baht. December 2023
review_2_text: Hot coffee was only 20 baht! It was very convenient as the nearby 7-Eleven doesn't have hot coffee! It was delicious!
review_3_text: That's great.

name: น้ำผลไม้วัยรุ่น
review_1_text: Every flavor is delicious.

name: Chiang cafe 清·咖啡
review_1_text: The food and drinks are amazing, highly recommended!
review_2_text: The shop is clean and has a hotel atmosphere.

name: All in cafe
review_1_text: Wow, I am so impressed with the chicken souvlaki! The Mediterranean spices were perfectly balanced. 👌The Greek salad was delicious and the tzadziki was off the chain.  These guys know Greek food. It's a small, small shop but 110% worth finding.They also have a limited menu on Grab. Do yourself a favor, and give them a shot--you won't regret it!
review_2_text: Everything here is proper. They don’t *** around when it comes to food. Amazing experience meeting Darius. It was a privilege. True authentic food coming from a humble man with a great story and lots of surprises. Recipes are straight from his family tree and have been passed on for generations.
review_3_text: Some of the best Greek food I have had. Very unassuming place, good chat with the owner. Amazing tzatziki
review_4_text:
I just stopped by Get Er to the Greek at All-In Cafe, and I was absolutely blown away! Darius has put together a small, focused menu, but every single item is made with pure quality. I had the chicken and beef souvlaki wraps, and they were some of the best Greek food I’ve ever had—he’s using sirloin steak, organic chicken, and top-notch ingredients across the board.

On top of that, Darius is just a genuinely great guy—passionate about his craft and committed to making amazing food. You can taste the effort and love he puts into every dish.

If you’re a fan of authentic, high-quality Greek food, this is a spot you need to check out. Highly recommend!

Location: Get Er to the Greek @ All-In Cafe
review_5_text: This is exactly what I needed in my life. So fresh and clean and delicious and the owner was a top quality guy. Will be back asap!

name: Daughter's Happy Place café
review_1_text: Lovely food and super friendly staff ! If you want to have a relaxing time in a cozy, air conditioned cafe, this is the place ! Free WiFi as well, I couldn't ask for better !
review_2_text: The food is delicious! I had the Cocoa drink and could not believe how nice it tasted, a definite gem ! Air conditioning and WiFi, awesome place with very friendly owners.

name: สรัม คาเฟ่
review_1_text: The owner of this coffee shop is very nice, the ingredients are very cheap, and they also have food options. The Thai milk tea is delicious.
review_2_text: I happened to pass by a coffee shop today, and Srum coffee was delicious. The staff were very friendly. I'll definitely go back for coffee before I go back to China.

name: อลังการคาเฟ่ กาแฟสด&ชาลืมผัว

name: ชาคุมะ
review_1_text: The owner put all her heart into this small Cafe and it is very affordable.
review_2_text: Small, inexpensive cafe with good croissants

name: Bake for u
review_1_text: This morning, we stopped by Bake for U and enjoyed a cappuccino latte and Thai tea. Both drinks were freshly made and absolutely delicious. The café has a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for sitting down to enjoy your meal. They bake their own cakes, breads, and pastries, adding a fresh aroma to the air. The staff was very friendly, providing quick and efficient service. The upkeep of the place is excellent, with the owner even taking care of the plants outside. There's also a cozy outdoor seating area if you prefer to enjoy your food and drinks in the fresh air.
review_2_text: Nice place.  Friendly service.  An iced coffee latte was only 35 Baht.  There are snacks and a bakery but I wasn't hungry.
review_3_text: Very nice little breakfast spot, recommended!!
review_4_text:
The nicest family bakery.

Good coffee, good pastries, good bread, good breakfast/brunch deals and better people.

I usually don't have breakfast but it was impossible not to try the croissants and the cookies. Cakes are veery tasty too.
review_5_text: Very nice place and really great and cheap breakfast. Authentic Thai people with big hearts and quality products :)

name: ช้างเผือกซอย3
WANCHAM COFFEE & DRINK หวานฉ่ำ ช้างเผือก
review_1_text: Lady owner recommended the Mango passionfruit pineapple smoothie for 80 baht - this is hands down the best smoothie we had in Thailand 🙏
review_2_text: The owner is so sweet lady, and her coconut Ice cream is top notch :) also the juice is very fresh. Worth every bath spent.
review_3_text:
Has the best coconut coffee frappe thing I've ever had, absolutely hooked on them.

Owner is super friendly as well welcomes with a smile every time
review_4_text: We had excellent three breakfasts here. I can only recommend the place! All is super fresh and tasty. Thank you! ขอบคุณ
review_5_text:
Delicious homemade coconut icecrean. No dairy.
Very friendly staff.
Well worth a visit.
Wide selection of beverages

name: Chim noi home made
review_1_text: Delicious, fresh, fragrant, and sweet curry puffs with many fillings. Order them at Chang Phueak Bus Terminal or call to order online. You must try them. They're truly delicious.

name: KAME KAFE (คาเมะคาเฟ่) - ถนนสนามกีฬา
review_1_text:
This small café sits right by the main road, tucked inside a hotel property. We were pleasantly surprised — despite its simple look, the coffee quality was excellent, with a good variety of beans. Drinks like cappuccino and latte were well-balanced and smooth.

We'll definitely be coming back regularly!
review_2_text: Good service and polite staff. The drinks prices are also very reasonable.
review_3_text: This cafe is located in the checkin area of a hotel and things are organized and clean and it feels right. They have a large drink menu. You can choose the roast level of your coffee and I got light one and it was very good. Taiwanese milk tea was also great. One of the best quality drinks around for sure. It seems like a very popular spot for delivery pick ups.
review_4_text: KAME KAFE is perhaps the only cafe I would consider working till late because it’s open till 10:30pm. The only slight (-) is probably the tables and chair, not a lot and can be a little squeaky. Other than that, the air-condition temp is just nice for work environment. I was able to focus well, on top of that, the cafe has cream cheese topping for drinks
review_5_text: I visited Kame Kafe and tried the Coconut Matcha Foam—it was delicious! The service was really nice and the staff were friendly. Great atmosphere overall. I definitely recommend this place!

name: Cafe’ Amazon
review_1_text:
Cool cafe
Nice atmosphere
Laptop friendly

--> toilet 5 min walk by street to another building
review_2_text: There was a power outage for over an hour, but the staff were friendly. 😅
review_3_text: Very best coffee place in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: Sell drinks but for the toilet you have to go to the supermarket 100m down the road even though they have plenty space inside. Dirty windows. Bad set up, bad maintenance
review_5_text: Tooooo cold. Please adjust your air conditioning. 🙏

name: Elephant Organic ( Health Foods )
review_1_text: Been missing the access to herbs, oil, and tinctures and Elephant Organic filled that void internationally. Tucked away down a busy local business shop street. The shop is clean and well well organized. Enjoyed the jams and the friendliness Cee was amazing! If you are in need of natural Earthly necessities stop by.
review_2_text: Fabulous, local health food & healthy products store just near Old City... an easy walk from the North Gate.  Especially love that they stock Pure Thai Naturals products. Nice people & great service.
review_3_text: Amazing shop with super foods, natural products, ceremonial cacao, honey, candles,, essential oils. I’m a regular here, absolutely love it! And the owner is the best!!!! This is kind of a small business I wish we had more in the world. Thank you!
review_4_text:
An absolute beautiful establishment!

Since I am plant-based/vegan/organic lifestyle, I love to visit and support local organic health stores.

I found elephant organic health foods shop just  by searching organic on Google maps, and this rare gem store popped up as I’m so thankful and blessed to have found this wonderful place.

For those who are health conscious, looking for organic Superfoods/powders/protein powder/grains, essential oils, delicious smoothies, and other health products, this is the place to stop in and shop. They have a little bit of everything in case you’re traveling abroad and worried about not having certain items with you to satisfy your health needs.

They have their own brand/ products of organic superfood powders and more to satisfy all of your health needs.

I started out shopping for a vegan floss which I found and I love, then I saw a gentleman walked in and ordered a smoothie which I didn’t realize until I saw the menu later. So I decided to order the super green smoothie and it was delicious especially if you enjoy your greens, well balanced flavor with the fruits and their in-store brand super green organic powder.

I love how they utilize their own products in their smoothies, a great way to sample their powders so if you plan to make your own smoothies at home , you can buy the powder there and enjoy at home or wherever you’re staying so you can make your own smoothies.

You can also order their products and have them shipped if you plan to stay in Thailand for sometime

I had the pleasure of speaking with the owner  Sasa who is very friendly, cool, and fun to talk with especially aboutHealth/travel/life /and more. Sasa is very knowledgeable about Health foods/and more to help accommodate your daily needs to optimize nutrition and overall to maintain a healthy body.

I ended up staying in the shop for almost 2 hours, just hanging out having a great conversation with the owner and other team members, shopping around, testing out products, and also ordering a second smoothie which was the berry boost, another delicious smoothie on the menu as I look forward to trying more before I leave.

So I ended up buying a few smoothies, some super green powder, mosquito repellent, vegan floss, and Sasa’s Bonita essential oil made by the owner.

Overall, this is a beautiful establishment as I am blessed to have found Elephant Organic (Health Foods). Be sure to stop in and try a smoothie and test out some of their products and enjoy a great experience. 😃🙏🏼🌱💚🫐🥭🥥🥬🇹🇭
review_5_text: These are the best smoothies in Chiang Mai, and they're only 65-75 baht! Plus they have an amazing selection of health foods and herbal products, including allergen friendly food alternatives. Prices are surprisingly good for the quality of products they sell. And the owners are super friendly and helpful. There's nothing else like this in the city - 100% worth the visit!

name: GANDAMU กันดามู กันพลาเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: The shop has a very friendly atmosphere. I had a lot of fun talking to the staff and they gave great recommendations. I was extremely impressed!
review_2_text: The shop owner is polite, friendly, and very welcoming. I'll definitely be a frequent customer next time.
review_3_text: The shop is very friendly and talkative. I had a lot of fun talking with the staff and they gave me really good recommendations. I'm impressed.
review_4_text: The shop owner was very nice and friendly. The shop is great.😔👍

name: มนตรี
review_1_text: Retro, Identity, Good Taste. Orange Americano makes me feel fresh and relaxed. Feel of Aroma from Coffee and Fresh Orange juice. This Cafe' s look like applies from the old style coffee shop and the new cafe but keeps the atmosphere of '60.
review_2_text:
This is the great coffee shop,you must try. Good price for everyone.
The shop look very old and vintage style.
I ordered Vanilla Latte(60฿). I really prefer it.
review_3_text:
Super cute coffee corner 🧡 delicious coffee, and a lovely group of people serving. Come by for perhaps the best cappuccino in Chaing Mai.

If I were a Chiang Maian, I’d be happy to try everything they serve 🍀
review_4_text: Best coffee in chiang mai. And super friendly staff:)
review_5_text: Best Coffe in town and the team is so friendly! thanks 🙏🏼

name: GG’s Café
review_1_text: Nice place good vibes good coffee and GG has very good energy!
review_2_text: A Very Cute and Relaxed Coffee Shop. It is a great spot to take it easy, and have a break during the day. The customers are nice, and the owner is passionate about her shop and her coffee!!!
review_3_text: Very nice place! Super central and food is delicious
review_4_text: GG She’s super friendly and fun, plus the coffee is really good
review_5_text: GG is a wonderful young woman with a radiant spirit. She runs the café herself, and the espresso is authentically European — a solid 10/10

name: Montrio Reflow Cnx
review_1_text: Definitely the spot to go to just north of old town for a quality tasty brew. Super authentic and local vibe, rustic decor with lots of space to sit and enjoy your drink. The price for a coffee is pretty good. You can also tell that they have high quality coffee machines and have a wide range of coffee beans. They don’t just do coffee either! I try and grab a coffee every time I pass by! Great spot slightly hidden in plain sight.
review_2_text: Hidden gem! This cafe is set in a little corner on a busy street. Feels more like a garage than a cafe but the coffee is delicious and they really care about the taste! Super fair prices and friendly staff. Awesome. Also great coconut water!
review_3_text:
Nice, typical Thai café. Exceptionally clean. The ice cubes are made with boiled water. The owners are very friendly and kind. The place has an industrial charm, with lots of upcycled decor.
One star off: I ordered a caramel macchiato, but there was no caramel syrup in it – it still tasted really good though.
review_4_text: Was here 3 times in Chiang Mai within 1 week. They serve the best coffee in Chiang Mai. The vibes and atmosphere is just amazing! Super recommend!
review_5_text: Really really good coffee.  The shop is run by a group of young, friendly and cute barista. Different roast level to choose from and the latte is always served at the perfect temperature with the right consistency.  Cool vibe, bright and airy and excellent price.  Excellent place and great people !

name: อิสลามโรตี
review_1_text: This is probably the only place i know that they’re using COCONUT OIL instead of margarine. There are a few options of flours you can choose as well: rose, riceberry, wholewheat, sesame etc! (The tastes are slightly different too not just the pretty colours)
review_2_text: The batter is good, the pandan leaves are fragrant, and it's fried until crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, but they didn't add enough milk. There's a long queue, and it's mostly locals. The price is inexpensive.
review_3_text: Islam Roti is a roti cart open Monday to Saturday, closed on Sundays. It offers authentic flavors at affordable prices with friendly service. If you're passing by Chang Phueak Gate, stop by and try it!
review_4_text: I ordered a Nutella roti, and wow, there was so much Nutella! It was only 25฿, but they piled it on like it was worth over 100฿! It came in a nice box and bag. Not only was it cheap, but it was also delicious. Anyone visiting Chiang Mai needs to order one! It's seriously amazing! I don't know their opening and closing times, but I ordered in the evening, around 8 PM.
review_5_text: Roti with egg and milk, packed in a nice box, 25 baht per box, very filling and delicious.

name: MY FAV! Coffee
review_1_text:
Iced Americano, 45 baht. Great price! The coffee is fragrant, the seller is polite and nice. Support their business! ❤️

P.S. Takeaway only.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious, well-rounded, and inexpensive. The service is good. We ordered takeaway.

name: ธันวา พิศดาร
Q Roast Cafe
review_1_text: Nice cafe! Drunk a cup of coffee and one singha beer large size in very cheap price and good atmosphere.

name: TARAKO BAKERY & CAFE
review_1_text:
Cute little spot for coffee, matcha and ice cream. I stopped by around lunch time needing a quiet break and ordered a matcha latte (they have oat milk!) It was about 70-75 THB and made with traditional methods and attention. The gentleman who made it kindly brought it to a seat I got facing outside on a lovely little tray along with a spoon and a little cookie/biscuit! Nice little surprise and I allowed myself to indulge.

The matcha wasn't bitter nor sweet- a gentle aroma that even those who prefer sugar can enjoy with little to no added sugar. The sweetness in the biscuit can balance it if you want sugar and of course you can add it.

A lovely group of women, I believe one is an owner like the gentleman who served me, gave me some travel advice for temples to visit since it is important to me. We had a nice chat and connected on an authentic level.

Great acoustic music and covers of Western songs played the whole time too. Highly recommend this little gem!
review_2_text: Tasty cheesecake with fruits - a small portion for just 60 baht. The staff was very friendly and the place had a pleasant atmosphere.
review_3_text: Great Thai tea, you can ask for the level of sweetness you want. Seating is small but very cute!
review_4_text: Great quality coffee, great service!
review_5_text: Small cozy cafe next to Mercure Hotel.

name: เรารักของเล่นคาเฟ่
review_1_text:
The coffee is reasonablely priced, and the iced latte was flavorful. I had a butter/milk toast and asked to have honey added. It was delicious. The service staff were very friendly. English isn't spoken but pointing to menu items (every item has a photo) and using Google Translate easily solves any problems.
A cup stacking game is available for use at the large table.
Note: Bathroom and wi-fi are available.
review_2_text: Love the vibe, the place is so cool. Please come and wish you enjoy.
review_3_text:
Very cute ,
Simple
Fun atmosphere
Young people
Very reasonable pricing
25/35 THB for most drinks
review_4_text:
Very nice coffee and good price
Please try this shop
review_5_text:
There are so many cute toys!
There are a few small tables inside and outside,
and the friendly owner prepares food and tea.
It's a cozy cafe, like a snack bar in front of a school. ㅎㅎ
+Chic, chubby cats wander around casually.

I'll add this! It looks like they have a vintage clothing store right next door, and they have so many cute items🤩
The clothes are all neatly organized, and if you're good at treasure hunting, you can find some great items.

Coffee morning cnx
review_1_text: I found the best coffee shop in mae Hong son. Full flavour. Beautiful decor. Friendly staff. A comfortable place to relax, read or chat. 5 stars from me.
review_2_text: Delicious drinks, cheap prices, lovely staff.

name: cafe withus
review_1_text: It's delicious and cheap, so I think about it again and again^^

name: Chum Coffee

Less sweet, normal sweet, or unsweetened – you can tell the staff.
Every item on the menu is delicious.

review_1_text: Super nice staff
review_2_text: 💚 This coffee shop is so beautiful! It's spacious with glass walls perfect for enjoying the atmosphere and lovely lighting. There are lots of photo opportunities. The coffee is fragrant and delicious, and the prices are very reasonable. It's a great place to relax all day long. ☕️
review_3_text: The shop has cute decor and a view of the stadium. I ordered a medium roast Americano and it was perfect. The croissant was also delicious, served warm. I want to go back and buy another one! 😍

name: Bang Coffee
review_1_text: She was very helpful and understood English.  She made my ice latte fast. It also tasted wonderful. 😋
review_2_text: It tastes good.

name: Cafe’23
review_1_text: This shop has hot and cold drinks. They also offer delivery via Grab.

name: Light Up Cafe
review_1_text:
Great spot for a quick eat or takeaway coffee.  We ordered iced lattes and americanos daily; both were great and served within minutes of ordering.

Food is basic, but who doesn’t love a ham and cheese toasty/ croissant when on the go.
review_2_text: Mill cream croissant is different from the picture. I ordered from Lineman and it showed like the cream is made with good quality but in reality the cream inside is whipping cream. And Matcha shake has no taste of matcha at all. Only tastes like milk.
review_3_text: Chic cafe offering coffees, smoothies, pizzas, cakes and finger food. They no  longer serve steaks despite what the signage says. The interior is cosy and attracts local undergrads. Their coffee and smoothies seem to be a huge hit looking at the number of patrons each day. Staff is very friendly and helpful. One speaks good English and very accommodating. I think you can book the second floor for meeting or YouTube shoots if you ask.
review_4_text: Good breakfast options for a quick solution, coffee is good and service is fast
review_5_text:
Quick, friendly, delicious tea.
They used too much ice though, so was hard to get the jelly.
Beautiful street frontage.
Many people stopped to take a photo.
Small space, so wouldn't be ideal for working or taking too long.

name: SD Coffee
review_1_text: Very cheap smoothie on campus.

review_1_text: It’s good~~~
review_2_text: The iced tea is delicious, with a unique aroma. This branch has a huge selection of desserts. I couldn't decide which one to choose. The salespeople are very friendly. If you're looking for a reasonably priced drink, I highly recommend this place. ☕
review_3_text: It's delicious!

Lom Coffee ลม กาแฟ
Overcup

You can choose the roast level of your coffee as you like and their coffee was actually great and the value is great given the quality and space.
review_2_text: Clean workstation, good quality coffee, good espresso. Outlets and workably ergonomic seating.
review_3_text:
If you like silence i recommend for this Store
The coffee and Matcha is good

Really good Nan light roast.
Made to order.
review_5_text:
Pure Matcha uses 100% pure green tea powder for a wonderful aroma.
The coffee is also delicious and has a pleasant sweetness. The price is reasonable.
The vintage atmosphere has stood the test of time.

name: พันธุ์ไทย coffee
review_1_text: 5 glasses for almost an hour, is that too long?

review_1_text: Really cute little place. Anytime I feel like Pad Ka Praow I come here. Very flavourful and well seasoned. Only 40 baht or 50 baht with an egg. The owners are super nice and friendly too
review_2_text: We always had the place to ourselves. Humble place. Nice and quiet. Very convenient for us as we are checked-in ay the Lotus Hotel. Our go to place to quench thirst!
review_3_text: lovely little place with an awesome atmosphere! we had Thai Tea, Rice with Omelette and Spicy Stir-Fried Minced Pork with Holy Basil.The flavor is very intense and delicious! Also, the owner is very friendly!
review_4_text:
Hidden gem in one of the strangely abandoned attachment of the hotel.
You wouldn’t expect to find a nice lady serving nice Thai lunches and fruit smoothies. Great value.
-nice tree shade and breeze too
review_5_text: Super nice and simple cafe. Minimal menu, great and quick service.

name: Homebar
review_1_text: A small pickup coffee place right next to or a part of a local restaurant. I got salted caramel latte and it was not so good unfortunately.
review_2_text: Coffee shop for take away coffee.
review_3_text:
The coffee is delicious. It's a small shop.
The prices are affordable.

I ordered an orange juice coffee for 45 baht.
review_4_text: A small coffee shop that uses the front of the house, which used to be a rice and curry shop, to open a small cafe in a brown wooden box. It focuses on grab & go. There is a menu of drinks at very affordable prices, starting at 30 baht. Very cheap! And the taste is good too.
review_5_text: Cute shop 🌈

ร้านทศวรรษชานม
Glass Cafe
review_1_text: The dirty with soy milk was surprisingly satisfying - best coffee with soy milk I ever had so far. Their signature drinks were very creative and pretty-looking. You should also try their bakery, the coconut cake we had was not too sweet and deliciously creamy. The staff were very informative and super nice.
review_2_text: The place is really ‘glass’y, bright and modern vibe. Drinks selections are variety enough. Coffee itself tastes decent. Dirty is pretty good. Price is considered on a high side. Cafe itself is a bit hideous, need to carefully look out for the logo. Bakery looks good, gonna try next time.
review_3_text: The newest cafe in Nimman. Nice coffee and services. Come and visit, you will never disappoint. 🥰
review_4_text:
Lovely Cafe💛
A must to visit! High quality coffee +  fresh baked bakery
Friendly staffs 😊🎁
review_5_text:
Nice and Cozy place with very friendly staffs.
Since I am a BIG fan of Yuzu I ordered “Some Yuzu” Dang, one sip and you know it, Its a high quality Yuzu right here, must try!

name: Café Amazon คาเฟ่ อเมซอน ปตท.ช้างม่อย
review_1_text: They are open from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day.

name: cherry coffee
review_1_text: Coffee..great. Green tea milk tea..strong. Smooth and creamy cappuccino..

name: Beyond CAFÉ
review_1_text: This is a great little coffee and tea shop. I came here to relax and have some green tea. I received exactly what I wanted. The tea was good. The atmosphere was relaxing with good music. To add the barista was very helpful and polite. It's experiences and interactions with people like her that make me return to a business.
review_2_text: A cute cafe I came across walking back from the farmers market. Various selection of drinks including coffee, milk tea, smoothies, hot tea, and Italian soda.
review_3_text: Size of portions is not for adult. I asked to put more spaghetti, Thai female came and started shout on me something on Thai language showing that I need get out. This my first time of so disrespectful service in Thailand.
review_4_text:
The cappuccino is good. I ordered 2 for my mom and she said she likes it.

Highly recommended cafe and not expensive. They gave me a free thai tea 😘😘😘
review_5_text: Great place for breakfast! Their honey toast is possibly the best breakfast I’ve ever had in my life!

name: กูบ้าชามุก สาขารัตนโกสินทร์
รสพญา กาแฟ
review_1_text: The shop owner is cute and friendly. The coffee is delicious and cheap.
review_2_text: I'm addicted to the green tea from this shop. The owner is very cute and friendly.
review_3_text: Delicious green tea. Very friendly service.

name: Moddangfire
review_1_text: Great coffee only 25 thb
review_2_text: Good coffee roaster here.
review_3_text: coffee experian
review_4_text: We came for pizza but stumbled upon a coffee shop with a lovely female barista. She was fun to talk to and gave great coffee recommendations. She's got what she likes and can suggest whatever flavor profile you prefer. Definitely stop by! Come for coffee and pizza at this "guerrilla" shop. The owners of both shops are siblings. Highly recommend trying them. Everyone has their own tastes, and what's delicious to us might not be the same for everyone.🤟🏼😎
review_5_text: I'd forgotten it was Buddha's Birthday. Following the map this morning, I arrived only to find the doors closed, seemingly about to miss my trip. Luckily, a few persistent Korean tourists knocked and managed to get in, finally allowing me to have coffee and pizza. Coffee and pizza for breakfast is a rare combination for me, but it didn't seem out of place here. I had no idea these items came from two different shops. Perhaps the owners were used to this order, so everyone worked efficiently and we were quickly eating. They had several coffee bean options, and the coffee paired perfectly with the thin, crispy pizza – highly recommended. The two owners were incredibly welcoming; if they hadn't worked overtime, I would have missed out on breakfast. Thank you so much!

name: ฉันทนา (พี่อั้ม)
Monsoon Tea Wat Ket
review_1_text: Great place to stop for tea. Extensive tea list. Comfortable surroundings near the river. Friendly staff (but he did get my order wrong and I got two meals when I only requested one!). One order of tea is enough for 2 or 3 people, but no one tells you that! Regardless of the errors, enjoy a nice cup lychee, mango, coconut or passionfruit tea with friends in a cozy tea retreat.
review_2_text:
I love their tea! Amazing flavor and business model. I also did their tea blend workshop and was so worth it! The staff was soooo friendly and kind!
I will definitely be coming back
review_3_text: Nice tea house with multiple rooms and outdoor seating area, calm ambience and a good selection of locally produced teas and tea blends. The staff were friendly and gifted us a few extra small packs of tea with our purchase.
review_4_text:
A forest-friendly tea shop in Chiang Mai — now relocated just across the street. The peaceful atmosphere remains, with a great selection of teas and a simple yet interesting food menu.

What I loved most was their signature tea. It's perfect for enjoying at home and makes a lovely souvenir or gift for friends.
review_5_text: I went to a tea tasting and blending hosted by Monsoon Tea and had a fantastic time. The teahouse is set in a truly beautiful location along the Ping River. The atmosphere was beautiful and calming, and the staff were all incredibly caring. Teddy, the host, was thorough and knowledgeable, guiding me through tastings of many teas before leading a fun, hands-on blending session. I loved being able to take home a generous amount of my own custom blend. The class also included a large, delicious lunch with savory tea-based dishes. Afterwards, I was able to work from the tranquil space and get quite a lot done. Highly recommended for anyone who loves tea, food, or unique experiences!

name: Natwat Home Café
review_1_text: For a small café, Natwat does not feel crowded, the ambience is very calm and inviting. Our service was wonderful, with those little touches of noticing us right when we walked in and suggesting alternatives to things they were out of. They get all of the little touches right. Lovely seating inside or outside in the garden area.
review_2_text: The coffee was good and the staff was friendly, and the cookie my friend ordered was so big!!
review_3_text:
Delicious food, I really recommend to try the breakfast quesadilla 🤤
Coffee also is very good and stuff is super friendly.
review_4_text:
Outstanding food! The best coffee I've had in Chiang Mai so far. Will be coming back.

Edit. I've been regularly coming to Natwat over a period of a month and actually ended up moving to the area. My favorite place for breakfast and coffee 🥳
review_5_text: This is a great place for brunch! Their menu has a wide range of western brunch dishes which made it so hard for me to pick! For coffee, i ordered black coffee with coconut water which had an interesting taste. For food, we ordered a bagel, quesadilla, egg Benedict and baked eggs in tomato. I will come back and try other dishes!

name: เนื้อหอมตี้ฟ้าฮ่าม
กาแฟสืบสาน
review_1_text: Delicious coffee shop, affordable prices, good atmosphere, beautiful corners to sit and relax while sipping coffee.
review_2_text: Sip on fragrant coffee, admire the traditional house, and listen to the sounds of traditional Thai music – it's like stepping back in time to Chiang Mai of the past.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is shady and Lanna-style. During the time of teaching at the Lanna Heritage Home, the atmosphere is different.
review_4_text: This coffee shop is located within the Lanna Heritage School and offers a very friendly atmosphere. Feel free to sit as long as you like, and the prices are reasonable. You can even order other drinks if you don't like what you're looking for. The shop isn't air-conditioned because the atmosphere is already pleasant, but it does offer free WiFi. Since it's located within a school, most customers are students or their accompanying parents.
review_5_text: The cake was delicious, and the milk tea was smooth and creamy.

name: กาแฟ & ชา อร่อยซอย2
โมมูคอฟฟี่
ENTHEOS
review_1_text:
Chiang Mai's best cafe and burger place!

1. The inside of the cafe is so clean, and the bathroom is clean.
The outdoor terrace on the second floor is so pretty, and the pictures come out well!

2. The hamburgers are so delicious.. The best hamburger in my life.🍔 patty is so thick, and rich in ingredients!
We were very full even though two women shared a burger and a half.

3. Coffee is also delicious. ⭐️⭐️⭐️coffee bean (roasted by the cafe owner himself)

4. The boss and the staff are so kind and sweet!
review_2_text: The coffee there is very good!! Next time we’ll try the burger there!!
review_3_text: Nice and cozy coffee shop. The shop is actually much larger than what you see from the outside. They offer a variety of specialty coffees. The owner is super friendly a nice place to drop by to have a cup of coffee with friends.
review_4_text: We have been looking for a place with good burgers and saw good reviews about Entheos. The reviews are very very accurate. We came here twice. The first time to try the burgers. We both had the double cheeseburger. Additionally, i had fries ans a cola. The burgers were excellent. The patties were nice big and juicy. I grew up in LA with In-N-Out Burger and I can say that these burgers are just as good or dare I say better than In-N-Out. It is a bit pricey but worth it. We had coffee there the next day (Mocha and Flat White). The coffees were also excellent and very reasonably price. We will come back again for burgers and coffee.
review_5_text: The burgers here can go toe to toe with any other spot in Chiang Mai, but the thing that really sets it apart is the coffee, which is excellent.  Be aware that this is not a fast dining spot and come prepared to sit.  There are games and a couple of guitars and a few outlets and overall a nice atmosphere.  The people who work here are very nice as well.

name: Hop Chafé สาขาหลังปรินส์
Coffee Cup คอฟฟี่คัพ
review_1_text: This is a lovely little coffee shop, that has very good lattes. It was a staple for us to go there before continuing on to the Sunshine massage school. The owner is so sweet and kind. The coffees were tasty, and very economically priced. Would highly recommend this cute little coffee shop.
review_2_text: My favorite coffee stand! The owner consistently makes the perfect temperature coffees and is so smiley. She's very sweet! The coffees are economically priced and I stop by every day, since it's close to Sunshine Massage School. I will miss her coffee when I leave!
review_3_text:
My favorite place for coffee
Since 3 month I come here just for coffee
Ladies is so sweet smiling 🌸🌸🌸
review_4_text:
I love this place for a hot or iced coffee/latte/mocha....
Good service and attention 👍
review_5_text: Great coffee, great prices and friendly staff! My favorite spot to pick up a coffee during my lunch break.

name: Pod Por Cafe ป๊อด ปอ
review_2_text: So delicious!

name: BURGER BAR เบอร์เกอร์บาร์ กาแฟ ชา สมูทตี้คาเฟ่
review_1_text: Was looking for a taste of home and found this gem.  😋  I ordered a pork hamburger to try something a little different with fries.  The porkburger was flavourful and juicy with a homemade sauce.  The fries, good, crispy and soft in the center.  Milk bubble tea was good as well lots of ice and refreshing.  The price was just over 115 bht with an addition Coke.
review_2_text: Just devoured what might just be the very best (value) burger ever! Dropped in on a whim and ordered the egg cheese burger and an iced cappuccino. The drink was great but the burger was truly spectacular! Made from scratch and TASTY!! The price for the two? I doubt it can be beaten anywhere, Try this place. The welcoming and most friendly service is much appreciated. 👍👍👍
review_3_text: Excellent value, great burgers, varied menu with fish and chips, chicken on rice and beef burgers. Smoothies and coffee too!
review_4_text: Fabulous burgers made fresh to order, crispy fries, and excellent iced coffee. Run by a lovely family. You can get food to go but the small dining area is very nice.
review_5_text: Nice place with good coffee and thai drinks. They have a milk for vegans ❤️ The prices are very reasonable:)

name: Mingmitr Coffee
review_1_text:
Amazing coffee!
Every day he created a different piece of art in my cappuccino and instantly made my day — simply incredible! And he even did it in my takeaway coffee. You can really feel the passion and attention to detail. Great coffee, lovely atmosphere, and highly recommended ☕️✨

Cappuccino was very good
review_2_text:
Wow! I'm impressed. I wish they'd do flat white (hot latte with double shot in smaller cup), but I'm very happy to get this hot latte!
The place is full of locals working on their laptop which I like (I can't deal with tourists even if I'm one); and the music is not too loud making it perfect to concentrate.
I'll come back. The barista behind the counter is a magician, I had to order a second latte!
review_3_text: I wanted to give a shout out to their latte art! It’s so beautiful! The staff are sooooo kind, they always are very diligent and friendly. I love the coffee too!
review_4_text:
Loved coffee from this brand. It had a good aroma and nice flavour even though they made it with dark roasts bean.
I tried many times and now became a regular customer of this brand.
Good coffee shop in Chiangmai!
Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
On a good location, close to the bus station and Mc Cormick hospital you find this coffee shop.

Nice atmosphere and clean. Enough seats available and also enough parking.

The service is of a good level. Very friendly.

The coffee is of very good quality.

Recommendable.

name: Bean Scene Cafe
review_1_text:
I had an amazing experience at this cafe! They teach you everything about coffee — from the absolute basics to advanced brewing methods and even latte art. The teacher is incredibly kind, patient, and humble. He takes the time to make sure you truly understand each step, and he never gives up until you get it right.

When I first joined, I didn’t know anything about coffee, but now I feel confident — almost like a professional barista! The atmosphere is friendly and inspiring, and you can really feel the teacher’s passion for coffee. Highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to learn how to make great coffee!

Also after 1Pm you can come and enjoy the good coffee a very nice place for working and drinking a good cup of coffee
review_2_text: A wonderful coffee shop with friendly employees! The staff was welcoming from the second I walked in the door. It is a clean and cool interior with good wi-fi. I really enjoyed their matcha—you can tell it is good quality and not just “green tea powder.” They have soy milk available! Less than a 10 minute walk from Bus Terminals 2 & 3.
review_3_text: My favorite thing about this café is that the coffee tastes amazing, and the customer service is excellent. The décor is lovely, and the place feels so cozy.
review_4_text: It’s cool,relax and quiet place coffee shop. Coffee is really nice and friendly nice customer service. And also near Bus Terminal 2&3 before we go, we can take a rest that cafe shop.
review_5_text: Cute and cozy cafe with delicious coffee and smoothies. The owner and staffs are very nice. Definitely visit again!

name: Lily of the Valley Cafe
review_1_text:
I ordered Cocoa Frappe and Blueberry Cheesecake.
The Frappe was really amazing. It's simple but the taste 5-stars. Pure chocolate taste. Doesn't take like diluted in ice.

The cheesecake was also amazing. From the base that has an interesting crunch, the cheese layer that just creamy and dense but doesn't taste heavy, and the toppings it was really good!

High Praises from room 516
review_2_text: Just dealt with Food Poisoning for the last 48 hours - this place served up sweaty smelling chicken. DO NOT RISK IT. Should have stopped my daughter from eating it but I figured out the smell a little too late.
review_3_text: The owner is very friendly and the service is top notch. ✨
review_4_text: The dry Khao Soi with crispy chicken was delicious. The service was good and lovely.

name: พระจันทร์กาแฟโบราณถุงกระดาษ
review_1_text: Big bag of iced tea. Fast and prompt service.
review_2_text: Good value, rich taste
review_3_text: Large, satisfying glass at a cheap price.
review_4_text: Complete ten, get one free

name: O-KAY coffee & tea
review_1_text:
Great little coffee shop, that serves a great Cha Thai. Love the way they make the Tea, especially when you want it hot, it’s strong enough and not too sweet.
They have a variety of coffees, on the plan to try them.
review_2_text:
Very good coffee, with the option to choose the sugar level and whether you prefer a strong or medium coffee.

I highly recommend it; I was warmly welcomed!

It would be great if they could also add a coconut milk latte to the menu.😊
review_3_text: Coffee here is way more than “o-kay”, it’s really great and the prices are super reasonable. The staff is super friendly too. I keep coming back
review_4_text: Such good coffee and nice to be able to choose my preferred coffee roast and sweetness. Good prices and very kind shop owners.
review_5_text: Lovely place, good price , good coffee and friendly staff

name: ดารา คอฟฟี่
เปล่ง Slow Bar
review_1_text:
The specialty selected bean that you can choose! ☕️
You can find the quality coffee in cheap price. Nice owner~ also nice community here in a small kiosk.
The shop nearby bus terminal so you can walk to.
review_2_text: Best coffee in town. The boss selects and roasts all of his coffee beans. Can have drip coffee, mocha pot or espresso machine. It's just a small shop but a must try if you come to Chiang Mai! Also there is a small smoothie shop across the road for those hot days, very affordable and very high quality for both.
review_3_text: Great coffee!
review_4_text: Amazing coffe! Very professional and cool vibes
review_5_text:
This coffee shop focuses heavily on quality. We ordered a dark roast Americano with a crema on top, and it was very rich in flavor. We also tried civet coffee for the first time, and it was incredibly fragrant and smooth.
The owner also let us sample a fruity blend with a light roasted aroma. I highly recommend this shop, especially for coffee lovers passing by the area.

name: Bunny Story - คาเฟ่กระต่าย
review_1_text:
So nice :) highly recommended
Lovely bunnies
So kind owner

Dog is incredible 🤣🤣
It behaves rabbits and it looks so cute
And also : there is so tasty orange coffee
review_2_text: Rabbits are my favorite animals ever! It was a wonderful experience to see the beautiful rabbits here of all shapes and sizes ❤️ employees were so friendly.
review_3_text: Amazing cafe with very cute bunnies and dogs! The drinks were delicious, and the service was impeccable. Very nice owner who made us feel welcome! The bunnies were adorable and well taken care of. The 2 dogs were very sweet and loved to be pet. Would definitely recommend it if you are a bunny lover!
review_4_text: An absolute must visit! The owner is so lovely, and as soon as you come in you’re greeted by her sweet dog cookie! She does bark when you get there which might make people who don’t know dogs nervous, but that’s just her way of saying hello! Food and drinks are delicious and the service is very fast. I sat in the pen with the rabbits who are all clearly very well looked after, very very friendly jumping up onto my lap! Would 100% recommend for animal lovers
review_5_text: It's one of the cutest cafés in town. It's a bit far off the center, but I totally recommend you come here! The menu is in Thai, but the owner can speak a bit of English. Prices are decent as well. But the highlights are the bunnies in the back and Cookie, the owner's dog. The animals are well-behaved, and you can feed the bunnies with some pre-cut carrots for ca. 20 Baht. There aren't many customers around noon. However, the café is packed with students from a nearby school in the afternoon, but we didn't mind them. There is a lot of heart to this place 🩷

name: The Sun กาแฟโบราณถุงกระดาษ
review_1_text:
I ordered iced coffee with jelly. It was run by two lovely girls with lovely smiles.
The prices were reasonable, and the atmosphere made it easy for foreigners who didn't speak the language to order.
I highly recommend it. 🙏🏻‎✨
Iced coffee with jelly: 20 baht
review_2_text: Cheap and good, very fast.
review_3_text: Affordable and good quality – it really does exist!
review_4_text: Selling things and relying on parking on the main road, but the general public is prohibited from parking and is chased away to park elsewhere. May you prosper.
review_5_text: Delicious and rich

name: Slow Coffee
review_1_text:
What a cool and unusual little spot that has delicious coffee.
Served with heart and of course, a smile. We got complimentary pea water drinks upon arrival! Go and say hello and enjoy a good brew

name: ร้านชินชา ไข่มุกตักเอง
I'm Avocado & Smoothies
review_1_text: Cutest smoothie shop off the beaten path. A cool, tiny respite from the heat for an avocado coconut smoothie no sugar no milk on request. They can add more coconut water for 10 baht or just regular water. Adorable place, extremely friendly and helpful.
review_2_text:
Really good
Best looking avocado dish I've ever had
Best tasting avocado I've ever had
Nice lady, nice merch
Beautiful garden 😍🥑
review_3_text:
The best smoothie I’ve ever had❤️ This place has lots of really special + tasty + healthy smoothies. Highly recommend “avocado&coconut smoothie” or “purple sweet potato&Avocado smoothie”🥑
Really cozy vibe and so kind🥰 Must visit place in Chiangmai !!!!!
review_4_text: The coconut milk recommended by the cafe owner was so delicious. Strong creamy similar to avocado The best coconut milk I've ever tried in Thailand!
review_5_text: Golden Gem of Chiang Mai! Best vegetarian avocado breakfast ever :) If you're serching for healthy start of the day - that is the place!

name: Click Online Coffee By Moka Pot
review_1_text: If you want to experience the taste of a moka pot, come here. It's great.

name: THE Y SMART COFFEE
review_1_text: The coffee is good. The guy who make the coffee also very passionate about it. I mean, look at the bunny. How come you not love it. ♥️♥️♥️
review_2_text: Really good place to spend time while you wait for a bus or do some laptop work. They have lot of electric plugs and nice staff and comfortable chairs.
review_3_text: Very kind and Good coffee..
review_4_text: Lovely coffee!
review_5_text: Closed on two occasions we’ve tried

name: S…Sip coffee
review_1_text: the coffee is amazing! the shop is located right next to the bus terminal and opens super early - so in case you need amazing coffee right after a long bus ride, that's the place to be! the owner pi noi (i hope i write it the right way) is a cute, lovely person, who made everything to make my stay as comfy as possible! i will definitely come back as soon as possible!
review_2_text: Absolutely fantastic drinks and the service was amazing. Noi is such a lovely person and her coffee shop is the first thing open and it’s only 2 minutes away from the station ! We had a Thai tea and coffee. But the real star here is noi, she is so friendly and helpful. Gave us lots of recommendations for things to do in Chiang mai !
review_3_text:
Best location for relaxing and chill with coffee and unique. The owner her name is Noi, she is very freindly (Language barrier is not interrupting her kind and service mind at all.

Love
review_4_text: We first noticed the shop while walking and stopped for a watermelon smoothie and it was soooooooo soooo sooo good that we had to double back for another one and I had to write a review for her she’s so sweet 🥹
review_5_text: The owner was super kind and the smoothies were great. she even recommended a Ganesha statue nearby

name: Sweets for gods Cafe
review_1_text: Cosy yet elegant, atmospheric little place to eat laddu while looking out at Ganesha.  Both masala chai tea and mango and coconut laddu were rich in flavour, the latter filling with its grainy texture. 150baths.
review_2_text: A beautiful little spot and the masala chai is lovely
review_3_text: This place is a hidden gem! The coffee was prime quality and taste, the place is so comfy and the prices are truly cheap. I definitely recommend to visit this place
review_4_text: Good Vibes!  I met a new friend from England. This place very well:)
review_5_text: It has this certain humbled, regal aesthetic. Felt welcomed and although they don’t have a full menu they offer delightful & bright sweet snacks for a moment of pleasure during your day. I will be recording this one as a recommended option in Chiang Mae for meetings, computer work, writing, & relaxing. Not to mention it shares a lot with a beautiful temple. This is a secret little place to keep in your heart.

name: Good Day Coffee กู๊ดเดย์คอฟฟี่ - สันกู่เหล็ก
review_1_text:
One of my favourite coffee’s in Chiang mai! Their dark roast is superb. I used to visit their hatch on Suthep road, near Nimman, and was delighted to find they’d opened a little venue near my work.

Cool and bright decor inside, there are seats but it’s mainly a takeout spot. If you’re in the area and want a coffee, this place will not disappoint. Also does wonderful selection of tea and other drinks.
review_2_text: They offer three levels of coffee roasting, along with very friendly prices for this area. 👍👍
review_3_text:
I'm in love with the drinks at this shop 🍵☕️🥤
The shop is decorated adorably, and the owner is kind.
The quality is worth the price 🥰
review_4_text: The shopkeepers are friendly, lovely, and very kind.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious. There's seating available. It's clean and tidy. There's also a restroom. Highly recommended!

name: Doipui Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
I give Doi Pui Coffee 4 stars. Reason is that the Americano Orange is of really good quality, made with fresh oranges! Really nice.

The service of this place is okay. The only thing what I don't get it why, when the shop is empty, they don't serve the coffee; you need to pick it up.

The atmosphere is, actually, not okay. It's old and really needs to be cleaned and refreshed. The furniture is old and broke.

I really think when the owner invests a bit in renovation, there will be more customers.

The location is perfect , just opposed the bus stations 2 and 3.
review_2_text:
Run away from this cafe!! Like a scam place
They put free wifi in front of the shop but I urgently need to charge my battery for work to send my email. But they charge 20 baht for phone and laptop 40 baht!!

which I already ordered some drink which just a cheap fake green tea but i know we need to order smth the  can use a wifi and charger.

They dont put this sign in front of the shop even I’m Thai but this cafe is way too greedy and don’t communicate clearly

Anyway it can still alive in this business as only they are quite close to bus terminal

By the way, their drink also quite expensive and cheap quality already
