review_3_text: Nice little coffee shop. Very good on a hot day because it is cold and dark inside. Located next to bus terminal 2 and 3. Coffee tastes different. Friendly professional service
review_4_text:
The signs inside clearly state that charging costs 20 Baht for 1 hour. But we were then informed that charging for 15 minutes (as that's all the time we had to drink our coffee before getting the bus) would cost 20 Baht. That equates to 80 Baht per hour....the signs are very misleading, and do not mention any minimum charge.

No toilet is available for customers. There is a bathroom there, but the guy said that it is only for him and customers cannot use it.
review_5_text:
Good for waiting a bus time with cool AC.
Cafe late and one piece of butter toast 80 baht. But no toilet.

name: Bakery by Daeng
review_1_text:
While waiting for our bus for Chiang Rai, we got some beverages and bread to go from here.

Their Thai milk tea was good. It has strong tea flavor balanced out by the milk and a little sweetness. Their iced coffee was strong as well. We also bought a few packs of bread. It was good decision and we had something to munch on during the bus long bus ride.

name: Jino Coffee
review_1_text: This is a great cafe at the Bus Station in Chiang Mai. It's situated just a few steps across the Bus Station car park. They make delicious iced coffee and they offer hot meals. You can sit on the seats provided under shade which is appreciated 🙏🏻The food is delicious, made fresh and have great prices. The ladies working there are very welcoming and helpful. 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻☕☕☕🍛🍜
review_2_text: Very good cafe, friendly service, and reasonable prices. It takes a few minutes to get there, but the quality and hospitality make up for it. I would come back for a coffee and a toasted sandwich.

name: Stan’s Cafe
review_1_text: The coffee is very nice, good quality beans. Price is surprisingly very good (50-100baht). Nice atmosphere.
review_2_text: I liked this place. Sat here drinking coffee and drawing for hours, really enjoyed it :)
review_3_text: Really nice coffee shop with super friendly employees! Highly recommend :)
review_4_text: There are a variety of coffees to choose from, and the prices are very cute. The decorations are in a soothing tone, and there's a big teddy bear too. It's really cute! ✨🧸✨
review_5_text: A very friendly welcome. Delicious coffee, made with love. Delicious cheesecake with various flavors. We were served homemade cantuccini with our coffee. The owners and staff are proud of their business, and rightly so.

name: Rise&Bloom Coffee (Star Avenue 7)
review_1_text: I was recommended this spot by a Korean traveler I met in Pai, and I’m so glad I followed their advice. This isn’t just a coffee shop; it’s a masterclass in craft. The owner is incredibly passionate and clearly a specialist in the field—their knowledge of beans and brewing is deep, yet they are so humble and dedicated to supporting local farmers. You can taste the quality and the heart in every cup. If you're looking for a coffee experience that supports the community and satisfies the soul, do not miss this place.
review_2_text: The coffee is really delicious. I can’t believe it tastes this good even when brewed with an espresso machine! Next time, I’d like to try it as a drip coffee. A friend recommended this place, and I’m glad I came — I really enjoyed it.
review_3_text: Cute small coffee shop. Nice barista. I've ordered light roasted cappuccino with oat milk. It was good .
review_4_text: Of you are coming to Chiang Mai Bus Terminal you just have to come here also. Amazing taste of coffee, barista knows all about the products that he is selling. Ask him any question about the coffee culture in the North Thailand, recommendations, buy some coffee and enjoy the rest of your day.
review_5_text: a small, quiet and cosy café near the bus terminal in Chiang Mai. excellent coffee and a small selection of cakes (to eat in or take away).

name: coco house
review_1_text: Nice
review_2_text:

The shop has seating, free Wi-Fi, and you can also take your order home. Coconut pudding, coconut jelly, fresh coconut water, and blended coconut drinks are all made from
100% fragrant coconuts, with no preservatives added. Every step of the production process is clean and safe.

name: Star Coffee (Supalai Monte)
review_1_text: This quaint cafe is a hidden gem. The owner Mr Lee is a wonderful man who is extremely happy to help you with just about anything you need.  There’s delicious fruit shakes, coffees, a variety of iced drinks, an assortment of food and so much more.  If you get a chance to stop by be sure to meet the owner and say hello.  He’s a delightful man and your day will be better and brighter as a result of your visit here 👍🙏🤗
review_2_text:
Super bitter coffee. I think it is too roasted! You need to change the brand guys 😳😟
Tried many times. All the same 😔
review_3_text: The owner is very friendly and helpful. Everything I had on my 3 or 4 visits here was very good. The coffee was always excellent.
review_4_text: Great coffee and great service for a cheap price
review_5_text: Very tasty ! Thank u for the best coco I ever drink!

name: ร้านกาแฟสร้างสรรค์3

review_1_text:
First time being here and this place was great! Didnt expect it to be that spacious but it is. High ceiling makes it great.

Great food selection with both Thai and western and of course great taste 😋Coffee was great as well. Plenty of parking and seating areas both indoor and outdoor. Great for any group size with friends, family or a date. Large table for working as well.

Will definitely come back!
review_2_text:
Vaanaa ​Cafe​ &​ Bistro

review_4_text: Great first stop after arriving in Chiang Mai. Conveniently located a few minutes away from the bus station this cafe provides great food, great ambiance, great service. They also have wifi and sockets. Will definitely come back!
review_5_text: If you're looking for a comfortable retreat, Vaanaa Cafe & Bistro is worth checking out. The interior is wonderfully airy and spacious, and the air conditioning keeps things refreshingly cool. We were very impressed with the tasty desserts and refreshing drinks they offer. The only area for improvement would be staff training, as they struggled to provide much information about the menu. Nevertheless, it's a generally positive experience and a great spot to unwind

name: Oxygen Coffee Studio - The BASE Height
review_1_text: LOVE this little coffee shop. We get iced matcha lattes and iced lattes every time and they are ALWAYS perfect and super affordable. The baristas are so so kind and it is nice that it's downstairs from our condo, very convenient. Such a treat!
review_2_text: Great place to grab breakfast. Fast service and good quality. Definitely recommended.
review_3_text:

I’ll change my review once you fix this!

review_5_text: Oxygen Coffee Studio is a gem worth visiting! The staff are friendly, and above all, the coffee is delicious. The shop is located next to a 7/11, and while it might feel like you’re stepping onto private property, it’s fully open to the public. A real recommendation if you’re in the area—it’s just a short 4-5 minute walk from the bus station. Prices are good, around 60bath for a cappuccino

review_2_text:
คาเฟ่เปิดใหม่โซน CBP (ร้านอยู่ข้างคลินิก Dr. Chen พอดี) ร้านกว้าง บรรยากาศน่ารัก อบอุ่น ตกแต่งสไตล์มินิมอลโทนสีขาว+ไม้สีเหลืองอ่อน เหมือนคาเฟ่สวย ๆ จากเมืองจีน ที่ผมสั่งไปมีชานมเกาลัดคาราเมล อร่อยหอมใบชามากไม่เหมือนชานมทั่วไปที่นมกลบหมดแทบไม่ได้กลิ่นใบชา หวานพอดีไม่เลี่ยน มีเกาลัดกรุบ ๆ ให้เคี้ยว โดยรวมถือว่าอร่อยสุด ๆ เป็นเมนูเครื่องดื่มที่สร้างสรรค์มาก กับบะหมี่แห้งหมูสับ (พนักงานเสริฟบอกว่าชื่อ ‘วั่นจ๋าเมี่ยน’) เมนูนี้ก็ดี ให้ปริมาณเยอะมาก เส้นเหนียวนุ่มรสชาติแนวอาหารจีนแท้ ๆ แบบทำให้คนจีนทาน  ทางร้านเอาทีรามิสุกับยำสาหร่ายจีนมาให้ลองทานด้วยครับ บอกว่าเป็นเมนูเทสก่อนก่อนวางขาย น่ารักมาก ๆ รสชาติทุกเมนูที่ผมได้ทานคือรู้เลยว่าตั้งใจให้ลูกค้า เชฟหล่อ+เฟรนด์ลี่ ประสบการณ์ครั้งแรกประทับใจมาก มาซ้ำอีกแน่นอนครับ

A newly opened café in the CBP zone, the shop is conveniently located right next to Dr. Chen's clinic. The shop is roomy, lovely, and warm, decorated in a minimalist style with white and light yellow wood tones, reminiscent of a beautiful café from China. I ordered a chestnut caramel milk tea, which was delightful and had a strong tea aroma, unlike typical milk teas where the milk often overwhelms the tea flavour. It was perfectly sweetened, not overly sweet, and included crunchy chestnuts for added texture. Overall, it was extremely delicious.

The café offered a very creative drink menu, along with a dish of dry noodles with minced pork (the waiter referred to it as 'Wan Zha Mian'). This dish was also excellent, with a generous portion. The noodles were perfectly chewy and soft, and the taste was authentically Chinese, as if it were tailored specifically to Chinese tastes. The café also offered complimentary tiramisu and Chinese seaweed salad, as these dishes were being test-marketed before being officially added to the menu. Every dish I tried seemed intentionally crafted to please customers.

The chef was handsome and friendly, enhancing the overall pleasant experience. My first visit was very impressive. I will absolutely return!
review_3_text: Delicious and not too salty~ The drinks were great too, I'll definitely come again next time.
review_4_text: Wonton dumplings, chestnut milk tea, traditional Chinese flavor NICE
review_5_text: It was delicious! Authentic Chinese flavor.

name: ShinefoonCoffeeHouse
review_1_text: Great morning coffee, friendly barrister, good prices, very simple....

name: MEENCOFFEE
review_1_text: Came close to closing time and got a Thai tea to go. She pulled the tea from the espresso machine. The flavour was intense, smooth, and so fragrant. Definitely coming back. Barista was also friendly and warm.
review_2_text: Good vibes with great coffee ☕️
review_3_text: Great coffee and nice service!
review_4_text: A good cozy cafe with good coffee and friendly staff
review_5_text:
Best value coffee in the neighborhood/area or even Chiang Mai.

I'm a regular customer. I've been visiting daily for a year now.
The owner/barista is always nice to all her customers; I've never experienced an unhappy or unsatisfied customer.
The cafe is clean, cozy, and has a warm atmosphere. Give this place a visit once, and you won't be disappointed with the taste of the coffee or the value. You might even become a regular here.
The coffee tastes great, and considering the price and quality per cup, it's definitely the best value in Chiang Mai. I've been a regular customer for a year, and it's consistently delicious every time. The owner takes great care of the shop, and she has many regular customers who love it. I've never heard of a customer being dissatisfied with the drinks or service from the owner in all the years I've been here.

The shop is clean, and the atmosphere is warm. If you have the chance to try the drinks here, I guarantee you'll become a regular customer.

name: KANA Coffee
review_1_text: my goto place in CM for hot cappuccino and flat whites. For the price, quality is up with the best. The home made kanom jeen nam niao is a delicious bargain if you want a quick grab to eat.
review_2_text:
1.)Coffee taste good
2.)nice service

review_4_text: The interior design and atmosphere aren’t particularly impressive, especially compared to other coffee spots in Chiang Mai. But the coffee is absolutely amazing - easily my personal favorite in the city.
review_5_text: Opened recently by friendly young Thai couple. Best Coffee in CM- CBP!

name: Roastniyom Coffee - Chiang Mai Business Park
review_1_text: Inside Jing Jai market. Frappe not bad. Orange cake at 75 baht is reasonable! Nice cake. The almond caramel cake is nice too.
review_2_text: Lovely little cafe in Chiang Mai, many options of coffee to choose from and very delicious! Employees are very kind and respectful. Cool AC and plenty of seating.
review_3_text:

I'm this large coffee shop.  Good coffee and the cheese cake was Pretty good too.
review_4_text: I love this coffee shop! The coffee is great, perfect to work in, and the best part is the staff. They are all wonderful
review_5_text: Always great coffee as usual. Hidden gem on the otherside of town that I rarely go it.

name: Kana Coffee

Balanced. Velvety. Effortlessly good.
For 65 baht, this Dirty is hard to beat.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious and the service is excellent.
review_3_text: Receive half each
review_4_text: The coffee and pastries are very delicious.

name: Always Cafe&Bistro

The service is really kind even though the workers don't speak English they make their best effort to be nice. Also it's a great place to work with plenty of space. My only regret is not having found it earlier.

review_4_text:

review_5_text: Mango Bingsu not too sweet. Highly recommended 👍🏻

name: Khamsaen Cafe (คำแสน คาเฟ่)
review_1_text:
The restaurant is truly elegant and stylish – definitely one of the nicest places around. The design is beautiful, with a pool and trees all around, and you can sit outside, enjoy a coffee and a dessert in a very relaxing atmosphere. The vibe is absolutely 5/5 – calm, elegant, and perfect for a break or meeting with friends.

The food was good, but not amazing. We both ordered pasta – I had lasagna and my partner had spaghetti Alfredo – unfortunately, both dishes were a bit watery, so the taste didn’t quite match the beautiful setting. Still, it wasn’t bad at all, just not as great as we expected from such a luxurious place.

Overall, it’s definitely worth visiting, at least for a coffee and dessert, to enjoy the atmosphere. Highly recommended for the vibe and surroundings.
review_2_text: The food was terrible and overpriced, with many hidden charges. Management should clearly include all costs in the menu prices so customers aren't made uncomfortable by a 10% service charge on top of 7% VAT. The same meal would cost around 30 THB just down the road. 190THB+19THB+14.63THB TOTAL 223.63THB it's just a scam way of running a food business.
review_3_text:
Whoever owns this place needs to change staff immediately before they run such a beautiful place into the dirt with bad reviews resulting from the terrible service. If you can't change the staff, consider removing the 10% gratuity fee so that they actually have some incentive to do their job correctly.

Our company of 2 adults and 2 children ordered about 4 food items from the menu, and then the older male waiter asked several times something like "but maybe you also want pizza?" after we ordered. I understand you get 10% of the bill as gratuity but don't make it so stupidly obvious you want us to order more. He also did this strange thing that when he poured the water he didn't put the glasses near us and left them on the other side of the double table.

After bringing the food, the waiter disappeared and never came back. When I went to get the bill, I saw him looking at some videos in the phone with a younger staff member. There was one other table in the restaurant besides us, and he was just openly being lazy. No plates were cleared from our table for about 20 minutes after we finished the food, or after we paid the bill. We talked with another table about the service, and they also said it was terrible, but I can't remember what issue they had.

I snapped a picture of the waiter as best as I could, as well as the pic of our table uncleared.
review_4_text:
Food: 0/5. poor quality, badly cooked, and overpriced.
Salmon was overcooked and dried, no taste. Sauce was just put in the microwave, no taste, oily.
Pizza: frozen and just reheated, used canned ingredients as topping on top. Wow.
Probably one of the worst meal I’ve had in a long time, and super overpriced too.

Service: 0/5, no hello, no thank you, no smile. This is very rare. I haven’t experienced poor service like this in a long time. We also asked for chili flakes, and never got it.. Staff don’t care about customers but love to talk with other employees. The only 2 words the staff said to us was “READY?” And “SCAN or Card?” And you have to pay extra for service charge 😂 what a joke.

We’re are happy to try this place so we know how bad it is, and we will never come back.

Atmosphere: 4/5 : nice and beautiful with outside seating, nice old Lanna style. But the staff behavior and the poor food quality ruined the experience, to be honest. Please avoid this place. You have much better options for beautiful cafe and restaurant around Chiang Mai. :)
review_5_text: Food was cold and nothing special. I had better Thai food at the local market than in this place. Service was really poor. We had to ask to be served otherwise they just ignored us. Cocktails were one big disaster. The restaurant looks really good and stylish but there were like hundreds of mosquitoes so you can't even enjoy your dinner because you constantly fight mosquitoes. At the end we refused to pay for the service charge because we were not happy with the food, cocktails and service but the lady said we had to pay for it because there is no way to take the service charge off the bill. Also we were in Thailand for over a month, everyday eating in the restaurants and paying a similar amount for food but this place had some special high tax because just for this tax and service charge we paid in total almost 500 THB. I wouldn't recommend this place. Waste of money.

name: เต่าบิน หน้าวชิ
review_1_text: It was unclean; there were a lot of ants in the drink.

name: TONG KAFE
review_1_text: Great coffee and ideal stop while enjoying the views. Friendly staff and a great atmosphere ☺️
review_2_text: Just dropped off for coffee, which was really very good. What makes it stand out however it was extremely clean toilets. Owner asks you to remove your shoes before you go in, and I think that makes all the difference.
review_3_text: Basic coffee shop. Friendly simple man serves and makes coffee.   Coffee taste is good and the beans are grown locally.  This shop will does not make specialty coffees like cappuccino.  Expresso and americano.   Short selection of drink.  Some beer is in the refrigerator.  Cool weather at this location. 10 minutes past doi suthep.  10 minutes before you reach Doi Pui.  No food at this location. There are other shops to buy at food nearby.
review_4_text:
We went up there by accident and as our kids were sleeping decided to get a cup of coffee.
It was the best Mocha cup we've had in Thailand this trip so far and we were lucky enough to experience this eerie atmosphere while sipping our coffees
review_5_text: Amazing place on top of the mountain few kilometer pass doi sutep, nice and easy place to chat and get out of the sun, right infront. of the parking of the bubhing place, cheap and strong coffee, a cat that was the king of the moment, and lovely person making the coffee, would definite go back, and recomend it to all.

name: Sai silver
review_1_text:
Unexpected oasis of Kyoto-esque elegance and calm in an alley in Suthep.

Extensive selection of matcha in their Slow bar, a large architecturally-pleasing space that manages to feel surprisingly intimate, restrained even, and even their clayware ‘cups’ are exquisite.

Tip 1: there’s an 80baht entrance fee, ostensibly to prevent hordes of IG-hunters trampling over the grounds. The ticket can be redeemed as a discount for your drink.

Tip 2: 80baht ticket only partially deters crowds so go early. At 10am the space was serene, full of book readers, solo matcha lovers, small groups engaged in polite chatter. By 11.30, the gardens were overrun by selfie-seekers and tourist vans depositing loud groups and noisy children.
review_2_text: Make sure to stop here for a Thai tea after heading up to the temple. The owner is lovely and the drink we incredible. Great music as well which really set the vibe. I nice oasis in the chaos of other tourist shops.
review_3_text: Not just a stand.. It's a full fledged independent coffee shop with a character out of step from the touristy shops near by. Nice view of the forest from the back of the shop and, most critical, an excellent cup of coffee.
review_4_text: Great place for coffee right next to Doi Suthep. Cool setting and hospitable. Recommended
review_5_text: Awesome coffee and drink art, cost and a great vibe! Definitely stop by here before/after the temple

name: BK Coffee House
review_1_text: Excellent Thai milk tea
review_2_text: Small cafe..great coffee..smoothies and other drinks are available..excellent service..excellent prices
review_3_text:
Small, very tidy shop with a high-quality espresso machine. They offer coffees, smoothies, and ice cream. You're welcome to bring food from the shop next door to your table. They also had vegan milk alternatives.

We had a delicious Americano and passionfruit smoothie and would definitely come back.
review_4_text: The drink shop here is pretty good. After buying my drinks, I went to the gift shop next door. It's small, but it has a lot of stuff, especially at very good prices. You can save a lot of money by just turning the corner. The owner is also very friendly.
review_5_text: Great places for a quick coffee before sightseeing :)

name: ฮักดอย คอฟฟี่
review_1_text: The coffee with milk so smooth
review_2_text: A place where you can enjoy a cup of coffee while looking down from the entrance of Doi Suthep Temple~

name: Mr. Waffles (Waffel-Cafe)
review_1_text:
Nice price and really good waffles
Missing a bin to throw the trash in
review_2_text:
ENGLISH
Mr. Waffles offers super delicious waffles on the way to or from the temple. The many variations are each freshly prepared.

The employees were very friendly and the product tasted great - what more could you want?

Here you pay cash - enjoy the little refreshment.

Feel free to follow my Google Maps profile, check out my other reviews and be sure to visit foodadvisorblog!
