review_3_text: This waffle is the most delicious.
review_4_text: it is delicious
review_5_text: beautiful

name: Coffee JEANS
review_1_text: Good coffee at a good price and a nice chill spot to relax and recharge after the climb.
review_3_text: nice coffee, you can visit temple and then take a rest here.
review_4_text: Iced oat latte 10/10
review_5_text: Amazing cappuccino with amazing people, musician included

name: Enjoy Coffee Bar
review_1_text: Tried  Banana Coconut smoothie and Mango Pineapple smoothie, they were the best smoothies that I had ever. The staff is also so polite and welcoming. Definitely worth a try :)
review_2_text: It's a nice little cafe for a quick rest stop after visiting the temple. We ordered the Espresso Sunrise, which was an "interesting " concoction, a popular drink in Thailand. Nice area to chill, but wish they sell some other snacks other than Sticky Rice Mango.
review_3_text: Great coffee. Was open before 7.00am and that was a bonus. Good way to kick start the day with good views.
review_4_text: Great local craft coffee with alternative milk selection
review_5_text: Cute coffee bar with a view and breeze. Excellent coffee and friendly owner.

name: Raan Beem Coffee
review_1_text: Very delicious and cheap coffee. Nice staff. And they have OAT MILK 😍
review_2_text: Great fresh fruit shakes for low money on lower end of straits to Doi Suthep.
review_3_text: Simple place that serves nice drinks. We ordered a mango smoothie - yum! And and orange juice espresso. FUN!
review_4_text: Amazing dragon fruit smoothie! Make sure you stop here if you’re close and thirsty!!! 🙌
review_5_text: Got the mango smoothie, ice looked clean and bought externally. Very refreshing after waking around!

name: Suan Son Coffee
review_1_text: A new landmark viewpoint with a café, park lodge, cheap price, full quality 💯
review_2_text: What a nice place, not crowded :)
review_3_text: The taste is very bad, and it’s quite expensive. I recommend trying a different café instead.
review_4_text: It's worth visiting like that.
review_5_text: Beautiful calm place

name: Law Coffee Club ลอว์คอฟฟี่คลับ คณะนิติศาสตร์ มช.
review_1_text: The student cafe offers a variety of menus, including coffee, tea, and soda. There are also some seats available for studying, working, or discussing with your team. However, the ambiance can be quite loud.
review_2_text: I really like this place…so much better than the “livin’ the dream” farang place close by.  Nice working area, many students and great staff serving good drinks.  It’s in a nice walking area and always enjoyable to visit.
review_3_text: Great coffee quality! I used them at home as well. Good employees :)
review_4_text: Very lively environment with a lot of students. Good for getting work done when you want people around!
review_5_text: Probably the best coffee shop inside CMU.

name: ร้านต้นไผ่
Living A Dream ร้านกาแฟอ่างแก้ว
review_1_text: My favorite cafe in Chiang Mai. Location is  perfect. Beautiful view. Good choice of food and drinks. I always have coconut. Green tea latte with almond milk is my second choice.
review_2_text: This restaurant is directly across from the water, so you get a great view. The staff speaks very good english. The food is always delicious. They have indoor and outdoor seating. We really enjoy this place.
review_3_text:
The atmosphere is very beautiful i recommend going here if you are in the lake's area. I got an iced espresso and an almond croissant. The croissant was ok, not too bad not too good, I enjoyed it but would not come back for it.
The iced Espresso i got was an iced latte, I asked why i have milk inside my drink and they told me that I should have ordered an iced Americano and not an espresso because the iced espresso is actually an iced latte. It is not specified in the menu, I don't know if that's is a cultural thing but i would ask next time if my drink has milk inside of it.
review_4_text:
The coffee shop with the best view in Chiang Mai.
I went there the other day, and the service was excellent, especially from the cashier. The food was delicious as well. I highly recommend the fruit granola yogurt and a hot caramel latte.
review_5_text: Free bathroom even if you don’t buy anything! They are really friendly and the food and drinks are solid with a super awesome view of the water and mountain.

name: Ta Lon Suan Nom
review_1_text:
This place has fantastic coffee and a nice garden setting where you can sit in the shade and hear the sounds of animals at the zoo, which is just next door. This morning I thought I would try their yogurt/fruit bowl for breakfast, and was super disappointed to find that it was some kind of icy dish with a tiny bit of fruit, topped by a sugary syrup so sweet it could break your teeth. I tried to scoop out just the fruit, but there was so much syrup I couldn’t eat it. If you like *really sweet* desserts, you might like this dish. But when I see the word “yogurt,” I am expecting something a little tart. If the menu included a description I could have anticipated this and just stuck with my coffee. That said, the staff is friendly, the service is great, and I will for sure come back for more delicious coffee!
❤️☕️❤️
review_2_text: My husband and I stopped by this very cozy place for iced coffee and iced thai tea. It was a great surprise. There is wifi, the attendants speak perfectly English and the drinks were good. We had a great morning in the garden, enjoying the outside area of the cafe.
review_3_text:
Ordered toast.

This wasn’t toasted. The bread looked like it saw a toaster from across the room and decided that was enough effort for the day.

The cheese was just placed on top like it was waiting for instructions. Just soft, pale bread holding a square of existential disappointment.

Please eat somewhere else.
review_4_text: I had a really good salad! A lot of ingredients and nice dressing. Atmosphere is nice in the yard and stuff are kind.
review_5_text: Very nice peaceful cafe with a nice garden area. The drinks are good and the food is also decent as far as what i tried. I liked the mushed potatoes especially. It’s a good spot when you feel like having a slow and relaxing time. I also tried their pork burger and it was decent enough and i liked its garlic flavor.

name: Pak café
review_2_text: very cheap
review_3_text: I was visiting Chiang Mai University and was so out of it from the blazing sun that I had an iced Americano...it was the best...and it was only 35 baht. The portions were generous and the taste was delicious. Two large dogs were also wandering around in front of the store, so gentle and cute.
review_4_text: It's quiet and friendly, but it's a shame there's no Wi-Fi.
review_5_text: Dangerous dog

name: Juicy Juice x moh coffee
review_1_text: came here everyday after class during 2023-24. best milk tea in this campus
review_2_text: Nice small coffee shop inside chiang mai university. Coffee 25 bht

name: กาแฟสดรัฐศาสตร์(กาแฟสังคม)
review_1_text: Cheap but good taste coffee and tea
review_2_text: Good drinks, student-friendly prices. Bring your own cup and get a 3 baht discount.
review_3_text: A glass of green tea is only 20 baht. It's cheap and delicious.

name: CMU Cafe and More
review_1_text: The best thing i love in here is the feeling. Very big university with a lot of very old trees. Coffee is good and then we can take a electric car going around the uni 🤎☘️
review_2_text: It's a Cafe feeling like camping in the park. They prepared the camper seats and tables for us and we could sit there all day long.
review_3_text: Pleasant, peaceful park-like  place to enjoy coffee or smoothies.  Quality of drinks are high.  Plenty of easy access parking
review_4_text:
Have always enjoyed stopping here for good coffee as I wait for our daughter who is attending university here. The coffee is good, the staff are polite and they normally serve fresh cake and pastries, but unfortunately today, they fail miserably
Their muffins are dry and days old, even after being heated up in the microwave. I loathe sending back food in Thailand and yet hate wasting food money on unedible food.
I asked the staff for cream, that it might help the taste or lack of and ask they soulful suggest,was I buy another dessert
It's all very frustrating when you find a place you rave about and recommend and then come back and suffer for it
Maybe it's a change of ownership or new staff or too early in the day
I dislike giving bad staff reviews. It's not like they are earning in these jobs, and chances are  they themselves are students, earning weekly pocket money
Maybe it's the I am older and cantankerous, so take my review with a pinch of salt, I think I just needed to vent
No one died
I'll live to drink coffee and eat fresh pastries again, just maybe not here
review_5_text: **CMU Cafe and More** is a great spot for anyone looking for a cozy place to relax or catch up on some work while enjoying a delicious coffee or snack. Located on the Chiang Mai University campus, this café has a chill and laid-back atmosphere, making it perfect for students and visitors alike. They offer a wide range of beverages, from specialty coffees to refreshing iced drinks, along with a variety of light bites and pastries. The café is known for its friendly service and convenient location, making it an ideal spot for a quick break between classes or a peaceful place to unwind. It’s a must-try if you’re on the CMU campus!

name: Dice Club ChiangMai
review_1_text: Probably my favorite game shop in Chiang Mai for playing. Reasonably priced per hour or day, knowledgeable staff, well-priced drinks, and lots of games to choose from! They have both Thailand English instructions for most games.
review_2_text: Huge variety of games. 50 baht/hour or you can get a day pass for $129. If you're thirsty,  get a 1 hour pass with drink for $99 (+29 for each additional hour). Enjoyed our time there!
review_3_text:
In the older days, this cafe is good but now they treated customers like a bit*h.
What kind of board game shop is that?
review_4_text: Great staff, large game selection and cute animals
review_5_text:
A lot of broad game !
Sound good ❤️❤️

name: Mii Cafe' Organic Coffee
review_1_text: Mii Cafe touts itself for serving organic coffee, and based on that one cuppa I had, I think they're pretty good. I don't think it's the kind of cafe you'd make a trip down to, more like a quick stopover or for a takeaway. Not much seating as I can tell, and it's a shared location with another business renting cameras. With that said, still pretty darn good coffee and because of their more than reasonable price I give it a 4 star rating. Photo of their chalkboard menu correct as at mid January 2020.
review_2_text: The coffee was just perfect, one of the best I've had in Chiang Mai!

name: Mac Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: This shop is so friendly and cute, the staff are very nice and recommend the products very well. I had no knowledge about what I wanted and they gave me very great advice! They take care of their costumers very well and the price is great:)
review_2_text: Great service. The staff gave very good advice.
review_3_text: I went in for a 2nd hand MacBook but walked out empty-handed because of the high prices. The woman who helped us was very kind and knowledgeable though, and it’s a cute cafe.
review_4_text: Mac Cafe in Chiang Mai offers a peaceful retreat despite its busy roadside location. The atmosphere is pleasant, complemented by friendly and accommodating staff. The coffee is particularly noteworthy, making it a worthwhile stop for both a great brew and a tech check-out.
review_5_text: Awesome little spot with great people and a supremely cute Pomeranian. We were told my laptop could be fixed for super cheap and were so impressed with the honesty and absence of profit motive of the staff we ended up buying an M1 for a fantastic price instead. Tom, the owner, is Aussie but speaks Thai and has a local Thai employee as well. Thrilled to have an upgraded laptop now! They make custom tea and espresso drinks at the cafe also :) Come here for fixes n great deals on sweet tech! 💯

name: Hello māo café
review_1_text: Friendly, helpful staff and the cats behave well and are lovely. However, the cats were not well groomed (the fur had not been brushed) and many of them were sick with runny noses. However, I cannot know whether the cats receive medicine and are groomed later so I will still give a fair review of 3 stars. I just hope the staff finds the time to take a bit more care of the cats or, maybe give the customers brushes so they can do the grooming instead?
review_2_text:
Guys, please help the cats get better - some of them are really sick. Some have runny noses and itchy eyes.

People here have written that the cats are skinny, but I think they look that way because many of them are still teenagers and therefore appear very thin. They have free access to food.

The cat room smells terrible. When you keep multiple animals in the same room, you need to keep it clean. My feet were sticking to the floor, and I'm guessing it's because of the urine that can remain on the cats' paws. You need to wash the floors several times a day and change the litter in their litter box more often. The smell is truly terrible. For comparison, you can go to a similar place in Niman. It's spotlessly clean and there's no smell.

And of course, it's worth mentioning that some of the cats are very dirty. Because they have long hair, some of them have fecal matter under their tails. I feel so sorry for the animals that the staff and owner don't care about them.

In our parish, one of the employees was studying English with a tutor while working. It would be better if you brushed one of the cats or washed them:/
review_3_text: I had a great time at the cat café! The cats are super cute, playful, and full of energy. They all look very happy and well cared for. It was a lovely experience, I’d love to visit again!
review_4_text: Cozy cafe with delicious drink options. The orange americano and caramel macchiato tastes good. The kittens are very interactive. Got house rules before playing with cats (such as wearing socks). If you are not wearing socks, can buy a pair for 10 baht.
review_5_text:
The room has a strong smell when I arrive, happens to be their wet food feeding time shortly after I arrive. It's a bit of a mess honestly, the food bits are everywhere and that explains why there are ants and also the cats are not very clean. Just look at their fur condition and you can tell it's messy and not groomed at all, except for those in the isolation boxes.

This is also the first time I seen kittens in a cat cafe. If the customers are experienced with cats, I think it's okay but I don't think everyone who comes in have experience with cats, what's more for the dedicate kittens.

They charge 150 baht (comes with a drink) and 10 baht for their socks. I didn't even want to recycle the socks because of the food bits on the floor.

The cats are thin, when you touch them, and that's not normal when more than half of the cats are thin, they seem to have more than 30 cats, including a handful of kittens. All the cats needs a bath badly.

I saw the boss who is a Chinese PRC and she seems like also selling cats at the same time. She is friendly and easy but not sure how much training and instructions she passed on to the staff to care for the cats.

name: หยูอี่ชา เชียงใหม่ - RUYI CHA CNX
review_1_text: Lovely space with a good great tea 🤟🏿🤟🏿🤟🏿
review_2_text: We came to the restaurant and the waitress left and didnt come back.
review_3_text: Good bubble!
review_4_text: This small tea shop near Chiang Mai University is beautifully decorated in a retro Chinese style. You can dine in or take some home. There's a great photo corner for souvenirs. The tea is delicious, with prices starting at just 20 baht per cup. I'll definitely be back!
review_5_text: A small but well-designed place with many photo opportunities. It's an open-air space, but can get quite hot during the day. The drinks are average.

name: T-TEN Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: Nice latte and espresso. The Thai-style espresso is quite sweet 🤣 so keep that in mind if you prefer less sugar. Friendly service.
review_2_text: I stopped by T-Ten Cafe recently and honestly, it’s such a cozy spot. The atmosphere is super relaxed, with a simple but warm design that makes you feel comfortable right away. It’s the kind of place where you can sit for hours, either reading a book or chatting with friends.
review_3_text: We love T-TEN! The food is very tasty and the service is great. We go at least once a week. They have oat milk too which is good cause I can't drink dairy.
review_4_text:
LOVE it!
I keep coming back. The fried banana is so yummy! And they now have charging ports. Never seen these anywhere else 🥳✨
Cappuccino is strong 👍

The atmosphere, the service, and the food were all excellent.
review_5_text: Staff is very kind .. and making delicious drink ! 🩷😊☺️🥰💐😚

name: CoMMA@NEO
review_1_text: Coming out of the dentist office. We wanted to go to a cafe nearby. Since we were already parked, we went to Neo Cafe. Great selection of music and a good sound system. Electric outlets available. Good coffee.
review_2_text: Tasty "flat white", closer in flavor to a good cappucino, although lacking any velvety microfoam texture. Small coffee bar in a music store, so don't expect to get work done here, just a good cup of coffee. :)
review_3_text: Little coffee place at hifi shop
review_4_text: Music & Coffee Lover's cafe
review_5_text: Great coffee

name: Neo Entertainment Gallery
review_1_text:
Neo Entertainment Gallery locates near Ibis Hotel on Huaykaew road. The place specializes on HIFI stereo, audio equipment and turntable. Neo Entertainment also offers CDs and Vinyls for sell. The upper floors are the vinyls and artworks (thats why they are also an "gallery"). From the looks, they also have mini cafe as well on the lower floor.

Lovely attentive staff at all times during my visit.
review_2_text: Very nice ambience and great coffee
review_3_text: Quality audio/video products
review_4_text: มีทั้งหูฟัง Gadgets ลำโพง และเครื่องเสียงไฮเอนด์  บริการดี ประทับใจ มีร้านกาแฟเป็นโซนต้อนรับด้วยนะคะ เยี่ยม!
review_5_text: If you want the best sound system, you have to come here.

name: กลิ่นกาแฟภูคำ:: Klin Coffee Phucome
review_1_text: This café has a great selection of coffee and other drinks. Its location is perfect for tourists and visitors staying nearby. Situated in the heart of Chiang Mai, it offers good value for money and a cozy atmosphere.
review_2_text: Conveniently located at the corner of intersection, across the street from my hotel. The owner is a nice guy and I ordered an americano coffee. It is good.
review_3_text: Barista is a really lovely man and my iced latte was delicious!
review_4_text: Good coffee and cheap price 👍
review_5_text:
A roadside coffee shop selling exhaust fumes

is alright. The passion fruit coffee is pretty good. 👍

name: Juice Central 2
review_1_text:
One of the most impressive things about this café is how incredibly friendly the owner is 😊
Always smiling, welcoming, and easy to talk to. The atmosphere feels warm and inviting — more like visiting a friend than just stopping by a coffee shop.

The service is genuine and attentive, with great menu recommendations and no rush at all. It truly makes the whole experience even better.

Great drinks, delicious pastries, and such a lovely owner — definitely a 10/10 experience! ☕✨
review_2_text:
I regret living on the other side of town, but I'm ready to commute here every day. First of all, this place is amazing because of the friendly staff. I couldn't resist when the owner invited me in. Also, they have excellent homemade baking, which is a rarity in Thailand.

I’ll keep coming back until I’ve tried every single cake. And after that, I'll keep coming until the owner kicks me out! Great place. You should definitely check it out.
review_3_text:
This place became our morning habit. We stop in for a drink almost every day. 🫂 The owners always meet us with a smile, so warm and friendly, like visiting friends. The atmosphere is simple and kind, without any show - that is why we like to come back. The cafe owners teach us Thai words 🙏😄

The coffee is tasty and not expensive. But the best part is their homemade bakery. In Chiang Mai coffee shops it is rare to find something really homemade, fresh and warm. Here they have pies, cakes, cheesecake. My favorite is the pie with pandan - it is amazing! All is fresh and made with love.

💛 If you want not only coffee, but also a cozy place with good people and real taste - I really recommend to come here.
review_4_text: Absolutely amazing place. The atmosphere created by the crew, along with delicious coffee, smoothies, and pastries, is wonderful. The prices are very friendly. The owner (a very passionate traveller) and the rest of the staff are incredibly helpful—they are happy to give recommendations and assist with your travels. Wi-Fi is also available. One of the best places I've visited in Chiang Mai (and I've been to a lot!). Can't wait to come back!
review_5_text:
amazing fruit smoothies and muffin🥧
the boss is friendly and warm
I‘ll order another taste of fruit smoothies tomorrow🍹

name: The FAM Story
review_1_text: Decent bibimbap for 99 baht.  No small dishes, but the restaurant is really cute with lots of books.
review_2_text: It's delicious. It tastes exactly like the tteokbokki you eat in Korea. They even made the steamed buns for you!!! You have to take off your shoes before going in!! The store is clean and cool, and the owners are Korean and are really, really kind. I'll come again~!
review_3_text:
This is a place where you can eat Korean food. You can also read a book and enjoy a cup of coffee together by sharing opinions with each other in various gatherings. Please visit once. You'll feel like you're in Korea. ^^

This is a place where you can eat Korean food. You can read a book and enjoy a cup of coffee together by sharing opinions with each other in various gatherings. Please visit once. I feel like Korea well. ^^
review_4_text: Korean kimchi stew, kimbap, and ramen are so delicious.
review_5_text: When you come here, you can feel the taste and affection of Korea.

name: Miracle Coffee - Chang Khian
review_1_text:
Nice little coffee shop tucked away on this road. Reasonably priced, most iced stuff is 35 thb each and hot stuff is 25 thb each.

They give takeaway packaging to drink easily while walking. Had the iced latte and it was good, generous portion. 😊

Place is open from early morning 7am.

Recommended.
review_2_text: The taste is delicious and well-balanced. The staff are lovely. 🥰
review_3_text: The price is cheap!
review_4_text: They aren't taking my order.
review_5_text: The taste is delicious and well-rounded.

name: Mook Ju The bubble Tea
review_1_text: Went here at 8.40 and they told me they are closed, but signs say they close 9PM and the Google Maps listing says 9.30PM (all the staff are inside and busy on their phones) Very bad service 0 star
review_2_text: There are many menus that I really like. The mellow flavor of Taiwanese tea is unlike anywhere else. It's fragrant and very strong. But the most outstanding menu that I recommend you try is the Hokkaido milk brownsugar. It's so fragrant and delicious. Once you try it, you'll be hooked and will definitely want to try it again.
review_3_text:
The pearls are delicious, sweet, and fragrant, and the price is not too expensive.
But if...
you're not ready to serve, don't open yet. It's a waste of time. It's a good idea to find staff who are willing to work.
review_4_text: Umm Lukkana's bubble tea is delicious, with chewy bubbles and a perfectly balanced flavor.
review_5_text: It's very delicious. I ordered it less sweet.

name: The Teashop
review_1_text: The drinks menu is delicious, the service is excellent, the atmosphere is great, and the owner is incredibly kind. It's my absolute favorite!
review_2_text: The water tasted great! The seller, an elderly gentleman, was very kind and lovely. It's a perfect place to relax and chill. I was very impressed.
review_3_text: Because I went to compete in university sports, the shop owner was so incredibly kind 💕 and made me some free snacks. The shop owner was so kind! Thank you so much! 🙏🔥
review_4_text: The food was delicious and the service was excellent. I will definitely come back.
review_5_text: The matcha was delicious, and the atmosphere of the shop was great. I was very impressed.

name: Camp71 Chiang mai
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop, really nice coffee and one of the best honey lemon sodas we’ve had. Really cool clothes shop, you need to explore this just to see the cool things they have here, really retro, and clothing is reasonably priced.
review_2_text:
Date of Visit: August 20th

This is a café I stopped at on my way to Nimmanhaemin. I was recommended the cappuccino. I think the taste was average, but the atmosphere was very nice for working. It was the first café I visited in Chiang Mai, and I have very good memories of it.
review_3_text: Unusual specialist shop selling vintage things, including toys, clocks, sewing machines and other paraphernalia. Looks like a museum selling antique things. Very interesting shop.
review_4_text:
Tranquil place to sit and enjoy the music. Very sweet staff. Only drinks on the menu, coffee, tea and specialty sodas.
Attached to a 3 level clothing store.
review_5_text: Inside an amazing clothes shop that is also part retro museum, pinball machines, model cars by the hundreds, military models

name: Hill Cup Boutique Coffee
review_1_text: Coffee is ok, this place is at the bottom of an apartment block.  The cafe has some bench seating, little tables and couches to sit at.  Pretty fast WiFi if you’re looking to work here.  Nice and cool inside if you’re looking to escape the heat in summer.  They have a cheese tea, I want game enough to try it... #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: This place is closed. I went there after a long search because it said it was open, but it was closed. Please take note, everyone.
review_3_text:
If you like strong coffee, this is the place. The coffee is intensely strong and satisfying.
Delicious pastries, affordable prices, and ample parking. It's a shame there's no outdoor seating.
review_4_text: There are outdoor seats, but only four.

name: Drunk on Fruits
review_1_text: 3 orders from grab and I still want more. One of the best places to get a quick sandwich and fresh fruit soda/tea in Chiang Mai. One suggestion though. Instead of using egg mayo in the toastie, consider using a fried egg or plain omelette to mix things up a bit. 💯
review_2_text:
Awesome place for tea specialities and coffee and outstanding sandwiches:)
Cute place
review_3_text: We stopped by this place on our walk from Chiang Mai University Lake to Nimmanhaemin Starbucks. There's only one table. Credit cards, WeChat Pay, and other payment options are accepted. The food is delicious.
review_4_text: The shop has a good atmosphere, delicious drinks, and lots of fruit.

name: WAKO BAKE
review_1_text:
so good we went several times!
amazing food, really delicious.
the staff is friendly and polite, great service. The ambience is also nice, with air conditioning, wifi and good music.
review_2_text:
Friendly service, though orders took much longer than expected (30 minutes) considering the few customers at the time.

Food is standard, though portions are small for the price; guess you pay for the setting, which is nicely designed.
review_3_text: We heard about this place from a friend, and wow, what a gem! High-speed 150 Mbps internet, big tables with power sockets, a great food selection, and a beautiful, peaceful garden. It's a perfect place for working and chilling. The bacon sandwich is amazing, and the prices are great.
review_4_text: The food, the place, and the service were incredible! I’ll recomend it 10 out of 10
review_5_text: Delicious vegetarian (and non) food packed with flavour. The garden is so peaceful and the drinks are delicious! I had the spicy red curry, hot Thai tea, and a mango/passion smoothie. The service was quick! Can’t wait to return.

name: bays coffee co.
review_1_text: This place is a winner !  Very good coffee and cake. But, this place has a lot more to offer.  It has an attached vegan restaurant with lots of shared seating.  Both AC seating and non AC.  The interior has nice decor with modern furniture made For large people.  This shop has a very large and beautiful supply of baked goods.  The apple crumble is awesome.  The coffee taste will bring me back to this place.  The. Lunch and dinner food looks very nice and fresh.  There were 3 very professional and polite bartistas working.   I highly recommend this place
review_2_text: Best Hot Chocolate I have ever had in Chiang Mai! It is so close to what I had in Spain!
review_3_text: The place is incredibly comfortable and beautiful, and the staff are hardworking, kind, helpful, and extremely excited that you're there! Also, you can't beat the food, it's too good. Would 100% recommend for everybody!
review_4_text:
A cozy place with a pleasant interior and polite staff, located a short distance from the main road. It will be a real discovery for coffee enthusiasts: a wide assortment of different varieties (cold brew with coconut milk is my recommendation 👍). The desserts are also good, especially the carrot cake. Not crowded and stays open late, which is also an advantage.

It's  not a cheap, but prices are ok for this quality. They also have a happy hour (2-4pm) when you can buy one coffee and get a second one for free.
review_5_text: Found this gem of a place.   Lovely outdoor sittimg area and the interior is nice too.  The eggs benedict was delicious.   They have a huge variety on their menu from breakfast items to sandwiches and wraps and burgers even. The coffee is really good and they even make you plain matcha tea if you want.  We will try to come here again before we leave.

name: Food Exchange at Novotel Chiangmai Nimman Journeyhub
review_1_text:
This restaurant is seriously underrated. Whether it’s Thai or Western cuisine, every dish is absolutely delicious. What really impressed me is how well they balance the flavors — nothing is too salty, and everything is seasoned just right. Whether you’re craving authentic Thai flavors or a really good Italian pizza, they deliver on both fronts.

I honestly think this place is worth a special trip. The food blew me away — I originally just stopped by because I was tired and wanted something near the hotel, but I was genuinely surprised by how amazing it was. Despite the lack of crowds, the quality is top-notch. The space is also really cozy and atmospheric, making it a perfect spot for group gatherings.

The staff here are incredibly attentive, and every detail in how the food is prepared is just right. Their service is truly outstanding.
review_2_text: Very bad western food. The club sandwich came out cold even though it’s grilled somehow, and it’s like a supermarket quality sandwich that I can make myself with zero cooking experience. I had a bite of it and immediately felt sadness. The burger was slightly better, but literally zero juice drips doesn’t matter how hard you squeeze it. This is the first bad food I have had in this city this year.
review_3_text: Food are generally good but the grilled river prawns did not seem hit my expectation. For the price, I would think more can be done to increase the food selection. Surprisingly, the fried chicken drum let's tasted exceptionally good.
review_4_text: I am a allcor plus member and I stay in many Accor hotels around Thailand. That is by far the best Accor restaurant I am experienced. My girlfriend and me are now extending our stay in Novotel for about one month and we are eating daily in the restaurant. They have delicious seefood, pizza and also healthy options. The staff is excellent. After having a bit bad experience in Andaman in phuket I really like Novotel and the Novotel food exchange a lot. Also if you register as member and buy the Accor plus membership you will get free welcome drinks and 50% discount of the food if you bring your partner. I am seriously considering living full time in Accor hotels!
review_5_text:
Gets better.
Nice friendly service with great smiles.
Adequate hot food and nice little local delicacies section.
Good pastries and bread.
Nice coffee too.

name: Lush Cafe & Garden
review_1_text:
Nice atmosphere, if not for the loud  customers of certain nationality, probably from the attached hotel.

Decent food and drinks too. I ordered one with peanut butter, a bit off, but they said it was home made.
review_2_text: This place is very peaceful and has a great atmosphere. The food tasted really good, but it was not hot when it was served. It took a long time for the meal even though they did not appear to be busy when we were there, but perhaps they were busy with delivery orders. I would eat here again, I didn't mind waiting, but hope that the food would be hot next time.
review_3_text: Fantastic cafe with nice garden. It feels like Bali here and pretty nice to relax. This seems like a part of a 3 star hotel and you can use the bathroom inside the hotel. Their coffee is very good as well as the food and the value is also great.
review_4_text:
Gorgeous garden and patio area! I ordered a Thai tea which was sweet but a little too milky. My husband ordered a latte and a Thai tea as well and both of his drinks were perfect.
I really enjoyed the views and the calm atmosphere which was perfect for studying.
review_5_text:
Food is very tasty. I picked up fried rice with northern style dish.
Passionfruit freppe is really fresh.
Vibe is cozy and good relaxing. WiFi is quite strong.
Plenty of parking lots.

name: สอง ชา เย็น เย็น (2ong Cha Yen Yen)
Cafe Mong Pearl
review_1_text:
Very good quality food served with lots of respect in terms of communication and services. I requested her to make Pure Vegetarian food with my choice of ingredients in burger, and she did it very well & I really like that taste.

I recommend all pure vegetarian should visit this once.
Price is also reasonable. One average person can eat within 150 Baht.
review_2_text: Little cafe close to Chiang Mai University. Came here for breakfast but didn’t eat anything because more than half of the menu was not available. Apparently it’s not high season so no bagels, no waffles and the only smoothie available was banana. Decent coffee though but if you want to eat anything I’d recommend waiting for high season...
review_3_text:
Excellent! Fantastic, really good! Comida fabulosa, se agradece después de tantos días viajando!

The place looks closed when we walked by, but it just lacks outside light!

Super nice food, highly recommended!
review_4_text: Laid back and a nice place to relax after a nice walk outside. Local and western food are available. The shop owner speaks English as well. Free Wifi with a purchase :)
review_5_text: The food is actually good! We enjoyed the food here. Lady boss speaks English and very friendly.  If you are driving here, do find parking elsewhere as within 100 metes area is quite hard to find.

name: YOBO (โยโบ) Smoothie Bowl & Yogurt Café Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
A bowl of the most delicious Oatmeal I ever had and she even made it with Oatmilk 😁 and don’t get me started on the Vibes, her playlist is top tier. The tea was also delicious. I will definitely be back!

Update: I keep going back and now I’m addicted to the yogurt bowls! You have to check this place out when you’re in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: The fruits yogurt is very tasty.. An d coffee as well. I have 10/10
review_3_text: Stumbled across this little gem! Not only is this coffee shop cute, but the coffee is really good and they have a great range of healthy breakfasts: smoothie bowls, homemade yogurt and fruits. Somthing about this branding really appeals and the lady greeting you as you come in holds the space so well.
review_4_text:
Great spot for a fantastic fruitbowl, many choices and i tryed alot of them!
They also serve egg coffee wich was new to me but very delicious.
Both for 250 baht quality and a good start of the day
review_5_text: WOW. The Himalayan pink salt whipped foam espresso was phenomenal. Unique, sweet, salty. Same with the egg foam coconut latte. The mocha smoothie bowl was a great combo of sweet, creamy, bitter, and crunchy. I think the star was the apple cinnamon yogurt granola cup. I would absolutely eat that everyday!

name: Khum coffee
review_1_text:
Located inside Khum Phu Come hotel near a lobby.

Lots of drinks for coffee and non coffee.

Good taste of americano.

The drink was quick served.

Price was not expensive.

name: Maajoy cafe
review_1_text: A small coffee vendor that has some unique drinks like yuzu coffee. I feel like I should have tried that one, but I chose ice cappuccino and it was a bit over roasted and a bit too bitter for my liking unfortunately.
review_2_text: Dark roasted bean gives a strong bitter coffee flavor.
review_3_text: Good yuzu matcha for 70 baht, iced green tea 35 baht, amazing 🙏
review_4_text: Excellent coffee place, very good coffe specialities and snacks - friendly staff. Coffee starts from 30 thb
review_5_text: So good

name: Mingmitr Coffee - เจ็ดยอด
review_1_text:
Cozy coffee shop kind of vibes.  I am here during Chirstmas and NY eve.
The decoration looks really nice!

Good place  to get a hot cappucinon with friends and family.
Staffs are  so friendly.
Pet Friendly environment! There is an orange cat in the neighbour come say hello!
review_2_text: Nice atmosphere and friendly staffs. Lots of drinks and snacks available. A perfect place for your every cup!!
review_3_text:
Mingmitr Coffee Jedyod Branch is very cozy and invating place.

It is a great spot whether you come alone or with friends
Plenty of  parking lot.
review_4_text: Good coffee with reasonable price👍🏼👍🏼
review_5_text: The best coffee, atmosphere, and service in Chiang Mai.

name: The yard cake & shake
review_1_text: great food and atmosphere ♥️
review_2_text: Nice date spot!

name: Miracle coffee
review_1_text: Love the coffee here. Quick service and strong coffee (Better than other miracle nearby). Polite service and 25 for hot coffee, 35 for iced

name: อุ๊ยไข่ชากาแฟ
review_1_text:
Delicious roadside stall coffee and super affordable price.
25baht for iced milk coffee
review_2_text: I've tried all the coffee carts on this street and this is the one I keep coming back to.
review_3_text: The flavor is great and rich, plus it's very cheap.

name: GOOD CUP MATCHA
review_1_text: We didn't eat, but the coffee was really good! Delicious!

name: Slowbar Huay Kaew by Pop Up
OG RichCoffee (ออกฤทธิ์)
troop cafe
review_1_text: Lux hidden gem with a curated wide range of delicious food. They have sous vide eggs, yummy cappuccinos and beautiful plating (see photos). Fresh pastries flown in from Sydney, Australia and air purifiers inside sun-drenched interior.
review_2_text:
Small simple café, but the price of the food is up there with the more fancy cafés in town. The food looks pretty, but unfortunately the taste and quality doesn't match the price.

The avocado toast had a few very thin slices of avocado on top and instead of being spread with avocado the toast was covered in a thick layer of very sweet mayo for some reason. The bacon (cost extra) was very thin and seemed more like ham than bacon. The egg was perfectly cooked through.
review_3_text: Beautiful café with a nice view to the lush green garden and with affordable prices. Great place for work.
review_4_text: I go here every Friday. The place isn't crowded. The internet is fast and so is the service. If you are looking for quite place to work, this is a good spot!
review_5_text: Great coffee shop with amazing breakfast options. It’s really quiet so it’s great place to work!

name: ร้านน้ำผลไม้ปั่น & ลูกชิ้นทอด กาดรินคำ
แนนนี่น้ำโบราณ
Cottontree
review_1_text: Best espresso in the past 10 years, made of local beans - just giving credit where it's due. Carrot cake is good. Cappuccino was made with care suitable for brain surgery on one's own mother.
review_2_text:
🍃This cosy coffee shop, tucked away in the sports centre near Maya Mall, serves freshly brewed coffee. They offer a selection of local coffee blends.

💓The friendly staff, cozy space, and free Wi-Fi make it a great place to relax. They also have a clean-out house available.
review_3_text: As for coffee and service, it's simply really good. Barista knows what they are doing. But for the cakes there is still some room for improvement.
review_4_text:
Quaint little place just at the back of Hotel Mayu near a badminton centre. Presumably for the parents to wait after they drop their kids off for a badminton session...

The coffee was really lovely, the food is also nice as well. If you live nearby in one of the hotels or u are coming to Mayu mall and looking for some coffee or brunch food then i think its definately worth the short walk over to get some coffee
review_5_text: Another peaceful cafe with good coffee and dessert. The smoothie bowl was cool and could be better with more crunchy granola or cacao nibs. Hot flat white was delicious with moderate price of 70 Baht. The banoffee pie was delicious; it's a big one. You should probably go with someone to finish it.

name: CAMP Creative and meeting place
review_1_text: I think this is one of the best working place here in Chiang Mai. You can work here if you just buy some food/beverage. It seems like you get 2 hours of wifi / 50baht you spend. It’s quiet and you easily forgot that you’re in a huuge shopping mall. Until you need to use a toilet, then you need to use shopping mall’s ”public toilet”. That’s something they could improve on! Terrace is nice and I 100% will come back soon.
review_2_text: This is a good spot to get some work done, everyone is quiet. It is located in Maya mall on the 5th floor. You must purchase at least one item to enter. There is lots of food and drink to choose from and has standard cafe prices: I paid 85bht for a watermelon smoothie. There are lots of different areas and an outside terrace (good for making calls). Only problem is there are a lack of seating options with back support so hard to stay and work for a long time. You get 2 hours of wifi for each 50bht you spend which feels reasonable. Wifi was strong but didn't reach to the terrace. Overall it was a great experience  ☺️
review_3_text:
Great space to work or study.
Perfect place for working, studying, or simply connecting to the internet in a calm and comfortable environment. They offer a menu with a good variety of food and drinks, which makes it easy to spend several hours here. Highly recommended if you need a productive space.
review_4_text: This has become my favorite coworking spot in Nimman. It’s got great wifi and a cafe with great drinks (the food looks ok - basics), and it clean and free!
review_5_text:
A spacious and trendy looking area to get some work done. I like the convenience of CAMP being in the mall in case I want to have more food options later 😁

The only downside is the WiFi strength isn’t strong here so expect some choppy date speeds. Other than that, I would give this place a visit 👌🏽 -@melanieguintu

name: Café Amazon สาขา MAYA Lifestyle Shopping Center
review_1_text: The worst shop ever, totally unfriendly to customers. I wanted to sit at a table and order coffee. I already had my bag there, and it was impossible to order a coffee from the side of the tables. I had to go to the other side to order and that meant I lost my seat. I just wanted to drink a cup of coffee in peace, not from a paper cup. Truly uncooperative, unfriendly, passive-aggressive, irritating service. One floor down at Roastniyom, it's exactly as it should be, and you order your coffee and she said take a seat. "I'll bring it to your table right away." Thank you so much, because that's how customer service should be, thanks Amazon coffee for nothing. And if you then tell him that this isn't right, they look at you as if to say, "What do you want? You're just a unimportant customer, but what do you want from us?"
review_2_text: Consistent quality across the chain of shops. This location is great for sipping a latte and people watching.
review_3_text:
Bad attitude from staff. Refused to give my wife a splash of milk in her tea, which has never been an issue in any other Cafe Amazons. When I asked why, they just said we can not! I offered to pay extra & they said, no we can not. The staff were rude and laughing between themselves at us. The manager eventually came and gave us some milk.

We'll be giving this one a miss in future.
review_4_text: Rude employee. They don’t close at 10, even though it says so, they just closed before and then had a terrible attitude when we asked if they knew about any other cafe. She did speak English and when she got annoyed, she just started saying she didn’t and ignored us.
review_5_text: Staff refuse to hand me a coffee at the table behind the station and insisted that the only way to got my paid coffee is to walk around to the spot they place it. I can walk fine and it okey to grasp my heavy belongings with me. But it kind of rude for me.

name: MINIMAL COFFEE - MAYA
review_1_text: The dark roast beans made a good strong, slightly bitter iced Americano. It was good coffee to have after a movie in the mall. Friendly staff and I appreciate them asking for my drink preferences.
review_2_text: The latte coffee is fine, and the price is very reasonable even though it’s located inside Maya.
review_3_text: Cheap and good, 125 baht for 2😛
review_4_text:
The Americano and coconut coffee was just average. Americano was strong but the coconut coffee was very watery. Black orange coffee was good. However totally different experience than the one at Central festival where I gave it a 5*

The location at Central festival mall the coconut 🥥 it was delicious as well as the DIRTY coffee. Not sure why it tasted watery at this location
review_5_text: The best staff and coffee in Chiang Mai !!!

name: Nanafruit Dessert
review_1_text:
Famous for cloudy cake and it is generally ok.  All are meant to be for that camereating moment when you lift the plastic shield and allows the cheese mix flowing down.

Good for a break and camera.

Fyi, the rosemary is just for decor 😅

name: Mon Chou Chou Maya
review_1_text: You should teach your employees how to give service to the customers . I came to the shop in maya shopping mall around 9:15pm. I ordered milk tea without bubble. Medium size for 40B in the menu and she charged me 45B. The drink came out with the bubble included. I showed her that was including bubble and she got upset and gave me 5B. Her actions was very rude. She haven’t learn about etiquette or how can she working in the service industry.
review_2_text: The staff at this restaurant seem untrained in their manners and service. I've been a regular customer since 2019, but unfortunately, I've had to stop eating there this year because the staff were rude, didn't clearly explain the details, and spoke in a curt tone as if I was asking for free food. I usually eat at two branches: the one in front of the Faculty of Pharmacy at Chiang Mai University and the one at Maya. I don't expect the restaurant to improve, but I wanted to let them know. If they're not ready, they might not sell it for now. It's a shame that it's delicious, but the "people" make me not want to eat it anymore.
review_3_text: Bubble tea shop on B1 floor.

name: Cmor by Recall Hotels, Chiangmai
review_1_text:
Cmor Hotel Chiang Mai – A Hidden Gem in the Heart of the City

I recently stayed at Cmor Hotel Chiang Mai and had a truly enjoyable experience. The hotel is modern, clean, and located in a quiet yet convenient area near Nimmanhaemin Road — one of the trendiest parts of Chiang Mai.

The room was spacious, well-designed, and equipped with all the necessary amenities. I especially appreciated the comfortable bed and the strong Wi-Fi, which made it easy to work and relax.

What really stood out, however, was the staff. Everyone from the front desk to housekeeping was incredibly friendly and helpful. They went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed and were always happy to offer recommendations for local attractions and food spots.

The pool area is small but cozy, perfect for a quick dip after a day of exploring. The breakfast buffet was fresh and had a good variety of both local and international options.

Overall, I highly recommend Cmor Hotel for anyone visiting Chiang Mai — whether you're traveling for business, with family, or just on a relaxing getaway.
review_2_text:
I stayed at this hotel for a couple of nights and had a truly wonderful experience.🥰 All of the staff were kind, professional, and very sweet, which made my stay in Sharma Cmor much more comfortable.

I especially want to thank a staff member named Puupay. Late one night, when I needed help, she went out of her way to assist me with so much care and discretion. Even though it wasn’t something the hotel normally provides, she personally helped me and made sure I felt comfortable and not embarrassed at all. Her thoughtfulness and warmth genuinely touched me.🥰😊🙏🙏

Because of people like Puupay, this hotel feels more than just a place to stay🥰🥰 it feels like a place where guests are truly cared for. I highly recommend this hotel and sincerely appreciate the kindness of the staff.
review_3_text:
We were away for a special celebration. I guess this was the 'authentic' experience. Lots of Thai locals use this hotel.

The Pros: rooms are large and clean. Free bottled water, tea and coffee in the room.
Kitchenette for those who want to cook for themselves.
Located in short walking distance to a very busy and popular shopping/dining area.
Small but well presented breakfast

Cons: On a flight path - if you want a peaceful night sleep this is not for you, unless you're a very very deep sleeper.
The ladies on reception were not very friendly and seemed as if we were an inconvenience and that they would rather be somewhere else.
Breakfast not smooth - omelette stand never operated, and i had to turn on the waffle machine as noone could work out why it wasn't doing anything.
Pool on first floor, in the shade.
review_4_text: Great location with convenient transportation. The accommodation is excellent—very clean, with a swimming pool and well-appointed rooms. The staff are friendly, lovely, and attentive. Breakfast is good, with a wide variety of options and great taste. The hotel is located in the heart of Chiang Mai, close to Maya Shopping Mall and the airport. Beautiful views and pleasant weather make the stay even better.
review_5_text: My stay at this hotel was truly delightful. The room was clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated, with all the necessary amenities provided. The staff were warm, welcoming, and offered excellent service throughout my stay. The location was convenient and made traveling around the city very easy. It’s a great choice whether for relaxation or business. I would definitely stay here again on my next visit.”

name: Street Coffee Crew
review_1_text: Great vibe , great ice americano , sweetest lazy white doggo, vinyl turntables for a morning coffee, honestly my favourite coffee shop of all time in the entire galaxy , 5 stars would caffeinate again (and I will). Also the crew are a nice bunch of people.
review_2_text:
They’re usually mixing records straight from the wall behind the deck. Awesome staff. Great affordable coffee. Cozy small space, almost always full of people, but that’s what makes it good. Hoping it can keep its local charm, but it seems too cool to not be found out by tourists 🫣

Used to be a little cart nearby, so it’s nice to see two brick and mortar locations. Their second location is open air and just as cool, a short drive away.
review_3_text: A awesome place. Young and hip vibe, and hip-hop based music was also good. Highly recommanded.
review_4_text: The magic latte was super good, probably the best in chiang mai. But the music was quite loud inside, I don’t see how people can talk or work there.
review_5_text: I love that they offer a choice of light, medium, or dark roast beans — all at the same price! The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, with a steady flow of customers during the late morning. Their pastries are delicious and reasonably priced.

name: Bannom Minimal Cafe
review_1_text: Highly recommended for students/working professionals who like to study/work peacefully in a cozy place. Has a lot of coffee varieties in their menu with delicious pastries for reasonable price. With very fast wifi and location is easy to pin on Grab/Bolt ride app.
review_2_text:
Nice place to sit, relax, or get some work done.

Lots of seating and have 2 floors.

Most are nearby college students working on assignments or locals working on laptops.

Affordable prices.

Strong Wifi.

AC is quite strong.

Open till late (1 am), perfect for catching deadlines or simply working in different timezones.
review_3_text: Baannom Cafe is a great place to read and relax. There are plenty of seating options, making it easy to find a cozy spot. The menu offers a variety of food and beverages, ensuring there’s something for everyone. The peaceful atmosphere makes it a perfect spot to unwind with a book or enjoy a quiet break.
review_4_text: It's nice to drop off your laundry at the nearby coin laundromat and enjoy a refreshing drink while you wait. The coconut drink was especially refreshing and delicious.
review_5_text: Great co working space! Great coffee, great prices! Very recommended!

name: Starbucks Maya Shopping Mall Chiangmai
review_1_text: Good service with all of staff and clean area, just a little bit noisy because they have many tourist, is still be nice
review_2_text: This Starbucks branch is really pleasant and welcoming. The atmosphere is calm and comfortable, making it a great place to sit, relax, or get some work done. The staff were friendly and efficient, and everything felt well organized and clean. It’s a nice spot to enjoy a coffee break in a relaxed environment, and I’d happily come back again.
review_3_text: Very conveniently located on the ground floor of Maya. First time I’ve had the Starbucks peppermint chewing gum. See photos. And also first time I’ve had the banana cake with mixed grains.
review_4_text: Visited them twice during my 4 day stay in Chiang Mai. The staff were friendly. The location is good, but there are a lot of kids using it for studying, which is not good for paying customers as they stay there for hours that regular customers paying like us have no place to sit and enjoy our coffee.
review_5_text: The Starbucks in the Maya mall is a great place to hideaway and get some work done in their many tables and cosy nooks. The staff are wonderful, speak really great English and make amazing suggestions for coffee etc. They even do decaf coffee if you love the taste but can’t handle the caffeine ❤️and the wifi is pretty good too.

name: anyday coffee coworking space
review_1_text: One place to ho if you like good coffee and a decent place to relax and especially to work. One of the best co-working locations I have seen in the area. Good desks and very good chairs for long time stay and work comfortably. Iced Mocha really good, intense taste just as I like it. Croissants and waffles delicious as well. Recommended
review_2_text:
Anyday Coffee Coworking Space is one of the best places I’ve worked from. The owner Glauy is super friendly and always helps me with anything I need — from setup to small requests. The Wi-Fi is fast and reliable, and the chairs are comfortable enough to work all day without any issues.

What I love the most is how quiet and peaceful the space always is — no distractions, just perfect focus. Plus, it’s cool inside all the time (AC is always on), which makes working here really enjoyable, even on hot days.

If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a calm place to work with great coffee and friendly people — this is the spot! ☕💻
review_3_text: The waffle is just amazing, crispy outside and soft inside. Price is reasonable. Can get a bundle of coffee and waffle with only 89 baht. the environment is quiet and chill.
review_4_text:
reasonable price
comfortable place
good atmosphere

i really love this place.
ive beenhere several times.
the female owner is really kind and friendly.
touchable cat
review_5_text: The coffee is yum.  The desk chairs for working are perfect, new and comfortable.   And the areas have great natural lighting.   Lots of bike parking too.

name: Cha Tra Mue
review_1_text:
Very delicious Thai Tea with bubble. Reasonable price. A little bit much ice.

Love it.
review_2_text: Both the thai milk tea and the green milk tea are SOOOO GOOD!!! I drank like four cups in one day!!! I simply fell in love with thai milk tea when I first tried Cha Tra Mue in Thailand a few years ago. I recommend also buying the tea bags if you really love the drinks!
review_3_text: Nice more chill ChaTraMue location 🤗 On the bottom floor. Lots of tables and good quieter place. Vegan options too. Staff is super friendly. I've been here two times.
review_4_text:
We really like this brand and this one is easy to get to in the basement of the mall.
It's busy, so expect a short wait.
review_5_text: They messed up my iced black tea by putting in black pearls (which I did not ordered); but corrected it quickly upon feedback. Friendly staff, one just need to have more patience with them.

name: เสื้อเฮีย ร้านสกรีนเสื้อเชียงใหม่ และคาเฟ่
review_1_text: Best shop for print good quality and very fast service . Thanks you ! We will print again here ☀️🤘🏆
review_2_text: Good atmosphere, good coffee, good taste. The best are banoffee and coffee.
review_3_text: Fast and convenient, in just 15 minutes, you can get your own custom-designed shirt at an affordable price. Enjoy the cozy atmosphere of coffee shop, with a coffee corner where you can relax and sip while waiting for your shirt to be printed.
review_4_text: The staff at this shop are very good at service. I went to there to make a  T shirt and it very quickly, less than 20 minutes, and it was beautiful too. I’m 100% recommend you.
review_5_text: Nice Coffee Shop, good thai music, they even can make t-shirt with your own design.

name: EatMor Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: Great food, very flavourful and presented perfectly. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Cream cheese dessert is highly recommended.
Khao soi is good.
review_3_text: Discovering the EatMor cafe @ Cmor hotel was a pleasant surprise. The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, with friendly staff to match. The menu offered a great selection of options to suit any taste. Excellent coffee and blended drinksI thoroughly enjoyed our visit and will definitely be back for more! 5/5 stars.
review_4_text: Quiet place to work on laptop, easy to find, spacious, great food and cost, lovely service 🙏
review_5_text: Great location next to the hottest area of Nimman, there’s things to do every day that’s just a 5min walk away. There is some noise every night from the airplanes passing above, but they did not bother us at all.

name: Roastniyom Coffee Decem
review_1_text: Great experience at Roastniyom Coffee Decem. The coffee was rich and well-balanced, prices are reasonable, and there’s a great variety of pastries to choose from. Definitely worth a visit in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text:
Coffee to start morning. Nice stop before leaving Chiang Mai
Somewhat difficult to find at first, have to drive slowly in notice
review_3_text: Such a peaceful quiet nice place 😇 The friendliest service, great prices and amazing matcha!
review_4_text: Extremely attentive, fast and nice staff and great quality of coffee and drinks. Among my Top 3 Coffee places in Chiang Mai. They have one of the best Cocoa Frappes I have ever tried. Great place, highly recommended to check out when you are in Chiang Mai and are looking for some good coffee.
review_5_text:
Nice bakery.
Good atmosphere.
Coffee below average IMHO.

coffee fresh
nice

review_4_text: The coffee is delicious.

review_1_text: 35thb for hot coffee/cappuccino at this cafe. The space is actually not bad at this price. They have AC and a few comfy couch.

name: We R coffee
review_1_text:
Small shop that you can buy take away or sit at the store to sip your drinks.
There are 3 coffee bean choices:
_ Dark roast: Robusta

Coffee quality is quite good and the volume is a lot for a very reasonable price.
review_2_text: I picked up ice americano here. It is a tiny cafe, mostly for to go, but the prices are cheaper than most of the coffee places around and the quality is good.
review_3_text: Very quaint coffee place, really nice.  I ordered the iced latte, and it was perfect. Price was even better 🙂, only goes to show you that you don't need to pay a lot to get good coffee.
review_4_text: a nice cozy place, the barista customized the coffee for me, I got a Mint Coffee black hot while it’s only available for iced
review_5_text: Great coffee, and very friendly owner. It also opens before 8am.

name: Pa Porn Lanna Food
review_1_text: The shop has moved slightly from its original location on the map. There are no tables to sit and eat now. Importantly, come in the morning, otherwise everything will be sold out (don't trust the app; by 10:30 AM, many items are already gone). The grilled pork ribs are amazing. The fermented fish chili paste is perfectly fragrant. Overall, everything is delicious, living up to the recommendations of those familiar with the area. My biggest regret is that the owner only makes Hang Le (Northern Thai curry) during the Songkran festival. I'll definitely come back to try it next time.
review_2_text: You can enjoy Northern Lanna cuisine from breakfast. Gaeng Om, Sai Oo, and Keum Yang are all delicious.
review_3_text: Grilled ribs, larb, om, sai ua, and larb pla, the main dishes. The rest are ordered as side dishes. Don't forget to order jin som mok.
review_4_text:
It's a very delicious local dish.

Every time I come back to Chiang Mai, I have to stop by and try it.
review_5_text: I like the food here. The taste is delicious and original. I personally like the ab ong ao. ;)

YENJAI KOFE SLOWBAR
review_1_text: It’s actually the cheapest place to pick up cappuccino around and it’s decent. I like how the store looks and you can tell the guy is serious about coffee. He is nice and the drinks are good. The store is tiny, so you probably wanna get it to go.
review_2_text: A nice coffee shop. The owner likes art, he paints and makes coffee so the internal coffee space is nicely decorated.
review_3_text: A lovely and well-designed café I stumbled upon by chance. Really charming and inviting!
review_4_text: Really great little spot for a coffee, tucked away off the beaten track. Lovely host, who has set up a shop on the side of his home!
review_5_text: A small shop with a retro atmosphere, good coffee at reasonable prices, and the owner is very friendly.

review_2_text: The chadela is very fragrant and very delicious... As for the roti, I recommend it. The dough is very delicious and most importantly, it doesn't absorb oil...it's the best...
review_3_text: It's a bit hidden away, but worth it. Very friendly owners, who also speak good English. We had coffee (iced cappuccino), Persian tea, and banana roti. Everything was delicious.
review_4_text: I like it..very delicious..the price is very reasonable..I recommend this shop.

name: Bang Bo Roti บังโบโรตี
review_1_text: This is a very cozy place where you will be greeted with a smile and fed the most delicious roti. We go here every week.
review_2_text:
45 minute to make 1 roti.
When customer ask to cancel because you prefer do Online orders rather then Customer in shop, dont be rude and be polite to him.
The woman very rude
You deserve 0 stars not even 1.
review_3_text: Every time I come to Chiang Mai, I have to stop by. I'm really addicted to Pakistani tea and Southern tea. It's so strong and satisfying. The owner is very kind. He recommended me a thick, soft roti with cheese. Wow, it's so delicious that it comes out of my mouth.
review_4_text:
Bang Bo Roti: A paradise for roti, tea, and coffee lovers in Chiang Mai!
If you're looking for a delicious roti shop in Chiang Mai, you absolutely can't miss "Bang Bo Roti"! Their roti is perfectly sweet and fragrant, with generous fillings and a wide variety of options, from banana and cheese roti to cheese roti and various special rotis – guaranteed to please everyone.

But the deliciousness of this shop isn't limited to roti. Their drinks are equally amazing, from fragrant coffee and rich Pakistani tea to refreshing blended drinks.

And you absolutely can't miss the beef rice bowl! It's the best I've ever had. The beef is tender, the flavor is perfectly balanced, and it pairs flawlessly with the hot rice.
review_5_text: The roti is delicious. It's fried until crispy and the filling is just the right amount of sweet. I really like the corn cheese roti. It's delicious. The water is reasonably priced. The hot Pakistani tea is very fragrant. I've never tried it before. P.S. There are musical instruments and board games to play for free. I like this the most.

name: Siri Cha
review_1_text:
I came across this small coffee shop on my way back to my hotel after my morning workout at Maxx Fitness on the 5th floor of Maya Mall.
I used to drink iced Americano every day, but lately I've become completely addicted to Thai tea.
My morning commute to work, picking up two cups of coffee and Thai tea, is a joy.
The owner is friendly and has a lovely smile.
And the prices are also very reasonable.
review_2_text: Since the hotel was nearby, I drank it while walking back and forth. I skipped breakfast and this was much better. The coffee was delicious, and the price was amazing. QR code payment was accepted.
review_3_text: The staff were polite and cheerful, and the Thai tea was delicious.

name: P PLOY COFFEE

review_2_text: Matcha latte is so good
review_3_text:

The shop is cute and cozy....

review_5_text: The shop has a good atmosphere and delicious coffee.

review_4_text: Staff just so friendly matcha just lovely taste
review_5_text: It has a/c, couches, and 40 baht green tea lattes. What more could you ask for?

The man was very friendly who runs it .
His brown cookies were amazing.
Nice comfy chairs and the ambience is perfect to get away from crowded areas .

Check it out !!!
review_4_text:

Feb 28, 2025
review_5_text: What a great place! The owner himself is a older guy and he is so friendly. 10/10 ⭐️

name: FOEI
review_1_text:
FOEI in Santitham is such a hidden gem.

Cozy vibe, great coffee, and super friendly staff. The drinks and desserts are beautifully made and taste amazing. Perfect spot to chill, work, or catch up with friends.

Highly recommended!
review_2_text: I tried here couple of items and can say that matcha tasted better cold. Hot cocoa was more milk than cocoa. The black coffee was 👌
review_3_text:
Good coffee with great taste at an affordable price Parking is available
Perfect for chilling and relaxing.
review_4_text: Arrived a second before closing, the owner was amazing. I took two cakes and each was better than the other.
review_5_text: Forget the rest, Foei is the final boss of coffee in Chiang Mai. From lattes to that zesty orange coffee, they don’t miss. My daily routine? The 'Super Duper x Foei' double-hit. Eat, sip, repeat. You can thank me later.

name: Paper Plane CNX
review_1_text:
We payed 11€ for one night and this was the best place we stayed at for this price. Good AC, clean, hot water. Wasn't looking for more at this price.

Cons - bathroom has like plastic bit in roof (instead of window) - looks ok, but rain makes it very loud.

Also there was some minor noise behind the walls, but for short period of time
review_2_text:
We stayed in room 1, and if you checked the previous review, someone had already pointed out a strong smell coming from the bathroom drain. I can't believe this problem hasn't been solved after all these months. When we asked for assistance regarding this issue, they just placed a plate with air freshener to cover the drain. However, even with five air fresheners in the bathroom, the smell couldn't be offset. I think the hotel should take this problem more seriously.

On the next night, we suddenly couldn't get into the room and couldn't find any staff to help us physically. We could only contact the receptionist by text. They told us they had changed the password, but we were confused as to why they didn't inform us initially. What if we had come back late at night and no one responded to our WhatsApp text?

We also doubted the cleanliness of the room as the bed sheet had so many black stains. The air conditioner and fridge were running, but they weren't cooling at all. Moreover, the digital door lock was too simple and didn't have a latch inside the room, which made us feel insecure.

The receptionist was responsive tho, and replied to us in a timely manner. The design of the room was cozy, and the location was fine. Those are the pros I can think of. It's budget-friendly, indeed, but the hotel should focus more on the facilities and service.
review_3_text: Great location. The coffee is good and the flavors are bold. Indoor and outdoor seating available in a lovely small garden. They also sell coffee beans in case you want to bring some home. The coffee shop itself isn’t big but very cozy and friendly atmosphere. Super friendly and helpful staff. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
WARNING! Read before you book!

Terrible Service.
Booked a room during the Loy Krathong and before I booked and paid I contacted the premise via Whatsapp to confirm the availability of the room and been confirmed it was available.

Yet at the last minute they cancelled my booking stating it's a system error for the room had already been booked during that day.  Apparently cancelling my booking and hiked up the price to sell for more profit.

Ended up ruining my stay in Chiangmai during the Loy Krathong.  The worst ever travelling experience.
review_5_text: They have a cafe at the entrance and I had hot cappuccino and it was ok. The space has AC, but is pretty small and only 1 good table and others are small tables.

review_1_text: Cold brew coffee in very good

name: Jerry's

It's taste very good and I liked the aromatic, fresh of the bean from Thailand. There are a LOT of bean for filter as well. I've tried the honey one yesterday. I ordered the Shine Mascat Cheese Tart, which was incredibly delicious. I highly recommend it. If you're passing through Maya, stop by. There's plenty of parking.
review_5_text: Beautiful photo spots, fragrant coffee – it's so good! Delicious pastries. Highly recommended! Good taste coffee!

name: Huangfulong
review_1_text:
What an Amazing and Beautiful Tea House!! Definitely worth a visit!!
I have lived in Chiang Mai for over a year and have been yet to run into something so unique.
I can’t wait to bring my family and friends here!!
See you guys soon 😉
review_2_text:
Great place for tea lovers.

The owner Khun Mc is a gracious host and is very knowledgeable about tea, tea customs, and traditional Lanna and Chinese culture.

He serves and sells high quality pu-erh tea and the traditional snacks that come with the tea set are delicious and unique.

Additionally, the house is exquisitely decorated with traditional Chinese furniture and wares.

Definitely 5 stars!!!
review_3_text: Great place to get Oolong and Pu-Erh tea and all kinds of tea wear. The owner is very polite and you can taste test test before you purchase them.
review_4_text: Amazing place to learn more about the tea and try it, peaceful atmosphere of China. Friendly owners, highly recommend to visit!
review_5_text:
Here is very nice and beautiful!

name: Homey Home Cafe

A notably ecclectic and volumnious spread of seating is spread across multiple floors on the interior, and likewise across multiple outdoor areas. Early morning opening hours here on a weekday are quiet, making for an opportune time to snoop about, explore the many facets of Homey's fascinating and beautifully laid-out space, and find the perfect nook to spend the next hour or two. Not to forget Homey's cafe aspect, where friendly and welcoming staff serve up great beverages and bites to accompany one's time here.
review_2_text: Cozy morning magic in Chiang Mai's Santhitham! This homey haven whips up fluffy toasts, fresh brews, and sweet treats that warm the soul—especially those creamy matcha drinks we savored two of, perfectly blended and refreshing. All in a charming indoor-outdoor setup with different theme rooms and endless photo ops. Relaxed vibes, friendly faces, and that feel-good escape? Your perfect start to any day.
review_3_text: Unexpected to find this cafe in the suburb neighborhood with small lanes of residential shop houses. Its just 100m from our accommodation place. The coffee and tea drinks are good - go for the iced version as weather is quite hot. Try a cake too.
review_4_text: Such a big house, made as a cafe. It is 4 half-storey house as far as I can see. The serve western breakfast sets, which came with a big portion of salad.
review_5_text: I'm confused by the employee's statement that said the matcha here is expensive. 129 baht per glass. I intend to walk in and buy it. Whether it's cheap or expensive, I can pay. Employees don't need to ask customers questions like this.

review_3_text: Nice cozy coffee spot, the iced latte was delicious (50B). They’ve got 3 different blends (dark, medium, light roast). Love the cups it comes in, friendly staff.

good taste of coffees.
