review_3_text: Great coffee here, opens early which is good before cycling. Only tried 1x sandwich thus far, chicken and avocado and it was great.
review_4_text: We’ve had breakfast here for a couple of times. Delicious sandwiches and wraps, good coffee, great service and budget-friendly prices.
review_5_text: Very tasty and good amount for the value of money 👍

name: ชามาเล
review_1_text: Very good
review_2_text:
Thai Milk Bubble Tea is so, so delicious!
And it's only 20 baht!
It's so delicious for the price!!!
I drank it every time I passed by, but this is the only picture I have ㅠㅠ
It's not a cafe in the building, but rather a little out front of the restaurant.

name: ชาตันหยง (สาขาสันติธรรม)
review_1_text: The taste is very delicious.
review_2_text: The shopkeeper was very kind. 🥰

name: Rice&Coffee - สันติธรรม เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: So delicious! The owner is so kind and friendly. I ordered Tom Yum instant noodles with creamy egg, but if you want a boiled egg too, you have to order it separately. ❤️🥰
review_2_text: Delicious, filling, and great value.

name: Inthanin Coffee
review_1_text: I had low expectations since it's located right behind the gas station so was imagining more of a 7-11.   Instead I found the chairs and seating area to be comfortable and the coffee to be ok.   I enjoyed sitting and spending an hour working and reading my book.
review_2_text: Nice quiet cafe great place to get some work done,  located in the gas station off the main road, friendly staff & good tasting coffee. Iced Latte (75B)
review_3_text: I like coming to the Inthanin coffee shops for a refreshment. Also the fact that supporting a Thai company seems more correct to me than supporting the American companies when visiting Thailand. This Inthanin is located a bit outside the city center but if you happen to pass by it go and have a cool or warm refreshment in there
review_4_text:
A quiet place to work, right off the main street.

Was looking for a place to do some computer work for a couple of hours and wondered into this little coffee shop. It is a chain, but not as pricey as Starbucks, but with many tables and couches. The coffee is good and the food too, and with Free wifi it is a great little spot to get in some work for the afternoon.
review_5_text: It's a cafe attached to a petrol station. Coffee was good, staff were friendly, plenty of seating.

name: MOO Coffee @Santitham มูคอฟฟี่ สันติธรรม
review_1_text:
My biggest issue was the music. Loud and definitely not the type of music I want to hear when I just woke up or have a bad cold.

I even told the barista that I have a phone call to do and to lower the music, I guess he didn’t understand but he saw I was on a call later and didn’t even think to lower the music. I hope the owner reads this review and make sure in the future not to play hiphop music!
review_2_text: I picked up hot Americano here and it was very by old. You can choose medium or dark roast.
review_3_text: Highly recommend! A good taste coffee and nice atmosphere. Hidden place in Santitum with the view of Doi Suthep
review_4_text:
Fancy delicious coffee, just go for the signature coffee but only next year coz today's the last in 2022.
cute owner speaking excellent English (should take a photo, will do it next year lol)
review_5_text:
Great coffee and welcoming vibe.

Flat white, medium roast 🤌🏼

name: Cafe Liberty Chiang Mai
review_1_text: If you’re in Chiang Mai and love coffee, Cafe Liberty is a must-visit! Their coffee is perfectly brewed, with rich flavors and a smooth finish that will delight your taste buds. The cozy atmosphere and friendly staff make it the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great cup of coffee. Don’t miss out – come and taste the difference at Cafe Liberty!
review_2_text:
There are almond milk and oat milk in substitutions for regular dairy milk.
Coffee beans have 2 options: dark roast and medium roast.
Coffee is good.
Coffee space is small with inside and outdoor seats.
Staff is nice.
review_3_text:
I strongly advocate for small business owners and their endeavors.
. Enjoyed a delightful ice Mocha that was absolutely delicious.
. The barista was exceptionally polite and provided me with a wonderful xperience.
. The establishment is modest yet pleasant.
review_4_text: Ordered Thai tea frappe and cocoa, both tasty. There is toilet so can stay long time.
review_5_text: Decent coffee and there are a few tables outside. I would like my cappuccino a bit stronger though.

name: บริษัทเต็มอิ่มเติมรัก จำกัด
ร้านชาข้าวเฟนียว
Shift cafe สาขาเจ็ดยอด
Bluemochatea
review_1_text:
A cozy and cozy coffee shop, perfect for chilling out.

The owner is lovely and friendly.

This shop is great for meeting friends for work or working quietly on your laptop (Wifi available).

There's seating both indoors (air-conditioned) and outdoors on wooden chairs.

They have a wide variety of drinks, including tea and coffee.

We tried the rose tea – it was fragrant and had a strong tea aroma – and the hot latte was smooth and delicious.

Regarding the tea roasting section, we recommend trying it yourself. If you like it, you can buy some to take home. If you're planning to open a tea shop, you can come and try the teas and get advice. They even have tea menus available. They roast and wholesale tea leaves, and have many different types and blends of tea.

Parking is available on the street in the alley next to the shop.
review_2_text:
This place is really good for drinks.

I like the americano,
and the various teas.

The owner is very kind.

There's a cute and very friendly dog.

I've been to this shop 10 times already.
review_3_text: You have to come and try it. I stumbled upon this. I don't usually come here for this kind of noodles. It's delicious and the price is good.
review_4_text: This coffee shop has a cozy atmosphere and super strong WiFi. If you're looking for a place to work from morning till evening, I highly recommend this place. Parking is available around the shop, along the street. Once you get there, don't forget to try their new coffee flavors; they have a wide variety to choose from, plus many different teas. I've tried so many that I'm wide awake now!
review_5_text: The coffee is excellent, the tea is fragrant and delicious, and the prices are reasonable.

name: Hoo Cafe & Studio
review_1_text:
A chill-out spot with a great atmosphere near Nimmanhaeminda Road and Maya.
Near Wat Chedi Yot. Delicious food and great music.
Morning coffee and lunch from 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Evening drinks from 5:00 PM to midnight.
Folk songs, great music, and great promotions every day.
review_2_text:
A chill-out spot with a great atmosphere, great music, and delicious food.
Coffee in the morning and drinks in the evening. Near Nimman and Maya.
review_3_text: คาเฟ่แอร์เย็นฉ่ำ กาแฟดี อาหารอร่อย บรรยากาศชิลๆ มีดนตรีสด นั่งได้ตั้งแต่กลางวันถึงกลางคืน
review_4_text: A chill place with a great atmosphere, beautiful girls, delicious food, and affordable prices. Near Maya Shopping Mall. They serve coffee during the day and other drinks in the evening, with nice music. Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
A chill-out spot with a great atmosphere near Nimmanhaemin, Maya, and Chedi Yot.
Coffee during the day, cold drinks in the evening, and delicious food.

name: orange coffee 59/1ถ.เทพารักษ์ ต.ช้างเผือก อ.เมืองเชียงใหม่
Wish and Whisk
review_1_text:
One of the best coffee shops to work with the laptop. Calm atmosphere, super sweet owner that bakes fresh cakes every day, and a piano! :)
We love coming here
review_2_text: delicious latte with a dense and fine bubble foam, a beautiful interior. one of the best coffees in town
review_3_text: Very nice place! Coffee is good and also cakes. It's very quiet, nice background music. Great atmosphere to enjoy some coffee and also for people that work remotely.
review_4_text: The bear cookies are so gooooood!!! Honestly all of the pastries are awesome, and the coffee is always good.
review_5_text:
Very nice lady, cool interior.
Enjoyed the lemon cake. Good coffee too, she knows what's she's doing!

name: The Extraction @TCA space สันติธรรม
review_1_text: The price is poor.   Its ambience is very good. There are many chair outside.  And you can sit in the room too.  Service is pleasant
review_2_text: This is a little hidden gem. Coffee is delicious and very well priced in comparison to others in the neighborhood. Quiet space to work as well
review_3_text: The place to be for coffee drinking cyclists. Great coffee specialties - of course all with Latte Art - nice air conditioned seating with good Wifi to get your business done. And then you can buygood quality, nice and inexpensive cycling kits as well as great bike phone bags among others.
review_4_text: Selection is tiny, coffee was okay at best. But the barista kept watching something loudly on their phone, not caring at all about me being there. Just rude :/
review_5_text: Quiet and well hidden place. Good coffee, not expensive. Nice atmosphere for working, as well as Just relax, reading a book or talk to a friend.

name: อำไพ คาเฟ่ Amphai café
review_1_text: Classic Thai bar. Not a big fan of the surroundings .
review_2_text: Nice Thai live music place ..
review_3_text: Nice bar. Good food, very friendly staff. Attractive prices 👌🏽
review_4_text: I happened to come to use the service at the shop today and went to use the shop's restroom. It turned out that the water spray hose wasn't flowing and the toilet was clogged. I understand that the shop is renovating, but the thing that needs urgent fixing is the restroom. Please help fix it. I hope to come back and use the service again.
review_5_text: The shop is nice. The live music is good. The atmosphere is okay. But I'd like to see some improvements in cleanliness, especially the restroom.

name: สถานีแอบรัก-ชามุก
review_1_text: Great to go drink place. I dropped by not knowing what to get and I saw another customer getting a good looking drink, so I asked for the same one, which was coconut drink with boba. It was one of the best coconut drinks I have tried and the price was better than most of other stores around.
review_2_text: As others have said before, amazing coconut milk smoothie for 40 baht. And extremely generous size of the drink. Friendly owner running the store, and it's busy for take out and delivery as well. Mostly some outside seating when I went.
review_3_text:
I love this place.  I’ve been coming here every week for their very tasty - and very affordable - coconut smoothie.

Lovely family run business, which is always busy, especially with Thais!
review_4_text: Cheap and a lot given. I ordered Cocoa drink with boba, 50% sweet. Big cup cost only 30 Baht (price as of 2023).
review_5_text: Coconut smoothies with boba is good.

name: Lucky's Vietnamese Restaurant - Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
A very homie Vietnamese, not a lot of choice but uniqueness menus and delicious. Owner and staff are very nice.

They are also welcome pets even it is outdoor only but the weather is so nice.

Sauces are special nutty, a little buttery (from nut) and not so spicy. อร่อยเลย
review_2_text: 15/10 — this place is unbelievable! The food is beyond excellent and the staff are so friendly. We’ve spent a lot of time in Vietnam and have eaten at countless Vietnamese restaurants around the world, and this one easily makes my top five of all time. We had the bun cha, bun no na bo, and the custard dessert — each dish was somehow even better than the last. So happy to have discovered this place, and we’ll absolutely be back. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting!
review_3_text:
Reservations are recommended!
We stopped by yesterday for the coconut coffee slushy to take away and made reservations for today at opening time.
The food was delicious; the service was amazing and the entire staff is very friendly and pleasant.
They have been super busy so please be patient; it’s worth it.
It’s a very small menu and everything is made to order and you can tell how much work they do to keep everything fresh and delicious.
review_4_text:
Overrated. Nam nuoang averages at 60baht a roll, tastes good but at 230baht per 4 strips you get what you pay for. 25minutes after namnuoang arrives we received our noodle esk dish which should normally be fast, we even came at a non full table time.
Seeing the queue the day before i was hyped, but after i ate i realise its because of restaurant preparation time.
The food is not bad in anysense just overrated, many reviews say its as good as vietnam. How though i highly doubt people saying that have had anything but touristy foods in VN.
review_5_text: I went to dinner with my friend last night. We had a Nem Nuong Nha Trang, with extra meat, extra rice paper, and pudding. It was my first time eating Vietnamese food. It's so delicious. The combination of crispy and crunchy is truly amazing. My friend said that he had tried that dish in China before, but this one is his favourite. Even though there is no service charge, the staff are friendly and welcoming. Some restaurants require a service charge, but the service is not good. The vegetables are, needless to say, fresh. The dessert is not too sweet; it has a really nice taste. If you want to try Vietnamese food in Chiang Mai, I recommend this restaurant.

name: Areemitr Coffee
review_1_text:
It has been ten days since I returned to my hometown, but I still miss Areemitr’s coffee so much, especially the decaf. The decaf there was better than any I’ve had in all the many countries I’ve traveled to.

The atmosphere was incredibly quiet, warm, and peaceful. I was deeply impressed by the coffee expert who looked like a grandfather—or perhaps a father—and by the kind service of his grandson, or maybe his son. My heart felt warm because of them.

On my last day, I said goodbye and told them I hoped we’d meet again next year.
I visit Chiang Mai every year, so it felt a little sad that I only discovered this place now.
At the end of 2026, I’ll go there every day :)
Until then, I wish you good health and happiness.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee, good price! The owner is very kind, and the service is thoughtful, they provide mosquitoes spray on every table. Sometimes you have to wait over 20mins due to too many customers, but the owner will tell you waiting time while ordering. This cafe is almost my everyday coming-to place. Really a hidden gem!
review_3_text:
We stopped by 2 days we were in Chiang Mai, and on Christmas day we got takeaways (where they gave us Dunkin Donuts free with our coffee 🥲)
They’re so kind and generous, it cost us 70baht (Aus$3.50) for 2 coffees, mine with almond milk (milk lab too) which is crazy, they could easily charge double, & the coffee is good quality. They provide free water & wifi, and kindly refused when i tried to leave them a tip.
The bathroom for the cafe is in their house which they kindly let me use.

If you are in the area definitely check them out, they deserve all the business they can get & they make incredible coffees.

thank you so much ☺️
review_4_text: Wanna know why this place is popular? The latte is double the size of other places, 40bhat, and tastes A+ level. Yea you could find some places with S tier coffee that might edge Areemitr out, but you will pay triple the price or more. The only downside is the wait times; I hope they can upgrade to a larger machine or hire help and expand their wonderful business.
review_5_text:
The iced latte ☕ really lives up to the recommendations—absolutely delicious. The price is a rare find in this area at just 40 THB.🌟

The owner and his son are incredibly lovely and welcoming, which adds to the experience. The location works perfectly for me and gives off very homey, cozy vibes.

The only small note is that the menu is quite limited, but that’s totally okay. I’ll definitely be coming back!💖

name: อยู่สุข - U sook 𝗛𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝗳𝗲
review_1_text: I really like this place ,I came here many times so it’s already my second home 😊🌻
review_2_text: What’s not to love?? The staff is kind, the ambience is like a cozy crafty back yard garden, the food and drinks are tasty. My new favorite place in santitham 💗
review_3_text: My favourite coffee shop in Chiang Mai. Beautiful large hot latte and a cake for 100B and in a garden with plenty of shade and fans. Super chilled out place to relax.
review_4_text: I was passing by the store and the atmosphere seemed nice, so I went in. Inside, there are plenty of tables and various small activities, making it a great place to bring kids. They also have coffee, light meals, and a bakery menu. A hot Americano costs 40 baht, and it was so delicious that I couldn't help but wonder, "Is this only 40 baht?" It was a very smooth and well-balanced coffee. The other menu items were also good :)
review_5_text: This is a cute cafe. The food and drinks are delicious and reasonably priced. We ordered Khao Soi Gai (chicken noodle soup) and Pad Krapow (stir-fried basil with chicken), both were excellent. The matcha sago dessert was unique and tasty. There are many photo opportunities and activities to do. The service was excellent. Highly recommended.

name: Magic Brew Coffee
review_1_text: Absolutely 5 stars. A magic cafe that brews both good coffee and Thai tea. Once you drink their ice latte and fresh orange americano, you will understand why they have queues everyday in the shop. Drinks are cheap, around 40/50 baht per cup. The owner grows his own bean proudly. I think they are a family small business. Do order their ice latte, it’s strong nutty flavored coffee with special chocolate aroma. Most importantly, try their Thai tea, both black and green are super good. Their tea is way better than Chatramue with same price. I guess their secret is to boil the tea with moka pot. Fantastic flavor! My top 5 cafe in Chiangmai.
review_2_text:
During my stay in Chiang Mai, my perfect morning routine starts next door at Nana Bakery, where I pick up a freshly baked pastry, then bring it over to Magic Brew Cafe to enjoy with their excellent latte.

This cozy spot attracts many regular Western customers, some even bringing their own breakfast to pair with the coffee. The latte here has a rich, full-bodied flavor with low acidity, which makes it one of my personal favorites in town.

The staff are friendly and welcoming, and the menu is affordable with plenty of variety, making it a great choice for a relaxed and satisfying start to the day.
review_3_text: This neighborhood cafe seems to have a devoted crowd of regulars and I can understand why. Good relaxing vibes, super friendly barista and his partner who seem dedicated to their craft. Very good coffee at one of the lowest prices around.  What's not to like?
review_4_text:
Tried so many coffee and Thai tea in chiang mai. This is the best. The coffee is delicious and made with such care and love. The thai tea is brewed in a mocha pot, it gives it a special kick of freshness and taste.

The smoothies, the coconut, the orange coffee - everything in this shop is so fresh, and you can feel it when you drink.

+ they have a large bar sitting, it functions as a real social hub of santitham.
Costumers are a mix of locals and foreigners with a good palette for coffee.

Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
A coffee shop in Chiang Mai that’s always busy with both locals and tourists.
They offer three roast levels — light, medium, and dark. I’m a dark-roast person, so I usually go for the iced dark-roast espresso. It’s bold, aromatic, and really refreshing.
Good prices and friendly service make this a place I can come back to almost every day. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in Chiang Mai. 👍

name: Mood:D Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text: Cute little indoor / air conditioned cafe. Peaceful break from traffic noise. Fair prices considering the overheads they would have. I had the teriyaki chicken bowl and plain iced latte. Food was tasty. Only disappointment was the coffee that didn’t have any ice and was sweetened heavily without me asking. Maybe due to a language miscommunication.  They have some baked goods that looked nice though I didn’t try them. There is a little shelf of card and board games that people can use, which is a nice touch.
review_2_text: Relatively modern cafe with AC. You can choose the roast level of your coffee here, but my americano should be better for the price. I also tried chicken nuggets and that could be better as well. The space is nicer than many cafes around with some decent tables and power outlets. It would be not a bad option during the summer time.
review_3_text: I stopped by for a quick drink, and ended up having hours of great conversation with the owner and her staff. The decor is simple and minimalist, and I even got to see the rooftop area that serves really delicious izakaya style skewers. Great sunset and mountain view there. The business is fairly new so I look forward to how the cafe/hostel/izakaya combination will evolve in the future.
review_4_text: We came 3-4 times and ordered the same thing 🤣🤣 its so good and affordable too
review_5_text: I really liked the cafe, it is small and very clean. The interior is nice. The coffee was tasty and the brownie was good too. This is a good place to work because they provide fast wifi, A/C, sockets and most importantly the place is quiet.

name: บ.เสือป่า-ไอที จำกัด
review_1_text: The parking lot is spacious, the staff are friendly, and there is a complete range of food stalls, coffee shops, IT equipment, and mobile phones. I really like it.
review_2_text: Sent the phone for repairs. The first time in March, they sent it back very quickly. In short, the Wi-Fi didn't work and the sound was gone. Sent it back again in early April. Until now in May, it still hasn't been repaired. In short, is it repaired or is it being delayed?
review_3_text: The repair service was very fast and efficient.
review_4_text: I went to buy IT equipment. I bought several items and asked for wholesale prices. I really like it.
review_5_text:
So skilled
Understand the problem
Standard repair price

name: RUF Cafe
review_1_text: service is nice and coffee is not bad
review_2_text: The air conditioning is cool, the music is great, there's plenty of parking, and the staff are welcoming. Come and check it out! 🤟🏼😎
review_3_text: A super chic coffee shop in the Santitham area. The atmosphere is great, with lots of photo spots and a spacious parking area. The staff are friendly and helpful.
review_4_text: The sweet drinks/coffee are delicious. The atmosphere in the shop is beautifully decorated. It is located in the FUR shop. The parking lot is very spacious. When we went, there was a promotion, buy 2 get 1 free. 🥰
review_5_text:
Want to lose weight? Drink an Americano. Want a phone number? Be brave enough to ask.

RUF Cafe, with its Hot Summer style, is located in the FUR CAFE CNX project, alongside a kingdom of imported furniture from America and Scandinavia from famous designers. The colors are eye-catching, and they also sell furniture. There's plenty of parking.
The drink menu includes coffee with a choice of medium and dark roast beans, as well as non-coffee options.

name: Happy Penguin
review_1_text: Loved this coffee stand! The prices are super nice, and the coffee is delicious. Fast service, nice people, and great value for money. Highly recommend!

name: Sugar Kaffee
review_1_text:
Chiang Mai is famous for its coffee culture. You can find coffee shops nearly everywhere, and this shop is one of the greatest values.

The average price for a cup of coffee in the coffee house (the place where free Wi-Fi is provided and you can sit for a while for your works) is around 50 THB. And the average price for a cup of coffee in the small coffee shop (the place without proper sitting areas, like street stalls etc.) usually ranges between 30 - 40 THB.

However, this coffee shop has made the great value. With 20 THB for a hot coffee and 25 THB for an iced one, the price is killing.

They also provide some basic seats for a rest, but not the lounge like you can get your works done. Still, it is a good price for coffee and the taste is good too.

Overall it’s a good place to have some coffee
review_2_text: 20thb for americano and 25thb for cappuccino and other coffee doesn’t matter hot or ice. The price is so good and the coffee is good too.
review_3_text: Delicious Hot Cappuccino for 20b? I'll gladly come here 2-3x a day at these prices. I just noticed they have an upstairs terrace, looks neat. Maybe I'll hang out next time.
review_4_text:
Been coming here every day now for two months.
Lovely coffee, great spot in the heart of Santitham
Chiang Mai, Tic and Goy will serve you with the warmest of welcomes.
review_5_text:
Perfect price! Have vegan milk ✨🫶🙏👍
Thank you so much

name: PAPA ANDRÉ Café & Bistro
review_1_text:
A cute coffee shop located in a small alley.

Drinks and desserts are available at reasonable prices (as shown on the menu).

Few board games are imported recently to kill some time.
review_2_text: A small, simple shop, but every dish is delicious.

name: LAMO.COFFEE&TEA(CHIANGMAI)
review_1_text: This restaurant is really delicious, everything on the menu is great. Highly recommend!

name: soh
review_1_text: Such a wonderful time with great coffee and excellent cakes and pastries. Brilliantly executed by Sunny and Yun, the lovely couple who own and run this magical place. Sit back, enjoy the great music and the fantastic food. You may see a couple of cute stray cats lounging about relaxing. Don't miss this spot. Thanks guys, we really had a great time. See you soon.
review_2_text: Great place! Come visit if you are around. They have a very special coffee, best one I tried in Chiang Mai, and better than that, they have great service. Always smiling and being kind. I wish them the best and recommend for a stop if you want to get a coffe and a small cake. Everything handmade.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee; delicious cardamom bun and very sweet owners. I had a lovely chat with them. It's a bit out of my way but I'm gonna visit again to try more of their pastries and drink this good coffee again. Kapunka Sandy and Yun 🩷
review_4_text: We tried the matcha banana cake and really enjoyed it. The owner was very welcoming and runs the café by themselves, which made the experience feel extra personal. The place is small, cute, and cozy — a lovely spot to slow down and enjoy a treat.
review_5_text: Stop by and soak up some immaculate vibes ✨️with Yun and Sunny, a charming couple who speak good English and handmake their baked goods daily. Super Charming spot!

name: Maldives Cafe Santhitham
review_1_text: She is so kind and the smoothie is good
review_2_text: Coming from Bangkok looking for a coffee shop, I stumbled upon this one. It's not a very big shop, but the coffee and Thai tea are delicious. The prices are reasonable. Good, I recommend it.
review_3_text: Very delicious, strong coffee flavor.

name: Good One
review_1_text: Coffee shop opens on Valentine's Day, February 14, 2021

name: fine fine mood
review_1_text: One of the best coffee shops in town. I love it so much and they are so nice!!!! Amazing Americano❤️ The new venue is so cute! Highly recommend
review_2_text: The best coffee is here , I love this coffee shop 😋 😍 💕
review_3_text: Cute little cafe. Friendly guy working there. Very chill, nice for working :)
review_4_text:
Ordered mocha and was delicious.
The owner was calm but kind and friendly.
Like the mood of the place.
review_5_text: Nice and  comfy space for coffee

name: Slow bar cafe’หน้าตึก
review_1_text: I picked up ice americano and it was a bit too diluted. You can not choose the roast level here.
review_2_text: This cafe doesn't exist. As usual closed businesses keep the Google maps page open, in negligence.
review_3_text: Good
review_4_text:
I got my haircut thanks to a recommendation from a nail salon. There's also a hair salon inside, and the barista in the photo is also a designer. I showed her the style I wanted, and she shampooed and cut my hair right away. I was worried, but she did such a great job that I'm going back for another perm. ^^
Changed my hairstyle while traveling...it was an exciting experience. ^^
review_5_text: Strong coffee, nice atmosphere, and the barista is good at chatting with customers.

name: Sweet Memory
review_1_text: Delicious food, friendly vendors

name: หน้าบ้านมีแฟ
JJ COFFEE
review_1_text: healthy food with great taste and sweet staff!
review_2_text: Good coffee and a very friendly staff
review_3_text: closed maybe
review_4_text: Tasty

name: COFFEE OR TEA
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee spot set up in a truck, with a warm and welcoming vibe. I had a cold cappuccino and it was excellent! The place is also impressively clean.
review_2_text: This is a cute coffee shop near my hotel. I drank coffee there every morning and afternoon during my three-day stay in Santitham. Both the coffee and tea were delicious. The shop was also very clean. And best of all, the owner was friendly, kind, and easy to talk to. If I ever return to Santitham, I'll definitely visit again.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee, a wide variety of menu options, and great prices!

Savor exquisite European-style cakes and pastries, paired with expertly brewed coffee and a variety of fine teas—all at prices friendlier than those in the historic center. What makes this experience truly special? Every visit supports and empowers the local deaf community, making your time here not only delightful but meaningful.

review_3_text:
Hello. I'm InRoll, a 100% Korean.

There are so many cafes in Santitham. Some are so famous you can't even find a spot, while others have thousands of stars and incredibly good reviews. However, if you look carefully, you'll find some with few reviews but still great reviews. This is a hidden gem cafe. Located right next to the market, it's not an easy place to find, but if you visit, you'll experience something special.

They serve coffee that's attractive to look at, and I found it to be the strongest and most delicious coffee in Chiang Mai. Of course, don't ask for it to be sweetened. That way, you can enjoy the original flavor. The taste was incredibly rich and nutty. Every time I go to a cafe, the flavor varies depending on the milk they use, but this one was just right. The rich, nutty flavor was so good that I couldn't help but say it was delicious.

If you're visiting this market or planning to, I highly recommend stopping by. They usually don't have seating, so you can get takeout. Thank you.
review_4_text:
After work, I had some time to wander around Chiang Mai. I wandered around from Chang Phueak Bus Terminal to Thanin Market, where I stopped for a coffee. Walking through the market, I found SS Coffee, a small, uncrowded coffee shop with a friendly atmosphere and excellent prices. Coffee starts at just 45 baht! It's a rare price. Try ordering a medium-roast iced Americano and you'll see that even for just ten baht, you can find quality and flavor. It's not just about the intensity, but also the aroma of the coffee beans.
The owner also acts as a guide, offering recommendations for places to visit in Chiang Mai. Chatting with him was fun, like hanging out at a friend's house.
For those looking for a good cup of coffee to replenish their caffeine fix during a day of exploring Chiang Mai, this is a must-try.
review_5_text: I'm not a coffee drinker, but of all the ones I've had, this shop is the most delicious. The iced latte has a fragrant aroma of coffee and milk, just the right strength, not bitter, and not too sweet. The iced green tea is also fragrant and rich, not cloyingly sweet, and well-balanced. The iced cocoa has a strong cocoa flavor, not cloyingly sweet. The owner is very polite, and his skills are consistently excellent. The price is not outrageously expensive, and it's worth it for the well-balanced flavor that you can't find in expensive, luxurious shops.

The shop's decor features beautifully painted polar-themed murals on the walls. The air conditioning is icy cold, creating a truly chill atmosphere. The shop offers both bingsu and drinks, just like any other cafe. The bingsu comes in two sizes, and the flavors are decent.
review_4_text: ZONE Bingsu & Café is a very stylish cafe. The interior has a calming atmosphere, perfect for relaxing. Their bingsu (Korean shaved ice) is especially delicious, with a wide variety of flavors, including fruit and red beans. Each one is beautifully presented, almost too good to eat. The drink menu is also extensive, offering not only coffee and tea, but also seasonal special drinks. The friendly staff and excellent service are a plus. It's a great spot for chatting with friends, reading alone, or even a date, so be sure to give it a try. I'm sure it'll become your favorite.
review_5_text:
I'll definitely be back here! 💓 Normally, when I go to other bingsu places, I don't finish them because they're too sweet.
But I ordered two items at this place and finished them all. They were incredibly delicious, not too sweet, and a joy to eat.
The blueberry bingsu was incredibly delicious! The size M cost 185 baht, which is a great value for the portion.
In the hot weather, if you're looking for a cool dessert, I highly recommend this place.

name: ทันใจ กาแฟโบราณ
review_1_text: Traditional style drink store that sells coffee, thai milk tea and other drinks. The way they make coffee here is old style. The thai milk tea I got was a bit too sweet though.
review_2_text: Delicious and inexpensive✨

name: Choy Coffee
review_1_text: It was good experience. Had variety of choices for coffee. I ordered honely lemon matcha and orange coffee which both were an experience. They're located in the market so you have a chance to walk around too to buy fruit or snacks. They open really early to fulfill your early dose of caffeine. Nice place.
review_2_text: Finally I found a morning coffee shop that I can easily take out with reasonable price. Of course it has a good coffee
review_3_text: Where can one find good coffee for a low, low price? Choy Coffee, of course. 30 baht for a latte that cost 40-50 baht elsewhere, Choy Coffee is now firmly on my caffeine hit list. They sell more than coffee. The Kiwi Smoothie is something special and the Peach Soda is also a must try. They are tucked in a corner of Thanin Market where the watch repair men are.
review_4_text: Very nice. Iced capu is only 35baht and taste good. Good quality and cheap.
review_5_text: Visited on 12/24. This take-out coffee shop in Thanin Market seems popular and is always busy. You order at the counter and pay when you receive your order. The iced Americano in Chiang Mai is delicious. They offer medium and dark roasts, so be sure to specify when ordering. In addition to coffee, they also offer smoothies and sodas. Please note that there is no seating available, so if you want to relax, please be aware of this.

name: Minimal coffee - Kad Thanin
review_1_text: Minimal is one of the best pick up coffee chains in Chiang Mai. Their cappuccino and latte are especially good. I have been to some of other locations and they have just opened up this one and it is right by a large local market.
review_2_text: Small coffee shop, good coffee with 3 bean options: light, medium and dark roast.
review_3_text: One of my favourite coffeeshops in cnx. Very kind staff and great coffee.
review_4_text: The best coffee for 40b. There is choice of 3 grades of bean roast. Demand Signature, the smoothest one, and you'll be indulged. Though there is no any cakes just coockies
review_5_text: Iced Coffee Latte is the best!!!

name: Early Owls
review_1_text: I really enjoyed the food here and meals were under 200 baht each from what I saw. I enjoyed my coffee. The atmosphere is nice. Only have lower stars on service as it is pretty much self service goto the counter order and pay. But the staff standing outside were helpful if you asked questions. Nice quiet cafe area to relax in.
review_2_text:
Latte 80 ฿ (2025)

Has english menu.

Very nice environment and they offer tiny camping chairs and tables that you could take and bring it to anywhere you like to sit.

Setup your own camp, and be happy with the greenary environment here.

The trees are tall and there are some noisy squirrels here, maybe their mating season. One of them is an albino. (I think with its pale complexion)

The coffee was okay, i appreciate the latte art, and really i am here to drink the view in with me.

Nice toilet and clean too.
review_3_text:
This was the first cafe we visited in Chiang Mai. It’s a beautiful and peaceful place, and we liked the concept of choosing your own place to sit down outside in the garden. The yoghurt bowl and the breakfast wrap were really good, as well as the fresh juices.
Only small downside was, as more guests arrived, the restrooms got messier, but that unfortunately is mostly on the guests, so not really a critique to the cafe.
review_4_text: Good drinks! Helpful staff and the garden was clean and tidy. So nice to sit, relax and have a nice drink. Good place to escape the busy city for a little bit. There was no small table available for us but we preferred the mat anyways for that picnic vibe so it was fine!
review_5_text: Early Owls is a space that has a yoga studio (for indoor practice) and a cafe. There’s also tons of green space to do yoga outdoors. For yoga, you have to pay in advance (250 Baht per person for each class) and you can only book 4-5 days beforehand. The classes are taught in Thai with some English phrases to supplement. Lovely space but didn’t try the food or drinks, and I would say the yoga experience is 4/5.

name: Green Roasters Coffee
review_1_text: Great V60 drip coffee from a local coffee farm 120 baht. Espresso is cheaper of course. The host is very precise, cleans his espresso machine every time, so top quality. Nice atmosphere too.
review_2_text:
This is a great coffee shop in the neighborhood! There are 3 bean roast options available - all of them are local to the Chiang Mai region. The espresso taste is fantastic.

The coffee shop has a cozy feel. And the barista owner is very sweet. The chairs are great for lounging and there’s WiFi available.
review_3_text:
Coffee made with passion & professional attitude is what I felt from Green Roasters.

The time I went was months ago, I remember they offered choice of house blend from Kanchanaburi,  Chiangmai to seasonal blend from Columbia. Price were very affordable from $45B up.

I ordered Flat White, also it's out of the menu but lady owner made it for me, thank you for the coffee, which was nutty and full body.

The cafe itself is very simple and clean. Their coffee machine is same as i saw in Asama Cafe, which is rare in Chiangmai. The morning I went were all locals and the owner were having a class with secondary school students about coffee beans, I was very impressed that they put their efforts not only on business but to the community too.
review_4_text: Very cozy coffee shop in CNX one of hidden gems that you should visit.
review_5_text:
Small coffee roasters and cafes offer a really good coffee for a very reasonable price (especially for the quality). My light roast Americano was clean, tasty with complexity and was not too hot. The shop offers both local and foreign beans.

The owner was friendly and even offered to wash my thermal mug.

name: ชาตรามือ สาขาม.ราชภัฏเชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
This branch also has 'Thai Tea Slushy'!
Or, as it's also called, the Thai Tea Slushy with the "Hand Brand" logo 😋 (You have to spread the word!)

The atmosphere under the classroom building is great; I often stop by to study here.
Because the aroma of Thai tea in the shop helps me relax from studying and also makes me feel more alert.
review_2_text: Cha Tra Mue is a Thai beverage franchise, a Thai tea brand that has been a part of Thailand's culture for over 50 years. They offer drinks such as lemon tea and Thai milk tea, as well as snacks. This branch is located on the 1st floor of the 90th Anniversary Building at Chiang Mai Rajabhat University, Wiang Bua Campus.
review_3_text: I ordered green tea with brown sugar boba. The staff brought me green tea with brown sugar boba. Okay, I understand that communication can be misunderstood. I had already received the order and nothing happened. But the staff turned to another staff and said that the customer was talking nonsense. Is this okay? How did you know? My friend who was standing there heard it all. She glanced at the customer with the corner of her eye. If you don't love service work, go do something else. Or stay in the back and don't come out to greet customers. Just because you're a university student, can you treat me however you want? I came to pay as a customer. Because I asked many friends and they have encountered similar situations many times where the staff have used harsh words. Please improve our service.
review_4_text: The staff have very poor manners; they should receive training in customer service etiquette.
review_5_text: The employee insulted the customer and caused damage.

name: Friendly. Drink
review_1_text: Totally recommend!!! Amazing coffee! Excellent fresh, fruity drinks! (They no longer serve food, but there’s a great Khao Soi restaurant across the street.)
review_2_text: Friendly lady, excellent smoothie! 🙏
review_3_text: The matcha is incredibly delicious (with a million 'k's!), the price is lovely, and the service is 100% excellent! 🫸🏻💘🫷🏻
review_4_text: Thai tea and fruit smoothies are delicious!
review_5_text:
☺️ The smoothies are so delicious and refreshing! 😍 I personally love the taro smoothie the most. It's fragrant, sweet, and has sweet whipped cream. It's so delicious when eaten hot! 🥰
Come and visit! The owner is kind 😊 and there's nice music to listen to 🥰

name: Hana Kaze - ฮานะ คาเซะ ม.ราชภัฎ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: I ordered a flower and coffee set, but the initial delivery was incorrect. I contacted the shop, and they promptly corrected it. They handled the situation very well. The flowers are lovely, and everyone complimented them. I'm extremely impressed! 😊
review_2_text: The iced tea is incredibly delicious! The milk story drink is amazing and so refreshing. The shredded chicken noodles are also very tasty and filling. They also sell flowers, and the florist and barista are super nice!
review_3_text: The flower arrangements are so beautiful and sweet. You can specify what kind of flower you want. It looks exactly like the picture, and the drinks are delicious.
review_4_text: The flower shop is very cute, I was impressed. The staff are friendly.
review_5_text:
I messaged them late at night and they still responded, which was amazing!!!
The shop is lovely and the service is excellent. The coffee tastes great and the flower basket is adorable. I'll definitely shop there again when I have the chance. ❤️

name: MILK BAR coffee & beverage
review_1_text:
Very nice coffee, full of flavour, dark roast .
Had a latte, not over sweetened like in many other places, but still smooth and delicious. Would highly recommend.
review_2_text: Fresh coffee is very good price, 30 baht. The taste is delicious and worth the price. This is my regular shop.

review_2_text: The owner is friendly, the shop is cute, and the food tastes great. When it first opened, they had a buy one get one free promotion. The promotion is over now, but I still come to support them as a customer.
review_3_text: A cozy cafe with delicious coffee for 50 baht and friendly service. Oat milk was included free of charge ;)
review_4_text: I recommend very good coffee and nice owners
review_5_text: The soft latte is so delicious!!! 🩷🩷 I love it!

review_2_text: The shop is cute. The crepes are delicious and you get a lot. I'll come back and support you again.
review_3_text: Strong tea, not-too-sweet whipped cream. Good! 👍
review_4_text: The crispy rolled wafers are delicious—small, thin, and wonderfully crunchy. The fresh coffee is strong and satisfying, and the crepes are generous in portion size. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: The whipped cream is so delicious and smooth.

name: Elite Coffee Old Home (หลัง ม.ราชภัฏ)

review_2_text: A fantastic roadside shop; the owner is warm and welcoming, the coffee is good, and the interior is comfortable.

name: พอดีคาเฟ่ & บิสโทร Por Dee Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: Very cute cafe and bistro. Very quiet and peaceful place. You can definitely enjoy the atmosphere and your coffee. The aunties were very friendly and charming. Coffee was so good. The cheese and spinach toast I ordered was cute and delicious. They only take cash. I'd definitely visit this place again. Great place to chill and relax. This place was very close to my airbnb and recommended by my host. I highly commend ☺️❤️
review_2_text:
A warm welcome awaits you by Sai and her team.
Beautiful fresh coffee and flavour filled food served with hospitality in a  magestically beautiful and peaceful oasis to relax in.
review_3_text: Such a nice relaxing cafe with a very nice well maintained garden. I came to have lunch and it was not really a good decision as their pasta and food were not as good as many other local restaurants around. However, the space is very nice so I don’t regret coming here anyways. Getting some drinks would be good here.
review_4_text: Great comfortable place to get some work done and drink great coffee.  There’s a nice padded leather bench seat that extends one length of the place that’s really nice to sit on.  The tables are beautifully crafted and so solid they don’t rock around when your leaning on them.  There’s some futon style seating and an outdoor area but the air conditioned interior is fantastic.  A hot latte will cost you 55 baht, they have WiFi and it’s quite fast. #BeatTheGrind
review_5_text:
A beautiful café with plants— but the manager is stubborn and has arrogant pride.

If you order a coffee and charge your MacBook there, they would charge 100 baht per hour. (coffee is around 70 baht, tasteful).

I asked if the charging fee could be cheaper (already I showed intent for paying 'electricity fee'), and the manager got annoyed in 2 minutes and forbade me to enter.

Ok, so I went to another café, and just wrote an honest review.

name: อุดม Coffee

review_2_text: Great little coffee shop with good drinks selection. The owner is very professional and kind.
review_3_text: Very amazing a tasty drinks and good price
review_4_text:

review_1_text: The shop owner is friendly and the prices are very reasonable, not expensive at all, starting from 25฿.

name: Seal Sweet Chiang Mai
review_1_text: This cafe is rlly cozy and really cute. It’s perfect for anyone who wants to have a chill day or relax with some cute atmosphere and enjoy Japanese aesthetic style of cafe. The drinks are also really delicious and good pricing as well.
review_2_text: The atmosphere is great, cool, quiet, and a nice place to sit. There are various toys to play with, and the seal plushie is adorable. The drinks are delicious and well-balanced. I highly recommend going!
review_3_text: The shop isn't big, but it's super cute! They even have video games to play. It feels like hanging out at a friend's place with your group.
review_4_text: The Orange Americano here is really delicious... The daytime temperature of 35 degrees Celsius has completely cooled down. If you like Orange Americano, please try it here🥹
review_5_text: The cafe is nice and the decor is very cute. However, the reviews said it was quiet and peaceful, but when I arrived, the cafe was full of noisy and annoying students. It was almost impossible to take pictures anywhere. They had taken other people's chairs and tables to put their belongings and bags on, leaving only the tables available. They were playing games, working, and talking loudly. I had to sit outside to find some peace and quiet. It was hot inside, though; the only cool place was inside the cafe.

name: Piccolo coffee
review_1_text: Piccola Coffee is a coffee shop located inside Borabora. Initially, I followed the signs to the coffee shop but couldn't find it. I had to call to find out that I parked at the Bora Bora parking lot. It's a small coffee shop; you order and pay, then go up a side staircase to the second floor. There aren't many tables, but the view is great and it's super chill.

name: JJ House caf'e เจเจเฮ้าส์ คาเฟ่ บริการอาหาร&เครื่องดื่ม สำหรับสายนั่งชิลล์

review_2_text:
Cheap condensed milk green tea

name: Crepesso cafe (クレ－ペッソ カフェ)
review_1_text: A very lovely and well decorated place to get your dose of caffeine! The owners are very friendly and smiley! The price is very affordable and the coffee/milk tea here is very good! I'd definitely come back here again for it! Croffles are not bad either!
review_2_text: Very chilled place in nice relaxed area, good coffee, great friendly owners and super cute chubby dog☺️🫠 Reccomend to come for a nice coffee time☕️🐶
review_3_text:
Lovely and clean little cafe. Coffee and Thai tea is incredible!
We also really enjoyed the croissants.
Very affordable price. Very friendly people!
Highly recommend!
review_4_text: My first time to know about and try the passion fruit presso and it was great as my drink of choice is always iced Americano. The coffee beans are roasted also giving the Americano a fresh smooth roasted flavor.
review_5_text: A wonderful café. Perfect coffee, excellent service, and low prices.

name: ฮิมขัว Coffee&Waffle
review_1_text: I stayed at a hotel nearby and came here almost every day for the delicious lattes and cozy, comfortable atmosphere. The  food is delicious as well (I had salad wraps and waffles). And the owner is so genuinely kind and welcoming. I highly recommend this place!
review_2_text:
While strolling around the area, we stumbled upon this café by chance, and what a wonderful discovery! The owner is incredibly kind and helpful. The coffee and waffles are simply amazing 😍
Go ​​for it, it's really inexpensive and the quality is excellent.
Thanks again for a lovely time 🌸
review_3_text: The waffles are incredibly good and the coffee is perfect, thank you so much for the warm welcome 😊

name: Keane Coffee and Guest House.
review_1_text: Really nice coffe shop. We had a night flight and had to wait few hours to check in to our hotel so visited this place. The people working didn't mind us waiting and relaxing. We ordered few drinks and truly enjoyed them. The lemon cheesecake tea was unbelievably good.
review_2_text:
If you’re looking for a cozy-ish spot to sip coffee while escaping the crowds, Keane Coffee & Guest House is a hidden gem near Jing Jai Market. With its vintage and hipster decor, stepping inside feels like entering a warm, inviting home. The ambiance is relaxing with nice music in the background, although the lighting leans a bit too warm for our taste.

The seating is well thought out, with options for both work and chilling. We enjoyed their light and medium roast iced lattes, both of which were made well. They also have a good selection of non-caffeinated drinks, making it a great choice for everyone. They also have non-dairy milk options with additional 20 Bahts. The drinks are priced between 60-85 Bahts which is not bad for the air conditioned cafe.

On a second visit, we tried the Thai iced tea, but it was a bit too creamy for our liking, despite its popularity. The butter cake was tasty but on the small side for the price.

Overall, it’s a lovely cafe with friendly owners and a chill vibe, perfect for getting some work done or just unwinding with good music.

Definitely worth checking out!
review_3_text:
I’m so proud of myself for finding such a cozy and minimalist space in Chiang Mai. I even feel a little envious to share this vibe with others! But I truly hope that someone who’s been longing for a place like this will discover it and find peace of mind here.
The place is super clean and smells amazing. The guest house is safe, quiet, and reasonably priced.
The café is perfect for chilling, reading, or even a photo shoot.
review_4_text: This room has a minimalist and cozy design. The dark green walls create a calm and relaxing ambiance, while the warm beige curtains complement the darker tones. The low bed with dark bedding adds to the simplicity, and the wooden floor provides a natural and warm feel. The bedside table with a lamp and water bottles adds functionality and a welcoming touch. The ceiling-mounted air conditioner ensures comfort, but the room might feel a bit small due to the compact arrangement. Overall, it’s a practical and serene space.🫶🏻🧸
review_5_text: Feel like home , cozy ,classy, friendly 🧋🥤☕️

name: วิฬาร์คาเฟ่น้องแมวเชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
First of all, Thais can get into the cafe just order a drink and enjoy your cat vibes there. However, foreigners have to pay 100 baht minimum for the entry even though you get a drink as well.
I don't understand why they have 2 prices for the entry, what's the matter?
The cats were so cute and very chubby though.
review_2_text: It's very make your happy if you come here you will love because cats have so cute 🥰🥰If you don't want to play cat games, there are board games and drinks available.
review_3_text:
I'd describe this place as quaint, peaceful, and homey. You'd expect that the place would be dirty because of the aesthetic but everything was clean and smelt good.

The music played in the cafe added to the peaceful vibe of the place, and the service was fast and the staff were really helpful. The drinks they had was cheap too, and were quite good.

If you're in the area, this place is a must-visit for cat lovers.
review_4_text: Found this place coincidentally and was a true gem. The place has a good drinks menu and cute cats. All cats look quite comfortable with people and it shows how well these cats are living in this place. There r also board games, so u can kill ur time if u get bored. But u won't be, because of these cute cats! Such a healing place for me 🥹
review_5_text:
You may have the whole playground with the cats if you visit this place around noon time.

Very peaceful with soft music.

All the cats are super cute.

The beverage price is very reasonable.

review_5_text: The staff is very slow, only taking orders and not processing orders that were already taken... It's a huge waste of time. They haven't even started working in 10 minutes.

The juices, milk tea, and desserts here are all delicious, but I really wanted to share the new homemade rice paper rolls!❗️The organic vegetables were sweet and went perfectly with the homemade Thai herb sauce!❣️

name: Gallery Drip Coffee JingJai Market
review_1_text: This café gets quite busy on weekends, but it’s spacious with plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors. The coffee is genuinely good, and the staff are fast and friendly. Located right inside Jing Jai Market, it’s super convenient to enjoy a cup of coffee and then wander around shopping.
review_2_text:
Located at the end of the open air market, this air conditioned cafe offers a much needed respite from the heat. There are Thai beans of various origin, taste profile, and processing method. We were happy to take the staff's recommendation and liked our iced black.

The ice jelly however was kind of weird, too milky and the jelly wasn't smooth like we expected.
review_3_text: A coffee shop serving only drip coffee, with a calm Japanese-style atmosphere and beautifully crafted sustainable natural furniture.
review_4_text: Very friendly staff and delicious drinks - highly recommend the Black Honey Coffee & Thai Tea.
review_5_text: The gallery drip is a pillar in the Thailand coffee scene. From Hua Hin to BkK to CM, it’s a great place to this location is beautiful and the staff are amazing. Great coffee.

name: COME-SOOK Slow Bar
review_1_text: Nice cold brew and ice cocoa (my kid's most favorite). Bakery is delicious with good ingredients. The owner is a friendly person. I visit this shop every time whenever I am in Chiang-mai. Starting to know from Nana Jungle Market 4 years ago.
review_2_text:
Bought during the Nana Jungle saturday market
One of the most delicious drip coffees I’ve had plus a lot of options ☕️
Down to earth & professional, friendly & fast 👍🏼
Underrated, will come again before leaving chiangmai
review_3_text: Nice coffee truck ☕️🚚
review_4_text: Friendly and passionate Barista with good coffee
review_5_text: Excellent Arabica coffee.

name: Thancoff Coffee Truck
review_1_text:
This is such a unique way to setup a barista brew in a fully equipped truck, The artisanal coffee is wonderfully aromatic with a bold, full-bodied flavour.

As it’s a one-man operation, you simply write your name and order on a slip of paper and pin it onto a metal stand — a fun and charming system that adds to the experience.

There are several unique coffee vendors brewing coffee at their own special way at Jing Jai Market however I trusted coffee machine more than any other way ☕️
review_2_text:
This is a one man operation serving coffee and tea beverages in Jing Jai market.

The ordering system was a little difficult to fathom at the start as it was not stated - you write out your name and orders on a slip of paper and then stick it in the spike in front. The owner/server will work his way through the order slips and call your name when it is your turn.

It can be quite a long wait on a busy day as it is just one man, but the drinks were still nice.  We had three cappacinos, a caramel latte and two Americanos without sugar.  Prices start from 50 THB.
review_3_text: The owner was already closing up the store but still made me a really good iced latte! Thank you!
review_4_text: Need something to drink at Jingjai market, and attracted by this good looking truck. Ordered an orange coffee, not the best but still good.
review_5_text: Cute coffee truck in the market, but 75% of the cup is just ice. Got a matcha orange and the taste is just ok. Not worth the wait.

name: Roastniyom JJ-ECO ร้านกาแฟรสนิยมสาขา ECO (ตลาดจริงใจมาร์เก็ต)
review_1_text:
A Hidden Gem in the Rhythm of a Hectic Life**

If you're looking for a perfect break spot in the Chang Phueak area, come to **Roastniyom JJ-ECO, True Market branch (Address: RX4W+7H8)**. This shop is like a small oasis hidden in a bustling market.

*   **Atmosphere:** Relaxed and friendly, perfect for a short rest while shopping or waiting for friends. There is both indoor and outdoor seating.
*   **Service:** The staff are friendly and very fast. They are cheerful and make drinks quickly, even during busy times.
*   **Taste:** The coffee has a rich and well-balanced taste as expected from Roastniyom. The latte has a fragrant milk foam and beautiful art on the cup. It's a great drink for re-energizing.
*   **Conclusion:** A great "value-for-money" shop. Convenient and fast. The RX4W+7H8 pin makes it very easy to find! Highly recommended if you are near the Chang Phueak area.
review_2_text:
I visited this café and was truly impressed by both the atmosphere and the quality of the coffee.

However, during my visit on February 10, 2026, the staff member on duty appeared quite tired and slightly tense, which affected the overall experience for customers to some extent. It even made me hesitate to order an additional drink, despite the menu being very appealing. My friends who were with me noticed the same thing.

Having additional staff during busy periods might help the service run more smoothly, as the café is clearly very popular. Every time I visit Chiang Mai, I bring friends here and always recommend this place to other international friends as well.

On a previous visit, I was served by a male staff member who handled a very busy and noisy situation with great professionalism. He was polite, attentive, and considerate. My friends were very impressed, and one of them translated for me when he apologized to customers for the noise that day (the café was extremely crowded). I could tell he was tired and working alone, and although he seemed a bit stressed, he still did his best to smile and provide excellent service to everyone.

Overall, this is a lovely café, and I sincerely hope to have an even better experience on my next visit.
review_3_text:
Nice cafe in heart of the market.

Air conditioning was very comfortable.The place to set inside is limited.But you can sit outside, If the weather is good.

I\nTried the black orange coffee?Which is just expresso in orange juice and it was just Devine.That's what you need on a hot summer day.
review_4_text:
Very nice coffee in this chain. All other branches I got good service. They got my order wrong. Then they told me there's no large lattes🙄.
I asked for extra hot. They gave me like warm. I asked them to make it hotter. They microwaved it 😳😅.
Honestly Roastniyom you normally do better.  This branch has a service problem☠️☠️☠️
review_5_text: The coconut latte was so delicious. Recommended, especially if you do not drink milk. Cold with coconut pieces. The atmosphere is beautiful. Good for work, read or anything talk with a friend. Quite during weekdays.

review_2_text: Loving the vibe here on a lazy Wednesday afternoon. Got the americano beer, not actual beer, just americano topped with cream cheese. Perfect snack/drink. And this chain looks amazing (based on the pics on the menu).

The hot mocha is nice, got a great latte art on it, no sweet very chocolate and the milk is of good quality! The only downside is they overshadowed the espresso flavour for a bit.

The staff are so friendly. You can also purchase drip bags and whole beans here.
review_4_text: We loved our visit to this coffee shop. It is beautiful inside, small but very zen and it has a lovely vibe. They have a lot of matcha drinks, good coffee and icecream. Our drinks were very good, the service was friendly and we will be back here again soon.
review_5_text: I have visited many branches of the Baristro , and this one is near Jing Jai Market, it is very convenient to visit. The space is just right, the coffee is great and the staff are very nice.

review_1_text: Great small cafe with a cool, laid-back atmosphere. The coffee is excellent and the bakery selection is super tasty. Definitely worth a visit if you’re looking for a chill spot to grab a caffeine fix in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: Excellent coffee. Choice of light roast or dark roast artisanal coffee beans. I had a double cappuccino, which was superb. Located right next to the weekly Jing Jai farmers market.

review_4_text: This coffee shop and bakery in Kad Kham Thiang offers a comfortable seating area with beautiful potted plants, croissants, and a selection of pastries. It's a great place to relax and enjoy the plants afterwards.
review_5_text: Hong Kong egg waffles are delicious! It's close to Jing Zhai Market and a great place to visit the flower market!

name: Choojai Coffee
review_1_text:
The coffee man who grew, roast, grind and make his own pour over coffee in a bustling weekend market! It’s as much as an experience as it is good coffee. You get a choice of light or medium roast and my favourite was definitely the light. You can sit for as long as you like, and get as many cups as you like - it’s a pay as you wish place. Also sells bags of his own beans and ground coffee as well. A lot of people are frightened to approach or sit down as there are no clear signs but take the leap of faith and good coffee will follow (no sugar or milk, just pour over). He speaks decent English but coffee is a universal language.

He is only here on weekends! Saw his stand on a Saturday but not in the exact location marked on google maps. Take your time in finding this place - it’s worth it!
review_2_text:
Nice Drip Coffee street stall with interesting pricing: Pay as you like :)

Every cup has a unique drawing too! and you can ask for different levels of roasting. Must stop by if you’re in Jing Jia Market
review_3_text: We saw this coffee on a travel YouTube video and so glad we went to visit. The drip coffee is delicious. There is no set price, you pay by donation. There is a lady there that can draw you on a coffee cup for a donation as well. Great atmosphere and service, definitely recommend checking them out. We went on Saturday and they weren't there and came back to find them on Sunday so might be a Sunday only thing.
review_4_text: Just a guy making pour over. Has light and medium roast. No sugar or milk. He is selling beans on the side and makes them himself. It is free. He is here to make friends and spread love. You can pay but it is up to you and what you can afford. Super nice and creates a wonderful community of people. It is great to listen to the conversations and he truly cares about you and your experience at his little shop. A wonder man.
review_5_text: Good coffee with a relaxing environment. I love the light roast coffee there. Fruity aftertaste note with medium body. Recommended if you are visiting to JingJai Market. (JJ Market)

name: COFFEE ON WHEELS
review_1_text: Great coffee. Smooth , nicely roasted. Friendly staff and the closest I've been to a surfboard for waaaay to long. Really recommend if at Jing Jai Market. They are at the back behind the food market. Look for the surfboard at the van :-)
review_2_text:
Very friendly team behind this truck at Jing Jai open market and they serve good cold drinks like Thai milk tea and other tea beverages.

Service was quite fast and the wait was relatively short.  They are slightly cheaper than Thancoff truck with prices starting from 40 THB.
review_3_text: my partner ordered kiwi soda, it’s not something we would ever ordered but it was absolutely delicious i really recommend it!!
review_4_text: Nice Coffee Truck 🚛 delicious coffee and Thai tea for affordable prices
review_5_text: I came back after two weeks, but it's still a popular coffee shop.

name: MORITORA • もり とら
review_1_text: Nice drinks
review_2_text: Damn good pour over specialty coffee!!!!
review_3_text: This is one of the first camping-themed coffee shops, and the decor is incredibly atmospheric. Being an outdoor cafe, it might be a bit hot, but it's a must-visit for photography enthusiasts!
review_4_text: I came on 19/10/63 at 10.25. It was a ridge with good weather, 23 degrees, comfortable and cool. The overall atmosphere was like camping. I would recommend installing a partition to prevent cars from being seen, that would be awesome. You can park your car at the Jing Jai Market project without a fee. The bathroom is also in the Jing Jai project. Most of the coffee here is drip coffee, both hot and cold, starting at 60 baht. An interesting item is the cold drip coffee mixed with fresh sugar. The coffee has fresh sugar cane pulp, which is fragrant and delicious. The shop uses bagasse straws, which are biodegradable, which is quite good. Other menus currently include toast and fried eggs. The shop just opened not long ago. The name of the shop is "Kin Phee Suea Korng". Another dessert I would like to recommend is Nazo, a Mexican dessert made from pumpkin. It looks like Thai fried dumplings, but the dumpling skin is harder. It's a pleasure to eat with coffee.
review_5_text: A cup of coffee, a ray of morning light, a small gathering with a few friends at a campsite—pretending to be camping in the heart of the city, earnestly enjoying the tranquil moments. In Chiang Mai, this is life.

review_2_text: The shop owner is kind.

It was self-priced, so I paid about the same price as a nearby trailer coffee, but the beans were bland and the service was terrible. I didn't even waste 10 baht.

name: TRAILER COFFEE Jing Jai Market
review_1_text: The peach sparkling iced coffee is incredible! 70 baht is a very fair price and the quality is unbeatable. They have a wide variety of hot and cold coffee drinks and some capsules for instant iced coffee as well.
review_2_text: Trailer Coffee is a coffee cart in the Zhenxin Market. You'll find it as you walk along the stalls on the left after entering. We buy a cup every time we come. We love their fruit-flavored coffees, like lychee, peach, and orange, which are refreshing and the fruit aromas go well with the coffee, making it very smooth. Plus, their gradient colors are beautiful and great for taking photos. They also have decaffeinated Italian sodas. The drinks are delicious and affordable. It's a great place to rest when you're tired from shopping. There are seats nearby, and with live music, the overall atmosphere is relaxed and pleasant. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: I don't usually drink coffee, but this orange Americano is quite good and very refreshing.

review_1_text: I love this place! The woman working (owner?) is very friendly and knowledgeable about the plants. It’s a great place to sit and have a drink and enjoy the beautiful garden. My partner and I are very motivated by our visits here and are discussing how we can incorporate some of her ideas and plants into our own garden.
review_2_text: A refreshing break after or during shopping. Located in the heart of the Kamtien garden center, the coffee shop offers a variety of coffees and other refreshments at reasonable prices. Clean, pleasant atmosphere with friendly, fast service.

review_2_text: It a lovely cafe located at the Kham Tien garden market.  We came early in the morning, very relaxing and fresh.
review_3_text: I came across this restaurant by chance at the plant market. I ordered pork fried rice as a simple meal, but what I got was very fast. The staff was very service-minded. I was sitting working. The staff intentionally placed a plate of rice for me quietly, not daring to disturb me. The fried rice was like purple crab rice. The taste was very delicious. It was the best fried rice I had eaten in a year. I was very surprised that I didn't come to buy plants very often, but I just found this restaurant. I recommend you to come and eat. The price is not expensive, the atmosphere is very good.
review_4_text: Nice area to take a break from shopping at endless amount of plant shops.  Atmosphere is beautiful with all the trees and plants.  Coconut pie has by far been the best (out of about 4) that I have tried in Thailand. Coconut smoothie was not sweet at all but just got them to add more sugar syrup (or whatever) to make it better. Host was friendly and welcoming.
review_5_text: Very appropriate coffee shop for kham Thiang market.  The shop is filled with beautiful plants.    Nice fountain.  Coffee taste is excellent.  There are some cakes.  But, they don’t look very appetizing. Friendly service.  Very professional.

name: Jowa Cafe & Hotel
review_1_text: I booked based on the glowing reviews we read, but our room 201 - had a tub which was what my wife enjoys most but it’s small! The bed mattress is on the floor so not easy and comes with several tripping hazards too. The bum gun leaks so our towels were soaked but there is no way to get dry ones when the desk staff is away. No toilet paper so bring your own. Maybe this room is best for short people because everything is very low. The area is not easy to walk so you need to use grab for everything. If you have allergies the a/c filter may be dirty like ours was

review_3_text:
Pleasant cafe, good range of espresso drinks (from a gorgeous red La Marzocco), some cakes & sandwiches, *friendly service*, fast wifi, clean restrooms.
No car parking in front, but there's a lot 50 meters away.
review_4_text: Good coffee in a beautifully outfitted environment.  Plenty of power points around, comfortable seats and decent coffee for 55 baht for a hot latte. #BeatTheGrind
review_5_text:
Great property. Quiet and quaint neighbourhood.
Great coffee and awesome front desk.

review_2_text:

review_2_text: Cozy coffee bar, great coffee, nice barista perfect for morning and afternoon break
review_3_text:
What a pleasant surprise. The rain came so we saw the signboard and dropped in for a quick coffee after finishing our khao soi across the road. This is definitely one of the better cups I've had in Thailand so far 👍

Am a big coffee nerd back home in Sydney so it was nice to find abit of well-rounded acidity (long black/americano) in place of the usual bombardment of smokey/darker roast tastes that you often get across Thailand, even from supposed 'specialty' coffee joints. Was great seeing the barista enjoy his craft (weighing in, distributing etc).

Small shop with a couple seats and tables inside and a few counter stools outside the window. Very chill.

Don't hesitate to drop in for your caffeine fix if you're in the neighbourhood.
review_4_text: Very simple shop, but everything I ordered over the course of two visits was good. I especially liked the Sun Zest. The owner seemed like a nice guy.
review_5_text: Small places along the road. Excellent coffe and a really nice guy behind the counter.

name: KIMcoffee
