review_2_text: Delicious brownie and Americano. Relaxed atmosphere and friendly owner. Highly recommend!
review_3_text: Lovely cafe! definitely a place for chilling.
review_4_text:
This coffee shop is run by a young, somewhat shy owner who loves music.
The coffee shop has recently undergone a renovation, and its interior is neat and clean.
This is a coffee shop for those who love coffee and music.
review_5_text:
The cafe has a lovely atmosphere and plays great music. The owner loves listening to music and watching movies, and the atmosphere reflects that perfectly. It's a very comfortable place to sit.
Relaxing atmosphere with vibe of good music and movies.

name: 168 COFFEE AT CHIANG MAI
review_1_text: Retro cafe that seems more like a drinks place than a place to buy baked goods.  I see more antique radios and televisions than I did baked goods.  Latte will set you back 50 baht and there’s a large bench in the middle you can work from.  I tried a lemon tea which was nice, can’t drink coffee at the moment on account of coming back from India and my stomach is riddled with bacteria 😝. Will be back to try their coffees!! #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: So cute place!!! Good coffee and signature deserts! So nice atmosphere there!!!!
review_3_text: Nice and quite place. Drinks were great.
review_4_text: Good food Excellent service staff and all decoration all as goods 🍻
review_5_text: Went later in afternoon so not sure about the bakery. Nothing on offer. Decent Latte though and I enjoyed the last century decor and Philadelphia memorabilia.

name: ร้านพระจันทร์กาแฟ
review_1_text: Awesome fried bananas!
review_2_text: It's a coffee cart. They have both cup and bag coffees. They have a wide variety of menus, including soda, tea, and coffee. They serve a fairly large amount. You can order from the vendors at the front of the shop. In the same shop, they also sell fried bananas and fried potatoes, starting at 20 baht. If you go to the shop, it's only for take-away; there's no seating inside.

name: คนรักไม้ Lanna Cafe
review_1_text: We had a great experience here! We stayed at a hotel nearby where there were plenty of options for drinks but we loved this place the most. The women who helped us were so kind and sweet. I ordered an iced coffee and my partner ordered a strawberry smoothie. They offered us each a steamed bun while we waited for our drinks. The also offered us a discount which was very generous given the prices were all very economical. Either way we tipped the woman and she was so very grateful. Please please please try this place out, they even wrapped our drinks in napkins!
review_2_text: Good coffee, reasonable price.
review_3_text: I was staying nearby, and as I was walking past the cafe, the owner struck up a conversation with me. I was having trouble at the time, so I asked her for help, and she helped me out. I'm so grateful 🙏 I also had Thai tea at the cafe. She adjusted the sweetness just right, and it was delicious. Then she asked if I wanted to eat some food, and showed me all kinds of pictures. The portions were generous and delicious. I could eat it every day. The owner is always smiling, and it's a place that makes me feel glad I came to Chiang Mai. Everything the owner's cooking is delicious!
review_4_text: The coffee tastes good and is satisfactory. There is seating inside, which is a showroom for various decorative wood products, along with renovation design services.
review_5_text: Good service and lovely

name: โมชิคอฟฟี่บาร์
review_1_text: Great quality coffee with reasonable price! Vegan option is also available with non-dairy milk and vegan whipcream. Menu are various
review_2_text: A small street cafe with great coffee!
review_3_text: Okay, considering the price.
review_4_text: mellow

name: 6 Signature tea & coffee
review_1_text: This cafe is super cute and cozy, with a lovely style. The photos turn out so beautiful I have to come back again! ✨ The iced tea is delicious, and the matcha is incredibly fragrant.
review_2_text:
Newly opened shop located beneath All Red Hostel.
Rich cocoa, a must-try for cocoa lovers.
The tea is also fragrant, both Thai tea and green tea.
The owner is handsome and provides excellent service. You definitely won't feel lonely here.
review_3_text: Thai tea has the best and strongest flavor 👍🏻
review_4_text: For tea and coffee lovers, I highly recommend this 👍

name: All Red Cafe&Hostel
review_1_text: The surrounding is peaceful. Though the bathroom and toilets are shared, they have a great service maintenance. I would totally recommend it. I stayed here 3 nights and it had no issues at all.  I got the 1 bunk bed and the place was VERY quiet, The front desk ladies were super sweet and helpful and spoke English fairly well. No problems communicating. It is by no means where the action of town is but it is about five minutes away by garb or bolt. You’ll probably want a moto if you are staying here. AC works very well and is placed in a great spot. Issue with charging plug, if you put anything it keeps on falling, especially 3 pin adapter. lots of places to sit and work; downstairs terrace, living room, upstairs room and private terrace all are option. The shared bathroom still feels private, as there's 2 toilets and 2 showers for 2 rooms. Free cold water, hot water and coffe
review_2_text: Highly recommend. I stayed in the dorm room and it was surprisingly quiet, with multiple spots to work if you need to. I actually chose to stay here instead of booking a private room closer to the Old Town because the atmosphere, the owner, and the cleanliness are hard to beat. Grab rides are cheap and easy if you don’t have your own transport. Definitely book ahead if you want a private room because they sell out fast! But honestly, the dorms are great too, and each bed has its own curtain for privacy. Free coffee and water and plenty of spaces to do some work on your laptop.
review_3_text: I stayed here 3 nights . Two nights in a private room with king bed 🛌, clean , big , but a little bit noise because near the main of  street . One night in a bunk beds with less privacy but less noise because a room without windows . I really recommend this place especially for the atmosphere and the warm and empathy of the owner. Thanks for everything 🌿
review_4_text: It is very close to central mall and they speak english so well. The surrounding is so peaceful too. Though the bathroom and toilets are shared, they have a great service maintenance. I would totally recommend it. I stayed here 2 nights and it had no issues at all.
review_5_text: This was def a five star experience, cannot beat the price! Close to sunshine massage school. I got the 2 bunk room and the place was VERY quiet, thank god! Not social, but I was in class all day making friends with my classmates and seeing the night market so not a problem at all. The front desk ladies were super sweet and helpful and spoke English between fairly and well. No problems communicating. It is by no means where the action of town is but it is about five minutes away by moto. You’ll probably want a moto if you are staying here. Just wish they had soy milk at the cafe :) AC works very well and is placed in a great spot.

name: สถานีกาแฟ coffee station
Morrow coff.
review_1_text:
A tiny homey coffee shop hidden in small alley. Cute decorations with warm welcoming vibe here ready to serve good coffee.☕️

Reasonable price and friendly staff. They also  offer soft cookies and sweet bites🍪🍩
review_2_text: "Morrow Coff. is a hidden gem! The coffee is rich and flavorful, the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the prices are surprisingly affordable. The staff truly love what they do — their service comes with genuine warmth and a smile. Highly recommended!"
review_3_text: Amazinggg mixed berry smoothie. So cute and cozy inside. Perfect place to relax and read
review_4_text: Love this place! Fair prices, quick and friendly service. Small space inside but never super busy so you can sit if you want. Very nice modern decor
review_5_text: A small, quiet cafe perfect for chilling out. Great atmosphere, beautiful lighting for photos. Their new Thai tea cream cheese is incredibly delicious – rich, creamy, and perfectly sweet. Their matcha green tea is also gorgeous. The desserts are tasty, the staff are friendly and provide excellent service 👍🏻👍🏻. Prices are reasonable, you'll get change back from a 100 baht note. Plenty of parking. This is my nth visit.

name: ร้านกาแฟสดมิราเคิล นครชัยแอร์
review_1_text: It tastes good.
review_2_text: The drinks are delicious.
review_3_text: Delicious, affordable, and high-quality food—only here!

name: MAKE KAFE' เมคคาเฟ่
review_1_text: Delicious food, clean environment, good service, and affordable prices.
review_2_text: Good service, good taste, reasonable price, convenient
review_3_text: Recommend a place to sit and work, chill out.

name: First image studio
review_1_text: Staying home alone

name: Rodem Cafe 로뎀 카페
review_1_text: Smaller coffee shop in the lobby of Supalai Monte 2 with great coffee and matcha, chill atmosphere and friendly staff. Good selection of home made pastry and cakes. They offer almond and pistachio milk as a cow milk substitute. Certainly recommended for both dining in or take away.
review_2_text: Just moved into the area and love this place it’s my go to for a good coffee/ pastry and had a smoothie today that’s delish. Staff is really friendly and good English speaker. Great chilled quiet atmosphere with chill music on.
review_3_text: Cute/chill place to go to and the staff is very nice. Coffee is good
review_4_text: First time here kinda nervous just kidding 🤓 The Person working today was so amazing and lovely! The piecing is good the coffee is tasty :) come and try for yourself!
review_5_text: Probably the best iced cappuccino I’ve had in Thailand during my over two-month stay here. The barista was very friendly. The cheesecake didn’t quite suit my taste, but I’d happily come back for the coffee.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text:
28 Feb 2026 5pm
Black Coffee Hot big is Thb 50
Very smooth and not acidic coffee
felt like its drip coffee or hot Americano
Better price then other fancy coffee
review_2_text: As someone who drinks his coffee black, this was easily the best place to get coffee in the mall. The medium roast is bold and smooth, similar to a dark roast elsewhere, but without the burnt taste.
review_3_text: I usually sit in the evening. Honey Lite is my favorite.
review_4_text: Why does the small hot black coffee cost ฿ 65 ？But here it say‘s ฿40 on the menu.No good coffee here but some place to sit.
review_5_text: One of Amazon Cafe friendchise located in Central Festival Chiang Mai. Their Thai tea taste normal. The price of the Amazon Cafe is quite cheap compared to other coffee shop in the same area. There are plenty of seat available. The outdoor area is a good place to sit but after 15.30 pm sunlight will reach some of the outdoor area.

name: 1:2 Chiangmai brew - Central Chiangmai
review_1_text:
This coffee shop originated in Chiang Rai, became popular in Bangkok, and has now opened in Chiang Mai.
Good coffee at an affordable price.
They offer dark, medium, and light roasts.
It's recommended to check the details of the coffee grinder before ordering, as there are no details on the order form.
review_2_text: The staff are lovely, the service is excellent, and they offer great recommendations. Importantly, the flavors are just right – not too sweet, everything on the menu is delicious. If you happen to be passing by, try a drink here; you'll definitely love it, especially the shop's signature menu items.
review_3_text: I ordered a matcha smoothie and waited for over half an hour before being informed that it was out of stock. All I got was a refund and the option to buy something else. I felt I should have received better compensation. In short, it was a complete waste of time and I got nothing. First and last time.
review_4_text: The food tastes good, but the restaurant doesn't have seating. The price is reasonable.
review_5_text:
The prices were cheaper than many other cafes in Chiang Mai, but the quality was good. It's a nationwide chain.
To the owner: When registering on Google Maps, it's better to use ONE TO TWO instead of 1:2 as people won't search for 1:2.

name: Arigato
review_1_text:
Located inside Tops — this is our go to spot for coffee — it’s reasonably priced and most importantly, their beans are delicious.  We’re also greeted with such care and kindness each time.  Highly recommend.

There are also a handful of tables coupled with comfy chairs if you want to sit for a bit.
review_2_text: The matcha is delicious, and the drinks are cheap, but the chairs in the shop are so uncomfortable you'll get tired no matter how long you sit.

name: Mon Chou Chou-เซ็นทรัล​ เฟสติวัล​ ​เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
The mall opens at 10:00 AM. It's now 11:30 AM, and the staff says the pearls aren't ready yet.
What time do they start selling?
review_2_text: The staff should listen to the customer's order more. If you order it without sweetness, you should not add sugar or syrup. This person made an excuse that they only added syrup. What they made is over. It's a waste of money and they have to throw it away.
review_3_text: This cafe offers no seating and is only open for takeout. It's a great place to buy drinks and enjoy them with your food.
review_4_text: The staff seem unwilling to work and don't care about customers. I thought I was the only one who experienced this. After reading other reviews, I assumed it was the same.
review_5_text: Please train your employees to have good manners.

name: Segafredo Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee
review_2_text: Every menu is delicious. There should be more seats.

name: Choco Bear Cafe
review_1_text: Great cafe. Delicious drinks, lots of great board games, homemade cakes, very comfortable and the owners are so nice and helpful. We’ll definitely be back!

name: The Arrow Rest
review_1_text:
Absolutely loved it here the staff are amazing. I’ve never done archery before in my life and They taught me everything about archery and I ended up doing so well!! Loved it so much, but I went the day before I left and I wished I’d tried it at the beginning so I could go a few times during my stay.
They have a lovely cafe there too so I could chill out before my lesson!
Highly recommend them if you want to learn and practice there! ❤️❤️
review_2_text: Excellent. Second time here. Loved it even more than the first. K. Nont the owner, who  himself was in the Paralympic, was exceptional as my instructor. Had good fun. Definitely coming back next time I’m in Chiang Mai. Felt like Legolas for an hour there 🧝🏻‍♂️
review_3_text: Just moved to Chang mai and feel very lucky to have stumbled across this place. From the uk and used to do archery, it’s been great to get back into it again. Such a lovely place, great vibes, lovely drinks and the staff are amazing, super helpful and kind. Will definitely be going back. Definitely give this place a visit.
review_4_text:
An amazing place for first time archery lessons. Small and intimate, the instructors are kind and professional and will guide you through it. It’s cheaper if you book in advance so they know you’re coming and have time for you - just send them a message via Facebook messenger. We booked it only an hour in advance.
Highly recommended!!!
review_5_text: My first archery experience was amazing. The instructor was very good and explained each step in a detailed and easy-to-understand way. The shop also has a café area to relax, and the matcha menu is the best—super delicious! 10/10. If you visit Chiang Mai, don’t forget to come and try it.🏹💕

name: Starbucks
review_1_text: Good ambiance and great customer service.
review_2_text:
1.) It is the good location on the first floor near the fountain which in front of the mall.
2.) The area for sit it’s a lot of chairs and tables.
3.) The staffs are active to service you but slow to clean the tables.
**On the weekend is crowded here it’s not a good choice to come here.
*** MY PROBLEM is a lot of MOSQUITOES fly around I have a mosquito spray they still bit me. I think they should fix this problem it’s quite dangerous for humans.
review_3_text: The food tastes great, and the service is nice too.
review_4_text: My chill spot after walking around Central Mall. I visit this location at least 4 times a week and the staff is friendly. The place is always clean. I see many tourists pop in and out while I dine here.
review_5_text: I paid triple the amount for a latte that came tasting of warm milk. I had to request another shot of coffee to flavour the milk. I get a better coffee from any street cart for 45baht. Extremely dissatisfied

name: Café Amazon - Greenpark Chiangmai
review_1_text:
I left my phone here on 14th June 2023 around 6 p.m. Not knowing it until 8 p.m. the same day. I used my friend's phone to call my phone and the barista at Amazon picked up. She said someone found my phone on the floor and had handed it to her. It was pretty late, but she was waiting for me to come pick my phone up. That's a very nice of her and bad for me that I didn't ask her name. Thank you so much!!!

Everyone who works here are very friendly and manners. Always smiles and remembers me what I always order.
review_2_text:
Super comfortable, air-conditioned dining area.  Quiet, smooth jazz playing.
Great way to start my day with a delicious cup of coffee.
review_3_text: Good
review_4_text: I really like this shop. The staff are friendly, lovely, and provide excellent service. The drinks are delicious and strong, just like every time I visit.
review_5_text: The milk green tea tastes terrible. The color is very pale. It's unlike anything I've ever had.

name: Memorize Brownie สาขาเซ็นทรัล เฟสติวัล เชียงใหม่ คาเฟ่ขนมหวาน บราวนี่ เค้ก และ กาแฟ ชาไทย ชาเขียว
review_1_text:
Definitely one of the best brownies every had.
It’s moisture and dark.
Not too sweet. The frappe is great too.
review_2_text: We had the brownie shot. There are 10 so good enough to share. The brownie was moist and the cream was light. Really enjoyed it.
review_3_text: Legit good brownie shake. Even with no sugar it's sweet. Tastes  good with the brownie chips sprinkled on top
review_4_text: Best brownie in Chiang Mai 😋
review_5_text: Memorize brownie was delicious, coffee was not good one.

name: Cha Tra Mue
review_1_text:
Thai tea (30% sweet) 45 ฿ (2025)

Give me Cha Tra Mue anytime I will be happy.

Even though it has an extensive menu, but I simply couldn’t resist to order Thai Tea, because it is that good.

I could smell the tea fragrance from afar before reaching the stall.

It is a wonderful treat for me in Thailand.

Yummy, kop khun krap!
review_2_text: Gotta try Thai teas from the famous Cha Tra Mue brand while in Thailand. Having a view of a Thomas train riding around inside mall while enjoying the drinks is also a bonus.
review_3_text:
Came by for a hot drink as I was getting sick from the heat - and thought the honey lemon drink would be a good ail to my condition.

The drink came a little too sweet though, I was half hoping it’s due to the honey and not cos of added sugar..

In any case, it’s still a great place to catch a cup of tea or our favourite cocoa 👍🏻
review_4_text: A tea store stand selling packed original product from Cha Tra Mue Tea and Coffee as well as prepared coffee and tea drinks. The staff is friendly, the prices are great and they have sitting area.
review_5_text: Good drink. I ordered Thai tea

name: minimal coffee central festival
review_1_text: Tiny cups and they don’t even fill it up. not good tasting. Way too sweet and overpriced for what they serve. All 3 ladies working looked unfriendly and really gives no reason to visit this place. There are better spots a floor away
review_2_text:
First off coconut iced coffee + dirty coffee ☕ 5* fantastic. However there is very limited seating. I went to a seat where there were 4 chairs with 1 person and the customer didn't allow me sit as she had a bunch of papers and laptop 💻 was probably using it as a workspace. All the other seats also has 1-2 people occupying 4 seats and seemed like they were working.

Tip: find a seat first before ordering.
review_3_text: The coffee was way too sour, and I didn’t feel welcomed at all. The place also had kind of a cheap vibe.
review_4_text: I got the orange presso which was a delicious afternoon pick me up. 60 baht which i thought was very fair. Got it lightly sweetened which was perfect!
review_5_text: Reasonable and wonderful coffee. 55b for one hot coffee. Must try.

name: Doppio
review_1_text: Amazing coffee beverages and friendly staff! I had the Black Yellow (pineapple) and Orange Espresso. Really good stuff!
review_2_text: 3 bartistas working today. 3 professionals all very attentive to my requests.  I was provided 3 different roasts to choose from.  The coffee taste very good and the equipment is all professional quality.   It is located inside the shopping mall 3 rd floor 100 meters From the banks. Coffee is not cheap here ! I wish they had more food options.
review_3_text: This is a coffee shop located in the Central Festival. The price of coffee is a little expensive, but the coffee tastes very good and the staff is kind. The chair is very uncomfortable.
review_4_text:
3rd floor coffee kiosk.  Flavorful well made coffee drinks.  Innovative combinations.

Try the 'Dirty Thai Tea,'.  An expresso shot in cold Thai tea.
review_5_text: Great coffee. A little bit on the pricey side compared with other places.

name: Baan Sabun-nga บ้านสะบันงา
review_1_text:
Absolutely lovely cafe and owner! It’s a cosy place with nice undercover outdoor cafe tables and chairs under a traditional Thai 2-roomed BnB.

The coffee was delicious, atmosphere was peaceful for me to sit and work for a couple of hours, and the owner was lovely. She patiently helped me practice and learn a bit more Thai and some facts about the local area, and speak excellent English.

Although I didn’t go upstairs, I bet here is a lovely place to stay as well!
review_2_text: I’m so impressed! Baan Sabun-nga is a cafe that feels like you’re just hanging out at a friend’s house. The shop itself is a beautifully designed modern-Thai wooden house that feels incredibly warm and cozy. The ground floor has a lovely minimalist cafe vibe that is just perfectly put together.  My favourite part was how peaceful and shady the atmosphere is outside, as it’s the perfect spot for anyone looking to escape the noise and to sip some coffee & relax. There's a nice water-feature outside too. The owner is also wonderful and very friendly, providing excellent service that makes you feel right at home.  Her English is 100% exceptional. The coffee is great.
review_3_text:
If you're tired of the noise from cars and motorbikes, this is the perfect place to visit.
It feels like time has stopped-calm and cozy.
The owner is incredibly friendly and speaks excellent English. And the coffee? My wife said, "It's much cheaper and tastes way better than Starbucks at Central Festival!" Highly recommended!
review_4_text: A true hidden gem in Chiang Mai. The coffee is outstanding, and the owner’s kindness makes every morning feel brighter. I was so happy to enjoy such delicious coffee throughout my stay. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: An absolute hidden gem - cozy and tranquil. The lady boss is exceptional - warm and kind. The traditional Thai house and decorative are very unique.

name: Black Canyon เซ็นทรัลเฟสติวัล เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Good service n decent matcha. Abit sweet though but I like the ambience n wifi .
review_2_text:
Foods and beverages there were good but came out pretty slow. It’s a place where you visit when you have time to kill.

Because the price of drink stalls in Central mall is very high, sitting in a cafe/restaurant like this make more sense.
Proper seating with about the same cost.
review_3_text: We ordered the pad Thai and it was ok. I think I expected it to have a little more flavour. The service was fine and there was no service charge.
review_4_text:
Food is ok drinks is good
1.)I feel like their food is freeze dried go to microwave
2.)if you have member card more value-able10%discount
3.)good table
review_5_text: The fish was old and not really good to eat. It took 30 mins to cook this 💩. Dont recommend.

name: เสนาทิพย์คอฟฟี่ Senatip cafe
review_1_text:
truly unique little coffee shop, nicely decorated inside and out, good prices and cozy atmosphere
owner is sweet and friendly, cold cocoa was very tasty 😋
review_2_text: This charming hidden café is a little oasis surrounded by beautiful flowers and greenery. The coffee is excellent, and the service is warm and friendly. Located just beside a small laundry place and a short walk positioned behind Green Park Shopping Center, it’s a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a peaceful break.
review_3_text: The iced latte is perfect!!!! Cute inside. Nice to hang out in for awhile
review_4_text: Good
review_5_text: Love the place

name: Roastniyom Coffee, Central Festival
review_1_text:
Great location for people watching in the mall. Always reliable coffee.

Delicious coffee and other drinks.  Fresh pastry.
review_2_text: Can’t really fault this place. Fairly comfortable for a mall coffee. And have wifi
review_3_text:
The shop is located on the 4th floor of Central Chiang Mai. They offer a wide variety of drinks, as well as bakery items and pastries at reasonable prices.

The coffee tastes good, with a decent selection of coffee beans. They also have both premium and regular matcha.

Free drinking water is provided in a pitcher.

The staff are lovely, provide good service, and have a great service mind.
review_4_text: Rosniyom's dark roast coffee has a color similar to medium roast, but when ordered dark roast, it still has a sour taste.
review_5_text: My favorite coffee shop at CentralFestival Chiang Mai.

name: Light up cafe
review_1_text: The shop offers a variety of drinks, including bubble milk tea, smoothies, coffee, as well as cakes and bread. It is located next to OfficeMate.
review_2_text: I ordered Hot Chocolate and the staff said they only had Cocoa. I said yes, but the staff made me Iced Cocoa. I told them I ordered hot, not cold (do you understand English?). But the staff argued that it was cold and scowled. I asked to speak to the owner. The staff called and said that the owner wouldn't let me change it, even though it was the staff's fault. This is the service at the Central Festival Chiangmai branch.
review_3_text: The staff at this branch are shouting and talking, playing around, and being very loud. You can hear them standing across the street buying things. The owner of the shop at the market is shaking his head and not caring that customers are waiting for drinks in front of the shop. The owner probably never comes to check on them. Very bad.
review_4_text: The service was terrible. They didn't know anything when I asked questions (they had no knowledge of coffee whatsoever, despite selling it). The person taking orders was constantly on their phone, seemingly chatting on LINE, completely ignoring customers. It was like they didn't want to sell anything, and they spoke abruptly and rudely. Absolutely awful.

name: Little Bao-Homemade steamed buns (Central Chiangmai Branch)
review_1_text: A selection of delicious vegan amd vegetarian bao buns (no meat, no fish, no egg, no dairy - plants only!). Stall can be found on the ground floor next to Amazon Cafe. Seating available around stalls in this bustling mall.
review_2_text: This is just a kiosk in Central Festival but me and my daughter simply Love this spot. We are vegans and they sell plant based BAO buns and plant based dumplings both are a must have. We love the bbq plant based pork BAO ❤️
review_3_text: There is a small table for two people to sit at. The bao buns are yummy 😋. The mantous is good as well. Nice place for a snack.
review_4_text: Must visit if you're vegan or vegetarian - lots of delicious plant based options, clearly labelled too. It's in the food court area in central mall.
review_5_text:
Delicious minced pork bao bun.
Went back for 2nds and 3rds it was so good.
Highly recommend

name: On the table
review_1_text: I really enjoyed their vegan / vegetarian menu: spicy crispy mushroom salad and vegan sushi.
review_2_text:
My family's regular restaurant.

Lots of delicious vegetarian food.
I ordered the Balanced Tofu Rice with Calamari today. I wasn't disappointed.
review_3_text: At first we were hesitant because it had no reviews, but given the wide variety, we decided to take a chance. It was worth it: plenty of drinks to choose from, and delicious food. The service was quick, although the portions could have been bigger. The downside is that they charge a 10% service fee.
review_4_text:
550 Thai Baht, economy class, great value! The portion was very satisfying for two people.

The salad had a bit too much dressing and was a little too sour. The rice looked a bit dry, but the texture was still okay.
review_5_text:
I'm so angry that they're selling such poor quality food. I came here because I wasn't feeling well. The food was expensive, and the panna cotta was terrible. The panna cotta was bland and hard. The sauce was too sweet, lacking strawberry flavor, and was all pink. It made my throat hurt, and I felt sick.

The staff and chef didn't know the order of serving. They brought the main course first, and the salad came last. It made me unable to eat the salad.

The sashimi rice bowl was apparently ordered for children. The staff didn't care about the kitchen, so they put wasabi on the plate. This carelessness was so obvious.

They rushed to take my order. We were still talking, and they already wrote it down.

name: SOUTHERN BUBBLE TEA
review_1_text: Even though I arrived when there was a crowd of customers, the staff was very courteous and warming. Instead of waiting around the counter, I took a seat just to relax my feet. A few minutes later my coffee and cake was brought to my table. I was very pleased on the staff here this afternoon. Seeing that they stay busy means a lot due to their service. I will come back to try different items. The cake was not overwhelming with sugar and blended well with my coffee. I ordered the carmel macchiato which I enjoyed and loved the price.
review_2_text: Decent coffee taste with normal price for coffee place
review_3_text:
Disgusting coffee. Ordered a Latte & the coffee was badly burnt. It tastes like an ashtray.
Disgusting
review_4_text: Undrinkable :( No flavour. Ordered unsweet ice Cappuccino and what I got tasted like water and milk. Left the coffee. Just couldn't drink it. Sorry. I think the barrista needs training :/
review_5_text: Terrible coffee, it's cheap but you may as well spend an extra 10baht for a decent cup somewhere else.

name: Momizu House
review_1_text:
Our favorite milk tea in Central Festival Mall! The staff are friendly and we love that they offer the golden tapioca "bubbles" that are smaller in size and feel more delicate.

They also have a creamy pudding that you can order separately or make a part of your drink: chocolate, milk or matcha green tea flavors.
review_2_text: The drinks weren't bad, but the service was terrible and inconsistent. Some days were good, some days were bad. Today, I inquired about my accumulated points, but the answers were unclear. The staff argued amongst themselves and turned their backs to the customers. I was confused and had no answers. When I asked another person, they had to get a more polite colleague to respond. It was very frustrating.

name: Yuzu House by Honey moni - Central Chiangmai
review_1_text: Columbia Barrel Aged rum iced drip coffee not worth the money. But other drinks with Yuzu are delicious!
review_2_text: Very refreshing(Yuzu Soda)
review_3_text: yuzu holy grail
review_4_text: So good delicious
review_5_text: The yuzu juice is very so refreshing!

name: Tomato Matcha Bar Green Park
review_1_text: Excellent variety of matcha, lovely staff, and perfect for grab and go. A little gem for matcha lovers!
review_2_text:
Best Matcha with Best Service
Yame no tsuyu is real.

Cozy place 😊
review_3_text: The green tea is excellent, with many varieties to choose from. The shop is very cute.
review_4_text: The matcha is delicious and there are many varieties to choose from. The staff are very chatty and provide excellent service.

name: Tatum Coffee
review_1_text: The drinks are all delicious, cheap, and the owner is friendly. It's a great coffee shop.

name: Curry Puff Coffee สาขาบิสสิเนสพาร์ค
review_1_text:
We came in the morning, the weather was nice. The staff were smiling, provided excellent service, and were very polite. The prices were reasonable.
There is parking in front of the shop.
review_2_text:

review_1_text: Don't usually leave reviews, however this place deserves one. Great and underrated place for coffee. Spent three consecutive mornings here. Peaceful atmosphere, unassuming place, fantastic affordable latte. Highly recommended. While many may head to the cafes near the reservoir for the views (but more crowded and pricier), I came back to this place during my visits, which still brings me right next to nature within the arboretum

name: RotSomJai (Kin Sa Bo)
review_1_text:
Rossomjai Coffee has strategically relocated from a local community setting to a more prominent position near the main road leading to Doi Suthep, a move that is expected to enhance its visibility and accessibility. While the flavor profile of the coffee did not align with my personal preferences, it is important to acknowledge that taste is subjective, and other patrons may find it quite appealing.

Upon attempting to connect to the internet, I noted that the restaurant's Wi-Fi network was detectable. However, there was no visible display of the Wi-Fi password within the establishment. As a guest, I felt a degree of discomfort in approaching the staff to request the password, particularly as they appeared to be fully engaged with their duties at the bar. I suggest that prominently displaying Wi-Fi credentials, perhaps on tables, could significantly improve customer convenience and encourage a more seamless online experience.

Furthermore, I recommend a review of the current table arrangements. My seating position, directly facing the bar, exposed me to a somewhat cluttered area, which could detract from the overall ambiance. Optimizing the layout could enhance the dining experience for guests.

In terms of pricing, the cost of items was acceptable, though it was comparatively higher than some local competitors who offer what I perceive as a more comprehensive experience.
review_2_text: A tiny cafe with good drinks. The thing here is they will adjust your drink how you want it and it is super flexible as you can see in the picture. The space is tiny, so it is better for many to just to get a take away.
review_3_text: Their entrance shows pour over coffee.. but they don’t have pour over coffee…
review_4_text: Thai milk tea can be adjusted with the sugar levels and how strong tea flavour you want.
review_5_text:
Delicious! I don’t like overly sweet drinks so I love how customizable these drinks are. You can get 0, 10, 25, 50% sweet as well as adjust for how strong of tea flavor you want.

name: Press continue cafe
review_1_text:
I was looking for a cafe with outlets to spend my last afternoon in Chiang Mai (forgot my portable battery pack in Bangkok 😭) and Press continue was perfectly suited for my needs! It wasn’t my original plan but I saw it on Google Maps and thought it would be a good fit because I’m a big gamer.
Coolest little cafe ever and I’m glad I stopped by! Super geeked to be able to try out some old-school NES games, and spent like 2-3 hours trying to beat Super Mario 3 to no avail. That game is harder than it looks! There were a few modern consoles too, though I didn’t try them. The owner’s wife was sweet and helpful, and it didn’t feel like there was any rush at all. Sabai maak maaaaak!
The owner’s collection is extensive and amazing to browse.
I got a Thai tea (45 baht), good price, refreshing and yummy to drink while gaming. Unfortunately no food offerings, which would’ve made this perfect cafe even more perfect.

In conclusion: highly recommend, if you’re a casual or avid gamer and looking for good drinks and games while on your way back to the city from the mountain temples!
review_2_text: Amazing place to chill and play some games! We played Mario kart on the switch and some Ps5 , they have a menu of nice drinks, the decor is awesome, the owner is just lovely. Comfy couches to sit on, they have retro Nintendo 64, PlayStation 1 and some other ones , loved this spot will be back for sure ! And it was nice and cool in there on a hot day! 5 Stars 🌟
review_3_text: I've been here yesterday, what a stunning gaming cafe! Owner and staff have been super friendly and helpful. There are five CRTs with retro consoles where I spent my time. Everything is well set up, cleaned and maintained. You can play almost all retro games you wish. There are also five flat screens with PS5s and Switches. For the retro consoles you buy a drink and can use them, for the modern consoles its 50 THB per hour, which I think is very fair. Highly recommend this place, loved it!
review_4_text:
This cafe bring me further than just playing ps5 but with some of retro consoles I never heared of them even I am the big fan of gaming console

you can order cafe or lots of drink and enjoy many types of game including lots of mainstram games in both single player & multi players like Black myth wukong , Elden ring , Ghost of yotei , tekken 8 , street fighter 6 or even party animals and smash bow in Nintendo you named it.

With service minded , caring , kind from P kwan & P bol I'm highly recommened you guys to visit here even for chating and exchange teenage dream in console

Cheers !!!

review_1_text:

My husband and I tried their specialty burger flavors, and they were both incredible!! They also have regular burgers if you want a safe option. We'd love to visit the Red Panda again next time we're in the area!
review_2_text: If you’re looking for the best hamburgers in Thailand, Red Panda is unbeatable. The patties are juicy, packed with flavor, and cooked exactly right. Fresh toppings, great buns, and amazing service. Easily one of my favorite spots.
review_3_text: Place was amazing! Coffee was good and there was a game room with a Nintendo Switch. The slide is super fast as well! It’s also Christian owned which is rare here in Chiang Mai which makes it 10x better.
review_4_text:
Really nice and chilled cafe, they have a  spacious area. 2 couch areas, a big wooden table for more people to sit and 3x 2-person tables and 2 high chair sitting areas. Above they have a co-working area which you can book and a game room with Nintendo switch, ping pong table, board games etc.
Really nice place to hang around. Really chill and nice ambience. Staff is very friendly, prices are totally ok and acceptable.
Nice atmosphere. They have a metal slide which you can slide down (on your own risk, it's quite fast).
Their food and drink (Thai Tea) tastes really good, can also recommend the Matcha Brownie. They also have a small section of merchandise, red Panda branded.
Would love to come back here, big recommendation...
review_5_text:
Great Vibes & Even Better Coffee!
This place totally surprised me! I just dropped by for a quick caffeine fix, but ended up staying much longer than planned. The vibe is super chill—perfect for catching up with friends (because it has a game room) or just getting some work done.

I tried their iced caramel macchiato and iced es-yen and it was amazing—not too sweet, and you could still taste the espresso. I also grabbed a brownie, and wow… soft, moist, and full of flavor.

The staff was really friendly, too. They even recommended a few drinks to try next time, which I really appreciated. The space is clean, well-lit, and has that cozy, Instagram-worthy interior (MUST try their slide).

Definitely one of my new go-to spots in Chang Mai, Thailand. Highly recommended!

name: CuppaCharm Coffee
review_1_text:
I visited this café two times, and I had a great experience. The place is clean, with relaxing jazz music playing in the background. The drinks are reasonably priced, with a variety of options, including coffee, tea, and soda. You can also customize the sweetness level and add extras like honey if you prefer. They also offer free Wi-Fi and charging spots, which is super convenient.

I had a chat with the owner, who was incredibly friendly. They mentioned that the café opened just a few months ago and that they’re planning to introduce a new menu soon. On my first visit, I ordered a Cocoa Latte with regular sweetness. It was delicious! The owner also gave me a banana cake with caramel to try for free, saying they were still perfecting the recipe. It was fantastic!

The next day, I decided to visit again in the late evening and stayed until the place was about to close. One of the owners remembered me and asked if I wanted to try an unreleased drink, a strawberry latte. The day before, I had asked if they had any fruity drinks besides peach since I’m not a big fan of peach, and they told me the strawberry latte would be available the next day. So, of course, I came back.

The drink was great, but at first, they gave me a regular straw, which made it a bit difficult to mix the strawberry with the milk and drink it properly. When the owner asked for my feedback, I mentioned that the straw wasn’t strong enough for mixing and wasn’t wide enough for the strawberry pulp to pass through. She immediately apologized and brought me a larger straw, the kind used for bubble tea. On top of that, she gave me another banana cake on the house.

I’ll definitely be back if I visit this city again!
review_2_text: The café is nice. Cakes are delicious. However, I ordered a cup of filtered coffee (because I saw beautiful v60 gears at the bar), and it's not good. It seems they don't have a clue how to make filter coffee but still sell it 😅.
review_3_text: I’m pretty sure we were given 2 cups of milk when we ordered two hot cappuccinos… at least say that you don’t know how to make a drink, but to wait quite a while for that.. just kind of unprofessional. Wanted to give a good review but just being honest about our experience.

review_5_text: Located at the entrance of an alley near the university, this coffeeshop will become one of my favorites in Chiang Mai. It has been open for a month by Golf and Sophia, a friendly young Thai couple who are smiling and who will give you a warm welcome. They have concocted different homemade blends of organic coffees from plantations in the Chiang Dao district, north of Chiang Mai. Whether you like a smooth or strong coffee, there will be one to suit your taste. Unless you prefer an excellent green tea or a delicious strawberry milk! The space is bright with a high ceiling. The polished concrete floor and vintage furniture elements contribute to the relaxed atmosphere. This coffeeshop stands out for another significant aspect. Golf and Sophia are lovers of good music and they have equipped their shop with high-end audio equipment. A delicious coffee or tea while listening to good songs and sound in a warm and smiling atmosphere, all this at very reasonable prices... what else?

​The cafe boasts a beautiful two-floor layout with plenty of seating for both groups and digital nomads looking for a seat. The decor is cool, featuring a fusion of contemporary and classic Western-inspired designs.

​The ambience is laid back... the light jazz background music encourages soft, low tones, creating thr atmosphere for working, reading, or quiet conversation.

Check them out
review_2_text:
Absolutely a hidden gem of Chiang Mai mostly known to locals.  Cafe has a lovely ambience with a quiet atmosphere similar to a library. Despite the cafe being filled with students, it was silent.

The staff are friendly and added bonus of in house cats roaming freely to entertain you.  Deserts, cakes and light food served which were all delicious. It was my favourite hiding place while I was in Chiang Mai. Great place with great coffee and cakes. A must try if you are looking for a nice place to chill and relax during a busy holiday.
review_3_text:
We came across this café during our walks and, despite the construction next door, decided to give it a try. The space is beautifully decorated with a good mix of seating — cozy window spots for solo visitors, tables for couples, and larger setups for groups.

The menu is quite limited, offering only four breakfast items along with drinks. While we were there, we noticed several university students working on their laptops over drinks.

Overall, it’s a charming place for a morning coffee if you’re not allergic to cats and can tolerate some construction noise.

Anyway, if the owner and kitchen takes this issue into account, it would be ideal and relaxing place to spend time with yourself or friends/family. The girls were very polite and helpful. Barista made a decent coffee, and i enjoyed it. Thank you!
review_3_text:
I am writing to provide a complete account of my experience, as the management’s recent response has chosen to sidestep the core issues and instead offer a selective, dismissive version of events. This has only compounded the disappointment.

Here is a detailed timeline of what actually transpired:

· 2:00 PM: I had a scheduled afternoon tea meeting with two long‑unseen friends at this café. As I had a fixed commitment in Lamphun at 3:00 PM, I informed my friends in advance that I would only have about one hour for our visit.
· 2:20 PM: I arrived at the café. Upon learning that my friends were delayed in traffic, I selected an empty table and, as a gesture of goodwill and intent to consume, promptly ordered a drink for my companion (an iced chocolate). I planned to order more once my friends arrived.
· 2:49 PM: My friends finally arrived. Given the time, I could now stay for only 5‑10 minutes before leaving for my next appointment. To avoid ordering a drink I would have no time to enjoy—and to prevent waste—I politely informed my friends that I would not be ordering further and would leave shortly after a brief greeting.
· The Critical Moment: The café was nearly empty (aside from our party of four, there were approximately two other customers). A polite female staff member reminded us of the minimum spend policy. While I was displeased by the inflexibility given my imminent departure, I understood her position. However, the situation escalated when i leave and turn back ,a male employee with thinning, grey‑white curly hair intervened. His demeanor was not helpful but confrontational. He used an iPad to mechanically translate the rules in a manner that felt deliberately intimidating and demeaning, as if addressing a severe violation rather than a customer who had already consumed and was communicating a change of plans.

Key Points the Management’s Reply Conveniently Ignored:

1. I was a consuming customer, not loitering. A purchase was made immediately upon sitting.
2. I explained my time limit to both my friends and the staff.
3. The central failure was one of tone and empathy, not policy. The management’s defense of the “rule” while completely ignoring how it was delivered is telling.
4. Additional concerning practices observed:
· A table inside was marked “Reserved,” yet staff indicated it would be given to us if we ordered four drinks. This suggests the “reservation” was a tactic to pressure higher spending, which is deceptive.
As far as i know approached to order more if they stay over an hour with a single drink, confirming a culture of pressurized upselling over genuine hospitality.
A establishment that values rigid enforcement over thoughtful service. If a mandatory fee is required, transparent models exist (e.g., The Baristro Asian Style, which posts policies and charges admission at the door). What is unacceptable is cornering customers with last‑minute demands after they are already seated.

The male employee with thinning, grey‑white curly hair intervened in question has made it clear he does not care. Therefore, I can only caution others: if you seek a place where respect and understanding come before strict monetization of your seat, you may wish to look elsewhere in Chiang Mai. I certainly will.

Lovely café, perfect for coffee or getting some work done.
A cozy and stylish place with a beautiful outdoor area that’s ideal for sitting with your laptop or just enjoying a good coffee. The atmosphere is calm and inspiring, making it easy to focus or relax. Definitely a great spot to spend a few hours 🫶😍
review_2_text: Must be the worst coffee I've had in Chiang Mai, a city with so much great coffee. Medium light roast, Thai Ethiopia blend, Americano iced. Tasted like water and burnt roast. I composed a couple of polite messages in Google translate to see if they'd help me out, but I wasn't offered to try something else. The guy said 'ok, thank you'. I left the coffee and went elsewhere.
review_3_text: I have been here so many times, and the coffee is so good. Absolutely love this coffee shop! The coffee tastes great, and the whole place has a calm, quiet atmosphere—perfect for relaxing or getting work done. There are plenty of charging spots, which is super convenient. The seating is very comfortable, the space feels cozy, and the staff are friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a chill and well-equipped café!Love this shop so much 🩷✨
review_4_text: I arrived and nobody said hello to me, it was super weird. The coffee is good however. But wow the rudeness of the people… I didn’t feel welcomed.
review_5_text: The aesthetic is very well done. The service is great. Great coffee and presentation. The backyard is done well also.  Top notch.

name: Twenty T Coffee Cafe
review_1_text: After over 2 years in Thailand, it's rare to find such diverse coffee beans! This 10㎡ shop carries global varieties – from commercial blends to single-origin beans. Truly amazed how this tiny space holds a coffee universe. A must-visit for coffee lovers!
review_2_text: Delicious and special coffee. I saw coffee beans here that I haven't seen anywhere else in Thailand. Definitely recommend and I will definitely come back next time👍🏽👏🏽
review_3_text:
Productwise, it is best coffee in the neighborhood!
The owners are amongst the nicest people I've met, although I don't speak thaï that much they always try and talk to me. I always feel welcome here.
When you add to it the warmest and coziest atmosphere with some of the cutest cats you get this incredible place!
A little hidden gem!
review_4_text: The best coffee in Chiang Mai no doubt, small local business with a varaity of local coffee beans, the service is amazing too, recommend!
review_5_text: This coffee shop has the BEST coffee in chiang mai hands down! It has so many unique flavors you must go and try 🙌🏽

name: บ้านขนม เจ็ดยอด HAPPY TASTY มะพร้าวน้ำหอม สด ไม่มีน้ำตาล 100%
review_1_text: Walking into the store already knowing their products are going to be very good since the space is well organized and every corner is cleaned and well detailed. The guy is a true professional and I can tell he does not skip any layer of the processes to make it easier and making sure he makes effort to make it really good. I think this place and the guy is special, so you need to come check it out. Highly recommended.
review_2_text:
Nicely decorated store.
I ordered ice cream with sweet bun. The shop owner gives us a donut. All are very good.
Highly recommended.
review_3_text: This is just so good. We came here not in purpose but just passed by for a coffee. Their thai tea latte is so good and the owner was so kind to provide a refill of it🤣 We also ordered the coconut ice cream with taro pearl and it tasted soooo good too. The vibe here was so relaxing that we felt so sleepy haha. The owner was so polite and kind and generous. 😊
review_4_text: Delicious and friendly owner. Would definitely come back again
review_5_text: It was really good! The owner was really nice and gave us lots of delicious freebies :)

name: Finfon Cafe
review_1_text:
A small cafe
Named after a dog and a cat
The coffee is delicious. The best seating is the 6th floor for the atmosphere!!
The prices are incredible: 15,000 won for 8 cups.
review_2_text:
Try the Cold Drip; it's subtly delicious, perfect for a second cup of the day.
Relaxing and won't affect your sleep.
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious. The owner is lovely and friendly. The two cats are also cute. The desserts are delicious. The owner makes them all himself. I will definitely go back and support you again.
review_4_text: Delicious cake, relaxing atmosphere.

name: One by one coffee
review_1_text: Small coffee shop at the same place with the noodle shop. It's very comfortable to take some grandma's noodles and a cap of coffee for breakfast!
review_2_text: The prices are cheap and the drinks taste good. I recommend buying a drink here and also trying the noodles, as they're in the same shop. It's like killing two birds with one stone!
review_3_text: The latte here is very delicious. I recommend you to come and buy it. Order the noodles too, they are very delicious.
review_4_text: This coffee shop is a small, affordable cafe that's popular with young people and students who don't have much money.
review_5_text: The drink is delicious and not overly sweet. There's also a noodle shop next door. Very early in the morning. ☺️

name: PK HOUSE Cafe
review_1_text: Very friendly service, tasty mango and milk frappé and a cute Pomeranian dog!
review_2_text: The desserts and food are soooooo delicious! Everything!

name: MAIRUBDAD : ไม้รับแดด
Sleepless X FiveFiveFive
review_1_text: Delicious drinks and coffee, friendly atmosphere, browse custom clothing, second-hand vintage clothing, chill out.
review_2_text: glowing

name: ชาโครตมุก สาขา 2 (สูตรเมืองป้าว)
review_1_text: The shop offers Thai tea at the affordable price of 25 ฿ and is conveniently situated near the local road. It is known for its diverse beverage selection, which makes it a popular choice among the local community. While the offerings are appealing, the staff's lack of smiles and perceived unfriendliness during my visit was somewhat disappointing. I would have gladly returned if the staff had been more welcoming, but unfortunately, this experience has led me to believe that this will be my final visit.
review_2_text: Delicious brewed coffee, generous portions 👍🏻

name: ร้านกาแฟข้างวัด (เจ็ดยอด)
review_1_text: Nice lady great iced cappuccino 35B.
review_2_text:
Everyone's standards may be different, but for me, this cafe is simply fantastic.

Reasonable prices, great food, a great atmosphere, and a friendly owner. This is a place I'll be visiting often while staying around Chiang Mai's Jet Yot area.

If you're ever in the area, I highly recommend stopping by.
review_3_text: The fruit smoothies are delicious, I recommend the coconut smoothie with fresh milk. The prices are reasonable and the atmosphere is nice, located next to the temple.
review_4_text: The fruit smoothies are very delicious. The vendor is in a good mood.

name: fruit cafe' บาร์ข้างวัดเจ็ดยอด
review_1_text: Delicious smoothies! Order whichever kind you like. Absolutely amazing!

name: Taste Me Sandwich Cafe
review_1_text: Great little place with delicious food! Bread was very good, all the ingredients were quality and fresh. The latte came with a very cute cat foam art, and tasted great! The worker was very friendly and the service was quick. Overall, a great cafe for a quick meal and a drink. The full sandwich was pretty big so if you're not starving, a half would probably be good too. Will definitely come back!
review_2_text: Probably the best sandwich I have had in Thailand and healthy too. I had Italian Milano Salami, but will try the raw parma ham next time. Nice friendly staff, fair priced.
review_3_text: Sandwich is tasty. The owner is really friendly. Small local shop recommend to visit🤤👍👍
review_4_text: the BEST tuna sandwich omg I wanna go back. Plus, peach iced tea is so refreshing loved everything
review_5_text: Delicious Sandwiches, I eat an Italian Salami. Best Quality Food, thanks you so much. Best Sandwich since long Time.

name: ชูศิลป์ คาเฟ่ chusilp cafe
review_1_text:
Cute spot, nearby a university and had nice air conditioning!

I ordered two iced mochas to go (45 baht each), and was given an easy to carry bag for this purpose. Price is good, strong WiFi, bathroom access (outside) and decent service. Also tasty coffee!

Would recommend!
review_2_text:
Super cute little shop with solid coffee, great prices, and awesome barista.

Hope this places gets poppin! Come support ~
review_3_text: It's a cafe right next to our apartment, so I went to this cafe😀I was worried because there was no review, but I am leaving a review because the coffee tastes really great👍👍The price is cheap and the coffee is so good. It's the best latte I've ever had in Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: Good small Café with great coffee. Definitely recommend.
review_5_text: The coffee was delicious, and reading the sticky notes on the wall was enjoyable.

name: Lego Cafe กาแฟสด นมสด ชานมไข่มุก น้ำผลไม้ปั่น สมูทตี้ ขนมปังปิ้ง
review_1_text: This place has become one of my favourite stops to have an amazing cup of coffee. The owner speaks english very well. She is very friendly and easy to have a chat with. The place looks cute too!
review_2_text: The best americano next to our house. I really love this tiny cute coffee place.
review_3_text: Delicious smoothies at affordable prices

name: Becoming Coffee House
review_1_text: Ver good coffee in a nice space. They had their coffee beans being dried right outside and the quality of the coffee is good. I came in and chill a bit and luckily, i got to play with the baby cats and i had a great time here. The staffs were really nice as well.
review_2_text:
Cute little shop with 2 cats. Owner customized my drink because I can't drink milk! Ordered coffee latte (oat milk) black orange coffee and a mixed fruit cookie 🍪

Very friendly and speaks good English the female owner is very social
review_3_text:
They proceed their own coffee beans here.
Coffee is good. There are light roasted and medium roasted coffee bean options.
Store owners are nice.
review_4_text: If you are fan of cats and coffee - this place is a must visit. This is cozy cafe with cute cat craft souvenirs, 2 amazing cats and very tasty coffee
review_5_text:
so happy to find the cafe open in early morning, and feel fresh with beautiful garden. Cheese cake and lemon cake are highly reccommened.
P.S. Cats normally join to cafe on Tuesday and Saturday.

name: Beans of us Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: What a hidden lovely place. I tried the Thai-Ethiopian coffee blend with oat milk. Great natural high standard flavours and notes. I am picky about coffee, Ethiopian arabica coffee blends well with other regional beans, but it also tastes incredibly good without blending and adding nothing in it. The chocolate chip cookie was warm and fresh, I don't think I had something like this anywhere in Thailand so far. The lady at the coffee bar was nice and welcoming.
review_2_text: White tone is cold-brew coffee mixed with forest honey. It is absolutely refreshing. Definitely a perfect glass for hot weather day. The barista is friendly and professional. The atmosphere in the cafe is nice and the place is spacious which is absolutely for working or being a gathering place for chitchatting.
review_3_text: This cafe has a really nice atmosphere, and the coffee was so good. I got a vanilla latte, and it was just what I wanted. It is also pet friendly, so you can bring your little puppy and enjoy your coffee and a snack.
review_4_text: I cam we here very early in the morning after my half marathon. So I was alone and the staff was still a bit sleepy. Not judging. I would be too if I had to work on a Sunday morning at 7am 😅 I usually don’t like to have the first coffee of the day at a coffee shop since the machine is not up to speed. But I really needed one. And it was good.
review_5_text: This café offers a wide variety of coffee beans, and the special drink I tried, White Tone, is beautifully balanced with the aroma of both tea and coffee. The flavor is smooth and satisfying. The seating is comfortable, making it a perfect spot to work all day, and the parking area is spacious.

name: วาคาเฟ่
review_1_text:
The coffee is delicious, with a great taste and a wonderful caramel aroma.
The staff are lovely and friendly. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious! The aroma is amazing as soon as you walk in. The atmosphere is lovely and very inviting, with a sophisticated and elegant feel. The staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
review_3_text:
The coffee is delicious, and the staff are very friendly.
I highly recommend the matcha green tea with coconut.
review_4_text: It was delicious! The coffee was fragrant and smooth. The shop is cute, the atmosphere is nice, and the staff provided excellent service.
review_5_text: It was delicious! Very well-balanced flavor. I really like this taste. I will definitely order again.

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขาโลตัสโกเฟลชชุมชนเจ็ดยอด
ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขา เอสโซ่ เจ็ดยอด
review_1_text: Many branches of this coffee shop in the north, nice coffee beans they use 👍
review_2_text: Great coffee with reasonable price.
review_3_text: The coffee shop at the gas station is affordable, the taste is decent, there's parking available, and the staff provides good service.
review_4_text: Delicious, not expensive, good service, parking at a gas station, reasonable price.
review_5_text: It's delicious. I'm happily waiting for the car to be washed.

name: นัดพบ cafe'
review_1_text:
I went in for my first cup of fresh coffee. While waiting, I ordered some rad na to fill my stomach first. The hot pan was incredibly flavorful. The aroma of stir-fried basil was so wonderful. I ordered two basil chicken and fried egg dishes to take home and one fried chicken noodle soup for my husband and son. Everyone said it was delicious. Where did you buy it? I'll ask for other dishes tomorrow. If it tastes good, I'll make it my regular place.
Nadpob Cafe, Chang Phueak: A newly opened restaurant worth a try. The food and drinks are delicious. The service is excellent. The place is very inviting.
review_2_text: The food and drinks are very delicious. There are many menus that are impressive in taste. Some things seem common, but when you try them, the shop creates a difference in the flavors hidden in the food in an unbelievable way. Spicy and smooth, each type of food is perfectly balanced. I recommend the stir-fried basil and stir-fried chili paste over rice. The flavor is very strong. The fried rice has a unique egg and wok aroma. The noodles are so well-balanced that you have to order more. There are many other menus that you have to come back to try. The green tea, Thai tea, and fresh coffee are very satisfying. The service is friendly. I want to tell foodies and tasters that you must not miss this shop. Nadpob cafe, Chang Phueak, Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: I ordered coffee from Line Man and it was delicious. I'll go try it at the shop. What a surprise!!

name: สภากาแฟสันติธรรม
review_1_text: I am not into popcorn, but for whoever is: There is a funky looking popcorn place in this side street.
review_2_text: They have freshly popped regular popcorn and pre-made premium popcorn, both of which are delicious, but the premium popcorn seems a bit pricey for the amount. They offer samples so you can taste all the popcorn flavors. I bought durian and chocolate banana, which are my favorites. I'm going to go back once I've finished them all.
review_3_text: A cute and cozy restaurant with delicious food at affordable prices. Friendly service and comfortable seating.
review_4_text: Delicious, inexpensive, authentic
review_5_text: I go eat there almost every day.

name: Cherry Top 1994 Coffee & Bar
review_1_text: This is a great little bar!  Very attractive interior with proper amount of cocktail lighting, nice outdoor seating area too.  They make a great Manhattan, the King of Cocktails, and currently have a 2-1 drink special that is hard to beat.  Not far from old city, it's atmospheric and sexy with a classic vibe.  They have a full complement of cocktails.  I found it late in my stay in Chiang Mai but I'll be back!
review_2_text: Nice atmosphere, great service and good music and food. And delicious cocktails.
review_3_text: Good service and sooo yummy!!
review_4_text: Bar is closed 6:00 pm high expectations dashed. Good luck to the owner .
review_5_text: The best restaurant in town

name: Artistic Lab
review_1_text: We had a wonderful experience at the Artistic Lab! 😍 The perfume bar was so much fun - we could mix our own scents, and it felt really special to create something personal. It was also good value for money! The staff were incredibly kind, helpful, and made the whole visit feel relaxed and enjoyable. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique experience ☺️
review_2_text: Terrific cafe! Spotlessly clean cafe that serves a good cuppa of latte, every single time without exception. The barista is attentive and jovial. Makes you feel right at home. You can stay here as long as you like. Unlike some cafes, they don't chase you away. The Wi-Fi is fast and they play soothing Korean and Japanese music in the background. Add that to a rainy day and you have...love. Highly recommended. They have a perfume lab next door that allows you to mix and match your scents for a small fee. Perfect gifts with a personal touch! Opens daily except Wednesdays.
review_3_text: Very thoughtful and friendly staffs. The cakes are delicious and the perfumes are uniquely blended.
review_4_text: A little pretentious and complicated for my taste. Though it's a cool atmosphere and our drinks were delicious. I got the Pink Bubble and it was nice and refreshing. The wife got one of the Perfume Drinks, the Flower Set. Seemed like a lot of effort for a drink bit she enjoyed it.
review_5_text: Very clinical looking cafe it’s like being in one of those beauty therapy places but with less nail polish fumes wafting around.  Really good affordable coffee and an assortment of seating available.  There’s super fast WiFi and power points available at the window seats if you fancy day dreaming at staring out into the car park.  Bathrooms are located outside. #BeatTheGrind

name: เติมใจรัก Coffee home
review_1_text:
This cozy little coffee shop is truly worth the short trip off the beaten path. It has that personal, welcoming feel that’s getting harder to find these days.
The food here is a standout, freshly made, and absolutely delicious. It’s not crowded with tourists, which helps the place keep its natural charm and relaxed atmosphere. I tried the pork rice bowl and highly recommend it; the flavor and quality were surprisingly good for such a humble setting.
I’ll definitely be back to try more dishes. A real Chiang Mai gem!
review_2_text: Nice family run place to eat. A little bit of the beaten track but worth the visit. I had hoped to make it back… next time I’m in town I’ll go for sure.
review_3_text:
Great spot for food and coffee, the atmosphere is unique with vintage vehicles and retro technology and knickknacks all around. It is far from the road so there is no traffic. This appears to be their garden, where you are a guest; it really is a shop that feels like home.
Edit: a year later it is even better! The food is amazing 👏
review_4_text: Such a nice relaxing place with good food and great service. The lady here is super nice and welcoming and the space is comfortable and feels really great. They have nice home cooked meals aside from drinks, so you can plan to spend some time here if you wanna just sit back and relax for a bit.
review_5_text:
A retro delight. CDs and cassette, turntable. A menu of traditional cafe food, replete with some untypical additions. Delicious 👌.

Indoor and outdoor seating. Be careful walking on the moss-covered bricks outside when it rains!

name: Mon Cafe
review_1_text: Local cafe with a few chairs. I picked up thai tea and it was good and cheaper than many other places.
review_2_text:
Good Thai milk tea.
Can ask for sugar adjustment.
review_3_text: I love the ice latte here, best I've had in forever! Made with real espresso and not the powdered coffee, to the price of 35thb. The girl who runs this place is a sweetheart too and will greet you with a big smile.
review_4_text: Mon is a cheerful and nice girl. She speak  english too. Ordered a coffee and it taste similar to Singapore standard. The shop is located at the side of the road and it is beside a restaurant.
review_5_text: Friendly service. Very good rich dark Americano more like a double espresso for only 30 baht. This place according to the girl that served me is called Mon Cafe not Coffee Love.

name: 74 Coffee Smoothies
review_1_text:
This isn’t a place for a good coffee as their coffee drinks taste way too burnt. But if you can’t find any coffee shop around and you need a quick caffeine fix, this might do for you.

The price, even though not expensive compared to other coffee shops but with the quality of your coffee drinks that taste like burnt smoke, I feel it’s not worth paying that price.

The staff aren’t too friendly here but they’re doing their job and try not to be too unpleasant. They just don’t seem very inviting and pleasant much, maybe I happened to come here on their bad day. 🤔

The seating area outside is quite nice and simple, good place to sit while waiting for your car to be cleaned (there’s a car wash service right next to the cafe and Go gym next to it). I’ve seen some people do their computer work here at times.

So, out of convenience and if you can’t find any good cafe around here, this place will do. They serve typical hot and cold coffee and tea beverages and smoothies. But this won’t be the kinda place that I would go for a good coffee though.
review_2_text: Next to GoGym and Clean Food. Holy Trinity for the healthy, buffed, caffeine addict.
review_3_text: They remember your drink, good coffee, friendly staff and comfortable place to chill. Get your motorcycle or car washed next door and enjoy your favorite beverage
review_4_text: Good and awesome food
review_5_text: Rude bad people

name: ร้านมิสเตอร์วิลเลี่ยมกาแฟโบราณ สาขาพี่แอน
review_1_text: A nice local shop with a friendly local atmosphere. I had a fresh orange juice, and the price was very reasonable. The owner speak very good English, warm and helpful. A great spot for a quick, refreshing drink
review_2_text: Best thai tea in all of Chiang Mai
review_3_text: The service was excellent. ❤️
review_4_text: Best drinks and service in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: The vendor is kind, lovely, and has a great personality. There are activities to play and points to collect each time you visit. Once you collect enough points, you get a chance to win a prize through a random draw. The drinks are delicious, the cups are large, and the prices are affordable.💖

name: Dezy coffee
review_1_text: Very nice and chill place, drinks so yyyaaammmyyy
review_2_text: The drinks are reasonably priced and the owner is lovely and kind.

name: ศุข๖๖ A BLISSFUL (幸福六六 )เต็มไปด้วยความสุข Coffee and Craft
review_1_text: Decent to go coffee spot. They have lots of coffee gears and some of the beans from Kenya and Ethiopia.
review_2_text:
Small home cafe open to the road with few seats ☕️
Good service & good coffee
Light & medium roasts with different origins
review_3_text:
It was near my accommodation, so I passed by often.
It's a bit out of the way, but it's always crowded.
Last time, I had an iced Yirgacheffe,
and thought I'd try a warm one next time I visit.
Today, I had a warm drip Yirgacheffe.
It was as delicious as I expected.
It's the best coffee I've had at a cafe in Thailand so far.
However, if you're used to coffees costing around 40 baht,
then 100 baht might be a bit much.
If it were in the Nimman area, it would probably be quite famous.
If you happen to pass by, I recommend stopping by.
review_4_text:
The coffee is excellent. Every menu item is a wonderful experience. The barista is skilled and understands how to create each unique drink. Come try it!

(Professional Barista with good coffee beans, every drink is perfect)
review_5_text:
An art studio and slow bar cafe with a dark, artsy atmosphere. The baristas present excellent coffee, and of course, it tastes great.

Come enjoy the flavors of coffee using the Flair Espresso machine and a variety of craft coffee equipment.

name: Rakun cha
review_1_text: Cheap drink pick up place. Good enough for a quick to go drink.
review_2_text: Good take away drink store.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee, cocktails, drinks and matcha.

name: Stay
review_1_text:
Air conditioner + amazing coffee 👌🏻👌🏻
The coffee was amazing but I also recommend the milk tea!! Great local flavour! The place is clean and has air conditioner and the prices are good. Give it a try!
review_2_text: I stopped by here because it was so hot while I was walking around. The latte and cappuccino were both rich and delicious. Everyone here is friendly and the coffee is delicious~~
review_3_text: I happened to stop by. A rich and delicious latte~~~!! Highly recommended :)

name: Karn Coffee&Bakery
review_1_text: Cheap and decent coffee in this corner cafe.  The premise is nicely cooled and there’s an assortment of seating styles including tables and bench seating overlooking the road.  WiFi is very fast and there’s delicious cakes available.  Hot latte with cost you 35 baht. #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: Good coffee variety of food and bakery.
review_3_text: Always friendly service. The drinks are great and both the Thai food (try the pad kra pao) and western breakfasts are awesome quality! Great spot for quiet work/reading/hanging out and chatting!
review_4_text: Coffee? Sometimes good, sometimes not. Okay food for a Thai like me. Decent price but staff here are always noisy. They talk a lot and some time ignored costumers.
review_5_text: It's ok but disappointed that they have no more egg tarts.

name: NA-MO coffee&bakery’s
review_1_text: I passed by a few times here and it was always closed. It was finally open and I came in and it is actually nicer than how it looked from outside. They have a good selection of coffee bean as well as the roast level. The people were also nice. One unique and noticeable thing was the cup is bigger than most of the take away cups and I was easily tell the difference and the weight in my hand, so the value feels even better.
review_2_text: Amazing Smoothies, the mango smoothie is crazy good , it’s more like a dessert than a smoothie, The owner Milk is awesome and she has the best service and I can easily say this is the best place to get a cold drink in the whole of Chiang Mai
review_3_text: Good banana shake  & Good  cold chocolate
review_4_text: Good coffee and milkshake
review_5_text: Great ice cappucino

name: KRISP Café
review_1_text: A very cool and incredibly creative place combined with an art gallery. Two floors with plenty of cozy, beautiful spots for working and getting inspired. An interesting space with seating both indoors and outdoors. The coffee is good, and the overall atmosphere makes you want to stay longer. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Such a beautiful café with a unique vibe, it feels like a contemporary art museum.
Outside, there’s a pool designed for sitting and working, which makes the space really special. Inside, you’ll find paintings and sculptures everywhere, adding so much character to the place.

The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, perfect if you’re looking for a quiet spot to work on your projects. We ordered a mocha and a matcha chocolate, and both were absolutely delicious.

A lovely place to slow down, get inspired, and stay longer than planned. ☕✨❤
review_3_text: Lovely place for breakfast. I highly recommend the almond croissant which tasted delicious. There’s plenty of comfortable seating indoors and outdoors to enjoy your pastries and coffee. I would come back if I return to Chiang Mai!
review_4_text:
I love Krisp because: 1) the coffee is fantastic - the best I've had in Thailand, 2) the interior is so nice. Thoughtfully designed with a great eye for architecture and respecting the modernist style - it's quality. 3) It's a quiet and pleasant space to work or read. Comfortable seats and plenty of space.
It's a home away from home and the service is great too. 🙏🏼
review_5_text: A beautiful spot that feels like a little escape from the city chaos. Tasty desserts, good drinks, friendly staff, plenty of seating, and charming decor.

name: Saruda Finest Pastry Espace
review_1_text:
I expected a bit more from this café. The atmosphere is very pleasant, and the interior design is really nice and thoughtfully done. The pastries are great and well presented.

There is an art gallery on the second floor, which is a nice concept, but unfortunately the space feels quite cluttered and messy, with boxes and items stored around. This sense of disorder is noticeable in other parts of the café as well. If the gallery and surrounding areas were organized and cleaned up, this could become a really great place.

I didn’t quite enjoy the coffee, but that’s a matter of personal taste. Overall, the café has good potential.
review_2_text:
Tried the lemon cake.
It’s quite refreshing. With layers of lemon jelly and the cream is not too heavy.
Very nice outlook and the taste is there too.
Love the environment and there’s steps at the outside of the stall for sun walking.
Friendly staff and very chill environment
review_3_text: Very delicious cakes. Not too sweet and very well balanced. Each cake looks creative and beautiful. I really enjoyed it.
review_4_text: There is another location in Nimman, but this location is larger and nicer and this location has a large car parking. I feel Saruda has the best cakes in Chiang Mai. They don’t just look nice and different, but they actually taste great and sophisticated. What I can tell you is their cakes are not average cakes. The prices are higher than most of the cakes in town, but they are well worth it.
review_5_text:
