name: Mont Blanc Patisserie
review_1_text:
Mont Blanc Patisserie might just be one of Chiang Mai’s top 10 restaurants overall when I consider service, ambience, decor and the dining experience. I’ve eaten my way through this city, including the Michelin approved spots, and very few of them can come close to what this place delivers.

The staff were warm, polite and helpful, as one would expect from the amazing people of Chiang Mai. The ambience is spot on: warm lighting, music at the right volume, and décor that feels like it was curated tastefully by people who appreciate old books, vintage cameras, radios that take you back in time, and classic vinyl. It’s effortlessly charming.

I’m sitting here right now wondering how I’ve only ever tried their desserts, which are themselves absolutely fantastic and not too sweet. This is my second day in a row coming here, yesterday I was only here to have dessert, thinking that’s all they offered. But today, the food and ambience really hit me on a completely different level. The chicken steak with pepper sauce? Easily one of the best chicken thighs I’ve had anywhere. Perfectly seared for a crispy skin that was packed with flavor, and the meat was juicy well‑seasoned. The mashed potatoes  tasted like it was made by my grandmother, a compliment of the highest order.

In two visits, I feel like a teenager falling in love for the first time, everything seems perfect, but this is genuinely how good it is.

Mont Blanc Patisserie easily stands alongside, if not above,  the very best restaurants I’ve visited in Chiang Mai. I’ll be back. Often.
review_2_text: Love this place and always enjoy the atmosphere whenever I’m here. The only thing that keeps me and many of my friends from coming more often is the consistently high music volume. It’s noticeably louder than anywhere else in town, which makes it tough to work or even have a relaxed conversation. Everything else about the place is genuinely fantastic, so it still deserves 5 stars. I just hope the owners consider turning the music down a bit so more people can enjoy this great spot.
review_3_text:
Huge thanks to Pon and Mon for making our visit such a great experience! They were so friendly, welcoming, and attentive ,  you can really feel the positive energy as soon as you walk in. Their service was spot on and made us feel right at home.
The food was absolutely delicious, and the prices are more than reasonable for the quality and portions you get. It’s honestly such great value for money!
The place has such a nice, comfortable vibe , clean, cozy, and perfect for relaxing and enjoying a good meal. Plus, the parking is excellent, which makes everything so convenient.
Overall, everything was fantastic. Highly, highly recommended!

name: Mai bakery in garden
review_1_text:
Mai Bakery in Garden is such a charming and cozy spot; it instantly gives you that warm, farmhouse feeling the moment you step inside. The interior design feels just like a countryside home in Texas, with rustic wooden furniture, soft colors, and lovely vintage decorations that make you feel right at home. The whole place is surrounded by greenery, making it a peaceful retreat for anyone who loves nature and good food.

The café offers a wide selection of dishes, freshly baked cakes, and excellent coffee. Whether you’re in the mood for a hearty breakfast, a light brunch, or just a slice of cake with a cup of latte, Mai Bakery in Garden has something for everyone. Everything is beautifully presented and tastes just as good as it looks.

One of the best parts about this place is that it’s connected to a hotel; making it incredibly convenient for hotel guests. Imagine waking up in the morning and walking just a few steps to enjoy your breakfast in a lovely garden atmosphere, surrounded by flowers, trees, and fresh air. It’s the perfect way to start the day.

Mai Bakery in Garden is not just a café, it’s a relaxing experience. Whether you come for the food, the cozy ambiance, or just to unwind with a book and a cup of coffee, you’ll leave feeling refreshed and happy. It’s truly one of those hidden gems you’ll want to return to again and again.

Dr. Niwech
review_2_text:
This place is an absolute hidden gem! 💎 The garden is a tranquil oasis—so serene and cozy, it feels like a little escape from the hustle and bustle. The coffee here is exceptional, and the desserts? Wow, they’re simply divine.

We’ve spent countless hours sitting in the garden, soaking in the peaceful atmosphere. Even though it’s tucked just behind a busy and noisy main road, the space is so well-hidden and insulated that you can barely hear the traffic.

The ambiance is enhanced by the gentle background music they play. The volume is perfect—not intrusive, but just enough to notice if you want to. It’s kept so low that you can still hear the birds singing, creating a perfect harmony of nature and music.

The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, which only adds to the charm. This spot truly has it all: amazing coffee, delicious desserts, peaceful surroundings, and the perfect touch of music. Highly recommend!

name: Café Fleur de Mai
review_1_text: The café has been newly renovated, and I really love the new vibe. It’s more private and cozy, with a nice balcony overlooking the river. Even when it’s hot outside, it stays cool inside. There’s a cat named Betty and some great books to browse while you sip your drink. Drinks are around 70–80, desserts about 90, pretty reasonable. In the evening, there’s a nice DJ set. It feels more like visiting a friend’s home than a typical café. A great spot to relax, read, or get some work done.
review_2_text:
Cosy little Cafe! The coffee and drinks in general are delicious and fairly priced at around 50 per hot drink. The seating is quite comfy - there are few tall tables and a small bar. Great place to read a book and decent enough to do some brief work on your laptop.
The staff is always friendly here too and the place never feels crowded.
review_3_text: Good place to get some quick work done. Coffee is great and the place is clean, funky and great tunes playing in the background.  The bathroom facilities are very new and the cafe is very well lit.  The stools aren’t extremely comfortable but for an hour or so it’s fine.  WiFi is good but there’s only one power outlet for charging your computer. #BeatTheGrind
review_4_text:
Very good vibe here,river view,good
Quality coffee and cake , reasonable price, love it!
review_5_text: Cozy & cute cafe! Great for working, they have fast WiFi and a nice menu of coffee drinks, beer, wine, and liquor (gin, bourbon, and baileys). No food menu, but there is a small pastry case. Inside there are 4 high top tables (8 seats) and a small bar with 5 seats. Also four tables outside. The breeze was nice today but there is also AC for hot afternoons.

name: hahm.coffeebar
review_1_text:
Small coffee shop with nice and warmly decoration in Fah Hahm area front of Charoen Rat Rd.

Did not expect much but it surprisingly GOOD coffee. Delicious coffee, fast, and cheap price.
Americano 55THB

Open early from 7AM. Can be your daily dose on your way to work.
review_2_text: Cute aesthetic coffee shop across the famous curry spot. Such a great spot to cool off and enjoy your drinks. Recommend the “Here comes the sun”. It was refreshing and light - Nothing I’ve ever had! I also got the matcha Latte with oat milk. You can tell it’s high quality matcha and the oat milk was so creamy. The employee Fon who made our drinks was so sweet.
review_3_text:
Had an excellent caramel macchiato here!!!Just the way I like it

Very nicely designed cafe and the ambiance is very nice
review_4_text: Excellent matcha latte and “here comes the sun” (incredible yuzu honey espresso) with a really lovely quiet vibe! Highly recommend this cute little place!
review_5_text: I was having lunch around this area so I stopped by this little cafe after lunch. I didn’t expect much but OMG they have one of the best Thai milk tea! I would love to go back there for their thai milk tea!

This Cafe Amazon is probably my fav because of the comfy indoor/outdoor seating options & waterfall feature 😍
Quiet setting. So peaceful sitting outside under the covered deck, listening to the sound of running water with beautiful koi fish swimming about. Outdoor outlets make it perfect for working online & being able to enjoy the coffee shop life 🫶🏽
review_2_text: This branch of Cafe Amazon is located in the PTT Fa Ham station. There is a spacious and shady garden area where when you buy a coffee you can sit at a table in the garden. The staff are good and they inform me of various promotions too. I am very impressed with the discount from using the service.
review_3_text: Nice atmosphere, good place to stop and grab some coffee

review_1_text: Good coffee at good price
review_2_text: A bright morning in Chiang Mai. I ordered an iced espresso but received a coconut Americano. I was very upset. The staff didn't say anything about changing it or taking any responsibility, so I just accepted it feeling confused. This will be my only visit to Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: I've encountered this more than 2-3 times. I ordered one drink and waited over 10 minutes. Ultimately, I had to cancel the order. Waiting any longer would mean being late for work. And more than 4-5 times, there's no parking available. Okay, that's it.
review_4_text:
Very good coffee and Taiwanese milk tea!
The staff are super friendly and very quick with orders, and the prices are absolutely reasonable for the size. They offer two different coffee roasts, which you can choose from.
I love coming here and highly recommend it!
review_5_text: The iced tea was very delicious. The staff had long eyelashes and a stern face, not really ready to serve customers. But I forgive them because the iced tea is the best in Chiang Mai and very strong. However, some days when I order it, there are a lot of tea scraps.

name: The Thaiger Coffee
review_1_text: Great place for nice coffee.   Cool vintage Thai movie posters on the walls. Pleasant staff.  Recommended.
review_2_text: Nicely decorated, lovely Team, refreshing Honey Lemon Soda
review_3_text:
I stumbled upon this coffee shop and restaurant on my way. I looked in because they had such a wide selection of teas, and I realized they also serve steak.

I was happy to be able to enjoy a generous portion of protein and vegetables at a reasonable price. The coffee was also very strong and delicious. I'm leaving after enjoying my meal!
review_4_text: All the menus on the roadside are really cheap, the food is clean and tasty, and the coffee is even better than Starbucks.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious, they use high-quality ingredients. It's also very affordable at only 35 baht per cup. The food is delicious too, everything on the menu is tasty. The owner is lovely, very kind and always smiling. I'm a regular customer now!

name: หอมกาแฟ Goodlife เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop tucked away. Well worth the short detour from the freeway walking or transport. I ordered mocha yen (iced). 45 baht and delicious. Lovely staff and I recommend this cafe. Support local🙏🏻
review_2_text: This is my favourite coffee in Chiang May! Take away only but always top quality. Hope you guys will start working earlier at least 8:00
review_3_text: The coffee is very fragrant and delicious. This shop is the best I've ever had. I recommend it. The price is not expensive. The owner is cute and the service is very good.
review_4_text:
Introducing our Cocoa 😍 / Matcha / Thai Tea / Green Tea / Cappuccino / Pink Milk. Keep switching between them! It's a small shop but the quality is excellent, delicious, and the prices are great.
**In the picture, I mixed my own drink and it was delicious!! Matcha Cocoa ❤️ You can show the picture to the staff; it's not on the menu 🤩🤣
review_5_text: Located on a back road with little traffic, this cafe is quiet and secluded. Enjoy a delicious, reasonably priced cafe latte before you leave.

name: CLÉ - เคลย์ cafe & eatery
review_1_text: There is a large outdoor area with loads of greenery and a pond with koi, and an indoor area with AC to escape the heat. The ambiance is so lovely. I enjoyed the cheesy katsu and a lychee tea 🤗
review_2_text:
Cafe now decoration with Christmas theme. It's warm and cozy.
The drinks is reasonable price.
The bakery taste good.
There are parking lots.
review_3_text: Tasty basic northern Thai food. The location is quite out of the way, and quiet. Lots of beautiful woodwork and greenery. The lunchtime staff were okay, but happy to ignore me despite there being few other customers. I didn't mind too much. Recommend the hojicha latte, which has a deep roasted green tea taste. Because of the fountain it is a bit too loud for quiet conversation. I didn't mind at all, but some might. Many many flies attacked my food as soon as I looked away.
review_4_text: Cool cafe, kind of a hidden gem you gotta know about to find. Really nice atmosphere, you can tell they care about the details. And hey, they've got toffee nut latte – trust me, it's good!
review_5_text: I love everything about this cafe. The interior design, the flow, the vibe, the thoughtful attention to detail, the music, the bathrooms and the Food!!! A+  I am so glad I discovered this location. We love it!

review_1_text:
Great little spot for a quick bite. Located inside the hotel, on the second floor.

Staff was kind and courteous, gave a free cookie after the meal.

Thai basil chicken was very nice!
review_2_text:
I absolutely love this place. To be honest I didn’t come here in person yet since it’s a bit far, but will definitely do that some day. Anyway I always order delivery, and it’s the best. First of all: the food is excellent, I love the grilled vegetables and the duck, or salmon. Yum! And bonus: they put these cute little notes on my food when I order. Also whenever I communicate with them, they are so friendly and always helpful. Thank you guys, your resto is really one of my favorites!
UPDATE: I visited in person recently. The resto is part of a hotel and it’s super cute and modern! Recommend.
review_3_text: This is one of our favorite cafes in Chiang Mai. The environment is lovely and peaceful. Their baked goods are exceptional and I love their crispy chicken green curry and rainbow tea!
review_4_text:
Ordered a birthday cake from here and it was one of the best cakes I’ve ever had! So moist, flavorful and has the perfect amount of sweetness; I couldn’t be happier!!

The cafe itself is beautifully designed and has a relaxing atmosphere that’s perfect for working or reading. The service is also excellent and the staff are very welcoming. Although this place is a bit hidden away, I highly recommend coming here if anyone gets the chance. You will not be disappointed!
review_5_text: Great coffee and Pastries!  I was able to park in the facility which is alway a plus!  From the car park person to the cafe, everyone was nice and professional!

review_2_text:

review_4_text: love it!

review_5_text:

They have a variety of menu items, and the shop can separate the tea from the ice.
Highly recommended!!! Free delivery for 5 glasses in the nearby area.

nice coffee and warm hospitality. Owner can speak good English and he’s able to recommend the type of beans to the type of coffee that you would prefer (e.g americano, latte, cappuccino etc).

review_2_text: Nice place to have a coffee on doi pui.
review_3_text: An amazing little coffee house with great fresh brewed coffee and the most friendly staff on the mountain!!!
review_4_text: Great view and nice people with a free tea
review_5_text: This might be the best place on the trip. The cafe is on an upper floor where you can enjoy the fresh air and a cool breeze. It has a designated smoking area. If you are a smoker, I recommend it. However, the bathrooms are not polite, as Deng says.

Also available are local honey and raspberries ✌️
review_2_text: Great coffee, service and view, honestly enjoyed itmore than the small villages
review_3_text: One of the best cafes in this area. Easy and large parking space, great view, and good drinks. It is very relaxing and the staff is nice. It is a nice stop when you are on a scooter trip.

review_5_text:

Worth to go after visiting Doi Suthep, super quiet surrounded by nature

review_5_text: Good coffee for a rainy. Very friendly staff and they speak good english

Ordered hot Hmong coffee, hot Thai milk tea, Thai ice bubble tea.

review_2_text: Nice little coffee shop. Very good latte and delicious homemade fresh waffles 🧇😋😋😍
review_3_text: Amazing experience! Very tasty coffee and welcoming space.
review_4_text: Nice cozy cafe
review_5_text:
Noh Mor Ha
I apologize if the location is incorrect. While the coordinates I've placed here indicate "Noh Mor Ha" restaurant on Google Maps, it's listed as I'm Hmong cafe & coffee.

If you're visiting the Hmong hill tribe village of Doi Pui in Chiang Mai (about 8 km past Wat Phra That Doi Suthep),
and you're tired and want a place to rest, eat, and drink, I highly recommend this place: "Noh Mor Ha." They sell made-to-order food and drinks. The taste is great, and they can customize your order to your liking – spicy, sour, salty, sweet, and delicious (I'm not sure if I was just really hungry when I ate there!!!). They have a variety of dishes on the menu (as shown in the pictures).

name: Lan Kafae Hmong Coffee
review_1_text:
Great place for spending some time’s admiring the scenery, they sells some great coffee, tea and some snacks.

Got the opportunity to meet the owner / barista / roasters while he worked.

We talked about the coffee beans, quality and sizes, also the region around here.

They make around 40 kg every 1 or 2 weeks depending on the harvest.
review_2_text: Part of Hmong Doi Pui village, there is one of the beautiful coffee shop which is located at the back of the village on the hill. You would be able to have some pure coffee while enjoying look at the view of the village and having a beautiful pictures in the garden, and if you have a little times you would be able to the sample house that they used to live,and coffee plants. I would suggest you to try a very good coffee for those who like coffee.
review_3_text: Great place to take a break. Good view, Thai milk tea is good . Price is reasonable cheap in the tourism place. Lots puzzle game for play.
review_4_text: Great service.  Very friendly staff.  Coffee was very good and affordable.  The Thai tea was the right amount of sweetness.  Shop also sells brain teasers made out of teak wood.
review_5_text: Amazing restaurant and super friendly staff. Their Khao soi is the best in Thailand!! Delicious 😋😋

name: Hmong Doi Pui Family Coffee
review_1_text:
Late January 2026 Local Hmong cafe serving a wide range of specialty and crafted coffee ☕️

One of the few interesting places at the village originated when the peoples of this region once cultivated opium poppy plantations.  The then late king made efforts to introduce more sustainable alternative crops and soon a small coffee industry was born.

The selection itself is notable from basic blends to single origin beans 🫘 reflecting the deep knowledge of the family behind this local brand.  Even selective beans are available as well as various brewing options.

The staff is strictly counter style with option to do your own pour 🫗 over order.  Retails options are also available as well as other coffee by products and alternative drinks.  Meals pairings are also at hand.

The atmosphere and the view are particularly beautiful and once can imagine the restful view in the early sunrises 🌅 😍 👌   Truly one of the must visit places in the village.
review_2_text: Very nice place to relax and enjoy the view and good coffee. We hat a tasty Iced Cappuccino. The hot Mocha was rather disappointing as I missed intense Mocha, it was rather weak, so not my personal favorite. Maybe the Iced Mocha would be a better choice.
review_3_text:
Great place to drink coffee: beautiful view, incredibly hospitable staff, delicious coffee.
There are very few places where the coffee beans from the coffee you drink are picked directly around you. The employee who processes and roasts the coffee beans gave us a whole tour and showed us how the machine works. Really very nice, thanks! The quality of the coffee is also very good. You can also buy ground coffee and coffee beans here.
Besides this there's a restaurant as well.
review_4_text: If you're looking for a perfect blend of great coffee and stunning views, this cafe on top of the mountain is a must-visit. The coffee is exceptional, making it a great spot for both relaxing and working. I always go for studying and writing, and the serene atmosphere, combined with the panoramic mountain views and the mesmerizing movement of the clouds, provides the ideal environment for focus and creativity. Be prepared for a short, 10-minute walk from where you park, but the breathtaking scenery and peaceful setting make it well worth the effort.
review_5_text: We visited the quaint Hmong village, which in itself is an amazing adventure and a must do when visiting Chaing Mai.  But at the top of a rather twisting, sloped mountainside walk through the village is this incredibly beautiful cafe Hmong Doi Pui Family Coffee.  The view is breathtaking, so to order a coffee and sit facing the view of this amazing village and mountains is an experience you can't miss, and definitely worth the walk.  Beautiful friendly staff and a large area to sit with a great variety of drinks and food on the menu. Definitely instagramable!!

name: Cafe Leng Doi Pui
review_1_text: Nice cafe with many options to choose from. Nice view
review_2_text:
Nice simple place to experience local house and environment, Leng family hospitality make us feel so welcome and comfortable.
We also join herbalism class though by Leng mother, learn to pick medicinal herb to later cook in their kitchen.
Couldn’t recommend to stay at there place more!
review_3_text: A really lovely little spot for a coffee out of the tourist crowds. Worth the short walk up the hill for the lovely view over the village  Hand grown picked and roasted daily.  Small accommodation units in the cooler air at the top of the village. The steep walk up is well worth it. The owner is charming.  Bought a pack of his coffee which this morning I am enjoying back in New Zealand. Delicious full flavour but not bitter so highly recommended too.
review_4_text:
This place is a hidden gem in Doi Pui Hmong village. As it is located bit away from the main tourist area (you need to walk about 200m) to get to this place. It has basic cottages (about 6, I think) on various ground levels. Although I had only a meal at this place, I am sure it is a nice experience to stay in one of these cottages.
The food was delicious, and well-presented authentic Hmong food. Food is freshly prepared using local ingredients. You immediately see the difference between pre-prepared food and freshly prepared food.
The owner and his wife are very friendly. You can sit at the open-air dining area at the top part of the property with an amazing view over the valley.
There are only very small direction signs (name and how to get to this place) at the centre part of the village and that could be the reason that it is not known to visitors.
review_5_text: Wonderful and quiet place to eat, drink, and rest. I had iced Americano for 50 baths and vegetarian rice with vegetables and egg for 60 baths. You can see right in front a beautiful view of the village and mountains.

name: ALL TWO COFFEE BAR
review_1_text: cool

name: Focus Coffee Rich
review_1_text: Great little coffee shop.

name: วงเวียนมะพร้าวปั่น
ร้านกาแฟสด เอ คัพ
review_1_text: This shop has a sleek, stylish decor and serves all sorts of Southeast Asian drinks. I ordered the popular "Watermelon, Orange, Strawberry, Pineapple" blended smoothie. It was delicious, with just the right amount of sweetness.

name: ปั่นละมุนช่างเคี่ยน
ชานมไข่มุก
DAS COFFEE
review_1_text: They use real cups instead of plastic ones which is good. The inside is ac and the outside is spacious with comfortable chairs. Two cappuccino's for 100thb. Friendly barista.
review_2_text: Coffee: 45 Baht. Ambient small cafe' with great coffee and a friendly owner. Individual tables which are good for laptops/reading. A small outside/roadside area has tables and permits smoking (for those that do).
review_3_text: Terrible ! I went almost all coffee shops near here. This coffee shop is the most unkind. I spilled a little water in toilet and smoking ashes outside. The owner came to me “ you’re not welcome, you’re dirty”. I think the saying is rude but I apologized politely several times. But she came again and repeated again. She needs totally clean space , why she’s running the coffee shop ? Coffee shop should provide coffee but also good services. The staffs were also unkind and they don’t clean often. Sometimes I clean the left coffee cups and trashes and returned the tray. They never say Thank you. They just always see the phones. Even this coffee shop don’t keep the business hour. They are very lazy, never seen that it’s open in the business hour they post. They should change the time or make a notice to customers. That’s why this coffee shop don’t have many customers in this village. In Chiangmai, this coffee shop is the worst coffee shop that I’ve gone. They don’t respect customers at all.
review_4_text: Friendly stuff, good aircondition and delicious latte for only 45baht
review_5_text: Best cappuccino in Town

name: ชามิจิ
review_1_text: The tea is fragrant and delicious.

name: ร้านกาแฟพี่นิค
ON THE WAY CAFE CHIANG MAI @ CHANG KHIAN
review_1_text:
Small 2-3 stools
EXPRESSO machine
Really Cafe latte for  35 baht
They make  expresso based flavored ICED drinks add 10 baht per extra ingredient.
review_2_text: The coffee is really good, and the people who make it do it well.

name: Hop chafe' สาขาช่างเคี่ยน
review_1_text: What's wrong with the staff?? I've bought 1-2 times and only once have they spoken rudely. I'm confused. I've never thought about buying again because their words are so bad. They don't welcome customers, ja ja ja, ja ja, they slam their voices, slam their things, and make loud noises?? Today I decided to buy again. The conclusion was the same. It's like the customer asked to eat for free. I don't usually give stars to restaurants, but this one asked. If the owner sees this, they should be able to consider each comment. But if the seller is the owner, with this kind of attitude, don't do business with them again. #They came to support, not to ask for free food.
review_2_text: Can you please write a review? I usually don’t review any store, but this is the first one. I ordered a normal drink, scanned to pay for them, and told them that I had transferred the money. The first time I told them, I thought they couldn’t hear me because I was wearing a mask. I told them the second time, and they responded in an irritated tone and said, “Yes, I know. Let me take a picture of the receipt.” I didn’t know they wanted to take a picture of the receipt because I usually buy things but they never ask. Which means that when I said I had transferred the money, they heard me but didn’t say they wanted to take a picture of the receipt. I don’t know where their bad mood came from, they just yelled at the customer. If you don’t want to work or can’t control your temper, then you shouldn’t work in service. From other people’s reviews, they all gave negative reviews to the store. The staff should also consider this. I hope you will take this into consideration to improve. And I won’t buy from the store again.
review_3_text: I went to buy something around 10 am. The staff seemed to have low blood sugar; they were very rude. Normally, I respect shopkeepers and service staff a lot, but after experiencing this, I won't be buying from them again. It was only 10 am, so maybe they weren't just tired.
review_4_text: The staff chased us away, saying they were cleaning the shop. They didn't let us in, but their own friend let them in. I'm so confused. This isn't the first time. I understand it's late, it's already 4 a.m., but shouldn't we have told each other nicely?
review_5_text: The service staff was terrible.

name: โอยูชาหน้าหอปอแก้ว
Nozawa Hostel and Onsen
review_1_text:
TLDR:
Probably the best hostel/onsen experience I’ve had in Southeast Asia. I was worried about the room being hot, but the air-con was totally fine (a quick cool-down after the onsen helps). Beds are spacious, super comfy, and come with thick, soft pillows and daily bottled water. The lockable capsule setup with blackout curtains feels private and secure, plus you even get a yukata like a Japanese ryokan.
The outdoor onsen is beautiful—steam room, sauna, cold, warm, and hot baths—easily one of the best in town. Minor issues: unclear pool steps, and WiFi isn’t stable for work calls. Still highly recommended.

Do note the different timings for men and women. The hostel is for males only, and residents get free onsen use.

If you're keen, read on below:
review_2_text:
I visited Onsen last Saturday night and was truly impressed. The facilities are beautifully maintained, spotlessly clean, and everything is in perfect working order. From the hot baths and cold plunge to the sauna, steam room, l, the experience was both relaxing and rejuvenating.

A special thank you to the staff member who welcomed me. He spoke excellent English, was warm, professional, and went out of his way to explain everything clearly. His kindness and helpfulness made me feel immediately comfortable and added so much to the overall experience.  If I could change one thing, it’s to make the hot baths hotter, More like other onsen in Chaing mai😀🙏
review_3_text:
Very good place. Friendly staff.

Lively atmosphere. Clean.

Bit expensive before 10pm. Especially as the relaxation room is dark and only lit by blokes on their phones. Would be much more comfortable place to spend time if there were usb reading lights so you could read a book.

No seal on sauna door either so doesn't get that hot.

Definite 5* if they could sort those things
review_4_text:
Onsen Price in March 2026:
- 300 baht 10:00pm-12:00am
- 450 baht before 10:00
- check out their timetable for different genders

I went there for the onsen, which is great.  The sauna is not working well but others are fine.  I had a good time and local goes there too.  I spent the whole 2 hours there and got to spoke to a few locals.
review_5_text:
“No Shower!”

Ok so this place has no shower, it only has the onsen to shower in. So between the hours of 10am-6pm you cannot shower as the onsen becomes women only. The place is really nice but staff are all over the place in terms of it taking so long to get into the onsen to actually shower. Staff are very friendly though. The rooms are soo hot there is no aircon coming into the individual beds. I booked to stay for 3 nights but checked out after 2. This place is ok if you don't need a shower when you first check in and for 1 night only.

name: กาแฟล่ำซำ
review_1_text: The atmosphere of the small shop is great, with mountain views, delicious coffee, and delicious food. It's the best! 🫰👌👌👍👍🤫

name: Kanal Coffee&Curry
review_1_text: Dropped by into this café before meeting friends and was pleasantly surprised. The setting is cosy and welcoming, making it a great place to unwind. I sampled the latte with both dark and medium roast beans — both were excellent, though the dark roast stood out for me. The tonkatsu curry was superb, full of flavour and very satisfying. If you visit around 3 in the afternoon, the natural light makes the space especially charming and perfect for a photo. A wonderful spot I’d happily recommend.
review_2_text: The atmosphere was fantastic. We sat in the garden in the evening, relaxing and having dinner before heading home. I think it would be just as good for working during the day though. Plenty of parking. I had the beef curry and fish and chips, and they were so delicious I'll definitely be back. Haven't tried the drinks yet.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is great, the drinks are reasonably priced, and the staff are lovely with excellent service. The restrooms are clean and spacious. Please support this shop! ❤️
review_4_text: Check out this cool cafe in the Kan Khlong area! ☕️🍛 Kanal Coffee & Curry has a great vibe, decorated in an industrial loft style with raw concrete walls that perfectly complement the furniture and decor.
review_5_text: Come and give it a try! Cold drinks are available. There are indoor and outdoor areas. Chill out with the Doi Suthep Jews. Everyone likes their own style. We all like the same things. 🤟🏼😎

name: Inthanin Coffee สาขาช้างเผือก
review_1_text:
☕ Inthanin Coffee – Chang Phueak Branch

Stopped by this cozy café on a relaxing day and absolutely loved the atmosphere. The shop offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and a breezy outdoor area surrounded by greenery 🌿 — perfect for working or just unwinding with a cup of coffee.

The coffee was aromatic and flavorful, with quality that exceeded the price. Staff were polite, friendly, and always ready with a smile 😊.
There’s convenient parking available, which is a big plus if you’re driving 🚗.

Whether you’re just passing by or looking for a peaceful spot to recharge, I highly recommend visiting this branch. It’s the kind of place where you can sip slowly, breathe easy, and enjoy a moment of calm with a shot of caffeine 💚
review_2_text: The atmosphere is nice, there are many promotions, the store isn't very big, and it's located inside a Bangchak gas station.
review_3_text:
☕ Inthanin Coffee, Chang Phueak Branch
Stop by for a relaxing coffee on a chill day. This shop has seating both inside (air-conditioned) and outside. The coffee has a wonderful aroma and great taste, with mid-range prices that offer excellent value for money.
The staff are polite, friendly, and welcoming. Plus, there's convenient parking. 🚗 If you're passing by this area, I highly recommend stopping by. You can chill out and get a caffeine boost! 💚
review_4_text: Anyone who's been to this branch should try the San Sai branch (Sam Yaek Market 8143). You'll notice a huge difference in seating, service, and care. You have to go! Try it and you'll understand what warm, welcoming service is like. "You are important" isn't just a greeting.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious...the staff provides excellent service; everyone is polite and courteous. There's no long wait, there are many new menu items, the seating is spacious, clean, and quiet.

name: Looper Wave
review_1_text: This complex of swimming pool, onsen, and café is a great place to relax. The spacious pool is divided into lanes, with a hot tub and a cold stone bath nearby. There are quite a lot of signs informing visitors about the rules in this area. On the second floor, there’s a cozy café with great coffee. The prices are reasonable, and the service is good.
review_2_text:
Looper Wave is more than just a swimming pool—it’s also a great café with a modern, chill vibe. Through large glass windows, you can enjoy views of the pool while sipping coffee.

The barista, with extensive latte competition experience, delivers exceptional latte art.

Creative coffee options, especially the peanut-infused one, are a must-try. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
This review is strictly for the cafe itself, not the pool/onsen.

Forget about going here to work. Probably not even to hang out and chill. Plenty of other places for that. It's clearly not the place for either.
I don't think it even knows what it wants to be. It's really dark and loud, in stark contrast to the entire property around it. Plus it doesn't serve food!

This cafe really should be redesigned to complement the pool/ "onsen" business.

The chairs are super uncomfortable, and the tables are tiny.
The music was very loud too, and the Cafe had most of its blinds down so they can play some really out of place cartoon projected onto the wall. No idea what they are thinking.

I got the "energy" smoothie which was absolutely terrible. It was really small for the price (120, +20 for almond milk,) and it came out as a thick slush that you need a spoon for (which they didn't give). It tasted like a bag of cacao blended with a couple ice cubes. Pretty gross and not what was expected.

Hard pass on this place. Wifi was good and nice view of the pool though.
review_4_text: Good decoration and vibe but not a place to work because loud music (good for chilling) and uncomfortable chair. Btw, the coffee is not good as expected (by this price) and the staff is really not warm welcome … maybe she had a bad morning before going to work at the café. I really have no idea that it is not allow to wait outside before 10am. (bad air pollution then need to find some free space to sit and wait). Once the staff arrived and saw me sitting on the 2nd floor, she was frustrated and spoke to me with negative attitude like I would steal or break sth. by just sitting in front of the cafe… but honestly no sign at the G floor not to go upstair before 10am…who is gonna know? Better sit by the pool if the weather is nice. 😢
review_5_text: Excellent cafe. I am the first one to review. It is amazing. Great pool next to it. I will come back!! Thank you.

name: Boon Bnb& Cafe (บุญบีเอ็นบีแอนด์คาเฟ่)
review_1_text: I did not stay at the bnb just came to the cafe- the atmosphere is so relaxing and pleasant. Lots of different types of areas to sit. It’s an inside/outside vibe. Nice spot to work and enjoy lunch and a coffee or tea. I ordered the Thai tea. The stir fried ramen with spicy basil and chicken. And my husband had the pork steak and fries. All pretty good. 344baht total.
review_2_text: Had a great stay at this lovely BnB. Rooms are clean and spacious, and the location is nice and peaceful. Lovely pool and the hosts are genuinely lovely people. They did everything to ensure we had an amazing stay and were exceedingly thoughtful.
review_3_text:
The property is located in a residential area away from the hustle and bustle of the city. It is very relaxing, plus they have an in-house pool which is great.

The rooms are great and very spacious. They have a laundry service is very useful since the weather is very hot and we tend to sweat a lot.

I especially enjoyed the yummy breakfast which is included with the room.
review_4_text: Did not stay here but went to the cafe. Great atmosphere, very cozy.  Indoors and outside seating.  Breakfast was excellent, and drinks were good.
review_5_text: I came in for brunch and I did not stay here, so this review is for the food and the space. The space is nice and very relaxing vibe, and the pool is small but it feels like a perfect size for the cool chilling space. The food here are pretty affordable and decent, but could be better in terms of the quality. Given the space, the value is still good enough in my opinion.

name: Backin
review_1_text:
Nice atmosphere and good selection of craft beer taps
The owner is nice, friendly and passionate about craft beers. Easy going vibe for evening for drinking with Hobbit house style.
review_2_text: Pretty cool place but quite small.  Frodo makes a pretty good coffee, he had to leave to go on a quest, I think they ran out of milk 😝. Has some outdoor seating next to a fountain and inside is quite cool on a hot summers day.  They have food but I didn’t try any of it, most people come here to have a coffee.  Not the best place to work but there are bench seats you can charge your laptop from.  #BeatTheGrind
review_3_text: Very nice atmosphere - cosy little Hobit house! Nice coffee, nice own. A local gem. They operate more like a pub, open till midnight with live music on Friday and Sat. Even better in the winter evenings as they open the outdoor area with camp fire.
review_4_text: What's not to love? A beautiful little taste of The Shire here in Chiang Mai. Small bar menu (all good), good coffee and a great beer selection. I haven't had a chance to enjoy live music here yet but I greatly look forward to returning with my family.
review_5_text: Went to this place for some early evening cocktails and beers break. They have good selections of beers. The mixers are also not bad. Although the place is quite small and the outdoor seating can be improved in terms of look and comfortability for the customers.

name: SWAN CAFE
review_1_text: Wrong Swan Cafe. If you're likely looking for the one with great view on a mountain, search for the "Swan Cafe&Garden". It's not this one :D
review_2_text: This place is not here
review_3_text: A cafe on a mountain in Mae Taeng District. From the shop, you can see the Phra That Wat Thung Luang. The shop is decorated cutely. I asked the owner if the name was Sawan, and he said Swan. But calling it Sawan wouldn't be wrong because the owner's name is Sawanya. The shop is cute and the coffee is very delicious.
review_4_text:
The matcha latte was good. I ordered dessert: Brownie white chocolate with green tea (so good and not too sweet!), Banoffee, and waffle coconut custard (also delicious). Everyone there was nice. The view is amazing; you must stop by if you're passing around the area.
The atmosphere was great. The brownie white chocolate with green tea was incredibly delicious and not too sweet. You have to try it! The shop's decor was also very beautiful. There was a dog barking to greet you at the entrance to the shop.
review_5_text: It's a coffee drinking experience you can't find anywhere else.

name: PAPA CAFÉ
review_1_text:
My mom and I visited a cafe near our house. We ordered a latte frappe and a Thai tea ice cream, but the owner almost gave us an extra cup of latte frappe ㅠㅠ It was the kindest thing in the world!!! They even gave us an extra glass of water. We made some great memories in Chiang Mai during our one-month stay🇹🇼🇹🇼🇹🇼

Thank you for the cafe host!!
I enjoyed my time with my mom, and it was even more fun :)
review_2_text: Good, this is my second time here.

name: LARK LAI KOREA FOOD
review_1_text: Delicious. Good quality chicken, recommend 👍👍
review_2_text: Warning if you go here: the staff try to get money out of ‘dumb farangs’ (foreigners) by adding expenses to your tab that you did not order. Be sure to check the prices as the dishes are all written in Thai on the receipt. Our 355 bhat meal came out to 600 and they didn’t think we’d notice. Their acting was very bad, and you could sense the conniving beforehand, snide excitement (when they thought we fell for it) and guilt after. Sounds ridiculous and made up but really showed the flip side to the genuine Thai hospitality. Bummer too, I was gonna leave a great review for their food.
review_3_text: Got kimbap delivered from here. Did not like it at all. Very tasteless.
review_4_text: Spaghetti is yummy!very spicy
review_5_text: It seems like a place run by a Hallyu fan(?). It was a space where customers were also packing goods and such. But the food was really delicious! The chicken feet were not spicy and soft, and the tom nyang kung was really tasty and I recommend it! There weren't many customers, but I recommend the taste. When you go, you can hear Korean music, and you can see posters of Korean singers, cup holders, stickers, etc. The customers were mostly women in their teens and twenties! It's worth going at least once if you're looking for food, regardless of the atmosphere. Stir-fried chicken feet was 75 baht, tom nyang kung was 135 baht, and omelet rice was 75 baht.

name: ร้านกาแฟ Maa Hao
review_1_text: Our favourite coffee place in Chiang Mai! Very good coffee. The owner is an absolutely lovely woman that is always happy to see You and it was a pleasure to be her customer. Greetings from Poland!
review_2_text: Delicious coffee! The owner and her mother are wonderful people. The best place in Chiang Mai !
review_3_text: Affordable prices, and everything is incredibly delicious! The dark roast coffee (less sweet) and the green tea (less sweet) are both amazing 🤩 I finally got a chance to stop by. It's near my dorm and I drive past it often. I'll definitely be back more often!

name: JOINT.S
review_1_text: A café with adorable fluffy white dogs.  They’re absolutely the cutest! 🐶 The chicken rice was delicious, and the coffee was excellent. Both the owner and the dogs were super friendly. The café has a lovely outdoor area where you can enjoy your meal in a great atmosphere. I totally fell in love with the three fluffy dogs today. I’ll definitely come back again! ☕🤍
review_2_text: we were eating next door and they came ask us if we want to order some coffee, and because there was no coffee in the restaurant next door it was perfect time for that, friendly people and super cool dogs
review_3_text:
We came here specifically to see the two adorable Samoyeds and they were indeed so fluffy and cute (though a bit loud as they barked quite a bit 😅).

The cafe environment was nice, and the coffee was decent. We had a good time, and the male barista was kind enough to let us stay past 5pm since it was raining.

The only downside was how hard it was to call for an e-hailing ride from this location. It was raining, and the area felt quiet, which made us panic a little. Thankfully, we managed to get back to the Nimman area in the end.
review_4_text:
If you're looking forward to meeting adorable 🐶, your wish will come true.
Run by a passionate and loving couple, this place boasts a unique and captivating style. You can feel the meticulous care and attention in every aspect of their management. Plus, they serve delightful coffee, ensuring a wonderful afternoon for all."
review_5_text: Nice cafe with a very nice garden with large white dogs. They have great drinks and great space, but the staff could be nicer. The dogs are well behaving ones and you can touch them.

name: 2STREETCOFFEECREW
review_1_text: Chill vibes central in Chiang Mai! Sipped on a creamy matcha latte that was pure green goodness—smooth, not too sweet, with that perfect frothy top—while sinking into the cozy nook, lost in the great background music weaving mellow tunes through the air. Ideal spot for unwinding and letting the day melt away.
review_2_text:
After the rain
A cup of hot latte is just what you need.
The coffee shop around the corner is very distinctive, and the staff are warm and sweet.
The coffee beans are amazing. The medium-roast flavor is very rich, and the acidity is just right. It's mellow and has a long aftertaste. I'll definitely visit often.
review_3_text: You can choose the roast level and each cup is carefully made. It’s one of the popular coffee pick up spots in this area. My light roast americano was good.
review_4_text: Best coffee in Chiang Mai! Regular coffee stop with great staff and very good coffee. The cafe has a great vibe, with a friendly team who are always happy to see you. Highly recommend 2StreetCoffeeCrew. Love it here.
review_5_text:
One of my favourite coffee spots in Chiang Mai. Amazing coffee, the best staff, wonderful vibe.

Just a joyous spot to hang out for a coffee solo or meet a friend.

Must visit destination when in Chiang Mai.

name: Lung Nuad Coffee
review_1_text:
Great quality coffee, Friendly prices, and a funny barista. 🤣🤣
You should definitely try, guarantee you will love this Cofee shop. 😊😎
review_2_text: Cool local coffee shop. Variety of coffee beans to choose from. Extensive non-coffee drinks menu as well. Nice chilled out atmosphere. Appreciated the owner letting me prectise my basic Thai 😆
review_3_text: Pretty good coffee and they roast their beans. It is a small space and the music is a bit loud. I got to see how they roast it and it was kinda cool. The prices are good for to go.
review_4_text: lovely cafe with a cute cat and khun Top the barista is very fun and friendly
review_5_text: My neighborhood coffee spot! I am a regular and he is ready with my order. I typically get takeaway but it is a cute spot to sit for a coffee or snack. Both indoor and outdoor seating. Every time I go back he has a small new way to make it even better!

name: จงชงดี ชาใต้ - สาขาเจ็ดยอด
review_1_text: The Southern Thai tea is fragrant, the cocoa is rich and satisfying, everything is delicious and the prices are reasonable. The female staff member is friendly, polite, and provides good recommendations.
review_2_text: The tea is very strong and delicious. There is a lot of parking space. Many cars can park there.

name: มายเฮ้าท์ กาแฟสด
review_1_text: Pretty good Thai iced milk tea. Fragrance is present, although the overall taste leans towards the milky side.

name: CM Cafe By Mook Hom
review_1_text:
So cool to feed the Koi, seven of them 😎
Even a Swing in the Garden 😻
Kind of a View of Doi Suthep and Doi Pui
review_2_text: Quiet, little cafe that serves decent coffee and cakes. The homemade cheesecake is terrific. Worth a visit if you are in this area. Wi-Fi is a little slow though so you need to be more patient. Otherwise, a quiet spot to chill and collect your thoughts. Next to an IVF hospital.
review_3_text: Nice quiet neighborhood cafe with plenty of natural lighting. A bit tight as far as seating but I notice the traffic seems to be flowing through pretty quickly. Milk teas and Americano were both solid.
review_4_text:
Friendly atmosphere.
There is a selection of tea and coffee.
The owner is friendly
review_5_text: Good coffee ^___^

name: CDK
review_1_text:
One of my Favorite Spot near Jed Yod 🤩
Friendly owner, delicious Brown Sugar 🙏
🏞️

name: Goodneighbor Cafe
review_1_text:
The cold drink was placed directly on the table without a coaster or tray, and the water flowed onto the table. I felt that there was a lack of basic serving consideration.
The response during the ordering process was somewhat dry, and there was a lack of guidance on additional requests, so the overall atmosphere was not comfortable.
The flavor and completeness of the food did not meet expectations for the price range. Compared to other stores with similar prices, it was difficult to feel any competitiveness.
review_2_text: Amazing and healthy food. Probably the best breakfast I had in Thailand. Highly recommend the açai protein bowl, so yummy! The coffee is also high quality. I went there 3 times, and always I left with a smile. The staff are really kind and friendly. Great experience :)
review_3_text: Great place for breakfast. There is a big variety of smoothies and bowls. We came here a few times already and the food was great. The presentation is beautiful of both - food and drinks. Most importantly they are pet-friendly!
review_4_text:
Once again, Google family...❤️

Upon traveling Thailand, my lady and I found this gem of a place. Smooth techno music, friendly staff, and the food was great. If youre looking for a place to chill/work or just simply be lazy with great breakfast, you won't regret spending your time here! First time here today and we will be back. See you soon 😊 ❤️
review_5_text:
I’ve visited this place multiple times, but today’s experience crossed a line.🫠🫠

The server wearing a black top and denim shorts clearly treated customers differently based on race. She was friendly, smiling, and attentive toward Western customers, yet noticeably cold and impatient with Chinese customers. The difference in attitude was obvious and difficult to ignore.

Equal treatment is not optional in customer service it is the minimum standard. When race determines how a customer is treated, that is racial discrimination. There is no justification for it.

My coffee also initially appeared underfilled. Although a brief explanation was given, the interaction felt dismissive and unprofessional.

If this difference in treatment was indeed based on race, it reflects not a lack of professionalism alone, but a troubling ignorance of the basic value of equality.

No matter how good the food may be, respect and fairness matter more. Because of this experience, I will not be returning. If racial bias is tolerated here, it is not something I can overlook or stay silent about, and I would warn others accordingly.🙏

name: คณะกาแฟ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Good Cafe
review_2_text: 👍🏻Matcha Coconut and Americano Coconut are so refreshing! You get a whole coconut for 88฿.

name: The Blue Hut Cafe
review_1_text: This beautiful little spot is a hidden gem with the most lusciously green and flowery garden Ive seen here. It serves great coffee in a cozy cafe with inside and outside seating in the garden sun or shade, super green and nice and zen. I definitely recommend!
review_2_text: Great cosy place to come and enjoy a coffee and work from your laptop.  It’s kind of like being in someone’s living room rather than a cafe it’s a very friendly and warm environment with a fantastic barista who is very welcoming.  Place is nicely air conditioned and has a variety of seating available including individual desks and couches. #BeatTheGrind
review_3_text:
Great Ambiente! Good Coffee and Offer. The garden is nice and quiet.
Prices are good and the selfmade cookies are delicious 🤤.
review_4_text: This should be on the must do list for dates in Chiang Mai. Nice cosy hidden gem.
review_5_text: I absolutely loved this place! Delicious coffee, reasonably priced, quiet, and local. They have a beautiful garden with butterfly bushes. I loved sitting out on the porch while it rained. My husband and I came here frequently over the past month. Our favorite coffee shop in Chiang Mai!

name: Pakamon Factory
review_1_text: I’ve been there several times already since last year, half of the cakes are delicious for me, some are so so or too sweet!
review_2_text: Delicious tiramisu, served in a cute cafe with plenty of indoor & outdoor seating. Fair prices, so we will be returning.
review_3_text:
Nice cafe with homemade cakes.
Good coffee with blended drinks.
Very cheap with the quality made.
Can come often to explore the flavors.
Friendly staffs.
Large parking spaces.
review_4_text: A pretty spot with a great garden and beautifully presented treats. Unfortunately, the taste was a bit let down by the ingredients.
review_5_text: Pretty good cakes. Lots of 'em. Pricing is not cheap, if you buy by piece, but reasonable. But you can buy a whole cake with 8-10 pieces for 350 THB. And THAT is a good deal without doubt. Everything I tried was pretty delicious. Locations setting is very nice too, in cute garden with a few vintage cars standing around. All in all an afternoon coffee with cake to enjoy. Will be back.

name: Omnia Cafe & Roastery
review_1_text: The staff was very friendly and explained each coffee bean clearly. I chose one from Chiang Mai, and it was really good. The place is also great for working.
review_2_text: A specialist Coffee joint! The latte is heavenly and the medium roasted long black is aromatic! The premise is small but rustic and delightfully warm. A must try for genuine coffee lovers. It has won numerous awards.
review_3_text: Very good coffee and it was nice that it was served with a glass bottle of water. The flavor of the coffee I tried was pretty distinctive and I enjoyed my cup. The space is small and the tables and chairs are limited.
review_4_text:
People might have heard that this place has a good coffee but why order green tea latte?

The only lesson I ordered the green tea latte here because the green tea here is not the actual green tea. It’s the green tea that made from jasmine! Hahaha you heard it right. It’s also quite a favor as well. I really enjoyed the green tea latte here ❤️
review_5_text: Great coffee and a cool little hipster environment to work from.  There’s a large table with stools you can sit at with a power point next to it.  The bathroom is clean and tidy inside the premise and a hot latte with set you back 65 baht.  The barista was quite polite and had a great command of the English language. #BeatTheGrind

name: Blend it smoothies

review_2_text:

I tried 3 kinds of smoothies and everyone was so good.  My favorite is mango + passion fruit.
The lady owner is always beautiful and friendly:)

review_4_text: Smoothies are always perfect. Ultra Mango is amazing in the morning 🙏
review_5_text: Very cute and delicious smoothie stand with a small sit down area and lots of delicious options on the menu including smoothies made from fresh fruits, bubble teas and coffees. The owner/staff is friendly and it's fun to watch her make the different drinks. Highly recommend

name: Rainy Sunny
review_1_text: They have MANY services! Do not be fooled by the bottles, they offer tote bags, canvases (in many shapes) sand painting, painting clay and bottles! The food was actually amazing and service was quick, waiters are nice and efficient. The atmosphere was amazing, had live music but would recommend coming on a day where it is not blazing hot as it is only outdoor seating. This is definitely a revisit!! The best place ever to chill and enjoy good food
review_2_text:
So calm, laid back nice atmosphere for just relax/ laptop or painting.
Liked the music, have wifi. And coffee is nice too.

Become my secret goto place for basically doing me time.
review_3_text: We loved this as a Sunday activity for a family! We came and painted 3 bottles and had some brunch and drinks. The bottles were just 40 THB each and you can choose which paints etc you want. There’s a small ask that everyone who paints also buys a drink which we think is fair and the prices are all reasonable! Our son who is 4 loved it, and us parents did too. If you’re a family and wonder what it’s like we recently showed it on our YouTube “best places for outdoors as a family Chiang Mai”
review_4_text: An introvert-friendly spot. Spent the entire afternoon here, doing my own art haha. Would recommend — the fried chicken bites were tasty too.
review_5_text: Inexpensive cakes and other pastries. Music a bit too loud. Cute cat welcomed us when we arrived.

name: the bliss kitchen
review_1_text: Great spot to relax with a coffee or grab a sandwich. Cozy atmosphere, friendly service, and the prices are very reasonable. Definitely a nice place to unwind or catch up with a friend.
review_2_text: Cute little cafe, hidden down the end of a quiet street, with a small menu and limited outdoor seating. Great coffee, delicious food and tasty bakery items too, fresh out of the oven! All to a wonderfully chilled soundtrack playing in the background and super sweet owner/staff!! 🥰

Nice little cafe. Reasonably priced but I found my americano to be a little watery.

I wish they had a bathroom, though.
review_4_text:
Five Stars for Charm, Coffee, and a Truly Magical Experience! ✨

I stumbled upon this little gem in Chiang Rai, and I'm so glad I did! From the moment I stepped inside, I was captivated.  The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, the perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort. But what truly sets this coffee shop apart is the owner.  She's absolutely enchanting – warm, welcoming, and radiating a genuine kindness that immediately puts you at ease. Her smile is infectious, and her easygoing nature makes you feel like you've known her for years.

Beyond the captivating owner, the coffee and Thai iced tea are exceptional! The coffee is rich, aromatic, and perfectly brewed.  The Thai iced tea is the best I've had in Thailand – perfectly balanced, creamy, and intensely flavorful.  It's clear that only the highest quality ingredients are used.

This isn't just a coffee shop; it's an experience. It's a place where you can relax, unwind, and soak in the charming atmosphere while enjoying delicious drinks.  The owner's warmth and hospitality add an extra layer of magic, making it a truly unforgettable spot.  If you're in Chiang Rai, you absolutely MUST visit this hidden treasure!  You won't regret it.  I can't wait to go back!  ☕🇹🇭💖

review_5_text:
Chubboy Cafe - Chubboy Cafe is a coffee shop in Chiang Mai with a unique and distinctive style. This time, I ordered drinks through the Foodpanda app and was extremely impressed with the speed of delivery and, most importantly, the generous discounts. It was even better value than I expected. I ordered the Iced Cocoa and Iced Matcha Latte. The flavors were rich, just the right amount of sweet, and not at all cloying. The cocoa had a distinct aroma, while the matcha gave a refreshing, Japanese-inspired feel. I didn't want to put my cup down. The packaging was cute and the attention to detail was excellent. Even with delivery, the quality remained excellent.

If you're in Chiang Mai or looking for a cafe with great drinks, excellent service, and reasonable prices, Chubboy Cafe is a must-try. You won't be disappointed. Especially if you find a discount code on Foodpanda, it will be even more worth it.

Okay so I ordered from Chubboy Cafe on Foodpanda the other day and damn, it was way better than I expected. Got a crazy good discount, like almost half-off kind of deal. I got an iced cocoa and iced matcha—both were bomb. The cocoa was super rich and smooth, not too sweet. And the matcha? Bro, it tasted like a straight-up Tokyo café moment. So good.

Even the packaging was cute, like they actually put effort into it even though it was just delivery. If you’re in Chiang Mai and craving something cold and tasty without breaking the bank, def check out Chubboy. And if you catch a discount on Foodpanda? Say less. Worth it 100%.

name: Moon Cafe
review_1_text:
Moon Cafe is a brand-new coffee shop located at the front of Capital O The Singha Chiang Mai Hotel. You can conveniently enter through the hotel lobby, which makes it super easy for hotel guests—just come downstairs in the morning and enjoy your coffee without having to go far.

The coffee here is really good, and the space is large with plenty of seating, making it perfect whether you’re coming alone for a quiet cup or with a big group of friends. The atmosphere is comfortable and welcoming.

The shop is still new, and soon they’ll also be serving bakery items, which will make it an even better spot to relax. Definitely a great addition for both hotel guests and anyone in the area looking for good coffee in a spacious setting!

Hmong Doi Pui Village

Hmong Doi Pui Village is more than just an ordinary village; it's a cultural learning center that seamlessly blends with the beauty of nature. Located at a considerable altitude, the air here is exceptionally clean, even on the hottest days at sea level.

A hike to the top of the village reveals a beautifully arranged flower garden with a small, artificial waterfall, creating a very relaxing atmosphere.

There's also a Hmong-run coffee shop offering friendly prices, perfect for enjoying a cup of coffee while soaking in the natural beauty of Doi Pui.

Overall, Hmong Doi Pui Village is ideal for those seeking a change from city cafes, wanting to breathe fresh air and learn about local culture.

Review of Coffee or Me

Coffee or Me is a charming café nestled within a hotel, which I happened upon by chance while driving through the area. It’s an ideal spot for those seeking a quiet, nature-filled retreat to work or unwind, offering a refreshing contrast to the bustling cafés in downtown Chiang Mai. With its lush greenery and serene atmosphere, the setting is undeniably inviting.

However, when it comes to the coffee, I found it somewhat underwhelming—perhaps because the café prioritizes ambiance over the quality of its brews. Additionally, the service felt a bit distant, which slightly detracted from the overall experience. A more attentive approach to customer service could enhance both the atmosphere and the coffee itself, making this hidden gem even more enjoyable.

A little bit more expensive than other places but well worth it.   Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
Good coffee, delicious cheesecake, good seats for working on your laptop or studying.
Weekends are crowded but that’s not a surprise.

Aircon is too cold in some seats. The ice cold air is blasting you right in the face. Be careful where you sit

name: Taste of Art
review_1_text:
This is one of my favorite spots in Chiang Mai! The spaghetti is cooked perfectly every time, the bagels are fantastic, and the coffee is top quality. The atmosphere is warm, and the staff are super friendly and incredibly attentive.

What I appreciate the most is how dog-friendly they are. Not only do they welcome dogs, but they always treat my dog like a little princess — it’s truly heartwarming.

If you’re looking for great food, great coffee, and genuinely kind service, this is the place to be! 💛🐶✨

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommended!
review_2_text:
One of my favorite places in Chiang Mai! It was my go-to spot in 2023, and I’m back again in 2025.

The environment is lovely, with a cute little garden. The coffee is great, the staff are friendly, and the prices are reasonable. The food is delicious as well. It can get a bit busy in the late morning, but it’s totally worth it!
review_3_text:
What a gem! So peaceful and quiet. Big difference from the Old City. Delicious coffee. Salmon for the salmon, avocado, scrambled egg & caper bagel was perfect fresh.

Cute coffee mugs. Friendly staff. Greenery. Fresh air. Super intimate coffee spot ✨
review_4_text: Such a lovely place! Everything was so tasty, the atmosphere was amazing, and the staff were super friendly. We had a really great time here! Perfect Coffe ❤️
review_5_text: We remembered this place after three years and came back today. The best coffee in Thailand, really nice staff and very delicious food and many veggie options.

name: WARI ワーリ COFFEE - ช้างเคี่ยน
review_1_text: This place is great and run by the nicest of people. It's great to both take out a well as sit in the shade outdoors to enjoy a drink. Surprisingly great coffee for a small shop. Highly recommended. I'd post more pictures but they would all be of the same drink I get every time.
review_2_text: I saw the good reviews and thought I would try. Maybe it was just a bad day for the staff but I thought they were not friendly. The coffee was average and the the seating uncomfortable.  Sorry for bad review, but need to be honest.
review_3_text: Great early morning cafe @40thb
review_5_text:
The outdoor tables were cool and the coffee was delicious, served by two pretty ladies... but it's outside the city, so there's no traffic...

I just found out today that this is a franchise coffee shop...

name: Nuer Sang - เหนือแสง , Creative studio & Design production
review_1_text: Very creative places and art space
review_2_text: Excellent shared creative space with changing exhibitions, friendly staff and nice coffee too 😀
review_3_text: A coffee shop with a studio where artists can showcase their work.
review_4_text: There is both a cafe and an art gallery.

name: Until
review_1_text: LOVE this local restaurant and cafe. Bomb lattes, delicious fresh salads and beautiful entrees. Always fills us up for a great price. A must try 💛
review_2_text: Love the food here!! It tastes fresh and the prices are great. Def a fan and come back weekly! Also, they take American credit cards so that makes things even better!
review_3_text: The restaurant's recommended dish is very delicious. It's fragrant, tasty, and not too sweet.

name: Coffity at home
review_1_text: Ordered an iced vanilla latte and plain hot americano. Both are fantastic!
review_2_text: Great coffee and such a good price ☕️ Only 45 baht for this delicious Americano!
review_3_text: Very cute place just next to my home.
review_4_text: I stumbled upon this place while walking from Nana Market. Open from 7:30 AM to 3:00 PM, the owner runs it leisurely. Hidden away on the main street, I ordered an orange black coffee, and the combination of coffee and orange was exquisite. The relaxing atmosphere, with its relaxing music and tree-lined surroundings, is truly captivating. I highly recommend it.
review_5_text: A small coffee shop. The coffee beans are medium-roasted and blended. They have their own unique flavors. The price is not expensive. The taste is better than the price. The owner makes the coffee himself (the owner is cute).

name: WhyD.cnx | Coffee Shop
review_1_text: Such a nice coffee shop! The staff are very kind and welcoming. Coffee tastes great and the atmosphere feels warm and relaxing. I felt very comfortable here.
review_2_text:
Everything is perfect!
I went on Sunday and there were not so many people but there were people coming all day.
review_3_text: Very nice open space with a nice garden. The barista here is great and he makes excellent coffee. I was gonna spend some time here, but there were many bugs in the garden as expected and the leaves from the tree kept falling into my cup, so I could not really get relaxed even though it’s such a nice space. I think you wanna wear long pants when you come here so you would be less distracted from the bugs.
review_4_text:
Nice place to hang out for those seeking peace and quiet still within the city boundary. The cafe is small but it has a large yard featuring tall trees and two friendly dogs.

One star less than perfection due to mosquitoes although they do provide spray.
review_5_text: Perfect little cafe. great cofffee, peaceful garden, super friendly staff, and cute dogs

name: บ้านบอล
review_1_text: Nice 👍

name: hohm cafe
review_1_text: Delicious and creative coffee options you won’t find in other places. They’ve even won some serious awards. Friendly and passionate owner. Cozy, quirky and peaceful natural atmosphere. What more could you want?
review_2_text:
Having lived in Chiang Mai for a while now and tried more coffee shops than I care to admit too, this place offers the best dark roast espresso I have found anywhere in Thailand.

The lady is always lovely and makes the same perfect espresso every time.

If your an espresso fan, this is the place for you.

PS.  If they have cake on, get a slice.  Generous portion and absolutely delightful.
review_3_text: Really lovely garden area to sit and relax. Beautiful and peaceful. Food was tasty and the drinks were delicious. A bit on the pricey side, but definitely worth it for the ambiance. Will be back to try some dessert and enjoy the garden again. Be prepared for mosquitos if you go late afternoon/evening!
review_4_text: A fantastic cafe with a nice ambiance. The owner is very friendly and is a brilliant mixologist! He custom curated our cocktails based on our flavor preferences. Coffee is great too. We will definitely be coming back!
review_5_text:
The drinks and food are just perfect in taste.  Very friendly service as well.  2 thumbs up!!

Hohm is one of my always favourite cafe in Chinagmai. “Bad Blood”is my favourite drink in here.

name: Stucco Loft Residency Hotel
review_1_text:
Me wife and I stayed 4 night at this hotel and this was a real pleasure.
The staff is very friendly, helpfull and they make sure the stay is as enjoyable as possible.
The food was great, usually I don't eat at hotel but it make me change my mind.
We were looking for a place calm and relax to work on our project and it was perfect. The location is great because we are far enought of the main street to be in a complet silence but close enought (approx. 10m) to the main road with all the commodities.
It was a incredible experience.
The only complain if we can call it a complain, is that the room can feel dark a moment even with a big sun outside.
Execpt for that, we loved this hotel.
Would recommand no problem.

Nathan.
review_2_text: The room are clean  and stuff are friendly. I can Rent motorcycle without deposit.
review_3_text: Really quiet and nice breakfast and really kind and good service 100% recommended
review_4_text:
The hotel is a great place for relaxing. The rooms are very nice, with much place. There is a pool outside, which is great to take a swim in. The staff is very friendly, they will help you with everything you need. They even have a cute coffee shop by the reception, where they also serve their breakfast.

If you are staying here, I would recommend to have a car available. If you do not want to take the bike into the city center, you have to take a Taxi or something similar. With GrabCar it costs about 100 Baths.
review_5_text: We loved the modern industrial style building which has been built with amazing attention to detail. Indi, our hostess looked after us so well and nothing was too much trouble - including extra chairs in our room. Food was also great and I recommend the iced Thai tea. Set slightly out of the city we felt like we were in the countryside. A Grab taxi to old city was about 100B and to Maya shopping mall about 77B. One of the best places we’ve stayed at in 4 months of Travelling in SE Asia.

name: Baan Suan Fon Muang Coffee
review_1_text:
The first time I rented a Thai dress, it cost 300 baht. It was great. But the second time I went, I was getting married, so I bought a Thai dress for my wedding photos. They charged me 1,500 baht for the couple.
Don't tell me you're the bride. The price will immediately increase, even though it's the same piece. That's extortion.
review_2_text: Relax and enjoy your favorite coffee in a friendly atmosphere, along with the beautiful owner.
review_3_text: Good atmosphere, friendly owner.
review_4_text: Expensive, not tasty, nice location, convenient parking.
review_5_text: I took my child to Thai dance class. It's in a garden setting.

name: Near.Me.Coffee(กาแฟใกล้ฉัน)
Mamo slow bar มาโม
ร้านกาแฟ Over the Moon🌕🌟
Star Coffee
review_1_text: Friendly staffs and excellent coffee.
review_2_text: I always go there to kill time while my bike is being washed. The coffee is cheap and the owner is very kind.
review_3_text: very good

name: Coffee Three Time
review_1_text: It's delicious. The seller is very cute and friendly.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious and there are seats available.
review_3_text: The coffee is really delicious.
review_4_text: It's delicious!

name: Baan coffee
review_1_text: Very friendly staff and good coffee ☕️

name: La Lune Cafe - ลาลูนคาเฟ่ ร้านขนมไทย ของหวาน อาหารและเครื่องดื่ม เชียงใหม่
