review_1_text: good
review_2_text: It was delicious! Highly recommend! 👍🏻

name: ชามิจิ สาขาMBC หน้าค่ายป.พัน7
review_1_text: The bubble tea is delicious. I often order from Foodpanda. This is my first time at the shop. The seller is lovely.

name: อิแม่กาแฟ
review_1_text: At first visit, I didn't expect anything apart from some form of caffeine for my body to continue my day. Turns out that this coffee shop is a hidden gems of this area. Khun Dao, the owner, is serious about the ingredients. Coffee beans, milks, and others are specifically selected from specialist suppliers, not a random picked from next door convenient stores. You can order online via platforms, but if you visit the shop by yourself, you can even request for seasonal special beans! All of these for only quarter of the price of a cup of Starbucks!!! Unfortunately, the downside is that it's only available for takeaway, no table in the shop.
review_2_text: Everything is delicious and the prices are reasonable. Parking is difficult, and they're extremely busy with orders.
review_3_text: It's next to the market so it's hard to find a parking spot, so I always use Grab. They have a wide variety of drinks, including coffee and fruit juice, and they're all delicious and worth the price. They're not super tasty though haha, so it's perfect for when you just want a drink on the cheap.
review_4_text: This is one of the first shops I'll choose for bubble tea. - The problem is slowness. When I saw the shop, I understood that they only do one person. - I moved to ordering after 2 PM instead, not during Prime Time. - For those who are in a rush to eat bubble tea during the noon or afternoon, I recommend ordering elsewhere. - I like the small pearls and the lava pearls the most. The Taiwanese tea is delicious. The coffee is just right. I ordered the Oreo blended 5 times, and only once the taste was weak. (If I have another time, I'll call and let you know.)
review_5_text: The drinks at the shop are very delicious. Whenever I have business to run, I stop by and buy some. Or if I'm busy, I order through the rider app.

name: YODDOI CAFE ญอดดอย
review_1_text: We had a wonderful coffee there on Sunday. We found the place by accident, but it was a very happy accident. It’s tiny but very cute and the coffee is so nice! I had a coconut Americano and it was super refreshing, while my boyfriend had an iced cappuccino and loved it as well. The greatest thing about the place was the people though - we had a great chat with them, they taught us some Thai words, and even gave us local advice. 10/10. ❤️
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious, aromatic, and strong. I highly recommend it to coffee lovers. The owner is friendly and approachable.
review_3_text: Thai tea is rich in flavor, sweet, fragrant, and well-balanced, and it's also affordable.
review_4_text: A small, newly opened shop in an alley. The taste is amazing. 5 stars!

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: A great little store with good service and Amazon’s coffee of course…comfortable seating! Got everything you want to sit inside cafe and enjoy your coffee and right on the main drive!!
review_2_text: Love the honey-lemon drink.
review_3_text: Nice cafe
review_4_text: The employees are very rude, as if they have the most power. They go in to buy food as if they are begging for food. They can't ask anything. Most recently, I was standing waiting at the receiving area and was chased away to sit and make a lot of noise. I felt very disappointed. I'm not sure if it was the head of the employees or not. There was only one person. Please ask the owner to come and check on the employees. Many people have been affected by this, and it's not the first time. I probably won't use this branch again.
review_5_text: Very comfortable and spacious seating area. The only downside is that there's only one power outlet for customers to work from, and that spot is completely occupied by a group of laptop users.

name: ยื่นสั่ง ปรางทิพย์
review_1_text: Thank you for the shrimp fried rice, it was delicious! Above all, you have such a kind heart. May you receive only good things in return. 🥰🥰🥰

name: Hop cafe สาขา ปตท.เชียงใหม่-แม่ริม 1
review_1_text: Employees seem to be forced to work. They really want to sell or just work day to day to get things done.
review_2_text: delicious

name: Khun Tanai de Cafe
review_1_text:
Cozy atrium 'wedge' at the end of the building.   Large windows with indoor and outdoor seating gives a great view of an intersection in this quiet neighborhood.

The iced cappuccino was well made and flavorfull.  Counter help, helpful.
review_2_text: Padthai was purely sweet, even the sweetness is my favourite savory. On top of that, chives was not clean out.
review_3_text: Nice little spot in Chaing Mai, Thailand, offering a mix of Thai and western food, makes a good pit stop, for drinks and food, there are also toilet facilities. Food was nice however my hot latte was served a little cool for my liking, looked amazing though!
review_4_text: Found this sweet place in my neighbourhood, it has two floors with the view on the temple, sounds of birds in the background and now and then a car passing by. Plenty spots to charge your Laptop and phone. Amazing staff, very helpful, giving advice and opinion and speaks good english :)
review_5_text: a small local coffee place worth checking out

name: poom poom coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee.
review_2_text: I only drank coffee, so I don't know the taste of anything else.

name: ร้านชาใจ๋ดี Cha Jai Dee Bubble tea ชานมไข่มุก&กาแฟสด
Thar Jao Rimping Restaurant/Coffee Shop/Bar
review_1_text: Freindly price, authentic food, welcoming staff, relaxing environment in which you can even take a nap. Yet, there is some mosquito issue. On the day I visit, I fell in love with the bands playing the most classical and soulful songs.
review_2_text: Lovely place to come for a coffee or a meal. Thai food only but really good, and friendly staff. Right by the river in a beautiful and calm setting
review_3_text: Enchanting place lovely fresh food great vibe with soft live music. Provided mossy spray but to be honest didn't have a problem with gentle breeze.
review_4_text: This is quite a quiet place for family time with a good point of view beside Ping river
review_5_text: Restaurant has its own good location by the Ping river, good foods with good live music start from 19:00 or 19:30 hrs onward

name: Six Day Coffee
review_1_text: must visit! friendly owner and cute fur friends. i adored this rustic and down to earth cafe look, and the only cafe i can find with this look in chiang mai. perfect for a read. coffee was good too
review_2_text:
Lovely Place and Calm :)
Coffee is nice. Dog and cat is so cute !
review_3_text:
very good coffee!
cats is soooo cute!
review_4_text: Excellent coffee and relaxed atmosphere. The place has a very sweet dog and friendly and cuddly cats 🐱❤️
review_5_text:
The coffee is good, the chocolate is delicious, and the staff are friendly.
The prices are very reasonable.

name: YOURMINE Coffee Roaster - Ping River
review_1_text:
A new coffee shop has opened under the underpass by the Ping River. It's the third branch of YourMine.
Prices start at 50 baht, with options for light, medium, and dark roasts. The coffee tastes great, and they roast their own beans. They also have imported beans to choose from. There are many fancy and delicious menu items.
For example, coconut foam latte, Black Forest, and matcha strawberry. If you're in the area, stop by often!
review_2_text: The cream puffs are delicious, the coffee is good, and the service is excellent.

name: กาแฟคุณนาย
i-House Cafe'
review_1_text: I am very regular in this coffee. Cold and hot coffees, I usually take cold espresso, bring my own cup - like the taste. Good price, nice taste, friendly owner.
review_2_text: good and cheap. tasty desserts too. nice owner.
review_3_text: Friendly little coffee place...
review_4_text: Awesome
review_5_text: A small, beautiful cafe with several kinds of cakes.

name: FIKA SKY CAFE
review_1_text:
Lovely cafe with an array of amazing Thai dishes.
We had the pad Thai, morning glory and crispy pork with basil over rice
Everything was cooked to perfection
Worth a visit if you’re in the area
review_2_text:
Great first visit! A friend recommended the crispy pork here and we were not disappointed! Highly recommend the "Turbo" menu, serving a large portion of classic crispy pork with the typical sauce, as well as a nice portion of chilli and basil crispy pork (kaprow), and a fried egg too!

Love that there is parking, the greenery is refreshing, the atmosphere is relaxed and tranquil, there is indoor and outdoor seating, definitely a good escape from the busy city.
review_3_text: Such a beautiful place! The food was great service was fast. Also the Cappuccino was perfect 💜 will definitely come back.
review_4_text: Delicious. Fairly priced. Friendly staff. Clean.
review_5_text: As with many other places in Chiang Mai, this is a very humble and unassuming cafe tucked into a village area, serving very simple but unique, awesome food. Highly recommend visiting the place for enjoying honest, tasty and unique food!

name: Single Origin Store
review_1_text: Food is better looking than tasting - recommend Einsupanner if you like sweet. Their coffee choices are diverse with in house coffee bean mix. The photos are pretty too
review_2_text:
Very nice cafe. Great coffee and food. If you're into coffee specialty, it's highly recommended to visit and enjoying the cozy vibes.
A plus point for dog allowed(in a stroller) indoor.
Definitely come back to try more coffee!
review_3_text: Enjoying a cup of smith single origin coffee along with an urban-pop /R&B music. Nice location with plenty of parking spaces, which is a rare find in Chiang Mai. Must try when you have a chance.
review_4_text: It can be seen that the coffee shop's equipment is very professional. The space is also large and has a sense of design. The coffee I chose was lightly roasted, and the taste was good and quite balanced.
review_5_text: I always order their coffee bean to make at home for many years, The coffee here is the most reliable and best quality as always.

name: Wake Up Coffee @ B2 Resort
review_1_text: Places is really nice. Staff is super great. Wi-Fi is very fast. I’ve seen some weird reviews on other locations under this name not sure who is having a bad experience there but perfect experience.
review_2_text:
In the fast-paced world of business, finding a space that fosters both productivity and inspiration can be a challenge. Wake Up Coffee, nestled amidst the urban landscape, emerges as a vibrant solution, offering a professional haven fueled by exquisite coffee and a meticulously curated ambiance.

Beyond the mid-range price point, which caters to both discerning palates and budget-conscious individuals, Wake Up Coffee distinguishes itself through its commitment to quality. Meticulously sourced beans, roasted to perfection, sing in every cup, whether you opt for a bold espresso or a creamy cappuccino. This dedication to artisanal brewing ensures a consistently satisfying coffee experience, never compromising on flavor or aroma.

The spacious interior, bathed in natural light, provides ample room for focused work or collaborative brainstorming. Minimalist elegance blends with warm wooden accents, creating a serene yet invigorating atmosphere. Pops of color inject a touch of playful energy, while the overall design prioritizes functionality, with ample table space and conveniently placed power outlets. This thoughtfully crafted environment fosters a sense of belonging, making it ideal for meetings, solo work sessions, or simply enjoying a break in a comfortable and aesthetically pleasing setting.

What truly sets Wake Up Coffee apart is its 24-hour operation. It becomes a beacon for the nocturnal workforce, a sanctuary for entrepreneurs and remote professionals burning the midnight oil. The seamless Wi-Fi and strategically placed power outlets transform the space into a vibrant co-working hub, where the gentle hum of conversation and the occasional clinking of cups provide a comforting backdrop for focused work. This 24/7 accessibility makes Wake Up Coffee a haven for those who thrive under the cloak of night, offering a space where deadlines and creative pursuits can flourish regardless of the hour.

Whether you're a seasoned professional seeking a stimulating environment to kick-start your day or a freelancer chasing the perfect work haven, Wake Up Coffee delivers on all fronts. It's a place where exquisite coffee meets inspiring ambiance, where productivity flourishes alongside community, and where every cup is an invitation to awaken your full potential. It's not just about the caffeine; it's about creating a space for professional growth, fostering collaboration, and offering a serene oasis to recharge and thrive, 24 hours a day.
review_3_text: cafe very quiet place belong to the hotel B2 no food no cake only pizza box warmup with mocrowave coffee is fine, stuff talk very sweet but no service :) 3/5
review_4_text: The first time in my 22 years in Thailand were they do not accept cash
review_5_text: It's a coffee shop + check-in of B2 Hotel. The staff are a bit busy, running to many locations, but the service is good. The coffee tastes good. The price is not too much. Come sit and relax comfortably. Parking is convenient.

name: Hello Koko
review_1_text: The place is clean, the atmosphere is nice, and it feels warm and inviting, like eating at home.
review_2_text: You have to try it yourself! ^_^

name: Bake Me Home
review_1_text: The location of this cafe is perfect. Amidst the green and abundant vegetation, lies a cute coffee shop and bakery. I have personally found baked items that I rarely see anywhere else, and the quality is great too. This place is not at all expensive for the quantity and quality served. It is a little bit out of town, but definitely the place to be when you want to be in the quiet and have a peaceful time. Place has WiFi, friendly and helpful staff and is clean. Definitely recommend.
review_2_text: We went to the waterfall stop by the cafe, it’s next to the entrance of waterfall. We ordered the latte, but you can check the photo that it’s really common. My wife felt a little itchy because a lot of mosquitos there. So it was not a good experience. But we hear that there are some delicious bread there, maybe we will try it on the next time.
review_3_text: A humble cafe in a lush green setting. We stopped by for a quick drink and snack after a hike. The owner was lovely and suggested a few items to us. The garlic and cream cheese bun was delicious 😋 Such a lovely place, worth a visit.
review_4_text: Cute little bakery, stopped there on our way from the waterfalls (btw. almost no water there in Feb/March), if you like sour, you will love their iced lemon tea. The savoury pastry on the photo was also delicious!!
review_5_text:
This little homemade bakery is very delicious with imported ingredients such as flour, milk and butter from France, Japan and Korea. You can taste the different with other bakery shop in Chiang Mai city. It is not the best bakery shop in Chiang Mai, but it's really good for me.

I suggest you to order the Garlic cream cheese, Lady C bun, and various kind of croissant. The price is also good 55 baht (1.7$) for one plain croissant.

If you want to take way these bread home, the young owner will explain how you reheat it, which give the same deliciousness at the café. Warm and cozy place with beautiful nature near Doi Kham. I'm honestly recommend.

name: Sweety berry
review_1_text: I've never seen it before.
review_2_text: What is this place? There is no information.

name: Hug Him Doi Thai Coffee
review_1_text:
After hiking approximately 1 hour (we are Dutch, 29 and 24 and fit) we came here for a small lunch/snack. Visiting in April, so not in high season. Because of that they had limited options, but nice easy fried food. Fine drinks. Map of the trail next to the bar.
Toilets are close to Anagami Temple next door
review_2_text: Cute little coffee shop. Nice chilled atmosphere, and they do a pretty decent Thai tea.
review_3_text:
Best place for a coffee halfway, before begin journey up to the peak of Suthep mountain.
Good Coffee
review_4_text: Nice little cafe, they close earlier if not many customers, but untill 17:00 I think is common. Be careful when driving in and out of the main road, sharp turns with fast cars. This is also the location of the fire station for the national park, and fire extinguisher equipment is easily accessible nearby.
review_5_text: Really well set up little cafe, good coffee and sweet ladies in charge with a nearby quaint dust temple.  Lovely little seating areas and heard the birds and the frogs in the ponds.  A great place to stop after Doi Suthep or just before Wat Pha Lat

name: Srinehru Schoo
review_1_text:
The coffee shop located inside of Srineru school.
When I visit here, this shop wasn’t opened that I couldn’t try anything but the scenery from viewpoint was really great.
review_2_text:
The atmosphere was great. When I went up on January 22nd, the Thai cherry blossoms had already faded, but the weather was still cool and comfortable.
The coffee shop is located behind the school; it's the school's coffee shop. You can park your car and walk across the school's lawn to the shop. There are seats as shown in the picture.
The coffee is freshly brewed and fragrant. There are cute little kids acting as baristas, with teachers helping (but the teachers seem to be the main brewers 😁). The shop roasts its own coffee beans, and the prices are reasonable. I ordered two iced espressos, 60 baht each.
For those who want to visit the shop on weekdays, you can bring snacks or gifts to give to the children. But if you're coming in a group, contact the school beforehand so the children can wear Hmong costumes for photos. The road here is a bit narrow for private cars, making it difficult to pass each other, but it's definitely worth the trip.
review_3_text:
Visited on January 14, 2026 🇰🇷
This is a school that students actually attend.
By mid-January, all the flowers had already fallen...🥲
If you go inside the school, you'll find a handmade souvenir shop and a student-run cafe. The souvenir prices are reasonable, so I bought several. The cafe also sells coffee beans grown on-site, so if you like the coffee, you might want to buy some. There are seats in front of the cafe with great views.
Kids get off school around 4 PM. You can see the adorable sight of them lining up to get a drink each.
You can use the restrooms, and if you bring a scooter, you can park there.
review_4_text: The shop is located behind the school. The view is good, the air is fresh. Come on Saturday, the little boy makes delicious coffee. It tastes good.
review_5_text: It's a coffee shop with city views of Chiang Mai, located within a hotel. Looking back, you can see Khun Chang Kian housing estate.

name: Chong Wa Coffee Shop
review_1_text:
I came across this charming little shop by chance, a cozy café with a general store vibe. Though small, it offers an impressive variety of items. The coffee is freshly ground from beans grown in the nearby mountains, with a rich aroma and a pleasantly bold bitterness. Sitting in the backyard under the shade of a tree, enjoying the gentle breeze and soothing music, with a well-mannered dog keeping me company, felt incredibly relaxing.

The real surprise was the fried noodles, which were unexpectedly delicious. The noodles were perfectly cooked and not greasy at all. The friendly owner’s warm hospitality made up for the missed cherry blossoms, leaving a lasting impression of comfort and contentment.
review_2_text: Nice place to have a coffee. First time in Thailand I had a coffee like at home, strong. I loved it. The owner speaks very good English and is very kind. We came to the village to see the cherry blossom, we understand we need to come around February. We didn't regret the long ride, we found this nice place.
review_3_text: Decent cafe for a coffee or quick bite when visiting Doi Pui and surrounds.  Many hikers use the cafe for lunch, and the place is pretty small (three tables on a deck in back and a couple of tables out front), so it can get overwhelmed on weekends.  The Phad Krapow Moo is pretty good, but the owner has only one wok, so service can be a little slow if it’s busy.  The attached store has a decent variety of drinks and snacks.
review_4_text: Nice coffee shop with a good view and nice outdoor seating.
review_5_text: My favourite place in Chiang Mai. I hike here almost every week. The coffee & food is good and Chong Wa and his  wife are so friendly and engaging. It's a wonderful place & experience

name: BA RUNG บาหรั่ง
review_1_text: We stopped here for lunch and coffee after hiking the Khun Chang Khean trail. The food was delicious and the staff were friendly and made us feel very welcome. They also offer homestay accommodation. Many people don’t realize this and think you have to stay overnight to come in, but you can simply walk in for food and drinks. It’s also super affordable.
review_2_text: If you explore the end of Doi Pui area, you have to visit this cafe to relax and enjoy the nature. The foods are delicious. This cafe is simple but I'm gratefull I can eat at here ♥️
review_3_text: What a great place...peaceful, in a such lovely garden. Green green and green. Had a super good lunch there it was perfectly cooked. Run by a charming family. Highy recommended. Cherry blossom season in December in the whole area 😍
review_4_text:
Such a good place to make a stop!

Hidden gems in this village. Blossom cottages with balcony. A beautiful Homestay with Hot shower available. The best ever for 9c temperature!

Good coffee, good food, drinks with reasonable price and friendly service by locals.
review_5_text: Owner is super friendly and helpful. Breakfast is included. We got the 1000B wooden hut room. Room is decently good. We request for an extra mattress to sleep separately from my good friend. They are happy to provide. There is a nice campfire setting. The surroundings is beautifully decorated with flowers. Will come back again.

name: Seng Coffee & Beverage
review_1_text: A sweet little cafe in a peaceful Hmong village which sells locally grown tea and coffee, fruit wine and honey! They have a nice little rooftop looking out onto the forest, where you can sit and watch village life whilst enjoying a drink. Recommend to stop by here if you’re nearby!
review_2_text:
Just had the coffee here as I was told the coffee bean is self-cultivated behind this cafe.

Had a iced latte. Super fragrant coffee, strong yet not too overwhelming for me. I dont think I'll be able to take the americano.
A very good coffee indeed.

Very friendly people.

Can chill downstairs or upstairs where there is a good view of the mountains and if you are lucky, a full blossom of sakura trees.
review_3_text: Definitely a must visit place in Chang Mai. There they make their own coffee, which you can also buy. In addition, there is simply a beautiful view. A must for coffee lovers and people who want to see a coffee farm.
review_4_text: The coffee is self grown by family  and grinded by hand. Worth a visit when you make the passage up. We did it by scooter. So don't hesitate. You can do it. Nice scenic view on top.
review_5_text: Amazing coffee in a cute little village.

name: Formula Hmong Coffee
review_1_text:
Definitely worth it, pad kra pao was delicious! Ordered it twice and they made it quickly. Cappuccino was good too if not a bit small.

But the atmosphere, calmness and good food makes this 5 stars for me
review_2_text: We came to see the cherry blossom only to find out that the season was over. But, we found this rustic cafe where we enjoyed iced latte and hot cappuccino with great views. The road to this cafe odd dangerous and one must drive carefully. It’s in a small untouched village where people are simple and away from the city.
review_3_text: Nice view, good atmosphere, better for lovers, adventurers and backpackers, good place for hikers to take a rest, fews parking lot, good quality Arabica coffee beans with cheap price, fews Thai food menu, good luck for you all to get to this place ^^
review_4_text: Amazing place to stop by after hiking up.
review_5_text: Really nice place and coffee price is not expensive. Best place to go and enjoy.

name: Hug Hmong coffee
review_1_text: Very cute small coffee shop with good fresh coffee
review_2_text: Przepyszna palona kawa Americano z lodem, z dodatkiem miodu własnej produkcji 😍.
review_3_text: I have to say, this village has so many coffee shops...because it's a major production center for roasted and ground Arabica coffee beans. Since you've made the effort to come all the way here, it would be a shame not to buy some to take home. They have a variety of coffee beans to choose from: light, medium, and dark roasts, and they also have ground beans (the packaging looks great as a souvenir). There's only one size: 250 grams for 250 baht. After getting your coffee, don't forget to explore the area before you leave. Along the way, there are souvenir shops, and you can admire the northern Thai cherry blossoms up close (the trees aren't tall, and the blossoms are abundant...absolutely stunning!). The Khun Chang Kian village sign is at the end of the road, another interesting viewpoint.
review_4_text: 06/12/20 The Himalayan cherry blossoms haven't bloomed yet. Let's try some fragrant coffee to make up for the inconvenience.

name: From Farm to Sip
review_1_text:
Awesome little shack with very professional barista who went above and beyond to prepare really skillful V60 pour over coffee.
Go visit!
review_2_text: Learned about coffee today and taste the fruit, learned about robusta arabica and light roast coffee,
review_3_text: What a lovely spot. Sip on a cup of coffee, that comes straight from the land, overlooking the village & surrounding mountains.
review_4_text: Very enjoyable experience sipping coffee overlooking the highlands
review_5_text:
Farm to drip☕️
Excellent coffee high in the mountain👍🏻
Great to have this energy intake for trail running⛰

name: Hwoa Dhe' Craft - ฮ๋าวเด้ คราฟ
review_1_text: We were very impressed by this village. It has a simple, rustic, and peaceful atmosphere that makes you feel relaxed right away. Unfortunately, when we visited, the cherry blossoms had already faded, which was a bit disappointing. However, we found a lovely small café with handcrafted coffee and a very calm, quiet vibe. It was the perfect place to slow down and enjoy the moment. Highly recommended for anyone who loves nature and tranquility.
review_2_text: A great coffee shop that uses high-quality coffee brewed by the coffee farmers who own the plantation themselves. The beans come directly from local growing areas. There is a wide variety of menu options to choose from. The drip coffee and hot latte are both delicious and well-crafted. They also sell coffee beans, which are perfect to buy as souvenirs or gifts.
review_3_text: Great coffee made by the Thailand Coffee Brewer League 2024 winner Yod!!!😋
review_4_text: The coffee here is incredibly delicious and complex. The coffee is as I understand from the mountain itself, special processing techniques made by the owners surly elevate the coffee to the highest quality. The cafe itself is perfectly beautiful and rustic. Overall this is my favourite coffee run of all in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: very nice, beautiful road to come here

name: Khun Chang Kian Coffee Farmer
review_1_text: Coffee, coffee, coffee everywhere you look. Nice coffee farm with a nice little coffee shop. Only shame is that the lady who runs the place do not speak english. We would love to hear more about processing, during the tasting of their excellent coffee.
review_2_text:
After exhausting hiking, we visit this place and drink a very good coffees here.
Both the ice late and the drip coffee were very delicious, the owner is definitely a master in his work.
To enter the shop you need to walk through the woody stairs - looks pretty impressive!
The view is also really nice. If you are lucky you can observe how the owner is preparing the coffee beans in the backyard :)
Definitely recommended!
review_3_text: Happy lovely coffee mountain people 👏

name: View Suai Coffee
review_1_text: Lovely little place, seems popular and after a meal (fried rice with chicken) and after a  delicious cappuccino i understand why atleast 15 new costumers walked in during my sitting! Stunning views, good food and great coffe, what else can you ask for?
review_2_text: I went to 2 coffee spots here after hiking up from chiang mai city. I enjoyed this one a lot mainly because the service here was much friendlier. Also it has a much better view. It seems like this shop gets more traffic from people on tour groups and excursions and the prices were slightly higher but it was worth it for the welcoming atmosphere. Also the latte I had was made perfectly with just the right sugar level I requested and the egg fried rice was good.
review_3_text: Stumbled upon this place whilst driving a scooter. Loved the egg fried rice and the vegetable stir fry with rice! Also had the BEST Thai tea here that I have had so far!!! Can’t stop thinking about it. I would give it 5/5, but the chickens/roosters that are tied to a pole is just not ok…
review_4_text: Great affordable food. Amazing views! Staff is friendly. Coffee is roasted in the town- 200 baht for 200g coffee bags. Amazing coffee! Great lemon tea. Had Tom Yum soup (asked for less spicy). Delicious!
review_5_text:
Very good cafe with fantastic overlooking view.
Their foods and coffees are great indeed.
Especially, I can say their Khao pot which is fried rice was most tasty all over the Chiang mai.

name: Baan Suan Café Khun Chang Khian
review_1_text: Great new wonderful Hmong Homestay in the village. The owner is an awesome and nice guy.  We had tour of the new rooms and I can’t wait to come back and stay here!  Loved the multiple balconies and food.
review_2_text: The food was amazing after a long hike up the mountain. Staff very friendly and the place is nice and clean
review_3_text: A Quiet and beautiful place. Coffe made with local coffee beans. Bread feeled homemade. Also, very cheap.
review_4_text: Incredibly beautiful spot. Owned by such a sweet couple. We rode scooters through the town and it is stunning. We got stuck in the rain and talked with the owners for a while. It was a lovely experience.
review_5_text:
Great coffee made to order.
Really tasty pad kra pao made from scratch
A quiet refuge on the mountain

name: Khun Chang Khian Coffee Farm
review_1_text:
A beautiful and interesting place but not sure it worth the trip , if you haven’t seen a natural, rural coffee farm … small farm no frills is worth it …
Lack some context & explanation, as far as I understood is part of a pilot project from a local university.
Some panels or basic info will make this a great experience.
Work in progress it remains to see the future
Good luck
review_2_text: Gorgeous place in the mountains. Great coffee too.
review_3_text:
We came across this fantastic rustic cafe driving along the "forest" road. They are a university coffee growing research centre selling coffee - beans and some teas - to passers by and it is such a wonderful place plus the coffee is excellent. It's well worth a trip out to have a cup, or
two, of coffee.
review_4_text:
At Khun Chang Kian Coffee Farm Cafe, your coffee experience couldn't get any closer to its roots—literally! Enjoy exceptional espressos while you take in breathtaking views and the very coffee plants that make your drink. It's a serene and unique experience for any coffee lover.

An excellent way to enjoy the natural ambiance of Khun Chang Kian! 🌱☕
review_5_text: Slow cafe with cafe garden view is here. You can walk around to see beautiful flowers and coffee trees. The natural atmosphere is so good here. The cafe is owned by Thai Mhong.

name: กาแฟเกษตร มช.
review_1_text: Great view and atmosphere, just above the coffee farm. The coffee was tasty.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee.
review_3_text:
A cafe and farm deep in the mountains
Here, I enjoyed the small white coffee flower tea and coffee that I've been loving ever since! ️
Also available are accommodations for university research students.
review_4_text: mellow

name: ร้าน สถานีวิจัยกาแฟ
1678 Cafe
review_1_text: A nice cafe with peaceful atmosphere, the coffee is great, the paintings are lovely! We go Ruamchok area pretty often and just knew this place, it’s a bit hard to find, but worth trying!
review_2_text: The coffee here is amazing, the barista is very good. The food is great too, very good service. Definitely try this place. Will be coming back.
review_3_text:
A wonderful atmosphere! ✨

The greenery is tastefully designed and planted.

The interior is bright and spacious, and the seats are well-spaced, ensuring privacy for each table. It's fantastic!

I love every painting the owner has chosen. 💚

The staff are friendly and polite, and the drinks are above average. ✨

The courtyard is deep and lush, and it would be very comfortable to sit here on a relatively cool afternoon between November and February.

The restrooms are clean and stylish.

1678 Cafe is a great place to read, unwind, or do some online work.

Highly recommended~❤️‍🩹
review_4_text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere. The food is delicious and every dish looks delicious. The taste is not disappointing. 👍👍 The parking is spacious and convenient. The bathroom is also very beautiful.
review_5_text:
Friendly staff, a luxurious atmosphere, hotel-like interior, and delicious coffee are rare in cafes like this. I highly recommend visiting.
